11206323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206323.value: 設計具有優越拉伸塑形的多組元金屬玻璃

11206323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206323.value: Metallic glasses (MGs) are well known for their superb strength, excellent elastic strain limit, superior thermal-plastic formability and outstanding corrosion resistance. Therefore, they have been considered as an excellent candidate material for structural applications, particularly for micro- and nano-devices. However, the Archilles’ heel of MGs is their lack of tensile ductility at room temperature, which limits their widespread applications even at the small size scale. Over the past years, extensive research efforts have been dedicated to overcoming the tensile brittleness in MGs; nevertheless, as of today, the achieved room-temperature tensile ductility is still limited, with a maximum of 1.6% at a yield strength of 1.6 GPa. In this project, we would like to propose the design of multi-principal element MGs or high entropy MGs (HEMGs) that can overcome the tensile brittleness in conventional MGs. Our preliminary results already showed that the HEMG with the carefully selected composition can attain a tensile ductility of 3% at a yield strength of 2 GPa, outperforming the so-called ductile MGs reported in the literature. Compared to conventional MGs, such as Zr-based MGs that exhibit a well-defined atomic cluster (i.e., icosahedral cluster) as their prototypical short-range order (SRO), the atomic structure of the HEMGs we designed contains a variety of atomic clusters as their SROs, which is seemingly in line with their compositional complexity (i.e., without any base element). Very interestingly, while this unique amorphous structure still yields via the formation of shear bands, it quickly undergoes shear induced ordering as the shear band propagates into the amorphous structure, leading to the self-locking of individual micro-sized shear bands and hence shear band proliferation at the macroscopical scale. As a result, the HEMG exhibits unusual plasticity even under tension. As inspired by this interesting finding, we would like to address the following critical issues if the project could be funded: (1) what is the nature of SROs or even medium range orders (MROs) in our HEMG? (2) what causes shear induced ordering in our HEMG, as opposed to shear induced disordering in conventional MGs? (3) Is there a systematic way that help us identify those MGs which could have a similar deformation mechanism as the HEMG we discovered? In the long run, we envision that our research may stimulate further interest in the design of ductile glasses and spur innovations in the manufacturing of high-quality glasses, which could be valuable to the reindustrialization of Hong Kong. 金屬玻璃以其高強度、高彈性應變極限、優越熱塑性成形能力和耐腐蝕性而聞名。它們是結構應用的理想材料，特別適用於微型和納米設備。然而，金屬玻璃在室溫下缺乏拉伸延性，限制了其應用。過去幾年，大量研究致力於克服金屬玻璃的拉伸脆性。然而，迄今為止，在室溫下實現的拉伸延性仍有限。我們計劃提出多主元素金屬玻璃或高熵金屬玻璃的設計方案，以克服其脆性。初步結果顯示，通過精心選擇成分，金屬玻璃在屈服強度為2 GPa時可達到3%左右的拉伸延性，優於文獻報導的可延展金屬玻璃。與傳統金屬玻璃相比，高熵金屬玻璃的原子結構具有短程有序，符合其複雜組成。有趣的是，金屬玻璃在受拉過程中表現出異常的可塑性，這得益於剪切帶的有序化。我們希望解決金屬玻璃中短程和中程有序性質的問題，研究高熵金屬玻璃的剪切誘導有序化機制，並找到與之相似的玻璃變形機制。這項研究可能激發對可延展玻璃設計和高質量玻璃製造的興趣，對香港的再工業化具有價值。

11206623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206623.value: 基于双尺度时空学习的多尺度异常检测

11206623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11206623.value: Dr Wang, Bingchuan Prof Ye, Terry Tao

11206623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206623.value: 本项目旨在边缘传感器网络下研究基于双尺度迭代学习的最优DPS建模方法和电池系统多尺度异常诊断。首先，将无源RFID标签设计为具有温度传感的 “边缘传感器”，由此形成一个基于低成本“边缘传感器”的网络。在传感网络的环境下，研究双尺度迭代学习以获得最佳时空分离，包括慢尺度空间适应和快尺度时间学习，并在此基础上开发出用于DPS的在线性能预测的时空模型。最后研究基于滑动窗口的多尺度信息的统计评估方法，包括用于早期检测的子空间的时间相异性和用于全局尺度评估的时空熵，不同尺度的评估的集成可以更有效地进行异常检测和定位。

11206723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11206723.value: 基于多维碳纳米管轻量化材料设计的多尺度力学研究

11206723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11206723.value: The proposed project aims to develop a theoretical and numerical framework for understanding and characterizing the mechanical characteristic of a lightweight material constructed from hierarchical super carbon nanotubes (HSCNTs) based on the combination of atomic-based cellular automata algorithm (ACAA) and continuum mechanics. In the hierarchical material, the primary structure is the single walled carbon nanotubes (SWCNTs). The secondary structure is the super carbon nanotubes (SCNTs) fabricated from the primary structure (i.e. SWCNTs). The tertiary structure is the lowest-level HSCNTs fabricated from the secondary structure (i.e. SCNTs). Similarly, a higher-level structure is fabricated from lower-level structures and, thus, the structure formed in this way is a hierarchical structure. Carbon nanotubes (CNTs), SCNTs and HSCNTs are formed by rolling a graphene sheet, a sheet fabricated by CNTs and a sheet fabricated by SCNTs, respectively, at specific angles (chiral). The combination of the rolling angles (chiralities) decides the properties of the structures. A structure generated hierarchically from SCNTs or higher-level structures is known as hierarchical super carbon nanotubes (HSCNTs). As SWCNTs, SCNTs and HSCNTs are hollow shell structures, the structure fabricated by them is a lightweight material. Through the synthesis of HSCNTs with manipulated chirality and hierarchy, a macro/nano-sized material with unique properties can be formed because the properties are dependent on the chirality at various levels of structures from the lowest-level structures (SWCNTs) to higher-level structures (SCNTs and HSCNTs). A comprehensive understanding of the macro/nano-sized materials made from HSCNTs can be achieved by developing an appropriate multi-scale theoretical framework. Thus, this project aims to develop a multi-scale mechanics model in which both primary CNTs and secondary SCNTs are treated as a discrete system at the atomic scale because they are in nanoscale, but HSCNTs will be treated as macroscopic materials because the size of the structure is in macro scale. Material properties of SCNTs with different chirality will be obtained using a modified ACAA algorithm based on the Tersoff-Brenner many-body potential. At the micron scale of the tertiary or higher-level structure (i.e. HSCNTs), the constitutive relationship will be developed as a function of the elastic constants at different chirality of the primary and the secondary structures using molecular structure mechanics. Based on the developed constitutive law, a multi-scale theoretical framework will be established for the analysis and design of HSCNT-constructed materials (HSCMs) with specific high performance. This is the key towards achieving practical application of this new class of material. 该项目拟基于原子尺度上的元胞自动机算法(ACAA)和连续介质力学的结合，建立一个理论和数值模型用以研究多维超级碳纳米管(HSCNTs)构建的轻质材料的力学特性。在拟研究的多维材料中，一级结构是单壁碳纳米管(SWCNTs)。二级结构是由一级结构(即SWCNTs)制备的超级碳纳米管(SCNTs)。三级结构是由二级结构(即SCNTs)制备的最低级超级碳纳米管。同样，一个高层级结构是由低层级结构构成的，因此，以这种方式形成的结构是多维结构。碳纳米管和低层级结构先装配成石墨烯，然后以特定角度(手性)卷曲石墨烯形成超级碳纳米管。转角(手性)的组合决定了超级碳纳米管网络结构的性质。由碳纳米管和各层级超级碳纳米管生成的结构被称为多维超级碳纳米管(HSCNTs)。由于碳纳米管和各层级超级碳纳米管都是空心壳结构，因此它们制成的结构是一种轻质材料。通过手性和层级控制的多维超级碳纳米管的组合，可以形成具有独特性质的宏观/纳米材料，因为其性质取决于从最低级结构(SWCNTs)到更高级别结构(SCNTs和HSCNTs)的不同级别结构的手性。通过开发适当的多尺度理论框架，可以全面了解由多维超级碳纳米管制成的宏观/纳米材料。因此，本项目旨在建立一个多尺度力学模型，其中碳纳米管和低层级超级碳纳米管在原子尺度上被视为一个离散系统，因为它们是纳米尺度的，但高层级超级碳纳米管将被视为宏观材料，因为结构的尺寸是宏观尺度的。本项目拟采用基于Tersoff-Brenner多体势的改进ACAA算法，对具有不同手性的超级碳纳米管的材料性质进行研究。在三级或更高一级结构(即多维超级碳纳米管)的微米尺度上，利用分子结构力学，将本构关系发展为一级和二级结构在不同手性下的弹性常数的函数。基于已发展的本构关系，建立多维超级碳纳米管结构的多尺度理论框架用于材料分析与设计，这是实现这种新型材料实际应用的关键。

11207323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207323.value: 多種不確定性和通信約束下多智能體系統的分佈式最優自主部署控制

11207323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207323.value: Over the past two decades, cooperative control of multiple dynamic systems, also called multi-agent systems, has drawn increasing interest in the control and robotics communities. This is motivated by many complicated tasks in a wide range of real-world applications, including environmental monitoring, search and rescue, and precision agriculture, which cannot be easily accomplished by a single system. Those complicated tasks can often be completed by networked multiple dynamic systems through their cooperation/coordination. One important and interesting topic in this area is distributed optimal self-deployment control of multi-agent systems, also known as distributed coverage control, the objective of which is to achieve optimal coverage performance by properly deploying agents in a given mission field through distributed control strategies that use only certain information from the agent itself and its neighbors. Numerous researchers, including the PI, have devoted themselves to the problem of distributed optimal self-deployment control for multi-agent systems over the past two decades. However, most existing research assumes that networked agents can always obtain accurate measurements and knowledge of terrain roughness. In addition, each agent in practical multi-agent systems is often equipped with simple hardware components with limited energy and communication resources, resulting in a limited operational lifetime, limited communication bandwidth and range, and transmission delays. Unfortunately, few studies in the open literature on distributed optimal self-deployment control for multi-agent systems deal with measurement errors and unknown terrain roughness, especially when they are also subject to limited energy and communication resources. Thus, it is critical to take into consideration those uncertainties as well as energy and communication limitations in the development of distributed optimal self-deployment control strategies. This project aims to investigate several fundamental problems in distributed optimal self-deployment control under various real-world uncertainties and constraints, including measurement errors, unknown terrain roughness, limited energy resources, limited communication bandwidth and range, and transmission delays. To overcome the challenges arising from those uncertainties and practical constraints, this project will develop novel distributed optimal self-deployment control strategies to achieve the optimality and stability of the resulting closed-loop multi-agent systems. It is expected that the results of this project will provide solutions to several fundamental and critical challenges in distributed optimal self-deployment control of multi-agent systems, thus facilitating their real-world applications. 過去二十年間，控制和機器人等領域對多智能體系統協同控制的興趣與日俱增。 這是因為在環境監測、搜救和精准農業等現實應用中，許多複雜的任務僅靠單一系統難以完成，而通過網絡化多智能體系統的合作/協同往往可以實現目標。協同控制領域的一個重要的課題是多智能體系統的分佈式最優自主部署控制，也稱為分佈式覆蓋控制。其目標是通過分佈式控制策略，僅使用智能體本身及其鄰居的某些信息，通過智能體在給定任務區域的自主部署，實現智能體對任務區域內的最優覆蓋效能。現有的大多數研究假定智能體總是能够獲得準確的量測結果和地形信息。目前關於多智能體系統分佈式最優自主部署控制的研究很少涉及測量誤差和未知地形，尤其是考慮實際中多智能體系統受限於有限的能源和通信資源的情況。因此，在製定分佈式優化自主部署控制策略時，需要詳細研究這些不確定性以及能源和通信限制對多動態系統的影響。本項目旨在研究實際任務環境中存在多種不確定性和約束條件下（包括測量誤差、未知地形、有限能量資源、有限通信帶寬、有限通信範圍以及傳輸延遲），分佈式最優自主部署控制的若干基本問題。 為了克服不確定性和實際約束帶來的挑戰，本項目將提出新型分佈式最優自主部署控制策略，以保證閉環多智能體系統的最優性和穩定性。預計本項目的研究成果將為分佈式最優自主部署控制中的若干基本問題和關鍵挑戰提供解決方案，從而促進多智能體系統協同控制方法在現實世界中的應用。

11207823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11207823.value: PID控製的魯棒裕度及可解釋性理論

11207823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11207823.value: For well over a century, PID control stood out as the most favored method for its unparallel simplicity, ease of implementation and cost-effectiveness. For a technology so mature and successful, what can be new and worthy of attention? Surprisingly, even in a post-modern and information-centric era of present time, PID control continues to demonstrate its sustained power, serving an awe-inspiring testimony to its incredible vitality and overwhelming acceptance by industrial control and automation communities. This dominance of PID control is unlikely to be changed in the near future due to the long existing industrial control infrastructure. Despite its omnipresent utilities, however, PID control is also limited. The fact that PID controllers rely exclusively on empirical, trial-and-error tuning makes it not readily adaptable, and in fact poorly equipped for coping with the increased complexity of today's and future complex engineering systems, thus calling for reexamination and further development of the PID method. Toward this need, we seek to develop systematically an explainable PID control theory, for which we target system robustness-arguably the most important goal in feedback control-as pilot problems. The project is focused on the maximal gain and phase margins attainable by PID control, two key measures of robustness. The project also seeks extensions of PID control to multi-agent systems, investigating the robustness of PID feedback protocols for consensus control. Four synergistic tasks are proposed, consisting of (1) developing analytical and computational methods for quantifying the maximal gain/phase margins achievable by PID control; (2) characterizing the gain/phase margins and performance tradeoffs with PID controllers; (3) developing PID gain/phase consensus margins for multi-agent systems; and (4) validating the theoretical development by simulation and experimental implementation. Being at the core of the PID control design and implementation, and of an explainable PID control theory, these objectives, from both model-based design and model-free tuning perspectives, hold the key for the broader applications of PID control to increasingly more complex, uncertain, and more performance-driven networked industrial control systems, while still retaining its essential simplicity and leveraging on the existing industrial control infrastructure. Built on the PI’s prior successes and ongoing work on PID control and multi-agent systems, a coherent technical approach has been carved out, which consists of realistic solution strategies that are believed to be both theoretically significant and practically feasible, answering to some of the key challenges for future applications of the PID control method. 一個多世紀以來，PID 控制因其無與倫比的簡單性、易於實施和成本效益而成為最受歡迎的控制方法。對於一个如此成熟和成功的技術，還有什麼是新颖的、值得關注的呢？令人驚訝的是，即使在當今後現代和以信息為中心的時代，PID控制依然以其在工業控制和自動化领域的普遍使用而持續地展示其力量，其令人難以置信的生命力。由於長期存在的工業控制基礎設施，PID 控制的這種主導地位在不久的將來不太可能改變。然而，儘管 PID 控制的實际应用無處不在，但它也受到限制。事實上，PID 控制器完全依賴於經驗、試錯整定，使其不易適應、並且實際上無法應對當今和未來複雜工程系統日益增加的複雜性，为此需要重新審查和進一步發展PID方法。針對這一需求，我們尋求系統地開發一種具可解釋性的 PID 控制理論。我們针对系統魯棒性（可以說是反饋控制中最重要的目標），将其作為中心問題。項目聚焦于通過 PID 控制可實現的兩個關鍵魯棒性指標，即最大增益和相位裕度。我们還尋求將 PID 控制擴展到多智能體系統，研究用於一致性协同控制的 PID 反饋協議的魯棒性。項目包含四項紧密相关的任務，包括（1）發展分析和計算方法用以量化 PID 控制可實現的最大增益/相位裕度； (2) 刻画增益/相位裕度和 PID 控制器的性能權衡； (3) 研究多智能體系統的 PID 增益/相位一致裕度； (4)通過模擬和實驗驗證理論结果。作為 PID 控制設計和實現以及可解釋的 PID 控制理論的核心，這些目標從基於模型的設計和無模型調節的角度來看，皆是 PID 控制更廣泛應用到日益複雜、不確定且高性能驅動的網絡工業控制系統的關鍵，同時仍可保留其簡單性並利用現有的工業控制基礎設施。基於 PI 先前的成功以及正在進行的 PID 控制和多智能體系統工作，本项目提出了系统的技術方法，包括具有理論意義和實踐可行性的解決方案，有望对PID控制方法将来應用中的主要挑戰提供解答。

11208123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208123.value: 基于NeRF表示和文本驱动的3D生成和编辑

11208123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208123.value: Creativity is a defining characteristic of human intelligence but a big challenge for artificial intelligence (AI). Recent advancements in text-to-image generation that produce images from natural language descriptions with unmatched photorealism and astounding imagination have demonstrated the AI's extraordinary creativity. This enchantment is constructed from billions of image-text pairs. Adapting it from images to 3D objects and scenes has enormous practical value, but it requires large-scale labeled 3D data, which does not exist at this time. To circumvent this limitation, we propose text-driven 3D generation and manipulation techniques that leverage deep priors of pre-trained text-image models. Consequently, no 3D data are required, and tremendous computational resources are conserved by reusing pretrained models. These powerful 2D models also guarantee quality and diversity in a 3D generation. The neural radiance field (NeRF) is chosen over mesh or point cloud as the representation of 3D models due to its superior rendering quality and compatibility with neural networks. First, we propose a text-driven NeRF stylization method for transforming existing 3D models into artistic styles described by text prompts. Both color and geometry encoded in the NeRF model will be stylized so as to minimize the contrastive distance between NeRF renderings and the text prompt measured by the contrastive language-image pre-training model (CLIP). Next, we propose a text-driven NeRF generation method for constructing open-set 3D models from scratch using a text-to-image diffusion model that has been pretrained on image data. Multiview frames generated by diffusion models constrain the 3D reconstruction of NeRF, whereas the 3D geometry of NeRF mandates 3D consistency in multi-view image generation. With the text-to-video diffusion prior, we extend it beyond static NeRF generation to dynamic NeRF generation, enabling motions in the generated 3D objects or scenes. Further, we propose a differentiable method to extract textured mesh from NeRF, given that artists may wish to modify generated models, but NeRF's implicit neural representation is difficult to edit. With it, artists can freely edit the geometry and color of NeRF models via mesh proxies. Our previous work in text-driven image editing and NeRF manipulation serves as the foundation for this project. Several building blocks of the proposed methodologies have been shown to be both feasible and effective by our preliminary experiments. This project's research findings will push the frontiers of AI creation and have a significant impact on industries such as gaming, design, film, and the metaverse, which place high demands on 3D modeling and rendering. 创造力是人类智能的一个决定性特征，然而对于人工智能（AI）来说却是一个巨大的挑战。最近AI技术在文本生成图像方面取得的进展，正以无与伦比的逼真度和惊人的想象力展示了人工智能的非凡创造力。这种魔力是通过数十亿个图像-文本数据训练得到的。如果能将文本驱动生成的技术从图像扩展到三维物体和场景，将具有巨大的实际价值，但却受限于缺乏大规模标记的3D数据。为了克服这个限制，我们提出了利用预训练的文本-图像生成模型的深度先验知识扩展到文本驱动的3D生成和编辑技术。该方法使用预训练图像生成模型，一方面不需要3D数据，另一方面可以通过节省大量的计算资源。而且这些强大的图像模型还能保证在3D生成中的质量和多样性。 由于神经辐射场（NeRF）出色的渲染质量和与神经网络的兼容性，我们选择它作为3D模型的表示，而不是传统的网格或点云。首先，我们提出了一种基于文本驱动的NeRF风格化方法，用于将现有的3D模型转化为由文本提示描述的艺术风格。具体实现方案为：将NeRF模型中的颜色和几何编码进行风格化，以使NeRF的渲染图像与文本提示通过对比性语言-图像预训练模型（CLIP）衡量的对比距离最小化。接下来，我们提出了一种基于文本驱动的NeRF生成方法，使用已经在图像数据上进行了预训练的文本到图像扩散模型，从头开始构建3D模型。扩散模型生成的多视图用于NeRF的3D重建，而NeRF的3D几何约束保证多视图的3D一致性。借助文本到视频扩散模型先验，我们将进一步扩展到动态NeRF的生成，实现生成的3D对象或场景的运动。此外，我们提出了一种可微分方法，可以从NeRF中提取带纹理的mesh，因为艺术家可能希望修改生成的模型，但NeRF的隐式神经表示很难进行编辑。借助该方法，艺术家可以通过mesh代理自由编辑NeRF模型的几何和颜色。 我们在文本驱动的图像生成和NeRF编辑方面的先前工作为该项目奠定了基础。我们的初步实验表明，所提出的方法的几个构建模块都是可行和有效的。该项目的研究成果将推动AI创作的前沿，并对游戏、设计、电影和元宇宙等对3D建模和渲染需求较高的行业产生重大影响。

11208223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208223.value: 多智能体网络非合作博弈的分布式固定时间收敛纳什均衡寻求和应用

11208223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208223.value: Distributed Nash equilibrium seeking in games over multi-agent networks has recently attracted considerable interest in research communities due to its distinctive advantages such as scalability, robustness, adaptability, and privacy protection, and also due to its great potential in wide engineering applications such as power allocation among micro-grids, energy consumption games of heating-ventilation-air-conditioning (HVAC) systems and plug-in-hybrid-electric-vehicle (PHEV) systems, and formation control of unmanned aerial or surface vehicles (UAVs or USVs). Many effective and efficient approaches have been developed. Most of existing works focus on distributed Nash equilibrium seeking with asymptotical or exponential convergence over undirected network topologies though some of them indeed consider finite-time convergence or directed network topologies. Those existing works with asymptotical or exponential convergence only ensure that Nash equilibriums are reached when times goes to infinity. For those approaches with finite-time convergence, the settling time is nevertheless dependent on their initial states and can grow unbounded with the increasing distance of the initial states from equilibrium points. In addition, most of existing works concentrate on distributed Nash equilibrium seeking under ideal network scenarios though some of them do consider simple non-ideal scenarios such as network-induced uniform transmission delays. However, many practical applications call for fixed-time convergence instead of finite-time, exponential or asymptotical convergence, that is, Nash equilibrium seeking is achieved within a pre-specified time which is independent of initial conditions and implies better transient performance. Moreover, network-induced transmission delays are often non-uniform, time-varying, or even unbounded, and they are known to have significant adverse effects on the concerned systems, even worse, to disrupt their intended functions or services. Motivated by these observations, this project proposes to investigate and develop novel approaches and methodologies for distributed Nash equilibrium seeking with fixed-time convergence in non-cooperative games over multi-agent networks under undirected/directed network topologies, and/or network-induced transmission delays. The outcomes of this project are expected to enrich theoretical foundation on distributed Nash equilibrium seeking in non-cooperative games over multi-agent networks, and, in turn, the proposed approaches and methodologies will provide more design tools and guidelines for distributed fixed-time converging Nash equilibrium seeking for non-cooperative games over multi-agent networks in practical engineering applications. 近年来，多智能体网络博弈中的分布式纳什均衡寻求因其可扩展性、鲁棒性、适应性和隐私保护等独特优势，以及在广泛工程应用中的巨大潜力，引起了研究界的极大兴趣。这些工程应用包括微电网之间的分配，暖通空调（HVAC）系统和插电式混合动力汽车（PHEV）系统的能耗博弈，以及无人机或地面车辆（UAV或USV）的编队控制。已经开发出许多有效且高效的方法。大多数现有的工作都集中在无向网络拓扑上渐近或指数收敛的分布式纳什均衡寻求，尽管其中一些最近确实考虑了有限时间收敛或有向网络拓扑。那些现有的渐近或指数收敛的工作只能确保当时间趋于无穷时达到纳什均衡。对于那些具有有限时间收敛的方法，收敛时间仍然取决于它们的初始状态，并且可以随着初始状态与平衡点的距离的增加而无限制地增长。此外，大多数现有工作都集中在理想网络场景下的分布式纳什均衡寻求，尽管其中一些确实考虑了简单的非理想场景，例如网络引起的均匀时滞。然而，许多实际应用要求固定时间收敛，而不是有限时间、指数或渐近收敛，即在与初始条件无关的预先指定的时间内实现纳什均衡寻求。此外，实际网络中引起的时延通常是不均匀的、时变的，甚至更糟糕的是无界的，并且时延会对相关系统产生显着的不利影响。受这些观察的启发，该项目建议研究和开发新的方法，在具有无向/有向网络拓扑和/或网络传输时延的多智能体网络非合作博弈中达到固定时间收敛的分布式纳什均衡寻求。该项目的成果预计将丰富多智能体网络非合作博弈中分布式纳什均衡寻求的理论基础，反过来，所提出的方法将为多智能体网络非合作博弈中分布式固定时间收敛纳什均衡寻求提供更多的设计工具和指南。

11208823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11208823.value: 高溫結構用高強韌化學複雜型金屬間化合物的成分設計和組織調控

11208823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208823.value: 具有長程有序晶體結構的金屬間化合物合金（IMA）代表了一類獨特的金属材料，在耐高温結構應用领域極具吸引力。 然而，大多數高强度IMA在室溫下通常會發生嚴重的脆化行為，特別是沿晶界的开裂和失效。 這一嚴重的問題極大地限制了它們的大規模應用，並困擾了材料科學家幾十年。 不幸的是，早期研究中的大多數傳統IMA主要是基於化學簡單型合金系統展开設計，如Ni3Al和NiAl合金。由於進一步優化合金化學成分和微觀結構的能力十分有限，這些系統至今未能突破這一棘手的科学難題。 在本项目中，我們創新性地脫離了傳統的智慧，初步設計了一種基於多組分CoNiAlTiTaNbB體系的新型L12型化学复杂型IMA（CCIMA）。 引人注目的是，這種新型CCIMA在室溫下表現出出乎意料的優异的强度-延性協同作用，即約1.7GPa的超高抗拉强度和超過30%的拉伸塑性，優於以往研究中的大多數傳統IMA。 初步結果表明，晶界無序的納米層和獨特的可變形納米孿晶硼化物可能对其優异的力學性能中發揮重要作用。 然而，复杂合金化效應和潜在的微觀機制仍然難以捉摸。更引人注目的是，當測試溫度升高到700℃時，我們發現其强度进一步增加而不是减少，表現出了顯著的反常屈服現象。 受這些結果的啟發，我們可以預期該類合金有望在更高的溫度下具有優异的抗軟化效能。然而，截止目前為止尚未有相關探索。 此外，蠕變行為也是衡量耐高溫材料服役性能的一個十分關鍵的科學問題，但尚未得到很好的評估和研究，控制蠕變抗力的結構起源也仍然知之甚少。 因此，我們建議對這種新型CCIMA的成分設計、微觀結構控制和變形行為進行系統的研究。 通過該項目的成功實施，我們將以定量化的方式為這些新型CCIMA的“成分-微觀結構-性能”的內在相關性提供獨特的見解。 基於這些成果，我們將更加有效且具有針對性地實現CCIMA的成分設計和微觀結構控制，從而大大促進新型耐高溫結構材料的創新設計和可控製造。 更為重要的是，我們相信從這項擬議工作中獲得的知識和技術將大大有利於各種現代工業的發展，尤其是那些嚴重依賴先進高溫結構合金的高端製造業等。

11208923.value: 高效光催化鉍複合納米纖維原位溫度傳感器 高效光催化鉍複合納米纖維原位溫度傳感器 高效光催化鉍複合納米纖維原位溫度傳感器

11208923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11208923.value: 人類亟需積極應對環境污染和能源問題以謀求社會的可持續發展。近年來，利用太陽光等可持續能源來降解有機污染物的光催化技術引起了廣泛的研究和關注。此工藝節能、環保，可直接進行能量轉換，廣泛應用於水處理、除臭、防污等方面。在光催化技術中，反應的效率與溫度有關，但目前沒有有效的方法來對其過程進行原位溫度監測和控制。因此，對該過程的進一步研究和開發已成為許多國家的重要戰略計劃。 不同與二氧化鈦、氧化鋅等主流傳統催化劑，鉍基半導體氧化物有大的可變帶隙，高的折射率、良好的光導電和光致發光特性並因其無毒、低成本、窄帶隙、熱穩定和耐腐蝕性強及電子遷移率和可見光誘導光催化活性高等優點而備受關注並在光催化過程中發揮著重要作用。但半導體粉末材料比表面積小、活性位點不足、載流子分離能力差、易團聚等問題導致了其不理想的光催化效率。為了實現這種材料的實際和商用價值，以上存在的問題也需要解決。 為了克服上述缺點，本項目將研究雙功能光催化核殼結構複合納米纖維。芯層由稀土離子摻雜的低聲子能量硫氧化物附著的聚甲基丙烯酸甲酯組成。稀土離子的引入不僅可以通過上轉換發光進一步增強光催化過程，並可以實現基於熒光強度監測的原位光學溫度傳感。殼層由鉍基氧化物半導體結合石墨氮化碳附著的聚丙烯腈組成。氮化碳提供了額外的活性位點並促進了空間電荷的分離，從而可進一步提高光催化活性和效率。以上複合納米纖維將使用改進的、可控且經濟高效的同軸靜電紡絲工藝合成，此工藝有效避免了粉末團聚問題。新型複合納米纖維有望具有較寬的光催化響應範圍、較大的吸附容量、良好的溫控性能，將為光催化技術和應用的發展提供新的參考。

11209123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209123.value: 數據作為資產設的施管理框架用以支持混合工作場所

11209123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209123.value: Hybrid working that combines remote and in-office working is becoming a ‘civilization-level change’ working model in the post-COVID-19 era. These changes are disrupting existing facility management practices to (re)shape people-centered hybrid workplaces. While the FM industry has been adopting various emerging technologies and digital solutions (e.g. PropTech, industry 4.0, digital twin, augmented reality, artificial intelligence, etc.) to achieve workplace transformation, it is imperative to explore how data can serve as an asset to enhance the efficiency and reliability of facilities and hybrid workplaces. Nevertheless, increasing the productivity and operational intelligence of hybrid workplaces is challenging as it is necessary to collect, integrate, process, sharing and analyze volume and variety of facilities and workspaces data, behavioral and activity data of occupants, environmental data and operational analytics insights. The use of idiosyncratic data would result in information silos and inconsistency, and this could render the automation and intelligence of hybrid workplaces difficult. Reshaping and transforming traditional facilities and workspaces into hybrid ones through a data-as-an asset lens may open up new ways to harvest data essential for improving the total performance and operational intelligence of built assets and hybrid workplaces. This research aims to develop a data-as-an-asset enabled facility management framework to improve the efficiency and reliability of hybrid facilities and workspaces. The framework consists of an information model for encoding, processing and managing metadata and domain knowledge; a service-oriented, asset-based mechanism to share and exchange facility and workplace information; a method to evaluate the value of personal, organizational, community, government and public data assets; and a cloud-based software reference architecture and a prototype system to support the implementation of the data- as-an-asset hybrid facilities and workplaces management (FWM) solutions. The research begins with a series of interviews, case studies and focus group meetings to unveil the obstacles and requirements of applying a data-as-an-asset approach to devise hybrid FWM solutions and to identify the feasible strategies and roadmaps for stakeholders to reformulate the value chain and implement workplace transformation. A data-as-an-asset based hybrid FWM prototype will then be developed based on a cloud native software reference architecture. Finally, case studies will be employed to validate the developed framework and prototype. The novelty of this investigation lies in the innovative use of the data-as-an-asset approaches and the social science theories to delineate the problems, capacities and solutions associated with next-generation FM solutions. The findings should help foster a harmonious community for smart, sustainable and resilient built environment. 混合辦公結合了遙距與實體辦公模式正成為後疫代「文明程度進化」的新工作模式。這些變化將會影響現有的設施管理實踐，並顛覆我們塑造或重新塑造以人為本的混合工作場所的概念。雖然設施管理行業一直採用各種新興技術和數字解決方案來實現工作場所轉型（如:物業技術、工業4.0、數字孿生、虛加現實、人工智能、等），但為了進一步提高設施和混合工作場所的效率和可靠性，確實有必要探索如何將數據變為資產來實現未來工作場所轉型的大趨勢。 然而，提高混合工作場所的生產力和運營智能面對很多挑戰，尤其是需要搜集、集成、處理、共享和分析大量與各種設施和工作空間的數據、用戶行為和活動數據、環境數據、以及運營分析見解。使用支離破碎的數據會導致信息孤島和不一致的問題，令日後混合工作場所的自動化和智能化發展變得困難。通過數據作為資產的視角把傳統設施和工作空間重新塑造和轉化為混合設施和工作空間，可開闢新方法收集有助於提高建築資產和混合工作場所的總體性能和運營智能相關的數據。 本研究旨在開發一個支持數據作為資產的設施管理框架，以提高混合設施和工作空間的效率和可靠性。該框架基於信息模型的要求進行編碼、處理和管理元數據和領域知識；以服務為導向、基於資產的機制，建立用於共享和交換設施和工作場所的信息平台；評估個人、組織、社區、政府和公共數據資產價值的方法；開發基於雲的軟件參考架構和原型系統，用以支持數據作為資產混合設施和工作場所管理（FWM）解決方案的實施。 該研究先從一系列訪談、案例研究和焦點小組會議開始，揭示應用數據作為資產方法設計混合FWM解決方案的障礙和要求，並為利益相關者確定可行的策略和路線圖，以重新制定價值鏈並實施工作場所轉型。然後，跟據雲原生軟件參考架構開發以數據作為資產的混合FWM原型。最後，利用案例研究來驗證所開發的框架和原型。 這研究項目的新穎之處在於創新地使用數據作為資產方法和社會科學理論來描述與下一代設施管理解決方案相關的問題、能力和解決辦法。研究結果應有助培育和諧社區，打造智能、可持續和有彈性的建築環境。

11209823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11209823.value: 基于噬菌体特征和深度学习模型的精准噬菌体分析

11209823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11209823.value: Bacteriophages (“phages”), a type of virus mainly infecting bacteria, are highly abundant and ubiquitous. They can kill their bacterial hosts or integrate their sequences into the hosts’ genomes. Thus, they play vital roles in regulating the compositions and functions of microbial communities. Recently, phage therapy gained a resurgence of attention because of the growing concern of antibiotic-resistant bacteria. These bacteria evolve to defeat antibiotic medicines and have become a major threat to global health. Phage therapy is one promising strategy to treat these bacterial infections. Despite the importance of phages, novel phages awaiting to be discovered and characterized constitute a large portion of “viral dark matter.” The recent advances in high-throughput sequencing, particularly metagenomic sequencing, have made novel phage discovery significantly faster. However, a major barrier to leveraging all the data for phage study is the lack of optimized computational methods/tools. Toward our long-term goal of investigating “what phages are there” and “what do they do in various habitats”, we propose three research objectives. The first objective is to detect phage contigs from noisy and heterogeneous metagenomic data, which is one primary resource for new phage discovery. The second objective is to classify novel phages into their taxonomic groups, which can provide essential knowledge on their evolution and functions. The third objective is to develop a computational method to identify the hosts of new phages, which can provide us with key insights into phages’ roles in microbiome and fundamental knowledge for designing phage therapy. To achieve the three objectives, we must tackle several major challenges. The first challenge is the high diversity of phages, which can fail even the most powerful sequence comparison methods for phage classification and detection. Second, thousands of phage genera form a long tail distribution with highly imbalanced data distribution. Phages from rare groups are often misclassified into large groups. The third challenge is the limited characterization of phage-host interactions, which is just the tip of an iceberg compared to all phages on the planet. We will tackle these challenges using modern machine learning models that can extract more abstract features beyond sequence conservation from a large amount of sequencing data. By integrating phage properties with the customized learning models, our research is expected to advance the field of computational characterization of phages. We will test and optimize our new tools on both the public data and the marine microbial sequencing data provided by our collaborator. 噬菌體（“噬菌體”）是一種主要感染細菌的病毒，數量非常豐富並且無處不在。它們有不同的生活方式，有的可以殺死細菌宿主，有的可以和宿主共存并將其序列整合到宿主的基因組。因此，它們在調節微生物群落的組成和功能方面發揮著至關重要的作用。最近，由於對抗生素耐藥細菌對人類健康的威脅越來越大，噬菌體療法重新受到關注。噬菌體療法是治療這些超級細菌感染的一種輔助策略。儘管噬菌體很重要，大部分的噬菌體還沒有被發現，因此，它們被稱為 “病毒暗物質”。 高通量測序技術的發展，特別是宏基因組測序技術，大大加快了新型噬菌體的發現速度。然而，目前缺乏一套能利用所有數據來研究噬菌體的計算方法/工具。我們的長期研究目標是回答兩個科學問題：“樣品裡有什麼噬菌體”和“它們在做什麼”。為了回答這兩個問題，我們提出三個具體的研究目標。 第一個目標是從嘈雜和異質的宏基因組中檢測噬菌體的基因組片段。第二個目標是將新型噬菌體分類，從而更好的了解這些噬菌體的性質，進化，和功能。第三個目標是開發一個計算識別新噬菌體宿主的方法，從而了解噬菌體在微生物組中的作用以及更好的設計噬菌體療法。 要實現這三個目標，必須破解幾大挑戰。首先，噬菌體多樣性很高，即使是最強大的序列比較方法也可能無法識別新的噬菌體。第二，噬菌體屬形成長尾分佈，數據分佈高度不平衡。來自稀有群體的噬菌體經常被錯誤地分類為大群體。第三個挑戰是已知的噬菌體與宿主相互關係很有限。我們將使用現代機器學習模型來應對這些挑戰，這些模型可以提取來自大量測序數據的更抽象的特徵。通過將噬菌體特性與定制學習模型相結合，我們的研究預計將推進噬菌體的發現和分析。我們將測試並優化我們在公共數據和海洋微生物測序方面的新工具，並和我們的合作者一起持續優化算法。

11211523.value: 輕薄柔軟皮膚集成嗅覺反饋界面

11211523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11211523.value: 虛擬實境和擴增實境（VR/AR）為使用者提供了反饋體驗從而可以使用戶感受視覺、聽覺、乃至觸覺等信息反饋。 因此VR/AR可以用在諸多領域，比如娛樂、培訓和醫學。 目前的VR/AR技術主要依賴於3D現實眼鏡與音效。 近年來報導的最先進的VR/AR技術可以將觸覺資訊以柔軟可穿戴的形式移植進來，從而大幅提升和擴展應用領域。 儘管如此，嗅覺資訊作反饋為人類五感中及其重要之一，尤其是可穿戴與使用者集成的便攜式系統卻沒有被深入開發。 嗅覺資訊與視覺和聽覺信息類似，可以為使用者提供生理和心理上的刺激與影響。 因此開發嗅覺反饋系統在學術與工業界均有著及其重要的意義。 實現輕薄柔軟可穿戴的嗅覺反饋系統，新型的技術需要滿足一下幾點需求：（a）整個電子系統可以構建在軟襯底用以實現可穿戴形式，或者小型化輕量化直接集成在用戶皮膚上; （b）盡可能提供多樣的味道信息，並且具有長時間工作且氣味強度操作可調節功能; （c）嗅覺反饋系統需要滿足無線化和定製化的需求以適應使用者的不同使用場景; （d）氣溫源可以輕易被獲取且具有良好的生物相容性; （e）具有靈敏的響應時間以及精準的濃度控制系統。 為此，我們提出來一種給予柔性小型化氣味發生器的皮膚集成的嗅覺反饋系統，其兼具有無限可程式設計功能，可以為VR應用提供嗅覺資訊。 項目目標致力於優化用於嗅覺反饋系統的材料選擇、器件設計、能量管理，從而達到高性能的嗅覺反饋系統以具備高反應靈敏度、精準濃度控制、長效工作時間、高電學和力學穩定性以及低功耗。 專案的成功將會帶來大範圍的新應用：從4D電影，到嗅覺信息的傳遞，到醫學治療，到情緒平復以及VR/AR在線教育。 這將為娛樂，教育和人機交互等領域與場景帶來全新的潛能和豐富的應用。

11212823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11212823.value: RAC-Touch：基於儲層計算和 Active Touch 的新架構，可實現更大、更快和更強大的電子皮膚

11212823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11212823.value: Dr Bartolozzi, Chiara Prof Shi, Bertram

11212823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11212823.value: The sense of touch is essential for us to thrive in vision-denied situations (e.g., replacing a light bulb). Akin to humans, touch is a critical sense in robots, especially to enable them to work alongside humans in unstructured environments and interact naturally with them. Such artificial skin technology, termed electronic or e-skin, is expected to allow for social robots in senior facilities, teleoperated surgery, sensory feedback in prosthetic devices, online shopping, etc. However, despite this apparent need to digitize the sense of touch, it has proved much more complex than digitizing vision or auditory senses, due to the following conflicting requirements: (1) high number of touch pixels or taxels (2) fast sampling rate from the taxel array (3) less wires to make a robust system (4) low data rate to enable quick processing and feedback in closed-loop system design. This proposal aims to take inspiration from biology and create a neuromorphic e-skin with three main novelties: (1) Instead of reading out the raw values of all sensors, they are modulated using feedback voltages and combined onto a single wire. Recent advances in machine learning (reservoir computing) show how such a combined signature can be used to classify the information in the original sensor array values. (2) Human senses are developed jointly with motor actions defined by behavior through an action-perception loop. We propose to use feedback from the sensed values and task goal to decide further the following sequence of feedback voltages and arm movements to be done to maximize information transfer to the e-skin thus changing the sensing to “active” touch. (3) To reduce data rates, the raw signal from the e-skin is analyzed for significant changes from the baseline, and scanning is performed only for those cases. This event-driven approach reduces the average data rate significantly. By combining Reservoir computing with ACtive touch, we expect our proposed RAC-touch e-skin to reduce wires by ~50%, keep average latency < 1ms, reduce average data rate by >10X while retaining classification accuracy close to that of the original taxel array by exploiting active sensing through feedback. The results will be demonstrated using a robot arm as well as a human worn tactile glove using our e-skin. 觸覺對於我們在視覺障礙的情況特別突顯它的重要性（好比摸黑換燈泡）。 如同人類，觸覺對於機器人來說是一個至關重要的官感，尤其是讓它們能夠在不工整的環境中與人類一起工作並自然地互動。 這種技術製造出來的人造皮膚可被稱為電子化皮膚，我們對此技術的期望是可應用在高級設施中的社交機器人、遙控手術、義肢中的感覺反饋設備、網上購物等。然而，儘管有必要將觸覺數字化，事實證明由於以下相互矛盾的因素，觸覺數字化比視覺數字化或聽覺更複雜：(1) 高數量的觸摸像素或分類素 (2) 快速採樣率taxel陣列 (3) 更少的電線，使系統更耐用 (4) 低數據速率，以實現閉環系統設計中高速處理及反饋。 該提案旨在從生物學中獲取靈感並創建仿神經形態電子皮膚具有三個主要創新點：（1）與其讀出所有傳感器的值，而是使用反饋電壓進行調節並組合到單根線上。最近的機器學習（儲層計算）的進步展示如何將這種結合起來的特徵可用於對原始傳感器陣列值中的信息進行分類。 (2)人類感官的發展是透過動作技能與行為共同發展的感知循環。 我們提議使用來自感知值和任務目標的反饋來決定接下來接收到的反饋電壓及手臂動作來最大化資料轉移至電子皮膚，從而改變傳感成“主動”觸摸。 (3) 為了降低數據速率，當來自電子皮膚的原始信號進行分析與基線相比有顯著變化，並且僅對這些情況進行掃描。這種事件觸發的方法可明顯著降低平均數據速率。通過將儲層計算(Reservoir computing)與活躍觸碰 (ACtive touch) 結合，我們提出的 RACtouch電子皮膚預計可減少約 50% 的電線，保持平均延遲 小於 1 毫秒，減少平均數據率提高10 倍以上，同時保持接近原始 Taxel 的分類精度通過反饋利用主動傳感陣列。 此專案成果將透過機器人手臂以及透過人類佩戴我們所提出的電子皮膚觸覺手套。

11213023.value: 不完善通信的多智能體網絡分佈式鏡像下降優化算法

11213023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11213023.value: 這份研究考慮在不完美通信下的分佈式優化問題。分佈式優化的目的是通過沒有中央協調的分佈式的策略、去求解決全局目標函數的最小值。全局目標函數是多智能體中每個智能體目標函數的總和。每個智能體只有自己目標函數的信息，它們通過與相鄰智能體的信息交流來實現全局目標函數的最小化。 分佈式優化已廣泛應用於傳感器網絡、分佈式控制、分佈式資源設計和分佈式估計等許多研究領域。分佈式鏡像下降算法（MDA）近年來已成為分佈式優化中的流行工具。不同於傳統次梯度下降算法中的歐幾里德距離，MDA中採用基於Bregman散度的非歐幾里德距離作為距離測度函數來求解分佈式優化問題。研究事實證明，MDA是處理大規模分佈式網絡系統優化問題的有效工具因為其可以實現更快的收斂速度。 相鄰智能體之間的信息傳輸是解決分佈式優化問題的關鍵。然而，由於通訊延遲、有限數據傳輸速率和通訊噪聲等各種限制，現實生活中的信息傳輸渠道並不完美。近年來，很多更加完善的分佈式優化算法被設計用於不同通訊限制下的分佈式優化問題。然而，由於MDA中Bregman散度的特殊性質，很多已有解決通訊限制分佈式優化問題的方法不能直接運用於MDA。考慮到大規模網絡在現實生活中的廣泛運用，如何使用MDA來解決通訊限制下的分佈式優化問題是一個非常有意義的研究課題。

11213523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11213523.value: 致災風暴大氣邊界層風與湍流結構觀測與建模研究

11213523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11213523.value: Dr Chan, Pak-Wai Prof Chen, Minghua

11213523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11213523.value: 摘要 風暴是最具災難性的自然災害，其所致經濟損失佔全球保險損失總額的 70% 以上。 由於氣候變化，風暴導致的災害未來可能會變得更加頻繁和嚴重。 因此，全面了解致災風暴的大氣邊界層風與湍流結構，對於結構抗風設計和防災減災具有重要意義。 自 20 世紀 60 年代以來，已建立了較為成熟的常態強風（例如季候風和溫帶氣旋）大氣邊界層風與湍流結構模型，這些模型目前仍在風與結構設計規範中使用。 然而，由於非常態強風（如熱帶氣旋、雷暴和龍捲風）複雜的運動學和熱力學結構以及有限的觀測數據，目前尚未建立可精確描述非常態強風大氣邊界層風與湍流結構的模型。 為了進行全方位的氣象觀測，香港天文台建立了密集的觀測網絡，觀測儀器包括飛機投擲的下投式探空儀、無線電探空氣球、激光雷達、聲波雷達、多普勒雷達風廓線儀、微波輻射計、無線電聲波探測系統、多普勒天氣雷達、配備各種氣象傳感器的氣象站、浮標和氣象飛機等。 此外，356米高的深圳氣象塔和深圳氣象站網絡所記錄的氣象數據亦將用於本項目的研究。 這些全面而寶貴的實測數據將為本項目的研究奠定堅實的基礎。 本項目旨在全面研究熱帶氣旋、雷暴和龍捲風等致災風暴的風和湍流結構，並以此為基礎建立致災風暴大氣邊界層風與湍流剖線模型。 本項目主要研究內容包括：（1）熱帶氣旋的風與湍流結構的研究；（2）基於機器學習的雷暴識別與風特性分析； （3）基於遙感觀測的龍捲風識別與三維風場研究；（4） 熱帶氣旋、雷暴和龍捲風的風與湍流剖線的對比研究與建模。任務1將基於香港天文台和深圳氣象局長期、多種類的數據，建立標準化的氣象觀測數據庫，並基於該數據庫全面研究熱帶氣旋的風與湍流結構，例如邊界層高度、低空急流特征、湍流強度剖線、功率譜密度等。任務2將開發基於機器學習的雷暴檢測和分類系統，分析雷暴非平穩風與湍流特性的時空演變規律。 任務3將根據多普勒天氣雷達和三維掃描激光雷達的遙感記錄，深入研究龍捲風風速與湍流強度的三維分佈。任務4將系統比較常態強風與非常態強風的風與湍流結構，結合人工神經網絡技術，提出熱帶氣旋、雷暴和龍捲風的風與湍流剖線模型。 本項目將增強我們對熱帶氣旋、雷暴和龍捲風的大氣邊界層風與湍流結構的認識，為香港和其他致災風暴多發地區的結構抗風設計提供重要科學依據，並為風與結構設計規範的修訂與改進提供參考。

11214023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11214023.value: 通過結構調控和電解質改性實現鋅離子電池高電壓高容量有機正極

11214023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11214023.value: 可持續能源的發電和供應是21世紀人類面臨的主要任務。在某種程度上，鋰離子電池的商業成功滿足了能源需求，但有機電解質的易燃性導致了安全隱患的大量出現，包括火災和爆炸。水系鋅離子電池通過使用廉價、不可燃的水作為電解質而有效地減小了安全風險。然而，尋找合適的陰極材料是一個必須解決的關鍵問題。 有機材料由於其低毒性、高理論容量、可預測的合成、良好的結構多樣性和經濟實惠性，是水系鋅離子電池合適的陰極材料，並符合環境可持續性的理念。然而，高電位的有機電極並不常見，大多數報導的基於有機陰極的水系鋅離子電池的電壓都低於1.2 V。因此，有機材料基水系鋅離子電池的低輸出電壓和較低的比能量密度是它們的主要缺點。廣泛使用的有機材料基水系鋅離子電池的發展取決於電壓和容量的協同改進。 對於p型有機材料，反應過程的能量變化可以分為兩步反應。第一步是通過氧化p型有機物將電子從p共軛結構中移除。第二步：電解質中的陰離子平衡仍存在於有機物上的正電荷。陰極電位與吉布斯自由能成反比（陰極電位=-ΔG/nF）。提高能量的秘訣在於控制每個階段的能量轉移，以提高有機材料的電壓。 在這個項目中，我們建議向有機材料中添加電子吸引基團，以降低其電子損失能量，並研究有機材料結構與電化學性能之間的關係，為水系鋅離子電池創建高電壓、高容量的有機陰極。從電解質控制的角度，還將向電解質中添加表面活性劑，以提高脫溶能量並擴大水分解視窗，從而增強電池迴圈穩定性。為了創建高性能的有機材料，我們還將研究使用高電壓鹵素（Br2）對高容量有機材料進行物理/化學固定。此外，還將利用機器學習對高性能有機材料進行高通量篩選，為高性能有機材料的開發鋪平道路。

11214123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11214123.value: 用於快速高解析度成像/傳感應用的 CMOS 可重構太赫茲源和檢測陣列

11214123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11214123.value: Dr Gao, Liang Dr Wu, Geng Bo

11214123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11214123.value: The Central and HKSAR governments are keen to transform Hong Kong into a global innovation hub. To achieve this, we need an industry that opens to a worldwide market and one that can attract and retain talents with its sustainable growth which will last for decades. Market Research Future, an international research company, reported in October 2022 that the Sixth-Generation (6G) wireless communications market will reach USD 340 billion by the end of 2040, representing a compound annual growth rate of 58.1% from 2031 to 2040. In this project, we embark on the research on terahertz (THz) frontends for 6G and beyond, aiming at creating innovative technologies locally. While we cannot predict the yet-to-be-found killer applications for 6G, integrating different communications, imaging, and sensing functionalities in a wireless system is unavoidable. We propose to develop enabling technologies for reconfigurable THz source and detection array for fast and high-resolution imaging and sensing, paving the way for their integration with wireless communications. With the staunch support from the Innovation and Technology Commission since 2010, the State Key Laboratory of Terahertz and Millimeter Waves (City University of Hong Kong) is equipped with state-of-the-art antenna measurement systems and millimeter-wave and THz IC characterization platforms up to 1.1 THz. In 2017, we were awarded a 5-year Theme-Based Research Scheme (TRS) project (T42-103/16-N) funded by the Hong Kong Research Grants Council in which we developed record-high-power THz sources using low-cost 65-nm CMOS technology, THz Mueller matrix polarimetric imaging techniques, and a 1-bit space-time-coding metasurface antenna capable of converting guided waves into any desired free-space waves in both space and frequency domains. The THz sources were reported in papers published in the IEEE Journal of Solid-State Circuits, whereas the metasurface antenna, operating at millimeter waves, was published in Nature Electronics. Riding on the success of the TRS project, we propose to develop a spatiotemporally modulated THz source capable of radiating a reconfigurable beam at 340 GHz and a large-scale coherent heterodyne receiver array at 675 GHz for THz imaging and sensing. The THz source can provide beam scanning and beam focusing. For the receiver array, we will conveniently adopt the 640-to-690-GHz high-power (9.1 dBm) radiator chip developed in the TRS project as the illumination source. The receiver array can be redesigned to work at 340GHz afterward. Successful project execution would enable the integration of THz imaging and sensing into 6G, contributing to developing a sustainable industry in Hong Kong. 中央和香港特別行政區政府渴望將香港轉變為全球創新中心。 為此，我們需要一個可持續發展數十年的面向全球市場的產業來吸引和留住人才。 隨著無線通訊技術的不斷發展，6G以及其後續技術的研究成為當前的焦點。根據國際市場研究公司Market Research Future在2022年10月發佈的報告，第六代（6G）無線通訊市場預計將在2040年底達到3400億美元，從2031年到2040年的複合年增長率為58.1%。而太赫茲頻段（THz）作為一個有潛力的研究領域，具有廣闊的應用前景，在這個項目中，我們開始進行針對太赫茲（THz）射頻前端的研究，致力於在本土創造新興技術為6G及其後續技術提供創新的解決方案。雖然我們無法預測在6G時代還未出現的殺手級應用，但在無線系統中整合不同的通信、成像和感知功能已成為不可避免的趨勢， 為此我們提出開發新型的可重構太赫茲源和檢測陣列技術，以實現快速、高解析度的成像和感知，為其與無線通訊的集成鋪平道路。 自2010年起在創新科技署的大力支持下，太赫茲與毫米波國家重點實驗室（香港城市大學）裝備了最先進的天線測量系統和可覆蓋1.1 THz以內所有頻段的毫米波與太赫茲積體電路特性測試平臺。 2017年，我們獲得了香港研究資助局資助的為期5年的“主題研究計畫”（TRS）專案（T42-103/16-N），在這個項目中，我們使用低成本的65納米CMOS工藝，開發了輻射功率創紀錄的高功率太赫茲源、太赫茲穆勒矩陣偏振成像技術，以及一種能在空間和頻域中將導波轉換為任何所需的自由空間電磁波的1位元時空編碼超表面天線。 其中太赫茲輻射源的相關研究成果已發表在IEEE的《固態電路學報》(JSSC)中，並且在毫米波頻段工作的時空編碼超表面天線的研究成果也已經發表在《自然電子學》(Nature Electronics)上。 借助 TRS 專案的成功，我們提出開發一種能夠在 340 GHz 頻段輻射可重構波束的時空調制太赫茲源，以及用於太赫茲成像和傳感的 675 GHz 大規模相干外差接收機陣列。 太赫茲源能夠實現波束掃描和波束聚焦， 對於接收機陣列，我們可以方便地採用TRS專案中已經開發的640至690GHz高功率（9.1dBm）輻射晶片作為輻射源， 之後亦可以對接收機陣列進行重新設計以便在 340GHz 下工作。成功執行該專案將使太赫茲成像和傳感能夠融入6G中，為香港發展可持續發展的產業做出貢獻。

11214423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11214423.value: 化學複雜金屬間化合物的抗輻照能力及微觀結構穩定性研究

11214423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11214423.value: 先進的第四代（G-IV）核反應堆被認為是一種高效的解決全球能源危機和環境污染的方案。現有的傳統結構材料無法滿足此類極端環境（高溫和高輻照劑量）的要求。因此，設計承受更高的輻射劑量和工作溫度的金屬結構材料已成為發展先進核反應堆的關鍵問題。 近些年來，不同於無序結構的傳統合金，由於優異的高溫性能、良好的抗氧化和抗輻照能力，有序結構的化學複雜金屬間化合物引起了廣泛關注。已有研究顯示在無序結構的合金裡，引入化學複雜性可以有效降低平均自由度電子和聲子的路徑，進而可調控缺陷動力學，有助於增強抗輻射性。此外，大量文獻表明有序結構的合金具有較低的原子遷移率和緩慢的晶格擴散，可以增加空位和間隙原子的能壘，從而提高其抗輻射性。基於此，我們期待通過有序的晶體結構和化學複雜性的有效結合，有望設計具有出色的抗輻射能力兼具優良的機械性能的新合金（即化學複雜金屬間化合物）。然而，目前此類新合金體系的輻照響應及相關機制還從未報導過。 為了保證材料在第四代核反應堆應用的安全可靠性，這項研究旨在設計一種具有優異的強塑性及出色的抗輻照能力的化學複雜金屬間化合物。首先借助熱力學計算和熱力後處理，我們將系統評估其成分-微觀組織-力學性能關係。隨後，將研究在高溫下缺陷演變和輻照誘導的元素偏析行為。最後，通過透射電子顯微鏡和原子探針斷層掃描技術，進一步揭示此類新合金在高溫和高輻照條件下的微觀組織穩定性。 該項目的成功實施有助於理解此類新合金的輻照響應和相關機制，這將為先進的核反應系統用耐輻照合金的創新設計提供理論指導。

11214523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11214523.value: 積極組織壓力管理對少數族裔建築工人績效提升的研究

11214523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11214523.value: Prof COOPER, Cary Prof OLOMOLAIYE, Paul

11214523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11214523.value: In a recent survey, employers in Hong Kong have noted their strongest hiring intentions since 2020 (Manpower Group 2022). Construction offers the most dynamic employment outlook, at 61% in 2022, due to large-scale infrastructure projects. However, approximately half of the registered construction workers are aged 50 or above, leading to serious shortages of laborers in the construction industry. As a result, the number of ethnic minority workers, mainly from South Asian countries, had increased by 3.7-fold in 2021 (Census & Statistics Department 2011; CIC 2021). In fact, ethnic minority construction workers (EMCWs) often work on demanding tasks (heavy workload with limitedly understandable instructions) in risky environments (job insecurity and unfair wages) involving complex social networking (language barriers and different culture/religions). Furthermore, employers/local workers continue to resist hiring/collaborating with EMCWs in their companies at construction sites (Equal Opportunity Commission 2020). These challenges (i.e., stressors) induce great stress in the EMCWs in comparison with native workers (Chan et al. 2017), which may significantly influence the performance of EMCWs and the profitability of construction companies. Although the Construction Industry Council has introduced various training protocols for construction workers, less attention has been given to construction companies for handling the specific constraints related to EMCWs at construction sites. Medical studies have shown that a reasonable level of stress can stimulate overall organizational performance (Marshall & Cooper 1976). However, excessive stress may seriously worsen performance (e.g., distrust, low productivity, turnover, accidents). The proposed research thus aims to improve the performance of EMCWs in construction companies in HK (a challenging environment) through a proactive Organizational Stress Management (OSM) approach. The objectives are (1) to identify stressors, stress, organizational coping strategies and performance; (2) to construct complicated organizational Stress‒Performance relationships (Stressors, Stress, Organizational Coping Strategies, and Performance) for EMCWs; (3) to develop a proactive Organizational Stress Management (OSM) model for EMCWs, (4) to verify the OSM model for EMCWs with real case studies, and (5) to propose an Organizational Stress Management guidelines for improving the performance of EMCWs in the industry. A triangulation method, including a large-scale survey and a longitudinal case study with both quantitative and qualitative data, will be adopted to cross-validate the results in the study. It is envisaged that the findings will help in devising a holistic OSM model with practical OSM guidelines/programs specifically for EMCWs in this complicated industry in order to support the holistic development of HK in the long term. The proposed research thus aims to improve the performance of EMCWs in construction companies in HK (a challenging environment) through a proactive Organizational Stress Management (OSM) approach. The objectives are (1) to identify stressors, stress, organizational coping strategies and performance; (2) to construct complicated organizational Stress‒Performance relationships (Stressors, Stress, Organizational Coping Strategies, and Performance) for EMCWs; (3) to develop a proactive Organizational Stress Management (OSM) model for EMCWs, and (4) to propose an Organizational Stress Management guideline for improving the performance of EMCWs in the industry. It is envisaged that the findings will help in devising a holistic OSM model with practical OSM guidelines/programs specifically for EMCWs in this complicated industry in order to support the holistic development of HK in the long term. 少數族裔建築工人經常在涉及復雜社會網絡（語言障礙和不同的文化/宗教）的風險環境中（如工作不穩定，工資不公平等）從事艱鉅的任務（如工作量大而指令難以理解）。與本地工人相比，這些挑戰（即壓力源）給少數族裔建築工人帶來了巨大的壓力，可能對少數族裔建築工人的績效和建築公司的盈利能力產生顯著影響。因此，本研究旨在通過積極的組織壓力管理方法來提高香港建築公司這挑戰性環境下少數族裔建築工人的績效。主要研究目標包括：（1）識別壓力源、壓力、組織應對策略與績效；（2）為少數族裔建築工人構建複雜的組織壓力-績效關係（壓力源、壓力、組織應對策略與績效）；(3) 為少數族裔建築工開發積極的組織壓力管理模型；(4) 形成組織壓力管理指南以提高少數族裔建築工人在行業中的績效。研究預期結果將有助於建立全面的積極組織壓力管理模型，形成積極的組織壓力管理實施指南或企劃，為建築行業復雜環境下的少數族裔建築工人實踐提供指引，從而支持香港的全面可持續發展。

11215123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215123.value: 计算广泛博奕中的纳什均衡，完美子博奕均衡，序列均衡以及完美贝叶斯均衡

11215123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215123.value: 作为博弈论中的一类广泛的非合作博弈，广泛形式博弈有很多应用。为了模拟玩家的理性行为，行为策略中纳什均衡的创建极大地促进了广泛形式博弈的发展。尽管如此，广泛形式的博弈在行为策略上可以有许多纳什均衡，其中一些均衡可能与我们关于广泛形式博弈的结果应该是什么的直觉观念不一致，特别是沿着非均衡路径。为了弥补这一缺陷，文献中提出了行为策略中纳什均衡的一些改进，例如行为策略中的子博弈完美均衡、顺序均衡和完美贝叶斯均衡。为了进一步促进扩展博弈的应用，该项目旨在开发有效且高效的可微分路径跟踪方法来计算有限扩展博弈中行为策略中的纳什均衡和子博弈完美均衡、顺序均衡和完美贝叶斯均衡完美回忆。为了实现这些目标，我们将从计算角度制定这些平衡概念的等效定义。为了构造一条到达特定均衡的有效平滑路径，我们将为玩家的每个信息集分配一个代理，并用一个介于 0 和 1 之间的额外变量构成熵障碍代理扩展形式博弈，其中每个代理针对给定的问题求解行为策略概况和信念系统是严格凸优化问题。通过这个障碍博弈，我们将建立一条有效的平滑路径，该路径与额外变量的顶部和底部水平相交，并满足当额外变量接近零时，路径的每个极限点都会产生所需的平衡。作为替代方案，我们将设计可微的线性追踪程序来选择行为策略中的纳什均衡和子博弈完美均衡、序贯均衡和完美贝叶斯均衡。我们将充分受益于广泛形式博弈的特殊结构，开发有效的程序，以数字方式遵循行为策略、顺序均衡和完美贝叶斯均衡中的纳什均衡和子博弈完美均衡的平滑路径，并提供软件包用于方法的应用。

11215323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215323.value: 融合網絡漏洞時空特徵的信息物理系統網絡韌性規劃

11215323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215323.value: Digitalization exposes societies and industries to new (cyber) vulnerabilities. Specific to Cyber-Physical Systems (CPSs), which benefit for the integration of cyber elements and physical processes, attacks to the cyber networks can generate cascading impacts to the interconnected physical processes. Cybersecurity risk assessment, then, becomes fundamental for CPSs. Vulnerability assessment is the basis, however, concerns arise on the snapshot scenario modelling of attack-defense interactive behavior, which neglects the real-life threats posed by intelligent (sequential) attacks and fails to analyze their timing and sequencing nature; thus, they remain unknown known. As a consequence, the realism of cyber-resilience-oriented decision analysis is weakened, leading to incorrect cost-benefit assessment of a range of options. In this project, we propose to develop a methodology for enabling cyber-resilience-oriented planning of CPSs, so as to provide the system with the ability of withstanding, absorbing, recovering from, and adapting to the consequences of cascades from uncertain attacks, whilst minimizing the investment costs and the recovery time. First, we will cluster the stochastic operation characteristics of a CPS, which is dynamically influenced by the uncertainty originating from multiple physical and environmental factors. Second, we will uncover the spatiotemporal characteristics related to CPS vulnerabilities, in relation to their relevance for the cascading impacts on the system physical process. To give due account to this, we will analyze the centrality of the different vulnerabilities and their interdependencies. Third, we will optimize the cyber-resilience-oriented planning. On one hand, a redundancy planning will be sought to enable the system to avoid and withstand potential damage from uncertain sequential attacks. The cost-optimal decision will be acquired by the integration of dynamic graphical modelling into game theory, capable of trading off the decision robustness against the uncertainty of sequential attack behavior. On the other hand, a response and recovery planning will be sought to enable the system to absorb, recover from, and adapt to attack-provoked cascading failures. The cost- and time-optimal decision will be reached when the countermeasures preferentially cut off cascade paths for gracefully degrading the system functionality and, then, reestablish the operation within an acceptable duration. The proposed methodology will be demonstrated on real-world CPS applications, with the underlying aim of mining new information and knowledge to cybersecurity protection and resilience enhancements of CPSs in dealing with cyber vulnerable scenarios. 數字化使社會與工業面臨新的（網絡）漏洞。網絡通信與物理過程的高度相互依賴性增加了信息物理系統（CPS）的網絡攻擊界面，容易觸發級聯效應在網絡與物理過程的傳播。因此，網絡安全風險評估已成為CPS的一項基本研究。作為基礎任務的漏洞評估具有侷限性，單一快照場景的建模方式忽略了攻擊-防禦交互行為的真實性，未能捕捉智能、連續網絡威脅的時序特徵。這種未知的研究狀態將削弱網絡韌性決策分析的現實性，導致成本效益分析結果失當。 本項目將開發CPS網絡韌性規劃方法，建立系統承受、吸收、恢復和適應不確定的級聯故障攻擊的能力，並且最大限度地降低投資成本與恢復時間。首先，洞察物理瞬態、環境擾動等多元不確定性，聚類系統運行隨機特徵。其次，揭示網絡漏洞時空特徵，以及它們在遭受網絡攻擊後對物理過程級聯影響的相關性。為此，分析網絡漏洞的時空中心性與相互依賴性。再次，優化CPS網絡韌性規劃。一方面，開發系統冗餘性規劃方法，建立系統規避、抵抗不確定的連續攻擊的能力。通過融合動態圖形建模與博弈論模型，實現能夠權衡決策魯棒性與連續攻擊行為不確定性的成本最優決策。另一方面，開發系統攻擊響應及恢復規劃方法，建立系統吸收、恢復、適應網絡攻擊及其級聯後果的能力，構建級聯路徑優先切斷、系統功能平穩退化、系統運行及時恢復的響應秩序，實現成本與時間最優決策。本項目研究方法將在CPS現實應用中進行示例演示，為CPS網絡安全保護和韌性增強研究提供新的信息和知識。

11215523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215523.value: 蜂巢啓發的固體清潔界面

11215523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215523.value: Many living surfaces in nature have orchestrated a high level of sophistication that enables them to adapt to various environments with excellent functionalities. Natural surfaces that can repel foreign matters, protect inner organs, and sustain interfacial functions have attracted growing attention. The past two decades have witnessed extensive accomplishments in studying and mimicking liquid-repellent surfaces, as exemplified by the lotus leaf, beetle, and pitcher plant, which repel foreign matters by virtue of large surface tension to overcome resistive adhesion. However, developing surfaces that repel solid particles has remained elusive and challenging, owing to the absence of surface tension in dry environments as well as the relatively amplified adhesion over gravity or inertia as a result of the scaling effect. This project is inspired by our recent discovery of an interesting solid repellency phenomenon on a honey bee’s comb surface that the adhered pollens and dust can be ballistically shot away without the use of water and extra energy because of the manifestation of a unique stiffness gradient ranging from a soft tip to a rigid base. The objectives of the proposed project are to probe the fundamental mechanisms responsible for the solid repellency observed on the honey bee’s comb and translate the learned insights to develop artificial surfaces for practical self-cleaning applications. We will first experimentally investigate the peculiar dynamic interaction between solid particles of varying size and surface energy and comb surfaces of living bees with the aim of uncovering the necessary conditions for achieving the preferred solid-repellency performance. An analytical biomechanics modeling describing the competition between the inertia force and adhesion force of particles as well as a dynamics modeling quantifying the acceleration of combs and particles will be developed and validated by our experimental observations, with an emphasis on elucidating the effect of stiffness gradient on the solid repellency. Last, we will construct a bio-inspired solid-repellent device for solar panel self-cleaning, which is essential to address the worldwide soiling problem that hinders the efficient utilization of solar energy. We envision that revealing the new solid repellency mechanism on the honey bee’s comb will enrich and extend our fundamental understanding of self-cleaning phenomenon beyond the lotus effect, and would open up a new avenue for the design of new materials and devices for a wide range of applications in green energy and environment. 在自然界中，許多生物利用精心設計的表面實現特定功能來適應複雜的動態環境。其中能夠排斥異物、保護內部器官和維持介面功能的生物表面引起了廣泛關注。 在過去的二十年裡，人們通過學習自然如荷葉、甲蟲和豬籠草等生物，在仿生疏水表面領域取得了廣泛的成就。這些表面憑藉表面張力克服粘附力來排斥異物。 然而，由於乾燥環境缺失表面張力以及微觀尺度下粘附力起主導作用，開發可排斥固體微粒的表面仍然具有挑戰性。 該項目基於我們近期在蜜蜂淨角器表面發現的一種有趣的固體排斥現象。蜜蜂淨角器可在不借助水和額外能量輸入的前提下彈走粘附在其表面的花粉和灰塵。這一現象的關鍵可能在於其獨特的剛度梯度，即柔軟的端部到堅硬的基部。 該專案旨在探索在蜜蜂淨角器上觀察到的固體排斥現象的基本機制，並利用這一機開發人造自清潔表面。為揭示實現固體排斥性的必要條件，我們將實驗探究不同尺寸和表面能的固體顆粒與蜜蜂淨角器表面之間的動態相互作用。 基於剛度梯度特性，我們將建立生物力學模型以描述顆粒慣性力和粘附力的競爭作用，並建立動力學模型預測淨角器和其表面顆粒運動學特性。最後，我們將構建一種用於太陽能電池板自清潔的仿生固體排斥裝置，這對於解決全球性太陽能表面污染問題至關重要。 我們預計，揭示蜜蜂淨角器的固體排斥機制將擴展我們對荷葉效應之外的自清潔現象的基本理解，並為新型梯度材料和清潔設備的設計提供指導。

11215723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11215723.value: 昂貴演化多目標優化中的準確性和組件共享

11215723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11215723.value: Many real-world applications involve optimizing multiple costly-to-evaluate conflicting objectives, such as finding strong yet ductile material, building a neural network with high accuracy and low latency, and designing products with high quality and low cost. Many algorithms have been proposed to produce a finite set of different trade-off solutions for decision makers to choose their preferred ones. Existing algorithms have two major drawbacks: (i) A finite set of solutions may not contain the ones that exactly match the decision maker's preferences. A large amount of computational resources is indeed wasted on searching for those not-very-useful solutions. (ii) In many applications, a preference could correspond to a different version of product or application scenario. To reduce the manufacturing cost and support module designs, it usually requires that different optimal solutions should share some common components. No existing expensive multiobjective optimization algorithm consider this requirement. This project makes a first systematic attempt to address the exactness and component sharing issues in expensive multiobjective optimization. We will develop and study Bayesian optimization algorithms for finding a finite number of optimal solutions to exactly fit the decision maker's preferences, a linear function for modelling all the optimal solutions close to a given preference, and a general model for all the optimal solutions to an expensive multiobjective optimization problem. All these algorithms treat component sharing as their constraints. This project will make the best use of ideas and techniques from evolutionary computation, single objective expensive optimization algorithms, traditional optimization, and machine learning. The proposed algorithms will be tested on shape optimization of wind turbine blades. 許多現實應用涉及優化多個評估成本高昂並且相互衝突的目標，例如尋找既堅固而又有延展性的材料，構建精度高且延遲低的神經網絡，以及設計質量高並且成本低的產品等。人們已經提出了許多算法來產生一組對多個目標進行不同權衡取捨的解決方案來供決策者進行選擇。現有算法有兩個主要缺點：（i）有限的解決方案集可能不包含完全符合決策者偏好的解決方案。大量的計算資源會被浪費在尋找那些不太有用的解決方案上。 (ii)在許多問題中，偏好可以被定義為不同版本的產品或應用場景。而在現實應用中，為了降低製造成本和支持模塊設計，通常要求不同的最優解決方案共享一些通用的組件。現有的昂貴的多目標優化算法沒有考慮這一要求。 本項目首次系統地嘗試解決昂貴多目標優化中的準確性和組件共享問題。我們將開發和研究：1）用於尋找完全符合決策者偏好的最佳解決方案的貝葉斯優化算法，2）用於刻畫滿足給定偏好及附近偏好的全體最佳方案的線性模型，3）以及針對昂貴多目標優化問題所有最佳解決方案的通用模型。所有這些算法都將組件共享視為它們的約束。該項目將充分利用進化計算、單目標昂貴優化算法、傳統優化和機器學習的思想和技術。所提出的算法將在風力渦輪機葉片的形狀優化上進行測試。

11216123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11216123.value: 可提高牙科修復復合材料抗斷裂能力的仿生架構設計

11216123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11216123.value: Dental restorative composite (DRC) has drawn extensive business and research and development (R&D) interests in recent decades for its beneficial effects on people’s health. Meanwhile, due to high standard of safety and aesthetics, the widely utilized DRCs are made by resin-based composites reinforced by ceramic fillers. Compared to that of human teeth and metallic dental restorative materials, fracture resistance to occlusal load of the current DRC is far from satisfactory, which hinders the utilization of DRC and counteracts its beneficial effects to patients and dental industry. This project proposes a bio-inspired architectural design to address above difficulty. Inspired by the superior fracture resistance of human teeth attributed to their non-uniform mechanical properties, DRCs with non-uniform mechanical properties will be developed by an architectural design in the goal of enhancing fracture resistance while maintaining material composition and feasible mechanical behaviors, such as tooth-like rigidity and strength, of the current DRC. Following research tasks will be carried out to reach this goal. Firstly, a new process invented by PI’s preliminary work will be adopted to fabricate bio-inspired and conventional DRCs. Secondly, standardized experiments and state-of-the-art microscopies will be conducted to characterize mechanical behavior of specimens. Thirdly, finite element analysis (FEA) models will be constructed to simulate deformation and cracking of bio-inspired DRC and validated by comparing with experimental results obtained by the PI’s preliminary work. Fourthly, validated FEA models will be utilized to compare the performance of the DRCs with different architectures. Architectural design facilitated by Ashby’s chart will be conducted to select optimal architecture(s) which enhance fracture resistance while maintaining material composition and feasible mechanical behaviors. Lastly, the optimal structure achieved through FEA will be fabricated and confirmed by standardized mechanical experiments. In summary, this project will conduct comprehensive research that combines fabrication, mechanical experiments, materials selection, and computational simulation. A mechanistically determined, computation/modeling guided, and experimentally validated design framework will be constructed for the R&D of the next generation of fracture resistant DRCs. Long-term wise, the methodologies and concepts established by this project will benefit the R&D of polymer-based composites in various applications. 近幾十年來，牙科修復復合材料（dental restorative composite，簡稱DRC）得到了廣泛的商業和研發關注。以陶瓷填料增強的樹脂基DRC因其優越的安全性和美觀性被廣泛使用。但其在咬合載荷下的抗斷裂能力遠低於人牙和金屬DRC。這阻礙了DRC的應用，抵消了其對患者和牙科產業的益處。 本項目擬以仿生架構設計來解決上述問題。人牙優越的抗斷裂能力來源於其非均勻分布的力學性質。受此啟發，本項目將在保持材料組份和良性機械性能（如與人牙近似的剛性和強度）不變的基礎上，開發力學性質非均勻分布的DRC，以期提升其斷裂性能。 為了實現這一目標，將開展以下研究任務。首先，采用項目主要負責人（principal investigator，簡稱PI）前期工作發明的一種新工藝來制造仿生DRC和傳統DRC。其次，采用標準實驗和先進顯微鏡表征試樣的力學行為。第三，建立有限元分析（finite element analysis，簡稱FEA）模型來模擬仿生DRC的變形和開裂，並通過與PI前期工作獲得的實驗結果進行比較來驗證該FEA模型。第四，利用已驗證的FEA模型來比較不同架構的DRC的性能。通過Ashby圖進行架構設計，選擇在保持材料組份和良性機械性能不變的基礎上可提高抗斷裂能力的優化架構。最後，制造優化架構，並通過標準實驗進行確認。 總之，本項目將開展制造、力學實驗、材料選擇、計算模擬相結合的綜合研究。以期構建一個由機理決定、計算或建模指導、實驗驗證的設計框架，用於下一代抗斷裂DRC的研發。從長遠來看，本項目建立的方法和概念將有助於聚合物基復合材料在多種應用中的研發。

11216323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11216323.value: 自動駕駛系統中場景驅動的運動規劃模型選擇

11216323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11216323.value: As an essential module in autonomous driving systems, motion planning is responsible for generating a collision-free, kinematic feasible, and comfortable driving trajectory given the inputs from environment perception, prediction, and global routing. With safety as the top concern, motion planning models need to generate a feasible trajectory in a timely manner and be responsive to changing traffic scenarios. Many motion planning models have been developed in recent years with the aim to provide the best average performance under all possible scenarios where performance is usually evaluated from the ego vehicle’s perspective, referred to as microscopic performance. The current research development in motion planning cannot address the following challenges in adopting motion planning models for real autonomous driving systems. Firstly, due to the complexity of traffic scenarios, it is impossible to develop a one-size-fits-all model for all traffic scenarios. On the other hand, it is not necessary to adopt only one motion planning model either. The challenge from this perspective is how to select the most appropriate motion planning models according to traffic scenarios. Secondly, when evaluating motion planning models, we should consider not only the performance of the ego vehicle, but also its impact on traffic flow, referred to as macroscopic performance. The challenge from this perspective is how to evaluate the impact of a motion planning model on its current traffic scenario, predict its impact on the following traffic scenarios, and proactively incorporate such impact into global routing. To address the aforementioned challenges, this project will by no means develop another motion planning model, but consolidate the existing efforts in motion planning to select the right motion planning models for different scenarios. To this end, we will first develop a framework to comprehensively evaluate the microscopic and macroscopic performance of existing models and recommend the most appropriate model for any given scenario. To capture the impact of motion planning model selection on traffic scenarios in the following lane segments, we will develop a traffic scenario prediction model to predict the traffic flow in each following lane segment, which will be used as the input of existing routing algorithms so that microscopic and macroscopic performances can be better aligned. To ensure the responsiveness of motion planning, we will develop an online motion planning model selection framework to handle the cases where the pre-selected motion planning model cannot generate a feasible trajectory in a timely manner due to changing traffic scenarios. 作為自動駕駛系統中的一個關鍵模塊，運動規劃負責根據環境感知、預測和全局路徑的輸入，生成無碰撞、可行且舒適的駕駛軌跡。在將安全作為首要關注點的前提下，運動規劃模型需要及時生成可行的軌跡，並能對變化的交通情況做出反應。近年來，學術界及業界已經開發了許多運動規劃模型，目的是在所有可能的情況下提供最佳的平均性能，這種性能通常從自我車輛的角度進行評估，被稱為微觀性能。然而，當前在運動規劃方面的研究開發無法解決以下在實際自動駕駛系統中採用運動規劃模型的挑戰。首先，由於交通情況的複雜性，不可能為所有的交通情況開發一種通用的模型。另一方面，也沒有必要只採用一種運動規劃模型。從這個角度來看，挑戰在於如何根據交通情況選擇最適合的運動規劃模型。其次，當評估運動規劃模型時，我們不應只考慮自我車輛的性能，還應考慮其對交通流的影響，即宏觀性能。從這個角度來看，挑戰在於如何評估運動規劃模型對其當前交通情況的影響，預測其對接下來的交通情況的影響，並主動將這種影響納入全局路徑規劃。為了解決上述挑戰，這個項目旨在合理挖掘現有的運動規劃工作，為不同的情況選擇合適的運動規劃模型。為此，我們將首先開發一個框架，全面評估現有模型的微觀和宏觀性能，並為任何給定的情況推薦最合適的模型。為了捕捉運動規劃模型選擇對接下來的車道段交通情況的影響，我們將開發一種交通情況預測模型，預測每個接下來的車道段的交通流，用作現有路由算法的輸入，以便微觀和宏觀性能可以更好地對齊。為了確保運動規劃的響應性，我們將開發一個在線運動規劃模型選擇框架，以處理由於交通情況變化，預選的運動規劃模型無法及時生成可行軌跡的情況。

11216823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11216823.value: 寬頻高增益多波束太赫茲天線的設計

11216823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11216823.value: 為了滿足無線通道中高速且低延遲的數據傳輸需求，學術界和工業界對運作在太赫茲頻率的射頻通訊系統展現出強烈興趣。在眾多旨在實現微波和毫米波頻率下的多波束和可控波束天線的技術中，Luneburg透鏡以其寬頻帶和廣泛的掃描角度範圍脫穎而出。加上其不需要昂貴的相移器，使得該技術對THz頻段的應用尤為引人。 Luneburg透鏡天線在太赫茲頻率下更傾向於採用平面結構，為了能更方便地與饋源天線集成。此目的可以透過變換光學技術實現。為了提升其在太赫茲頻率下的頻帶性能，我們將採用包括新型機器學習方法在內的高效優化算法。與此同時，我們也將研究高效的製造方法和低損耗材料，以更好地製作這些天線。 磁電偶極子因其卓越的輻射特性—包括寬頻帶、低交叉極化輻射、低背面輻射、對稱輻射模式以及與傳統天線如偶極子、縫隙和微帶天線相比的更為穩定的增益和波束寬度—將被選為透鏡天線的饋源。我們計劃研究在100至200 GHz頻率範圍，易於製造的高效磁電偶極子天線。值得注意的是，專為自由空間輻射設計的磁電偶極子，當用於由高介電常數材料製成的Luneburg透鏡時，可能匹配性不佳。因此，我們將進一步尋找方法，透過創新地調整天線結構並加入合適的匹配層，以優化其匹配效果。 此項目的成功將顯著提高未來在太赫茲頻率運作的無線系統的性能，並降低其生產成本。

11217123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217123.value: 基于新型金属透镜的喇叭天线增益提升方法研究

11217123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217123.value: 在無線通信中，天線是直接影響信號傳輸和接收質量的重要前端。一般來説，天線增益的提升可有效彌補空氣中的功率損耗。透鏡加載是實現天線增益提升的常用方式。然而，在實際應用中，絕大多數的通信系統僅預留天線的安裝空間十分有限。因此，設計一類適用於天線的緊湊型高增益的透鏡具有十分重要的研究價值。同時，考慮到毫米波（mmWave）通信系統具備更寬的帶寬、更快的數據速率以及在未來更加廣泛的應用，所以本項目的天線設計將主要在毫米波頻段中實現。 喇叭天線以其結構簡單、易於激勵、輻射方向圖穩定等優點在通信系統中得到廣泛應用。迄今為止，超表面和介質透鏡已被普遍用於提高喇叭天線的增益。但這些設計都存有一定的弊端，它們或需要增加額外的尺寸來加載消反射塗層，或受限於有限的工作帶寬。而相較於超表面和介質透鏡，金屬透鏡擁有更低的成本和更高的功率容量。同時，基於3D打印技術，金屬透鏡具有極高的設計自由度、易於集成和一體化加工等優勢。除此之外，目前鮮有金屬透鏡用於提高喇叭天線增益。根據上述情況，本計劃創新性地提出一類新型金屬透鏡。它可有效地提升喇叭天線增益，同時與喇叭天線高度集成。 在計劃中，首先，研究了金屬透鏡的形狀對天線整體性能的影響，總結了這類透鏡的設計方法。並且，提出了降低天線剖面高度的方法，並設計一種低剖面金屬透鏡天線。 隨後，利用提出的新型金屬透鏡，設計一種緊湊的寬帶圓極化（CP）毫米波喇叭天線。為了產生圓極化波，天線內需要兩個正交的電場。在本計劃中，將分別為兩個正交的電場設計不同的金屬透鏡，用來提升增益的同時並實現高度集成。而圓極化金屬透鏡天線同時實現緊湊尺寸和寬帶特性，具有極大的挑戰性。本計劃將解決這一難題。 最後，本項目將利用提出的金屬透鏡，設計一種雙頻天線。由於微波系統技術成熟、成本較低、信號覆蓋範圍較大，目前仍被廣泛使用。所以這一部分是為設計同時適用於微波和毫米波應用的天線。 在本計劃書的每一個設計中都將給出一個指南，以便於天線設計。

11217323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217323.value: 基于微流产生的细胞与微结构相互作用的新型自动化高通量微流控细胞融合系统

11217323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217323.value: Cell fusion can occur naturally in the human body or be caused by chemical/engineering means. During embryogenesis, tissue development/regeneration, and immune responses, some human cells can fuse together. Undesired cell fusion can also be found in tumor progression, generating drug-resistive tumor cells. On the other hand, cell fusion can be applied to integrate desired cell properties, e.g., combining the proliferation of cancer cells and monoclonal antibody production of B lymphocytes as an unlimited antibody source for immunotherapy applications. In the past decades, researchers have developed several cell fusion techniques based on biological, chemical, ultrasound, dielectrophoretic, and laser/thermal fusogens. Nevertheless, many of them are either bio-toxic or can lead to defects in fusion products. There are still technical hurdles to be tackled, e.g. accurate pairing of parent cells and preservation of desired cell functions, for achieving a high-throughput and highly promising cell fusion process and improvements in the corresponding applications. This proposed research aims at addressing the above limitations to offer a novel cell fusion technique called ‘microfluidic cell fusion’. We plan to implement this technique by applying pure hydrodynamics on cells and microstructures as an automated microfluidic cell fusion system. In principle, cell fusion can be achieved by fusing the contacting membrane region between two parent cells. Compared to existing methods, minimal thermal, electrical, and chemical disruptions are induced to components over the entire cells, such that viability and functions can be more likely preserved in the fused cells. With careful design of the flow profiles and microstructures, the microflow-induced stresses around the cells stretch cell membranes and induce their strain energy beyond a barrier level to obtain cell fusion. We will perform theoretical analysis, numerical simulation, and experiments to obtain a sufficient strain-energy-based criterion for the successful microfluidic cell fusion process. Accordingly, we will extend the device design as an array of microfluidic cell fusion microstructures for the required operations. We will also utilize pneumatic microvalves to automate the operation procedures. Together, the proposed platform will achieve automated, high-throughput and promising cell fusion. We strongly believe microfluidic cell fusion will contribute to applications such as monoclonal antibody production, cancer immunotherapy and nuclear reprogramming of somatic cells. This technology also holds great prospects in deeper mechanistic studies on immunology, development biology, cell–cell interactions, and nuclear reprogramming occurred in co-growing cells and tissue engineering. 细胞融合可以在人体内自然发生，也可以由化学/工程手段引起。在胚胎发生、组织发育/再生和免疫反应过程中，一些人类细胞可以融合在一起。在肿瘤进展中也可以发现不需要的细胞融合而产生耐药性肿瘤细胞。另一方面，细胞融合可用于整合所需的细胞特性，例如，结合癌细胞的增殖和B淋巴细胞的单克隆抗体生产作为免疫治疗应用的无限抗体来源。在过去的几十年里，研究人员开发了几种基于生物、化学、超声波、介电泳和激光/热梭原的细胞融合技术。然而，其中许多技术具有生物毒性或可能导致聚变产物的缺陷。这些技术障碍需要解决（例如母细胞的精确配对和所需细胞功能的保留）以实现高通量和极具前景的细胞融合过程以及相应应用的改进。 这项拟议的研究旨在解决上述限制，以提供一种称为“微流控细胞融合”的新型细胞融合技术。我们计划通过在细胞和微结构上应用纯流体动力学作为自动化微流体细胞融合系统来实现这项技术。原则上，细胞融合可以通过融合两个亲本细胞之间的接触膜区域来实现。与现有方法相比，对整个细胞的组分诱导的热，电和化学破坏最小，因此在融合细胞中更有可能保留活力和功能。通过仔细设计流动和微观结构，细胞周围的微流诱导应力拉伸细胞膜并诱导其应变能超过屏障水平以获得细胞融合。我们将进行理论分析、数值模拟和实验，以获得足够的基于应变能的准则，以实现成功的微流控细胞融合过程。因此，我们将器件设计扩展为一系列微流控细胞融合微结构，用于所需的操作。我们还将利用气动微阀来自动化操作程序。总之，拟议的平台将实现自动化、高通量和有前途的细胞融合。我们坚信微流控细胞融合将有助于单克隆抗体生产、癌症免疫治疗和体细胞核重编程等应用。该技术在免疫学、发育生物学、细胞间相互作用以及共生长细胞和组织工程中发生的核重编程的更深入的机制研究中也具有广阔的前景。

11217523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217523.value: 從空氣中收集水和能量：開發基於霧的自供電系統（FSS）以實現高效的霧收集

11217523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217523.value: 淡水是人類活動最重要的自然資源之一，全球許多地區對清潔淡水的需求巨大。然而，水安全對人類構成的威脅正迅速成為一個重大的全球問題，目前影響著超過 11 億人。考慮到這一點，尋找解決水安全問題的有效途徑是許多國家的緊迫任務。霧氣收集是一種典型的大氣水捕獲方案，可實現快速的現場淡水生產。最重要的是，它是一種很有前途的飲用水生產方法，不需要長距離或超長距離運輸或大量能源消耗。 該提案旨在開發一種創新的基於霧的自供電系統（FSS），從空氣中捕獲水和能量。我們的初步實驗室規模演示不僅創下了高功率液滴輸出的世界紀錄，而且最重要的是，為使用 FSS 系統從空氣中生產現場淡水、為遠程電器供電以及隨後的供電打開了新的窗口。實現“離網”概念。 FSS系統的零排放特性也完全符合2050年全球碳中和的目標。 通過這個項目，我們嘗試採用三種新的基於“液滴”的方法，以提高我們基準 FSS 的霧收集率。霧收集效率與液滴與固體表面的動態相互作用相關。了解所提出的液滴動力學增強方法的基本機制將是該項目的優先任務。特別是，（1）電力、（2）毛細管冷卻和（3）振動對液滴動力學和霧收集率的影響將受到關注。我們還將嘗試設計一個高度集成的FSS，由一系列垂直DEG組成，每個DEG都可以被視為一個獨立的電源。這種簡單但重要的結構有望解決傳統 DEG 由於滑動液滴中殘留電荷而導致的電輸出有限的問題。該項目收集的理論和實驗結果將為構建集成的FSS提供重要的設計框架，該FSS可以有效地從室外環境的空氣中捕獲水和能量。該項目背後所獲得的有關空氣動力學、傳熱、電子和材料科學的知識將成為許多其他應用的重要知識平台。

11217623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217623.value: 新型非接觸式機電能量轉換系統：一種應用於直接操縱設備的新型無線電磁執行器

11217623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217623.value: 該項目研究目的是開發一種新型非接觸式機電能量轉換系統（NEECS），該系統使用無線驅動方式來供應、傳輸和轉換能量。這一新想法將無線電能傳輸技術融入到電磁執行器設計中，可以創新性地以無線的方式驅動電機輸出機械動力。因此，電機和無線電能傳輸被集成到一個執行器系統中，推動以無線方式從電能到機械能的轉換。專案的重點在於新型NEECS的設計，研究目標包括：（1）研究提出的新型無線功率傳輸橫向磁通電機的設計標準、工作原理和運行理論的關鍵因素；（2）實現NEECS獨特的一體機設計和特殊的電氣繞組設計；（3）實現從高頻電能傳輸到低頻電機運行的全新無線功率驅動電路設計；（4）通過所提出的原邊控制策略，利用無差拍和滑模理論對副邊無源電機系統實現快速與精確的控制；（5）完成所提出的NEECS的二次狀態估計，並用於具有更好執行器系統魯棒性的無感測器控制；（6）為NEECS開發原型機和實驗測試平臺，並實施系統級實驗測試和論證。該項目的成功不但能極大地改變傳統的電機和執行器行業，而且能對香港、大灣區乃至全球的學術界、工業界和教育界提供正面意義。

11217823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217823.value: 構建適應大規模上下文相互作用的自適應分佈式計算框架

11217823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217823.value: Distributed computation is projected as one of the key technology trends by Gartner, and has gained momentum since the past decade, ranging from efficiently training large-scale foundation models, and collaborative driving strategy learning for future autonomous driving, to precision healthcare and federated wearable devices. Distributed computation is largely influenced by massive emerging contexts, i.e., different environmental conditions or situations, such as time, location, communication bandwidth constraints, privacy requirements, and heterogeneity in data statistics and resources. The interplay among these contexts often influences system performance, especially when the number of contexts becomes large. For example, reduced communication among clients may help to protect privacy but may degrade computation performance. However, carefully examining the context interplay is tractable for only a few cases with a small number of contexts, and it is urgent to build an adaptive distributed computation framework suitable for massive context interplay. To tackle these challenges, this project will inspect two tractable examples with fewer contexts, gain a deep understanding of the communication-computation-privacy/timeliness interplay, bring new perspectives towards looking into the massive context interplay problem, and finally aim to build a comprehensive distributed model learning framework through an online contextual learning approach. This project plans to perform the following distributed computation tasks towards this objective. 1) We plan to design a novel random compression mechanism via compressing the exchanged model parameters to meet the dynamically changing differential privacy requirement across time and clients while retaining satisfactory distributed computation performance (e.g., learning convergence). 2) To support the timely model update in a communication-constrained distributed learning system, we propose to design an effective scheduling scheme to determine clients' participation in sharing models. 3) Bypassing the analysis of the complicated massive context interplay, we aim to devise a general online contextual learning approach that can gradually find an optimal model from aggregating a number of existing models. In addition, we plan to evaluate our proposed framework via proof-of-concept experiments in both general neural network training and federated healthcare diagnosis tasks. This project brings together knowledge and methodologies in networking, machine learning, information theory, and communications to achieve a theoretical understanding of the adaptive distributed computation framework with algorithmic design and performance analysis, to test it in proof-of-concept experiments, and in turn, to provide insights to improve the framework. We strongly believe that this project will greatly inspire the related research community. 分佈式計算被Gartner預測爲關鍵的技術趨勢之一，並自過去十年以來持續髮展，應用範圍從高效訓練大規模基礎模型、未來自動駕駛的協作駕駛策略學習，到精準醫療和聯邦可穿戴設備等領域。分佈式計算受到不斷湧現的大規模上下文影響，這些上下文包括時間、位置、通信帶寬限製、隱私要求以及數據統計和資源的異構性。這些上下文之間的相互作用經常影響繫統性能，特別是當上下文數量增多時。例如，減少客戶端之間的通信可能有助於保護隱私，但可能會降低計算性能。然而，仔細研究上下文之間的相互作用在隻有少數上下文和少量情況的情況下是可行的，因此迫切需要構建適用於大量複雜上下文及其相互作用的自適應分佈式計算框架。 爲了解決這些挑戰，該項目將從研究兩個較少上下文數量的可處理示例開始，深入了解通信-計算-隱私/及時性之間的相互作用，並爲研究龐大的上下文相互作用問題帶來新的視角，最終通過在線上下文學習方法構建一個全麵的分佈式模型學習框架。 該項目計劃通過以下分佈式計算任務來實現上述目標。1）我們計劃設計一種新穎的隨機壓縮機製，通過對交換的模型參數進行壓縮，以滿足隨時間和客戶端動態變化的差分隱私要求，同時保持令人滿意的分佈式計算性能（例如學習收斂）。2）爲了支持通信受限的分佈式學習繫統中的及時模型更新，我們提出設計一個有效的調度方案，以確定客戶端參與模型共享的時間。3）通過繞開複雜的大規模上下文相互作用分析，我們旨在設計一種通用的在線上下文學習方法，可以逐步從聚合多個現有模型中找到最優模型。此外，我們計劃在常規神經網絡訓練和聯邦醫療診斷任務中通過概唸驗証實驗來評估我們提出的框架。 該項目將整合網絡、機器學習、信息論和通信等領域的知識和方法，通過算法設計和性能分析，實現對自適應分佈式計算框架的理論理解，並在概唸驗証實驗中進行測試，從而提供改進該框架的見解。我們堅信該項目將極大地激髮相關研究社區的興趣和創新。

11217923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11217923.value: 一种单足连续弹跳的小型旋翼机器人

11217923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11217923.value: 小型无人机在环境探测、货物运输等领域应用广泛。然而，相较于传统的中、大型飞行器，厘米级的小型飞行器、飞行机器人在气动效率、驱动效率等方面有显著劣势，其滞空巡航时间普遍较短，这严重限制了其飞行范围和应用领域。 为了克服飞行效率上的瓶颈并提升飞行器的功能性，空中机器人的多模态研究受到了广泛关注。对小型飞行机器人来说，引入轮式、足式爬行运动模式已被证实是一种有前景且有效的地面行进策略。不过，从结构上看，这些机器人通常是飞行器与轮式、足式爬行机构的直接结合，仅有少数功能部件可以同时应用于两种运动形式。这些额外的质量一定程度上进一步降低了飞行效率。此外，这些机器人并未展示出常规的跳跃、腿足机器人相似的运动敏捷性和路面通过性。 本项研究提出一种小于50克的弹跳型飞行机器人，它由一个常规的小型四旋翼飞行器和一个被动式的弹性腿部机构组成。在弹跳模式下，该机器人可以利用旋翼控制其弹跳运动，并能够在地面进行高效、灵活的连续弹跳。我们将详细介绍实现这种敏捷、灵巧的弹跳机器人的研究计划，其包括三个步骤：首先，我们将基于弹跳机器人原型机进行的弹跳动力学系统辨识，推导其动力学模型并制定弹跳控制策略。我们将开发一种适应于被动弹跳的控制策略。由于弹性腿上并未配置任何驱动器，因此机器人的弹跃控制完全依赖空中阶段的旋翼推力动态调节。在此阶段，我们将使用运动捕捉系统来提供反馈，完成弹跃控制。其次，我们将引入光流和测距传感器以实现自主控制。当这些传感器的读数与IMU的读数融合时，可以提供速度、高度等方面的估计，从而消除对外部反馈的依赖。最后，为了充分利用空中推进带来的优势，我们计划提出一种带有双向推力螺旋桨的弹跳型四轴飞行器，以提高弹跳敏捷性。在跳跃时，空中阶段施加的向下的推力可使机器人加速下落并缩短步距，突破了依赖地面反作用力驱动的传统跳跃机器人的跳跃弹道限制，从而提高弹跳速度。 我们预期，本项目提出的弹跳飞行机器人，相较于传统的多模态飞行机器人，将能大幅提升地面运动的敏捷性，并实现更高的运动效率及更长的巡航时间，从而扩展小型空中飞行机器人的应用领域。本项目的主要贡献包括但不限于：（i）混合飞行和弹跳机器人的设计，以及弹跳控制策略的开发；（ii）展示了小于50克的旋翼机的稳定连续弹跳和自主控制能力；以及（iii）使用空中推进来提升弹跳敏捷性，以此突显混合平台的能力。
