11218523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11218523.value: 用於癌症免疫治療的在體細胞工程技術研究及應用

11218523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11218523.value: The concept of deploying the immune system as a tool to treat cancer has been explored for a long time and becomes increasingly popular in the past decade since the approval of chimeric antigen receptor (CAR) T-cells for treating advanced blood cancer. Different cancer immunotherapies are developed with an emphasis on direct or indirect T-cell engineering around three technical routes, including immune checkpoint blockade, adoptive cell infusion, or cancer vaccination. In many cases, a first and essential process for relevant therapeutic strategy is the intracellular introduction of nucleic acid (NA)-based therapeutic materials to engineering cells of the immune system. While it is relatively easy to introduce NAs to cultured cells in laboratories, limited techniques are available for delivering NAs directly in human body, especially when the associated cytosolic delivery is required in a footprint-free manner without leaving behind any additional reagents in human body. Towards this goal, this proposal aims to address the unmet needs mentioned above by developing a revolutionary in vivo cell engineering platform. The technical innovation relies on the development of a novel hydrogel-based electronics device for in vivo, non-viral, non-liposomal, delivery of nucleic acids therapeutics to mammalian cells by microarrayed electroporation in a one-shot operation on living organisms. The multi-functional organic device (µEPO) will be made of conductive hydrogels and work as an electrical biointerface for one-shot trans-tissue local gene delivery, combining controlled macromolecules release, in situ electroporation, and in vivo gene-transfection in a trinity, which overcomes the challenges of inefficient delivery of biologic molecules (e.g., proteins, nucleic acids) to immune cells in existing immunotherapies. Based on the technical advancement, this project will further explore potential improvements of current cancer immunotherapy strategies by two different approaches, namely transdermal cancer DNA vaccination and in-body manufacturing of engineered T-cells. The first one would require subcutaneous delivery of neoantigen gene to dendritic cells for subsequent T-cell activation, offering a solution for a self-administrable and painless transdermal gene delivery in the clinical practice. The second one involves direct gene-editing in lymph node to produce immune checkpoint inhibited endogenous T-cells in living organisms in a minimally invasive manner, providing an innovative solution to augment the traditional ICB potency as a long effective way without the need of T-cell extraction and infusion. Either way, the induction tumor-specific immune response is expected to achieve prophylactic or therapeutic benefits to cancer immunotherapy in rodent animal model. 利用免疫系統作為治療癌症的工具的概念已經被探索了很長時間。自嵌合抗原受體免疫細胞（CAR-T）被批准用於治療晚期血癌以來，免疫療法在過去十年中變得越來越流行。 不同的癌症免疫療法的技術重點主要圍繞三種技術路線直接或間接 對T細胞進行工程改造，包括免疫檢查點封鎖、過繼細胞輸注或癌症疫苗接種。很多多情況下，相關治療策略的首要且重要的步驟是基於核酸（NA）的治療物質引入到免疫系統的細胞質中。 雖然在實驗室中將NA引入培養細胞相對容易，但可用於將NA在體直接遞送到人體細胞內的技術有限。為了實現這一目標，本項目旨在通過開發新型的體內細胞工程平台來解決上述未滿足的臨床需求。這項技術創新依賴於一種新型水凝膠電子設備的開發，該設備可通過微陣列電穿孔對活體進行一次性操作，將用於疾病治療的核酸物質在體內以非病毒、非脂質體的方式遞送至人體細胞內，誘導腫瘤特異性免疫反應，以實現癌症免疫療法的預防或治療益處。

11218823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11218823.value: 將 AlphaFold 的潛在蛋白質組空間納入細胞間相互作用

11218823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11218823.value: In this proposal, we take advantage of recent breakthroughs in protein structure prediction to devise new methods as well as improve existing procedures in studying spatial transcriptomics data. Spatial transcriptomics technology allows transcript (or sequence) abundances to be read from a tissue sample at the cell-level resolution, giving us the abundances at individual points of a grid over the sample. The ability to examine gene expressions (from the transcript abundances) across neighboring grid points (or spots) allows us to study and understand cell-cell interactions (CCIs), which regulate tissue formation and cellular functions. However, current spatial transcriptomics technologies suffer at least two drawbacks to studying CCIs. First, they cannot extract transcriptomes from precisely within the cell, which results in ambiguities in the inferred interactions. Second, spatial transcriptomics technologies have high dropout rates. Current analysis methods for inferring the content of two neighboring spot interactions are based on observing the co-occurrences of known bindings between ligands and receptors. This severely restricts their inference power. To remedy this, we take advantage of the near-complete collection of predicted protein structures from AlphaFold. A large machine-learning model can learn the latent structural space and infer possible interactions between ligands and receptors. Single-cell sequencing (scRNA-seq) technologies are able to specifically extract the expressions from a single cell with a relatively lower dropout rate, allowing us to infer expressions of single cells in the spatial transcriptomics data. Our approach incorporates this as well. For this project, we use a deep learning model to perform dimensionality reduction on the structures, with additional information from curated biological data to supervise the learning. Then, we assess the usability of resultant vectors with the protein structure similarity search problem. Next, the resultant vectors, together with the spatial transcriptomics data, are then used to infer the affinities between ligand and receptor and to infer novel ligand-receptor pairs. The affinities inferred are then used in a novel method that combines spatial transcriptomics data, scRNA-seq data, and the learned embeddings to infer cell-cell interactions (CCIs). Furthermore, with the results obtained, we intend to find spatial variable ligand-receptor pairs from the CCIs, reconstruct cell hierarchies for the CCIs, and integrate multi-omics data with the CCIs. 在這項提案中，我們利用蛋白質結構預測方面的最新突破來設計新方法並改進研究空間轉錄組數據的現有程序。空間轉錄組學技術允許以細胞水平分辨率從組織樣本中讀取轉錄本（或序列）豐度，從而為我們提供樣本上網格各個點的豐度。檢查鄰近網格點（或點）的基因表達（來自轉錄本豐度）的能力使我們能夠研究和理解細胞間相互作用（CCI），細胞間相互作用調節組織形成和細胞功能。然而，當前的空間轉錄組學技術在研究 CCI 時至少存在兩個缺點。首先，他們無法從細胞內精確提取轉錄組，這導致推斷的相互作用含糊不清。其次，空間轉錄組學技術的流失率很高。當前用於推斷兩個相鄰點相互作用的內容的分析方法是基於觀察配體和受體之間已知結合的共現。這嚴重限制了他們的推理能力。為了解決這個問題，我們利用了 AlphaFold 中近乎完整的預測蛋白質結構集合。大型機器學習模型可以學習潛在的結構空間並推斷配體和受體之間可能的相互作用。單細胞測序（scRNA-seq）技術能夠以相對較低的丟失率特異性地提取單個細胞的表達，使我們能夠在空間轉錄組數據中推斷單個細胞的表達。我們的方法也包含了這一點。對於這個項目，我們使用深度學習模型對結構進行降維，並使用來自精選生物數據的附加信息來監督學習。然後，我們通過蛋白質結構相似性搜索問題評估所得向量的可用性。接下來，所得向量與空間轉錄組數據一起用於推斷配體和受體之間的親和力。然後將推斷出的親和力用於一種新方法，該方法結合了空間轉錄組數據、scRNA-seq 數據和學習到的嵌入來推斷細胞間相互作用 (CCI)。此外，我們打算從 CCI 中找到空間可變的配體-受體對，重建 CCI 的細胞層次結構，並將多組學數據與 CCI 整合。

11300123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300123.value: 基于连续体束缚态和 Kerker 条件的非局域惠更斯超构元件

11300123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300123.value: 超構元件是一種新穎的平面光學器件，由陣列化的亞波長結構組成，可以靈活地操控電磁波的相位、幅度、偏振等，其能力遠遠超出了傳統的笨重的元件。 蔡定平教授（項目共同負責人）首先展示了高效連續寬帶工作超構元件—消色差超構透鏡。 它是通過採用特殊設計的集成共振單元進行相位補償來實現的，其中每個超構原子都有獨立的局部響應。 另一方面，在寬帶照明下，對超構原子陣列具有非局域集體響應的帶通操作超構元件也具有各種特殊應用，例如光學非線性、生物醫學成像、虛擬現實顯示和量子光學。 然而，由於物理機制和設計方法的限制，已知的非局域超構元件仍然面臨著低品質因數、低效率、複雜配置和低維光場操縱的難題。 例如，對於圓偏振光下的透射或反射光，理論偏振轉換效率僅限於約25%。 在這計畫中，我們提出了一種提高非局域惠更斯介電質超構元件效率的新型解決方案。 同時考慮連續體準束縛態（q-BIC）和Kerker條件的物理機制，以實現窄帶操作的高質量因子和效率增強。 超構原子被設計為一個納米圓柱體，在六方晶格內有一個偏移納米孔。 每個超構原子根據幾何相排列進行旋轉，以構成用於定制波前的超構元件的相位分布。 對稱性破缺可以激發q-BIC，其品質因數可以通過調整幾何參數來控制。 同時，我們通過將q-BIC與其他多極模式耦合，進一步引入了Kerker條件。 我們新穎的複合材料設計方法可以在設計的諧振波長下提供更高的偏振轉換效率（>60%），與一般的非局域超構元件相比，我們的超構元件品質因數可大於200。 概念驗證演示將通過所提出的用於可見光聚焦和成像的超構元件（也稱為非局域惠更斯超透鏡）進行設計、製造和表徵。 我們提出的非局域超透鏡的預期實驗工作效率將比已報告的非局域超透鏡學術報告至少高7倍。 該項目的成功完成為高效諧振超構元件的實現和應用提供了重要的方法。 我們的惠更斯超構元件的優點是尺寸緊湊、效率高、可定制的窄工作頻帶和低功耗。 此項目的科研成果可以推動下一代光學器件和系統的革命，例如先進顯示技術、個人穿戴設備以及非線性/量子應用。

11300723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300723.value: 新興電子垃圾汙染物液晶單體在斑馬魚中的毒理代謝動力學和毒物效應動力學

11300723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300723.value: 為滿足不斷增長的需求，全球液晶顯示屏的產量正不斷上升。許多有機化合物，如液晶單體，會在液晶顯示屏的使用過程中不斷釋放到環境中。液晶單體是制造液晶顯示屏所必須的顯色物質。最新的研究顯示，此類物質可能是一類具有環境持久性，生物纍積性，以及生物毒性的新興汙染物，併在室內灰塵，堆填區滲濾液，沈積物，以及水生生物及人體內都有檢出。長期暴露於此類汙染物可能對生物體的健康造成負面影響。然而，對液晶單體作為環境汙染物的風險和毒性機制的認識，依舊非常匱乏。 我們之前的研究，已經確認了三種廣泛分佈於水環境中的主要液晶單體汙染物（即3VbcH、Pe3bcH和tFMeO-3bcHP），對水生生態環境可能造成長期的危害。為揭示此類汙染物的毒性機理，本項目擬運用斑馬魚作為生物模型，分別從體外組織，胚胎，和成魚暴露三個方面對三種主要液晶單體汙染物的毒理代謝動力學和毒物效應動力學進行深入研究。本項目將會運用最先進的檢測技術，分析液晶單體在斑馬魚體內的代謝產物，發育毒性，以及生殖毒性，併通過轉錄組學和模擬分子對接所獲得的信息，完成危害結局路徑分析。 本項研究將會顯著推進我們對液晶單體這類新興的電子垃圾汙染物，在水生生物中的毒理代謝動力學和毒物效應動力學的認識。本項研究的結論將會幫助開發環境友好的顯色物質，減少電子垃圾汙染對水生生態環境的影響，亦能在評估及管理新興電子垃圾汙染物領域，促進香港在地區和全球研究中的地位，對保護本港及大灣區的生態環境做出積極地貢獻。

11300923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11300923.value: 介觀鎳氧化物超導結器件中的相敏測量

11300923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11300923.value: Superconductivity is regarded as a fascinating manifestation of a macroscopic-scale quantum coherent state. The microscopic theories developed aiming to explain such phenomenon have largely irrigated other research fields spanning across condensed matter, particle and even nuclear physics. On the other hand, the understanding of unconventional superconductivity, which usually involves condensation of strongly correlated electrons into frictionless superfluid through unusual interactions, remains challenging. In particular, the mechanism of high-temperature superconductivity (HTS) since its discovery in copper oxides has been the ‘holy grail’ enigma in condensed matter physics for over 35 years. One promising strategy to unveil this long-standing puzzle is to search for superconducting layered oxides with similar electronic configuration to that of copper oxides. After a long and difficult campaign, the discovery of superconducting infinite-layer (IL) nickelates as a new class of unconventional superconductors has furthered this quest and engendered a novel paradigm for understanding HTS. To this end, investigation of the symmetry of the pairing state in IL nickelates has proven to be an indispensable approach to unravelling the underlying physics of the pairing mechanism; however, due to the significant challenges in materials synthesis and despite attempts using indirect approaches, a clear demonstration of the symmetry of the superconducting order parameter of nickelates is still elusive. In this project, we propose to use high-quality IL nickelate films grown in our laboratory to form different superconducting mesoscopic devices for phase-sensitive experiments. Across these measurements, we plan to leverage superconducting quantum coherence of the pairing electrons in these devices for providing compelling evidence on the pairing-state symmetry. This proposal is built upon two extraordinary qualities: (1) our unique strength in growth of top-crystallinity thin films of superconducting IL nickelates; (2) our special expertise and excellent existing resources on device fabrication and quantum transport measurements of junctions. The key to the success of this proposed research largely relies on a seamless coordination of tasks at research fronts of both synthesis and measurements, for which we are immensely well positioned. Though collaborations, we will establish close-loop feedback between materials perfection, device quality control and high-precision measurements. This project will answer key questions on the pairing symmetry of the superconducting nickelates, marking impactful footsteps towards understanding the nature of pairing interactions in unconventional superconductivity. 超導性被認為是宏觀量子相干態的一種迷人的表現。為了解釋這種現象而發展的微觀理論，已經在凝聚態物理、粒子物理甚至核物理等其他研究領域產生了深遠的影響。另一方面，對非常規超導性的理解仍然具有挑戰性，因為它通常涉及通過不尋常的相互作用將強關聯電子凝結成無摩擦的超流體的過程。特別是自從在銅氧化物中發現高溫超導電性（HTS）以來，高溫超導的機理已經成為凝聚態物理中長達35年的“聖杯”之謎。揭開這個長期懸而未決的難題的一個策略是尋找具有類似於銅氧化物的電子構型的超導層狀氧化物。經過漫長而艱難的探索，無限層鎳氧化物作為一類新型的非常規超導體的發現，推動了這一探索，並為理解HTS提供了一個新的範式。為此，在無限層鎳氧化物中研究配對態的對稱性已被證明是揭示配對機制背後物理的必不可少的方法；然而，由於材料合成方面的重大挑戰，儘管有一些間接的方法，但對鎳氧化物超導序參量的對稱性的清晰證明仍然難以獲得。 在這個項目中，我們建議使用本實驗室生長的高質量無限層鎳氧化物薄膜，製備不同的超導介觀器件，並進行有關的相位敏感實驗。在這些測量中，我們計劃利用這些器件中配對電子的超導量子相干性，為超導配對態對稱性信息提供有力的實驗證據。此研究基於兩個重要方面：（1）我們在生長高晶體質量超導鎳氧化物薄膜方面的獨特優勢；（2）我們在器件製備和超導隧道結的量子輸運測量方面的特殊專長和優質資源。這項研究的成功關鍵在於實現合成和測量兩個研究前沿任務的無縫協調。對此我們有著極大的技術優勢。通過合作，我們將進行材料質量、器件質量的控制以及高精度測量。這個項目將回答有關鎳氧化物超導配對對稱性的關鍵問題，為理解非常規超導性中配對相互作用的機理提供重要支撐。

11302023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11302023.value: 用於幾何深度學習的框架小波：球、圖和神經網絡

11302023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302023.value: Deep learning based on the architecture of multilayer artificial neural networks has revolutionized modern society and people's daily life during the past decade ranging from automated driving, online shopping, AI assistant, to smart surveillant systems, medical diagnosis, drug discovery, and so on. While deep learning models, such as the convolutional neural networks, have been successfully used in speech recognition, image classification, or video processing, where the underlying domain of data is the Euclidean space, geometric deep learning goes beyond the training and learning of data defined on Euclidian domains and deal with commonly appeared non-Euclidean structured data in real-life applications, such as graph data and manifold data. For example, in network sciences, the road network dataset includes traffic directions and road junctions are (directed) graph data that can be used for supporting the development of intelligent transport system; in biomedical and drug industry, the drug–target–indication interaction and relationship provide a graph-structured data; in geology, remote sensing data are naturally spherical signals; and in computer vision, 3D objects are modeled as Riemannian surfaces with color texture. Geometric deep learning aims at encoding geometric priors of non-Euclidean data into the design of deep neural network models to improve the overall neural network performance. Framelet systems, naturally equipped with the properties of multiscale analysis, sparse representation, customized filter bank design, fast algorithmic implementation, and so on, provide a powerful mathematical tool for geometric deep learning. In this project, we focus on two of the most important mathematical objects, the graphs and the spheres, and consider (1) the development of framelet systems on spheres and graphs with desirable properties; (2) the integration of framelet systems into the design of neural network models for geometric deep learning; (3) the theoretical connections between the framelet systems as well as the neural network models from the viewpoints of discretization and continuity; and (4) the extension and generalization of the framelet systems and their respected neural network models to more general domains. The outcomes of this project would be powerful framelet systems and deep learning models with rich mathematical theory for geometric deep learning. 過去十年來，基於多層人工神經網絡架構的深度學習徹底改變了現代社會和人們的日常生活，從自動駕駛、在線購物、人工智能助手，到智能監控系統、醫療診斷、藥物發現等。雖然深度學習模型（例如卷積神經網絡）已成功應用於語音識別、圖像分類或視頻處理，其中數據的基礎域是歐幾里德空間，但幾何深度學習，超越於歐幾里德域上定義的數據的訓練和學習，可以處理現實應用中常見的非歐幾里德結構化數據，例如圖數據和流形數據。例如，在網絡科學中，路網數據集包括交通方向、路口等（有向）圖數據，可用於支持智能交通系統的開發；在生物醫學和製藥行業，藥物-靶標-適應症的相互作用和關係提供了圖形結構的數據；在地質學中，遙感數據本質上是球形信號；在計算機視覺中，3D 對像被建模為具有顏色紋理的黎曼曲面。幾何深度學習旨在將非歐幾裡得數據的幾何先驗編碼到深度神經網絡模型的設計中以提高神經網絡的整體性能。框架小波系統天然具備多尺度分析、稀疏表示、定制濾波器組設計、快速算法實現等特性，為幾何深度學習提供了強大的數學工具。在這個項目中，我們關注兩個最重要的數學對象，圖和球，並考慮（1）開發具有所需屬性的球和圖上的框架系統； (2) 將框架系統集成到幾何深度學習的神經網絡模型設計中； (3)從離散化和連續性角度分析框架系統與神經網絡模型之間的理論聯繫； （4）將框架系統及其相應的神經網絡模型擴展到更通用的領域。該項目的成果將是強大的框架系統和深度學習模型並具有豐富的幾何深度學習數學理論。

11302623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11302623.value: 混合相MoS2高選擇性電催化還原NO3(-)的催化協同作用機理研究及同步操作分析

11302623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11302623.value: Prof Feng, Shien-Ping Prof Mitch, William A.

11302623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302623.value: 反硝化是將硝酸鹽 (NO3-) 轉化為無害的氮氣 (N2) 的過程，對於環境保護非常重要。水中過量存在的NO3-會導致當地水體富營養化，攝取過量的NO3-則會嚴重影響人類的健康。因此，反硝化對於生活廢水的回收或妥善排放尤其重要。在香港的《2030+氣候行動計劃》中，香港承諾擴大灰水的再利用，例如再利用園藝和雨水收集系統的水。然而，香港目前的反硝化處理主要是生物驅動的，其處理持續時間和能力受到氣候變化導致的日益零星的降雨模式的威脅。因此，迫切需要一種快速且具有成本效益的反硝化技術來實現香港的長期灰水回收目標。 此項目將開發混合相 MoS2（mp-MoS2）作為電催化脫硝的新型電催化劑。 mp-MoS2有兩個主要相，1T和2H，它們具有不同的催化性能。兩相的適當混合可以實現催化協同作用，正如 PI 最近使用糠醛（一種生物質相關化學品）證明以上假設。此發現已發表在 ACS Catalysis 的封面上。在研究電催化脫硝機理後，PI 假設 mp-MoS2 的協同效應有潛力提供 HK 所需的快速、經濟高效的脫硝技術。初步實驗表明，mp-MoS2 能夠以良好的產率將 NO3 轉化為 N2，並且比單相變體的轉化效率更高。顯然，此催化劑存在值得研究的協同催化效應。 受上述發現的啟發，擬議項目將闡明 1T 和 2H 相如何在電催化脫硝中發揮協同作用。將研究NO3-和關鍵中間體的還原。然後將使用最先進的掃描電化學顯微鏡（SECM）進行操作分析，以探測催化劑與底物的相互作用。實驗和光譜結果將與單個物種吸附能的密度泛函理論（DFT）模擬相關聯，以全面了解反應機理和混合相催化劑所發揮的催化作用。 研究結果將啟發高效、環保且具有成本效益的反硝化電催化劑的設計。此外，該研究還將揭示多相催化劑中不同組分如何協作，這將有利於未來用於復雜電化學反應的其他多相催化劑的開發。從長遠來看，我們希望擴大MoS2催化系統的規模，以實現快速、按需的脫硝系統，從而支持甚至取代香港目前的灰水脫硝方案。

11302723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11302723.value: 擦邊極限下譜結構的躍遷及其應用

11302723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302723.value: Boltzmann equation derived by Boltzmann in 1872 is a fundamental equation in statistical physics that describes the behavior of rarefied gas under the assumption of elastic collision and molecule chaos. It is a mathematical model for the time evolution of the distribution function of particles in a non-equilibrium gas. It not only has many applications in physics, engineering and other areas, but also provides many challenging mathematical problems. There are fruitful results on the mathematical theory for the Boltzmann equation, such as the renormalized solutions by DiPerna-Lions and the trend to equilibrium study by Desvillettes-Villani among many others. However, there are still many interesting problems remaining unsolved, such as the Hilbert's 6th problem 'Mathematical treatment of the axioms of physics'. On the other hand, Landau equation is an effective kinetic model derived by Landau formally in 1936 for the charged particles governed by the Coulomb potential in the weakly coupling regime. The Boltzmann and Landau equations are closely related through the grazing collision limit that has been extensively investigated, cf. [2,5,11,12,18] and the references therein. In the perturbation framework, the spectrum structures for both the Boltzmann equation and the Landau equaton have been well studied since the poineer work by Ellis-Pinsky, Nicolaenko, Ukai, Caflisch. However, the transition in the spectrum structures of these two typical kinetic models through the grazing limit still unclear. An attempt was made in our recent work by investigating the transition of the optimal time decay structures. Precisely, in the regime of parameters in the cross-section where there is no spectrum gap for the linearized Boltzmann operator without angular cutoff but it does for the linearized Landau operator, the continuous transition of time decay structure of the Boltzmann operator to the one for the Landau operator was analyzed. This in some sense reveals how the spectrum of the linearized non-cutoff Boltzmann equation changes through the grazing limit. On the other hand, in terms of spectrum structure, this result is far from being satisfactory. Therefore, as a further step along this direction, this proposal aims to understand the transition of the spectrum structures in the grazing limit and then apply it to the study on the solution behavior, hydrodynamic limit and Green's functions analysis. We believe that the expected results can further enrich the understanding on the relation between these two fundamental equations in the perturbation framework. 1872年由Boltzmann建立的Boltzmann方程是統計物理中的基本方程，它描述了在彈性碰撞和分子混沌假設下稀薄氣體的運動規律。Boltzmann方程是一個描述處在非平衡態粒子的分佈函數隨時間演化規律的數學模型。它不僅在物理、工程和其它領域中有諸多應用，而且也提出了許多具有挑戰性的數學問題。關於Boltzmann方程的數學理論的研究已經取得了許多進展：例如DiPerna-Lions的重整化解、Desvillettes-Villani關於趨於平衡態的研究等等。即便如此，還有許多有趣的問題還是懸而未決的：例如Hilbert第六問題“物理學公理化的數學處理”等。另一方面1936年由Landau形式上推導出的Landau方程是一個描述在弱耦合狀態下受庫侖勢支配的帶電粒子運動規律的有效動理學模型。 Boltzmann方程和Landau方程通過檫邊碰撞極限密切相關，相關的研究見【2，5，11，12，18】及其所引文獻。在擾動框架下，基於Ellis-Pinsky、Nicolaenko、Ukai、Caflisch等人的開創性工作，Boltzmann方程和朗道方程的譜結構都得到了很好的研究。但是在檫邊極限下這兩類動理學方程譜結構的躍遷還是不清楚的。我們近期的一項工作探討了它們最優時間衰減結構的躍遷。準確地說，在不帶角截斷線性化的Boltzmann運算元沒有譜間隙的橫截面的參數範圍內，線性化的Landau運算元卻有譜間隙，我們分析了線性化Boltzmann運算元的時間衰減結構向線性化Landau運算元的時間衰減結構的連續躍遷。這在某種意義上揭示了線性化的非角截斷Boltzmann方程的譜是如何通過檫邊極限而變化的。另一方面，就譜結構的研究而言，這一結果遠不能令人滿意。因此，作為這一研究方向的進一步深入，本項目在瞭解檫邊極限下譜結構的躍遷，並將其應用于解的性態、流體動力極限和格林函數分析等問題的研究。我們相信預期的結果可以進一步豐富對這兩個基本方程在攝動框架下的關係的理解。

11302823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11302823.value: 高效的蒙特卡罗方法：随机微分方程、多尺度和约束动力学的控制变量

11302823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11302823.value: We propose efficient Monte Carlo (MC) methods for a broad class of stochastic differential equations (SDEs). These equations can have multiscale properties or constrained solutions. The proposed methods will be part of the next generation of MC techniques and will provide effective tools to meet fundamental needs arising from scientific, industrial, or societal challenges. Indeed, experts from various disciplines need to model and simulate quantities formulated in terms of the aforementioned stochastic models. We will consider variance reduction strategies of MC estimators such as control variates, ad-hoc approaches, and their applications in numerical analysis for SDEs, finance, and materials science. We will introduce a control variate estimator for quantities expressed as the expectation of a function of a diffusion process. The control variate is built with the same function and with a random process that satisfies the same equation as the diffusion process except that the Brownian motion is replaced by its optimal polynomial approximation. This will yield a practical control variate estimator with a dramatic small variance. We will tackle the parameter calibration problem for observed option prices with a multiscale volatility model. We will estimate the cost functional of this optimization problem with a martingale control variate strategy. We will propose efficient Monte Carlo simulations for statistics of hysteretic elastoplastic systems subjected to colored noise via a control variate estimator driven by approximation diffusion. We will introduce a new long excursion formulation to characterize and simulate efficiently the diffusivity properties related to dry friction with noise as experimentally studied by physicists. 我们提出了适用于一类广泛的随机微分方程（SDEs）的高效蒙特卡罗（MC）方法。这些方程可以具有多尺度属性或约束解。我们的方法将成为下一代MC技术的一部分，并提供有效的工具来满足科学、工业或社会挑战所需的基本需求。事实上，来自不同学科的专家需要对基于上述随机模型生成的数量进行建模和模拟。 在研究中，我们考虑了减少MC估计器方差的策略，例如控制变量和特殊方法，并将它们应用于SDEs、金融和材料科学的数值分析中。我们引入了一个控制变量估计器，用于表示扩散过程函数的期望。控制变量是使用相同的函数和随机过程构建的，该过程满足与扩散过程相同的方程，唯一的区别是我们用最优多项式来近似布朗运动。这将产生一个具有显著较小方差的实际控制变量估计器。 我们将运用多尺度波动模型来解决观察期权价格的参数校准问题。我们将使用鞅控制变量策略来估计这个优化问题的成本函数。此外，我们将提出有效的蒙特卡罗模拟方法，用于统计迟滞弹塑性系统受彩色噪声驱动时的近似扩散。最后，我们将介绍一种新的长偏移公式，以表征和高效地模拟与干摩擦噪声相关的扩散系数性质，该性质已由物理学家进行了实验研究

11303223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303223.value: 关于一类广义平均场博弈的研究

11303223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303223.value: The Mean Field Game (MFG) theory was introduced independently by Caines-Huang-Malhame and Lasry-Lions. It serves as a systematic framework for characterizing the continuum limits of N-player stochastic games, which are often simpler to analyze. The MFG theory has developed a rich mathematical theory and a wide variety of applications, including economics, engineering, finance, social science and many others. Though many efforts have been spent on the MFG theory in the past decade, the MFG framework is fundamentally limited to the games with homogeneous minor players where the mean field interaction is only via the distribution of their states. Apparently, many MFG models in the reality are beyond such well-studied ones. For instance, the real-world stock market consists of not only individual traders (with a small amount of money) but also fund companies (with a large amount of money). On one hand, a fund company itself can have a significant impact on the prices of stocks they trade and thus affect the individual traders' decisions. On the other hand, an individual trader has little influence on the prices of the traded stocks however all the individual traders as a whole can have an impact on the prices. This is a typical model of MFGs with major and minor players. Again take the stock market as an example. It is common sense that it is not good to buy a particular stock while other traders are buying but it is good to buy while others are selling. In such configuration, the traders act strategically, taking into account all the information they have (not just others' wealth). This leads to a Nash equilibrium, in which the mean field interaction depends on the others' strategies. This type of MFGs is called the MFG of controls. Our current proposed project is devoted to the systematic studies on the above two types of the MFG models: MFGs with a major player, and MFGs of controls. Our studies are expected through their master equations. The master equations serve as a powerful tool in the MFG framework and it decodes all the information on the MFG. One of the main methods to solve the master equations is via the corresponding mean field forward-backward stochastic differential equations. 平均场博弈理论是由Caines-Huang-Malhame和Lasry-Lions同时独立提出的。它作为描述有限玩家随机博弈极限的一个系统框架，往往更容易分析。平均场博弈理论不但蕴藏了丰富的数学理论，还具有广泛的实际应用。平均场博弈理论已被应用于经济学、工程学、金融学、社会科学等。 尽管过去十年人们在平均场博弈理论研究中付出大量努力，但是平均场博弈模型框架仍然局限于只具有同等次要玩家并且平均场相互作用仅依赖于所有玩家的状态分布。显然，现实中的平均场博弈模型往往都超出这一已知框架。例如，现实世界的股票市场中不仅有（拥有少量资金的）个人交易者还有（拥有大量资金的）基金公司。一方面，基金公司自身就可以对其交易的股票价格产生重大影响，从而左右个人交易者的决策。另一方面，单个个人交易者不会对其交易的股票价格产生太大影响，但是所有该股票的个人交易者作为一个整体会对其价格产生重大影响。这是一个典型的具有主要和次要玩家的平均场博弈模型。我们再次以股票市场为例描述一个平均场博弈模型。一个股票市场中的基本常识是当一个交易者想买入特定股票时其应该希望其他交易者卖出该股票而不是同时买入该股票。在这种情况下，交易者会考虑市场中的所有信息（不仅仅是其他交易者的财富信息）来做出买卖决策。这将使平均场博弈中的相互作用依赖于其他交易者的决策信息。此类平均场博弈模型被称为平均场博弈控制模型。 该项目致力于对上述两种平均场博弈模型进行系统研究。其主要方法是通过研究它们的主方程来得到平均场博弈中的所有信息。在平均场博弈理论中，主方程具有重要意义。求解主方程的重要办法之一是研究其对应的正倒向平均场随机微分方程。

11303923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11303923.value: 使用原位紫外光電子能譜研究電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面的電子結構

11303923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11303923.value: 在包括有機發光二極管和有機太陽能電池在內的有機光電器件中，電荷傳輸層被廣泛應用於增强器件性能。通過在電極和發光/光吸收層之間的界面插入一層電荷傳輸層，可以使界面形成合適的能級排列，並且顯著改善電荷的注入/提取（Nat. Mater. 17，329，2018）。在過去的30年裏，人們對有機光電器件中電荷傳輸層的特性進行了廣泛研究。具體來說，對於有機/有機界面，研究人員提出一些理論模型來解釋界面處的能級排列。（Nat. Mater. Rev. 4, 627,2019）；對於金屬氧化物/有機界面，在2009年，多倫多大學的Lu Zhenghong教授也提出了一個統一理論來描述實驗結果。（Nat. Mater. 11, 76, 2012）這些關於傳輸層界面能級的研究極大地促進了有機光電器件的發展。 近年來，作爲一種新興的光電材料，鈣鈦礦吸引了越來越多的關注。得益於過去二三十年中，從對有機光電器件的研究中積累的豐富經驗，鈣鈦礦太陽能電池在短短幾年時間就實現了非常高的器件效率。同時，以鈣鈦礦爲發光層的LED器件也因爲其優良的性能而得到大量關注。在這些鈣鈦礦光電器件中，包括有機或金屬氧化物在內的傳統電荷傳輸層仍然被廣泛使用。但是，相比於有機光活性層材料，由於鈣鈦礦材料擁有更多樣的組分結構和强離子特性，它與電荷傳輸層的界面也更複雜。因此我們有理由推測，電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦的界面擁有與傳統有機器件中的界面所不同的電子結構。雖然近期的一些研究報道了某些特定界面組合的電子結構信息，目前人們對於該領域的理解仍然非常局限。界面的能級對齊規則也仍然不清晰。所以，進一步研究電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦的界面是非常必要的。 最近，該項目申請人使用原位紫外光電子能譜技術對一系列電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面進行了初步研究。原位紫外光電子能譜是一種可以探測到界面電子結構的先進技術。在這些研究中，我們發現電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面顯示出與傳統的電荷傳輸層/有機物界面所不同的能級對齊趨勢。該結果也證明了深入研究電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦界面的必要性。因此，在該項目中，我們提議使用原位紫外光電子能譜結合其他表面分析技術的方法來研究更廣泛的電荷傳輸層/鈣鈦礦組合，從而提出一個統一理論來解釋該類界面的能級對齊方式。之後，我們將基於該理論提出一個電荷傳輸層的選擇策略，以期進一步優化和提升鈣鈦礦光電器件的性能。

11304723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304723.value: 胺類分子導線在pH, 電廠以及超分子相互作用的調控下的電輸運性質

11304723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304723.value: Amine is an important chemical group that appears ubiquitously in biological macromolecules including nucleic acids and proteins, as well as in synthetic organic materials such as approximately 42% of drugs and drug candidates. Understanding the fundamental role that amines play in constructing the physical properties that amine-containing materials exhibit is critically relevant in biomedicine and materials chemistry. However, there remain open questions about the specific electronic contributions of amines to the total transport properties of a material. For example, to control the electronic characteristics of amine-functionalized compounds by external stimuli is still a work in progress. Molecular junctions have emerged as a powerful platform for investigating the response of organic electronic materials to external stimuli at the single molecule level. Furthermore, this experimental approach allows us to relate the materials’ electronic and mechanical properties to their chemical composition, three-dimensional structures, and conformational dynamics. In this research, new molecular wires that are functionalized by amine groups will be implemented for constructing electronic circuits, however, the research focus is on how the electronic properties of these molecular wires will change upon a change in the environmental control. First, amines will be incorporated as chemical linkers, backbones, or side groups in a series of molecular wires, and single molecule conductance of these molecular wires under protonated and deprotonated states will be determined. Second, a dynamical response of single molecule conductance of amine compounds to a varying bias voltage and pH will be characterized, allowing us to probe the interplay between the two external controls. Next, host-guest complexes formed between a macrocycle and an amine-containing molecular wire will be attached to gold electrodes for determining whether and how the supramolecular interactions impact charge transport at nanoscale. Specific tuning of the supramolecular interactions in molecular junctions will be achieved by a modulation of the environmental pH. Last, novel functional molecular units will be explored. This project seeks to develop new chemical strategies and theories underlying the electronic response of amines to various external stimuli through the design and measurements of a series of structurally diverse amine compounds. The fundamental knowledge generated by this research will contribute to the general understanding of molecular electronic structures, nanoscale electrochemistry, and supramolecular assembly. 氨基是一類重要的化學官能團，在生物大分子中，例如核酸和蛋白質，以及合成的有機材料中，例如42%的藥品和候選藥品中，無處不在。理解氨基這個結構組成對物質性能的影響，對生物醫藥以及材料科學都有重要意義。然而，對於氨基是如何影響材料的輸運性質的，仍有很多疑問。例如，利用外加手段來調控氨基修飾的分子的電學性質仍是在進展中的一項工作。分子結，是探索研究有機電子材料對外加條件變化產生響應的一個非常有效的平台。而且，這個實驗方法使我們能夠將材料的電子和機械性能與它的化學組成，空間結構，以及空間構型的動態變化進行聯繫。在這個項目中，新的氨基修飾的分子導線會被用於構築電路，我們關注研究的核心是分子導線的性質在環境調控下是如何變化的。首先，我們會對胺類分子在質子化以及非質子化態下的單分子電導進行測試。其次，我們會改變所加電壓以及pH值，對胺類分子電導的變化進行研究，並探索這兩個外加控制的聯繫。之後，大環和包含氨基的分子鏈所組成的主客體化合物會被連接在電路中來確定超分子相互作用是否以及如何影響納米尺度下的電荷輸運。最後，新穎的功能分子模塊會被探究。這個項目通過設計和測試一系列結構各異的胺類分子來對外加環境如何調控胺類分子電子學性質這個問題進行深入研究。這個項目獲得的結果會積極推進我們對分子的電子結構的理解，以及推動納米電化學以及超分子組裝等領域的發展。

11304823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304823.value: 从量子信息扰动来理解量子混沌

11304823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304823.value: Quantum technology, such as quantum computation and quantum simulation, has become a new driving force for our society. Google recently confirmed quantum supremacy in a 53-qubit system [Nature 574, 505 (2019)], demonstrating the clear advantages of quantum computers over classical computers. At the heart of these technological advances is quantum information science. Due to its importance, the 2022 Nobel Prize in Physics is awarded to Alain Aspect, John Clauser, and Anton Zeilinger “for experiments with entangled photons, establishing the violation of Bell inequalities and pioneering quantum information science.” In order to manipulate quantum information in a device, we must understand its behavior in generic chaotic quantum many-body systems. One interesting feature of such systems is that they are expected to thermalize, which results in the effective loss of quantum information. Such a process is frequently referred to as quantum information scrambling. Although substantial efforts have been devoted to understanding this subject, a unifying understanding of how quantum information scrambling occurs is still lacking. In this proposal, we propose to tackle this problem using a tool called the out-of-time-ordered correlator (OTOC), which can potentially serve as a universal diagnostic to understand quantum information scrambling in a chaotic quantum many-body system. We will study this problem from two complementary angles. First, we will focus on physical systems with unique microscopic details. We have laid out two tasks in this direction: (A) To study OTOC in a Wannier-Stark lattice and (B) To study OTOC in systems with weak ergodicity breaking. We will analyze how unique microscopic details affect quantum information scrambling. Second, we will study models defined on unitary quantum circuits. The advantage of this approach is that we can focus on extracting universal features of quantum chaos without worrying about the details of specific systems. We have laid out one task in this direction: (C) To study OTOC and the spectral form factor in unitary quantum circuits. By combining research output from these two complementary angles, our proposal will produce fundamental new insights into the mechanism of quantum information scrambling in a generic chaotic quantum many-body system. These new insights will, in turn, contribute to the design of better quantum information processing devices. 量子計算和量子模擬等量子技術已成為我們社會的新動力。谷歌最近在一個有53個比特的量子系統中證實了量子霸權的存在[Nature 574 505 (2019)]，因而證明了量子計算機相對於經典計算機的明顯優勢。這些技術進步的核心是量子信息科學。由於其重要性，2022年諾貝爾物理學獎授予阿蘭·阿斯佩、約翰·克勞瑟和安東·塞林格。 為了更好地操控量子信息，我們必須了解其在一般混沌量子多體系統中的行為。這種系統的一個有趣的特徵是，它們預計會發生熱化，這會導致量子信息的逐漸損失。這種過程通常被稱為量子信息的擾動(quantum information scrambling)。儘管人們為理解這個現象付出了大量努力，但目前仍缺乏對於這個問題的統一的理解。 在本項目中，我們將使用一種稱為OTOC的理論工具來解決這個問題，該工具有可能作為一種通用的方法來理解混沌量子多體系統中的量子信息擾動。我們將從兩個互補的角度來研究這個問題。首先，我們將重點關注具有獨特微觀細節的物理系統。我們在這個方向上提出了兩項任務：（A）研究 Wannier-Stark 格子中的 OTOC；（B）研究具有弱遍歷性破壞的系統中的 OTOC。我們將分析獨特的微觀模型的細節如何影響量子信息擾亂。其次，我們將研究定義在酉量子電路(Unitary Quantum Circuits)上的模型。這種方法的優點是我們可以專注於提取量子混沌的普遍特徵，而不用擔心特定係統的細節。我們在這個方向上佈置了一項任務：(C) 研究酉量子電路中的 OTOC 和光譜形狀因子。通過結合這兩個互補角度的研究成果，我們的研究將對一個一般的混沌量子多體系統中的量子信息置亂機制產生根本性的新見解。這些新見解反過來將有助於設計更好的量子信息處理設備。

11304923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11304923.value: 细胞质膜贴附的四价铂抗癌光氧化剂以降低药物耐药性

11304923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11304923.value: Despite the continuing emergence of new antineoplastic modalities, such as immunotherapy, conventional chemotherapeutic agents remain the standard treatment for most cancers in the clinic. One of the major reasons for the failure of chemotherapy is drug resistance, which can arise via multiple mechanisms. In case of DNA-damaging agents, such as platinum-based drugs, several parallel mechanisms, including reduced uptake, increased efflux, enhanced DNA damage repair, and failure to induce apoptosis, are used by cancer cells to detoxify the drugs. Targeting one of these mechanisms alone may not be able to effectively overcome drug resistance. As such, a novel strategy that can bypass these intracellular resistance pathways is highly demanded, and such complexes with new action modes may also represent a direction for future development. Our preliminary data showed that a platinum(IV) complex based on carboplatin, a clinically-used platinum(II) drug, did not enter cancer cells but accumulated well in the plasma membrane where the complex remained stable prior to activation. In contrast to classical platinum(IV) prodrugs, upon irradiation with near-infrared light, our platinum(IV) complex acted as a photooxidant to oxidize lipids and proteins, releasing the original platinum(II) drug and axial ligands. Consequently, cell death occurred due to the loss of cell membrane integrity, and the platinum(IV) photooxidant exhibited significantly augmented photocytotoxicity compared with carboplatin, especially in platinum-refractory cancer cells. Based on this preliminary study, we will first design and synthesize analogues of the platinum(IV) photooxidant. The photooxidative properties and photoreduction processes of these complexes will be examined. Subsequently, in vitro evaluation and cellular mechanistic study on the membrane-targeted platinum(IV) photooxidants will be performed. We will also investigate the toxicity and antitumor efficacy of the lead compounds in vivo. Our proposed research represents a possible direction for developing photoactivatable platinum coordination complexes with novel modes of action; this strategy of anchoring platinum(IV) photooxidants to the cell membrane to inflict damage in a controllable fashion will likely lead to the discovery of several anticancer platinum(IV) coordination complexes that can trigger intracellular signaling cascades and effectively overcome platinum resistance. Such complexes will also broaden the family of organelle-targeted metallodrugs with controllable activation properties. 尽管免疫疗法等新型抗肿瘤方案不断涌现，传统化疗依旧是临床中治疗多种癌症的标准手段。化疗失败的主要原因之一是由多种机制引起的肿瘤耐药。以DNA损伤药物比如顺铂为例，癌细胞可以通过降低药物摄取、增强药物排出、加强DNA损伤修复并避免凋亡等并行机制减轻药物毒性，而针对其中单一机制可能无法有效克服耐药性。因此，迫切需要开发一类以新的作用机制绕过这些耐药通路的化合物，为将来的药物研发提供方向。在临床铂类药物卡铂的基础上，我们合成了一种新的四价铂前药；初步实验显示它会聚集在细胞膜上而非进入细胞内部，并在光激活前保持稳定。与传统铂类药物不同的是，该化合物在近红外光激活下会作为光氧化剂氧化脂质和蛋白质，释放出卡铂和轴向配体，破坏细胞膜完整性从而杀死细胞。相较于卡铂，该四价铂光氧化剂在耐药细胞中的光毒性显著提升。在前期研究的基础上，我们首先将设计合成一系列四价铂光氧化剂，研究这类配合物的光氧化性质和光还原过程。随后，将开展靶向细胞膜的四价铂光氧化剂的体外实验以及细胞层面作用机制研究。我们也会探究先导化合物在活体中的抗肿瘤活性和毒性。本项目将为研发具有新颖作用机制的光激活四价铂配合物提供思路：将四价铂光氧化剂黏附在细胞膜上，从而绕过癌细胞内的耐药机制以可控的方式杀伤细胞，启动一系列细胞内信号级联通路，并有效克服铂药耐药性。这项研究亦可进一步扩大靶向细胞器的可控激活金属药物家族。

11305223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11305223.value: 用於水下成像和傳感的雙目超透鏡

11305223.label: Project Objectives
11305223.value: Learning from the nature creator, we will design a novel binocular meta-lens system for underwater stereo vision. The gallium nitride (GaN) cylindrical nano-antennas will be precisely calculated and designed to provide a full 2π phase modulation for the focusing phase arrangement. The polarization-independent GaN-based binocular meta-lens will be able to work for arbitrary polarization light to implement the compact configuration of the underwater stereo imaging system. To fabricate the binocular meta-lens optical chips with specifically designed geometric shape, feature size, and local surface roughness, we carefully considered the limitations of fabrications, critical dimensions, and empirical parameters of the production process for the precisely designed nano-antennas layout and masks. Experimentally, we use advanced semiconductor electronics manufacturing processes, such as electron-beam lithography (EBL), thermal evaporation, electron-gun deposition, atomic layer deposition (ALD), plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), dry etching, wet etching, and lift-off process, etc. for our binocular meta-lens fabrication. To characterize the fabricated binocular meta-lens, we use ellipsometer, scanning electron microscope, atomic force microscope, optical spectrometer, home-made focusing profile and light field optical sectioning system, etc. for the measurements of the physical features and dimensions, optical refractive index (n) & extinction coefficient (k), transmission and reflection spectrum, local surface roughness, optical efficiency, point spread function, etc. To analyze the hydrophobicity of the GaN-based binocular meta-lens. The hydrophobicity measurement and characterization will verify the intrinsic super-hydrophobicity properties of our nanostructured GaN meta-lens, which enable anti-adhesion, stain-resistant, and self-cleaning functions for our novel underwater imaging device. To develop the generalized depth calculation formula for the binocular meta-lens imaging system in underwater stereo vision. The new generalized depth calculation formula can be used for all-size binocular vision systems, i.e., both our small miniaturized meta-lens and large lenses of the traditional optical camera. The disparity imaging data containing objects is extracted with the captured image through the matching algorithm. Deep learning will be introduced to image processing to improve data processing efficiency. Deep learning enables this stereo vision system to realize the fast underwater object's depth and image computation for real-time processing capability, and reduce the imaging degradation effect in the aquatic environment. To demonstrate the intelligent underwater stereo vision binocular meta-lens system for imaging and depth sensing in clean water and scattering environments, we will use our binocular meta-lens system to experimentally investigate the obtained imaging and depth information using the deep learning method. We expect our results will show an innovative and novel underwater meta-optical imaging and sensing system.
rows: Learning from the nature creator, we will design a novel binocular meta-lens system for underwater stereo vision. The gallium nitride (GaN) cylindrical nano-antennas will be precisely calculated and designed to provide a full 2π phase modulation for the focusing phase arrangement. The polarization-independent GaN-based binocular meta-lens will be able to work for arbitrary polarization light to implement the compact configuration of the underwater stereo imaging system.

To fabricate the binocular meta-lens optical chips with specifically designed geometric shape, feature size, and local surface roughness, we carefully considered the limitations of fabrications, critical dimensions, and empirical parameters of the production process for the precisely designed nano-antennas layout and masks. Experimentally, we use advanced semiconductor electronics manufacturing processes, such as electron-beam lithography (EBL), thermal evaporation, electron-gun deposition, atomic layer deposition (ALD), plasma-enhanced chemical vapor deposition (PECVD), dry etching, wet etching, and lift-off process, etc. for our binocular meta-lens fabrication.

To characterize the fabricated binocular meta-lens, we use ellipsometer, scanning electron microscope, atomic force microscope, optical spectrometer, home-made focusing profile and light field optical sectioning system, etc. for the measurements of the physical features and dimensions, optical refractive index (n) & extinction coefficient (k), transmission and reflection spectrum, local surface roughness, optical efficiency, point spread function, etc.

To analyze the hydrophobicity of the GaN-based binocular meta-lens. The hydrophobicity measurement and characterization will verify the intrinsic super-hydrophobicity properties of our nanostructured GaN meta-lens, which enable anti-adhesion, stain-resistant, and self-cleaning functions for our novel underwater imaging device.

To develop the generalized depth calculation formula for the binocular meta-lens imaging system in underwater stereo vision. The new generalized depth calculation formula can be used for all-size binocular vision systems, i.e., both our small miniaturized meta-lens and large lenses of the traditional optical camera. The disparity imaging data containing objects is extracted with the captured image through the matching algorithm. Deep learning will be introduced to image processing to improve data processing efficiency. Deep learning enables this stereo vision system to realize the fast underwater object's depth and image computation for real-time processing capability, and reduce the imaging degradation effect in the aquatic environment.

To demonstrate the intelligent underwater stereo vision binocular meta-lens system for imaging and depth sensing in clean water and scattering environments, we will use our binocular meta-lens system to experimentally investigate the obtained imaging and depth information using the deep learning method. We expect our results will show an innovative and novel underwater meta-optical imaging and sensing system.

11305223.value: 水下環境的光學應用對於環境管理、生物地球化學、浮游植物生態、底棲過程、全球變化等都至關重要。許多用於水下成像和深度傳感的光學技術已經被開發出來。 雙目立體視覺是觀察目標和檢測深度的基本方法，例如大自然對於人類或某些捕食動物的雙目配置。 目前在工程上，雙目立體視覺系統由兩個相機組成，需要復雜的數據轉換來標定與校正兩個相機系統。 最重要的是，對於體積龐大且結構複雜的雙目立體視覺光學系統來說，水下應用場景可能會變得狹窄且難以到達。 這對各種水下環境來說都是一個艱難挑戰，導致了對緊湊且高效的集成光學系統的高度需求。 超構元件是先進新穎的平面光學器件，由亞波長納米天線組成。 光學超構元件可以操縱入射電磁波的相位、幅度、偏振等。超構元件可實現超越原始天然光學材料和傳統光學元件的新穎功能。 光學超構元件的優點是重量輕、緊湊、耐用、用途廣泛。 這個研究項目中，我們提出了一種用於水下深度傳感和成像的新型雙目超構元件光學設備。 考慮到對溫度、濕度和壓力等環境條件的耐受性，我們選擇氮化鎵作為超透鏡的基礎材料。 氮化鎵是一種化學和機械都非常穩定的化合物，對極端條件的環境具有很高的抵抗力。 氮化鎵雙目超透鏡經過特殊設計和先進微納製造，用於演示水下立體視覺和深度傳感。 相比於傳統的雙相機立體視覺系統需要校正，我們的雙目超構元件的優點是沒有球面相位像差，並且不需要畸變校正或相機校準， 我們期望成像和深度測量的結果可以是光學衍射極限。 同時，我們將開發全尺寸雙目視覺系統的廣義深度計算公式。 我們還將引入深度學習進行圖像處理，以提高數據處理效率，實現快速的實時深度和圖像計算。 除了平面元光學元件的無像差優勢外，我們的納米結構 氮化鎵雙目超透鏡固有的超疏水特性將實現防粘附、防污和自清潔的新型水下成像設備。 我們相信該項目的重大影響可以推動下一代水下光學器件和系統的革命，例如水下環境微納機器人、微型潛艇機器視覺、海洋生態調查等。

11305523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11305523.value: 本項目的目的是發展由可壓縮歐拉方程控制的多維穩態接觸間斷的嚴格數學理論。 特別是，我们主要關注凸角楔上超音速流動的三維接觸間斷的全域存在性，軸對稱管道中跨音速接觸間斷的穩定性以及其他相關問題。 正如Courant-Friedrichs在[24]中所說，可壓縮流體表現出明顯的非線性現象，例如馬赫反射和射流。所有這些現象都可以由基本波及其相互作用來表述。作為基本波之一，由於在應用中的重要性和複雜性，接觸間斷引起了人們的極大興趣。在本項目中，我們將通過研究幾個重要的結構來研究接觸間斷的穩定性。確切地說，我們將首先嘗試在軸對稱管道中建立三維跨音速接觸間斷的穩定性。接下來，我們將考慮凸角楔塊上三維跨音速射流的全局存在性以及其他相關問題。 在數學上，這些問題可以表述為由雙曲橢圓混合型非線性方程控制下的自由邊界問題。關鍵的困難來自於接觸間斷是一個自由邊界，其兩側的狀態是未知的，並且它是高超音速側的特徵面。特別是與其他困難點相結合，例如非線性，角點奇點等。到目前為止，關於可壓縮歐拉方程控制下的二維定常接觸間斷的存在性和穩定性已經有很多文獻。繼續研究三維定常接觸間斷是很自然的。然而，針對此類問題的嚴謹數學理論遠未得到滿足。我們相信本項目中發展的想法和技術將有助於多維守恆定律的數學理論。偏微分方程和數學流體動力學領域的其他數學家也會對這項工作感興趣。 幾年來，我們一直在研究相關問題。我們在 [30] 中建立了有限長管道中超音速接觸間斷的穩定性;[31]中有限長管道中跨音速接觸間斷的穩定性;[36]中含跨音速激波的射流問題的全域存在性和唯一性;[37]中三維稀疏波和接觸間斷的局部穩定性;在無限長軸對稱管道中具有非平凡的漩渦的歐拉流的全域存在性 [25];[9]中具有大旋度的無限長管道中二維定常接觸間斷的全域存在性和唯一性;[5]中楔形上三維弱跨音速激波的穩定性。在本項目中，我們將主要關注上述工作中使用的技術的進一步發展，以研究上述目標。

11305823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11305823.value: 布朗圈集和随机共形几何

11305823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11305823.value: 布朗圈集是由Lawler和Werner引进的。布朗圈是一个从同一点开始和结束的布朗运动，而布朗圈集是一个随机的布朗圈的集合。布朗圈集的定义有一个强度系数c>0，c越大布朗圈集里就有更多的布朗圈。布朗圈集的分布是共形不变的，它和其它许多共形几何里的重要模型都有密切关联。 布朗圈集首先可以被视作一个几何对象。布朗圈集里的布朗圈互相交叉形成的连通集称为簇。Werner和Sheffield证明了布朗圈集在c=1时出现相变：如果c<=1，则一个有限领域内的布朗圈集几乎必然形成无限多个簇；如果c>1，则几乎必然只形成一个簇。 在之前的工作中，我们分析了c<=1时布朗圈集中簇的内部结构。对于临界值c=1，我们进一步将所有和簇边界相交的布朗圈分解成了一个布朗游走的泊松点过程。本项目的第一个目标是研究如何反向从这个泊松点过程重构布朗圈。这个问题和另一个问题紧密相关：簇的边界上是否存在被布朗圈多次访问的点。在一个最近的工作中，我们证明了当c<1时，簇的边界上存在被访问两次的点。然而临界情况c=1更为复杂，我们计划在将来工作中解决。这些多次访问点的Hausdorff维数和一些一般化的相交、隔离的指数直接相关。我们在过去的一个工作中定义了这些指数，并准备在将来进一步研究。 布朗圈集里的每个布朗圈都带有时间参数，所以布朗圈集也定义了一个局部时场。在临界c=1时，这个场就是高斯自由场的平方，这一结果也叫做“同构定理”。在本项目中，我们计划对每个c<1的情形建立一个共共形不变的场，并建立c<1的同构定理。这样的场在之前从未被构建，它的建立将会引出许许多多有意义的新问题。
