11306723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11306723.value: 關於有限溫度核弗雷德霍姆行列式的研究

11306723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11306723.value: Determinantal point processes are important stochastic models in both mathematics and physics. They are closely related to numerous research topics, such as random matrix theory, Dyson Brownian motion, free fermionic theory, quantum gravity, etc. A central objective in the study of determinantal point processes is to understand the probability that there are exactly certain number of points in a given interval. It is well-known that this probability can be expressed in terms of Fredholm determinants of integral operators with corresponding correlation kernels. Based on this remarkable relation, various significant results have been obtained in the literature, such as explicit expressions of the probability, the large gap asymptotics, the rigidity bounds, etc. In recent years, motivated by quantum mechanics and other interesting models, there are a considerable amount of research interests in Fredholm determinants associated with kernels under finite temperature deformations. Although breakthrough has been made, there are still many significant problems unsolved. In this project, we plan to study Fredholm determinants associated with finite-temperature kernels using matrix-valued and operator-valued Riemann-Hilbert problems. We will derive the explicit expressions, and establish their relation with integrable systems. Furthermore, we will try to derive large gap asymptotics of these Fredholm determinants under various scaling limits, when width of the gap tends to infinity. 行列式點過程是數學和物理學中重要的隨機模型。它們與諸多研究課題密切相關，如隨機矩陣理論、戴森布朗運動、自由費米子理論、量子引力等。研究行列式點過程的一個中心目標是獲取在給定區間內，恰好存在一定數量的點的概率。眾所周知，這個概率可以用相應相關核的積分算子的弗雷德霍姆行列式來表示。基於這個重要關係，研究者們已經獲得了許多重要的結果，如該概率的顯式表達式、大間隙漸近、剛性間隙等。近年來，在量子力學和其他有趣模型的推動下，人們對與有限溫度變形下的核相關的弗雷德霍姆行列式產生了相當大的研究興趣。這方面的研究，雖然已取得了一些突破，但仍有許多重要問題尚待解決。 在本項目中，我們計劃採用矩陣值和算子值黎曼-希爾伯特問題來研究與有限溫度核相關的弗雷德霍姆行列式。我們將推導它們的顯式表示式，並建立其與可積系統的關係。此外，當間隙寬度趨於無窮大時，我們將研究這些弗雷德霍姆行列式的大間隙漸近性質。

11307323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11307323.value: 高效鈣鈦礦/有機串聯太陽電池的模擬設計與製造策略

11307323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307323.value: To tackle the daunting challenges of increasing global energy demand and achieving carbon neutrality simultaneously to preserve the environment, it is imperative to develop a viable solution that combines the development of novel materials and scalable processing methods to produce clean energy. The emergence of both solution-processed organic and metal halide perovskite semiconductors and their derived solar cells has the potential to transform the landscape of photovoltaic technology in delivering scalable and high-performance solar cells to provide sustainable green energy. While the power conversion efficiencies (PCEs) of both single-junction organic solar cells (OSCs) and perovskite solar cells (PSCs) are rapidly ascending to >19% and >25%, respectively, their maximum efficiency is limited to ~30% accordingly to the Shockley-Queisser model for single-junction devices. However, it is possible to significantly increase the efficiency of solar cells to over 40% by constructing a multi-junction (or tandem) device that consists of multiple light absorbers with considerably different bandgaps to reduce the overall transmission and thermalization losses of the solar cells. In this project, we will develop high-performance monolithic perovskite/organic tandem solar cells (TSCs) comprising a wide bandgap (WBG) perovskite front cell and a narrow bandgap (NBG) organic rear cell connected through a recombination junction. The WBG (Eg: 1.7-1.85 eV) PSCs are chosen for the front cell due to their strong and broad absorption for visible light, smaller voltage loss, and higher photoresponse when compared to their organic counterparts with approximate bandgap. While NBG (Eg: 1.1-1.25 eV) OSCs can potentially offer better near-infrared absorption tunability and stability compared with the Sn-based NBG perovskites, making them favorable candidates for the rear cell of the tandem cells. Moreover, the advantage of the perovskite and organic light absorbing layers being processed from orthogonal solvents imposes fewer constraints on the choice of the materials for constructing the recombination junction and provides better flexibility on the device design of TSCs. To demonstrate state-of-the-art perovskite/organic TSCs, an integrated strategy combining materials, interface, optical, and process engineering will be adopted to optimize the two subcells and the interconnect junction simultaneously. In addition, a comprehensive optoelectronic model will also be developed to simulate the electrical and optical properties of the TSCs and to provide guidelines to optimize their device performance. The successful implementation of this proposed project will have far-reaching impacts on developing high-efficiency, low-cost and scalable TSC technology and will further pave the way for its commercialization. 為了應對全球能源需求不斷增長和碳中和的雙重挑戰，我們必須使用新型材料開發可持續方案來生產清潔能源。而可溶液加工的有機和金屬鹵化物鈣鈦礦半導體為製備高效、低成本、可大規模生產的太陽能電池提供了可行方案。儘管單結有機太陽能電池和鈣鈦礦太陽能電池的能量轉換效率 (Power conversion efficiency, PCE) 已分別升至 >19% 和 >25%，但多結器件的效率更具潛力，理論效率可超過 40%。 在這個項目中，我們將開發具有寬帶隙（Wide Bandgap, WBG）鈣鈦礦前子電池和窄帶隙（Narrow bandgap, NBG）有機頂部後電池的高性能鈣鈦礦/有機串聯太陽能電池（Tandem solar cells, TSC）。前部電池選擇對可見光具有廣泛吸收和電壓損失較小的WBG鈣鈦礦電池，而後部電池則選擇具有更好穩定性和近紅外吸收可調性的NBG有機電池。 為了開發高性能的 TSC，我們將採用結合材料、界面、光學和工藝工程的整體策略進行優化。此外，還將開發一個全面的光電模型用於模擬和優化器件結構指導。該項目的成功實施將對開發高效、低成本、可大規模製備的TSC技術產生重大影響，進一步促進其商業化。

11307623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11307623.value: 通過光敏劑誘導的靶向蛋白質降解來觸發鐵死亡以增強抗腫瘤免疫

11307623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307623.value: Proteolysis-targeting chimera (PROTAC) has emerged as a promising technology for targeted protein degradation. By using a tailor-made protein degrader consisting of a ligand that can bind to a protein of interest and another ligand that can bind to an E3 ubiquitin ligase connected covalently with an appropriate linker, it can degrade disease-causing proteins by hijacking the ubiquitin–proteasome system. This approach has found potential application in cancer treatment. Despite the various advantages, this strategy still has some limitations that hinder its clinical translation. The PROTACs developed so far generally show low systemic bioavailability and limited cell permeability. The off-target biodistribution due to the non-selective expression of E3 ligases in the target and normal cells, as well as the Hook effect that favors the formation of binary over ternary complexes may also lead to severe side effects and reduced potency, respectively. Moreover, the options of E3 ligases remain very limited. An alternative approach has recently been proposed which utilizes a photosensitizer conjugated with a protein-binding ligand to generate reactive oxygen species (ROS) upon light irradiation for degradation of the bound protein. The molecular design of these protein degraders is simpler and more flexible. As E3 ligases are no longer the weapon for protein degradation, this approach can resolve the relevant drawbacks and relax the requirements of the linkers, and just the protein targeting would be a critical issue. Moreover, owing to the short diffusion range of the short-lived ROS, the degradation of proteins can occur with high spatiotemporal precision. However, development of this approach is still in the infancy, and only a handful of examples have been reported so far. As a result, we propose herein a project to develop novel photosensitizers for targeted photodegradation of two important proteins, namely the cysteine/glutamate antiporter system Xc- and the lipid repair enzyme glutathione peroxidase 4 with a view to triggering immunogenic cell death through ferroptosis, which is a unique form of regulated cell death. The proposed studies involve the design and synthesis of a series of zinc(II) phthalocyanine-based photosensitizers substituted with an inhibitor of these proteins and a tumor-targeting peptide to promote the cellular uptake into the target cells. It is believed that these conjugates can induce photodegradation of these proteins specifically, triggering ferroptotic cell death and potent antitumor immunity. This hypothesis will be validated through a series of carefully designed experiments with a range of cell lines and tumor-bearing mice. 蛋白酶降解靶向技術（Proteolysis-Targeting Chimera，簡稱PROTAC）已經成為一項有前景的技術，用於實現蛋白質的有針對性降解。該技術利用一種定制的蛋白質降解劑，由一個與目標蛋白結合的配體和另一個可結合E3泛素連接酶的配體，通過適當的連接物共價結合組成。通過劫持泛素-蛋白酶體系統，該技術能夠降解導致疾病的蛋白質。在癌症治療中，這一方法顯示出潛在的應用前景。儘管具備多種優點，但該策略仍存在一些限制，制約了其在臨床上的應用。目前為止，已開發的PROTAC通常表現出較低的系統生物利用度和有限的細胞穿透性。 E3連接酶配體難以特異性靶向腫瘤細胞，常常在目標細胞和正常細胞中出現“脫靶”現象，以及“Hook效應” 導致二元復合物的形成多於三元復合物，這些都可能導致嚴重的副作用和療效的降低。此外，已開發可用的E3連接酶選擇有限。所以另一種替代方法被提出，該方法利用與蛋白質結合的配體結合的光敏劑，在光照照射下產生活性氧（Reactive Oxygen Species，簡稱ROS），從而降解所結合的蛋白質。這些蛋白質降解劑的分子設計更為簡單和靈活。因為E3連接酶不再是蛋白質降解的關鍵因素，使得這一方法能夠克服相關的限制，並減輕對連接物的要求，所以只需要專注在蛋白質的靶向這個研究方向。此外，由於ROS的存在時間極短，擴散範圍有限，令蛋白質的降解可以在高精度的條件下進行。然而，這一方法的發展仍處於初級階段，迄今為止只有少數幾個示例報導。因此，我們在此提出一個項目，旨在開發新型光敏劑，通過靶向光誘導降解半胱氨酸/谷氨酸抗運輸體系統Xc-和脂質修復酶穀胱甘肽過氧化物酶4 ，從而誘導鐵死亡並觸發免疫原性細胞死亡。該項目將通過一系列精心設計的實驗，在多種細胞系和攜帶腫瘤的小鼠模型中進行驗證。

11307823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11307823.value: 集成量子態光源和片上量子干涉儀

11307823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11307823.value: Quantum states of light such as squeezed states and entangled states have found many applications in quantum technologies such as quantum metrology, quantum sensing, quantum information processing, quantum computing, and quantum communication. These quantum-oriented technologies promise superior performance to their classical counterparts. In the meantime, interferometric technique is widely used in precision measurement and optical remote sensing, and is the fundamental building block for quantum computing. Construction using the hardware with quantum entanglement leads to a novel type of quantum interferometer with advantages over traditional classical interferometers. Protocols for these have all been demonstrated in laboratory table-top settings. However, for practical real-world applications especially in quantum sensing and quantum computing, it is highly desirable to have the aforementioned sources and devices constructed in integrated platforms for portability and scalability. Integrated systems also have the advantages of strong quantum nonlinear interaction accompanied with low loss, which are all crucial for the delicate quantum effects. In this research program, we will design, construct, and test a number of integrated quantum devices for generating squeezed states and entangled states on-chip. The devices will be constructed on two platforms of periodically poled lithium niobate (PPLN) wave guide and silica glass micro-ring resonator, respectively. As the first application of these devices, we will construct a novel quantum nonlinear interferometer with these quantum devices and demonstrate quantum advantages in phase sensing. The developed devices can also serve as a part of measurement elements to achieve on-chip quantum measurement, which avoids the detrimental effect of losses in chip coupling process. This will pave the way for miniaturization of quantum sensors and large-scale quantum computing. The program implements the mature quantum optical technology in an integrated platform, making it a step closer for large scale real-world applications. The robustness of the integrated systems is ideal for implementing quantum interference processes, which are key elements in optical quantum computing. Potential industrial transfer of the quantum technology in sensing applications will be straightforward with the success of the program. The design and testing of the on-chip quantum devices require a deep understanding of quantum physics, which provides a perfect platform for training next generation quantum physicists and preparing them for the on-going quantum revolution. 光的量子態，如壓縮態和糾纏態，在量子測量、量子傳感、量子資訊處理、量子計算和量子通信等量子科技中有許多應用。 這些量子技術有望獲得優於經典技術的效能。 同時，干涉測量技術被廣泛應用於精密測量和光學遙感，並是量子計算的基本組成部分。 使用具有量子糾纏的硬件進行構建干涉儀便形成了一種新型的量子干涉儀，該干涉儀具有超越傳統經典干涉儀的優勢。 所有這些都已在實驗室平臺上進行了演示。 然而，對於現實世界的實際應用，特別是在量子傳感和量子計算中，在集成平臺中構建上述量子光源和設備是非常具有吸引力的，這可以方便攜帶以及實現可擴展性。 集成系統還具有很强的量子非線性相互作用和低損耗的優點，這些對於脆弱的量子效應都至關重要。 在本研究項目中，我們將設計、構建和測試多種集成量子器件，並在晶片上產生壓縮態和糾纏態。 這些器件將分別構建在週期性極化鈮酸鋰（PPLN）波導和矽玻璃微環諧振器兩個平臺上。 作為這些器件的首次應用，我們將用它們構建一種新型的量子非線性干涉儀，並展示在相位傳感方面的量子優勢。 所開發的器件還可以作為測量元件的一部分，實現片上量子測量。這將避免晶片耦合過程中損耗的不利影響，並為量子傳感器的小型化和大規模量子計算鋪平道路。 該項目在一個集成平臺上實現業已成熟的量子光學技术，使其離大規模的實際應用又近了一步。 集成系統的魯棒性是實現量子干涉過程的理想選擇，而量子干涉則是光量子計算的關鍵元素。 隨著該項目的成功實施，量子科技在傳感應用中的潜在產業轉移將是直接的。 晶片上量子器件的設計和測試需要對量子物理學有深入的瞭解，這為培訓下一代量子物理學家並為正在進行的量子革命做好準備提供了一個完美的平臺。

11308223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11308223.value: 用於自由空間傳播波和導波之間非互易轉換的超原子和超表面

11308223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308223.value: Lorentz reciprocity is a fundamental theorem in classical electromagnetism that implies a symmetric response of the systems under the interchange of source and detector. Breaking the Lorentz reciprocity can open numerous possibilities for exploring new physics and realizing novel optical properties. Optical nonreciprocity can be realized by several mechanisms, including nonlinearity, external field biasing, and time modulation. It has been applied to manipulate various properties of light, leading to many essential optical devices and applications such as optical isolators, optical circulators, invisible sensing, and full-duplex communications. Conventional research mainly focused on the nonreciprocal manipulation of free-space propagating waves (FPWs) or guided waves (GWs) separately. In this proposed project, we plan to conduct theoretical and experimental study on the nonreciprocal conversion between FPWs and GWs. We aim to realize the unidirectional conversion between the two types of waves, i.e., allowing the conversion from one type to the other but suppressing the reversed conversion. We will design meta-atoms (i.e., artificial resonating unit) breaking the local time-reversal symmetry and enabling nonreciprocal conversion between FPWs and GWs. We will then apply the meta-atoms to design metasurfaces to achieve efficient nonreciprocal conversion between FPWs and GWs. In addition, we will engineer the metasurfaces to control the directionality of the converted GWs to realize wave steering and focusing. The project is grounded on the PI’s expertise in nanophotonics and metasurfaces and is expected to generate rich outputs. It will offer new mechanisms for achieving efficient one-way conversion between FPWs and GWs, facilitating the development of photonic integrated circuits and light energy harvesting technologies. It will generate metasurfaces with new functionalities for designing ultra-thin optical devices in the era of flat optics. The results will contribute to a comprehensive understanding of Lorentz reciprocity in optical systems and will also benefit the research of non-Hermitian physics and topological photonics where nonreciprocal hopping plays an essential role. 洛倫茲互易性是經典電磁學的一個基本定理，對應系統在源和探測器互換情況下的對稱響應，打破洛倫茲互易性可以帶來很多新的物理和光學性質。光學非互易性可以利用非線性、偏置外場和時間調製等機制實現，已被應用於調控光的各種屬性，產生了諸多重要的光器件和應用，例如光隔離器、光環行器、隱形傳感和全雙工通信。既往研究主要針對自由空間傳播波或導波進行單獨的非互易調控。在本項目中，我們將利用理論和實驗方法研究傳播波和導波之間的非互易轉換，實現兩種類型波之間的單向轉換。我們將設計共振超原子，打破局部時間反演對稱性，然後利用超原子來設計超表面，以實現傳播波和導波之間的高效非互易轉換。此外，我們還將設計超表面來控制導波的方向性，以實現導波的轉向和聚焦。該項目預計將產生豐富的成果，提供實現空間傳播波和導波之間高效單向轉換的新機制，促進光集成電路和光能收集技術的發展，產生用於設計超薄光器件的新功能超表面。這些成果有助於我們全面理解光學系統的洛倫茲互易性，也有助於發展非厄米物理和拓撲光學相關研究。

11308323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11308323.value: 基于机器学习的计算概率测量空间最小能量路径的弦方法

11308323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308323.value: 本提案研究了随机相互作用粒子系统中多个平衡分布之间的噪声诱导转移路径。这些相互作用粒子系统出现在统计物理学、材料科学、社会科学、经济学和机器学习等各个领域的应用中。随着粒子数量趋近于无穷大，粒子分布具有平均场极限，由定义在概率测度空间上的明确定义的自由能的Wasserstein梯度流描述。然而，相互作用通常会产生多个最小化自由能的稳定测度。因此，对于有限数量的粒子，经验分布可以在概率空间中在这些不同的亚稳态之间切换。这种突变或转变通常被称为罕见事件，虽然发生频率非常低，但在系统层面上具有重要影响。了解转变如何发生的常见方法是基于大偏差理论和最小作用原理来数值地研究最优转移路径。这条路径可以在自由能景观上得到很好的几何描述，并被称为最小能量路径(MEP)。 研究这条路径最突出的方法可能是弦方法，这是一种基于梯度的几何方法，用于计算MEP。 本项目旨在攻克概率测量空间中串方法的两个挑战：(1)如何在无限维的概率测度空间中数值近似曲线；(2)如何在缺乏欧几里得度量的情况下设计计算效率高的动力学，以在Wasserstein流形上演化路径。我们使用最近出现的科学机器学习技术，提供全面高效的数值解决方案。我们提出了两种方法：(1)我们采用欧拉观点将曲线视为静态模型，并将深度神经网络构造为概率密度函数曲线的函数，通过物理信息神经网络(PINN)方法的思想来解决训练算法的核心问题；(2)我们采用拉格朗日动态观点，通过将曲线与流映射关联来探索新的参数化概率测度曲线，并通过归一化流技术离散化流映射，设计弦动力学来找到最优参数。 这些结果将推进在高维状态的概率空间中各种自由能的路径查找方法，并实现以交互粒子系统建模的应用中罕见事件的数据驱动研究。

11308923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11308923.value: 二维过渡金属硫族化物的电化学锂离子插层与剥离策略，用于相调控和能源方面的应用

11308923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11308923.value: Two-dimensional (2D) transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), a rising star in the post-graphene era, constitute a charming material library. Electrochemical lithium intercalation and exfoliation strategy (developed by our group) is a powerful tool for the scalable production of the atomically thin materials. Interestingly, semiconducting-to-metallic phase transitions are often induced during the electrochemical lithium intercalation process, making the exfoliated final products (atomically thin TMDs) differ structurally and electronically from their starting counterparts (bulk crystals). Still, the in-depth phase transition mechanism remains to be clarified, and the correlation between phases and lithium intercalation amounts has not been investigated. These scientific issues will be addressed in this project, before delving into the energy application of the produced 2D TMDs. Firstly, the phase evolution and its in-depth mechanism are planned to be clarified with the help of the state-of-the-art in-situ and ex-situ characterization technologies. In-situ X-ray diffraction (XRD), Raman, and transmission electron microscope (TEM) will undertake the task of detecting the new-emerging phases of TMDs during lithium intercalation in real time and in operando. The Ex-situ high angle angular dark field-scanning transmission electron microscopy (HAADF-STEM) is intended to be used to directly observe the lithium occupancy and the zigzag-chain arrangements of atoms in lithium intercalated TMDs. Secondly, MoS2 and TaS2 nanosheets are planned to be exfoliated from MoS2, Li0.1MoS2, Li0.3MoS2, Li0.5MoS2, Li0.8MoS2, Li1.1MoS2, and Li1.4MoS2, as well as, TaS2, Li0.1TaS2, Li0.2TaS2, Li0.5TaS2, Li0.7TaS2, and LiTaS2. Ex-situ multimodal characterizations will follow shortly, including HAADF-STEM, Raman, XRD, X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS), and atomic force microscope (AFM), to investigate the phase, electronic structure, and morphology of the exfoliated TMDs nanosheets. By comparing the data with only lithium intercalated TMDs, we plan to uncover the underlying mechanism of the exfoliation process to the final properties of the exfoliated TMDs. Thirdly, supercapacitor electrodes will be fabricated using the exfoliated TMDs nanosheets with different phases (2H, 1T and 1T’) and different lithium intercalation amounts. Then, their supercapacitor performances will be investigated. On this basis, we will summarize how phases and lithium intercalation amounts influence the supercapacitor performance. The successful implementation of this proposal is expected to lead to a comprehensive understanding of lithium intercalation and exfoliation mechanism on TMDs. The results can provide us an effective guidance for tuning phase and lithium intercalation amounts of the exfoliated TMDs nanosheets on constructing TMDs based electrodes with superior electrochemical capacitance for energy application. 电化学锂离子插层和剥离策略是大规模制备原子薄层材料的有力工具。有趣的是，在电化学锂插层过程中经常引起相变，使剥离后的最终产物（原子薄层TMDs）在结构和电子方面与其起始对应物（块晶体）有所不同。然而，深入的相变机制仍需澄清，相与锂离子插层数量之间的关系尚未被研究。这些科学问题将在这个项目中得以解决，然后再探讨所产生的二维TMDs在能源方面的应用。 首先，计划利用先进的原位和非原位表征技术来澄清相演变及其深层机制。原位X射线衍射（XRD）、拉曼和透射电子显微镜（TEM）将用于探测TMDs在锂插层过程中新出现的相。同时采用非原位的高角度环形暗场扫描透射电子显微镜（HAADF-STEM）来直接观察锂插层TMDs中的锂的占位和原子的的排列。 其次，计划从MoS2、Li0.1MoS2、Li0.3MoS2、Li0.5MoS2、Li0.8MoS2、Li1.1MoS2和Li1.4MoS2以及TaS2、Li0.1TaS2、Li0.2TaS2、Li0.5TaS2、Li0.7TaS2和LiTaS2中剥离出MoS2和TaS2纳米片。随后将进行非原位的多模态表征，包括HAADF-STEM、拉曼、XRD、X射线光电子能谱（XPS）和原子力显微镜（AFM），以研究剥离的TMDs纳米片的相、电子结构和形态。通过将这些数据与仅锂插层TMDs进行比较，我们计划揭示剥离过程的潜在机制与剥离后TMDs的最终性质之间的关系。 第三，使用不同相（2H、1T和1T'）和不同锂离子插层数量的剥离TMDs纳米片制备超级电容器电极，然后调查其超级电容器性能。在此基础上，我们将总结相和锂离子插层数量如何影响超级电容器的性能，构建具有优越电化学电容的TMDs电极，用于能源应用。

11309323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11309323.value: 伯努利滲流模型中的若幹問題

11309323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11309323.value: 伯努利滲流模型是一個經典模型。我們在每一個格點獨立地放置粒子：給定一個參數p，每個格點以概率p有一個粒子，以概率1-p沒有粒子。當我們改變參數，顯著的相變會發生於某個臨界值p_c：對於pp_c，粒子會形成一個無限的（巨大的）連通簇。 滲流理論有廣泛應用，有助於人們理解不同繫統中的空間關聯。一個例子是由Drossel和Schwabl在1992年引進的“森林大火”過程。在此過程中，新樹在格點上以速率1出現，閃電以很小的速率zeta>0打在格點上。當一棵樹被擊中，包含它的連通簇也會被全部燒毀。這個模型的意義在於它給出了一個典型的“自組織臨界性”的例子。“自組織臨界性”是一個引人入勝的現象，能夠用於解釋自然中出現的復雜性。 在本研究計劃中，對於二維和高維中和滲流模型相關的幾個關鍵問題，我們試圖增進理解。我們的起點是我們最近在二維“凍結滲流”和“森林大火”模型上的一繫列工作：我們證明了存在“特殊尺度”、“近臨界雪崩”和一個驚人的“反集中現象”。我們的證明主要用到了一個有雜質的滲流模型。我們計劃繼續研究這個有雜質的滲流模型，併對此證明一個普遍性原則。除此以外，我們對於二維臨界和近臨界滲流模型的詳盡理解，也會使得我們可以詳盡地描述大臨界連通簇的幾何性質，比如我們希望得到關於在這些隨機連通簇上的隨機遊走的更好的結果。最後，我們計劃更好理解滲流模型中出現的“圖案”，以便在幾個方嚮上延拓最近關於“詞語滲流”的一些重要結果。這種延拓已有人考慮。我們希望將已知的結果和我們“詞語滲流”的工作中包含的想法和工具結合起來。

11309423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11309423.value: 具光功能性過渡金屬配合物作為觸發帶有癌細胞選擇性的免疫原性細胞死亡的光誘導劑的策略設計

11309423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11309423.value: 本項目旨在開發具光功能性過渡金屬配合物作為觸發帶有癌細胞選擇性的免疫原性細胞死亡的光誘導劑。在過去的數十年中，透過利用可高度時空控制活性氧產生的光敏劑，光動力療法已成為一種有效的非侵入性癌症治療方法。該療法的抗腫瘤作用源於直接殺死癌細胞，並對腫瘤血管造成損害，同時刺激炎症和免疫反應。誘導免疫反應的重要性在於其可抑制腫瘤轉移和復發，從而大幅提高患者的生存率。然而，由於腫瘤微環境的免疫抑制特性，傳統光動力療法引起的效果通常較輕微而且短效。因此，開發可引起免疫原性細胞死亡的光誘導劑吸引了廣泛興趣。該方法可以重塑免疫抑制的腫瘤微環境，建立強大而持久的保護性抗腫瘤免疫反應，從而根除原發性和轉移性腫瘤，並防止其復發。最近，由於其有趣的光物理特性、可受控的活性氧產生效率、優異的細胞滲透性和可調節的細胞器靶向，具光功能過渡金屬配合物在生物成像和光動力療法受到了廣泛關注。我們預計開發具有癌細胞靶向和光誘導免疫原性細胞死亡能力的新型過渡金屬配合物將會提供創新的治療診斷試劑。此項目中，我們將設計可以選擇性地靶向癌細胞並積聚在特定細胞器中的過渡金屬配合物。在光照條件下，該配合物可高效產生活性氧，從而導致癌細胞的集中氧化應激，誘發免疫原性細胞死亡，並引發有效且持久的抗腫瘤免疫反應，進而抑制腫瘤生長、轉移及復發。雖然免疫原性細胞光誘導劑的發展在近期引起了廣泛的關注，但是迄今為止大部份已開發的試劑都源於有機分子和納米顆粒。相較之下，分子化合物的使用一直稀缺。我們相信，利用具有優異特點的光功能過渡金屬配合物作為具有癌細胞靶向和光誘導免疫原性細胞死亡能力的光誘導劑，將能大幅拓寬光動力療法的應用範圍，並進一步增強對癌症治療的影響。這將在藥物化學、藥理學和免疫學領域引起廣泛的興趣。該項目產生的成果將強化具光功能過渡金屬配合物作為治療診斷劑的獨特角色，並提供有效的癌症診斷和治療的機會。

11309623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11309623.value: 利用高品質因子和小模式體積的等離激元磁共振實現TMDC範德華異質結層間激子的光譜和空間選擇性發光增強

11309623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11309623.value: 過渡金屬二硫化物（TMDC）範德華異質結中的層間激子在基於莫爾勢的單光子源、高空間相干激子激光器等量子光學領域具有重要應用前景。然而，層間激子的電子-空穴對在空間上被分離在異質結的不同層中，顯著抑制其輻射復合。新近研究表明將範德華異質結與金納米針尖-薄膜構成的納腔耦合，可在一定程度上打破上述物理約束，實現Purcell增強的非共振層間激子發射。但是，這種等離激元寬帶增強方法存在三點局限：（1）納腔在增強層間激子輻射的同時也會加速層內激子的輻射復合，不利於層間激子的形成；（2）層間激子的非輻射衰減速率比其輻射衰減速率大5個數量級，意味著其量子產率相當低；（3）Purcell增強因子顯著依賴於針尖-薄膜距離。 為了解決上述問題，本項目提出將TMDC範德華異質結與超緊湊的金納米立方體-薄膜構成的等離激元納腔（NCoM）進行耦合，從理論和實驗上探究NCoM納腔對層間激子發射過程的選擇性增強效應。與上述具有寬帶但較弱Purcell增強效應的針尖-薄膜納腔相比，本項目提出的NCoM結構具有高品質的磁偶極模式（品質因子約25），能在頻譜上選擇性地與層間激子的發射峰共振並實現Purcell增強，而不會與層內激子發生共振。此外，磁偶極的較小模式體積（約10^4 nm^3）使其能在微區局域激發層間激子，避免了來自周圍異質結區域的背景貢獻。最後，通過調控NCoM間隙大小可有效調節磁偶極模式峰位，以研究層間激子發射峰與磁偶極模式匹配程度對等離激元增強效應的影響規律，有望觀察到納腔引起的層間激子從非輻射淬滅到Purcell輻射增強的轉變，以更好地理解層間激子的形成和輻射機理。在理論分析方面，我們將結合耦合速率方程和NCoM-異質結耦合結構的溫度依賴、時間分辨光致發光光譜來揭示熱平衡下層內和層間激子的關聯性。此外，我們還將發展一個全量子模型對納腔-激子的相互作用進行微觀描述。 總體而言，本項目將利用一種嶄新的等離激範式來有效操控層間激子的輻射和非輻射弛豫途徑及其動力學過程。研究結果有望為在等離激元納腔量子電動力學框架下研究多激子體系的新穎物理行為鋪平道路，也將為利用TMDC範德華異質結構建諸如激子激光器和發光二極管等高性能、超緊湊的納米光子學和光電子學器件提供物理平台。

11309723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11309723.value: 基於超薄共價有機聚合物的局部環境調控及二氧化碳還原制甲醇的研究

11309823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11309823.value: 抵銷干涉形成連續譜中的綁定態的存在性理論

11309823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11309823.value: A bound state in the continuum (BIC) is an eigenmode of a linear operator with the eigenvalue in the continuous spectrum, i.e. the eigenvalue is an embedded eigenvalue. In recent years, there has been a significant research interest on BICs of electromagnetic waves in the photonics community, mainly due to their important applications in lasing, sensing, switching, filtering, nonlinear optics, etc. Theoretical works on BICs are concerned with the physical mechanisms leading to the formation of BICs, resonant and leaky states surrounding the BICs, the effect of structural perturbations on the BICs, etc. Except for simple BICs, such as those related to symmetry mismatch and separability, precise conditions on the existence of many BICs are not available. In particular, destructive interference was identified as the physical mechanism for many BICs, but the precise conditions that guarantee the total elimination of outgoing waves are typically unknown. In this project, we consider a few general models and try to identify conditions (sufficient conditions) under which the existence of BICs can be rigorously proved. Our work contributes to the theoretical foundation of the interdisciplinary research on BICs, and also provides useful guidance for realizing their practical applications. 連續譜中的綁定態（BIC）是線性算子的一種特徵模，其特徵值在連續譜之中。近年來，BIC在光學中有很多應用，包括激光，檢測，開關，過濾，非線性效應等。關於BIC的理論研究包括形成BIC的物理機理，靠近BIC的共振模的特性，結構擾動對BIC的影響等。但是，除了一些特別簡單的情況，BIC的存在性沒有嚴格的理論。雖然抵銷干涉被認為是形成BIC的一個重要機理，但沒有理論解釋在什麼條件之下，外行波被完全消除，因而BIC得以行成。本項研究計畫的目的是建立嚴格的BIC的存在性理論。對幾類通用的模型，我們將找出BIC存在的條件，再給予嚴格的證明。我們的工作可以給BIC的研究建立扎實的理論基礎，對其應用提供指導。

11310023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11310023.value: 關於一個可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程的自由邊界問題

11310023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11310023.value: 我們在本項目中提出研究一個關於可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程的自由邊界問題， 可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程是等離子體中可壓縮歐拉-泊松方程的完全非線性對應。作為靜電相互作用的一個完全非線性模型， 應用完全非線性模型的優點在於可以允許點電荷具有有限電場。 在本項目中我們專注於時間局部理論並提出研究以下問題： 1）對於可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程的自由邊界問題， 确定類似歐拉方程自由邊界問題中泰勒符號條件的穩定性條件，並在此條件下導出解的時間局部先驗估計， 2）在1）中确定的穩定性條件下，建立可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程的自由邊界問題在索伯列夫 空間中的時間局部適定性。 研究流體動力學及等離子體中的自由邊界問題具有挑戰性。 蒙日-安培方程的完全非線性特點耦合流體型自由邊界問題使得研究極具挑戰性和意義。 本項目的成功將為可壓縮歐拉-蒙日-安培方程的自由邊界問題長時間（整體或幾乎整體）解的研究奠定基礎並對發展流體及相關自由邊界問題的分析及幾何工具有所貢獻。

11310123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11310123.value: 離子液體包水電解液的設計與製備及其在高性能超級電容器中的應用研究

11310123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11310123.value: Electrochemical double-layer capacitors (EDLCs) are promising energy storage devices for applications that simultaneously require high power output and a long lifespan. In commercial EDLCs, organic electrolytes have been widely used by virtue of their broad electrochemical windows that endow a high operation voltage and thereof an increased energy density. Nevertheless, the flammability and volatility of organic electrolytes bring in safety concerns, and the critical purity requirement of organic electrolytes inevitably makes the fabrication complex, thereby increasing the cost of EDLCs. Moreover, the relatively sluggish ion transportation in organic electrolytes also limits further improvements in the power density of EDLCs. Thus, developing new electrolytes concurrently featured with wide electrochemical windows, high ionic conductivities, reduced cost, and superior safety is desirable for the further advance of EDLC technology. In this project, we will develop a "water-in-ionic liquid" electrolyte with a broad electrochemical window and rapid ion transportation to improve the energy density, power density, and cycle stability of EDLCs. This project is based on the following rationales: 1) ionic liquids are compounds completely comprising cations and anions that may have strong interactions with water molecules; 2) the unique solvation structures induced by the strong interactions between the cations/anions of ionic liquids and water molecules are expected to suppress the decomposition of water, and thus broaden the electrochemical windows of electrolytes; 3) the introduction of water into ionic liquids is favorable to the dissociation of ionic liquids, which decreases the viscosity of electrolytes and thus modulate their ionic conductivity. In the project, a series of ionic liquids with different combinations of cations (e.g., pyrrolidinium- and imidazolium-based cations) and anions (e.g., sulfonate-, tetrafluoroborate-, and imide-based anions) will be used to prepare electrolytes, and the impacts of water incorporation in ionic liquids on the solvation structures, electrochemical windows, and ionic conductivities of the electrolytes will be studied. Moreover, prototypes of EDLCs will be fabricated to demonstrate the practical applications of the screened electrolytes. The implementation of the proposed project will lead to further understanding, and insight into, the design and development of new electrolyte systems for high-performance EDLCs, as well as other aqueous energy storage devices such as Li-, Na-, and Zn-ion supercapacitors and batteries. 電化學雙電層超級電容器 (EDLC) 是一種兼具高功率輸出和長循環壽命的新型電化學器件。有機電解液因其具有寬電化學窗口而被廣泛使用在商用EDLCs器件中，從而使商用器件具有較高的工作電壓和能量密度。然而，有機電解質易燃和易揮發的特性帶來了安全隱患。同時，有機電解液較高的純度要求使得製造過程繁瑣，同時也導致較高的成本。因此，開發兼具寬電化學窗口、低成本、高離子電導率的新型電解液有助於推動EDLC的進一步發展和應用。在本項目中，我們擬開發一種兼具寬電化學窗口和高離子電導率的“離子液體包水”電解液，以提高EDLC的能量密度、功率密度和循環穩定性。該項目基於以下原理:1) 離子液體是由陽離子和陰離子組成的有機化合物，與水分子有很强的相互作用; 2) 離子液體的陽離子/陰離子與水分子之間的强相互作用可以形成獨特的溶劑化結構幷抑制水的分解，從而拓寬電解液的電化學窗口; 3) 在離子液體中引入水有利於離子液體的解離，降低電解液的粘度，從而提高電解液的離子電導率。本項目將使用一系列具有不同陽離子(如吡啶和咪唑基陽離子)和陰離子 (如磺酸鹽、四氟硼酸鹽和亞胺基陰離子) 組合的離子液體來製備電解液，並研究離子液體中水的摻入對電解液的溶劑化結構、電化學窗口和離子電導率的影響。並進一步構建EDLCs的原型器件來評估電解液的實際應用前景。該項目的實施將有助於超級電容器電解液的設計和開發，以及應用於其他水系儲能設備，如鋰離子、鈉離子和鋅離子超級電容器和電池。

11310223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11310223.value: 基于单原子吸附位点的多孔吸附材料的开发

11310223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11310223.value: Chemical separation accounts for approximately 15% of the world’s total energy consumption. Most of today’s chemical separation processes utilize volatility differences to induce selectivity, which involve phase change and thus are energy intensive. Adsorbent-based separation, which involves no phase change but exploits differences in polarizability, size, or shape to impart selectivity, has huge potential to reduce the high energy consumption, emissions, and pollution associated with today’s industrial chemical separations. However, adsorptive separation cannot work effectively when such chemical and/or physical distinctions between molecules are not pronounced. Prominent examples include air separation (N2/O2), natural gas purification (N2/CH4), carbon monoxide extraction (CO/CO2), nitric oxide extraction (NO/O2), and olefin-paraffin separation (e.g., C2H4/C2H6 and C3H6/C3H8), where gas molecules in each pair have very similar physical chemistry properties. In this project, we aim to address the challenge of separating gases that lack the common chemical and/or physical distinctions mentioned above by developing π-backbonding adsorbents that can selectively bind inert π-acidic gases (e.g., N2, CO, NO, C2H4, and C3H6). π-backbonding is a chemical bond that can form between reducing transition metals and π-acidic gases. We will achieve it by addressing the following questions: 1) How to design and develop zeolites and metal-organic frameworks (MOFs) adsorbents that accommodate and regulate various transition metal species as single-atom π-backbonding sites, based on the same concept by comparing these two most important categories of porous adsorbent substrates; 2) How to fine-tune the affinity of the adsorption sites to selected π-acidic gases as probes; 3) How to elucidate the gas adsorption mechanism via a combined experimental and molecular simulation study to enable rational design of π-backbonding adsorbents; and 4) How to prove the efficacy of our novel π backbonding adsorbents through selective gas adsorption studies. Research on the fundamentals of gas adsorption serves as the cornerstone of a suite of gas technologies for the handling of inert π-acidic gases, including gas separation, detection, and (catalytic) gas conversion. As the first study on the role of porous anionic frameworks of zeolites and MOFs in modulating extraframework single-atom transition metal ions as π-backbonding sites, this project would unleash the potential of manipulating π-backbonding interactions as a handle for designing next-generation single-atom adsorbents. Thus, the new knowledge and new adsorbent materials generated in this proposal will be invaluable to advance selective adsorption-based gas technologies, which will potentially bring considerable economic and environmental benefits. 化学分离消耗的能量约占全球能耗总量的15%。大多数化学分离过程利用混合物中各组分挥发性差异来诱导选择性，由于其涉及相变，能耗非常高。基于固体吸附剂的化学分离过程不涉及相变，而是利用各组分极化性、尺寸或形状的差异来诱导选择性，使其在减少当今工业化学分离相关的高能耗、排放和污染方面具有巨大潜力。然而，当分子之间的化学和/或物理区别不明显时，吸附分离不能有效地发挥作用。突出的例子包括空气分离 (N2/O2)、天然气净化 (N2/CH4)、一氧化碳去除 (CO/CO2)、一氧化氮去除 (NO/O2) 和烯烃-石蜡分离（例如 C2H4/C2H6 和 C3H6/C3H8）。这里每一对气体分子具有非常相似的物理化学性质。 本项目的目标是通过开发可以选择性结合惰性π酸性气体（例如N2、CO、NO、C2H4和C3H6）的反馈π键吸附剂来解决分离缺乏上述常见化学和/或物理特征的气体的挑战。 的反馈π键是一种可以在还原性过渡金属和π-酸性气体之间形成的化学键。我们将通过解决以下问题来实现这一目标：1）如何设计和开发基于沸石和金属有机框架（MOF）吸附剂，以通过比较这两种最重要的多孔吸附基质类别，基于相同的概念来容纳和调节各种过渡金属物种作为单原子的反馈π键合位点； 2）如何微调吸附位点对选定的π酸性气体作为探针的亲和力； 3）如何通过实验和分子模拟相结合的研究来阐明气体吸附机理，从而合理设计的反馈π键吸附剂； 4) 如何通过选择性气体吸附研究证明我们的新型 的反馈π键吸附剂的功效。 用于处理惰性π酸性气体，包括气体分离、检测和（催化）气体转化。作为第一个关于沸石和 MOF 的多孔阴离子骨架在调节骨架外单原子过渡金属离子作为 的反馈π键位点中的作用的研究，该项目将释放操纵 的反馈π键相互作用的潜力，作为设计下一代单原子吸附剂的抓手。因此，该提案中产生的新知识和新吸附材料对于推进基于选择性吸附的气体技术具有不可估量的价值，这将有可能带来可观的经济和环境效益。

11500123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500123.value: 超越认知评估：针对人类与AI协同合作的人工智能委托授权研究框架

11500123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500123.value: 人工智能正在颠覆和重塑业务流程, 其角色已经从传统的决策支持转变为更微妙的决策自动化。虽然人工智能已经显示出在复杂的分析决策中补充甚至取代人类的能力，但人类与人工智能的合作，而不是任何单独一方占据主导地位，已经被预测为未来的趋势。到目前为止，人们对人类如何通过授权运营管理决策来向人工智能分配权利和责任知之甚少，这被认为是人类实现与人工智能的协作智能的主要障碍之一。 本项目利用归因理论和认知评估来探索人类经理人（委托人）和人工智能系统（代理人）之间的委托关系。基于归因理论的认知评估过程是委托人通过观察代理人的行为和工作结果而主动、持续地进行的，它可以塑造委托人对代理人禀赋的感知。在作出是否授权决定时，委托人将回溯此前对代理人禀赋的感知情况。认知评估已经被用来理论化和理解人与人之间的委托授权关系。然而，很少有研究调查人类经理人如何在与人工智能协作的背景下对具有自主性的人工智能进行评估，以做出授权决策。 我们打算在人工智能委托授权理论框架中扩展认知评估理论，以更好地了解人类经理人将其日常操作任务委派给人工智能系统的意愿。我们提出，人类经理人所感知到的人工智能禀赋是从主观评价（即人工智能是否能够模仿人类决策并满足经理人的主观期望）和客观评价（即AI是否能够完成任务并取得更好的销售业绩）发展而来的。此外，人类经理人对人工智能的后续评估过程存在确认偏见，即偏向于接受符合已有评估结果的感知。委托结果可以通过委托过程的反馈循环中的重复评估进一步塑造人类经理人对人工智能判断的信心。 为此，我们收集了2017年1月至2019年9月期间1006名门店经理的每日对人工智能系统的委托决策和委托结果的真实现场数据，包括人工智能的每日运营决策、经理人委托决策、绩效报告和经理评估报告。该人工智能系统于2018年3月开始实施。我们打算使用这个数据集来研究人类经理人对人工智能的认知评估和任务属性影响其委托意愿的潜在机制。考虑到决策自动化中人类与人工智能互相协作的趋势将继续，该项目的可交付成果将为使用或计划使用人工智能系统进行决策自动化的公司带来重大影响，引导最快的途径实现人类与人工智能的协作智能。

11500223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500223.value: 如何在P2P市場中應對負評

11500223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500223.value: 本文研究P2P市場中商家應該如何應對負評帶來的影響。已有文獻建議不管負評的起因如何，商家都應該認錯並對消費者做出相應補償，只有少數文獻研究了如何通過辯解方式和消費者溝通。本文通過在P2P環境中的田野實驗發現，負評是否具有客觀衡量標準是商家能否使用辯解方式的重要基礎。如果負評有客觀衡量標準，商家應該通過辯解方式與消費者溝通；如果負評沒有客觀衡量標準，商家的辯解會讓負評對未來銷售產生進一步的傷害。本文繼續通過田野實驗探討了商家辯解產生正向或負向效果的底層機制。

11500723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500723.value: 分析师是否真正理解并购与收购交易？来自分析师报告的证据

11500723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500723.value: Mergers and Acquisitions (M&As) are among the most important corporate events. Yet, investors have consistently complained that the information environment around M&A remains opaque as the financial reporting system generates inadequate signals about the quality of acquisitions. In such an inadequate information environment, the role of analysts as information intermediaries in M&A becomes even more critical. Yet, analysts' role in the information processing of M&A isn't systematically studied. The limited extant literature has focused on short-term summary outputs and suggests that analysts struggle to understand M&As as the earnings forecast error and dispersion increase post-acquisition. The extant literature has three major limitations with regards to answering the following questions- 1) Whether analysts understand M&A, and 2) Whether and in what way analysts contribute towards improving the information environment of M&As. First, the focus on short-term summary measures doesn't allow for investigating whether analysts get the long-term value implications of the transaction. Second, the existing literature doesn't analyze whether the error in short-term summary outputs is driven by the analyst's failure to unravel the economic implication or the reporting complexity of the transaction. Third, the narrow focus on short-term summary output isn't adequate to fully capture whether and how analysts contribute towards improving the information environment around M&A as it excludes one crucial aspect of analysts' output, i.e., the textual content of the analyst reports. In this project, we utilize modern textual analysis techniques to identify discussions around important topics in the context of M&A that analysts cover in their reports. We then use the breadth of discussion and the underlying tone of those topics to infer their understanding of the M&A transactions. Then, we identify the topics investors care about the most by linking market reactions to the quality of coverage of those topics. Finally, we investigate if the information content of their report helps improve the association between short-term market reaction to M&A and the long-term value implication of these transactions. We contribute to the literature on M&A and Analysts by furthering our understanding of whether and how analysts are able to analyze M&A by capturing their understanding of the transactions along two important interrelated dimensions, i.e., time (short-term vs. long-term) and complexity (reporting vs. economic ). Further, we contribute to the literature by investigating if analysts help improve the information environment around M&A, taking into consideration a broader set of their output than previously examined in prior research. 并购与收购（M&A）是最为重要的公司业务事件之一。然而，投资者一直反复抱怨围绕并购与收购的信息环境仍然不透明，因为财务报告系统未能充分传递有关并购与收购质量的信息。在这种信息不足的环境下，分析师作为并购与收购信息中介的角色变得愈发关键。然而，分析师在并购与收购信息处理中的作用尚未得到系统的研究。有限的现有文献主要集中在短期的总结性指标上，结果表明分析师在理解并购与收购方面存在困难，因为分析师在并购与收购后收益预测误差和分散程度增加。现有文献在回答以下两个问题上存在三个主要限制：（一）分析师是否真正理解并购与收购，以及（二）分析师是否且以何种方式改善并购与收购信息环境。首先，仅关注短期总结性指标无法调查分析师是否能够把握交易的长期价值影响。其次，现有文献未分析短期总结性指标中的误差究竟是由于分析师未能解析交易的经济含义，还是由于交易的报告复杂性所致。第三，狭隘地关注短期总结性指标并不足以充分捕捉分析师在改善并购与收购信息环境方面是否以及如何发挥作用，因为这种方式排除了分析师报告中的一个关键要素，即文本内容。在这个项目中，我们运用现代文本分析技术来识别分析师在其报告中涵盖的并购与收购相关重要主题的讨论。然后，我们根据这些主题的讨论广度和基本语调来推断他们对并购与收购交易的理解程度。接下来，我们通过将市场反应与这些主题的覆盖质量联系起来，确定投资者最关心的主题。最后，我们调查他们的报告是否能够有助于改善市场对并购与收购的短期反应与这些交易的长期价值影响之间的关联。我们通过捕捉分析师对交易的理解，从时间（短期与长期）和复杂性（报告与实体）两个重要且相互关联的维度，来进一步理解分析师是否与如何理分析并购与收购，以此在并购与收购和分析师文献领域做出贡献。此外，我们通过考虑比以往研究中更广泛的指标集合，调查分析师是否有助于改善并购与收购信息环境，进一步对文献做出贡献。

11500823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11500823.value: 商品市場中隨時間變化的風險

11500823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11500823.value: Commodities are an integral component of the global economy, serving critical functions in food production, manufacturing, and industrial processes. Producers and consumers of commodities are exposed to unwanted price fluctuations that increase the risk of doing business, and they commonly use commodity futures contracts to hedge price risk. Effective hedging necessitates a competent understanding of the behavior of commodity futures returns. Existing work on commodity futures tends to focus on the characterization of risk premia (e.g., Gorton and Rouwenhorst, 2006) or a trade-off between risk and return that restricts the quantity of risk to be static (Szymanowska et al., 2014; Bakshi et al., 2019). That is, while risk factor realizations are allowed to vary over time, factor exposures are typically held constant. There remains limited work on dynamic trade-offs between risk and return through the channel of time-varying factor exposures. The goal of this proposal is to achieve a deeper understanding of how dynamic risk-return trade-offs in commodity markets can arise from time variation in factor exposures, as well as the associated conditional asset pricing implications. Our proposal contains four parts. In the first part, we seek to quantify the number of factors necessary to explain the comovement in commodity premia and to document their behavior. How many independent sources of comovement can we identify? How much variation exists in these common components, and how do they change through business cycles? The second part is concerned with identifying the most informative conditioning variables for the systematic risk exposure of commodity premia. We look for a subset of conditioning variables that contributes maximally to explaining a panel of commodity returns. The identity of the most important variables helps to pinpoint the economic mechanisms that generate commodity risk premia. The third part pertains to building a conditional asset pricing model to explain the cross section of commodity risk premia. How well do common factors that explain comovement price the cross section of commodity returns? Finally, the fourth part compares our model description of commodity risk premia with alternative models from the literature. We investigate whether proposed asset pricing factors from the literature contribute to the description of commodity risk premia while controlling for the factors our model uncovers, raising the hurdle for economic and statistical significance. 商品是全球經濟的一個重要組成部分，在食品生產、製造業和工業加工中發揮著關鍵作用。商品的生產者和消費者所面臨的價格波動增加了經商的風險，因此他們通常使用商品期貨合約來對沖價格風險。有效的對沖需要參與者對商品期貨回報規律有充分的認知。目前關於商品期貨的研究往往專注於風險溢價的刻畫（例如Gorton和Rouwenhorst，2006），或者是在風險和回報之間的權衡。這類研究都限制了風險暴露是靜態的（Szymanowska等，2014; Bakshi等，2019）。也就是說，他們允許觀察到的風險因子隨時間變化，但風險暴露通常保持恒定。目前對於允許風險因子暴露隨時間變化，從而實現動態權衡風險和回報的研究還很有限。本研究的目標是更深入地了解商品市場中動態風險回報權衡是如何因為時間變化的風險因子暴露而出現的，以及由此帶來的條件資產定價啟示。 我們的研究提案包含四個部分。在第一部分，我們希望量化用於解釋商品風險溢價的共同波動因子數量，並記錄它們的規律。例如，我們將確定獨立的共同波動源有多少個？這些共同因素中存在多少變化，並且它們在商業周期中如何變化？第二部分關注於最能反映系統性風險暴露的風險因子。我們希望尋找一小組對解釋一揽子商品收益有最大貢獻的因子集合。識別最重要的因子有助於準確描述產生商品風險溢價的經濟機制。第三部分涉及構建條件資產定價模型來解釋商品風險溢價的截面特徵。例如，針對商品截面收益，我們將研究用於解釋共同波動的因子在定價方面的表現如何？最後，第四部分將我們的商品風險溢價模型與文獻中的替代模型進行比較。我們將探究，在控制了我們的模型發現的因子後，文獻中提出的資產定價因子是否仍有助於描述商品風險溢價，從而提高經濟和統計顯著性的標準。

11501223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11501223.value: 智能手机对我们的大脑总是不好吗？使用智能手机休息对创造力的正面影响

11501223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11501223.value: Smartphones have unequivocally become an indispensable part of people’s lives. Although smartphones benefit people in myriad ways, including connecting people with each other and improving access to information, public concerns and prior empirical findings suggest that smartphones negatively influence cognitive performance. However, is smartphone use always bad for our cognitive functioning and performance? This research challenges this notion. Specifically, this project focuses on a prevalent yet understudied type of smartphone use, namely taking a break with a smartphone, and examines its potential positive impacts on cognitive performance, in particular creativity. This research proposes that taking a break with a smartphone, as compared with a comparable break (e.g., taking a break with a PC), can boost creativity. Recent empirical findings have shown that smartphone use could provide psychological comfort and relieve stress (Melumad & Meyer, 2020; Melumad & Pham, 2020) more than PC use. Building on the recent findings, this project examines the effect of smartphone use and psychological comfort on a subsequent creativity task. This research aims to achieve three main goals. First, this project examines an important yet understudied type of smartphone use behavior: taking a break with a smartphone. Although people frequently use their smartphones for a break throughout the day, no prior research has examined whether, how, and why this behavior can impact people’s subsequent cognitive performance. Second, this research challenges a common view that smartphones have a bad influence on people’s various cognitive functioning. This research shows that a specific, “appropriate” way to use a smartphone can be beneficial, extending the current understanding of the effect of smartphone use. Third, this research provides practical implications for the general public and various organizations striving for creativity. Creativity is not only important for culture and art industries but also critical to individual, organizational, and societal success and the cornerstone of innovation. Many individuals and organizations (schools, companies, and households) try to regulate their smartphone use (e.g., “no phone at work policy”), believing that all smartphone use is detrimental to their cognitive performance. This project aims to help the general public and organizations better manage smartphone use in a healthier, more structured, and intentional way, helping them achieve the most critical skill in modern society: creativity. 智能手机已经明确地成为人们生活中不可或缺的一部分。尽管智能手机以各种方式使人们受益，如连接人与人并增强信息获取的能力，但公众的担忧和先前的实证研究结果都表明智能手机对认知性能产生了负面影响。 然而，使用智能手机对我们的认知功能和表现总是有害的吗？这项研究对此提出了挑战。具体来说，该项目关注了一种普遍但较少研究的智能手机使用方式，即使用智能手机休息，并探讨了它对认知性能，特别是创造性的潜在正面影响。 这项研究提出，与相似的休息方式（例如，使用电脑休息）相比，使用智能手机休息可以提高创造力。最近的实证研究已经表明，与使用PC相比，智能手机的使用可以提供心理安慰并缓解压力（Melumad＆Meyer, 2020; Melumad＆Pham, 2020）。基于这些最新的研究成果，该项目探讨了智能手机的使用及心理舒适度对随后的创造性任务的影响。 这项研究旨在实现三个主要目标。首先，该项目研究了一种重要但鲜为人知的智能手机使用行为：使用智能手机休息。尽管人们经常在一天中使用他们的智能手机休息，但以前没有研究过这种行为是否、如何以及为什么会影响人们随后的认知性能。 其次，这项研究挑战了一种普遍观点，即智能手机对人们的各种认知功能有不良影响。这项研究表明，以一种特定的、“适当”的方式使用智能手机是有益的，扩展了当前对智能手机使用效果的理解。 第三，这项研究为追求创造力的大众和各种组织提供实际意义。创造性不仅对文化和艺术行业很重要，而且对个人、组织和社会的成功以及创新的基石至关重要。许多个人和组织（学校、公司和家庭）试图规范他们的智能手机使用（例如，“工作时禁用手机的政策”），认为所有的智能手机使用都对他们的认知性能有害。该项目旨在帮助大众和组织以更健康、更有结构和有意图的方式更好地管理智能手机的使用，帮助他们获得现代社会中最关键的技能：创造力。

11502023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502023.value: 时变因子选择的资产定价模型

11502023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11502023.value: Prof QIAO, Xiao Mr Yang, Jiangshan Dr ZHOU, Zhixin

11502023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502023.value: 实证资产定价采用线性因子模型来近似随机折现因子（SDF）并解释横截面回报的差异。然而，逐渐积累的“因子动物园”挑战进一步因子模型的组成和选择。许多实证研究仅基于其历史总体表现评估和选择因子，忽略了SDF中因子组成的潜在时间变化，并隐含地假设时间不变的稀疏结构。本项目研究以下研究问题：因子模型的组成是否随时间变化？虽然时间变化建模允许因子风险敞口或溢价的变化，但“全局稀疏性”的“幻觉”仍然主导着文献寻找一组小而固定的因子。本项目提出了一种新的时间变化视角，通过突出因子模型组成随时间变化的潜在变化，实现了变量选择的时变稀疏性。我们提出了一种稀疏融合广义矩估计方法（SFGMM），用于估计时变系数模型，实现了时变模型组成。我们的方法提供了动态SDF模型的替代估计方法，由大量的预测变量和测试资产作为工具变量。

11502423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502423.value: 企业政治关联外部溢出性的综合分析：来自势均力敌的选举结果的证据

11502423.label: Project Objectives
11502423.value: Conduct a firm-valuation event study for the within-industry spillover effect of business peers’ political connections unexpectedly gained from close elections Do conditional tests of the spillover effect in which we evaluate the conditions that underlie the externalities of political connections Test if the spillover effect depends on the strength or power of political connections Test the legislation and bill-passing channel for explicit political influence in which the spillover effect occurs meaningfully Evaluate comprehensively which nature of corporate political connections: private goods or common goods, dominates in the spillover effect Present the results in top workshops/conferences, write and publish a paper in a top-tier finance journal

11502423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502423.value: Firms often seek political connections which affect corporate business and valuation. The literature on political connections in corporate business and finance has offered various channels in which politically connected firms benefit from political connections. For example, these firms can gain more government contracts, easier access to financing, and increased sales; some are more likely to be bailed out in distress and less disciplined. But the overall benefit of corporate political connections is not apparent if one looks beyond the directly-connected firms. Political connections can be private goods exclusive to the connected firms but hurt other firms. But they can also serve as common or public goods benefiting all firms in the same industry. This project will investigate and evaluate the spillover effect of political connections among business peers. If a firm’s valuation gets impaired by the political connections of its business peers or rivals, public concerns about the political connection’s overall benefits are warranted. If the spillover effect is positive instead, the general view on political connections may become more lenient. This research plans to examine how political connections spill over to other firms if business peers who make political contributions subsequently have their supported politicians winning in close elections in the U.S. The close elections have election outcomes within a 5% margin of winning votes. Previous research found that close elections have a sufficient random component of political connections to provide quasi-randomized experiments for testing the effect of political connections. We will conduct an event study to estimate and evaluate the valuation effect on a firm when its business peers unexpectedly gain political connections from close elections. We will examine the spillover effect’s conditions that underlie and facilitate the externalities, such as in regulated and homogenous industries as well as in high economic policy uncertain periods. Political connections involve political power and influence in legislation. Once passed, congressional bills related to industry-specific government regulation and policy potentially affect directly-political-connected firms and other firms in the same industry. We will test whether regulatory changes through bill passing are an explicit political-influence channel for facilitating positive or negative externalities. The analysis of spillover effects of political influence will fill the void in the literature on corporate political power. The project’s results can also guide the Hong Kong government in promoting economies across China’s Greater Bay Area, where subtle political interactions in cross-border businesses are bound to affect local corporate valuation and decisions. 公司经常寻求影响公司业务和估值的政治联系。关于企业业务和财务中的政治影响力的文献提供了各种渠道，使有政治联系的企业从政治影响力中受益。例如，这些公司可以获得更多的政府合同，更容易获得融资，并增加销售额；有些人也更有可能在困境中获得救助，而不太可能受到纪律处分。但如果我们超越直接关联的公司，企业政治联系的总体好处并不显而易见。政治联系可以是私人物品，专属于有联系的公司，但却损害了其他公司。但它们也可以作为共同或公共物品，使同一行业的所有公司受益。 该项目将调查和评估商业同行之间政治关系的溢出效应。如果一家公司的估值因其商业同行或竞争对手的政治关系而受损，那么公众对政治关系整体利益的担忧是有道理的。如果溢出效应是积极的，公众对企业政治关系的看法可能会变得更加宽容。 这项研究计划探讨，如果做出政治贡献的商界同行随后让其支持的政客在美国的势均力敌的选举中获胜，那么政治关系如何蔓延到其他公司。势均力敌的选举中，选举结果的票差在 5% 之内。此前的研究发现，势均力敌的选举具有足够的政治关系随机成分，可以为检验政治关系的效果提供准随机实验。 我们将进行一项事件研究，以评估当企业同行意外地从势均力敌的选举中获得政治影响力时，对企业的估值影响。我们将研究造成外部性的溢出效应的条件，例如受监管和同质的行业。政治联系涉及立法中的政治影响。一旦通过，与特定行业的政府监管和政策相关的国会法案可能会影响与政治直接相关的公司和同一行业的其他公司。我们将测试通过法案通过的监管变革是否是促进正外部性或负外部性的明确政治影响渠道。 对政治影响力溢出效应的分析将填补企业政治关系文献中的空白。该项目的结果还可以为香港政府促进中国大湾区的经济提供指导，因为大湾区必然会发生微妙的政治互动，从而影响公司估值和其他企业决策。

11502823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11502823.value: 線上平台的引入給供貨商帶來的戰略轉型: 來自花卉市場的證據

11502823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11502823.value: 由於線下批發/零售業因疫情而停滯不前，生鮮產品市場一直在線上擴張並且快速增長。生鮮產品作為需要顧客體驗感受的非標準化商品，也被認為是電子商務發展的最後一塊。供應商雖然可以通過線上平臺找到新的銷售機會，但是也面臨著因產品質量或產品腐爛及損耗帶來的高損失和退貨率等挑戰。儘管生鮮產品市場的線上平台在不斷擴張，但目前沒有關於供應商如何利用線上平臺的相關研究。因此，本論文旨在探討線上平臺的採用如何影響供應商的產品創新戰略，即供應商如何生產和分配具有創新特性（即專利）的產品或服務，以及哪些因素調節了這種採用的影響。該研究使用了來自中國第二大的花卉拍賣市場-鬥南電子交易中心（DFETC）的獨特數據。該平臺於2021年11月引入線上銷售平臺，為我們提供了設計准實驗的環境。該研究使用雙重差分法（Difference-in-Difference），比較供應商採用線上平臺前後產品創新戰略的變化。結果初步表明，供應商在使用線上平臺期間，創新產品銷售量和銷售額增多。對於不同特點的供應商，較大的供應商在使用線上平臺期間更多地增加創新產品銷售量和銷售額。參加農民合作社的供應商卻減少了創新產品的數量和銷售額。線上和線下之間的顯著溢出效應表明，儘管生鮮產品市場的電子市場充滿了不確定性和風險，但互聯網可以幫助供應商在網上宣傳創新產品，並且提高買家的意識來建立品牌影響力。通過了解這些影響，生鮮平臺管理者和供應商可以根據具體情境定製平臺策略，以降低線上平台帶來的風險。

11503023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11503023.value: 危機風險的新衡量標準及其在股票收益時間序列和橫截面中的定價

11503023.label: Project Objectives
11503023.value: Refine the time series and cross-sectional analysis and compare with related predictors in the literature. Compare the time series predictability to the implications of the leading asset pricing models.
rows: Refine the time series and cross-sectional analysis and compare with related predictors in the literature.
Compare the time series predictability to the implications of the leading asset pricing models.

11503023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11503023.value: Historically, economic and financial crises are characterized by a surge in the implied volatility of short-term (as opposed to long-term) put options (as opposed to to call options). We propose a new method to capture both effects, the result of which is the new variable spc, which predicts both the time series and the cross-section of stock returns. In this proposal, we present the summary statistics of spc and our preliminary evidence on its pricing. We are currently working to expand our analysis to link the time series predictability with the implications of leading asset pricing models. Our time series evidence could become a new target moment for evaluating all asset pricing models. To this end, the main objective of this proposed project is to seek financial support for one full-time RA or Ph.D. student to help us expand our analysis. 從歷史上看，經濟和金融危機的特點是短期（相對於長期）看跌期權（相對於看漲期權）的隱含波動率激增。 我們提出了一種新方法來捕獲這兩種效應，其結果是新變量 spc，它可以預測股票收益的時間序列和橫截面。 在本提案中，我們提供了 spc 的匯總統計數據以及我們對其定價的初步證據。 我們目前正在努力擴展我們的分析，將時間序列的可預測性與領先資產定價模型的影響聯繫起來。 我們的時間序列證據可能成為評估所有資產定價模型的新目標時刻。 為此，該擬議項目的主要目標是為一名全職 RA 或博士尋求財政支持。

11503223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11503223.value: 持續加劇的氣候變化下的氣候金融：來自中國沿海城市熱帶氣旋的證據

11503223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11503223.value: Prof Chan, Johnny Chung Leung Prof Zhang, Wenrui Prof Zhou, Wen

11503223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11503223.value: 持續的氣候變化導致熱帶氣旋加劇，伴有強風和暴雨。氣候變化加劇還將影響財政政策、政府預算和公共債務。為了更好地準備氣候融資，政府需要充分了解各種氣候變化事件的相關成本，這對於加強政府財務管理體係以有效利用外部金融資源也至關重要。然而，如何將熱帶氣旋的物理影響貨幣化以提供氣候融資在文獻中仍然是一個空白。總體而言，日益加劇的氣候脆弱性要求深入了解氣候與經濟的關係。 該項目的新穎之處在於，通過將熱帶氣旋的詳細氣候信息納入計量經濟模型，提出了一個將氣候科學與經濟學聯繫起來的定量框架。這使我們能夠表徵加劇的氣候變化，以精確量化氣候與經濟的關係。通過跨學科合作，該項目將（1）構建氣候經濟框架來研究中國沿海熱帶氣旋的經濟影響； (2) 揭示熱帶氣旋影響經濟的機制； (3) 評估城市已採用的適應策略的有效性，探索允許城市通過應對氣候變化相關風險來維持城市可持續性的最佳策略； (4) 利用機器學習技術預測未來的熱帶氣旋，並提出中國大灣區適應氣候預算。 該項目的重要意義體現在三個方面。首先，它對中國國民經濟的可持續發展至關重要。沿海城市是中國經濟增長的“引擎”。中國超過60%的人口居住在沿海省份，評估過去和未來的熱帶氣旋對當地經濟和居民的影響是可持續氣候融資的必要步驟。其次，大灣區是中國的創新中心，大灣區許多城市面臨著日益嚴峻的氣候變化挑戰。大灣區如何適應氣候變化加劇，關係到國民經濟的可持續發展。因此，政策制定者必須了解適應戰略的經濟影響和有效性。第三，氣候風險是企業戰略管理的重點關注點之一。了解氣候與經濟的關係有助上市公司更好地適應氣候變化，維持香港在世界金融市場的競爭力。

11504523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11504523.value: 財務錯報檢測： 基於透皮光學成像的應用

11504523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11504523.value: Financial misreporting is a first-order concern for a wide range of stakeholders. For example, Enron’s shareholders lost billions of dollars, eroding investor confidence in the capital markets and undermining the SEC’s objectives. Therefore, it comes as no surprise that researchers have devoted tremendous effort to develop and improve models to predict financial misreporting. For decades, these models have relied mainly on accounting numbers collected from the financial statements (e.g., Jones 1991; Dechow, Sloan, and Sweeney 1995; Dechow and Dichev 2002; McNichols 2002; Kothari, Leone, and Wasley 2005; Dechow, Ge, Larson, and Sloan 2011). Recently, a growing strand of research takes a very different approach and builds on findings from the social psychology literature which suggest that liars exhibit many different “markers” that can be used to identify deception such as word usage (Larcker and Zakolyukina 2012) and vocal cues (Hobson, Mayew, and Venkatachalam 2012). Prior research has acknowledged that physiological changes (e.g., blood pressure and heart rate) are particularly effective at detecting deception, but data limitations have precluded this possibility. However, recent innovations in medicine and computer science make this a viable option. In this proposal, we explore the efficacy of a new technology called Transdermal Optical Imaging (TOI) in detecting financial misreporting. TOI was invented by Kang Lee (Tier 1 Canada Research Chair at the University of Toronto). TOI relies on the following intuition. Human skin is translucent, so changes in facial blood flow lead to changes in skin pigmentation. For example, individuals blush when they are embarrassed. The human eye can detect extreme changes in skin pigmentation, but computers are needed to detect subtle changes. Due to improvements in the resolution of cameras, TOI can be applied remotely using modern video recordings. For further details on TOI and its potential in detecting deception, please refer to Kang Lee’s Ted Talk: https://youtu.be/6diqpGKOvic?t=332. 財務報告錯報是眾多利益相關者關注的首要問題。例如，安然事件對其股東造成了數十億美元的損失，打擊了投資者對資本市場的信心，也破壞了美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的目標。因此，學者們投入巨大精力開發和改進預測財務報告錯報的模型也就不足為奇了。幾十年來，這些模型主要依賴於財務報表中的會計數據（如 Jones 1991；Dechow、Sloan 和 Sweeney 1995；Dechow 和 Dichev 2002；McNichols 2002；Kothari、Leone 和 Wasley 2005；Dechow、Ge、Larson 和 Sloan 2011）。近年來，越來越多的文獻採用了新穎的手段，並以社會心理學的研究結論為基礎研究這一問題。這些社會心理學研究表明，說謊者會表現出許多可被用於識別欺詐行為的"標記"，如用詞（Larcker 和 Zakolyukina，2012 ）和聲音線索（Hobson、Mayew 和 Venkatachalam，2012 ）。先前的研究證實生理變化（如血壓和心率）對檢測欺騙行為效果顯著，但受限於數據，該方法無法被運用於財務報告錯報的偵測。然而，最近醫學和計算機科學的創新成果使其成為一種可行方案。在本研究設計中，我們將探索一種名為透皮光學成像（TOI）的新技術在檢測財務虛報方面的效果。透皮光學成像是由Kang Lee（在多倫多大學的加拿大一級首席科學家）發明，其原理依賴於以下特質：人的皮膚是半透明的，因此面部血流的變化會導致皮膚色素的變化，例如，人在尷尬時會臉紅。人眼可以檢測到皮膚色素的極端變化，但對於細微變化的檢測則需要計算機程序協助捕捉。得益於攝像頭分辨率的提高，TOI可以通過現代影視資料進行遠程應用。有關TOI及其在檢測欺騙行為方面的潛力的更多詳情，請參閱 Kang Lee在Ted上的演講：https://youtu.be/6diqpGKOvic?t=332。
