11505023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505023.value: 審計事務所要提供高質量的審計服務，依賴於其最寶貴的資產——審計師人才。審計師審計師的財務知識和特定行業的專業知識（例如，金融行業和高新技術產業）自然會影響審計結果。現有的研究發現審計師性別、年齡、智力和個人經歴等特徵(例如，出生在經濟衰退時期)可能對審計質量產生顯著影響。例如，在經濟下行時期開始職業生涯的審計師，往往具有更高程度的職業懷疑態度，更有可能發錶非標准審計意見。現有的研究也認為併發現證據錶明，由於工作壓力和時間壓力而導致審計師的忙碌對審計質量產生負面影響。在本研究計劃中，我們利用新穎的數據來源研究審計師的另一個重要特徵：外部職位。軼事證據錶明，審計合夥人的行業經驗和知識對許多公司來說都很有價值，因此他們可以被任命為董事會成員或被邀請作為公司的共同投資者。然而，對審計合夥人外部職位的普遍行以及外部職位是否對審計質量有影響，我們知之甚少。我們的研究計劃將探究新的數據源來闡明這些問題。就目前所知，我們的研究是第一個對審計合夥人外部職位的研究。我們的研究結果可能具有重要的政策意義。如果承擔外部職務會損害審計合夥人的審計質量，監管機構可以考慮設置限制此類行為。

11505823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505823.value: Empirical evidence indicates that the recent inflation surge in many countries stems from the rising prices of imported goods. Our project provides a framework to evaluate the monetary policy that fights inflation driven by foreign price shocks. This project has three objectives: (1) Establish a baseline framework to incorporate foreign price shocks into monetary policy analysis, which reflects the nature of the shocks as a combination of technology and markup shocks, as well as an idiosyncratic shock that transmits through open economy production networks. (2) Obtain the analytical solution of optimal monetary policy in terms of an optimal inflation targeting rule. (3) Evaluate real-time monetary policy for post-covid inflation in several countries using the optimal inflation targeting rule. We advocate a rule that depends on foreign price shocks and the nominal exchange rate. The output of this project can provide new insights into monetary policy design when foreign price shock is one of the major concerns. 实证表明近期很多国家的通胀来源于进口物价的上涨。我们的项目提供了一个可供评价货币政策在对抗此类通胀时有效性的框架。这个项目有三个目标：（1）建立一个基准框架将进口物价的上涨引入到货币政策分析中。该框架需要反映进口物价上涨的特点，即一方面类似于技术冲击与加价冲击的组合，一方面类似于传导于开放经济生产网络中的部门冲击。（2）获得最优货币政策的显示解，该结果以最优通胀目标的形式展现。（3）用最优通胀目标来评价不同国家疫情后实时货币政策的优化程度。该项目的产出可以为输入型通胀下货币政策的设计提供新的启示。

11505923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11505923.value: 自動化技術是否讓工作更安全？

11505923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11505923.value: Prof HU, Xiaoli Dr Zhang, Rengong(Alex)

11505923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11505923.value: Technology has rapidly changed the relationship between labor and capital. This phenomenon triggered lively discussions in the media and tremendous research on how technology would affect the labor market. In this project, we focus on a crucial but largely overlooked question in the machine-vs-labor context: how technology adoption influences workplace safety. Specifically, we examine whether the automation adoption would (i) affect workers’ injury rates and (ii) influence firms’ violation of labor protection laws related to safety-health and wage-hour regulations. Since automation weakens labor’s importance in production, it shifts the bargaining powers away from workers and toward the capital. Hence, automation adoption will inevitably influence how much resources and attention employers would devote to labor protection. We utilize novel and unique data to conduct the first comprehensive firm-level empirical analysis on automation and workplace safety. Using the tax changes that promote capital investment as the identification, we employ difference-in-differences models to draw causal inferences. Our data granularity enables us to study how firm characteristics such as financial constraints, public-listed status, and corporate governance moderate the effect of automation on safety. These analyses are essential but could not be studied in prior research relying on the aggregated data. We also examine the spillover effect, i.e., how one firm’s robot adoption would affect the safety of nonadopting peer firms through local labor markets or product market competitions. 科技的迅猛發展已經並且正在加速改變勞動和資本之間的關係。機器的採用如何影響勞動者 - 這一關鍵問題激發了大量的媒體討論，並引起了關於技術如何影響勞動力市場的大量研究。在這個項目中，我們關注機器與勞動力之間一個至關重要但往往被忽視的問題：技術採用如何影響工作場所安全。具體而言，我們研究自動化採用是否會影響工傷事故率，並且是否會影響企業對安全生產和工時工資相關的勞動法的合規情況。由於自動化削弱了勞動在生產中的重要性，它將議價權力從工人轉移到資本。因此，自動化採用必然會影響雇主在勞動保護方面的資源投入和關注力。我們利用新穎而獨特的資料，進行了首次全面的企業級實證分析，研究自動化和工作場所安全之間的關係。我們利用促進資本投資的稅收減免政策作為識別工具，採用雙重差分模型進行因果推斷。我們的微觀資料使我們能夠研究企業特徵（如財務約束、上市狀況、和公司治理）對自動化和安全生產關係的調節作用。我們還研究了溢出效應，即一家公司的機器人採用如何通過本地勞動力市場或產品市場競爭來影響未採用同類技術的同行業公司的安全情況。我們期待這些企業層面的分析可以提供依據宏觀總體數據的先前文獻無法提供的洞見。

11506023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506023.value: 克服多元文化團隊中的文化地位劣勢——論領導者全球認同感的作用

11506023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11506023.value: Prof Chen, Ya-ru Prof KIM, You Jin Prof Lee, Jean Prof YIM, Junhyok Prof Yu, Andrew

11506023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506023.value: Globalization has led to increasing numbers of multinational corporations (MNCs) and multicultural work groups. The coronavirus pandemic has only added new layers of uncertainty and complexity to an already-competitive and changing landscape of the global economy. Leaders capable of navigating and operating effectively in such an environment are one key for global success and are in higher demand than ever. In general, leaders enjoy higher status than their followers and this high status makes it easier for them to lead followers and the team effectively. However, leaders in a multicultural context may face a unique challenge that prior literature has not considered: they have lower cultural status (defined as the cultural prominence, respect, and influence; Chen et al., 2004) than their team members. This creates a theoretical and practical puzzle: does low cultural status of global team leaders negatively affect team effectiveness, and if so, what kind of leaders will be able to overcome the cultural status disadvantage? Integrating social identity theory with the input-process-outcome (IPO) model of team effectiveness, we predict that lower levels of leader cultural status will be associated with lower levels of team coordination and higher levels of status conflict. In turn, lower levels of team coordination and higher levels of status conflict will be associated with lower levels of team effectiveness. We then further identify leader global identity—that is, a leader’s sense of belonging to and identification with groups operating in the global work environment of MNCs (Shokef & Erez, 2015)—as a critical leader characteristic that attenuates the negative effect of low leader cultural status on team effectiveness. Specifically, we argue that the negative effect of low cultural status on team coordination (as well as the positive effect of low cultural status on status conflict) are attenuated when levels of global identity are high rather than low. We propose a multi-wave, multi-source field study to test our model with 200 teams from an MNC. Our work opens up a novel line of study in multicultural research that has important practical implications for the type of leaders MNCs may hire, as well as how global leaders with differing levels of cultural status should behave in order to lead effectively in a multicultural team context. 隨著全球化浪潮的興起，跨國公司和多文化工作團隊的數量不斷增加。新冠疫情進一步加劇了全球經濟競爭和不確定性的變化。在這個競爭激烈且快速變化的環境中，具備有效運營和領導能力的人成為全球成功的關鍵，並且比以往更受追捧。一般來說，領導者擁有比追隨者更高的地位，這有助於他們更有效地引導追隨者和團隊。然而，在多元文化背景下，領導者可能面臨獨特的挑戰，這些挑戰在過去的研究中未曾被充分考慮：他們在文化地位上相對於團隊成員較低（文化地位指的是文化突顯度、尊重和影響力；Chen等，2004）。這帶來了一個理論和實踐上的難題：全球團隊領導者的低文化地位是否會對團隊效能產生負面影響，以及什麼樣的領導者能夠克服文化地位的劣勢？因此，我們將社會認同理論與團隊有效性的輸入-過程-結果（IPO）模型相結合，預測領導者低文化地位與團隊協調水平下降以及地位衝突增加呈正相關。相應地，團隊協調水平下降和地位衝突增加將導致團隊效能降低。我們進一步推測，全球認同感作為關鍵的領導者特質，即領導者對於在跨國公司全球工作環境中運營的團隊的歸屬感和認同感（Shokef和Erez，2015），能夠減輕領導者低文化地位對團隊效能的負面影響。具體而言，我們認為當領導者全球認同感水平較高時，能夠減弱低文化地位對團隊協調的負面影響（以及減弱低文化地位對地位衝突的影響）。為了驗證我們的模型，我們計劃進行一項跨多個時間點和多個來源的實地研究，樣本包括一家跨國公司的200個團隊。我們的研究開闢了多元文化研究的新方向，並對於跨國公司在招聘領導者時具有重要的實踐意義，同時也為在多元文化團隊環境中具有不同文化地位的全球領導者如何行事以實現有效領導提供了重要的實踐指導。

11506323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506323.value: ESG評級機構如何塑造ESG披露和ESG成果？來自Refinitiv的ESG評級方法更新的證據

11506323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506323.value: The majority of ESG rating agencies have relied on company-provided materials such as corporate disclosures when they evaluate ESG performance of the company. For instance, Refinitv, one of the leading ESG rating providers, mentions “company disclosure is at the core of our methodology” in their ASSET4 ESG score methodology guide. Therefore, given that there are various benefits of having high ESG rating, such as better access to capital, firms may try to align their corporate disclosure to rating agencies’ rating schemes in an attempt to boost ESG rating. In this proposed study, I focus on the recent ESG rating methodology update by Refinitv, and examine whether the firms followed by Refinitiv improved ESG disclosure and practices after the methodology update. In early 2020, Refinitv, one of the well-known ESG rating providers, announced updates to its ASSET4 ESG score rating methodology. Notably, Refinitv changed the way they treat firms that didn’t disclose ESG metrics. Before the methodology update, they allocated a score of 0.5 to companies which didn’t report on metrics, essentially giving them the ‘benefit of the doubt.’ However, given that this may disincentivize companies to report their ESG matters, updated methodology now assigns a score of zero to companies who don’t report on metrics relevant to the industry (Refinitv, 2020). In this paper, I examine whether firms respond to this exogenous rating methodology change by increasing their ESG disclosure and improving their ESG practices. This study has several contributions. The existing literature on ESG disclosure examine how various stakeholders such as institutional investors, policymakers and NGOs affect ESG reporting (Dhaliwal et al., 2011; Reid and Toffel, 2009; Cho and Patten, 2007). This paper extends this literature by focusing on the role of ESG rating agency – which is another important but less studied party – in shaping firms’ ESG disclosure. This study also contributes to the literature on the real effects of ESG disclosure as it examines how exogenous change in ESG disclosure affects firm’s ESG practices and outcomes. Finally, my study should be of interest to ESG rating agencies as it examines the impact of ESG rating methodology on ESG disclosures and practices. 大多數ESG評級機構在評估公司的ESG表現時，都依賴於公司提供的資料，如企業披露文件。例如，領先的ESG評級提供者之一Refinitiv在其ASSET4 ESG評分方法指南中提到：“公司披露是我們方法的核心”。因此，考慮到高ESG評級具有諸多好處，如更好地獲得資本，公司可能會試圖將其企業披露與評級機構的評級方案保持一致，以提升ESG評級。在這項提案的研究中，我專注於Refinitiv最近的ESG評級方法更新，並檢驗了在方法更新後，Refinitiv追蹤的公司是否在ESG披露和實踐方面取得了改善。 在2020年初，知名的ESG評級提供者之一Refinitiv宣布對其ASSET4 ESG評分方法進行了更新。值得注意的是，Refinitiv改變了他們對未披露ESG指標的公司的處理方式。在方法更新之前，他們對未報告指標的公司分配了0.5分，實質上是給予了他們“疑點利益”。然而，考慮到這可能會阻礙公司報告其ESG事項，更新後的方法現在將不報告與行業相關指標的公司的得分設定為零（Refinitiv，2020）。在本文中，我將檢驗公司是否對這種外生性評級方法變化做出反應，通過增加其ESG披露並改善其ESG實踐。 這項研究具有幾點貢獻。現有的ESG披露文獻探討了各種利益相關者（如機構投資者、政策制定者和非政府組織）如何影響ESG報告（Dhaliwal等，2011年；Reid和Toffel，2009年；Cho和Patten，2007年）。本文通過關注ESG評級機構的角色（這是另一個重要但較少研究的方面），擴展了這一文獻。此外，本研究也為ESG披露的實際影響文獻做出了貢獻，因為它考察了ESG披露的外生性變化如何影響公司的ESG實踐和結果。最後，我的研究對ESG評級機構應該具有興趣，因為它考察了ESG評級方法對ESG披露和實踐的影響。

11506623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506623.value: 优越客户信息下的偏见推荐算法和数据合规法案探讨

11506623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11506623.value: Prof Dukes, Anthony Prof Lu, Michelle Yi

11506623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506623.value: By learning superior consumer information (preference knowledge that exceeds consumers' own prior) from both behavioral and personal data, an intermediary platform such as Netflix can facilitate product matching by personalizing product recommendations. However, the recommender may have biased incentives to steer consumers into accepting a less relevant but more profitable product, which may induce consumer suspicion that leads to rejection and deadweight welfare loss. In this project, we aim to examine the non-pricing economic implications of superior knowledge by building the micro-foundation of personalized recommendations with three building blocks: cheap-talk model, biased incentives, and consumer profiling. The consumers' intrinsic preference match value is correlated with both the behavioral data and personal data. But the consumers only learn their personal data, and the behavioral data is accessable only by the firm. Specifically, we plan to examine three compliance rules, under which the recommender is permitted to personalize recommendations using (1) only the personal data, (2) only the behavioral data, or (3) both personal and behavioral data. We will analyze the optimal recommendation strategy under each information structure and then make static comparisons to examine the welfare implications of the compliance rule. Our preliminary results show that in equilibrium, more consumer data may not necessarily imply more accurate personalization. Therefore, the optimal recommendation strategies require formal examination. This project may make theoretical contributions by extending the classic signaling games to partial information exchange with superior knowledge. In addition, this project aims to help consumer advocates and regulators better understand the welfare implications of the compliance rules, and thus help characterise the optimal data usage policies by rules of reasons. 通过学习消费者的行为和个人数据，如奈飞和天猫这样的数字平台可以使用针对性的推荐来促进产品匹配。但推荐系统可能会因追求更高的利润而偏向于推荐与消费者不太相关但更有盈利潜力的产品，这可能导致消费者怀疑而拒绝接受。 在这个研究项目中，我们旨在建立一个空谈博弈的个性化产品推荐微观基础，这是一种玩家间的博弈论沟通，不直接影响博弈的收益。这适用于那些对其匹配价值有部分了解的消费者，这种价值与行为数据和个人数据都有关。主要目标是检查三种合规规则，推荐系统可以使用（1）仅个人数据，（2）仅行为数据，或（3）两者数据来进行个性化推荐。我们的初步结果显示，即使拥有更多的消费者数据，甚至获得优质信息，也可能不会导致更准确的推荐。 由于公司和消费者之间的策略互动可能会混淆数据规定的福利影响，这个项目将帮助消费者倡导者，如香港的个人数据私隐专员公署(PCPD)和个人数据条例(PDO)以及通用数据保护条例(GDPR)的监管者更好地理解每个合规规则的间接好处和风险，并帮助数字营销算法和产品经理在最佳边界上优化他们的个性化推荐算法。

11506723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11506723.value: 识别和估计时变模型中的模型误设

11506723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11506723.value: There is growing empirical evidence that the structure of economic relationships changes over time. Enabling time variation in econometric models is vital in economic and finance studies, such as when capturing time-varying risk exposures, modeling dynamic volatility estimation, engaging in high-frequency and high-dimensional factor model analysis, and solving for policy functions in dynamic stochastic general equilibrium models. Recent years have witnessed great enthusiasm for developing time-varying econometric models. Unfortunately, existing economic theory does not identify the underlying conditioning or state variables that drive time variation. Hence, all the existing time-varying estimation methods run the risk, to varying degrees, of misspecification. Different dynamic and time-varying econometric methods often produce diverse and even conflicting results. Since all models could be wrong, the primary focus should not be on developing sophisticated test statistics to reject existing models. The more meaningful approach seeks to know and measure the discrepancy between the actual underlying process and a given specification method. However, econometricians and empirical practitioners have long struggled to measure and test the appropriateness of time variation modeling so that they could decide on an appropriate modeling strategy. This project intends to fill the gap and objectively evaluate time-varying misspecification detection and tests. We will develop a novel and first-available methodology for testing and measuring time variation specifications in this project. Misspecification in time-varying modeling can come from various channels, such as omitted variable biases from conditioning variables, failure to include deterministic processes, the existence of latent processes, and so forth. We aim to provide guidance to empirical practitioners regarding the choice of appropriate time variation specification methods and to determine the richness of the conditioning variables used in modeling time variation in economic and financial systems. As a direct application, this project will revisit the stochastic discount factor model with time-varying risk prices. In the literature, there is an ongoing debate about whether the source of time variation in factor prices is a function of time or some stochastic processes. If conditioning variables drive time-varying parameters, is the unsatisfactory improvement in its explanatory power due to the existence of omitted variable biases? This proposal also intends to extend our estimation and testing methodology to high-frequency analysis, in which observations are sampled frequently. The literature has documented time variation in factors and factor loadings. We intend to answer whether this variation is due to changes in factors or factor loadings, given the altered high-frequency covariance matrix structure. 越来越多的实证证据表明，经济关系的结构会随着时间的推移而发生变化，近年来，人们对发展时变计量经济模型充满热情。在经济和金融研究中，启用时变计量经济模型至关重要，例如在捕捉时变风险敞口、建模动态波动率估计、进行高频和高维因子模型分析以及求解动态随机一般均衡模型中的政策函数时。 然而，现有的经济理论并未确定驱动时变的潜在条件变量或状态变量。因此，所有现有的时变估计方法都面临不同程度的模型错误设定的风险。不同的动态和时变计量经济方法通常会产生不同甚至是相互矛盾的结果。由于所有模型都可能是错误的，主要关注点不应该是发展复杂的检验统计量来拒绝现有模型。更有意义的方法是寻求了解和衡量实际潜在过程与给定规范方法之间的差异。然而，计量经济学家和实证从业者长期以来一直在努力衡量和检验时变建模的适当性，以便他们能够确定合适的建模策略。 本项目旨在填补这一空白，并客观评估时变错位检测和测试。本项目将重新审视具有时变风险价格的随机贴现因子模型。在文献中，关于因子价格时变来源是时间函数还是某种随机过程的问题一直存在争议。如果条件变量驱动时变参数，那么其解释力不佳是否归因于遗漏变量偏差的存在？本项目将通过采用我们新提出的错位估计和检验方法来调查这个问题，并检测遗漏变量偏差。本提案还打算将我们的估计和检验方法扩展到高频分析中，即观察值采样频繁。文献已经记录了因子和因子负荷的时变。我们打算回答这种变化是由于因子的变化还是由于因子负荷的变化，考虑到高频协方差矩阵结构的改变。 在本项目中，我们将开发一种新颖的测试和衡量时变规范的方法。我们的目标是为实证从业者提供关于选择合适的时变规范方法的指导，并确定用于建模经济和金融系统中时变的条件变量的丰富程度。

11507023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507023.value: 企业会计欺诈的产品市场影响：基于零售数据的实证研究

11507023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507023.value: Corporate accounting fraud refers to the phenomenon that the financial statements of listed companies are intentionally manipulated, and material damages are caused to investors. This topic is not only of interest to academic researchers, but also to investors, the press, and policymakers. Despite numerous existing studies, there is limited empirical evidence on the impact of corporate accounting fraud on the product market. As demonstrated theoretically by Sadka (2006), if the manager manipulates the books to make her firm appear more efficient than real, the market will expect such an efficient firm to charge a lower price and/or produce a higher quantity. Therefore, to avoid detection of the accounting fraud, the fraud firm needs to adjust its product market behaviors to be consistent with the misreported financial statement. This argument is consistent with the earlier accounting scandal of WorldCom, which aggressively lowered prices during the fraud period. A more recent example is Luckin Coffee, which dramatically reduced product prices by providing substantial discount or free products and increased the market share, at the same time of its accounting fraud. Furthermore, a firm’s fraudulent accounting practices will also have spillover effects on the product market behaviors of its peer firms (Sadka 2006). When the firm aggressively prices down or produces more of its products, it could significantly put a downward pressure on the peer firms’ pricing and production decisions and lower the profitability. Therefore, because of lower equilibrium price or markup, the industry as a whole will underperform. Our project studies the product market implications of firms’ fraudulent accounting practices, and we will examine the direct effect on the fraudulent firms as well as the spillover effect on the peer firms. A significant empirical challenge facing researchers is that information on product market is limited. Our proposed research is made possible by combining a recently available dataset on product prices for a wide range of consumer nondurable goods sold at diverse geographic locations around the United States. Our paper contributes to the literature on corporate accounting fraud (Amiram et al. 2018). Understanding the implications to the product market is critical to draw a holistic view of the effects of corporate accounting fraud. Given the lack of empirical research on the effect of corporate accounting fraud on the product market, our work will complement existing evidence on the costs of accounting frauds, which focuses on the financial markets to equity and debt holders. 企业会计欺诈是指上市公司故意操纵财务报表，对投资者造成实质性损害的现象。这个话题不仅引起学术研究者的兴趣，也吸引了投资者、新闻媒体和政策制定者的关注。尽管已经有许多研究，但是有关企业会计欺诈对产品市场的影响的实证证据仍然很有限。就像Sadka（2006）在理论上所表明的，如果经理人为让其公司看起来比实际更高效而操纵账目，市场就会预期这样一家高效的公司会收取更低的价格和/或生产更多的产品。因此，为了避免被发现会计欺诈，欺诈公司需要调整其产品市场行为以与虚报的财务报表一致。这个论点与WorldCom先前的会计丑闻相一致，该公司在欺诈期间大幅降低了价格。一个更近期的例子是瑞幸咖啡，在其会计欺诈期间通过提供大量折扣或免费产品来大幅降低产品价格并增加市场份额。此外，一家公司的会计欺诈行为也会对其同行公司的产品市场行为产生溢出效应（Sadka，2006）。当公司大幅降价或增加其产品产量时，它可能会显著地对同行公司的定价和生产决策施加下行压力，并降低盈利能力。因此，由于较低的均衡价格或利润率，整个行业的表现将不佳。我们的项目研究了企业欺诈会计实践对产品市场的影响，并将研究这种欺诈对欺诈公司的直接影响以及对同行公司的溢出效应。研究人员面临的一个重要实证挑战是产品市场信息有限。由于最近提供了一个数据集，包括在美国各地销售的各种消费品的产品价格，我们的研究得以实现。我们的论文为企业会计欺诈的文献做出了贡献（Amiram等，2018）。了解企业会计欺诈对产品市场的影响对于全面了解企业会计欺诈的影响至关重要。鉴于缺乏有关企业会计欺诈对产品市场影响的实证研究，我们的研究将补充现有有关会计欺诈成本的证据，这些证据主要针对股权和债务持有人的金融市场。

11507223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507223.value: 一種不依賴分佈信息的時間序列模型

11507223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11507223.value: Mr HU, Jie Dr WANG, Shuming

11507223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507223.value: Dynamic decision-making under uncertainty has found its successful applications in various domains, including inventory management, portfolio optimization, and transportation, to name a few. Based on realized uncertain parameters, each decision must account for both the immediate effects and its future ramifications on decisions to make. One key issue of modeling such a decision process is characterizing uncertain parameters. When independent and identically distributed (i.i.d.) samples are available, the sample average approximation and distributionally robust optimization approaches are well developed to characterize the distribution of uncertainties. In practice, however, uncertainties over time may be non-i.i.d. and even be correlated, and so are the historical observations. As such, using historical observations to directly approximate the distribution of future uncertainties is not suitable. This motivates us to study a new approach to model sequentially revealed uncertainties with non-i.i.d. historical observations. In this project, we propose to use time series to describe uncertain parameters and treat the remaining random residuals as the underlying source of uncertainty. The residuals are not necessarily i.i.d., and the joint distribution they follow may be hard to specify precisely. Based on only the historical residuals obtained from the estimation procedure of the time series, we adopt the distributional robust optimization approach to characterize the uncertainty via a nested ambiguity set. Equipped with the distribution-free time series, we can solve the resulting optimization problem to inform dynamic decisions under uncertainty. As a starting step, we consider the VAR and VARMA processes. We investigate the measure concentration of our proposed nested ambiguity set as well as finite-sample performance guarantees of the optimization problem. We plan to extend along the following directions. First, the time series can follow a more general process (such as vector ARIMA or multivariate ARCH). Second, for the sake of computational tractability, it is possible to consider other statistical distances in constructing the nested ambiguity set. Third, we explore high-quality and scalable approximations of the optimization problem. Finally, we are keen on applying our distribution-free time series model to solve dynamic problems in practice. 不確定性下的動態決策已成功應用於庫存管理、投資組合優化和運輸等多個領域。基於已實現的不確定參數，每項決策都必須考慮對當下的直接影響和未來影響。此類動態決策過程建模的一個關鍵問題是描述不確定參數的分佈。當獨立同分佈的樣本可用時，樣本平均近似和分佈式魯棒優化方法能很好地描述不確定性的分佈。 然而在實踐中，不確定性隨時間的變化可能是非獨立或非同分佈的，甚至是相關的，歷史觀測數據也是如此。因此，使用歷史觀測數據直接近似未來不確定性的分佈是不合適的。這促使我們研究一種新的方法，利用非獨立同分佈的歷史觀測數據對貫序揭示的不確定性進行建模。 本課題中，我們提出使用時間序列來描述不確定，並將剩餘的隨機殘差作為不確定性的來源。殘差並不一定是獨立同分佈的，它們所遵循的聯合分佈可能很難精確指定。根據時間序列估計過程中獲得的歷史殘差，我們採用一種不依賴分佈信息的方法，通過一個嵌套式的模糊集來描述不確定性的分佈。這種不依賴分佈信息的時間序列模型可以用於優化問題中，為不確定性下的動態決策提供指導。首先，我們考慮 VAR 和 VARMA 過程，研究所提出的嵌套式模糊集的度量集中以及其在優化問題中的有限樣本表現保證。我們計劃沿著以下方向進行擴展。首先，時間序列可以遵循更一般的過程（如向量 ARIMA 或多元 ARCH過）。其次，為了提高可計算性，可以在構建嵌套式模糊集時考慮其他統計距離。第三，我們探索優化問題的可計算的、高質量的近似解。最後，我們將應用這一模型來解決實際中的動態決策問題。

11507323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507323.value: 用於企業信用風險評估的多模態數據增強深度學習框架

11507323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507323.value: 在香港特別行政區財政司司長發表的2022-23年度財政預算案裡，司長強調政府將推動持續創新，鼓勵研究機構提出金融科技解決方案，以消除香港金融科技行業發展的瓶頸。 因此，擬議的GRF項目在戰略上符合香港特別行政區政府對香港和大灣區（GBA）技術創新和金融科技發展的呼籲。 更具體地說，擬議的 GRF 項目旨在開發一種新穎的多模式數據增強型深度學習框架，以改進企業信用風險評估。 隨著COVID-19大流行和全球經濟衰退造成的金融動盪日益加劇，及時評估個別企業的信用風險以避免全國性的金融困境變得越來越重要。 儘管之前已經有一些研究探討了企業信用風險評估的主題，但傳統方法主要只關注定量的財務因素，缺乏對這些模型評估的定性解釋/論證。 最近，研究人員開始研究從財經新聞文章、公司年度報告和公共社交媒體文本中提取的公司高維“情感表達”等定性因素，以加強企業信用風險評估。 因此，擬議的 GRF 項目旨在利用最先進的人工智能（AI）方法，即深度學習，能夠對高維輸入特徵（定量和定性特徵）和輸出類別之間複雜的非線性關係進行建模，以引導企業信用風險評估。 然而，深度學習的一個常見問題是缺乏標記的訓練樣本來訓練以數百萬個模型參數為特徵的深度神經網絡。 另一個問題是深度神經網絡的黑盒決策方法使得很難向業務用戶解釋這些網絡的決策/預測。 在設計科學（DS）研究方法的指導下，擬議的GRF項目的目標是解決上述研究問題。 例如，所提出的數據增強深度學習方法可以緩解缺乏標記訓練樣本的問題，多模態數據（例如文本情感表達和情感視頻幀）可以提高基於深度學習的企業信用風險評估的“可解釋性”。 因此，這項研究也有助於開發可解釋的人工智能。 為了確保短期/長期的業務和社會影響，我們計劃通過在納斯達克上市的行業合作夥伴對我們的研究成果（例如原型系統）進行技術轉讓。 由於擬議的GRF項目將為該地區開發一種新穎的基於深度學習的金融科技服務，因此有助於將香港發展成為世界金融科技中心，從而促進香港的長期經濟增長。

11507523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11507523.value: 可能錯誤設定的高維因子模型中結構變化的估計和測試：奇點方法

11507523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11507523.value: While high-dimensional factor models are useful tools for big data processing and machine learning, practitioners should be cautious when interpreting the estimation results of a factor model because the factor loading coefficients may undergo structural changes. In our preliminary study, we propose a quasi-maximum likelihood (QML) estimator for a single unknown break date. The new estimator can be applied under a broader context by allowing more types of breaks than existing methods. Our preliminary study also proposes a likelihood ratio (LR) test for breaks in loadings based on the QML estimator. We show that underlying structural changes in factor loading matrix leads to singular subsample covariance matrices of pseudo-factors. Our preliminary work proves that this singularity results in the QML estimator equal to the true break point with a probability approaching one in large samples under circumstances where existing estimators do not work. In addition, the superior performance of the QML estimator under the singularity also makes our LR test more powerful than existing tests, so it can detect structural breaks with a higher probability. Given the good properties of our QML estimator and LR test, we would like to extend the results to a more general setting. First, we will consider a more realistic setup with possibly multiple breaks in the sample. The project will establish the conditions under which the QML estimator can maintain its accuracy for multiple break points. Also, the project plans to generalize the LR test and study its sensitivity to multiple breaks (i.e., the power properties). We will propose a test for m breaks versus m+1 breaks, which requires us to investigate the properties of the QML estimator when the number of breaks is underestimated. Third, we will consider the robustness of the QML estimator under the case where the number of factors is possibly overestimated. Preliminary simulation supports the robustness property and we plan to further investigate this conjecture. 高維因數模型是大資料處理和機器學習的有用工具，但在解釋因數模型的估計結果時，從業者應謹慎，因為因數載荷係數可能會發生結構性變化。在我們的初步研究中，我們提出了一種用於單個未知中斷點的准最大似然（QML）估計器。新的估計器可以在更廣泛的背景下應用，允許比現有方法更多類型的中斷點。我們的初步研究還提出了基於QML估計器的載荷中斷點的似然比（LR）檢驗。 我們證明了因數載荷矩陣中的潛在結構性變化會導致偽因數的子樣本協方差矩陣奇異。我們的初步工作證明了在現有估計器無法工作的情況下，這種奇異性導致QML估計器等於真實的中斷點，在大樣本下概率趨近於1。此外，QML估計器在奇異性下的優越性能也使得我們的LR檢驗比現有檢驗更具有功效，因此可以更高概率地檢測結構性中斷點。 鑒於我們QML估計器和LR檢驗的良好性質，我們希望將結果推廣到更一般的設置中。首先，我們將考慮可能存在多個中斷點的更現實的設置。該專案將建立QML估計器在多個中斷點情況下保持準確性的條件。此外，該專案計畫推廣LR檢驗並研究其對多個中斷點的敏感性（即功效性質）。我們將提出一個m個中斷點與m+1個中斷點的檢驗，這要求我們調查當中斷點數量被低估時QML估計器的性質。第三，我們將考慮在可能過高估計因數數量的情況下，QML估計器的穩健性。初步模擬支持魯棒性的性質，我們計畫進一步研究這個猜想。

11508223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508223.value: 公平且高效地分配资源是经济学、运筹学和理论计算机科学等许多领域的基本问题。竞争均衡，经济学中的一个重要概念，经常被用作商品分配的效率和公平的基准。众所周知的福利经济学第一定理保证了竞争均衡的效率，而在收入相等条件下的竞争均衡被证明是无嫉妒的（经济学中的一个核心的公平概念）。由于这些重要性质，计算各种市场中的竞争均衡引起了经济学和理论计算机科学的广泛研究兴趣。在这些文献中，可替代性（GS）的概念已被证明对设计高效实用的竞争均衡算法至关重要。一个效用函数被称为满足GS的如果某些商品的价格上涨，而其他商品的价格保持不变，那么价格不变的每种商品的需求量都不会减少。尽管 GS 这个概念很重要，但要确定满足 GS 的效用函数却很困难。与竞争均衡密切相关的最大纳什福利（MNW）分配是效率和公平的另一个基准。它被定义为使所有参与分配的人的价值函数乘积最大化的多种商品的分配。虽然 MNW 分配具有 "不可思议 "的公平性，但即使在简单的线性价值函数情况下，它也很难求解。 在本项目中，我们提出用离散凸分析来刻画GS ，并研究其在分析简单实用的市场动态和 MNW 问题中的应用。特别地，我们提出用S凹性，一个离散凹性的概念，为可分割商品拍卖市场中的 GS 提供一个完整的刻画，并推导出一个自然的价格调整动态的单调性性质，以及使用 M自然凹性（另一个离散凹性的概念）为易处理的 MNW 问题提供一个刻画。如果研究取得成功，本项目的研究成果将以离散凸分析的角度，从根本上理解 GS 在竞争均衡和MNW问题的算法设计中的作用，从而为相关文献做出重要贡献，而且我们的项目所得出的见解可以指导决策者调整市场价格以达到竞争均衡，并实现高效公平的资源分配。

11508523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508523.value: 排序和估計問題的自適應採樣方法

11508523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508523.value: This project aims to propose adaptive sampling methods for ranking and estimation problems that concern a number of stochastic systems with unknown means. These problems find applications in operations research, e.g., measurement of financial risk, and in healthcare management, e.g., inference of adaptive experiments in clinical trials. Our primary focus in this project is on the development of adaptive sampling methods for identifying the system with the mth largest mean among K stochastic systems, and estimating its mean. We plan to investigate adaptive sampling methods including epsilon-Greedy and upper confidence bound (UCB) policies, propose a unified framework for studying various estimators for the mean of the ranked system, and provide theoretical supports to the proposed sampling methods and the ranked-mean estimators. We shall further apply the proposed adaptive sampling methods and estimators to several important applications, including the measurement of portfolio risk, and hypothesis testing in clinical trials. 在此項目中，我們提出針對未知均值的隨機系統的排序和估計問題的自適應採樣方法。此類問題廣泛應用於諸於金融風險度量之類的運籌學領域，以及諸如醫療管理中的臨床測試的自適應實驗。此項目的關注點在於研發可用於辨識K個隨機系統中第m最優系統的自適應採樣方法。我們致力於epsilion貪婪和上置信界（UCB）採樣方法，提出一體化的框架用於研究不同的均值估計量，提供此類方法和估計量的理論保證。我們將進一步把所提出的方法和估計量應用到幾個重要的實際問題，包括投資組合的風險度量和臨床測試的假設檢驗。

11508623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11508623.value: 在風險和模糊性下的魯棒目標導向動態決策制定

11508623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11508623.value: Markov decision processes (MDPs) are one of the standard models for sequential decision-making. To formulate an MDP, one needs to specify the transition kernel, which can be estimated from available data using statistical analysis. However, any error in estimating the transition kernel will be carried over to (and often amplified by) the MDP. As a result, we may obtain a poor policy that is over-optimistic. In recent years, robust Markov decision processes (robust MDPs) have emerged as a promising framework to overcome the aforementioned issue of ambiguity. In contrast to MDPs, robust MDPs consider a set of possible transition kernels, called the ambiguity set, instead of a single estimate. The policy obtained from solving a robust MDP is reliable since it simultaneously hedges against all possible kernels. However, the optimal worst-case performances are often overly conservative, and so robust MDPs do not offer practical insights into the actual performance of these reliable policies. By applying the idea of robust satisficing, in this project, we propose robust satisficing MDPs, where the expected returns of feasible policies are soft-constrained to achieve a user-specified target under ambiguity. We plan to address three important research questions. First, we build the optimization model for these robust satisficing MDPs and derive their tractable reformation. We plan to derive bounds on their performance and develop tailored algorithms for large-scale problems. Second, we plan to incorporate risk-averse optimization into the proposed robust satisficing MDPs, and we plan to investigate (approximate) dynamic programming algorithms to solve this problem. Third, we investigate the case where a baseline policy is available. We plan to propose a robust satisficing MDP with a baseline target and derive its tractable reformation. We plan to conduct a case study on a medical resource planning problem and understand how the consideration of model ambiguity would affect the optimality. Assuming positive results in this project, the frameworks and algorithms developed would provide a reliable target-based framework for sequential decision-making problems. Our proposed framework can be used for a wide range of applications, and our results will enrich the literature on both Markov decision processes and robust optimization. We plan to provide open source implementation online in order to encourage other researchers and practitioners to adopt the proposed framework. 馬爾可夫決策過程（MDPs）是順序決策的標準模型之一。為了製定一個MDP，需要指定轉移核函數，可以通過統計分析從可用數據中進行估計。然而，估計轉移核函數時的任何誤差都會傳遞到MDP中（並通常被放大）。結果就是，我們可能得到一個過於樂觀的不良策略。 近年來，魯棒馬爾可夫決策過程（robust MDPs）作為一種有前途的框架出現，用於克服上述模糊性問題。與MDPs不同，魯棒MDPs考慮一組可能的轉移核函數，稱為模糊集，而不是單一估計值。從解決魯棒MDP中得到的策略是可靠的，因為它同時對抗所有可能的核函數。然而，最優最壞情況表現通常過於保守，因此魯棒MDPs無法提供對這些可靠策略實際性能的實用洞察。 通過應用魯棒滿意化的思想，在這個項目中，我們提出了魯棒滿意化MDPs，其中可行策略的預期回報被軟約束以實現用戶指定的目標。我們計劃解決三個重要的研究問題。首先，我們為這些魯棒滿意化MDPs建立優化模型，並推導出其易處理的改進形式。我們計劃對它們的性能進行界定，並為大規模問題開發量身定制的算法。 其次，我們計劃將風險厭惡優化納入到提出的魯棒滿意化MDPs中，併計劃研究（近似）動態規划算法來解決這個問題。 第三，我們研究了基線策略可用的情況。我們計劃提出一個具有基線目標的魯棒滿意化MDP，並推導出其易處理的改進形式。我們計劃在醫療資源規劃問題上進行案例研究，並了解考慮模型模糊性將如何影響最優性。 在假設本項目取得積極結果的情況下，所開發的框架和算法將為順序決策問題提供可靠的基於目標的框架。我們提出的框架可用於廣泛的應用，並且我們的結果將豐富馬爾可夫決策過程和魯棒優化的文獻資料。我們計劃在線提供開源實現，以鼓勵其他研究人員和實踐者採用所提出的框架。

11509223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11509223.value: 不同網站來源的先前信念和一致性對信息診斷性與可信度不同網站來源的先前信念和一致性對信息診斷性與可信度的影響

11509223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11509223.value: Prof NAH, Fui Hoon Dr Peng, Chih-Hung Prof SIAU, Keng Leng

11509223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11509223.value: This proposal aims to build on existing work on enhancing credibility and believability of information in healthcare websites, particularly those from non-official alternative online health portals. Leveraging on the opportunities presented by a new experimental API called Portals, which allows healthcare information to be seamlessly integrated from multiple external websites, this proposal advocates that this could allow users to make better informed healthcare decisions. This is predicated upon better diagnosticity, and credibility perceptions of information provided at the non-official healthcare websites. The seamless integration of related healthcare information from multiple sources is a departure from current usage norms, where users need to purposively search for additional information from other sources (websites) that are of uncertain origins, giving rise to questions about the intentions, credibility, independence, and neutrality of these other websites. A recent preliminary work (Lee, Shen and Sia, 2021), an experimental study, provides evidence that multiple sources of information indeed enhances perceptions of information seekers on information quality and credibility. It further suggests that inconsistent health information contents in websites, as compared to consistent contents, resulted in a stronger interaction effect on perceived information quality. Building on this preliminary work, we will like to more deeply explore if this could be due to the cognitive switching modes between fast (automatic) and deliberate (conscious) processing, according to Cognitive Switching Theory (Louis and Sutton, 1991), as incongruent information presentation could lead to increased arousal and attention in people. In the preliminary work, we did not take into account the prior beliefs of individuals. Still, earlier existing research suggest that confirmation bias and the corresponding cognitive dissonance, particularly when people have prior beliefs towards a target cognition could, nevertheless, lead people to respond better to consistent rather than inconsistent information. We will thus like to disentangle this tension, and seek clarification to understand more precisely how people behave when faced with consistent versus inconsistent information that are congruent (or incongruent) with their prior beliefs. From the academic perspective, this will help to shed light on how people process and believe the multitude of healthcare information they encounter (e.g. search for) online. From the practitioner perspective, it could also give guidance on how healthcare websites could provide features that assist users to access to better quality healthcare information. 本研究旨在以現有工作為基礎，提高醫療保健網站信息的真實性和可信度，特別是來自非官方替代網路健康門戶網站的信息。利用名為 Portals 的新實驗性 API 提供的機會，該 API 允許從多個外部網站無縫集成醫療保健信息，該提案主張這可以讓用戶做出更明智的醫療保健決策。 這是基於更好的診斷性和對非官方醫療保健網站提供的信息的可信度感知。來自多個來源的相關醫療保健信息的無縫整合背離了當前的使用規範，用戶需要有目的地從來源不確定的其他來源（網站）搜索附加信息，從而引發有關意圖、可信度、獨立性的問題，以及這些其他網站的中立性。 最近的一項初步工作（Lee、Shen 和 Sia，2021 年）是一項實驗性研究，它提供的證據表明，多種信息來源確實增強了信息尋求者對信息品質和可信度的感知。 它進一步表明，與一致的內容相比，網站中不一致的健康信息內容對感知信息質量產生了更強的交互作用。根據認知轉換理論（Louis and Sutton, 1991），我們希望更深入地探討這是否是由於快速（自動）和刻意（有意識）處理之間的認知轉換模式不一致。信息呈現可以提高人們的覺醒和注意力。 早期的現有研究表明，確認偏差和相應的認知失調，特別是當人們對目標認知有先前的信念時，可能會導致人們對一致而不是不一致的信息做出更好的反應。 因此，我們希望解開這種緊張關係，並尋求澄清，以更準確地了解人們在面對與其先前信念一致（或不一致）的一致或不一致信息時的行為方式。從學術角度來看，這將有助於闡明人們如何處理和相信他們在網上遇到（例如搜索）的大量醫療信息。從業者的角度來看，它還可以指導醫療保健網站如何提供幫助用戶訪問更優質醫療保健信息的功能。

11509323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11509323.value: 現在說“謝謝”還為時過早：行動前的讚賞會抵制親社會行為

11600123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11600123.value: 善政與勝概:唐代亭記中的吏治與風景

11600123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11600123.value: 本計畫硏究中唐新興文類亭記，以之作為獨特視角，考察地方官和文士如何表達吏治理想，書寫山水勝概，並抒發個人高情。中唐以降，著名文士大多有長期地方仕宦的經歷，但不同於前代地方官或盡心政務而不見超脫情懷、或寄情山水而未以治績見稱，任職地方官的中唐文士既上承漢循吏的吏治精神，同時延續六朝以來吟詠林泉的傳統，兼有善政與勝概的書寫。由地方官修築之吏亭恰能銜接政治與山水，亭記則闡發其意義，開啟新的表現方式。新出土的中唐政治家與書法家顏真卿（709－785）《西亭記》碑亦為亭記研究提供新視野。亭記有褒讚地方官之功能，與德政碑、去思碑等表彰離任官員的生碑作用相類；但生碑之樹立與書寫都受朝廷管控，而吏亭之建立與亭記之表述則不受朝廷規管，從命名到記人、敘事、寫景、抒情，都可以容納文士的個人視角，有較大的自我表達空間，亦有更強的文學性。吏亭與亭記塑造地方新名勝，被後代文士不斷歌詠，並載入方志，成為地方歷史文化的重要組成。 Through examining Accounts of Pavilions (亭記), a literary genre burgeoning in the mid-Tang dynasty, this study aims to investigate how literati used Accounts of Pavilions to convey their ambitions in political administration, and how they expressed they own feelings while portraying mountains and waters. Most eminent mid-Tang literati had experiences of serving as local officials on a long-term basis. However, they were different from the previous generations of local officials, who were known by either devoting themselves to government affairs but without detachment from worldly affairs, or indulging in nature but not noted for political achievements. The mid-Tang literati who took on the duties of local officials carried on the Han upright officials’ spirit of dedication to conducting wholehearted service in political administration, and meanwhile continued the tradition of depicting mountain retreats in poetry since the Six dynasties. They thus combined righteous governance with enchanting landscape, and a new concept of political administration took its form. The official pavilions (吏亭) constructed at scenic spots were material representations of local officials’ political achievements and could exactly connect politics and landscape. Accordingly, Accounts of Pavilions not only explicated official pavilions’ political significance, but also depicted local splendid views, expressed personal feelings (or high-mindedness). Therefore, this new genre became an ideal means of exhibiting local officials’ aspirations. The newly excavated The Account of the West Pavilion (西亭記) by the mid-Tang politician and calligrapher, Yan Zhenqing 顏真卿（709－785）, also provides a new perspective for research on Accounts of Pavilions. Accounts of Pavilions had functions of eulogizing local officials, which were similar with those of the steles honoring officials who left their spots, such as steles of benevolent governance (德政碑) and steles of memorializing those who had left the local offices (去思碑). However, while the establishment and composing of the steles for living officials were both under the control of the imperial court, the construction of official pavilions and expression of Accounts of Pavilions fell out of the court’s management. From naming the pavilion to giving an account of someone’s life, narrating stories in writing, depicting natural scenery, and expressing one’s emotions, all could accommodate literati’s personal perspective and provide a larger space for their self-expression. Therefore, Accounts of Pavilions also have a much stronger sense of literality. Official Pavilions and Accounts of Pavilions formed new scenic spots. They were constantly narrated in poetry by later generations’ literati and recorded in local gazetteers, and further became an important component of local history and culture. Original Official Pavilions may disappear with the passage of time but could be textualized through Accounts of Pavilions. Accounts of Pavilions were primarily engraved on stones. Such material medium could possibly be lost as the carved stones were destroyed. Yet, Accounts of Pavilions were also textualized due to its preservation in collections of literary works. Local officials of later generations were thus able to renovate Official Pavilions according to the texts of Accounts of Pavilions and re-engrave the accounts, which, eventually, transformed the textualized Official Pavilions and Accounts of Pavilions into new landscape.

11600523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11600523.value: 聲形地境：評估與拓展香港聲音地圖的藝術可能性－Ambisonics實地錄音的應用

11600523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11600523.value: Field recording – on location rather than studio recording – is an increasingly common medium for creative expression adopted by artists and musicians. A popular method for showcasing field recording-based work is through online interactive soundmaps which have proliferated since the late 1990s; examples such as radio aporee allow anyone to contribute their recordings, tagged to the precise location of their capture through map Application Programming Interfaces (APIs). By encouraging discussions on issues of identity and place in relation to sound, they have raised public awareness of sonic environments and enabled their preservation. However, the reliance on standard map APIs and audio streaming functionalities has led to a homogenisation, limiting the variety and development of the artistic possibilities of soundmaps, in addition to complicity in digital ecosystems with ethical concerns. The proposal expands the use of soundmaps in an artistic context, beyond the normalised practice of browsing Google Maps whilst clicking through stereo recordings, for a more imaginative and critical listening experience using Ambisonic field recordings of Hong Kong. Ambisonics is a 3D sound format which has become increasingly accessible due to its incorporation into 360-video and VR formats; its strength derives from its flexibility in offering a more immersive experience which has thus far not been used extensively in soundmaps. Interviews with ten sound practitioners based in Hong Kong and abroad and surveys with 20 local and international participants running local soundmaps or contributing to global soundmaps will be conducted to determine strategies for creating soundmaps and field recordings. These primary data sources will be coded and analysed to develop the first typology of soundmaps concerned primarily with its use as an artistic tool, of interest to sound practice scholars. The typology will be used by the PI to develop a soundmap in collaboration with four local sound practitioners and local residents through a series of workshops on soundmaps, field recording and Ambisonics. We will consider soundmaps as topologies, referring to the mathematical study of properties preserved under continuous transformations, as a creative analogy for liberating recordings from the overtly indexical structure of standard online soundmaps. The practice-based research extends the PI’s previous work using Ambisonics field recordings to create soundmaps where sound enables a form of cartography without relying exclusively on sight for navigation. Concurrently, we will contextualise the artistic research through scholarly papers and present the research and artistic outputs in an exhibition, both online and offline. 田野錄音（亦作實地錄音，發生在錄音室之外）是逐漸廣為藝術家和音樂家採用的創作媒介。自90年代末以來，透過線上互動聲音地圖來展示實地錄音作品的手法與日俱增，例如Radio Aporee運用網上地圖服務的應用程式介面 (API)，讓任何人能夠分享他們的錄音，並標記在精確的位置上。這促進了關於地方、身份與聲音的討論，提升了公眾對於聲景的關注，並使之得以保存。然而，過度依賴標準網上地圖API和聲音串流功能卻導致了同質化，限制著聲音地圖的多樣發展與藝術潛力，伴隨著數碼生態中的道德問題。 此計劃旨在擴展聲音地圖的藝術運用－比起在瀏覽Google地圖時點擊播放立體聲(Stereo)錄音的常規做法，運用Ambisonic香港實地錄音帶來更具富想象空間和批判性的聆聽體驗。Ambisonics是一種3D聲音格式，在融合360影片和虛擬實境的應用中逐漸普及，能夠靈活地提供更身歷其境的體驗，這在聲音地圖的創作中還未得到廣泛的運用。 為了確立創作的策略，此計劃將採訪十位來自香港和海外的聲音工作者，並透過問卷調查二十位為當地或全球聲音地圖作出貢獻的本地和國際持分者。這些主要數據將被編碼和分析，協助建立第一個關注以聲音地圖作為創作工具的類型學，同時引起聲音實踐學者的興趣。通過一系列關於聲音地圖、實地錄音與Ambisonics的工作坊，首席研究員將運用該類型學與四位本地聲音工作者和居民共同創作一個聲音地圖。我們把聲音地圖比喻為拓撲學－在連續變化下保留特性的數學研究－期望將錄音從標準線上聲音地圖的公開索引結構中解放出來。這項實踐式研究拓展了首席研究員之前的工作，以Ambisonics作為創作聲音地圖的依據，而無需單憑視覺導航。同時，我們將藝術研究置於學術論文的語境中，並通過線上與線下的展覽展示研究和藝術成果。

11600623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11600623.value: 在香港刑事訴訟中協助兒童溝通：評估引入中介計劃

11600623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11600623.value: Children can face many difficulties communicating in criminal proceedings, be they involved as a victim, witness or defendant. They may lack the capacity to understand the language used by police, lawyers and judges and may be unable to effectively explain events, articulate responses to questions or give effective directions to their lawyers. Children’s more limited communication and language skills can affect their ability to understand procedural rights and the legal protections afforded to them. This may leave children feeling intimidated, confused, distressed and unsupported in criminal proceedings. More importantly, their ability to effectively participate in criminal proceedings and consequently their right to a fair trial can be negatively impacted. In recognition of the communication difficulties children face, many jurisdictions have adopted special measures to support children involved in criminal proceedings, particularly as victims and witnesses. These measures are designed to improve their ability to communicate and give reliable evidence. One method is to provide an intermediary to facilitate communication between the child and the criminal justice professionals. Intermediaries assist children to give cogent testimony, to fully understand questions asked of them, accurately communicate their responses to criminal justice professionals and assist them to understand questions asked. Such support can help ensure children’s effective participation in criminal proceedings and alleviate the stress felt by children. This project will examine why children face difficulties communicating in criminal trials in Hong Kong and what impact this has. It will review the measures that are available to help children communicate during criminal proceedings in Hong Kong, assess the need for reform and explore the desirability of introducing new measures, particularly intermediaries. To determine whether and, if so, what sort of intermediary scheme Hong Kong ought to adopt the project will explore and evaluate the intermediary schemes introduced in other jurisdictions, including England, New South Wales and the Australian Capital Territory. It will seek and incorporate professional stakeholder views about the effectiveness of these schemes. It will then assess and make recommendations about whether intermediaries should be introduced in Hong Kong and about the design detail of such a scheme. The overall aim of this project is to improve criminal justice outcomes for children in Hong Kong. 儿童在刑事诉讼中可能会面临许多沟通困难，无论他们是 作为受害人、证人或被告参与其中。他们可能缺乏理解的能力 警察、律师和法官使用的语言，可能无法有效解释 事件、明确回答问题或向律师提供有效指示。 儿童的沟通和语言技能较为有限，可能会影响他们的能力 了解程序性权利以及为其提供的法律保护。这可能会留下 儿童在犯罪过程中感到害怕、困惑、痛苦和得不到支持 诉讼程序。更重要的是，他们有效参与犯罪的能力 诉讼程序及其公平审判的权利可能会受到负面影响。在 认识到儿童面临的沟通困难，许多司法管辖区已 采取特别措施支持参与刑事诉讼的儿童， 尤其是作为受害者和证人。这些措施旨在提高他们的 沟通并提供可靠证据的能力。一种方法是提供一个 促进儿童与刑事司法之间沟通的中介人 专业人士。中介协助孩子提供令人信服的证言，充分理解 向他们提出问题，准确地将他们的回答传达给刑事司法 专业人士并帮助他们理解所提出的问题。这样的支持可以帮助 确保儿童有效参与刑事诉讼并缓解压力 孩子们感受到的

11602023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11602023.value: 通过快速光学成像检验触觉前注意改变的大脑动态网络

11602023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602023.value: We perceive the world through various sensory modalities (e.g., auditory: hear the bird singing; visual: see the cat running; somatosensory: feel the fluffy dog next to the leg). Human brain can automatically and constantly monitor unexpected changes in the environment through these sensory modalities without conscious awareness (e.g., even while we are focused on reading a book at an outdoor coffee shop, our brain can still automatically detect changes in the environment, such as a dropped coffee cup, a car appearing nearby, or a customer's sharp bag accidentally brushing against your arm). This ability is known as pre-attentive change detection. It is crucial for human survival which prepares us for the remedial actions (e.g., avoid being hurt by the dropped coffee cup, being hit by the car and being hurt by the sharp things) with our limited attentional resources. According to the prediction violation theory (Winkler, 2007), human brains automatically search for regularities in the environment to build predictive models for anticipating future events. An error signal (i.e., a mismatch response) is elicited when the prediction and the incoming events do not match. This error signal prepares us to update our predictive model and initiate remedial actions. We proposed a generic fronto-sensory brain network supporting the prediction violation hypothesis across different sensory modalities involving an early inferior frontal cortex (IFC) - sensory cortices (e.g., superior temporal, occipital cortices, and somatosensory cortices; STC, OC, and SMC) - late IFC brain network (Tse et al., 2021). The early IFC and late IFC are responsible for none-modality specific prediction model establishment/fitting process, respectively. While the sensory cortex is associating with modality-specific prediction error generation. Our previous studies using Event-related optical signal (EROS) have consistently demonstrated similar mismatch response brain activation sequence in pre-attentive visual and auditory change detection (i.e., early IFC - OC – late IFC and early IFC – STC – late IFC) which support the prediction violation hypothesis. However, the brain dynamics and potential mechanisms underlying somatosensory pre-attentive change detection is still largely unknown. The current study proposes four experiments to establish a generic fronto-sensory brain network and to test the prediction violation hypothesis underlying pre-attentive change detection in somatosensory modality. Understanding the neural basis of somatosensory mismatch responses is essential for developing training protocols for people who cannot rely on visual or auditory information in their daily life, such as blind or deaf people. 我們通過各種感知覺通道感知這個世界（例如：聽覺： 聽到鳥叫聲； 視覺：看到奔跑的貓； 觸覺： 感覺到腿邊的毛茸茸的小狗）。人類大腦能夠無意識地通過各種感知覺通道自動並持續的監測環境中的意外改變 （例如：儘管我們在室外咖啡店裡專注於看書， 我們的大腦仍然可以自動探測環境中的變化，比如跌落的咖啡杯，身旁略過的汽車，某個顧客的書包邊緣蹭過你的手臂）。 這種能力叫做前注意探測。 這對於人類生存尤為重要， 能夠幫助我們在注意資源有限的情況下準備好應對的行為（例如， 避免被跌落咖啡杯弄傷， 避免被車撞到， 避免被尖銳的東西傷到）。 根據預期違背理論（Winkler, 2007）, 人類大腦能夠自動搜索環境中的規律並建立預期模型來預測未來發生的事件。 當預期和發生的事件不一致的時候會引發錯誤信號（即，失匹配反應）。這個錯誤信號可以幫助我們更新我們的預期模型以及啟動應對反應。 我們提出一個對於各種感知覺通道通用的前額葉-感覺的大腦網絡 （早期前額葉-感知覺皮層 （例如， 上顳葉，枕葉，感知覺皮層）-後期前額葉， Tse et al, 2021）以支持預期違背假設。早期和晚期的前額葉分別負責非特定感知覺通道相關的預期模型的建立和擬合過程。感知覺皮層則是和特定感知覺通道的預期錯誤信號的產生有關。 我們之前的研究使用光學成像技術在視覺和聽覺的改變探測中持續展示了相似的失匹配腦部反應順序 （即， 早期前額葉-枕葉-後期前額葉， 早期前額葉-顳葉-後期前額葉）支持了預期違背假設。然而，觸覺前意識改變探測的大腦動態和潛在機制存在很多未知。 當前研究提出四個實驗來建立一個通用的額葉-感知覺大腦網絡並監測觸覺的前意識改變檢測的預期違背假設。理解觸覺失匹配反應對於發展針對無法以來視覺或聽覺的人群（例如盲人或失聰人群）提供訓練有很重要的作用。

11602123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11602123.value: Prof Aarseth, Espen Prof HOLOPAINEN, Jussi Pekka Dr Möring, Sebastian

11602123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602123.value: 電腦遊戲已經成為一種文化表現形式。紐約現代藝術博物館自2013年起開始收藏電 腦遊戲；一款電腦遊戲在2017年電子藝術節（Ars Electronica）上獲得了金尼卡獎 （Golden Nica award）；專門展示電腦遊戲的美術館和藝術節亦相繼出現。學術上 ，電腦遊戲不僅被視為一種開發的技術，也因為其意義層面而成為人文學科的研究 對象。與其他媒體相比，電腦遊戲的不同之處是：它們把決定權交給玩家，而玩家 亦需要一定技巧。電腦遊戲的特殊性催生了遊戲詮釋學這一範式——即對電腦遊戲 的詮釋研究，探討這種新媒體的作品是如何創造意義，並被玩家解讀。然而，隨著 Youtube、Twitch.TV、嗶哩嗶哩和鬥魚等服務，令「直播」（在線觀看其他人玩遊 戲）變得流行，在直播中，玩家顯然不是唯一在詮釋遊戲的人。由於許多遊戲直播 都是「電子競技 」產業的一部分——即商業電腦遊戲競賽，因此通常使用運動研 究的範式來解釋當中涉及的意義生成。然而，玩遊戲不僅在被描述為「體育 」之 前已具有意義，而且還包括創意和藝術成果。此外，網路上所盛行的越軌遊戲玩法 正正表明，儘管遊戲往往試圖講述特定的故事，但越來越多人以顛覆設計者意圖和 遊戲文本的方式進行遊戲：玩家從設計者手中奪回遊戲，挪用他們設計的功能世界 ，並在其中表演以表達自我。迄今為止，遊戲詮釋學一直主要以第一人稱視角去分 析遊戲文本。它未曾開始探討，如何看待遊戲作為被他人觀看的自我表達工具，而 到目前為止，這現象主要是從社會科學的角度來研究。通過表演的概念，我們將表 達性的遊戲玩法納入人文學科的範疇。 我們的目標包含兩個層面，首先，我們希望推進電腦遊戲詮釋學的發展，令它得以應對當今遊戲的消費方式。我們試圖了解「被表演」如何挑戰主流的遊戲詮釋學觀點，以及有什麼情況令玩遊戲被「作為表演」地欣賞。我們提出，把表演視為遊戲詮釋的觀點。此外，我們將探討電腦遊戲在表演中的角色，以及電腦遊戲的存在如何令表演被詮釋為有意義。我們對玩遊戲表演的定義建基於傳統表演藝術。對電腦遊戲作為共存和藝術表達空間的進一步理解，將有助於虛擬表演的理論，並有助於在虛擬領域開展更高層次的藝術形式和文化實踐。我們的研究有助理解遊戲作為媒體如何被受眾使用，我們預期是次研究的結果，可以為對遊戲或類遊戲在線環境感興趣的媒體研究學者帶來貢獻。

11602523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11602523.value: 認罪認罰從寬制度是否重塑了中國的刑事司法? - 一項基於實證的研究

11602523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11602523.value: Dr Wu, Jun Dr Xiao, Huina

11602523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11602523.value: 中國的認罪認罰從寬制度類似普通法國家的有罪答辯制度和美國的辯訴交易制度。中國的認罪認罰從寬制度允許被告以認罪換取較輕的刑罰。認罪認罰從寬意味着承認有罪、承擔罪責和接受懲罰。這一制度備受爭議，因爲它可能會受到警察、檢察官甚至法院的操縱和濫用，從而侵犯被告的權益。本項目研究認罪認罰從寬制度是否重塑了中國的刑事司法制度，如果是，又是如何重塑的。本項目提出四個基本研究問題：第一，認罪認罰從寬制度是否從根本上改變中國刑事司法制度的權力平衡。換言之，引入認罪認罰制度之後，刑事訴訟程序是否由流水線式合作處理案件轉向以檢察院爲中心的制度？第二，檢察院如何作出認罪認罰從寬決定？檢察院根據認罪認罰從寬決定提出量刑建議時會考慮哪些因素？第三，法院如何應對近期檢察院權力的提高？第四，認罪認罰對被告有何影響？認罪認罰是否必然導致對被告的輕判？刑事司法系統對認罪認罰的被告有何程序保障？這些措施在實踐中是否有效？中國刑事辯護律師在保護認罪認罰的被告人權利方面有哪些策略？ 通過對認罪認罰從寬處理案件的統計分析，本項目將揭示法院在多大程度上認可檢察院的量刑建議以及影響案件結果的因素。本項目將通過訪談研究對認罪認罰的被告人權益的保障情況，特別是被告人可獲得的程序保障，被告人的權益在實踐中是否受到侵犯，以及被告人是否抗拒認罪認罰。 本項目力求揭示檢察院和法院對認罪認罰從寬制度的態度，以及該制度在實踐中如何運作，特別是檢察官如何和被告人和刑事律師談判，以及他們如何和地方法院溝通。本研究還將調查法院如何審查檢察院的量刑建議。 本項目將（向最高人民檢察院和最高人民法院）建議修改目前的認罪認罰從寬制度，爲被告人提供進一步的程序保障。

11603423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11603423.value: 中美於2003-2023年間的破裂關係：從權力轉移理論和結構主題模型看中國政府的不滿

11603423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11603423.value: Almost all specialists agree that Sino-US relations are now at their rockiest in decades, perhaps going all the way back to US President Richard Nixon’s groundbreaking visit to the People’s Republic (PRC) in February 1972. From the perspective of power transition theory, which is used frequently to model Sino-US relations, growing trouble in the relationship between any dominant power and rising power is to be expected when two conditions are met: (1) the rising power is nearing the point of parity with the dominant state in comprehensive national strength; and (2) the rising power’s elites, especially the governing elites, are dissatisfied with the international order over which the dominant power presides. In a worst-case scenario, tensions between the dominant state and rising challenger fueled by the structural change and the challenger’s dissatisfaction could escalate to war. Despite the pivotal role the rising power’s satisfaction/dissatisfaction plays in power transition theory, the dissatisfaction variable is woefully understudied. Some analysts have provided useful indicators for measuring degree of dissatisfaction after it appears, but not for explaining the circumstances under which it might arise and then take root. There is solid evidence to suggest that Chinese Communist Party (CCP) elites have become increasingly dissatisfied with the US-led liberal international order during the past 15-20 years. The question is: Why, exactly? The issue of concern is not simply everyday policy disputes. There are already any number of excellent treatments chronicling the key issues and events in the Sino-US relationship’s breakdown. The issue is: From a conceptual point of view, what is the underlying structure of CCP elite dissatisfaction? Is there a root or core abstract concern which drives all the others? The guiding hypothesis in this research is that a persistent and growing CCP aversion to permanent decentering in world history and international relations is the root factor structuring Chinese dissatisfaction. To test this proposition, the research will use the big data analysis tool of structural topic modeling (STM) combined with rigorous discourse analysis to examine what PRC elites are actually writing and saying about the US-led liberal international order in news propaganda (the People’s Daily) and quasi-academic IR journals (Xiandai Guoji Guanxi and Guoji Wenti Yanjiu). Because STM is exceptional at uncovering latent topics in a discourse which researchers did not anticipate existed, even if the guiding hypothesis proves limited, the structure of PRC dissatisfaction can still be uncovered. 絶大部份中美專家都同意，自1972年美國總統尼克松訪華以來，目前的中美關係至為緊張。根據經常被用以解釋中美關係的權力轉移理論，當兩國出現以下兩種情況時，雙方的矛盾便會加劇：一) 崛起國的綜合國家實力趨近主導國；二) 崛起國的精英，尤其是政府官員，益發不滿主導國當道的國際秩序。這種因為國家實力出現結構性轉變，以及相關政府不滿情緒持續高漲而引起的緊張局勢，在最壞的情況下，可升級至以戰爭收場。 無可否認，在權力轉移理論中，研究崛起國滿意與否殊關重要。然而，學術界卻鮮有進一步釐定引致這種滿意或不滿意的變量因素。例如近年有研究人員整合了有用的指標以量度政府的不滿意程度，欲沒有解釋在什麼情況下一個政府會產生並持續感到不滿。中國政府在過去15至20年間，顯然對美國主導的自由國際秩序越趨不滿。為什麼會出現這樣的情況？ 現時有不少研究針對闡釋引致中美關係破裂的事件，但值得關注的不僅是日常的政策項目，本研究從基本概念出發，調研中國政府不滿情緒的結構性原因，探討是否有一種深層次的核心原則，多年來一直影響中國政府精英對國際關係和其他問題的判斷。 我們假設中國政府日漸厭惡中國持續在全球歷史和國際關係格局中的邊緣化角色。為了驗證這個命題，本研究將結合大數據分析工具結構主題模型（STM）和嚴謹的論述分析方法，分析中國政府精英在新聞報章（人民日報）和中國學術國際關係期刊（現代國際關係和國際問題研究）中，如何描述美國主導的自由國際秩序。儘管研究假設可能有所局限，但STM擅於發現研究人員預測以外的潛在話語，本研究將得以全面解構中國政府對國際格局不滿的緣由。

11603823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11603823.value: 大流行后社会分裂与冲突：理论与实验

11603823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11603823.value: Dr BAO, Te Prof SZECH, Nora

11603823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11603823.value: 尽管COVID-19大流行即将结束，但其对社会各个方面仍产生深远的影响。历史经验表明，大流行通常会引发社会分裂、冲突甚至战争。尽管这种时间上的相关性在历史和社会学文献中被广泛记录，但其中是否存在因果关系仍有待深入研究。 本项目的目标是深入研究大流行是否确实导致社会冲突，以及它是如何将一个原本具有广泛共识、良好运作的社会转变为一个充满分歧观点、饱受动荡和冲突困扰的社会。特别是从社会经济的角度来看，我们关注的是大流行中哪些特征会导致社会内部形成强烈的群体认同，从而引发所谓的“多米诺效应”，即在各种社会问题上引发公众的极化反应。 本研究出发点是将COVID-19大流行视为一个典型的分裂型公共事件，即其中公众的事前非极化类型分布可能会导致事后的极化反应（Hu等，2022年）。我们推测，这种分裂现象的根本原因在于个体感染病毒的风险暴露率是非递增的。换句话说，即使在社会中存在微小的异质性，只要病毒具有人际传播的特性，公众对待疫情的态度和反应都将呈现二元模式，一些人倾向于“安全至上”，而另一些人则主张“生活如常”。 我们假设这种疫情期间的极化行为模式有潜力成为一系列在正常情况下不会导致分裂反应的社会问题上的触发因素。我们提出了一个传递机制，该机制通过大流行后形成的强烈内部群体认同来解释（详见4.1-4.3）。为了从典型的分散但不极化的社会（其中异质性个体通常具有弱内部群体认同）中识别出这种形成的现实条件，本研究计划在亚洲（香港与新加坡）和欧洲（德国与荷兰）进行实验室和田野实验。 总之，本项目着重研究“大流行中的极化反应 → 其他非分裂公共事件中的极化反应”的传递机制。了解这种传递机制的运作方式将是制定后大流行时期政策的第一步，这些政策有助于社会的恢复。

11603923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11603923.value: 構建中國的基於信任和情境的自動決策演算法之解釋權

11603923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11603923.value: Prof Ding, Xiaodong Mr Yu, Ronald Ker-Wei

11603923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11603923.value: 我们现在生活在一个人工智能（AI）和大数据的时代，其中算法在做出许多影响我们日常生活的重要决策方面起着关键作用。毫无疑问，决策算法在诸如叫车、自动驾驶和购买推荐等领域的广泛应用带来了更高效率和更好服务等好处。然而，这些算法也由于AI的黑箱问题为法律体系带来了严重挑战。首先，如果决策算法接管人类在做出有约束力的决策方面的角色，但这些决策无法得到适当解释，人类的自主权就会受到威胁。其次，许多基于算法的推荐系统依赖于收集的用户偏好数据，从而可能产生信息茧房，侵犯了个人自由。第三，当算法在不完整的数据集上进行训练时，它们可能引入歧视和偏见。 针对上述风险，学者们提出了两个解决方案来解决上述问题：强制算法披露以解决黑箱问题，以及创建解释权以增加个人自由。然而，对于强制披露，全面披露是否实际和可取是一个有效的问题。此外，国家法律提供的解释权的内容、范围、时间和方式的问题仍然存在很大的争议和不确定性。本研究认为，解释权应基于情境完整性和信任理论，而不是个人权利模式。本研究旨在通过回答以下问题来填补这一空白：中国解释权的适当设计是什么？在回答这个问题时，本项目将使用混合方法解决四个子问题：首先，欧盟和中国法律规定的解释权的个人权利途径相关的问题；其次，解释权路径是否可以被外部监管模型取代；第三，如果不能，应如何用信任和基于情境的理论重构解释权以避免所识别的问题？第四，探讨将影响解释权设计的中国商业部门的独特性。 本研究建议解释权应该是一种动态的、沟通的、相对主义的程序权利，由信任和基于情境的理论支持。研究结果将有助于阐明超越专注于特定司法管辖区的研究的算法监管的一般模式。

11604123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11604123.value: 重建儒家王國：丁若鏞的政法哲學

11604123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11604123.value: Since the creation of the modern Korean state, one of the most intellectually captivating questions for Korean historians and philosophers has been the relation between Confucianism and modernity. Korean scholars’ long preoccupation with this question was propelled in part by the popular perception of Confucianism as the greatest obstacle to the transformation of Korea into a modern state and society. Many Korean historians and philosophers in the 1970s and 1980s cast skepticism on Confucianism as being fundamentally at odds with (Western) modernity and actively revisited the relation between Confucianism and modernity by critically distinguishing a new version of Confucianism that emerged in the eighteenth-century—widely known as “Practical Learning”—from Cheng-Zhu Neo-Confucianism, which had been firmly established in Korea as intellectual and political orthodoxy since the seventeenth-century. According to Korean scholars subscribing to this revisionist position, Confucians scholars of the late Chosŏn period such as Hong Tae-yong, Pak Chi-wŏn, Pak Chae-ka, and especially Chŏng Yagyong advanced a new type of Confucianism, which stressed the practicality of Confucian learning with a view to advancing scientific knowledge, promoting socioeconomic and political reform, and, ultimately, improving the people’s economic well-being. Chŏng Yagyong (1762-1836), better known by his penname Tasan, has been given special attention as a thinker who laid the systematic philosophical foundation for Practical Learning by radically challenging the orthodoxy of Neo-Confucianism. In the revisionist interpretation, Tasan is casually portrayed as the Korean harbinger of Western-style modernity, characterized by a centralized state and a society of autonomous individuals a la Kant. This project aims to reevaluate Tasan’s vision of a good society by paying close attention to his legal-political philosophy, which has been largely ignored in the Anglophone studies on Tasan. It shows that a careful study of Tasan’s legal and political writings such as The Ancient Glosses on the Book of Documents (尙書古訓), The Proposal for Good Government (經世遺表) and Toward a New Criminal Law (欽欽新書), supplemented by his ritual theories, reveals that what Tasan anticipated was not so much a Western-style modern state but a Confucian moral state, at the core of which lies a ritual-based political order and a moral society of authentic Confucian gentlemen and gentlewomen. This project also aims to show the intimate connection between Tasan’s classical studies and his vision for a good society. 自從現代韓國國家的建立以來，儒學與現代性之間的關係一直是韓國歷史學家和哲學家最為關注的問題之一。韓國學者長期以來對這個問題的關注，部分是因為人們普遍認為儒家思想是韓國向現代國家和社會轉型的最大障礙。 在20世紀70年代和80年代，許多韓國歷史學家和哲學家對儒學與（西方）現代性之間根本不一致的觀點表示了懷疑，並透過批判性地區分十八世紀出現的新版本儒學，積極重新審視儒學與現代性之間的關係。 這一被廣泛稱為「實學」的新版本儒學來自程朱理學，在17世紀以來，程朱理學在韓國牢固確立了知識和政治的正統地位。根據支持這一修正主義立場的韓國學者，朝鮮後期的儒家學者，如洪大容、朴趾源、朴齊家，特別是丁若鏞，提出了一種強調實用性的新型儒學。 這種儒家學習的目的是提升科學知識，推動社會經濟和政治改革，從而最終改善人民的經濟福祉。 筆名塔山的思想家丁若鏞（1762-1836）受到特別關注，他通過徹底挑戰新儒家的正統思想，為實學奠定了系統的哲學基礎。在修正主義的解釋中，塔山被描繪成韓國西方現代性的先驅，其特點是集權國家和康德式的自治個人社會。這個項目的目的是透過深入探討塔山的法律政治哲學，重新評估他對美好社會的願景，而這一點在西方學者對塔山的研究中常常被忽視。這顯示出，對塔山的法律和政治著作進行仔細研究，如《尚書古訓》、《經世遺表》和《欽欽新書》，輔以他的禮制理論，將揭示出塔山所預期的並不是那麼類似於西式現代國家，而更像是一個儒家道德國家，其核心是建立在禮儀為基礎的政治秩序和真正的儒家紳士淑女的道德社會。此外，這個項目還旨在展示塔山的古典研究與他對美好社會願景之間的緊密聯繫。

11604323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11604323.value: 立法者作為在民主化進程中外交政策的行動者:來自緬甸(2011-2021年)的見解。

11604323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11604323.value: The proposal will examine the case of Myanmar’s past decade of political opening (2011-2021) to question the prevailing narrative that parliaments, especially in post-authoritarian settings, wield limited influence over foreign policymaking. How do nascent legislatures engage with foreign affairs? Does the role of parliaments in foreign policymaking affect the democratisation of societies emerging from authoritarian rule? The project will concentrate on the practice of international affairs developed by Myanmar’s Parliament of the Union (Pyidaungsu Hluttaw) across two five-year legislatures (2011-2016 and 2016-2021). It will be grounded on an in-depth investigation of publicly available, Burmese-language legislative proceedings and accompanying interviews with former parliamentarians and United Nations experts. It will develop a novel and counterintuitive hypothesis: that the involvement of Myanmar’s parliament in foreign affairs has contributed significantly, and perhaps decisively, to the collapse the democratic experiment in 2021. To understand the impact of parliament as an emerging institution getting involved in international issues, the study will first probe the proposition that Myanmar’s legislature positioned itself as a significant foreign policy actor until a coup shut it down in February 2021. It will unpack such process, and the outcomes it led to, by examining the micro-foundations of the legislature’s international activity. It will characterize and explain patterns in the foreign policy action and behaviour of individual parliamentarians across two legislatures controlled by competing ruling parties. Which individuals engaged in foreign policy activity? What potentially conflictual issues did they address on the floor? How did other legislators, including army-appointed ones, responded? Then, focusing on the major diplomatic or national security issues and international human rights disputes identified, the project will build a multiple case study to test the hypothesis that parliamentary involvement in contentious foreign affairs affected democratization, altered Myanmar’s civil-military equilibrium and, ultimately, fostered the military takeover of 2021. The contributions of this project are twofold. Informed by the literature on parliament and international affairs, the study will assess the records of a post-authoritarian, non-Western legislatures in foreign policy and identify policy applications for complex, sometimes highly sensitive, foreign and national security contexts. In addition, shedding light unto unexamined Burmese-language materials teh project will aim to provide novel empirical insights on how Myanmar’s hybrid, semi-civilian regime operated and why it collapsed within a decade. The findings will informed understandings of hybrid regime dynamics and foreign policy governance after political opening in fledgling democracies. 本提案將研究緬甸過去十年(2011-2021 年)政治開放的情況,以質疑盛行的說法,即議會對外交決策的影響力有限，尤其是在後威權環境下。新興立法機構如何參與外交事務?議會在制定外交政策中的角色是否會影響從威權統治中崛起的社會的民主化?該項目將重點研究緬甸聯邦議會(Pyidaungsu Hluttaw)在兩個五年任期(2011-2016和2016-2021)間發展的國際事務實踐。該項目將以對公開可獲取的緬甸語立法程序的深入調查為基礎,並結合對前議員和聯合國專家的採訪。它將提出一種新穎而反直覺的假設:緬甸議會在外交事務中的參與對於2021年民主實驗的崩潰起到了重大甚至決定性的作用。 為了解作為新興機構參與國際事務的議會的影響,本研究將首先探討這樣一個觀點:緬甸的立法機構在2021年2月發生政變之前,將自己定位為一個重要的外交政策行動者。它將通過研究立法機構的國際活動的微觀基礎,來揭示這一過程以及其導致的結果。它將描述並解釋由相互競爭的執政黨控制的兩個立法機構中個別議員的外交政策行動和行為模式。哪些人參與了外交政策活動?他們在會場上討論了哪些可能產生衝突的問題?其他議員,包括軍隊任命的議員,是如何回應的?然後,重點關注已確定的重大外交或國家安全問題以及國際人權爭端,本研究將建立一個多案例研究,以驗證以下假設:議會參與有爭議的外交事務影響了民主化進程,改變了緬甸的軍民平衡,並最終促成了2021年的軍事接管。 本項目有兩方面的貢獻。在對議會和國際事務的文獻進行研究的基礎上,該研究將評估後威權時代的非西方立法機構在外交政策方面的記錄,並確定在複雜、有時非常敏感的外交和國家安全背景下的政策應用。此外,通過揭示未被研究的緬甸語材料,該項目旨在提供新穎的實證見解,說明緬甸的混合半文明政權是如何運作的,以及為何在十年內崩潰。研究結果將有助於對新興民主國家在政治開放後的混合政權動態和外交政策治理的理解。

11606023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11606023.value: 用於品牌塑造的線上企業教學視頻：航空安全視頻的定性研究

11606023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606023.value: 視頻媒介通信是企業通信中的一個顯而易見的通信渠道。視頻讓內容創作者能夠使用各種多模態和多語言資源進行意義構建，從而為創意符號學工作開闢了可能性。能夠使用多種模式的能力使視頻成為以視覺和聽覺模式等其他符號設計特徵呈現說明的適當媒介。這種視頻所提供的可能性在全球化的航空業中尤其重要，因為難以假定意義構建的實踐。然而，到目前為止，很少有人關注使用社會語言學的方向來探究企業通信中的視頻媒介通信。 是次研究項目將專注於飛行安全視頻。這是一種企業說明視頻體裁。儘管此類型的影片和其跨話語性質以將安全、企業和跨文化論述綜合在一起的特點非常重要，但它到目前為止主要在航空安全領域被研究，主要關注乘客的信息記憶作為效果的指標。飛行安全視頻在提高航空公司企業形象方面的交易，尤其是人際潛力方面的知識普遍匱乏。如何創作並使用在社交媒體平台上發布的飛行安全視頻來提升企業形象的研究也是不足。此研究旨在針對這些被忽略的範疇，專注探究以下方向：1）識別飛行安全視頻的體裁特徵；2）研究這些視頻中多語言和多模態資源的運用；3）瞭解這些視頻作為品牌策略的使用情況；以及4）推薦設計具有交易和人際功能的企業說明視頻的方法。 飛行安全視頻的跨話語性質需要以跨學科的角度去理解它們如何被設計來實現多種功能。是次研究將采用多種研究方法，以全球化的社會語言學（Blommaert，2010）的基礎架構作爲支持。該理論強調資源的流動性。視頻將被概念化為一個超語空間，它允許進行批判和創新的意義構建（Li，2011）。是次研究將在社交媒體平台上收集15年來10家航空公司創作的30個飛行安全視頻，包括提供給跨國觀眾的英語和其他語言的視頻。是次研究將使用多模態體裁分析研究這些視頻，以揭示企業形象如何隨著時間推移透過話語構建。研究也將收集與航空公司員工或公關專業人員的電子郵件訪談， 以及300個評論。所收集的資料將以歸納方式分析，以識別出現的主題。 是次項目的研究結果將在實證和專業水平上作出貢獻。在實證上，是次研究可以為企業說明視頻的研究做出貢獻。這是在企業通信和社會語言學中尚未充分探索的體裁。在專業層面，此研究也將帶來教學模型的開發，該模型具有數位多模態創作的原則，有助通訊專家為全球受眾設計專業的、視頻化的內容。

11606123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11606123.value: 白話文在香港的初期發展史(1920-1935)

11606123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11606123.value: 本計劃以歷史文獻的搜集、分析為基礎，從政府、商界、學界、大眾等不同層面探究五四白話文在香港的初期發展進程，並選取重要而受忽略的報紙、雜誌及教科書，再輔以華人機構與政府的相關檔案文獻，呈現時人對文言、白話語體的迎拒狀況。繼英文之後，文言文的書寫文體在香港具備強勢地位，而白話文在香港則經歷了15年(1920-1935)匍匐前行的歲月，其「初期」發展史不可謂不漫長；它雖然不如國內那樣自上而下地被大舉推動，但也不能夠簡單化地將之定論為受壓於舊文化氛圍便運而不動。事實上，它整體上未曾與文言文發生你死我活的對立。為具體闡明白話文的初期發展步伐，這15年將會被分作五年一組、共三個時段，進而觀察香港社會內部的時局轉變、國內政局發展與文白發展的趨勢。將要觸及的不只是文字書寫形式轉變問題，還有語言文字使用習慣背後反映的社群文化邊界與社會局勢、人口流動、現代國家觀念轉變的複雜互動關係，這些均影響了白話文的在地化發展進程。反過來說，當釐清了一幅相對清晰的白話文歷史發展圖景的時候，也有助展現香港社會文化轉變的思想脈絡以及新舊知識社群的交流網絡。 This project examines the resistance and assistance encountered in the development of vernacular Chinese (modern written Chinese；白話文) in Hong Kong, 1920-1935 from its inception to its rise走上發展的道路. Vernacular Chinese was once widely used after 1936 due to anti-Japanese war. However, the early development of vernacular Chinese should be traced back from 1920 to 1935. Under what kinds of social environment and conditions was vernacular Chinese developed in these 15 years in Hong Kong was the concern of the project. Specifically, how vernacular Chinese was employed in different settings such as education, politics and business, academia and culture will be adopted as research method and perspective. An analysis on how the education system had affected the development of vernacular Chinese will be made so as to delineate the relationship between the attitudes of the education officials on the use of Classical Chinese(文言文) and vernacular Chinese and the use of vernacular articles in local school textbooks in terms of their length, quantity and teaching content. At the same time, there will be a discussion on the relationship between the development of Hong Kong's Vernacular Chinese and southbound scholars who fled to Hong Kong before WWII. A comprehensive study of how people of different classes regarded the vernacular and the classics will be conducted. This an area which has long been neglected in the field. The study is conducive to the understanding of the development of the localization of vernacular Chinese in Hong Kong. Indeed many publications of the early 1920s reflected that in Hong Kong's literary or cultural settings, Wen and Bai (文白) was not incompatible. Wen and Bai were frequently used at the same time in many newspapers or literary publications. This phenomenon lasted for a long time in post-war Hong Kong. However, this does not mean that there is no dispute between the use of Wen and Bai in Hong Kong. The complex phenomenon of the users’ habits of the two written forms is reflected in the development process of vernacular writing and the reasons behind it ought to be investigated. This project hopes to gain a relatively clear picture of the historical development and ideological context of the vernacular. According to the PI of this project, only few existing publications discussed the history of the development of Vernacular Chinese in Hong Kong. Yet, there are still many important academic questions that are worth further exploration. For example, what was the outlook of vernacular language when it appeared in Hong Kong? How did vernacular interact with classical Chinese in the process of development? What are the differences in the attitudes of Hong Kong society? How were Wen and Bai used in the local primary and secondary school Chinese textbooks? Were there any differences in the attitudes of acceptance among the Hong Kong community and how frequent were Wen and Bai used by Hong Kong elite groups and the general public? The research on these issues can help obtain a better understanding of the development history of Wen and Bai in Hong Kong and provide new insights into the cultural characteristics and social knowledge structure of Hong Kong society. By means of collecting primary source materials such as archival materials, newspapers and magazines, primary and secondary school Chinese textbooks, memoirs, diaries, literary works, public and private letters, conference minutes, etc., we hope to gain a better understanding of the above issues and hopefully the research objectives can be achieved. The academic findings could have a social impact on readers of different levels such as students, researchers, educators and even the general public. They can understand the historical aspects of the development of vernacular Chinese in Hong Kong.

11607623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11607623.value: 動作研究：通過人機協作運動和編排進行設計和表演

11607623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11607623.value: Prof Chan, Anna Chung Ying Prof Diana, Carla Prof Ju, Wendy

11607623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11607623.value: Movement-based technologies have been used by performers and artists to extend the stage and installation space beyond the static aspects of a piece to a more dynamic interaction in time using effectors in the environment. These programmable movement actuators have often resembled the concept of robotics, although the original intention of serving human needs have now been supplanted by generations of social robots that have human-like behavioral attributes whose designs go beyond merely responding-to-requests, to interacting socially in a human environment. Recent works have increasingly applied state-of-the-art movement technologies to performance and exhibition, enabling narratives of how humans interact with machines in an increasingly technological future. However, on the robotics side, these works tend to frame machines as static, working, obedient, and sometimes threatening entities, contrary to recent advances in human-machine social interaction. Instead of using the metaphor of robots as subservient to human needs, we broaden the narrative to show how humans and machines can be collaborative partners in creative performance that utilizes nonverbal movement gestures as common media of communication. This collaborative interaction requires knowing how human performers perceive machine interactions, how to design machine movements in reaction to human movements, and how to choreograph human-machine interactions in spatial terms into compelling narratives. In this practice-based research proposal, we will create movements and interactions for robotic devices for performance and exhibition-performance contexts by co-designing with local performers in the dance and experimental media community. We will interview and prototype with a cohort of 25 leading movement artists in Hong Kong in a series of co-design workshops with robotic arms of different scales, to understand how performers perceive working creatively with movement technologies, to facilitate the design of robotic movements, and to create improvised and choreographed workflows for movement sequences of humans and robots in a collaborative space. The workshop prototypes are tested with audience-centered focus groups on three aspects of performance: dance, conceptual performance, and exhibition-performance. Insights from the focus groups will be qualitatively analyzed and applied to the three research and artistic outputs of the project: a human-machine dance performance, journal and conference papers on perception and design of robotic arm movements, and a gallery exhibition that allows general audiences to participate by modulating performer-machine interaction in space. The outcomes from this work provides guidelines for design of performer-machine interactions in increasingly prominent performance technology communities, drawing attention to social interactions of robots in human everyday life. 基於運動的技術已被表演者和藝術家使用於將舞台和裝置空間擴展，超越作品的靜態方面到利用環境中的效應器進行更動態的瞬時交互。這些可編程運動致動器通常和機器人的概念相似，儘管服務人類需求的初衷現已被一代又一代的社交機器人所取代，這些機器人具有類似人類的行為屬性，其設計不僅僅是響應請求，而是在人文環境中進行社交交互。 最近的作品越來越多地將最先進的運動技術應用於表演和展覽，使人們能夠在技術日益發達的未來敘述人類如何與機器互動。然而，在機器人技術方面，這些作品傾向於將機器視為靜態的、工作的、服從的、有時甚至是具有威脅性的實體，這與人機社交交互的最新進展相反。我們不把機器人比喻為屈從於人類的需求，而是擴大了敘述範圍，利用非語言運動手勢作為共同的交流媒介以展示人類和機器如何成為創造性表演中的協作夥伴。這種協作交互需要了解人類表演者如何感知機器互動，如何設計響應人類運動的機器運動，以及如何將空間方面的人機交互編排以形成引人入勝的敘述。 這個基於實踐的研究提案中，我們將通過與舞蹈和實驗媒體社區的當地表演者共同設計，為表演和展覽表演環境的機器人設備創建的動作和交互。我們將在一系列不同規模的機械臂聯合設計研討會上採訪香港25名領先的動作藝術家並製作原型，以了解表演者如何看待利用動作技術進行創造性工作，以促進機器人動作的設計，並為協作空間中的人類和機器人的運動序列創建即興和編排的工作流程。研討會原型通過以觀眾為中心的焦點小組對錶演的三個方面進行了測試：舞蹈、概念表演和展覽表演。焦點小組的見解將被定性分析並應用於該項目的三項研究和藝術成果：人機舞蹈表演、關於機器人手臂運動感知和設計的期刊和會議論文，以及通過調節空間中的表演者機器交互讓普通觀眾可以參觀的畫廊展覽。 這項工作的成果為日益突出的表演技術社區中表演者與機器交互的設計提供了指導，引起人們對人類日常生活中機器人社交互動的關注。

11608123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
11608123.value: 夫妻面對慢性疾病時的二元應對及其結果：系統綜述與元分析

11608123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
11608123.value: Dr Falconier, Mariana K. Dr Tam, Wai-san, Wilson

11608123.label: Project Objectives
11608123.value: Study 1 (on correlational evidence): By synthesizing the observational studies on dyadic coping (Figure 1) of couples living with chronic illness and accounting for the transactional process in couple adjustment, this systematic review and meta-analysis have two objectives (Figure 2): Objective 1.1: To evaluate the aggregated associations of the patient’s and their partner’s (a) total dyadic coping, (b) positive dyadic coping, (c) negative dyadic coping, and (d) each of the four categories of dyadic coping with one’s own three outcomes (i.e., physical health, psychological well-being, and relationship satisfaction; actor effects) as well as the other party’s outcomes (partner effects) according to the actor–partner interdependence model. Objective 1.2: To assess to what extent these aggregated associations vary by disease-related (e.g., cancer vs. other chronic diseases, prognosis, severity, and stage), relationship-related (e.g., opposite- vs. same-sex, and length), methodological (e.g., study design, recruitment methods, dyadic coping measures), and sociodemographic characteristics. Study 2 (on interventional evidence): By consolidating the findings from randomized controlled trials on the effects of couple-focused interventions targeting at least one dimension of dyadic coping among couples living with chronic illness, this systematic review and meta-analysis have two objectives (Figure 3): Objective 2.1: To evaluate the pooled effect sizes of couple-focused interventions targeting at least one dimension of dyadic coping for the three outcomes (i.e., physical health, psychological well-being, and relationship satisfaction) compared with control interventions (i.e., couple-focused, patient-alone, and partner-alone). Objective 2.2: To investigate to what extent the pooled intervention effects vary by the sample (e.g., diseases, relationships, and sociodemographics) and intervention (e.g., theoretical framework, methodology, dosages, and intervention content) characteristics.

11608123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
11608123.value: 慢性疾病不僅會影響患者本人，也會影響其伴侶。夫妻間的二元應對指夫妻如何共同應對壓力的方式。在夫妻二元應對的理論和實踐研究中存在兩個挑戰。首先，目前只有兩篇元分析，壹篇是關於普通壓力情況（Falconier等人，2015），另壹篇是關於癌癥（Ştefǎnuţ等人，2021），沒有針對慢性疾病的整體情況進行研究。此外，這兩篇元分析只研究了伴侶關系功能等結果，而沒有考慮到身體健康和心理健康等核心結果。更重要的是，目前還沒有任何元分析通過對夫妻間數據進行分析，評估夫妻之間的雙向效應。其次，還沒有元分析評估針對夫妻二元應對的心理支援措施的效果，因此心理支援措施的益處尚未得出定論。此外，在哪些亞群體中效果最好，目前了解不多。因此，建立夫妻二元應對與慢性疾病結果之間相關和因果關系的整合視角非常重要。我們將擴展癌癥和伴侶關系功能的範疇，考慮患者和伴侶間的相互依賴關系，闡明影響夫妻對慢性疾病進行最佳調適的調節機制。 在研究1中（相關研究證據），我們將整合所有觀察性研究，分析夫妻間二元應對與慢性疾病中的三個結果（即身體健康、心理健康和關系滿意度）之間的關聯。我們將（a）使用行動者—伴侶相互依賴模型對夫妻間的二元應對在這三個結果上的聚合效應以及行動者和伴侶效應進行量化評估，（b）評估與疾病相關的（例如癌癥與其他疾病）、與伴侶關系相關的（例如異性與同性）、研究方法和社會人口學因素對這些關聯的調節作用。 在研究2中（心理支援研究證據），我們將整合所有關於增強慢性疾病夫妻二元應對的隨機對照試驗。我們將（a）比較針對夫妻二元應對至少壹個維度的夫妻心理支援與單獨患者和單獨伴侶心理支援之間的差異，（b）測試樣本特征（例如疾病、伴侶關系、社會人口學）和心理支援特征對效果的調節作用。 該項目將是首個使用行動者—伴侶相互依賴模型並評估夫妻心理支援措施在增強夫妻二元應對及結果方面效果的元分析。通過提供最高水平的證據，這些創新發現將有助於夫妻患病管理研究的理論進展，為醫療保健和社會服務中制定扶助夫妻的政策，優化夫妻的臨床和心理社會結果。
