12600423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12600423.value: “Passage”：一首利用特定場地的聆聽體驗，包括香港少數民族社區的口述曆史錄音、根據錄音制作的音樂以及地理定位技術。

12600423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12600423.value: The current conversations regarding Hong Kong’s immigrant population, including many migratory workers and domestic helpers, often remain focused on their identity as non-ethnic Chinese individuals. The ongoing COVID-19 pandemic has further deepened the marginalization of Hong Kong’s ethnic minority, and there is an urgent need to foster a deeper understanding of these communities as an integral part of Hong Kong, a city that boasts a rich history as a destination for immigrants who left home to start anew in a foreign land. While one of the most effective ways to hear from community members is to record and disseminate their first-hand accounts as recorded oral history, such recordings also tend to become forgotten within vast online archives. Furthermore, recorded testimony often contains very personal details and recollections, and thus the listener may not be able to readily relate to and viscerally connect with personal accounts of these individuals who are already perceived as outsiders. In response, this proposed practice-as-research project seeks to expand our understanding of the intersection between music, recorded testimony, and place through the process of building a new, open oral history archive that focuses on under-documented communities in Hong Kong, as well as developing geolocation-based technology to embed these individuals’ stories within the familiarity of the city’s geographic location. As a result, I investigate how music can be combined with technology to highlight the stories of the underrepresented ethnic minority communities in Hong Kong. The project includes three main objectives: 1) to create and disseminate a new collection of oral history recordings with individuals who identify as being part of the ethnic minority immigrant communities in Hong Kong; 2) to create an instrumental music score based on the sounds and musical qualities of the recorded speech; and 3) to create a site-specific and immersive listening experience where both the oral history and the music inspired by the interviews are heard as part of a ferry journey from the Central Piers to one of the outlying islands, thereby creating a physical and location-based connection between the interviewees’ stories and the listener’s real-time experience in Hong Kong, recalling the sea journeys that characterized the experience of immigrating to Hong Kong in the 19th and 20th centuries. 目前，關于香港移民人口（包括許多外來務工人員和家庭傭工）的討論往往仍集中在他們作為非華裔的身份上。現時正在流行的 COVID-19 進一步加深了香港少數族裔的邊緣化，因此有迫切需要加深對這些社區的了解，將其視為香港不可分割的一部分，因為香港擁有悠久的曆史，作為一個背井離鄉到異國他鄉重新開始的移民目的地。 雖然聽取社區成員意見的最有效方法之一是將他們的第一手敘述錄制成口述曆史並加以傳播，但這些錄音也往往會被遺忘在龐大的在線檔案及資料庫中。此外，錄制的證詞往往包含非常個人化的細節和回憶，因此聽衆可能無法輕易與這些已被視為局外人的個人敘述産生共鳴和直觀聯系。 為此，我提出了這個實踐式研究項目，旨在通過建立一個新的、開放式的口述歷史檔案（重點關注香港記錄不足的社區），以及開發基于地理定位的技術，將這些人的故事嵌入我們所熟悉的城市地理位置中，從而拓展我們對音樂、錄音證詞和地點之間交集的理解。因此，我研究了如何將音樂與技術相結合，以突出香港代表性不足的少數民族社區的故事。 該項目包括三個主要目標： 1) 制作並傳播新的口述歷史錄音集，采訪對象為香港少數族裔移民社區的成員；2) 根據錄音的聲音和音樂特質創作器樂作品； 3) 創造一個特定地點的沈浸式聆聽體驗，讓聽眾乘坐由中環碼頭開往離島的渡輪旅程中聆聽及感受其互動作品，從而在受訪者的故事和聽衆在香港的實時體驗之間建立起物理和地點上的聯系，讓聽眾回想起 19 世紀和 20 世紀移民到香港的海上旅程。

12601723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12601723.value: 中國內地的「三失」大學畢業生群體：基於大數據與混合方法的研究

12601723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12601723.value: Dr Fu, Qiang Prof Lai, Gina W. F. Dr Zhang, Chunni

12601723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12601723.value: 最近的新聞媒體報導了「三失」青年的現象，該群體在學術上被稱為「尼特族」，即非在職、不在學或不在培訓的年青人。儘管全球教育擴張為青年提供了接受高等教育的機會，有助於減少年青人因低學歷而淪爲尼特族的問題。但與此同時，在西方和亞洲社會中，擁有大學學歷的尼特族（以下簡稱新尼特族）的數量呈增長趨勢。現有的研究主要關注低學歷的尼特族及其被邊緣化的就業經歷，對高學歷尼特族的情況則了解不足。 這項研究將採用混合方法，從客觀和主觀維度探討中國內地的新尼特族（21-29歲）現象。一方面，這項研究將使用多個大規模有代表性的數據，分析過去三十年新尼特族的規模和社會人口特徵的變化。我們將結合全國性追蹤調查與統計數據，分析微觀和宏觀因素如何導致大學畢業生成為尼特族。另一方面，這項研究將運用大數據技術對新尼特族在綫論壇數據進行內容分析，並邀請新尼特族青年參與深入訪談，以瞭解和分析新尼特族的教育、職場經歷與職業抱負。 這項研究有三項貢獻。首先，通過分析中國新尼特族在過去三十年的變化，我們能更好地瞭解年青人在從學校到職場轉變過程的變化。其次，不同於現有研究強調尼特族的低學歷和弱勢家庭背景，這項研究將從宏觀和微觀角度分析新尼特族產生的原因，並與現有文獻對話。第三，尼特族在社會中相對「隱蔽」，這項研究將採用混合方法接觸到新尼特族群體，並從多個視角研究這一群體。因此，本研究不僅可以豐富了對這個新興群體的理解，還可以為他們發聲，為促進大學畢業生就業和發展提供政策啟示。

12602823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12602823.value: 桃與李：李白的懷舊詩學

12602823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12602823.value: 本研究項目是對唐代大詩人李白（701–762）作品中的桃李意象的首次全面考察。李白在天寶元年（742）應唐玄宗的詔令進入長安一事，標誌著他的職業生涯的頂峯。桃李意象在他在京任職翰林期間及其後的作品中發揮著重要作用。雖然這些意象在中國傳統文學中早已深受喜愛，然而，李白對這些意象的繼承與開創，在學界中尚未見系統性的相關研究。本研究將從跨學科角度探討這些意象，通過檢視李白的生平思想等相關背景，考察他如何在作品中以新穎的藝術手段，把這些鍾愛的意象作詩學的表述，從而造就嶄新的美學效果。 本項目由五個主題組成，分別探討： 1）桃李意象在李白的作品中以哪些獨特的譬喻方式表達；2）李白如何以獨特的意義和特徵構建他的桃花源；3）李白二入長安的經歷如何造就他對桃李意象的獨特構建和懷舊詩學；4）桃李意象如何隨著時間的推移而變化，對李詩中的時間流逝的主題有何促進作用；5）李詩與其他冒險文學中的一些同類的英雄有何共同特點。 研究工作採取多維視角進行。例如，對於桃李兩種花果的文學傳統，首先追溯先唐時期的情況，再比較其他盛唐作家的不同藝術表現，並考察地理和時間的轉變如何帶動這些意象在李詩中的不同詩學表述。本研究的主要對象文本是李白的作品，文體涉及：詩、賦、序、讚等，約共有100首作品。除了參考其他作家、史家、宗教人物等的著作外，還會涉足於日語和其他西方語言寫成的神話、語言學、詩學等方面的創作及理論文本。這種廣闊的視野旨在開拓新思維、新角度，進行學術研究，並開啟與其他文化的對話。 本項目的預期研究成果包括：在知名期刊上發表三篇學術論文，在國際學術會議上發表的三篇學術報告。此外，通過公開講座和出版一本面向廣大讀者的書籍等知識轉移活動對社會產生影響。

12603123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12603123.value: 本地化或區域化？粵港澳大灣區數字平臺驅動下的產業轉型和智慧製造生產網絡的重構

12603123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12603123.value: Prof Li, Xun Dr Yu, Zhen

12603123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12603123.value: Manufacturing is amongst the many sectors that have undergone dramatic transformation driven by the rise of digital platforms and widespread of disruptive technologies, such as artificial intelligence (AI). Since the early 2010s, we have witnessed geographical restructuring of global production as reflected by the increasing government initiatives in selected advanced economies in terms of pro-reshoring policies seeking to localise/regionalise production empowered by digital technologies. Existing literature on reshoring/near-shoring has focused on the national-level analysis of western economies, such as Germany, the UK and the USA. The organisational and spatial reconfiguration of smart production enabled by AI technology in the global southern city-regions remain under-explored. This research aims to unpack the digital platform-driven industrial restructuring and reconfiguration of smart production networks in the Guangdong–Hong Kong–Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA), a dynamic city-region undergoing digital transformation in southern China. The project is built on the decades of endeavours of the principal investigator in industrial restructuring in China and particularly digital platform-driven regional transformation in GBA established in recent fieldworks. Drawing upon the developing insights from economic geography literatures on industrial restructuring in the digital age of global economy, the research develops a multi-scalar analytical framework to explore the interplay between localisation and regionalisation dynamics in the reconfiguration of smart production networks. By employing comparative case study methods, the project examines and compares digital platform-driven restructuring of Hong Kong manufacturing in GBA in two interrelated dimensions: AI-enabled digitalisation of the established manufacturing in major production cities in GBA, such as Shenzhen, Dongguan, Huizhou, Guangzhou and Foshan, and reindustrialisation-initiated development of smart manufacturing in Hong Kong. A mixed-method approach will be adopted for data collection and analysis through documentary research, questionnaire survey and semi-structured interviews with concerned stakeholders involving indigenous and foreign digital platforms, AI tech companies, traditional and advanced manufacturing firms engaging in digitalisation, business associations, as well as regulatory authorities and policy makers at various levels of governments in GBA. The project will extend existing literature on digital transformation dominated by consumer platforms to manufacturing domains and industrial restructuring. It will enrich the burgeoning debates on production network reconfiguration in smart manufacturing and digital technology industries. The findings will faciliate cross-sectoral industrial policies pertaining to a new regional space of smart ‘world factory’ in GBA, particularly the reindustrialisation initiatives in Hong Kong. The project will generate research outcomes for international comparative studies of industrial restructuring in the digital era of Industry 4.0. 製造業是眾多正經歷數碼轉型的行業之一。數字平台的興起和顛覆性數字技術如人工智能（AI）等的廣泛傳播，推動了製造業的數碼轉型。自2010年代初以來全球生產網絡發生了空間和組織結構的重組，尤其反映在日益增加的某些發達經濟體政府支持製造業回流政策方面採取的舉措，進而尋求數字技術支持下的本地化/區域化生產和製造。目前關於製造業回流/近岸回流（near-shoring）的文獻主要集中在國家層面的分析, 如德國、英國、美國等西方經濟體。相比之下，人工智能（AI）技術賦能對全球智能生產網絡的空間重構在全球南部發展中國家和地區的城市及區域的影響尚未得到充分探討。有鑒於此，本研究旨在考察中國南方的粵港澳大灣區以數字化平台驅動的產業轉型和智能生產網絡的重構。該項目建立在首席研究員過往數十年有關中國、尤其是珠三角-- 香港地區產業結構調整，以及近年對數字平台驅動的區域產業結構調整的實地考察基礎之上。借鑒經濟地理學中對全球經濟轉型中數字平臺驅動地方產業結構調整的相關文獻，本項目擬建構一個多尺度的分析框架，探究粵港澳大灣區數字平臺驅動下產業轉型的本地化和區域化動因之間的相互作用，以及智能生產網絡重構的組織和空間形態。通過比較案例分析方法，該項目考察並比較大灣區數字平台驅動的產業轉型過程中：1）人工智能技術驅動下大灣區現有製造業的數字化進程，特別是深圳、東莞、惠州、廣州和佛山等主要城市，2）香港智能製造業發展及其對再/新型工業化的影響。本項目將綜合多種研究方法，包括文獻綜述、實地數據收集和觀察，對相關持份者包括本土和外國數字平台、人工智能製造開發及應用公司、傳統和參與數字化的先進製造企業、商業協會、以及大灣區各級政府的相關關監管機構和政策制定者等進行問卷調查和半結構式訪談等。該項目將推動現有文獻有關數字化產業轉型主要針對消費者平台，拓展到製造業數字平臺及其驅動下的產業數碼轉型，並豐富有關智能製造生產網絡重構的研究。研究結果將有助於大灣區、尤其是香港特區政府及業界製定智能“世界工廠”新區域空間的產業政策和相關策略。此外，本項目的研究成果將為進一步進行工業4.0數字時代製造業數碼轉型的國際比較研究提供理論和實證基礎。

12604823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12604823.value: 癉惡勸善：從《大誥》與《癉惡錄》看明太祖以嚴刑峻法致治的進與退

12604823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12604823.value: Ming historians generally agreed that Zhu Yuanzhang 朱元璋 (Ming Taizu, r. 1368-1398), the Founding Emperor of the Ming regime, emphasised the didactic nature of the law in his legislation. Guided by the principle of integrating punishments with education (Mingxing bijiao明刑弼教), Zhu tried to address the ills in 14th century China through legal means. While historians have studied the application and implications of Zhu’s legal apparatus on different sectors of society, the evolution of early Ming social realities under his judicial activities, and his harsh measures against adversaries, a critical question in early Ming legal scholarship remains: Did Zhu Yuanzhang succeed and how can such success be measured? Through two novel approaches, in the proposed study, I will scrutinise the way in which the founding emperor of the Ming dynasty sought to create his ideal Jiangnan-based realm during the latter part of his rule, to understand and evaluate the effectiveness of his harsh legal measures in facilitating social transformation. First, instead of following the crime-defining titles of the entries, I shall identify and analyse all of the crimes committed by the culprits in each of the cases collected in the Dagao 大誥 (Grand Pronouncement, three issues, 1385-1387) and the Dagao wuchen 大誥武臣 (1387). Second, by investigating Zhu’s Dan’elu 癉惡錄 (1390), an underexplored collection of cases handled by the emperor and now preserved in the rare book library of the Palace Museum in Taipei, I will shed light on the post-Dagao interactions between Zhu and his subjects in the judicial arena in the last decade of the Hongwu reign. After implementing his harsh legal policies through the Dagao and placards of ad hoc laws, the criminal offences recorded by the Dan’elu published a few years later suggest that his subjects generally disregarded the powerful threat of bloody punishments imposed by the emperor. By studying this new source of early Ming judiciary in conjunction with the Dagao and the 1389 version of the Great Ming Code, how Zhu Yuanzhang ‘learned’ from the limited reform that his harsh punishments failed to secure, and how he might have adjusted legislation to better reflect social realities and revised his approach to achieve his ideal moral society when faced with his ‘untameable’ subjects can be traced. 古今中外普遍認同明太祖朱元璋（1368-1398件在位）在立綱陳紀的過程中，強調以法律改革社會的教化意義。在明刑弼教的原則下，他致力以刑罰手段改變受蒙元文化影響深遠的中華社會。前輩明史學者多注意太祖不同的立法如何針對處置個別的社會群體；另有一些則透過他的司法活動查探當時的社會實況；更有不少研究專門揭示這位開國君主鎮壓所謂不良份子的血腥手段。雖然過去數十年已累積了大量有關明太祖以法治國的研究成果，惟獨相關的根本問題卻始終未被認真回答：明太祖的嚴刑峻法是否成功地移風易俗？ 本研究以兩種前人未曾嘗試的新切入點，察勘明太祖晚年在建立以江南為中心的政體秩序時，所面對的掙扎，從而了解及評估他施行的猛烈法律手段效用如何。 其一，我們不受三篇《大誥》及《大誥武臣》（1385-87年間刊行）條目中常具誤導性標題的約束，逐條分析案件中各名犯人所犯的所有罪行，以見太祖判刑的真相。 其二，透過比較分析藏於台北故宮博物院圖書館的孤本《癉惡錄》，從這部明太祖頒於1390年而罕為人知的判案紀錄，揭示洪武晚期太祖在法律場域與臣民的真正互動情況。從這部頒布於《大誥》行用只數年後的《癉惡錄》，可見太祖雖在1385年以後採用以猛治國的手段，社會大眾卻是無動於衷，罪犯的鮮血無助於洗淨社會的貪污敗德風氣。 因此，本研究期望以這新史料結合《大誥》與1398年的《大明律》定本，去了解太祖面對嚴刑峻法所為有限時所取得的教訓，以及此後他在用法態度上所作的調校。這位中國史上最強勢的君王，當他的理想秩序終究無法以猛烈手段實踐時，也需作出符合民風與社會條件的妥協。

12605723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12605723.value: 2019冠狀病毒病是民主的無聲刺客？超越民主倒退及獨裁化的分析

12605723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12605723.value: The literature on the state of democracy and freedom around the world has been overshadowed the growing concerns about democratic backsliding, the proliferation of illiberal democracies and electoral authoritarianism, and lately, outright autocratization against the background of the Covid-19 pandemic which has provided the pretext for radical measures. The proposed research focuses on the electoral arena where leaders in both electoral democracies and electoral autocracies had to overcome a series of health, socioeconomic, and political risks amid the pandemic. Developing a database covering all national elections and referendums (known here as ‘electoral episodes’) from February 2020 onwards, the analysis will move not only beyond the restrictive scope of the emergent literature which seeks to prevent elections and referendums from becoming ‘super spreader events’ with the help of stringent measures, but also the overarching concern for democratic backsliding and autocratization. To the extent that one acknowledges the normative concerns of such debates, the proposed research is going to make an original contribution in four ways to shed light on the particulars of regime choices and changes amid the pandemic: (a) how regime types shaped the choices available to the leaders in response to the crisis, (b) how such choices were made and presented to various stakeholders of the regimes, (c) how the public responded, and (d) the extent to which the elections and referendums in question served to consolidate or weaken the incumbents. In all, the project is expected to yield nuanced analyses and conclusive findings with supporting evidence on to compare democracies, where there have been warnings about a rapid rise of populist, illiberal politics at the expense of the check-and-balance and power-sharing politics, with the hybrid and the authoritarian regimes, whose leaders are said to have taken advantage of the pandemic to consolidate autocratic rule. In addition to small-N case studies, which would provide rich details and narratives, we propose to bring together under the Most Similar Systems Design as well as the Most Dissimilar Systems Design of the ‘electoral episodes’ with reference to both regime types and the geographical distribution where they took place. Moreover, the database allows us to empirically put to test hypotheses regarding how the interplay of institutional arrangements and state capacity have shaped the leaders’ choices, the policy outcomes, the overall performance of the incumbents seeking re-election, as well as how democratic backsliding and autocratization were checked in some nations but not in others. 關注世界各地民主和自由狀況的學術文獻充斥著對民主倒退、自由倒退的民主國家和利用選舉作專制統治的國家激增的擔憂，並且關注新冠肺炎疫情如何提供了藉口讓政府採取更激進的防疫措施而促成專制化的後果。本研究將重點檢視在疫情的背景下，民主國家和威權國家的政治領袖在選舉中如何克服的一系列健康、社會經濟和政治風險。我們會開發一個從2020年2月開始涵蓋世界各地全國層面的選舉和公投（稱為「選舉事件」）的資料庫，關注的不僅是防止選舉和公投成為「超級傳播事件」的措施，還有對民主倒退和獨裁化的爭議作出更仔細的觀察。擬議的研究希望在四個方面作出貢獻，以闡明不同政治體制在疫情中的選擇和促成的變化：（a）當權者在應對疫情擴散危機時可能作出的選擇，（b）當權者如何做出選擇並向各持分者交代，（c）公眾的回應，以及（d）當權者多大程度上在選舉和公投中鞏固或削弱自己地位。研究所採用的設計和方法有助比較民主國家與混合政權和專制政權這些非民主國家面對不同的政治情況：前者備受民粹主義、反自由主義主張的迅速崛起所挑戰而有可能犧牲原來對公權力的制衡和求同存異的政治環境，而後者則似乎更有可能利用疫情來鞏固專制統治。 除了依靠個別的案例進行深度討論外，我們還建議按照政治制度類型和地理分佈，探用「最相似的系統設計」以及「最不同的系統設計」結合起來對「選舉事件」作比較分析。此外，「選舉事件」資料庫可以助我們有系統地發掘相關的的數據，從而解釋當權者在不同的政治體制和國家能力相互作用的影響下所作的選擇、政策成效、乃至當權者尋求續任時的整體表現，以及解釋為何一些國家何以成功遏制民主倒退和獨裁化，但在其他國家卻沒有成功。

12606223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12606223.value: 香港公民身份觀念的傳遞：一項基於讀者來信的批評性話語分析

12606223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12606223.value: Prof Flowerdew, John Leslie Dr Wang , Simon Ho

12606223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12606223.value: One area of debate emerging from the recent socio-political upheavals in Hong Kong SAR has been focused on what entails (good) citizenship, especially in light of the government’s adoption of the slogan, “patriots governing Hong Kong”, to justify changes to the electoral system. Likewise, the roll out of COVID vaccines has engendered discussions on what it means to be a good citizen (or patriot), i.e., by fulfilling one's civic and public duty in getting vaccinated. It is therefore within this politically charged climate that we aim to study forms of citizenship in Hong Kong, and, more specifically, how citizenship may be communicated through written argumentation in public forums. While there has been much research carried out on media reports of recent socio-political events (protests) in the SAR, in this project we propose to shift the analytical focus to a type of public forum that has been somewhat neglected to date - the letter pages of Hong Kong’s main English language daily newspaper, the South China Morning Post. With the understanding that the letters section of a newspaper is an opportunity for non-professional writers (i.e., citizens) to express their opinions on current affairs and topics of public interest, we suggest that a closer examination of the subject content, language and argumentative strategies of these letters will provide us with much insight into how people may communicate and form ideas about citizenship relevant to the current Hong Kong context. After first building a corpus of letters published in the SCMP over the past decade, we intend to combine quantitative (corpus analytical tools) and qualitative approaches (textual analysis) to carry out our research. This research will not only uncover key issues of public interest raised by the letter writers over the period concerned, but also examine the strategies of argumentation used, thus gaining critical insight into the broader discourses on which these arguments are based. As such, our project expects to offer a comprehensive analysis of how citizenship is communicated through this forum, particularly with respect to the claims, goals and values that are drawn upon in processes of argumentation across the data set. Moreover, this project is directed towards facilitating educational activities that seek to inspire future generations in the art of communicating citizenship in public discourse, along with the compilation of a digital archive of letters for future research. 最近香港特區社會政治動盪，特別是政府為改變選舉制度而採用了 “愛國者治港” 的口號，引起了一場聚焦何謂（合格的）公民的辯論。同樣，COVID疫苗的推出引發了什麼是好公民（或愛國者）的討論，即，通過履行接種疫苗的公民和公共職責。因此，我們想在這一政治氣候下研究香港公民身份的形式，更具體地說是如何通過公共論壇的書面辯論來傳遞公民身份。雖然，針對香港特區近期社會政治事件（抗議）的媒體報導已有大量的研究，但就本項目我建議將分析焦點轉移到至今被忽視的一種公共論壇——香港主流英語日報《南華早報》的讀者來信版面。該版面為非專業作家（即公民）闡述他們對當今時事和公眾關注話題的觀點提供了機會。基於這一了解，我們建議進一步研究這些來信的主題內容、語言和論述策略，這將有助於我們深入了解人們在香港當前背景下如何傳遞和形成公民身份的觀念。首先，我們會將就過去十年南華早報出版的讀者來信建成一個語料庫，結合定量（語料分析工具）和定性（文本分析）方法進行研究。該研究將不僅揭示來信作者在關注期內所提出的公眾利益的重點問題，還研究他們所採用的論述策略，以便從這些論點所基於的更廣泛話語中獲取關鍵。因此，我們項目期待提供一個全面分析，剖析公民意識是如何通過這個論壇傳遞的，尤其是在整個數據集的論證過程中所引用的主張、目標和價值觀。此外，這個項目旨在促進教育活動以啟發後人公共話語中傳遞公民意識的藝術，同時還匯編了一個數字信件檔案以供將來研究使用。

12608123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608123.value: 桌遊製造在香港：關於設計，社群和外延性的多元方法研究

12608123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12608123.value: Prof Calleja, Gordon Dr Leino, Olli Tapio

12608123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608123.value: In this project, we will research current board game production inside Hong Kong, focusing especially on design, distribution, and outreach. We argue that by combining established game research writing into an interdisciplinary approach focusing on textual analysis, game analysis models, and qualitative methods focusing on amplifying local creators, a better understanding of what makes Hong Kong board game space unique can be achieved, allowing for better positioning within a global scope. Board game research has existed for a significant amount of time across different fields including game research, play research, media archaeology and media cultures, and it is further growing as board games become more and more popular. There is significant research about board game design, board game design communities, regional design choices, as well as East Asian board game archaeology. However, there is currently a dearth of research that looks at modern design choices in East Asian communities, including Hong Kong. Board game artefacts with Hong Kong ties are already plentiful, including commercial successful games, such as Zombicide and Cyberpunk 2077: Gangs of Night City, independent hits such as Deception: Murder in Hong Kong, as well as smaller innovative designs which have not achieved their due non-local recognition, such as Eila and Something Shiny. This research aims to platform such games, by compiling them, analysing them and researching in which ways local design communities stand out. In this research, we will first conduct a comparative analysis of pre-modern regional board games such as Mahjong and Go, and tie this with relevant academic work (such as Wirman and Leino, 2017; Nanako, 1988 respectively). We will then compile a comprehensive list of local board games, and through them contact their designers and publishers to learn about their design choices, local issues such as distribution, development and global proliferation, and future projections for the board game scene. Through both our initial research, as well as our expert opinions, we will make claims on exceptional factors in Hong Kong board games. Through this research, we hope to not only to target common academic metrics such as conferences, journals and symposia. We also want to further promote board games as a playful socially-engaged practice; whether through community events such as board game nights or special interest group meetings. Additionally, we want to promote local voices by addressing production concerns and amplifying their creations locally, regionally and internationally. 在此項目中，我們會研究香港範圍內的桌遊製造，聚焦設計、發行和外延性。我們認為通過在已有遊戲研究的基礎上拓展跨學科方法，關注文本分析、遊戲研究模型和質性研究以強調本地創作者，我們可以更好地理解是什麼讓香港桌遊空間獨特，也讓我們更好地在全球範圍內定位本地桌遊。 桌遊研究存在於多個研究領域，包括遊戲研究，遊玩研究，媒介考古學和媒介研究，並且桌遊研究本身也在隨著桌遊的現代復興浪潮而持續發展。關於桌遊設計，社群，地區性設計以及東亞桌遊考古已經有長足的研究，但是目前罕有研究關注當代東亞遊戲社群的設計選擇，包括香港。涉及香港的桌遊產品非常之多，包括商業性成功的遊戲、本地獨立公司的外銷遊戲，本地創意者針對香港的特定製作，以及遊戲製作新手希望打入桌遊市場的作品。此項研究希望可以聚焦這些遊戲，匯編、分析以及研究本地設計群體的獨特性。 在研究中，我們將首先進行比較分析，與前現代的地區性桌遊比如麻將和圍棋進行對比並且參考相關的理論研究（例如Wirman和Leino, 2017; Nanako, 1988)。我們會收集匯編一個綜合性的本地桌遊名單，藉此聯繫設計師與製作方來了解他們的設計選擇，包括發行、開發、國際推廣等本地議題，以及對本地桌遊發展做未來預測。通過此項研究，我們希望不只產出學術成果，也希望可以進一步推廣桌遊作為遊玩性的社會參與之實踐，並且藉由對全球產業的西方面向的發展反思來增強本地的聲音。

12608623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608623.value: 驗證以翻譯及口譯為融合：香港對非洲提供發展援助的語言運用

12608623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12608623.value: Prof MARAIS, Kobus Dr Ruiz Rosendo, Lucia

12608623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608623.value: This research project is concerned with Hong Kong humanitarian organizations active internationally, specifically in Africa, where there is a growing demand for Hong Kong development aid. The study aims to move forward the theoretical debate on the role of translation in development studies, defining development practice as semiotic adaptation to a changing environment which as such entails a translational dimension. More specifically, the study examines the linguistic inclusion of Malawian communities in Hong Kong development aid through the use of translation and interpreting. Providing development aid in international settings requires adaptation to diverse environments. This adaptation is enabled through the provision of translation of knowledge between local communities and aid organizations. Research on international organizations has shown that the way in which translation affects the inclusion of local communities does not tend to be given prominent attention in the aid sector. The translation and interpreting needs of local communities are often neglected when delivering emergency and development aid (Federici et al., 2019; Todorova 2019). Development aid organizations rely on aid workers who are often not trained in language work (Footitt, Crack and Tesseur, 2020). At the same time, donors do not tend to ask implementing organizations to include translation in their projects (Crack, 2018). In order to examine language use and translation within the aid sector in Hong Kong, this project will directly engage with the emergency disaster relief section of the Hong Kong Red Cross, a beneficiary of the Disaster Relief Fund of the Government of the Hong Kong SAR and local communities recipients of disaster relief in Malawi. The study will be based on ethnographic research aimed at investigating the critical role of translation and interpreting in establishing an equal, two-way dialogue between Hong Kong development aid organizations and the communities they serve within Malawi. The ethnographic fieldwork, consisting of participant observations supplemented with surveys and interviews, will be conducted at two locations: 1) the PI will spend three months working closely with the Hong Kong Red Cross, while at the same time 2) a local RA in Malawi will spend three months observing the local humanitarian staff in their communication with beneficiaries, including interviews with beneficiaries on their communication preferences. As a result, a specialised translation and interpreting training program will be developed, as well as policy recommendations on translation and interpreting use for all participants in the Hong Kong relief and humanitarian sector. 本研究項目主要圍繞積極參與國際人道救援工作的香港人道救援組織，由於非洲對香港提供的發展援助需求日益殷切，故相關組識的工作主要集中在非洲。是項研究旨在推進發展研究中有關翻譯所扮演的角色在理論層面上的爭辯，並將發展實踐定義為符號學層面上的應對，藉此適應不斷變化的環境所產生的翻譯維度。具體而言，本研究將探討馬拉威社區如何透過筆譯和口譯方式在語言上融入香港所提供的發展援助。 提供國際援助時，往往需要透過當地社區和援助組織提供不同知識的翻譯，以適應當地不同的環境。不同對國際援助組織的研究顯示，翻譯影響組織融入當地社區的方式，在援助組織內部不受重視。在組織提供緊急和發展援助時，當地社區的筆譯和口譯需求常被忽視（Federici 等人，2019 年；Todorova，2019 年）。這些援助組織所依賴的援助人員，亦大多沒有受過語言培訓（Footitt、Crack 和 Tesseur，2020 年）。同時，捐助者亦往往不會要求援助組織將專業翻譯人員納入其救援方案中（Crack，2018 年）。 為了研究香港人道救援組織的語言使用和翻譯情況，此研究將與香港特別行政區政府賑災基金的受助方 - 香港紅十字會緊急救災部，以及馬拉威災後受援社區直接接觸。此項研究將以人種學研究為基礎，旨在調查筆譯和口譯如何在香港援助組織與在馬拉威服務的社區之間建立平等、雙向對話的關鍵作用。人種學實地調查將在兩個地點進行，調查內容包括參與觀察以及訪談： 1.) 首席研究員將和香港紅十字會密切合作，為期三個月，同時 2.) 馬拉威當地一名研究助理將觀察當地人道救援工作人員與受益人溝通情況，包括就受益人之溝通偏好進行訪談。 最終，我們將為香港人道救援領域的所有參與者制定專門的筆譯和口譯培訓計劃，以及相關筆譯和口譯工作的政策建議。

12608923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12608923.value: 睡眠在兒童早期詞彙和語法習得中的作用

12608923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12608923.value: Successful language learning involves encoding new linguistic knowledge and consolidating it in memory. Language acquisition research has placed a great focus on the former but much less on the latter. Sleep is a key factor in memory consolidation and has gained increasing attention in developmental research because of children’s distinctive sleep patterns. Yet, to date, research marrying early language acquisition and sleep remains slim. Two issues stand out in particular. First, as a child’s language develops, her memory also undergoes substantial maturing. Importantly, the hippocampus is not mature until 18-24 months. A predominant mechanism through which sleep affects memory is hippocampus-dependent, by reactivating new hippocampal memories and their bounding representations in the cortex. These suggest that the effect of sleep on language learning before and after hippocampal maturation may vary. Second, language is multifaceted. Some linguistic knowledge is acquired through explicit instructions whereas some via implicit exposure; some requires precise memorization while some requires abstraction. Different encodings are treated differently during sleep. Thus, different linguistic facets may have different sleep-related effects. Combined, these two issues lead to an emerging hypothesis: Before and after hippocampal maturation, linguistic knowledge of different natures would have different gains from sleep. To approach this novel hypothesis in a refined and structured way, I adopt two operationalizations. First, I target 15 and 27 months, which, based on prior neurological research, correspond to before and after hippocampal maturation respectively. Second, I use explicitly-taught concrete nouns and implicitly-learned rule patterns to represent distinct linguistic facets. Therefore, 15- and 27-month-old children will participate in a word-learning task (Expt.1) and a rule-learning task (Expt.2), in two visits: Visit 1 includes a learning phase and a test phase, and Visit 2 includes the same test, conducted after a delay of 4 hours during which some children nap (Sleep Condition) and some stay awake (Wake Condition). Improvement in performance, evaluated via eye-tracking, from Visit 1 to 2 in the Sleep Condition (relative to Wake) will be taken as an indication of sleep-related gains. We will learn whether sleep benefits early language learning, and how it varies with linguistic knowledge type and developmental stage. Findings will bring an interdisciplinary synergy between language acquisition, sleep, and memory. Findings will also yield scientifically-informed formulae with sleep as an ingredient for optimal language learning, which will be used in guiding educational and clinical practices, as well as public policymaking. 成功的語言學習包括對新的語言知識進行編碼，並將其鞏固在記憶裡。語言習得的研究一向側重於前者，對後者卻關注寥寥。記憶鞏固中，睡眠是一個關鍵因素；兒童獨特的睡眠模式也使這一因素在發展研究學中得到重視。然而，迄今為止，將早期語言習得和睡眠結合起來的研究卻依然不多。 其中，兩個研究缺口尤為突出。第一，兒童早期語言發展伴隨著記憶的重大成熟。18個月到24個月之前，海馬體並未發展到較為成熟的階段；而海馬體是睡眠對記憶施加影響的一個重要環節–––初初形成的海馬體記憶及其在大腦皮層中的關聯表徵會在睡眠中得到重新激活。以上表明：海馬體成熟前後，睡眠對語言學習的影響或有所不同。第二，語言是多面向的。有些語言知識是經由顯性指導習得的，有些則是隱性接觸；有些需要精確記憶，而有些則需要抽象歸納。我們知道，不同類型的記憶編碼在睡眠中會得到不同的處理。以上表明：睡眠在不同的語言面向的習得中，或起到不同作用。 結合以上兩個問題，不難得出一個新的假設：在海馬體成熟前後，不同性質的語言知識在睡眠中的收穫會有所不同。為了更有係統地探討此假設，本研究採取以下兩個具體操作：首先，時間節點上，選擇15個月和27個月，分別對應神經學研究中海馬體成熟之前和之後的階段；其次，學習內容上，使用具象名詞的顯性習得和抽象語法的隱性習得，分別代表不同性質的語言面向。所以，本研究中，15個月和27個月的兒童將參加一個詞彙學習任務（實驗一）和一個語法學習任務（實驗二）。每個任務，都會分成兩次訪問進行：第一次訪問包括學習階段和測試階段；第二次訪問包括相同的測試，但會在4個小時的延遲之後進行；在延遲的時間內，一些兒童會小睡一會兒（睡眠組），而另一些兒童則保持清醒（清醒組）。兒童的語言學習成果，會在第一次和第二次訪問的測試階段中，透過眼動追蹤進行評估，兩次評估的差異將被視為延遲收益；之後，睡眠組和清醒組的延遲收益會被進行比較，從中分析睡眠對於語言學習所起到的作用。 通過此項研究，我們將了解睡眠對早期語言習得是否起到正面作用，以及它的作用是如何隨著語言知識的不同面向和兒童成長的不同階段而變化的。研究結果將促進語言習得、睡眠和記憶研究領域之間的跨學科協同；將幫助我們更准確地建構語言習得的優化公式，及睡眠這個因子在其中的貢獻；還將用於指導教育和臨床實踐，以及公共政策的制定。

12610023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12610023.value: 廣東話助詞的語篇語用功能：廣東話中立場標記的綜合論述

12610023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12610023.value: 當人們説話時，他們慣常地需要表達他們對某些情況的立場。例如，説話人如何評估某一個情況，説話人對某個結論有多確定，等等。因此，所有語言均應該為其語言使用者提供不同的手段與資源去表達説話人不同層次的情緒與觀點。近期的研究揭示了一系列説話人可用於表達自己情感和觀點的語言手段，當中包括有：情態動詞（如：may, might），副詞（如：probably, certainly），情態短語（如：I think, I believe），以及一些明確傳達説話人主觀情緒或態度的詞彙和語句（如：I just hate/love that）。除此以外，語言使用者亦經常運用不同的語法手段以表達他們對事情的評價、判斷等等（即他們的「立場」- “stance”）。其中一種常見用於中文或其他東南亞語言的語法手段就是語法助詞的運用。在這些語言中，廣東話更是運用語法助詞去表達説話人主觀情緒和判斷的表表者。其中，句末助詞（sentence-final particles/SFPs）的運用最是引起學者的關注。廣東話的句末助詞有着強大的功能，只是改動一個助詞即能帶來整個句子意義的改變。例如：「佢去咩」的意思是「佢去？！（我好懷疑！）」；但「佢去㗎」的意思則是「佢去！（我好確定！）」除了句末，謂語助詞（verbal particles/VPs）作為一組位於動詞後位置的語法元素，對於表達説話人的立場也是極為重要。謂語助詞對於句子的意思起了關鍵的作用。例如：「沖返個涼」的意思是「（好享受噉）沖個涼」；但「沖定個涼」的意思則是「（保險啲噉）沖個涼」。除了SFPs和 VPs ，有另一組出現在句首位置的語法標記對於表達説話人的情感和語氣亦起了關鍵的作用，它們就是話語標記（discourse markers/DMs）了。這一組助詞一般都出現在小句的始起位置。它們除了用於連接不同的小句部分，亦肩負表達各種情感和溝通的功能（如：尋求確認、表達懷疑等等）。雖然SFPs，VPs 和 DMs對表達説話人的立場極其重要，亦是組成人類認知不可或缺的部分；但令人 驚訝的是，有關於廣東話DMs 的研究卻少之又少。因此，本研究首先會對廣東話DMs 作為立場標記時的功能作詳細分析， 並全面探討廣東話DMs ，SFPs及VPs如何能夠相互合作成為一個表達説話人情感和立場的語法體系。本研究更着重找出這些廣東話助詞如何在語篇和語用層面上發揮不同的人際功能。

12610423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12610423.value: 需求響應型公交、家庭和工作地點以及日常出行行為

12610423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12610423.value: Demand Responsive Bus (DRB, 定制公交 in Chinese) is emerging as an important alternative to traditional public transport. Much research attention has been paid to the acceptance, usage patterns, and design of DRB, not much research has been conducted to investigate the implications of DRB on people’s home and work locations and travel behavior. This research is proposed to address this research gap. The study will focus on comparing the spatial and sociodemographic profiles of commuters by different transport modes including DRB and understanding how DRB plays a role in shaping people’s daily travel behavior and influencing residential and work location choices. The empirical study will be conducted in Shenzhen where the DRB services are most developed in China. We shall identify three groups of daily commuters using private transport, traditional public transport (e.g. bus or rail transit), and DRB. We shall collect first-hand data from both DRB users and non-users living in different districts of Shenzhen. Various statistical analysis and modelling approaches including stated preference methods will be applied to characterize DRB users and examine the impacts of DRB usage on travel behavior, travel satisfaction and home as well as work locations. Findings of this project shall enrich the literature on demand responsive transport and new mobility services in general. They will be particularly relevant for urban and transport planners to develop land use and transport policies to facilitate the development of DRB and maximize its social, wellbeing, environmental and transport benefits. 需求響應式公交（DRB）正在成為重要的新興公交。作為傳統公共交通的替代方案，DRB已引起很多研究的興趣，關注DRB 的接受度、使用模式和設計等。但現有研究尚未分析 DRB 對家庭和工作地點的選擇和出行行為的影響。本項研究正是為了填補這一研究空白。我們將比較使用包括DRB在內的不同交通方式的通勤者的空間和社會人口特徵，並了解 DRB 如影響人們的日常出行行為，居住和工作地點的選擇。實證研究將在DRB發展最快的深圳進行。我們將區分使用私人交通、傳統公共交通（例如公交車或軌道交通）和 DRB的三組日常通勤者並收集來自居住在深圳的不同地區的 DRB 用戶和非用戶的第一手數據。利用各種統計分析和建模方法，包括所述偏好法來描述 DRB 用戶的特徵並分析DRB如何影響出行行為、出行滿意度以及家庭和工作地點的選擇。該項目的研究結果將豐富有關需求響應型等新興交通模式的文獻。本研究將有助於城市和交通規劃者制定土地使用和交通政策，以促進DRB 的發展並最大化其社會、環境和交通效益。

12612823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
12612823.value: 口語材料難度之自動評估：運用語音識別技術

12612823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
12612823.value: Dr Fantinuoli, Claudio Prof Liu, Min-hua Dr Liu, Nannan

12612823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
12612823.value: The assessment of speech difficulty is at the core of translation and interpreting studies and is relevant to all aspects of language learning and cognitive testing. Educators and employers expend a great amount of time and effort to select material that is appropriate for competence development and for discriminating between different levels of skills. In recent years, attempts have been made to use automated assessment to make the selection of texts more objective and less costly. A typical approach is to use readability or coherence measures to automatically grade texts. However, studies have shown that current tools do not handle difficulty assessment for speech well and to date, a speech-based automated assessor does not exist. With the development of automatic speech recognition technology, it is possible to turn a large number of speeches into transcripts and find reliable indicators that can predict the perception of difficulty by professionals and novices. This proposed project aims to provide an automated difficulty assessor for speech. It will use simultaneous interpreting as a case study, as this form of speech processing requires immediate local comprehension and production. The project will use a large sample of simultaneous interpreting performances from a diverse group of professionals at the United Nations (UN) and student interpreters, the latter data will be collected at three time points over a two-year training program. Audio recordings will be used to build corpora of English to Chinese interpreting, comprising 45 hours of English speeches and their interpretation. Automatic speech recognition tools will be used, with novel techniques applied to accurately transcribing dysfluent, accented and spoken features in English and Chinese. This proposed project will go beyond previous studies by adopting a longitudinal, expert–novice design; it will assemble linguistic and prosodic difficulty indicators that have psychological validity in speech processing. The difficulty levels of the English speeches will be judged by professionals and students, and the performances will be rated both objectively and by using validated rubrics; the performance measures have been investigated in previous research of the PI and the Co-I. This project will deliver an automated software program and web tool for assessing the difficulty of English speeches. The assessor will assist educators and employers in knowing a speech’s level of difficulty without listening to the speech or having it interpreted first. 口語材料難度評估是語言學習、認知測試的重要環節，也是翻譯研究的核心問題。難易度適中的材料有助於不同的學習階段，也能區分不同的能力水準。然而，材料選擇往往十分耗時耗力。近年來，有學者利用各項自動評估工具（如閱讀難度分級、連貫度分析等），使材料選擇更加客觀、簡便。然而，這些工具並不能有效評估口語材料的難度。本研究旨在利用自動語音識別技術，開發一個口語材料難度的自動測量工具。研究以同聲傳譯為對象，利用同聲傳譯當下理解、即時產出之特性，分析經由語音識別轉寫的同聲傳譯口語材料，從文本、音頻中找到各項指標，預測專業、新手譯員對難度的感知。本研究將收集聯合國職業口譯員之口譯錄音，建立英譯中同聲傳譯語料庫。之後並以同樣的英文源語材料，收集學生譯員在兩年口譯班期間三個時間點的同聲傳譯表現。建成的語料庫包含15小時的英文源語、30小時的中文譯語音頻、文本。本研究亦將首次採用長期追蹤、專家與新手對比的設計，關注處理口語訊息時對語言、韻律特徵之心裡感知。本研究採用的研究方法還包括：改善語音識別技術，更準確地轉寫不流利、有口音，在認知壓力下產出的英、中口語；邀請專業與學生譯員評判英文源語之難度；利用本項目負責人、共同負責人研究中已驗證的評分工具，評估譯員的口譯表現。本研究開發的英文口語難度評估工具可作為軟體、網路工具，使用者無需聆聽口語材料，即可知曉其難度。

13200123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13200123.value: Prof Chen, Hui Prof Li, Jun

13200123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13200123.value: 了解企業的投資決策對學術界和實踐者至關重要。直觀上，高資本成本會阻礙投資，因為它大幅折現這些投資所產生的未來現金流。資本成本作為一個折現率，隨著投資的風險增加而增加，因為投資者不喜歡風險。因此，風險越高，資本成本越大，投資就越少。 然而，在這個提案中，我們記錄了一個新穎而有力的實證結果：具有高系統風險的公司實際上比低風險公司投資更多。這個證據與上述直覺相反。此外，這個結果挑戰了所謂的「實物期權」效應，即公司在不確定性高時等待投資的理念。 為了理解這個令人困惑的結果，我們利用了資產定價文獻中一個眾所周知的實證觀察，即貝塔異常，來理解系統風險與異常企業投資之間令人困惑的正向關係。貝塔異常指的是一個實證結果，即具有高系統風險（或「貝塔」）的公司平均獲得較低的風險調整回報（或「阿爾法」）。因此，我們推測高風險公司可能會利用低資本成本增加投資。 為了正式驗證這個推測，我們建立了一個動態模型，幫助我們理解資本成本如何決定投資。具體而言，在我們的模型中，資本成本包括基於風險的組成部分，它增加了資本成本，以及一個文獻中新穎的定價錯誤組成部分。 憑藉這些新元素，我們的目標是實現兩個目標。首先，我們評估模型中的定價錯誤組成部分是否能夠壓倒基於風險的組成部分，為高貝塔公司生成低風險調整的資本成本。第二，高貝塔公司的管理者在觀察到低資本成本時立即做出投資決策。因此，我們的模型預計能夠複製實證的規律：高系統風險與企業投資之間的正向關係。 簡而言之，在這個提出的研究中，我們計劃提供一個統一的模型來理解負貝塔-阿爾法關係（貝塔異常），並將其與正貝塔-投資關係（實際異常）相關聯。

13200323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13200323.value: 回顧香港聯合國教科文組織亞太遺產獲獎者：利用 IAD-NAAS 分析可持續遺產保護的集體行動

13200323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13200323.value: When a heritage conservation project involves many different stakeholders, collective action problems may arise at the individual level or organisation level. Informed by a framework for analysing collective action called Institutional Analysis and Development (IAD) attributed to the Nobel laureate Elinor Ostrom, this project (1) examines how recipients of UNESCO Asia-Pacific Awards for Culture Heritage Conservation (Awards) in Hong Kong have fared in sustaining collective action for conservation activities over the years after receiving their Awards; and (2) analyses the mechanisms in which the Awards can sustain, improve, or lessen collaborative efforts among the project stakeholders. Theoretically, this project is timely because although there is abundant literature about the institutional arrangements of heritage conservation, few investigations focus on collective action in such conservation works, especially in the Asian urban context. One important institutional arrangement is an international heritage framework, like the Awards. Policy-wise, the study can provide policy makers with informed suggestions on how to further promote and sustain collective efforts for conservation, such as adaptive reuse of internationally well-recognised heritage conservation projects. It can also inform the private sector about best practices and beneficial conditions that foster more viable, bottom-up, collaborative conservation projects. To inform the IAD framework, the data gathering will include (a) a review of relevant government/stakeholders’ reports, audio-visual materials, land instruments (leases and licences), and other archival documents that are publicly available; and (b) interviews about the pertinent experiences and opinions of the four projects’ stakeholders. These are: The Mills (developer-led, revitalised industrial building, creative incubation centre), VIVA Blue House (community-initiated, government-supported, urban residential community development), Tai O Heritage Hotel (government-led, revitalised marine police building in a rural community development), and Mei Ho House Youth Hostel (government-led, revitalised public housing complex). 當一個文化遺產保護項目涉及許多不同的利益相關者時，個人或組織層面可能會出現集體行動問題。受諾貝爾獎得主艾琳·奧斯特羅委託的制度分析和發展（IAD）框架的啟發，本項目（1）研究聯合國教科文組織亞太文化遺產保護獎（獎項）在香港獲獎者如何在獲獎後多年維持集體行動進行保護活動；（2）分析獎項可能維持、改進或減少項目利益相關者之間協作努力的機制。從理論上來說，這個項目是及時的，因為雖然有關文化遺產保護制度安排的文獻豐富，但鮮有調查注視文化遺產保護工作中的集體行動，特別是在亞洲城市背景下。國際文化遺產框架（如獎項）是一個重要的制度安排。從政策上來說，本研究可以為政策制定者提供有關如何進一步促進和維持集體保護努力的建議，例如國際上廣為認可的文化遺產保護項目之適應性再利用。它還可以向私營機構提供有關促進更具可行性、從下而上協作保護項目的最佳實踐和有益條件之信息。為了擬定IAD框架，研究團隊作數據收集，包括（a）審查有關政府或利益相關者報告、音頻視頻材料、土地文件（租賃和許可證）和其他公開檔案；以及（b）訪談四個保護項目利益相關者，了解其相關經驗和意見。這些保護項目為南豐紗廠（開發商主導的工廈活化及創意孵化中心）、We 嘩藍屋（社區發起、政府支持的城市住宅社區發展）、大澳文物酒店（在農村社區發展中政府主導的舊水警建築活化）及美荷樓青年旅舍（政府主導的舊公屋活化）。

13300223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13300223.value: 善用濕地 - 了解物種群落在人工地境中的組建過程

13300223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13300223.value: Dr SO, Ken Dr SUNG, Yik Hei Prof WONG, Pui Yun Paulina

13300223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13300223.value: 從文明誕生以來，人類一直依賴大自然提供的重要生態系統服務。然而，許多自然棲息地，包括濕地，在不可持續的發展下已經消失或退化，對生物多樣性造成了不利的影響。在這樣的背景下，各國每年投資 1,330 億美元用於基於自然的解決方案 (Nature-based solution, NbS)，以應對社會挑戰，同時增強生物多樣性。然而，解決方案的成功取決於物種對於人類短期和長期干擾的反應，以及所涉及的潛在物種組建過程的深入理解。事實上，高分辨率的長期生物多樣性數據集對於揭示與自然波動交織在一起的長期人為干擾（例如土地利用變化和氣候變化）對物種的影響至關重要。不幸的是，在亞洲熱帶地區，這樣的數據集非常有限，這限制了基於自然的解決方案的建立和應用能力。 鑑於亞洲即將面臨大規模的沿海開發，我們將利用香港和深圳沿海地區進行的每月水鳥監測計劃收集到的數據集 (為亞洲最長的數據集之一，共24年)，研究濕地鳥類群落在面對大規模沿海開發時的變化。研究結果將揭示人為威脅怎樣隨著時間推移影響濕地生物多樣性，並從生物多樣性的角度為該地區制定基於濕地的解決方案。 本次研究中，我們將結合不同面向的生物多樣性方法（即納入互補的物種分類、性狀和進化信息作為評估單位），使用零模型來測試觀察到的濕地鳥類多樣性在空間尺度上隨時間變化是隨機的還是遵循確定性的物種組建過程。接著，我們將利用從歷史遙感圖像（例如土地覆蓋變化）和觀測站（例如溫度、空氣污染物）中提取的獨特和累積的人為因素，研究其對濕地鳥類多樣性的影響。此外，我們還將收集新的跨學科地方尺度數據，包括魚塘管理方式（例如養分輸入、植被結構）、水鳥的食物（例如陸地和水生大型無脊椎動物）以及漁民對野生動物的看法，以瞭解其中的直接和間接關係。透過結構方程模型研究人為干擾對水鳥的影響，提供基於自然的水產養殖管理的信息。我們推測，隨著時間的推移，人為干擾的增加將使不同地點的水鳥群落趨於統一，而同質化的程度則取決於魚塘的管理方式。 通過揭示從地方到地景尺度的濕地鳥類多樣性在應對沿海開發中所受到的影響，此項目將為亞洲濕地生物多樣性的長遠保育發展提供重要信息，從而協助建立更加環保和全面的基於自然的解決方案。

13500823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13500823.value: 主觀年齡對地位和炫耀性消費的影響

13500823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13500823.value: 雖然一個人的實際年齡是不可改變的，但成年人往往會通過日常的社會和個人經歷感覺自己比實際年齡年輕或年長，這就是所謂的主觀年齡。例如，根據周圍其他人的平均年齡，一個人會覺得自己更老或更年輕 (Amatulli et al., 2018; Park et al., 2021)。此外，當人們想起自己的家庭義務或對父母的經濟依賴時，也會感覺自己更老或更年輕（Giles，2010）。由於感覺自己變年輕或變老是一種常見的體驗，因此人們對主觀年齡與心理和行為結果的關係進行了研究。特別是，感覺自己更年輕與更好的健康狀況相關的大量研究結果，得到了學術界和政策制定者的廣泛關注（Kotter-Grühn et al., 2016；世界衛生組織，2021）。然而，除了與健康相關的結果外，很少有研究探討感覺主觀年齡是如何影響消費者行為的。 有趣的是，廣告和營銷以及公共信息也會影響消費者的主觀年齡（例如，依雲公司的 "活出年輕 "營銷活動；Star Health & Allied Insurance Co.的健康保險廣告文案 "唯一重要的老年指南"；新加坡老齡問題部級委員會的 "我感覺自己還年輕！"活動）。為了更好地理解主觀年齡對消費者行為，我們準備研究，對於不同性別，主觀年齡如何影響對社會地位的認知和炫耀性消費（例如，對奢侈品牌的偏好）。 進化心理學認為，男性和女性的不同行為源於同繁衍相關的不同動機，在此基礎上，我們預測，男性和女性在感覺自己更年輕或更年長時，會對他們的社會地位認知產生不同的影響，進而影響他們的炫耀性消費。兩項試點研究為上述預測提供了初步證據。我們的目的是，嚴格檢驗主觀年齡、性別，通過社會地位認知，從而影響炫耀性消費。基於此，我們提出了多項研究，包括在線、實驗室實驗、現場實驗和購物日記研究。放在一起，這些研究結果將整合社會心理學、市場營銷學和老年學等不同學科，從而幫助我們理解主觀年齡、社會地位、性別差異和炫耀性消費。本研究還將進一步為從業人員和政策制定者提供有益的啟示，幫助他們了解如何利用消費者年齡相關的經驗，以及如何開發和實施與消費者年齡相關的信息。

13501023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501023.value: 集團審計的知識溢出：對跨國企業審計效能與效率在2019冠狀病毒病 (COVID-19) 期間及其後的影響

13501023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501023.value: 隨著全球跨國企業 (MNCs) 的增加，集團審計已成為越來越普遍的審計模式 (Burke et al. 2020; Carson et al. 2022)。美國公眾公司會計監督委員會 (PCAOB) 發現了一些涉及使用組成審計師的審計失敗案例，於是修訂了相關的標準和規定，目的在於通過更嚴格的監控和記錄來提高集團審計的品質 (PCAOB 2016; 2021)。然而，集團審計的好處往往被忽視。這研究的旨意是通過探索集團審計的優點來填補這個縫隙。首先，組成審計師熟悉子公司的當地稅法，法規，商業運營和習俗，並可以向首席審計師提供獨特及當地的資訊 (Barrett et al. 2005; Sunderland and Trompeter 2017; Kim et al. 2021)。我們預期這些對首席審計師因外部性而獲取當地的特定知識，在其後的跨國企業審計中是有用和有價值的。因此，我們假設更大的辦公室級集團審計經驗與後續跨國企業審計的效能帶正相關 (如顯示在出現更少的財務重述，更小的絕對性可操控預提項目，更少的內部控制報告錯誤）。我們通過展示如何在不受地理限制的情況下傳遞知識；如集團審計環境的設定中；從而豐富知識溢出的文獻，並對跨國企業審計帶來好處。其次，我們還提出，審計合夥人可以通過領導與其所處國家不同的其他組成審計師的集團審計工作中，獲得虛擬的領導和管理技能。在COVID-19爆發期間，這些虛擬技能有助於團隊協調 (Bauer et al. 2022)。因此，我們假設更大的合夥人級集團審計經驗與審計效率在大流行期間（COVID-19爆發後）帶正相關（如顯示在出現更短的審計報告時間滯後，和降低的審計費用）。此外，我們建議，集團審計不僅對首席審計師有利，無論是辦公室級（在特定的當地知識溢出方面）還是合夥人級（由於獲得虛擬領導的技能），而且還為其後的跨國企業提供經濟優勢，就是跨國企業將能以更低的審計價格享受到更優質的審計服務。總括而言，我們相信集團審計可為審計從業人員及長遠的審計市場帶來雙贏的局面。

13501423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501423.value: 風格就是女王！從熵的視角來檢測語言複雜性對內容營銷的影響

13501423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13501423.value: Prof CHUNG, Yuho Prof CUI, Geng Prof Xie, Haoran

13501423.label: Project Objectives
13501423.value: Go beyond content and text analyses and to examine the unexplored impact of linguistic styles on the success of marketing texts by adopting innovative methods of computational linguistics Adopt entropy-based measures of linguistic complexity, i.e., lexical and syntactic diversity and test their inverted-U effect on marketing outcomes Assess the trade-off from linguistic complexity between the readability and narrativity of content Test the role of author-reader homophily in moderating the effect of linguistic complexity Establish the contextual validity for the effect of linguistics complexity on reader response across product and text categories under different contexts (platforms) Generate meaningful theoretical and managerial implications for content marketing and communications in the digital age
rows: Go beyond content and text analyses and to examine the unexplored impact of linguistic styles on the success of marketing texts by adopting innovative methods of computational linguistics
Adopt entropy-based measures of linguistic complexity, i.e., lexical and syntactic diversity and test their inverted-U effect on marketing outcomes
Assess the trade-off from linguistic complexity between the readability and narrativity of content
Test the role of author-reader homophily in moderating the effect of linguistic complexity
Establish the contextual validity for the effect of linguistics complexity on reader response across product and text categories under different contexts (platforms)
Generate meaningful theoretical and managerial implications for content marketing and communications in the digital age

13501423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501423.value: Since Bill Gates hailed “Content is King” in 1996, marketers have embraced “content marketing” to reach and engage consumers on e-commerce and social media platforms and churned out voluminous amount of content. Yet, cutting through the clutter has been challenging. While high-impact content is critical to e-marketing success, we have little insight into the success factors of engaging content. Although existing studies have adopted text and sentiment analyses to study the content of social media marketing, they are limited to the analysis of sentiments and topics. While important content and topics may be similar, we believe that linguistic style is the differentiating factor. However, the relationship between content and linguistic styles of authors and its effect on consumer response remain unexplored in the literature. Linguistic complexity of authors is regarded as the hallmark of their linguistic styles and differentiates the effect of content. Drawing from computational linguistics and information-theoretic models, we adopt two entropy-based measures of linguistic complexity, i.e., lexical (vocabulary) and syntactic diversity, and propose an inverted-U effect of linguistic complexity on the overall outcome and a significant trade-off between the readability and narrativity of content. We further posit that creator-reader homophily (similarity) moderates the effect of linguistic complexity on readability and narrativity. To assess the effect of linguistic complexity on reader response and marketing performance, we will conduct linguistic analysis of three text corpora, each being a unique type of content and context. First, we assess the effect of linguistic complexity of promotion pitches of Kickstarter film projects on project success and backer support. Genre familiarity of films will serve as a proxy of reader homophily. Second, to examine marketing content in social media, we will analyze the influencer-level data from the Blog Meets Brand platform and use reader response as the dependent variable. Third, we will analyze the product reviews from Amazon.com and the effect of linguistic complexity on reader response and reviewer popularity, followed by an online experiment. For its originality, this research will be the first in marketing to adopt innovative methods of computational linguistics to assess the effect of linguistic complexity in terms of both lexical and syntactic diversity on the performance of marketing texts. By going beyond text analyses, the findings will shed light on the role of linguistic styles in content marketing, inform practitioners of the essential linguistic properties of high-impact content, and generate meaningful implications for effective content and marketing research. 自 1996 年比爾·蓋茨 (Bill Gates) 提出“內容為王”以來，營銷人員廣泛採用“內容營銷”在電子商務和社交媒體平臺上接觸並吸引消費者， 從而產出了大量的內容。然而要脫穎而出仍充滿挑戰。雖然具有高影響力的內容對於電子營銷的成功至關重要，但我們對于引人入勝的內容的成功要素知之甚少。 現有研究採用文本和情感分析來審視社交媒體營銷內容，但它們僅限於情感和話題分析。雖然重要的內容和話題可能相似，我們認為語言風格才是最重要的差異化因素。然而現有文獻中尚未探討內容與語言風格之間的關係及其對消費者反應的影響。 作者的語言複雜性被視為其語言風格的標誌，足以區分內容的效果。我們借鑒計算語言學和資訊論模型，採用兩種基於熵的語言複雜性度量，即詞彙（詞匯）和句法多樣性，並提出語言複雜性對整體結果的影響呈倒U型；而且內容的可讀性和敘述性之間存在顯著權衡。我們進一步假設作者-讀者同質性（相似性）調節語言複雜性對可讀性及敘述性的影響。 為了檢驗語言複雜性對讀者反應和營銷績效的影響，我們將對三個文本語料庫進行語言學分析，每個語料庫都具有獨特的內容和情景。首先，我們檢測Kickstarter 電影項目宣傳的語言複雜性對項目成功和支持者的的影響；電影類型的熟悉程度將作為讀者同質性的衡量。第二、為了檢測社交媒體中的營銷內容，我們將分析來自Blog Meets Brands平臺的網紅級數據，並用讀者反應作為因變量。第三，我們將分析來自 Amazon.com 的產品評論以及語言複雜性對讀者反應和作者受歡迎程度的影響，然後進行在線實驗。 這項研究的獨創性在於它將是營銷領域第一個採用具有創新性的計算語言學方法來檢測語言複雜性，包括詞彙和句法多樣性，對營銷文本表現的的影響，因而超越了文本分析。研究結果還將揭示語言風格在內容營銷中的作用，讓從業者瞭解高影響力內容的基本語言特性，並對有效內容和市場研究產生有意義的影響。

13501523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501523.value: 授之以漁還是授之以魚？

13501523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13501523.value: Prof Crant, J. Michael Prof WANG, Nan

13501523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501523.value: 研究摘要 我們通常認為，組織中的導師制度有利於新員工的成長進步，但不同導師的不同教導風格對新員工的主動行為和職業發展會產生不同的影響。遺憾的是，學術界對這方面研究的空白還有待填補。本項目提出授權式和依賴式這兩個新的概念，從新的視角，研究新員工在進入組織初期的的成長軌跡。 我們將授權式教導定義為“授之以漁”；把依賴式教導定義為 “授之以魚”，探索隨著時間的推移，導師的主動性性格如何影響他們對新員工的教導方式，從而塑造員工的主動行為。同時，我們也追蹤員工的主動行為如何影響員工的表現和職業發展。本研究計畫將導師制度下的導師和新員工放進互動的視角，計通過多階段多源頭的數據收集方式，來探索本項目的研究課題及研究假設。 本研究旨在填補三個空白：1. 本研究第一次從“授之以漁”及 “授之以魚”的視角對導師制度進行研究；2. 本研究將導師制度放入長期互動的視角，填補了以前僅僅對導師制度做靜態研究的空白；3. 本研究從互動的視角，同時將導師和新員工一起放進研究模型，探索導師和新員工如何同時影響導師教導及結果的長期變化軌跡。

13501823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13501823.value: 人造符號中的語言與貿易

13501823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13501823.value: Dr Yang, Yang Dr Zhao, Xiaojian

13501823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13501823.value: Language evolves when trade expands. Historians and linguists document the emergence of pidgins, i.e. grammatically simplified means of communication, in historical contacts such as trade, between groups with different language backgrounds, especially in the East-West encounters in recent centuries. Historical accounts and linguistic studies provide important insights on the co-evolution of language and trade, but face the challenge of drawing causal inference due to the endogeneity of historical events and the challenge of generalizability because they typically study particular historical events or linguistic phenomena. We develop an experiment to understand language-trade co-evolution in a laboratory setting. It first teaches different groups of participants different (artificial) languages, and then lets them interact and trade in sender-receiver communication games. We will investigate: whether there is information transmission, and whether there is a stable language, emerging from the communication between agents with different language backgrounds, and whether the emergent languages, if any, are pidgins, or extended forms of the language originally spoken by one of the groups. Motivated by historical accounts, we will then investigate how the authority’s foreign language policy (whether or not it allows complete learning of foreign languages) and the potential gains to trade influence the emergent language and communication efficiency in the interactions. We derive hypotheses that partial learning is more likely to induce pidgins, that the trading partner who gains more from trade is more likely to adopt the other group’s language, that pidgins are associated with lower communication efficiency than a complete adoption of an extended form of one of the original languages, and others. Our experimental design allows us to test the above hypotheses, to examine the entire process of language formation and evolution in the laboratory, and more generally, to generate insights on the co-evolution of language and trade.

13502123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502123.value: 表征道德身份對新員工適應的影響

13502123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502123.value: Prof LEE, Cynthia Prof ZHU, Jinlong

13502123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502123.value: 為了成功地適應新的工作環境，新來者可能需要從同事那裡塑造针對自己的積極看法，以獲得他們的支持。 关于人類感知理論的新的研究表明，道德比能力和溫暖更為重要，這是人們在形成初始印象時對他人看法的關鍵方面。 因此，一個表征了自己道德身份的新來者，通过向工作場所的其他人公開展示自己的道德和道德價值觀，可能會引起同事的好反應。 但是，反對證據表明，表現出道德的人也可能會被視為不幽默或一种人际威脅, 比如他们可能会用高度道德相關的狹窄標準限制他人的行為选择。 因此，表征道德身份会如何影響新员工适应的机制尚不清楚。 我们將人的道德理論與道德責備文獻融合在一起，认为一方面，表征道德可以使新员工降低人際關係的不確定性，进而獲得同事的信任和支持。 另一方面，同事可能會通過預期（甚至想像）來體驗道德責備。 此外，在捍衛他們受威脅的自我時，同事甚至可能會質疑新來者表征道德身份的意圖，並可能認為個人是一個偽君子，從而發展出破壞而不是支持新人的意圖。 關於預期的道德責備的文獻表明，個人參與對他人的道德主張的反應至關重要。 因此，團隊負責人的底線心態是與新老员工之間的互動相關的邊界條件。 通過強調绩效優先於所有其他（包括道德）問題，領導者可能會限制下属的道德選擇，從而使他們对他人的道德选择采用更加戒备的态度。 相反，團隊的道德氣候可能會減少不道德行為的可能性，從而減輕這種負面反應。

13502223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502223.value: 企業會對同行業其他企業碳排放實踐的負面報導作出回應嗎？-基於戰略性披露角度的探究

13502223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502223.value: Prof WANG, Ke Dr Xie, Lingmin

13502223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502223.value: Climate change is widely perceived to be one of the biggest challenges of our time. According to data released by NASA, the world has warmed dramatically over the past century, with the global average temperature increasing by between 0.15 and 0.20 degrees Celsius per decade since 1975. As a root cause of global warming, corporate carbon practices have attracted significant attention from regulators, investors, and the general public and become headline issues in the media. In recent years, heavily emitting large corporations have begun to suffer backlash from various stakeholder groups, which has resulted in severe reputational damage. In line with this, prior studies document how investors, banks, and activist groups react to the media coverage of firms’ climate-threatening behavior. As another important stakeholder group, peer firms are also significantly influenced by the publicized climate-threatening practices. However, little is known about how peers respond to such negative carbon-related media coverage. Focusing on corporate voluntary carbon disclosures, this proposed study will investigate how peers respond to negative carbon news by strategically altering their voluntary carbon-related disclosures. According to the literature on intra-industry information spillover, negative carbon news can damage the reputation of non-covered peers while, at the same time, offering opportunities for peers to gain advantages in the product market. Facing these two opposite effects, peers’ responses may vary with their own carbon emission levels. Specifically, low-emission peers may increase their carbon disclosure to highlight their green performance. Such disclosures could further damage the reputation of the publicized firm and, in turn, help low-emission peers gain more advantages in the capital and product markets. In contrast, high-emission peers may reduce their carbon disclosure because the disclosure of climate-threatening carbon behavior may place heavy emitters in the spotlight and further exacerbate the reputational damage caused by the negative carbon news. We are interested in two types of voluntary carbon disclosure, namely narrative carbon-related management discussions in earnings conference calls and voluntary disclosures of carbon emission quantity. Based on a cohort-based matching difference-in-differences methodology, we will examine whether low-emission (high-emission) peers increase (decrease) these two forms of voluntary carbon disclosure following the negative carbon news. This study contributes to the emerging literature on climate change risk and carbon disclosure. It also adds to our understanding of peer strategic disclosure in the context of carbon emission practices. In early 2022, U.S. regulators proposed mandating the corporate reporting of carbon emissions. Our study thus provides meaningful implications for them. 氣候變化被廣泛認為是我們這個時代面臨的最大挑戰之一。根據NASA發佈的數據，過去一個世紀裡世界氣溫急劇升高，全球平均氣溫自1975年以來每十年增加0.15至0.20攝氏度。作為全球變暖的根本原因，企業的碳排放行為已引起監管機構、投資者和公眾的重視，並成為媒體關注的頭條問題。近年來，高排放的大型企業開始受到各利益相關者團體的強烈抵制，導致嚴重的聲譽損害。與此一致，既有文獻記錄了投資者、銀行和活動家團體如何對企業威脅氣候的行為的媒體報導做出反應。作為另一個重要的利益相關者群體，同行業企業也會受到負面碳相關媒體報導的影響。然而，我們對同行企業如何應對此類報導知之甚少。本研究將聚焦於企業自願性碳披露，探究同行企業如何通過戰略性地調整自願性碳披露來應對負面碳新聞。 根據行業內信息溢出的相關文獻，負面碳新聞可能會損害未受報導同行企業的聲譽，但與此同時，也可能為同行企業提供獲得產品市場競爭優勢的機會。面對這兩種相反的效應，未被報導的同行企業的反應可能會因其自身的碳排放水平而異。具體而言，低排放同行企業可能會增加碳披露以凸顯其綠色表現。這種披露可能進一步損害被報導企業的聲譽，從而幫助低排放同行企業在資本和產品市場上獲得更多優勢。相反，高排放同行企業可能會減少碳披露，因為公開披露威脅氣候的碳行為可能會將高排放同行企業置於風頭浪尖，進一步加劇負面碳新聞造成的聲譽損害。 我們關注兩種類型的自願性碳披露，即在業績發布電話會議中管理層關於碳排放相關事項的討論和碳排放量的自願性披露。基於雙重查分檢驗法，我們將研究低排放（高排放）同行企業是否在負面碳新聞後增加（減少）這兩種形式的自願性碳披露。 本課題將為近年來逐漸出現的氣候變化風險和碳披露文獻做出貢獻，亦會增進我們對碳排放實踐背景下同行業企業戰略性披露的理解。在2022年初，美國監管機構提議強制上市企業進行碳排放披露。因此，我們的研究也將提供重要的政策性意義。

13502423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13502423.value: 分析師和審計師的五大人格特質是否重要？一種基於視頻測量和語言學的機器學習方法

13502423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13502423.value: Prof Kim, Jeong Bon Dr Wang, Rencheng

13502423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13502423.value: Using a machine-learning approach based on videometrics and linguistics, the proposed research will develop new measures of analysts’ and auditors’ personalities that incorporate their Big Five personality traits, i.e., openness, conscientiousness, extraversion, agreeableness, and neuroticism. We will conduct several predictive tests to examine 1) whether analysts’ Big Five personality traits are associated with analysts’ forecast accuracy and informativeness and 2) whether auditors’ Big Five personality traits are associated with audit efficiency and audit quality. Our validated measure of Big Five personality traits will provide a strong foundation for future theory-building and empirical research that investigates the influences of various personalities on professional services provided by capital market information intermediaries. Our empirical findings will also extend the knowledge of how analysts’ and auditors’ personalities influence their information acquisition and dissemination processes. 13503323.value: 社交CRM: 耦合非齐次隐马尔可夫模型方法

13503323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13503323.value: Owing to the increasing accessibility and prevalence of smart devices, mobile networks, and especially social media, a modern customer not only can easily interact with the firm by voicing her opinions, but also can interact with other customers. Both types of interactions here can ultimately translate into important CRM outcomes (e.g., sales). As a result, firms’ sales performance is not merely driven by firms’ direct relationship with the customer (firm-customer relationship, FCR), but also indirectly by the relationship among customers (customer-customer relationship, CCR). However, many firms fail to realize that sales can be (at least partially) driven by CCR, giving rise to suboptimal marketing decisions, such as misguided promotion strategy and inaccurate sales forecasting. In addition, although FCR research has been prolific, very few works have investigated CCR, much less its interplay with FCR. These conceptual and practical gaps require modern CRM research to embrace CCR as a dimension of equal importance to FCR – a novel CRM framework called social CRM. We contend that CCR can exert important influences on CRM outcomes (e.g., sales) both directly and indirectly by shaping FCR. Specifically, we propose a Coupled Nonhomogeneous Hidden Markov Model (CNHMM) that encompasses both FCR and CCR and, importantly, their interdependence over time. By employing two simultaneously evolving Markov processes for FCR and CCR, our model allows us to identify customers’ latent FCR and CCR states (e.g., low, moderate, and high CCR states), monitor their change in relationship states (e.g., moving from a moderate to high CCR state), and capture the interplay between FCR and CCR states (e.g., a high CCR state gives rise to a high FCR state). We plan to test our model employing large-scale longitudinal mobile service data from a major telecommunication carrier, which includes 217,726 subscribers and their service usage for a 24-month period. Here we provide a proof of concept and demonstrate the feasibility of our model. Our preliminary analyses demonstrate that our model boasts great potential for uncovering the interactive evolution of consumers’ hidden FCR and CCR states, and can prove a powerful tool for firms to influence customer spending. To realize the full potential of our model, we propose extending our preliminary analysis to population-scale data on more behavior outcomes. Importantly, we also intend to conduct a series of simulation analyses and a field experiment to generate and test applied knowledge on actively managing customer segments and formulating effective targeting strategies. 由於智能設備、移動網絡，尤其是社交媒體的普及和便利性不斷增加，客戶如今不僅可以通過表達自己的觀點輕鬆地與公司互動，還可以與其他客戶互動。這兩種互動類型最終都可以轉化為重要的CRM結果（例如銷售額）。因此，公司的銷售業績不僅僅由公司與客戶之間的直接關係（公司-客戶關係，FCR）驅動，還間接地由客戶之間的關係（客戶-客戶關係，CCR）驅動。然而，許多公司未能意識到銷售額可以（至少部分地）由CCR驅動，從而導致次優的營銷決策，例如錯誤的促銷策略和不準確的銷售預測。此外，儘管FCR研究非常豐富，但很少有研究探討CCR，更不用說其與FCR的相互作用了。 这些概念和现实上的差距要求当代CRM研究将CCR视为与FCR同等重要的维度——一种称为社交CRM的新型CRM框架。我们认为CCR可以直接，或间接通过塑造FCR的方式对CRM结果（例如销售额）产生重要影响。具体而言，我们提出了一种耦合非齐次隐马尔可夫模型（CNHMM），该模型包含了FCR和CCR，以及它们随时间的相互依赖关系。通过为采用两个同时演变的马尔可夫过程来刻画FCR和CCR，我们的模型允许我们识别客户的潜在FCR和CCR状态（例如，低、中、高CCR状态），监测他们状态的变化（例如，从中CCR状态转移到高CCR状态），并捕捉FCR和CCR状态之间的相互影响（例如，高CCR状态导致高FCR状态）。 我们计划使用一家大型电信运营商的大规模（面板）移动服务数据来测试我们的模型。该数据包括217,726名用户和他们在24个月内的服务使用情况。通过这个数据，我们提供了一个概念验证，并展示了我们模型的可行性。我们的初步分析表明，我们的模型具有发掘消费者隐藏的FCR和CCR状态交互演变的巨大潜力，因而可以成为公司影响客户消费的有力工具。为了实现我们模型的全部潜力，我们建议将我们的初步分析扩展到更多消费者行为的大规模数据上。重要的是，我们还打算进行一系列的模拟分析和田野实验，以生成和测试有效的应用型知识，用以管理细分客户群和制定有效的客户定位策略。

13601223.label: Project Objectives
13601223.value: Compilation, Collation and Revision Published copies of the works of So Man-jok(1921-1997) on the Confucian Classics are incomplete. Most of these published materials come from his treatises. A Collection of Commentaries on The Book of Rites, published in 1984, contains of 18 treatises. Fortunately, more than 20 years ago, I made copies of unpublished manuscripts containing 14 treatises on the Three Books of Rites, bringing the total number of treatises to 32. The unpublished treatises were written on original 20 x 20 manuscript paper, with ‘The Chinese University of Hong Kong’ printed in the lower left-hand corner. Although the handwriting is neat, it is not that of So’s. The text was hand-copied by his student and fellow professor Tang Kwok-kwong. In terms of textual arrangement, the handwritten treatises (especially quotations from classical texts or previous scholarship) must be individually examined and compared with the original text. Here is a list of the titles of the 32 treatises: Published in〈經詁拾存．《禮記》之部〉: 1.〈奉席如橋衡解〉2.〈席間函丈解〉3.〈卹勿解〉4.〈喪三年以為極句解〉5.〈歛手足形還葬句解〉6.〈月令作者時代說〉7.〈具曲植籧筐解〉8.〈荔挺出〉9.〈昔者仲尼與於蜡賓事畢句解〉10.〈月生於西解〉11.〈魯郊解〉12.〈素積解〉13.〈大夫以魚須文竹解〉14.〈宵雅肄三解〉15.〈六成復綴以崇天子夾振之而駟伐解〉16.〈禘說〉17.〈魯禘說〉18.〈孚尹旁達解〉 Unpublished: 19.〈經禮三百曲禮三千解〉20.〈《禮運》《禮器》《郊特牲》分合之迹〉21.〈《深衣》續衽鉤邊解〉22.〈《樂記》《樂書》異文〉23.〈《大戴禮》多錯雜說〉24.〈三禮圖宜加重訂〉25.〈士冠禮母拜說〉26.〈一獻無牲攷〉27.〈為政請射解〉28.〈追享朝享申先鄭義〉29.〈庫門天子皋門雉門天子應門解〉30.〈駔圭璋璧琮琥璜之渠眉疏璧琮以斂尸解〉31.〈《周禮》田主田祖即社稷〉32.〈《考工記》輈人任木解〉 Organization and Verification To develop his theoretical framework, So compared the various Confucian doctrines that had emerged since the Han dynasty and pinpointed the strengths and weakness of each doctrine. This allowed him to identify and learn from the ‘best’ doctrinal texts. He demonstrated his key points through an integrated analysis of the diction, philosophical arguments and other features of the texts, accompanied by abundant references. Only by tracing his reasoning, clarifying his network of references, and then organizing these references can we situate So’s theories in the context of the development of the study of the Confucian Classics. This will enable us to identify the strengths of So’s theories in comparison with those of his predecessors and demonstrate their value to future generations. Extended Discussion Regardless of the validity of So’s novel theories, his approach to studying rituals and etiquettes offers a great source of inspiration for future scholars. Critically studying his writings on this topic will allow us to follow the path of So’s scholarship and learn from his findings. To this end, the proposed project will combine modern academics methods to re-examine and rethink relevant issues, expand the arguments, identifying the crux of the problem, and more accurately interpret the original meanings of the texts. Searching for General Rules and Explaining Their Connotations Most of the surviving commentaries by So focus on interpreting the diction of the Three Books of Rites. While some use various examples of rituals, others focus on single important rituals such as Lujiaojie (魯郊解), Ludishuo (魯禘說 ), and Dishuo (禘說), providing important insight into the State of Lu’s ritual system. These commentaries offer not only critical analysis of the ritual texts, but also interpretations of the meanings of the rituals. So’s comments on the connotations of the rituals are worth examining. Passing On the Knowledge of the Lingnan School of Confucian Studies – Looking Back to Zheng Xuan and Making New Breakthroughs The Lingnan School of Confucian Studies emerged in the Xuehaitang Academy, which was founded by Ruan Yuan (阮元,1764-1849). This educational institution promoted the development of Lingnan scholarship and nurtured many scholars, such as Chen Li (陳澧, 1810-1882), who were well-versed in both the classics and general knowledge. Chen Li was a prominent Confucian scholar who regarded Zheng Xuan’s writings as the definitive scholarly account of ritual. The Lingnan School of Confucian Studies continued to thrive into the early Republic of China period. In Chen Li’s years, prominent late Imperial Lingnan scholars Zheng Zhao (曾釗, 1793-1854) and Hou Kang (侯康, 1798-1837) were also devoted to studying ritual classics and published their findings. Chen Li’s disciple Zhang Qi-gan (張其淦, 1859-1946), who called himself the ‘Lingnan Wanderer’, also devoted himself to studying classical texts and published treatises such as Hongfan Wei (《洪範微》) and The Study of Rituals and Etiquettes in the Zuozhuan (《左傳禮說》). Zhang Qigan was a close friend of So Yuek-wu’s (蘇若瑚, 1851-1917), the grandfather of So. Commentaries suggest that So’s study of ritual was both in line with the Lingnan School and looked back to the much earlier writings of Zheng Xuan to inspire future advancements in research. Inheritance and Innovation: Setting a Direction and Goals for Modern Ritual Studies Through an overarching plan of ‘points’ ‘lines’ and ‘planes’, the proposed project will first summarise the strengths of So’s scholarship on rituals and etiquettes and describe Lingnan studies of the Confucian Classics. It will then attempt to create a blueprint for the further development of ritual studies, setting a direction and goals for scholars today. Wherever possible, So’s commentaries will be compared with those Confucian scholars from both the Greater China Area and overseas sinologists especially Japanese sinologists and Korean sinologists during the Joseon period such as the Lingnan School嶺南學派and Jihu School 畿湖學派, and Jeong Yak-yong’s （丁若鏞, 1762-1836) ritual studies. This will help to accentuate So’s achievements.
