13601223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601223.value: Before and after the 1911 Revolution and during the Japanese invasion of mainland China, many Chinese intellectuals, especially Cantonese members of the Imperial Academy (established in the late Qing dynasty) migrated south to Hong Kong to escape the upheaval. Thanks to their efforts to transmit, promote, nourish and reinforce Confucianism in the then British colony, Hong Kong became a hub for the study of the Confucian Classics, gaining unique and enduring strengths in this field. The incoming Confucian scholars had their own specific research interests and domains. The most distinguished of these scholars was So Man-jok (1921-1997) who specialized in ritual studies and distinguished himself from his contemporaries in that speciality. So taught the Confucian Classics for several decades. His teaching inspired generations of students and future academics, contributing immensely to scholarship on the Confucian Classics in Hong Kong. So also applied Confucian teaching in his personal life. He exhibited grace as both a teacher and a Confucian scholar, setting an example for other academics. So’s specialist subject was the Three Books of Rites《三禮》. Not only did he examine their vocabulary, syntax, and punctuation, So also offered new explanations of the ideas that they conveyed, which had allegedly been misinterpreted by Tang scholars in the compilation known as Yishu義疏. As well as continuing a family tradition of Confucian scholarship, So drew on the writings of his predecessors, particularly the ritual studies of Zheng Xuan (127-200). This reflects the unique emphasis of Lingnan Confucian studies, namely “elaborating on classical texts through transmission, not creation.” So’s impressive contribution to ritual studies covered a broad range of topics, from problematic word use and controversies of authenticity in particular texts to the principles and interpretations of the rituals described. The proposed project will be the first attempt to compile and collate a full collection of So’s findings, both published and unpublished (appearing neither in the catalogue of So’s works edited by Suen Kwong-hoi, nor on the main website commemorating So), compare them with those of Han and Qing Chinese scholars and Korean and Japanese sinologists which involves an immense amount of research results from antiquity; and, most importantly, carry out a thorough examination and critical study of his ritual studies thus proving the importance of So’s contribution to Lingnan Confucian studies. The ultimate purpose of the project will be to provide today’s audiences with an exemplary approach to the study of traditional Chinese culture. 蘇文擢教授（1921-1997）國學深醇，既是一代辭章家，也是一代鴻儒。蘇教授之學術兼綜傳統學術的義理、考據、詞章，於六藝鑽研至深，尤擅長於《三禮》。蘇教授之禮學，不但精於考證經文句讀以至疑難字詞，更注重闡明禮意，多發前人（尤其是唐人疏義）之所未發。蘇教授之學，既有家學淵源，亦得力於吸收自漢宋迄清之舊學，尤其是鄭玄（127-200）禮學，呈現獨特的「以禮意說經」的嶺南經學特色，所謂「舊學商量加邃密，新知培養轉深沉」，信哉斯言。現存蘇教授已出版的經學著作並不完整，主要散見於《經詁拾存》、《邃加室叢稿》、《邃加室詩文集》及《淺語集》之中。《經詁拾存．〈爾雅〉之部》載錄《爾雅》研究札記十三條，條目涉及《爾雅》的眾多重要議題。就禮學而言，除《邃加室叢稿．禮之要義》及《邃加室詩文集．明禮論序》兩文外，發表於上世紀八十年代初的《經詁拾存．〈禮記〉之部》，共有十八條，以訓釋《禮記》字句為主，亦有專門討論重要禮典的。另有筆者於二十多年前複印並保存至今的手稿三《禮》經詁十四條。取與已發表的《禮記》經詁合璧，共得《三禮》經詁三十二條。此等經詁，採用傳統條目札記體式，無不針對《三禮》文本的疑難處，廣綜舊帙，參酌羣言，推尋研覈，斷以己意。其識見之卓著，論證之謹嚴，與乾嘉學人相較，亦毫不遜色。加上這些詁禮之作皆用雅醇的古文寫成，短小精悍，堪與清人說禮佳構相媲美。多篇文章關涉禮學的重大課題，如禮學文獻的著作時代及分合、郊禘大祭等，均為聚訟千年的老大難題。後學可藉此等文章窺探蘇教授的治禮路數，並擴而充之，發揚下去。本計劃旨在輯集蘇教授禮詁之散見於各種文集、刊物及未刊手稿，然後細加整理，校對訂正各篇文字及引文，並廣參自漢宋迄清，尤其是清末民初嶺南禮學大家如陳澧（1810-1882）、曾釗（1793-1854）、侯康（1798-1837）、張其淦（1859-1946）等人之說，為之疏通證明，說明蘇教授禮學與中土以至嶺南經學的關係，將香港經學與嶺南經學以至鄭學連接起來。本著實事求是的原則，計劃包含延伸討論蘇教授之說部分，突顯蘇教授禮學所具傳承與開拓的特點，使今人研治禮學知所取徑，藉此尋求突破與拓展的可能。要言之，就禮詁所見，蘇教授禮學既以家學及嶺南經學為本，更溯流而上，接通鄭玄之學，擔當承傳與開拓的角色。

13601423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13601423.value: 重申自然：1980年代以來中國小說中的生態批評與民族

13601423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601423.value: 本研究項目基於本人對中國生態電影中民族與生態關係的探討，且在以下諸方面對該議題作出延伸與擴展。 其一，在生態電影研究中，本人開拓了生態批評中民族問題之探索。本項目則進一步思考生態書寫中“自然”之問題。在廣義的生態批評中，部分學者們往往不加區分地使用“自然”與“環境”的概念 。更有甚者，有人盡力避免使用“自然”一詞，因為他們認為“自然”承載了過多的哲學、文化與意識形態之意涵，影響了生態批評以科學技術為本柢的理性思考，攪擾了對文學與環境的研究。然而，若沒有對“自然”多重意義的思考，生態批評也將無法梳理出文學的複雜涵義。而這一問題在現代中國文學的解讀中更為突出，因為在此，傳統、現代、中國、西方等各式不同對“自然”的理解相互碰撞，重塑著人們對自然為何的認識，以及中國現代性追求中何為自然的思索。 其二，本項目將對“自然”的思考，與中國的“民族”問題以及構建現代中國民族國家問題之思考相結合。傳統思維中自然、天、天下、世界等理念的關聯，現代理性中對自然科學與自然哲學的理解，以及各式進化與革命的理論，均塑造了中國的民族和民族主義之觀念以及各民族間的關係。本人將考察文學作品中各不同層面的“民族”是如何為“自然”所啟示並與“自然”相作用；這些不同形式的相互作用，特別是在現代性轉型時期，又是如何塑造不同層面的民族形式、它們的自我認識，以及其政治與文化之認同。本人也將同時考察不同民族對待自然的不同態度是如何影響了自然，其社會與文化後果如何。 本項目是本人二十世紀中國文學中“自然”研究的一部分，它將聚焦於1980年代以來的小說寫作。這時期的小說在構建民族身份與美學形態的過程中，呈現出對自然與民族的明顯的自我意識。本人將對這一提議的探討置於眾多的歷史性討論之中，例如“八十年代文學”、“短二十世紀”、“長九十年代”等，從人與自然的角度來發掘這些討論將如何啟發本項目的思考。 本項目計劃發表三篇相關論文，試圖激發“自然”與“民族”的批評潛力。如可能，希望這些成果最終形成一部專著。

13601523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13601523.value: 東盟的科研產出與合作：一項採用序貫混合方法的研究

13601523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13601523.value: Prof Lim, Miguel Antonio Prof Mok, Ka Ho Prof Tran, Ly Prof Yang, Lili

13601523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601523.value: A new large region in higher education is in development. The Association of Southeast Asian Nations (ASEAN) currently consists of 10 countries and was established in 1967 with the goals of fostering regional peace and enhancing socio-cultural, economic, and political cooperation. These efforts are currently contributing to the development of a more harmonised and stronger ASEAN higher education system, as indicated in the ASEAN Work Plan on Education adopted in May 2021. With a population of over 680 million people, ASEAN member states comprise a substantial portion of the global population, and their growing economic footprint impacts the surrounding nations through partnerships. Hong Kong collaborates considerably with ASEAN member states. ASEAN countries are also important strategic partners in the Belt and Road Initiative. ASEAN has the potential to build a significant higher education system that produces meaningful contributions to global science. However, despite its recent development, ASEAN science remains a non-central player in the ‘centre-periphery’ global science system. The development of the ASEAN science system not only in quality and quantity but also through its connectivity with the systems of other countries, is vital to building a more integrated, equal, and plural global science system. Nonetheless, the literature has not adequately investigated the current state and development of this emerging region’s scientific output. The proposed project will fill this gap through its explanatory sequential mixed-method design. Its quantitative component will examine the quantity and scientific influence of the research output from ASEAN member states since 2000 using bibliometric data. The quantitative component will produce an overview of research output and evaluate the international connectivity of ASEAN member states in terms of research collaborations both with other ASEAN countries (intra-ASEAN connectivity) and other regions and countries (extra-ASEAN connectivity). Subsequently, the qualitative component will go beyond what can be achieved by numbers. Semi-structured interviews with researchers, policymakers and research officers at universities in ASEAN member states, and qualitative policy document analysis will be used to investigate the purpose of scientific publications and meanings ascribed to intra- versus extra-ASEAN collaborations. The qualitative component will expand on the quantitative findings from the first phase. The findings will improve our understanding of the development of ASEAN science, and the scientific research connectivity both among ASEAN states and between ASEAN and other countries and regions. The findings will also have policy implications for ASEAN countries about the development of their science systems at both regional and national levels. 一個新的高等教育區域正在形成。以促進地區和平，加強社會文化、經濟和政治合作為目標的東南亞國家聯盟 (ASEAN) 成立於1967年，目前由10個國家組成。正如2021年5月通過的《東盟教育工作計劃》所言，東盟正在為建成一個更加協調和更加強大的高等教育體系而努力。東盟成員國人口超過6.8億，佔世界人口的很大一部分，它們日益增長的經濟影響力也通過夥伴關係影響著周邊國家。東盟成員國與香港合作緊密，同時也是“一帶一路”重要戰略合作夥伴。 東盟有潛力建成一個舉足輕重的高等教育體系，為全球科學做出有意義的貢獻。然而，雖然近些年來東盟科學取得了長足發展，它仍然是“中心-邊緣”全球科學體系中的非中心參與者。從質量、數量、和國家間科學體係的互聯互通等意義上來講，東盟科學體系的發展都對於建設更加一體化、平等和多元化的全球科學體系至關重要。儘管如此，現有文獻中對於這一新興地區科研產出現狀和發展的研究仍然不足。 本項目將採用一項解釋性序貫混合方法的研究設計來填補這一研究空白。其定量研究部分將利用文獻計量數據探索2000年以來東盟成員國研究成果的數量和科學影響力。定量研究部分將概述研究成果，並評估東盟成員國在與其他東盟國家（即東盟內部連通性）和其他地區和國家（即東盟外連通性）的研究合作方面的國際連通性。隨後，質性研究部分將超越數字，利用對東盟成員國大學研究人員、政策制定者和官員的半結構化訪談以及質性政策文本分析，調查科研成果的目的以及東盟內、外部合作的意義。定性部分將擴展第一階段的定量分析結果。 這些發現將增進我們對東盟科學發展、東盟國家之間以及東盟與其他國家和地區之間科研互聯互通的了解。研究結果還將對東盟國家區域和國家層面的科研政策制定有所啟發。

13601723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13601723.value: 社會企業中介作為範式構建者：朝向創新還是同構？

13601723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13601723.value: Prof CHANDRA, Yanto Dr Nie, Lin Prof Teasdale, Simon

13601723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601723.value: 中介組織，包括孵化器、能力建設組織和加速器，已如雨後春筍般湧現，成為支持社會企業創建和發展的重要制度參與者。政府通常使用中介來彌補社會企業和公共資金之間的空白，因為政府認識到社會企業是提供公共服務的反應靈敏和創新的方式，希望這將為社會企業創造一個支持性的基礎設施。在這個過程中，中介充當“經紀人”，能使不太有聯系的社會企業獲得重要資源。一些最新的文獻強調了中介在推動社會企業方面的支持作用，例如通過提供培訓、輔導和咨詢服務，並將它們與其他參與者聯繫起來推動合作。人們忽視的是中介作為範式構建者的作用，他們通過孵化和競賽等方式，在構建社會企業的新的制度規範、價值觀和話語方面具有很大的影響力。中介這種塑造領域的作用可能對社會企業的制度領域有重要意義，並通過組織實踐和行為產生影響。為了解決研究空白，本研究借鑒了新制度理論，並提出了兩項以香港為研究場地的研究。在第一項研究中，我們將進行定性內容分析，以檢查由中介和其他範式構建者傳播的社會企業的定義。在第二項研究中，我們將進行民族志案例研究，以調查中介對社會企業的做法、過程和影響，以及社會企業如何感知和回應這些影響。本研究的貢獻有三方面。首先，這項研究將通過範式構建者在制度化過程中所扮演的角色來擴展新制度理論。其次，這項研究將通過對中介複雜作用的更好和更細致的理解，揭示社會企業的一個較少研究的方面。最後，我們還將為政策制定者和社會企業從業者提供重要的指導和實踐啟示，以培育不同利益相關者之間的協同關係。重要的是，我們希望這項研究能鼓勵更多的聲音，並為如何構建一個支持和促進社會企業生態系統的進一步和更多的討論提供更多的空間。

13601823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13601823.value: 關於資訊披露之於馬塞勒斯頁岩氣田開採意義的研究

13601823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13601823.value: Dr GUO, Wenshu Prof Hopenhayn, Hugo Prof QIU, Dongxiao Larry Prof ZHANG, Tianle

13601823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13601823.value: Information disclosure usually affects the decision-making process of buyers and sellers when the product quality is unknown to both sides, with its ultimate consequence being hard to predict. The phenomenon is especially evident in the natural resource exploration industry. How does information concerning deposit quantities affect the location choices of exploration and production companies? How does the information affect the pricing strategies of mineral rights owners? What determines the division of value gains from the information, if any, between the two parties? This research project seeks to answer these questions by studying the shale gas exploration industry in the United States, using the case of the Marcellus Shale in Pennsylvania. The Marcellus Shale is the largest shale gas deposit in the United States. Estimates of its reserve quantity has varied significantly in the past, mainly due to the lack of public productivity information. In November 2010, the Pennsylvania Department of Environmental Protection began disclosing well-specific production data. The information allows shale gas operators and mineral rights owners (typically residents who own the lands) to re-assess their strategies as to where to explore and how much to charge, providing a valuable opportunity to examine its impact on the mineral rights market. The first part of this research project is a theoretical study of the bargaining process between shale gas operators and landowners. The project will build an economic model in which operators conduct Bayesian learning of the reserve distribution while bargaining with landowners to determine the division of future production revenue. The second part of the research project is an empirical study using a novel dataset from the Marcellus Shale. A structural model of the mineral rights market will be built, in which shale gas operators make discrete-continuous choices about where and how much to invest, and landowners set prices for their lease contracts. This project will contribute to both economic research and industrial policy designing. First, it addresses an important question as to how information that reveals product quality affects the market equilibrium. Second, it provides empirical evidence to regulators on how social welfare is changed and re-allocated due to information disclosure, informing the market impact of policies concerning information sharing in a broad set of industries, including but not limited to shale gas exploration. Finally, the experience learned in this project also sheds light on the development of the shale gas industry in other countries, especially in China. 在買賣市場中，當產品的品質具有不確定性時， 資訊的披露通常會影響買賣雙方的決策過程，而最終的結果往往難以預料。 這一情況在自然資源開採行業中尤為明顯。 涉及資源儲量的資訊如何影響開採和生產企業的位置選擇？ 這種資訊如何影響礦權持有人的定價決策？ 如果這樣的資訊有其價值，那麼這種價值又是如何在開採企業和礦權持有人之間分配的？ 本研究專案旨在通過對於美國頁岩氣開採行業的研究，利用賓夕法尼亞州馬塞勒斯氣田這一案例，來回答上述問題。 馬塞勒斯氣田是美國儲量最大的頁岩氣礦藏。 過去由於公開性生產數據的缺失，關於馬塞勒斯氣田儲量的估計曾經變動很大。 從2010年11月開始，賓夕法尼亞州環保部開始公佈以氣井為單位的生產數據。 這一資訊使得頁岩氣開採商和氣權持有人（通常是本地居民）得以重新評估他們關於勘探位置選擇和礦權定價的策略，因而為研究該資訊對於礦權市場的影響提供了寶貴的機會。 本研究專案的第一部分將通過構建理論模型，對頁岩氣開採商與土地擁有者之間的談判過程進行分析。 在該模型中，頁岩氣開採商一邊對礦藏儲量的分佈進行貝葉斯學習，一邊與土地擁有者就未來生產收益分配進行談判。 本專案的第二部分計劃利用馬塞勒斯氣田的生產數據進行實證研究。 在該部分所構建的結構實證模型中，頁岩氣開採商選擇勘探的位置與投入的資金，而土地擁有者則有權為土地租賃合約進行定價。 該研究專案將同時著力經濟學研究與產業政策的制定。 首先，本專案致力於回答一個重要的經濟學問題，即揭示產品質量的資訊是如何影響市場均衡的。 同時，該專案又為監管者提供了關於資訊披露如何影響社會福利變化與再分配的實證經驗，從而進一步闡述了涉及信息共用的政策如何在更廣闊意義上影響相關產業。 最後，在該專案研究中所獲取的經驗，也會為包括中國在內的其他國家的頁岩氣行業發展提供有價值的借鑒。

13602323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13602323.value: 探討亞洲綠色城市發展中，城市遺產保育的潛力

13602323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13602323.value: Conservation of cultural and natural heritage has acquired increasing importance for rapidly urbanising cities seeking to foster more sustainable forms of urban development (Bandarin and van Oers, 2012). This project seeks to determine whether and how the integration and conservation of cultural and natural heritage in cities can encourage more genuine green transitions, as opposed to the capital-intensive ‘green-infrastructure’ focused projects that are commonly pursued in cities around the world. It also seeks to identify where some common ground can be found between the aspirations of various stakeholders, including civil society leaders, governments and policy makers. While heritage is increasingly recognised by the UN and other organisations as a critical component in sustainable development initiatives, it is an area that requires greater attention by policy makers, municipal governments, and academics alike. Moreover, there are a lack of focused case studies illustrating how exactly cities can harness cultural and natural heritage to achieve sustainable development goals. This project therefore seeks to address the under-studied role of natural and cultural heritage conservation in developing more socially and ecologically sustainable cities. The project will draw on three case studies of cities that have a mixture of cultural and natural heritage existing in the built environment, as well as innovative governance initiatives that seek to integrate them into the core of urban development strategies. This includes: Hong Kong; Penang (Malaysia); and Singapore. The cities are comparable in that they have common historical, cultural and geographical characteristics and face similar challenges regarding sustainable urban development. The project will draw on qualitative methods, including semi-structured interviews with 10-15 key stakeholders in each city. Furthermore, policies related to the promotion of natural heritage in each city will be examined, particularly in relation to urban development initiatives, as these differ significantly in each case. The findings will be analysed through an urban political ecology lens to investigate the linkages between natural and cultural heritage in three case studies, and the political-economic factors affecting conservation. The findings from this proposed research will provide both academic insights in the field of heritage studies and urban planning, and planning implications for urban policy pertaining to sustainable urban development and heritage conservation in Asian cities and beyond. 在迅速的城市化及尋求更可持續城市發展模式的過程中，「文化和自然遺產」的保育越來越受到社會重視。本研究目標為對比在全球不同城市中被資本追逐的「綠色基礎設施」背景下，探討城市中「文化和自然遺產」的融合與保育是否能夠及如何推動更為綠色的轉型。此外，本研究亦會識別不同持分者於城市中「文化和自然遺產」融合與保育相關議題的共識，例如公民領袖、政府和政策制定者等。雖然隨聯合國和其他組織認識到保育「文化和自然遺產」於可持續發展計劃中能發揮關鍵作用，但此議題仍需政策制定者、政府以及學術界進一步討論及關注。與此同時，因現階段缺乏城市如何利用「文化和自然遺產」來實現可持續發展目標的實例。故此，本研究會以「文化和自然遺產」的保育作切入點，探討發展社會和生態可持續城市的可行性，以填補學術空白。 本研究將以三個文化和自然遺產並存、採用創新管治模式管治，並將其管治融入城市發展核心的城市進行研究。這些城市分別為：香港、馬來西亞(檳城)及新加坡。由於上述城市於歷史、文化、及地理特徵上類同，而它們同時亦面對相似的可持續城市發展挑戰，因此它們相當具有可比性。是次研究將會採用定性研究的方法進行資料蒐集，其中包括在每個城市邀請十至十五位持分者進行半結構化訪談。另一方面，由於各城市在推廣自然遺產與城市發展方面的措施不盡相同，本研究將會進詳細調查每一個城市的相關政策，特別是與城市發展相關的部分，以確保可比性。同時，是次研究的結果會通過城市政治生態學的角度出發及分析，以詳述三個案例在本研究中自然與文化遺產之間的聯繫，以及影響保育的政治經濟因素。而本研究將為遺產研究和城市規劃領域提供深入的學術見解，並為亞洲以及其他國家的可持續城市發展及遺產保護的城市政策規劃帶來實質的貢獻及借鑑。

13604023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604023.value: 跨国制度逻辑与主观幸福感：四种制度秩序的物质实践和意义的影响

13604023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13604023.value: Prof Ho , Lok Sang Prof Rojas, Mariano

13604023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604023.value: Over the last decade, the literature on the relationship between institutions and the well-being of populations has expanded, but theorization of the link between the two is recent. In addition, despite being applied across different fields, a discussion on how specific institutional logics affect subjective well-being is absent. This research gap needs to be addressed because institutional practices and meanings may provide a more comprehensive understanding of how institutions affect individuals’ well-being by interacting with their beliefs and attitudes. Relevant logics vary across institutional orders and societies and operate as frameworks of individuals subjectivity. Therefore, the primary research question of this proposal is: Does institutional logics affect individual-level subjective well-being through legitimization of beliefs and attitudes across countries and institutional domains? In this research project, I will focus on four institutions considered central to any society: market, family, political system, and religion. The study will aim to determine whether country-to-country heterogeneities in meanings embedded in their institutions explain gaps in subjective well-being using five cross-national datasets, including countries from different regions and levels of development. Institutions are constitutive building blocks of political and social life. Since the revival of institutions in social sciences, neo-institutionalists have noticed that institutional structures constrain individuals’ choices and actions, although individuals constitute them. These institutions are the reflection of what Friedland and Alford defined as supra-organizational patterns of human activity by which actors produce (and reproduce) their material subsistence and symbolic systems to order reality and render the experience of time and space meaningful, i.e., institutional logics. Each institutional order has a central logic formed by a set of material and symbolic constructions as its organizing principle. However, this logic is latent and not directly observable. We only observe forms in which it is concretized, such as family relationships, decisions of their members, and attitudes toward kinship. These institutional logics are crucial for subjective well-being and are available to social actors to elaborate, manipulate, and use strategically to their advantage. Therefore, the project is highly significant to understand how institutional structures affect the balance between life challenges and individuals’ capabilities to address them. In this research, I will use several representative and probabilistic cross-national datasets to examine how different institutional logics affect individuals’ well-being by interacting with individual beliefs as a legitimizing path. 在过去的十年中，关于制度与人口福利之间关系的文献已经扩展，但两者之间的理论化是最近的。此外，尽管应用于不同领域，但特定制度逻辑如何影响主观幸福感的讨论是缺失的。需要解决这一研究空白，因为制度实践和意义可能通过与信仰和态度互动来提供更全面的了解制度如何影响个人的幸福感。相关逻辑因制度秩序和社会而异，并作为个体主观性的框架运作。因此，本提案的主要研究问题是：制度逻辑是否通过在国家和制度领域之间合法化信仰和态度影响个体层面的主观幸福感？在这个研究项目中，我将关注四个被认为是任何社会中心的机构：市场、家庭、政治体系和宗教。该研究旨在确定不同国家之间嵌入在其机构中的意义解释主观幸福感差距的原因，使用五个跨国数据集，包括来自不同地区和发展水平的国家。制度是政治和社会生活的组成部分。自从社会科学中制度的复兴以来，新制度主义者已经注意到制度结构限制了个体的选择和行动，尽管个体构成了它们。这些机构是Friedland和Alford定义的人类活动的超组织模式的反映，通过这些模式，演员们产生（和再生产）他们的物质生存和符号系统来组织现实并使时间和空间的经验有意义，即制度逻辑。每个制度秩序都有一个由一组物质和符号构造形成的中心逻辑作为其组织原则。然而，这种逻辑是潜在的，不是直接可观察的。我们只观察到它被具体化的形式，例如家庭关系、成员的决策和对亲属关系的态度。这些制度逻辑对主观幸福感至关重要，并可供社会行为者用来制定、操纵和战略性地利用它们的优势。因此，该项目对于理解制度结构如何影响生活挑战与个体应对这些挑战的能力之间的平衡非常重要。在这项研究中，我将使用几个代表性和概率性的跨国数据集，通过与个人信仰的互动来研究不同制度逻辑如何影响个体的幸福感。

13604323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13604323.value: 香港安老院舍個人護理員工作特性及健康：一项混合方法研究

13604323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13604323.value: Prof Dong, Dong Prof Lee, Yin King Prof Yau, Sui Yu

13604323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13604323.value: Building and retaining a sustainable long-term care (LTC) workforce is a critical global challenge in the face of the rapidly aging population. In Hong Kong’s Residential Care Homes of the Elderly (RCHEs) and LTC facilities across the globe, personal care workers account for the majority of the formal care workforce and provide essential assistance for daily living and companionship to older adults with complex care needs. Yet personal care is physically and emotionally demanding, and often characterized by low wages, precarious working conditions, limited career development opportunities, understaffing, and overloading. As a result of poor job quality, personal care workers are at high risk of experiencing adverse well-being outcomes, including job dissatisfaction, job stress, and emotional burnout. As paraprofessionals in RCHEs, personal care workers are largely left out by existing research and social service initiatives of professional health and social care workforce development. And where such studies exist, they tend to be one-sided and predominantly focus on the “ill-being” aspects, and thus fail to account for the complex experiences of personal care workers in the workplace. This study will develop a balanced and comprehensive investigation of the well-being and job characteristics of personal care workers in Hong Kong’s RCHEs. More specifically, drawing on the job demands-resources theory as an integrative framework, this study will examine the job demands and resources that influence personal care workers’ positive and negative outcomes of well-being (i.e., work engagement and burnout). A three-phase exploratory sequential mixed-method design will be employed. In Phase I, a qualitative exploratory study will be employed to develop a contextualized and in-depth understanding of personal care workers’ job characteristics through semi-structural interviews with 30 personal care workers and 20 key stakeholders in the LTC sector. Phase II will develop survey instruments to measure job characteristics and worker well-being based on literature reviews and empirical findings in Phase I. Phase III will conduct a cross-sectional survey among a representative sample of 400 personal care workers to empirically test the interrelationships among job demands, resources, and personal care workers’ well-being outcomes. To the best of our knowledge, this study will be the first local research to systematically examine the well-being and job characteristics of personal care workers. It will have theoretical, policy, and practical implications to advance a systemic approach to support personal care workers in LTC facilities by improving the job quality and cultivating the well-being of this essential workforce. 在人口老齡化的背景下，建立並保持可持續的長期護理行業勞動力是一項全球性的挑戰。在香港的安老院舍及世界上許多地區的長期護理設施中，個人護理員佔據了正式護理工作人員的絕大部分，為有複雜護理需求的長者提供不可或缺的日常生活協助和陪伴。然而，個人護理工作在體力和情感上都有很高的要求，個人護理員常常面臨著低工資、不穩定的工作條件、有限的職業發展機會、人手不足和超負荷工作等問題。由於工作質量差，個人護理員有很高的風險會經歷不良的健康結果，包括工作不滿意、工作壓力和情感倦怠等。 作為安老院舍中的輔助專業人員，個人護理員的護理工作被現有的大部分發展專業健康及社會護理勞動力的研究及社會服務計劃所忽視。而現有的這類研究往往也是單向的，主要關注「不良」的方面，因而未能考慮到個人護理員在護理工作中的複雜經歷。 本研究將對香港安老院舍的個人護理員的健康及工作特性進行全面的調查。更具體來說，本研究將根據工作需求-資源理論作為一種整全的框架，考察影響個人護理員正面和負面健康結果的工作需求和資源。本研究講採用三階段的探索性序列混合方法設計。第一階段將對個人護理員和長期護理行業的利益相關者進行半結構式訪談，第二階段將根據文獻回顧和第一階段的實證結果開發調查工具，第三階段將對個人護理員進行橫斷面調查。本研究將對理論、政策、和社會服務產生意義，有助於探索系統性的方法，通過提高工作質量和健康福祉來支持安老院舍的個人護理員。

13605523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13605523.value: 人类面孔识别中的熟悉度操控

13605523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13605523.value: Prof Hsiao, Janet Hui-wen Dr Jin, Haiyang

13605523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13605523.value: Face recognition is a fundamental visual task for humans. In recent years it has become clear that facial familiarity is a key variable that influences face recognition. As such, finding laboratory-driven methods of establishing facial familiarity in a controlled environment is essential for progress in theoretical development. A number of studies have adopted a variety of different methodological protocols for establishing familiarity with faces, but there is a lack of understanding of how familiarity emerges and the extent to which laboratory-driven familiarity can be considered similar to familiarity with faces that develops in the natural world. Therefore, in this project we carefully apply a variety of methods for establishing face familiarity, using a longitudinal design to track changes over time. We will adopt a range of measures, including perception, electroencephalography (EEG), and eye-tracking, to examine how changes in familiarity affect responses to faces, and then we will compare these to measures derived for faces which are naturally familiar to participants. After the initial longitudinal study, we will follow up with comparisons of different familiarity methods to establish clearly the conditions under which laboratory-driven familiarity has external validity. The variety of methods will allow us to develop conceptual models that integrate behaviour, its underlying neural basis, and eye-movements, giving a more comprehensive basis for understanding familiarity and its physiological and cognitive markers than current formulations. In turn, this will allow the field to undertake more precise and efficient manipulations of familiarity for the purposes of model-testing and theoretical development. 面孔知覺是作為社會物種的人類的一項基本視覺任務。近年來，越來越多的證據表明，面孔熟悉性是廣泛影響面孔知覺加工的一個關鍵因素。因此，找到一個實驗室驅動的在控制環境中評估面孔熟悉度的方法對於面孔加工理論的發展至關重要。雖然已有研究採用不同的方法範式來評估面孔的熟悉性，但對於熟悉性的出現以及實驗室驅動的面孔熟悉性和自然環境下發展出來的面孔熟悉性的相似程度等問題還不清楚。由此，本研究中，我們將謹慎採用不同方法去評估面孔熟悉性，並用縱向研究的方法來追蹤熟悉性隨時間的變化。我們將採用行為、眼動和腦電等多種測量方法，並運用機器學習的方法分析數據，來研究熟悉性的變化如何影響人們對面孔的反應。此外，我們還將比較受試者在實驗室環境下測得的和自然環境下測得的面孔熟悉性數據。這項工作將在香港的兩個地點進行，與研究相關的其他參與者兩地互換，從而更好地避免受試者在測試前暴露於其他參與者。在最初的縱向研究之後，我們還將追蹤比較不同的熟悉性方法，以此探究在何種條件下實驗室驅動的面孔熟悉性具有外部效度。多種方法的使用將幫助我們建立概念模型去整合行為及其背後的神經基礎和眼動數據，為理解面孔熟悉性和它的生理和認知標記提供更全面的基礎。反過來，這也將幫助該領域能更精確和高效地操控面孔熟悉性，以進行模式測試和理論發展。

13605623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13605623.value: 時間性、具身化和創造力：中國社交媒體新實踐的批判性多模態研究

13605623.label: Project Objectives
13605623.value: Theorize the interrelations between multimodality and temporality and explore new conceptualizations of temporality and multimodality applicable to emergent practices on (Chinese) social media (through case study 1); Theorize the interrelations between multimodality and embodiment and discuss implications of these entanglements of bodies and voices across digital and physical spaces for the sense of self and identity performance (through case study 2); Provide a more rounded and updated theorization of multimodal semiotic practices mediated by latest digital technologies (through case study 1 and 2); Investigate the types of time-sensitive writing practices afforded by the function of bullet comments, explain how users explore the distinct temporal affordances of bullet comments in multimodal writing practices, and demonstrate their new experiences of time, temporality and multimodality (through case study 1); Examine new affordances for synthetic embodiment provided by short video-sharing platforms, explain how elderly users’ mediated practices reframe their relationships with the voices and performances of others and potentially transform their sense of self, and discuss whether and how digital technologies make the elderly users vulnerable to vicious content and negative experiences (through case study 2); Examine the latest form of ‘advertising’ on Chinese social media, analyse its multimodal meaning-making strategies, discuss its potential influences on users’ online experiences and consuming habits, on the marketing industry, and explain how it may contribute to and sustain wider political economies of language, creativity and affect in China (through case study 3); Offer a comprehensive study of multimodal practices on Chinese social media, illustrate latest developments in Chinese cyberspace, and shed light on China’s distinct technology-afforded modernity (through case study 1, 2 and 3).
rows: Theorize the interrelations between multimodality and temporality and explore new conceptualizations of temporality and multimodality applicable to emergent practices on (Chinese) social media (through case study 1);

Theorize the interrelations between multimodality and embodiment and discuss implications of these entanglements of bodies and voices across digital and physical spaces for the sense of self and identity performance (through case study 2);
Provide a more rounded and updated theorization of multimodal semiotic practices mediated by latest digital technologies (through case study 1 and 2);

Investigate the types of time-sensitive writing practices afforded by the function of bullet comments, explain how users explore the distinct temporal affordances of bullet comments in multimodal writing practices, and demonstrate their new experiences of time, temporality and multimodality (through case study 1);

Examine new affordances for synthetic embodiment provided by short video-sharing platforms, explain how elderly users’ mediated practices reframe their relationships with the voices and performances of others and potentially transform their sense of self, and discuss whether and how digital technologies make the elderly users vulnerable to vicious content and negative experiences (through case study 2);

Examine the latest form of ‘advertising’ on Chinese social media, analyse its multimodal meaning-making strategies, discuss its potential influences on users’ online experiences and consuming habits, on the marketing industry, and explain how it may contribute to and sustain wider political economies of language, creativity and affect in China (through case study 3);

Offer a comprehensive study of multimodal practices on Chinese social media, illustrate latest developments in Chinese cyberspace, and shed light on China’s distinct technology-afforded modernity (through case study 1, 2 and 3).

13605623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13605623.value: 得益于國家主導的數字化轉型戰略決策，中國數字產業經濟快速增長，成為過去二十年全球數字創新的領先者之一(Woetzel 2018；CPC 新聞 2020）。 無縫融入普通中國人的日常生活，中國社交媒體平台覆蓋各個年齡段，發揮廣泛的商業、社交、文化和政治功能。 正如最近的一篇評論（Huang 2021）所指出的，中國各地的物理時間和空間已經被巨大的、標準化的高鐵網絡壓縮，同理，中國互聯網成為中國人現代化生活最大的矯平器。 在線資源為中國社交媒體用戶提供了各種表達意見，建立網絡、進行經濟交易、參與想像的“中國網民”社區的新方式（Yang et al. 2015）。 新穎的語言和符號學實踐包括多語种語言遊戲、新詞、表情符號、模因、“轉錄實踐”（Li 和 Zhu 2019），以及最新的多模態網絡表達被精英團體（包括國家政府）和普通民眾採用，服務於不同的社會和政治目的（Li 2016；Dong，2018；Zhou 2020a；Zhou2022a）。 在本項目中，我將對中國社交媒體上跨越廣泛的年齡/社會群體並涵蓋多種新平台的多模態實踐進行全面的研究。 通過調查新興數字技術及其獨特的符號學意義，我將進一步理論化多模態研究中的兩個概念，即“時間性”和“具身化”。總的來說，我的目標是提供更全面和更新的由數字技術介導的多模態符號學實踐理論，以啟發其他研究。 其次，本項目提供了三個涉及目前未充分研究的用戶群體及其新實踐的案例研究，以擴大當前的研究範圍並闡明中國社交媒體上營銷行業、數字經濟、青年文化、網絡社區等領域的最新發展。 最重要的是，我將強調中國數字現代性的獨特之處，即網絡上人力資源，數據， 情感和價值觀的流通。 響應最近在數字話語研究，社會語言學，社會符號學中進行更多情境和民族志研究的呼籲，本項目採用多學科的視角來研究社交媒體用戶的體驗和實踐。 此外，我將探討數字技術，用戶的創造性實踐，以及日益商業化的中國社交媒體之間複雜的相互作用。

13606223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13606223.value: 轉化國族文化為知識產權：中國網絡遊戲產業中的國風遊戲研究

13606223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13606223.value: Dr Chew, Matthew Ming-tak Miss Yang , Jing

13606223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13606223.value: 「國風遊戲」是指挪用中國古典藝術形式或描繪中國傳統生活方式的遊戲類型。行業報告顯示，中國大部分具有原創知識產權的遊戲均為國風遊戲（GPC＆CNG 2021）。然而，國風遊戲近年來的流行也引發不少關於如何在游戲中表現國族文化的爭議。 近幾十年來，中國的網絡遊戲產業迅速發展。中國互聯網信息中心（2021）的數據顯示，截至2021年6月，中國有5.0925億網絡遊戲玩家。CNG的報告顯示，2021年中國遊戲市場的收入為444.8億美元，其中334.4億美元來自手機遊戲（Pandaily 2022）。大多數關於中國網絡遊戲產業的研究集中在對其商業模式和政策環境的分析上，僅有少數研究涉及該產業的文化面向，包括遊戲設計、創意和遊戲文化。然而，對遊戲製作的研究却甚为稀缺。迄今為止，尚未有系統的研究探討政策規定、商業動機、遊戲設計師和市場營銷人員的創意以及玩家的參與是如何使得國風遊戲在行業中佔據主導地位的。 為填補這一空填，本研究旨在討論遊戲公司如何在開發原創遊戲知識產權時採用國族文化元素。具體而言，遊戲公司如何在政策規定、商業利益和玩家反饋的動態環境中製作和推廣他們的國風遊戲？為了回答這個問題，本研究將運用文化產業化的分析框架來解析國風遊戲的形塑過程，其中涉及多種因素（如文化、社會趨勢、生產驅動、生產條件、製作實踐、文本和公眾）。本研究的成果將為創意產業、文化政策和遊戲研究等領域做出貢獻。

13607023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607023.value: 關於倖存，價值和生存風險的基本議題

13607023.label: Project Objectives
13607023.value: To clarify key notions employed in current debates on existential risk – for instance, the notions of 'humanity', 'our descendants', 'value of the future'. To evaluate arguments for reducing existential risk based on consequentialist/impartial utilitarian assumptions. In particular, to offer an evaluation of those arguments proposed by Parfit, Bostrom, Ord, Greaves and MacAskill. To develop and apply an account of the value of humanity to the current debates on catastrophic and existential risk reduction. To develop arguments for existential risk reduction that deploy notions of intergenerational duties, perfectionist values and narrativity. To investigate the notion of cosmic significance and how this concept can be combined with perfectionist accounts of value.

13607023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607023.value: Existential risks are classified as such because of the threat they pose to humanity’s potential. According to recent authors, these threats include climate change, artificial intelligence (AI) value misalignment, pandemics, nuclear wars, and many types of natural catastrophes. This research project will primarily focus on a series of philosophical issues arising from reflecting on this category of threats. Specifically, the proposed project will study foundational issues in our ethical and systematic thinking regarding existential risks by utilising the methods of academic philosophy, in particular, works on value theory, normative and applies ethics. For instance, I propose to investigate these questions: What should count as ‘humanity’ and ‘our descendants’? Should we only include the long-term persistence of biological human beings as the sole instance of our survival? Furthermore, what is the value of such persistence? Should the value of humanity only be determined by the sum of the individual well-being of present, past, and/or future generations or should it also involve the cosmic significance and narrative structure of the whole trajectory of humanity? Relatedly, this research will also explore whether the value of humanity and of its persistence may reside (at least partially) in pursuing and obtaining certain collective ends (e.g., some forms of knowledge, beauty, and morality), which we seem to value independently of their contribution to the welfare of the individuals achieving them. After developing a general account of the value of humanity, I will apply it to the current debate on the morality of existential risk reduction. The project will be informed by recent works on longtermism — roughly, the idea that positively influencing the long-term future of humanity should be a key moral priority of our time — and on the expected long-term trajectory of our species. One guiding idea unifying the project is that, in making choices with a likely bearing on future generations, our rational and moral decisions should include considerations about the likelihood of increasing or decreasing existential risk to humanity. 生存風險之所以叫如此是因為它對人類生存的潛在威脅。當代學者認為這些生存風險包括環境變化，價值不對齊的人工智能，流行病大流行，核大戰，還有其他的自然災害。此研究項目將主要關注與由這些風險所引產生的哲學的問題。具體運用哲學方法研究我們對於生存風險的倫理和系統思維。這些哲學方法主要包括價值理論，規範理論和應用倫理學。比如，在此研究項目中，我會探討以下問題：何謂“人類”和“我們的後代”？我們是否應該把生物意義上的人類長久持續存在作為人類存活的唯一狀態？這種持續存在的價值又是什麼？人類的價值是否應該僅僅由過去，現在和將來個體福祉的總和決定？還是，人類價值還需要考慮整個人類進程在宇宙中的意義和敘事結構？與此相關，此項研究還將探究人類的價值和人類可持續發展是否屬於（至少部分屬於）追求某些集體目的（比如某種形式的知識，美麗和道德。這些目的被普遍認為是獨立於追求個體福祉的。在建立一個普遍的關於人類價值的理論之後，我會將此理論運用於當今關於降低生存風險的道德討論中。這項研究是基於近期關於長遠主義的研究基礎之上的。長遠主義的大致觀點是積極地影響人類長久可持續的未來是我們這個時代的道德優先。引導此研究項目的基本觀點是：如果要在我們做決策時考慮到我們的後代，我們的理性和道德決定就應該考慮我們此決定將是否可能提高或降低生存風險對人類的威脅。

13607123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
13607123.value: Prof Qiu, Jack Linchuan Dr Sun, Ping Dr ZHOU, Yang

13607123.label: Project Objectives
13607123.value: To contribute knowledge to the fields of Media and Communication Studies and Cultural Studies by examining the digital participatory culture among China’s platform workers’ communities To document and analyse platform workers’ digitally mediated community building practices and organisational forms, including their first-hand experiences, meanings, motivations, aspirations, as well as the challenges they face in production, social reproduction and cultural realm To produce a theoretically reflexive but strongly grounded account of the class dynamics of digital participatory culture and working-class agency and creativity in the Global South context To develop a typology of platform workers’ digital communities, and devise a framework to make sense of, reflect and assess respective potentials for an autonomous, proactive, progressive, and collective worker culture To inform relevant stakeholders (e.g., the government and its trade unions, companies, civic groups and workers themselves) of the opportunities and challenges digital technologies posed for building platform workers’ participatory culture, so as to develop a more effective, powerful and reflexive strategy to promote positive social changes that benefit the workers and all.

13607123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607123.value: This project addresses questions of working-class cultural production through a study of participatory culture in the digitally mediated communities built by platform workers in China. According to the government's China Sharing Economy Development Report (2021), the number of participants in the sharing economy in China reached 830 million in 2020, including approximately 84 million service providers. The new platform economy, where most low-skilled workers are concentrated, and the extensive application of algorithmic technology have both created new labour issues. While labour and cultural studies have discussed cultural production by factory workers as an effective way to cultivate working-class solidarity, the cultural production of platform workers, who largely work in a rather dispersed environment and whose production processes and connections heavily rely on digital platforms, are rarely explored. This project thus sets out to examine the opportunities and challenges digital technologies bring about for an autonomous, proactive, progressive, and above all, collective worker culture, that is, to cultivate what we call ‘worker communities for themselves’, through which workers are capable of asserting themselves collectively in various processes of reforms and struggles for social equality and betterment. By engaging theoretical discussions in three layers – (i) a political-economic analysis of the current state of Chinese capitalism and its contradictions experienced by workers at a macro level; (ii) a classic discussion of community organisation at the meso level; and (iii) a critical reflection of the relationships between digital technology, community and participatory culture through the lens of affordance – this research addresses three questions: (i) what types of digitally mediated worker communities are there; (ii) how do these communities work and sustain themselves; and (iii) what are the roles of digital technologies in mediating these communities and their potential? To answer these questions, the research employs a mixed-method design, combining a quantitative survey, online and offline participant observation, in-depth interviews, and focus groups for data collection, with thematic analysis and discourse analysis employed to analyse the data. The premise is that building worker power from below presents an effective, powerful, and reflexive – though difficult – means of promoting positive social changes that benefit the workers and beyond, and that the penetration of and advances in digital technologies promise huge potential for connections of all sorts among workers themselves and between them and other stakeholders. 这个项目通过研究中国互联网平台劳工在数字媒体社区中构建的参与性文化，探讨有关工人阶级文化生产的问题。根据政府的《中国共享经济发展报告》（2021年）显示，2020年中国分享经济参与者达到8.3亿人，其中大约有8400万为服务提供者。新的平台经济集中了大部分低技能工人，算法技术的广泛应用也带来了新的劳工问题。现有的劳工和文化研究已经讨论了工厂工人的文化生产作为培养工人阶级团结的有效途径，但在数字平台上工作的工作者的文化生产很少被探讨，后者在一个分散的环境中工作，其生产过程和联系在很大程度上依赖于数字平台。 因此，该项目旨在研究数字技术为自治、积极、进步和集体的工人文化带来的机会和挑战，即研究平台工人们如何通过培养“工人自身的社区”来在各种改革和争取社会平等与改善的斗争过程中集体地维护自己的权益。本项目将在三个层面上进行理论讨论：（i）对中国资本主义当前状态的政治经济分析，以及工人在宏观层面上所经历的矛盾；（ii）关于中观层面的社区组织的讨论；以及（iii）通过“可供性”（affordance）的视角对数字技术、社区和参与性文化之间的关系进行批判性反思。这项研究将探讨三个问题：（i）有哪些类型的数字媒体工人社区；（ii）这些社区如何运作和维持；以及（iii）数字技术在调解这些社区及其潜力方面的作用是什么？为了回答这些问题，研究将采用不同的研究方法，结合定量调查、线上和线下参与者观察、深度访谈以及焦点小组讨论等数据收集方法，同时运用主题分析和话语分析来分析数据。 尽管困难重重，从基层建立工人权力是促进有益社会变革的一种有效、强大且反思性的方式。我们相信数字技术的渗透和进步为工人之间以及他们与其他利益相关者形成新的联结提供了巨大潜力。

13607323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607323.value: 胶片跨境亚洲： 电影史上韩国与香港、新加坡和台湾华语电影的三次邂逅

13607323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607323.value: 该项目研究1950年代至新千年的韩国电影是如何在一个区域和跨区域的脉络影响中被逐步形塑的。这个脉络包含香港、台湾及新加坡的海外华语电影。通过对跨国合拍片的实践进行深入分析，该研究旨在重新探讨“国别电影”这个常规概念。为此，我将关注战后亚洲电影的三个时期。第一个时期始于1957年，将韩国、香港和新加坡的战后电影连结在一起。第二个时期始于1970年代，以合拍片进入全球化体系为特征。第三个时期则聚焦新千年的后冷战亚太电影。我将论证韩国与华语电影的连结源于该地区共同经历的战后创伤、殖民地/后殖民地/跨国文化、冷战政治、历史上的内部联系以及新的经济环境。通过对20世纪50年代末至今的区域文化产业进行历史梳理，我旨在提出迥异于“国别电影”的跨国电影史研究视角。这个全新的视角建立在历史上确切存在的区域电影文化之上。该项目将被遗忘的议题重新放置于电影史研究的脉络中，并为亚洲地区关于全球化、区域/本土电影的制作和接受的论述提供新的观点。 在为期36个月的受资助期内，我将撰写一本专著，该专著计划由一家国际知名的大学出版社出版。此外，我还准备在具国际影响力的电影研究和亚洲研究期刊上发表至少两篇文章。该项目将以原始档案研究为主要的研究方法。因此，我需要多次前往韩国、新加坡、台湾和美国搜集资料来源。除了专著和期刊文章，我还将组织和主办一个相关主题的国际性电影研究会议。该会议上的发表的论文将汇编为一本专题学术期刊，或者由一家国际知名的出版社编辑成书。该项目将为亚洲跨国电影历史研究带来突破性的视角。我希望该项目将为研究亚洲电影的跨境制作、流通和消费提供不可或缺的资源，并且为研究者在未来对该领域继续深入研究开辟新路

13607723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
13607723.value: 一战期间中国劳工兵团的口译员研究

13607723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
13607723.value: The contribution of the Chinese Labour Corp (CLC) to the Allies military effort against Germany in WWI has only recently come into focus. The CLC was composed of Chinese men recruited by the British and French armies to compensate for the shortage of manpower resulting from casualties in the first years of the War. Since the majority of these recruits were labourers with no prior exposure to European languages, interpreters and translators were also enrolled to facilitate interactions with the supervising British and French officers. Existing scholarship has identified problems in communication owing to a shortage of interpreters and to cultural misunderstandings. Currently lacking is an in-depth study of the positionalities of the interpreters in order to clearly define their mediating roles in both British and French army settings. The project “Interpreters for the Chinese Labour Corps During WWWI” speaks to the growing concern in translation and interpreting studies with acts of translation in conflict zones and times of war. It does so by adopting a comparative perspective to identify the roles played by interpreters in mediating between the labourers and their military superiors. It looks to examine the complex dilemmas posed by both linguistic interpretation and intercultural mediation in extreme conditions such as the frontline. It seeks to evaluate how ideological and socio-cultural differences played out in the relations between the interpreters and their superiors and with the rest of the Corps. Through extensive field and archival research, the study also wishes to uncover the various ways in which interpreters were considered and treated by British and French military personnel. The project thus intends to both contribute to scholarship on the history of WWI by bringing into focus an understudied group, and to the theoretical modelling of translation during armed conflict. 中国劳工兵团（CLC）在一战中对抗德国的盟军军事力量做出了重要贡献，但是他们的努力直到最近才受到关注。 老公兵团由英国和法国军队招募的中国男性组成，以弥补战争前几年因伤亡而导致的劳动力短缺。由于这些招募者中的大多数是没有接触过欧洲语言的劳动者，因此也招募了口译员和翻译员以便与英国和法国军官进行交流。现有的学术研究已经指出了由于口译员短缺和文化误解而导致的沟通问题；目前缺乏的是对口译员自身定位的深入研究，以便清楚地描述他们在英国和法国军队环境中的调解角色。本项研究“一战期间中国劳工兵团的口译员”反映了翻译和口译研究领域对冲突区域和战争时期翻译行为的日益关注。通过采取比较的视角来描述口译员在调解劳工和他们的军事上级之间所扮演的角色，旨在研究在极端条件下（如前线）语言解释和跨文化调解所带来的复杂困境。本研究试图评估意识形态和社会文化差异在口译员与他们的上级以及整个队伍之间的关系中所起的作用。通过大量的实地和档案研究，该研究还希望揭示英国和法国军事人员如何看待口译员的方式。因此，该项目旨在通过聚焦一个未被充分研究的群体来为一战历史学研究做出贡献，并为武装冲突期间的翻译理论建模做出贡献。

14100023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14100023.value: 消化性潰瘍出血內鏡止血後大劑量靜脈滴注質子泵抑制劑與口服競爭性酸鉀阻滯劑的比較

14100023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14100023.value: Bleeding peptic ulcer disease is a common emergency. Early endoscopy diagnoses actively bleeding lesions or those with a vessel that mandates hemostatic treatment. Recurrent bleeding after endoscopic hemostasis carries a 3 fold increase in mortality. The current recommended adjunctive treatment is acid suppression using a high-dose intravenous infusion of proton pump inhibitor (PPI). Such as high-dose PPI infusion renders intragastric pH neutral. In theory, this prevents clot lysis and recurrent bleeding. The rate of recurrent bleeding after this infusion has been around 6 to 7%. Potassium-competitive acid blockers (P-CAB) belong to a new class of drugs with superior antisecretory effects. Given in an oral form, P-CAB in a high dose can suppress acid secretion comparable to that of an intravenous PPI infusion. The use of P-CAB, as a treatment for high-risk bleeding ulcers, has not been studied. We propose a one-sided non-inferiority randomized control trial to compare an intravenous infusion of high-dose PPI and a P-CAB (in an equivalent dose that renders gastric pH neutral). Our hypothesis is that P-CAB, as an adjunct to endoscopic hemostatic treatment is not worse than a high-dose PPI infusion in preventing recurrent bleeding. Our primary endpoint is recurrent bleeding within 30 days after randomization. Other outcome measures include red cell transfusion, the need for further interventions (endoscopic, radiological, or surgery), and all-cause mortality. To understand the respective control of gastric pH, we will also measure pH profiles over 24 hours in a small subgroup of patients given either PPI or P-CAB. 消化性潰瘍出血是一種常見的急症。早期內鏡診斷出血性或需要止血治療的病變。內鏡止血後,復發性出血導致死亡率增加3倍。標準輔助治療是使用高劑量靜脈注射 質子泵抑制劑（PPI）的輸注。高劑量PPI輸注使胃內pH中性。防止血栓溶解和反復出血。這個輸注後復發性出血的發生率約爲6%至7%。鉀競爭性酸阻滯劑（P-CAB）是一類新型的具有優良的抗酸劑。以口服形式給予，高劑量的P-CAB可以抑制酸性分泌與靜脈注射PPI相當。P-CAB作爲治療高危出血性潰瘍，尚未進行研究。在急性消化性潰瘍出血的患者中, 我們提出比較靜脈PPI 注射和口服PCAB的非劣效性隨機對照試驗. 研究終點爲內鏡治療後復發性出血.

14100423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14100423.value: Adolescent idiopathic scoliosis (AIS) is a three-dimensional spinal deformity occurring predominantly in 10-13 years old girls with a prevalence of 1-4% in Hong Kong and worldwide. Current clinical management for AIS is very limited and unsatisfactory, which are targeting the anatomical deformity (bracing and corrective surgery) rather than the cause. If left untreated, the deformity may deteriorate, particularly in patients who are still undergoing skeletal growth. The pathogenesis of AIS is largely unknown. Paraspinal muscles are important tethering component that help in stabilizing the spine in maintaining the proper upright posture. Discrepancy between the concave and convex sides of paraspinal muscles in AIS have been reported. Moreover, patients with AIS have weaker limb muscles strength than healthy subjects with similar age and sex. It was reported that increase in lean mass at age 10 years resulted in reduction of scoliosis risk by 20% at age 15 years. Till now, it remains unclear whether such abnormal muscle phenotypes contribute to the initiation and/or progression of spinal deformity or secondary to spinal deformity. The identification of genes and cells associated with the abnormal tissue remodeling in AIS paraspinal muscle is a key step to develop new diagnostic and therapeutic strategies. Emerging combined analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing and spatial transcriptomics (ST) enables researcher to systemically map the molecular, cellular, and spatial signature underlying the pathological changes and provide direct link to the tissue histology. Recently, we conducted single-nucleus RNA-seq and ST on one AIS and one non-AIS paraspinal muscle tissues and identified a novel X gene positive fibroblast cell cluster in AIS muscle. We hypothesize that the increased number of X+ fibroblast cells is associated with aberrant muscle fiber type phenotype and curve progress in AIS. The aims of this proposed study is: (i) to identify and characterize cell types and their spatial allocation in AIS and non-AIS paraspinal muscle tissues by combined single-nucleus and spatial transcriptomics; (ii) to verify the expression of X+ fibroblasts in paraspinal muscle tissues of AIS and its functions with human myoblast cellular model; and (iii) to study the effect of X+ fibroblasts and its clinical implication as therapeutic target on curve progression in mouse model of scoliosis. This proposed study will be complementary to our previous studies to advance our understanding on the pathogenesis of AIS curve progression and will shed light on the development of novel therapeutic strategy for AIS. 青少年特發性脊柱側彎（AIS）是一種主要發生在10至13歲女孩身上的三維脊柱畸形，全球和香港的患病率約為1-4%。目前對於AIS的臨床管理非常有限且不滿意，主要針對解剖畸形（矯正支架和手術矯正），而非治療病因。如果不進行治療，畸形可能會惡化，尤其是在骨骼生長期間的患者。AIS的發病機制大部分尚不明確。副脊肌是維持正確直立姿勢並穩定脊柱的重要組成部分。報告中提到，AIS的副脊肌凹面和凸面之間存在差異。此外，AIS患者的四肢肌肉力量較健康同齡和性別的人群要弱。有報告指出，10歲時肌肉的增長會使15歲時的脊柱側彎風險降低20%。迄今為止，這些異常肌肉表型是否導致脊柱畸形的起始和/或進展，或者是脊柱畸形的結果，仍不清楚。識別與AIS副脊肌異常組織重塑相關的基因和細胞是開發新的診斷和治療策略的關鍵步驟。結合單細胞RNA測序和空間轉錄組學（ST）的新興綜合分析方法使研究人員能夠系統地描繪致病變化的分子、細胞和空間特徵，並直接關聯組織組織學。最近，我們對一個AIS和一個非AIS副脊肌組織進行了單核RNA測序和ST，並在AIS肌肉中識別出一個新的X基因陽性纖維母細胞細胞群。我們假設X+纖維母細胞數量的增加與AIS中異常肌纖維型態表現和曲線進展有關。本研究的目標是：（i）通過結合單細胞核和空間轉錄組學，識別和描述AIS和非AIS副脊肌組織中的細胞類型及其空間分佈；（ii）驗證AIS副脊肌組織中X+纖維母細胞的表達，並利用人類肌母細胞模型研究其功能；（iii）研究X+纖維母細胞及其作為治療靶點對脊柱側彎小鼠模型的曲線進展的影響及其臨床意義。這項提議的研究將補充我們以前的研究，推進我們對AIS發病機制的理解，並為AIS的新治療策略的開發提供啟示。

14100823.value: 研究CCDC88C基因的雜合突變對小腦共濟舒緩的影響

14100823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14100823.value: Prof Chan, Ting Fung Prof Kwan, Kin Ming

14100823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14100823.value: The high energy demand and post-mitotic status of neurons make these cells susceptible to genome instability. Neuronal DNA damage plays a notable role in neuronal dysfunction in aging and age-associated diseases, including neurodegenerative disorders. The cerebellum is a vital part of the human brain responsible for controlling body balance and regulating motor movement. Spinocerebellar ataxias (SCAs) are hereditary middle-age-onset neurological conditions typically characterized by progressive deterioration of the cerebellum. SCA patients present with muscle stiffness, rigidity, tremors and problems with balance and coordination as major symptoms. DNA damage has been reported in various SCAs. Some disease-causing genes function in cellular DNA damage repair processes, and their mutational effects directly lead to accumulation of DNA strand breaks. Other SCA causative mutations have less well defined implications in neuronal DNA damage. Our team has identified a missense mutation in the CCDC88C gene in patients suffering from a novel subtype of SCA, SCA40. CCDC88C is a protein containing 2,028 amino acids. We have identified a cellular protein that interacts with CCDC88C via yeast two-hybrid screening and found that the cellular function of this particular CCDC88C-interacting protein is involved in cellular DNA damage repair. The knockdown of either CCDC88C or the CCDC88C-interacting protein triggers DNA damage. A mutant CCDC88C protein carrying a histidine substitution at the arginine 464 position has compromised its ability to interact with this CCDC88C-interacting protein. Besides defining a DNA damage pathogenic mechanism for SCA40, the proposed work will also provide new knowledge on the normal functioning of CCDC88C in maintaining genome stability/integrity in cerebellar neurons and/or other neuronal cell types. 神經元的高能量需求和後絲分裂狀態使這些細胞容易受到基因組不穩定性的影響。神經元DNA損傷在神經退行的神經元功能障礙中扮演重要角色。小腦是人腦的重要組成部分，負責控制身體平衡和調節運動。提示小腦性共濟失調症（SCA）是一種遺傳性的神經系統疾病。SCA患者的主要症狀包括平衡協調問題。在細胞DNA損傷修復過程中，基因突變能直接導致DNA鏈斷裂的積累。我們的團隊在一種亞型SCA（SCA40）患者中發現了CCDC88C基因的突變。CCDC88C是一種含有2,028個氨基酸的蛋白質。我們確定了一種與CCDC88C蛋白有相互作用的蛋白，並發現這種與CCDC88C反應的蛋白的細胞功能涉及細胞DNA損傷修復。敲除CCDC88C或這相互作用蛋白都會引發DNA損傷。SCA40基因突變減少了 CCDC88C 與其反應蛋白的相互作用。除了確定 SCA40 的 DNA 損傷預警機制外，這項目提供有關 CCDC88C 在小腦神經元和/或其他神經細胞類型中維持的作用基因組穩定性/缺陷的正常功能的新知識。

14102123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14102123.value: 第一期隨機對照臨床試驗CPP-抗血管內皮生長因子治療新生血管性老年黃斑病變的安全性和有效性

14102123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14102123.value: Prof Chen, Lijia Dr Chu, Wai Kit Dr Ho, Mary Dr Lee, Tak Kwong Benjamin Prof Pang, Chi Pui Prof Tham, Clement C. Prof Wei, Gang Prof Young, Alvin Lerrmann Dr Zhao, Yongqian

14102123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14102123.value: 隨著抗血管內皮生長因子藥物（抗 VEGF）的出現，新生血管性老年黃斑病變 (nAMD) 的治療發生了革命性的變化。 阻斷血管內皮生長因子的單克隆抗體（Avastin；羅氏製藥）、雙特異性抗體（Faricimab，羅氏製藥），抗體片段（Ranibizumab；諾華製藥）或融合蛋白（Aflibercept，拜耳製藥）已經過大型多中心臨床試驗證明可有效預防因新生血管性老年黃斑病變導致的視力喪失。 然而，所有這些治療都需要頻繁的侵入性玻璃體內注射。 不同的回顧性研究表明第一年平均需要8 次注射，第二年需要大約 4 次注射。 這是基於最常使用的“按需治療”方案最基本的所需注射次數，如是“治療和延伸”方案，注射的次數會更多。 這些注射治療對患者來說是巨大的負擔，並為醫療保健提供者帶來巨大的工作量。 當還考慮到玻璃體腔注射費用高昂，導致大量患者停止注射及早治療並喪失視力。 我們的研究團隊一直致力於細胞穿透肽（CPP）的開發，當與抗血管內皮生長因子結合時，可外用滴於眼睛，能良好的滲透眼部至視網膜及有極隹的生體可用率。 CPP 是一種已針對眼部滲透進行優化改良的分子。 我們的前導數據顯示，在使用結合了藥物濃度相當於現時玻璃體內注射抗血管內皮生長因子的CPP 後，對視網膜有良好的生體可用率。 我們最近一項於獼猴身上使用激光誘導產生脈絡膜血管增生(CNV) 的新生血管性老年黃斑病變的模型， 在外用 CPP-抗血管內皮生長因子後, 其前導數據顯示在減小 CNV 病變的大小及滲漏方面具有很強的治療效果，可媲美玻璃體內注射抗血管內皮生長因子對照組的治療成效。 此項目現已進入轉化階段。此提案旨在進行首次於人體執行外用 CPP-抗血管內皮生長因子治療新生血管性老年黃斑病變的第1 期臨床試驗。 預期結果是外用 CPP 抗血管內皮生長因子將減少玻璃體內注射的次數，從而減輕患者的治療和金錢負擔。 本研究旨在證明外用抗血管內皮生長因子藥物的應用安全有效，新生血管性老年黃斑病變患者可以在家自主進行治療。

14102923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14102923.value: 一個新型長非編碼RNA在食管癌發病中的功能和機制研究

14102923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14102923.value: Esophageal squamous carcinoma (ESCC) is a serious cancer burden for China including HK, as a major cause of cancer deaths, with a high rate of metastasis and recurrence and very low 5-y survival rate (~20%). Frequent activation of PI3K/AKT signaling has been reported in this tumor and ESCC cells are also sensitive PI3K inhibitors and DNA methylation inhibitors. More mechanistic study on cancer genes related to PI3K/AKT signaling and CpG methylation will benefit esophageal cancer patients. My previous epigenome study discovered a downregulated transcript KIAA0495 in ESCC, from the critical tumor suppressor locus 1p36.3, which is silenced by its promoter CpG methylation but readily expressed in multiple normal tissues including normal esophagus. Its downregulation/promoter methylation is significantly associated with poorer survival of esophageal cancer patients. This transcript was primarily claimed as a long non-coding RNA (lncRNA). My further bioinformatics and protein studies showed that there is an open reading frame (orf2) from this lncRNA which is actually protein-coding and codes a small peptide/protein-K95orf2. Pilot study showed that restoration of the expression of this protein K95orf2 induces apoptosis, cycle arrest, senescence and autophagy of ESCC cells, inhibits cell signaling especially PI3K/AKT signaling, and further suppresses ESCC cell growth and tumorigenesis. Thus, I propose to further study the alterations, functions and molecular mechanisms of this novel lncRNA-encoded small protein in ESCC pathogenesis. I will examine its biological functions as a phospholipid binding protein, in regulating cell proliferation, apoptosis, EMT, stemness and metastasis via regulating multiple signaling especially PI3K/AKT activation. I will determine its regulated target genes and cell signaling network through RNA-seq. I will further character the molecular mechanisms of its suppression of PI3K/AKT signaling via plasma membrane-related phospholipid binding. Through this study, I will elucidate the alterations, molecular functions and mechanisms of this novel protein related to ESCC pathogenesis, and its potential as a biomarker for ESCC. Data obtained from this project will shed light on the crucial biological functions of novel proteins translated from lncRNA ORFs in cancer pathogenesis, and further help to develop therapeutic strategies combating cancer. 食管鱗癌(ESCC)是中國包括香港的一個嚴重癌症負擔, 是癌症死亡的主要原因，其轉移和復發率很高, 5 年生存率極低(~20%)。 據報導，在該腫瘤中PI3K/AKT信號傳導被頻繁激活，令ESCC 細胞對PI3K 抑制劑和 DNA 甲基化抑制劑敏感。 更多對PI3K/AKT相關致癌機制, 信號傳導和CpG 甲基化研究將使食管癌患者受益。 我以前的表觀基因組研究發現一個ESCC中下調的轉錄本 KIAA0495, 來自關鍵抑癌基因座 1p36.3。其啟動子 CpG 甲基化使其沉默, 但在包括正常食管在內的多種正常組織中表達。 其表達下調/啟動子甲基化與食道癌患者較差生存率顯著相關。 該轉錄本最初被認為是長非編碼 RNA(lncRNA)。 我進一步的生物信息學和蛋白質研究表明，這個lncRNA有一個開放閱讀框orf2, 實際上是蛋白質編碼並編碼小肽/蛋白質K95orf2。 初步研究表明，恢復該蛋白K95orf2 的表達誘導ESCC細胞凋亡、週期停滯、衰老和自噬，抑制細胞信號傳導尤其是 PI3K/AKT信號激活，並進一步抑制 ESCC 細胞生長和腫瘤發生。 因此我將進一步研究這種新型 lncRNA 編碼小蛋白在 ESCC 發病中的變化、功能和作用分子機制。 我將檢查它作為磷脂結合蛋白的生物學功能，尤其是通過調節多種信號傳導包括PI3K/AKT激活來調節細胞凋亡、EMT、乾性和轉移。 通過RNA-seq, 我將確定其調控的靶基因和信號傳導。 我將進一步研究其通過質膜相關磷脂結合抑制 PI3K/AKT 信號傳導的分子機制。 通過這項研究，我將闡明這種與ESCC發病相關的新型蛋白質的變化、功能和分子機制及其作為食管鱗癌生物標誌物的潛力。 從該項目獲得的數據將揭示從 lncRNA ORF翻譯的新型蛋白質在癌症發病中的關鍵生物功能和作用機制，並進一步幫助制定對抗癌症的治療策略。

14103523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14103523.value: YKL-40 介導的神經膠質細胞在阿爾茨海默病中發揮功能的機制

14103523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103523.value: 主要目標- 擬議研究的主要目標是揭示YKL-40（一種阿爾茨海默病可溶性生物標誌物）如何通過介導星形膠質細胞和小膠質細胞之間的串擾來促進阿爾茨海默病(AD)的進展。 背景 - YKL-40 是一種由人幾丁質酶 3 樣 1 (CHI3L1) 基因編碼的星形膠質細胞糖蛋白，可作為 AD 的診斷生物標誌物。高水平的 YKL-40 表明晚期 AD 或正常衰老過程。然而，YKL-40 在 AD 發展中的功能作用尚未明確。 我們的研究結果 - 在 7 個月大的 5XFAD AD 小鼠的腦脊液、血漿和海馬裂解物中觀察到 YKL-40 表達增加。 YKL-40 表達上調與星形膠質細胞激活和增強的 PI3-K/AKT 信號傳導相關。在原代星形膠質細胞中，Abeta1-42 以劑量依賴性方式上調 YKL-40。此外，用 YKL-40 和/或 Abeta1-42 處理原代神經元會導致顯著的突觸變性、樹突複雜性降低和電參數受損。事實上，YKL-40 和 Abeta1-42 的聯合治療導致原代培養神經元中尖峰率的抑制增加。此外，在有症狀的 5XFAD 小鼠中，星形膠質細胞特異性敲除 YKL-40 超過 7 天，可有效減少多個大腦區域的澱粉樣斑塊沉積。這一發現還與神經膠質活化減弱、神經元損耗減少和記憶功能恢復相關。 懸而未決的問題——幾個懸而未決的問題需要解決。例如，YKL-40在星形膠質細胞和小膠質細胞中調節哪些與AD病理特徵相關的生物學功能？介導星形膠質細胞和小膠質細胞之間串擾的潛在機制是什麼？ YKL-40 的六種已知受體（AGER、CD44、IL13Rα2、LGALS3、PTGDR2、TMEM219）中的哪一種以及介導其在星形膠質細胞和小膠質細胞中發揮作用的關鍵信號通路？ 策略 – 我們將結合組織學和功能分析，對星形膠質細胞中條件性敲除 YKL-40 的 5XFAD 小鼠進行詳細評估。原代膠質細胞培養物、急性腦切片將用於闡明介導 YKL-40 生物學作用的潛在信號傳導機制和受體。 長期影響 - 總體而言，我們提出的研究結果將為 YKL-40 在 AD 發病機制中的作用提供新的見解，並將提供支持 YKL-40 靶向 AD 治療的證據。

14103823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14103823.value: Prof Ferrier, David Ellard Keith Prof Qu, Zhe

14103823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14103823.value: 生物學的一個中心主題是瞭解生物體是如何進化的。節肢動物包括昆蟲、甲殼動物（如蟹和蝦）、螯肢動物（如蠍子和蜘蛛）和多足動物（如蜈蚣和千足蟲），構成地球80%以上已知的動物物種。它們在陸地和水生棲息地中佔主導地位，並在農業、水產養殖業和人類疾病等與人類社會直接相關的領域中發揮著重要作用。瞭解它們的生物學和進化對於基礎科學和實用價值都至關重要。 多足動物是土壤生態系統和農業系統中重要的動物。作為食腐動物，千足蟲以腐爛的土壤物質為食,降解有機化合物; 而作為捕食者，蜈蚣則維持土壤系統的生態平衡。儘管其在生態、農業和進化方面意義重大，但多足動物仍然是全球研究最少的節肢動物。 在較早前，我們的團隊在多足動物的基因組方面提供了寶貴的生物學見解(Chipman et al 2014 PLOS Biology; Kenny et al 2015 Genome Biology and Evolution; Qu et al 2020 PLOS Biology; So et al 2022 Nature Communications)。在此基礎上，本項目旨在研究多足類動物的基因組和microRNA, 以瞭解節肢動物的進化並闡明多足動物的獨特生物學。

14104123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104123.value: Irx3 和 Irx5 基因在眼球前段發育的功能

14104123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104123.value: The anterior segment of the eye includes the cornea, iris, ciliary body and lens. Abnormal development of the anterior segment structures will cause a spectrum of congenital disorder called anterior segment dysgenesis (ASD), leading to visual impairment and blindness. Mutations of IRX5 gene cause Hamamy syndrome, patients develop severe progressive myopia and other ocular abnormalities. IRX3 and IRXB gene cluster are implicated as candidate genes for a case of severe ASD. However, the underlying pathogenic mechanisms for the ocular symptoms and the roles of IRX genes in the development of anterior segment structures are not known. Irx3 and Irx5 encode two closely linked homeodomain transcription factor genes on the IrxB gene cluster. They have specific as well as redundant functions in multiple developmental systems, but their functions during ocular anterior segment development are not known. Using a series of Irx3 and Irx5 single and compound mutant mice, in our preliminary study we discovered that Irx3 and Irx5 are required for the development of the cornea and multiple anterior segment structures. Based on our current data, we hypothesize that (1) Irx3 and Irx5 are required for the differentiation and maintenance of multiple ocular neural crest cell derived structures in the anterior segment; (2) Irx3 and Irx5 are required in the peri-placodal surface ectoderm for the formation of corneal epithelium and other epithelial derivatives in the anterior segment; (3) the peri-placodal surface epithelium is required to interact with the underlying ocular neural crest cells for the morphogenesis of anterior segment structures. The aim of this study is to investigate the functions of Irx3 and Irx5 in the ocular neural crest cells and the surface ectoderm during the development of the ocular anterior segment. The specific objectives are: (1) by genetic approach using a series of Irx3 and Irx5 mouse mutants, including neural crest-specific and surface ectoderm-specific conditional knockouts, we will delineate the temporal and cell type-specific requirement of Irx3/Irx5 during anterior segment development; (2) by single-cell RNA-seq transcriptome analysis we will elucidate the roles of Irx3 and Irx5 and the molecular mechanisms in controlling the development of the surface ectoderm, neural crest and other cell lineages. By integrating the data obtained from mouse genetics, scRNA transcriptomes, cell based functional analysis, we will elucidate the functions of Irx3 and Irx5 and the interactions between the surface ectoderm and neural crest cells during anterior segment development. 眼球前段包含眼角膜、虹膜、睫狀體及晶狀體，其發育異常會造成一系列名為眼球前段發育不全的先天性疾病，導致視力障礙，甚至失明。IRX5的基因突變會引致哈馬邁綜合症(Hamamy syndrome)，病人會患上嚴重的漸進性近視及其他眼部異況；IRX3 和IRXB 基因簇亦涉為一宗嚴重眼球前段發育不全個案的候選基因。然而，其眼部癥狀的致病機理，以及IRX 基因在眼球前段結構發育的功能，並未知悉。 Irx3 和Irx5 為兩條位於IrxB 基因簇上的連鎖基因，屬同源框架轉錄因子。在多個發育系統的過程中，它們各有特定及重叠的功能，但它們在眼球前段發育的功能則屬未知。透過一系列Irx3、Irx5 及複合的小鼠突變體，我們初步發現眼角膜和多個眼球前段結構的發育均需要Irx3 及Irx5。我們就現時的數據提出以下假說：一、Irx3 及Irx5 作用於維持和分化眼部神經嵴細胞，以形成各個眼球前段結構；二、基板周的表面外胚層細胞需要Irx3 及Irx5，以形成角膜上皮和其他眼球前段的上皮衍生結構；三、眼球前段的形態發生需要基板周的外層上皮，以之與下層的眼部神經嵴細胞作相互影響。 這項研究目的旨在探索Irx3 及Irx5 在眼球前段發育時，於神經嵴細胞和表面外胚層的功能。具體目標為：一、以遺傳學方式，透過一系列的Irx3 及Irx5的突變小鼠——包括神經嵴細胞特定及上皮特定條件式敲除——我們將分析於眼前段發育當中，Irx3/Irx5在特定時間上和細胞種類上的功能；二、利用單細胞RNA測序轉錄組分析，我們將了解Irx3 及Irx5 在控制表面外胚層、神經嵴及其他細胞譜系發育時的功能及其分子機理。綜合小鼠遺傳學、單細胞RNA測序轉錄組以及細胞功能分析所獲得之數據，我們將會解構Irx3和Irx5於眼球前段發育時的功能，以及其中表面外胚層與神經嵴細胞的相互作用。

14104223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104223.value: 剖析乳腺癌亞型特異性衰老加速，並開發基於分子和組織學圖像的衰老時鐘，用於預測高風險早發患者

14104223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104223.value: 乳腺癌已超過肺癌，成為最常見的惡性腫瘤。2020年全球有685,000人死於乳腺癌。早發乳腺癌，通常定義為45歲以下患病，對全球健康構成日益嚴重的威脅。乳腺癌的傳統危險因素，如家族史、BRCA1/2突變、緻密乳房、肥胖和飲酒，已得到廣泛研究。 然而，對於這種年輕化的流行病學趨勢，尚未找到令人信服的科學解釋。 更重要的是，早發乳腺癌的病因學和基礎生物學在很大程度上仍不清楚。 儘管遺傳性乳腺癌的發病機制已得到很好的表徵，但它們僅佔早發乳腺癌的一小部分，因而無法解釋其迅速攀升的發病率、更為嚴重的侵襲性和相對較差的臨床結果。 此外，儘管臨床表現存在明顯差異，但目前所有乳腺癌患者都接受同樣的治療，導致年輕患者治療不足或過度治療。 闡明與早發乳腺癌臨床結果相關的生物學機制對於優化患者的臨床管理和個體化治療至關重要。 重要的是，乳腺癌是一種異質性疾病，可分為基底樣亞型、HER2富集型、管腔A型、管腔B型和正常樣亞型。我們的初步研究表明，早發乳腺癌包含相同的五種固有亞型，但患病率與遲發乳腺癌截然不同。更具體地說，管腔A和管腔B亞型在遲發乳腺癌中更為普遍，並且與細胞衰老等衰老特徵密切相關。相比之下，年輕患者顯示出基底樣亞型和HER2富集亞型的患病率較高，而已知這些亞型更具侵襲性。此外，利用基於轉錄組學的衰老時鐘，我們發現早發患者表現出明顯的衰老加速，且預後較差。本項目中，我們將首先基於多中心隊列研究對早發乳腺癌進行全面的臨床和分子表徵（目標 1）。隨後，我們將闡明乳腺癌亞型與衰老標誌的特異性的關聯性，並開發分子衰老時鐘（目標 2）。最後，為促進臨床轉化，我們將開發衰老速率模型，基於 H&E 染色組織學圖像的深度學習來識別高風險的早發乳腺癌患者（目標 3）。為支持該項目，我們收集了一個大型數據隊列，涵蓋來自 27 個公共數據集和兩個獨立內部數據集的 6000 多名患者和細胞系。為實現這些目標，我們將在合作者的支持下整合圖像處理、生物信息學分析、人工智能和必要的實驗驗證。

14104523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104523.value: 細菌Fx通過抑制具核梭桿菌抑制結直腸腫瘤發生的作用及機制

14104523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14104523.value: Prof Chan, Ka-Leung Francis Prof Ng, Siew-chien Miss SUN, Yuting

14104523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104523.value: 具核梭桿菌 (Fn) 是促進結直腸癌 (CRC) 的典型致病菌之一。 Fn等致病菌的致病作用是否可以被特定的有益菌抑制及其作用機制尚未被研究。我們發現了一種潛在的益生菌 Fx，它對 CRC 和 Fn 具有抑制作用。本研究旨在充分闡明Fx通過拮抗Fn而發揮抑制CRC的作用及其分子機制，並明確Fx聯合Fn对CRC的臨床應用價值。 我們的初步研究結果表明，宏基因組學數據中Fx 與 Fn 表現出最高的負相關性，並且與對照受試者相比，CRC 患者的糞便中Fx豐度顯著降低。 Fx 顯著抑制結腸癌細胞的生長、克隆形成和細胞週期進程，並誘導結腸癌細胞凋亡，但不誘導正常細胞凋亡。 Fx還顯著抑制Fn的生長和聚集。此外，Fn對結腸癌細胞生長和遷移的促進作用被隨後的Fx處理顯著消除。通過加熱/蛋白酶-K處理，證實Fx的有效成分為非蛋白質。代謝組學分析發現了 Fx 產生的嘌呤衍生物 Hx。據報導，嘌呤衍生物具有抗腫瘤和抗微生物作用，CRC患者血液中的Hx顯著降低，並能增強腸道屏障功能。根據轉錄組分析，Fx顯著下調參與嘌呤回收並促進腫瘤生長的NT5E基因的表達。 DCR3 基因在 CRC 中過表達並抑制細胞凋亡，Fn 上調 DCR3，但隨後 Fx 處理下調 DCR3。 基於這些發現，我們推測 Fx 通過拮抗 Fn 的致癌作用而在抑制 CRC 中發揮重要作用，並且 Fx 產生 Hx 來阻斷 NT5E 介導的嘌呤補救，抑制 Fn 生長，並通過下調Fn促進的DCR3表達而誘導癌細胞凋亡。本研究將1) 評估Fx 和Hx 在自發性和致癌物誘導的CRC 小鼠模型中抑制Fn 促進的結直腸腫瘤發生的有效性，並闡明Fx/Hx 對腸道屏障功能和腸道微生物組的影響； 2）通過臨床樣本、基因敲除/敲低和過表達細胞模型以及芯片實驗，研究Fx通過Hx-NT5E和DCR3抗腫瘤和抗Fn作用的分子機制； 3)評價Fx聯合Fn的診斷和預後價值。這些發現將增加我們對微生物驅動的 CRC 發展的理解，並有助於製定 CRC 預防、診斷和預後的新策略。

14104623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104623.value: 紅樹林相手蟹共生體對木質纖維素降解機制的多組學研究

14104623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14104623.value: Prof Ma, Ka Ya Prof Ng , Peter Kee Lin Prof Qiu, Jianwen

14104623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104623.value: 紅樹林是全球最具生產力的生態系統之一，而螃蟹的活動對紅樹林棲息地的正常運作與健康有非常重要的關係，尤其是相手蟹科(Family Sesarmidae)的蟹類。紅樹製造的養份主要以落葉形式供給棲息地中的其他生物，但大部分的動物都無法消化木質纖維素，蟹類能轉化紅樹葉中的營養，從而在生態系統中成為食物鏈的重要環節和關鍵的營養物質回收者。但我們對蟹類如何消化木質纖維素並獲得足夠的營養缺乏有系統的研究，因此尚不清楚當中的機制。我們最近的研究發現蟹類可以合成內源性CAZymes，但與其他蟹類相比，草食性紅樹蟹類顯著提高了這些酶基因的表達水平，並寄宿了具有木質纖維素降解能力的腸道微生物。這首次證明，相手蟹可能同時利用來自宿主及共生菌的酵素進行木質纖維素降解。在本研究中，我們將利用腸道微生物組的宏基因組、內源性CAZyme表達譜的轉錄組分析以及宿主/微生物消化酶的蛋白組分析和酶活性測定在內等的多組學方法，去解析紅樹林蟹類消化木質纖維素的機制，並闡明該機制在不同飲食偏好和系統發育位置的蟹類中如何演化。我們的目標是驗證兩個主要的假說：1/草食性紅樹林螃蟹利用腸道內共生微生物組和宿主編碼的CAZymes組成的共生物體協同完成的木質纖維素降解；2/在草食性紅樹林相手蟹比其他食性的蟹類有著 CAZyme基因家族的擴張、更高的表達水平，以及更豐富的纖維素降解內共生微生物，以更好地適應木質纖維素降解。這個項目將揭示相手蟹類的如何以植物材料為食物來源，從而促進陸生化以及適應性輻射的機制。我們也可以闡明，不同的生物對共生微生物和宿主編碼的酶進行木質纖維素降解的依賴程度如何根據系統發育和環境因素而變化。此外，研究結果也將增強我們對紅樹林生態系統功能的理解，並對在全球氣候變化下對這一重要而脆弱的棲息地進行保護產生影響。

14104923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14104923.value: 膳食果糖增加而膳食多酚減少腸絨毛長度的機理研究

14104923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14104923.value: Prof Chen, Zhen-Yu Prof ZHAO, Danyue

14104923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14104923.value: 肥胖是一種全球流行病。過量攝取果糖和高果糖玉米糖漿是導致肥胖的主要飲食因素之一。最近研究顯示，果糖引起的肥胖部分原因是拉長了腸絨毛長度，擴大絨毛表面並導致吸收更多膳食脂肪和糖。果糖誘導腸絨毛延長的分子機制是通過調節 1-磷酸果糖 (F1-P) 對參與上皮細胞死亡和存活的基因表達，當中包括丙酮酸激酶 M2 亞型 (PKM2)、缺氧-誘導因子-1α (HIF-1α)、蛋白質烯醇化酶-1 (ENO1)、乳酸脫氫酶 A (LDHA) 和酮己糖激酶 (KHK)。而我們初步實驗結果發現，原兒茶酸（PCA）是飲食中常見的多酚，它可以有效縮短腸絨毛長度，從而將果糖誘導的肥胖小鼠體重減輕。這促使我們進一步研究 PCA 對腸絨毛變短的根本機制。 我們假設 PCA 能夠逆轉 F1-P 的作用，並對參與調節果糖誘導的肥胖中腸絨毛長度基因的表達具有相反調節作用。我們將使用 C57BL/6J 小鼠作為模型。小鼠隨機分為5組（每組10隻）：低脂飲食組（LFD）、高脂飲食組（HFD）、高脂高果糖飲食組（HFHF）、HFD組加PCA組(HFD+PCA)和HFHF加PCA組(HFHF+PCA)。 PCA 每天灌胃給小鼠，劑量為 1 克/公斤體重，持續 10 週。計劃試驗測量包括：脂肪吸收、口服脂肪耐量試驗和口服蔗糖耐量試驗；測量血清、肝臟和糞便中的脂質；十二指腸、近端空腸、遠端空腸和迴腸的腸絨毛長度的組織學分析和測量；通過免疫組織化學 (IHC) 測量葡萄糖轉運蛋白 5 (GLUT5)；測定小腸中 KHK 和 PK的活性；使用 RT-PCR 和 Western blot 檢測腸上皮細胞中 PKM2、HIF-1α、ENO1 和 LDHA 的mRNA和蛋白質。 我們預計PCA和其他多酚可以逆轉F1-P的作用，對PKM2、HIF-1α、ENO1、LDHA、KHK的表達產生相反作用，縮短腸絨毛長度，讓果糖誘導的肥胖小鼠減少脂肪吸收。此研究結果將為肥胖管理而設計減肥保健補充劑提供新視角。

14105123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14105123.value: DHX36與 RNA二級結構互作在RNA豐度調節中的作用機制研究

14105123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14105123.value: Prof CHEN, Xiaona Prof SUN, Hao

14105123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14105123.value: RNA molecules play versatile roles as a genetic material carrying heritable information and as a ribozyme catalyzing essential biological processes. It is increasingly appreciated that secondary structures of mRNAs play key biological functions especially in post-transcriptional regulation mainly through mediating mRNA interplay with RNA binding proteins (RBPs). The past decade has seen a surge of interest in the development and adaptation of RNA structural probing methods. Still, the filed is at its infancy stage; we are only scratching the surface of how mRNA structure dynamically changes in cells and how it drives RBP regulatory functions. In this work, we dive into the field to investigate how one particular RBP, DHX36 helicase binds and modulates mRNA structures in vivo, and also to elucidate the mechanism underlying how DHX36-induced structural changes modulates mRNA post-transcriptional processing. In our pilot work, we conducted in vivo RNA Structure-seq to globally profile RNA structures in HEK293T cells with or without DHX36 knockout (KO). Combining with DHX36 binding profiles, we found that DHX36 loss causes mRNA structural gain thus decreased structural accessibility, especially in 3’UTR regions. Further analyses unveiled that DHX36-induced 3’UTR structural accessibility is associated with post-transcriptional mRNA decrease. Mechanistically, we found YTHDF1 binding events are enriched in DHX36 binding sites and related to DHX36 regulation of mRNA abundance. Altogether, our preliminary results led us to hypothesize that DHX36 binding induces increased 3’UTR structural accessibility and promotes m6A dependent YTHDF1 recruitment and subsequent RNA degradation. Three objectives are proposed (1) to demonstrate DHX36 binding induces mRNA structural change; (2) to elucidate DHX36 induced structural change regulates mRNA abundance; (3) to uncover YTHDF1 mediates DHX36 effect on mRNA abundance. Once completed, our findings will shed novel insights into the interplay between RNA structures and RBPs and how it orchestrates post-transcriptional mRNA processing. RNA分子作為攜帶遺傳信息的遺傳物質和催化重要生物過程的核酶發揮著多種作用。越來越多證據顯示mRNA 的二級結構可以通過介導 mRNA 與 RNA 結合蛋白 (RBP) 的相互作用發揮著關鍵的生物學功能，特別是在轉錄後調節中。因此在過去十年裡，人們對RNA結構探測方法的開發和應用的興趣激增，儘管如此，該領域仍處於起步階段。 我們對 mRNA 結構如何在細胞中動態變化以及它如何驅動 RBP 調節功能的研究還是遠遠不夠。為了促進該領域發展，在這項工作中，我們將深入研究一種特定的 RBP，DHX36 解旋酶，如何在體內結合和調節 mRNA 結構，並闡明 DHX36 誘導的結構變化如何調節 mRNA 轉錄後加工的潛在機制。 在我們的前期研究中，我們進行了體內 RNA Structure-seq實驗，以全面分析DHX36 敲除 (KO) 的 HEK293T 細胞中 RNA 結構如何變化。 並且通過整合 DHX36 的RNA結合譜信息，我們發現 DHX36 丟失會導致 mRNA 結構性增多，從而降低結構可及性，這一現象在mRNA 3'UTR 區域尤其顯著。 進一步的分析表明，DHX36 誘導的 這一3’UTR 結構可及性與轉錄後 mRNA 的減少有關。通過 進一步的機制探索我們發現 RNA甲基化reader蛋白YTHDF1 在 DHX36 結合位點中富集，並且與 DHX36 對 mRNA 豐度的調節有關。基於以上結果，我們提出一個中心假設 ：DHX36 結合會誘導 3'UTR 結構可及性增加，從而促進 YTHDF1 的招募和隨後的 RNA 降解。為了證明如上假設，我們 提出了三個研究子目標（1）證明 DHX36 結合誘導 mRNA 結構變化； (2) 闡明DHX36誘導的結構變化調節mRNA豐度； (3)揭示YTHDF1介導DHX36對mRNA豐度的影響。 一旦完成，我們的研究結果將對 RNA 結構和 RBP 之間的相互作用以及其如何協調轉錄後 mRNA 加工提供新的見解。

14105823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14105823.value: 以 Runx1 為範例研究骨骼肌幹細胞中可變啟動子的使用機制機制剖析

14105823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14105823.value: Skeletal muscle allows voluntary movement and plays a key role in regulating metabolism and homeostasis in the organism. Meanwhile it has a remarkable ability to regenerate after injury thus provides an excellent model to study tissue regeneration. Muscle regeneration relies on its resident muscle stem cells (also called satellite cells, SCs) which normally lie quiescently beneath the basal lamina of muscle fiber. SCs can quickly activate and proliferate as myoblasts following injury, then differentiate and fuse into myofibers; a subset of SCs undergoes self-renewal and returns to quiescent state to replenish the stem cell pool. Each state of the myogenic lineage progression is orchestrated by complex regulatory networks of intrinsic and extrinsic factors/mechanisms. Disruption of the regulations may render SC loss of ability to regenerate, contributing to muscle wasting conditions such as muscular dystrophy, cachexia, and sarcopenia that are prevalent in human society. Intrinsic gene regulations at both transcriptional and post-transcriptional levels are key mechanisms governing SC regenerative activities. The use of alternative promoters enables production of multiple mRNA isoforms thus plays a significant role in post-transcriptional gene regulation in cells. However, the underlying mechanisms governing promoter choice remain elusive. Here in this study, we propose to unravel the mechanism through a novel perspective of three- dimensional (3D) chromatin looping. The importance of 3D genome organization in orchestrating gene expression is well recognized; in particular, enhancer (E) and promoter (P) interplays are key to directing gene expression. We thus propose to dissect how E-P interaction may govern alternative promoter usage in SC using Runx1 gene as a paradigm. Our preliminary results demonstrate that Runx1 undergoes promoter switch from P2 to P1 when SCs transition from activation to proliferation phase and the derived protein products play stage-specific roles; it is likely the switch is executed by MYC driven E/P loop rewiring. We thus hypothesize that alternative promoter usage can be orchestrated by 3D chromatin loop remolding. Three Objectives are proposed (1) To further study Runx1 alternative promoter usage and function in SCs. (2) To further elucidate the underlying mechanism of Runx1 promoter switch. (3) To explore the pervasiveness of alternative promoter usage in regenerating and aging SCs. Once completed, this study will provide novel mechanistic insights into alternative promoter usage and 3D chromatin regulation. It will also provide new knowledgebase for further understanding intrinsic regulations of SC regenerative activities, which will benefit future therapeutic development for treating muscle damages and diseases. 骨骼肌是自主運動的基礎器官，在調節生物體內的新陳代謝和穩態中也起著關鍵作用。同時，它在損傷後具有很強的再生能力，因此提供了一個極好的研究組織再生的模型。肌肉再生依賴於其內的肌肉乾細胞（也稱為衛星細胞），這些細胞通常位於肌纖維的基底膜下，並處於靜止狀態，但在損傷後可迅速激活並增殖為成成肌細胞，然後分化、融合生成肌纖維；一部分成肌細胞會自我更新並返回靜止狀態以補充成體幹細胞庫。肌源性譜系進程的每一個過程都由內在、外在的複雜網絡調控。如果調控被破壞將可能會導致肌肉乾細胞失去再生能力，進而誘發肌肉損耗相關疾病，比如肌肉萎縮症、惡病質和肌少症。轉錄和轉錄後水平的內在基因調控是控制肌肉乾細胞再生活動的關鍵機制，使用可變啟動子能夠產生多種 mRNA 亞型，因此在細胞轉錄後水平基因調控中發揮著重要作用。然而，控制啟動子選擇的潛在機制目前仍不清楚。在本項研究中，我們計劃通過三維（3D）染色質互作環的新視角來揭示這一機制。 3D 基因組結構在協調基因表達中的重要性已得到廣泛認可；特別是增強子 (E) 和啟動子 (P) 間的相互作用對於指導基因表達至關重要。因此，我們計劃使用 Runx1 基因作為範例來剖析 E-P 相互作用如何控制肌肉乾細胞中可變啟動子的使用。我們的初步結果表明，當肌肉乾細胞從激活期過渡到增殖期時，Runx1的表達從啟動子 P2 轉換到 P1，而對應的蛋白產物也發揮階段特異性作用；進一步研究表明這種切換很可能是由 MYC 驅動的 E/P 互作環重塑所致。因此，我們假設3D 染色質環重塑可調控可變啟動子的使用。為了驗證該假說，我們提出了三個目標（1）進一步研究肌肉乾細胞中Runx1可變啟動子的選擇和功能。（2）進一步闡明Runx1啟動子切換的潛在機制。（3）探索再生和衰老肌肉乾細胞中可變啟動子使用的普遍性。一旦完成這項研究將為可變啟動子使用和3D染色質調控提供新的機制性見解，並為進一步了解肌肉乾細胞再生活動的內在調控提供新的認知。這些發現將有利於未來用於治療肌肉損傷和疾病的藥物開發。

14106223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14106223.value: 使用人工智能聊天機械人進行數碼化失眠認知行為治療 (CBT-I) 對失眠青年人的療效：一項評估者盲法、隨機對照實驗

14106223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14106223.value: Dr Chan, Joey Wing-yan Dr Chan, Ngan Yin Dr Chau, Steven Wai Ho Dr Li , Shirley Xin Prof Wing, Yun Kwok

14106223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14106223.value: 失眠是常見的睡眠問題，影響全球 9.4%-38.2% 的青年人。青年人失眠與其心理健康問題有關，給他們健康和社會經濟造成巨大負擔。我們團隊證實，失眠認知行為治療（CBT-I）能有效改善本港青年人的失眠和心理健康問題。越來越多證據支持數碼化心理健康干預的有效性，這些數碼化干預能解決面對面治療的不足之處，包括臨床醫生短缺、可及性有限、成本高昂以及求助的恥辱感。我們過往和正在進行的隨機對照實驗證明，數碼化 CBT-I 在改善青年人失眠和心理健康問題方面，有顯著成效。 然而，高流失率和低依從性是提供有效數碼化心理健康干預面臨的一大挑戰。一項系統性研究發現，隨著互動程度的提高，數碼化干預更具吸引力和有效性。技術進步帶來了在數碼化干預中，加強人機互動的新思路。人工智能（AI）聊天機械人就擴展了數碼化干預，從提供單向教學和信息內容，到提供雙向互動、智能且以患者為中心的對話代理。我們在一款心理健康教育在線遊戲中，就加入聊天機械人功能，並得到用戶的積極反饋。我們的機器學習技術，支持聊天機械人的開發，使其理解用戶的自然語言輸入。在一項病例對照試點研究中，帶有AI聊天機械人的 CBT-I 應用程式，與不帶有AI聊天機械人的 CBT-I 應用程式相比，減少了青年人的失眠症狀（d=0.49）。與活性對照組相比，聊天機械人組別的睡眠日記完成率也更高（意味著對干預的依從性更高）。研究發現，干預效果與依從性之間存在正相關。最近的一項統合分析顯示，心理健康聊天機械人具有中等療效（g=0.55）。AI心理健康聊天機械人，已展現出增強數碼化干預的潛力，但其有效性的證據還很有限。 此項目旨在進行一項評估者盲法、隨機對照實驗，評估帶有AI聊天機械人的 CBT-I 應用程式，與不帶有AI聊天機械人的 CBT-I 應用程式相比，在減少青年人失眠症狀方面的療效。這項研究不僅有助於證實AI聊天機械人在改善失眠方面的功效，研究結果還將為AI心理健康聊天機械人的療效提供進一步的實證支持，從而為決策者、治療師、學者和持份者，提供有關數碼化心理健康干預的未來方向、發展和建議。
