14504823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14504823.value: 有關銷售團隊在產品線設計中的作用

14504823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14504823.value: 儘管電子商務迅速增長，許多行業仍然依賴銷售人員來銷售產品。在美國，超過1300萬人，佔勞動力的10%以上，從事“銷售或相關職業”（美國勞工統計局，2021年）。在香港，服務和銷售工人佔所有15歲及以上的勞動力的17.8%（香港特區政府統計處，2022年）。 銷售人員在消費者的選擇中起著重要作用。當有多種產品可供選擇時，消費者會更傾向於購買銷售人員花費最多努力說服他們購買的產品。然而，現有的銷售團隊管理研究主要關注銷售團隊激勵方案的設計，假設整體銷售是銷售人員努力的函數，而不考慮銷售人員的努力對消費者選擇的影響。此外，現有的研究都將產品設計視為給定，而我們提出公司需要在產品設計階段考慮銷售人員的角色。 在這個項目中，我們將考慮銷售人員的努力對消費者偏好的影響，並研究銷售團隊的存在如何影響公司的產品線設計。 我們首先建立一個單一產品模型。我們展示了銷售人員的存在會使消費者感覺較不敏感於價格，這將導致在產品質量給定的情況下，最優價格較高。當產品質量是內生的時候，如果只有部分銷售人員的努力進入消費者的效用，公司將選擇較低的產品質量並設定較低的價格。 我們進一步建立了一個雙產品模型，研究銷售人員的存在如何影響兩個垂直差異化產品的產品質量水平。我們還計劃研究銷售人員的存在如何影響兩個水平差異化產品的差異程度。此外，我們計劃研究公司應如何在銷售佣金、產品質量和價格之間做出權衡。 我們的研究結果將對公司提供關於他們在產品線設計和價格決策時應如何考慮銷售團隊的角色方面重要的管理啟示。

14505023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505023.value: 廣義學術影響力排名方法

14505023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505023.value: This project generalizes and combines two classical problems of intellectual influence. The first is the scholar ranking problem which quantifies the academic influence of a scholar based on the total citations of each article published by the scholar. The second is the journal ranking problem which measures the impact of an academic journal based on total citations of all articles in the journal from other journals. Their rankings are important for public interest since many researchers and their institutions are subsidized by the taxpayer’s money. These ranking methods can apply to other situations, including citations for patents, web pages, and aggregation of expert rankings. These two problems are closely related but lack a formal link. The scholar ranking problem does not distinguish the source of citation so the ranking of the journal is irrelevant. The journal ranking problem cares only about total citations and thus the distribution of citations among articles it published is irrelevant. Given the complementarities, we study three general setups. The first is a generalized scholar ranking problem that takes the ranking of citing journals into account. Using results from the journal ranking problem, we find the cardinal ranking of journals. Together with the citation details, we calculate scores for each article. With scores for every article published by a scholar, we find an influence measure of the scholar as in classical scholar ranking problems. The second is a generalized journal ranking problem that allows citation measures dependent on the distribution of citations over articles in a journal. We calculate a citing-journal-specific score for a journal by a scoring method from scholar ranking problem to aggregate citation index over all articles published in the journal. Based on all these scores, we find the ranking of a scholar as in journal ranking problems. The third is a generalized intellectual influence problem that ranks both scholars and journals. This allows a journal to be more influential when a famous scholar is publishing or citing an article from it. It also allows a scholar to be more influential if the scholar publishes an article in or gets cited by a prestigious journal. We employ axiomatic methods to derive new solutions in the three general setups. With new methods, we have new scholar and journal rankings. Our method extends to new applications, including the influence of online opinion leaders, ranking related to sports competition, and ranking related to economic competitiveness. 這個計畫將學術影響力的兩個經典問題進行了泛化和結合。第一個是學者排名問題，該問題根據學者發表的每篇文章的總引用次數量化學者的學術影響力。第二個是期刊排名問題，該問題根據其他期刊中所有文章對該期刊的總引用次數來衡量學術期刊的學術影響力。這些排名方法對公眾利益非常重要，因為許多研究人員及其機構都是由納稅人的錢資助的。這些排名方法也可以應用於其他情況，包括專利引用、網頁引用以及專家對項目的聚合排名。 這兩個問題密切相關，但缺乏正式的聯繫。學者排名問題不區分引用來源，因此期刊排名與其無關。期刊排名問題只關心總引用次數，因此它所發表的文章之間的引用分配是無關緊要的。鑒於互補性，我們研究了三個廣義的排名問題。 第一個是廣義的學者排名問題，考慮引用期刊的排名。利用期刊排名問題的結果，我們找到期刊的基數排名。再加上引用詳細信息，我們計算每篇文章的分數。對於學者發表的每篇文章的分數，我們像經典的學者排名問題那樣找到學者的影響力度量。 第二個是廣義的期刊排名問題，允許引用措施依賴於期刊文章之間引用的分配。我們使用學者排名問題的評分方法來計算期刊的引用-期刊特定分數，以聚合期刊中發表的所有文章的引用指數。基於所有這些分數，我們像期刊排名問題那樣找到學者的排名。 第三個是廣義的學術影響力問題，同時排名學者和期刊。這使得當著名學者在發表或引用該期刊的文章時，該期刊可以更具影響力。它也使得學者在優秀期刊發表文章或被優秀期刊引用時，其影響力可以更大。 我們將採用公理方法來推導廣義設置中的新解決方案。利用新的排名方法，我們將找到了新的學者和期刊排名。我們的方法還可以擴展到新的應用，包括網絡意見領袖的影響力、與體育競賽相關的排名以及與經濟競爭力相關的排名。

14505123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505123.value: 誰在乎監管風險？來自國會聽證會的證據 誰在乎監管風險？來自國會聽證會的證據 誰在乎監管風險？來自國會聽證會的證據

14505123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505123.value: 企業面臨著越來越大的壓力，要求在環境、社會和治理 (ESG) 問題上進行預防性支出。社會責任投資者 (SRI) 可以在引導公司投資其 ESG 概況而不是推遲投資方面發揮重要作用。最近的幾項研究探討了 SRI 在公司 ESG 概況中的作用，以及它們是否通過聲音和退出威脅的渠道促進公司的 ESG 投資。然而，這些渠道的有效性以及社會責任投資機構在多大程度上具有真正的 ESG 動機仍然是一個有爭議的問題。美國國會在深水地平線石油洩漏和 Equifax 數據洩露等負面 ESG 事件發生後舉行的聽證會，可以成為研究 SRI 對投資組合公司在 ESG 問題上不當行為的矛盾動機的完美實驗環境。國會聽證會的重要性不僅在於它們會傳喚和審問大公司的高管，聽證會受到媒體的廣泛報導，而且在通過可能損害受影響行業（或甚至更廣泛）。因此，此時企業高管最需要投資者和國會朋友的持續支持和支持，以遏制不利的立法。這種支持可能會影響聽證會的性質（例如，聽證會中表達的語氣或“情緒”）以及最終的立法。先前的文獻中尚未記錄 SRI 在這種情況下的作用，他們的行為以聽證會上表達的情緒為條件，可能有助於說明他們對 ESG 問題的態度以及他們是否有真正的 ESG 目標。我們計劃調查政策制定者在聽證會上表達的情緒是否受到他們與 SRI 的聯繫（通過捐款和遊說）的影響；當聽證會的整體情緒較為負面時，SRI 是否更有可能剝離（退出）；一旦了解後續立法的結果，SRI 是否會增加受影響行業的投資組合權重，並加強與投資組合公司在 ESG 問題上的接觸。特別是，我們認為，如果 SRI 在立法失敗或比預期更寬鬆時增加投資組合公司的持股並加大參與力度，這表明了真正的 ESG 偏好。最後，我們建議研究負面情緒較多的聽證會是否會促使 SRI 加強與其他行業的投資組合公司的接觸。

14505223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14505223.value: 親社會動機並非完全一樣：不同的親社會動機如何被不同地感知和獎勵（或懲罰）

14505223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14505223.value: Prof LI, Ning Prof Su, Rong

14505223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14505223.value: 隨著服務業的發展和團隊協作的增加，員工的親社會動機正成為組織日益重要的話題。事實上，研究發現，具有高度親社會動機的員工更有可能加倍努力幫助他人，從而提高團隊和組織的效率。因此，組織試圖培養員工的親社會傾向。 然而，雖然研究發現員工親社會動機可以使組織受益，但尚不清楚它是否有利於員工本身。對於親社會動機對員工的影響，外行和研究人員持有不同的觀點。在流行文化中，“好人最後到達終點”的觀念非常普遍，一定程度上說明親社會動機可能會阻礙員工在工作中取得成功。但與此同時，約翰·鄧普頓爵士有句名言：人們“通過幫助他人來幫助自己”。文獻中的實證結果也好壞參半。雖然一些研究人員發現親社會動機對員工績效和職業成果有積極影響，但其他研究人員卻發現了相反的結果。這些截然不同的理論和研究結果留下了一些懸而未決的問題：員工應該在工作中表達還是隱藏他們的親社會傾向？他們如何才能在不影響績效評估和職業前景的情況下展現親社會傾向？ 擬議的研究將尋求對這些研究問題提供見解。我們認為親社會動機是否會提高或削弱員工績效和職業前景取決於所表現出的親社會動機的類型。具體來說，我們建議一些親社會動機是可自由裁量的（例如，“幫助別人讓我快樂”），而另一些則是強制性的（例如，“如果我不幫忙，我感覺自己像個壞人”）；一些親社會動機普遍針對一般人、社區和社會（例如，“我想幫助社會”），而另一些則專門針對組織內或與組織相關的人（例如，“我想幫助我的同事和客戶”）。這些不同類型的親社會動機可能會被管理者以不同的方式感知，這將導致員工不同的績效和職業成果。此外，我們將研究當男性和女性員工表現出特定類型的親社會動機時，他們是否會受到不同的評價。 我們希望擬議研究的結果將為有關親社會動機的文獻做出貢獻，並為員工提供關於是否以及如何在工作中表現出親社會傾向的實用建議。

14506023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14506023.value: Prof Bai, Yan Prof Jin, Keyu

14506023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506023.value: Rethinking supply chains in an era of protracted global uncertainty is one of the most important international economic questions of our times. Trade wars, constant geopolitical threats, pandemics, climate change, and bouts of protectionist sentiments are just some of the challenges to the global trading order. What is different between now and in the past is that trading partners are more integrated than ever, but shocks and uncertainty are more long-lived and enduring. As a result, supply-chain disruptions have greater negative impacts on global industrial production and trade than before. The impact can be long-lasting since it takes time and effort for firms to search for new suppliers, especially in new foreign markets and for firms with limited import experience. To quantitatively assess the aggregate implications of supply-chain disruptions, we make two advances relative to the literature. The first is to document how sourcing patterns depend on firm characteristics. Our preliminary results show that firms build supply chains over the life cycle and that their choice of suppliers depends on import experience. The longer a firm remains in a market, the more it imports from that market. Additionally, importers are more likely to add new varieties in previous importing countries. Our second advance is to develop a dynamic open-economy model with heterogeneous firms and endogenous global sourcing. A firm decides where and when to import and invests in searching for suppliers to improve its sourcing efficiencies. Higher sourcing efficiency in one country increases the benefit of adding other sourcing countries. Hence, the investment decision depends on the import experience and is shaped by future returns from expanding sourcing opportunities globally. It is challenging to compute our model with endogenous global sourcing. The optimization problem is non-convex and involves discrete choices regarding sourcing from additional countries and dynamic investment decisions. To tackle the challenge, we rewrite the problem as the optimal investment and stopping time for entering new sourcing countries. We solve HJB equations with inequalities and provide an efficient method to deal with the large state space when many countries are considered. Our model can match the observed slow formation of supply chains and experience-dependent sourcing patterns. We then use the model to assess the aggregate implications of various shocks. The micro-founded dynamic setup is expected to provide concrete answers to the amplifying and persistent effects of a negative shock on global production and trade and supply chain realignments. 在全球長期不確定的時代重新思考供應鍊是我們時代的重要國際經濟問題之一。貿易戰，持續不斷的地緣政治威脅，流行病，氣候變化和保護主義情緒，都只是全球貿易秩序面臨的部分挑戰。和過去不同，貿易夥伴比以往任何時候都更加一體化，但衝擊和不確定性更加持久，供應鏈中斷對全球工業生產和貿易的負面影響比以往更大。這種負面影響可能是持久的，因為企業需要時間和精力來尋找新的供應商，特別是對於那些在新的國外市場和那些進口經驗有限的企業。 為了定量評估供應鏈中斷的總體影響，我們相對於文獻做出了兩項進展。首先是記錄了企業的採購模式取決於企業特徵。我們的初步結果表明，企業在整個生命週期中逐步建立供應鏈，他們對供應商的選擇取決於他們的進口經驗。企業在市場上停留的時間越長，從該市場進口的就越多。此外，更有可能在過去的幾年中添加新品種。我們的第二個進展是開發了一個具有企業異質性的內生的全球採購動態開放經濟模型。企業決定何時何地進口多少產品，同時投資尋找供應商以提高采購效率。在一個國家的更高的採購效率也增加其他採購國家的效益。因此，投資決策取決於進口經驗並受未來擴大全球採購機會帶來的回報的影響。 使用內生全球採購來計算我們的模型具有很大的挑戰性。這個優化問題是非凸的，涉及有關進入一個國家的離散選擇來自其他國家和動態的投資決策。為了應對挑戰，我們將問題重寫為最優投資和進入新的國家的最優停止時間。我們求解有不等式的 HJB 方程，並提供了一種有效的方法來考慮當有許多國家時狀態變量多時的計算。我們的模型可以匹配觀察到的供應鏈緩慢形成和經驗依賴的採購模式。然後我們使用該模型來評估各種衝擊的總體影響。微觀基礎的動態設置有望提供負面衝擊對全球的生產，貿易和供應鏈的重組放大和持續影響的具體應對。

14506123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506123.value: 衝突、和平與國際商務：跨國企業如何應對東道國政治暴力與和平協議？

14506123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506123.value: Several months into 2022, the world has already witnessed 36,936 incidents of political violence events in 102 countries, resulting in 48,422 fatalities (ACLED, 2022). Multinational enterprises (MNEs) are grappling with uncertainty and potential damage due to violent conflicts they might encounter in their worldwide operations (Aon, 2017). The uniqueness of violent conflicts, compared to other types of country risks, such as corruption and policy instability, lies in the direct and sudden threat they can pose to the physical security of MNEs’ assets, especially human capital (Hiatt and Sine, 2014). Despite its practical prominence, research that examines how MNEs respond to such threat remains scarce. There are important gaps in the current literature. First, previous research mostly investigates foreign investment or divestment as MNEs' responses to host country violent conflicts. Such a limited choice of outcome variables constrains our understanding of the variety of responses MNEs actually take and the relevant decision-making process. Second, research tends to treat these shocks as static and paid little attention to their dynamic progression. A conflict might go from an onset stage to a resolution stage, during which process the host-country environment changes drastically. However, with very few exceptions (e.g., Albino-Pimentel et al., 2022), prior research rarely studies how MNEs' responses in conflict zones change with the development and progress of conflict events. This proposed project seeks to fill the research gap by conducting two studies. In study one, I plan to explore different actions MNEs take to respond to host country terrorist incidents, besides divestment. Building on crisis management literature (Mitroff, 1994; Williams, Gruber, Sutcliffe, Shepherd, & Zhao, 2017), I identify two types of actions to respond to host country terrorist attacks—impact assessment actions and impact reduction actions. I examine how an MNE’s likelihood of adopting impact assessment actions and impact reduction actions is jointly influenced by the severity of political violence and the MNE’s top management team diversity. In study two, I plan to explore how MNEs' investment decisions change in response to the onset and the resolution of violent conflicts in host countries. Building on political ideology research, I further explore how MNEs' likelihood of leaving and re-entering a host country when conflicts occur and when peace agreements are reached varies as a function of their CEOs' political ideology, specifically, conversation vs. liberalism. 2022年進入數個月，全球已經見證了102個國家中36,936起政治暴力事件，導致48,422人死亡（ACLED，2022年）。跨國企業（MNEs）正面臨不確定性和潛在的損害，可能會在其全球業務中遇到暴力衝突（Aon，2017年）。 與其他類型的國家風險（如腐敗和政策不穩定性）相比，政治暴力的獨特之處在於它們對MNE資產的物理安全，尤其是人力資本，可能構成的直接和突然威脅（Hiatt和Sine，2014年）。儘管實際上很突出，但研究如何MNE應對這種威脅的研究仍然很少。目前的文獻存在重要的缺口。首先，先前的研究主要調查了MNE對待主機國家政治暴力衝突時的外國投資或撤資。這樣有限的結果變數選擇制約了我們對MNE實際採取的各種應對措施以及相關決策過程的理解。其次，研究傾向於將這些衝擊視為靜態的，並且很少關注它們的動態進展。衝突可能從發生階段轉向解決階段，在這個過程中，主機國的環境會發生劇變。然而，除了極少數的例外（例如，Albino-Pimentel等人，2022年），先前的研究很少研究了在衝突事件的發展和進展中MNE對衝突區域的應對如何變化。 本提案旨在通過進行兩項研究來填補研究空白。在第一項研究中，我計劃探討除了撤資之外的MNE應對主機國恐怖事件所採取的不同行動。在危機管理文獻的基礎上（Mitroff，1994年；Williams，Gruber，Sutcliffe，Shepherd和Zhao，2017年），我確定了兩種應對主機國恐怖襲擊的行動類型——影響評估行動和影響減少行動。我研究了MNE採取影響評估行動和影響減少行動的可能性如何受政治暴力的嚴重程度和MNE的高級管理團隊多樣性的共同影響。在第二項研究中，我計劃探討MNE對主機國暴力衝突的發生和解決作出投資決策的變化。基於政治意識形態研究，我進一步探討了MNE在發生衝突和達成和平協議時離開和重新進入主機國的可能性如何受其首席執行官（CEO）的政治意識形態的影響，具體而言是保守主義與自由主義的區別。

14506223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506223.value: 疫情期間的同理心：面對危機時的組織同理心和社會認可

14506223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506223.value: 2019冠狀病毒病大流行的嚴重性和範圍帶來了巨大的不確定性、焦慮和 甚至對人類產生恐懼，並造成巨大的健康問題、情緒困擾和經濟損失，給世界各地的許多人帶來困難。面對這一巨大挑戰，政府和非政府組織的力量還不夠。儘管企業自身遭受損失，它們提供的幫助是重要的。事實上，企業擁有如此多的力量、資源和能力，使得它們成為現代社會的重要參與者。然而，許多企業選擇不採取任何行動 ; 還有一些企業可能會誤解，認為僅提供有形援助（例如“出示資金”）就足夠。然而，我們認為，除了金錢和其他有形援助外，至關重要的是，企業表達理解、關心和支持的真正意願和努力援助將為社區帶來重大改變。本質上，這就是組織同理心，除了提供切實的幫助外，還能夠帶來情感上的提升。這是在這種背景下，我們的研究考察在危機期間，企業向社區表現同理心的重要性。 近年來，對組織同理心這一話題的關注迅速增長。然而，這一調查還處於初級階段，許多基本問題還有待完全回答和解決。實證研究更加有限，並且大多是專注於一個或幾個組織。企業以同理心做出回應時的主要目標不太可能是盈利能力。因此，我們的研究探討了組織同理心是否可以改善社會認可。我們將為這項研究收集大樣本數據闡明組織同理心在危機中的重要性。 我們進一步假設誰參與了同理心的傳達以及如何傳達同理心會對前述主要關係產生調節作用。本研究主要藉鑑來自營銷中使用的歸因理論，並與在戰略管理中對這主題的知識相結合，重點關注兩個方面：領導者的參與和溝通重點，這將增加組織同理心的真確性。我們認為，如果一家企業的領導者直接表達他們的同理心，就會加強前述主要關係。此外，一家企業在表達同理心時，將重點放在關注社區成員或社會，不在企業本身身上，同樣會加強前述主要關係。我們使用香港上市公司來檢驗這些假設。

14506423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14506423.value: 消費者可退換情境下的產品組合設計

14506423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14506423.value: 在疫情期間，隨著在線銷售的增加，消費者退換購買的產品已成為一種明顯的行為。越來越多的零售商可以輕鬆地提供退貨服務。產品退貨逐漸成為消費者搜索過程中不可或缺的部分，因為它幫助客戶在購買時接受關於效用的不確定性。在這項工作中，我們開發了一個全新的消費者選擇模型來捕捉消費者選擇過程的幾個關鍵要素：(1) 消費者對產品的效用不確定性一部分來自產品的適用度，並且只有在消費者購買並嘗試產品後，才能意識到這部分產品的效用不確定性；(2) 在檢查階段，消費者對產品的個體偏好可能各不相同，因此他們最初可能去不同的產品；(3) 消費者可以通過退換順序地體驗產品。我們是首批考察產品組合對退換行為影響的論文之一。在這項工作中，我們發現在存在退換行為的情況下，零售商應該推出更多的產品組合以最大化收入。忽略退換行為會損害零售商的收入。隨著項目的進行，我們將展示產品組合優化問題的難度，因此我們專注於提供一個有性能保證的高效算法。我們還會研究產品組合推薦和定價問題的結合。最後但同樣重要的是，我們想研究退換政策如何影響消費者剩餘和社會福利。

14507223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507223.value: 區塊鏈科技支持時間銀行中的廣義社會交換：過程和結果

14507223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507223.value: Blockchains are hailed as a trust machine that produces “trustless trust.” The transparency and local control of data, conferred by their Distributed Ledger Technologies, build trust and can produce monetary outcomes. The rule for the continued successful blockchain operation is based on both “dry” (technological) code and “wet” (human) code; i.e., any mechanisms that operate and are enforced out of the dry code actually have human factors. However, most of the studies, mainly originated from the fields of fintech or supply chain, have focused on the technology’s capabilities to improve transactions in the markets or the networks. Less is known about the utility of blockchain in organizing or governing altruistic social exchanges. If blockchains are functional and effective, the systems should work not just in business and trade settings. This study begs the question of how blockchains may preserve valuable mechanisms that breed commitments for people’s wellbeing and social solidarity in settings where trust is most needed and outcomes are social rather than pecuniary. Time bank is a community-based exchange system which enables participants to exchange goods or services using time credits as ‘currency’ for exchange. According to generalized social exchange research, through participation and commitments in the social exchanges, members of a social group identify with and become emotionally attached to the group due to intensive exchange and habitual interactions. In such processes, the implementation of the collaborator matters, as the organization of exchange can direct how the individuals will interact, and vice versa. This study explores the process of blockchain implementation and governance in time banks considering the generalized social exchange perspective -- groups with at least three members exchanging resources through generalised reciprocity. We started a policy-focused study on time banks on their usage for active aging, volunteering, and community building (Au & Ng, 2022). Our preliminary analysis revealed stakeholders’ apparent needs on digitalization for efficiency and scaling-up. They believed using blockchain technologies could improve their impact. This proposed research shall conduct a longitudinal qualitative study investigating time banks which introduce block chain technologies, and also interviewing and observing users, NGO hosts and technology providers. The abductive process shall build explanations while testing our understanding. Then, a survey shall verify the theoretical predictions, adding rigor to observations in the qualitative study. Overall, this project offers theoretical and practical implications on the application and governance of innovative technologies in an altruistic context and generalized social exchange perspective. 區塊鏈被譽為一種以“無需信任為基礎”去產生信任的機器。 分佈式賬本技術賦予的數據透明度和控制可以建立信任並達致實質的成效。 區塊鏈持續成功運行的規則基於“乾”（技術）代碼和“濕”（人類）代碼； 也就是說，任何在代碼中運行和執行的機制實際上都存在人為因素。 然而， 區塊鏈的大多數研究發現主要源自金融科技或供應鏈領域，重點關注該技術改善市場或網絡交易的能力。 人們對區塊鏈在組織或管理利他性社會交流方面的效用知之甚少。 如果區塊鏈功能強大且有效，那麼該系統不僅應該在商業和貿易環境中發揮作用。 這項研究因而提出了這樣的問題：區塊鏈如何保留有價值的機制，在最需要信任且結果是社會性而非金錢性的環境中，培育對個人福祉和社會團結的關顧。 時間銀行是一個基於社區的交換系統，使參與者能夠使用時間積分作為“貨幣”，來交換商品或服務。 根據對廣義社會交換（意指至少三個成員的團體通過廣義互惠交換資源）的研究，通過對社會交換的參與和承諾，社會群體的成員由於頻繁的交流和習慣性的互動而對這個群體產生認同和情感依賴。 在這樣的過程中，合作者的實施情況很重要，因為交換組織可以指導個人如何互動，反之亦然。 本研究考慮了廣義社會交換的視角 ，進一步探討時間銀行中區塊鏈的實施和治理過程。在一項正進行、以政策為本的研究中，我們研究時間銀行在應對老齡化、志願服務和社區建設中的使用情況（Au & Ng，2022）。 我們的初步分析揭示了利益相關者對數字化以提高效率和擴大規模有明顯的需求，並且提及使用區塊鏈技術可以提高其影響力。 故此，本研究將對引入區塊鏈技術的時間銀行進行縱向定性研究，並對用戶、非政府組織主辦方和技術提供商進行訪談和觀察。 溯因過程（abducation) 的方法將在測試我們的理解的同時建立解釋； 然後，調查(survey)應驗證理論預測，增加定性研究中觀察結果的嚴謹性。 總體而言，這項目會為利他主義背景和廣義社會交換視角下創新技術的應用和治理，提供理論基礎和檢驗其實踐意義。

14507323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507323.value: China’s overwhelming reliance on coal has become a big challenge to the global ambition of carbon neutrality. China’s rich coal endowment and explosive energy demand from its fast-growing economy are often considered two main reasons. However, both explanations are debatable. First, China’s share of global coal reserves is barely 11%, one third of its output share and one fifth of its consumption share. Second, China was on a similar trajectory of energy intensity reduction prior to the 2000s as in many other countries. The downward trend was reversed in the early 2000s. The predicted China’s energy intensity in 2019 by a naïve linear extrapolation would be merely half of the actual level. In this project, we will investigate two novel channels through which regional disparity may increase a country’s reliance on coal. We first document the huge spatial imbalance in coal supply and demand in China. The coal price liberalization, which started in the early 2000s, implies a de facto huge energy subsidy in the coal-rich areas. In an economy with imperfect labor mobility, if the coal-rich areas coincide with the low-income areas, as in China, cheaper costs in both energy and labor will attract disproportionally more resources to energy-intensive industries in the coal-rich areas, entrench the coal addiction and raise the aggregate emissions. This is what we refer to as the spatial origin of China's coal dependence. Moreover, energy-intensive industries can be over-invested because of their negative environmental spillover effects on other regions. Further, the spatial coincidence of income and coal richness generates a strong desire for the coal-rich areas to promote the local economies. The early 2000s is, once again, a critical period when local officials became more aggressive in pursuing their careers and might churn out more local industrial policies that lead to over-invested energy-intensive industries. This is what we refer to as the policy origin of China’s coal dependence. Our analysis will consist of four steps. The first step is to collect domestic and international data to present a comprehensive set of facts on the two economic origins. The second part is to apply the existing accounting framework to measure the importance of the two channels. In the third part, we will develop a quantitative model that can be structurally estimated to quantify the economic and environmental effects of the two origins. The last part will be devoted to policy implications. 在這個項目中，我們將研究兩個新的渠道來理解國家對煤炭的依賴。我們首先呈現中國煤炭供需情況存在巨大的空間不平衡。煤炭價格自由化始於2000年代初，這意味著對煤炭資源豐富的地區事實上存在巨額能源補貼。在一個在勞動力流動性不完善的經濟體中，如果煤炭資源豐富的地區與低收入地區重合，就像中國那樣，能源和勞動力成本的下降將吸引將更多的資源投入到煤炭資源豐富的地區的能源密集型產業。這就是我們所指的作為中國煤炭依賴的空間根源。 此外，能源密集型產業由於其負面影響可能會被過度投資。對其他地區的環境溢出效應。空間重合收入和煤炭豐富度產生了煤炭豐富地區的強烈願望當地經濟。2000年代初再次是地方官員的關鍵時期在追求自己的職業生涯時變得更加積極，並且可能會生產出更多本地產品產業政策導致能源密集型產業過度投資。我們稱之為中國煤炭依賴的政策根源。

14507423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507423.value: 海外歸國人員對中國企業的績效、創新及國際化的影響

14507423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14507423.value: Prof LIU, Sibo Prof Toth, Russell

14507423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507423.value: Since the adoption of the reform and opening-up policies in the late 1970s, an increasing number of Chinese students have traveled abroad to study. At the same time, the Chinese government has set up various programs to promote the return of these highly skilled migrants. The overseas returnees were hired by universities, governments, and businesses. Nicknamed “haigui” or “sea turtles,” they brought new knowledge, technologies, managerial skills, and international academic and business networks that were not available in China. How do Chinese firms benefit from the arrival of overseas returnees? In recent years, China is in transition from a manufacturing center to a global innovation hub. How much did the returnees contribute to this process? Our proposed project will investigate these topics from three angles: performance, innovation, and internationalization of firms. We also plan to perform a heterogeneous analysis based on different types of Chinese firms and different types of returnees. The first challenge to implementing this research design is that firm-level data usually do not include employment information about returnees. We plan to overcome this by adopting a big data approach using information from LinkedIn, an online platform used for professional networking and career development. Professionals and students who seek networking or new job opportunities often open an account on LinkedIn. Because LinkedIn has information on more than 500 million high-skilled individuals around the world, we will be able to identify Chinese returnees by tracking their overseas study and work experience and their work experience in China. We will then merge the relevant firm names in LinkedIn with the Orbis and other databases, which provide production, patent, exports and outward foreign investment information on more than one million Chinese industrial firms. The second challenge is reverse causality. Returnees may choose to join firms with future growth potential. A simple correlation between the arrival of returnees and subsequent firm growth will not imply causality. We will solve this problem using a shift-share type instrumental variable approach. We will use the local economic conditions in a foreign country to model the outmigration probability of overseas Chinese in that country. We will then use a predetermined migration network to translate the outflow of returnees from foreign countries into inflow to Chinese cities and firms. The instrument variable approach will be able to solve the reverse causality problem as long as the instruments are relevant and exogenous. 自1970年代末的改革開放政策實施以來，越來越多的中國學生赴海外學習。與此同時，中國政府設立了各種項目來促進這些高技能公民的歸國。據國家統計局數據，2019年超過700,000名中國學生出國留學，而返回的學生人數達到580,000。這些海外歸國人員被高校、政府和企業聘用，他們被暱稱爲“海龜”，帶回了中國之前沒有的新知識、技術、管理技能以及國際學術和商務網絡。中國企業如何從海外歸國人員的到來中受益？我們的研究項目將從三個角度探討這個話題：績效、創新和國際化。我們還計劃根據不同類型的中國企業和不同類型的歸國者進行異質性分析。 實施這一研究的首個挑戰是，公司級數據通常不包括關於歸國者的信息。我們計劃採用大數據方法，利用LinkedIn這個用於職業網絡和職業髮展的在線平颱的信息來克服這一問題。尋求人際網絡或新的工作機會的專業人士和學生經常在LinkedIn上開設賬戶。由於LinkedIn擁有世界各地超過5億高技能個體的信息，我們將能夠通過追踪他們的海外學習和工作經驗以及在中國的工作經驗來確定中國歸國者。然後，我們將LinkedIn中的相關公司名稱與Orbis和其他數據庫合並，這些數據庫爲超過一百萬家中國工業企業提供了生産、專利、出口和對外投資信息。第二個挑戰是反向因果性。歸國者可能選擇加入具有未來增長潛力的公司。歸國者的到來與隨後的公司增長之間的簡單相關性並不意味着因果關繫。我們將使用份額移動法工具變量來解決這個問題。我們將使用外國的當地經濟條件來估計該國海外華人的出境概率。然後，我們將使用預定的移民網絡，將外國歸國者的流出轉化爲中國城市的流入。隻要工具變量與研究內容相關且是外生的，該工具變量方法就能較好地解決反向因果性問題。

14507523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507523.value: 資源錯配，企業動態，與中國經濟三產化

14507523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14507523.value: Dr Chen, Xilu Prof Song, Michael Zheng

14507523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507523.value: 要利用數字技術克服 “鮑莫爾病”—— 中華人民共和國副總理劉鶴 在過去的十年裏，中國經歷了快速的第三產業化進程。中國第三產業占 GDP 的比重從 2012 年的 45% 上升到 2020 年的 54%，而相對應的第二產業比重則從 46% 下降到 38%。此外，自 1978 年以來，第三產業就業人口占比穩步增長，而近十年來增速進一步加快，使得第三產業就業人口幾乎占到中國勞動力總數的一半。同一時期裏，中國經濟還經歷了產業技術的快速升級。以出口為例，2000 年以前，由於勞動力成本低廉的優勢，中國的出口主要集中在紡織、服裝、皮革和玩具等低附加值行業。而自 2000 年以來，中國在電子、機械和運輸設備出口方面建立起主導地位。隨著技術的飛速發展，生產資源不斷從工業部門向外轉移，這與鮑莫爾病的警告不謀而合——鮑莫爾病是一種增長不平衡的現象：如果第三產業的增長主要由需求驅動，那麽第三產業化進程將阻礙總生產率的提高。這種不平衡增長現象指出，如果第三產業的增長主要由需求驅動，而不是由重大的技術進步驅動，那麽第三產業化進程就會阻礙總生產率的提高。尤其是在中國副總理劉鶴在去年的世界互聯網大會上的主題演講中正式發出了鮑莫爾病的警告之後，中國經濟面臨鮑莫爾病的風險引發了世界的廣泛關注。 在本研究項目中，我們不僅從總量層面，還從企業動態層面，關於企業規模與增長的共同分布以及企業的進入和退出等角度，對中國的第三產業化進程進行了實證解析。這為理解中國第三產業化的本質和中國經濟中的鮑莫爾病風險鋪平了道路。我們獲取了涵蓋製造業和服務業的企業級調查和登記記錄，這使得我們能夠將製造業、生產性服務業和消費性服務業的部門生產率增長進一步分解為以下幾個方面的變化：（1）部門有效生產率；（2）行業內的資源錯配；（3）跨行業的資源錯配。我們分析了企業動態，例如不同企業規模的增長率差異、企業的進入與退出，是如何對上述分解的方面產生影響，以及這些影響在不同行業之間的差異，從而進一步地揭示了資源錯配與企業動態是如何共同塑造了中國的第三產業化進程。我們構建了一個全面的含企業動態與非同類偏好的多部門動態一般均衡模型，並將其與實際的中國經濟進行校準。通過定量框架下的反事實分析，我們能夠對中國的第三產業化進程進行福利分析，並提供政策建議，例如如何在資源錯配和企業動態並非微不足道的模型經濟中，對快速的第三產業化進程實施產業政策。

14507823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14507823.value: 關於會計政策的自主變更

14507823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14507823.value: 應計會計系統允許對相同的經濟交易進行不同處理方式。確認收入早（後）於現金時間(的會計處理 被視為自由(保守) 方式。先前文獻文件發現投資者認為 保守的會計選擇為理想的報告屬性( Francis等。 2005 )並獎勵 這種做法( Dechow等人2010)。但是，由於應應計會計系統只能重新分配 不同財政期間的現金收入,不能創造超出企業生命週期中的現金收益總約束範圍外收入 ，保守主義會計低估了(高估) 公司處於早期(晚期)階段時的收益。 為了實現“報告的”當前收益的最大可能的策略是早期採用自由主義 會計選擇,後期採用保守選擇。秘密在於 轉換為保守會計時,自由主義會計期間的累計準備金處理記錄為留存收益的期初餘額,不影響本期收益。軼事證據表明公司管理層經常使用 樣板語言以證明會計政策變更的合理性。某些天真的投資者只專注於當前收益而未能建立當前收益與先前收益的準備金聯繫， 可能會高估此類公司價值。 儘管會計政策的自願變更是與所有重大外部財務報表用戶相關的重要問題 ,由於數據不容易獲得,現有研究局限於有限 樣本量而得到結論也是相互矛盾。我們將 通過文本分析獲得涵蓋廣泛範圍和時間序列的會計政策變更大規模數據。我們想研究以下問題:首先,預期達到公司生命週期高峰是公司從自由派到保守派會計政策轉換的重要考慮因素 ? 其次,公司進入後期階段並改變為保守 會計選擇可以預測公司長期收入? 第三,投資者可以 看穿 通過轉換為保守的會計政策導致的盈餘膨脹嗎？

14600223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600223.value: 評估支持氣候的司法判決對減緩氣候變化的貢獻

14600223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600223.value: 在世界各地，氣候行動倡導者已將政府和企業告上法庭，以期促進採取更雄心勃勃的行動來減緩氣候變化，特別是通過減少溫室氣體排放。 有時，倡導者會佔上風，法院命令政府甚至企業實現法院本身指定的減排目標。 更常見的是，法院命令政府根據相關法律和政策採取法院認為適當的措施。 大量學者對這些有利於氣候行動倡導者的司法判決進行了批判性的探討。 例如，有人提出了一些問題，例如法院法律推理的說服力、這些判決與分權原則的一致性，以及科學證據在多大程度上可以用來確定被告在全球範圍內的“公平份額”。減緩氣候變化的努力。 因此，學術界的焦點主要集中在法院判決的有效性上。 儘管從法律角度來看其有效性，有利的法院判決可能會或可能不會有效地有助於緩解氣候變化。 人們對氣候訴訟實現真正緩解成果的能力知之甚少（例如 Setzer 和 Vanhala，2019 年；Peel 和 Osofsky，2020 年）。 有利於氣候行動倡導者的法院判決不僅在該判決未得到執行時可能無效，而且在其執行導致碳洩漏等意外後果時也可能無效。 例如，如果一家石油公司在競爭性環境中運營，那麼命令該公司減少排放的司法判決可能不會取得真正的緩解效果。 有時，意想不到的後果甚至可能導致全球溫室氣體排放量淨增加。 例如，限制天然氣生產的決定可能會使公用事業公司更難放棄煤炭（一種碳密集型能源）。 該項目評估了有利於氣候行動倡導者的司法判決的現實效果。 特別是，該項目確定在哪些情況下氣候行動倡導者的法庭勝利有助於緩解氣候變化。 該項目以現有的經濟研究和其他關於執行重要司法判決所採取措施的研究為基礎，以法律分析和排放核算為基礎，定量或定性地識別和評估氣候訴訟的各種後果——它們對排放量的直接影響。判斷的範圍及範圍，以及其間接（例如社會、政治和地緣政治）影響。 為了實施該項目，PI 利用他作為《聯合國氣候變化框架公約》專家名冊成員接受的排放核算培訓以及他在公共管理方面的背景來補充他的法律專業知識。 我們進行了原型案例研究，以評估烏爾根達訴荷蘭案司法判決的後果，這是迄今為止最著名的氣候訴訟之一。 發表在《環境法雜誌》上的結果表明，政府為遵守判決而採取的措施並沒有減少全球溫室氣體排放量，反而可能略有增加。 這尤其是因為對外國廢物進口徵稅導致更多廢物在英國被填埋，而不是在荷蘭通過能源回收進行焚燒。 該研究項目有助於確定 Urgenda 是否是一個例外，或者是否存在氣候訴訟無法產生氣候行動或適得其反的措施的根本原因。

14600423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14600423.value: 創造條件：香港城市剩餘空間臨時創造場所的新類型

14600423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14600423.value: Dr Cai, Ling Prof Hou, Jeffrey

14600423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600423.value: This research by design proposal seeks to combine two disconnected topics, “Urban Residual Spaces” and the disappearing “Culture of Making” within the city of Hong Kong. By weaving together these disparate subjects, the project aims to create an opportunity to engage directly with Hong Kong’s disenfranchised youth community, severely impacted by the unprecedented social unrest and Covid conditions that have afflicted the city in the last three years. Lost urban spaces arise due to the city’s extreme density coupled with the territory’s strict planning regulations, producing “by-product places” (Ferretto, 2019) that have the potential to become bridges to connect communities, specifically local craftspeople and the youth of the Sham Shui Po District. Building upon two previous research projects this proposal employs the architectural prototype as a vehicle to generate knowledge. The prototype is an exploratory and experimental learning vehicle that allows an idea to be translated, implemented and tested in terms of direct impact on the community. “Prototypes are engines of change, they contain systems that create an output that changes an environment, they enable us to study the effect of that output” (Bunschoten, 2010) hence our proposed prototype becomes a didactic framework to investigate stakeholders' concerns, provide insights regarding community engagement and a means to transfer practical knowledge into theory. Hong Kong has a long history of “making”, from pre-war handmade goods to mass-manufactured products of the 1960s. However, after the 1979 development of the Pearl River Delta region most Hong Kong factories relocated to the Mainland, leaving behind a set of tenacious craftspeople who kept their trades alive by adapting their skills to the city’s new conditions. The bamboo scaffolding epitomizes this “inherited ingenious DIY wisdom” (Siu, 2013) where a traditional practice is reinvented to become an alternative construction method. Our research question focuses on investigating the relationship between “making” and community engagement. Can making spaces help foster a better sense of belonging, reconnect detached generations, and ultimately by engaging the mind with the hands help establish a culture of learning by making? Young people today live in a culture where everything is closed and sealed, hiding prevents interrogation, restrains problem finding and dampens curiosity (Ingold, 2013). This project aims to create the conditions, physical and educational, that awaken a sense of awareness in thinking by doing, connect people with materials and attempt to reestablish a making culture within Hong Kong. 這項設計方案研究旨在將兩個互不相關的主題結合起來：“城市剩餘空間”和香港城市內正在消失的“製造文化”。通過將這些不同的主題編織在一起，該項目旨在創造一個機會，讓人們能夠直接接觸香港被剝奪權利的青年群體，這些青年群體在過去三年中受到了前所未有的社會動盪和新冠疫情的嚴重影響。潛在城市空間的出現是由於城市的極端密度加上該地區嚴格的規劃規定，產生了“副產品場所”（Ferretto P. W.，剩餘思維：回收香港失去的城市空間，2019），這些副產品有可能成為連接香港的橋樑社區，特別是深水埗區的本地工匠和青年。 該提案以之前的兩個研究項目為基礎，採用架構原型作為生成知識的工具。該原型是一種探索性和實驗性的學習工具，可以將想法轉化、實施和測試，以對社區產生直接影響。 “原型是變革的引擎，它們包含創建改變環境的輸出的系統，它們使我們能夠研究該輸出的影響”（Bunschoten，2010）因此我們提出的原型成為一個教學框架，用於調查利益相關者的擔憂，提供關於社區參與的見解以及將實踐知識轉化為理論的方法。 香港擁有悠久的“製造”歷史，從戰前的手工製品到20世紀60年代的大規模製造產品。然而，1979年珠江三角洲地區發展後，大多數香港工廠遷往內地，留下了一批頑強的工匠，他們通過調整自己的技能以適應城市的新情況，使自己的行業得以生存。竹腳手架體現了這種“繼承的巧妙的DIY智慧”（Siu，2013），傳統做法被重新發明，成為一種替代的施工方法。 我們的研究問題側重於調查“製作”與社區參與之間的關係。創造空間能否有助於培養更好的歸屬感，重新連接疏遠的幾代人，並最終通過用手來思考，幫助建立一種通過創造來學習的文化？今天的年輕人生活在一種一切都封閉和密封的文化中，隱藏可以防止審訊，限制發現問題並抑制好奇心（Ingold，Making：人類學，考古學，藝術和建築，2013）。該項目旨在創造物質和教育條件，通過實踐喚醒思考意識，將人與材料聯繫起來，並嘗試在香港重建製造文化。

14600723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14600723.value: 隨著中國與全球的國際交易增加，理解中國法院根據中國的私法國際私法會在哪種情況下行使管轄權至關重要。評論者指出，中國法院在選擇適用法律上有一種“回家去的趨勢”，即“在可能的情況下，法院會適用國內法的趨勢”。類似的回家去的趨勢也可能存在於中國法院在行使管轄權的實踐上。法院傾向行使管轄權，而不會因為在某些案件裡不合適行使管轄權而將案件的管轄權讓給外國法院。這可能導致中國與其他法域之間產生管轄權衝突。最高人民法院最近將禁訟令權力添加到中國法院就是一個例子。與此同時，海牙私法國際法會議已經重新啟動了旨在協調全球管轄規則的管轄權項目。因此，現在正是對中國的管轄制度進行全面研究的最佳時機。本項目旨在研究中國法院在處理管轄權問題方面的司法實踐。它旨在解答三個問題：1. 在中國法院的管轄規則應用中是否存在“回家去的趨勢”？2. 是什麼原因促成了目前的司法實踐狀況？3. 可以提出哪些建議來改進目前的狀況（例如加入海牙管轄權項目的最終公約）？本項目將進行實證研究，收集並研究有關這些問題的數據。該等數據源自審查過去二十年（2003年至2022年）中國法院所有有關國際合同管轄權的案件。此外，本項目將進行比較研究，將中國的管轄權規則與美國、歐盟和海牙會議的草案公約的管轄權規則進行對比。這項研究的調查結果對學術界和律師都具有重大價值。鑑於中國與世界各國的互動，任何學者都無法忽視中國的國際私法。對於律師也非常重要——不僅僅是在中國執業的律師，而是全球每一位在國際爭端解決方面提供建議的律師。這項研究是本人對中國國際私法實證研究的最後一部分。本人已經進行了關於適用法（獲傑出青年學者計劃資助）和在中國執行外國判決的研究。在完成後，此項目將揭示中國國際私法的全貌。

14601023.value: 兒童性别規範化/非規範化與社交心理發展

14601023.value: Dr Li, Gu Dr van der Miesen, Anna I. R. Dr VanderLaan, Doug
rows: Dr van der Miesen, Anna I. R.

14601023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601023.value: 性別是人類生活的一個核心組織特徵。近來,人們對兒童性別非規範化(GN,一種廣義的術語,指身分認同和行為不跟從文化定義的性別規範;GN也指形容詞「不同性別規範」)表示濃厚興趣。部分GN兒童可能為跨性別或出現性別認同障礙。研究GN兒童有助於更好地理解性別發展,同時亦因為GN兒童面對較高的社交心理挑戰，相關研究尤其重要。現時關於 GN 兒童的科學證據稀少,且主要依賴門診轉介的兒童。 最近的研究強調要研究社區內的GN兒童,因為社區兒童的GN也存在高低程度,並同樣與社交心理風險有關。關於中國等非西方國家的兒童GN研究尤為罕見,儘管中國龐大的青年人口和社會文化因素使得 GN 成為一個重要的話題。 除了抽樣存在差距外,還存在幾個理論差距。例如,朋輩關係與 GN個人的社交心理福祉顯著相關,但仍很少研究測試它是否一種保護機制 。之前的研究也主要關注人們表達出來的GN,而不是個體感知自己的GN程度。普遍來說,人們對 GN兒童感受到的性別相似性知之甚少,以及這如何影響他們的福祉感。最後,人們有可能對這些兒童面臨的挑戰缺乏認知。消極結果的看法可能是一個兩刃劍 —— 一方面,負面結果的擔憂可能有助於阻止對 GN的鼓勵,另一方面,知道這些結果能促進更多的支持與理解。同時調查兒童的福祉結果和人們對GC和GN兒童的預期結果將闡明不同性別類型兒童的性別認知和社會心理結果,從而有助於提供更貼身的公共教育和臨床計劃,滿足不同需求。這項研究也將為測量工具 GN 提供數據並建立第一個大型GN中國兒童數據庫,進而促進在此領域的未來跟蹤研究。 這項工作將同時有助於開始萌芽的中國兒童性別認同障礙的臨床工作。 在第一項研究中,一萬位中國地區六至十二歲兒童的父母將在線完成有關兒童GN的結構化測量以及社交心理福祉。分析將著重於GN的模式、 與社交心理成果的聯繫,以及朋輩關系作爲一個風險因素 ,說明GN與社交心理結果之間的關系。從大量多樣化的第一項研究樣本中,我們將會抽出三百位兒童參與第二項研究，分別爲一百個跨性別/性別非規範化(GN)、性別規範化(GC)以及相對中性的兒童。 實驗會記錄兒童感知性別相似性以及 GC 與 GN 兒童的社交心理結果。分析將著重於兒童表達出來的GN與內在感知的GN與社交心理福祉的關聯,以及參與者對於描述爲 GC或者GN 的兒童的社交心理結果的看法。此項研究將有助於性別發展理論與實踐,同時秉乘國際上對於GN研究的蓬勃興趣，填補中國背景中知識的稀缺。

14601323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601323.value: 利用社交媒體數據監測交通服務滿意度並評估地鐵系統服務質量改進計劃的有效性

14601323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14601323.value: Prof Jian, Sisi Dr Luo, Shuli Prof SONG, Linqi

14601323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601323.value: To reduce car dependence and achieve low-carbon transport in cities, it is critical to ensure public transport service quality. Two monitoring and evaluation approaches are traditionally used for public transport projects: statistics (e.g. headway/frequency, punctuality) and customer surveys. The former presents an objective way to monitor the system, but it does not reflect user experience. The latter captures a user’s subjective experience, but it only communicates a momentary experience rather than their experience over the course of a lengthy monitoring period. Although repeated panel surveys – and even single, cross-sectional surveys – may inquire about repeated occurrences or more extended time spans, the conventional survey approach remains costly and unable to reflect user satisfaction levels in a timely manner. This research proposes an analytical strategy for monitoring user satisfaction with transit services and evaluating the effectiveness of a transport service improvement in the urban service system, a procedure that can inform urban policy in the interest of appropriate resource usage. We will argue for involving public users in the monitoring and evaluating intervention plans via a social sensing approach. The social-media–driven proliferation of voluntary user information collection has enabled the retrieval of users’ subjective opinions. We aim to apply social media analysis methods to monitor the spatial and temporal variation of transit user satisfaction levels across different service quality dimensions in connection with selected programmes. As a preliminary step, we have identified relevant recent (2019–2022) service quality improvement programmes for urban rail (or metro) systems in the three largest cities of the Greater Bay Area (GBA): Hong Kong, Guangzhou and Shenzhen. This proposed project aims to achieve four tasks. First, we will compile a social media dataset to examine passenger perceptions of the metro system. We will apply the latest machine learning techniques to remove fake and duplicate reviews. Second, to address concerns about population bias in the social media data, we will estimate population bias in social media data and perform a questionnaire survey in our “ground truth” approach to offset any potential bias. Third, we will develop a transport-domain-oriented BERT model, which we coin as TransBERT, and use it for sentiment analysis of passenger perceptions of the metro system. Lastly, we will analyse the sentiment variation and transit ridership before and after the implementation of selected service quality improvement programmes as a new evaluation tool for programme effectiveness. 公共交通服務質量對於減少對於汽車的依賴及實現城市低碳交通至關重要。公共交通項目傳統上使用兩種監測和評估方法：統計和客戶調查。前者提供了一種客觀的系統監控方式，但並不能反映用戶體驗。後者捕獲了用戶的主觀體驗，但它僅傳達了瞬時體驗，而不是他們在長時間監控期間的體驗。本研究提出了一種分析策略，用於監測用戶對交通服務的滿意度，並評估城市服務系統中交通服務改進的有效性，這一程序可以為城市政策提供信息，以促進適當的資源利用。我們將通過社會感知方法讓公眾用戶參與監測和評估干預計劃。社交媒體驅動的自願用戶信息收集的激增使得用戶主觀意見的檢索成為可能。我們的目標是應用社交媒體分析方法來監測與選定項目相關的不同服務質量維度的交通用戶滿意度的空間和時間變化。我們已確定了大灣區 (GBA) 三個最大城市：香港、廣州和深圳的城市軌道交通（或地鐵）系統近期（2019-2022 年）相關服務質量提升計劃。該項目旨在實現四項任務。首先，我們將編譯一個社交媒體數據集來檢查乘客對地鐵系統的看法。我們將應用最新的機器學習技術來刪除虛假和重複的評論。其次，我們將估計社交媒體數據中的人口偏見，並進行問卷調查以抵消潛在的偏見。第三，我們將開發一個面向運輸領域的 BERT 模型，我們將其命名為 TransBERT，並將其用於乘客對地鐵系統感知的情感分析。最後，我們將分析所選服務質量改善計劃實施前後的情緒變化和公交乘客量，作為地鐵系統服務質量改進計劃有效性的新評估工具。

14601723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14601723.value: 無領導組織：對推特抗議中無領導程度的系統考察

14601723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14601723.value: Contemporary protest movements, especially on social media, are usually portrayed by the mass media as the manifestation of a new age of leaderless revolution. Publicly identifiable leaders and formal organizations are commonly absent in these movements, and social media has been thought to enable and accelerate leaderless social movements. Previous studies have discussed the advantages and disadvantages of leaderlessness in networked social movements based on case studies. However, the concept of leaderlessness has not been well articulated and operationalized. This problem further hinders systematic comparisons of leaderlessness across protest movements around the globe and thus makes causal inferences about the consequences of leaderlessness difficult. To fill this gap, the proposed study will extend our previous research to define leaderlessness in terms of unequal distribution of influence on social media and the instability of diffused leaders over the trajectories of networked movements. Furthermore, the proposed study will archive a large-scale and comprehensive database of major Twitter protests (more than 100), including all related tweets (more than 1 billion) and metadata regarding protest movements (e.g., number of participants, duration, state response). Combing the new measure of leaderlessness and the archive of protest movements, the proposed study will test the relationships between leaderlessness and coordination and other protest characteristics, including the outcomes of the social movements. The proposed study will help social movement researchers analyze social media protests in more systematic ways and draw more meaningful comparisons. In addition, the findings are expected to suggest how citizens could coordinate through leaderless structures and how governments could respond more appropriately to leaderlessness. Finally, it will advance our understanding of leaderless structures and online coordination that may go beyond protest movements, such as online election and marketing campaigns. 當代的抗爭性社會運動，特別是在社交媒體上運動，通常被大眾媒體描繪為新時代無領導性革命的一種體現。 這些運動通常缺乏公開可識別的領袖和正式組織。社交媒體被認為能夠促進和加速無領導社會運動的發展。 以往的研究基於案例研究，討論了網路社會運動中無領導性的優缺點。 然而，無領導這一概念並沒有被很好地闡述和操作化。 這一問題阻礙了對全球抗議運動中無領導性的系統比較，因此使得關於無領導性後果的因果推斷非常困難。 為了填補這一研究空缺，擬議研究將擴展我們以前的研究，將無領導性定義為社交媒體上影響分佈不均和網路運動軌跡上分散領導的不穩定性。 此外，擬議研究將建立一個大規模推特抗議運動數據庫（超過100個），包括其所有相關推文（超過10億條）以及有關抗議運動的元數據（例如參與者數量、持續時間、國家回應等）。 結合新的無領導性度量和抗議運動檔案，擬議研究將檢驗運動無領導性與協調性以及其它抗議特徵之間的關係，包括社會運動的結果。 擬議研究將幫助社會運動研究人員以更系統的方式分析社交媒體上的抗議，並進行更有意義的比較。 此外，研究結果有望提出公民如何通過無領導結構進行協調以及政府如何更適當地回應無領導性。 最後，它將推進我們對無領導結構和在線協調的理解，這可能超出了抗議運動，例如在線選舉和營銷活動。

14602223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14602223.value: 人工智能外推的文化後果

14602223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14602223.value: Dr Yousefzadeh, Roozbeh Prof Zang, Emma

14602223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14602223.value: Imagine: you are a young, well-educated, immigrant woman applying for a mortgage and getting rejected. An AI model assessed your profile and made that decision. The model had learned from the data of past mortgage holders. So, you want to know if the model has seen anyone as young and educated as you are (i.e., whether the training set contains profiles similar to the testing sample). If it has not seen anyone like you, it must have made educated guesses in at least some dimensions of your attributes, such as age and education. In math terms, such "guesses" are called "extrapolation." Extrapolations performed by AI models are hidden by default. Because they are hidden, their consequences go unseen in cases of unjustified extrapolation. This study will help us see extrapolations and then draw on cultural theories to build a conceptual framework for AI accountability. In current regulatory frameworks of the European Union, United States, China, and Hong Kong, AI accountability is vaguely defined as a call for data privacy and a need to improve ethical practices during data collection without a measure for discriminatory decisions. AI-driven platforms confront us with unfair decisions wrongly assumed to be correct simply because they are automated. We will reveal the exact ways AI makes unjustified decisions. This project combines two fields—cultural theory and machine learning—where collaborations remain nascent. This project partakes in the larger debate on AI's reconfiguration of gender, ethnicity, and other cultural differences. The proliferating scholarship pronouncing the crisis of diversity and its fatal capture by AI indicates the battle fought yesterday about human emancipation continues today on the terrain of machine learning. The issue is not that machines do not know cultural differences; a trained model knows them only too well. The problem is that extrapolated differences are assumed to be justified because algorithms have automated these dimensions. We have done similar quantitative research using US adult income datasets. This project will extend our previous work to HK's labor, wage, and employment datasets 2016-2021 (accessible on the website of the Department of Statistics). The dataset is helpful in two ways: first, it provides up-to-date reference points, and second, it brings the Eurocentric studies of AI ethics to the specific contexts of East Asia. The extended research will help identify vulnerable groups in AI-driven economies. 假设您是一位年輕、受過良好教育的移民女性，申請抵押貸款並遭到拒絕。人工智能模型評估了您的個人資料並做出了決定。該模型學習了過去抵押貸款持有人的數據中。因此，您想知道該模型是否見過像您一樣年輕且受過教育的人（即traning set是否包含與測試樣本相似的資料）。如果它沒有見過像您這樣的人，那麼它一定至少在您屬性的某些方面（例如年齡和教育程度）做出了猜測。用數學術語來說，這種“猜測”稱為“外推法”。 AI 模型執行的外推默認情況下是隱藏的。所以在不合理的推斷的情況下，它們的後果也是看不见的。我們將揭示人工智能如何做出不合理決定的確切方式。人工智能驅動的平台讓我們面臨不公平的決策，僅僅因為它們是自動化的，就被錯誤地認為是正確的。這項研究將幫助我們利用文化理論來構建人工智能問責制的概念框架。在歐盟、美國、中國和香港的現行監管框架中，人工智能問責制被模糊地定義為數據隱私及數據收集，而少採取歧視性決策措施。

14603023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603023.value: 不確定下的新聞風險評估和管理: 對香港新聞自由前景的啟示

14603023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603023.value: The Hong Kong society and its news media had experienced significant changes since the end of the mass protests in 2019 and the establishment of the National Security Law in 2020. The news media have to grapple with the new and often ambiguous legal environment. With the closing down of critical media outlets and arrests of journalists in 2021, Hong Kong’s ranking in Reporters Without Borders’ press freedom index dropped from 73rd in 2019 to 148th in 2022. For some observers, changes in the media scene are part of the overall process of the city’s democratic backsliding. However, it could be misleading and oversimplifying to declare the complete “death” of press freedom in the city. Many journalists are still trying to hold onto their normative self-understanding as independent professionals serving the public interest while constantly assessing and managing the risks associated with their work. Against this background, this project asks: How do media organizations and journalists assess and manage the risks associated with the reporting of “sensitive” topics under the condition of uncertainty? How does the new legal and political environment impinge on journalistic work indirectly via the creation of “frictions” in news reporting? How does the nature and character of media self-censorship change? How do journalists negotiate and revise their normative understanding of journalistic professionalism in the process? Through tackling these questions, the project shall help derive a more nuanced and concrete understanding of the condition of press freedom in Hong Kong from the perspective of media operation and journalistic practices. It facilitates an appreciation of the continual strategic interactions and negotiation between journalists and their working environment. Since the news media constitute a core institution in a modern society, the study shall also inform us about the prospect of Hong Kong as a liberal enclave within China. Beyond Hong Kong, this study shall enrich our theoretical understanding of media freedom in hybrid regimes and/or societies experiencing democratic backsliding. It draws upon and further develops a relational and interactional perspective on media freedom, which sees media freedom as being constantly negotiated and realized through the strategic interactions among multiple players inside a relational field. This study shall also generate new insights on long-standing topics such as the concept of self-censorship, while the notions of risk assessment and management should expand our understanding of the ways media and journalists attempt to respond to political pressure and maintain their professionalism simultaneously. 在2019年反修例運動及2020年港區國安法生效之後，香港社會和新聞媒體均經歷了重大轉變。新聞界需要掌握如何在新的以及往往是模糊的法律環境之下運作。2021年，有香港記者反拘捕及控告，亦有具批判性的媒體結業。香港在無國界記者的新聞自由世界排名由2019年的73位下跌至2022年的第148位。一些觀察者認為，新聞媒體的轉變，是香港過去數年所經歷的民主倒退的一部分。 不過，單純地指新聞自由已"死"，可能會過份簡化現實的狀況。很多新聞工作者仍然嘗試守護其身份和理念，仍然視自己為獨立於政治和商業力量以外，為公眾提供服務的專業人士。但不能否定，他們亦同時需要時刻評估及管理工作涉及的風險。 在以上的背景下，本研究計劃的主要問題是，在不確性高的環境中，新聞機構及記者如何評估和管理報道"敏感"議題時附帶的風險? 新的法律和政治環境如何通常產生"磨擦力"而影響新聞工作? 自我審查的特徵如何轉變? 在整個過程中，香港的新聞工作者如何商議及調整對專業理念的理解? 通過回應這些問題，本研究將有助社會更細緻及具體地，通過了解新聞工作的運作和實踐，了解香港新聞自由的狀況。計劃的發現將揭示新聞工作者與政治環境之間持續不斷的策略互動。由於新聞媒體是任何一個現代社會中的主要社會制度之一，本研究亦可幫助我們理解香港社會整體的發展，尤其是香港在甚麼意義和程度上仍有可能是中國境內一個相對自由的空間。 在香港以外，這個研究可以增進人們對混合型政體以及經歷民主倒退的社會的理解。本研究會延續並推展一種強調關係和互動的對媒體自由的理論觀點。本研究亦會就著一些重要的和由來已久的問題和現象 -- 如媒體自我審查 -- 提出新的發現。而風險評估和管理則可以擴大現存文獻對媒體和新聞工作者如何應對政治壓力的分析。

14603523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14603523.value: 行動與決定：人們在追求獎勵時如何做出退出決定？

14603523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14603523.value: 人們會辭職，這可能讓營銷人員和管理者感到困惑。 據《福布斯》報導，儘管 Netflix 在 2022 年贏得了多項金球獎和艾美獎，但 2022 年仍將連續失去數百萬訂閱用戶。 《衛報》還報導稱，當英國取消新冠病毒限制後，英國辦公室職員似乎比其他歐洲國家的同事更不願意回到辦公桌前。 與此同時，一些運動員似乎面臨著相反的問題：湯姆·布雷迪（Tom Brady），如穆罕默德·阿里（Muhammad Ali）和邁克爾·喬丹（Michael Jordan），可能會成為另一個“G.O.A.T.”。 （有史以來最偉大的）只是不知道如何退休。 這些觀察激發我們思考： • 是什麼讓人們決定退出？ • 為什麼有些人會輕易退出，而另一些人卻覺得彷彿猶豫不決？ • 在決定是否退出時，人們如何進行成本效益分析？ • 在設計獎勵計劃時，營銷人員和管理人員可以採取哪些措施來戰略性地促使人們做出退出決定，而不剝奪他們的選擇自由？ 我們提出了一個行為科學項目，旨在了解人們如何決定退出。 我們的研究涉及獎勵追求的情況，在這種情況下，人們會付出成本（努力、時間或金錢）來獲得利益，並提出獎勵結構會影響退出決策：人們在零碎獎勵下比在一次性獎勵下更有可能退出獎勵。 我們的主張建立在“決策點”的概念之上（Soman 2015）。 在實驗室和現場環境中設計了六個實驗，目的是（a）表明決策點是人們考慮退出獎勵追求的關鍵必要條件，（b）揭示哪種獎勵結構會引發更多決策點，以及（b ）揭示當人們在決策點停下來思考時，會考慮成本，而不是收益。 我們的研究旨在做出三項不同的貢獻。 首先，它通過區分決策（有決策點）和行動（沒有決策點）並確定決策點的力量，對決策文獻做出了貢獻。 其次，它對動機和目標文獻做出了貢獻，不僅強調了退出決策的獨特性，而且解決了現有文獻中尚未解答的一個有趣的問題：為什麼有些人退出太容易，而另一些人則覺得退出太難。 最後但並非最不重要的一點是，對於香港的營銷人員和經理來說，我們的研究為如何戰略性地設計激勵計劃以解決客戶群萎縮和人才流失問題提供了建議。

14604323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604323.value: 香港的網絡攻擊行為：以話語為中心的網絡民族學研究

14604323.label: Project Objectives
14604323.value: To investigate online aggression as situated social and discourse practices; To uncover the covert discourse strategies of online aggression that are not immediately recognizable through micro-linguistic analysis; To complement existing cyberbullying research by offering a comprehensive understanding of the issue from the voices of different social actors, including netizens, bystander users, and policy makers; To identify possible mismatches between public perceptions and institutional definitions of online aggression; To explore policy implications to enhance public’s critical awareness of online aggression in the future.
rows: To investigate online aggression as situated social and discourse practices;
To uncover the covert discourse strategies of online aggression that are not immediately recognizable through micro-linguistic analysis;

To complement existing cyberbullying research by offering a comprehensive understanding of the issue from the voices of different social actors, including netizens, bystander users, and policy makers;
To identify possible mismatches between public perceptions and institutional definitions of online aggression;
To explore policy implications to enhance public’s critical awareness of online aggression in the future.

14604323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604323.value: Online aggression, which often results in cyberbullying, is a problem of increasing concern around the world. This known social issue is hard to define and tackle, because online aggression is highly complex and contextual in nature, and its complexity lies in its wide range of motives and forms of expression. In Hong Kong, cyberbullying is a significant yet under-researched topic. The limited literature thus far suggests that addressing cyberbullying requires efforts from multiple disciplines and stakeholders. Existing research usually relies on participants’ self-reports and very little is done on how online aggression unfolds in actual interactional contexts, and rarely is there a study that draws on voices from multiple social actors. Understanding online aggression as a situated social practice, this project aims to complement existing research by offering a language and discourse dimension to the topic. The aim is to reveal the complexity and multiplicity of aggression through analyzing the digital practices and discourses of different social actors, including netizens, bystanders, the government and law enforcement bodies. Seeing online aggression as a contextualized discourse practice allows for a close examination of the conditions under which aggression takes place, the strategic digital practices and discourse strategies adopted by netizens, how aggression is constantly redefined and justified as acceptable in various contexts of communication, and how online aggression is constructed differently by stakeholders including policy makers. Focusing on three cases of aggression on the local forum LIHKG, the study adopts a discourse-centred online ethnographic (DCOE) research design (Androutsopoulos, 2008), combining systematic observation of online discursive practices and interviews. Both screen-based and user-based data will be collected. Phase 1 contextualizes the study by reviewing recent literature and media reports, and identifies major themes of online aggression. Through conducting digital ethnography and Critical Discourse Analysis of a selection of LIHKG posts, Phase 2 observes the digital practices and discursive strategies deployed by netizens that (re)define, legitimize and naturalize aggressive behavior. To complement and explain Phase 2’s findings, Phase 3 elicits insider users’ perspectives through data-prompted interviews with regular LIHKG users who report to have witnessed or participated in discussions related to the three focal cases. Phase 4 collects relevant policy documents and analyzes institutional definitions and representations of online aggression, and reveals possible mismatches between young people’s and institutional understanding of the issue. It is hoped that this project will eventually facilitate more accurate and informed policy development in the future. 網絡欺凌是全球日益關注的問題。這個社會問題難以定義和解決，因為網絡攻擊行為的性質高度複雜和具有情境性，其複雜性在於其廣泛的動機和表達形式。在香港，網絡欺凌是一個重要但尚未得到充分研究的話題。迄今為止，有限的文獻表明，解決網絡欺凌需要多學科和利益相關者的努力。現有的研究通常依賴參與者的自我報告，很少研究網絡攻擊行為在實際互動情境中的展現，也很少有研究從多個社會行為者的聲音中獲得資料。 本研究旨在通過提供語言和話語層面的維度，補充現有研究，揭示網民、旁觀者、政府和執法機構的話語。本研究將網絡攻擊行為視為一種情境化的話語實踐，仔細研究攻擊行為發生的條件，網民如何在不同的溝通情境中不斷重新定義和合理化網絡攻擊行為，以及政策制定者等利益相關者如何不同地構建網絡攻擊行為。 本研究聚焦於本地論壇LIHKG上三個攻擊事件，採用“以話語為中心的網絡民族學”（Androutsopoulos，2008）的研究設計，結合對網絡話語實踐的系統觀察和訪談 收集基於屏幕和用戶的數據。第一階段通過回顧最近的文獻和媒體報導，確定了網絡攻擊行為的主要主題。第二階段通過對選定的LIHKG帖子進行數字民族學和批判性話語分析，觀察網民採用的話語策略，以重新定義、合理化和自然化攻擊行為。為了補充和解釋第二階段的發現，第三階段通過數據引導的訪談，收集LIHKG用戶的觀點。第四階段收集相關政策文件，分析政策制定者如何定義和構建網絡攻擊行為，以及他們如何解決這個問題。 網絡攻擊行為是一個複雜且需要多學科和利益相關者參與的問題。通過理解網絡攻擊行為的語言和話語層面，可以更好地揭示攻擊行為的本質和發生的條件，從而制定更有效的解決方案。

14604423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604423.value: 同步電腦中介傳播與面對面溝通模式對第二語言學員在協作前任務規劃的參與度對解決問題任務表現的影響：跨個體與內個體觀點

14604423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604423.value: 目標：本研究探討如何利用同步電腦中介傳播（SCMC）工具支持第二語言（L2）學習參與度。研究將檢視香港英語作為第二語言（ESL）學員在SCMC和面對面模式規劃口語任務的參與，規劃參與度對未來英語任務表現成功的預測，及在過程中的瞬時影響因素。 背景：任務型語言教學（TBLT）是種教學法，旨在透過有意義的任務培養學員L2溝通技能。為準備學員應對任務，一個重要策略是協作任務前規劃。這包括讓兩名或更多學員有時間計劃未來使用L2進行任務時的內容（說什麼）和語言（如何說）。雖有研究探討任務前規劃對任務表現產生語言質量的影響，鮮有研究專注規劃本身的參與。這是重要的研究領域，因參與的各個維度（行為、認知、社交和情感）可能會影響語言和內容質量，學員在以後能否回想起計劃內容，及最終任務的學習價值。在目前的教育環境，語言教師也需要考慮SCMC工具（如視訊會議，文本通訊軟件）是否能夠像面對面溝通般吸引學員參與。 描述：研究將採用混合方法設計，實驗後將進行多重個案研究。實驗能對兩種規劃模式（SCMC，面對面）對L2協作規劃參與度以及規劃參與度與任務表現間的關係進行概率判斷（即跨個體觀點）。共128名大學本科ESL學生將在SCMC或面對面模式下完成配對規劃任務，之後進行英語獨白任務。量化測量包括：（1）規劃話語行為、認知和社交參與的指標；（2）每秒情感參與評分，以衡量情感參與；及（3）於任務表現的語義（L2編碼的想法）的測量。多重個案研究將涉及24名有目的選擇的個體。此外，個案研究將利用刺激回憶訪談，旨在了解學員在一刻到一刻的規劃參與如何與後續任務中的語義內容相關（即內個體觀點）。 意義：研究將提供有關行為、認知、社交和情感參與維度在SCMC和面對面下的體現，參與如何預測後續L2任務中計劃的語義內容，及個體和情境因素如何在一刻到一刻間帶來成功的規劃。方法上，研究的創新在使用自我動態法來衡量情感參與（使用電腦程式進行的每秒情感評分）。這在TBLT研究中是新穎的，且在前任務規劃研究尚未使用。這方法克服了TBLT研究中常用的任務後問卷的局限（記憶偏差、缺乏動態數據），並使情感參與的衡量維度與其他維度的話語測量方法一致。由於研究針對在英語教學環境中最需要英語支援的大學生（中文教學學校的大一學生），結果將為希望改善線上課堂中學員參與度和L2學習的英語教師提供急需的實證建議。

14604623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604623.value: 信息傳播的年齡差異：社會網絡角度

14604623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14604623.value: Ms Chen, Amber Xuqian Dr Li, Tianyuan Prof Liang, Yucheng Prof LU, Minjie Dr Zhang, Fan Ms Zhang, Hanyu

14604623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604623.value: Older adults are more vulnerable to spreading misinformation compared with younger age groups, damaging their reputation, reinforcing negative age stereotypes, and making themselves and those around them more vulnerable to frauds. The mainstream explanation attributes these age differences to cognitive failures, such as inattentiveness and lack of analytical thinking among older adults. This proposed project attempts to complement or even challenge this dominant view by suggesting that older adults may share more misinformation than younger adults for socioemotional reasons. We attempt to explain age differences in information sharing based on our previous work on socioemotional selectivity theory. The theory argues that people shift their prioritization from knowledge-related goals to socioemotional goals with age. The social functions of a piece of information may sometimes be more important than its accuracy to older adults. Moreover, the focus on socioemotional goals also makes older adults more likely to have smaller social networks with a higher percentage of close social partners. This type of social networks is called “dense” social networks in social network research. According to the finite population learning model, a network with higher density tends to serve social functions rather than informational functions. These smaller and denser social networks may make the social cues of information (even misinformation) more salient for older than younger adults. Such salient social cues may motivate older adults to share information even when the perceived credibility of the information is lower. To test these hypotheses, Study 1 will use big data approach and social network analysis to analyze naturalistic data from Facebook, examining whether older adults are more likely to share misinformation than are younger adults, and whether these age differences are more likely to occur when the social networks are denser. Study 2 tests the same hypotheses in a laboratory setting where older and younger adults decide whether to share information, which varies in credibility and social cues, to their close vs peripheral social partners. Study 3 will directly manipulate the density of social networks via structured conversations. We will test, in an interactive environment, whether older adults’ message sharing behavior is more highly influenced by social cues but less by credibility, in denser than sparser social networks, compared with younger adults. These findings, if obtained, may suggest that the current practice of improving digital literacy of older adults may not be sufficient to reduce their misinformation spread. Interventions should target social cues as well. 與年輕群體相比，老年人更容易傳播錯誤信息，從而損害他們的聲譽，強化負面的年齡刻板印象，並使他們和身邊的人更容易受到欺詐。主流解釋將這些年齡差異歸因於認知失敗，例如老年人注意力不集中和缺乏分析思維等。此項目試圖補充甚至挑戰這種主流觀點，認為由於社會情感原因，老年人可能比年輕人分享更多的錯誤信息。我們試圖根據先前關於社會情緒選擇理論的研究來解釋信息共享中的年齡差異。該理論認為，隨著年齡的增長，人們會將優先考慮的目標從與知識相關的目標轉向社會情感目標。對於老年人來說，一條信息的社會功能有時可能比其準確性更重要。此外，對社會情感目標的關注也使得老年人更有可能擁有較小的社交網絡和較高比例的親密社會夥伴。這種類型的社交網絡在社交網絡研究中被稱為“密集”社交網絡。根據有限群體學習模型，密度較高的網絡往往服務於社會功能而不是信息功能。這些更細小密集的社交網絡可能會使信息（甚至錯誤信息）的社交線索對老年人比年輕人更顯著。這種顯著的社交線索可能會激勵老年人分享信息，即使信息的可信度較低。 為了檢驗這些假設，研究一將使用大數據方法和社交網絡分析來分析Facebook的自然數據，研究老年人是否比年輕人更容易分享錯誤信息，以及這些年齡差異是否更有可能在社交網絡更加密集時發生。研究二在實驗室環境中測試了相同的假設，其中老年人和年輕人決定是否與他們的親密和外圍社會夥伴分享信息，這些信息的可信度和社會線索各不相同。研究三將通過結構化對話直接操縱社交網絡的密度。我們將在互動環境中測試，與年輕人相比，老年人在更密集而不是更稀疏的社交網絡中，信息共享的行為是否更多受到社交線索的影響，較少受到可信度的影響。 如果有了這些發現，可能表明當前提升老年人數位素養的做法可能不足以減少他們的錯誤信息傳播。此外，干預措施也應針對社會線索。

14604923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14604923.value: 標題：沉澱的意識：現象學、詮釋學與解構學

14604923.label: Project Objectives
14604923.value: The central objective is to offer a systematic and comprehensive analysis of sedimentations by publishing four articles, which would clarify the meaning of concept of sedimentation and address its function, meaning and significance in phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction. To this day, no such study has been offered in any of these fields of research. Another objective is to organize an international conference, “What is Sedimentation? Consciousness, History, Language,” which would address a large variety of ways in which sedimentations has been and can be further conceptualized in phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction. The third objective is to develop a new course at The Chinese University of Hong Kong, which would introduce the students to these three major traditions in Continental thought while focusing on the plethora of themes associated with this research project. The fourth objective is to show how the analysis of sedimentations that we come across in genetic phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction enriches our understanding of the historicity of consciousness and how it opens the possibility for further investigation into the topic. The fifth objective is to provide a new theoretical framework to conceptualize the relation between three major traditions in Continental thought: phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction. All three are concerned with the sedimentations of consciousness, which they address on the basis of distinct philosophical strategies. The objective is to articulate with precision these three distinct philosophical strategies while focusing on the concept of reactivation in genetic phenomenology, innovation in hermeneutics, and de-sedimentation in deconstruction. The sixth objective is to investigate the possibility of applying the concept of sedimentation in philosophy of culture while focusing on its significance in the phenomenological and hermeneutical investigations of the constitution of the lifeworld. The seventh objective is to clarify the meaning of the unconscious in phenomenology by binding it to the concept of sedimentation, as it has been addressed in Husserl’s and Merleau-Ponty’s writings.

14604923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14604923.value: Although the concept of sedimentation is of crucial importance in phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction, in the critical literature it remains largely overlooked. This project aims to offer the first comprehensive analysis of sedimentation by focusing on its origins in Husserlian phenomenology and on its further development in hermeneutics and deconstruction. Broadly speaking, sedimentations are actively constituted meanings, which have hovered into forgetfulness. Although forgotten, these meanings retain their validity as the historical roots of schematizing consciousness. A philosophical study of sedimentations relies upon the possibility to remove the layers of sedimentation in retroactive analysis. This project will investigate how such a philosophical study is undertaken in phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction. My goal is to publish four articles in well-established journals in Continental philosophy. 1) “Sedimentations and the Unconscious: Husserl and Merleau-Ponty” will trace the meaning of sedimentations in classical phenomenology. The article will show that the concept of sedimentation deepens the phenomenological analysis of consciousness by disclosing the level of the unconscious, understood as the historically-formed layer of latent intentionality. 2) “Sedimentations and the Lifeworld: Husserl, Schutz, Gurwitsch” will demonstrate that sedimentations are not just characteristics of consciousness, but also dimensions of the lifeworld, understood as a cultural and historical world of experience. 3) “Language and Sedimentation: Husserl and Derrida” will demonstrate that the concept of sedimentation provides a fresh basis to rethink the relation between phenomenology and deconstruction. While phenomenology binds sedimentation with reactivation, understood as the recovery of original intuition, deconstruction joins sedimentation with de-sedimentation, understood as the uncovering of the play of differences. 4) “Sedimentation, Reactivation and Innovation: From Husserl to Ricœur” will suggest that the concept of sedimentations provides a fresh possibility to rethink the relation between phenomenology and hermeneutics. While for phenomenologists, who couple sedimentations with reactivation, the task is to uncover the dimensions of meaning that are covered up by layers of sedimentations, hermeneutically-oriented thinkers couple sedimentation with innovation and draw a distinction between dead meanings and living meanings, suggesting that the sedimented meanings always call for novel reinterpretations. The implications of the project are far-reaching and its relevance is threefold. The project will 1) offer the first systematic analysis of a concept whose central significance in Continental philosophy is beyond doubt; 2) provide a new ground to conceptualize the relation between three major traditions in Continental thought: phenomenology, hermeneutics and deconstruction; 3) significantly deepen our understanding of the historicity of consciousness. 摘要：儘管沉澱這個概念在現象學、詮釋學和解構學中極為關鍵，但在批判性文獻裏，它仍未得到充分研究。本計畫旨在為沉澱提供首次全面分析，著重於它在胡塞爾現象學中的起源，以及在詮釋學和解構學中的進一步發展。 摘要：儘管沉澱這個概念在現象學、詮釋學和解構學中極為關鍵，但在批判性文獻裏，它仍未得到充分研究。本計畫旨在為沉澱提供首次全面分析，著重於它在胡塞爾現象學中的起源，以及在詮釋學和解構學中的進一步發展。 總的來説，沉澱是滑進遺忘之中的積極構成意義。儘管被遺忘，這些意義作為構築意識的歷史根源，仍保留它的有效性。沉澱的哲學研究，仰賴使用反溯的方法去除不同層面的沉澱是否可能。本計畫將探討這一種哲學研究在現象學、詮釋學和解構學中是如何進行。 我的目標是在獲得公認的歐陸哲學期刊上發表四篇文章。第一篇題為「沉澱與無意識：胡塞爾與梅洛龐蒂」，將追溯沉澱在古典現象學中的意義。該文章將說明沉澱透過揭示無意識，加深了對意識的現象學分析。無意識在這裏理解為歷史形成的潛在意向性。第二篇題為「沉澱與生活世界：胡塞爾、舒茲、古爾維奇」，將說明沉澱不僅是意識的特徵，也是生活世界的維度。生活世界在這裏理解為一個文化和歷史經驗的世界。第三篇題為「語言與沉澱：胡塞爾與德希達」，將說明沉澱這概念為重新思考現象學與解構學之間的關係提供了嶄新的基礎。現象學把沉澱與重新激活連在一起（重新激活指恢復原始直覺），而解構學把沉澱與去沉澱連在一起（去沉澱指揭示差異）。第四篇題為「沉澱、重新激活與創新：從胡塞爾到利科」，將提出沉澱這概念為重新思考現象學與詮釋學之間的關係提供了新的可能。現象學家把沉澱與重新激活連在一起，是為了揭示被沉澱所掩蓋的意義維度，而詮釋導向的思想家將沉澱與創新連在一起，並對暮氣沉沉的意義和活躍的意義進行區分，意味著沉澱的意義總是需要新穎詮釋來揭示。 本計畫影響遠達，具有三重相關面向。本計畫將 1) 首次為一個在歐陸哲學中具有重要意義和地位的概念作出系統的分析；2) 提供一個新的基礎，把現象學、詮釋學和解構學三個歐陸思想主流之間的關係概念化；3) 顯著加深我們對意識的歷史性的理解。

14605023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605023.value: 早期基督教與自然科學 ── 以凱撒利亞的巴西流為例

14605023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14605023.value: Prof Drecoll, Volker Henning Prof Radde-Gallwitz, Andrew

14605023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605023.value: 在古典時代晚期，基督教思想家在科學知識的傳播上辦演著重要角色。他們的著作反映著他們積極地與當時各個希臘自然哲學流派有所互動。然而，這一重要課題——早期基督教與自然科學之間的關係——在學術界卻沒有受到足夠的關注。本研究聚焦於一位典範——第四世紀的基督教思想家，凱撒利亞的巴西流；並探討其在《論六日創造》中對自然科學的理解及應用。《論六日創造》是現存最早的對《創世記》的創造論述做出字面詮釋的文本之一，它也展現著巴西流對希臘科學的熟稔。雖然學術界已有對此著作的研究，但在「與自然科學的關係」這一議題上，卻仍缺少深入全面的討論。 本研究之目的是整理及分析巴西流在其創造論述中對自然科學的理解及應用。研究成果將有助於釐清早期基督教與自然科學的關係。本研究透過古代自然科學之視角給予《論六日創造》以全新的解讀。為此，我採用了開創性的研究方法。 首先，我對巴西流的科學知識之分析，不單建基於他本人及其他早期教會的著作，更會考究當時的哲學及科學理論，尤其是與之相關的論述學傳統和古代原始資料。本研究將開創將這些自然科學之史料與基督教典籍作比較分析的先河。其次，我的分析會系統地圍繞三個科學範疇——物理學、動物學及醫學，從而使該研究能與科學史學家們展開更多的對話。第三，為了能夠更立體地理解巴西流的科學觀，我會透過兩個脈絡將他的思想呈現出來：(─) 他所身處的第四世紀的解經傳統；以及(二)他的兄弟兼繼承者呂撒的貴格利所呈現的神學處境。為此，我邀請了沃克爾·亨寧·德雷科爾（Volker Henning Drecoll）教授及安德魯·拉德-加維茨（Andrew Radde-Gallwitz）教授成為此項目的合作研究者。 本研究的結果會以專著的形式發表，這將成為學界首部探討早期基督教與希臘自然科學的著作。我也會在國際學術會議上發表相關論文，並將舉行一系列的線上講座，與學者、學生及大眾分享該項目的研究成果。從研究階段直至成果發佈，本項目皆將展現出人文學科領域的國際合作。

14605223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605223.value: 香港在政治壓力下之政治價值變遷

14605223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14605223.value: Dr Cheng, Wai Edmund Prof Lam, Wai-man Prof Tang, Gary Prof Wong, Hok-wui Stan Prof Yuen, Samson Wai-hei

14605223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605223.value: This study examines the changes in political values in Hong Kong after 2020, by dint of the Asian Barometer Wave VI Survey (ABS). Hong Kong has undergone major political changes since 2019. The 2019 Anti-Extradition Movement led to the enactment of the National Security Law (NSL) for Hong Kong. Hong Kong has also been under the severe impact of the COVID-19 pandemic since early 2020. Both events pointed to a tightening of state control, somehow at the expense of social and political rights of citizens. This study will examine how the political values of Hong Kong people changed as a result of the tightening of state control since the NSL and the COVID pandemic. How would Hong Kong people adjudicate the balance between their rights and security concerns (including national security and their physical survival)? How would their attitudes towards democracy and human rights change under an era of increased state control? Would the political change and/or the health crisis lead to acceptance of more state control and of more conservative values? Or would the evaluation and trust towards the political institutions deteriorate as a result of these changes? Hong Kong is also under the impact of a new wave of emigration. In this study, we would analyze the interrelationships between local identity, propensity to emigrate and political participation. This would help us to uncover the causes and impacts of the emigration wave. The study will rely on the Asian Barometer Survey (ABS) Wave VI core questionnaire as the research tool. The ABS is a cross-national survey on political attitudes in 16 countries/regions in Asia and Australia since 2001. The core questionnaire uses the same set of questions across all regions, and most questions are repeatedly asked in different waves. To be carried out in early 2024, this Wave VI survey will allow us to ascertain the value changes since last wave (2019-21) by comparing the data with that of past waves, and we can compare the political values of Hong Kong with other Asian countries/regions. 14605423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605423.value: 新見北京大學藏王念孫手稿的古音與古籍研究計劃

14605423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605423.value: 王念孫是清代乾嘉學術中的代表人物，他對古音的研究，對先秦、秦漢古籍的校釋，至今仍為 學者肯定與採用。然而學者對王氏之學的研究，多局限在幾種已經刊刻的著作。我們近十年來 收集並公布了不少各地圖書館珍藏的王氏稿抄校本，從原始材料上突破了目前的困局，成果甚 豐。本計劃在此基礎上，擬將現藏北京大學的王念孫手稿整理研究，盡快發表。 本計劃的新材料是北京大學在1930年從羅振玉手中購藏至今，共五十七冊，數量之多實屬罕見 ，且絕大部分從未刊印，材料彌足珍貴，饒具學術價值。本計劃將已經抄錄的手稿材料整理成 《資料彙編》，然後研究手稿所見王念孫的古聲母系統，輯錄並分析王氏在手稿中所引先秦、 秦漢古籍文例的校釋，配合比對王氏其他著述以及近世出土文獻，如實呈現王念孫在古音學、訓詁學、古籍校勘學等方面的實績。研究成果將上載至計劃網頁，繼續開拓並深化研究王氏之學的新里程。 Wang Niansun (1744–1832) was a representative scholar of the Qian-Jia School during the Qing dynasty. His research on Old Chinese phonology, in addition to collations and interpretations of pre-Qin, Qin and Han ancient texts have been widely acknowledged and applied by scholars to this day. However, most existing studies on Wang Niansun’s scholarship have been limited to his hitherto published works. In the recent decade, we have discovered texts collated by Wang Niansun that remain in manuscript form in various libraries. We have already used these original materials to achieve a fruitful outcome. On this basis, this project proposes to collate, examine, and publish Wang’s manuscripts preserved in Peking University as soon as possible. Purchased and collected by Luo Zhenyu (1866–1940) in the 1930s, the new materials studied in this project consist of 57 volumes in total. It is rare to acquire such a voluminous number of Wang’s manuscripts that remain mostly unpublished, so these materials are of great academic value. This project will compile the copied manuscripts into a book entitled Ziliao huibian (《資料匯編》，A Collection of Materials), and study Wang’s Old Chinese initials system documented therein. By compiling and analyzing Wang’s collations and interpretations of pre-Qin, Qin and Han ancient texts and comparing them with his other works, this study aims to give an authentic view of Wang’s achievement in Old Chinese phonology, semantics, and textual criticism. To facilitate further research on Wang’s studies, these research outputs will be uploaded to the project’s website for easy access.

14605723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14605723.value: 社會資本、服務參與和自我管理對患有慢性疾病的年青人從學校到職場發展結果的影響

14605723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14605723.value: Dr Cheung, Jacky Chau-kiu Dr Leung, Pamela Pui-yu

14605723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14605723.value: Young people with chronic disabling health conditions are often capable of doing well in both post-secondary education and the workplace. However, they face numerous personal and environmental challenges in their school-to-work transitions. For example, they may experience discrimination and have lower self-confidence in finding opportunities for post-secondary education and work. Health considerations may influence their school-to-work development and decisions. These young people are under-represented within the labor market, despite possessing relevant capabilities and motivation. These obstacles may become precursors to more serious problems such as long-term unemployment and financial difficulties. Thus, finding ways to help these young people is a pressing concern for research. To this end, the proposed research project will sample 500 young people between the ages of 15 and 29 with chronic disabling health conditions and 60 social workers responsible for service provision to these young people. A mixed method of both quantitative and qualitative approaches to data collection and data analysis will be adopted. For quantitative data, participants will be surveyed twice, at an initial time point and one year later, in order to monitor their development. For qualitative data, five focus group interviews will be conducted with 30 young people and 20 social workers who participated in the baseline and follow-up surveys. We will explore the factors that may lead to the successful transition of these young people from school to work. The effects of (1) social capital from family and peer networks, (2) participation in supported employment and social work services, and (3) self-management of chronic disabling health conditions on school-to-work developmental outcomes will be examined. Mediation analysis will be conducted to explore the direct and indirect cascading relationships between variables. The research will investigate the relationships between social capital and school-to-work developmental outcomes through the first mediator, service participation, then subsequently, through the second mediator of self-management. The way these factors interact with personal, family, and other background characteristics to shape the development of these young people is also an important area of investigation. The research findings will provide valuable information to social workers and policymakers for the development of policies and practices that will directly help young people with chronic disabling health conditions. These measures will facilitate these young people in reaching their potential and utilizing their talents in the workforce. In turn, the supply of talent for the workforce can be enhanced, which will benefit society in the long term.
