14607123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607123.value: 大西洋革命者：十八世紀末的普世主義、排斥和軍國主義

14607123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607123.value: What does it mean to fight for a cause? And what does it mean to do so when that cause is not a nation or a people, but an abstract ideal? Atlantic Revolutionaries: Universalism, Exclusion, and Militarism in the Late Eighteenth Century asks this question by tracing the lives of nine people who participated in the American, French, and Haitian Revolutions, focusing as much as possible on people who participated in more than one of those events, and whose contributions took place away from their homelands. In doing so, it investigates the extent to which the ideals of the Enlightenment could be part of a universal movement. Like other recent scholarship on the Enlightenment and the Atlantic World, it investigates how ideals phrased as universal claims about human rights and equality coexisted, and could even mask, profound inequalities between women and men, and between whites and non-whites. It also asks what “fighting” entails, when the biggest victories were only won violently, given the criticisms of violence in some corners of the Enlightenment. The Enlightenment was based on the idea that people, using their reason, could make the world a better place. It was also based on the idea that there were certain rights to which all humans were entitled. These ideas claimed for themselves universal relevance and, therefore, meant that any fight on their behalf was open to all people, even if the goals of any particular phase of the struggle were limited to one nation. These beliefs helped inspire these nine people to fight in battles that took them to different parts of the Atlantic World, but also showed the problems that people encountered when trying to put those ideas in place, and the limits to which governments inspired by Enlightenment ideas could improve people’s lives. All of them – whether intentionally or not – provided examples of ways in which the Atlantic Revolutions were part of one broader movement, and the ways in which those revolutionaries’ actions and beliefs retained their national, or even local, character. In investigating these questions, Atlantic Revolutionaries also asks what it means to advocate the ideas of the Enlightenment in today’s post-colonial world. This project will result in one book; two journal articles; at least one international conference paper; and several podcasts and pieces in the popular press. 為一項事業而奮鬥意味着什麼？當不是為了國家或者民族，而是為了一個抽象的理想時，這樣做又意味著什麼？ 《大西洋革命者：十八世紀末的普世主義、排外與軍國主義》通過追蹤參與美國、法國和海地革命的九個人的生活來提出這個問題，並儘可能關注那些參與了不止一場、並且遠離故鄉的革命的人們。在此過程中，本項目調查了啓蒙運動的觀念在多大程度上可以成為一個廣泛運動的一部分。與最近關於啓蒙運動和大西洋世界的其他學術研究一樣，它研究了關於人權和平等的普遍主張的觀念如何與女性與男性之間、白人與非白人之間的深刻不平等共存，乃至掩蓋它們。鑑於啓蒙運動中某些角落對暴力的批評，它還詢問了當最大的勝利只能通過暴力贏得時，“戰鬥”意味着什麼。 啓蒙運動基於這樣一個理念：人們可以利用理性讓世界變得更美好。它還基於這樣的理念，即存在一種所有人都有權享有的權利。這些思想聲稱自己具有普世意義，因此意味著以此為名義的任何鬥爭向所有人開放，即使鬥爭的任何特定階段的目標僅限於一個國家。這些信念激勵著這九個人在大西洋世界的不同地方參加戰鬥，但同時也反映了人們在試圖將這些想法付諸實踐時遇到的問題，以及受啓蒙思想啓發的政府在改善人們的生活方面的侷限性。所有這些——無論是有意還是無意——為説明大西洋革命如何成為一場更廣泛的運動的一部分，以及這些革命者的行動和信仰如何保留其國家甚至地方特徵做出了例證。在研究這些問題時，《大西洋革命者》還提出了在當今後殖民世界倡導啓蒙運動思想意味着什麼的問題。 該項目將出版一本書；兩篇期刊文章；至少一篇國際會議論文；以及流行媒體上的一些播客和文章。

14607423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607423.value: 我們的印象，他們的印象：菲律賓馬尼拉殖民統治的演變（1901至1941年）

14607423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607423.value: The project investigates the forces shaping the governance of Manila, the Philippine capital city, during the American colonial era (1898-1946). Focusing upon the formation, development, and expression of political authority, the study analyzes the character of local administration and the endeavors of Filipinos therein. In 1898 the United States’ colonization of the Philippines commenced. With the passing of Act No. 82 in January 1901, the Americans permitted Filipinos to assume municipal responsibilities. Yet, in what ways Filipinos subsequently sculpted governmental strategies and, so, societal evolution in Manila is not clear. For instance, how did the Filipino comprehension of American colonization influence the policies and actions of the city’s administration? More specifically, whilst the national government from the early-1900s promoted the advancement of public education, city planning, public health, economic growth, and infrastructure construction as articulations of American-driven social reform, how did these matters align, or clash, with the Filipinos’ perception as to what the make-up of their civilization, and their capital city, should be? The inquiry will probe Manila’s governmental operations circa 1901 to 1941, i.e. between Act No. 82’s passing and the commencement of World War Two in Asia, and how they corresponded with the Americans and Filipinos’ grasp of ‘good modern governance’. Accordingly, the project will assess the Filipinos who held positions of authority within the city administration, and will seek to evaluate how their actions contributed to the attainment of social and economic progress before national independence occurred. Furthermore, the study will assess not only the achievements of Manila’s government but its imperfections too. In doing this the study will reveal both positive and negative Filipino agency upon urban management, and it will expose those within Manila who contested the nature of native-held, native-shaped public authority. Likewise, the investigation will uncover in what ways, or not, Filipino politicians in the Philippines’ principal city conformed to the principles of American-styled democracy implanted by the colonial regime post-1898. The study, in opening a new window to comprehend the American Empire, shall present original insights of the relationship between societal transformation, the issuing of public authority by native hands, and the management of a colonial capital city. In examining national governmental involvements alongside local political initiatives, the project will be of interest to persons interested in the Philippines’ past, administrative practices within the frame of American imperialism, and the development of colonial capitals in Asia. 本計劃旨在探討菲律賓首都馬尼拉在美國殖民時期（1898至1946 年）各種影響城市管治的力量。從政治權威的形成、發展和表達等方面分析地方政府的特性以及菲律賓人在其中的參予。 美國在1898年開始殖民統治菲律賓，並於 1901 年 1 月通過第 82 號法案容許菲律賓人承擔治市責任。然而，菲律賓人在當中如何制定治理策略以及對馬尼拉社會的演變尚待研究。例如，菲律賓人對美國殖民統治的理解如何影響市政府的政策和行動？國家政府從 1900 年代初開始進一步推動公共教育、城市規劃、公共衛生、經濟增長和基礎建設等政策，這些被視為美國主導的社會改革活動與當地人對其文明及國都的形成有何相似或衝突的地方？ 透過研究1901 年至 1941 年間（即由第 82 號法案通過至第二次世界大戰在亞洲爆發期間）馬尼拉政府的運作，了解它如何符合美國人和菲律賓人對「良好現代管治」的理解。本研究分析在城市管治中握有權力的菲律賓人，他們的表現如何在國家獨立前為社會和經濟進步作出貢獻；評論馬尼拉政府的成就及缺點；揭示在城市管理上的動力及阻力，及那些對本土而來的公共權力提出質疑的人；分析菲律賓主要城市的菲藉政治家有沒有導守由1898 年後殖民政權而來的美式民主原則。本研究為理解美利堅帝國打開了一扇新的窗口，對社會轉型、當地人手中的公共權力與殖民首府城市管理之間的關係提出獨到的見解。透過查考國家政府的參與以及地方政治舉措，本研究的讀者將會是對菲律賓的過去、美帝國主義框架下的行政實踐以及亞洲殖民首都的發展感興趣的人士。

14607623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607623.value: 宋代理學的萬物一體觀與敬論及其當代哲學價值

14607623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607623.value: 本項目將系統地梳理宋代儒學的萬物一體觀與敬論的發展史，重點考察張載、程顥、程頤、二程後學與朱熹之間的差異，把宋代儒學的觀念聯繫到當代西方哲學，探討概念在知覺中的作用，以及自我意識在道德中的作用。 宋明理學在一個根本問題上分裂為兩大陣營。這個根本問題是：一體，抑或持敬？道德行動者應該以怎樣的心靈姿態去面對他所處的世界？程顥將儒家的核心德目「仁」界定為「與天地萬物為一體」，而程頤與朱熹對此有所保留，轉而主張涵養持敬，讓心靈維持道德警醒與自我意識，時時知曉自己是其身體與行為的「主宰」。王陽明揚棄了朱子的敬論，重新闡發一體觀。本研究項目將區分程顥的「知覺的一體觀」與張載的「觀想的一體觀」，指出二程後學偏離了程顥的思想，其中一些人的一體觀受到禪宗或張載的影響。禪宗的影響是朱熹之所以批評二程後學的一體觀並轉向敬論的重要原因。 一體與持敬之間的張力可以通過比較哲學的維度進行探討。近年來兩個相關的爭論，一個發生於McDowell與Dreyfus之間，另一個發生在Korsgaard與Crowell之間，兩個爭論反映了不同的歐陸哲學元素在英美世界的相互競爭。McDowell與Korsgaard二人受康德思想影響，而Dreyfus與Crowell二人對前兩人的批評又吸收了海德格爾哲學成分。兩個爭論皆能呼應本研究的主題。東西方哲學都會面臨如下問題：自我意識，抑或親身體證？概念性，抑或現實性？哪方面才是規範性的來源？哪方面在感知與行動中起決定作用？McDowell與Dreyfus的爭論集中在以下問題：是否概念性深入地遍在於一切經驗之中，抑或人在世界之中的親身參與先於任何概念性？Korsgaard與Crowell的分歧在於：是否反思性的、抽離的自我意識是規範性的來源，抑或自我意識產生於行動者的更根本的現實性？本項目一方面將通過Dreyfus與Crowell的視角闡發程顥的一體觀；另一方面試圖探討：朱熹哲學是否具有類似McDowell哲學的先驗論成分？他是否認為知覺先在地具有某些的概念性成分？

14607723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14607723.value: 自主機器人能否改善自閉症兒童的眼神交流？ 基於機器人的干預措施與基於人類的干預措施的比較

14607723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14607723.value: 自閉症譜系障礙是一種複雜且異質的神經發育狀況（美國精神病學協會 [APA]，2013）。 自閉症患者在社交互動方面存在困難，並且會產生受限和重複的行為。 根據《精神疾病診斷和統計手冊》第五版（DSM-5；APA，2013），自閉症患者難以與他人建立目光接觸和共同關注。 先前的研究已經檢驗了社交機器人是否可以改善自閉症患者的目光接觸和/或共同註意力，但他們得出的結果好壞參半（例如，Chung，2020；Zheng et al.，2020）。 此外，這些研究在研究設計上存在局限性，包括樣本量小和缺乏維持學習成果的證據。 顯著的局限性之一是這些研究部署了由人類控制的機器人（即在綠野仙踪（WOZ）範式下）。 儘管 WOZ 對於快速編程機器人在復雜環境中的反應非常有效，但它並不是一種在臨床環境中長期大規模使用的可持續技術。 因此，本研究建議部署一個社交機器人，它可以自動檢測自閉症兒童的目光，並檢查為期四個月的基於機器人的干預（RBI）是否比內容和持續時間匹配的人類干預更有效 基於乾預（HBI）的改善眼神接觸。 此外，RBI 和 HBI 不是一次性提供，而是持續四個月，每週兩次，以捕捉自閉症兒童在干預期間對機器人和人類代理的反應變化。 將檢查 RBI 和 HBI 學習成果的維持及其將獲得的眼神交流技能推廣到人與人之間的互動。 將招募150名4至6歲的自閉症兒童，並隨機分配至RBI和HBI。 有瞭如此大的樣本量，我們可以分析智力功能和自閉症嚴重程度的影響。 我們假設 RBI 比 HBI 更有可能增強人與人之間互動中的目光接觸，並且這種學習成果至少持續一個月。 這些發現將揭示社交機器人在臨床環境中治療自閉症兒童的應用。

14608623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608623.value: 在迅速老化的人口中公眾對醫療輔助生命終止程序的接受程度：用以引導香港政策的混合研究

14608623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14608623.value: Prof Chung, Roger Yat-Nork Prof Dong, Dong Prof Jackson, Emily Prof Wong, Eliza Lai-yi Prof YEOH, Eng Kiong

14608623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608623.value: Background: By 2042, one-third of Hong Kong’s population will be over 65 years of age. Addressing the needs of the elderly will therefore become an increasingly important consideration of Hong Kong’s social policies. In response to highly publicized cases of “mercy killing” of severely ill elderly by family members, there have been calls for public discussion of medically assisted life-ending procedures (LEP). Although LEP such as euthanasia are legal in a number of countries, such procedures are prohibited in Hong Kong and the provision of palliative care is the current standard of care for terminally ill patients. Objectives: This study will examine public attitudes and medical stakeholder opinions on medically assisted LEP. To inform future policies, it is first necessary to understand the cultural acceptance of LEP in Hong Kong and to understand the circumstances in which LEP may or may not be acceptable to the general public (e.g. to alleviate suffering for terminal patients). The investigators will also assess whether support/opposition to LEP is associated with levels of social support, perceptions of healthcare affordability and quality, perceived social services availability and levels of filial piety. The study also will obtain in-depth opinions of LEP from physicians. Methods: An anonymous telephone survey will first be conducted to assess public opinions of LEP in various clinical scenarios. The survey will interview adults who are 35 years of age or older to capture views of elderly adults and those with elderly parents (n=3000). The study will also investigate the sociodemographic (e.g. income, religiosity), health-related and attitudinal (e.g. perceived quality of palliative care, level of filial piety) factors that are associated with acceptance of various LEP. Individuals will be also asked their reasons for opposing/supporting LEP. Qualitative interviews will then be conducted with physicians who treat severely ill elderly (including oncologists, neurologists n=30). After informing of the results of the survey, participants will be asked to give their in-depth views of: possible positive and negative consequences, professional concerns, and likely difficulties of provisioning LEP to patients for thematic analysis. Main Outcomes: Baseline acceptability of various LEP in Hong Kong will be determined and the respondent characteristics associated with support/opposition to LEP will also be identified. Perceived inadequacies in current standard of care can also be identified as targets for improved elderly healthcare services. Thematic analysis of physician’s views can also identify the main areas of concern and likely consequences of legalizing LEP in Hong Kong. 背景：在2042 年前，香港三分之一的人口將超過 65 歲。因此，滿足長者的需要將成為香港社會政策日益重要的考慮因素。針對一些傳媒廣泛報道的重病老人被家人「安樂死」的案例，有人呼籲公眾需要討論醫療輔助生命終止程序（LEP）。雖然安樂死等 LEP 在許多國家是合法的，但此類程序在香港是被禁止的，而且提供紓緩治療仍是目前對絕症患者的醫療準則。 目標：本研究將調查公眾對LEP 的態度和醫療服務持份者的意見。為了令未來的政策有所依據，首先有必要了解香港文化對 LEP 的接受程度，並了解 LEP被公眾接受與不接受的情況（例如，為了減輕末期患者的痛苦）。調查人員還會評估社會支持水平、對醫療保健負擔能力和質量的看法、對社會服務可用性的看法以及孝順程度是否與對 LEP 的支持/反對有關。此研究還將會獲取醫生對 LEP 的深入意見。 方法：首先硏究將會進行匿名電話調查，以評估不同臨床情景下公眾對LEP 的意見。該調查將採訪 35 歲或以上的成年人，以了解長者和有年長父母的人 (n=3000) 的看法。此研究還將會探討與各種LEP的接受程度相關的社會人口因素（例如收入、宗教信仰）、健康相關因素以及態度因素（例如對紓緩治療質量的評價、孝順程度）。此外，研究還將探討每位受訪者反對/支持 LEP 的個人理由。然後研究將與治療老年重症患者的醫生（包括腫瘤科醫生、神經科醫生，n=30）進行質性訪談。在被告知量性調查結果後，參與者將被要求就以下方面發表深入的看法以進行主題性分析：可能的正面和負面後果、業界的擔憂以及為患者提供 LEP可能遇到的困難。 主要結果：此硏究將可以判斷出在香港對各種類型的LEP 的基線可接受程度，並識別出受訪者支持/反對 LEP 相關的特徵。當前護理標準的不足之處也可以被視為改善老年醫療保健服務的目標。對醫生觀點的主題分析還可以辨識出LEP 在港合法化的主要需關注領域和可能後果。

14608723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608723.value: 中國知識產權損害賠償制度之研究

14608723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608723.value: Multinational enterprises and China’s trading partners have long criticized the unreasonably low damages for intellectual property (IP) infringement granted by Chinese courts. It is also quite common that courts grant only a small percentage of the amount claimed by plaintiffs who successfully prove the IP infringement. The United State Trade Representative therefore has explicitly indicated in its Special 301 Reports multiple times that IP is not well protected in China because its courts have failed to provide sufficient compensation for IP owners whose rights are infringed. The Chinese government has also viewed the low damages as a major flaw of its IP system. Both President Xi Jinping and the Supreme People’s Court (SPC) have declared the determination to raise damages for IP infringement. China’s resolve of raising damages was finally legislated into three major intellectual property (IP) laws in 2019 and 2020, which later came into effect in 2019 and 2021. There are five notable changes of damages rules in this wave of IP reform. First, right holders and courts have more flexibilities in choosing different method to calculate damages. Second, statutory damages are substantially raised. Third, punitive damages are introduced to all three major IP laws, namely Trademark Law, Patent Law, and Copyright Law. Fourth, the burden-shifting evidence rule concerning damages, which only existed in Trademark Law, are introduced to Patent Law and Copyright Law as well. Fifth, damages rules in different IP laws have substantively converged. This project aims to study the impact of recent reform on damages in China. We propose to compare and analyse damages awarded by the SPC and the three IP Courts in Beijing, Shanghai and Guangzhou three years before and three years after the IP reform. The PI will also explore how the new punitive damages rules for IP infringement are implemented. The aim of these inquiries is to understand the impact of the IP damages reform based on empirical evidence. We will examine whether the policy goal is achieved after the reform. Moreover, under the new IP laws, China plans to apply a unified standard for damages determination in different categories of IP. We will examine whether this one-size-fits-all approach can appropriately address damages issues in different types of IP, or under identical or similar damages rules, whether courts will still develop dissimilar methods to evaluate damages across three major categories of IP. 在中國投資的外國企業與中國的貿易對手國常批評中國法院對於知識產權侵害案件的損害賠償認定過低，即使原告勝訴，法院常常僅同意其主張損害賠償額的一小部分。美國貿易代表因此數次於其特別301報告中指出，法院判決過低的損害賠償額，是中國保護知產不足的原因之一。中國政府也認為，過低的損害賠償額是其知識產權制度的缺漏之一，因此國家主席習近平及最高人民法院都曾表示要提升知產侵害案件損害賠償額的決心。 近年來，中國知識產權改革反映了提升損害賠償的共識，2019年到2020年修正的三種主要知識產權法律(商標法、專利法與著作權法)，分別在2019年到2021年生效，在這一波改革中，主要有五項重點。第一，權利人和法院有更多的彈性選擇不同的損害賠償計算方式；第二，法定賠償額實質提升；第三，導入懲罰性賠償制度；第四，舉證責任的變更；第五；商標、專利和著作權等不同類型知識產權損害賠償制度的整合。 本研究以中國知識產權損害賠償制度的改革為對象，比較並分析北京、上海和廣州知識產權法院在前述改革開始施行前、後三年的判決，並觀察中國法院如何適用新的懲罰性賠償規範。本研究將以實證數據為基礎，分析改革是否有具體成效，本研究也將探討不同類型的知識產權損害賠償在實踐上有何差異。

14608923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14608923.value: 社會少數、身份認同和自我表達：香港跨性別者和性別代名詞

14608923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14608923.value: This research is concerned with the larger questions of identity and self-expression among marginalised groups in society. When these groups in society express identity in ways people around them do not accept, what are the power dynamics involved? In what ways is the identity expression of the marginalised groups received? How do the marginalised groups respond to identity denial, and how do they express their agency against it? What are the constraints that these socially marginalised groups face? The particular case that this research examines is transgender people and gender pronouns. For the majority of people in society – cisgender people – gender pronouns may seem something mundane, simple, and taken for granted. However, for transgender people, using a gender pronoun that they identify with is a crucial site of presentation of their identity and self to the world. Transgender people may be subjected to misgendering, a form of identity denial where transgender people’s membership in the gender group with which they identify is invalidated. Misgendering and mispronouncing is a form of discursive microaggression that negatively affects well-being and make transgender people feel disregarded and erased. While most previous research on transgender people and gender pronouns has been conducted in the English-speaking world, this proposed research is one of the first research specifically focusing on gender pronouns among transgender people in the Chinese-speaking world. It involves a quantitative survey of 250 transgender people and in-depth qualitative interviews with 30 transgender people in Hong Kong. The Hong Kong context is theoretically interesting as (1) it involves an examination of transgender people’s use of gender pronouns in a bilingual context; and (2) there is no protection against discrimination on the grounds of gender identity nor is there legal gender recognition – these social and legal constraints allow for an examination of the challenges transgender people face when they use gender pronouns and the resilience and agency they display. I have been working on transgender issues in Hong Kong for more than 10 years and have worked on the largest-scale study of transgender people in Hong Kong. I am very well connected with the NGOs that work with transgender people in Hong Kong. Generating social impact to raise awareness about gender pronouns is an important part of this project. The social impact activities include (1) an exhibition that target the public; (2) sharing sessions that target service providers and employers; and (3) sharing sessions with students. 本研究關注社會邊緣化群體中身份認同和自我表達的課題。當社會上邊緣化群體以不被周遭人士接受的方式表達身份時，是如何牽涉到權力關係？邊緣化群體的身份表達以何種方式被看待？當身份被否定時，這些邊緣化群體是如何回應，並展現他們的能動性？這些社會邊緣化群體面臨哪些限制？ 本研究所探討的個案是跨性別者和性別代名詞。對於社會上的大多數人 - 順性別人士 - 性別代名詞可能是一件平凡、簡單和理所當然的事情。然而，對於跨性別者來說，使用他們所認同的性別代名詞是向世界展示自己身份和自我表達的關鍵。跨性別者可能會面對性別錯稱，即一種身份否定，否定跨性別在其認同性別群體中的成員身份。性別錯稱及性別代名詞使用錯誤是一種話語上的微歧視，使跨性別者感到被忽視和否定，為跨性別人士的福祉帶來負面影響。 現時關於跨性別者和性別代名詞的研究大多數都是在英語國家進行的，本研究是首批專門關注在中文世界裡跨性別者使用性別代名詞的研究。本研究將會對香港 250 名跨性別者進行定量調查和 30 名跨性別者進行深入訪談。 香港是一個理論上有趣的研究個案，因為（1）它涉及對雙語環境中跨性別者使用性別代名詞的考察；（2）香港並沒有針對性別認同歧視的法律保障，也沒有性別承認法 - 這些社會和法律限制對跨性別者使用性別代名詞時面臨的挑戰以及他們所展示的韌性及能動性帶來影響，能讓研究員進行深入考察。 我在香港的跨性別議題上已經工作了超過十年，並進行了香港最大規模的跨性別者研究。我跟在香港與跨性別者合作的非政府組織有很好的聯繫。 提高公眾對性別代名詞的認識並帶來社會影響是本研究的重要部分。社會影響活動包括（1）針對公眾的展覽；（2）針對服務提供者和雇主的分享會；以及（3）與學生進行分享會。

14609123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609123.value: 以生態動力學方式促進小學生身體素養與健康：集群隨機對照試驗

14609123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609123.value: Prof Chow, Yia Ji Prof Rudd, James Prof Sit, Cindy Hui-ping

14609123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609123.value: The research team has found that very little is known about the impact of an Ecological Dynamics (ED) intervention on primary school children’s physical literacy and well-being in the Hong Kong context. The aim of this project is therefore to introduce a physical literacy and well-being framework through an ED intervention that allows primary school children to develop good physical activity (PA) and daily behavioral habits. The levels of physical activity (PA) among primary school students in Hong Kong and in other developed nations are below the levels that are sufficient to promote health. Based on the unique physical literacy journey and lifestyle of different individuals, the proposed project would offer the primary school children a meaningful way to achieve active lifestyle development and encourage them to realize their physical literacy journey in later life. A four-arm randomized controlled trial will be employed in this proposed project. An ED intervention will be conducted for ten months in primary schools located in each of the 18 administrative districts of Hong Kong. Four classes in senior primary students (grade 4-6) at each school will be randomly assigned to the four different conditions. These participating schools will be equipped with sit-stand desks, PA recess facility and equipment, and sleep pillows. The research team will adopt both objective measures (aerobic fitness, fundamental movement skills, daily behavior - physical activity, and cognitive function) and self-reported measures (perceived physical literacy, quality of life, sleep quality) covering the elements and domains of physical literacy and well-being to examine the effects of ED interventions. The proposed project therefore adds to the current literature by proposing an ED intervention and provides insight into the benefits of sit-stand desks combining PA recess and daytime sleepiness in Hong Kong primary schools. This proposed project can facilitate interaction among primary school children, their teachers (not restricted to PE teachers), and parents to promote mutual understanding of the importance of active lifestyles and well-being of our younger generations. 於香港環境中，對於以生態動力學（Ecological Dynamics，簡稱ED）方式用作干預對小學生的身體素養和健康影響之研究尚屬有限。為彌補這一知識空缺，本研究的目標在於透過生態動力學的干預，引入身體素養和健康的框架，從而促進小學生的體力活動（Physical Activity，簡稱PA）和日常行為習慣的培養。香港以及其他發達國家的小學生的體力活動水平並未達到促進健康所需的程度，因此有必要對此予以關注。由於個人身體素養之旅程及生活方式皆具獨特性，因此本研究為小學生提供實現有意義積極生活方式的途徑，同時鼓勵其能在未來繼續追求身體素養之旅。 為實現上述目標，本研究計劃採用了四臂隨機對照試驗的設計，在香港的十八個行政區進行為期六個月的生態動力學干預。參與學校將包括高年級小學生（4-6年級）的四個班級，這些班級將被隨機分配至四種不同的情境中。參與學校將被配備坐站式桌椅、課間與小息體力活動設施與器材，以及小睡枕頭。研究團隊將結合客觀測量（包括有氧運動能力、基本運動技能、日常行為 - 體力活動，以及認知功能）和主觀測量（包括感知身體素養、生活品質以及睡眠品質）進行評估，涵蓋身體素養和健康的各個層面，探究以生態動力學方式干預之效果。 本研究不僅為現有文獻提供洞察與補充，也為香港的小學引入坐站式桌椅、課間與小息體力活動以及日間小睡之生態動力學方式之干預。同時，是項研究也有助於促進小學生、教師（不僅限於體育教師）以及家長之間的互動，從而加深我們對於年輕一代積極生活方式和健康重要性的相互理解。

14609923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14609923.value: 評估晝夜光照、噪音和綠色/藍色空間對不同輪班護士心理健康的影響

14609923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14609923.value: Prof Huss, Anke Dr Lee, Priscilla Ming Yi Miss Li, Beixi Miss Ma, Yuen Ting Julie Dr Wang, Feng

14609923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14609923.value: Background Hong Kong nurses work rotating shifts to provide health services to people living in the world’s highest density city. About one in three Hong Kong nurses experienced depression and anxiety. Since the pandemic of COVID-19, the tight shift work schedule has posed Hong Kong nurses with excessive occupational stress, which further exaggerates their mental health problems more than ever before. Recommendations of control measures in past shift work studies are mainly provided on modification of shift work schedule, which is hard to implement due to the complex organizational management. This proposed project assesses the mental health impacts of exposure to light at day and night, noise, and green/blue spaces among Hong Kong nurses, aiming at identifying important environmental features as feasible control measures to inform policymakers in alleviating mental health problems for nurses. Project objectives Primary objectives are to 1) measure individual nurse’s environmental exposure features (light at day and night, noise and green/blue spaces); 2) illustrate the characteristics of these environmental exposures among nurses with different work shifts; 3) assess the mental health impacts (i.e. depression, anxiety) of these environmental exposures. Brief description We plan to randomly recruit 364 nurses for this 2-year cross-sectional survey. We will obtain participants’ epidemiology information, perceived environmental exposures, sleep quality, and mental health problems (depression/anxiety) using a standard questionnaire. A package with a portable ambient light data logger, noise dosimeter, and actigraphy will be distributed to the participants to collect individual exposures to light at day and night, noise, sleep, and physical activity. Remotely-sensed vegetation indices coupled with geographic location and questionnaires will be used to assess the green/blue spaces in residential areas and workplaces. Morning spot saliva and urine samples will be collected to assess the biomarker levels (melatonin, cortisone/cortisol). Mental health impacts of exposure to light at day and night, noise, and green/blue spaces among nurses with different work shifts will be examined using multiple logistic/linear regression analysis. Significance This proposed study will provide new insight into improving environmental influences to alleviate nurses’ mental health problems by promoting better green/blue spaces, optimal light, and lower noise. Our findings are highly useful when it is hard to modify shift work schedules through administrative control. Results can be applied to other cities and other work settings to facilitate the development of health-promotion policies to mitigate the negative health outcomes from the shift work schedule and reduce burdens to the healthcare system. 研究背景 香港護士通過輪班工作，為世界上人口密度最高的城市居民提供不間斷的醫療服務。大約三分之一的香港護士有抑鬱和焦慮的症狀。自COVID-19大流行以來，緊張的輪班工作使香港護士承受了過大的職業壓力，她們的精神健康問題比以往任何時候都更加嚴重。現有研究提出的改善措施著眼於修改輪班工作安排。但由於工作組織管理複雜，很難實施。本項目旨在評估晝夜光照、噪音、綠色/藍色空間對香港護士精神健康的影響，從而找出重要的環境因素作為可行的改善措施，為決策者提供資訊，以緩解護士的精神健康問題。 研究目標 主要目標是：1)測量護士個人環境暴露的特徵(晝夜光照、噪音和綠色/藍色空間)；2)顯示不同輪班護士暴露於這些環境的特徵；3)評估這些環境暴露對精神健康的影響(即抑鬱和焦慮)。 研究簡介 我們計畫招募364名護士參與這項為期2年的橫斷面研究。我們將使用標準問卷獲取參與者的流行病學資訊、環境暴露的感受、睡眠品質和心理健康問題（抑鬱和焦慮）。我們還將邀請參與者隨身攜帶便攜式環境光線記錄儀等，並佩戴腕動計以收集個人光照、噪聲、睡眠和體力活動等暴露情況。綠地覆蓋指數、地理位置和問卷調查將用於評估住宅區和工作場所的綠/藍空間。我們將同時收集晨間唾液和尿液樣本，以評估生物標誌物（如褪黑激素）水平。多重邏輯/線性回歸分析法將被用於分析不同輪班安排護士的光暴露、噪音和綠色/藍色空間暴露對心理健康的影響。 研究意義 這項研究將為改善環境的不良影響提供新的見解。在很難改變輪班工作時間安排的情況下，通過改善綠色/藍色空間、優化光線和降低噪音來緩解護士的心理健康問題也許是可行的方法。研究結果可應用於其他城市和其他工作環境，以優化促進健康政策，減輕輪班工作對健康造成的負面影響，進而減輕醫療系統的負擔。

14610223.value: 古典詩、本地史與文化認同︰1990年代以來的香港詩詞創作比賽

14610623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14610623.value: 國際法院的戰略訴訟: 對結構性影響的實證判例法評估

14610623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14610623.value: Strategic litigation is on the rise. The key feature of this litigation model is that one or more of the parties intend to use the court to promote structural change. This litigation model has implications beyond the individual litigant and adjudication of discrete interests based upon a completed set of events, typical of traditional litigation, to challenges to the distribution of political, social, economic, and legal values in a society. Strategic litigation entails strategy formation through analysis of the social situation at hand and reflection on the most appropriate judicial forum and sequencing of litigation alongside non-legal strategies, with the aim to maximise cause impact. While there is a growing literature on the nature of supranational strategic litigation generally, and in relation to the practice of regional human rights courts, there has been limited attempt to comprehensively evaluate the nature of this litigation model before the International Court of Justice (‘ICJ’). This project will fill that gap. Strategic litigation has a long history in the ICJ, with social movements increasingly exploring the possibility of litigating their causes before the Court. Through a detailed analysis of judicial practice, this project considers the suitability of strategic litigation before the ICJ as well as the extent to which the Court has – and indeed can – adapt its working methods to accommodate the novel features of this litigation model. Through a careful documentation of strategic litigation practice since 1950, this project seeks to identify the extent to which such litigation has produced, or is capable of producing, the desired structural impact. The project will evaluate strategic litigation from the perspective of the goals of the litigating States and seeks to measure its impact in stimulating the structural change sought in the litigation. The Principal Investigator, Professor Michael Ramsden, has the experience and background necessary to complete this project to an international standard. He previously successfully completed a GRF on a related but more general question about the nature of strategic litigation (‘Strategic Litigation: An International and Comparative Study, 2014/2015). He has also made a start into analysing select recent strategic litigations before the ICJ and their immediate term impacts, with articles published in the European Journal of International Law and Vanderbilt Journal of Transnational Law. Continuing to publish in high impact scholarly venues, this project will provide the first comprehensive and systematic enquiry into the structural impact of strategic litigation before the ICJ. 戰略訴訟呈上升趨勢。這種訴訟模式的主要特徵是，一個或 更多的當事人打算利用法院來促進結構變革。本訴訟 模型的影響超出了個人訴訟當事人和離散的裁決 基於一組已完成事件的利益，這是傳統訴訟的典型特徵，到 對社會中政治、社會、經濟和法律價值分配的挑戰。 戰略訴訟需要 過分析社會狀況來制定戰略 對最合適的司法論壇和訴訟順序的手和思考 與非法律策略一起，旨在最大限度地發揮事業影響力。 雖然關於超國家戰略訴訟性質的文獻越來越多 總的來說，就區域人權法院的實踐而言，存在著 之前對這種訴訟模式性質進行綜合評價的嘗試有限 國際法院（「國際法院」）。這個專案將填補這一空白。戰略訴訟在國際法院有著悠久的歷史，社會運動日益增多 探討向法院提起訴訟的可能性。通過詳細的 司法實踐分析，本專案考慮戰略訴訟的適用性 國際法院以及法院已經——而且確實能夠——適應的程度 其工作方法適應了這種訴訟模式的新特點。 通過自1950年以來，該專案仔細記錄了戰略訴訟實踐，旨在 確定此類訴訟在多大程度上已經產生或能夠產生 期望的結構性影響。該專案將從 從訴訟國的目標的角度出發，並設法衡量其在訴訟國方面的影響 刺激訴訟中尋求的結構變革 首席研究員邁克爾·拉姆斯登教授擁有豐富的經驗和 按照國際標準完成該專案所需的背景。他 之前成功完成了GRF，涉及一個相關但更普遍的問題 戰略訴訟的性質（“戰略訴訟：國際和 比較研究，2014/2015）。他還開始分析最近的精選 國際法院的戰略訴訟及其近期影響，附文章 發表於《歐洲國際法雜誌》和《范德比爾特雜誌》 跨國法。繼續在高影響力的學術場所發表文章，該專案 將首次全面系統地調查 國際法院的戰略訴訟。

14610923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14610923.value: 『我的心在下沉』：通過影像發聲探索香港南亞女性的情感掙扎

14610923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14610923.value: Prof Huang, Shixin Prof Mak, Arthur Dun-ping

14610923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14610923.value: Discussions of emotional struggling by South Asian women in Hong Kong often resort to heart-related metaphors. Expressions like “my heart is sinking” or “there is a lot of burden on my heart” or “I feel my heart is getting smaller” are recurrent and convey different experiences of emotional discomfort under the overriding paradigm of heart-related issues. Doctors may label such anecdotes of struggling in terms of mental health issues, yet the biomedical frameworks in which they are embedded are unlikely to fully encapsulate their experiences (Giordano, 2014). Doctors and social workers alike may try to adopt culturalist explanations to make sense of these women’s suffering, which is often associated with the underutilization of available mental health services. When treated as an isolated “fixed variable,” however, culture has often been seen to hinder rather than promote care and understanding (Kleinman, 2004) By contrast, South Asian women may instead have ambivalent understandings of their experiences of emotional struggling and not necessarily comprehend them in biomedical terms (Giordano, 2014; Kleinman & Good, 1985). Heart-related metaphors appear to convey a spectrum of emotions, which may be situational and related to everyday concerns or instead run deep and become entangled with their life-worlds and intersecting social identities. For example, emotional distress has been attributed to the female identity and to such lifecycle events as menstruation, pregnancy and menopause (Fund, 2009), while questions to do with ethnic and migrant identities have also contributed to suffering (Tonsing, 2015) where their challenges remain unseen (Anand & Cochrane, 2005). While psychotherapy may be a useful resource to interpret and process emotional distress, the point is that there is a danger in reducing emotional struggling to biomedical explanations (Giordano, 2014; Kleinman & Good, 1985). As a continuance of our last GRF study on communication justice and intersecting forms of discrimination in South Asian women’s health experience, this study will engage in a 24-month participatory-action research that employs techniques of the “photovoice” method to explore what it means to experience emotional suffering from the perspectives of South Asian women in HK. The aim of the study is threefold: (1) to provide the space where our interlocutors are able to define and/or dimensionalize emotional discomfort in their own terms by means of photos and discussion; (2) to acknowledge the emotional response elicited by discussions of this nature; (3) and to explore the different strategies they may employ to cope with emotional struggling. 在香港的南亞女性中，對於情感掙扎的討論往往會借用與心臟相關的隱喻。例如「我的心在下沉」、「我心上有沉重的負擔」或者「我感覺我的心在變小」等表達方式經常出現，傳達了在以心臟相關問題為主導範疇下的不同情感困擾經歷。 醫生可能會將這些困擾的故事歸類為心理健康問題，然而，這些故事所嵌入的生物醫學框架很可能無法完全涵蓋他們的經歷（Giordano，2014）。醫生和社工可能會嘗試採用文化解釋來理解這些女性的苦難，這通常與現有精神健康服務的未充分利用有關。然而，當文化被視為孤立的「固定變量」時，往往會阻礙而非促進關懷和理解（Kleinman，2004）。 相比之下，南亞女性對於情感掙扎的理解可能存在矛盾的觀點，並不一定以生物醫學術語來理解這些經歷（Giordano，2014；Kleinman＆Good，1985）。與心臟相關的隱喻似乎傳達了一系列情感，這些情感可能與具體情境和日常關切有關，或者深深地與她們的生活世界和交織的社會身份相連。例如，情感困擾被歸因於女性身份以及月經、懷孕和更年期等生命周期事件（Fund，2009），而與種族和移民身份有關的問題也導致了苦難（Tonsing，2015），即便如此，她們的挑戰仍然未被看見（Anand＆Cochrane，2005）。儘管心理治療可能是解釋和處理情感困擾的有用資源，但要注意將情感掙扎簡化為生物醫學解釋的危險（Giordano，2014；Kleinman＆Good，1985）。 作為我們上一個關於南亞女性健康體驗中溝通正義和交織形式歧視的GRF研究的延續，本研究將進行為期24個月的參與行動研究，採用「影像發聲」方法，從居於香港的南亞女性角度探索情感困擾的意義。該研究的目標有三個：（1）提供一個空間，讓我們的對話者能夠通過照片和討論以她們自己的術語定義和/或描述情感不適；（2）確認因討論所引起的情感反應；（3）探索她們可能採用的應對情感困擾的不同策略。

14611823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14611823.value: 以腕動計測量的作息模式與重度抑鬱症的患病軌跡和治療成效之間的關係

14611823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14611823.value: Dr Chung, Ka-Fai Prof Harvey, Allison Mr Poon, Chun Yin Dr Smagula, Stephen Prof Yeung, Wing-Fai

14611823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14611823.value: 背景 紊亂的作息模式除了是重度抑鬱症的常見臨床特徵及合併症外，更是導致抑鬱發作和殘留症狀的重要因素。雖然目前針對抑鬱症的治療可以有效治療抑鬱症，但患者卻常常在治療後仍然留下作息模式紊亂的問題，嚴重影響對病情發展的預測。近年的研究證實針對睡眠和晝夜節律的治療能有效改善作息模式紊亂和抑鬱症狀。為了推進針對抑鬱症而設的個人化睡眠和晝夜節律治療的發展，我們需要先深入了解作息模式在抑鬱症治療和預後中所扮演的角色。 目標 本研究將包括一項縱向生態研究和一項隨機對照試驗。目標是 (1) 通過集群分析來識別重度抑鬱症患者的作息狀況； (2) 研究作息特徵/模式與抑鬱症預後之間的關係； (3) 探究針對睡眠和晝夜節律的治療對重度抑鬱症的效用以及作息特徵/模式會否影響其成效。 方法 研究一將招募70 名患有重度抑鬱症的參與者以及 70 名與他們年齡和性別匹配的健康對照者。他們將會連續 4 週戴上手錶式腕動計以記錄作息模式。在研究二中，上述的 70 名患有重度抑鬱症的參與者將按 1:1 的比例隨機分配至治療小組(TranS-C) 和照常護理組(CAU)。治療小組將接受由受訓的治療師提供為期 8 週的 TranS-C 治療，而 CAU 組將在 8 週期間正常生活。評估問卷將會在基線和治療後收集。整個研究二中亦會使用手錶式腕動計收集作息模式數據。此外，參與者的抑鬱嚴重程度將透過病人健康狀況問卷（PHQ-9）評估；同時亦會收集焦慮症狀、睡眠障礙、疲勞、生活質量和功能障礙等數據。 重要性 本研究將是首次嘗試了解以手錶式腕動計測量的作息模式對抑鬱症治療和預後的作用。由於作息模式紊亂比抑鬱症相比較少被污名化且更容易改變，針對睡眠和晝夜節律的治療會比針對抑鬱症的治療容易接受，因此有助於鼓勵他們自主尋求幫助和適時提供證據為本的個人化治療，從而對公共衛生產生重大影響。

14612023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14612023.value: 人與人工智能：人機交流中的語言風格和語言調適

14612023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14612023.value: This study compares the speech patterns of Cantonese speakers in human-human interaction (HHI) with those in human-machine interaction (HMI). It is now common for ordinary people to interact with AI assistants and products using their speech. Despite such prevalence, it is still unclear how humans would adapt their speech behaviours towards AI-machines in HMI. Recent studies demonstrated that English speakers talk differently in HMI resulting in an AI-directed speech register. Besides, speakers often accommodate to their interlocutors by modifying pronunciations and lexical choice to facilitate communication. Recent studies showed that speakers accommodated to human interlocutors but not necessarily to AI-assistants. The emerging field of HMI speech features is mainly based on English with a monolingual perspective while more than half of the world’s population are bilingual or multilingual. Whether there is an AI-directed speech register in Cantonese and whether speakers would accommodate, especially to machine, in their second language (L2 English) is still unknown. To better understand human’s communication patterns in HMI, this project investigates AI-directed register and speech accommodation with improved research methods over previous studies in two aspects. First, three age groups (children, young and old adults) are included to explore how people with different age and cognitive profiles would interact with an AI-voice. Second, it is still unknown if the fidelity of the AI-voice would have any influence on speakers’ speech patterns. It is possible that people are more willing to accommodate to a more natural-sounding AI-voice than one that is more machine-like. A customized AI-voice with two levels of fidelity instead of an existing commercial AI-assistant will be used for better manipulation of the target speech patterns and experimental control. Theoretically, the results of whether and how speakers would accommodate in HMI as compared to HHI can help decipher whether the mediated accounts or the unmedicated accounts of alignment can better explain human speech patterns. Practically, by understanding how the elderly and children reacts to an AI-voice, the designs of AI technology can be improved to accommodate the specific needs of these groups of users. Speech patterns of the elderly in HMI can also help develop more suitable and user-friendly interfaces in the future as many new AI technologies such as caring robots are designed to serve them. It is hoped that this project can break new ground in the understanding of the intertwining complexity of human, society and technology from the speech perspective. 本研究旨在比較廣東話使用者在人與人交流（HHI）和人與機器交流（HMI）中的語言模式。現今，人們已習慣使用語音與人工智能（AI）助手進行交流。儘管如此，學術界仍未清楚人們在HMI中是如何調適其語言。最新的研究表明，英語使用者在HMI中會使用面向AI的一種語言風格。此外，為了更好地交流，說話者通常會依據對話者的需求調整其發音和詞彙。當對話者是人類時，說話者會積極調適其發音以便更好地交流，但當對話者是AI智能助手時，說話者不一定會進行類似的調適。現階段針對HMI的語言特徵研究主要以英語為主，但是全球超過一半的人口是雙語或多語使用者。因此，新的研究不應該只限於英語或者單語使用者，而是有必要拓展到更多樣的語言，例如廣東話。針對廣東話的HMI研究非常有限，因此這個領域依然有很多未知之數。例如，廣東話中是否也存在面向AI的一種語言風格？說話者是否會在使用第二語言（例如香港英文）與AI智能助手交流時調適其發音？ 為了更好地了解人類在HMI中的溝通模式，本研究不僅將探討AI導向的語言風格及語言調適，還會從兩方面改進前人的研究方法。首先，本研究會收集三個年齡組（兒童、年輕人和老年人）的研究數據，以探索不同年齡和認知能力的說話者如何與AI人工智能進行交流。其次，目前的研究尚不清楚AI聲音的仿真度是否會對使用者的語言模式產生任何影響。人們可能會更願意對那些聽起來自然的AI聲音進行適應，但是對於那些聽起來較機械的聲音，人們可能會放棄調適。因此，為了更好地達到實驗目的，本研究會定制一把具有兩種不同仿真度的AI聲音，並對比不同仿真度對HMI語言交流模式的影響。 從理論的角度來看，比較HMI和HHI的語言調適模式可以幫助我們更好地去瞭解究竟是積極調適理論還是非調適理論更能解釋人類在社會活動中的語言變化。此外，當了解到老年人和兒童是如何針對AI聲音進行調適的話，我們可以進一步改進AI聲音的設計，以滿足這些用戶群體的特定需求。探究中老年人在HMI中的語言模式還可以幫助開發更適合老人的護理機器人。因此，本研究將從語言學的角度探索人、社會與新興技術三者之間的關係，並嘗試改進前人的研究方法，從而可以更全面地瞭解人與AI之間的語言交流。

14612923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14612923.value: 聽覺類別學習遷移的神經表徵機制

14612923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14612923.value: Generalization is a critical hallmark of human learning and cognition. The functional purpose of learning is to utilize past experiences, skills, and knowledge in new but similar scenarios so that we do not need to relearn every context-specific property when we encounter a new scenario. However, generalization poses significant challenges for our cognitive and neural learning systems across learning domains. Language learning, in particular, is one domain that may face the most challenging generalization problem among others because humans learn a language with limited input but use it in unlimited scenarios, especially for non-native second language learners. Thus, understanding how we learn and what we acquire that pertain to successful generalization are critical steps toward building theoretical models of language learning and informing education practice. In this proposal, we aim to examine the nature of neural representations of category knowledge associated with successful generalization and reveal representational neural systems involved in speech-like auditory category learning and generalization. Specifically, we examine changes in neural patterns underlying the representations of category knowledge during and after training for adult learners and investigate to which extent these neural changes predict generalization success. Three types of computational-based representational models (i.e., category labeling, decision bound distance, and distributional perceptual similarity) are constructed based on our Hierarchical Representation and Generalization (HRG) hypothesis to model neural pattern changes and predict generalization performance. We devised two functional Magnetic Resonance Imaging (fMRI) experiments where we manipulate different generalization contexts hierarchically, from changes in surface acoustics to input ears to the statistical distribution of the sounds from the training set, which enable us to test the generalization limitations and how different hypothesized representational systems (i.e., frontoparietal and auditory-motor networks) transfer the acquired category knowledge to new contexts. Finally, we propose constructing prediction models to predict individual learners' generalization performances with their neural changes and representational measures during training. Significant individual differences in generalization have been observed in speech and auditory category learning studies. Training-induced neural changes have been considered candidate neuromarkers of generalization success. By integrating the present novel generalization experimental design, representational modeling analysis, and advanced predictive modeling techniques, we can test novel hypotheses and predictions of the neurobiology of language learning and uncover the neural sources of individual differences in generalization. The potential findings could guide educational practice and clinical research by examining new training protocols to maximize generalization performances and minimize individual differences. 遷移能力是人類學習和認知的一個重要標誌。學習的目的是應用過去習得的經驗、技能和知識在新情境中，使得我們在遇到新環境時不需要重新學習與情境相關的每個特性。然而，無論哪個學習領域，要實現知識和技能的成功遷移，對我們的認知和學習神經系統都是一項重大挑戰。語言學習，可能是最具挑戰性的領域之一，因為人類需要在有限的語言輸入中學習語言，並應用於接近無限的新情境中；對成年人的第二語言學習尤為如此。因此，瞭解人類大腦如何學習並成功遷移語言知識和技能是建立語言學習認知神經模型和指導語言教育實踐的關鍵步驟。 在本研究項目中，我們的研究目的是考察支援聽覺類別學習遷移的神經表徵特性，並揭示聽覺類別學習和遷移相關的神經系統。我們計畫通過分析成人學習者在聲音分類訓練過程中及訓練結束後類別知識表徵的神經模式變化，考察這些神經變化在何種程度上能預測類別遷移的表現。根據我們提出的層級表徵和遷移（HRG）假設，我們構建了三類計算表徵模型（包括類別標記、決策邊界距離和分佈知覺相似性），以模擬神經模式變化，並預測遷移任務的表現。我們設計了兩個功能磁共振成像實驗去檢驗假設。在實驗中，我們操縱了不同新異程度的遷移情境，從表面聲學的變化、輸入耳朵的改變到訓練聲音集分佈模式的變化，這使我們能夠測試遷移的邊界和局限性，以及與不同模型假設相關的神經表徵系統（如前額頂葉和聽覺運動網絡）如何將所學的類別知識遷移到新情境中。 最後，我們計畫構建個體遷移預測模型，以預測不同學習者在訓練期間的神經表徵變化對訓練後遷移表現的影響。在語音和聽覺類別學習研究中，不同學習者之間存在顯著的個體差異。訓練引起的神經變化被認為是成功遷移的潛在神經標記。通過整合當前創新的遷移實驗範式、神經表徵分析和先進的預測建模技術，我們可以檢驗語言學習認知神經方面的新假說，並揭示學習遷移個體差異的神經來源。未來的研究成果可以通過構建新的訓練策略來指導教育實踐和臨床研究，以最大限度地提高語言學習遷移表現並減少個體差異。

14614123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14614123.value: 以理論為基礎的跨專業教育計劃助提高香港華人社區長者的2019年冠狀病毒疫苗接種率

14614223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14614223.value: 納西東巴手稿與敦煌藏語文獻比較研究

14614223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14614223.value: The Naxi manuscripts, written in a uniquely “pictographic” script, have found their way from the remote Himalayan foothills of China into many museums and library collections across the world. But beyond detailing the myths and rituals of this small Tibeto-Burman minority people, what can these enigmatic manuscripts tell us about the early religious practices of Tibet? It has long been suggested that the Naxi manuscripts contain an inheritance from early Tibetan religion that has been filtered into the composite religious edifice of the Naxi people. The study of these connections has, however, not gone beyond identifying some surface-level similarities between the Naxi religion and what is known as organized “Bon” religion, which began to take shape in the eleventh century. This project aims to connect newly discovered Naxi manuscripts which have yet to be fully deciphered with the early Tibetan manuscripts excavated at Dunhuang that date from the ninth to tenth centuries. It will attempt to show how Naxi manuscripts have recorded and preserved certain features of early Tibetan religion via the deciphering of manuscripts that, despite being written in the Naxi script, are meant to be read in the Tibetan, and not Naxi, language. From such a study we can identify undiscovered affinities between the Naxi dongba religious specialists and the bon pos, the religious specialists attested in the Dunhuang manuscripts. New discoveries of Naxi manuscripts offer inights into elements of Tibetan ritual previously thought lost. By focusing on such connections, it will be possible to create tools for scholars of Tibetan studies to approach and use the Naxi manuscripts in their research, tools that include a bilingual glossary and a guide to iconographic depictions. This will have the double benefit of helping to develop Naxi studies by allowing more scholars to access the manuscripts (which we have many thousands of, but that very few people can read), and leading to the possibility of broadening Tibetan studies by incorporating the corpus of Naxi ritual literature under its umbrella. 納西手稿由獨特的“象形文字”書寫而成，並從中國偏遠的喜馬拉雅山麓進入到了全球多個博物館和圖書館典藏中。但是，除詳細記錄了納西這個藏緬少數民族的神話和儀式之外，這些神秘手稿還能如何為我們講述西藏早期的宗教儀式？長期以來都有人認為納西手稿具有早期西藏宗教的傳承，而後者已經滲入到了納西人的整體宗教構建中。然而，對這些聯繫的研究，目前為止無非是停留在納西宗教與十一世紀開始成形的雍仲苯教之間的一些表面的相似之處。該項目旨在將新發現的尚未完全破譯的納西族手稿與敦煌發掘的九至十世紀的早期西藏手稿聯繫起來。 通過破譯納西手稿，本項目將試圖展示此類手稿是如何記錄和保存早期西藏宗教的某些特征的。儘管這些手稿由納西語寫成，但應以藏語而不是納西語進行閱讀。從此研究中，我們能夠找出納西東巴祭司與敦煌手稿中所記載的宗教祭司苯波之間尚且不為人知的親緣關係。新發現的納西手稿可以幫助我們深入了解一些原以為已經遺失的西藏宗教儀式元素。關注這些聯繫有可能為西藏研究者們創造在研究中借鑒和使用納西手稿的工具，包括雙語詞彙表和圖形書寫指南等。 這也將有助於發展納西研究，讓更多的學者能夠查閱納西手稿（我們有成千上萬的手稿，但很少有人能閱讀），並通過將納西儀式文獻納入西藏研究之中從而擴大後者的研究前景。

14614423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14614423.value: 東亞都市女性的家庭管理：大阪和香港女性經濟支柱的個人、社會及財務管理的人類學研究

14614423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14614423.value: Urban East Asian society continues to be understood as consisting primarily of male family breadwinners and women who may work but who are largely responsible for family caregiving. This model dominates academic, popular media, and policy-level approaches to East Asian societies in spite of dramatic shifts in women’s educational levels, marital patterns, and household composition in recent decades. Specifically, the numbers of women who are primary income earners in their families have increased in recent years due to women’s rising levels of education, increased singlehood and divorce, and increased migration. Women-headed households are often assumed to be impoverished, marginal, and socially isolated yet data suggests that in spite of socio-economic impediments and economic hardship, a growing majority of female primary earners are managing family caregiving, economic activities, and are active in their communities. In sum, little is known about how women primary earners manage their resources, foster new identities for themselves and their children, create networks in their communities, and thereby shape their societies. Using anthropological methods of indepth interviews, the project aims to investigate how women primary earners - who financially support themselves and dependents - manage their personal lives and identities, their incomes and household finances, and social networks and engagements. Women primary earners in this study include never-married, divorced, separated, and widowed women, and women who are married and living in households in which husbands are absent or are secondary earners either by choice or due to constraints such as disability or unsuitability to labor market conditions. The study compares female primary earners and their families in Osaka and Hong Kong, two East Asian cities with growing numbers of female primary earner households. Both societies have experienced rapid economic growth based on state-supported models of a male primary earner. At the same time both societies have high levels of women’s labor force participation, creating conflict between feminine carer ideals and the reality of women’s need or desire to serve as primary earner for various reasons. The comparison of Osaka and Hong Kong will allow an enriched understanding of how family, state, and normative values shape female primary earners’ experiences in managing their personal, familial and social lives. The findings are expected to have a significant impact on academic literature on East Asian families and may shape policy formation in ways that support women primary earners and their families in an era of growing family and lifestyle diversity. 東亞都市的社會一向被認為主要由擔當經濟支柱的男性及可能有工作但主力仍是照顧家庭的女性所組成。儘管近幾十年來女性的教育水平、婚姻模式和家庭結構皆有着天翻地覆的變化，但這種看法仍主導着東亞社會的學術、大眾媒體和政策層面的方向。具體而言，近年來女性擔當家庭經濟支柱的數目上升，歸因於女性受教育程度的提高、單身和離婚，及移民的情況增加。以女性為戶主的家庭常被認為是貧困、邊緣及被社會孤立的，但從數據反映出，儘管存在歧視、社會經濟障礙及經濟拮據，依然有越來越多的女性擔當經濟支柱並照顧家庭、從事經濟活動，及活躍在社區中。總的來說，對女性經濟支柱如何管理她們的資源、為她們自己及孩子培養新的身份，及與社區聯繫從而形塑她們的社會所知甚少。本研究採用人類學中深度訪談的方法，調查在經濟上能養活自己及他人的女性經濟支柱，如何管理個人生活和個性身份、個人收入和家庭財務，以及社交網絡和參與。當中女性經濟支柱包括從未結婚、已離婚、分居中和喪偶的婦女，以及已婚而丈夫不在家庭中，或丈夫是家庭中次要經濟來源（可能是出於自身選擇、殘疾或不合勞工市場現況等原因）的婦女。本研究比較了大阪和香港這兩個東亞都市的女性經濟支柱及其家庭，女性擔當經濟支柱的家庭數量在這兩地正不斷增加。這兩地的社會都在政府支持男性擔當經濟支柱的模式基礎上，經歷了快速的經濟增長。與此同時，這兩地的女性參與勞動的比率都很高，從而在女性擔當照顧者的模楷及（出於女性自身需要或願望）家庭經濟支柱之間引起了衝突。藉由大阪和香港的比較，可以更深入地瞭解家庭、政府和規範價值觀如何形塑女性經濟支柱在管理個人、家庭和社會生活的經驗。研究結果預期將對有關東亞家庭的學術文獻有顯著的影響，並在家庭和生活方式日益多元化的時代，可能左右到政策上以支持女性經濟支柱及其家庭的方式而製定。

14614523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14614523.value: 商務印書館與美育運動的跨文化脈絡研究 (1897-1940)

14614523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14614523.value: The Commercial Press (the Press) is the most prominent book company in promoting modern thought and culture in the May Fourth Era. Echoing the call of the New Culture Movement and the Aesthetic Education Movement, the Press published a number of works to promote fine art, aesthetics, and aesthetic education, bringing different foreign aesthetic thought into modern China. Present studies on the Aesthetic Education Movement mainly focus on the contribution of Cai Yuanpei蔡元培 and Wang Guowei王國維, especially on their receptions of the aesthetics of Kant, Schopenhauer and Schiller. Besides these prominent names, many books and translation publications that played a role in the dissemination of aesthetic education thought remain underexplored. In our preliminary statistics, at least 27 books and translations, with around 40 lesser-known intellectuals involved, are closely related to the movement. Our project aims to reevaluate the contributions and limitations of the Press in the history of modern Chinese aesthetic education, through an integrated discussion on the publishing strategy of the Press in aesthetic education. It attempts to identify the sources of thought, explore the history of thought exchange, and reveal the transcultural network of aesthetic education thought by case studies on selected works and textual analysis. Key issues of the project include (1) to analyze the contributions of various Chinese intellectuals and translators on the promotion of aesthetic education in The Commercial Press in the May Fourth period, (2) to investigate the transculturality of May Fourth aesthetic education in connection with the philosophy and literature in Europe, Russia, US, and Japan, (3) to explicate the complexity of the discussion in the history of modern Chinese aesthetic education through a transcultural perspective, (4) to reflect on the dynamics and tensions of the Aesthetic Education Movement delivered by The Commercial Press in an era of change. 商務印書館（商務）是五四時期宣傳新思想和新文化的重鎮。商務響應新文化運動與美育運動的號召，曾出版大量推動美術、美學和美育的作品，將各種外國美學思想引入現代中國。 現存對美育運動的研究主要集中於蔡元培和王國維的貢獻，尤其是他們對康德、叔本華和席勒美學的接受。該時期其實尚有各種書籍與譯作曾為美育思想的傳播作出重要貢獻，但未為學界深入探討。據初步統計，與美育運動密切相關的書籍和譯著超過20本，涉及約40位較少為人論及的知識份子。 本計劃旨在探討1897-1940年間商務的出版策略如何推動美育運動，並重新審視其在中國現代美育史上的貢獻和限制。本計劃將選取相關作品進行個案研究和文本分析，查考其中美育思想的來源與流變，藉以揭示美育思想的跨文化網路。 本計劃之主要議題包括：（1）分析五四時期中國知識份子和翻譯家透過商務印書館對美育的貢獻，（2）連繫歐、俄、美、日等地的哲學與文學，探究五四美育的跨文化性，（3）從跨文化視角闡釋中國現代美育史討論的複雜性；（4）反思商務在變動的時代下推動美育所呈現的動力和張力。

14614723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14614723.value: 危機與敘事的政治：以戦時日本為例

14614723.label: Project Objectives
14614723.value: To explore the connections between storytelling and politics. To use case studies from Japan during its war in China (1937-1945) and the Asia-Pacific War (1941-1945) to show how storytelling about political leaders in Japan served as a vehicle of hope for the future. Biographical stories about leaders like Tōjō Hideki, Konoe Fumimaro, and others offered a message of hope. They offered plausible narratives as to why those leaders were the appropriate men to navigate the ship of state during an unfolding global crisis. To show why storytelling matters, and how storytelling helped justify and legitimize Japan's aggressive war for hegemony in Asia. To use biographical storytelling during World War II to place Japanese history in global context. I hope to show that the use of stories about political leaders to convey messages of hope was part of a global trend, one that was not limited to fascist regimes. To produce at least one peer-reviewed article for submission to a leading international journal.

14614723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14614723.value: Stories have power, and storytelling can be a meaningful political act. The evocative nature of storytelling, notes philosopher and political theorist Hannah Arendt, is what gives stories their true power. “Storytelling,” she writes, “reveals meaning without the error of defining it.” Without stories to assign meaning, the past “would remain an unbearable sequence of sheer happenings.” This project takes Arendt’s notion as its point of departure and explores the power and political impact of biographical storytelling during Japan’s time of crisis, the era of World War II (1937-1945). It focuses on tales about Japanese political leaders during Japan’s war in China and the Asia-Pacific War. In specific, I hope to show how the mass media and even propaganda outlets circulated stories that built support for about Japan’s extraordinarily popular wartime prime ministers and governmental officials, Konoe Fumimaro, Tōjō Hideki, and a number of other wartime leaders. In doing so, I do not seek to analyze propaganda per se, although some biographical stories were propagandistic in nature. Instead, I intend instead to study the politics of storytelling, and to explore the social and political meanings those stories may have held. I will focus on commonly told stories about both the childhood and adult lives of Japan’s political and military leaders to show how stories were part and parcel of a politics of hope during the wartime era. The world appeared to be amid a great turning point in political history. I hope to show that storytelling played an important political function during this perceived turning point. By “revealing meaning” without being ham-handed or clumsy, many stories served as a type of persuasive discourse that represented a cry of hope for Japan's future. They highlighted why Japanese leaders were the appropriate men to navigate the ship of state during an unfolding global crisis. This project is significant in that it will show how the very act of storytelling (especially biographical storytelling) contributed to the extraordinary popularity of leaders like Konoe and Tōjō. More importantly, I hope to show that by legitimizing and popularizing political leaders, stories also served as vehicles of hope for Japan’s future. They were part of a cultural politics of hope that was common to regimes on either side of the global war—fascist, militarist, and democratic regimes alike. Studying these histories remains a powerful reminder of the importance of stories in the shaping of political discourse even in today’s world. 故事帶有力量，而敘事能夠是一種具有意義的政治行為。哲學家及政治理論家漢娜．阿倫特（Hannah Arendt）曾說過，敘事所具備的撼動人心的性質正正為故事賦予真正的力量。她說道：「敘事能揭示意義，同時能避免犯下為意義下定義的錯誤。」如若缺少了故事去賦予意義，過去「只不過是令人難以承受的一系列所發生的事。」本研究以阿倫特的概念為出發點，探討人物敘事於日本危機之時，即第二次世界大戰（1937-1945）中所蘊含的力量與政治影響。我會集中討論日本在華及在亞太地區戰爭期間有關日本政治領袖的軼事。更明確來說，我希望展示大眾傳媒以至宣傳媒介如何傳播故事，藉此為極受歡迎的日本戰時首相和政府官員吸納支持，特別是近衛文麿、東條英機和其他幾位戰時領袖。然而，這研究的目的並不是要分析那些宣傳本身，儘管有些人物傳記故事本來就帶有宣傳的意味和性質。反而，我著意去研究敘事的政治，並去探究那些故事所蘊涵的社會及政治意義。 我會集中討論關於日本政治及軍事領袖們家傳戶曉的童年及成年生活故事，去展示故事如何在戰爭時期成為希望的政治（politics of hope）不可或缺的元素。其時，世界似乎正處於政治史上的重大轉捩點。我期望顯示出敘事在那個人們所感知的轉捩點中所擔當的重要政治功能。因著能夠「揭示意義」而不顯得笨拙，很多故事成為了一種具感染力、具說服力的論述，而這種論述代表著對日本未來抱有希望的吶喊。它們正正強調為何時任日本領袖們正是適合不過的人選，於逐步迫近的全球危機中能帶領國家之船掌舵航行。 本研究的重要之處在於能反映敘事（尤其是人物傳記的敘事）這種行為本身如何掀起對近衛文麿及東條英機等領袖的狂熱支持。更重要的是，我希望展示出種種故事在為政治領袖們建立正當性及支持度時，同時驅動著對日本未來的希望。這些都是關於希望的文化政治，常見於這場全球戰爭中的兩方陣營——法西斯政權如是，軍國主義政權如是，民主政權亦如是。 研讀這段歷史正好是一個強而有力的提醒，提醒著我們故事在塑造政治論述中的重要性，即或於今天的世界。

14615723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14615723.value: 嶺南西部漢銅器的考古學研究與漢帝國對嶺南地區的融合

14615723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14615723.value: The aim of this project is to interrogate long-held assumptions about local bronze production in western Lingnan and the accessibility of bronzes in the region through an archaeological study of Han bronzes. Lingnan was conquered in a military campaign undertaken by Han Wudi, and thereafter integrated into the imperial infrastructure. While its overall economic development is often thought to have lagged behind other parts of the empire, previous studies of Lingnan bronzes have argued that much bronzeware might have been locally manufactured, although imported bronzes clearly also played a part. The development of local craft production, however, is hard to square with the underdeveloped image of Lingnan, considering sophisticated resources and management that would have been needed. Nonetheless, Han bronze objects in the region have not been subjected to any systematic investigation. Little is yet known about the extent to which local production took place, and how the accessibility of bronzes contributed to integrating Lingnan into the imperial economic system. In order to shed light on the role of bronzes, this study will focus on several aspects of bronzes from western Lingnan, including ore sources, manufacturing techniques, and the ranks of occupants of tombs where bronzes have been found. This project will use a number of research methods, including metallurgical analysis, geochemical analysis, and multivariate statistical analysis of burial goods and rank indicators. The new datasets generated by this project are expected to enable several outstanding issues to be resolved: (a) whether the ore sources of Han bronzes in Lingnan are similar to the local ore sources or to those of bronzes manufactured in other regions; (b) whether the chemical composition and manufacturing techniques of bronzes are similar or different to other known Han bronzes, and if intergroup variations among bronzes from Lingnan exist; and (c) whether bronzes were not exclusively high-status markers but may have been accessible to individuals further down the social scale. The project’s research outputs will contribute to the study of Han empire in several important ways. First, the study will provide data for determining whether, and how far, bronzes were locally manufactured. Second, this project will help to illuminate how local supply and transportation of bronzes took place during the Han period. Finally, its findings will help to provide a better understanding of how Lingnan was integrated into the imperial system through the development of local craft industry and the interregional transportation of metal goods. 本項目旨在通過對漢代青銅器的考古研究，重新審視在嶺南西部地區可能存在的本土青銅生產以及關於嶺南地區青銅器獲取方式的長期假設。嶺南在漢武帝的征服後納入了帝國版圖，雖然整體經濟發展落後於漢王朝的其他地區，對嶺南青銅器的以往研究卻指出，許多青銅器可能是在本地製造，儘管進口青銅器也毫無疑問扮演著重要角色。考慮到青銅器生產所需複雜的資源和管理，本地銅器生產發展這一說法與嶺南的落後形象不太相符。由於該地區漢代青銅器尚未經系統的分析，我們對本地的生產程度瞭解有限，青銅器的獲取如何影響到漢代帝國經濟對當地融合也是極待解決的問題。為了闡明青銅器的歷史作用，本研究將重點關注嶺南西部地區青銅器的多個方面，包括原料來源、製造技術以及出土青銅器的墓葬其墓主的身份地位。本研究將採用多種研究方法，包括冶金分析、地球化學分析以及隨葬品和墓主身份指標的多元統計分析。本項目產生的新資料預計將有助於解決以下幾個未解決問題：（a）漢代嶺南青銅器的原料來源是類似於本地礦料來源還是類似於其他地區所製作的青銅器礦料來源；（b）青銅器的化學組成和製造技術是否與已知的其他漢代青銅器相似或不同，以及嶺南青銅器之間是否存在組內差異；（c）青銅器是否僅僅是高社會地位的標誌，還是在社會不同層及和身份的群體也有一定流通性。本項目的研究成果將從以下方面推動對漢代帝國的研究。首先，該研究將提供資料，以確定青銅器是否在本地製造，以及製造程度達到何種水平。其次，本研究將有助於闡明漢代青銅器的本地供應和運輸方式。最後，本研究結果將有助理解嶺南如何通過本地手工業的發展和金屬貨物的區域運輸來融入帝國體系。

14615923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14615923.value: 香港患有輕度認知障礙的中國老年夫婦的經歷變化：縱向香港患有輕度認知障礙的中國老年夫婦的經歷變化：縱向香港患有輕度認知障礙的中國老年夫婦的經歷變化：縱向二元混合方法調查

14615923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14615923.value: Prof Chan, Helen Yue-lai Prof Fung, Helene Hoi-lam Prof Lou, Vivian Weiqun Dr Lu, Peiyi Prof Mok , Vincent Chung Tong Prof Wu, Bei

14615923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14615923.value: Alzheimer’s disease and related dementias (ADRD) are global public health priorities. Compared to those with normal cognition, individuals with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) have a 3-5 times higher risk of developing ADRD. Thus, the MCI stage provides a window of opportunity to delay cognitive deterioration before it reaches the clinical stage of ADRD. Accumulating evidence suggests that older adults’ coping with life stressors (e.g., MCI) can impact their own and their partners’ psychological and marital well-being. However, existing research on cognitive impairment primarily conceptualizes coping with stressors as an individual phenomenon, whereas how couples collaboratively cope with MCI remains poorly understood. A limited body of literature on couple-based cognition research is available in Western cultures, leaving a significant gap in understanding these issues in non-Western cultures. Couple-based studies are warranted in diverse cultures to generate culturally and contextually relevant knowledge of the stress and coping processes within intimate relationships. Therefore, we propose a dyadic, longitudinal, mixed-methods study with a sequential explanatory design to investigate how older persons with MCI and their partners jointly cope with MCI and whether dyadic coping leads to changes in psychological and marital outcomes for both partners, while investigating the moderating effects of Chinese cultural values. The proposed study encompasses two phases. First, we will collect longitudinal survey data from a cohort of 223 older couples (i.e., 446 respondents) to quantify changes in couple-level coping behaviors, psychological well-being, marital functioning, and orientation to Chinese cultural values at three time points (baseline [T1], 12 months [T2], and 24 months [T3]). Innovative dyadic analytic techniques (i.e., the actor-partner interdependence model [APIM] and APIM moderation analysis) and latent profile analyses will be used. Second, upon completion of the quantitative data collection, we will conduct follow-up in-depth individual interviews with a purposeful subsample of 30 couples (i.e., 60 respondents) to derive nuanced understandings of couples’ collaborative coping behaviors, transitions, and dynamics in their marital relationships and of their lived experiences. The qualitative interviews will be examined using content analysis. The proposed study is the first to investigate the longitudinal relationships of dyadic coping behaviors with changes in psychological and marital outcomes among older couples living with MCI in Chinese culture. The findings will: 1) identify older couples at high risk of experiencing psychological and marital dysfunctions, which will inform the development of targeted intervention efforts; and 2) contribute a unique Chinese cultural perspective to existing dyadic health theory and research. 腦退化症是全球公共衛生的優先事項。與認知能力正常的人相比，輕度認知障礙（MCI）患者罹患腦退化症的風險要高3-5倍。因此，MCI階段為患者提供了一個窗口期，可在認知退化達到腦退化症臨床階段之前將其延緩。越來越多的證據表明，老年人應對生活壓力（如MCI）的能力會影響其自身及伴侶的心理健康和婚姻幸福。然而，現存關於認知障礙的研究將壓力視為個人現象，而關於伴侶之間如何共同應對MCI仍知之甚少。西方文化中，基於夫妻的認知研究文獻仍有限，這也給瞭解非西方文化中此類問題留下了巨大的研究空白。我們需要在不同文化背景下開展以夫妻為基礎的研究，以產生與當地文化和背景相關的知識，瞭解親密關係中的壓力和應對過程。本研究採用動態縱向混合研究方法，旨在研究MCI患者及其伴侶如何共同應對MCI，以及合作應對應對行為是否會導致伴侶雙方的心理和婚姻結果發生變化，並調查中國文化價值觀在其中的調節作用。 此研究包含兩個階段。其一，我們將收集223對老年夫妻的縱向問卷資料（即446名受訪者），以量化在三個時間點（基線[T1]、12個月[T2]和24個月[T3]）夫妻層面的應對行為、心理健康、婚姻功能以及中國文化價值觀導向的變化。我們將採用行為者-伴侶相互依賴模型 [APIM]和APIM調節分）和潛在特徵分析。其二，在完成定量資料收集後，我們將有目的地對30對夫妻（即60名受訪者）進行深度個人訪談，以深入瞭解夫妻在婚姻關係中的合作應對行為、改變、以及他們的生活經歷。定性訪談將採用內容分析法。本研究是首次在中國文化背景下對患有MCI的老年夫妻的雙向應對行為與心理和婚姻結果變化之間的縱向關係進行調查。研究結果將：（1）識別存在心理和婚姻功能障礙的高風險老年夫婦，為制定針對性干預措施提供參考；（2）為現有的伴侶健康理論和研究提供獨特的中華文化視角。

14616123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616123.value: 香港的家庭多種語言及尼泊爾少數族裔的語言政策：第三空間的視角

14616123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14616123.value: Dr GU, Mingyue Michelle Prof Phyak, Bahadur Prem

14616123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616123.value: Research shows that Nepali ethnic minorities are one of the most marginalized, segregated and disadvantaged ethnic minorities in Hong Kong (Tsung & Gao, 2012). The ‘biliterate’ (Chinese and English) and ‘trilingual’ (Cantonese, Mandarin and English) language policy of the city is one of the major factors affecting their sociocultural, educational, economic and professional engagement in the public sphere. This policy has created an unequal linguistic environment contributing to growing language shift and loss of ethnic minority languages (Thapa & Adamson, 2018). It has posed an increased pressure for them to speak Chinese and English not only in public spaces but also in the family domain. In Hong Kong, two recent studies (Gu & Tong, 2020; Gu & Han, 2021) have investigated how South Asian ethnic minorities, including Nepalis, have managed multilingualism in the family. Based on migrant mothers’ interview data, they found that the family language policy of ethnic minorities is shaped by their educational, economic, and cultural experiences in Hong Kong. However, they do not problematize and critically assess the role of the family in creating a multilingual space nor do they pay attention to language practices and ideological tensions among the family members across generations. This study uses ‘thirdspace’ (Soja, 1996) and ‘embedded mixed method’ (Creswell & Clark, 2007) to investigate and problematize the role of the family in language management, practices and ideologies of Nepali ethnic minorities in Hong Kong. The study focuses on how Nepali minorities across generations perceive the role of their family in creating a multilingual environment that supports the use of their heritage language and examines their ideological and implementational tensions to manage multilingualism in relation to official language policy. First, we conduct a survey of two hundred families to understand the situation of family multilingualism. By using a set of questionnaire, we will collect data about language practices, management and ideologies, and impacts of the official language policy on language choice, particularly heritage languages, in the family. Second, we use ethnography (Curdt-Christiansen, 2016) to collect in-depth data from twelve families representing four major Indigenous/tribal groups: Limbu, Rai, Gurung, and Magar. Participant observation, in-interviews, including oral history, and field notes will be used as major data collection methods. Language-related artefacts, multilingual performances, and affordances will also be collected. The survey data will be analyzed by using statistical tools and the ethnographic data will be coded and analyzed by using a thematic approach.

14616223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616223.value: 手語語音意識訓練對聾健雙語兒童語言和識字發展的影響

14616223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616223.value: Sign languages have their own phonological systems which govern how visual phonological units can be combined to form the structural composition of a sign. Higher levels of sign language phonological awareness (i.e., knowledge of how sign-phonological units, namely handshape, location, and movement, combine to form signs) have been linked to stronger language and literacy skills in deaf/hard-of-hearing (DHH) children. However, no research has investigated whether teaching interventions aimed at increasing sign-phonological awareness can lead to improved educational outcomes in these areas of linguistic development. As DHH children often face obstacles in attaining levels of literacy equal to those of their hearing peers, research aimed at improving reading skills in this population is of critical importance. Furthermore, in DHH and hearing bilinguals, higher levels of phonological awareness in one language have been found to correlate with linguistic skills in the other language, suggesting that phonological awareness may have cross-linguistic benefits. If this is the case, improving sign-language phonological awareness could have positive developmental effects, not only in DHH children, but hearing children as well, given that they have some knowledge of a natural sign language. This three-year research project proposes to investigate the effects of sign language phonological awareness training for DHH and, additionally, hearing children who know Hong Kong Sign Language (HKSL). Looking at both DHH and hearing children who have been exposed to HKSL, Cantonese, and written Chinese through a bimodal bilingual educational program, we intend to investigate whether training in sign-phonological awareness can lead to improvements in (1) sign-phonological awareness and language production skills in HKSL; (2) phonological awareness and language production skills in Cantonese through cross-linguistic transfer; and (3) Chinese reading comprehension, vocabulary size, and word learning ability. 手語語音意識訓練對聾健雙語兒童語言和識字發展的影響 手語擁有自己的語音系統，規範視覺語音單位如何組合形成手語的結構。較高的手語語音意識水平（即對手型、位置和動作等手語語音單位如何組合形成手語的認識），已證實與聾/弱聽（DHH）兒童擁有較強的語言和識字技能相關。然而，目前尚無研究調查提高手語語音意識的教學是否可以改善這些語言發展領域的教育成果。由於DHH兒童往往難以取得與其健聽同輩等同的識字水平，因此旨在改善這一群體的閱讀技能的研究至關重要。此外，過往關於聾健雙語者的研究指出，一種語言的語音意識水平與另一種語言的語言技能有着正向的關連，這表明提升語音意識可能具有跨語言的好處。如果是這樣，提高手語語音意識可能不僅對DHH兒童的發展產生積極的影響，而且對健聽兒童也可能產生相同影響，前提是他們需對自然手語有一定的認識。此研究項目爲期三年，調查對象是在雙渠道雙語教育課程中接受香港手語（HKSL）、廣東話和書面中文教育的DHH兒童和有接觸HKSL的健聽兒童，志在探討手語語音意識訓練能否透過跨語言轉移，提升他們的(1) HKSL手語語音意識和語言產出技能；(2) 廣東話的語音意識和語言產出技能；以及 (3) 中文閱讀理解、詞量和詞語學習能力。

14616323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616323.value: 基於領域知識引導的深度學習與智慧手機拍照估算室內PM2.5濃度

14616323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616323.value: 空氣污染對人類健康構成了重大威脅。 據報導，室內和室外空氣污染的綜合影響每年導致全球約七百萬人過早死亡。 本專案提出使用廣泛可獲得的智能手機照片來測量室內PM2.5濃度，以解決室內空氣環境數據缺乏的問題。 專案將結合深度學習和光學物理學領域知識，提出一種新的研究框架，用於通過單個智慧手機照片來測量室內PM2.5濃度。 專案也將開發一款移動應用程式來實現這種方法，並能夠為使用者提供室內/室外PM2.5監測和眾包暴露估計服務。 本專案所提出的使用智慧手機照片進行即時室內空氣污染監測的方法可以在顯著降低成本和提高估算精度的同時提高處理效率併為用戶帶來極大的便捷性。

14616723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616723.value: 數據驅動的地方研究：評估公共空間社交活動和關係以支持香港公共房屋社區

14616723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616723.value: In sustainable high-density cities, public spaces play an important role in social and community interaction, which can lead to place attachment, collaboration and improved social capital (Friedmann, 2010; Talen, 1999). In high-rise cities such as Hong Kong, public spaces in residential estates are of crucial importance, as they facilitate everyday activities and extend people's limited domestic space (Gou et al., 2018). Surveys have shown, however, that these areas are often too regulated, and more flexible spaces are needed for social activities (Lai, 2018; Yung et al., 2017). As Hong Kong continues to construct new public housing across its territory, there is an urgent need for systematic and quantitative research into public space socialising mechanisms, to improve design guidelines for estate layouts and public spaces which promote the formation of supportive communities. Recent developments in Computer Vision methodologies allow to trace human movements and location data from building or drone-mounted camera footage through Machine Learning algorithms (Gorrini et al., 2014; Philpot & Levine, 2022). Compared to manual observation techniques, these methods provide researchers with much higher amounts of samples, longer observation periods, higher levels of variety and accuracy (Schlickman, 2020). While these new technologies are most often applied to pragmatic applications relating to crowd safety, transport planning, shopping etc. (Brunetti, 2018), there is a lack of multi-disciplinary research connecting location analysis to social science. This project addresses these research gaps by referencing the fields of time geography and urban place studies, to identify behavioural parameters that indicate the ability of public spaces to support social interaction and placemaking. This project will (A) employ a Computer Vision based detection and analysis method, to evaluate spatial movement, social interaction and activity patterns in public spaces. The study will then (B) conduct a series of public space studies in several public housing estate open spaces, to collect behavioural data against different urban morphological settings. It will then (C) analyse correlations and formulate recommendations aimed at estate planners, public space designers and managers. The study will provide detailed, evidence-based insights into which facilities and spatial configurations support housing residents' public space needs, focusing on social activities, mental wellbeing, and processes of care in and by the community. This knowledge can contribute to Chapters 4 and 11 of Hong Kong’s Planning Standards and Guidelines (‘’Recreation, Open Space and Greening’’ and ‘’Urban Design Guidelines’’), and to planning processes for new public housing across Hong Kong, or in similar high-density locations internationally. 在可持續的高密度城市中，公共空間在社交和社區互動發揮著重要作用，增強地方歸屬感、協作和改善社會資本 (Friedmann, 2010; Talen, 1999)。 在香港等摩天城市，住宅區的公共空間至關重要，可促進日常活動並擴大人們有限的家庭空間 (Gou et al., 2018)。 然而調查顯示，這些區域往往監管過於嚴格，需要更靈活的空間進行社交活動 (Lai, 2018; Yung et al., 2017)。 隨著香港不斷在全境興建新的公共房屋，迫切需要對公共空間社交機制進行系統性、定量性的研究，以完善屋邨佈局和公共空間的設計指引，支持地方社區的形成。 電腦視覺 (computer vision) 運算法的最新發展允許通過機器學習從建築物或無人機安裝的攝像機鏡頭中跟踪人體運動和位置數據 (Gorrini et al., 2014; Philpot & Levine, 2022)。 與手動觀察技術相比，這些方法為研究人員提供了更多的樣本、更長的觀察週期、更高的多樣性和準確性 (Schlickman, 2020)。 雖然這些新技術最常應用於與人群安全、交通規劃、購物等相關的實用性研究 (Brunetti, 2018)，但仍缺乏應用於將地方分析與社會科學聯繫起來的跨學科研究。 這項目通過參考時間地理學和城市地方考察等領域來解決這些研究缺口，找出公共空間如何能更有效地支持社會互動和場所營造能力的參數。 該項目將 (A) 採用基於電腦視覺的檢測和分析方法，以評估公共場所的空間動線、社交互動和活動模式。 然後，這研究將(B)在多個公共屋邨開放空間進行一系列公共空間考察，以收集不同城市形態環境的行為數據。 然後，它將 (C) 分析數據相關性，並且為屋邨規劃者、公共空間設計師和管理者提出精確建議。 這研究將提供詳細的、循證的見解，了解哪些設施和空間配置能更有效支持居民的公共空間需求，重點關注社區活動、精神健康以及鄰舍互助的過程。 這些知識可以為香港規劃標準和準則的第 4 章和第 11 章（「康樂、休憩用地及綠化」和「城市設計指引」）以及香港各地新建公共住房的規劃流程和相類似的國際高密度城市做出貢獻。

14616923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
14616923.value: 性別、權力及網絡性騷擾: 一個四個東亞城市的比較研究

14616923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
14616923.value: Ms Lü, Pin Prof Nakano, Lynne Yukie Prof Otani, Junko Prof Shen , Hsiu-Hua Prof Wang , Xiying

14616923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14616923.value: 目標： 該項目旨在收集關於四個東亞城市（香港、北京、台北和大阪）年齡在18至29歲的大學生在網絡上遭受性騷擾（Online sexual harassment，下文簡稱網絡性騷擾）的系統性比較數據。它將研究性別、權力不平等以及不同政策體制和政府對虛擬世界的控制對網絡性騷擾的影響。儘管技術的快速發展極大地提高了獲取信息和民主參與公共討論的途徑，但也帶來了新的風險和傷害形式。網絡性騷擾就是其中的一個例子，它是在西方國家通過技術手段實施的性暴力中最常見的形式。然而，在非西方語境中對其本質瞭解甚少。 背景： 網絡性騷擾包括不受歡迎的性徵求、收到不受歡迎的性信息/圖片，以及在社交網絡、電報頻道、視頻發佈網站、個人博客、聊天室和討論論壇，或通過智能手機等技術中未經許可分享關於個人的性信息/文字/圖片。儘管有越來越多的文獻開始調查這個話題，但仍存在四個方面的研究空白。首先，以前的網絡性騷擾研究往往集中在兒童、青少年和女性的受害經歷上，而男性受到的關注有限。其次，它著重於受害而忽視了施害。第三，大多數網絡性騷擾研究只考察了單一的西方國家，對非西方社會基本未探討。第四，相關研究尚未進行比較調查，以瞭解不同的性別體制和因不同的暴力對女性的法律和政策反應而導致的不同程度的權力不平等如何塑造了網絡性騷擾的施害以及受害者的反應。通過結合在線調查、深度訪談和對與網絡性騷擾相關的立法和政府政策的系統審查，本項目將嘗試解決上述問題。本研究將比較對網絡性騷擾的不同文化含義，研究男性和女性在遭受網絡性騷擾經歷方面的共性和差異，並調查文化、社會和政治背景如何影響對網絡性騷擾的應對。 東亞社會的互聯網接入率與西方社會相當，但在文化和政治背景方面與西方社會存在差異。 貢獻與意義： 通過比較研究，我們可以確定女權運動、網絡厭女文化、政府對虛擬世界的控制以及與網絡性騷擾有關的政策是如何影響個人對網絡性騷擾的理解，其發生的感知和背景，以及受害者對此的反應。研究結果將對我們瞭解網絡性騷擾的文化內涵、性別和社會政治背景、風險因素、對健康的影響以及如何抵制網絡性騷擾做出重要貢獻。這些知識進而將有助於政策制定者制定立法回應，並鼓勵執法機構在調查投訴和執行法律時採用更有效的方法和程序。它還將使權益團體和教育者更容易設計干預措施，以預防非西方語境中的網絡性騷擾發生。

14617423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
14617423.value: Dense model learning aims to digest a large number of inputs and distill the useful information from all of them, which suits well the complex nature of economic and financial applications. L2-relaxation is one of the latest machine learning methods for dense models. This proposal seeks to extend the L2-relaxation from its relatively restrictive setting into much more general environment. One limitation of the theory of L2-relaxation is that the optimality is established under a block equicorrelated covariance, which is a special structure. To forsake the block equicorrelation, theoretical breakthroughs must be made. Once this step is successful, L2-relaxation can be expanded into a family of algorithms under the relaxation approach, and they can be applied to a variety of problems, including (i) forecast combination under low-rank covariance matrix based on factor models; (ii) high dimensional dense regressions; (iii) companion sparse features when sparsity is desirable in some particular contexts. These directions of generalization are useful in empirical studies such as mean-variance analysis with many assets, high dimensional predictive regressions in macroeconomics, and portfolio risk exposure control. 相對於機器學習中的稀疏模型，密集模型更適合應對複雜的經濟和金融場景，能夠從大量數據中提煉有價值的信息。"L2鬆弛"是當前眾多密集模型機器學習方法中的一個新方向，然而現有的研究文獻僅探討了其在較為嚴格假設條件下的統計特性。本研究計劃意在將L2鬆弛方法擴展至更廣泛的應用場景。 現有的L2鬆弛理論最大的局限在於，其最優性是基於具有塊等相關協方差這一特殊結構來建立的。我們需要尋求新的理論突破，以克服塊等相關性的限制。一旦成功實現這一目標，L2鬆弛有望擴展成為一個可應用於各種問題的算法系列，這些應用包括：（i）基於因子模型的低秩協方差矩陣下的預測組合；（ii）高維密集回歸模型；（iii）伴隨稀疏特徵的高維密集模型。這些泛化方向在研究中具有很高的實用價值，例如在處理大量資產的均值方差組合分析，高維預測回歸，以及資產組合風險敞口控制等問題時。
