15300023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300023.value: 開發以水為氫源的連續流立體發散金屬光氧化還原半氫化反應

15300023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300023.value: 炔烴的半加氫是化學工業中的重要反應，在藥物、農藥、天然產物等的製備中具有廣泛的應用。過去幾十年來，半氫化反應領域的主要研究焦點主要集中在立體選擇性和提供Z-或E-烯的化學選擇性，而進行反應的方法和裝置亦基本上保持不變。然而，這個領域仍然有非常需要解決的問題︰（一）化學選擇性和立體選擇性﹔（二）貴金屬催化劑的使用﹔（工）使用過量金屬還原劑﹔（四）有毒金屬及添加劑﹔（五）可擴展性差﹔（六）使用易燃氫氣和高壓設備。 在此，我們建議通過結合使用連續流化學和金屬光氧化還原催化來解決這些難題。連續流化學是一種強大的自動化合成技術，相對於傳統有機合成具有許多優勢。而金屬光氧化還原催化是一種多功能技術，利用光催化劑的力量和過渡金屬絡合物的反應性來實現條件溫和及高選擇性的反應。我們提出的方法以卑金屬催化劑和光催化劑代替貴金屬催化劑和金屬還原劑，通過單電子轉移（SET）過程還原金屬物質。我們的系統可以使用水作為氫源，同時反應可以在連續流中進行，以便於擴大反應規模並提高效率。我們的初步結果驗證了所提出研究的合理性，其中我們的金屬光氧化還原半氫化反應提供了具有優異化學選擇性和立體選擇性的烯烴。原型流動系統可以顯著強化該反應並將反應時間縮短至少95%。我們的金屬光氧化還原方法的潛力將得到充分探索，包括開發立體發散過程、可擴展的連續流系統和半氘化反應。其中機理研究的結果將指導擬議項目的開發，並為有機合成界提供重要的見解。 在我們新型金屬光氧化還原半氫化的開發過程中獲得的基礎和技術知識將對學術界和工業應用具有重要價值。所展示的流動系統將作為未來連續流光催化系統設計的代表模型。目前，流動化學在香港仍不發達。我們的研究將引起人們對連續流生產的關注，並有助於轉變精細化學品製造和製藥行業。

15300123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300123.value: 深度學習中超參數選擇的雙層優化

15300123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300123.value: 每個深度學習模型都有超參數，其值控制學習過程並影響預測效能。 超參數的一個例子是控制訓練誤差和模型複雜度之間的權衡的正則化參數。 雙層優化是一種很有前途的超參數選擇方法。 雙層優化問題由兩層優化問題組成，其中上層問題使超參數方面的驗證誤差最小化，而下層問題使用具有給定超參數值的訓練數據找到最優模型。 用於訓練深度學習模型的較低級別優化問題是大規模的且非凸的。 包括隨機梯度下降方法在內的一階優化方法由於其低記憶體需求和計算成本而成為標準的訓練科技。 此外，梯度方法的加速方案已被用於提高收斂速度和降低尋找平穩點的計算成本。 然而，由於具有大量數據的下層問題的不可微性和非凸性，深度學習中超參數選擇的雙層優化問題的平穩性和最優性還沒有得到很好的理解。 在數學上，低階問題的最優解和駐點定義了超參數的集值函數。 關於深度學習中集值函數的次微分的計算，我們知之甚少。 為了彌補這一差距，我們將研究雙層優化問題的平穩性和最優性，並開發有效的算法，使用光滑凸多數方法和加速方案來尋找超參數選擇的平穩點。 該項目旨在系統地研究超參數選擇的雙層優化問題的優化理論，並為深度學習中的優化問題開發高效的加速優化算法。 我們將建立駐點的理論性質和算法的收斂結果。 將進行模擬研究，以評估我們的算法，並將其與現有算法在速度、準確性和穩健性方面進行比較。 視光醫學影像的真實數據將用於證明新的理論和方法。 該項目的成果將產生長期而重大的影響，因為超參數選擇的雙層優化問題在許多實際應用中自然產生於深度學習，迫切需要創新的優化理論和算法。我們的新理論和算法將通過與領先的研究人員合作，並在頂級期刊和主要國際會議上發表文章，吸引國際科學界的關注。

15300423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300423.value: 非凸約束優化問題的 Frank-Wolfe 類型無投影一階優化算法

15300423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15300423.value: Prof Li, Guoyin Prof Takeda, Akiko

15300423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300423.value: In this project, the PI and his collaborators will study novel projection-free first-order methods for minimizing smooth functions over compact constraint sets that may not admit efficient projection routines. These problems arise naturally in contemporary applications such as low rank matrix completion. When the constraint sets are in addition convex, the Frank-Wolfe algorithm and its variants, which rely on efficient linear optimization oracles, form a prominent class of projection-free first-order methods and have been extensively studied in recent years. However, compared with the vast literature for convex constraint sets, the study of extensions of the Frank-Wolfe algorithm for nonconvex constraint sets is relatively scarce. In this project, the PI and his collaborators will investigate Frank-Wolfe type algorithms for some classes of nonconvex constraint sets. Our study will be conducted along two directions. On the one hand, we will further study the convergence properties of the Frank-Wolfe type algorithm proposed in the recent work of the PI and one of the co-I's, which was designed for nonconvex constraint sets defined as level sets of difference-of-convex functions that satisfy certain regularity conditions. These include extending various acceleration techniques such as extrapolation to this nonconvex setting, and analyzing local convergence rate based on a suitable angle condition and the Kurdyka-Lojasiewicz property. On the other hand, we will develop novel Frank-Wolfe type algorithms for new classes of nonconvex constraint sets that may not admit efficient projection routines, such as those involving level sets of non-Lipschitz sparsity inducing functions. Our study will encourage the proposal and utilization of optimization models involving these nonconvex constraint sets, which were previously difficult to work with due to the absence of efficient projection routines. 本項目將研究新型無投影一階算法用以極小化緊約束集上的光滑函數，當中約束集的投影一般難以實現。這類問題常見於低秩矩陣填充等應用問題。當約束集為凸時，Frank-Wolfe (FW) 算法及其變種作為一類重要的無投影一階算法被廣泛研究。然而，針對非凸約束集的 FW 算法的研究相對較少。本項目將研究一些適用於非凸約束集的 FW 類型算法。本研究項目將循兩方面進行。首先，我們將進一步研究我們最近提出的針對一類非凸約束集的 FW 類型算法的收斂性質，此類約束集為滿足一定條件的凸差函數的水平集。我們將探討各種加速技術，如外插加速法。另外，我們將針對其他非凸約束集開發新型的 FW 類型算法。研究成果可望促進涉及這些非凸約束集的優化模型的研究與發展。

15300923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15300923.value: 亞洲季風區主要都市區植被物候對地表溫度的響應

15300923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15300923.value: Prof Voogt, James A. Prof Wu, Chaoyang Prof Zhao, Chunhong

15300923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15300923.value: 全球快速城市化和全球氣候變化引起了人們對以下問題的嚴重關注：城市氣候與周圍生態系統之間的關係。 了解城市熱島（UHI）現象及其對植被物候的影響需要長期、一致的地表溫度（LST）和物候測量在適當的時候採樣空間和時間分辨率。 陸地衛星數據檔案為關於這個主題的研究。 然而，適當的分析方法、模型和理論來分析和解釋此類遙感數據集 - 解決有關 UHI 的引人注目的科學問題植被物候 - 仍然非常理想。 這項研究的目的是開發新方法來分析植被物候對 LST 的響應過去三十年亞洲季風區七個最大的都市區，使用派生的時間序列指標。 為了實現這個目標，我們首先重建一個時間序列每個大都市的年內和年際 LST 和植被 NDVI 軌跡一致分辨率為 30 m 的區域。 LST 參數（例如季節性、趨勢和異常）和植被然後從物候變量（例如，返綠、成熟、衰老和休眠）導出重建的數據集。 接下來，該提案將研究LST和通過評估物候變量來確定這種關係如何隨時間變化其隨當地氣候帶（LCZ）以及沿每個地區城鄉梯度的變化都會。 我們的分析將進一步揭示不同的城市化進程如何跨越大都市區，根據 VIIRS 的每月夜間燈光時間序列確定（Suomi-NPP 的可見紅外成像輻射計套件）數據引起了 LST 的變化以及各種背景氣候下的植被物候。 通過完成擬議的研究工作，將實現以下好處： • 這是對大多數國家的地表植被物候學的首次全面研究。亞洲季風區人口稠密的大都市區的 Landsat 時間序列圖像。 • 這項研究將擴大對LST-UHI-城市物候機制的認識城市化和郊區化對城市化和郊區化意義的體系和認識通過調節 LST 時空變化和動態來調節植被物候在城市擴張期間鑲嵌不透水和透水覆蓋物。 • 這項研究將通過以下方式增進對季節性和年際氣候變化的了解：分析 LST 和地表物候中的高時間分辨率數據，它將提供比現有儀器和設備更長、更準確的歷史基線觀測氣候記錄，這在氣候變化研究中空前重要。

15301023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301023.value: 基於拓撲半金屬的高電導和高穩定的互連線研究

15301023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301023.value: 《科學》雜誌在 2021 年提出了 125 個尚未解決的主要科學問題。其中一個問題是「拓撲量子計算可以實現嗎」？與傳統量子計算容易受到外界擾動影響導致量子退相幹不同，拓撲材料中的載流子輸運可以抵抗外界擾動，並能容忍一定程度的結構缺陷。拓撲材料的這些特性可以解決傳統材料中解決不了的一些問題。例如，拓撲半金屬在費米弧的表面態使得載流子傳輸受到很小的散射，從而可以在納米尺度下保持有很高的室溫電導率。 集成電路中的銅互連線隨著尺寸的減少，電阻率急劇地增加，同時電流密度的增加導致了銅互連中很容易發生電遷移。拓撲半金屬的輸運特性可以保證其在納米尺度上有著很高的電導率，而其共價鍵的晶體結構可以保證在很高的電流密度下有著很高的可靠性。在這個研究項目中，我們將系統地研究拓撲半金屬用於納米級別的互連線，具體內容包括材料的可控生長以及電導率的系統表征。

15301323.value: 研究鈣鈦礦量子點到矽的多激子能量轉移以增強光能捕獲

15301323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301323.value: 在傳統的光能捕獲器件中，超出帶隙能量的光子能量不幸地被浪費為熱載流子弛豫。 如何收集多餘的能量來提高光子轉換效率是一個重要的課題，一直吸引著研究人員的持續關注。 多激子產生（MEG）是一個過程，其中吸收的高能光子的能量可以在半導體中產生兩個或多個電子空穴對，以減輕上述損失。 近年來，MEG在鹵化物鈣鈦礦量子點（QD）中被廣泛觀察到。 在這個項目中，我們將使用鈣鈦礦量子點和高效MEG來敏化矽，通過多激子能量轉移來提高光捕獲效率。 該項目基於 PI 最近通過使用超快光學光譜法研究鈣鈦礦量子點的 MEG 效應及其在器件中用於光電流 QE 增強 >100% 的结果。 我們最近的初步實驗結果表明，從鈣鈦礦量子點到矽的能量轉移以及矽表面鈣鈦礦量子點的敏化可以增強概念驗證矽太陽能電池中光電流的產生。 該項目的提出將推動MEG的研究和應用進入一個新的階段。 該項目旨在深入了解如何從 MEG 量子點中有效地獲取多激子能量，以提高矽太陽能電池的光電流量子效率。 以下關鍵問題將得到解決。 (1) QD-Si距離對多激子能量轉移效率有何影響？ 為了解決這個問題，具有可調諧分離的鈣鈦礦量子點/矽雜化物將用於驗證預測的能量轉移效率，以找到比我們的初步結果更高效率的最佳距離。 (2) 多激子能量轉移在改善光電流產生方面的作用的證據是什麼？ 場效應鈍化等其他機制是否起作用？ 為了闡明能量轉移機制並找到證據，我們將對樣品和設備進行新穎的超快光學光譜分析以及電測量和比較研究。 (3) 表面沉積的鈣鈦礦量子點層在矽上是否可靠？ 如何提高其可靠性？ 我们將研究ALD-Al2O3鈍化層對鈣鈦礦量子點/矽混合太陽能電池穩定性的影響。 該項目的成功完成將更清晰地展示鈣鈦礦量子點到矽的多激子能量轉移過程，並具有有效的 MEG 效應以增強光電流。 我們的研究結果不僅將為高效太陽能電池的開發提供新的見解和重要信息，還為其他可受益於 MEG 的新型光捕獲光電器件的開發提供新的見解和重要信息。

15301623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301623.value: 超塑性 β-MX材料變形機制和柔性二維電子器件

15301623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301623.value: Very recently, an abnormal, extraordinary plasticity was unveiled in vdW-layered MX material — β-InSe, and soon in another β-MX material, β-GaSe. Benefiting from the ultra-high plastic deformation capabilities and the significantly lowered fracture and fragmentation tendency, such ultra-plastic, semiconducting, vdW-layered β-MX materials could open promising avenues for the future flexible electronics. It means, the fabrication and applications of 2D semiconducting devices will not be limited by the brittle and un-deformable structures, rather, they can be highly plastic, and behave flow-like nature like polymers for constructing the intriguing 2D devices. The β-MX materials are expected to serve as the unique freely-deformable inorganic semiconductors in future. The ultra-plasticity of β-InSe or more general, β-MX materials is associated with the facile interlayer gliding (interlayer dislocation slip). However, the full picture of the plastic deformation, especially the comparison of β-MX with the other vdW layered materials such as graphite and transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDs) remains obscure. So, what happens in micro-scale and in atomic-scale when the β-MX material is plastically deformed? Here we propose to perform comprehensive structural analysis, particularly the scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) and in situ (scanning) transmission electron microscopy (TEM), combined with theoretical atomistic simulations to investigate the defect evolutions and strain/stress conditions during the plastic deformation of β-MX materials. Meanwhile, we will also perform flexible device fabrication and testing using the ultra-plastic β-InSe and others, aiming for the 2D ultra-flexible devices, or even inorganic plastic electronics eventually. 最近，vdW 层状材料中出现了一種異常的可塑性材料 — β-InSe，和另一種 β-MX 材料 β-GaSe。受益於超高的塑性變形能力和顯著降低的斷裂和碎裂傾向，如超塑性、半導體、vdW層狀β-MX材料可以為未來的柔性電子產品開闢有希望的途徑。這意味著，二維半導體器件的製造和應用將不受脆性和不可變形的結構的限制，相反，它們可以具有高度的可塑性，並且表現出類似流動的性質，如聚合物，用於構建有趣的 2D 設備。 β-MX材料有望成為獨特的可自由變形的無機材料未來的半導體。β-InSe 或更一般的 β-MX 材料具备超塑性和層間滑動性能（層間位錯滑移）。然而，塑性變形，特別是 β-MX 與其他 vdW 層狀材料的比較石墨和過渡金屬二硫屬化物 (TMD) 等材料的比较仍然缺失。那麼，當 β-MX 材料在微觀尺度和原子尺度上會發生什麼？是否發生塑性變形？在這裡我們建議進行全面的結構分析，特別是掃描透射電子顯微鏡 (STEM) 和原位（掃描）透射電子顯微鏡（TEM），結合理論原子模擬研究缺陷演變和應變/應力條件β-MX 材料的塑性變形。同時，我們還將進行超塑性β-InSe等材料在柔性設備中的製造和測試，旨在實現二維超柔性設備，甚至最終实现無機塑性器件。

15301723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15301723.value: 理性设计和合成双特异性双环肽类作为新型免疫调节剂

15301723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15301723.value: Prof Lee, Terence Kin Wah Prof Wong, Wing-tak

15301723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15301723.value: Bispecific antibodies are unnatural single biomolecules that can bind two different epitopes. This ability offers new potential therapeutic applications beyond those natural antibodies with enhanced clinical efficacy and safety. Thus far, five FDA-approved bispecific antibodies and over 100 are in clinical trials. However, the production of bispecific antibodies remains extremely expensive. For example, Blinatumomab, which costs US$ 178,000 per treatment, is the most expensive oncology drug on the market. Thereby, searching for novel bispecific biomolecules that could mimic the bispecific antibodies is needed. Cyclic peptides are fascinating druggable molecules capable of mimicking protein secondary structures with remarkable target binding ability, extraordinary serum stability, and low immunogenicity. In this proposal, we will apply our recent developed efficient multi-component reaction to synthesise a collection of novel dumbbell-shaped, bifunctional, bicyclic peptides as macrophage-engaging bispecific antibody mimetics, namely the bispecific bicyclic peptides (BBP). These bicyclics, on one side, target the macrophage-specific SIRP-α, and on the other end, target overexpressed biomarkers on the cancer surface. We envisage such design could bring macrophages and cancer cells in proximity to enhance tumour recognition, inhibit immune checkpoints, and improve phagocytotic activities. The bicyclic peptides will be characterised against a panel of in vitro assays and in vivo models. Our preliminary data showed that our first prototype, SIRP-α x EpCAM BBP, could bind bispecifically to macrophage surface SIRP-α and cancer cell surface biomarker, EpCAM, which led to enhanced phagocytosis activities. These plausible sets of data demonstrated the potential of the unprecedented design. The success of designing novel BBPs as bispecific antibody mimetics could lead to a new type of immunotherapeutic design. 双特异性抗体是一种非天然单个生物分子，它可以结合两个不同的表位。这种能力提供了新的潜在治疗应用，超越那些具有增强的临床疗效和安全性的天然抗体。到目前为止，FDA 批准了五种双特异性抗体，超过 100 种正在进行临床试验。然而，双特异性抗体的生产成本仍然非常高昂。例如，一次治疗费用为 178,000 美元的布林妥莫单抗是市场上最昂贵的肿瘤药物。因此，需要寻找能够模拟双特异性抗体的新型双特异性生物分子。环肽是一种引人入胜的可成药分子，能够模仿蛋白质二级结构，具有显著的靶标结合能力、非凡的血清稳定性和低免疫原性。在本提案中，我们将使用我们最近开发的有效的多组分反应来合成一系列新型哑铃状、双功能、双环肽作为巨噬细胞结合双特异性抗体模拟物，即双特异性双环肽 (BBP)。这些双环肽，一方面靶向巨噬细胞特异性 SIRP-α，另一方面靶向癌细胞表面过表达的生物标志物。我们设想这种设计可以使巨噬细胞和癌细胞靠近，以增强肿瘤识别、抑制免疫检查点，并提高细胞毒性或吞噬活性。双环肽将针对一组体外检测和体内模型进行表征。我们的初步数据表明，我们的第一个 BBP 原型可以双特异性地结合到巨噬细胞表面的 SIRP-α 和肿瘤生物标志物 EpCAM 上，从而增强吞噬活性。这些可信的数据集证明了这种前所未有的设计的潜力。成功设计新型 BBP 作为双特异性抗体模拟物，可能带来一种新型的免疫治疗设计。

15302023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302023.value: 用於儲能應用的超順電 HfO2 基薄膜

15302023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302023.value: 與電化學儲能電容器相比，基於介電薄膜的電容器具有更高的電壓穩定性、更高的擊穿強度和更低的漏電流等優點。然而，與電化學材料相比，線性介電薄膜的儲能密度要低得多。 另一方面，與線性電介質相比，非線性鐵電薄膜由於其較高的介電常數而具有更高的能量存儲密度。 然而，由於大的殘餘極化導致可恢復能量低得多，使得鐵電儲能的效率低得多。 除了基於鐵電的儲能之外，弛豫鐵電和反鐵電材料由於其更窄的P-E環（對於弛豫鐵電）和零剩餘極化（對於反鐵電），進一步提高了可恢復的能量密度和效率。 人們採取了不同的策略來進一步提高弛豫鐵電體和反鐵電體的儲能性能，通常是通過摻雜、納米域工程和多層電容器的實現等。在所有方法中，最近出現的超順電弛豫結構和高熵穩定 非晶態結構對於提高鈣鈦礦複合氧化物的儲能密度和效率最重要。 然而，這些鈣鈦礦氧化物基薄膜仍然存在漏電流較大、介電擊穿強度較低和生長溫度較高（通常超過600℃）等缺點，使其難以用於一些有低溫要求的應用，例如柔性和薄膜材料。 可穿戴電子設備。 在本項目中，基於我們過去在鐵電HfO2方面的研究經驗，我們建議研究用於儲能應用的高熵超順電HfO2基薄膜。 這是首次利用高熵和超順電相結合的方法來大幅提高HfO2基鐵電薄膜的儲能密度和效率，儘管它們已被用作儲能電容器的關鍵柵極，但很少對其進行研究 先進集成電路（IC）產品中的介電材料。 鐵電 HfO2 具有高飽和極化、高介電擊穿強度以及超低漏電流的良好特性。 此外，低溫原子層沉積和退火（低於400℃）將其應用範圍擴大到柔性和可穿戴電子設備。 與弛豫鐵電性類似，超順電性源於極性納米區（PNR）的存在，由於其高飽和與剩餘極化比，導致非常窄的磁滯迴線（因此能量存儲效率高）和非常高的可恢復能量 非常高的介電常數。 除了超順電方法之外，我們還將通過摻雜誘導結構無序程度的增加來增加薄膜的高原子構型熵，從而進一步增強儲能性能。 較高的原子構型熵應進一步穩定晶體結構並增加抗電介質擊穿能力，從而導致巨大的能量存儲密度和效率以及低漏電流和高電介質擊穿強度。 由於HfO2薄膜與微電子工藝兼容，且其鐵電性在存儲器件中具有重要的戰略意義，因此其優異的儲能性能的實現將拓寬其在微電子器件中的應用。 HfO2基超級電容器具有高居里溫度和快速充放電速度的優點，在汽車、電力傳輸、航空航天和5G通信等高溫高速應用中具有廣闊的前景。

15302323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302323.value: 抛物方程反问题：条件稳定性与数值分析

15302323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302323.value: Inverse problems in partial differential equations have attracted substantial attention and interest among scientists and engineers. Theoretically, many (conditional) uniqueness results and stability estimates have been established in different scenarios. Practically, people proposed many numerical algorithms, with further discretization by finite difference methods, finite element methods or deep neural networks. However, very few results were available on error bounds of approximate reconstruction. This is attributed to the ill-posed nature of the inverse problems, low regularity of noisy measurements, (possibly) high nonlinearity, and delicate interplay between multiple unknown coefficients. In this project, we aim to systematically build a connection between the theoretical stability estimates and the numerical analysis of practical inversion schemes. We plan to study several parameter identification problems for parabolic equations, design efficient numerical schemes with full discretization, and derive error bounds for the numerical reconstruction of parameters. The key idea is to explore and apply suitable conditional stability using some Carleman estimates and weighted energy estimates. This project will consist of three parts. First, we aim to numerically recover a spatially dependent factor in the source term from some internal/lateral observation of the solution under the assumption that the initial condition is unknown. The numerical analysis relies on a carefully designed stabilized least-squares formulation, a conditional stability derived from the Carleman estimate, and several a priori error estimates for the direct problem. Second, we plan to study the nonlinear inverse potential problem to identify a spatially dependent coefficient of the zero-order term from the distributed observation at a terminal time and a small space-time subdomain. We aim to propose a numerical scheme with full discretization, whose error bound does not require any smallness or largeness condition of the terminal time as assumed in many existing works. The argument combines the Carleman estimate, the (discrete) maximal L^p regularity and the numerical analysis of direct problems. Third and finally, we intend to study the simultaneous recovery of two spatially dependent coefficients from the observation in two space-time subdomains. We will investigate the uniqueness and stability of the reconstruction, develop a decoupled numerical algorithm to identifying two parameters sequentially, and propose a completely discrete scheme with provable error estimates. 偏微分方程的反问题已经吸引了众多科学家和工程师的关注和兴趣。从理论上讲，许多（条件）唯一性结果和稳定性估计已在不同的场景中得到证明。实际上，人们提出了许多数值算法，利用有限差分方法、有限元方法或深度神经网络进行离散化。然而，关于近似重建的误差界的结果非常少。这可以归因于逆问题的病态性质，噪声测量的低规律性，非线性，以及多个未知系数之间的相互影响。 这个项目的目标是系统地建立理论稳定性估计与实际反演方案数值分析之间的联系。我们将研究几个抛物方程的参数识别问题，设计全离散化的数值方案，并推导出数值解的误差估计。关键的方法是探索并应用适当的条件稳定性，使用一些Carleman估计和加权能量估计。

15302423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302423.value: 利用超快時間分辨熒光及瞬態吸收光譜研究人類端粒和原癌基因鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸的熒光特性及發光探針的熒光增強效應

15302423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302423.value: 鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸是由富鳥嘌呤核酸序列形成的非規範四鏈二級結構，在人類端粒和原癌基因序列中廣泛存在。這些可存在於體內及體外的獨特核酸結構具有至關重要的生物學功能，也是診斷、治療及抗腫瘤藥物的重要靶標。此外，憑藉其高度的結構多態性及結構可控性，鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸在生物納米技術和功能分子電子器件方面亦有不可替代的應用潛力。由此，有效地識別和表徵鳥嘌呤四鏈結構的形成和性質是核酸及相關應用領域的重要研究課題。探究鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸的固有熒光及利用發光探針識別鳥嘌呤四鏈結構是目前該課題的兩個極具挑戰性的前沿和熱點。因其獨特的構型，鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸具有比大多數其他核酸二級結構更強的固有熒光發射；而硫代黃素是一種常用的四鏈結構小分子熒光探針。然而，已報導的關於鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸固有熒光及硫代黃素熒光增強所使用的研究方法僅限於傳統的穩態光譜和極少數的時間分辨光譜探測。因此，目前對於鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸固有熒光的起源及硫代黃素作為四鏈核酸熒光探針的發光機制所知甚少。針對這些問題，我們建議利用尖端的超快寬帶時間分辨光譜與穩態光譜相結合，對一系列精心挑選、具代表性的端粒及原癌基因鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸和相關四鏈結構進行細緻和深入研究；實時探索這些結構在不同微環境條件，如與硫代黃素結合及模擬細胞擁擠環境等，的光譜和動力學性質。研究結果將揭示目前未知的鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸的特徵熒光及熒光發射動力學；探明調控四鏈核酸發光效率和發光光譜的結構因素和主要微環境條件。研究結果亦會為詮釋控制鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸固有熒光的鹼基間電子偶聯，及闡明硫代黃素發光探針熒光增強效應的分子機制，提供直接的實驗證據。由此，本研究將顯著提昇在分子層面對鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸基本光物理及其與熒光探針相互作用的認知，並有助於促進無標記識別鳥嘌呤四鏈核酸新策略的設計，及四鏈核酸在如生物成像和熒光顯微鏡等生物技術中的應用與研發。

15302723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302723.value: 透過非對映異構體拆分和可見光誘導的合成方法製作新型手性金 (III) 配合物並用於不對稱催化反應

15302723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302723.value: Gold catalysis has opened new synthetic pathways in organic synthesis featuring high reactivity and distinctive selectivity. Asymmetric gold(I) catalysis has been demonstrated as a feasible way for the synthesis of chiral molecules. However, the linear geometry of chiral gold(I) complexes consisting of two coordination sites in opposite direction remains a significant challenge for chiral induction owing to the long distance separating the chiral ligands and substrates. To achieve high enantioselectivity, specially designed chiral ligands with extended chiral cavity for better substrate recognition have been developed. However, these specific approaches may not be easily applicable for a wide substrate scope. In contrast to the advancement of asymmetric gold(I) catalysis, the development of asymmetric gold(III) catalysis remains largely unexplored. Chiral gold(III) complexes have a square-planar geometry with four coordination sites. By rational ligand design, the chiral substituents of the chiral gold(III) catalysts can be placed in close proximity to the substrates for efficient asymmetric induction leading to high enantioselectivity. Thus, rational design and synthesis of novel chiral gold(III) complexes in a modular approach is a highly appealing research direction for the advancement of asymmetric gold catalysis. In this project, we plan to develop diastereomeric resolution as a new strategy for the synthesis of chiral C,O-chelated BINOL/gold(III) catalysts for asymmetric catalysis. Using chiral BINOLs as the chiral source, a series of new chiral C,O-chelated BINOL/gold(III) catalysts bearing sterically bulky substituents on the chiral oxazoline ligands will be synthesized for catalytic asymmetric cyclization reactions. Using visible light-mediated photoredox reaction as a new synthetic strategy instead of the traditional transmetalation approach, we intend to synthesize novel chiral oxazoline trans diphosphine gold(III) complexes for in situ generation of chiral gold(III) species with a vacant site in close proximity to the chiral substituents for enantioselectivity enhancement in asymmetric catalysis. Finally, we aim to design and synthesize novel C2-symmetric chiral oxazoline trans diphosphine gold(III) complexes featuring extended chiral environment created by the cooperative arrangement of chiral oxazoline and phosphine ligands for asymmetric catalysis. 金催化具有高反應活性和獨特的選擇性，此獨特性開闢了新的有機合成方法。在不對稱催化反應中，使用手性金（I）配合物作催化劑是獲得手性分子的有效方法。 然而，金（I）配合物的線性幾何結構使兩個配位點位於相反方向，相反方向的手性配體遠離底物，難以提供良好的手性誘導。現時，通過開發具有擴展手性環境的手性配體能提供更好的底物識別，以實現高對映選擇性。然而，這些專門設計的方法可能不適用於廣泛的底物範圍。相較於不對稱金（I）催化，不對稱金（III）催化的發展在很大程度上仍未得到探索。手性金 (III) 配合物具有平面正方形構型，共有四個配位點。金（III）中心周圍的手性環境可以通過配體設計作出微調，將手性金（III）催化劑的手性取代基放置在靠近活性位點的位置，從而對底物進行不對稱誘導，實現高對映選擇性。因此，配體的模組化設計和新型手性金（III）配合物的合成為不對稱金催化研究提供非常有吸引力的研究方向。 在本項目中，我們提出以非對映異構體的拆分作為合成手性C,O-螯合聯萘酚／金（III） 配合物的新策略，並應用該配合物作為不對稱催化的有效催化劑。我們計劃以手性聯萘酚作為手性源，合成一系列新型手性C,O-螯合聯萘酚／金（III）配合物。該類配合物在手性噁唑啉配體上帶有體積龐大的取代基，用於催化不對稱環化反應。 我們打算使用可見光介導的光氧化還原反應取代傳統的金屬交換反應，作為一種新的合成方法，用以合成新型手性噁唑啉反式二膦金（III）配合物。該類配合物可原位生成一種具有空位配位的手性金（III）物質，此配位接近鄰近配體的手性取代基，能提高不對稱催化中的對映選擇性。 最後，我們打算設計和合成新型C2對稱手性噁唑啉反式二膦金（III）配合物，通過手性噁唑啉和膦配體協同擴展的手性環境以改善不對稱催化。

15302823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15302823.value: 基于随机哈密尔顿相流的随机最优传输问题保结构算法

15302823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15302823.value: 随机最优传输涉及传输过程中的随机过程和随机噪声。它已被广泛应用于许多研究领域，如物流、经济学、计算机视觉、成像科学、图形学和机器学习等许多研究领域。本项目重点研究随机最优传输问题的保结构数值方法。Hamiltonian流的无穷维辛几何结构给出了运输问题最小化的必要条件，也是最优传输问题一个内在结构。在实际应用中通常需要高效的数值方法并尽可能保留原始系统的几何结构和动力学特性。尽管经典最优输运问题的数值计算结果硕果累累，但随机最优输运问题和随机Wasserstein—Hamiltonian流的保结构数值计算方法却很难构建。 在本项目中，我们将为随机最优传输问题和随机Wasserstein—Hamiltonian流设计并研究高效的保结构数值方法。为此，我们将首先分析连续域和离散图上的随机Wasserstein--Hamiltonian流的动力学行为。然后我们将提出一个基于矢量辅助变量和扩展辛几何结构的通用框架，以设计针对随机Wasserstein—Hamiltonian流的保结构数值方法。从边值问题的角度，我们将基于离散化的图结构，构建随机最优传输问题的数值求解器。此外，我们还将对所提出的数值方法进行收敛分析，包括正则化程序的误差估计、保结构逼近的强收敛率和弱收敛率，以及图上离散随机最优传输问题的近似误差。保结构数值方法的数值分析将为数值计算随机最优输运的研究奠定基础，并丰富图上离散随机最优输运问题的最优输运理论。该项目旨在分析连续域和离散图上随机Wasserstein—Hamiltonian的动力学行为、为随机最优传输问题和随机Wasserstein—Hamiltonian流构建高效的保结构数值方法、以及提供保结构数值方法的强收敛性和弱收敛性分析以及离散随机最优传输问题的误差估计。

15303423.value: 一类通过多项式优化求解非凸以及奇异广义纳什均衡问题的新方法

15303423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15303423.value: The Generalized Nash Equilibrium Problem (GNEP) is a kind of game to find strategies for a group of players such that each player's objective function is optimized, given other players' strategies. The solution to the GNEP is called a Generalized Nash Equilibrium (GNE). The GNEPs originated in economics to describe a social equilibrium, and they have been widely used in various areas, such as marketing, supply chain management, telecommunications, and machine learning. Typically, it is pretty challenging to find GNEs, especially when the GNEP is nonconvex. In this project, the PI will study nonconvex GNEPs given by polynomial functions. More specifically, we will investigate algorithms for finding GNEs of nonconvex GNEPs of polynomials efficiently. These approaches are mainly based on methods developed in the PI's recent joint work on solving convex GNEPs of polynomials using Lagrange multiplier expression and moment-SOS semidefinite relaxations. Also, we will develop numerical methods for solving large scale GNEPs by exploiting sparsity, based on the recent work by the PI and co-I on correlative sparse Lagrange multiplier expressions and sparse polynomial optimization. Besides that, we will study GNEs where the Karush-Kuhn-Tucker (KKT) conditions fail to hold and investigate new algorithms for finding GNEs when the GNEP has no GNE in the set of KKT points. In our approaches, polynomial optimization problems are formulated for finding GNEs of GNEPs of polynomials, and the moment-SOS hierarchy of semidefinite relaxations is applied to solve these polynomial optimization problems. Moreover, some novel techniques, such as feasible extensions, and Jacobian type relaxations, are explored to tackle the difficulties of the nonconvexity and singularity of GNEPs. Finally, this research will broaden our ability to solve difficult GNEPs, which cannot be solved by existing approaches and may lead to more efficient algorithms for solving GNEPs in applications. 广义纳什均衡问题是一类寻找关于一组参与者最佳策略的博弈，该问题的解也被称作“广义纳什均衡”。该类问题最最早被用于描述经济学中的模型，现已在市场营销、供应链管理、通信、机器学习等诸多领域被广泛应用。但通常来说，如何求解广义纳什均衡问题是一项重大的挑战， 在这个项目中，我们考虑由多项式函数给出的广义纳什均衡问题。我们旨在探究如何高效地数值求解非凸多项式广义纳什均衡问题。本研究所涉及的计算方法主要基于主要研究人前期关于凸纳什均衡问题的研究中所提出的基于拉格朗日乘子表示的矩-平方和松弛算法。此外，我们还考虑如何利用问题的稀疏性和主要研究人近期提出的稀疏拉格朗日乘子表示来加快半定松弛方法的计算速度。最后，我们还考虑不满足Karush-Kuhn-Tucker最优性条件的广义纳什均衡点，并探究如何计算他们。总的来说，我们将广义纳什均衡问题转化成一系列多项式优化问题，并使用该领域中的矩-平方和松弛这一方法对这些优化问题进行求解。得益于可行延拓、雅可比松弛等前沿工具，我们能够处理非凸性、奇异性等问题中的难点。通过该研究，我们能极大地拓宽对相关问题的求解能力，并催生出更多其在相关领域的应用。

15303723.value: 烯烴的未活化亞甲基C(sp3)–H 鍵的區域選擇性功能化以形成C(sp3)–C(sp3) 鍵：後過渡金屬烯丙基配合物的催化劑控制卡賓C– H 插入的配體設計

15303723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15303723.value: C(sp3)–H 鍵到 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 鍵的區域控制轉變是碳氫化合物結構和功能多樣化的有力策略。最需要的是能夠以步驟和原子經濟的方式選擇性地將廣泛豐富的烯烴轉化為醫藥產品和先進材料的技術。雖然許多區域控制轉化可用於操縱 C=C 鍵，但惰性 C(sp3)–H 鍵到 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 鍵的選擇性轉化仍然難以捉摸。羧酸二銠(II,II) 被廣泛用於通過活性金屬卡賓物種進行區域控制的惰性 C(sp3)–H 鍵功能化。設計者的二銠催化劑甚至可以根據其獨特的鍵能和空間特性將卡賓插入烷烴的叔鍵或伯鍵 C(sp3)-H 鍵。然而，能夠區分碳骨架上電子和空間相似的亞甲基C-H鍵的催化劑很少。 一些鋼琴凳[(pi-芳烴)釕]配合物被發現可以介導卡賓插入到烯烴的烯丙基C-H鍵上。以重氮丙二酸酯為試劑，1-苯基-1-戊烯轉化為其 選擇性 C-H 烷基化產物。通過烯丙基 C-H 活化生成的 pi-烯丙基釕配合物將經歷遷移卡賓插入以提供 C-C 鍵。值得注意的是，5-苯基-1-戊烯的類似反應提供了相同的α-烷基化產物，其特徵是遠程C-H烷基化和C=C鍵遷移。我們受到啟發，通過利用 pi-烯丙基釕配合物的鏈行走異構化，開髮用於烯烴遠程亞甲基位點區域控制烷基化的催化劑。 pi-烯丙基釕(II)絡合物的鏈行走異構化應通過可逆質子耦合金屬化-脫金屬化途徑通過1,3-烯丙基轉移發生。這項研究將首先通過系統地調節芳烴配體的電子和空間性質，描繪一些芳烴-釕配合物對烯丙基 C-H 裂解的內在結構區域選擇性特徵。我們希望通過利用共價和非共價機制來識別一些能夠對鏈行走異構化進行區域控制的功能化芳烴-釕配合物。顯然，不同尺寸和電子特性的取代基將提供有效的方法來將鏈行走異構化引導至最有利的亞甲基位置。 開發用於對映選擇性遠程 C-H 烷基化的手性芳烴-釕催化劑將是一個重要目標。將採用模塊化方法來製備一些平面手性芳烴釕衍生物的重點庫以供研究。手性芳烴配體應阻礙不受限制的重氮試劑接近金屬中心，從而導致 -烯丙基配合物的對映體控制的烷基化。我們預見催化對映體控制的 C(sp3)–C(sp3) 偶聯反應將為可持續藥物和材料合成提供強大的平台。

15303923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15303923.value: 自支撑多铁性钙钛矿氧化物薄膜的应力调控及其磁电耦合增强效应

15303923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15303923.value: Strain engineering has witnessed a great success in epitaxial thin films of perovskite oxides due to the strong couplings between charge, spin, orbital and lattice degrees of freedom. Recently, freestanding perovskite oxide membranes without the constraint imposed by growth substrates have been successfully synthesized, providing unprecedented opportunities for engineering perovskite oxides by extreme strain not achievable on the epitaxial substrates. This considerable progress also allows functional perovskite oxides with a rich spectrum of physical properties to be applied in flexible electronics. Among perovskite oxides, multiferroics are known as a class of materials of both scientific significance and technical values, in which several ferroic order parameters coexist. As the leading single-phase multiferroic material at room temperature, BiFeO3 (BFO) has attracted intensive research although its weak magnetoelectric (ME) coupling remains a key issue. So far, there are limited works on strain engineering of freestanding multiferroics based on BFO, especially with a focus on improving the ME coupling. The Principle Investigator's previous works [Nature 570, 87-90 (2019), Nat. Commun. 13, 5116 (2022)] have demonstrated the successful synthesis of freestanding perovskite oxides with high crystalline quality and novel properties related to the excellent flexibility of these membranes, paving a way to the strain engineering of freestanding BFO for enhanced performance. Stimulated by our previous works and some promising preliminary results, we propose to study the multiferroic properties of freestanding membranes based on BFO under extreme elastic strain, aiming at enhancing the ME coupling by strain engineering. We will prepare a series of BFO-related freestanding multiferroics, based on which flexible devices capable of stretching and bending will be fabricated. By studying the crystal and domain structures using a combination of advanced microscopies, we anticipate understanding the effects of extreme strain and strain gradient on freestanding multiferroics. We expect to achieve a significantly enhanced ME coupling, as well as emergent multiferroic properties in these novel systems. The success of this project will advance the fundamental research in strain engineering of freestanding multiferroics for exotic phases and their practical applications in flexible electronics. 钙钛矿氧化物薄膜中存在电荷、自旋、轨道和晶格自由度之间的强耦合作用，其丰富的物性能够通过衬底施加外延应力进行显著的调控。最近，不受生长衬底束缚的自支撑钙钛矿氧化物薄膜被成功制备出来，这为实现钙钛矿氧化物的极端应力调控提供了新的机遇，从而促进物性丰富的功能氧化物薄膜在柔性电子器件中的广泛应用。 作为特殊的一类钙钛矿氧化物材料，多铁性氧化物中同时存在两种或两种以上的铁性序参量，兼具基础研究意义和器件应用价值。其中，室温单相多铁明星材料铁酸铋引起了人们广泛的研究兴趣，然而，其较弱的磁电耦合作用仍然是有待解决的重要问题。目前，通过应力调控自支撑铁酸铋薄膜来增强磁电耦合效应的研究工作有限。申请人在此前的研究工作中，成功制备了高质量的自支撑钙钛矿氧化物单晶薄膜，并发现超柔性薄膜中新颖的物理性质，为通过应力调控铁酸铋薄膜来实现其性能提升提供了独特的途径和良好的条件。 基于此前的研究工作和一些较好的初步实验结果，该项目拟研究极端应力作用下的自支撑多铁钙钛矿氧化物薄膜中的物性，期望通过应力调控增强其磁电耦合效应。在该项目中，我们将生长一系列与铁酸铋相关的自支撑多铁氧化物薄膜，并制备可以施加拉伸和弯曲应力的柔性多功能器件。利用先进的探针和电子显微表征技术，研究极端应力和应力梯度作用下的自支撑多铁氧化物薄膜的晶格结构和铁性畴结构，期望在这类材料系统中实现显著增强的磁电耦合效应，并发现新颖的多铁性质。该项目的成功开展，将极大地促进关于自支撑多铁氧化物薄膜应力调控的基础物理研究，并推动其在柔性多功能电子器件中的实际应用。

15304023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15304023.value: 開發碳骨架負載的先進原子催化劑用於二氧化碳還原反應製備二碳產物

15304023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15304023.value: 為了實現碳中和目標，有效減少二氧化碳排放並將其轉化為高價值化學產品是具有潛力的解決方案之一。電化學催化二氧化碳還原反應則是其中最有發展潛力的一種方法，該方法不僅能夠將二氧化碳轉化為液體燃料，而且可以與可再生能源（太陽能、風能和潮汐能等）相結合，以較低的成本實現良性碳循環。為了利用二氧化碳還原反應生產具有更高工業價值的二碳與多碳產物，科學家們進行了大量的研究工作，但目前只有少數電催化劑表現出較高的效率和穩定性。由於具有超高的電催化活性和相較傳統催化劑更低的成本，原子催化劑有望突破目前二氧化碳還原反應在二碳產物轉化上的瓶頸。石墨炔負載的原子催化劑具有發展潛力，這是因為石墨炔具有豐富的碳成鍵環境和獨特的電子結構。因此，石墨炔不僅可以作為原子催化劑的穩定載體，還可以像我們之前研究證明的那樣成為催化中的活性位點，從而促進二碳產物的轉化。 在本項目中，我們旨在通過理論探索方法解決三個關鍵研究問題，包括（1）確定二氧化碳還原反應過程中二碳產物的反應機制；（2）實現碳負載原子催化劑中多活性位點的策略用於支持二碳產物的生成；(3)建立二氧化碳還原反應電催化劑的理論篩選方法。為了探索二氧化碳還原反應的機理，我們計劃構建超過10164個計算模型組，通過熱力學反應趨勢來全面研究二碳產物的反應路徑。為了實現原子催化劑的多活性位點，我們將研究金屬原子和碳載體之間的相互作用，近鄰效應和電子結構調控，從而篩選出能夠將二氧化碳高效轉化為二碳產物的石墨炔原子催化劑。最後，我們將結合先進的機器學習與理論計算來表徵影響二氧化碳還原反應性能的關鍵參數，從而進一步用於預測新型高效的碳骨架負載的原子催化劑，並為實驗合成提供理論指導。 該項目的研究成果不僅能為二氧化碳還原反應相關技術提供新的理論支持，還將促進高效原子催化劑的設計，以實現將二氧化碳有效轉化為高附加值化學品用於多樣化工業生產的目的。從長遠來看，這個項目不僅有利於香港的科技發展和人才培養，也有利於香港早日實現碳中和目標。

15304423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15304423.value: 不同密度和粘度的兩相 Navier-Stokes-Darcy 模型的解耦有限元方法及其数学分析

15304423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15304423.value: This project is to carry out systematic research on the analysis and numerical simulation of the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy model with different densities and viscosities for the coupled two-phase fluid flow and porous media flow. The goal of this project is to: (1) carry out the mathematical analysis for the well-posedness of the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy model with different densities and viscosities; (2) develop an efficient fully decoupled finite element method for solving the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy model with different densities and viscosities; (3) analyze the stability and convergence of the fully decoupled finite element method. There are many important applications that involve a fluid flow and a porous medium flow occurring in separate but abutting domains, with the two flows coupled at the interface between the two domains. For the Stokes-Darcy model, which governs the single phase coupled free flow and porous media flow, significant effort has been devoted to the development of different numerical methods. For the two-phase Stokes-Darcy type flows, there are several existing works for the simplified case with constant density and viscosity. Only one existing work is devoted for the more difficult case of non-constant density and viscosity. Therefore, significant challenges still remain for the Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy model with different densities and viscosities. The key technique to analyze the well-posedness of the target model is to utilize the framework of a branch of non-singular solutions with special treatment for the different densities/viscosities and the BJ interface condition. The key idea for the fully decoupled finite element method is to develop an appropriate semi-implicit semi-explicit scheme with stabilization to linearize the nonlinear terms in the strong coupling caused by the different densities and viscosities, and then decouple the whole model in three levels. For the convergence analysis, the energy method with special treatments on the interface has a strong potential for analyzing the proposed numerical method for the sophisticated Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy model with different densities/viscosities and BJ interface condition. 本項目旨在對耦合兩相液态自由流和多孔介質流的不同密度和粘度的Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy模型進行分析和數值模擬研究。該項目的目標是:( 1）對不同密度和粘度的Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy模型的適定性進行數學分析； (2) 開發一種高效的全解耦有限元方法來求解不同密度和粘度的 Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy 模型； (3)分析全解耦有限元方法的穩定性和收斂性. 有許多重要的應用涉及在單獨但鄰接的域中發生的液态自由流和多孔介質流，並且這兩種流在兩個区域之間的界面處耦合。對於描述單相耦合自由流和多孔介質流的斯托克斯-達西模型，人們投入了大量精力來開發不同的數值方法。而對於兩相 Stokes-Darcy 型流動，只有一些針對恆定密度和粘度的簡化情況的現有工作。現有工作里只有一項專門針對非恆定密度和粘度這一更困難的情況。因此，不同密度和粘度的 Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy 模型仍然面臨重大挑戰。 分析目標模型適定性的關鍵技術是利用非奇異解束的框架结构，對不同的密度/粘度和BJ界麵條件進行特殊處理。全解耦有限元方法的關鍵思想是開發合適的半隱式半顯式穩定性方案，將不同密度和粘度引起的強耦合中的非線性項線性化，然後將整個模型分三個層次解耦。對於收斂分析，對界面進行特殊處理的能量法對於分析具有不同密度/粘度和 BJ 界麵條件的複雜 Cahn-Hilliard-Navier-Stokes-Darcy 模型所提出的數值方法具有很強的潛力。

15304623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15304623.value: 单层二维有机无机杂化钙钛矿原位拉伸应变

15304623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15304623.value: 二维有机无机杂化钙钛矿（2D HOIPs）因其优异的光电性能和稳定性，成为光伏、光发射和光电探测的新型光电材料。2D HOIPs 展示由柔软有机链和硬质无机量子肼交替构成的层状结构。这种在分子尺度上周期性波动的软-硬层状体系，使2D HOIP成为应力-应变研究的有趣材料平台，对于应变调制有机无机杂化材料的能带结构和柔性电子学研究具有重要意义。尽管已经有很多使用金刚石压腔来探究材料应力-应变行为的工作，但对于2D HOIPs的应力-应变行为研究还鲜有报道，而这对于理解杂化钙钛矿平面电荷的运输非常重要。在此项目中，我们将使用集成扫描电子显微镜的推拉微机械装置来研究单层二维杂化钙钛矿的原位拉伸弹性应变。我们将测量单层二维杂化钙钛矿的力学参数，包括平面杨氏模量、弹性范围和断裂强度。此外，由于单层2D HOIP结构的高度可调节性，它们的机械性能可通过引入不同有机链和无机量子肼来调控。我们的研究范围包括以维度和化学成分为函数的单层2D HOIPs拉伸应力-应变行为。我们还将通过光谱来检查拉伸应变如何改变单层2D HOIPs的带隙，激子性质和rashba型自旋分裂。最后，构建基于单层2D HOIP的柔性光电子器件，探索应变介导的光电转化效率和光伏效应。

15305423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305423.value: 基于良溶剂交换体系的高结晶度导电高分子纤维：机理、制备和应用

15305423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305423.value: Highly-crystalline conducting polymer fibers (CPFs), consisting of continuous conducting polymers (CPs) crystal matrix, are much desired as they show a metal-level conductivity, high mechanical strength, excellent electrochemical activity, as well as huge promises in flexible electronic devices, as demonstrated in recent work. Although continuous CPFs have been achieved by wet-spinning via a poor solvent exchange process, namely dispersing CPs in a good solvent that disperses polymer well then coagulating in a poor solvent dispersing polymer poorly, it remains an enormous challenge to produce crystalline fibers due to the rapid aggregation and discontinuous crystallization of CP chains. Moreover, the distribution of such microstructural defects results in the inadequate electrical, electrochemical and mechanical performance, which further restricts the frontier applications of CPFs. There is an urgent need to establish an effective protocol to produce high-performance CPFs with a crystalline structure closely approximating the long-sought extended-chain conformation of CPs. We have recently achieved a highly crystalline wet-spun polyaniline fiber, a typical CPF, by means of a good solvent exchange approach. Good solvent exchange and fiber-formation probability are mutually exclusive in conventional wet-spinning process, and classical polymer crystallization theory is also difficult to clearly explain the improved crystallization of the obtained fibers. In-depth investigation is necessary to understand the method-structure-performance relation involved in the innovative approach. What is the solid molecular mechanism of improved crystallization during the good solvent exchange process? Is it possible to align the crystal matrix of CP chains to the fiber axis with the maximum continuity? How could this approach be extended to the production of other crystalline CPFs？ And what are the advantages of crystalline CPFs in flexible electronics? In this project, we will attempt to provide answers and solutions to these questions and challenges. Multidimensional observations, from nanoscale to microscale, of the microstructural evolution of polyaniline molecules, chains and fibers will be conducted during the fiber-formation process. The molecular dynamics in the two-fluid phase system will be derived and analyzed. Thereafter, a general protocol for fabricating crystalline CPFs will be established, a relation linking the electrical, mechanical and electrochemical performance of CPFs with the crystalline degree will be developed, and advanced flexible devices using crystalline CPFs as the working electrodes will be manufactured. The project is likely to develop an innovative technology for preparing highly crystalline CPFs and fabricating CPF-based flexible devices. Publications in leading journals and international patents will be the expected outputs. 因其具有金属级导电性、高机械强度、优异的电化学活性以及在柔性电子器件中的巨大前景，由连续导电聚合物晶体基质组装而成的高结晶导电聚合物纤维备受期待。 最近的研究工作证明基于不良溶剂交换工艺的湿法纺丝可以制备连续的导电高分子纤维，即将导电高分子分散于良溶剂中，然后在不良溶剂中凝固成型。然而由于分子链的快速聚集和不连续结晶，这种体系难以得到高结晶纤维。此外，微缺陷的分布也导致电学、电化学和机械性能不足，进一步限制了导电高分子纤维的前沿应用。因此迫切需要建立一种有效的方案来生产高性能导电高分子纤维，使其晶体结构接近长期以来寻找的导电高分子长链构象。 我们最近基于良溶剂交换的湿法纺丝体系初步制备了高结晶聚苯胺纤维，这是一种典型的导电高分子纤维。在传统的湿法纺丝工艺中，良溶剂交换和纤维形成概率是相互排斥的，而经典的聚合物结晶理论也很难清楚地解释纤维结晶性改善的分子机制。为了理解新方法中涉及的方法-结构-性能关系，有必要对其进行深入研究，明确良溶剂交换过程中改善结晶的固体分子机制，寻求以最大的连续性将导电高分子链的晶体矩阵沿纤维轴向对齐，实现这种方法在其它结晶导电高分子纤维的连续制备，挖掘结晶导电高分子纤维在柔性电子领域的优势。 在这个项目中，我们将尝试为这些问题和挑战提供解决方案。在纤维形成过程中，将对聚苯胺的分子、链和纤维微观结构演变过程进行跨越纳米尺度和微米尺度的多维观察。分析并确立双液相系统中的分子动力学。此后，将阐明制备结晶高分子纤维的宏观体系，建立导电高分子纤维的电学、机械性能、电化学性能与结晶度之间的关系，并制备使用结晶导电高分子纤维作为工作电极的先进柔性器件。 该项目提出一种新型的纤维制备方法，用于制备高结晶导电高分子纤维及其柔性器件。

15305523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305523.value: 关于可微分神经网络：泛化、逼近和非参数梯度估计应用

15305523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15305523.value: Deep learning has been achieving remarkable success in science, engineering, business, and industry. Many of the state-of-the-art deep learning methods involve the derivatives of neural networks, including deep score estimations, Wasserstein Generative Adversarial Networks (WGAN), f-GAN, density-ratio fittings with gradient penalties, and distributionally robust optimizations, etc. However, statistical learning theories for these deep neural estimations are largely untouched. The main reason is the lack of understanding of differentiable neural networks and their derivatives. This proposal aims to introduce and investigate differentiable neural networks, and to lay a foundation of statistical learning theory for deep nonparametric estimations with derivative involved. This study consists of three main components. The first component aims to introduce differentiable networks (networks activated by differentiable functions) and to investigate their theoretical properties, including network derivative representations, complexities, and approximation power. This part of the study is fundamental and necessary since derivatives of the network are involved in many popular and empirically successful deep learning methods. In the second component, as the application of the first one, we consider establishing the statistical learning theory for score-matching estimations and their variants using differentiable networks. This part of the study will serve as the statistical learning foundations of high-performance score-based generative models in machine learning. In the third component, we aim to establish a general framework for deep nonparametric estimation with gradient penalty, which covers Wasserstein GAN, f-GAN, density-ratio fitting, distributionally robust optimization, and so on. Based on this framework, we can also develop methodologies for nonparametric monotone regression, sparse regression, derivative estimation, and other tasks using differentiable networks. The established framework will serve as a rigorous foundation for many tasks in deep learning, which inspires novel learning methods and has a profound long-term impact on the deep learning community. 深度学习在科学、工程、商业和工业领域取得了显著的成功。许多最先进的深度学习方法涉及神经网络的导数，包括深度得分函数估计、Wasserstein生成对抗网络（WGAN）、f-GAN、带有梯度惩罚的密度比拟拟合和分布鲁棒优化等。然而，针对这些深度神经估计的统计学习理论尚未深入研究。主要原因是对可微分神经网络及其导数缺乏了解。 本提案旨在介绍和研究可微分神经网络，并为涉及导数的深度非参数估计奠定统计学习理论的基础。该研究包括三个主要组成部分。第一部分旨在介绍可微分网络（由可微分函数激活的网络）并研究其理论性质，包括网络导数表示、复杂度和逼近能力。这部分研究是基础性和必要的，因为网络的导数涉及许多流行且经验成功的深度学习方法。在第二部分中，作为第一部分的应用，我们考虑建立使用可微分网络的得分函数估计及其变体的统计学习理论。这部分研究将作为机器学习中基于得分函数的高性能生成模型的统计学习基础。在第三部分中，我们旨在建立一个包含梯度惩罚的深度非参数估计的通用框架，该框架涵盖了Wasserstein GAN、f-GAN、密度比拟拟合、分布鲁棒优化等。基于该框架，我们还可以使用可微分网络开发非参数单调回归、稀疏回归、导数估计和其他任务的方法。建立的框架将为深度学习中的许多任务提供严格的基础，激发新的学习方法，并对深度学习社区产生深远的长期影响。

15305823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15305823.value: 廢棄輪胎的資源化利用：新型增值化利用工藝設計、模擬、優化及分析

15305823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15305823.value: Prof He, Chang Prof Huang, Beijia Prof Shen, Weifeng Dr Yang, Sheng Prof Zhang, Quanguo

15306123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306123.value: 非線性色散方程的低正則積分子

15306123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306123.value: Nonlinear dispersive partial differential equations, such as the Korteweg–De Vries (KdV) equation and the nonlinear Schrödginer (NLS) equation, naturally arise in many physical and engineering applications. In most of these applications, the numerical solution of these nonlinear dispersive equations plays an important role. Correspondingly, the construction and analysis of efficient numerical methods for these nonlinear dispersive equations are of great theoretical value and practical importance. However, the development of computational methods for approximating the solutions of the KdV and NLS equations remains challenging in many respects, including the numerical computation of rough solutions and the development of structure-preserving algorithms. In this proect, new computational methods will be developed for the numerical solution of the KdV equation and the NLS equation, with rigorous analysis for the stability and convergence of the numerical solutions under low-regularity conditions when the energy techniques fail, with convergence order γ in the L^2 norm (up to a logarithmic factor) for initial data in H^γ. In addition, new post-processing techniques will be developed to construct low-regularity integrators which can conserve mass and energy simultaneously for the KdV and NLS equations. The techniques can also be combined with classical high-order time discretizaitons to obtain arbitrarily high-order mass- and energy-conserving methods for the corresponding equations. 非線性色散型偏微分方程，例如Korteweg–De Vries (KdV)方程和非線性Schrödginer(NLS)方程，在許多物理和工程應用中自然出現。在大多數應用中，這些非線性色散方程的數值解起著重要作用。相應地，構造和分析這些非線性色散方程的有效數值方法具有重要的理論價值和實際意義。然而，用於近似KdV和NLS方程解的計算方法的發展在許多方面仍然具有挑戰性，包括粗略解的數值計算和結構保持算法的發展。本項目將為KdV方程和NLS方程的數值解開發新的計算方法，並嚴格分析數值解在低正則條件下的穩定性和收斂性。

15306523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306523.value: 基金管理中的鬆弛化財富回撤約束：一類新型隨機控制和平均場博弈問題的研究

15306523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306523.value: The wealth drawdown constraint, referring to the guarantee that the fund account can never fall below a proportion of the past profit maximum, is offered by many hedge funds as a protection of the downside risk. However, this stringent constraint often leads to excessively conservative stock holdings and consumption plans, which may have adverse effects in capital growth and business expansion. One natural question arises: Can we improve the performance and utilize the wealth drawdown in steering decision making when the constraint can be violated? In response to this, we provide a new and more flexible consideration of the wealth drawdown in this proposal, in which the agent can fictitiously choose a singular control of capital injection such that the combination of the wealth and the injected capital dominates a proportion of the historical wealth maximum. Under this relaxed constraint, we formulate a new optimal control problem for a single agent, whose goal is to maximize the expected utility of consumption and minimize the cost of the fictitious capital injection. By introducing two auxiliary state processes with reflections, we can study the HJB equation with two Neumann boundary conditions, which eventually gives rise to a fully coupled system of nonlinear ODEs. We propose a novel fixed point method to tackle this challenging problem and will contribute to nonstandard proofs of the verification theorem that technically involve two running maximum processes. Some financial advantages of the relaxed constraint will be illustrated and discussed. To better understand the agent’s decision making in the highly competitive hedge fund industry, we also formulate a new competition game with n agents. The relaxed drawdown constraint now captures the agent’s concern on the historical peak of the average wealth from all peers. We propose to first work with a more tractable mean field game problem with a continuum of agents. In the absence of a common noise, we look for a mean field equilibrium by an analytical approach without heavy technicalities. For the best response control of the representative agent, we will develop a probabilistic representation using some constructed dual processes with reflections. Next, to meet the consistency condition and characterize the mean field equilibrium, we will establish a fixed point result using some novel arguments with the help of our dual processes and stochastic flow analysis. Finally, we plan to construct an approximate Nash equilibrium in the n-player game and discuss some interesting financial implications. 在大多數基金財富管理過程中，為避免下行風險過大，大多數基金管理公司會為顧客提供一類財富回撤約束的投資保障，從而使得基金帳戶不會低於過去歷史財富最高紀錄的固定比例。這種投資決策上的動態約束，可以有效防止基金帳戶的過大損失，但同時也會使得基金管理者在風險資產投資和消費決策上表現得過度保守，反而對基金財富的增長和業務的擴展起到反作用。為改善這種過度限制，一個自然的想法是：能否採取其他形式的財富回撤約束，在保障一定程度的最大回撤風險下，同時實現更進取的投資和消費策略呢？ 本項研究課題正是針對上述問題，提出了一類更加靈活的財富回撤的新型約束。和傳統的嚴格回撤相比，我們假設基金管理者可以用注資的形式保障基金帳戶和注資總和滿足歷史財富最高紀錄的回撤約束。在這種鬆弛化的財富回撤約束下，真實財富水平是可以降到回撤約束水平之下的。因此，基金管理者可以有效改善在風險資產上的投資意願，同時為保證一定程度的回撤約束，我們在對應的隨機控制問題裡要求決策者最小化注資成本。為解決這類新型的帶狀態限制的控制問題，我們引入了兩個帶反射邊界的輔助控制問題。其對應的HJB方程也是一類新的帶雙Neumann邊界的非線性方程。通過一些技術手段，最後我們需要用全新的不動點的方法去解決一類完全耦合的非線性ODE方程組。由於我們的輔助狀態過程中含有歷史峰值過程，其驗證定理的證明也需要大量非傳統的證明技巧。在數值實驗中，我們也會討論鬆弛限制中金融決策中的優勢。 另一方面，為更好理解基金行業中的高度同行競爭對基金管理者決策的影響，我們也將上述鬆弛化回撤約束引入到多个基金經理的博弈問題中。類似單個決策者的控制問題，在博弈問題中，每位基金經理的回撤參照過程都是所有人平均財富的歷史峰值。在基金經理人數趨於無窮時，我們先考慮一類平均場博弈問題。借助於平均場對控制耦合性的弱化，我們可以研究平均場均衡控制的存在性。具體而言，對代表基金經理，我們可以利用對偶化和概率表示的方法去描述其最優響應控制。在此基礎上，在帶反射的對偶隨機過程的框架下，我們再去利用隨機分析和隨機流的方法去研究一致性條件下的不動點證明。最後，我們也會進一步研究如何利用平均場均衡去逼近n個決策者下的博弈均衡以及探討其中的新的金融現象和訊息。

15306723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15306723.value: 為質子導體陶瓷燃料電池發展具有原位析出和陰離子摻雜的三導陰極材料

15306723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15306723.value: 質子陶瓷燃料電池（PCFC）是極具發展前景的清潔發電技術。 由於陰極的極化損失占該燃料電池總損失的超過50%，發展高效穩定的陰極材料是發展質子陶瓷燃料電池發展的關鍵。 具有同時傳導質子，氧離子和電子（簡稱三傳）並具有高催化活性的材料是質子陶瓷燃料電池陰極材料的首選。 目前已有單相的具有三傳特性的鈣鈦礦材料如PrBa0.5Sr0.5Co1.5Fe0.5O5+δ （PBSCF）和BaCo0.4Fe0.4Zr0.1Y0.1O3-δ （BCFZY）展現出良好的性能，但他們的性能還需要進一步提高。 本研究團隊最近發現通過對BaCo0.4Fe0.4Zr0.1Y0.1O3-δ （BCFZY）進行NiO納米顆粒原位析出可顯著提高陰極性能。 此外，也有研究發現通過鈣鈦礦材料體相陰離子（F-）摻雜可以弱化氧和金屬鍵和氫氧鍵，從而提高鈣鈦礦的傳輸特性性能。 因此，具有三傳特性的鈣鈦礦材料性能極有可能能通過同時表面修飾（原位析出）和體相修飾（陰離子摻雜）進一步提高。 然而，目前我們並不知道：（1）除Ni之外的其他金屬比如銅和銀是否也能從BCFZY和PBSCF中析出並提高性能; （2）是否析出的金屬納米顆粒會重新進入鈣鈦礦體相; （3）陰離子（F-）摻雜是否會有利於金屬的析出。 因此，本研究將重點探討以上問題。 我們將開發4組新材料：（1） BCFZYM （M=Cu and Ag）， （2） PBSCFM' （M' = Ni， Cu， 和 Ag）， （3） BCFZYMA （M = Cu 和 Ag; A = F）， 及 （4） PBSCFM'A （M' = Ni， Cu， 和 Ag; A = F)。 我們將對它們進行系統的表徵和測試。 也會將這些材料用於PCFC的陰極並測試電池性能和穩定性。 為減小陽極的擴散損失，我們將採用相反轉法制備具有指狀結構的電極。 我們也將採用基於密度泛函理論的原子尺度模擬理解材料的傳輸和表面交換特性。 將發展多物理場模型模擬電池性能。 本研究將開發新材料並明確陰離子摻雜對原位析出的影響關係。 本研究的順利實施將推動PCFC的發展，為清潔發電做出貢獻。

15307423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15307423.value: 二维铬金属硫族化合物的化学气相沉积制备及多铁性研究

15307423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15307423.value: 多铁体是一类同时具有自发磁化和自发电极化的材料，为研究电磁耦合提供了一个非常优异的材料平台。虽然关于体相三维材料的多铁性研究已经有数十年历史，但是最近人们惊喜地发现原子层厚的二维（2D）材料会表现出多铁性，为开发体积小、速度快、功耗低和效率高的数据存储设备以及探究新颖物理化学现象提供了更多的方向。例如，金属铬单质与硫族单质形成的化合物CraXb，已经被发现具有亚铁磁性、高导电性和压电特性，并且预测其磁化强度会与晶体体积相互耦合，为磁能、电能和机械能的三阶耦合提供了可能性。 由于铬金属的3d轨道具有未补偿的电子自旋态，并且二维原子晶体的晶格畸变和垂直限域效应也能潜在地打破反演对称性，因此我们提议研究二维CraXb薄层材料的多铁特性。首先，我们将使用化学气相沉积法，制备出具有良好晶体质量和超薄厚度的2D CraXb薄层材料，并测量其晶体结构、物质晶相和化学价态，以及使用压电力显微镜（PFM）和磁力显微镜（MFM）表征其压电性、铁电性和磁性。然后，在可控的磁场或电场条件下，结合PFM和MFM探究2D CraXb材料的电磁耦合。最后，我们会使用新兴的4D洛伦兹扫描透射电子显微镜（4D-LSTEM）技术，研究2D CraXb材料的亚铁磁性。我们这项研究会给认识二维拓扑电磁物理现象和寻找高速率、低功耗的数据存储设备提供更多机会。

15307523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15307523.value: 非光滑方程：稀疏性、奇異性及光滑化牛頓算法研究

15307523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15307523.value: 在本研究項目中，我們將深入研究如何求解的大規模非光滑方程（可能包含奇異性）。非光滑方程是數學規劃研究領域的重點研究問題之一。本研究項目考慮的一類重要問題是廣義方程，其在包括經濟學、工程學、決策科學、機器學習等諸多領域中發揮著重要的作用。非光滑方程在過去幾十年得到了廣汎地研究，並在理論和算法方面取得了令人印象深刻的進展。然而，近年來興起的“大數據革命”為非光滑方程的求解提出了新的挑戰。在這些應用中，我們需要在給定的時間内求得規模龐大的問題的高質量數值解。在本項目中，我們將解決求解大規模非光滑方程中理論和計算兩方面面臨的挑戰。更具體地說，我們將通過 Yosida 正則化將一類廣義方程問題等價地轉化成結構化的非光滑方程，並深入研究如何高效求解所得到的非光滑方程。首先，我們將深入研究並刻畫一類非光滑方程在解點的（廣義）雅可比矩陣的非奇異性。然後，我們將設計一種高效的稀疏光滑化牛頓算法用於求解大規模非光滑方程，並充分利用數據和非光滑方程解的稀疏性。當雅可比矩陣奇異時，牛頓算法在理論和數值計算兩方面都面臨著巨大的挑戰。不幸的是，雅可比奇異性在實際應用中廣汎存在。為解決雅可比奇異這一關鍵困難，我們將對一類能保持解的稀疏性的正則化技術進行研究，以緩解雅可比矩陣的奇異性問題。同時，我們將研究如何設計高效的光滑化牛頓算法求解一類滿足誤差界條件的奇異非光滑方程。基於本項目研發的理論和算法，我們將開發一種高效且魯棒的求解器。該項目的研究成果獎將對非光滑方程的理論和應用產生深遠的影響。

15307823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15307823.value: 考慮個體結構及滯育特性的物種時空分佈動力學研究

15307823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15307823.value: Species distribution is determined by interactions between individual organisms and their prevailing environmental conditions. It is well known that physiological states, such as the body size, influence individual metabolic rates, which further determine the population-level demographic characteristics like the mortality and fertility rates. Understanding how environmental variations alter species distribution requires linking processes between individual-level and population-level. In addition to other factors driven by seasonal environmental variations, individuals of some insects and other arthropods species undergo seasonal diapause, a physiological phenomenon characterized by the interruption or reduction of metabolic activity. For example, diapause can occur in different stages of mosquito life-cycle when temperature or humidity level is too low. The advantages of diapause include surviving through unfavorable seasons, coordinating the timing of foods, and reducing biotic challenges from predation. Motivated by mosquito growth in a spatial domain, the current project is going to propose a hypothetical physiologically structured model with following specific features: (i) seasonal factors regulating population growth; (ii) paused development of individuals during diapause; and (iii) spatial diffusion of individuals. The model, in the form of a partial differential equation with periodic parameters, will be formulated through a delicate balance between biological realism and mathematical tractability. In particular, periodic parameters are allowed to take zero on some degenerate intervals to capture the diapause phenomenon. Considering the model as an evolution equation in the time variable, the dynamical system approach through investigating the solution map on a functional space would be a promising tool. In particular, as model parameters are periodic functions in time, it is tempting to check whether a periodic semiflow can be defined on a suitable phase space and then dynamical system arguments can be developed for theoretical analysis. In this project, we are going to provide a synthetic approach to analyzing the model for both bounded and unbounded spatial domains. Further special cases will be investigated, including no spatial diffusion and no seasonal environmental variations. Model formulation and theoretical results will be further employed to study the mosquito population growth, in terms of species establishment, seasonality and spatial distribution. To do that, model parameters will be fitted by realistic data, and the model will be validated to the seasonal patterns of mosquitoes. Further simulations will focus on estimating species fitness under novel conditions and predicting the response of species distribution to climate change. 物種分布受到個體發育及其所處環境條件的互動影響。眾所周知，個體的生理狀態，如體型大小，會影響個體的新陳代謝速率，從而進一步決定種群級別的總體特徵，如物種的死亡率和生育率。理解環境變化如何改變物種分布需要考慮不同層級的相互作用過程。除了由季節性環境變化驅動的其他因素外，一些昆蟲和其他節肢動物的個體會經歷季節性的休眠（一種以減少或中斷新陳代謝活動為特徵的生理現象）。例如，當溫度或濕度過低時，蚊子的生命周期的不同階段可能會進入休眠。休眠的優點包括能夠在惡劣季節中生存、同步充足食物的供給期以及減少來自捕食的生物挑戰。 受空間區域內蚊子生長的啟發，本項目將提出數個具有以下特性的生理結構模型以研究物種的時空分佈：(i) 季節性因素對種群增長的調控；(ii) 個體在休眠期間的發育暫停；和 (iii) 個體的空間擴散。這些模型將以偏微分方程的形式，通過在生物現實性和數學可分析性之間的平衡考慮來構建。特別地，模型將允許周期性參數在一些退化區間上允許取零值，從而描述休眠現象。 該研究將以動態系統方法為主要工具，將模型視為時間變量中的演化方程，通過研究函數空間上的解映射性質揭示系統解的性質。特別地，由於模型參數是關於時間的周期函數，我們試圖在適當的相空間上構建周期半流，利用週期半流方法研究模型的理論結果。在此項目中，我們將提供一個綜合的方法來分析有限和無限空間區域時所對應的模型。 該研究中模型構建和理論結果將進一步用於研究蚊子種群增長，包括物種入侵及生存、季節性和空間分布。為此，模型參數將通過實際數據進行擬合，進一步的數值模擬將專注於估計在新環境下的物種適應性，以及預測物種在氣候變化情形下的空間分布。

15308323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15308323.value: 在原子尺度上揭示二維硒化銦相轉變和阻變行爲機制

15308323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15308323.value: Phase switching in matter is usually accompanied with dramatic property change that can be harvested in modern science and technology. The emerging two-dimensional (2D) phase-switching materials, such as transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDs), have become an exciting frontier not only to obtain new phases with exotic functionalities at the ultimate thickness limit, but also to manipulate these 2D functionalities through controlled phase switching for novel device applications. Compared to conventional materials, 2D phase-switching materials hold the great promise of further reducing the device size with faster response and less power consumption. The progress of realizing these technological benefits, however, is currently hindered by the limited choices of 2D phase-switching materials as well as the poor understanding and unreliable control of the 2D phase-switching behavior. Exploring new 2D phase-switching materials is needed for both the fundamental understanding of phase transformation with confined dimensionality and phase-change device applications. The objective of this project is to achieve the reversible and reproducible phase switching in 2D In2Se3 driven by the external electrical biasing, and to unravel the detailed switching dynamics and pathways on the atomic level. Combining our extensive experience on In2Se3 phases with the established phase-switching strategy for TMDs, we aim to attain reversible In2Se3 phase switching through controlled charge doping. Its feasibility has been proven by our proof-of-concept demonstration with charge injected from electron irradiation and ionic-liquid gating. With more reliable charge-doping approaches such as ionic-gel or high-k dielectrics gating, we expect to realize better controlled In2Se3 phase switching that is repeatable for more cycles. Based on the optimized switching performance, properties such as resistance change associated with phase switching will also be measured to assess its potential for device applications such as non-violate phase-change memories. Furthermore, to fill the knowledge gap on 2D phase-switching dynamics, we will perform the direct real-time observation of In2Se3 phase switching at the atomic scale using in situ transmission electron microscopy (TEM). Our expertise in TEM technology, consolidated by cutting-edge facilities including the in situ electrical holder and ultrafast camera, allows us to realize in situ phase switching with charge doping induced by either an electron beam or the applied bias, and to reveal the switching pathways such as the gliding of atomic layers and the formation and propagation of phase boundaries. The obtained mechanistic insight will substantially advance the understanding of 2D phase transformation and the way to control it for future phase-change device applications. 固體材料相變通常伴隨著劇烈的性質變化，在現代科技中有著廣汎的應用。新興的二維相變材料，例如過渡族金屬二硫屬化物（TMD），不僅可以在極限厚度下獲得具有特殊功能的新相，而且還可以通過可控相轉變操縱這些二維功能來實現新型電子器件。與傳統材料相比，二維相變材料有望進一步縮小器件尺寸，並具有更快的響應速度和更低的功耗。 然而，目前這些技術優勢的實現受阻于二維相變材料的有限選擇以及對二維相變行為的理解不足和控制不可靠等因素。目前迫切需要探索新的二維相變材料以更好的理解二維相變的機制和應用前景。 本項目的目標是在二維 In2Se3 中實現由外部電壓驅動的可逆且可重複的相轉變，並在原子尺度上揭示其具體的轉變動態過程和路徑。基於我們在 In2Se3 相方面的豐富經驗與已建立的 TMD 相轉變理論，我們的目標是通過受控電荷摻雜實現可逆的 In2Se3 相轉變。 我們已經通過電子輻照和離子液體門控注入電荷的演示證明了其可行性。 通過更可靠的電荷摻雜方法，例如離子凝膠或高 k 電介質門控，我們期望實現對In2Se3 相轉變的更好控制，尤其是更好的可重複性和更多的轉別次數。 基於優化的相變性能，我們還將測量與相變相關的電阻變化等特性，以評估其在非易失相變存儲器等器件應用上的潛力。 此外，為了填補二維相變動力學的知識空缺，我們將使用原位透射電子顯微鏡（TEM）在原子尺度上直接實時觀察 In2Se3 相變。 結合我們在 TEM方面的專業技術，和包括原位加電樣品台和超快相機在內的尖端設施，我們能夠利用電子束或施加偏壓誘導電荷摻雜來實現原位相轉變，並揭示其路徑，例如原子層的滑動以及相邊界的形成和移動。 本項目所獲得的結果將極大地增進對二維相變以及未來相變器件應用的理解。

15308623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15308623.value: 基於低維子空間技術的可擴展無導數優化算法

15308623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15308623.value: How to solve large-scale optimization problems without using derivatives? This is the question our project will address. It represents one of the most significant challenges in derivative-free optimization (DFO). In DFO, algorithms solve optimization problems based on function values. Such algorithms are needed in industrial and engineering applications where it is impossible or impractical to access derivatives or other first-order information. Most existing DFO algorithms cannot handle problems with more than a few hundred variables. However, recent applications in machine learning confront us with problems of much higher dimensions, urging us to develop DFO algorithms for large-scale problems. In this project, we target problems with 10^3 to 10^4 variables, generally considered as large-scale problems in DFO. We will propose a class of scalable DFO algorithms with low-dimensional subspace techniques. At each iteration, these algorithms use the local information to choose a low-dimensional subspace and then approximately minimize the objective function within this subspace. The subspace minimization is generally much cheaper than the original full-space problem due to the low dimensionality. We will prove the global convergence of these algorithms, and provide theoretical guarantees for their scalability by establishing worst-case complexity bounds. Moreover, we will further improve the algorithms' scalability with a strategy based on random projections. We will demonstrate high-probability worst-case complexity bounds for the randomized algorithms, showing that they have the same complexity as their deterministic counterparts while keeping the per-iteration cost independent of the dimension. Under the guidance of these theoretical results, we will implement scalable DFO solvers based on our subspace algorithms. We will integrate these solvers into the publicly available DFO packages we have been developing. In this way, our research will benefit the practitioners immediately. 如何在不使用導數的情況下解決大規模優化問題？這是我們的項目將要解決的問題。它代表了無導數優化（DFO）中最重要的挑戰之一。 DFO算法基於函數值解決優化問題。很多工業和工程應用中，導數或其他一階信息無法獲取或過於昂貴，因而需要這樣的算法。目前，大多數DFO算法最多能處理幾百個變量的問題。然而，機器學習中出現的問題迫使我們開發適用於大規模問題的DFO算法。 在這個項目中，我們的目標是解決具有10^3到10^4變量的問題。我們將提出一類可擴展的DFO算法，這些算法使用低維子空間技術。在每次迭代中，這些算法使用局部信息選擇一個低維子空間，然後在這個子空間內近似最小化目標函數。由於維度較低，子空間最小化通常比原始全空間問題便宜得多。我們將證明這些算法的全局收斂性和復雜性，為它們的可擴展性提供理論保證。 此外，我們將通過基於隨機投影的策略進一步提高算法的可擴展性。我們將建立隨機算法的高概率複雜性，證明明它們與其確定性算法具有相同的收斂速度，同時保持每次迭代的成本與維度無關。 在這些理論結果的指導下，我們將實現基於子空間算法的可擴展DFO求解器。我們將把這些求解器集成到我們一直在開發的DFO包中。

15309223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15309223.value: 稀疏复合优化的牛顿-增广拉格朗日方法

15309223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15309223.value: 大规模优化来自于数据驱动的学习问题。除了揭示数据中隐藏的范式或趋势， 优化建模还要处理两个主要任务。 一是从大量的变量中选取少数主要的变量。稀疏约束可以有的完成这一任务。第二个任务是处理机器学习过程中的误差以使其在某种度量下变得最小（最优）。通过复合的损失函数可以有效的对这一任务建立优化模型。 本基金的主要目的就是研究如何高效的求解这样建立的模型。 所以，研究高效的数值方法是本项目的主要任务。我们首先提出一阶和二阶最优性条件。这些条件的提出不仅有效的衡量数值解的质量， 而且要体现数据中的结构。我们计划使用的主要技巧是通过降维手段来构建一个光滑的等价模型。这样经典的理论可以被接入。其次， 我们研究使用增广拉格朗日方法来求解数值迭代中的子问题。发展快速的牛顿法是我们提出的办法之一。通过积极约束有效集的技巧来降低子问题的维数。牛顿法的二次收敛在规模小的问题上会显示它的最大优势。我们同时允许梯度法的使用。 这些新的技巧和构想需要理论上的保证。所以本项目将建立完整的收敛性分析。我们期望发展一套数值优化软件来解决诸多现实问题和推广。

15500023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500023.value: 使用不動產投資信託期权測度房地產市場風險

15500023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15500023.value: Prof Steiner, Eva Prof Titman, Sheridan Prof Zhan, Xintong, Eunice

15500023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500023.value: This study constructs novel risk measures for the housing market by extracting volatility information from REIT options. The U.S. REIT option market has been growing rapidly; by the end of 2020, more than 80% of REITs have traded options. With REITs as the underlying assets, we expect REIT options to offer more reliable, timely, and accurate information about future uncertainty in the housing market. The option-implied housing market risk measures may lead the realized volatility, reflect diverged opinions among industry professionals, and have a real impact on the future transaction and development of real estate. Moreover, REIT options allow us to generate market-, regional-, and property-level risk measures at various frequencies. We further extend measures to an international framework. A timely and reliable housing market risk measure sheds light on the theoretical prediction in the contingent claims framework about uncertainty and investment decisions (Titman (1985)). Housing market risk can impact the real economy through changes in housing prices (Mian et al. (2015)) and the household debt cycle (Mian et al. (2017)). Such risk measure also deepens our understanding of what drives boom-bust cycles in housing markets (Charles et al. (2018)). Existing literature on housing market risk measures relies on realized volatility or survey data. Moreover, several of these measures are not housing market specific or are contaminated by the outcomes of changing housing market risk. For example, the uncertainty index in Dorofeenko et al. (2014) is the variation in firm-level Total Factor Productivity. Nguyen-Thanh et al. (2020) construct a real estate uncertainty (REU) measure by linking uncertainty directly to the predictability of 40 housing variables. Options market, because of the distinctive features of low transaction costs and high leverage (Biais and Hillion (1994), is particularly attractive to informed traders. Option prices are very sensitive to and informative about economic shocks and uncertainty. For example, options whose lives span political events tend to be more expensive, reflecting that political uncertainty is priced (Kelly et al. (2016)). Bloom (2009) shows that option-implied volatility negatively predicts employment and output. Numerous studies documenting information transmission from the equity option market to stock prices and bond prices also support the informational advantage of the options market. We, therefore, expect the REIT option-implied volatility information to be a forward-looking housing market specific risk measure. We explore the time-series and cross-sectional features of the risk measures and examine the real impact on activities in the housing market. 本研究通過從房地產投資信託基金(REIT)期權中提取波動率信息構建房地產市場的新風險測度。美國房地產投資信託基金期權市場已經迅速發展：截至2016年底，超過80%的房地產投資信託基金進行了期權交易。我們認為以房地產投資信託基金作為標的資產的房地產投資信託基金期權能夠提供在房地產市場未來不確定性方面更加可靠、及時和準確的信息。隱含期權的房地產市場風險測度能夠引導已實現波動率，反映專業人士的不同意見，並且對房地產的未來交易和發展產生實際影響。此外，房地產投資信託基金期權允許在不同頻率上生成市場、區域和屬性多層面的風險測度。我們進一步將測度拓展到一個國際通用的框架。一個及時可靠的房地產市場風險測度能夠闡明或有權益框架中關於不確定性和投資決策的理論預測(Titman(1985))。房地產市場風險可以通過房價(Mian等人(2015))和家庭債務週期(Mian等人(2017))的變化影響實體經濟。這一風險測度也加深了我們對房地產市場繁榮蕭條週期驅動因素的理解(Charles等人(2018))。關於房地產市場風險測度的現有文獻依賴於已實現波動率或調查數據。而且其中一些測度並不是房地產市場特有的，或者受房地產市場風險變化帶來的結果所影響的。例如，Dorofeenko等人(2014)提出的不確定性指數是指公司層面全要素生產率的變化。Nguyen-Thanh等人(2020)通過直接連接不確定性和40個住房變量的可預測性構建了房地產不確定性(REU)測度。期權市場，由於其低交易成本和高槓桿的特點(Biais和Hillion(1994))，對知情交易者特別有吸引力。期權價格對經濟衝擊和不確定性非常敏感，並且能夠給其提供有用信息。例如，那些涵蓋政治事件的期權往往價格更高，這反映了政治不確定性已經被定價(Kelly等人(2016))。Bloom(2009)指出，期權隱含波動率反向預測就業和產出。大量記錄從股票期權市場到股票價格和債券價格的信息傳遞的研究也表明了期權市場的信息優勢。因此，我們認為房地產投資信託基金隱含期權的波動率信息能夠成爲一個具有前瞻性的房地產市場特有風險測度。我們探討了風險測度的時間序列和橫截面特征，並且檢驗了對房地產市場活動的實際影響。

15500423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500423.value: 使用方差和協方差分解來檢測什麼是造成顯著股票異常報酬的因素：一項國際性的研究

15500423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500423.value: The objective of this proposal is to investigate what drives the returns of prominent anomaly portfolios in an international setting. There are two approaches to explain anomaly returns: (i) the traditional time-series factor models such as the CAPM and (ii) variance/covariance decompositions such as Campbell et al. (2010). We focus on the latter. We first decompose unexpected anomaly returns into cash-flow (CF) and discount-rate (DR) news and then test whether returns of an anomaly portfolio can be explained by the covariance of its CF and DR news with the market CF and DR news as proposed by the two-beta model of Campbell and Vuolteenaho (2004) or the four-beta model of Campbell et al. Two methods are used to estimate CF and DR news: (i) vector autoregreesion (VAR) and (ii) valuation model combined with analyst earnings forecasts. The VAR typically uses annual frequency to estimate DR news first and then derive CF news, whereas the valuation model uses monthly frequency to estimate CF news first and then derives DR news. While studies show that monthly return predictability is low, studies find that analysts’ earnings revisions do contain valuable information content about stock valuation. We therefore mainly use the valuation model to estimate CF and DR news and the VAR as robustness checks. Prior studies using variance/covariance decomposition examine only five anomalies (size, value, investment, profitability, and momentum) and only for the U.S. market. We extend to examine several dozens of prominent anomalies and also to international markets including Hong Kong and focus on using the valuation model. Our results contribute to asset pricing literature by documenting which component of realized returns drives most variation in returns of prominent anomalies and whether the two-beta or four-beta model can explain returns of prominent anomalies. More uniquely, we follow Fama and French (2020) to construct a cross-sectional factors corresponding to the two-beta or four-beta model that can be used in time-series applications to test whether it can explain anomaly returns. These findings help understand sources of anomaly returns and which models, rational or behavioral, better explain them. Our findings can benefit investors and fund managers, particularly for conservative long-term investors who are relatively more concern about shocks to cash flows and are less concern about shocks to discounted rates. Our findings can benefit such investors most to distinguish between temporary and permanent damages when their retirement portfolio values drop. 此研究計劃的目的是檢測在國際環境中造成顯著異常投資組合回報的因素。有兩種方法可以解釋異常收益：(i)傳統的時間序列因子模型，例如CAPM；(ii)方差/協方差分解，例如Campbell等人（2010）。我們重點關注後者。我們首先將出乎意料的異常回報分解為現金流（CF）和貼現率（DR）新聞，然後測試異常投資組合的回報是否可以通過由Campbell和Vuolteenaho(2004)的二beta模型或Campbell等人的四beta模型提出其CF和DR新聞與市場CF和DR新聞的協方差來解釋。 有兩種方法可用來估計CF和DR消息：(i)向量自回歸(VAR)和(ii)估值模型結合分析師盈利預測。VAR通常使用年度頻率先估計DR新聞，然後得出CF新聞，而估值模型則使用每月頻率先估計CF新聞，然後得出DR新聞。儘管研究表明月回報可預測性較低，但研究發現分析師的盈利修正確實包含有關股票估值的有價值的信息內容。因此，我們主要使用估值模型來估計CF和DR新聞，並使用VAR\作為穩健性檢驗。 先前使用方差/協方差分解的研究僅檢查了五個顯著異常報酬的因子（規模、價值、投資、盈利能力和回報動量），並且僅針對美國市場。我們將研究範圍擴展到數十個顯著異常報酬的因子，並擴展到包括香港在內的國際市場，並將重點關注估值模型的使用。 我們結果對資產定價文獻的貢獻是已實現回報的哪個組成部分是驅動了顯著異常回報的最大變化，以及二beta或四beta模型是否可以解釋顯著異常的回報。更獨特的是，我們按照Fama和French（2020）構建了對應於二beta或四beta模型的橫截面因子，該模型可用於時間序列應用，以測試其是否可以解釋異常收益。這些發現有助於了解異常回報的來源以及哪些模型（理性模型或行為模型）可以更好地解釋它們。 我們的研究結果可以使投資者和基金經理受益，特別是對於保守的長期投資者來說，他們相對更擔心現金流的衝擊，而不太擔心貼現率的衝擊。我們的研究結果最有利於這些投資者在退休投資組合價值下降時區分暫時性損害和永久性損害。

15500823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500823.value: 隱去内容以獲利? 基於機會主義性内部交易和重大合同隱去内容的證據

15500823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500823.value: 证券交易委员会（SEC）的使命是保护投资者，维护公平、有序和高效的市场，并促进资本形成。为了实现这一使命，SEC 要求并监督 SEC 注册人（公司）的财务报告和披露，并禁止基于内幕信息的内幕交易。尽管之前的文献表明内部人士根据他们所拥有的私人信息进行公司股票交易（例如，Piotroski 和 Roulstone 2005；Ravina 和 Sapienza 2010；Cohen 等人 2012），但该文献中的一个关键挑战是研究人员无法直接观察内部人士掌握的信息。在这个项目中，我建议使用隱去合同内容來作为私人信息的存在。合同内容隱去表明私人信息被隱藏，因为公司需要向 SEC 提交重大合同。 了解管理者是否以及如何参与内幕交易以从合同内容隱去中受益非常重要，因为回答这个问题可以揭示合同内容隱去的动机，并对信息披露和内幕交易规则产生影响。首先，我考察“是否”的问题。如果管理人员利用合同内容隱去来隐瞒私人信息，他们可能会在该信息反映在股价之前参与公司股票交易以产生交易利润。另一方面，内幕交易可能会泄露管理者的内幕信息（例如，Brochet et al., 2010; Rogers et al., 2016）。预计市场将内幕交易推断为内幕私人信息的信号，管理人员可能会避免进行内幕交易，以避免泄露他们打算向市场隐瞒的信息。此外，隱去的信息理論上是无关紧要的，因此，管理者可能没有动力利用此类非重要信息进行交易。因此，内幕交易是否与内容隱去有关仍然是一个值得研究的实证问题。 接下来，我将探讨合同内容隱去如何与内幕交易相关以及如何使内部人士受益。代理问题导致管理者隐瞒反映其绩效或能力不佳的信息。如果管理者隱去合同内容以掩盖不良绩效或渎职行为，那么隱去信息将与内幕交易的賣出有关。另一方面，如果隱去信息是为了保护对竞争对手有价值的专有信息的泄露，我预计隱去信息更有可能与内幕交易的買入有关，因为好消息才会吸引更多竞争并承担更高的专有成本（Berger 和 Hann 2007)。 如果管理人员在重大合同中隱去信息的同時确实从事有利可图的内幕交易，那么结果將展示重大合同中隱去信息的“意外”后果，因为基于内幕私人信息的内幕交易违背了 SEC 创建公平有序资本市场的使命。

15500923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15500923.value: 社会互动下的定价与消费者识别

15500923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15500923.value: In a digital era, consumers’ purchase data is frequently tracked and analyzed by competing firms so as to charge differentiated prices between old and new consumers and entice consumer switching, a phenomenon called consumer recognition, which is booming in recent years and continues to grow rapidly thanks to the prosperous advances in information technologies. Existing literature has analyzed consumer recognition in various market contexts, without considering the increasingly important social interactions, which are gradually becoming an indispensable new product element and are continuously reshaping consumers’ product perceptions and firms’ competitive strategies in the past decade. Particularly for interactive platforms and multiplayer games, social interactions are their most prominent product elements. As such, it is more and more crucial to examine the interplay between consumer recognition and social interactions. Often, three major types of social interactions are abounded: (i) same-period social effect (SPSE) which refers to the positive externality that a consumer experiences from the interactions with his or her current-period peers; (ii) cross-period social effect (CPSE) which represents the positive externality consumers obtain from interacting with the early-period consumers of the firms; and (iii) cross-market social effect (CMSE) which occurs when a firm simultaneously serves two distinct but related markets with its revenue in one market (e.g., the advertising market) depending on the user base in the other market (e.g., the content service market). Indeed, there is sufficient evidence supporting the coexistence of social interactions and consumer recognition. It turns out that adopting consumer recognition has become a basic strategy for firms competing in an environment surrounded by active social interactions. The central theme of this proposal is to systematically understand how various types of social interactions alter the role and operational implementation of consumer recognition in a competitive market. Specifically, in a two-period duopoly setting, the pricing decisions interact with consumers' and firms' strategic behaviors, making the social interactions produce complicated cross-period influences. We would like to study how the presence of various social interactions would affect the competing firms’ pricing strategy and profit performance under consumer recognition. And how such impacts would further shape their endogenous incentives on whether to adopt consumer recognition. Our proposal aims to generate rich managerial insights that not only deepen firms' awareness on the different roles of aforementioned social effects, but also help firms to make better utilization on consumer recognition under social interactions, which are abounded in a digital era. 在数字化时代，消费者的购买行为数据常被企業追踪与分析，以便实施对旧有消费者以及新的消费者的价格差异化，从而吸引消费者转换，这种现象被称为消费者识别。近年来，由于信息技术的蓬勃发展，消费者识别现象持续快速增长。现有研究在许多市场环境下对消费者识别进行了分析，但对社会效应这一日益重要的因素考虑不足。社会效应已逐渐成为新的产品元素中不可或缺的部分，并在过去十年中持续地塑造着消费者对产品的感知和企业的竞争策略。特别是在互动平台和多人游戏中，社会效应是其中最显著的产品元素。因此，审视消费者识别与社交互动之间的关系变得越来越关键。 一般而言，社会效应主要有以下三种形式：(i) 同期社会效应，指消费者在与当前同期的其他消费者进行互动中所体验到的正向外部性；(ii) 跨期社会效应，指消费者在与公司早期消费者进行互动中所获得的正向外部性；(iii) 跨市场社会效应，发生在一家公司同时在两个相关但独立的市场（如广告市场和内容服务市场）中提供服务时，其中一个市场的收入依赖于另一个市场的用户基数。事实上，有充足的证据支持社会效应与消费者识别的共存关系。因此，采用消费者识别已成为公司在充满社交互动的环境中竞争的基本策略。 这份提案的核心主题是系统性地理解在具有竞争性市场中，各种类型的社会互动如何改变消费者识别的角色以及运作方式。具体来说，在双寡头、两期设定的情境下，定价决策是如何与消费者和公司的策略行为相互作用，以使得社会效应产生复杂的跨期影响。我们希望探讨各种社会互动的存在如何影响竞争对手在消费者识别下的定价策略以及利润表现，并进一步研究这些影响如何塑造他们对是否采用消费者识别的内生激励。我们的提案期望能够产生丰富的管理洞见，不仅能深化公司对于社会效应不同角色的认识，也能帮助他们在各种类型的社会互动中更好地运用消费者识别，这在数字时代尤为重要。

15501023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501023.value: 消費者共享住宿服務的選擇因素：長者和其他年齡群的比較

15501023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15501023.value: Prof QIU, Tianran Prof Song, Haiyan

15501023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501023.value: Peer-to-peer (P2P) accommodation sharing platforms, such as Airbnb, introduced a new paradigm into the tourism and hospitality industry more than a decade ago. This platform-based business model differs from the conventional economic approach and has transformed how tourism and hospitality products and services are consumed. The hospitality industry has faced tough setbacks from the pandemic, and it is time to discuss how it can rekindle tourism by caring for potential consumers such as senior citizens. This proposed project will aim to explore how P2P accommodation-sharing services can cope with the next difficult but must-win market of senior consumers. Using prospect theory and the unified theory of acceptance and use of technology, the proposed study will examine the impacts of determinants (accommodation attributes) and platform acceptance that affect how consumers choose P2P accommodation-sharing services and predict how the hospitality industry will evolve in the post-pandemic era of hospitality offerings. Our research design will follow a sequential three-stage approach, including exploratory and explanatory mixed methods. In the first stage, online reviews and supplementary interviews will be analysed using structural topic modelling to identify new and relevant attributes of senior citizens’ experiences with accommodation-sharing services, and choice experiments will be conducted to quantify their preferences for various accommodation attributes. In the second stage, two stated-choice experiments will be developed and conducted to collect data from the respondents about their preferences for the attributes of accommodation-sharing services, their platform acceptance, and their risk- and age-related perceptions. To address the reasons for intra- and intergroup differences among senior consumers, the proposed project will aim to incorporate the interplays among various aspects of platform acceptance using technology acceptance constructs, risk perceptions, and discrepancies in self-age perception (i.e., chronological versus cognitive age). Based on the estimated willingness to pay, platform acceptance, and risk and age perceptions determined through the use of discrete choice models, the proposed project will conduct cluster analyses to suggest segmentation of the senior market in the tourism accommodation market. To triangulate the quantitative findings, a series of in-depth interviews will be conducted in the third stage. The qualitative data will provide insight into the mechanism behind senior consumers’ heterogeneity in accommodation choice behaviours between each segment. The insights obtained during the proposed project will contribute to the literature on gerontology and marketing, the hospitality industry’s marketing strategies aimed at senior consumers, and the ongoing debate about consumers’ acceptance of new technologies and services. 十多年前，像Airbnb這樣的共享住宿平台為旅遊和酒店業引進了一種新範式。平台商業模式採取了不同於傳統經濟的路徑，並改變了旅遊和酒店的產品及服務的消費方式。酒店業在疫情中遭受了嚴重打擊，現在是時候討論如何通過回應潛在遊客(如：老年人)的需求來重振旅遊業，而他們往往又是後疫情時代的高風險人群。本研究計劃旨在探索共用住宿服務能夠如何顧及老年消費者，來開拓下一個很困難但必須要贏的市場。透過展望理論和整合型科技接受模式，本研究將探討決定性因素(住宿屬性)和平台接受度對消費者如何選擇共享住宿服務的影響，並預測酒店業在後疫情時代的服務供應將會如何演變。 本研究的設計將遵循連續的三階段法，包括探索性和解釋性的混合方法。在第一階段，將使用結構主題模型對線上評論和補充訪談進行分析，以確定長者在使用共享住宿服務體驗中的新的相關屬性，並進行選擇實驗以量化他們對各種住宿屬性的偏好。在第二階段，將開發並進行選擇實驗，以收集受訪者對共享住宿服務屬性的偏好、平台接受度以及風險和年齡相關感知的資料。為了解釋老年消費者群體內部和群體間差異的原因，本項目將利用技術接受結構、風險感知(新冠關注和選擇共享住宿服務的感知風險)以及自我年齡感知差異(即實際年齡與認知年齡)來整合平台接受度等各個方面之間的相互作用。通過運用離散選擇模型，本項目先確定估算的支付意願、平台接受度，以及風險和年齡的感知等，再將其進行聚類分析，以建議旅遊住宿市場如何對長者市場進行細分。然後，對定量結果採取交叉驗證，我們將在第三階段進行一系列深入訪談。定性資料將深入瞭解每個細分市場內部和之間的老年消費者在形成不同住宿選擇行為的深層機制。 從本項目所獲得的見解將有助於老年學和市場行銷方面的文獻，酒店業針對老年消費者的行銷策略，以及關於消費者接受新技術和新服務的持續辯論。

15501323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501323.value: 債券交易所買賣基金、錯誤定價和利益分歧

15501323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501323.value: Bond exchange-traded funds (ETFs) invest in fixed-income securities such as corporate bonds. The bond ETF market has developed substantially over the last decade. By 2020, the total net assets of bond ETFs reached over US$1 trillion. The ETF share prices are kept close to the net asset value (NAV) of the holdings via an arbitrage mechanism, which requires authorized participants (APs) to create or redeem ETF shares. APs will deliver a creation basket containing underlying assets and receive new ETF shares from the ETF manager (sponsor) when the share price is above NAV. Similarly, APs exchange ETF shares for a redemption basket of underlying securities when the price is below NAV. The extant literature primarily focuses on equity ETFs and studies the impacts of equity ETFs on underlying stocks' liquidity, mispricing, etc. This proposal investigates implications from a crucial distinction between bond and equity ETFs – the nature of creation/redemption baskets. The baskets for equity ETFs are almost identical to holdings. However, for bond ETFs, the baskets differ from the actual holdings due to the illiquidity of bonds (Todorov, 2021). Moreover, creation and redemption baskets often contain different bonds. We propose that the discrepancy in liquidity between creation and redemption baskets reflects the conflicts between APs and ETF sponsors, which can limit arbitrage activities. APs are usually large market makers and this dual role could prevent them from closing the arbitrage gap. For example, APs may redeem ETF shares when they have extremely negative bond inventory imbalances and demand more bonds to satisfy their market-making needs while they should have created shares in this scenario. In response, the sponsor could include more liquid and longer maturity bonds in the creation basket and illiquid and shorter duration bonds in the redemption basket to prevent further strengthening the mispricing. Since conflicts between ETF sponsors and APs affect arbitrage activities and thus ETF pricing, we argue that a factor model that takes into account such conflicts can explain ETF return anomalies. This project will establish an important link between mispricing and the roles of ETF stakeholders. It will enrich the understanding of how market frictions affect asset pricing. Finally, it will guide the policymakers to examine the impact of new investment vehicles on the underlying securities.

15501723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15501723.value: 主管底线思维的双刃剑效应：目标导向在情绪和行为反应中的作用

15501723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15501723.value: Prof Madera, Juan M. Dr Wen, Xueqi

15501723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15501723.value: 主管底线思维是指员工对于主管强调企业的底线结果而忽视其他重要结果（例如，员工需求或福祉）的感知。现有文献主要关注主管底线思维对员工的认知过程及其工作行为的影响，揭示了其正面和负面的效应（Babalola et al.，2021）。为了解释主管底线思维的双刃剑效应，我们将研究主管底线思维与员工的情绪（愤怒和激情）以及自主工作行为之间的关系，目的是通过情绪视角来理解主管底线思维的复杂性。借鉴认知评估理论和情绪的社会功能视角，我们将研究员工在面对主管底线思维时是否显示出明显的情绪和行为反应，以及这些反应是否取决于员工自身的目标取向。我们假设当员工以绩效目标为导向时，主管底线思维能够引起正面效应：激情和寻求反馈行为。然而，当员工以学习目标为导向时，主管底线思维往往会引发负面效应，即愤怒和回避反馈行为。 通过采用全周期研究方法，在三个分研究中，我们将使用一个多源多波段研究（被试间设计），一个基于场景的实验研究（被试间设计），和一个经验取样法研究（被试内设计）来测试提出的模型。这种方法不仅会提升研究结果的内部和外部效度，还会捕捉到主管底线思维的长期和偶发效应。此研究对文献和实践有以下几方面的贡献。首先，我们将研究主管底线思维对员工情绪体验（及其后续行为）的影响。特别是，我们将强调情绪机制在解释员工对主管底线思维行为反应时的作用。其次，我们把员工的目标取向作为调节因素，检验此因素如何改变员工对主管底线思维的情绪反应。这个结论将对主管底线思维何时能够在员工中引起不同情绪的学术理解进行修正，从而通过情绪的角度对研究主管底线思维的双刃剑效应提供新的思路。第三，不同于之前的研究单一考虑其对员工本职行为的影响，我们将扩展对主管底线思维的认识，检验其通过愤怒和激情的中介作用对员工的寻求反馈和回避反馈行为的影响。

15502123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15502123.value: 团队合作和收入分享对财富管理市场中财务顾问的生产力的影响

15502123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502123.value: With the aging population, people are increasingly encouraged to take more responsibility for their future retirement, and many people turn to professional financial advisors (FAs) for help. The management of FAs is important to both financial service firms and policy makers, due to the close relationship between FAs and clients, and the importance of FAs to consumer welfare.
