This proposed research empirically examines a common practice in the financial advisory (FA) industry: FAs team up to serve clients and split the revenue. We make use of a unique dataset that documents all the teaming and revenue-sharing activities as well as FA performances between January 2018 and December 2021 in one of the largest financial advisory companies in the US, aiming to answer several important managerial questions, including: 1. Should teaming be encouraged? What is the impact on the firm and on customers? 2. Should negotiation on share of revenue be encouraged? Will the firm be better or worse off by imposing the share? 3. How does COVID-19 affect teaming outcomes and performance of FAs, especially FAs in different groups (e.g. male versus female)? To answer these questions, we will use a combination of structural model approach and DID (difference in difference) approach. This research will contribute to both the salesforce management literature and the matching literature, as well as providing evidence on the differential impact of the COVID-19 pandemic. Our research findings will be interesting to not only financial service firms, but also to the general public and policy makers. 这项拟议的研究对财务顾问（FA）行业中的一种常见做法进行了实证研究：财务顾问组成团队为客户提供服务并分配收入。我们利用一个独特的数据集，记录了美国最大的金融咨询公司之一在2018年1月至2021年12月期间所有的团队合作和收入分享活动以及财务顾问（FA）的绩效，旨在解决几个重要的管理问题，包括：1. 是否应该鼓励团队合作？对公司和客户的影响是什么？2. 是否应该鼓励就收入份额进行谈判？强行规定份额对公司有利或有弊？3. COVID-19如何影响团队合作的效果和财务顾问的绩效，特别是不同群体的财务顾问（如男性与女性）？为解决上述问题，我们将采用结构模型法和DID（双重差分法）相结合的方法。这项研究将为销售队伍管理文献和匹配文献做出贡献，同时也为COVID-19大流行的不同影响提供证据。

15502323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15502323.value: 開發與驗證香港會展中心之環境、社會及治理（ESG）問題衡量表

15502323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15502323.value: Prof Back, Ki-Joon Dr Lee, Seoki

15502323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502323.value: Recognized as a highly profitable business tourism, the Meeting, Incentive, Convention, Exhibition (MICE) industry is rapidly growing worldwide. The development of the MICE industry prompts the proliferation of convention and exhibition (C&E) centers around the globe. With its strong public mission (i.e., local economic catalyst, urban renewal scheme), C&E centers mostly rely on public funds, known as publicly owned facilities. However, the negative aspect of C&E centers causes severe environmental issues; events held in a C&E center generate an enormous amount of waste, consume much energy, and produce a significant amount of carbon footprint through the air and/or ground transportation of visitors Considering that a C&E center is a public asset that is closely intertwined with social, environmental, and public agenda, its financial performance alone cannot truly reflect the center’s performance. In other industries, business entities regularly report their ESG management practices and performance as key non-financial information in response to the demands of various stakeholder members, thereby enhancing their financial value and social image. Surprisingly, as publicly owned facilities with a strong public mission of boosting local community in a socially sustainable means, C&E centers are negligent about ESG management and reporting. One of the possible reasons for the absence of ESG reporting at C&E centers is the lack of center-specific ESG measurement or performance rating system. Using a mixed-methods approach, the present study therefore aims to develop and validate a scale for C&E center-specific ESG issues that strengthens ESG management practices and improves performance. To enhance the scale validity, this study will analyze the significant gap between users and C&E center operators and cross-culturally validate ESG measurement through data collection in HK and the United States (US). Once the scale is validated, this study will also classify the identified attributes into three factors by examining the asymmetric impact of the attributes on C&E centers’ ESG benefits based on three-factor theory. The findings of this study will be used to enable ESG management reporting of C&E centers, to allow C&E center stakeholders to understand what ESG management practices and strategies promote C&E centers’ sustainable development, and to facilitate ESG strategic management and investment, together with theoretical contribution to ESG research in the tourism literature. 會展業是公認的利潤豐厚的商務旅遊，在全球範圍迅速發展。會展業的發展促進了會展中心在全球激增。會展中心具有強烈的公共使命（即助推地方經濟、城市更新計劃），它們大多依靠公共資金，因此被稱為公有設施。然而，會展中心的負面影響也造成了嚴重的環境問題。中心舉辦活動會產生大量廢物、消耗大量能源，並且由於访客空中及地面運輸而產生大量碳足跡。 考慮到會展中心是與社會、環境和公共議程密切相關的公共資產，僅靠財務業績並不能真實反映中心之績效。在其他行業，企業實體定期報告其ESG管理實踐和績效，作為關鍵的非財務信息，回應各利益相關方成員的要求，從而提升其財務價值和社會形象。令人驚訝的是，會展中心作為公有設施，具有很強的公共使命，以社會可持續發展的方式促進當地社區發展，但卻疏於對ESG的管理及報告。會展中心缺乏ESG的報告原因之一，是没有針對中心的 ESG 衡量辦法或績效考評系統。 因此，本研究採用混合方法，旨在開發和驗證一個針對會展中心 ESG 問題的量表，從而加強 ESG 管理實踐及提高績效。為了提高量表的有效性，本研究將分析用戶與會展中心經營者之間的顯著差距，在香港及美國收集數據，對 ESG 衡量進行跨文化驗證。在量表得到驗證後，本研究還將根據三因素理論，將所識別的屬性劃分為三個因素，研究這些屬性對中心ESG績效之非對稱影響。本研究之結果將用於促進會展中心的ESG管理報告，使會展中心的利益相關者瞭解哪些ESG管理做法及戰略能夠促進會展中心的可持續發展，並且促進ESG戰略管理及投資，同時為旅遊文獻中的ESG研究做出理論貢獻。

15502623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15502623.value: 超越目標設定：在中國製造業中實現減排

15502623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15502623.value: 世界經濟論壇指出，氣候變化導致的經濟損失每年超過11萬億美元，並預計到2050年，這些損失將占到全球經濟GDP的18%。由於碳排放是氣候變化的系統性原因，聯合國呼籲減排和避免，以保護可居住的地球並支持經濟發展。作為全球最大的排放國和製造業中心，中國製造商迫切需要減排，他們嚴重依賴煤炭發電，因此排放大量溫室氣體。 2022年，NewClimate Institute指出許多國際大型企業未能達到減排目標，而TÜV Rheinland發現，在中國受訪的工業企業中，有57％在應對排放問題上採取了較少的行動。缺乏進展是因為人們對減排實踐的範圍和特徵知之甚少，這阻礙了該行業實踐的傳播。對減排實踐採用嚴格的研究，以貢獻於聯合國的SDG13和支持中國2060年實現碳中和的目標是必要的，突顯了該項目的重要性。另一個原因是對於這些實踐如何以及何時採用以取得理想結果的認知有限。根據環境適應理論，內在經營條件（即產品類型和運營複雜性）和外部商業環境條件（即不確定性水平和商業環境的豐饒程度）影響了減排努力的結果。然而，管理者對於這些條件如何影響減排成果的表現結果（利益或阻礙）不了解。這個研究項目還回應了關於減排的財務和環境價值缺乏的認知，通過採用多方法研究設計，包括機器學習、事件和案例研究，以識別出有效的採用方法和時機。研究結果將為理論和實踐的進展做出貢獻，並通過依靠環境適應理論，揭示以下內容：（i）有效的減排實踐及其適用情況，（ii）採用減排實踐的特徵和範圍，（ iii）不同採用水平下的實踐績效價值，（iv）對績效結果有益（或有害）的經營和商業環境條件，以及（v）對中國製造業減少排放和促進減排實踐的管理和政策見解，以實現零排放。

15503023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503023.value: 稅收減免是否扭曲了激勵性薪酬制度？2018 年減稅和就業法案的證據

15503023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503023.value: The Tax Cuts and Jobs Act (TCJA or “the Act”), effective from 2018, significantly reduces the tax benefits of executive compensation by restricting the tax deduction to only $1 million of total compensation for each top executive of public companies. This change effectively repeals a long-standing exception to the $1 million limit for qualified performance-based compensation. It has long been suspected that the tax deductibility of performance-based compensation incentivizes firms to change features of the compensation contracts in order to camouflage cash compensation as incentive compensation, while allowing executives and firms to enjoy the tax benefits. We hypothesize that the repeal of the tax deductibility reduces such incentives of firms and, at the equilibrium, leads to an increase in performance target difficulty and payout uncertainty in bonus plans, which are essential for incentive provision. To test the hypotheses, we propose two measures of performance target difficulty based on ex post performance realization and ex ante information, respectively. We also draw from the literature and propose two measures of payout uncertainty. We will manually collect a large sample of performance measures, performance targets and realized performance, as well as other bonus plan features from proxy statement disclosures. Using this information, we will conduct empirical tests of our hypotheses. Performance target difficulty and payout uncertainty are important not only because it affects the ex post compensation payouts to executives; more importantly, it has implications for ex ante incentives provided by compensation contracts. In addition to contributing to the research on executive compensation contracting and performance evaluation, our study will be of interests to financial market regulators and other stakeholders in corporate governance. 自2018 年起生效的《減稅和就業法案》（TCJA 或“該法案”）將上市公司每位高管薪酬總額的稅收減免限制為僅100 萬美元，從而大幅降低了高管薪酬的稅收優惠。這一變化有效地廢除了長期存在的基於績效的薪酬上限為 100 萬美元的例外情況。長期以來，人們一直懷疑績效薪酬的稅收減免會激勵企業改變薪酬合同的特徵，將現金薪酬偽裝成激勵性薪酬，同時讓高管和企業享受稅收優惠。我們假設取消稅收減免會減少企業的這種激勵，並且在均衡狀態下會導致績效目標難度增加和獎金計劃支付的不確定性增加，而這對於提供激勵至關重要。為了檢驗這些假設，我們分別提出了基於事後績效實現和事前信息的績效目標難度的兩種衡量標準。我們還根據文獻提出了兩種支付不確定性的衡量標準。我們將手動收集績效指標樣本、績效目標和已實現績效，以及代理聲明披露中的其他獎金計劃特徵。利用這些信息，我們將對我們的假設進行實證檢驗。績效目標難度和支付不確定性很重要，不僅因為它影響高管的事後薪酬支付；更重要的是，它對補償合同提供的事前激勵產生影響。除了為高管薪酬承包和績效評估的研究做出貢獻外，我們的研究還將引起金融市場監管機構和公司治理中其他利益相關者的興趣。

15503223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503223.value: ESG时代的同行薪酬应用:以ESG薪酬与相对绩效评估(RPE)为例

15503223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503223.value: Corporate environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices are increasingly being proven to have significant value implications for various stakeholders, including shareholders in the long term. To incentivize the implementation of material ESG initiatives by firm management, a new type of incentive provision, ESG pay, has emerged. ESG pay links nonfinancial ESG criteria to executive compensation contracts and is an increasingly common practice carried out by companies worldwide. The evolving role of ESG performance in rewarding corporate managers and the prevailing difficulty of measuring and comparing ESG performance complicates the contracting landscape. How this emerging practice interacts with other incentives such as relative performance evaluation, which may affect contract effectiveness, remains unclear. To date, there are very few studies exploring how ESG pay shapes the usefulness of peer performance in benchmarking managerial efforts, whether the peer group development process has evolved to better reflect the company’s ESG strategy and impact or has been opportunistically used for managerial rent extraction, and, importantly, how these changes influence the effectiveness of ESG pay in improving firms’ ESG performance. The proposed project aims to fill this research gap. 企业环境、社会和治理(ESG)实践越来越多地被证明对各种利益相关者(包括长期股东)具有重要的价值含义。为了激励企业管理层实施重大的ESG举措，一种新型的激励措施——ESG薪酬应运而生。ESG薪酬将ESG这种非财务标准与高管薪酬合同联系起来，这一做法在全球企业中越来越普遍。ESG绩效在奖励企业管理者方面不断演变的作用，以及衡量和比较ESG绩效的普遍困难，使合同前景变得复杂。这种新兴做法如何与其他激励机制相互作用，目前尚不清楚。迄今为止，很少有研究探讨ESG薪酬如何塑造同行绩效在管理工作基准中的有用性，同行群体发展过程是否已经发展到更好地反映公司抯ESG战略和影响，或者被投机主义地用于管理租金提取，以及重要的是，这些变化如何影响ESG薪酬在改善公司方面的有效性?环境、社会和治理绩效。拟议的项目旨在填补这一研究空白。

15503323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503323.value: 在全球監管格局中構建韌性：政府貿易制裁對企業績效影響的事件研究

15503323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503323.value: Firms involve in the global supply chain are encountering increased political risks. Trade sanctions have been frequently used by governments amid growing geopolitical tensions. These sanctions aim to cut off the relation between a targeted firm and its trading partners, which may undermine the firm’s profitability and even threaten its survivability. However, anecdotal cases show that there are firms were achieving technological and sales breakthrough despite of being sanctioned. Thus, the long-term impacts of the trade sanctions remain to be unclear. The current operations management literature provides limited understanding about the impacts of the trade sanctions on the performance of targeted firms. To fill this gap, this project will use the US-China trade conflict as the backdrop to examine the impact of US government sanctions on Chinese firms. Specifically, this project will adopt a natural experiment design to capture the treatment effect of trade sanction on the firm’s performance in terms of profitability and survivability. The natural experiment aims to quantify the impacts of trade sanction by capturing significant abnormal changes in the performance of firms being sanctioned. This project will further explore the factors that can mitigate the impacts of trade sanction. Drawing from the resource acquisition perspective in relational view theory, this project proposes that the firms with high levels of vertical integration, innovation and political ties may suffer less from the sanction. This project seeks to provide both theoretical contributions and practical implications. Specifically, the project outcomes will contribute to the literature on supply chain risk management by broadening its scope to include trade sanctions as an increasingly salient risk, and systematically testing the risk mitigation factors. The outcomes will provide literature valuable insights for building supply chain resilience in an increasingly politicized global trade environment. Practically, this project will provide clear guidance for firms under the influence of trade sanctions in terms of which factors should be strengthened to survive and prosper. The project outcomes can also inform governments of the quantitative effects of sanctions, which can be important references for future policy making. 参与全球供应链的公司正面临越来越大的政治风险。在日益紧张的地缘政治环境中，贸易制裁已被政府频繁使用。这些制裁旨在切断目标公司与其交易伙伴的关系，这可能会削弱公司的盈利能力，甚至威胁到其生存。然而，有些公司在被制裁的情况下仍能取得技术和销售的突破。因此，贸易制裁对企业的的长期影响仍有待研究。现有的运营管理文献对贸易制裁对目标公司绩效的影响的理解有限。 为了填补这一空白，本项目将使用中美贸易冲突作为背景，来研究美国政府制裁对中国公司的影响。具体来说，本项目将采用自然实验设计，以探究贸易制裁对公司盈利能力和生存能力的影响。自然实验旨在通过捕捉被制裁公司绩效的异常变化，来量化贸易制裁的影响。本项目将进一步探讨能够减轻贸易制裁影响的因素。从关系理论中的资源获取视角出发，本项目提出，具有高度垂直整合、创新和政治联系的公司可能会受到的制裁影响较小。 本项目旨在提供理论贡献和实践意义。具体来说，项目关注贸易制裁这一越来越突出的风险，并系统地探索可缓解此风险的影响的因素，从而为供应链风险管理的文献做出贡献。项目将为在日益政治化的全球贸易环境中建立供应链韧性提供有价值的见解。在实践上，本项目将为受到贸易制裁影响的公司提供明确的指导，指出哪些因素应该得到加强，以利于企业应对贸易制裁。项目亦可量化政府制裁的效应，这对未来的政策制定可提供重要参考。

15503623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503623.value: 基于离散选择的香港出境游需求代理人基模型

15503623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15503623.value: Dr Masiero, Lorenzo Dr Yang, Yang

15503623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503623.value: It is critical for destination marketing organisations and firms to understand the market demand for tourism if they are to achieve better strategic planning and management. Hence, scholars have devoted tremendous efforts to analysing and understanding tourism demand. For instance, at the micro level, studies have acquired abundant knowledge on tourist preferences and heterogeneity. Meso-level studies have extensively examined social interactions among tourists, as well as market segmentations. At the macro level, investigations have achieved fruitful findings in terms of aggregated demand and market fluctuations. While all these studies are of substantial value, they are limited in scope to one specific analytical level. A full understanding of complex tourism demand requires multiple-level perspectives. For example, it is difficult for macro-level tourism demand studies to demonstrate the role of heterogenous tourist in market fluctuations, or for micro-level investigations to elaborate how interactions among tourists form and influence market demand for tourism. Therefore, looking forward to embracing a new normal in the tourism industry post-COVID-19 pandemic, it is time to push tourism demand analysis forward. This requires seeking a holistic and comprehensive framework that integrates tourism demand analyses from multiple levels. The proposed project intends to establish a micro-meso-macro analysis framework for the outbound tourism market using a discrete choice-informed agent-based model. This will be the first attempt to examine tourism demand from multiple analytical levels in a unified framework, making the study an important contribution to the tourism demand literature. It will investigate the interlocking interactions among micro, meso and macro dynamics in the tourism market. In particular, the proposed framework will use a discrete choice model to analyse individual tourist preferences at the micro level, and social interactions among tourists as well as market segments at the meso level. The outcome of the discrete choice analysis will then be fed into an agent-based modelling framework to simulate market demand fluctuations at the macro level. The dynamic microsimulation results of the proposed framework will shed better light on the underlying mechanisms of tourism demand at different analytical levels, ranging from how changes in individual preferences and tourist interactions can be reflected in market demand to how market fluctuations feed back into the dynamics of tourist preferences and interactions. Such an understanding of the interlocking interactions among different analytical levels will provide a solid foundation for practitioners to conduct strategic planning and project implementation. 為了更好地實現戰略規劃與管理，目的地管理機構和旅遊公司需要對其所經營的市場具備充分並細緻的了解。因此，學者們在分析和理解旅遊需求這一課題上做出了巨大的努力。例如，在微觀層面，學者們細緻的研究了遊客的偏好及其異質性；在中觀層面，學者們廣泛研究了遊客、遊客群組之間的社交互動以及細分市場的形成；在宏觀層面，各類調查在解釋市場總體需求和市場波動方面取得了豐碩的成果。雖然這些研究都在相應的分析層面做出了突出貢獻，它們的研究結果都因為研究範圍的限制而有所局限。然而，全面地理解與分析旅遊需求的複雜性需要多層次的視角。例如，宏觀層面的分析很難證實個體異質性如何影響市場波動，微觀層面的調查也很難解釋遊客之間的互動如何形成並影響旅遊市場的總體需求。因此，在展望後疫情時代旅遊業的新常態的同時，把旅遊需求研究推進到新的研究高度迫在眉睫。在這個過程中，一個充分考慮到旅遊需求的整體性和全面性的多層次分析框架必不可少。 擬議項目旨在利用离散选择模型和代理人基模型，構建一個微觀-中觀-宏觀互相影響的分析框架，用以研究香港的出境游需求。這將是利用多層次分析框架統一研究旅遊需求的一次大膽嘗試，並將對旅遊需求研究領域做出重要貢獻。這個框架將調查旅遊市場在微觀、中觀和宏觀動態之間的相互作用。具體來說，擬議的框架將使用離散選擇模型來分析微觀層面遊客的偏好，以及在中觀層面遊客之間的社交互動和細分市場。離散選擇分析的結果將被帶入一個代理人基模型，用以模擬宏觀層面的市場需求及波動。擬議框架的動態微觀模擬結果將更好地揭示在不同分析層面上旅遊市場各方互相影響的潜在機制。例如，個人偏好和遊客互動的變化如何會反映在市場需求中，市場波動又如何回饋、影響遊客的偏好及遊客間的互動。這種把握了不同分析層面聯繫的研究框架可以為從業者進行戰略規劃和項目實施提供堅實的基礎。

15503723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15503723.value: 數據驅動的電氣化自動駕駛系統的風險規避運營管理

15503723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15503723.value: Prof Cheng, Jianqiang Dr Lim, Yun Fong Prof Shen, Zuo-Jun Max

15503723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15503723.value: The concept of booming autonomous electrified mobility (AEM) is becoming widely accepted. Manufacturers are accelerating the development of AEM in the auto industry toward a new future for mobility. Reinventing our relationship with roads, AEM systems, which include autonomous electric vehicles (AEVs) and supporting technologies (e.g., vehicle-to-everything [V2X] communication), will provide the public with convenient and efficient mobility services. High reliability is required for such new systems because they interact with human safety. However, as a new paradigm, the AEM comes with inherent and complex risks and uncertainties. First, when initially adopting AEVs, vehicle failures often occur. For instance, Tesla customers have seen hundreds of vehicle failures and crashes on the roads under the autopilot system. Second, the vehicle recharging issue is always important because of the customers' range anxiety at low battery levels. More importantly, the public interest in sustainability and worldwide carbon-neutrality initiatives push the future mobility landscape to promise energy greenness. For instance, Toyota produces electric vehicles with solar panels embedded in the vehicles' exterior, harvesting solar energy on the roads. Nevertheless, harvesting solar energy highly depends on uncertain weather conditions. Third, facing a new mobility paradigm, customer demands in various regions and periods are greatly uncertain. Therefore, risk-averse operations concerning vehicle failures, weather-dependent solar energy harvesting, and spatial and temporal demands are needed for AEVs to provide robust services. We consider a mobility operator (she) managing a fleet of AEVs to solve the following problems. First, how can she optimize daily operations to relocate and recharge the AEVs while concerning potential vehicle failures, maximally harvesting solar energy, and satisfying customer demands? We build a distributionally robust chance-constrained (DRCC) model to formulate robust and risk-averse operational decision-making. However, the model is extremely difficult to solve due to the high-dimensional and correlated uncertainties. We then examine the second question: How can one reduce the uncertainty dimensionality while considering the problem features, leading to an approach integrating descriptive and prescriptive analytics? Third, anticipating risk-averse operations, how can the mobility operator strategically determine a robust infrastructure plan (i.e., AEV deployment and charging-station installation) that ensures a successful mobility landscape transition? More importantly, facing a new paradigm, the operator's decisions should be adaptable and dynamically improved as more data and experience are collected. We adopt data-driven optimization to solve the AEV fleet's risk-averse operations and strategic planning problems, contributing theoretically to the stochastic optimization literature and practically to developing a smart city. 蓬勃發展的自動駕駛電動汽車（AEM）的概念正在被廣泛接受。製造商正在加速汽車行業 AEM 的發展，邁向交通出行的新未來。包括自動電動汽車（AEV）和相關支持技術（例如車聯網【V2X】通信）在內的 AEM 系統將重塑我們與交通道路的關係，並將為公眾提供便捷高效的出行服務。 由於此類新系統的運作與人類安全相互交織，該類系統需要具備很高的可靠性。然而，AEM作為一種新的範式，具有固有的、複雜的風險和不確定性。首先，當人們在最初採用AEV時，可能經常會出現車輛故障。例如，特斯拉客戶在自動駕駛系統驅動下發生过數百起車輛故障和碰撞事故。其次，由於客戶常常對電池電量低時的續航里程感到焦慮，使得車輛充電問題顯得尤為重要。更重要的是，公眾對可持續發展和全球碳中和倡議的興趣推動未來的交通格局向能源綠色發展邁進。例如，豐田生產的電動汽車在汽車外部嵌入了太陽能電池板，在行駛道路上時收集太陽能。然而，收集太陽能在很大程度上取決於不確定的天氣條件。第三，面對新的出行範式，不同地區、不同時期的客戶需求具有很大的不確定性。因此，AEV 需要針對車輛故障、依賴天氣的太陽能收集以及空間和時間需求進行風險規避操作，以提供穩健的服務。 我們考慮一个管理着AEV 車隊的交通運營商，并尝试解決以下問題。首先，针对潛在的車輛故障，最大限度地收集太陽能並滿足客戶需求等場景及要求，该運營商如何優化日常運營並及時有效地對 AEV 進行調度和充電？我們將構建一個分佈魯棒優化機會約束（DRCC）模型來製定穩健且規避風險的運營決策。然而，由於高維和高度相關的不確定性，該模型極難求解。於是，我們嘗試研究第二個問題：如何在考慮問題特徵的同時降低不確定性維度，從而形成一種集成描述性和規範性分析的數學優化方法？第三，根據運營商規避風險的運營細節，移動運營商如何戰略性地確定穩健的基礎設施計劃（即 AEV 部署和充電站安裝等）以確保整個社會能有效成功轉型到一個新的交通出行範式？更重要的是，面對新的範式，運營商的決策應該隨著收集更多數據和經驗而具有適應性和動態提升的能力。 我們將採用數據驅動的優化來解決 AEV 車隊的風險規避運營和戰略規劃問題，在理論上為隨機優化文獻做出貢獻，並在實踐中為智慧城市的發展做出貢獻。

15505023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505023.value: 双边市场跨边网络的决定因素: 一项基于多个同样在线招聘平台的研究

15505023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505023.value: The extant research on the evolution of two-sided markets, or platforms, has uncovered that both direct network effects (i.e., the installed base of one side helps with the growth of itself termed DNE hereafter) and indirect or cross-network effects (i.e., the installed base of one side helps with the growth of the other side, termed CNE hereafter) exist to facilitate the growth of the platforms, and oftentimes, the two CNEs are asymmetric (i.e., the effect of the installed base of one side on the other side is not the same as the other CNE). These existing studies usually leveraged observations of installed base on both sides over time from a single two-side market to identify DNEs, and more importantly, CNEs, which however prevented researchers and practitioners from further assessment of (1) to what extent the existence of CNEs is robust, and they are asymmetric, and (2) if so, what are the determinants of the asymmetric CNEs. In this project, we leverage data from a Service-as-a-Software (i.e., SaaS) firm, whose product was implemented in 120 major cities across China as independent online job search and recruitment platforms to investigate to what extent CNEs exist in different cities, and how these CNEs are determined by city specific sociometric conditions. Our project is expected to shed light on key factors underpinning the heterogenous growth patterns of the same platform in different contexts. 现有的关于双边市场或平台演变的研究发现，直接网络效应（即平台一端的用户基础有助于该端用户自身的增长，以下称为 DNE）和间接或跨网络效应（即，平台一端的用户基础有助于另一端的用户增长，以下称为CNE）都能促进平台的增长。并且经常性的，两个CNEs是不对称的。这些现有的研究通常利用对一个具体的双边市场在一段时间内两端用户数目的观察来识别DNEs以及CNEs。然而，基于这些研究，研究人员和从业者难以进一步评估 (1) CNEs是否稳健的，并且不对称；(2) 如果是这样，那么不对称CNEs的决定因素是什么。在目前的项目中，我们将使用一家服务即软件（即 SaaS）公司的数据。该公司的产品作为独立的在线求职和招聘平台在中国约120个主要不同城市实施，且经历了不同的增长曲线。这些特征帮助我们调查CNEs是否在不同城市存在和不同，以及这些CNEs如何由城市特定的社会计量条件确定。我们的项目将揭示支撑同一平台在不同背景下异质增长模式的关键因素。

15505123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505123.value: 酒店業居家辦公？酒店業員工的彈性工作安排與工作選擇決定

15505123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505123.value: The long-standing problem of labor shortage in hospitality has worsened since the COVID-19 pandemic. Many employees who lost their jobs during the pandemic have left the industry for good. Hospitality businesses face the pressing challenge of bringing people back into the workforce, and must compete with not only hotels but other industries for labor. COVID-19 is also a turning point that changed people’s perception of remote work. Due to social distancing regulations, “work from home” (WFH) arrangements have become the new normal in many workplaces. However, many labor-intensive, customer-facing service jobs cannot be performed from home—hospitality jobs included. With the increase in WFH options offered in other industries, hospitality businesses have an inherent disadvantage in recruiting and retaining employees. Nevertheless, among the range of job positions in hotels, back office and administrative tasks are more likely to be performed remotely. Moreover, there are different types of Flexible Work Arrangements (FWAs). If hotels cannot provide “flexplace” for certain jobs, how about “flextime” (e.g., compressed workweek, reduced hours, and flexible start/stop times)? Previous studies have examined the key factors in hospitality employees’ career decisions. Among various job attributes, FWAs have rarely been considered in hospitality, perhaps because “flexplace” seems impossible in hospitality jobs. Given the demand for remote work and increased awareness of mental wellness and work-life balance due to the pandemic, there is an urgent need to investigate how FWAs can be adopted in hotels and whether FWAs can trade off with other job attributes when employees evaluate alternative job offers. This study aims to explore the possibility of FWAs in hotels and whether FWAs can make hospitality jobs more desirable to employees. In-depth interviews will be conducted with HR managers and employees from different departments to understand their hotel’s current practice and future plans of adopting FWAs, in light of the range of hotel positions. After comparing the feasibility of various FWAs, a survey will be designed to investigate hotel employees’ work conditions and preferences for different FWAs, with a stated choice experiment to examine the comparative effectiveness of selected FWAs and other job attributes in influencing their job choice. At times of labor shortage, flexible working is difficult to implement. But without innovating current work practices, the labor crisis will only continue to deteriorate. This study will shed light on the importance of FWAs in hospitality job decisions and inform hotel management of ways to support flexible working. 自 COVID-19 疫情以來，酒店業長期存在的勞動力短缺問題變得更加嚴重。 許多在疫情大流行期間失業的員工已經永遠離開了酒店業。 酒店企業面臨著讓人們重返勞動力市場的緊迫挑戰，不僅必須與其他酒店競爭，還必須與其他行業競爭勞動力。 COVID-19 也是一個轉折點，改變了人們對遠程工作的看法。 由於保持社交距離的規定，“在家工作”（WFH）安排已成為許多工作場所的新常態。 然而，許多勞動密集型、面向客戶的服務性工作無法在家完成——包括酒店工作。 隨著其他行業增加提供在家辦公的選擇，酒店企業在招聘和留住員工方面存在固有的劣勢。 然而，在酒店的一系列工作職位中，後台和行政任務更有可能遠程執行。 此外，還有不同類型的彈性工作安排（FWA）。 如果酒店無法為某些工作提供“彈性工作地點”，那麼“彈性工作時間”（例如壓縮工作週、減少工作時間和靈活的起/停時間）如何？ 之前的研究已經探討了酒店業員工職業決策的關鍵因素。 在各種工作條件中，FWA 在酒店業中很少被考慮，也許是因為“彈性工作制”在酒店業工作中似乎是不可能的。 鑑於疫情對遠程工作的需求以及心理健康和工作與生活平衡意識的增強，迫切需要研究酒店如何採用 FWA，以及在員工評估工作邀請時 FWA 是否可以與其他工作條件進行權衡。 本研究旨在探討酒店中 FWA 的可能性，以及 FWA 是否可以使酒店工作對員工來說更有吸引力。 我們將與人力資源經理和不同部門的員工進行深入訪談，以了解酒店目前的做法以及根據酒店職位的範圍採用FWA的未來計劃。 在比較各種FWA的可行性後，將設計一項調查來調查酒店員工的工作條件和對不同FWA的偏好，並通過選擇實驗來檢驗所選FWA和其他工作條件如何有效影響其工作選擇。 在勞動力短缺的情況下，彈性工作制很難實施。 但如果不創新當前的工作方式，勞動力危機只會持續惡化。 這項研究將闡明 FWA 在員工選擇酒店工作決策中的重要性，並告知酒店管理層支持靈活工作的方法。

15505623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15505623.value: 考虑期望水平和内生成功率的投资组合优化

15505623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15505623.value: Portfolio optimization models consider how to allocate a limited amount of resources among different investments so that the resulting portfolio could achieve a desired balance between the expected return and risk. These models typically assume that the returns from the investments are exogeneous to the allocation of resources. In many practical applications such as strategic hiring, research fund allocation, and venture capital portfolio selection, whether an investment could be successful may depend on the amount of resources allocated to the investment. Motivated by these applications, this project considers investments with binary outcomes, i.e., investments that would either succeed or fail. For each investment, the success rate increases with the amount of resources allocated to the investment. Given a limited amount of resources, we would like to find an allocation decision so as to maximize the probability that the total number of successful investments is no less than an aspiration level. Towards this end, we plan to propose stochastic programming and distributionally robust optimization models for this decision-making problem. Structural properties of optimal solutions will be analyzed. Efficient solution algorithms will be developed. Managerial implications on the optimal allocation decision will be studied. Our preliminary study focuses on the case of independent investments with linear success rate, i.e., each investment is independent from others and has a success rate that linearly increases in the amount of allocated resources. A stochastic programming model is formulated to optimize the resource allocation decision. Our analysis reveals that the optimal resource allocation tends to be more concentrated in a smaller subset of the investments as the amount of available resources increases. We also identify certain monotonic results on how a sequence of binomial distributions converges to its Poisson limit, which enriches the Poisson limit theorem (the law of rare events). In this project, we plan to find more structural properties for the optimal solution, improve the efficiency of the solution algorithm, further validate the insights obtained so far, and hopefully get more managerial implications through comparative static analysis. Then we will generalize this model by relaxing the linear relationship between success rate and resource allocation. The extension with dependent investments will be studied as well. Furthermore, we will use the approach of distributionally robust optimization to examine the case where the joint distribution of the endogenous investment outcomes is only partially known. 投资组合优化模型考虑如何在不同的投资之间分配有限的资源，以使最终的投资组合在预期收益和风险之间达到理想的均衡。这些模型通常假设资源配置对于投资回报是外生的。在战略招聘、研究经费分配、风险投资组合选择等许多实际应用中，投资成功与否可取决于分配给投资的资源量。本项目基于这些实际应用，着眼于二元结果的投资，即或成功或失败的投资，研究每项投资的成功率随分配的资源量递增的情况。在资源有限的约束下，我们希望找到一种资源分配方案，以最大化成功投资总数不低于预期水平的概率。为此，我们计划就该决策问题提出随机规划和分布式鲁棒优化模型，分析最优解的结构特性，开发有效的求解算法，并研究最佳分配决策的管理启示。 我们的初步研究考虑了回报相互独立的投资。在每项投资的成功率随资源分配呈线性增长情况下，我们通过随机规划模型来优化资源分配决策。基于最优解的性质，我们观察到随着可用资源数量的增加，最佳资源配置往往更集中于较小的投资子集。我们还得到了二项分布序列如何收敛到其泊松极限的一些单调性结果，从而丰富了泊松极限定理（罕见事件定律）。 在本项目中，我们计划更深入地研究最优解的结构属性，提高求解算法的效率，进一步验证目前已得到的管理启示，并通过比较静态分析获取更多管理见解。 接下来我们将就此模型开展一系列的拓展性研究，放宽成功率和资源分配之间的线性关系，并考虑投资回报不独立的情况。同时，我们还将采用分布式鲁棒优化方法，处理内生投资结果的联合分布仅部分已知的情况。

15506123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506123.value: 分析师重视ESG创新吗？ -来自美国专利“抽奖”的证据

15506123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506123.value: Green innovation is widely believed to be the key to reduce carbon emissions and to fight climate change (e.g., Acemoglu et al., 2012; Aghion et al.,2016; Nordhaus, 2019; United Nations, 2022). However, how capital market participants may view and react to ESG innovation is still relatively underexplored in the finance literature. In this project, we aim to fill the gap by studying how equity analysts react to ESG innovation, and whether their coverage helps reduce information asymmetry and increase capital allocation to firms that produce more ESG innovation. Specifically, we will exploit the US patent “lottery” as an exogenous source of variation in green patent grants, as utilized by Sampat and Williams (2019) and Farre-Mensa et al. (2020), to deal with the identification issue and establish a causal relationship between green innovation and analyst reactions. We ask four research questions: (1) Are analysts more likely to cover firms with more green innovation? (2) Do analysts view ESG innovation as positive NPV projects, as proxied by higher recommendations, higher target prices, and higher long-term growth forecasts? (3) Do analysts value the environmental consequences of ESG innovation, as proxied by more qualitative discussion on ESG issues in their research reports? (4) Is analyst coverage associated with a more positive relationship between ESG investment and ESG innovation? Our study contributes to the literature in at least three ways. First, it expands our understanding on how capital market participants may view ESG innovation (e.g., Andriosopoulos et al., 2021, Hege et al., 2022), by examining the reactions of equity analysts, who are prominent information intermediaries in the financial market, and whose views may represent a broader group of investors. Second, it adds to the debate on whether equity analysts value corporate ESG engagement (e.g., Ioannou and Serafeim, 2015; Adhikari, 2016; Qian et al., 2019), by exploring their reactions to ESG innovation, a specific and crucial component of ESG. Lastly, we add to the broader literature that examines the determinants and driving forces of green innovation (e.g., Acemoglu et al., 2012; Aghion et al., 2016; Calel and Dechezleprêtre, 2016), by examining whether analyst coverage matters in terms of motivating capital allocation to firms with more ESG innovation, because in the long-run, innovators will flow to and innovation will cluster in areas where the return to innovation is the highest. 绿色创新被普遍认为是减少碳排放和应对气候变化的关键（例如，Acemoglu等，2012年；Aghion等，2016年；Nordhaus，2019年；联合国，2022年）。然而，资本市场参与者对于ESG创新的看法和反应在金融文献中仍未被深入探讨。 在本项目中，我们的目标是研究股票分析师对ESG创新的反应，以及他们的覆盖是否有助于减少信息不对称和增加对ESG创新公司的资本配置，从而填补文献中相关的空白。具体而言，我们将利用美国专利“抽奖”作为绿色专利授予的外生来源，以应对鉴定问题并建立起绿色创新和分析师反应之间的因果关系。这一方法曾被Sampat和Williams（2019年）以及Farre-Mensa等人（2020年）使用。我们提出了四个研究问题：（1）分析师是否更可能关注拥有更多ESG创新的公司？（2）分析师是否将ESG创新视为正净现值的项目，即表现为更高的推荐评级、更高的目标价格和更高的长期增长预测？（3）分析师是否重视ESG创新的环境影响，即表现为在研究报告中包含更多的关于ESG问题的定性讨论？（4）ESG投资和ESG创新之间的正相关关系是否在更多分析师覆盖的公司中更强？ 我们的研究在至少三个方面对文献做出了贡献。首先，通过检验股票分析师的反应，我们扩展了对资本市场参与者如何看待ESG创新的理解（例如，Andriosopoulos等，2021年；Hege等，2022年）。股票分析师在金融市场中是重要的信息中介，他们的观点可能代表更广泛的投资者群体。第二，通过探索分析师对ESG创新的反应，即ESG的一个特定且关键的组成部分，我们增加了有关股票分析师是否重视企业ESG表现的讨论（例如，Ioannou和Serafeim，2015年；Adhikari，2016年；Qian等，2019年）。最后，通过检验分析师的覆盖是否有助于将更多资本配置到拥有更多ESG创新的公司，我们进一步拓展了有关绿色创新的决定因素和推动力的文献（例如，Acemoglu等，2012年；Aghion等，2016年；Calel和Dechezleprêtre，2016年）。从长远来看，创新者将会涌向创新回报最高的领域，创新也将在此聚集。

15506323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506323.value: 中庸之美：意见领袖营销成本和内容创新

15506323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15506323.value: Dr Chen, Xinyuan Dr LEUNG, Fine Dr Li, Yiwei

15506323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506323.value: 意见领袖营销已成为一项巨大的业务，超过 90% 的品牌都加入其中。意见领袖在社交媒体上创建内容，以实现从建立品牌到增加销量的各种营销目标（Santora 2022）。尽管意见领袖营销很受欢迎，但其有效性在很大程度上取决于意见领袖在社交媒体上所获得的的参与度（Leung、Gu、Li、Zhang 和 Palmatier 2022）。有些帖子会吸引人们的参与，激发人们对所认可的产品的兴趣，而另一些则不会。那么，是什么让一些帖子比其他帖子更有吸引力呢？ 新兴的意见领袖营销文献表明，意见领袖创建的内容更具创造性，因为意见领袖较少受到组织僵化的限制，并且对其追随者有更多的了解（Leung、Gu 和 Palmatier 2022）。这种创造力的好处类似于企业从开放式创新计划中获得的集体智慧（Chan 等人，2020）。然而，与开放式创新计划不同的是，意见领袖是独立承包商，他们获得报酬为赞助商品牌创建内容。公司和意见领袖之间这种明显的代理关系产生了激励问题，即，对意见领袖的营销支出是否以及如何影响其内容创造力，从而进一步影响消费者的参与度。对于创造力的外在和内在动机，以及创造力在影响消费者参与方面的作用，社会心理学和创造力研究的观点不一。这项研究的动机是推进对于激励–创造力–消费者参与的研究。 基于一个月微博帖子的初始数据集，我们收集了有关意见领袖营销支出（即对意见领袖的金钱激励）和意见领袖生成的内容创造力的负面影响以及创造力对消费者的倒 U 形效应的初步证据。我们的目标是通过收集纵向数据集并进行现场实验来扩展我们的调查，以探索意见领袖营销支出的创造力影响的过程和边界条件。特别是，我们认为意见领袖营销支出对创造力的负面影响是由于意见领袖内容创作的内在动机减少和外在动机增强造成的。重要的是，当公司选择与追随者互动性更高和/或与品牌更契合的影响者时，消极性就会减弱。这两个调节因素（即意见领袖与追随者的互动性和意见领袖与品牌的契合度）反映了意见领袖通过其工作为追随者创造价值的内在动机，因此被认为可以减轻意见领袖营销支出的负面影响。拟议的研究为意见领袖营销的蓬勃发展领域提供了理论和管理意义。

15506423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15506423.value: 旅游直播中激发环保酒店决策的介入性研究

15506423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15506423.value: Prof Lu, Zhicong Dr Yu, Nancy Xiaonan

15506423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15506423.value: Since the end of the COVID-19 pandemic, travel has resumed satisfying the pent-up desire to meet, reconnect, escape daily pressures, and enjoy leisure opportunities in new destinations around the world. Driven by worsening climate change and the pandemic, societies and businesses are driving sustainability efforts in the tourism industry. For instance, hotels are seeking eco-labels and information service providers such as Google are also implementing a new algorithm to make finding eco-friendly hotels easier. However, as free-willing consumers and the primary contributors to both the positive and negative impacts of tourism, tourists need more guidance to implement eco-friendly changes in their travel-related decision-making. Currently, research on tourism and pro-environmental behavior focuses on identifying the characteristics of eco-tourists and designing products that cater to this market segment. However, the proportion of self-motivated eco-tourists is small compared with the total number of travelers. Moreover, the educational and compulsory approach to promote pro-environmental decisions is found to be ineffective with a high cost because people choose to pay less attention or even ignore if they are not interested in the information. As such, we need an innovative intervention approach to promoting eco-friendly decision-making and behaviors among all consumers. This study will address this call by attempting to inspire people through travel live streaming (TLS) to consider eco-friendly hotels in their travel decision-making process. The goal is to design travel live streaming as a source of inspiration to promote eco-friendly decision-making in hotel choices. Through an interdisciplinary collaboration of researchers in tourism sociology, computer-human interaction design, and positive psychology, three sub-studies are planned to select real TLS sessions that are more inspiring (Study 1), identify sources of inspiration (Study 2), and design interventions to change viewers’ decision criteria for hotel products (Study 3). Inspiration, a motivational state that compels individuals to bring ideas to fruition, has been connected with many positive psychological states such as positive affect, creativity, and perspiration, as well as the attitudinal and behavioral changes that accompany these psychological states. TLS has emerged as a social media practice that inspires people to travel. TLS provides a novel context in which to generate inspiration by focusing on destination sightseeing and immersing viewers through narratives and synchronized live broadcasting. Thus, considering the increasing number of TLS viewers, this project will help to shape TLS as an influential social setting to promote values and behaviors beneficial to the environment and society. 自新型冠狀病毒肺炎 (COVID-19) 大流行結束以來，旅行已經恢復，以滿足人們壓抑已久的願望, 例如見面、重新聯繫、逃避日常壓力以及在世界各地的新目的地享受休閒機會。 在日益惡化的氣候變化和新冠疫情的推動下，社會和企業正在推動旅遊業的可持續發展。 例如，酒店正在尋求生態標籤，而谷歌等信息服務提供商也在實施一種新算法，以便更容易地找到生態友好型酒店。 然而，作為自由意誌的消費者和旅遊業正面和負面影響的主要貢獻者，遊客需要更多的指導，以在其旅行相關決策中增加選擇生態友好型旅遊產品的幾率。目前，旅遊和環保行為的研究重點是識別生態遊客的特徵併設計適合該細分市場的產品。 但與遊客總數相比，生態友好型遊客所佔比例較小。 此外，以教育或者強制的方法促進環保決策效果甚微。因此，我們需要一種創新的幹預方法來促進所有消費者的環保決策和行為。 本研究將通過嘗試通過旅行直播 (TLS) 激勵人們在旅行決策過程中考慮環保酒店來解決這一問題。此研究的目標是將旅遊直播設計為靈感來源，以促進酒店選擇中的環保決策。 通過旅遊社會學、人機交互設計和積極心理學研究人員的跨學科合作，計劃進行三項子研究。 靈感是一種迫使個人將想法付諸實踐的動機狀態，它與許多積極的心理狀態以及伴隨這些心理狀態的態度和行為的變化有關。 旅遊直播 已成為一種激勵人們旅行的社交媒體應用。因此，考慮到旅遊直播觀眾數量的不斷增加，該項目將有助於塑造旅遊直播為一個有影響力的社會環境，以促進對環境和社會有益的價值觀和行為的產生與形成。

15507323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507323.value: 顯示多還是少？ 數字產品預覽調查

15507323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507323.value: Digital content products, such as e-books, music streaming, and online courses, have profoundly changed our lives. Like traditional markets, digital product sellers can run a product trial strategy to attract consumers to understand the product better and motivate them to purchase. Differently, digital product sellers do not offer the entire product for free, but rather a proportion of the product content – a preview that enables consumers to have a partial experience. The existing research on product samples and trials has verified their effects on product sales in traditional markets. Some recent studies on digital content platforms examined the impact of previews on consumers’ purchase decisions. However, they constructed previews as a binary behavioral factor, namely, whether consumers looked at the previews. There is a lack of research on the design of preview content. How much content should be included in the previews? The answer to this question is critical for facilitating digital products’ short-term and long-term revenues. In the short term, preview content may affect immediate purchases. In the long term, the impression from previews, together with consumers’ experience, may affect their rating generation, which will further affect product sales. Given these motivations, in this project, I attempt to examine how product preview length affects consumers’ consumption and rating behaviors on digital content platforms. I will conduct the project using the data from an e-book platform in China, where each bookseller can decide whether and how much content is provided for product previews. The preliminary empirical results suggest a trade-off between the proportion of previews provided and consumers’ interest in viewing the remaining content. Moreover, based on the expectation disconfirmation theory, more previews can help consumers form accurate expectations so that their expectations are more likely to be positively disconfirmed after the experience, followed by higher satisfaction and more positive rating evaluation. But the extent of positive disconfirmation may drop with the increase of preview length. In the next plan, more analyses will be developed to explore other characteristics of product previews and the mechanisms of preview influences. This project contributes to the literature by examining the content design of product previews on digital content platforms. I focus on the length of previews and investigate its impacts on two business outcomes. The findings will shed new light on the preview strategy of digital products and provide guidance for digital content platforms and sellers to encourage more consumption and positive rating generation. 數字內容產品，例如電子書、音樂流媒體和線上課程，深刻地改變了我們的生活。與傳統市場相似，數字產品銷售商可以運用產品試用策略來吸引消費者更好地了解產品並激勵他們購買。不同的是，數字產品銷售商不會完全免費提供整個產品，而是提供部分產品內容作為預覽，讓消費者有部分體驗。 現有關於產品樣本和試用的研究已經驗證了它們對傳統市場產品銷售的影響。最近一些關於數字內容平台的研究探討了預覽對消費者購買決策的影響。然而，它們將預覽構建為一個二元行為因素，即消費者是否查看預覽。在預覽內容設計方面缺乏研究。預覽應該包含多少內容？這個問題的答案對於促進數字產品的短期和長期收益至關重要。在短期內，預覽內容可能會影響即時購買。在長期內，預覽的印象以及消費者的體驗可能會影響他們的評價生成，進而影響產品銷售。鑒於這些動機，在本项目中，我嘗試研究產品預覽長度如何影響數字內容平台上消費者的消費和評價行為。 我將使用中國的一家電子書平台的數據進行研究。在該平台上，每個書商都可以決定是否以及提供多少內容作為產品預覽。初步的實證結果表明，提供的預覽比例與消費者對剩餘內容的興趣之間存在權衡。此外，基於期望不符理論，更多的預覽可以幫助消費者形成準確的期望，使得他們的期望更有可能在體驗後獲得積極的肯定，從而獲得更高的滿意度和更正面的評估。但是，積極的确认程度可能會隨著預覽長度的增加而下降。在接下來的計劃中，將開展更多分析以深入探索產品預覽的其他特徵和預覽影響的機制。 总体来说，本项目通過研究數字內容平台上產品預覽的內容設計為文獻做出了貢獻。我著重研究預覽長度並調查其對兩個商業結果的影響。研究結果將為數字產品的預覽策略提供新的視角，並為數字內容平台和賣家提供关于鼓勵更多消費和積極評價生成的指導。

15507423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15507423.value: 数据驱动的非平稳需求多产品库存系统的算法

15507423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15507423.value: The class of multi-product inventory systems under a warehouse-capacity constraint is one of the most basic inventory models that captures a common complication practitioners face in practice. Most of the existing literature studying this class of systems assume that demand distributions are known a priori. However, such distributional information is hardly known in reality. Followed by the challenge of unknown demand distribution, it’s also widely observed in many real-world business settings that the products’ demands can be non-stationary and the demand distributions can change over time. Since it's typically unknown when the changes would occur and what the distribution will be like before and after the change, effectively managing multi-product inventory systems in today’s rapidly changing business environment becomes a more challenging task. In response to the aforementioned challenges, this project proposes to study a data-driven multi-product inventory system with censored demand in a non-stationary demand environment. Borrowing the notions from the existing literature, we measure the amount of changes in demand distributions through the Wasserstein-distance-based temporal variation. Building on our preliminary results on the setting of perishable products, we propose to construct effective online learning algorithms for the setting with non-perishable products under both smoothly-changing demand environment and drastically-changing demand environment. If successful, our research output will not only contribute to the literature on data-driven inventory models, but also help practitioners more effectively manage multi-product inventory systems in the rapidly changing business environment. 仓储容量约束下的多产品库存系统是最基本的库存模型之一，捕捉了实践中从业者面临的常见复杂情况。大部分现有文献研究此类系统时假设需求分布是事先已知的。然而，这些分布信息在现实中很难获取。除了未知需求分布的挑战之外，在许多实际业务环境中还广泛观察到产品需求的非平稳性。由于通常无法预知何时发生变化以及变化前后的分布情况，在当今快速变化的商业环境中有效地管理多品种库存系统变得更具挑战性。为了应对上述挑战，本项目提出非平稳需求环境下研究基于数据驱动的多品种库存系统。借鉴现有文献的概念，我们基于Wasserstein距离来衡量需求分布的变化量。在关于易腐产品的初步结果基础上，我们提出对非易腐产品，在平滑变化需求环境和急剧变化需求环境下，构建有效的在线学习算法。如果成功，我们的研究成果将不仅有助于数据驱动的库存模型的文献研究，也将帮助从业者更有效地管理多产品库存系统。

15508123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508123.value: 雇主品牌對工作嵌入和加入酒店業意願的影響：這對亞太地區的酒店員工和求職者應對人力資源挑戰有何作用？

15508123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15508123.value: Prof Buhalis, Dimitrios Dr Pang, Justin Matthew Dr Thomas, Nicholas

15508123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508123.value: The hotel industry is confronted with the challenges of labour shortage due to potential employees’ reluctance to join the sector because of its negative reputation of low pay, long hours and working in shifts and on weekends and holidays, and the increase in competition from other sectors to attract and retain new talents. Employer branding is one of the most important tasks to address the human resources challenges facing the hotel industry. Being able to market the employer brand to potential employees in the labour market and to retain their current employees are key talent management tasks. Although the concept of employer branding is not new, COVID-19 has changed the way business operates and how individuals are prioritizing their choices including work and personal lives. It is timely to conduct the proposed study to provide insights for hotels to address the current labour crisis. The Asia Pacific hotel market is selected for this study as the hotel industry shows signs of recovery from the COVID-19 pandemic with the lifting of travel restrictions. The number of new and pipeline hotels in the region has grown exponentially which demonstrates an increase in the supply of hotel rooms and the demand for labour to fill job openings. This study will investigate the employer branding process and brand value propositions being communicated by hotels and determine if they are aligned with the expectations of potential and current hotel employees. Furthermore, this study will investigate how potential and current hotel employees, at front line, supervisory, and managerial levels, perceive preferred employer brand attributes and how they contribute overall benefits and values attained. Finally, this study aims to identify the impact of employer value propositions on potential employees’ intention to apply for a job in the hotel industry and current employees’ job embeddedness. Results of the study will allow hotels to explore why employees demand for certain employer attributes. Further, the current study aims to provide insights for hotel practitioners in enhancing their employer brand and to design appropriate employer value propositions through strategically enhanced job design, compensation and benefit packages, advertising and communication, and other talent management practices to appeal to potential and current employees of different generations within the Asia Pacific region. To date, few researchers have investigated multi-generational perspectives of current and potential employees within the hotel industry. 由於酒店業薪酬低、工作時間長、週末節假日輪班工作等負面聲譽，加之其他行業在吸引和留住新人才方面的競爭加劇，造成潛在酒店員工不願加入該行業，從而引發酒店業面臨勞動力短缺的挑戰。要應對酒店業面臨的人力資源挑戰，雇主品牌建設是最重要的任務之一。如何在勞動力市場上向潛在員工推銷雇主品牌，並留住現有員工，是人才管理的關鍵任務。 雖然雇主品牌的概念並不新鮮，但 COVID-19 已經改變了企業的運作方式，以及個人對工作和生活的選擇優先級。開展本研究為酒店應對當前的勞動力危機提供見解是非常及時的。本研究選擇了亞太地區的酒店市場，因為隨著旅行限制的取消，酒店業出現了從 COVID-19 大流行病中復甦的跡象。該地區新建和籌備中的酒店數量成倍增長，這表明酒店客房供應和填補職位空缺的勞動力需求都在增加。 本研究將探究雇主品牌塑造過程和酒店傳達的品牌價值主張，並確定它們是否符合潛在和現有酒店員工的期望。此外，本研究還將調查酒店一線、主管和管理級別的潛在和在職員工如何看待首選雇主品牌屬性，以及這些屬性如何促進整體利益和價值的實現。最後，本研究旨在識別雇主價值主張對潛在員工申請酒店業工作的意向和在職員工工作嵌入度的影響。 研究結果將有助於酒店探索員工需要雇主具備某些特質的原因。此外，本研究還旨在為酒店從業人員提供見解，幫助他們提升雇主品牌，並通過戰略性地改進工作設計、薪酬和福利待遇、廣告和溝通以及其他人才管理實踐，設計適當的雇主價值主張，以吸引亞太地區不同代際的潛在和現有員工。迄今為止，很少有研究人員對酒店業現有和潛在員工的多代觀點進行調查。

15508423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508423.value: 酒店环境中的正念：特质、状态和干预

15508423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508423.value: 雇主们认识到采取行动帮助员工应对压力增大所带来的负面影响，从而保持其身心健康的重要性。COVID-19（新冠）大流行病及其应对措施凸显了采取这种行动的必要性，它极大地扰乱了职场，导致全球数百万人承受了更大的工作压力，甚至失去了工作。 正念是一种个人可以用来改善包括职场中身心健康的有效工具。然而，尽管在工作中练习正念的好处众所周知，但正念仍未被许多行业（如酒店业）的员工所采用。 在拟议项目中，我们将通过开展三项研究来探索工作场所中正念的不同方面。在研究 1 中，我们将把正念作为一种个人特质来研究；在研究 2 中，我们将把正念作为一种状态来研究，这种状态是由领导力塑造的，并会影响随之而来的行为；在研究 3 中，我们将把正念作为一种培训干预措施来研究，以提高员工的幸福感。这种多重研究方法将使我们能够全面了解正念在酒店业中的应用和优势。这将为酒店业雇主和员工提供大量的指导，以帮助他们了解如何在工作场所实施正念实践，从而提高服务水平并克服因员工倦怠而导致的服务失误。因此，拟议项目将通过明确的途径对社会产生积极影响。此外，由于拟议项目将描述正念培训、组织成果和员工福祉之间的关系，它也将为酒店业的著述发展做出独特的理论贡献。 重要的是，我们将通过三个模型来研究正念的不同方面，这一独特的方法将使我们能够确定领导者的谦逊如何影响员工的正念状态，确定如何将正念特质纳入正念培训干预中，并探索酒店业正念的三个方面。每个模型将仅用于研究下列三个领域中的一个领域。因此，拟议的项目将揭示正念如何影响角色内和角色外的工作绩效，并设计出可以实施的正念策略，以改善酒店业员工的福祉。

15508523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15508523.value: 多团队系统如何应对变化：一个来自核电站的现场研究

15508523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15508523.value: “別人聽到的往往與我們想要表達的經常不一樣。例如，我想讓控制室的操作員增加一點閥門的供水量，但他不知道究竟多少算“一點”。當大修來臨時，一切都會變得更加混亂。” “我們的日常工作就像開車一樣，需要協調很多事情才能保證安全、愉快的駕駛。而到了大修的時候，我們不僅僅是在開車，而且是一邊開、一邊在修理它！” ——來自核電站技術人員的訪談 多團隊系統(MTS) 被定義為一組緊密協作的團隊，以實現共同的高級目標（Mathieu等，2001 ），通常用於解決複雜且高度不穩定的狀況，例如醫療緊急情況（ Luciano 等，2021 ）、網絡安全（Tetrick等，2016）和軍事任務（Davison等，2012 ）。 MTS 由具有不同特點的（例如專業知識、規範和地點）的團隊組成，可以完成任何單一團隊都無法實現的目標；也正因為如此，MTS 的一個關鍵挑戰是如何實現團隊之間的有效協調（Luciano等，2018）。開頭第一個來自一位在核電廠工作員工的引言，就反映了這樣的挑戰。因此，學者們試圖了解哪些因素有利於或不利於 MTS 的協調（例如， DeChurch & Marks，2006；Porck等，2019）。 然而，無論從理論或是實證研究的角度來看，我們對 MTS 協調的理解仍然相當靜態。理論上說，雖然動態環境是MTS的關鍵情境，但很少有研究來看MTS是如何應對系統的變化或發展的。實證上看，大多數MTS的研究都是在實驗室模擬新形成的MTS，反复參與類似的環境，或者在短時間內在現場觀察MTS。儘管這些研究提供了重要的見解，但我們仍然對 MTS 如何適應不斷變化的環境知之甚少。從開頭兩段引言可以看出，核電站的檢修與日常運行存在較大偏差。 MTS 如何適應這種破壞以及哪些 MTS 可以更有效地進行調整的呢？ 這項研究的主要目的是計劃通過在不斷變化的環境中觀察 MTS 來推進 MTS 文獻的發展。我們將 Zaccaro、Marks 和 DeChurch（2012）的 MTS 屬性框架與團隊適應理論（Burke等，2006；Summers等，2012）相結合，探討 MTS 如何適應變化，以及在什麼條件下MTS 可以做出有效的適應。我們認為，當外部變化發生時，MTS 將經歷中斷和恢復階段，並且哪些(1) 具有高度的內部功能多樣性，(2) 與新添加的組成團隊有更多先前的工作聯繫，以及 (3 ）成熟度高的MTS不太可能經歷協調性喪失，並且更有可能快速恢復。最後，整合團隊的邊界管理行為起著調節作用。 我們已經獲得了一座擁有 9 座反應堆的核電站的收集數據許可，該核電站由 54 個MTS（擁有 1000 多名員工）來管理。我們準備（1）利用問卷調查和檔案數據進行定量研究，以及（2）進行定性研究來捕捉豐富的情境。這項研究將對現有的 MTS 研究做出重大貢獻。它也將對高可靠性組織產生顯著的實際影響。

15509023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15509023.value: 有误差的环保认证和价格信号对绿色产品策略的影响

15509023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509023.value: In recent years, the world has witnessed and suffered from many environmental issues, which receive increasing attention from various stakeholders. To reduce the negative impacts on the environment, many firms are advocating the design and adoption of green technology/products. More and more consumers who have serious environmental concerns are willing to reward firms for their sustainable efforts in producing products. However, a firm’s green practices usually cannot be observed by consumers, and the environmental quality of a product is often a credence attribute that cannot be readily experienced by consumers. In order to convey information about costly green product development, firms usually can charge high prices and/or apply for environmental certifications offered by third-party agencies (e.g., NGOs or governments). Certifications, although undoubtedly useful, may not perfectly reveal information to consumers due to the possible errors. When facing asymmetric information and a noisy certification, will the firm have the incentive to engage in green product development? Is applying the noisy certification beneficial? Should the firm use price to signal its product information? Those are critical questions faced by many firms. On the other hand, the certification agencies face the following questions: Will offering a certification that contains errors benefit the environment or social welfare? Should the certification be made voluntary or mandatory? How should the certification cost be charged to induce higher environmental or social benefits? What is the value of reducing errors in the certifying process? To answer the above questions, we will develop a game-theoretical model, in which a firm sells a product with private environmental quality and can choose whether to apply for a noisy certification. Based on the certification outcome, the firm then decides the price, which may further signal its environmental quality to consumers. We will consider three scenarios: (1) the certification is not offered (the benchmark case); (2) the certification is voluntary; (3) the certification is mandatory. We will study the firm’s optimal strategies in each scenario and examine how the certification cost and accuracy level will affect its strategies and profit. We will also explore the impacts of noisy certification and different certification schemes (voluntary or mandatory) on consumer surplus, environment, and social welfare. Finally, we will study some possible model extensions to verify the robustness of our main results and derive additional interesting managerial insights. 近年来，全球目睹并遭受了许多环境问题的困扰，这些问题受到了各种利益相关者越来越多的关注。为了减少对环境的负面影响，许多公司正在倡导采用绿色技术和生成绿色产品。越来越多的环保意识强烈的消费者愿意通过消费行为，来奖励那些在产品生产中努力实现可持续发展的公司。然而，公司的绿色实践通常无法被消费者观察到，产品的环境质量往往是一种信誉属性，消费者无法直接感知。为了传递关于高成本绿色产品开发的信息，公司通常会提高产品价格或申请由第三方机构（例如非政府组织或政府）提供的环保认证。尽管认证无疑是有用的，但由于可能存在的错误，它无法完全准确地向消费者揭示信息。在面对信息不对称和认证误差的情况下，企业是否还有动力投身于绿色产品的研发？申请有误差的认证是否对公司有益？企业是否应该通过价格信号来传达其产品的环保信息？这些都是许多企业面临的关键问题。另一方面，认证机构面临着以下问题：提供可能含有误差的认证是否能为环境或社会福利带来好处？认证应是自愿的还是强制的？应如何收取认证费用以激励更高的环境或社会效益？减少认证过程中的误差有多少价值？为了回答上述问题，我们将构建一个博弈论模型。在模型中，我们考虑一家公司销售一款产品，该产品的环保信息是公司的私有信息。该公司可以选择是否申请有误差的环保认证。基于认证结果，该公司决定产品价格，该价格也可能进一步向消费者传达产品的环境信息。 我们将考虑三种情况：（1）没有环保认证（基准案例）；（2）环保认证是自愿的；（3）环保认证是强制的。我们将研究每种情况下公司的最佳策略，并探究不同认证费用和认证准确性对公司策略和利润的影响。我们还将探究不同认证方案（自愿或强制）对消费者剩余、环境和社会福利的影响。最后，我们将研究一些可能的扩展模型，以验证主要结果的稳健性并得出一些额外的有管理学价值的结果。

15509823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15509823.value: Pollution creates grave and irreparable damage to human society. In response, many countries impose environmental policies. Nevertheless, these policies may bring costs to economies. As a result, transition finance emerges to meet firms’ financial obligations. For example, the London Stock Exchange Group launches a transition bond segment on its sustainable bond market. A transition bond is a debt instrument that funds polluting industries’ transition. Standard & Poor’s Global believes transition finance could contribute up to US$1 trillion annually, roughly 5% of the GDP in the United States. Yet, we know little about how firms adjust their leverage to the regulatory risk created by environmental policies such as carbon taxes (Diaz-Rainey et al., 2017; Stroebel and Wurgler, 2021). Environmental policies may incur abatement costs. Firms may leverage to finance the heightened costs. On the contrary, environmental policies increase operating risks (Geng et al., 2021). As a result, loaners may charge heavy-polluting firms higher interest rates (Chava, 2014; De Greiff et al., 2018; Herbohn et al., 2019; Fard et al., 2020; Huang et al., 2021). Firms may deleverage in response to interest rate rises. It is theoretically unclear how firms adjust their leverages to environmental policies. This project aims to provide an in-depth study of leverage adjustments to environmental policies. For example, what is the mechanism of the leverage adjustment? Does the adjustment depend on the debt maturity structure? Is the adjustment concentrated on firms with specific characteristics? These questions are important because they address the public concern about the financial instability created by environmental policies (Huang et al., 2021; Stroebel and Wurgler, 2021). They also enhance our understanding of the trade-off theory of capital structure by answering how firms adjust the optimal leverage ratio to environmental policies (Miller, 1977; Myers, 1984). However, it is empirically challenging to establish a causal relationship between environmental policies and corporate capital structure. The reasons are that the corporate exposure to emissions and financing choices could be jointly determined and they are likely correlated to other unobserved firm characteristics, both of which raise an endogeneity concern potentially resulting in biased estimates. To establish the causal relationship, this project exploits a unique opportunity provided by the introduction of a carbon tax policy in British Columbia (BC). Combining matching with a difference-in-difference approach, BC’s carbon tax allows us to uncover the causal effect of an environmental policy on the corporate capital structure. 污染給人類社會造成嚴重且難以彌補的損害。因此，許多國家實施了環境政策。然而，這些政策可能會給經濟帶來成本。因此，市場出現了轉型融資。這融資是為了履行企業的財務義務。例如，倫敦證券交易所集團在其可持續債券市場上推出了過渡債券部分。轉型債券是一種為污染行業轉型提供資金的債務工具。標準普爾全球公司認為，轉型融資每年可貢獻高達1萬億美元，約占美國GDP的5%。 然而，我們對企業如何調整槓桿以應對碳稅等環境政策帶來的監管風險知之甚少。環境政策可能會產生減排成本。企業可以利用槓桿來為增加的成本融資。相反，環境政策增加了經營風險。因此，貸款人可能會向重污染企業收取更高的利率。企業可能會因利率上升而去槓桿化。理論上尚不清楚企業如何調整其槓桿以適應環境政策。 此項目的目標是對環境政策的槓桿調整進行深入研究。比如槓桿調整的機制是什麼？調整是否取決於債務期限結構？調整是否集中針對有特點的企業？這些問題很重要，因為它們解決了公眾對環境政策造成的金融不穩定的擔憂。他們還通過回答企業如何根據環境政策調整最優槓桿率來增強我們對資本結構權衡理論的理解。

15510023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510023.value: 信息披露監管對專利市場的外部性影響：來自美國證券交易委員會关于重大合同刪減的新規則的證據

15510023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510023.value: 關於信息披露監管的文獻主要關注對披露公司自身的影響。 現有文獻中缺乏關於對整個市場的影響以及對披露公司之外的各方的外部性影響的證據，但這些證據對於證明信息披露監管的經濟合理性至關重要 (Leuz and Wysocki (2016))。 本研究旨在通過研究美國證券交易委員會關於重大合同刪減的新規則對專利市場的影響來填補這一空白。 上市公司必須提交重大合同作為定期報告和某些其他披露文件的附件，但他們可以選擇編輯某些商業敏感但非重要的信息。 直到最近，上市公司還必須提交一份保密處理請求，在其中詳細說明請求保密的依據。 2019 年 4 月，美國證券交易委員會在大多數情況下取消了這一要求，這將使公司更容易編輯重大合同中的信息。 我們預計新的重大合同刪減規則將對專利市場產生負面的外部效應。 作為經常被編輯的重要合同類型，專利銷售/許可協議包含的信息可能被專利交易中的買方和賣方用來評估目標專利的商業價值。 如果新規則下專利協議中的更多信息被刪減而無法提供給交易雙方，則專利市場的信息摩擦可能會加劇，導致專利交易的可能性下降。 我們計劃從 EDGAR數據庫獲取重大合同備案數據，從美國專利商標局的專利轉讓數據集中獲取專利交易數據。 我們將首先驗證以下猜想：根據新規則，企業更有可能編輯專利協議中的信息。 接下來，為了檢查對專利市場的外部性效應，我們將進行雙重差分測試，其中處理組（對照組）包括部分專利技術類別，這些類別中的大部分（小部分）專利所有者在新規則下增加了對其專利協議的刪減。 我們預計會發現，在採用新的重大合同刪減規則後，處理組中的專利銷售/許可交易數量相對於對照組顯著減少。 這項研究做出了兩個主要貢獻。 首先，它通過記錄美國證券交易委員會新的重大合同刪減規則對專利市場的負面外部影響，豐富了有關信息披露監管的經濟後果的文獻。 這種外部性的存在凸顯了在評估披露監管時考慮披露公司之外的收益和成本的重要性。 其次，這項研究揭示了會計文獻中很少研究的一項重要的公司活動——知識產權交易。

15510523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15510523.value: 政府补贴高于或低于营业收入对投资者重要吗？ 中国会计准则第16号的证据

15510523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15510523.value: Mr Qiu, Weite Prof Xie, Yuan

15510523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15510523.value: Government subsidy refers to the monetary or non-monetary assets obtained freely by a firm from the government. Government subsidies are usually provided for firms to conduct research and development (R&D) activities, maintain export competitiveness, and improve production efficiency. It is an economic tool to facilitate economic development, achieve policy goals, and mitigate market imperfection (Schwartz and Clements, 1999). Existing studies suggest that government subsidy becomes increasingly important in the major economies around the world and often contributes several percentages of GDP (Buigues and Sekkat, 2011). For example, in China, the government provided over 211 billion RMB in subsidies to public firms in 2020. In US, according to statistics from Good Jobs First, over 100 billion US dollars in subsidies are awarded to public companies every year. Despite the importance of government subsidies for both economic development and firm performance, there is no uniform rule or standard on how firms should disclose subsidy information in financial statements around the world. As the second largest economy in the world, China maintains mandatory financial reporting of subsidy information after the economic reform in the early 1990s. The unique institutional settings in China offer us a proper setting to explore how financial reporting rules of government subsidies affect investors’ valuation decisions as well as firms’ reporting behaviors. More particular, in 2017, the Ministry of Finance of China issued the newly revised Chinese Accounting Standards No.16: Government Subsidy (CAS No.16). The updated standard allows firms to recognize subsidies related to day-to-day activities as the operating income in the income statement. Before this regulatory change, subsidies were only allowed to be reported below the operating income as part of non-operating income. In the proposed research, we plan to examine how the change in the position of subsidies in the income statement, as a result of the issuance of CAS No.16, affects investor perception of firm value and firms’ financial reporting behavior in the post-regulation period. We plan to examine 1) the effect of regulatory changes on subsidy informativeness in the capital market, and 2) whether firms exploit the updated standard to manipulate the reported operating income. The findings of this research have the potential to enable us to better understand the economic consequences of the updated CAS No.16. More importantly, we aim to provide regulatory implications to both China and foreign regulators about the financial reporting of subsidies. 政府补贴是各国政府用来促进全球经济增长的主要政策工具。然而，企业如何披露补贴信息及其经济后果的研究相对较少。在这个项目中，我们利用中国2017年政府补贴披露相关的监管变化来测试上述问题。2007-2016年期间，中国上市公司被要求在损益表中报告非营业收入补贴，无论其经济实质如何。2017年，中国财政部发布了新修订的《中国会计准则第16号：政府补贴》（CAS第16号）。更新后的标准允许公司将补贴项目作为营业收入的一部分报告，如果管理人员认为这些项目与日常活动密切相关。投资者对这一监管变化的反应尚不清楚。一方面，如果报告高于营业收入的补贴能够很好地反映企业的经济实质，正如新标准所要实现的那样，那么随着标准的变化，补贴信息应该更具信息性和价值相关性。另一方面，如果企业利用监管，投机取巧地将补贴从营业外收入转向营业收入，那么补贴信息的信息性就会受到影响。随着政府补贴在经济发展中变得越来越重要，这项研究的潜在结果可以为补贴的财务报告提供重要的监管和市场影响的政策建议。

15511123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511123.value: 考虑顾客饱和效应的最优动态定价策略研究

15511123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511123.value: For many consumption goods, each consumption creates a stock in memory that diminishes over time, and the utility of current consumption represents an incremental utility from the past level rather than evaluated afresh each time. This is called consumer satiation effects. Given that consumer satiation affects the utility of new consumption, consumers' willingness to pay may vary with their satiation level. Therefore, it is important for firms to consider consumer satiation effects when making pricing decisions, because neglecting the impact of satiation may lead to considerable revenue loss. This gives rise to several questions: What is the optimal dynamic pricing strategy for a firm that takes into account consumer satiation effects? What does the consumer’s optimal consumption path look like? Can we quantify the revenue loss if a firm neglects consumer satiation effects? However, to our best knowledge, no literature has examined these questions. The proposed project will fill this gap. In this project, we will build an analytical model to examine the impact of consumer satiation on a monopolistic firm’s dynamic pricing strategy as well as consumers’ optimal consumption path. We assume that the firm sells consumption goods to a group of homogeneous consumers in an infinite horizon and that time is continuous. Each consumer makes repeated consumption decisions with the objective of maximizing her total discounted utility. To model the satiation effects, we build a utility model following Baucells and Sarin (2007), in which each consumption creates a satiation level that decays over time, and the next consumption generates an incremental utility over the satiation level which evolves exponentially. The monopolistic firm maximizes its total discounted revenue via dynamic pricing decisions, taking into account the consumer satiation effects. We will first use Hamilton-Jacob-Bellman equations to analyze the consumer’s decision problem for any given pricing sequence. Then, based on the consumer’s decision rule, we will analyze the seller’s problem. Our preliminary analysis shows that the seller’s optimal decision switches between ``selling” and ``pricing out” at certain satiation levels. We will calculate these satiation levels, fully characterize the firm’s optimal pricing strategy, and connect our findings with the practice. Finally, we will quantify the revenue loss if the firm neglects consumer satiation effects. Our findings will help managers design the optimal dynamic pricing strategy, especially for consumption goods that exhibit significant consumer satiation effects, and alert firms to the potential revenue loss if they neglect such effects. 对许多消费品而言，每次消费都会记录在顾客的脑海里，形成一定的饱和水平，并逐渐消退。顾客当前每次消费所带来的效用是以脑海里残存的记忆（饱和水平）为基础进行计算，而不是将脑海里记忆清零后重新计算。这种效应被称为顾客的饱和效应。因为饱和效应会影响每次消费所带来的效用，所以顾客的支付意愿也会随着饱和水平的高低而变化。因此，当卖家在制定定价策略的时候，需要考虑到顾客饱和效应所带来的影响，忽视这种效应可能会给卖家造成不小的损失。这就自然而然的产生几个问题：在考虑顾客饱和效应的情况下，卖家最优的动态定价策略是什么？由于饱和效应，顾客也会调整自己的消费策略，那么顾客最优的消费策略是什么？如果卖家忽略饱和效应，那么造成的损失是多少？据我们所知，截至目前，并没有文献研究以上这些问题。我们这份提案将弥补这部分空白。 在这份提案里，我们将会分析顾客的饱和效应如何影响垄断零售商的定价策略以及顾客的消费策略。我们假设一个无限期、连续时间的模型，垄断零售商向一类同质顾客销售某种消费品。顾客需要反复消费这种消费品，因此需要决定自己的消费策略。顾客的目标是最大化自己的贴现效用。为了考虑饱和效应的影响，我们采用Baucells and Sarin (2007)这篇文献里的效用模型。该效用模型假设顾客的每次消费都会形成一定的饱和水平，而这会影响顾客下一次消费的效用。顾客的饱和水平以指数方式演化。在考虑顾客的饱和效用的基础上，垄断零售商通过调整产品价格来最大化自己的贴现收益。 首先，我们将使用Hamilton-Jacob-Bellman方程来分析顾客的最优消费决策。然后，在顾客最优策略的基础上，我们再分析垄断零售商的定价决策。我们已经做了一些初步的分析，显示零售商的最优定价决策只有卖与不卖，且这两种决策在特定的饱和水平上发生切换。我们将会计算这些特定的饱和水平，刻画出零售商的最优定价策略，并且将我们的发现与现实进行对接。最后，我们将估算，如果忽略顾客的饱和效应，零售商将会承担多少损失。对于那些顾客饱和效应比较明显的消费品，我们的研究将会有助于管理者设计最优的定价策略，并且警示这些管理者忽略这种效应将会造成多大的损失。

15511523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511523.value: 股東代理參與對董事的事業有影響嗎？

15511523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511523.value: Proxy access is a governance mechanism that allows eligible shareholders to nominate director candidates without having to launch a proxy contest. Given that director nominees typically run unopposed in uncontested elections (e.g., Cai, Garner, and Walkling, 2009), proxy access can introduce a competitive threat to the proxy process and strengthen the career incentives of the board of directors. Until recently, the provision of proxy access had been rare. A rule amendment by the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) came into effect in 2011, requiring shareholder proposals seeking proxy access to be included in companies’ proxy materials. With this regulatory change and the surge of shareholder proposals that followed, proxy access has gradually become a widely-adopted governance practice. By the end of 2019, 76% of S&P 500 companies have amended bylaws to adopt proxy access, compared to less than 1% in 2014. When a proxy access provision is in place, shareholders can use it as leverage to engage with companies about refreshing the board, even if shareholders do not formally nominate new directors through proxy access. Prior literature on proxy access focuses on its value implications by studying stock market reactions to regulatory events related to proxy access rules (e.g., Cohn, Gillan, and Hartzell, 2016) or shareholder proposals for proxy access (e.g., Bhandari, Iliev, and Kalodimos, 2021). Despite its potential disciplinary effects on boards, there is a dearth of direct empirical evidence on the career consequences of proxy access for directors. Proxy access induces directors to be more responsive to shareholder demands only when it can impose career costs on directors. The widespread adoption of proxy access and the increased attention of researchers and policymakers that it has drawn call for an examination of whether proxy access has any impact on directors’ careers. In this project, I aim to shed light on this important issue. The findings of the proposed project will contribute to the academic literature by demonstrating the effectiveness of proxy access in disciplining directors. Meanwhile, the findings will provide valuable guidance to policymakers regarding regulations on shareholder empowerment. 代理參與是一項公司治理機制，允許符合資格的股東提名董事候選人，而無須發起代理權爭奪。 由於董事選舉通常缺乏競爭性（e.g., Cai, Garner, and Walkling, 2009），代理參與可以通過引入競爭威脅從而強化董事會成員的事業激勵。 直到近年，代理參與並不常見。 2011年，美國證券交易委員會（SEC）的一項法規修正條款生效，規定請求代理參與的股東提案必須納入公司的代理材料。 隨著這項法規的變更以及此後股東提案的大量湧現，代理參與逐漸成為被廣泛實施的治理機制。 2019年底，標普500指數里已有76%的公司通過修改章程採用了代理參與，而這個比例在2014年僅為不到1%。 即使股東並不正式提名新董事，他們仍然可以利用代理參與權作為籌碼，針對替換董事會成員的事宜，對公司進行干預。 現有文獻主要通過分析股票市場對代理參與相關的法規事件（e.g., Cohn, Gillan, and Hartzell, 2016）或者股東提案（e.g., Bhandari, Iliev, and Kalodimos, 2021）的反應，來研究代理參與權的價值影響。 儘管代理參與對董事會有潛在的約束效應，已有研究並未提供直接的實證證據，證明股東代理參與是否對董事的事業產生影響。 只有在股東代理參與權能夠影響董事事業的前提下，這項制度才可能促使董事更積極地滿足股東需求。 股東代理參與的廣泛實施以及它引起的學者與政策制定者的高度關注，使得“代理參與是否對董事的事業有影響”成為一個迫切需要解決的課題。 在這個項目中，我致力於研究這個重要的話題。 這個項目將通過實證研究，闡述股東代理參與作為一種約束董事的治理機制的有效性，對學術文獻做出貢獻。 同時，此項目的研究成果將對股東權利相關的政策制定者提供寶貴的參考依據。

15511723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15511723.value: 企業氣候遊說和碳足跡

15511723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15511723.value: Prof Chang, Xin Dr Fu, Kangkang

15511723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15511723.value: Large companies in carbon-intensive industries are responsible for major greenhouse gas emissions in the world. Meanwhile, these companies spend a sheer amount of money on lobbying on climate-related policies, especially those countries that lack ambitious climate change policies. Lobbying reports from 2000 to 2020 show that firms’ lobbying spending on climate-related issues in the U.S. Congress was as high as $12.36 billion, accounting for 17.52% of total corporate lobbying spending. Despite the enormous resources spent on climate lobbying and their potential impact on climate policy, existing studies only focus on how climate lobbying affects a policy’s enactment probability, and no prior studies have investigated whether and how climate lobbying affects companies’ progress toward net-zero emissions. This project aims to fill this gap by examining the effects of climate lobbying on companies’ greenhouse gas emissions, environmental efforts, and operating performance. Firms acquire information about climate policy legislation through climate lobbying, which enables them to resolve uncertainties on the timing and scope of climate actions and reduce expected transition costs (e.g., carbon taxes) in their environmental decision-making. Expected transition costs can also be reduced if climate policies are diluted or blocked as a result of lobbying. Legal liabilities arising from the implementation of climate policy can be lower for lobbying firms. Given that it is costly to engage in decarbonization activities to reduce climate risk exposure, firms may choose to employ climate lobbying as an alternative. Using textual analysis to identify climate lobbying, we will empirically model the substitution between climate lobbying and decarbonization efforts and address the following questions: (1) Do firms reduce decarbonization efforts and increase greenhouse gas emissions after climate lobbying? (2) What are the real (i.e., lower green investments and higher fossil capital investments) and economic effects (i.e., higher profitability and market valuation) of climate lobbying? (3) How to foster responsible corporate climate lobbying? Our findings will contribute to the literature of corporate environmental policy and corporate lobbying and yield policy implications for governments/lawmakers who are interested in promoting responsible climate lobbying. Our study will be among the first to reveal whether and how climate lobbying affects corporate carbon footprints and environmental management, thereby enabling environmentally responsible companies and investors to better manage corporate climate risk. It will reveal the importance of corporate political activities in the global transition to a green economy and inspire further research on the role of political activities in tackling climate change. 高碳行業的大型企業是全球溫室氣體的主要排放者。同時，這些公司在氣候相關政策的遊說上花費了大量金錢，尤其是在那些缺乏雄心壯志的氣候變化政策的國家。2000年至2020年的遊說報告顯示，公司在美國國會的氣候相關問題上的遊說支出高達123.6億美元，占企業遊說總支出的17.52%。儘管在氣候遊說上花費了大量資源並可能對氣候政策產生潛在影響，但現有的研究只關注了氣候遊說如何影響政策的實施概率，而沒有研究過氣候遊說是否以及如何影響公司實現淨零排放的進程。本項目旨在填補這一空白，研究氣候遊說對公司溫室氣體排放、環保努力和營運表現的影響。 企業通過氣候遊說獲取關於氣候政策立法的信息，這使他們能夠解決對氣候行動時機和範圍的不確定性，並在他們的環保決策中減少預期的過渡成本（例如，碳稅）。通过遊說稀釋或阻止氣候政策，企業也可以降低預期的過渡成本及氣候政策的實施中產生的法律責任。考慮到投入去碳活動以降低氣候風險的成本很高，公司可能會選擇使用氣候遊說作為一種替代方案。 本項目將使用文本分析來識別氣候遊說，實證分析氣候遊說和去碳努力的替代關係，並解答以下問題：（1）公司在進行氣候遊說後是否會減少去碳努力並增加溫室氣體排放？（2）氣候遊說的實際（即，綠色投資減少和化石資本投資增加）和經濟效果（即，利潤增加和市場評價提高）是什麼？（3）如何促進負責任的企業氣候遊說？ 本項目的研究結果將對企業環保政策和企業遊說的文獻做出貢獻，並為政府/立法者推動負責任氣候遊說提供政策啟示。本研究將是首批揭示氣候遊說是否以及如何影響企業碳足跡和環境管理的研究，有助于負責任的公司和投資者更好地管理企業氣候風險。它將揭示企業政治活動在全球過渡到綠色經濟中的重要性，並激發對政治活動在應對氣候變化中的角色的進一步研究。

15512323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15512323.value: 考慮消費者時間不一致偏好的兩階段預售管理

15512323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15512323.value: In online retail, presales with two payments allow shoppers to preorder a product by paying an upfront deposit and then settle the balance by paying the arrear. Products are subsequently delivered to consumers who finish both payments. This selling strategy is frequently observed both in China and worldwide. Under this selling strategy, there are several prices interacting with each other, consumers may change their preferences over time (i.e., time-inconsistent behavior), and sellers may obtain demand information via preorders, which together raise some critical concerns to sellers regarding whether to adopt this selling strategy, and if so, how to make pricing, capacity allocation, and inventory decisions. Moreover, this selling strategy also raises some operational issues to platforms, who usually make the rules (e.g., decide the timing of each payment). In addition, as sellers under presales with two payments may exploit consumers' deposits, the question faced by governments is whether and how to regulate this selling strategy. Motivated by the above context, this proposed project examines how to manage presales with two payments from the perspectives of sellers, platforms, governments, and consumers. We propose a game-theoretic base model in which a seller sells a product via presales with two payments and regular selling. With the passage of time, consumers decide whether to preorder or wait; and whether to settle the balance on time (for those who have preordered) or whether to buy the product via regular selling (for those who have chosen to wait). Consumers exhibit time-inconsistency in making decisions. When working on the project, we will first solve a seller's optimal pricing strategy. Then, we will modify the base model to incorporate a seller's capacity allocation and/or inventory planning decisions. After that, we will extend the base model to a competitive market and to a setting with platforms as a player. Next, we will characterize how fundamental forces, such as consumers' time-inconsistency level and their naivete degree, affect players' decisions and payoffs. Last, we will analyze consumer surplus and social welfare to provide insights for consumers and governments. Given the frequent use of presales with two payments in practice, our findings will be socially influential by developing a better understanding of the operational issues in the practices of this selling strategy. Our research will also provide valuable managerial implications for sellers, platforms, governments, and consumers. In addition, this project will contribute to the literature on presales/preorders as well as time-inconsistent behavior. 在網絡零售中，兩階段預售允許消費者先通過支付定金預訂產品、後通過支付尾款完成訂單並等待產品交付。這種銷售模式常見於中國及全球市場。它具有許多獨有特徵。例如，這種銷售模式涉及多個相互影響的價格，參與其中的消費者常常表現出時間不一致偏好，採用這種銷售模式的零售商可以通過預訂數量瞭解需求資訊等。這些特徵為零售商、電商平台和政府提出了新的挑戰，包括零售商是否應該採用兩階段預售，以及（如若採用）如何定價、分配產能和制定庫存決策等；電商平台如何制定相關運營決策（如決定活動節奏等）；政府是否需要以及（如若需要）如何監管這種銷售模式等。 受以上背景資訊啟發，本項目在考慮消費者時間不一致偏好的基礎上，研究如何從零售商、電商平台、政府和消費者的角度管理兩階段預售。我們提出了一個博弈論模型。在這個模型中，零售商通過兩階段預售和現貨銷售兩種模式銷售一種產品。隨著時間遷移，消費者先決定支付定金或等待，後（已經支付定金的消費者）決定是否支付尾款或（未支付定金的消費者）決定是否通過現貨銷售購買。消費者的偏好具有時間不一致性。 在執行本項目時，我們會首先研究零售商的定價問題。接著，我們計畫修改基礎模型以便研究零售商的產能分配問題和庫存策略。之後，我們將進一步修改模型以便將市場競爭和電商平台納入考慮。在此基礎上，我們將刻畫關鍵因素對各方的決策和收益的影響。最後，我們計畫從消費者剩餘和社會福利的角度分別為消費者和政府提供理論指導和政策建議。 鑒於兩階段預售在現實生活中的廣泛使用，本項目的研究成果將深化社會各界對該銷售模式中的運營問題的理解，同時為零售商、電商平台、政府和消費者提供決策參考和管理啟示。除此之外，本項目的研究也將有利於豐富預售管理理論和時間不一致偏好理論。

15513723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15513723.value: 了解去中心化自治組織作為區塊鏈經濟中新型組織形式的治理

15601023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15601023.value: 中国农村的政治经纪与稳定：类型，效果以及后果

15601023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15601023.value: Prof CHEN, Xi Dr Song, Zheren

15601023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15601023.value: The stability of Chinese authoritarianism perplexes academia and the general public. 136,330 likely collective action events located in over 96 percent of counties in China were identified between 2010 and 2017 (Zhang & Pan, 2019). Concerning various issues like housing demolition, migrant labor disputes, land expropriation, and pollution, the grievances were nonetheless absorbed without rocking the authoritarian stability. State-society bargaining as an essential mechanism of stability maintenance has received substantive attention (Chen, 2012; Lee & Zhang, 2013). By allowing aggrieved citizens a certain degree of political leverage and opportunities to obtain material concessions, the state appeases citizens without compromising its fundamental political order. However, state-society bargaining faces two major challenges. How does the bargaining succeed when valued resources like trust and information between the conflicting parties are far from guaranteed? Besides, the remarkable power imbalance between the state and society makes the bargaining more difficult. In this regard, this project proposes investigating a critical but poorly understood dimension of the bargaining model, i.e., brokerage. Brokerage here refers to an informal process by which a third party (namely, brokers) uses their linkages with the state and society to facilitate the bargaining. While helping aggrieved citizens with claim-making, brokers also assist the state in maintaining stability. We hence term this kind of interaction stability brokerage. Typical stability brokers under authoritarianism include community leaders, lawyers, reporters, NGOs, etc. With evidence from rural China, the project aims to address three questions. First, what kind of people serve as stability brokers between Chinese local governments and villagers? A typology of stability brokers will be developed. Then, the central question is, why are some brokerages more effective in absorbing popular grievances than others? Sometimes brokerage failed and even backfired to spur more intense conflicts. The 2019 Anti-ELAB movement in Hong Kong is a case in point. The failed brokerage of the chief executive was largely responsible for escalating the conflicts between Beijing and HK citizens. Furthermore, what are the consequences of stability brokerage for authoritarian state-society relations apart from stability? Does it facilitate clientelism or increase accountability? By focusing on the trilateral state-broker-society interactions, the project will enrich our understanding of the processes and outcomes of state-society bargaining and its implications for authoritarian stability.
