The study may also highlight the importance of regular physical activity for the physical and mental well-being of children with ASD. 患有自閉症譜系障礙 (ASD) 的兒童通常在運動和身體協調方面會有些困難。研究發現，運動式的干預計劃對於改善他們的運動能力和緩解症狀是有效的，但有些小朋友進步不如其他人。其中一個可能的原因是，有些小朋友因為難以遵循指示和做對動作，所以在運動計劃中參與度不高。在這個研究中，我們的目標是找出能夠優化和提升運動干預效果的方法。我們會特別集中探討音樂如何在一個為期10週的跆拳道培訓計劃中，對促進運動技能、增加參與度和提高身體活動水平方面起到作用。同時，我們也會分析在計劃完成後的隨訪期內，以上研究指標的變化情況。 根據Srinivasan團隊在2014年提出音樂體驗對自閉症兒童各種發展領域可能產生的影響的概念框架，及Karageorghis團隊在2016年提出關於音樂在運動時可能會影響人的心情、運動表現表現和結果這理論，我們建議檢驗將音樂治療元素融入專為自閉症兒童設計的跆拳道訓練的效果。我們會比較在這個運動干預的過程中，有加入音樂治療的跆拳道訓練和只接受跆拳道訓練的參加者，他們在心理健康和身體活動能力的指標的變化。評估會在運動干預開始前、運動干預後（隨機分組後的10週）以及3個月隨訪期後進行評估。 我們假設有加入音樂治療的跆拳道訓練，會比單獨進行跆拳道訓練對參加者產生更好的效果。這項研究的設計能夠讓我們了解，參加者在完成10週課運動干預所產生的整體改善，是否能夠在隨訪期後仍繼續保持或是退步。我們的評估項目包括運動參與度的即時影響（主要結果）、快樂程度、身體活動水平以及運動過程中的吃力程度，同時也會評估參加者的活動技能、身體健康狀況、運動表現、注意力、社交溝通和行為表現。這項研究的結果可能會為提升自閉症兒童在參與運動訓練課程時的身體活動水平和參與度提供參考策略。同時，此研究還可強調定期進行身體活動有助自閉症兒童的身體和心理健康的重要性。

15612723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15612723.value: 南宋中期的理學與政治文化

15612723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15612723.value: 12 世紀中葉的南宋，自稱為新儒家學者或 "道學 "追隨者的儒家士大夫，已成為活躍的地方領袖和政治中具有影響力的人物。目前的學術研究深入探討了道學家們如何參與地方事務，但對他們如何影響和改變朝廷政治動態的研究相對較少。余英時《朱熹的歷史世界》揭示了 1181 年後的政治進程，但對孝宗統治初期（1162-1189 年）的關鍵事件關注不夠，從而忽略了南宋政體的一些重要發展。我擬撰寫的書稿旨在揭示 1162 年至 1208 年間新儒家及其政治盟友，與孝宗及其內廷寵臣（近習）之間的互動，所產生的政治過程和文化，重點關注 1162 年至 1181 年這一關鍵時期。此研究將為我們提供了一個新的視角來看待南宋的政治史和思想史。 本研究關注道學家及其政治支持者（其中許多人來自福建興化軍）如何在 1181 年之前結成強大的政治聯盟，攻擊孝宗及其近習。由於近習是孝宗收復被金朝奪去的北方領土的主要支持者，道學家關於「恢復」的論述也相應地轉向溫和穩健。我的研究還表明，道學家及其黨派與孝宗近習之間的衝突，不僅在孝宗統治後持續存在，而且實際上導致了 1195 年的慶元黨禁。 通過研究道學同盟與朝廷近習之間長期而激烈的政治鬥爭，我的書主要從兩個方面對現有史學提出了挑戰和補充。首先，本書質疑了長期以來認為宋朝宮廷政治不受內廷干預的傳統觀點，從而對南宋政治文化做出新的解釋。其次，它說明了道學除了是一股重要的思想力量外，還始終與政治問題密不可分，並因此引發了嚴重的政治衝突。在這一過程中，我的研究表明，在帝制中國的語境中，學術發展如何與政治過程密不可分。

15612823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15612823.value: 来自中国大陆的新抵达移民青少年在香港的前瞻性研究：健康成長之路

15612823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15612823.value: Dr GU, Mingyue Michelle Dr Lu, Shuang Prof Shek, Daniel, Tan Lei Prof Wu, Qiaobing

15612823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15612823.value: Background: Immigrant youth from mainland China are an important part of Hong Kong’s future. They can contribute to Hong Kong’s human capital and their development has profound economic, social, and political implications. However, this community faces significant adaptation challenges and receives inadequate attention and support. Few studies focus on the holistic development of newly-arrived immigrant adolescents in their first few years of post-migration residency, when most adaptation challenges occur. A prospective approach is needed. Furthermore, despite the fact that resilience is critical to the adaptation of new immigrant youth, the resilience processes that help them cope with challenges and adapt to society are not fully understood. Objectives: Drawing on a multisystemic resilience framework and a positive youth development approach, the proposed project aims to: 1) systematically examine the developmental trajectories of newly-arrived immigrant adolescents from mainland China during their first two years living in Hong Kong, focusing on physical, psychosocial, and educational domains; 2) identify protective factors in the microsystem, mesosystem, and macrosystem, and their effects on the adaption process of newly-arrived immigrant adolescents; and 3) gain an in-depth understanding of the challenges faced by new immigrant adolescents in adapting to their lives in Hong Kong, in order to illuminate the dynamic resilience process through which immigrant adolescents cope with these challenges. Study design: With a mixed-method, four-wave longitudinal design, 800 newly-arrived immigrant adolescents from mainland China and their caregivers will be invited to complete a questionnaire about the adolescent’s development and resilience four times, at six-month intervals. Using growth mixture modeling, the adolescents will be classified into groups demonstrating different levels of adaptation based on their developmental trajectories across the four waves. Twenty adolescents and their families from the highly-adapted group and 20 from the group of maladapted adolescents will be interviewed following the fourth survey. The longitudinal relationships between different resilience factors and immigrant adolescents’ development will be examined using cross-lagged panel modeling. Contribution: The proposed research will provide a holistic understanding of the challenges and developmental trajectories of newly-arrived immigrant youth from mainland China to Hong Kong, which will inform policy-makers and professionals in regard to developing targeted and effective measures to best support and promote the positive development of immigrant youth. The findings will also generate an enhanced multisystemic model of resilience specific to migrant youth. This will enable us to promote the long-term well-being of both immigrant adolescents and wider society. 背景：来自中国大陆的移民青少年是香港未来的重要组成部分。他们可以为香港的人力资本做出贡献，对香港具有深远的经济、社会和政治影响。然而，这个群体面临着重大的适应挑战，且得到的关注和支持不足。很少有研究关注新抵达移民青少年在移民后最初几年的整体发展，而这段时间正是大多数适应挑战出现的时期，需要一种前瞻性的方法。此外，尽管抗逆力对于新移民青少年的适应至关重要，但帮助他们应对挑战并适应社会的抗逆力过程尚未完全被理解。 目标：本研究借鉴多系统抗逆力框架和青少年正面成長理論，旨在：1）系统研究来自中国大陆的新抵达移民青少年在香港生活的最初两年内的发展轨迹，重点关注身体、心理社会和教育领域；2）识别微觀系统、中間系统和宏觀系统中的保护因素，以及它们对新抵达移民青少年适应过程的影响；3）深入了解新移民青少年在适应香港生活时面临的挑战，以揭示移民青少年应对这些挑战的动态抗逆力过程。 研究设计：采用混合方法、四波次纵向设计，将邀请来自中国大陆的800名新抵达移民青少年及其照顾者四次填写关于青少年发展和韧性的问卷，每次间隔六个月。通过成长混合模型，将根据他们在四波次中的发展轨迹将青少年分类为表现出不同适应水平的群体。从适应程度较高的群体中选择20名青少年及其家庭，以及从适应程度较低的群体中选择20名青少年及其家庭，在第四次调查后对他们进行访谈。将使用交叉滞后面板模型研究不同韧性因素与移民青少年发展之间的纵向关系。 贡献：本研究将全面了解来自中国大陆的新抵达移民青少年在香港的挑战和发展轨迹，从而为政策制定者和专业人士提供信息，以制定有针对性和有效的措施，最好地支持和促进移民青少年的积极发展。研究结果还将生成一个针对移民青少年的增强多系统韧性模型，从而能够促进移民青少年和更广泛社会的长期福祉。

15613123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15613123.value: 社會數據化的技術政治爭議：有關香港數據治理公共爭議的數位民族誌

15613123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15613123.value: Social life and action are increasingly transformed into quantified data to be used for real-time tracking and predictive analysis. While this development of social datafication constitutes a paradigm shift in urban governance, it can also be a prime source of social–political contestation. In Hong Kong, such technopolitical contention has been manifesting itself online amid prolonged social distancing and urban policing. Following the 2019–2020 social unrest and the tensions in its aftermath, a networked counter-public sphere has emerged in which seemingly banal incidents involving data technology are turned into politically provocative narratives on online platforms. Smart lampposts, contact tracing, e-HKD, and SIM registration are prominent cases in point. However, while related narratives have surged and prompted connective acts of data disobedience in real-life contexts, few studies have investigated them as such, particularly in relation to their digital mediation and politicisation. Meanwhile, while prevailing literature has focused on data capitalism and its top-down effects in the West, studies concerning East Asia and particularly China tend to underscore a compliance culture regarding mass data collection and use. Less is known about how state-led datafication turns into technopolitical contention, and how lay citizens come to engage with data technology and act as a counterforce to the datafied power of the state in the digital age. The proposed study will fill these gaps in both empirical and theoretical knowledge by analysing the (trans)formation of the counter-public sphere and its resulting data disobedience in Hong Kong’s digital arena. It will analyse the aforementioned four cases that are integral to the city’s initiatives in data-driven governance. First, by integrating digital ethnography with archival research to offer a contextual analysis, it will extend decolonial data studies to unveil how a contentious politics of data unfolds in an understudied geopolitical context, particularly outside advanced Western democracies, and lay the groundwork for comparison. Second, the study will provide evidence-based knowledge of the digital mediation and politicisation of data-driven governance by unpacking the scope and patterns of the online articulation of contentious narratives and bottom-up interventions. Third, it will delineate the political scripts underpinning the mediated discourses and courses of action among the cases studied, to understand the nuances of citizens’ perceptions and imaginaries of our increasingly datafied society. This study will contribute to sociological understanding of state-led datafication and its contestation. It will also provide evidence to aid businesses, inform policymakers, and advance public debates about the ramifications of data-related policies. 在現今社會，越來越多的日常生活行為正在轉化為量化數據，用於實時追踪和預測分析。 雖然社會數據化的發展已漸漸構成了城市治理的範式轉變，但它也有可能成為社會政治爭論的主要根源之一。 在香港，相關的技術政治爭論開始在網絡上出現。 經過2019-2020年的社會動盪之後，一些涉及數據技術的事件在線上平台上引發一連串的公共爭議。 智慧燈柱、接觸者追蹤、港元數碼貨幣和電話智能卡實名登記制都是近年的典型例子。 然而，儘管相關事件增加並引發了一連串與日常生活息息相關的數據不服從事件，至今只有很少相關的研究調查。 與此同時，主流文獻主要關注西方的數據資本主義及其影響。有關東亞尤其是對中國方面的研究大多強調海量數據收集和數據使用上的服從文化。對於社會數據化如何轉變為技術政治爭議事件，以及普通公民如何參與數據技術並在數位時代成為社會數據化進程的一部份，人們知之甚少。 本研究將通過分析香港數位公共領域的技術政治爭議事件及其帶來的數據不服從行為，填補這些實際和理論知識方面的空缺。 本研究將分析上述四個與香港數據治理密不可分的案例。 首先，本研究將結合數位民族志與檔案研究以擴充去殖民代的數據研究，並揭示數據政治爭議如何在香港獨特的地緣政治背景下展開，為未來的比較研究奠定基礎。 其次，本研究將通過揭示有關技術政治爭議事件線上討論的模式和影響範圍，為有關數據治理網絡政治化的討論提供循證知識。 第三，本研究將描繪研究案例中的政治文化腳本，以了解公民對日益數據化社會的看法和想像。 這項研究將有助社會學者了解社會數據化及相關的公共爭議現象， 促進企業發展和政策制定，並推動有關數據政策及其影響的公眾討論。

15613223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15613223.value: 透過肢體、律動以及當代舞蹈來發展永續壓褶設計及生產方式

15613223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15613223.value: Mr Chang, Mao Tsen Prof LI, Li

15613223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15613223.value: The fashion industry is notorious for polluting the environment, and the awareness of being sustainable has been advocated for years in the fashion circle. The principal investigator’s (PI) long-standing interests, pleat, and pleating, are one of the most unsustainable fabric manipulations in the industry as pleats and pleating require more material and extra production process. This research aims to tackle this sustainability issue by producing new forms of pleats through digital technology and material redevelopment. Based on Huang’s taxonomy of pleats (2022), this study is going to use digital weaving and knitting technology to produce structural pleats, which embed pleating patterns in the textile structure, eliminating the post-processing thermal fixation stage (the most common pleating production in the market nowadays), and increasing its durability to avoid repleating. This method achieves sustainability by lowering the production cost, labour, and carbon footprint of transporting textiles to pleating studios and then to garment factories. The development of singularity of material (PLA fibre) in the sustainable pleats permits an easier recycling procedure than conventional, multi-material pleated garments. This research would like to demonstrate that being sustainable does not necessarily sacrifice the aesthetics of fashion. Also, the research outcome (pleating production and the design method) could possibly have some impact on the mass production market. The industry could directly adopt the knitting/ weaving patterns to create sustainable pleats, while consumers could be benefited from longer life-span pleated garments and easier ways to recycle them. In terms of application, this research will adopt live performance to experiment with the capacity of the material. Pleats, with the feature of expansion and contraction, are better observed and tested through movements and mobility than in a static status. Live performance has been adopted by several fashion designers, including Mariano Fortuny and Issey Miyake, as a medium to demonstrate the potential of pleats. This research will continue this heritage and work with a Hong Kong dance group to discover the full potential of pleats. As Haley Toelle from Nike said, designing for extreme scenarios could benefit everyone’s daily life situations. The extreme motions of the dancers can be a solid database for designing daily wear for the general public. This data collection and analysis establishes a solid ground that becomes the beginning of the next study to create a living cycle for cross-disciplinary research among art, design, and material science. 時裝產業在污染環境上特別惡名昭彰，因此服裝產業近幾年來特別提倡永續發展。主要計畫主持人長期關注且有興趣的布料質感創作-褶皺以及壓褶，則因為需要大量的材料以及額外的加工工序成為相當不環保的創作方式。本研究將透過數位科技以及材料的重新開發，產生新的壓褶可能來面對這個永續發展的問題。 根據黃才駿針對壓褶的分類法(2022) ，這個研究案將利用數位梭織以及針織技術來生產結構壓褶。此生產壓褶的方法能將壓褶版型內嵌於布料的結構中，減去熱塑定型的後加工過程(此工序為目前市面上最常見的壓褶成型方式)，並且增加褶子的耐久性而不需要重新壓褶。利用此方式來生產褶子能夠降低生產以及勞力成本、減少將布料從布廠運送到壓褶工廠再到成衣縫製廠的碳排放足跡。另外，發展單一材料 (天然抑或是人造的纖維)的永續褶子，則能夠使布料回收過程相較於傳統、複合媒材的衣物更加簡單。 這份研究也將展示在服裝創作的過程中，達成永續發展不盡然需要犧牲設計的美感，而研究成果 (壓褶的製造方式以及設計方法)能對於市場的量產規模產生影響力。服裝產業能夠直接採用此研究的針織/ 梭織版型來創造永續褶子，而消費者能夠享受更持久的壓褶服裝以及更簡單的回收方式。 從應用層面來說，這個研究將採用現場表演的方式來實驗研究成果的耐受性。相較於靜止的狀態，擁有開闔效果的壓褶相當適合透過律動以及在流動性中來觀察和測試。現場表演作為展示壓褶的潛力，已經被許多藝術家及設計師採用，例如: Mariano Fortuny 和三宅一生。這個研究將延續這個傳統並與香港的舞團合作來探索壓褶的可能性。就如同Nike 創新部門的Haley Toelle所說的，當我們針對極端情境來設計時，作品往往能夠對一般大眾的日常生活產生幫助。舞蹈中誇張的動作能夠成為設計服裝給一般大眾的參考資料庫。此研究所蒐集的資訊以及分析將成為下個研究的開端，形成一個在藝術、設計以及材料科學跨領域的研究循環。

15613323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15613323.value: 普通話發展性語言障礙兒童敘事能力損傷的原因探究

15613323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15613323.value: Dr Chan, Angel Wing-Shan Dr Deng, Xiangjun Dr Ebert, Kerry Danahy Prof Mai, Ziyin Prof Wang, Rumi Dr Yang, Binrang

15613323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15613323.value: Children with developmental language disorder (DLD) demonstrate significant and persistent impairments relative to typically developing (TD) peers on language tasks, including narrative production, a functional discourse-level communication task that requires accessing and integrating various levels of linguistic knowledge and strongly predicts educational outcomes. Children with DLD also exhibit limitations in sustained selective attention and working memory capacity. Despite robust evidence linking cognitive processing limitations with language deficits at single-word and sentence levels, few studies of DLD have examined the relationship between cognitive skills and discourse performance, and even fewer utilized a longitudinal design to explore the causal links between cognition and narrative performance. This project aims to 1) examine the functional language deficits (i.e., narrative macrostructure and microstructure) in children with DLD relative to their TD peers at two time points; 2) delineate the deficits in auditory and visuospatial sustained attention and working memory skills in DLD children across time; and 3) elucidate the longitudinal relationship between nonlinguistic cognitive and functional language skills in DLD and TD children. Two hundred Mandarin-speaking first-graders from Shenzhen city, half TD and half DLD, will complete assessments of sustained selective attention and working memory in the auditory and visual modalities using nonlinguistic stimuli, and produce stories that vary in task type (retell, tell) and length (short, long) at two time points, one year apart. Structural language performance on standardized tests will serve as control variable to pinpoint the role of cognitive skills in language performance beyond the single-word and sentence levels. The project will be among the first to simultaneously track narrative and cognitive development across time and the first to systematically manipulate the processing demands of narrative tasks using well-controlled stimuli. The results will advance our understanding of the underlying deficits of DLD by testing the explanatory power of domain-general processing accounts in a functional communication context, and investigating the generalizability of processing theories of DLD to Mandarin, a typologically different language from the most studied Indo-European languages. The project will fill a critical gap by generating the first narrative database of disordered language in child Mandarin that will be freely available to researchers and clinicians. As such, it will provide valuable reference information for DLD diagnosis, intervention planning, and progress monitoring, and for future studies of multilingual learners of Mandarin in Hong Kong and the overseas communities. Moreover, the results may inform intervention regimen to incorporate broad cognitive and language training protocols. 作為一項功能性的，語篇層次的溝通任務，敘事產出需要兒童提取和整合各個層次的語言知識，並能夠顯著預測兒童的學業表現。相比於典型發展兒童，發展性語言障礙（developmental language disorder, DLD）兒童在包括敘事產出在內的多種語言任務中表現出顯著和持續的困難。此外，發展性語言障礙兒童在持續性選擇注意力 （sustained selective attention）和工作記憶能力（working memory capacity）方面也有明顯的缺陷。已有大量證據表明，發展性語言障礙兒童在詞和句子層面的障礙表現與他們有限的認知加工能力相關，但很少有研究探究該人群的認知技能與語篇層面表現的關係。使用縱向實驗設計探索認知能力與敘事能力關係的研究則更為匱乏。 本項目旨在1）通過比較兩個時間點上發展性語言障礙兒童與同齡典型發展兒童的敘事產出表現（如宏觀敘事結構和微觀敘事結構），明確普通話發展性語言障礙兒童功能性語言缺陷所在；2）揭示發展性語言障礙兒童在聽覺和視覺空間持續注意力和工作記憶技能方面的缺陷，並探究其發展變化情況；3）闡明發展性語言障礙和典型發展兒童的非語言認知能力和功能性語言技能的長期關係。本項目將在深圳招募150名普通話母語的一年級兒童，一半為典型發展兒童，一半為發展性語言障礙兒童。非語言刺激將被用來探究視覺和聽覺兩種模式下兒童的持續性選擇注意力和工作記憶能力。兒童還將在兩個時間點（相隔一年）完成不同類型（複述retell和講述tell）和長度（長和短）的敘事產出任務。同時，兒童也將參加標準化語言能力測試，其中結構性語言任務表現將作為控制變量，以準確定位認知技能在單字詞和句子水平之外的語言表現中的作用。 作為首個同時追踪兒童敘事能力發展、認知能力發展及兩者關係的大型課題，本項目的創新之處還體現在藉助對實驗材料的精準控制來系統操縱敘事任務中的認知加工需求。通過探究領域一般(domain-general)認知加工理論在功能性交流語境中的解釋力，本研究的結果將推進我們對發展性語言障礙潛在缺陷的理解，並探索將發展性語言障礙認知加工理論推廣到漢語，這一與大多數印歐語系語言存在類型學差異的語言上。本項目還將填補一項關鍵的研究空白，即建立首個普通話語言障礙兒童敘事數據庫，並免費提供給研究人員和治療師。該數據庫能夠為發展性語言障礙的診斷、干預規劃及發展監測提供有價值的參考信息，並為有關香港和海外的多語言背景的漢語學習者的研究提供參考。此外，研究結果將有助於製定語言干預措施，包括廣泛的認知和語言訓練方案。

15613623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15613623.value: 新冠疫情下的不平等兒童發展 - 社會經濟地位、家庭培育及兒童成長軌跡

15613623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15613623.value: Prof Shek, Daniel, Tan Lei Dr Tam, Hau Lin, Cherry Dr To, Siu-ming

15613623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15613623.value: The COVID-19 pandemic has caused physical and psychological hazards with deep and enduring effects on human lives and the economy. In particular, children and their families from low socio-economic status (SES) backgrounds have been the hardest hit. Prolonged school closures, online home learning, the suspension of community services and congested living environments during the pandemic have created great hurdles in the learning and development of children from low SES backgrounds. Parents’ reduced salary and unemployment further constrain their financial resources, which may affect their children’s life trajectories. Families from high SES backgrounds have more resources to weather the pandemic than families from low SES backgrounds who are more vulnerable to the risks and challenges of the pandemic. Although scholars have called attention to childhood inequality during the pandemic, little is known about the stratifying effects of SES on the developmental trajectories of children in the context of the COVID-19 pandemic, in addition to the mediating pathways for these effects, particularly in the Chinese context. Following Lareau’s (2003) work on the concerted cultivation in the differentiated childhood experiences between middle- and working-class families, a new form of concerted cultivation with five components has been identified in Chinese contexts (i.e., provision of enrichment activities, effortful involvement in children’s academic performance, developing achievement mindsets and opportunities, developing and expanding children’s social circles and supporting children in using information technology in learning). The proposed study adopts the life course perspective to examine the relationship between family SES and children’s developmental trajectories in Hong Kong under the pandemic. The mediational roles of concerted cultivation trajectories will also be assessed. Moreover, we will explore how families from low SES backgrounds overcome the economic challenges during the pandemic to promote concerted cultivation for their children, despite their limited resources. The personal, familial, school and community resources that the families tap into to foster their children’s positive outcomes will be studied. The proposed study will adopt a mixed methods approach in a three-wave longitudinal survey study and a two-wave qualitative study using case interviews. Eight hundred dyads of children studying in Grade 4 and their parents will be recruited to complete the survey. In addition, 30 parent–child dyads from low SES backgrounds who practice concerted cultivation will be invited to share how they promoted their children’s development despite the economic challenges during the pandemic. This study will inform social policies and social work practices during the post-pandemic stage. 新冠疫情對身心帶來危害，並對人類生活和經濟產生了深遠而持久的影響 。其中，對那些來自低社會經濟地位（SES）的兒童及其家庭所造成的打擊最爲嚴重。在疫情期間，衆多因素（如：學校長期停課，在家網上學習，社區服務停滯，居住環境擁擠等）對低社會經濟地位的兒童之學習與成長造成嚴重阻礙。父母收入減少和失業更加劇其經濟負擔，從而對兒童的生活經歷帶來負面影響。高社會經濟地位的家庭擁有更多資源來應對疫情，而低社會經濟地位的家庭則更容易面臨疫情的風險和挑戰。儘管學者已呼籲社會關注疫情期間兒童所經歷的不平等遭遇，但疫情期間就社會經濟地位對兒童成長軌跡的分層影響，以及這些影響的中介路徑並不瞭解，尤其是在華人社會的情況。 Lareau（2003）曾研究中產家庭和基層家庭在培育兒童發展上存在差異。根據華人的社會文化背景，家長培育兒童之模式有五項特點，包括：包羅萬有的課外活動、主動參與兒童的學習、培養成就心態並發掘機會、拓展兒童的社交圈以及幫助兒童使用電子科技學習。本研究計劃從生命歷程的視角，探討在疫情期間，香港家庭社會經濟地位與兒童發展軌跡之間的關係。此外，我們將探討低社會經濟地位的家庭如何在資源有限的情況下克服疫情所帶來的經濟挑戰，培育子女的發展。我們還會研究這些家庭可以如何利用個人、家庭、學校和社區的資源，在促進兒童發展方面達到積極的效果。 本研究計劃採用混合研究方法，分別進行三個階段之縱向量化研究及兩個階段之質性個案訪談研究。我們將招募800名四年級學生及其家長進行這項研究。此外，我們還會邀請30組來自低社會經濟地位的家庭之父母和子女參與訪談，讓他們分享在疫情期間如何在經濟困難的情況下促進孩子的發展。這項研究將為後疫情階段的社會政策和社會工作實踐提供寶貴的參考資料。

15614223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15614223.value: 語料庫輔助的《基本法》新聞媒介再語境化研究

15614223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15614223.value: It has been 25 years since Hong Kong's handover on 1 July 1997 under the general framework of "one country, two systems". Although the Basic Law provides the legal basis for "one country, two systems" and safeguards the future of Hong Kong, concerns over its implementation and interpretations in Hong Kong have never ceased since its inception. Therefore, the Basic Law has been extensively examined from both legal and political perspectives in the last two decades. The proposed project will give a corpus-assisted discourse study of the recontextualization of the Basic Law in news media from four concerned areas: the US, Britain, Mainland China, and Hong Kong. Recontextualization refers to the dynamic process of relocation of elements of a text from its original context to a new text. The basic assumption is that recontextualization is not a neutral process but an act of control, always subject to constant appropriation and manipulation. The primary purpose is to examine the specific ways of recontextualizing the Basic Law and explore the dynamic relations between recontextualization, media, and politics. Four large corpora will be built by collecting all news texts concerning the Basic Law from 1 July 1997 to 30 June 2022. The theories and methods of critical discourse analysis and corpus linguistics are drawn upon to give a corpus-assisted discourse study of recontextualizing the Basic Law at multiple levels of texts: (1) the topics/themes/discourses; (2) the discursive strategies involved; (3) the linguistic means and realizations. This study will not only investigate the synchronic and diachronic differences in recontextualizing the Basic Law over the last 25 years but also explore the socio-political factors and hegemonic struggles behind the Basic Law recontextualizations. As the first extensive empirical study of recontextualizing the Basic Law in news media of the four concerned areas, this study contributes to media studies and discourse analysis in three ways. First, it underlines the dynamic turn in the study of news texts and proposes to give a corpus-assisted discourse study of recontextualization in a large number of news texts. Second, it presents an overview of preferential ways of recontextualizing the Basic Law in different/competing news media and illuminates the dynamic relations between recontextualization, news media, and politics. Third, it contributes to the growing literature on corpus-assisted discourse studies by drawing insights from the recent development in the theories and methods of critical discourse analysis and corpus linguistics.

15614423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15614423.value: 受害兒童的網絡欺凌行為：情緒風險因素和社會-生態保護因素的角色

15614423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15614423.value: Ms Cheung, Chok Fong Prof Shek, Daniel, Tan Lei

15614423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15614423.value: While cyberbullying is a pervasive social problem, there is limited research on how it develops among children. While researchers have regarded in-person victimization as an important trigger of cyberbullying perpetration, few studies have examined the mechanisms involved in transforming victims into bullies online. Using an integrated framework involving the General Aggression Model and the Social-Ecological Model, this study will improve our understanding of the developmental processes that contribute to cyberbullying by investigating how children process their emotions after being victimized and the moderating factors involved in the in-person victimization-cyberbullying link. The proposed study will utilize a mixed-method design comprising two phases: In Phase I, we will conduct a three-wave longitudinal quantitative study with a one-year time interval between the successive waves. Based on 1,422 children from 16 primary schools in Hong Kong, this survey will explore the relationship between in-person victimization and cyberbullying over time and whether in-person victimization triggers individual emotional states (anger, hostility, and anxiety) leading to cyberbullying (i.e., mediators). We also explore the moderating effects of several social-ecological factors on the relationship between in-person victimization and cyberbullying, including children’s social and emotional competence, parent-child relationship quality and parenting style, and identification with Chinese Confucian values (benevolence and forgiveness). In Phase II, 45 child-parent pairs who completed the three-wave survey will be invited to participate in a qualitative study, entailing in-depth interviews with children and focus groups with parents. The qualitative data produced will deepen understanding of how cyberbullying develops after a child has been victimized. The “personal accounts” and “stories” of the development of cyberbullying from the perspectives of children and their parents will help to understand the survey findings and to provide additional insights on the origin of cyberbullying, particularly with reference to the conceptual model tested in Phase I. The research findings will be used to produce resources designed to help prevent cyberbullying such as helping the victims to control their negative emotions and strengthen their psychosocial competence. This study will contribute significantly to tackle the problem of cyberbullying by delivering a deeper understanding of the emotional risk factors that lead some victims to engage in bullying online, alongside the social-ecological protective factors that parents, schools, and social workers can enhance to better support children and young people. It aims to use the research to propose a working model for future prevention and intervention programs of use to schoolteachers and social workers. 儘管網絡欺凌問題彌散於整個社會，關於網絡欺凌如何在兒童中演變的研究依然缺乏。雖然部分學者認為親身被害經歷是誘發網絡欺凌行為的一個重要因素，迄今甚少研究檢驗過受害者在網絡上轉化為欺凌實施者的整套機制。在整合了一般攻擊行為模型和社會-生態模型的理論框架下，此研究將探究兒童在受害後如何處理情緒和線下被害經歷導致網絡欺凌行為這一鏈條中的調節因數，進而增進對由受害經歷至實施網絡欺凌這一演變過程的認識。 此項目採用混合研究設計，分為兩個階段進行： 在第一階段，研究團隊將會進行一項三輪縱向定量研究，以一年為間距，收集合共三次數據。基於收集來自香港16間小學共1,422名兒童的數據，此調查將探究在時間推移下，線下受害經歷和網絡欺凌之間的關係，以及線下受害經歷是否會引起導致網絡欺凌的個體情緒狀態（例如：憤怒、敵意和焦慮），即這些情緒狀態是否作為線下受害經歷與網絡欺凌之間的中介變量。同時，研究團隊亦會探究多個社會-生態因素（例如：兒童的社會與情緒能力、親子關係品質與管教模式、以及對儒家傳統價值觀的認同）對線下受害經歷導致網絡欺凌之關係的調節效應。 在第二階段，研究團隊會邀請完成三輪問卷的45對親子參與定性研究，包括同兒童進行深度訪談及同家長進行焦點小組訪談。訪談所收集的訊息無疑能加深對兒童受害後產生網絡欺凌行為之機制的理解。兒童及其家長對網絡欺凌演變過程之「個體敘事」和「故事」的視角將有助於對問卷調查發現結果的理解，並進一步結合第一階段的概念模型、為網絡欺凌之起源提供見解。 本研究的成果將被用於設計預防網絡欺凌的方案，包括幫助受害兒童控制其負面情緒並強化其社會心理能力。透過了解導致部分網絡欺凌受害者實施網絡欺凌行為的情緒風險因素，是次研究將為解決網絡欺凌問題做出重要貢獻。其次，認識社會-生態保護因素也能啟發家長、學校和社工為兒童及年輕人提供更有效的支援。總括而言，是次研究旨在為學校教師和社工日後的預防及幹預項目提供一個參考模型。

15614623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15614623.value: 程序公義與精神健康：一項使用虛擬情境故事及時序表的混合定性研究

15614723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
15614723.value: 通向有效利他主義的黑暗之路

15614723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
15614723.value: Dr BAI, Feng Prof Uhlmann, Eric

15614723.label: Project Objectives
15614723.value: Explore proneness to moral hubris as an antecedent of effective altruism Investigate the effect of effective altruism on (im)moral behavior Examine the interpersonal influence of effective altruism on perceptions of morality
rows: Explore proneness to moral hubris as an antecedent of effective altruism
Investigate the effect of effective altruism on (im)moral behavior
Examine the interpersonal influence of effective altruism on perceptions of morality

15614723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
15614723.value: 有效利他主義（E.A.），一場基於我們應盡可能去做最大善事的結果主義哲學和社會運動，正在變得越來越有影響力。社會科學家們已經認識到，我們大部分的利他性給予都是“無效的”，這是由我們對他人痛苦的情感反應驅動的，而不是理性計算的影響或後果。為了“治愈”我們的“扭曲”利他主義，學者們提出了各種策略，如聯合評估、單位請求，以及提供效果資訊。儘管這些幹預在一定程度上有助於增加對“有效”事業的給予，但由於人們繼續基於他們的情感反應選擇較不有效的選項，這些幹預無法消除“無效”的給予。這些研究隱含著一種假設，即E.A.在道德上是好的和優越的。然而，研究已經顯示，有效的利他主義者（E.A.s）比他們的“無效”對等者（“同情者”）被認為道德程度較低，並且作為社會夥伴的吸引力也較低。 對於E.A.s的這種不佳的看法是否有任何真實性？在這份提議中，我們提出存在一種被忽視的，通往E.A.的黑暗路徑，其特徵是有傾向感到自己因道德正義和優越而感到自豪，也就是道德傲慢。具體來說，Bai等人（2022年8月）最近提出道德傲慢源於一種潛在的自我主義，以對自己有利，並發現傾向於道德傲慢的人對傷害的情感反應減弱，且對道德的自我主義動機增強。我們提出，這種對同情關懷的減少和對自私的增強組合，會釋放效益主義的決策，並為道德傲慢的人提供參與E.A.的動力驅使。此外，我們認為實踐E.A.反過來使E.A.s免於感到羞愧，並通過引起道德傲慢的感覺來抑製道德上可疑的行為。因此，當道德傲慢的E.A.s以一種不一緻甚至可能引人注目的方式進行（不）道德行為時，觀察者可能會察覺到他們的道德不一緻性並懷疑他們的道德。 我們的初步研究（N = 297）確實發現，傾向於經歷道德傲慢的人往往具有高度的擴展性利他主義和注重效果的特質，這兩種心理特質被認為是E.A.s的原型（Caviola等人，2022），並在進行假設性捐贈決策時優先選擇有效（而非無效）的慈善機構。基於初步研究，我們提議通過三項預先註冊的研究來測試我們的假設——一項在線調查（研究1），一項實驗（研究2），和一項多源現場調查（研究3）。研究1旨在對美國參與者的代表性樣本進行實際捐贈決策，以複製我們的初步研究結果。研究2計劃操控參與者的有效給予經驗，以對有效利他主義與道德傲慢之間的關係進行更強的因果推論，這將在真實的有效利他主義者樣本中進行。最後，研究3設定來檢查自我報告的有效利他主義對（不）道德行為和熟悉的同伴報告的人際感知的影響。

16100023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16100023.value: 通过活性依赖性基因表达研究记忆更新的分子和神经电路机制

16100023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16100023.value: 记忆必须根据动物的外部和内部环境的变化进行灵活修改。虽然记忆巩固已经得到了广泛的研究，但缺乏有关分子和神经电路水平的记忆修改的信息。除了在记忆巩固中的经典作用外，活性依赖性基因表达已被认为与记忆修改有关：消退（通过反复暴露于记忆环境来抑制记忆）或更新（根据冲突的经验重写记忆环境）。这种记忆修改的机制对于治疗心理障碍，特别是创伤后应激障碍（PTSD）非常重要。我们之前在果蝇中的研究表明，当组蛋白去乙酰化酶2同源物Rpd3被抑制时，老化的、令人厌恶的长期记忆（LTM）可以更灵活地通过最近的冲突记忆进行更新。这里的核心问题是Rpd3如何平衡冲突的记忆，从而影响记忆更新的灵活性。我们的初步数据表明，有一个特定的调节神经回路用于记忆更新，其特征是Rpd3调节的活性依赖性转录。我们假设这个调节神经回路中的Rpd3下游基因在记忆更新中发挥重要作用。本研究的目标如下：1）进一步描述通过Rpd3进行的记忆更新，2）识别用于记忆更新的Rpd3下游效应基因，以及3）了解基于神经回路的记忆更新机制。本研究的长期目标是了解冲突记忆如何加权，从而实现成功的记忆更新，以及我们是否最终可以针对该系统治疗PTSD、焦虑或抑郁症。我们的初步结果确定了Rpd3的靶基因集，其中一些确实参与了记忆更新。研究其他靶基因可能会揭示完整的记忆更新基因集，所有这些都可能是治疗靶点。此外，了解基于神经回路的机制将提供有关如何在神经网络中使用活性依赖性基因表达进行记忆更新的见解。因此，我们的提案对于分子和神经网络水平的记忆更新的整体概念化以及治疗某些心理障碍的可能方法具有重要意义。
