16301723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16301723.value: 高壓高溫下非生物碳氫化合物的第一性原理研究

16301723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301723.value: Carbon cycle processes in the atmosphere and biosphere considerably influence the global climate and have thus attracted significant research interest. Notably, the appearance of carbon is not limited to Earth’s near-surface reservoirs, and Earth’s interior contains more than 90% of the planet’s carbon. The deep carbon cycle substantially influences the carbon budget near Earth’s surface with great implications for global climate change and human energy consumption. In general, Earth’s internal environments become more reducing (i.e., less oxidizing) with increasing depth. Therefore, hydrocarbons play important roles in the deep carbon cycle, and are closely relevant to the formation of diamonds, abiogenic petroleum origin, and the generation of life at great depths. However, owing to experimental difficulties at the high pressure (HP) and high temperature (HT) conditions typically found in deep Earth, our knowledge regarding the physical and chemical properties of deep hydrocarbons is very limited, particularly at the molecular scale. In this proposed project, we will develop and apply first-principles methods accelerated by data-driven machine learning techniques to study hydrocarbons at both HP and HT conditions. To ensure consistency with natural environments, we will investigate the effects of solvation by supercritical water, silicate interfaces, and nanoconfinement on several important hydrocarbon reactions, e.g., the Fischer-Tropsch-type (FTT) synthesis, which refers to the conversion of inorganic carbon to organic matter in a broader context. To guide the experiments, we will compute the Raman spectra of the reactants and products of the FTT synthesis to study how characteristic Raman bands change with pressure, temperature, and chemical environments. The proposed research will help reveal the molecular picture of hydrocarbon reactions in deep Earth, and our simulation results will help researchers better interpret their experimental data. This proposed study will thus enhance the understanding of abiotic hydrocarbon formation in Earth’s interior, and the knowledge gained from this study will help us better know Earth’s deep carbon cycle. 大氣和生物圈中的碳循環過程極大地影響著全球氣候，因此引起了人們的廣泛研究興趣。 值得注意的是，碳的出現不僅限於地球的近地表儲層，地球的內部甚至含有地球90%以上的碳。 深部碳循環極大地影響地球表面附近的碳預算，並深刻影響全球氣候變化和人類能源消耗。 一般來說，地球內部隨著深度的增加，環境變得更具還原性（即氧化性更少）。因此，碳氫化合物在深層碳循環中發揮著重要作用，與鑽石的形成、非生物石油起源和生成，甚至生命起源等有關。由於高壓下的實驗有很多困難，地球深處通常存在高壓（HP）和高溫（HT）條件，我們對深層碳氫化合物的物理和化學性質瞭解非常有限，特別是在分子尺度上。 在這個項目中，我們將開發和應用第一原理方法，並通過數據驅動的機器學習技術來研究高壓和高溫碳氫化合物的性質。為了保持與自然環境的一致性，我們將研究超臨界水、硅酸鹽界面和納米尺度限制下的溶劑化作用對幾個重要的烴反應的影響，例如費托型（FTT）合成，這裡泛指無機碳向有機物的轉化。為了指導實驗，我們將計算 FTT 合成的反應物和產物的拉曼光譜，以研究特徵拉曼譜如何隨壓力、溫度和化學環境變化。 擬開展的研究將有助於揭示地球深處碳氫化合物反應的分子圖像，我們的模擬結果將幫助研究人員更好地解釋他們的實驗數據。 總而言之，這項擬開展的研究將增強對地球內部非生物碳氫化合物形成的理解，從這項研究中獲得的知識將幫助我們更好地了解地球的深層碳循環。

16301823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16301823.value: 鋁基陰離子及其過渡金屬配合物的反應機理研究

16301823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301823.value: Traditionally, the negative charge on an anion or an anionic ligand in a metal complex is typically localized in an electronegative center. Recently, a number of alumanyl (also called aluminyl in literature because of a formal Al(I) metal center) anions and their transition-metal (TM) complexes (TM-alumanyl complexes), in which the negative charge is localized in an electropositive aluminum center, have been synthesized and found to show unusual reactivity toward activation of small molecules. In view of the new development, we anticipate that our current knowledge may not work well with these electropositive donor ligands and therefore an in-depth investigation of their electronic structures and reactivity is highly desired. This proposal builds on a recently published theoretical study by our own on the reactivity of copper(I) and gold(I) alumanyl complexes toward heteroallenes such as carbon dioxide. In this just published work, we obtained the details of how the electrons of TM−Al σ-bond transfer to its reaction partners and achieved much better elucidation of their role in the reactions. Moreover, we are been recently privileged to be invited for a collaborative project studying the mechanistic aspects of the experimentally observed reaction of a scandium(III) alumanyl complex with benzene in the presence of bromo(diphenyl)methane. Over the past 5 years, we have witnessed tremendous progress in the studies of the above-mentioned unusual chemical species. It is gradually recognized that, containing both TM and electropositive Al centers, TM-alumanyl complexes exhibit unique electronic properties, and would open up new reactivities including catalytic activities. To our best knowledge, the study of TM-alumanyl complexes remains in its infant stage and systematic theoretical understanding of the reactivity of TM-alumanyls remains unavailable. Therefore, in this proposed research, we intend to perform density functional theory (DFT) calculations to systematically explore the reaction mechanisms involving various alumanyl anions and their transition-metal complexes. We hope that this research will serve as a reference of experimental studies on the development and improvement of targeted organic syntheses. 傳統上，金屬配合物中陰離子配體上的負電荷通常位於電負性原子上。最近，許多鋁基陰離子及其過渡金屬配合物，其負電荷位於正電性鋁原子上。這些新化學物種對小分子的活化表現出異常的反應性。我們目前的知識無法很好地理解這些反應性，因此非常需要對其電子結構和反應性進行深入研究。 我們最近研究銅和金的鋁基配合物對二氧化碳的反應性，闡明鋁基陰離子在反應中的作用，這個項目建立於此理論研究之上。此外，我們最近還有幸受邀參加一個合作課題， 研究在溴（二苯基）甲烷存在下，鈧鋁配合物與苯的實驗反應的機理。在過去的5年中，我們見證了人們對鋁基陰離子及其過渡金屬配合物研究的巨大進展。人們認識到，這些新化學物種表現出獨特的電子性質和催化活性，但對它們的理論研究仍處於起步階段。因此，本課題擬進行密度泛函理論（DFT）計算，系統地探索有關各種鋁基陰離子及其過渡金屬配合物的反應機理。希望本研究能為靶向有機合成物開發和改進實驗研究提供理論參考。

16301923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16301923.value: 腸道微生物在馬兜鈴酸腎炎中的角色和風險緩解策略研究

16301923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16301923.value: Exposure to aristolochic acid (AA) has been associated with the development of aristolochic acid nephropathy (AAN) and Balkan endemic nephropathy (BEN) and affects over 100,000,000 people globally. AAN and BEN are kidney diseases that share similar clinical and morphological characteristics, but originate from consumption of AA-containing herbal medicines and prolonged exposure through AA-contaminated food and water, respectively. In 2022, the World Health Organization called for global action to prevent AA-associated cancers. Accumulating evidence suggests that the disruption of the gut microbiome (GM) can contribute significantly to disease development, thereby implicating GM’s role in AA toxicity. However, the functional role of GM in AA toxicity remains unexplored despite decades of research in AA nephrotoxicity and carcinogenicity. Here we test the hypothesis that interactions between AA and GM influence AA toxicity. Building on preliminary data, we will test this hypothesis in four specific aims that characterize the functional role of the GM on AA metabolism and subsequent AA-DNA adduct formation. Our ultimate goal is to characterize the impact of AA exposure on GM structure and the role of gut microflora in mediating AA toxicity and development of AAN. GM species in human fecal extracts will be isolated by colony collection on agar plates and tested individually for the AA metabolism efficiency. Species that show AA metabolizing capability during in vitro incubation will be extracted for DNA and identified by sequencing techniques. The significance of this research project is that the previously unexplored AA–GM interactions can generate insights into the mechanism of AA toxicity and AAN/BEN development. Results will facilitate the development of GM-related therapeutic strategies, such as fecal transplantation, to reduce exposure and associated health risks. The proposed studies will apply integrated sequencing, mass spectrometry, and chemometric algorithms to the study of GM–AA interactions. Results will provide new knowledge and deeper understanding of the toxicological mechanism of AA exposure in consideration of GM’s complexity. Data from this study will provide the foundation for exploring potential AAN risk reduction, prevention, and therapeutic strategies based on the manipulation of GM in people exposed to AA. 馬兜鈴酸 （AA）暴露與馬兜鈴酸腎炎（AAN）和巴爾幹腎炎（BEN）的發展有關，影響著全球超過一億人。AAN和BEN是腎臟疾病，具有相似的臨床和形態學特徵，但分別源於攝入含有AA的中草藥和長期食用被AA污染的食物和飲用水。2022年，世界衛生組織呼籲全球採取行動以預防AA相關癌症。 越來越多的證據表明，腸道微生物（GM）的破壞對疾病的發展有顯著影響，因此表明GM在AA毒性中的作用。然而，儘管對 AA 的腎毒性和致癌性已存在數十年的研究，GM 在 AA 毒性中的功能作用仍有待探索。在此，我們將檢驗AA和GM之間的相互作用會影響AA的毒性這一假設。在初步數據的基礎上，我們將基於四個具體的目標來驗證這一假設，以表徵GM對AA代謝和隨後的AA-DNA加合物形成的功能作用。我們的最終目標是表徵AA暴露對GM結構的影響以及腸道微生物在調節AA毒性和AAN/BEN發展中的作用。人類大便提取物中的GM物種將通過在琼脂平板上的塗板被分離出來，並進行AA代謝效率的單獨測試。在體外孵育期間表現AA代謝能力的物種將被提取DNA並通過序列技術加以識別。該研究項目的意義在於揭示以前未探索過的AA-GM 相互作用，可以深入了解 AA 毒性和 AAN/BEN 發展的機制。研究結果將有助於開發基於GM的治療策略，例如粪便移植，以減少暴露及降低相關健康風險。本研究將應用集成測序、質譜分析和化學計量學算法研究GM-AA相互作用。我們的研究結果將為在複雜的GM中研究AA暴露的毒理學機制提供新知識和更深入的理解。這項研究的數據有望為探索AA暴露人群通過調節GM的策略來預防和治療AAN/BEN的方法奠定基礎。

16302023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302023.value: 用磁隧穿電導譜表徵過渡金屬二硫化物范德華扭曲雙層體系的電子結構

16302023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302023.value: The great success in twisted graphene systems, in which graphene is a monolayer of carbon atoms, has proved twisting is an effective way to tailor the electronic band structures incontrovertibly and further triggered research passion in twisting of other two-dimensional layered materials, such as transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs). TMDC monolayer is composed of three atomic layers of X-M-X, X is a chalcogen atomic layers of selenium or sulphur or tellurium and M is a metal layer of molybdenum or tungsten. The broken inversion symmetry and strong spin-orbit coupling in TMDCs make the twisted TMDCs van der Waals bilayer (vdWB) a treasure trove of exotic correlated states, even comparing to the twisted graphene system. In fact, numerous striking features have been reported in twisted TMDCs vdWB, such as the emergency of unconventional superconductivity and ferromagnetism. While most of research interest is mainly focused on the discovery of intriguing properties in twisted TMDCs vdWB with huge progresses being achieved, the effort in experimental probe electronic band structure evolution which is the basis for interpretation of these intriguing properties, remains scarce. In this project, we propose to investigate the evolution of electronic band structures in twisted TMDCs vdWB heterostructures experimentally using magneto tunneling spectroscopy and microscopic mapping techniques. We aim to gain physical insight into the deep correlation between the evolution of electronic band structures and remarkable physical properties in twisted TMDCs vdWB heterostructures. 扭曲石墨烯體系（其中石墨烯是單層碳原子）的巨大成功無可爭議地證明了扭曲是改變電子能帶結構的有效方法，並進一步激發了對其他二維層狀材料扭曲體系的研究熱情，例如過渡金屬二硫化物（TMDC）體系。 TMDC單層由X-M-X三個原子層組成，X是硒或硫或碲的硫族原子層，M是鉬或鎢的金屬層。 TMDC 中破缺的反演對稱性和強自旋軌道耦合使得扭曲 TMDC 范德華雙層體系 (vdWB) 成為研究各種獨特和新穎相關態的寶庫，甚至與扭曲石墨烯體系相比也是如此。事實上，扭曲TMDC vdWB 中已經報導了許多引人注目的特徵，例如非常規超導性和鐵磁性的出現。目前大多數研究興趣主要集中在扭曲TMDC vdWB中新奇特性的發現，並取得了巨大進展。然而現時為解釋這些特性基礎的扭曲 TMDC vdWB電子能帶結構的演化，而作出的直接的實驗探測方面的努力仍然很少。在這個研究項目中，我們建議使用磁隧穿電導譜和顯微測繪技術相結合通過實驗研究扭曲 TMDC vdWB 異質結構中電子能帶結構的演化。我們的目標是從物理角度深入了解電子能帶結構的演化與扭曲 TMDC vdWB 異質結構中獨特和新穎的物理特性之間的深層相關性。

16302123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302123.value: 對於二維自旋軌道耦合的開放量子系統中局域集膚效應的直接觀測

16302123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302123.value: Open quantum systems exhibit a variety of counter-intuitive phenomena that rarely occur in closed systems. The non-Hermitian skin effect, i.e. the accumulation of particles at the boundary of an open system, is one such phenomenon. In contrast to ideal crystals, in which the electronic structure follows quantum mechanical band theory, band theory breaks down in non-Hermitian open systems, resulting in the skin effect. Despite extensive theoretical progress on the skin effect in non-Hermitian systems, it has rarely been experimentally observed in quantum systems. Furthermore, the realization of skin effects in higher dimensions remains unexplored. In this proposed project, we will use controlled dissipation in a system containing ultracold atoms to investigate the non-Hermitian skin effect in engineered two-dimensional (2D) topological bands. Ultracold atoms are attracting growing interest in the study of non-Hermitian physics owing to their atomic Hamiltonians being fully controllable. We have made great progress during the past few years in realizing dissipative spin–orbit-coupled fermions in lattices and in bulk substrates. Based on these developments, we will realize a versatile 2D experimental platform to directly study and characterize the non-Hermitian skin effect using an in-situ local probe. This will enable us to resolve several open questions regarding how to generalize the conventional band theory to the non-Hermitian regime in higher dimensions. We will also expand our capability to explore the localized skin effect in non-trivial topologies. To this end, we will (1) implement a homogeneous two-dimensional lattice with non-Hermitian spin-orbit couplings; (2) identify the skin effect through the measurement of the energy spectrum in k-space; and (3) observe the non-Hermitian skin effect via edge-to-edge transport. This proposed project will advance our understanding of topological phases and, importantly, will also train students in experimental atomic physics, quantum optics, and quantum materials. This will contribute to the generation of a highly trained workforce, thereby strengthening the research capacity in Hong Kong in quantum science and technology. 開放量子系統表現出多種在封閉系統中很少發生的反直覺現象。非厄米集膚效應，即開放系統邊界處的粒子積累就是這樣一種現象。與電子結構遵循量子力學能帶理論的理想晶體形成鮮明對比，能帶理論在非厄米開放系統中不再適用從而導致集膚效應。儘管非厄米系統中的集膚效應在理論上取得了廣泛的進展，但在量子系統中卻很少通過實驗觀察到。此外，在更高維度上實現集膚效應仍有待探索。在這個提議的項目中，我們將在超冷原子的系統中使用受控耗散來研究二維拓撲帶中的非厄米集膚效應。 超冷原子由於其原子哈密頓量是完全可控的，因此在非厄米物理學研究中引起了越來越多的興趣。過去幾年，我們在晶格和塊體中實現耗散自旋軌道耦合費米子方面取得了巨大進展。基於這些進展，我們將實現一個多功能的二維實驗平台，使用原位局部探測直接研究和表徵非厄米集膚效應。這將使我們能夠解決有關如何將傳統能帶理論推廣到更高維度的非厄米體系的開放性問題。 我們還將擴展我們探索非平凡拓撲中局部集膚效應的能力。為此，我們將（1）實現具有非厄米自旋軌道耦合的均勻二維晶格；（2）通過測量動量空間能譜來識別集膚效應； （3） 通過邊界輸運觀察非厄米集膚效應。這個提議的項目將增進我們對拓撲相的理解，並且還將培訓學生從事原子物理、量子光學和量子材料實驗。這將有助於培養訓練有素的勞動力，從而加強香港在量子科學和技術方面的研究能力。

16302223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302223.value: 球面資料內插的本質非振盪（ENO）方案

16302223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302223.value: This project aims to develop accurate and robust interpolation methods for ordered data points on the unit sphere. We propose to develop a new interpolation method called Spherical Essentially Non-Oscillatory (SENO). Following the same philosophy as the Essentially Non-Oscillatory (ENO) interpolation method for ordered data points, we aim to construct a technique that can automatically determine a stencil that produces the least oscillations in the reconstruction. This ability is essential when the underlying function is insufficiently regular. One natural extension of SENO is a version that takes a linear combination of various interpolants to achieve higher-order accuracy. This concept follows the Weighted Essentially Non-Oscillatory (WENO) interpolation in the Cartesian space. To demonstrate the effectiveness of these interpolation schemes, we consider two crucial applications from geosciences and the motion modeling of rigid bodies. These two problems require the solution of ordinary and partial differential equations of functions of unit vectors. The first application investigates high-frequency surface wave propagation on the Earth. Looking only at the travel time solution, we can solve the associated nonlinear Hamilton-Jacobi equation, i.e., the so-called surface eikonal equation. We propose to consider the method of characteristics and develop an adaptive ray tracing method based on SENO or on the weighted version. This approach will lead to a numerically efficient technique for multiple arrivals. The project will also investigate how SENO improves the accuracy of the advection equation on SO(3), the three-dimensional rotation group. Instead of applying the standard finite-difference method, which does not guarantee that the solution is an orthogonal matrix, we propose to construct a semi-Lagrangian strategy that relies on simple Runge-Kutta for the characteristics and SENO interpolation to update the solution at the next time step. The outcome of this project will be crucial to numerically solve the differential equations of spherical data and will have a significant impact on many science and engineering applications. These include computer graphics, aerospace, unmanned aerial vehicle trajectory planning, high-frequency surface wave propagation on the Earth, and motion modeling of filaments and fibers in complex fluids. 本項目旨在開發準確且強健的內插方法，用於單位球面上的有序數據點。我們提出了一種新的內插方法，稱為球面本質非振盪（SENO）。遵循有序數據點的本質非振盪（ENO）內插方法的相同理念，我們旨在構建一種技術，可以自動確定產生最少振盪的模板，以實現重建。當底層函數不足夠正則化時，這種能力是必不可少的。 SENO的一個自然擴展是它的一個版本，它採用各種內插器的線性組合以實現更高的精度。此概念遵循笛卡爾空間中加權本質非振盪（WENO）內插。 為了展示這些內插方案的有效性，我們考慮了兩個來自地球科學和剛體運動建模的關鍵應用。這兩個問題需要解決單位向量函數的常微分方程和偏微分方程的解。第一個應用研究地球上高頻表面波的傳播。僅關注行程時間解，我們可以解決相關的非線性哈密頓-雅可比方程，即所謂的表面測地線方程。我們建議考慮特徵值方法，並基於SENO或加權版本開發自適應射線跟踪方法。這種方法將導致一種數值高效的技術，可用於多個到達時間的情況。該項目還將研究SENO如何提高SO（3）上平移方程的準確度，SO（3）是三維旋轉群。我們建議不使用標準有限差分方法，因為該方法不能保證解是正交矩陣，而是構建一種半拉格朗日策略，依賴於特徵值的簡單龍格-庫塔和SENO內插來更新下一個時間步驟的解。 該項目的結果對於數值求解球面數據的微分方程非常重要，並將對許多科學和工程應用產生重大影響。這些應用包括計算機圖形學，航空航天，無人機軌跡規劃，地球上的高頻表面波傳播以及複雜流體中的線和纖維的運動建模。

16302323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302323.value: 在線方法與張量數據分析的統計理論

16302323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302323.value: Tensor learning is infamous for its high computational, storage, and memory costs. Online methods, which usually retain only a small set of the latest observations but discard old ones, are extremely suitable for the analysis of large tensorial data, especially for applications where data are revealed sequentially and a timely prediction is required. However, online methods for tensor learning are much under-explored, and the accompanying statistical theory is largely missing. The goal of this project is to develop online algorithms for low-rank tensor learning, covering both linear and generalized linear models. The PI will investigate: (1) the convergence performance of an online Riemannian gradient descent algorithm, the phenomenon of computational and statistical trade-off, and an adaptive strategy to achieve statistical optimality when the time horizon is unknown; (2) statistical inference for low-rank tensor learning based on online algorithms; (3) the regret performance of our proposed online generalized tensor learning algorithms and the respective regret lower bounds. 張量學習因其高計算、存儲和內存成本而惡名昭彰。線上方法，通常只保留一小部分最新的觀察結果但丟棄舊的觀察結果，極其適合於分析大型張量數據，尤其是在數據逐步呈現且需要及時預測的應用中。然而，對於張量學習的線上方法的研究遠未足夠，伴隨的統計理論也大都缺失。本項目的目標是開發低秩張量學習的線上算法，覆蓋線性和廣義線性模型。項目負責人將研究：(1) 線上黎曼梯度下降算法的收斂性能，計算與統計權衡的現象，以及在時間範疇未知時實現統計最優的自適應策略；(2) 基於線上算法的低秩張量學習的統計推斷；(3) 我們提出的線上廣義張量學習算法的懊悔性能以及相應的懊悔下限。

16302423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302423.value: 基于深度生成型模型的统计物理采样算法

16302423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302423.value: 分析和理解多体系统的行为是物理、化学和材料等领域的一个长久不衰的话题。在高维情况下，多体系统的复杂性往往超出了大多数解析分析方法的能力。因此，数值模拟成为了研究高维多体系统的常用工具。为了获得准确的模拟结果，通常需要尽可能多地从系统中获取样本。因此，采样速度往往是许多数值模拟方法的主要瓶颈。相关的研究在一直不断得尝试提高采样速度，这些研究的结果可以在量子多体采样相关的蒙特卡洛算法和分子动力学相关的动力学模拟算法的发展中看到。然而，更快的采样方法仍然可以提高我们理解多体系统的能力。 在深度学习方法中，深度生成型模型引起了很多关注。生成型模型能以快速的方式生成高质量的数据。它们的用途包括生成高精度图像和逼真的人声。人们可以用描述性的句子生成一个不存在的照片，或者用合成的声音接听电话。深度生成型模型的生成能力也可以用来进行采样。这种生成型模型辅助的采样方法可以获得两类优势：作为一个生成型模型，它的采样速度快，质量高；作为一种采样方法，采样得到的样本将遵循所研究系统的物理规律。 在这个项目中，我们提出利用深度生成型模型的最新发展来促进多体物理的新采样方法。我们希望开发出在质量和速度方面更好的新采样方法。这些方法将加速物理、化学和材料领域的数值模拟。同时这项研究对于多体系统的分析和理解方面也具有潜力。通过研究符合物理规律的采样过程，我们还希望提出具有可理解行为的新型生成型模型，为相关行业和应用提供可解释的人工智能。

16302623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302623.value: 重新思考臭氧管理 - 修改 EKMA 圖以量化氮氧化物和揮發性有機化合物排放控制對整體健康及脫碳的影響

16302623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302623.value: Since the implementation of the clean air plan in 2013, ozone (O3) pollution has become prominent in China. Conventional guideline to address the O3 pollution issue relies on a deep cut in volatile organic compounds (VOCs) emission in a region deemed to be VOC-limited. This guideline is experiencing great challenges due to the widespread nature of VOCs emission sources. Compared to the VOCs, NOx emission control exhibits several different features. First, NOx emission control measures align closely with national decarbonization policies because stringent controls of combustion sources are expected to substantially reduce both carbon and NOx emissions. Second, as a common precursor of both O3 and particulate matter, the reduction in NOx emission would bring co-benefits on reducing concentrations of both pollutants. Third, a subsequent transition to the NOx-limited regime is helpful for O3 attainment in the long run. From a health protection perspective, which is the key objective of pollution controls, health burden caused by the increasing O3 can be offset by health benefits brought by the decreasing nitrogen dioxide (NO2). In this new era of achieving carbon neutrality, the proposed study rethinks the ozone management guideline and aims to explore the overall health effects of NOx and VOCs emission controls. The empirical kinetics modeling approach (EKMA) diagram has been widely used to examine the dependence of O3 concentration on VOCs and NOx emissions. The proposed study will focus on changing the assessment paradigm of O3 pollution control from using concentrations to using health risks. To accomplish risk evaluation, time-series analyses will be performed based on long-term local health data to estimate the risk coefficients of different air pollutants. These risk coefficients, along with the Air Quality Health Index model in Hong Kong, will be used to evaluate the overall health risk of pollution mixtures (e.g., from decreasing NO2 and increasing O3). Based on the O3 EKMA diagrams, we will develop health risk EKMA diagrams to explore the dependence of the health risks of pollution mixtures on variations in pollutant emissions. Spatiotemporal variations in the sensitivity of health risks toward emission variations in Hong Kong and the Greater Bay Area of China will be analyzed. The health risk EKMA diagrams will then be applied to explore the net health effect of pollution variations toward carbon neutrality by 2060. The project’s deliverables will provide positive incentives for policy makers to improve air pollution control and climate change mitigation strategies. 自2013年實施清潔空氣計劃以來，臭氧（O3）污染問題突出。 解決 O3 污染問題的傳統指南依賴於在被視為 VOC 限制的地區大幅削減揮發性有機化合物 (VOC) 排放。 由於VOCs排放源的廣泛性，傳統指南正面臨著巨大的挑戰。 與VOCs相比，NOx排放控製表現出幾個不同的特點。 首先，氮氧化物排放控制措施與國家脫碳政策緊密結合，因為嚴格控制燃燒源預計將大幅減少碳和氮氧化物排放。 其次，作為 O3 和顆粒物的共同前體，NOx 排放的減少將為降低這兩種污染物的濃度帶來協同效益。 第三，從長遠來看，隨後過渡到氮氧化物限制制度有助於實現 O3。從污染控制的關鍵目標——健康保護的角度來看，O3增加帶來的健康負擔可以通過二氧化氮(NO2)減少帶來的健康益處來抵消。在實現碳中和的新時代，我們提出研究重新思考臭氧管理指南，旨在探討氮氧化物和揮發性有機化合物排放控制對整體健康的影響。 經驗動力學建模方法 (EKMA) 圖已廣泛用於檢查 O3 濃度對 VOC 和 NOx 排放的依賴性。 我們提出的研究將側重於改變 O3 污染控制的評估範式，從使用濃度到使用健康風險。 為了完成風險評估，將根據當地長期健康數據進行時間序列分析，估算不同空氣污染物的風險係數。 這些風險係數以及香港的空氣質量健康指數模型將用於評估污染混合物的整體健康風險（例如，NO2 減少和 O3 增加）。 基於「臭氧EKMA圖」，我們將開發「健康風險EKMA圖」，以探討污染混合物的健康風險對污染物排放變化的依賴性。 我們將分析香港和中國大灣區健康風險對排放變化的敏感性的時空變化。 然後，健康風險EKMA 圖將用於探索到2060 年實現碳中和的污染變化對健康的淨影響。該項目的成果將為政策制定者提供積極的激勵，以改善空氣污染控制和氣候變化緩解策略。

16302723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302723.value: 從水凝膠到彈性體：一種用於長期無線心電圖監測的皮膚黏附生物電子貼片

16302723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302723.value: Commercially available Electrocardiogram (ECG) devices are inadequate for use in long-term monitoring owing to their bulkiness and the necessity for external metal wires and the skin-contact medical tape that may cause patient discomfort, such as itching. Moreover, motion artifacts and impedance caused by unstable skin contact can lower ECG signal quality, potentially leading to misdiagnosis. Thus, to benefit asymptomatic patients (e.g., silent ischemia) or high-risk individuals (e.g., hypertension) who may require long-time ambulatory monitoring, it is crucial to develop skin-adherent wearable ECG sensors that form safe and conformal contact with dry or wet (e.g., sweaty) skin under dynamic conditions while acquiring stable signals. My laboratory has recently developed a single-lead patch with a novel scalable design that is being expanded to wearable multi-lead ECG bioelectronic patches. Our prototypical patch has a three-bridge elastomeric structure that ensures stable conductance and adhesion during body movement. Although the catechol-based polydopamine-polyacrylamide hydrogel adhesive in the patch adheres to wet and dry surfaces, its adhesion strength limits its use only to patients in a resting state. We have since improved this hydrogel such that the modified hydrogel displays strong and selective wet skin adhesion and can be used to record ECG signals in a patient moving and/or sweating. However, the intrinsic limitations of this hydrogel arise from its safety concern due to the polymerization synthesis through toxic monomers and its incorporation of oxidation-prone catechol groups compromising long-term stability, thus hindering the applicability for ambulatory monitoring. Accordingly, the proposed project will develop a biocompatible elastomer-based adhesive and conductive interface that can be integrated into the 12-lead ECG patch. The elastomer adhesive would exhibit strong adhesion under dynamic skin conditions (dry, wet, or sweaty). Leveraging the intrinsic biocompatibility of the elastomer, we will demonstrate a catechol-free strategy to engineer and functionalize the elastomeric surfaces in direct contact with the skin to enable strong covalent bonding for robust adhesion without irritation or allergic symptom. This adhesive will be further impregnated with soft and non-toxic liquid metal particles to induce electrical conductivity and thereby achieve skin-electrode impedance comparable with that of commercial electrodes. Finally, the adhesive will be integrated with our wearable patch and the signal quality and adhesion stability of the resulting ECG will be evaluated in volunteers with an emphasis on characterizing its performance during physical activity. The project will provide value to the community and improve the quality of life for cardiac patients and regular individuals. 目前，市售心電圖（ECG）裝置較為笨重，需要外接金屬線，且貼皮醫用膠帶或導致患者不適（如瘙癢），因此不適用於長期監測。此外，不穩定的皮膚接觸引起的動態干擾和阻抗波動會影响ECG信號質量，進而可能導致誤診。因此，對於需要長期流動監測的無症狀患者（例如，無症狀心肌缺血）或高風險個體（例如，高血壓）來說，開發可穿戴的心電圖儀，能安全和緊密地與乾燥或濕潤（例如，出汗）的皮膚接觸，並能在動態條件下獲取穩定信號，至關重要。 本實驗室最近開發了一種創新型可擴展的單導聯貼片，並將其擴展為可穿戴多導聯ECG生物電子貼片。我們的原型貼片具有三橋彈性體結構，可確保身體運動時器件的穩定導電性和附著力。儘管此類貼片使用基於鄰二苯酚基團的聚多巴胺-聚丙烯酰胺水凝膠黏著劑，使其可以黏附到濕潤和乾燥的皮膚表面，但黏著強度限制了其只適用於靜息狀態的患者。此後，我們改良了這種水凝膠，使其展現出選擇性的強濕皮黏附力，並可用於記錄移動和/或出汗患者的ECG信號。然而，由於有毒單體的聚合會引起安全問題，以及易氧化的鄰二苯酚基團對長期穩定性的影響，限制了這種水凝膠於動態監測的應用。 因此，本項目將開發一種可以整合到12導線ECG貼片上的生物相容彈性體基黏性導電界面。該彈性體黏著劑將在動態皮膚條件（乾燥、濕潤或出汗）下展示出強大的附著力。我們將利用彈性體的內在生物相容性，制定不含鄰二苯酚的合成策略，來改进彈性體與皮膚界面，實現強共價鍵結合，從而達到強附著力且對皮膚無刺激和無過敏症狀。這種黏著劑將進一步包埋柔性無毒的液態金屬粒子，以提高電導率，從而實現與商用電極相當的皮膚-電極阻抗。最後，該黏著劑將與我們的可穿戴貼片整合，並評估最終ECG的信號質量和附著穩定性，著重強調在身體活動期間的表現。該項目將有益於社會發展，改善心臟病患者和一般人群的生活質量。

16302823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16302823.value: 利用深度生成模型整合單細胞和空間轉錄組數據的統一框架

16302823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16302823.value: 空間轉錄組學 (ST) 技術的迅速出現為探索特定器官或組織的結構提供了前所未有的機會。 廣泛使用的 ST 技術基於下一代測序（基於序列的方法）或螢光原位雜交（基於圖像的方法）。 然而，它們還遠非完美。 一方面，基於 seq 的方法（例如 10X Visium）可以表徵每個位置的整個轉錄組，但這樣的位置包含多個細胞。 因此，基於 seq 的方法無法實現單細胞分辨率，限制了它們檢測細胞通信的能力。 另一方面，基於圖像的方法實現了單細胞分辨率，但只能捕獲數十到數百個基因的表達水平。 這種對轉錄組的不完整測量阻礙了使用基於圖像的 ST 技術的研究。 幸運的是，單細胞 RNA 測序 (scRNA-seq) 可以表徵不同細胞類型的整個轉錄組。 非常需要能夠有效整合 scRNA-seq 和 ST 數據以結合其互補信息的統計方法。 在本研究中，我們提出了一個利用深度生成模型整合 scRNA-seq 和 ST 數據的統一框架。 我們的目標是在單細胞分辨率下表徵整個轉錄組的空間模式。 在我們的試點研究中，我們開發了一種名為 SpatialScope 的統計方法來整合 scRNA-seq 和基於 seq 的 ST 數據。 與現有的細胞類型反卷積方法相比，SpatialScope 可以以單細胞分辨率捕獲整個轉錄組的空間分布。 儘管一些基於比對的方法也可以實現單細胞分辨率，但我們的試點研究結果表明，SpatialScope 在細胞類型識別和單個細胞基因表達水平表徵方面可以大大優於這些方法。 因此，SpatialScope 通過提供單細胞分辨率的空間分辨信息來檢測細胞通信。 為了擴展這一研究方向，我們建議擴展 SpatialScope，以從基於圖像的 ST 方法推斷未測量的基因表達。 基於圖像的 ST 數據的完整轉錄組可以極大地促進下游分析，例如差異表達基因的檢測。

16303123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303123.value: 转角摩尔超晶格中关联效应导致的电极化实验研究

16303123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
16303123.value: Prof Lin, Nian Prof Liu, Junwei

16303123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303123.value: Artificially stacking atomically thin materials with small twist angles or small lattice mismatches produces moiré superlattices (special interface structures generated by the interference of two periodic crystal lattices) with reshaped low-energy electronic states and electronic properties, which can generate new flat bands and exotic quantum phenomena. Recently, a new type of ferroelectricity has been engineered by stacking layered van der Waals (vdW) materials, although these materials are not ferroelectric in their bulk forms. The emergence of ferroelectric behaviors in twisted vdW semiconducting transition metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs), for example, arises from the formation of two types of locally R-stacking domains with opposite spontaneous electric polarization coexisting in one moiré unit cell. This type of electric polarization is locked by the special local atomic registries generated by the structurally relaxed parallel stacking geometry and not expected in antiparallel stacking TMDC moiré superlattices. However, in our recent experimental study, we discovered an abnormal electric polarization signature occurring in the half-filled insulating states in WSe2 antiparallel stacking moiré superlattices as probed by electronic transport measurements at cryogenic temperatures. We observed the following three abnormal features: electric-field-dependent half-filled insulating states, robust resistance hysteresis loops near the insulating states, and expandable/switchable local atomic registries that host moiré low-energy electronic states. We believe that this abnormal electric polarization is highly relevant to the moiré flat bands and strong correlation effects in WSe2 antiparallel stacking moiré superlattices. Subsequently, we will systematically investigate the low-temperature transport behaviors and interaction-induced electric polarization in different moiré interface structures to understand how inter-layer and intra-layer Coulomb interactions induce electric polarization in antiparallel stacking moiré superlattices. We will extend our research to various moiré systems and explore their structurally relaxed interface geometries, domain structures, correlated insulating states, and electric polarization behaviors. This project will provide critical knowledge and technical information needed to precisely control twisted moiré structures and modulate their electronic properties. Better understanding the underlying mechanisms of the unconventional electric polarization will have implications for two-dimensional device design and other technological applications. 人工叠加具有小扭角或小晶格错配的薄晶体材料，可以产生具有重塑的低能电子态和电子性质的摩尔超晶格同时也可以产生新的平带和奇异量子现象。最近，一种新型的铁电性材料已经通过堆叠层状范德瓦尔斯(vdW)材料被设计出来，尽管这些材料在它们的块状形式下不是铁电性性质。例如，在扭曲的vdW半导体过渡金属二硫族化合物(TMDCs)中，铁电行为的出现是由两种类型的局部R堆积畴的形成引起的，它们具有相反的自发电极化，共存于一个摩尔单元胞中。这种类型的电极化是由结构松弛的平行堆叠几何结构产生的特殊局部原子注册所锁定的，而不是在反平行堆叠的TMDC莫尔条纹超晶格中所期望的。然而，在我们最近的实验研究中，我们发现在低温下的电子输运测量中，在WSe2反平行堆叠摩尔超晶格的半填充绝缘状态中出现了异常的电极化特征。我们观察到以下三个异常特征: 电场依赖的半填充绝缘状态，绝缘状态附近的鲁棒电阻磁滞回线，以及可扩展/可切换的局部原子排列区，这些区承载着摩尔低能电子态。我们认为这种异常的电极化与WSe2反平行堆叠莫尔维尔超晶格中的莫尔维尔平带和强相关效应密切相关。我们将系统地研究不同莫尔条纹界面结构中的低温输运行为和相互作用诱导的电极化，以了解层间和层内库仑相互作用如何诱导反平行堆叠莫尔条纹超晶格中的电极化。我们将把我们的研究扩展到各种摩尔系统，并探索它们的结构松弛界面几何形状，域结构，相关绝缘状态和电极化行为。该项目将提供精确控制扭曲波纹结构和调制其电子特性所需的关键知识和技术信息，并更好地理解非常规电极化的潜在机制将对二维器件设计和其他技术应用产生影响。

16303523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16303523.value: 能量前沿上的Higgs玻色子的精确测量

16303523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16303523.value: 大型强子对撞机（LHC）是目前世界上最强力的粒子加速器。它的第三轮运行已在2022春季开始。这轮新的运行将会持续两到三年。本轮运行的目的在于将自从2011年LHC开始运行以来收集的质子-质子对撞数据量加倍。该数据集将被用于对当前的描述基本粒子及其相互作用的标准模型（SM）框架下没有预测的新的效应的搜寻。对于超越标准模型（BSM）的新物理的需求来自对暗物质的观测，宇宙中重子相对于反重子的主导，以及其他目前没有SM框架下有令人满意的解释的现象。 出于维护和设备升级的需要，LHC的运行在2019年秋季到2022年春季期间暂停。这段技术上的暂停期间被用于对目前积累的数据的分析。时至今日仍未有对BSM物理的显著证据的报告，故而新物理理论的粒子质量的下界被极大提升。目前一些重要的SM参数的精确测量已经完成。实验测量结果和标准模型预期的高度符合表示BSM物理应在本代加速器无法达到的更高的能标。基于对于计划中的已有的50%的数据集的分析，在LHC的运行周期中不太可能有对新粒子的直接观测。通往新物理发现的主要途径应为寻找SM中能很好预测的参数的在精确测量上的偏移。在这个途径上，未来几年中对现有数据集的扩张可能起到关键性作用。高光度LHC（HL-LHC）及相关项目提供的进一步的数据集扩张将会极大提升发现新物理的机会。 这个项目是此前GRF资助的对Higgs玻色子与标准模型中的费米子及规范玻色子的相互作用中的BSM物理的早期测量项目的延伸。香港小组通过在LHC的ATLAS实验中重建的Higgs玻色子衰变到Z玻色子对进而衰变到两对轻子开展了这些项目。这个衰变通道的优势在于可能完全重建末态，从而能够精确测量其中的Higgs耦合结构。最近观测到的W质量在测量上的偏移，测量和数据分析方法的改进，和灵敏的HL-LHC及相关项目如大型强子电子对撞机（LHeC）都提升了对LHC和/或HL-LHC中这个通道上BSM观测的期待。 作为相关研究的专家，香港小组期待在未来三年通过对LHC新收集的数据集的探索，改进当前测量的方法，以及对LHeC和HL-LHC的观测潜力的估计，大幅度提升这些测量的精确度。所有上文提到的方向的研究均已开始，并且HKUST的ATLAS小组当前正发挥首要作用。该组也期望对ATLAS探测器的运行，维护和升级方面提供主要的技术贡献。

16304023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16304023.value: 螺蕨酯類型聚酮化螺烯內酯A和B的全合成研究

16304023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304023.value: The central theme of this proposed study is to develop a new and efficient synthetic route for the chemical synthesis of potential anticancer drugs named spirohexenolides. Spirohexenolides were isolated in 2009 from strains of Streptomyces platensis by USA chemist Burkart and co-workers. They found that spirohexenolides exhibited a unique activity towards cancer cell line NCI-60 with novel mode of action, which later was revealed to target the human macrophage migration inhibitory factor (hMIF). Further preclinical evaluation of these natural products was hampered by the natural scarcity and their synthetic efforts did not lead to the completion of chemical synthesis of these natural products. Attracted by the potential as anticancer lead drugs, we propose a new synthetic strategy to address the problem of chemical synthesis. Careful structural examination (X-ray) suggests that the triene conjugation with the macrocycle is bent (non-planar), which would present extraordinary challenge for the construction of macrocycle or triene conjugation. To solve synthetic challenge, we propose 1) computational study of the bent triene conjugation within the macrocycle, 2) model studies of the unprecedented spirotetronate linked to pyranylidene via a double bond, and 3) dehydration as the last step to overcome the unfavorable formation of the bent triene conjugation within the macrocycle. Our preliminary results support our new synthetic strategy and a new enantioselective route has been developed for the synthesis of spirotetronate. Our proposed study provides a new strategy to address the unmet structural challenges from natural products and will lay a groundwork for chemical synthesis of analogs and further bioactivity evaluation. 這項擬議研究的中心主題是開發一種新的高效合成路線，用於化學合成潛在的抗癌藥物，稱為螺環氧烯內酯。2009年，美國化學家Burkart及其同事從鈍頂鏈黴菌株中分離出螺氧烯內酯。他們發現螺氧烯內酯對癌細胞系NCI-60表現出獨特的活性，具有新穎的作用方式，後來發現靶向人巨噬細胞遷移抑制因數（hMIF）。這些天然產物的進一步臨床前評估受到自然稀缺的阻礙，它們的合成努力並沒有完成這些天然產物的化學合成。被抗癌先導藥物的潛力所吸引，我們提出了一種新的合成策略來解決化學合成問題。仔細的結構檢查（X射線）表明，三烯共軛與大環是彎曲的（非平面的），這將給大環或三烯共軛的構建帶來非凡的挑戰。為了解決合成挑戰，我們提出了1）大環內彎曲三烯共軛的計算研究，2）通過雙鍵與吡亞基鍵連接的前所未有的螺烯酸鹽的模型研究，以及3）脫水作為克服大環內彎曲三烯共軛不利形成的最後一步。我們的初步結果支持我們的新合成策略，並且已經開發了用於合成螺酮的新對映選擇性路線。我們提出的研究提供了一種新的策略，以解決天然產物未滿足的結構挑戰，並將為類似物的化學合成和進一步的生物活性評估奠定基礎。

16304923.value: Hecke范畴和特征层范畴的Serre对偶

16304923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16304923.value: 对偶在数学中无处不在且功能强大，因为它们有助于将看似不相关的现象和对象联系起来。在代数几何中，Serre和Verdier对偶理论发挥着基础性作用。最近，Gorsky、Hogancamp、Mellit和Nakagane在A型有限Hecke范畴中发现了一种类似于Serre和Verdier对偶的新对偶。由于有限Hecke范畴在几何表示论和范畴化扭结不变量中起着核心作用，他们的结果在这两个学科中有着有趣的影响。这个项目计划利用几何方法将这种对偶扩展到A型之外，以及使用到抛物诱导的相对情形。此外，这个项目计划在特征层的（导出）范畴上探索类似的对偶，使其与有限Hecke范畴上的对偶相容。对这种对偶的理解将有助于深入了解特征层的（导出）范畴上的卷积幺半结构。

16305223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305223.value: 用於高能量密度可充鋰金屬電池碳酸鹽電解質添加劑

16305223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305223.value: 鋰離子電池已廣泛應用於便攜式電子設備、電動汽車和能量存儲等領域。目前鋰離子電池的能量密度主要受限於缺乏高容量正極材料、以石墨而非鋰金屬作為負極、以及缺乏穩定的電解質。採用層狀正極材料（例如鈷酸鋰或富鎳鎳鈷錳酸鋰）和石墨負極的鋰離子電池採用4.3 V的截止電壓以平衡能量密度和循環壽命。將截止電壓提高到4.6 V並將石墨替換為鋰金屬是進一步增加鋰離子電池能量密度的兩種可能方法。然而，目前不存在可以在這種條件下工作的電解質。該項目旨在通過組合有機矽組分和硝酸鋰開發適用於碳酸鹽電解質的合適添加劑組合。優化的添加劑組合有望幫助創建更穩定的正極-電解質膜和鋰金屬上的固體電解質膜，減少正極分解和負極上鋰枝晶的形成。因此，鋰離子電池的循環壽命將得到顯著改善。優化的電池將在3 V和4.6 V之間充放電1000次後實現前所未有的80％容量保留率。該項目的結果將對下一代適用於採用高電壓和鋰金屬負極的鋰離子電池的電解質設計產生重大影響。

16305523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305523.value: 芳香烴的光催化選擇性碳-碳鍵斷裂和官能化

16305523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305523.value: 本研究旨在開發一系列方法，選擇性地斷裂和官能化惰性芳香烴中的碳-碳鍵。合成有機化學是構建結構複雜的分子的科學，對於藥物的發現至關重要。在這一研究領域中，大部分的努力都集中在合成碳-碳鍵，這是將生物活性份子以獨特的三維結構聯接在一起的一個關鍵技術。與之相反的是碳-碳鍵的斷裂和官能化。與從小到大的常規分子合成策略不同的是，從易得的結構複雜的大分子（例如天然產物）出發，進行斷裂和重構化學鍵通常更加高效和經濟實用。 在化學鍵的斷裂研究中，碳-雜原子鍵由於其鍵能較弱且容易與其他化學鍵區分而成為主要研究對象。相比之下，碳-碳鍵的選擇性斷裂，由於其在有機分子中大量存在並具有高穩定性，成為一個艱巨的挑戰。在大多數文獻報告中，通常只有高張力或者含有活化基團的分子可以被選擇性斷裂。這些底物，尤其是環張力化合物，如環丙烷和環丁烷，為碳-碳鍵的斷裂提供了巨大的驅動力。然而，非張力碳-碳鍵的斷裂則很難實現。在這個項目中，我們的目標是發展一種普適的方法，來實現既沒有張力，也不含有活化基團的芳香烴類化合物的碳-碳鍵斷裂。 我們的主要策略是光催化自由基化學。與傳統的雙電子化學形成鮮明對照的是，光催化利用環境友好的可見光（LED燈）來產生高能的自由基物種，進而促進碳-碳鍵的斷裂。本研究的重點是選擇性斷裂Csp3-Csp3鍵，這是最普遍存在且最難以斷裂的化學鍵。我們提出使用光催化劑觸發兩種互補的反應途徑：碳陽離子耦合電子轉移（CCCET）和三重單電子氧化（SEO）串聯，來實現不同分子中碳-碳鍵的斷裂。本研究的主要挑戰是如何控制幾個競爭反應途徑的反應方向，並調節這些過程中的電子流動。最近，我們成功實現了基於三重SEO級聯來斷裂簡單的烷基苯。同時，我們也在實驗上證實了經由碳陽離子耦合電子轉移（CCCET）直接斷裂碳-碳鍵的可行性。基於這些令人鼓舞的初步結果，我們相信我們的策略在碳氫化合物的碳-碳鍵斷裂中具有很大的潛力。 除了斷裂碳-碳鍵之外，本項目還將探索所產生的碎片的各種官能化反應。在碳-碳鍵斷裂後，自由基部分和陽離子片段均可以進行化學修飾，變成有價值的分子。該部分研究將幫助我們更深入地了解基本化學鍵的斷裂和相關開殼物種的官能化。我們期望該研究結果將在合成和催化領域具有廣泛應用，並為直接從易得的碳氫化合物出發，製備功能分子提供新的解決方案，並藥物化學和藥物開發中實現應用。

16305623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16305623.value: 開發追踪SARS-CoV-2 刺突蛋白突變的開放平台

16305623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16305623.value: 由於2型冠狀病毒(CoV-2)的高傳染力和快速變異能力，急性呼吸道症(SARS)疫情對全球公共衞生構成嚴重威脅。SARS-CoV-2基因組大小約為2.6 - 3.2萬個核鹼基，並以每年每個核苷酸10^{-3} 個替換的變異速率持續演化。信使核糖核酸(mRNA)疫苗利用SARS-CoV-2的刺突蛋白(S蛋白)作抗原目標為接種者提供免疫力，顯著地降低因感染SARS的住院率及死亡率。然而SARS-CoV-2變異所產生的新型變種使得mRNA疫苗的免疫效果正逐漸減退。因此預測新型變種病毒的變異成為十分迫切需要的任務。 海量的SARS-CoV-2序列數據是攻克此難關的一把獨特鑰匙。在這研究項目內，我們計劃研發以數據庫及分析模塊為核心的刺突蛋白變異追蹤平台，監察SARS-CoV-2刺突蛋白的演化軌跡。數據庫會收納變異蛋白的基因序列、結構和生化功能，用以支持表徵變異活動、預測近期新變異點等數據分析工作，歸納出的基因變異圖譜更可以有助對流行變種進行針對性分析。這套綜合分析平台將會成為預警SARS-CoV-2病毒新型變種不可或缺的工具，並會對公眾開放，為抗擊SARS-CoV-2疫情作貢獻。

16306623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16306623.value: 河口近海環境浮遊植物來源類腐殖質溶解有機物研究

16306623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306623.value: Phytoplankton-derived organic matter could result in the formation of humic-like fluorescent dissolved organic matter (FDOM), largely through microbial processing. As the majority of humic-like FDOM is biologically recalcitrant, it constitutes a crucial portion of the refractory dissolved organic carbon; this will significantly impact long-term carbon sequestration in the global ocean and, hence, the global carbon cycle. The production and microbial processing of phytoplankton-derived humic-like FDOM in estuaries and coastal oceans have been poorly studied, mainly due to the complexity of phytoplankton species diversity and of humic-like FDOM sources and composition. To bridge this knowledge gap, the proposed project will target the Pearl River Estuary (PRE) in the Greater Bay Area, one of the fastest developing areas in China over the past several decades. The Pearl River is the second largest freshwater river China. Increased nutrient loading due to economic development has caused environmental issues such as algal blooms. The PRE is thus an ideal setting to measure gradients of nutrient concentrations and microbial and phytoplankton community compositions, allowing us to examine the dynamics of phytoplankton-derived humic-like FDOM and associated factors. We will conduct both laboratory culture experiments and field investigations. By combining comprehensive techniques such as the stable carbon isotope analysis, three-dimensional fluorescence spectroscopy, molecular biomarkers, ultrahigh-resolution Fourier transform ion cyclotron mass spectrometry (FT-ICR MS), and molecular microbial ecology techniques, we will (i) investigate the optical components of dissolved organic matter (DOM) and particulate organic matter (POM) derived from different phytoplankton species (i.e., diatoms and dinoflagellates); (ii) characterize the molecular composition of POM and DOM obtained from laboratory cultures of major bloom-forming phytoplankton and field samples from central bloom-forming and non-bloom areas; and (iii) assess the corresponding microbial community compositions of laboratory cultures and field samples. The results also will be interpreted in terms of other physiochemical parameters to elucidate community differences in humic-like FDOM production and the microbial transformation of humic-like FDOM derived from phytoplankton. Collectively, the proposed project will provide an understanding of the production and transformation of DOM in coastal oceans, which is crucial for elucidating the carbon cycle. The projected increases in anthropogenic eutrophication and global warming will dramatically affect phytoplankton communities, such as by changing the dominant species, and thus the composition of DOM pool. Therefore, our proposed study will provide a scientific basis for predicting future patterns of carbon cycling in coastal oceans and exploring how to enhance long-term carbon sequestration in the ocean. 浮遊植物源有機物可能通過微生物轉化過程形成類腐殖質熒光溶解有機物（FDOM）。由於大部分類腐殖質FDOM難以被異養微生物降解，它構成了難降解性溶解有機碳（RDOC）的重要組成部分；這將對全球海洋的長期碳封存以及全球碳循環產生顯著影響。河口和近海環境中浮遊植物源類腐殖質FDOM的生成和微生物轉化過程研究一直比較匱乏，主要是由於浮遊植物物種多樣性和類腐殖質FDOM來源和組成的復雜性高。 為了填補這一知識空白，本研究項目將以中國發展最快的地區之一——大灣區的珠江口為研究靶區。珠江是中國第二大淡水河流。由於經濟發展導致的營養鹽負荷增加，引發了諸如藻類水華等環境問題。因此，珠江口是一個理想的研究場所，可以測量營養鹽濃度和微生物、浮遊植物群落組成的梯度，從而研究浮遊植物源類腐殖質FDOM及其相關因素的動態變化。我們將進行實驗室培養實驗和野外調查。通過結合穩定碳同位素分析、三維熒光光譜學、分子生物標誌物、超高分辨傅立葉變換離子回旋質譜（FT-ICR MS）和微生物分子生態學技術等綜合技術，我們將（i）研究不同浮遊植物物種（如矽藻和甲藻）來源的溶解有機物（DOM）和顆粒有機物（POM）的光學性質；（ii）錶徵主要引發水華的浮遊植物實驗室培養物和中心水華區域以及非水華區域的野外樣品中獲得的POM和DOM的分子組成；（iii）評估實驗室培養物和野外樣品的相應微生物群落組成。結果還將結合其他物理化學參數解釋類腐殖質FDOM產生的群落差異以及源自浮遊植物的類腐殖質FDOM的微生物轉化。 總的來說，本課題將深入了解河口近海DOM的生成和轉化過程，這對於闡明碳循環至關重要。預計人類引起的富營養化和全球變暖將顯著影響浮遊植物群落，例如改變優勢物種和DOM的組成。因此，我們的研究將為預測未來河口近海的碳循環模式提供科學依據，這對於增強碳匯和海洋長期封存至關重要。

16306723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16306723.value: 軟界面的自發浸潤及黏附動力學

16306723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16306723.value: The surface mechanics of many soft solids, such as polymeric gels, soft tissues, and living cells, plays critical roles in important physical and biological processes. Systematic control of wetting and adhesion at soft interfaces is of major importance to many engineering applications. In contrast with their stiff counterparts, soft solids exhibit outstanding extensibilities, enhanced elastocapillarity, and rich nonlinear responses to external stresses. Capturing these mechanical features quantitatively requires an understanding of how the local material parameters at soft interfaces can determine contact dynamics at large length scales. Previous works have investigated wetting and adhesion on a uniformly soft substrate and shown that the local surface properties of soft gels, including solid surface stress, interfacial adhesion energy, and network porosity, control their contact mechanics at different length scales. Classical principles of contact mechanics, such as the Young-Dupre law and the Johnson-Kendall-Roberts theory, require major revisions for soft solids by including solid capillarity. Relaxation dynamics at soft interfaces are complicated by the competition between viscoelasticity and poroelasticity. The importance of local surface properties suggests that spontaneous contact dynamics may be driven by spatially varying interfacial parameters, such as surface stress gradients. However, creating reliable surface stress gradients on soft solids has been experimentally challenging, as conventional surface chemistry methods greatly alter the mechanical features of soft interfaces and often lack enough spatial precision. Meanwhile, recently developed surface technologies, including the fabrication of surface patterns and liquid-infused interfaces, are technically intractable for ultra-soft materials. In addition, due to the significant viscoelastic dissipations from the bulk, Marangoni-like interfacial flows have been rarely observed on soft solid surfaces. To address these challenges, we propose to investigate how the surface stresses of soft gels can be spatially controlled by varying local crosslinking density, and how the resulting surface gradients affect soft wetting and adhesion dynamics. We will first study the spontaneous movements of nanobeads on gel surfaces driven by highly deformed contact ridges. The results are expected to clarify the surface stress differences between uncrosslinked polymer solutions and crosslinked gels. Based on the relationship between crosslinking degree and local surface properties, we further plan to design soft substrates with large-scale surface gradients to control liquid wetting dynamics. The expected outcomes will not only improve our current understanding of dissipation mechanisms involved in soft dynamic wetting but also inform the future engineering of soft functional materials. 軟質固體包括了高分子凝膠、軟組織、以及活性細胞等材料系統，其界面力學性質在關鍵的生物物理過程中起到了至關重要的作用。同時，對軟界面接觸力學性質的調控將有助於相關的工程應用研究。相較於傳統硬材料，軟物質固體具有良好的延展性、顯著的毛細-彈性效應、以及複雜的非線性響應特徵。為定量描述軟界面的力學性質，我們需要理解其局域界面參數對於大尺度上接觸動力學的影響。先前工作已研究了均勻軟界面上的浸潤和粘附過程的物理規律。軟凝膠的界面參數，包括表面應力、黏附能、以及多孔性，被證明能在不同尺度上有效地控制接觸響應。例如，經典接觸力學模型，如楊氏和JKR定理，需要對軟界面材料進行修正。因此，控制界面力學性能的空間分佈，例如設計表面應力梯度，將可能實現軟界面上的自發動態接觸響應。然而，實驗上通過梯度界面控制軟表面浸潤及黏附動力學具有挑戰性。傳統的表面化學方法會不僅改變軟材料界面力學性質也缺乏空間精確度。同時，新興表面技術，包括表面形貌加工和界面液體灌充等方法，難以應用於軟材料體系。因此，類馬拉戈尼界面流幾乎從未在軟物質固體表面被觀測到。在該工作中，我們計劃通過交聯密度的空間分佈控制軟凝膠的表面應力，以及研究界面梯度對於浸潤及黏附動力學性質的影響。首先，我們將研究凝膠界面的納米顆粒在高形變浸潤脊上的運動。預期結果將澄清交聯高分子網格和未交聯自由鏈直接的表面能差異。在此基礎上，我們將進一步設計大尺度界面梯度來控制液滴的動態浸潤。該研究結果不僅將增進我們對於軟凝膠界面耗散機制的理解，同時有助於設計功能性軟物質材料。

16307023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307023.value: 從線性樣本中恢復流形上的數據的可證明且高效的算法

16307023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307023.value: High-dimensional data recovery from linear samples is a problem that arises frequently in science and engineering. In many applications of practical interest and great importance, the underlying data is assumed to lie on a known low-dimensional manifold. This research project will investigate provable and efficient non-convex algorithms to utilize the low-dimensional manifold structure to recover the high-dimensional data from its few linear samples. We will simultaneously exploit the geometry of the manifold and the probability model of the linear sampling operator. We will explore different manifold geometries and identify the one that best fits the sampling operator and the linear samples to develop efficient algorithms. We will construct loss functions to fit the linear samples such that the resulting non-convex optimization works best with the geometry of the manifold. The theoretical recovery guarantee of the algorithms will also be investigated. 從線性樣本恢復高維度數據是一個在科學和工程中經常出現的問題。在許多具有重要意義的實際應用中，基礎數據常被假設為位於已知的低維流形上。本研究項目將探討利用低維流形結構從其少數的線性樣本中恢復高維度數據的可證明且高效的非凸優化算法。我們將同時利用流形的幾何結構和線性取樣算子的概率模型。我們將探索不同的流形幾何結構，並確定最適合取樣算子和線性樣本的流形，以開發高效的算法。我們將構建損失函數以適配線性樣本，使得所得到的非凸優化能夠最好地配合流形的幾何結構。我們也將研究演算法的理論恢復保證。

16307323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307323.value: 使用智能動力降尺度和允許對流解析的模擬研究熱帶氣旋在全球變暖下的變化

16307323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307323.value: Tropical cyclones (TCs) have substantial societal impacts in coastal regions where they make their landfall. Global warming can potentially alter TC characteristics in many ways, such as changing their spatial distributions, occurrence frequency, moving speed, and intensity. Quantifying TC sensitivities to climate change is challenging because global simulations and high resolutions are needed at the same time, making the computational cost unaffordable to individual researchers. The former is necessary for predicting large-scale circulation changes while resolving meso- to small-scale processes like convection and turbulence requires the latter. Studies by modeling centers have pushed the resolution of global climate simulations to 14 km in recent years, and significant advances have been achieved regarding TC responses to global warming. However, substantial uncertainties still exist regarding TC characteristics under climate change. Here we propose using a smart dynamical downscaling (SDD) approach to assess how intense tropical cyclones may respond to global warming. The SDD approach trains a deep learning (DL) model to predict surface variables, such as wind and precipitation, at unresolved scales (e.g., 1 km) based on coarse-resolution (e.g., 100 km) large-scale circulation data. Carefully trained, the DL model can be applied to global climate simulation data to help rank circulation patterns and identify those time slices that can produce intense tropical cyclones. Then kilometer-scale resolution, also known as the convection-permitting resolution, can be used for downscaling simulations of those selected time slices. In SDD, computational resources requirement becomes less demanding, but convection can be resolved confidently with sufficient resolutions. This project will apply the SDD approach to the climate simulations under the SSP5-8.5 warming scenario from 2020 to 2100. Many kilometer-scale resolution simulations of potential TC cases will be conducted, and the 20 most intense TCs making landfall in China's coastal regions for each 10-year subperiod will be kept for further analysis. We will evaluate how those severe TCs respond to global warming in terms of their spatial distribution, translation speed, maximum sustained wind, and precipitation. We will analyze the connections between those TC characteristics changes and other dynamical and physical processes, such as large-scale circulation patterns, surface enthalpy flux, and cloud-radiation feedback, aiming to provide a physical understanding of the relevant changes. Potential discrepancies between our predictions and previous studies will be quantified and discussed. 熱帶氣旋(TC)在其登陸的沿海地區產生重大社會影響。 全球變暖可能會以多種方式改變熱帶氣旋的特徵，例如改變其空間分佈、發生頻率、移動速度和強度。 量化TC對氣候變化的敏感性具有挑戰性，因為這同時需要全球模擬和高分辨率，使得單個研究人員無法承受計算成本。 前者對於預測大規模環流變化是必要的，而解決對流和湍流等中尺度過程則需要後者。 近年來，模擬中心的研究已將全球氣候模擬分辨率提升至14公里，熱帶氣旋對全球變暖的響應也取得了重大進展。 然而，氣候變化下的熱帶氣旋特徵仍存在很大的不確定性。我們將使用智能動態降尺度（SDD）方法來評估熱帶氣旋對全球變暖的反應強度。 SDD 方法訓練深度學習模型，以基於粗分辨率（例如 100 公里）大規模環流數據來預測未解析尺度（例如 1 公里）的表面變量，例如風和降水。 經過訓練，深度學習模型可以應用於全球氣候模擬數據，以幫助對環流模式進行排名並識別那些可以產生強烈熱帶氣旋的時間片段。 然後，千米級分辨率可用於對這些選定時間片進行縮小模擬。 在 SDD 中，計算資源要求變得不那麼苛刻，但可以通過足夠的分辨率自信地解決對流問題。 本項目將採用SDD方法進行2020年至2100年SSP5-8.5變暖情景下的氣候模擬，對潛在的熱帶氣旋病例進行多公里分辨率的模擬，並對登陸中國沿海的每10年中的20個最強烈的熱帶氣旋進行模擬。我們將從空間分佈、平移速度、最大持續風速和降水等方面評估這些嚴重熱帶氣旋對全球變暖的反應。 我們將分析這些熱帶氣旋特徵變化與其他動力和物理過程（例如大尺度環流模式、表面焓通量和雲輻射反饋）之間的聯繫，旨在提供對相關變化的物理理解。 我們的預測與之前的研究之間的潛在差異將被量化和討論。

16307423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307423.value: 珠江口及鄰近陸架環境容量與富營養化減輕的物理-生物地球化學耦合研究

16307423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307423.value: 環境容量是指水生系統在不損害生態系統健康和生態系統支持和服務的情況下容納人為營養輸入的能力。 每個水生系統都具有獨特且時空變化的環境容量，其本質上受到系統裏耦合的物理生物地球化學過程和外部驅動因素的影響。 影響環境容量的關鍵因素包括與流體動力學（物理學）、生物地球化學過程、人為干擾（例如水產養殖）和氣候條件相關的水停留時間。 水生系統環境容量的定量知識不僅對於理解和預測生態系統對自然和人類活動（例如過度養分輸入和氣候變化）的響應至關重要，而且對於設計水生系統的有效營養鹽管理和緩解策略也至關重要。 珠江口（PRE）及其鄰近的南海北部陸架代表了一個動態的河口-陸架海洋系統，受到多種物理和生物地球化學強迫以及強烈的人為壓力源。 近幾十年來，觀測揭示了PRE的強烈空間變異性和富營養化和缺氧惡化的趨勢，但缺乏對PRE環境容量及其趨勢的定量估計。 同樣未知的是不同物理和生物地球化學因素對容量的相對貢獻。 此類定量知識是了解和預測 PRE 將如何應對日益加劇的人類活動和氣候變化、設計科學合理的管理策略，減輕富營養化並改善 PRE 及其鄰近陸架的整體海洋環境健康必不可少。 本項目擬將利用現有的觀測和數值模擬開展物理-生物地球化學耦合調查，量化時空變化的環境容量及其潛在的生物物理驅動因素，並評估潛在的營養鹽分管理方案。 該項目的目標包括： O1) 量化環境容量的空間變異性及對PRE 及其對鄰近陸架中物理和生物地球化學因素的響應； O2) 評估環境容量在過去、現在和未來的人為和氣候強迫條件下如何演變，並研究這些條件如何影響生態系統動態； O3) 定量評估營養鹽管理和緩解策略，特別是利用牡蠣養殖來增加 PRE 及其鄰近陸架的環境容量和減少富營養化的潛力。 本項目將通過建立基於科學的耦合物理-生物地球化學和緩解策略的數值模擬系統，對 PRE 及其鄰近陸架的環境容量進行首次定量評估。 雖然這項工作是針對 PRE 的，但研究結果同樣適用與也與受強烈人類活動和氣候變化影響的其他河口和沿海陸架系統。

16307923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
16307923.value: 以貝葉斯思維重塑蛋白質組學中肽段鑑定的質譜匹配方法

16307923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
16307923.value: Proteomics, which aims at the high-throughput identification and quantification of all proteins in a biological system, is an increasingly powerful analytical approach in life science research. In the most common “shotgun proteomics” workflow, the presence of any given protein is inferred from experimental observations of their constituent peptides in the form of tandem mass (MS/MS) spectra, which record their fragmentation patterns. Therefore, at the very core of proteomics technology is the computational task of assigning an observed MS/MS spectrum to the originating peptide, which is an error-prone exercise due to our limited knowledge about the true extent of the proteome, our inability to predict peptide fragmentation accurately, as well as inevitable experimental noise. The current method of choice, sequence database searching, is an inefficient and memoryless process that makes no reference to the mountain of publicly available data. In contrast, spectral library searching, which involves comparing experimental MS/MS spectra to reference spectra of carefully compiled spectral libraries of peptides, is a natural mechanism to leverage prior data to improve the sensitivity and accuracy of peptide identification. Finding the correct spectral match among thousands of candidates in the library, and assigning a well-calibrated and interpretable measure of confidence to the spectral match, is the fundamental challenge for spectral library searching. This proposed research aims at addressing this challenge by recasting spectrum-spectrum matching as a Bayesian inference problem, thereby providing a statistically sound basis for combining evidence of individual peak matches. The proposed research will have the following objectives. First, we plan to develop and validate a new spectral library search engine based on a Bayesian similarity scoring scheme, which has several theoretical and practical advantages over existing methods. It computes the desired posterior probability directly, offers better discrimination between good and bad matches, and naturally accounts for the expected variability in peak intensities learned from past data. The feasibility of this approach has been verified in our preliminary investigation. Second, we propose to extend this spectral library search engine to accomplish open modification searching, enabling the discovery of unexpected post-translational modifications and sequence variants. Third, we will explore the possibility of exploiting correlations between fragment ion peaks to enhance our Bayesian scoring scheme for better accuracy and sensitivity. Finally, we will ensure the wide and sustainable impact of our work by integrating our new advances into a complete and user-friendly data analysis pipeline for use by the community. 蛋白質組學旨在高通量地鑑定和定量生物系統中的所有蛋白質，是生命科學研究中日趨有力的分析方法。在最常見的工作流中，任何給定蛋白質的存在都是從它們的組成肽段的串聯質譜中推斷出來的。因此，在蛋白質組學技術的核心是從觀察到的串聯質譜推斷肽段序列的計算方法。而由於我們對蛋白質組的真實範圍知之甚少，且無法準確預測肽段的碎裂，這是一個容易出錯的步驟。 目前首選的方法——序列數據庫搜索，是一種低效且無記憶的過程，因其不參考可用數據的大量信息。相比之下，質譜庫搜索涉及將實驗串聯質譜與精心編制的肽段質譜庫中的參考質譜進行比較，是一種利用先前數據提高肽段鑑定的靈敏度和準確性的機制。在庫中找到正確的質譜匹配，並為質譜匹配的可信性度量，是質譜庫搜索的根本挑戰。本研究旨在將質譜匹配重新構建為貝葉斯推斷問題，從單峰匹配的證據集合計算質譜匹配的可信性，提供統計上可靠的基礎。 本研究的目標如下。首先，我們計劃開發和驗證基於貝葉斯相似性評分方案的新型光譜庫搜索引擎，該方案具有現有方法所沒有的幾個理論和實踐優勢。它可以直接計算所需的後驗概率，提供更好的區分好和壞的匹配，並自然地考慮了從過去數據中學習到的峰強度的預期變異性。這種方法的可行性已在我們的初步調查中得到驗證。其次，我們提出將這個質譜庫搜索引擎擴展到完成開放修飾搜索，實現意外的翻譯後修飾和序列變異的發現。第三，我們將探索利用峰之間的相關性，以增強我們的貝葉斯評分方案，以獲得更好的準確性和靈敏度。最後，我們將通過將我們的新搜索引擎整合到完整且方便的數據分析流程中，以確保我們的工作具有廣泛和可持續的影響。
