17304323.value: 通過金屬蛋白質組學方法揭示鉍化合物對Burkholderia cepacia 抗菌活性的機制

17304323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304323.value: 金屬化合物目前在臨床上用於診斷和治療目的, 例如，鉑金抗癌藥、金基抗風濕藥（金諾芬）以及鉍以抗潰瘍藥物為主。近年來，抗菌藥物耐藥性的出現和蔓延（AMR）對全球公共健康構成重大威脅，金屬的再利用解決抗菌素耐藥性危機受到越來越多的關注，並正在積極研究。 鉍與醫學聯繫已有兩個多世紀，用於治療 各種疾病；特別是胃腸道疾病，以及治療幽門螺桿菌（H. pylori）引起的感染。由於抗生素的日益普及，幽門螺桿菌感染難以治愈 。目前臨床上有三種鉍類藥物，即鉍劑。 次水楊酸鹽 (Pepto-Bismol)、次檸檬酸鉍 (CBS、De-Nol) 和雷尼替丁 檸檬酸鉍（Pylorid）。鉍藥物與抗生素組合，例如鉍基四元組 療法是臨床上公認的根除幽門螺桿菌包括抗生素耐藥菌株的一線療法。不过鉍治療幽門螺桿菌非理性設計，目前尚不清楚鉍化合物是否具有幽門螺桿菌以外的抗菌活性，此類研究將進一步拓寬鉍的藥用範圍。鑑於鉍類藥物對宿主的毒性較低，擴大鉍的抗菌譜是一項頗具吸引力的策略。 事實上，鉍劑藥物與β-內酰胺類抗生素合用最近已被重新用於治療 MBL 陽性細菌 感染。 我們初步数据表明鉍化合物對Burkholderia cepacia complex (Bcc) 表現出優異的抗菌活性，與某些抗生素相當。Bcc是一種人類病原體， 常導致免疫功能低下者患上肺炎。這一初步發現為擬議的方案奠定了堅實的基礎。基於這一令人興奮的發現，我們打算尋找更有效的鉍 化合物，並評估其與抗生素組合的功效，然後揭曉 化合物的分子作用機制。具體來說，我們將合成更多 鉍化合物針對Bcc進行進一步篩選。我們還將研究鉍化合物與抗生素在體外和細胞感染模型中的協同作用 ，評估鉍劑與抗生素聯合治療 Bcc 感染的潛力。 隨後，我們將用金屬蛋白質組學方法研究鉍化合物的分子作用機制，系統地追踪鉍結合蛋白，然後用生物信息學对Bi(III) 結合蛋白進行分類 ，並驗證受其影響的關鍵蛋白質靶點或用分子生物學或生物物理的方法进一步 驗證。 擬議項目將增強我們對 Bi(III) 化合物對抗幽門螺桿菌以外細菌的分子的作用機制， 進一步擴大鉍化合物/抗藥藥物的醫藥應用 特别是耐藥細菌感染。从該項目获得的知識將提供 開發針對耐藥性 Bcc 感染的療法的基本基礎。

17304523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17304523.value: 通過丙二酯合成法製備手性氨基酸

17304523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304523.value: 丙二酸酯合成法是有机化学中一种普遍应用的方法，通过一系列取代、水解和脱羧反应，将未取代的丙二酸酯转化为羧酸。由于底物易于获取，以及所得的羧酸产物应用潜力大，这种方法在过去的一个世纪里得到了广泛的使用。尽管有机化学领域一直致力于开发该合成方法的不对称版本，但取得的成功有限。我们的目标是通过实现氨基丙二酸的对映选择性脱羧反应来发展α-氨基酸的不对称合成。该研究计划的核心在于包括磺酸和磷酸在内的强酸可以加速丙二酸的脱羧，从而取代其背景反应。与此同时，当这些强酸配备有手性口袋时，它们还可以对脱羧和质子化步骤施加立体选择性控制。因此，成功地识别和优化这些手性强酸的结构可以成功制备一系列结构多样的α-氨基酸。鉴于这些氨基酸在多个研究领域的重要用途，预计该项目开发的方法将得到广泛应用。

17304623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17304623.value: 新元古代时代和沉积记录的研究 澳大利亚的雪球地球事件

17304623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304623.value: This project will help resolve the timing of Neoproterozoic Snowball Earth events in Australia and produce new continental-scale depositional models. Arguably the most extreme climatic events recorded in the sedimentary record, the Snowball Earth hypothesis proposes that ice sheets covered the entire planet two times during the Cryogenian (720 to 635 Ma). The Sturtian event is the older and longer of the two episodes, beginning around 720 Ma and lasting approximately 60 million years; the Marinoan followed roughly 10 million years after and lasted about 15 million years. Each glacial epoch is typically characterised in the stratigraphic record as massive and stratified diamictites, whereas enigmatic “cap” carbonates mark the snowball termination. New age constraints from multiple continents are helping clarify the timing and duration of Snowball Earth events; however, considerable uncertainty concerning the deglaciations casts doubt on the hypothesis. Snowball Earth climate states are attributed to a runaway albedo effect that requires extreme levels of greenhouse gasses in the atmosphere to overcome. Once achieved, modelling suggests that deglaciation should be rapid; however, the cap carbonite rocks typically ascribed to the deglaciation are likely to have been precipitated over protracted durations. This dichotomy between the deglacial modelling and the observed stratigraphy is a “fly in the ointment” of an otherwise robust Snowball Earth hypothesis. Nevertheless, the duration of time within the cap carbonates is highly uncertain, and their interpretation as “deglacial” is also disputed. These problems require holistic source-to-sink depositional models that include robust data to constrain time within the models. Therefore, this study has three objectives: 1) Develop new source-to-sink Snowball Earth depositional models that can explain the stratigraphic observations; 2) Correlate Snowball Earth deposits across the Australian continent; and 3) Better assess the timing and duration of Snowball Earth events, including the deglaciation. The project will combine detailed mapping and measured sections from several locations across Australia where the Snowball Earth sedimentary rocks are well preserved. New high-resolution geochronologic, geochemical and cyclo-stratigraphical data will be produced, and depositional models will be calibrated and tested using state-of-the-art forward modeling software. This multidisciplinary project will integrate sedimentology, geochronology, geochemistry, and modeling to deliver timely and significant results. 该项目将有助于确定澳大利亚新元古代雪球地球事件的时间，并产生新的大陆规模沉积模型。雪球地球假说可以说是沉积记录中记录的最极端的气候事件，它提出冰盖在成冰纪（720 至 635 Ma）期间两次覆盖整个地球。 Sturtian 事件是这两个事件中历史最悠久、时间最长的事件，始于 720 Ma 左右，持续约 6000 万年；马里诺人在大约 1000 万年后出现，并持续了大约 1500 万年。每个冰川时代在地层记录中的典型特征是块状和层状混积岩，而神秘的“帽”碳酸盐则标志着雪球的终止。来自多个大陆的新年龄限制正在帮助澄清雪球地球事件的时间和持续时间；然而，有关冰消作用的相当大的不确定性使人们对这一假设产生了怀疑。 雪球地球气候状态归因于失控的反照率效应，需要大气中极端水平的温室气体才能克服。模型表明，一旦实现，冰川消融将会很快。然而，通常归因于冰消作用的盖碳酸盐岩很可能是在很长一段时间内沉淀下来的。冰消模型和观测到的地层学之间的这种二分法是原本稳健的雪球地球假说的“美中不足”。然而，碳酸盐岩盖层内的持续时间高度不确定，并且它们对“冰消期”的解释也存在争议。这些问题需要整体的源-汇沉积模型，其中包括可靠的数据来限制模型内的时间。 因此，本研究有三个目标：1）开发新的可以解释地层观测的源到汇雪球地球沉积模型； 2) 关联整个澳大利亚大陆的雪球地球沉积物； 3) 更好地评估雪球地球事件的发生时间和持续时间，包括冰川消融。该项目将结合澳大利亚各地雪球地球沉积岩保存完好的多个地点的详细测绘和测量剖面。将产生新的高分辨率地质年代学、地球化学和旋回地层数据，并将使用最先进的正演模拟软件校准和测试沉积模型。这个多学科项目将整合沉积学、地质年代学、地球化学和建模，以提供及时和重要的结果。

17304723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17304723.value: 新的面板log-GARCH模型及其統計推斷

17304723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304723.value: In the era of big data, researchers frequently encounter greater challenges in analyzing a large panel of volatilities, which have a broad scope of application in asset pricing, portfolio selection, and risk management. For a large panel of volatilities, they can have the fixed individual effect caused by the heterogeneity in asset characteristics, the fixed time effect caused by the business cycle, technological progress, preference change, and policy switch, the interactive effect caused by the unobserved common shocks, and the spatio-temporal effect caused by the spatial and serial correlations in variance. However, so far less attempts have been made to analyze these important effects in the literature. Therefore, the goal of this project is to fill this gap. In terms of methodology, this project aims to propose three new panel log-GARCH models to study the aforementioned effects, including a fixed effects log-GARCH model, an interactive effect log-GARCH model, and a spatio-temporal AR-log-GARCH model. For each model, a systematic statistical inference procedure (including the estimation and testing) can be provided. The importance of all proposed methodologies can be demonstrated by a myriad of applications. In terms of theory, this project aims to develop some new technical treatments to prove the asymptotics of all proposed estimators and tests. Unlike the existing technical treatments only for the large serial-dimension case, the newly developed technical treatments in this project can work for the case that the cross-dimension is large while the serial-dimension is either large or small. 波動率在資產定價、組合選擇和風險管理等領域有廣泛的應用，但如何在大數據時代研究波動率是一個很大的挑戰。譬如，波動率可能具有由資產特徵異質性引起的固定個體效應，由商業周期、技術進步、偏好變化和政策轉變引起的固定時間效應，由未觀察到的共同衝擊引起的交互效應以及由方差的空間和時間相關性引起的空間及時間上的同步效應。然而，迄今為止，在文獻中對於這些重要效應的分析嘗試較少。因此，本項目的目標是填補這一空白。 在方法研究上，本項目旨在提出三個新的面板log-GARCH模型，以研究上述各類效應；包括一個具有固定效應的log-GARCH模型，一個具有交互作用效應的log-GARCH模型和一個具有時空效應的AR-log-GARCH模型。對於每個模型，本項目都旨在提供系統的統計推斷過程（包括估計和檢驗）。所有提出的方法的重要性可以通過大量的應用來證明。 在理論研究上，本項目旨在開發一些新的技術方法來證明所有提出的估計量和檢驗的漸近性質。與現有的技術方法僅適用於大的序列維數的情況不同，本項目中新開發的技術方法旨在適用於交叉維度很大而序列維度無論是大還是小的情況。

17304823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17304823.value: 環氧烯醇硅醚的分子內（4+3）環加成反應在複雜天然產物的分子骨架合成的應用

17304823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17304823.value: 含有芳香環的化合物很容易從石油工業中獲得，目前已有各種有機金屬反應來擴展其芳香環系統。由於它們平坦且富含電子，它們容易與各種酶和受體嵌入，可是這種結合通常是未有充分的特異性，以致過於雜亂無章。近年來，製藥行業和新藥研發越來要求開發具有三維結構的分子，以揭示這個鮮為人知的化學空間中新的性質和生物活性。然而，這個新方向的發展受限於具有確定結構，富含sp3碳的分子的合成方法。因此，發展構建環的方法學可以提供合成這些化合物的有力手段。 碳環構成了各種生物活性化合物、天然產物和材料的分子骨架。與開鏈化合物相比，碳環賦予分子剛性、構成了分子的體積、獨特的電子性質和具有確定的立體化學的分子結構。多環結構進一步增強了這些性質。 環加成反應可以有效地構建含環化合物，而我們已經開發了使用環氧烯醇硅醚作為親電試劑進行（4+3）環加成反應的方法，為合成具有確定立體化學的多環分子骨架提供了可行的途徑。這些分子骨架具有各種的官能團，其中許多是橋接多環化合物，這些化合物可以用於合成天然產物的中間體。 在本課題中，我們的目標是進一步研究這些（4+3）環加成反應，並應用在天然產物的合成中。我們擬探討應用環氧烯醇硅醚與呋喃的分子內（4+3）環加成反應來完成toxicodenane A的不對稱合成，這是一種從傳統中醫藥中分離出來，具有保護細胞的作用的天然產物。我們還將應用環氧烯醇硅醚與苯并[b]咔唑作為二烯的分子內（4+3）環加成反應作為關鍵步驟，研究抗癌和抗病毒天然產物tubingensin B的不對稱合成。這些天然產物或結構密切相關的分子骨架的成功合成將使得進行篩選它們的生物活性，從而進一步挖掘這些結構新穎、富含sp3碳結構的分子的新藥開發空間。

17305123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17305123.value: Artin-Schelter正則代數的導出幾何構造

17305123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305123.value: Artin-Schelter regular algebras (regular algebras for simplicity) are important examples of non- commutative projective schemes in the sense of Artin and Zhang. Artin Tate and Van den Bergh has established a beautiful geometric theory which associate to each regular algebra of dimension three a projective Calabi-Yau curve C together with an automorphism σ. Using this correspondence, they classified all regular algebras of dimension three. Unforunately such a geometric theory is missing in higher dimension. From the classification point of view, the most difficult class are those algebras with the same Hilbert series as a polynomial ring. We call such regular algebras Koszul, which can be viewed as quantization of a quadratic Poisson structure on projective spaces. There exists several partial results about classification of regular algebras of dimension four including the work of Lu-Palmieri-Wu-Zhang and the work of Rogalski-Zhang, which are all about non-Koszul types. The focus of this project is on a special class of Poisson structures on projective spaces that comes from moduli construction. We aim to use derived algebraic geometric method to construct a quantization of these Poisson structures, thereafter produce new examples of regular algebras of Koszul type. In a series of work joint with Alexander Polishchuk, the PI has proved several foundational results about Poisson geometry of the moduli stack of complexes of vector bundles over Calabi- Yau curves including the existence of 0-shifted Poisson structure and the existence of the derived symplectic foliation. The general theory leads to several applications in classic poisson geometry and integrable systems. We give a classification of symplectic leaves on meromorphic matrix algebra over an elliptic curve and construct bihamiltonian structures on a class of Feigin-Odesskii Poisson manifolds. The semi-classical limits of the famous Feigin-Odesskii elliptic algebras are components of our moduli stacks. The Poisson geometric properties of the moduli stack lead to novel results on the these algebras. The goal of this project is to establish a general geometric scheme to quantize those components of the Poisson moduli stack that are isomorphic to projective spaces, and provide a criteria of regularity for the quantized algebras. Meanwhile, we expect to make some progress on the long standing conjecture about regularity of elliptic algebras and on the study of linear modules of regular algebras of Koszul types. Artin-Schelter是非交換投射概形中最重要的一類。Artin， Tate和Van den Bergh在90年代初建立了一個幾何理論，對於一條Calabi-Yau曲線以及上面的一個自同構構造了一個3維的正則代數，並最終用此方法分類了所有的3維正則代數。由於高維正則代數的幾何理論尚未建立，4維及其以及以上的正則代數的分類結果所知不多。已知的結果包括Lu-Palmieri-Wu-Zhang以及Rolgaski-Zhang。從分類理論的角度，最困難的一類是和多項式代數具有相同希爾伯特函數的代數，我們稱之為Koszul類型。以上的所有高維的分類結果都是關於非Koszul類型。 在PI和Polishchuk的一系列工作中，我們構造了Calabi- Yau曲線上復形模空間上的導出Poisson結構並且分類其上的導出辛葉。這一結果在經典Poisson幾何和可積系統中有廣泛應用。比如我們利用它分類了橢圓曲線上的亞純函數域上矩陣空間的辛葉，構造了Feigin-Odesskii柏松流形（橢圓代數的半經典極限）上的bihamiltonian結構等等。 該項目的目標是基於我們在模空間Poisson結構建立一類特殊（任意維數）的正則代數的幾何理論。這一類正則代數是Calabi-Yau曲線復形模空間一些不可約分支的量子化。於此同時我們期望這一幾何理論能夠解決橢圓代數及其表示理論中一系列懸而未決的問題。

17305223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305223.value: Representation theory is to study symmetry of objects. The simplest example is the reflection: if one knows half, then one deduces another half. Higher degrees of symmetry are rotations, and the underlying object behind all these symmetries is a circle, which remains unchanged under those operations. Representation theory aims to find spaces invariant under a group of operations, whose origin can be traced back to the time of Frobenius about a century ago. Restriction is to view a representation as a subgroup representation. In other words, it is to study representations by reducing the symmetry, giving an inductive understanding on the internal structure of the underlying spaces of the representations. This project is to study restriction problems in one of the most fundamental groups -- the p-adic general linear groups i.e. the group of all invertible matrices on a vector space over a p-adic field. The classification of those irreducible representations has extensively studied over last fifty years, in a larger framework of Langlands program, while the restriction problems remain largely unknown until recently. Main tools in this project use the techniques on sequences of derivatives as well as criteria for branching laws, developed by the PI in previous work. 表示論是研究空間的對稱性。最簡單的的例子是反射: 利用反射由一面推測另一面。高維的對稱性來自於圓形: 任何以圓心的旋轉及反射可保存圓形的型狀。表示論的一個主要目標是找出群作用上不變的綫性空間，其源可追溯至約一個世紀前的德國數學家Frobenius。 分支問題是表示論上一個基本問題，利用子群表示來研究原先群的表示。換言之，利用一個誘導的方法去了解空間的深層結構。 本項目的目標是研究p進綫性群(由p進域上的可逆矩陣組成的群)的分支問題。而p進綫性群是在Langlands綱領一個最基本的群，已經研究了超過50多年，但其分支問題只是近年才有比較好的了解。而本項目的主要工具為由其負責人此前所研發的衍生子序列及分支律的判斷法則等。

17305523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17305523.value: 模擬極亮X-射線源中的黑洞超愛丁頓吸積

17305523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17305523.value: Prof Fragkos, Anastasios Prof Middleton, Matthew

17305523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305523.value: Recently broadband observations with unprecedented spectral and timing resolution indicate that at least a large fraction of ultraluminous X-ray sources (ULXs) are powered by super-Eddington compact objects (i.e. pulsars and stellar-mass black holes). Yet many important questions remain, such as what fraction of ULXs are powered by pulsars or stellar-mass black holes, how luminous and beamed the emission can be, and why they exhibit diversity in spectral properties. In this study, we propose to conduct general relativistic simulations of super-Eddington accretion around stellar-mass black holes in order to systemically investigate the structures of the accretion flows, the kinetic energy carried by the winds and jets, and the radiative properties such as the total luminosity and beaming factor. Furthermore, we will carry out sophisticated radiative calculations to obtain the energy spectrum of the super-Eddington accretion flow and study its dependence on the viewing angle of the observer. Lastly, we will use the results to interpret and model ULX observations. The results from this study will be very useful not only for understanding ULXs but also for studying the general accretion and emission physics in black hole astrophysical systems such as tidal disruption events and high redshift quasars, which are likely also undergoing super-Eddington accretion. 最近的高分辨率的多波譜觀測顯示至少有很大一部分超發光 X 射線源 (ULX)實際上是超愛丁頓吸積下的緻密天體（即脈衝星和恆星質量黑洞）。然而，許多重要的問題尚未得到解答，例如多少比例的ULX是脈衝星或是恆星質量黑洞，ULX輻射的亮度和發散度為多少，以及為什麼它們表現出光譜的多樣性。在這項研究中，我們打算進行廣義相對論下恆星質量黑洞的超愛丁頓吸積的模擬，來系統地研究ULX的吸積流的結構，風和噴射攜帶的動能，以及輻射的性質。此外，我們將進行先進的的輻射物理計算，以獲得此類超愛丁頓吸積流的能譜，並研究其對觀察者視角的依賴性。最後，我們將使用模擬結果來解釋ULX 觀測結果。這項研究的結果不僅對於可用於理解ULX ，而且可以用於研究包括潮汐破壞事件和高紅移類星體的其他高吸積率的黑洞系統。

17305723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17305723.value: 蒙古中肯特區域稀有金屬花崗岩體的綜合研究

17305723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17305723.value: This study will establish new knowledge of the formation and enrichment mechanisms of rare-metal granitoids. Rare metal (Li, Be, Nb, Ta, Rb, Cs, W, Sn) materials are increasingly important in 21st century human civilization, as they are utilized in a variety of developing technologies such as transistors, pin-head capacitors, compound semiconductors, flat-screen liquid-crystal displays, and thin-film solar cells. As such, exploration for rare metals is increasingly important, and rare-metal granitoids represent one of the primary resource types. Three main mechanisms are thought to produce rare-metal enriched granitoids: magmatic fractionation and crystallization, hydrothermal cycling during late-stage granitoid crystallization, and downwards flux of (near-)surface waters enriched with rare metals. This study seeks to develop new knowledge of these mechanisms and their relative importance via integrated investigations across the Khentey region of Mongolia. This region hosts multiple generations of rare-metal granitoid intrusions, with younger intrusions and late-stage pegmatites displaying diverse rare-metal enrichments and variable extents of alterations. We will explore this richly-varied intrusive suite via six approaches: 1] thermobarometry to determine pressures and temperatures of magmatic crystallization and hydrothermal alteration; 2] zircon geochemistry and geochronology to constrain timing of magmatic crystallization and hydrothermal alteration; 3] radiometric dating of various mineral phases via (dominantly) noble gas geo-/thermo-chronology to constrain the temperature-time path from crystallization to surface preservation, and gain new timing constraints on fluid alteration events; 4] fluorine concentration measurements to trace potential impacts of hot fluid partitioning and/or late hydrothermal alteration on rock compositions; 5] exploring for lithium (Li) isotopic fractionation in minerals associated with each of the three different phases of rare-metal granitoid development, to determine whether such rare-metal fractionation occurs in any of the phases, and if so, if it is associated with rare-metal enrichment; and 6] exploring for boron (B) isotopic fractionation in minerals associated with both granitoid crystallization and hydrothermal alteration, to track fractionation during these phases and its potential relationships to rare metal enrichment. The B work supplements the somewhat riskier Li work, as Li fractionation is not as well understood and hydrothermal alteration may not have the capacity to drive significant Li isotopic fractionation. The training and careers of two talented postdoctoral scholars will be advanced through this research. 這項研究將會建立有關稀有金屬花崗岩形成和富集機制的新認識。在二十一世紀的人類文明中，稀有金屬（鋰，鈹，鈮，鉭，銣，銫，鎢，錫）正變得愈發重要。它們被廣泛地運用到各項科技中，如晶體管，電容，化合物半導體，液晶平面顯示器，以及薄膜太陽能面板。因此，稀有金屬的勘探也變得愈發重要。稀有金屬花崗岩是稀有金屬的一種重要礦藏。人們認為這種花崗岩有三種主要的形成機制：岩漿分離結晶，花崗岩結晶後期的水熱作用成礦，以及富含稀有金屬的地表水的向下遷移成礦。本研究旨在通过对蒙古肯特地区的综合调查，发展关于这些机制及其相对重要性的新知识。這片區域經歷了多期稀有金屬花崗岩侵入。較晚期的花崗岩和偉晶岩表現出了多種稀有金屬富集現象和不同程度改造現象。我們將用六種研究手段來對這些形形色色的侵入體進行研究。第一，我們將用溫壓計來取得岩漿結晶和熱液改造過程的溫度和壓力。第二，我們將用鋯石地球化學和年代學數據來取得岩漿結晶和熱液作用的年齡。第三，我們將用以惰性氣體熱年代學為主導的各種放射性测年手段來取得從岩漿結晶到地表成藏的溫度-時間演化路径。第四，我們將測量氟的含量來追蹤熱液蚀变以及後期水熱活動對岩石成分的影響。第五，我們將研究不同期次花崗岩的礦物中的鋰同位素分餾情況來確認這些花崗岩中有無出現稀有金屬萃取分餾的現象，以及這些現象是否和稀有金屬的富集成礦有關。第六，我們將研究花崗岩中岩漿礦物和水熱礦物的硼同位素的分餾情況，從而了解这些阶段對鈹同位素的影響，以及它們與稀有金屬成礦的關係。由於科學界對鋰同位素的分餾過程的了解不深，並且水熱作用有可能不會對鋰同位素造成顯著影響，我們提出的硼同位素研究將會是挑戰性更大的鋰同位素研究的有效補充。這項研究將促進兩位充滿潛力的博士後研究員的學術訓練和研究工作。

17305923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17305923.value: 虛二次域類數的不可分性

17306023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17306023.value: 利用現代介形蟲和介形蟲化石研究雷賽布入侵-經蘇伊士運河由紅海向地中海的大量海洋生物物種入侵-的空間範圍、强度及歷史變化

17306023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17306023.value: Dr Albano, Paolo G. Prof Langer, Martin Prof Williams, Mark

17306023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306023.value: Invasive species and human-induced climatic warming are two of the major environmental issues we face. Often these work in concert, for example in the eastern Mediterranean Sea. Anthropogenic modification by the opening and widening of the Suez Canal – since 1869 – is responsible for the Lessepsian biotic invasion, allowing hundreds of marine species from the Indo-Pacific region to invade the eastern Mediterranean, fundamentally changing the native marine ecosystems there. Global warming accelerates this process by rendering the Mediterranean Sea more suitable for the inherently thermophilic tropical invaders. The Lessepsian invasion is one of the worst cases of marine ecological degradation caused by multiple human-induced issues (Suez opening and warming). Thus far, studies of the Lessepsian invasion have focussed on relatively large organisms with good mobility or dispersal ability such as molluscs, decapod crustaceans, and fishes and those on small meiobenthic organisms (they tend to have poor dispersal ability), which comprise two-thirds of marine diversity, remain limited. Also, there are few systematic studies of the Lessepsian invasion covering broad areas using consistent and quantitative methodologies. Studies tend to be compilations of ad hoc and often fragmentary information of various types of studies and observations. Meiobenthic Ostracoda (microscopic sized crustaceans) allow us time-efficient, consistent, and quantitative investigation covering broad areas, because their calcified shells are well preserved in archive dry sediment samples available from our collaborators and a small sample can include hundreds of specimens. In addition, the Suez Canal was opened in 1869. There is little information on the eastern Mediterranean ecosystem before the opening of the Suez Canal. However, rich downcore paleo-records of ostracod fossil shells can reconstruct the pristine ecosystem before this marine gateway was opened. Therefore, ostracods can be a good model system of small organisms and here we plan to investigate this model system in surface sediment and sediment core samples from the eastern Mediterranean and surface samples from broad central and southern Mediterranean. This spatio-temporal data will help better holistic understanding of distribution, history, and potential drivers of Lessepsian invasion, more specifically to: 1) elucidate spatial patterns of introduction to see whether specific ecologies (e.g., large, good dispersers and small, poor dispersers) provided enhanced/reduced pathways for introduction; 2) produce distribution maps for key species to effectively illustrate their spatial extents; 3) understand the natural baseline ecosystem before the Suez Canal opening using downcore paleo-records. These results will be useful to predict future patterns of invasion. 物種入侵和人類導致的氣候變暖是現時人類面臨的兩大主要環境問題。 在地中海東部，這些環境問題通常協同發生。 自1869年以來，蘇伊士運河的人為開鑿和拓寬導致成百上千的海洋生物物種由印度-太平洋地區入侵至地中海東部，極大地改變了當地原本的海洋生態環境，這種現象又被稱作雷賽布入侵。 全球變暖加速了這個過程，使地中海更加適合嗜熱的熱帶入侵物種生存。 雷賽布入侵是多重人類活動（蘇伊士運河的開通和全球變暖）影響下造成的最嚴重的海洋生態退化案例之一。 迄今為止，對於雷賽布入侵的研究多集中於相對較大的具有良好運動能力或擴散能力的生物體，例如軟體動物、十足甲殼動物和魚類。 但是對佔據了三分之二海洋生物多樣性的較小型底棲動物（其擴散能力往往較差）的研究仍舊缺乏。 對於雷賽布入侵問題，少有覆蓋大面積的、使用統一定量方法的系統性研究，本研究將集中彙編各個研究和觀測的即時及碎片化資料。 並且，利用較小型底棲介形蟲（顯微鏡可觀察大小的甲殼類動物），我們可以進行高效、永續、可定量且可覆蓋大面積研究區域的研究，從合作者提供的幹沉積物檔案樣品中已觀察到它鈣化的殼體被良好地保存了下來，並且少量沉積物樣品即可獲得上百個生物樣本。 並且，蘇伊士運河在1869年開通之前的情况少有記錄，沉積物柱樣中的介形蟲化石外殼的豐富記錄可以重建這一海洋通道開通前的遠古生態系統情况。 所以，我們將使用介形蟲這一小體型生物體作為代表性模型，研究蘇伊士運河這個典型生態系統，將於地中海東部取得表層沉積物和沉積物柱樣，於廣闊的地中海中部和南部取得表層沉積物，得到的時空變化數據將有助於更好地理解雷賽布入侵的物種分佈、歷史和可能的驅動因數， 即1）闡明入侵物種的空間分佈，明確特定體系（例如：大型、擴散能力强和小型、擴散能力弱的物種體系）是否有利於/不利於入侵； 2）繪製關鍵物種的分佈圖並闡釋其空間分佈； 3）利用沉積物柱樣的古記錄明確蘇伊士運河開通前的生態基線。 結果將有助於預測未來的生物入侵情况。

17306223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306223.value: Marine plastic pollution is recognised as one of the major environmental issues of the 21st century. The main problem is that plastic waste present in the environment is broken down into microplastics (<5 mm) and nanoplastics (<100 nm) that do not easily degrade in the natural environment. Micro- and nanoplastics have been recognised as serious pollutants, as they have been found in the air we breathe, the soil, and the oceans, and can even penetrate tissues and accumulate in organs. They can be taken up by fish and other organisms in the ocean, entering the food chain and ultimately ingested by humans. Southeast Asia is particularly vulnerable to plastic pollution as the region is home to eight of the world’s top 10 rivers, which contribute to the plastic debris introduced into the oceans. Moreover, the region is a major importer of plastic waste collected by other countries for recycling. In addition, four (China, Indonesia, Philippines, and Vietnam) out of the top 20 countries do not properly manage their plastic waste. Polystyrene (PS) and expanded PS (EPS) represent just over 6% of the global worldwide plastic production but contribute up to 60% of plastic debris found in Asia, which is significantly higher than in other regions of the world. PS and EPS have been recognised to induce physiological perturbation in several species. In this proposed study, we will investigate the fragmentation of polystyrene (PS) and PS foams (EPS and XPS) under natural conditions. Ten types of PS will be chosen for this study. They will be placed in coastal water, sandy beach and open air (at top of buildings) for continuous sub-sampling to monitor their fragmentation and weathering over a period of 2 years. In addition, a bio-based foam, Poly Lactic Acid (PLA) foam (produce by fermentation of organic material), will be chosen to assess the true environmental benefit of this alternative bioplastic. Factors controlling weathering, such as UV, temperature, mechanical abrasion, and bio-films, will be continuously monitored. State-of-the-art analytical instruments, such as FTIR and SEM images will be used to quantify changes at the surface of the plastic. Results of this study will allow us to estimate the temporal changes related to the degradation of PS plastics in different conditions in low latitude marine regions, which will allow us to evaluate the relative importance of different weathering factors on plastic fragmentation to better manage polystyrene waste. 17306323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17306323.value: 整合金屬組學方法破譯金屬在 COVID-19 免疫中的作用並發現新的生物標誌物

17306323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17306323.value: Dr Chan, Jasper Fuk Woo Prof Lu, Li Wei

17306323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306323.value: 由 SARS-CoV-2 引起的持續的新冠 (COVID-19) 大流行代表了一場全球危機。深入了解新冠的免疫和致病機制將有助於控制病毒傳播並促進更有效的治療。儘管我們對 新冠病理生理機制的了解正在不斷改善，但驅動 新冠疾病惡化的更有效的生物標誌物和內在機制仍有待發現。目前尚不清楚導致 新冠嚴重程度的危險因素，越來越多的臨床數據表明，宿主金屬（即元素）的不平衡與 新冠患者的嚴重程度和運動性有關。 生命必需元素參與許多重要的生命過程。金屬離子是免疫系統的關鍵調節劑，金屬的失調可能導致免疫缺陷。人們越來越認識到金屬與傳染病之間的密切聯繫。系統金屬穩態通過複雜的蛋白質組機制嚴格受到特定金屬蛋白的控制。然而，尚不清楚金屬如何在系統水平上響應 SARS-CoV-2 感染，以及金屬和金屬蛋白在 新冠免疫中發揮什麼作用，反之亦然。金屬的分佈及其形態、金屬與蛋白質的相互作用將為金屬介導的免疫提供重要信息，從而提高我們對病毒感染治療的了解。 我們是金屬組學和金屬蛋白質組學的領先團隊，最近還安裝了流式質譜儀。在這個項目中，我們將以新冠為例解讀金屬在免疫中的作用，並發現新的生物標誌物。具體來說，我們將首先通過包括質譜流式分析 (Cy-TOF) 在內的綜合金屬組學方法，對 新冠患者血清中的金屬組（包括金屬蛋白質組）和與炎症和抗體反應相關的蛋白質組進行多重血清學分析。我們將揭示患者血清樣本的獨特金屬組特徵，然後將患者與健康個體進行分類。重要的是，我們將發現金屬組和/或金屬蛋白質組與炎症介質的潛在相關網絡。將確定不同金屬之間和（金屬）蛋白質之間的潛在相互作用以及金屬與免疫調節細胞因子的關聯。然後，我們將加強對已識別的金屬離子和/或蛋白質的干預，以改變某些免疫細胞中炎症細胞因子表達（例如 IL-10）的變化。最後，我們將驗證所觀察到的現像在病毒感染小鼠模型中的作用，並構建金屬和/或蛋白質在 新冠疾病進展和免疫中發揮的可能工作流程。 通過這個項目，我們對金屬在感染過程中免疫學作用的理解將得到顯著增強。 重要的是，這些信息可能有助於揭示 新冠疾病的新病理生理學機制，從而發現新的生物標誌物，從而開發出更有效的抗病毒療法。 該方法可以很容易地擴展到其他疾病，以了解金屬組/金屬蛋白質組如何調節免疫和宿主對入侵病原體的防禦。

17306623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17306623.value: 冻融循环改变了火星地表的化学成分

17306623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306623.value: 现代的火星是一个非常氧化的的冰冻行星。然而，早期火星大气具有还原性，温室效应强烈，火星表面液态水丰富。火星从一颗曾经有水的行星过渡到现代冰冻行星的过程中，冻融循环是一个不可避免的关键地质作用。冻融循环的物理风化已经得到了广泛研究，并用于解释火星上许多独特的地貌特征。然而，对于冻融循环驱动的化学风化，尤其是其应用于火星的研究相对较少。通过几十年的研究，我们现在对火星表面的矿物学和地球化学的时空演变有了很好的认识。火星表面一些含水矿物的形成机制已经达成了共识，例如，火星大多数粘土矿物是通过热液改造和化学风化作用而形成的。然而，在火星表面成分还存在一些长期未解决的谜题。在这个研究计划中，我们将利用冻融循环来尝试解释其中的一些问题。我们假设火星表面的矿物变化与随着火星大气氧化、温度降低诱导的冻融循环的演化密切相关。首先，我们将检验古老的火星地区（诺亚纪，约41亿至37亿年前）中全球表面铁亏损是否可以通过还原大气环境下在全球平均年温度（MAT）高于0°C的的季节性冻融循环中的冰风化和随后的淋滤来解释。其次，我们将利用NASA的机遇号火星车在子午线平原的原位探测数据，来确定火星西方纪（约37亿至30亿年前）层状沉积物中的硫酸盐是否是全球MAT低于0°C但赤道MAT高于0°C情况下冻融循环诱导土壤盐渍化的结果。第三，我们将研究火星表面普遍存在的纳米相三价氧化铁（导致火星表面呈现红色）是否是由永冻土层上部的冻融作用而形成。第四，我们将测试冻土的突然解冻是否可以解释“天问一号”任务中“祝融号”着陆点最近的水活动。该项目将解决火星表面成分的几个长期难题，这对火星的古气候和天体生物学具有重要意义。此外，这项工作还可能为低温化学风化作为一种在普遍上未被认识到的地质过程提供新的见解。

17306823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17306823.value: 利用紅樹林檔案製定對全新世中晚期海平面變化機制的低緯度約束

17306823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17306823.value: Study of mid to late Holocene (past ~6000 years) sea level is societally relevant because it provides insight into the response of sea level to climatic changes during a period of time when ice sheets were in their current configuration. Open questions remain during this time period regarding: 1) drivers of sea-level change during periods of warmer and cooler climate, and 2) the timing and spatial variability of the modern onset of sea-level rise and its driving mechanisms. High-resolution records with the necessary precision to address these questions are largely limited to salt marsh records from the North Atlantic (in particular the US Atlantic coast). Recent work has demonstrated that it is feasible to produce high-resolution records from mangroves in locations where there is late Holocene accommodation space (i.e. in the Caribbean region where land is slowly subsiding in response to the disappearance of the former Laurentide ice sheet), which allows for reliable mangrove chronologies, and where there is micro tidal range, which improves the vertical precision of sea-level reconstructions. We propose to explore this idea further and consider the potential of mangroves to produce high-resolution (decadal temporal and sub-decimetre vertical) sea-level records from sites in the Caribbean (Puerto Rico and/or Belize). We will explore abiotic and biotic factors that contribute to a site’s potential to provide precise archives of sea-level change. New sea-level records generated from the Caribbean will be combined with a global network of reconstructions and input into a spatio-temporal statistical model to examine patterns of sea-level change and estimate the contribution of barystatic (net transfer of water from continental storage as land-ice or groundwater into the oceans), sterodynamic (changes in the ocean currents, temperature and salinity) and other driving mechanisms to sea-level changes over the past several millennia. 對全新世中晚期（過去約 6000 年）海平面的研究具有社會相關性，因為它可以深入了解冰蓋當前形態期間海平面對氣候變化的響應。在此期間，仍然存在以下懸而未決的問題：1）氣候變暖和變冷期間海平面變化的驅動因素，2）現代海平面上升的時間和空間變化及其驅動機制。具有解決這些問題所需精度的高分辨率記錄在很大程度上僅限於北大西洋（特別是美國大西洋海岸）的鹽沼記錄。最近的工作表明，在存在晚全新世住宿空間的地方（即在加勒比地區，由於前勞倫太德冰蓋的消失，土地正在緩慢下沉），從紅樹林中產生高分辨率記錄是可行的，這允許可靠的紅樹林年表，並且在存在微潮差的情況下，可以提高海平面重建的垂直精度。我們建議進一步探討這一想法，並考慮紅樹林從加勒比地區（波多黎各和/或伯利茲）產生高分辨率（十年時間和亞分米垂直）海平面記錄的潛力。我們將探索有助於某個地點提供海平面變化精確檔案潛力的非生物和生物因素。加勒比地區生成的新海平面記錄將與全球重建網絡相結合，並輸入時空統計模型，以檢查海平面變化模式並估計重壓靜壓（大陸儲存的水作為陸地儲存的淨轉移量）的貢獻。冰或地下水進入海洋）、空間動力學（洋流、溫度和鹽度的變化）以及過去幾千年來海平面變化的其他驅動機制。

17307123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307123.value: Stainless steel is the most widely used alloy for general anti-corrosion applications. However, pitting corrosion can still occur on stainless steel used in corrosive chloride environments such as seawater. In order to prevent pitting corrosion, co-oxidation of Cr-based passive film with other alloying elements, such as Mo and N, is typically employed, leading to the development of super stainless steel that is protected from pitting corrosion in chloride environment. Nevertheless, the Cr-based passive film can collapse once transpassive dissolution of Cr occurs, which is the major failure mechanism of super stainless steel in more severe corrosive environments. To improve the anti-corrosion properties of alloys, novel anti-corrosion mechanisms must be introduced to suppress pitting corrosion as well as transpassive corrosion simultaneously. The present project proposes a novel anti-corrosion mechanism that is used to develop a new iron-based complex concentrated alloy (Fe-CCA), demonstrating much improved anti-corrosion properties. Conventionally, Mn is considered a harmful alloying element in Cr-based anti-corrosion alloys such as stainless steel. In contrast, the proposed anti-corrosion mechanism turns the harmful Mn element into a unique advantage. The new Fe-CCA firstly forms a Cr-based passive film followed by a second Mn-based passive film. The first Cr-based passive film prevents pitting corrosion, and the second Mn-based passive film stops transpassive dissolution of the Cr-based passivation layer. This new anti-corrosion mechanism is defined as “sequential dual-passivation mechanism”. Consequently, neither pitting corrosion nor transpassive corrosion can occur, providing the new Fe-CCA with superior corrosion resistance up to ca. 1700 mV (saturated calomel electrode, SCE) in chloride environments. Furthermore, the sequential dual-passivation mechanism was successfully employed in another Fe-CCA with different chemical composition. Similarly, a Cr-based passive film and a Mn-based passive film form with increasing potential, demonstrating the same sequential dual-passivation mechanism. This mechanism prevents the alloy from corrosion up to 1600 mV (SCE). Two different superior anti-corrosion Fe-CCAs with different chemical compositions exhibit the same sequential dual-passivation mechanism, illustrating that this mechanism could be applied for different alloys. However, fundamental understandings related to the new Fe-CCA and the proposed sequential dual-passivation mechanism are still lacking. For instance, the composition-passivation relationship and the atomic-scale passivation mechanism have not yet been accomplished. Consequently, the aim of the proposed project is to provide systematic investigations towards the fundamental understanding of the sequential dual-passivation mechanism, the corrosion behavior of the new Fe-CCA, and explore its possible industrial applications. 不銹鋼是一般防腐應用中使用最廣泛的合金材料，但不銹鋼仍易於發生點腐蝕，尤其在海水等富含氯離子的環境中。為了進一步提高其耐點蝕能力，通常採用協同氧化機制，即以鉻為主要成分，與鉬、氮、銅、鎢等元素形成共氧化，從而開發出性能優異的超級不銹鋼。然而，在電化學腐蝕中，當掃描電位大於約1000mV時，由於鉻基鈍化膜中三價鉻被進一步氧化成水溶性的六價鉻，即使是超級不銹鋼的鈍化膜也會發生破裂，從而導致不銹鋼基底暴露在環境中發生過鈍化腐蝕。為了獲得更高的耐腐蝕電位，有必要引入新的耐蝕機制，同時實現抑制點蝕和過鈍化腐蝕。 基於此，本專案提出了一種新的鈍化機制，並成功開發了兩種超耐蝕鐵基複雜合金。錳被作為一種合金元素，傳統上一般被認為會削弱不銹鋼的耐腐蝕性能，然而，本專案所提出的耐蝕機制將有害的錳元素變廢為寶，實現其高電位鈍化，對不銹鋼產生保護作用。在3.5wt% NaCl溶液測試中，隨著電位的升高，新型鐵基複雜合金首先形成一層鉻基鈍化膜，然後形成第二層錳基鈍化膜。鉻基鈍化膜在低電位條件下表現出優異的耐點蝕能力，同時錳基鈍化膜阻止了因鉻再氧化產生的過鈍化腐蝕。在這種“連續雙層鈍化”耐蝕機制的保護下，這種新型不銹鋼的保護電位可高達1700 mV（飽和甘汞電極，SCE）。此外，該“連續雙層鈍化”機制還被成功應用於設計另一種不同成分的鐵基複雜合金，同樣地，隨著電位的增加，第二種鐵基複雜合金表現出連續的鉻基和錳基雙層鈍化，從而實現了其耐蝕電位高達1600mV。這兩種合金的耐腐蝕試驗結果充分證明，該“連續雙層鈍化”機制可廣泛用於耐蝕合金的設計。 儘管如此，對於鐵基複雜合金的設計原則和“連續雙層鈍化”機制的研究仍然處於非常初級的階段，合金成分和原子尺度下的鈍化機制及相互之間的聯繫尚未得到充分理解。因此，本項目將對新型鐵基複雜合金的鈍化行為及“連續雙層鈍化”機制進行系統的研究，並探索該新型合金的潛在工業應用。

17307323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17307323.value: 基於机器学习的量子化學研究面向化学空间结构的分子激发态

17307323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307323.value: 處於激發態的分子以及相應過程的理論計算研究對理解自然界中諸如光化學、光物理、生物螢光以及光電工程等等現象具有關鍵意義。解析各種實驗中相關的圖譜離不開對分子激發態的理論模擬；設計開發具有光電性能的新型分子材料也在一定程度上需要理論計算的指導。然而，對激發態的計算模擬要比相應的基態要困難得多：首先，進行一個精準的計算模擬需具備足夠專業的知識以設定正確的計算細節，而且這樣的計算成本通常相當高昂；其次，繁雜的電子激發態會導致過於龐大的化學（如分子的組成和結構）及功能（多樣化的激發態性質）的空間。研究分子在某一特定激發態的性質不僅在計算上而且在可能的排列組合上都很困難。基於這些原因，開發新型光電性能的分子目前仍由化學實驗上的理解主導。而發展精確且普適、可遷移的結構-功能關係量化模型，並將其應用於數值模擬進行分子設計，依然是個重要的挑戰。 機器學習已成功地被應用在諸多實際領域，並且展示了從高維度數據中提取隱含而複雜特徵的能力。機器學習工具同量子化學方法的結合正在快速發展，通低成本過構建準確的標準數據庫，進而預測複雜分子電子結構模型。一些機器學習應用於量子化學上確定分子基態的成功案例讓我們考慮其作為一種最佳方案，用於解決降低前述的計算成本，從而使在數值模擬上探尋功能性光發分子成為可能。 我們將結合從頭算的激發態量子化學方法，研究高效可遷移的機器學習模型。核心想法是通過整合處理一些諸如軌道、組態的量子化學參量，致力於提高代表哈密頓量作連續函數的表達能力，從而提升機器學習模型的可遷移性質。將於諸多廣泛的激發態性質中「學習」、捕獲到的結構-功能關係會實現對化學和功能空間的延拓。本方案將探索應用於熱活化延遲螢光材料的激發態研究。

17307723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17307723.value: 熱浪餘生—揭示位處不同緯度的海洋關鍵物種族羣的適應潛力

17307723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17307723.value: Marine heatwaves (MHWs) are extreme climatic events that have been recognized as an emerging threat to marine ecosystems globally. Driven by climate change, heatwaves are already causing deleterious ecosystem and socio-economic impacts. The Kuroshio Current system between Taiwan and the northwest coast of Japan is the fastest warming area in the north Pacific Ocean, with MHWs predicted to increase in frequency, duration and intensity over the next ~50 years. Despite this, the impacts of MHWs on key ecosystem groups such as the plankton is largely unknown, particularly in this region. Therefore, developing an understanding of the impacts that MHWs will have on the survival and adaptation of key species within marine communities has become an imperative. Euphausiids are key secondary producers in many ocean food-webs, and Euphausia pacifica is the most numerically dominant species in the north Pacific Ocean, supporting a large variety of predators such as commercially important fish species and charismatic marine megafauna such as whales. Despite the important of this group both to ecosystem function and as both direct and indirect commercial interest in this region, there is a key knowledge gap in the response of this species to MHWs in terms of individual organism physiology, which will largely dictate the future distribution and biomass of this species. Here, we propose to address this knowledge gap using two populations of E. pacifica from the north and south Kuroshio Current, to assess the extent to which this species has the capacity to adapt to, and recover from, a sudden rise in temperature. From field studies it is known that MHWs can have a two-pronged effect on euphausiids; a change in the overall quantity of euphausiids caused by distributional changes or mortality associated with high temperature, and a change in the overall quality of euphausiids as a food source for predators, through changes in overall length and total lipid content. We will experimentally assess the effects of consecutive MHWs and recovery periods on the physiological response of E. pacifica in terms of both quantity and quality, and compare the response across its range. The outcomes of this project will provide in-depth knowledge of the ecosystem consequences of increasing frequency and intensity of MHW events across the Kuroshio Current System due to changes in the abundance and distribution of a key secondary consumer and form a baseline from which to predict how organisms and systems may adapt to future change. 隨着氣候變化日趨嚴重，海洋熱浪對生態系統構成的威脅與日俱增，對社會及經濟的影響不容小覷。位處臺灣及日本之間的一段黑潮是北太平洋中暖化最快的水域，而海洋熱浪的頻率、強度及持續時間均預期會在未來半世紀上升。話雖如此，學界對於熱浪對黑潮水域的浮游生物等關鍵物種的影響仍只是略知皮毛。 磷蝦在不少海洋食物鏈中扮演次級生產者的角色，為鯨魚等大型海洋生物及各種具經濟價值的魚類提供食物。本研究將以北太平洋中極為普遍的太平洋磷蝦為模式生物，研究海洋熱浪對磷蝦生理的影響。根據現存野外研究，熱浪會從兩方面影響磷蝦：一）熱浪會增加磷蝦死亡率及影響其分佈，使得磷蝦數目下降；二）熱浪會影響磷蝦大小及脂肪含量，從而改變其營養價值。通過實驗去比較黑潮水域南部及北部的磷蝦族羣對熱浪的適應性及復原力，是次研究旨在預測黑潮水域的磷蝦族羣於氣候變化底下何去何從。本研究的結果將有助預測海洋熱浪對黑潮海域次級生產者的影響，並推測此現象將對生態系統產生何種連鎖效應，從而估計黑潮海域生態系統在氣候變化底下將有何改變。

17308023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308023.value: 西北澳大利亞早太古代東皮爾巴拉地體是一個研究地球非板塊構造時期的重要遺產和天然實驗室嗎？

17308023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17308023.value: Dr Webb, Andrew Alexander Gordon Dr Zuo, Jiawei

17308023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308023.value: The tectonics of early Earth remains highly controversial. There are two trending views: (1) like the present, these oldest rocks were formed in plate tectonic settings where horizontal motions dominate, and (2) these ancient rocks were instead formed in a non-plate tectonic setting where rocks dominantly move vertically. The Paleoarchean East Pilbara Terrane (NW Australia) stands out as an important constraint – massive granitoids domes and their surrounding greenstones are commonly interpreted by non-plate tectonics featuring granitoid-up and greenstone-down movements, an interpretation that makes this terrane a unique laboratory for the non-uniformitarian Earth. Still, some think that the East Pilbara Terrane is not special – it represents a well-preserved fragment of an ancient plate tectonic convergent margin with the earliest deformation being greenstones thrusting over granitoids (i.e., greenstone-up). The debate on the tectonic setting of the East Pilbara Terrane lasts until today, suggesting that a considerable amount of new data is required to end the stalemate. Here, we suggest three sub-projects that examine the validity of non-plate tectonic and plate tectonic models of the East Pilbara Terrane with data of unprecedented amounts and quality. With the application of analytical tools that are relatively new to this terrane, we seek to provide (1) deformation constraints across the terrane; (2) new age constraints for the greenstone stratigraphy; and (3) new age constraints for the observed deformation fabrics. The first sub-project will involve obtaining field, magnetic, and microscopic structural data from deformed granitoids and greenstones. These structural data will allow us to explore the deformation temperatures, shear senses, fabric orientations, as well as 3D strain geometries at micro- to macro-scales, and thus help to reveal deformation conditions and distributions. A large deviation from horizontal deformation patterns would imply the dominance of non-plate tectonic processes. The second sub-project will acquire new crystallization ages to explore whether the terrane has some older rocks stacking on younger rocks, a feature that is generally explained by plate tectonics. The third sub-project will involve acquiring deformation age data from the deformed rocks used in the first sub-project. We will use multiple isotopic dating techniques to constrain the timing of deformation under a wide range of temperature conditions. We will then use these age data to determine the sequence of deformation events. The earliest deformation being dominantly greenstone-down would be consistent with non-plate tectonics. The earliest deformation being dominantly greenstone-up would be consistent with plate tectonics. 早期地球具有怎樣的大地構造模式是一個充滿爭議的話題。科學界有兩種主流的觀點。第一種認為，地球上最古老的岩石是在水平運動主導的板塊構造環境中形成的，和現今的岩石類似。第二種認為，這些古老的岩石其實是在以垂向運動為主導的非板塊構造環境中形成的。位於西北澳大利亞的早太古代東皮爾巴拉地體給地球科學界提供了重要數據。那兒保存的花崗岩穹窿和環繞着的綠岩帶經常被認為形成於以花崗岩向上運動，綠岩向下運動為特徵的非板塊構造運動中。這個解釋使得東皮爾巴拉地體成為了研究非板塊構造地球的一個獨特的天然實驗室。然而，有一些地質學家認為東皮爾巴拉地體並不特殊，它仍然是經由板塊構造運動形成，最初經歷了綠岩相對於花崗岩向上的逆沖運動。對於東皮爾巴拉地體的構造模式的爭論持續到了今天，這說明我們需要大量的新數據來對這個問題進行進一步的厘定。在這個研究項目中，我們提出了三個子課題來採集空前質量和數量的數據，以期對東皮爾巴拉地體的板塊構造模型和非板塊構造模型進行充分檢驗。我們將利用之前在此處罕有使用的研究方法來取得區域性的構造樣式，岩石形成年齡，以及構造形成年齡。第一個子課題將收集花崗岩和綠岩的野外，地磁學，以及顯微構造數據。這些構造數據能夠讓我們在宏觀到微觀的尺度上了解變形溫度，剪切旋向，剪切方向，還有三維形變樣式，從而取得東皮爾巴拉地區變形環境和有關它的空間分布的知識。如果這些構造數據與板塊構造水平變形區別比較大，那麼就說明東皮爾巴拉的變形過程可能是非板塊構造的。第二個子課題將會探究綠岩的結晶年齡，從而判斷此地是否有一般在板塊運動中形成的較老岩石疊置於較新岩石上的逆沖構造。第三個子課題將會研究第一個子課題中發現的變形構造的形成時代。我們將利用多種同位素年代學方法來厘定不同溫度區間的構造變形年齡，從而釐清構造變形期次。如果最早的構造變形是綠岩向下運動，那麼可以解釋為非板塊構造。反之，則代表了板塊構造運動。

17308323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308323.value: 雙金屬電催化劑中微環境的理性設計: 通過協同電催化實現碳和氮含化合物的多功能共還原

17308323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308323.value: 實現由可再生能源驅動的清潔水和穩定食品供應的可持續社會已成為全球使命，並被聯合國確定為關鍵的可持續發展目標。 歐洲、中國和香港意識到形勢的緊迫性，已經設定了在2050年至2060年之間實現碳中和的目標。 目前，鑒於缺乏相關知識和技術，我們無法關閉人為碳迴圈和氮迴圈。 因此，我們迫切需要轉型的生產方法，以最大限度地提高農業實踐和工業中含碳廢物和含氮毒素的再迴圈效率。 電催化為將含碳廢物和含氮毒素可持續轉化為功能性含碳、含氮商品提供了機會。 目前，缺乏能夠克服含碳、含氮共還原的「活性-選擇性-可擴展性」困境的強大電催化劑，阻礙了聚合電催化用於替代化學品生產的廣泛應用。 為了應對這一挑戰，本GRF提案旨在開發能夠利用清潔能源將碳源和氮源（例如二氧化碳和硝酸鹽）共同轉化為功能性含碳、含氮分子的多功能電催化劑。 首先，將由豐富的地球金屬對組成的雙金屬層狀雙氫氧化物（LDHs）開發為納米尺度平臺，用於組裝相鄰的雙活性位點。 一個金屬位點將被調整以與含碳物種結合，而另一個將通過明智的金屬選擇設計為與含氮物種結合。 通過調整環繞協同雙金屬位點的微環境，將優化雙金屬LDH上碳、氮共還原的活性（產率）和產物選擇性（法拉第效率，FE）。 接下來，對質子耦合電子轉移（PCET）步驟進行機理研究，將使我們能夠探究決定雙金屬LDH的碳、氮共還原性能的關鍵內在和外部因素。 隨後，通過電化學、光譜學和計算研究，揭示質子和電子的作用，並在共還原過程中確定表面的含碳、含氮中間體。 在分子水平上獲得的信息將最終指導未來設計具有提高產率和FE的碳、氮共還原電催化劑。 最後，將開發一系列烷基質子轉移調節劑，以引導共還原中的PCET步驟，生成所需的含碳、含氮產物。 將建立協議，通過這些質子調節劑取代雙金屬LDH納米片中的陰離子，並擴大LDH的層間距，以增強底物擴散。 成功執行本提案將為領域提供能夠通過微環境調控促進碳、氮共還原的模組化雙金屬LDH電催化劑。 在此開發的突破性合作電催化方法論將為以綠色方式促進更先進的廢物再利用升級過程鋪平道路。

17308423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308423.value: 有機物在礦石流體中的金屬遷移：FTMS 的見解 和 IRMPD 光譜研究金和銅的結構和穩定性 生物分子簇

17308423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308423.value: 有機物普遍存在於地球表面，甚至整個上層 地殼區域，對其參與廣泛活動的能力具有重要意義 分子締合反應的範圍。在這些有機材料中，有機和 有機硫化合物特別受關注，因為它們對金屬的親和力增強 離子，例如Au+ 和金屬離子絡合物，例如[AuCl2]+。水熱液結果 硫代（SH基團）和有機硫配體的實驗表明，這些有助於 顯著提高金屬的流動性，因此將參與沈積 金屬硫化物礦床化學。同樣重要，但通常受到的關注要少得多 在礦石流體系統中，金屬-生物分子復合物被認為在 益生元化學，由於它們能夠增強和加速肽的產生， 核苷酸片段甚至原酶。在這些過渡金屬中，金（Au）和 銅（Cu）對有機配體表現出極強的親和力，特別是那些 含有硫醇基和羧酸根（COO-/COOH）基團。鑑於 Au 和的親和力增強 Cu 用於有機硫絡合，迫切需要更好地了解 分子尺度的締合反應控制著物質的遷移、轉化和沈積 Au 和 Cu 與有機硫配體。 正是這種知識差距促使我們的研究團隊發起了一項研究 金和銅有機硫絡合物的結構和分子光譜性質。 通過這樣做，我們希望能夠為理解這些地球化學做出貢獻。 重要的有機材料及其連接金和銅的能力。作為地球化學家，我們也 熱衷於更好地了解這些金屬有機硫絡合物所發揮的作用 在化學演化的早期階段。事實上，可以認為礦石流體 涉及催化金屬有機硫絡合物的化學是生物化學的核心 進化和生命本身的起源。受到其中一些有趣的觀察的啟發，我們 提議研究金和銅有機硫絡合物的結構和穩定性，使用 高分辨率離子質譜與結構敏感 IMPD 的結合 光譜學

17308723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308723.value: 行星極光輻射的控制因素研究

17308723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17308723.value: Dr Dunn, William Prof Lee, Man Hoi

17308723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308723.value: Planetary magnetic fields control energetic particles in their space environments and guide particles to polar atmospheres to produce stunning auroral structures. As revealed by spacecraft measurements, the pathways of energetic particles to these planetary polar atmospheres are diverse, suggesting different coupling processes between their ionospheres and magnetospheres. These planets all have dipole-dominated magnetic fields, rotate in the same direction, and are blown by the solar wind, but what controls the global-scale patterns of energy dissipation, remains unknown. Thus question remains why are the morphologies of planetary aurora so diverse, even though the global structures of planetary magnetic fields are similar? The answers not only further the understanding of fundamental planetary processes at different spatial and temporal scales, but also have potential contributions to future planetary mission developments. We will use high-resolution, three-dimensional supercomputer simulations for planetary solar wind-magnetosphere-ionosphere interactions, to quantify the external and internal control of the global morphology of planetary auroral emissions. Our preliminary results show that to first order, the global configuration of the polar magnetosphere is determined by the competing effects between the solar wind merging and planetary rotation. In this project, we will develop a theoretical framework including high-order factors such as mass loading and ionospheric conductance, which will be applicable to studying global structures of the polar aurora from the Earth-type to Jupiter-type, via transition states that are similar to the highly variable aurora patterns at Saturn. This generalized description of fundamental planetary magnetospheric physics, proposed here and validated by observations published in the literature, is also applicable to exoplanetary systems. In light of past successes in simulating the terrestrial and Jovian auroral structures and based on our previous development work on electron precipitation models in global magnetosphere simulations, we propose the following research activities/objectives, in order to provide new understandings of the fundamental control mechanisms of global planetary auroral morphologies: 1. Perform numerical experiments of high-resolution global simulations of the terrestrial magnetosphere with different first-order factors: 1) rotation speed; 2) magnetic moment; 2. Perform extended numerical experiments of high-resolution global simulations with higher order controlling factors: 1) mass loading rates; 2) ionospheric conductance; 3. Develop synoptic diagnostics that provide key knowledge for comparison with observations, especially with reported in the literature to validate the simulation results; 4. Provide new knowledge of the relationship between external/internal factors and the corresponding magnetospheric processes, for use as quantitative theoretical predictions. 行星磁場控制其空間環境中的高能粒子，並將粒子引導到極地大氣層產生令人驚嘆的極光結構。根據人造衛星和遙感的測量結果，高能粒子到達這些行星極地大氣層的路徑是多樣的，表明它們的電離層和磁層之間存在不同的耦合過程。這些行星都具有以偶極為主導的磁場，沿相同方向旋轉，並受到太陽風的驅動，但是控制能量耗散，形成極光的全球模式仍然未知。因此，即使行星磁場的全球結構相似，為什麼行星極光的形態如此多樣仍然是研究的基礎問題。這些答案不僅進一步促進了對不同空間和時間尺度上基本行星過程的理解，而且對未來的行星探測任務設計也有潛在的貢獻。我們將使用高分辨率的三維超級計算機模擬行星太陽風-磁層-電離層相互作用，量化全球行星極光輻射的外部和內部控制機制。我們的初步結果表明，主要控制因素是由太陽風驅動和行星旋轉之間競爭效應決定的。在這個項目中，我們將開發一個理論框架，包括諸如衛星等離子體質量加載和行星電離層電導率之類的高階因素，可用於研究從地球型到木星型的極光的全球結構，通過與類似於土星高度可變的極光模式的過渡狀態。這種基本行星磁層物理學的廣義描述，將通過發表在文獻中的觀測結果進行驗證，也適用於外行星系統的觀測研究。

17308823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17308823.value: 海岸地下水動力學和生物灌溉及其對紅樹林濕地系統中碳彙和循環的影響

17308823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17308823.value: Prof Gu, Ji-Dong Dr Luo, Xin

17308823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17308823.value: To improve the adaptation capacity of the society to climate change, it is very important to sequestrate the surplus CO2 generated by human activities. The mangrove marsh has been well recognized as a highly efficient and ecologically and environmentally friendly system for carbon sequestration. The major pathways to counteract the sequestrated carbon in the mangrove marsh, however, have been limitedly studied. This project will fully explore the role of coastal groundwater dynamics and biophysical forces in carbon sequestration and cycling using two representative mangrove marsh systems in Mai Po and Ting Kok in Hong Kong. These two sites are dominated by mud and mud-rich sand, respectively. We hypothesize that the sequestrated carbon in the mangrove marsh system will be significantly offset by major coastal carbon sink processes of submarine groundwater discharge (SGD), emission of CH4 and CO2 at the sediment-air and water-air interfaces, and bio-irrigation and bio-perturbation. In the project, we will delineate the reaction processes responsible for the organic carbon degradation using carbon components and their isotopic compositions and metagenomic analysis in the sediment and porewater of the mangrove marsh systems. The bioirrigation intensity will be quantified based on high-resolution radium disequilibrium analysis, and laboratory artificial tracer addition-incubation experiments. The SGD to the coastal waters will be estimated with 222Rn, and the fresh component of the SGD will be quantified based on high-resolution monitoring of inland groundwater and tide levels and the thermal imaging by handheld and airborne platforms. The CH4 and CO2 emission at the sediment-air and water-air interfaces will be quantified with chamber experiments. The measured DOC in the water, and CH4 and CO2 in the ambient air will be used to train the hyperspectral imaging by airborne or satellited based platforms. With the SGD obtained from in-situ measurements, thermal imaging and numerical modelling, the groundwater borne carbon components will be estimated, and their effects on the closure or disclosure of carbon cycling in the mangrove marsh systems will be explored. The project will serve as a hub that couples scientific research, technology development, and predictions for the blue carbon sequestration in the tropical and subtropical mangrove beaches. The project will also lead to a better understanding of carbon sequestration and cycling in the mangrove marsh systems, especially from the perspective of coastal groundwater dynamics and biophysical forces, and foster new carbon monitoring technologies in these systems. 為了提高人類對氣候變化的適應能力，通過封存人類活動產生的二氧化碳非常重要。紅樹林濕地被廣泛認可為一種高效、生態友好的碳封存系統。然而，目前對紅樹林濕地中碳封存的主要途徑的研究還相對有限。本項目將以香港的兩個代表性紅樹林濕地系統（米埔和汀角）為例，充分探討沿海地下水動力學和生物物理動力在碳封存和循環中的作用。這兩個地點分別由淤泥和泥質砂主導。我們的科學假設是：紅樹林濕地系統中的碳封存效果將受到海岸帶某些碳匯過程（包括海底地下水排泄、沉積物-空氣和水-空氣界面的CH4和CO2排放以及生物灌溉和生物擾動）的顯著抵消。在該項目中，我們將通過碳組分及其同位素組成和宏基因組，分析紅樹林濕地系統沉積物和孔隙水中的有機碳降解反應過程。將用高分辨率鐳不平衡分析方法量化生物灌溉強度，也將進行實驗室人工示踪劑孵育實驗。通過222Rn估計沿海水體的地下水排泄，並基於對內陸地下水和潮汐水位的高分辨率監測以及便攜式和機載熱成像來量化地下水淡水成分。將使用腔室實驗 (chamber experiments)來量化沉積物-空氣和水-空氣界面的CH4和CO2排放。測量水中的可溶性有機碳以及環境空氣中的CH4和CO2，將之用於訓練飛機或衛星平台的高光譜成像。利用通過原位測量、熱成像和數值模擬獲得的地下水排泄，將估計地下水帶來的碳組分，並探索其對紅樹林濕地系統中碳循環的封閉或解閉效應。該項目將成為熱帶和亞熱帶紅樹林灘地藍碳封存的科學研究、技術發展和預測提供平台，也將加深對這些系統中碳封存和循環理解，並推動這些系統中的新碳監測技術的發展。

17309023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309023.value: 具有氮掺杂的Stone-Wales缺陷结构纳米石墨烯的合成

17309023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309023.value: 具有完美原子晶格的石墨烯具有优异的电子和机械性能，但结构缺陷似乎是不可避免的。 一般来说，石墨烯中的缺陷分为两类：1）本征缺陷，包括点缺陷（零维）、位错（一维）和晶界（二维）； 2）外在缺陷：引入碳晶格的外来原子。 不幸的是，石墨烯中结构缺陷的产生通常是随机且任意发生的，这使得精确控制缺陷结构具有挑战性。从基础和应用的角度来看，彻底理解这些拓扑缺陷，包括化学和物理性质非常重要。 因此，对原子精确和单分散石墨烯碎片中明确的缺陷结构的研究，将在了解结构-性能关系（例如它们的光物理性能）方面发挥独特的作用。在所有缺陷中，Stone-Wales（S-W）缺陷（从化学角度来看，azupyrene单元，pyrene的结构异构体）已被很好地预测会改变石墨烯的电子特性、能带结构和态密度。然而，自从Anderson及其同事于1968年首次合成并表征了azupyrene以来，在过去的几十年里，嵌入azupyrene的石墨烯纳米结构的合成仍然难以捉摸。因此，石墨烯中由拓扑S-W缺陷（azupyrene单元）引起的物理化学性质仍然遥不可及，但有理由推测这种S-W缺陷在纳米石墨烯分子中的存在将对其拓扑和性质产生深远的影响。此外，将杂原子引入到石墨烯纳米结构中是改变其固有光电特性的另一种策略。 在杂原子中，氮（N）由于其基于不同杂化轨道键合方式的电子接受和给予能力，在调节π共轭结构的电子特性方面发挥着重要作用。 然而，π扩展体系的合成策略通常需要苛刻的反应条件，少有杂环可以忍受，从而阻碍了具有非交替拓扑的杂原子嵌入纳米石墨烯的发展。在该项目中，我们将建立一条新的研究路线，在分子水平上精准合成具有N掺杂的S-W缺陷结构的纳米石墨烯，作为赋予曲率、芳香性、化学活性等新特性的途径 、氧化还原和光物理特性，以及新的电子功能。 为了实现这一目标，该项目将利用不同的化学方法，包括有机化学、固态物理和光学建模。

17309223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309223.value: 用於特定協變量處理效應的非參數自助抽樣因果推斷

17309223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309223.value: Causal inference for covariate-specific treatment effects has drawn enormous attention of statistical researchers in recent years, partly because of the flourishing interests shown in personalised treatments in the field of medicine. Consider the common problem of comparing two treatments, where the major target of interest, termed the covariate-specific treatment effect (CSTE), takes the form of a difference between the expected responses to the two treatments, rendered by an individual or a homogeneous sub-population associated with a particular covariate setting. The challenge of the problem lies in the fact that each respondent is only assigned one of the two treatments, but not both. Under certain assumptions on the random mechanisms underlying the allocation of treatments and the potential responses, consistent estimators of CSTE have been developed in both parametric and nonparametric settings. This project focuses on the nonparametric setting where both the CSTE and the propensity score, viewed as functions of the covariate, do not assume any known parametric form, rendering statistical analysis of CSTE more challenging than that under a parametric setting. The kernel method has been a popular tool for building nonparametric CSTE estimators, based on which causal inference is often made by normal approximation. To facilitate the latter approach, the protocol is to suppress the bias of the CSTE kernel estimator using an undersmoothing bandwidth, followed by estimation of its asymptotic variance, at the expense of optimality in its performance of inferencing tasks. Explicit bias correction has been advocated as a remedy to restore optimality in related problems such as density estimation and nonparametric regression, but receives scanty attention for CSTE kernel estimation, probably because of the analytical complications involved in estimation of the asymptotic bias. This project aims to develop a bootstrap solution to the problem, which undertakes bias correction and statistical inference in one go, without compromising the performance of the CSTE estimator by undersmoothing, nor having to handle complicated analytical formulae of its asymptotic bias and variance by nonparametric, typically unstable, estimation. By relaxing a condition conventionally assumed on the range of the propensity score, our proposed solution is formulated to work under a general, practically relevant, scenario where the two treatments may be subject to vastly unbalanced supplies so that nonparametric estimation of the asymptotic bias and variance becomes analytically prohibitive. We also provide error assessment of the proposed bootstrap method, based on which the optimal orders of kernel bandwidths can be determined. 針對特定協變量處理效應的因果推斷在近年統計學研究中受到了大量關注，部分因為日漸增長的對於在醫療領域中針對個人的處理效應的興趣。考慮到最主要的問題，又稱為“特定協變量處理效應 (CSTE)”問題，即對比兩個不同的實驗處理，設定為處於某特定協變量環境中的一個個體或者是同質化的子群體對於兩組實驗處理反應變量期望值的差。此問題的挑戰在於每一個實驗的反應變量只對應於一種實驗處理，而不是全部兩種。假設實驗處理的分配和其潛在的反應變量的運行機制滿足某隨機性的條件，在參數化或非參數化的設定下都開發出具有一致性的CSTE估計器。本項目著眼於非參數化的設定，在此設定下被視為協變量的函數的CSTE和傾向性評分毋需採用任何可知的參數化形式，意味著相比於在參數化的設定情形下，針對CSTE的統計分析更加具有挑戰性。核函數方法在構建非參數化的CSTE估計器時廣受歡迎，而正態估計也時常被採用於核估計的因果推斷。為了便於正態估計，協議通過使用過度光滑帶寬來抑制CSTE核估計器的偏差，然后估計其漸近方差，以換取其在推斷任務性能上的最佳性。明確的偏差修正被提倡為修復密度估計和非參數回歸等相關問題中的最優性問題的解決方案，但對於CSTE核估計卻沒有得到足夠的關注，可能是因為在估計漸近偏差時涉及的分析復雜性。本項目旨在開發一種自助抽樣解決方案，一次性完成偏差修正和統計推斷，既不會因欠平滑而使CSTE估計器的性能受損，也無需通過通常情況下不穩定的非參數方法來處理其漸近偏差和方差的復雜分析公式。通過放寬傳統上對傾向性評分范圍的假設，我們提出的解決方案被構建為適用於一般性、實際相關的場景，即其中兩種實驗處理可能受到極度不平衡的供應，使非參數估計的漸近偏差和方差在分析上變得不再可行。我們還提供了基於此提出的自助抽樣方法的錯誤評估，可以確定核帶寬的最優漸進序列。

17309323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17309323.value: 圍繞雙星體的衛星和系外行星的動力學和演化

17309323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17309323.value: Dr Reffert, Sabine Dr Trifonov, Trifon

17309323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17309323.value: Planets and satellites orbiting around binaries have been discovered in both the solar system and extrasolar planetary systems. Their orbital properties provide important constraints on the formation and evolution of planets and satellites. We propose to investigate several problems related to the dynamics and evolution of the small satellites of Pluto-Charon and circumbinary extrasolar planets. (1) We will determine the free eccentricities (and other orbital parameters) of all known circumbinary planets and improve the free eccentricities of the satellites of Pluto-Charon. We will examine the clues that they provide on the origin and evolution of these objects. TIC 172900988 is the first system where the precession of the binary orbit due to gravitational perturbations from the planet has been detected. We will also examine whether there are other systems where the precession of the binary orbit is detectable. (2) A Hamiltonian theory that we have previously developed for the gravitational interactions between the binary and the circumbinary object assumes a circular binary orbit for application to the present-day Pluto system. We will modify this theory to account for non-circular binary orbit for application to circumbinary extrasolar planets. This will give an analytic theory for the precession of the binary orbit. We will also examine additional terms in the Hamiltonian theory to seek an explanation for the discrepancy at small distances from the center of mass between the numerically determined epicyclic frequency and the Hamiltonian theory that we have previously found, with particular application to the satellite Styx of Pluto-Charon. (3) We will use radial velocity and astrometric data to determine whether HD 202206 is a binary star system with a circumbinary brown dwarf or a solar-type star with two substellar companions. We will investigate the initial conditions and migration rate in a circumbinary disk that can lead to the formation of the 5:1 mean-motion resonance in HD 202206 and 6:1 mean-motion resonance in nu Ophiuchi. (4) We will examine the stability of circumbinary orbits and determine whether there are islands of stability, stabilized by secular apsidal alignment and mean-motion resonances, for eccentric circumbinary orbits that extend closer to the binary than the critical stability boundary for circular orbits. 天文學家已在太陽系和系外行星系統中發現圍繞雙星體運行的行星和衛星。它們的軌道特性對行星和衛星的形成和演化理論提供重要的約束。我們提議研究幾個與圍繞冥王星-凱倫的小衛星和圍繞雙星的系外行星的動力和演化有關的問題。（1）我們將確定所有已知繞雙星的系外行星的自由偏心率（和其他軌道參數），改進圍繞冥王星-凱倫的小衛星的自由偏心率，並研究它們對這些星體的起源和演化所提供的線索。TIC 172900988 是第一個檢測到由於行星引力攝動而導致雙星軌道進動的系統。我們還將研究是否有其他系統可以檢測到雙星軌道的進動。（2) 我們之前為冥王星-凱倫和小衛星之間的引力相互作用研發的哈密頓理論假設適用於當今的冥王星系統的圓形雙星軌道。我們將修改這一理論至非圓形雙星軌道，以應用於環雙星的系外行星。這將會給出雙星軌道進動的分析理論。此外，我們之前發現，在距質心較小距離處，計算確定的周轉頻率與哈密頓理論之間存在差異。我們還將研究哈密頓理論中的附加項，以尋求這個差異的解釋，特定應用於冥衛五。（3) 我們將利用視向速度和天體測量數據來確定 HD 202206 是否是一個具有環雙星褐矮星的雙星系統，還是具有兩個亞恆星伴星的太陽型恆星。我們將研究可能導致 HD 202206 中的 5:1 軌道共振和 nu Ophiuchi 中的 6:1 軌道共振形成的環雙星盤中的初始條件和遷移率。（4）我們將檢查環繞雙星軌道的穩定性，並確定是否存在通過長期近軸對齊和平均運動共振穩定，比圓形軌道的臨界穩定邊界更接近雙星的橢圓環雙星軌道的穩定島。
