17501123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501123.value: 文化特征在危机中的作用

17501123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501123.value: 在什么条件下，像利他和信任这样的亲社会文化特征会具有特定的经济意义？尽管它的重要性显而易见，经济学文献对其的研究却并不充分。我们的假设是高风险环境下，这些特征在塑造经济决策中的作用会被激活。我们获得了一个独特的数据集以对此假设提供证据，我们调查了人们在COVID-19--与经济活动相关的风险加剧期间--的决策过程中各种特征的作用。 在中国一家领先的物流公司的支持下，我们获得了一个快递绩效记录数据集。该公司在中国31个省份中随机选择了大量快递员样本。样本涵盖了2018年1月至2020年12月间超过400万条每日绩效记录（即交付量），以及快递员的个人特征（如出生年份、性别和身份证号）。在这个样本中，绝大多数快递员都是外地工人。来自不同家乡的快递员在同一个快递网点工作，使得我们能够有力地识别文化特征的影响。此外，这些数据涵盖了COVID-19疫情前后的时期，这非常适合我们探索这个危机期间快递员的劳动供给决策。 初步调查显示，在COVID-19危机爆发的封城时期，家乡是革命根据地的快递员（即在第一次国共内战期间，被中国共产党占领的地区）比非根据地的快递员每天投递的包裹明显较少。然而，在2020年大流行开始之前，这两组快递员的投递量没有差异。为什么来自共产革命根据地的快递员面对相同的危机选择提供相对较少的劳动力？在大流行前，物流行业是一个常规的劳动密集型产业，快递员与一般劳动力没有特别的差异。在疫情爆发后，由于快递物流涉及人与人之间的接触，快递员的工作环境变得更加危险。但物流行业对于处于封锁状态下的人们的福祉至关重要。我们推测，在这种情况下，利他主义和对政府的信任等亲社会特征变得与快递员的劳动供给决策相关。历史研究表明，来自根据地地区的人们往往比其他地区的人们更不利他，对政府的信任也较少。 在这个项目中，我们有两个目标。首先，我们计划使用双重差分方法，来确定文化背景对快递员在封城期间劳动供给决策上的因果影响。其次，我们计划对样本中的快递员进行调查，测量他们的风险偏好、利他和对政府信任度，以便直接调查和估计这种影响产生的渠道。

17501423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501423.value: 生鮮電商平臺上的動態定價策略：實證分析與田野實驗

17501423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501423.value: 生鮮電商行業發展迅速，蘊藏著巨大的消費潛力。截至2021年，生鮮電商交易規模已突破1,000億美元，佔生鮮行業銷售總額的12.4%。預計未來五年內，生鮮電商銷售額將增長至6,000億美元。疫情的爆發極大地推動了生鮮電商的發展。隨著生鮮電商行業的逐漸升溫，眾多資本紛紛湧入，2021年的投資額已經超過100億美元。儘管需求和投資大幅增長，生鮮電商依然在尋找可持續的商業模式上面臨著艱難挑戰。其中一個重要挑戰是如何制定有效的定價策略，以適應每日需求波動，並實現利潤最大化。此外，由於生鮮類產品具有保質期短、易損耗等特點，庫存積壓導致的食物浪費也是企業和社會關注的熱點問題。生鮮食品的損耗不僅降低了生鮮電商平台的利潤率，更產生了大量的資源浪費和環境負擔，阻礙了城市的可持續發展。本研究將聚焦於生鮮電商行業的定價策略優化，旨在探索三個研究問題：1）如何估計生鮮電商平台中消費者隨時間變化的動態價格彈性？2）如何無偏估計消費者對不同類別產品的動態價格彈性？3）如何根據估計的消費者動態價格彈性，優化生鮮電商平台動態定價策略？本研究首先計劃利用雙重機器學習方法，測量消費者對不同類別產品的動態價格彈性，以控制在識別價格和需求之間的因果關係時產生的高維混雜偏誤。其次，我們計劃基於估計的消費者動態價格彈性進行模擬分析，得出針對不同類別產品的最佳動態定價策略。再次，我們計劃通過大規模田野實驗，在真實的商業環境中實地檢驗動態定價策略對生鮮電商平台利潤提升的影響。本研究預期擴展動態定價的相關理論，並為電商平台提供管理學洞見。同時，本研究結論的運用也有助於減少食品浪費，提升社會福利。

17501623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501623.value: 分析师在 ESG 研究中的作用

17501623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501623.value: Analysts are important information intermediaries in capital markets that provide value relevant inputs to various capital market participants such as analysts, creditors, regulators, and suppliers (Givoly and Lakonishok, 1984; Brown 1993; Ramnath, Rock, and Shane 2008). In doing analysis for firms, analysts have access to a wide range of information such as security prices, firm-specific financial and operating information, industry data, and macroeconomic factors. Based upon analysis of multiple factors, analysts provide their opinions on valuation of firms in the form of stock recommendations, earnings forecasts, and target prices. A relatively recent literature on firms’ ESG (Environmental, Social, and Governance) activities has shown a positive relationship between ESG activities and firm value (Dhaliwal, Li, Tsang, and Yang 2011; Matsumura, Prakash, and Vera-Munoz 2014; Lys, Naughton, and Wang 2015). At the same time, there are widespread concerns about the extent of greenwashing in CSR disclosures by firms (Grewal and Serafeim, 2020; Raghunandan and Rajgopal, 2021). To the extent that ESG activities of firms have an impact on their profitability and valuation, one would expect that ESG activities of firms are an important factor that analysts should consider while valuing a firm. As a result, analysts that are better able to incorporate the analysis of ESG activities should have better forecasting properties and their reports should also be more informative for capital market participants. At the same time, analysts also play a monitoring role for managers and help improve the information environment of firms. As a consequence of this monitoring role and additional efforts expended by analysts in better understanding the ESG activities of firms, I expect that analyst coverage should have a disciplinary role on the extent of greenwashing claims made by managers. However, to the best of my knowledge, there are no studies that systematically look at the role of ESG analysis in analyst reports. In this study, I aim to fill this gap in literature by focusing on three primary research questions: 1. Do analysts discuss ESG activities and their impact in the research reports? If yes, what are the determinants of ESG discussions in analyst research reports? 2. Do market participants value analyst discussions of ESG activities (as evidenced by market reaction and information environment variables around the time of release of reports)? 3. Do analysts play a monitoring role in the extent of greenwashing claims made by firms in their reports? 分析师是资本市场中重要的信息中介者，为各种资本市场参与者提供价值相关的输入，如分析师、债权人、监管机构和供应商（Givoly和Lakonishok，1984; Brown 1993; Ramnath，Rock和Shane 2008）。在为公司进行分析时，分析师可以获得广泛的信息，如证券价格、公司特定的财务和运营信息、行业数据和宏观经济因素。基于对多种因素的分析，分析师以股票推荐、盈利预测和目标价格的形式提供对公司估值的意见。关于公司的环境、社会和治理（ESG）活动的相对较新的文献表明，ESG活动与公司价值之间存在积极的关系（Dhaliwal、Li、Tsang和Yang 2011; Matsumura、Prakash和Vera-Munoz 2014; Lys、Naughton和Wang 2015）。同时，人们普遍担心企业在企业社会责任披露中的虚假宣传程度（Grewal和Serafeim，2020; Raghunandan和Rajgopal，2021）。如果企业的ESG活动对其盈利能力和估值产生影响，那么我们可以预期，企业的ESG活动是分析师在估值企业时应考虑的重要因素。因此，能够更好地整合ESG活动分析的分析师应具有更好的预测性能，他们的报告也应更具信息量，以供资本市场参与者参考。同时，分析师还扮演着管理者的监督角色，帮助改善企业的信息环境。由于这种监督作用和分析师在更好地了解企业的ESG活动方面所做的额外努力，我预计分析师的覆盖范围应在企业虚假宣传程度方面发挥约束作用。然而，据我所知，尚无研究系统地探讨ESG分析在分析师报告中的作用。在本研究中，我旨在填补这一文献空白，重点关注三个主要研究问题：1.分析师是否在研究报告中讨论ESG活动及其影响？如果是，分析师研究报告中ESG讨论的决定因素是什么？2.市场参与者是否重视分析师对ESG活动的讨论（从发布报告时的市场反应和信息环境变量来看）？3.分析师是否在企业报告中虚假宣传程度方面发挥监督作用？

17501823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501823.value: 竞争公司在消费者信息不完整时如何提供个性化产品定位?

17501823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501823.value: The rapid development of predictive technologies and the availability of big data enable firms to personalize their product offerings to individuals based on their knowledge of individual consumer’s preferences. For example, the e-commerce platforms Amazon and Taobao carry such a wide range of products that these cannot be exhibited in full to each consumer. Therefore, these platforms use consumers’ behavioral and demographic data to predict consumers’ interests and show consumers products that best match their predicted interests, i.e., the platforms personalize their product positioning for each consumer. Similarly, offline retailers such as Macy’s and Nordstrom employ recommendation algorithms on their websites or mobile applications. In content markets, the homepages of users of platforms such as Netflix, TikTok, and Spotify feature links to content on genres, topics, and with political orientations that match users’ past viewing or listening history, such that different consumers may have different content on their homepages on the same platform. Prior research has studied personalized pricing and personalized communication but understanding of personalized product positioning remains limited. Firms may believe that with better knowledge of consumer preferences, they can further differentiate from their competitors and therefore benefit from personalized product offerings. Interestingly, our preliminary analysis shows that the degree of product differentiation due to firms’ personalized offerings is non-monotonic in the accuracy of firms’ knowledge of consumer preferences. Furthermore, as the accuracy of firms’ consumer knowledge increases, firms may offer more differentiated products to consumers but also engage in more intense price competition, which is contrary to the intuition that product differentiation lessens price competition. In this proposed project, we will exploit the abovementioned insights from our preliminary analysis to answer the following four questions. (1) What kind of personalized product positioning strategy should a firm use when a competing firm can also personalize its product positioning, and how do personalization strategies vary with mainstream products and niche products? (2) What is the relationship between positioning choice and price? (3) Do firms and consumers benefit when competing firms have accurate knowledge of individual consumer’s preferences? (4) Will firms compete in and profit from investing in increasing personalization accuracy, and what is the influence on consumer welfare? The findings from this proposed project will enhance our understanding of the impact of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence on firms’ personalization strategies, consumer welfare, and market equilibrium. 预测技术的快速发展和大数据的可用性使企业能够根据对个人消费者偏好的了解，为个人提供个性化的产品。 例如，Amazon、Taobao等电商平台的产品种类繁多，无法向每个消费者展示全部的产品。 因此，这些平台利用消费者的行为和统计数据来预测消费者的兴趣，并向消费者展示最符合其预测兴趣的产品，即平台为每个消费者个性化其产品定位。 同样，Macy和Nordstrom等线下零售商也在其网站或移动应用程序上采用推荐算法。 在内容市场中，Netflix、TikTok和Spotify等平台的用户主页上会提供与用户过去观看或收听历史相匹配的流派、主题和政治倾向的内容链接，因此不同的消费者即便使用同一平台也可能会在看到不同的内容。 已有的文献研究了个性化定价和个性化沟通，但对个性化产品定位的研究仍然有限。 企业可能认为，通过更好地了解消费者偏好，他们可以进一步区别于竞争对手，从而从个性化产品中受益。 有趣的是，我们的初步分析表明，企业个性化产品带来的产品差异化程度在企业了解消费者偏好的准确性的维度上并非单调变化。 此外，随着企业消费者知识准确性的提高，企业可能会向消费者提供更具差异化的产品，但也可能导致更激烈的价格竞争，这与产品差异化减少价格竞争的直觉相反。 在这个拟议的项目中，我们将来回答以下四个问题。 （1）当竞争企业可以个性化其产品定位时，企业应该采用什么样的个性化产品定位策略？主流产品和利基产品的个性化策略有何不同？ （2）定位选择与价格之间有何关系？ （3）当竞争企业准确了解个人消费者的偏好时，企业和消费者都会受益吗？ (4) 企业是否会在提高个性化准确性方面的投资中展开竞争并从中获利，这对消费者福利有何影响？ 该项目的研究结果将加深我们对人工智能等新兴技术对企业个性化战略、消费者福利和市场均衡影响的理解。

17501923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17501923.value: 历史结果与消费者学习

17501923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17501923.value: 在过去，消费者在购买产品的时候是看不到产品的历史价格信息的。然而，现代科技使得互联网平台可以向消费者展示产品历史价格。一个例子是香港的电商平台香港电视，它会追踪产品的历史价格信息并将其公布给消费者。 有感于以上的商业实践，本项目研究历史价格信息是如何影响消费者，商家和互联网平台的。我们考虑一个商家在两期向消费者销售一个新产品。产品本身的质量是不确定的。每个消费者会收到一个产品质量的信号，而公司知道产品的真实质量。我们考虑两种环境：公开历史价格信息和不公开历史价格信息。在公开历史价格信息的情况下，第二期的消费者可以看到第一期的价格和销量，并据此判断产品的质量。而在不公开历史价格信息的情况下，第二期消费者只能看到第一期的销量，并据此判断产品的质量。我们分析这两个模型的不同，并讨论历史价格信息的影响。 本研究对信息披露的研究有所贡献。过去，研究考虑了披露质量，需求，成本等信息而没有涉及历史价格信息。我们的研究还对观察学习的文献做出了贡献。最后，我们的研究将帮助互联网平台做更好的信息披露决策，以及帮助政府立法规管互联网平台的信息披露。

17502023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502023.value: 灾害预警信息披露的动态机制设计

17502023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502023.value: 当潜在的灾难（例如全球大流行、飓风登陆）即将来临时，我们面临着抉择，即采取高成本的预防措施（例如呆在家里、避难）或者承受灾害可能造成的潜在损害。此外，尽早采取行动对减轻灾害损失更为有效。同时，我们可能倾向于等待更多的证实证据来评估灾害的可能性。政府机构（例如疾病控制与预防中心、国家气象局）有责任提供可靠的时效信息，以帮助公众评估风险并引导公众适当作出行动。然而，机构和公众在控制经济损失和灾害损失之间的权衡方面，激励可能并不完全一致。 在这个项目中，我们将模拟这种情况，并使用两期信息设计框架研究机构的预警信息设计问题。灾难的是否发生在第二期结束时会被决定。然而，在每个时期，机构都会事先观察有关灾难的信号，基于此向公众提供一些信息。在收到机构的信息后，公众决定是否采取预防措施或等待进一步信息。因此，公众有两次机会采取行动，每次机会都出现在当期结束。第二期的信号比第一期的信号更加准确。机构需要在第一期开始前设计动态信息政策。 我们的初步研究结果表明，如果机构更关注灾害损失，它将夸大早期信号，而如果它更关注经济损失，它将淡化早期信号或晚期信号。这种行为的原因是机构面临着一种权衡，即提供当前激励和引导未来正确行动之间的权衡。在方法上，我们建立了一个动态信息设计模型。我们通过引入承诺效用来刻画机构向公众提供的信息量。

17502523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502523.value: 金融技術的採用與普惠金融：來自新冠疫情期間慈善眾籌借貸的證據

17502523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502523.value: We aggregate information from over one million crowdsourced charitable loans from Kiva.org to construct a novel measure of global financial inclusion initiatives. Kiva is a Fintech-driven charitable lending platform that intermediates zero-interest loans from a worldwide crowd to underbanked individuals mostly in the developing world. We investigate the impact of this Fintech platform on global financial inclusion by (i) examining the user-lenders’ social and personal preferences, (ii) exploring the dynamics of such preferences during normal times and the pandemic, and (iii) probing into the government’s role in promoting such initiatives. We aim to deliver findings in three areas. First, we ask whether the degree to which borrower regions and lender regions are socially connected predicts charitable lending. We hypothesize that charitable lenders exhibit “stamp collecting” lending behaviors, i.e., lending more to borrowers in unfamiliar regions, during normal times. However, after the outbreak of the pandemic, these lenders reverse the pattern and prioritize their lending to regions where they are more socially connected to. Second, we hypothesize loans to be funded slowlier if the borrowers are not smiling in their profile pictures taken for the loans during both normal times and the pandemic. To strengthen identification, we aim to replicate the same findings in a much smaller sample that consists of only repeated borrowers (N=9,341 vs. N=206,574 in the full sample). In the repeated borrowers’ sample, we aim to include borrower fixed effects and explore if the smile effect exists even within the same borrower. Third, we investigate whether various government policies implemented during the pandemic affect charitable lending. While many policies are intended for pandemic containment, we study a subset of them that have implications specific to financial inclusion in our settings. For example, we ask whether recipients of direct cash support increase their charitable lending on Kiva relative to user-lenders in regions that implement no such policy. All our hypotheses involved difference-in-differences (DiD) designs that exploit the pandemic as a shock and certain variables of interest as the treatment-control separation. For setups in which the treatment is staggered (e.g., staggered policy implementation), we estimate the event-based stacked regression similar to Cengiz et al. (2019) in order to avoid biases common in the standard two-way fixed effects (TWFE) DiD regressions with staggered intervention and treatment effect heterogeneity (Baker, Larcker, and Wang 2022). By incorporating the recent advances in econometrics and applied economics, we aim for interpretable and statistically unbiased identifications. 我們匯總了來自 Kiva.org 的 100 多萬筆眾籌慈善貸款的信息，構建了全球普惠金融倡議的新衡量標準。 Kiva 是一個由金融科技驅動的慈善貸款平臺，它將來自世界各地的零利率貸款仲介給生活在發展中國家，銀行服務不足的個人。我們通過（一）研究用戶借貸者的社會和個人偏好，（二）探索正常時期和新冠大流行時期此類偏好的動態變化，以及（三）探究政府在促進此類倡議中的作用，來研究該金融科技平臺對全球金融包容性的影響。 我們的計畫有三個研究目標。 首先，我們探索借款人所在地區和貸款人所在地區的社會聯繫程度是否會預測慈善貸款。 我們認為，在正常時期，慈善貸款人會表現出類似 「集郵 」貸款行為，即更多地貸款給不熟悉地區的借款人。 然而，在新冠疫情爆發后，這些貸款人會扭轉這種模式，優先向與他們有更多社會聯繫的地區貸款。 其次，我們認為，如果借款人在正常時期和新冠疫情期間為貸款拍攝的個人資料照片中沒有微笑，則貸款獲得資金挹注的速度會比較慢。 為了更確定因果關係，我們打算在一個只包括重複借款人的小樣本中，重複同樣的研究（樣本數=9 341，而全樣本數=206 574）。 在重複借款人樣本中，我們可以納入借款人固定效應，排除許多干擾的因素，並確立在同一借款人中也存在微笑效應。 第三，我們將研究新冠疫情期間實施的各種政府政策，是否會影響慈善貸款。 雖然許多政策都是為了遏制大流行，但我們會專注在對普惠金融有特定影響的政策。 例如，我們將探討政府直接普發現金政策的受惠者是否會增加其在Kiva上的慈善借貸。 我們的所有實證分析都採用了差分（DiD）設計，將新冠疫情作為一種外生變數，進行對照組與實驗組的比較分析。我們會參考Cengiz 等人（2019 年）以堆疊回歸分析法處理基於交錯外生處置效果的資料，以避免在交錯干預和處理效果異質性的標準雙向固定效應（TWFE）DiD 回歸中常見的偏差（Baker、Larcker 和 Wang，2022 年）。 通過結合計量經濟學和應用經濟學的最新進展，我們的目標是實現在統計上無偏見的因果識別。

17502623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502623.value: 中国的自下而上制度改革与经济增长

17502623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17502623.value: Prof Chen, Heng Prof Zhu, Xiaodong

17502623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502623.value: Numerous studies have attempted to identify the sources of total factor productivity (TFP) growth in China---the main driver of its spectacular economic growth during the reform period over 1978-2007 (Zhu, 2012), yet there remains a large residual that cannot be accounted for. In this proposed project, we study the role of bottom-up institutional innovations initiated and carried out by subnational governments in China’s TFP growth, with a particular focus on exploring the origins of the policy innovations across the space and the evolution of spatial patterns over time. We will collect and digitize text data on “Chronicle of Events” (“大事记”) from local gazetteers of different counties. This dataset on local event will provide a panoramic yet detailed view of the nation’s recent history. We will apply machine learning models to study the textual similarity of local events to subsequent policies at the central government level and infer policy innovation intensity of different localities in a model consistent way. We will also develop a quantifiable model that generates novel insights on how bottom-up policy initiatives introduce gradual yet transformative changes of central policies and diffuse across space. We will then estimate the model and conduct various counterfactual simulations to quantify the effects of bottom-up policy reforms on China’s economic growth and spatial income disparity. 中国全要素生产率（TFP）增长是中国改革时期（1978-2007）经济增长的主要驱动力（朱, 2012）。许多现有研究试图确定的来源，但仍存在大量的剩余余部分无法解释。在本项目中，我们将研究中国地方政府发起和实施的自下而上制度创新在中国TFP增长中的作用，特别关注探索政策创新在空间上的起源和随时间演变。 我们将收集和数字化不同县志中的“大事记”文本数据。这个关于地方事件的数据集将提供国家近期历史的全景和详细视角。我们将应用机器学习模型研究地方事件与随后的中央政策的文本相似性，并以与模型一致的方式推断不同地方的政策创新强度。我们还将开发一个可量化的模型，研究自下而上政策创新是如何逐渐改变中央层面的政策，并在空间上扩散。然后，我们将估计该模型并进行各种反事实模拟，量化自下而上的政策改革对中国经济增长和空间收入差距的影响。

17502723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17502723.value: 共同基金如何评估竞争对手：来自401(k) 计划的经验证据

17502723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17502723.value: Dr Huang, Shiyang Dr Shi, Ran

17502723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17502723.value: In this project, we exploit a unique setting of the defined-contribution (DC) retirement plans in the United States to understand what fund managers know about their competitors’ skills. Mutual funds are the most dominant product among large private-sector DC plans, i.e., the 401(k) plans. In the meantime, most plan sponsors (employers) engage mutual fund companies to operate pension plans, a service called “recordkeeping”. We focus on the menu change decisions of the recordkeepers, who are themselves mutual fund companies. These decisions parallel the decisions to invest or divest mutual funds made by households. By investigating the driving forces of these menu change decisions, we aim to understand the “signals” that mutual funds use to evaluate each other. For example, if, at the same time, fund F is added to the retirement plan menus operated by multiple fund companies (other than the one owning fund F, which may point towards conflicts of interest as in Pool, Sialm, and Stefanescu (2016)), we consider fund F receiving favourable “peer reviews”. Our study emphasizes the fact that fund flows reflect not only the preferences of households but also financial institutions. One important component of fund flows, as emphasized by Sialm, Starks, and Zhang (2015), is created from reallocations of retirement savings accounts, the assets of which are largely mutual funds. Since employees rarely change their retirement portfolios, menu change decisions are the main drivers of pension asset allocations and the resulting mutual fund flows incurred by the pension money. Since a large part of the menu change decisions are made by mutual fund companies, the induced fund flows mostly reflect the preferences of institutional investors. Our research then sheds light on this important heterogeneity in preferences embedded in observable fund flows. Our research contributes to the literature on fund managers’ decision-making process. On the portfolio level, geographical proximity (Coval and Moskowitz, 1999, 2001), social connections (Cohen, Frazzini, and Malloy, 2010), and personal experiences (Pool, Stoffman, and Yonker, 2012) all seem to affect fund managers’ holdings. We aim to contribute by studying how mutual funds when they act as the recordkeepers of pension plans, select other mutual fund products for their clients. We also contribute to the literature on pension plan efficiencies. We aim to understand the informational contents of the additions or removals of unaffiliated products. 在这个项目中，我们利用“美国固定缴款退休计划”的独特设置来研究基金经理如何了解其竞争对手的技能。共同基金是大型私营部门“固定缴款退休计划”（即 401(k) 计划）中最主要的产品。与此同时，大多数计划发起人（雇主）聘请共同基金公司来运营养老金计划，这项服务称为“记录保存”。 我们专注于记录管理人的产品清单变更决策，而他们本身就是共同基金公司。这些决定与家庭个人投资者投资或撤离共同基金的决定类似。通过调查这些产品清单变更决策的驱动因素，我们旨在研究共同基金用来相互评价的“信号”。例如，如果基金 F 同时被添加到由多家基金公司（除了拥有基金 F 的一家公司）运营的退休计划菜单中，这可能会导致利益冲突。因此，我们认为基金 F 获得了有利的“同行评审”。 我们的研究强调了这样一个事实：资金流向不仅反映了家庭的偏好，也反映了金融机构的偏好。正如过去的文献所强调的，资金流动的一个重要组成部分是通过退休储蓄账户的重新分配创建的，其资产主要是共同基金。由于员工很少改变他们的退休投资组合，产品清单变化决策是养老金资产配置以及养老金资金产生的共同基金流动的主要驱动力。同样地，由于产品清单变更决策很大一部分是由共同基金公司做出的，因此诱导的资金流向主要反映了机构投资者的偏好。然后，我们的项目揭示了如何利用可观察资金流来研究偏好的异质性。 我们的研究对基金经理决策过程的文献做出了贡献。在投资组合层面，地理邻近性、社会关系以及个人经历似乎都会影响基金经理的投资组合。我们的目标是研究共同基金在充当养老金计划的记录保管人时如何为其客户选择其他共同基金产品。我们还为有关养老金计划效率的文献做出贡献。不同于已有的文献，我们的目标是了解添加或删除非附属产品的信息内容。

17503023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503023.value: 金融科技时代的金融普惠：银行金融科技对资源分配的影响

17503023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17503023.value: Dr Kwan, Alan P. Prof Lin, Chen

17503023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503023.value: 随着近年金融科技在零售信贷市场的快速发展，一个对政策制定者和监管方至关重要的问题是：金融科技是否能改善金融普惠？目前绝大多数相关研究采用针对金融科技公司和传统金融机构的简单横向对比，然而， 由于商业银行等传统金融机构仍然在市场上扮演主要角色，了解大型商业银行的金融科技使用情况及其后果就显得不可或缺。现有银行对金融科技的使用不仅直接通过技术和商业模式的变革对资源分配产生直接影响，还可能通过对行业市场结构的潜在影响对整个资源配置对一般均衡带来间接作用。 银行金融科技使用如何影响资源分配并没有明确的理论假设。一方面，现存大型银行的特许权价值和数据储备可使得金融科技投资产生更大的协同价值， 由此导致的市场集中度上升可对金融普惠产生负面作用。另一方面，技术的使用可以让现有商业银行更好的和金融科技公司竞争，从而又可能提升对弱势客户群体的普惠。 本课题计划结合多项微观金融数据来探索以上问题。我们提出用三个不同的实证策略来捕捉银行间金融科技使用情况的差异，从而能够对比同一市场内不同银行的个人及小微客户的信贷资源获取成本。 本课题的实证分析还将引出更多的相关研究，例如金融科技对金融系统稳定和货币政策传导等的影响。总的来说，本课题对在金融科技时代进一步改进相关政策和监管制度有着重要意义。

17503223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503223.value: 粮食安全风险对农业贸易与结构转型的阻碍

17503223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503223.value: Labor productivity is generally higher in non-agriculture than in agriculture within a country. The productivity gap averages around 2:1 in developed countries, but 6:1 in developing countries. Despite the large productivity gap, developing countries have a large portion of their labor force working in agriculture. This misallocation of labor is a main reason for the low aggregate productivity and income in these countries. One explanation for the labor misallocation is the food problem: Because of low productivity in agriculture, developing countries need to have more people working in agriculture to meet the food demand of their people. Importing food, then, seems to be an obvious solution to both the food problem and the labor misallocation problem. In reality, however, imports account for less than 10% of total agricultural expenditures in the poor countries, but around 40% in rich countries. Thus, the food problem in developing countries is closely linked to a missing food trade problem. Tariffs cannot explain the missing trade because import tariffs in developing and developed countries are similar. I will study food security risk as a potential explanation for the missing food trade problem. Food self-sufficiency has long been a stated national policy in many developing countries, and food security risk is often used as a justification for the policy. The spikes in world agricultural prices in recent years and the several countries’ banning of agricultural exports in response to the price spikes have made it clear that the risk of relying on imports for food security is real. Many economists, on the other hand, argue that the food self-sufficiency policy often led to lower productivity in agriculture and worsening food security in the long run. Is food security risk an important reason for the missing food trade problem? Does food self-sufficiency policy help to mitigate food security risk? To address these questions, I will first collect data to construct measures of exogenous shocks to food security risk and use them to identify the effect of food security risk on sectoral labor allocation. I will then develop a novel model of agricultural trade under uncertainty to interpret the empirical results, and use the model to quantify the impact of food security risk on developing countries’ agricultural trade, structural change and aggregate productivity; and to study if there are policies that could help to mitigate food security risk and reduce labor misallocation at the same time. 劳动生产率在一个国家的非农业部门通常高于农业部门。在发达国家，非农与农业部门的生产率差距平均为2比1，而在发展中国家为6比1。尽管存在巨大的生产率差距，发展中国家仍有大部分劳动力从事农业工作。这种劳动力配置的错配是这些国家总体生产率和收入较低的主要原因之一。劳动力错配的一个解释是粮食问题：由于农业生产力低下，发展中国家需要有更多的人从事农业工作以满足人民的粮食需求。然而，事实上，进口粮食占国家总食品消费支出的比例在贫困国家不到10％，而在富裕国家占约40％。因此，发展中国家的粮食问题与缺失的粮食贸易问题密切相关。关税无法解释缺失的贸易，因为发展中国家和发达国家的进口关税相似。 我将研究粮食安全风险作为缺失粮食贸易问题的一个潜在解释。粮食自给自足长期以来一直是许多发展中国家的国家政策，而粮食安全风险常被用作该政策的理由。近年来世界粮食价格的激增以及一些国家对价格激增作出的禁止农产品出口的反应表明依赖进口的粮食安全风险是真实存在的。然而，许多经济学家认为，粮食自给自足政策往往导致农业生产率下降，长期来看也加剧了粮食安全问题。粮食安全风险是否是缺失粮食贸易问题的一个重要原因？粮食自给自足政策是否有助于缓解粮食安全风险？为了回答这些问题，我将首先收集数据，构建衡量粮食安全风险的外生冲击指标，并使用这些指标来确定粮食安全风险对部门劳动力配置的影响。然后，我将开发一个新颖的不确定性下农业贸易模型来解释实证结果，并使用该模型量化粮食安全风险对发展中国家农业贸易、结构转型和总体生产率的影响；并研究是否有政策可以同时缓解粮食安全风险和减少劳动力错误分配。

17503423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503423.value: 语言，国家建设，和经济发展

17503423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17503423.value: Dr Gaduh, Arya Mr KOK, CHUN CHEE

17503423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503423.value: The proposed project will study the effects of language prohibition in Indonesia on nation-building and economic development. Post-colonial nation-states often implemented policies to integrate individuals from diverse ethno-linguistic backgrounds. In particular, they prohibited learning of ethnic languages and promoted a single national language. Intuitively, a single language should be advantageous for unity - yet examples abound where such policies have failed and led to backlash. Hence, we seek to understand the conditions under which language prohibition policies can succeed. We do so in Indonesia, a country which has succeeded at building a relatively strong national identity despite more than 700 ethno-linguistic groups. We leverage plausibly exogenous variation resulting from a top-down policy that targeted ethnic Chinese. In 1957, the Indonesian government imposed regulations to limit the number of Chinese language medium schools. This resulted in a reduction from 2,000 schools in 1957 to 0 by 1965 -- resulting in ethnic Chinese becoming fluent mainly in the national language of Bahasa Indonesia. Based on preliminary fieldwork and socio-anthropological literature, we hypothesize that this resulted in stronger integration of ethnic Chinese into the Indonesian nation-state. Hence, we will conduct a retrospective survey to investigate the causal effects of language prohibition on national identity and development. E.g. To measure the relative strength of ethnic and national identification, we will ask respondents to self-rank identities and use lab-in-the-field experiments of public goods and contribution games, where we randomize ethnicity of the opposing player. To measure development, we collect data on inter-ethnic business and trading ties. To identify causality, we will use a Difference-in-Differences where we compare outcomes between four groups of individuals -- those born before and after the school closure policy, and, within each of these groups, those who lived in areas which had more Chinese-medium language schools and hence, were more affected by the policy, with those who lived in areas which had less Chinese-medium language schools. To measure intensity of school closures, we will collect data on the number of pre-closure Chinese-medium schools across Indonesia at the sub-district/village-level. Such a database does not yet exist. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first quantitative study of Chinese language prohibition on nation-building and economic development in Indonesia. Hence, it will provide insights for policy-makers to improve social cohesion. Academically, it sheds light on the mechanisms behind the mixed success of language prohibition policies by combining novel survey data with econometric techniques. 拟议的项目将研究印度尼西亚语言禁令对国家建设和经济发展的影响。后殖民国家经常实施政策，以整合来自不同族群和语言背景的个体。特别是，他们禁止学习民族语言并推广一种单一的国家语言。直觉上，单一语言应有利于团结 - 然而，很多例子表明此类政策失败并导致了强烈的反对。 因此，我们寻求了解语言禁令政策成功的条件。为此，我们选择印度尼西亚这个国家进行研究，尽管该国有700多个民族和语言群体，但它成功地建立了相对强大的国家认同。我们利用了一项自上而下的政策, 从而产生了可信的外生变动。 我们将进行一项回顾性调查，以研究语言禁令对国家认同和发展的因果效应。例如，为了衡量族群认同和国家认同的相对强度，我们将要求受访者对不同认同进行自我排名. 为了衡量发展情况，我们将收集关于族群间商业和贸易联系的数据。

17503623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17503623.value: 数字化和企业内部的社会不平等：一个信息处理能力赋权视角

17503623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17503623.value: The rise of digital technologies (e.g., artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, big data, and 5G) has led to significant changes in business operations and social activities. Accordingly, scholars are paying increasing attention to the social impacts of such technologies and debating whether they alleviate or exacerbate social inequality. The alleviating camp views digital technologies as an effective means of helping marginalized groups to gain equal social participation opportunities and public attention. In contrast, the exacerbating camp argues that disadvantaged subpopulations are often in an inferior position to benefit from digital technologies and may suffer bias in the digital world. Firms play a critical role in shaping social (in)equality, as they are responsible for job reward allocation and employment opportunities, which directly affect individuals’ social status and well-being. The rising within-firm inequality, such as the executive-employee pay gap and low-skilled worker unemployment, has attracted widespread public attention and the ire of watchdogs in recent years. Given that pay setting within organizations is a social exchange process that distributes job rewards among different groups of organizational members, prior studies have focused primarily on the roles of stakeholder forces and institutional factors. Under-researched is how the adoption of digital technologies influences pay inequality and employment. To inform the debate and address this research gap, the proposed project will investigate how firm digitalization affects within-firm inequality. In particular, we will attempt to answer the following questions: 1) How does firm digitalization affect social inequality within firms (i.e., executive-employee pay gap and low-skilled worker unemployment)? 2) How do a firm’s information characteristics (i.e., chief digital officer presence and technical personnel intensity) moderate the impact of digitalization on the executive-employee pay gap and low-skilled worker unemployment? 3) How do information environment factors (i.e., regional legal development and regional economic openness) moderate the impact of digitalization on the executive-employee pay gap and low-skilled worker unemployment? We expect our study to shed fresh light on the debate over how digital technologies affect social inequality. The findings will have important managerial implications for firms and policymakers to address the challenge of reducing within-firm inequality, an issue of rising public concern. 人工智能、区块链、云计算、大数据、5G等数字技术的兴起，导致商业运营和社会活动发生重大变化。因此，学者们越来越关注此类技术的社会影响，并争论它们是否会减轻或加剧社会不平等。缓解派认为数字技术是帮助边缘群体获得平等的社会参与机会和公众关注的有效手段。相比之下，加剧派认为，弱势群体往往处于劣势，无法从数字技术中受益，并且可能在数字世界中遭受偏见。 企业在塑造社会（不）平等方面发挥着关键作用，因为它们负责工作报酬分配和就业机会，这直接影响个人的社会地位和福祉。近年来，企业内部不平等现象的加剧，例如高管与雇员的薪酬差距和低技能工人失业，引起了公众和监管机构的的广泛关注。鉴于组织内部的薪酬设定是一个在不同组织成员群体之间分配工作奖励的社会交换过程，先前的研究主要集中在利益相关者力量和制度因素的作用上,缺乏关于数字技术的采用如何影响薪酬不平等和就业的研究。 并解决这一研究空白，本项目将调查企业数字化如何影响企业内部的不平等。我们将尝试回答以下问题： 1) 企业数字化如何影响企业内部的社会不平等（即高管与员工的薪酬差距和低技能工人失业）？ 2）企业的信息特征（即首席数字官的存在和技术人员密集度）如何调节数字化对高管与员工薪酬差距和低技能工人失业的影响？ 3）信息环境因素（即区域法制发展和区域经济开放度）如何调节数字化对高管薪酬差距和低技能工人失业的影响？ 我们的研究能够为有关数字技术如何影响社会不平等的争论提供新的启示。研究结果将对减少企业内部不平等这一公众日益关注的问题产生重要的管理意义。

17504223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504223.value: 晝夜節律如何影響消費者對算法建議和人類建議的相對偏好

17504223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504223.value: Consumers often seek recommendations when they make purchase decisions. These recommendations are traditionally made by human experts, but today it may be algorithms that generate recommendations for consumers. The existing literature has shed light on how consumers’ relative preference for algorithm-based versus human recommendations is affected by the characteristics of algorithms, products, and tasks. In this research, we aim to enrich this literature by studying the impact of time of day, a ubiquitous diurnal factor that permeates consumers’ daily lives, on the preference for either algorithm-based or human recommendation agents. We propose that consumers show a stronger preference for algorithm-based recommendation agents over human ones in the evening than in the morning because they believe that human cognitive functioning is worse in the evening. Boundary conditions that shed light on this mechanism will also be examined. We predict that the effect of time of day on the enhanced preference for algorithm-based recommendation agents is weaker when consumers are led to believe that human cognitive functioning does not significantly fluctuate across different times of day, when they are asked to seek recommendations that are focused on sensory experiences that are less subject to cognitive functioning, or among evening-type consumers who are less likely to subscribe to the notion that human cognitive functioning is stronger during daytime. The findings of this research will provide insights into how recommendation agent preference can be affected by a diurnal factor that influences people’s lives on a daily basis. They will also enrich our knowledge about how time of day may impact consumer behavior. Marketing practitioners can draw on the findings generated by this research to better design their recommendation system to increase consumer satisfaction with their recommendations. 消費者在做出購買決策時通常會尋求建議。傳統上，這些建議是由人類專家提供的，但今天也可能是由算法為消費者生成建議。現有文獻已經闡明了算法、產品和任務特性對消費者對基於算法的建議和人類建議的相對偏好的影響。本項目則研究日常生活中普遍存在的昼夜節律因素對算法或人類建議代理的偏好影響。我們提出，消費者在晚上比在早上更傾向於採用基於算法的建議，因為他們認為晚上人類的認知功能較差。另外我們預測，在消費者被引導相信人類的認知功能在不同的時間段內沒有明顯波動，被要求尋求專注於較不受認知功能影響的感官體驗的建議，或者是屬於晚型人的消費者時，晝夜節律對於算法建議偏好的影響將會減弱。這項研究的發現將有助於我們了解昼夜節律如何影響建議代理的偏好，以及關於時間因素如何影響消費者行為的知識。營銷從業者可以基於這項研究產生的結果更好地設計他們的建議系統，以增加消費者對他們建議的滿意度。

17504323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504323.value: 非货币信息和异构代理的信息、披露、价格

17504323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504323.value: One the most important functions of financial markets is to produce and aggregate information about the fundamentals of the traded assets. Information contained in market prices guide capital allocation and policy interventions. A voluminous literature has explored how trades by investors possessing dispersed information shape price informativeness. This literature typically assumes that investors are driven by pecuniary concerns and thus focus on firms' cash flows. However, in recent years the importance of other class of investors---those who have non-pecuniary concerns and evaluate performance of their investments not solely based on monetary payoffs---has become apparent. A prominent example of such investors are ESG investors who value investing in firms performing well along the environmental and social dimensions. In the presence of such investors, prices aggregate information not only about cash flows but also firms' non-monetary performance. In response to proliferation of ESG investing, regulators in many countries have considered (or, in fact, have already started) to require firms to disclose their non-financial information. The important question in this regard is how improvement in the quality of non-monetary public information affect market participants' trading activity, their incentives to acquire private information and, ultimately, price informativeness. The goal of this project is to shed light on this question. Our plan is to build a model in which investors with heterogeneous preferences trade the stock whose ``payoff'' consists of monetary and non-monetary components. Financial investors value only stock's monetary performance, while green investors also value stock's non-monetary performance. This preference heterogeneity implies that they trade differently based on their private information about the two payoff components and also seek to learn different information from the price. The main novelty of this project is its focus on the effect of public information on investors' trading behavior, information acquisition and price informativeness. 非货币（例如，ESG 相关）因素对资产价格和企业决策的重要性 最近的学术文献和政策辩论中都强调了这一点。 相当数量的市场 参与者愿意将 ESG 因素纳入投资决策中。 然而，一个并不令人满意的 ESG 信息（或一般非财务信息）的质量是阻碍 投资者在决策中充分考虑非货币因素。 作为对此的回应，监管机构 不同国家正在考虑建立强制性标准化要求来披露 非货币信息。 了解这些要求将如何影响投资者的行为、他们的 获取私人信息的激励措施以及最终价格的信息内容至关重要 政策制定者的兴趣。 更广泛地说，该项目旨在贡献大量重要的信息文献 和资产价格。 与现有文献相比，我们计划研究异质投资者 对驱动公司产出的不同风险因素的偏好。 具体来说，在我们的模型投资者中 异质偏好交易的股票的“收益”由货币和非货币部分组成。 金融投资者只看重股票的货币表现，而绿色投资者也看重 股票的非货币表现。 这种偏好异质性意味着他们基于不同的方式进行交易 关于他们关于两个支付部分的私人信息，并寻求了解不同的信息 从价格来看。 该项目的主要新颖之处在于它关注公共信息对投资者的影响 交易行为、信息获取和价格信息。

17504423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504423.value: 政治依从战略何时有效？领导者价值观与战略的匹配视角

17504423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504423.value: Political compliance strategy (PCS) refers to a firm’s stance on implementing business activities centered around government policies. Firms engage in PCS for institutional pressure or resource dependence (Durand & Jourdan, 2012; Greening & Gray, 1994; Raaijmakers et al., 2015), whereby firms gain legitimacy and critical resources by meeting governments’ demands or expectations. We know little about in which conditions PCSs will indeed improve firm performance. Drawing on theoretical perspectives from the upper echelons theory (Hambrick & Mason, 1984) and corporate political strategy literature (Hillman et al., 2004; Oliver & Holzinger, 2008), this research proposes a CEO value-strategy alignment model and predicts that corporate leaders’ personally held values moderate the relationship between PCS and firm performance. Specifically, this research predicts that Chinese non-state-owned (non-SOE) firms steered by a CEO who has an early-life exposure to a clan culture in their hometown are more likely to benefit from their PCS. This is because an early-life exposure to clan culture drives the CEO to develop a collectivistic ideology of “individual-state unity” that links their individual business success closely with the glory and prosperity of their state. This alignment between CEO collectivistic ideology of “individual-state unity” and political compliance strategy helps firms garner more benefits from their political compliance activities. This research further predicts that this alignment effect is moderated by a set of contextual factors, including the CEO’s overseas experiences, the firm’s foreign ownership, and the institutional development in the region when a firm is located. Empirically, I plan to test these predictions in the setting of non-SOE Chinese firms’ participation in the Belt and Road Initiative (BRI), which is a prominent form of PCS in China. I predict a positive relationship between a firm’s BRI participation and performance when the firm is steered by a CEO with early-life exposure to a clan culture in his/her hometown. Moreover, this interaction effect is weaker when the CEO has more overseas experiences, when the firm has greater foreign ownership, and when the firm is located in a region with better market development; but is stronger when the firm has a top management team with more members with similar exposure to clan cultures and when the firm is located in a region with a strong Confucianism culture. I plan to test these predictions by collecting the large longitudinal data from multiple archival sources and multi-wave field interviews. 政治依从战略（PCS）是指企业围绕政府政策开展业务活动的立场。企业出于制度压力或资源依赖而参与 PCS (Durand & Jourdan, 2012; Greening & Gray, 1994; Raaijmakers et al., 2015)，企业通过满足政府的要求或期望来获得合法性和关键资源。我们对 PCS 在哪些条件下确实能够提高公司绩效知之甚少。借鉴高层理论（Hambrick & Mason，1984）和企业政治战略文献（Hillman et al.，2004；Oliver & Holzinger，2008）的理论观点，本研究提出了一个 CEO 价值观-战略匹配性模型，并预测企业领导者个人持有的价值观调节 PCS 与公司绩效之间的关系。具体来说，这项研究预测，由早年接触过家乡宗族文化的首席执行官领导的中国非国有（非国有企业）公司更有可能从其个人电脑制中受益。这是因为，早年接触氏族文化促使首席执行官发展出一种“个人与国家团结”的集体主义意识形态，将个人商业的成功与国家的荣耀和繁荣紧密联系起来。首席执行官“个人与国家一体性”的集体主义意识形态与政治合规战略之间的这种一致性有助于企业从政治合规活动中获得更多利益。这项研究进一步预测，这种一致性效应会受到一系列背景因素的调节，包括首席执行官的海外经历、公司的外资所有权以及公司所在地区的制度发展。根据经验，我计划在中国非国有企业参与“一带一路”倡议（BRI）的背景下检验这些预测，“一带一路”倡议是中国 PCS 的一种重要形式。我预测，当一家公司由一位早年接触过家乡宗族文化的首席执行官领导的公司时，该公司的“一带一路”参与与绩效之间会存在正向关系。而且，当CEO海外经历较多、企业外资持股比例较高、企业位于市场发展较好的地区时，这种互动效应较弱；但当公司的高层管理团队中有更多具有类似宗族文化背景的成员并且公司位于儒家文化浓厚的地区时，这种影响会更强。我计划通过从多个档案来源和多波现场采访收集大量纵向数据来测试这些预测。

17504523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504523.value: 城市服務中的運營公平性研究

17504523.label: Project Objectives
17504523.value: To develop a bike-relocation algorithm that accounts for spatial equity for pedestrians, and satisfies bike users’ demand to their largest extent. This stage of the proposed study involves (1) developing metrics of spatial equity that reflect the bikes’ utilization of public spaces across the city and (2) incorporating the requirement on spatial equity into the bike-relocation algorithm. To design a field experiment to gauge the effectiveness and cost of the spatial equitable relocation algorithm, while accounting for the interference within the bike-sharing network. To obtain an unbiased effect of our algorithm, we aim to empirically map the bike trips between geofences, based on which we propose a set of selection criteria (e.g., synthetic control) for the treated and control groups to minimize the spillover effect. To identify major market frictions that dampen the effectiveness or increase the cost of spatial equitable operations for urban service providers. Utilizing the outcomes from the field experiment, we draw on literature from Psychology, Computer Science, and Economics to understand the gap between the effectiveness and costs of the algorithm observed in the experiment and that predicted by numerical simulation.

This stage of the proposed study involves (1) developing metrics of spatial equity that reflect the bikes’ utilization of public spaces across the city and (2) incorporating the requirement on spatial equity into the bike-relocation algorithm.

To design a field experiment to gauge the effectiveness and cost of the spatial equitable relocation algorithm, while accounting for the interference within the bike-sharing network. To obtain an unbiased effect of our algorithm, we aim to empirically map the bike trips between geofences, based on which we propose a set of selection criteria (e.g., synthetic control) for the treated and control groups to minimize the spillover effect.

To identify major market frictions that dampen the effectiveness or increase the cost of spatial equitable operations for urban service providers. 17504523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504523.value: 近年來，共享單車作為一種便捷、經濟的交通工具越來越受歡迎。與傳統的自行車共享運營商將自行車停放在固定停車站點不同，許多公司（如美團）已經采用了無樁式系統。這種無樁式自行車共享模式擺脫了站點概念，使自行車可以停放在幾乎任何地方。儘管無樁系統為自行車騎行者提供了更大的靈活性，在許多城市中，過多自由停放的單車擁擠了人行道，妨礙了行人的日常通勤。與此同時，共享單車平台在進行單車調度決策時，往往只關注最大化地滿足用戶需求，而很少關注自行車占用了多少的公共空間。因此，對單車使用量較高的地區，用來停放單車的人行道往往會受到更嚴重的擁擠，導致城市中的不同區域的公共空間被不同程度上的侵佔，進而引發公共空間不公平的分配。在這個項目中，我們與中國最大的共享單車運營商之一，美團單車，進行合作。我們將定義空間公平性的指標，並將這些指標納入美團單車的調度算法之中，使得在滿足用戶訂單的同時減少對人行道的擁擠。此外，我們還將通過實地試驗來衡量公平重定位算法的有效性。

17504623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17504623.value: 理解香港公共房屋對私人房價的影響

17504623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504623.value: Hong Kong is the world’s most expensive city to live in. Despite the large-scale provision of affordable government housing for low-income households, house prices have skyrocketed in the past two decades. We are motivated by a striking pattern in the data: the prices of the lowest-priced homes rose much faster than those of higher-end homes between 2004 and 2020. Housing has thus become disproportionately more unaffordable for the poorest households. In theory, demand for private low-end homes should fall with public housing provision, leading to lower prices and making low-end private homes more affordable for households not in public housing. However, we observe the opposite. What caused the massive and highly uneven increase in Hong Kong’s housing prices? What is the effect of public housing on private-sector housing prices? How can housing be made affordable again? We propose to explain this housing price puzzle by devising a quantitative model of Hong Kong’s housing market. Our proposed mechanism unfolds in two steps: 1) an insufficient public housing supply forces low-income households to seek private-sector rentals; 2) the market responds to this unmet demand by converting homes into subdivided low-end rental homes. To formalize this logic, we will add new features to the workhorse housing assignment model to analyze how the availability of public housing affects the low-end buyer and rental market segments. In this model, the pricing equilibrium is affected by the combination of public housing policy, private housing supply, and demographic structure. We will combine the model with empirical data from the Hong Kong Population Census, validate key model predictions using relevant moments in the data, and perform counterfactual policy analysis. Our contributions will be threefold. First, we will be the first to include a public rental housing sector and a choice between owning and renting in a housing assignment framework. This extended framework will enable future researchers to use the workhorse housing assignment model to analyze prices in cities with substantial rental segments and public rental housing. Second, this study will be the first to combine comprehensive and detailed data with a quantitative economic model to assess Hong Kong’s housing affordability crisis from 1997 to 2021, utilizing housing transaction data from the Land Registry and demographic data from the Population Census. Third, our counterfactual policy analysis of increased public housing construction, public rent adjustment, and rent control has the potential to inform future policy decisions in Hong Kong. 香港的居住成本是全球最昂貴之一。儘管政府長期為低收入家庭提供廉價公共房屋，過去二十年房價卻一路飆升。本研究項目的宗旨是要了解一個引人注目的數據：2004 年至 2020 年間，最低價房屋的價格上漲速度遠遠快於高端房屋的價格。因此，對於最貧困的家庭來說，住房變得更加難以負擔。從理論上講，政府大規模提供公共住房，應該導致私人低端住宅的需求下降，從而導致價格下降，並使低端私人住宅對於非公共住房的家庭來說更容易負擔得起。然而，我們卻觀察到相反的情況。是什麼原因導致香港房價大幅上漲且極不平衡？公共住房對私人房價有何影響？如何才能讓住房再次變得可負擔？ 我們建議利用一個量化模型來解釋這個房價難題。我們提出兩個可能性：1）公屋供應不足，迫使低收入家庭尋求私營機構出租； 2）市場通過將房屋轉變為細分的低端出租房屋來應對這種未滿足的需求。為了形式化這一邏輯，我們將設計一個住房分配模型，以分析公共住房如何影響低端租賃市場。在該模型中，定價均衡受到公共住房政策、私人住房供應和人口結構的綜合影響。我們將把模型與香港人口普查的經驗數據結合起來，利用數據中的相關時刻驗證關鍵模型的預測，並進行反事實的政策分析。 我們的貢獻將是三重的。一是率先將公共租賃住房納入一個基本的住房分配模型，而以分析公共租賃對於私人樓宇價格的影響。其次，將香港人口普查的數據與經濟模型相結合，分析香港1997年至2021年的住房市場。第三，為香港未來的政策決策提供信息，包括利用模型分析增加公共住房建設、公共租金調整和租金管制的反事實政策。

17504923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17504923.value: 我们的时代正在见识一场全球性的科学人才竞赛。在这场竞赛上，中国- 这个美国和欧盟STEM项目最大的国际学生来源国- 也启动了各式的人才计划以招募杰出的海外科学家。这些计划既受到了美国政府的密切关注，也受到了学术界的高度关注，尤其是在美国联邦调查局逮捕哈佛大学教授查尔斯·利伯（Charles Lieber）事件后。 尽管受到了密切关注，但有关中国招募外国科学人才的实证研究少之又少，更不用说这些实践的影响和政策意义。例如，我们对在华的外国科学家的数量和质量几乎一无所知，也不了解中国在培养这些科学家的研究能力方面所做出的努力以及取得的成就，更不了解中国在全球人才竞争中是否留住了在华外国专家中最具有创造力的那部分人才。尽管中国的研究环境可能存在诸多不利于培养顶尖科人才的因素，但中国在高等教育和人才发展方面投入了大量资源，并且表现出了极大的”千金募骏马”的意志。对于那些具备独立科研能力但却没有资金在经合组织国家进行独立研究的科学家来说，移居中国可能是一个很有吸引力的选择。 我们的项目以数据为中心采用实证的方法来研究在华的外国科学家。我们将使用OpenAlex来识别过去二十年间曾在中国工作和发表论文的所有外国科学家，以记录和研究这个人群的规模和科研能力。我们将手动收集中国985大学的外国科学家的简历，并通过海外博士论文库来寻找曾经与他们在同一个博士项目学习，从同一个领域毕业，并在接近的时间段进入了劳动力市场的海外同行。以这些科学家（及其子群）作为基准，我们可以回答有关中国作为研究地点的相对吸引力以及移民中国对外国科学家生产力影响等方面的问题。为了推进这个领域的发展，我们将向学术界分享自己收集的数据。据我们所知，还没有被任何科研团队系统的收集、整理与分享此类数据。 研究在华的外籍专家在学术上与政策上都具有重要意义。越来越多的国家正在制定计划，以吸引侨民和外国人才到本国来进行科研活动与人才培养。一些政府相信，吸引海外人才对于本国建立具有全球竞争力的研究机构和具有活力的知识型经济至关重要。我们诚切希望自己的研究能够为公共政策的制定和实施提供借鉴。

17505223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17505223.value: 中國新聞業何去何從？社交媒體對新聞市場的影響

17505223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17505223.value: Traditionally, the dissemination of reliable and truthful news relies on institutional media outlets serving as gatekeepers. The advent of social media has fundamentally changed how news is produced and spreads. To the extent that social media circulates noisy information, biased opinions, and fake news, there has been a concern of whither journalism—Is independent and impartial journalism that helps improve public accountability, promote social justness, and combat misinformation in decline? In this project, we propose to examine whether the surge of social media causes the decline of high-quality journalism and suppresses the production of socially-desirable information in China. The proposed project has three aims. First, we will provide systematic evidence on the distribution of political news and investigative journalism across newspapers and on social media. Second, we will empirically examine whether social media expedites or hinders the generation and circulation of high-quality journalism in two aspects: (1) whether social media reduces the pro-government bias (relative to market-oriented news) and (2) how social media affects the production of informative political news and investigative journalism. Third, we will develop a model to analyze how market competition and information technology interact to affect the dynamics of news markets and to quantify the welfare effects. A unique advantage is that we have assembled a comprehensive media dataset, including newspapers (2003-2021) and social media (2009-2021). Methodologically, this project will involve machine learning, causal inference, theoretical modelling, and structural estimation. To identify causal effects, we will exploit the quasi-random penetration of social media in the early stage as well as variations in event-induced information eruption. This project will contribute to media economics, political economy, and the Chinese economy as well as big data applications in the social sciences. In addition to providing the first systematic comparison in the dissemination of political information between social media and traditional media in nondemocracies, our study is among the first efforts to estimate the causal effect of social media on the supply of news. The theoretical model we develop will provide a novel framework for studying the media in nondemocracies. In the Chinese context, our study will shed light on the fundamental question of whether social media relaxes or restrains the production and circulation of socially desirable information. Finally, this project will contribute to big data applications by discerning various text-mining and machine-learning techniques in their applicability to different types of textual data. 传统上，可靠和真实新闻的传播依赖于作为看门人的机构媒体。社交媒体的出现从根本上改变了新闻的产生和传播方式。就社交媒体传播嘈杂的信息、有偏见的观点和假新闻而言，人们一直担心新闻业将走向何方——有助于提高公众责任感、促进社会公正和打击错误信息的独立和公正的新闻是否由于社交媒体的出现而衰落。在这个项目，我们建议研究社交媒体的在中国的广泛使用是否会导致高质量新闻的下降并抑制社会所需信息的产生。 本项目有三个目标。首先，我们将在大规模的数据基础上上，为政治新闻和调查性新闻在报纸和社交媒体上的传播提供系统证据。其次，我们将从两个方面实证检验社交媒体是加速还是阻碍了高质量新闻的产生和传播：（1）社交媒体是否减少了亲政府的偏见（相对于以市场为导向的新闻）和（2）如何社交媒体影响独立的政治新闻和调查性新闻的制作。第三，我们将建立一个模型来分析市场竞争和信息技术如何相互作用以影响新闻市场的动态发展，并且量化该影响的福利效应。 本项目的一个独特优势在于我们收集了一个全面的媒体数据集，包括报纸（2003-2021）和社交媒体（2009-2021）。在方法论上，该项目将涉及机器学习、因果推理、理论建模和结构估计。为了识别因果效应，我们将利用早期社交媒体的准随机渗透以及事件引发的信息爆发的变化。 该项目将有助于媒体经济学、政治经济学、中国经济以及大数据在社会科学中的应用。除了首次对非民主国家的社交媒体和传统媒体之间的政治信息传播进行系统比较之外，我们的研究对社交媒体如果影响新闻供应的这一前沿课题提供了少有的因果证据。我们建立的理论模型将为研究非民主国家的媒体经济提供一个新的框架。在中国的背景下，我们的研究将有助于阐明社交媒体到底放松还是限制了有益于社会发展的信息生产和流通这一根本问题。最后，该项目将通过识别各种文本挖掘和机器学习技术对不同类型文本数据的适用性，为大数据在社会科学的应用做出贡献。

17505423.label: Project Title(Chinese)

17505423.label: Project Objectives
17505423.value: Study the effect of pay transparency on patient satisfaction and in doing so, address the broader research question of how reduction in pay information asymmetry impacts hospital staff (e.g., doctors' and nurses' job satisfaction), which, in turn, affects patient outcomes. Conduct heterogeneity analyses of the effect of pay transparency on patient satisfaction.
