17607723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607723.value: In the past few decades, there have been dramatic changes in the way high-net-worth (HNW) families look at succession planning and the importance and value of such planning for the preservation of wealth and legacies. In the first place, with many such families owning operating businesses, the preservation of control is a common theme in their succession planning and the trust is often selected as the preferred structure for this purpose. Hong Kong, leveraging the city’s strategic location in the Greater Bay Area and sophisticated financial market, continues to expand its trust business in the region for their HNW clientele, whereas its close regional rival, Singapore, seizes upon its political stability and more relaxed COVID restrictions to boost its international competitiveness in trust and wealth management. Second, settlors are increasingly diversifying their investment portfolios to include crypto-assets, which have changed the dynamics of the wealth management industry. As a result of these developments, not only have the traditional rules been liberalised, but the making of trust law norms has become transnational. Despite the prevailing conception of the trust as a quintessential English concept that emerged in medieval England, the modern trust has spread transnationally, and innovations and modifications have been introduced. These innovations and modifications have shifted modern trust research from a predominantly national context to one that emphasises the interaction amongst transnational, national and local law-making. They have also raised the issue of the boundaries of modern trust and succession planning from doctrinal, social and even moral perspectives. Our research project will examine trust and succession planning in Hong Kong and Singapore in this transnational context from the conceptual and doctrinal perspectives to determine how trust and succession planning can best be regulated in these centres: • First, what is the nature of the transnational legal ordering of modern trust law? • Second, what are the boundaries of modern trust and succession planning? • Third, what are the challenges to the traditional conception of trust law, and what are their implications for the irreducible core content of trusteeship? We believe that an important but unresearched area is how to better regulate trust and succession planning so that the public interest is more fully taken into account. We will publish at least 3 academic articles/book chapters and organise research workshops to offer tangible benefits for academia, trust practitioners and government policymakers. 在過去幾十年中，高淨值（HNW）家族看待繼承規劃的方式發生了巨大變化，並認識到這種規劃對於保存財富和遺產的重要性和價值。首先，由於許多高淨值家族都擁有經營性企業，因此保護控制權是其繼承規劃的共同主題，而信託往往被選爲實現這一目的的首選結構。香港憑藉其在大灣區的戰略位置和成熟的金融市場，繼續爲其高淨值客戶拓展區內的信託業務，而與之相鄰的新加坡則利用其穩定的政治局勢和更爲寬鬆的 COVID 限制，提升其在信託和財富管理方面的國際競爭力。其次，財產授托人的投資組合日益多樣化，將加密資產納入其中，這改變了財富管理行業的動態。 由於這些發展，不僅傳統規則被放寬，而且信託法規範的制定也變得跨國化。儘管人們普遍認爲信託是產生於中世紀英國的典型英國概念，但現代信託已在跨國範圍內傳播，並引入了創新和修改。這些創新和修改使現代信託研究從以國家爲主導的背景轉向強調跨國、國家和地方立法之間互動的背景。它們還從理論、社會甚至道德角度提出了現代信託和繼承規劃的界限問題。我們的研究項目將在這一跨國背景下，從概念和理論的角度研究香港和新加坡的信託和繼承規劃，以確定如何在這些資產管理中心對信託和繼承規劃進行最佳規範： 首先，現代信託法的跨國法律秩序的性質是什麼？ 第二，現代信託和繼承規劃的界限是什麼？ 第三，傳統信託法概念面臨哪些挑戰，這些挑戰對不可縮減的信管核心內容有何影響？ 我們認爲，如何更好地規範信託和繼承規劃從而更充分地考慮公衆利益是一個重要但尚未被充分研究的領域。我們將發表至少 3 篇學術文章/書籍章節，並組織研究研討會，爲學術界、信託從業人員和政府政策制定者帶來清晰可見的效益。

17607823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17607823.value: 粤語的社會語音學變異：理解多語社群中的音系表徵與音變

17607823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17607823.value: All languages exhibit variation, with multiple ways of saying the same thing (e.g., walking vs. walkin’). No two people speak exactly the same way, nor does one person use the same speech patterns in all contexts. This type of variation is far from random, and does not reflect poor linguistic command or laziness. Rather, speakers make productive use of variation to convey social information, construct personal identities, and navigate and shape their societies. Research on sociolinguistic variation has predominantly been carried out in monolingual, English-speaking communities. Yet the majority of the world’s population is multilingual, changing not only their speech style within one language, but also switching between languages appropriate to various contexts. Determining how multilingual speakers perceive and make use of variable linguistic forms is essential for understanding how speech sounds take on social meaning and how they are organized in the mind. This project will investigate sociolinguistic variation in the multilingual environment of Hong Kong. The first study will collect spontaneous conversational speech from Cantonese speakers of different ages and backgrounds. The sibilant sounds “s” (as in Sai Kung) and “ts/ch” (as in Tsuen Wan or Wan Chai) have recently experienced change in their pronunciation, leading to a partial restructuring of the Cantonese sound system. This study will compare how sibilant pronunciation differs according to age, gender, socioeconomic status, and English proficiency, as well as how these sounds are produced under various topics and speech styles. The second study will use ultrasound tongue imaging to observe the tongue shapes that are used in sibilant production. Participants will recite words in Cantonese and English, to test how speakers produce sounds that are similar in their first and second language. In addition to Cantonese-English bilingual Hongkongers, this study will include Heritage speakers of Cantonese in Canada. These individuals have spoken Cantonese with their families from an early age, but have high English exposure and proficiency through living in an English-dominant community. The third study will experimentally test which social meanings are associated with Cantonese sibilant variants. Listeners will provide qualitative descriptions and quantitative ratings on a range of social scales, to examine how they evaluate speakers who use specific pronunciations. Together, these experiments will provide deeper understanding of how speakers use and understand linguistic variants across multiple languages, how first and second languages exert both social and linguistic influence on one another, and how language contact contributes to variation and change. 所有語言都展現出變異，有著多種表達同一句說話的方式（例如: walking vs. walkin’），沒有兩個人說話的方式完全相同，也沒有一個人在所有情境中使用相同的說話模式。這種變異遠非隨機，亦不反映使用者掌握語言不佳或懶散。相反，說話者充分運用語言變異來傳達社會信息、構建個人身份並引導和塑造社會。對社會語言學變異的研究主要是在單語、以英語為主的社區進行。然而，世界上大多數人是多語使用者，他們不僅會在同一種語言內改變說話風格，還會在不同情境中切換使用不同的語言。了解多語言使用者如何感知及運用不同的語言形式對於理解語音如何呈現社會意義以及語音在大腦中的組織方式至關重要。 本計劃將調查香港這個多語言環境中的社會語言學變異。第一項研究將收集不同年齡和背景的粵語使用者之間的自發對話。近來，粵語中的噝音“s”（例如: 西貢）和 “ts/ch”（例如: 荃灣/灣仔）的發音經歷了變化，這導致了粵語音系的部分重組。此研究將比較不同年齡、性別、社會經濟地位和英語能力的說話者在噝音發音方面的差異，並探究這些聲音在不同話題和言語風格下的發音。第二項研究將使用超聲波舌頭影像來觀察噝音發音時所使用的舌頭形狀。參與者將使用粤語和英語朗讀詞語，以此測試說話者如何發出在第一和第二語言相似的聲音。除了香港的粤英雙語使用者，本研究還將納入加拿大的粤語族裔語言學習者。這些參與者從小就與家人以粵語溝通，但由於生活在以英語為主要語言的社區中，他們有著大量的英語接觸量及具有高水平的英語能力。第三項研究將通過實驗測試與粤語噝音變體相關聯的社會意義。聆聽者將對一系列社會評估指標進行定性描述和定量評分，以研究他們如何評價使用特定發音的說話者。上述各項實驗將加深對於說話者如何在多種語言中使用和理解語言變體、第一和第二語言如何在社會和語言層面上相互影響、以及語言接觸如何導致變異和變化的理解。

17609323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609323.value: 香港稅務制度：新時代！ 新瓶裝新酒？

17609323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609323.value: A story of the Hong Kong tax system from 1939 to 2009 has been told which shows, with legal analysis in the context of the political process and socio-economic characteristics, how a simple and low-rate tax system has helped Hong Kong to become a flourishing economy in the world post the Second World War. More than a decade has passed since then. An extended up-to-date narrative is required to identify change, and lack of change, to the system. Furthermore, there exists a hypothesis to prove: that is, with forces from within and outside, locally, regionally and internationally, politically and socio-economically, individually and collectively, all challenging the not-yet-broken tax system and presenting opportunities, the time has come for a research-informed, comprehensive and substantive review of the system itself. The new era, after the social unrest and COVID-19, may lead to fresh perspectives and new ideas, apart from revisiting a number of options raised in vain (such as “shelving” the GST and the vacancy tax) or dropped (for example the “suspension” of estate duty) under the new lens. Finally yet importantly, the role that mainland China may play in reshaping or reforming the Hong Kong tax system, in the special light of its strategies in its relationship with Hong Kong, cannot be overlooked. These include, but are not limited to, what changes to the Hong Kong tax system would likely include if the impact of the PRC factor is to be maximised, and what the Hong Kong tax system may learn from the mainland system. 香港稅務制度自1939年至2009年的發展史，就是按照政治進程和社會經濟特徵背景下的法律分析，向我們顯示了奉行低稅率的簡單稅制如何協助香港在第二次世界大戰後成為舉世矚目的繁榮經濟體的故事，已有論述。十多年後的今天，我們需要與時並進，以廣泛和適時的論述，識別現行稅制所需的改變。此外，還要證實一項假設：隨着各種內外因素、本地以至區域及國際因素、政治和社會經濟因素、個人及集體因素對尚未動搖的稅制提出挑戰而同時呈現機會，現在正是以研究成果為據對稅制本身進行全面和實質審查的時機。在社會動盪和新冠疫情過後的新時代，除了促使我們重新審視一些曾徒勞提出（例如被「擱置」的商品及服務稅和空置稅）或被取消（例如「暫停」遺產稅）的選項之外，還可能會為我們帶來新觀點和新思維。最後，同樣不能忽視的是，特別考慮到國家就中港關係而制訂的策略，國家在重塑或改革香港稅制方面可擔當何等角色，包括但不限於香港稅制在中國因素產生最大影響下可能迎來哪些變化，以及內地稅制對香港稅制有何啟示。

17609523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609523.value: 推進香港的公平：中學生求學經歷的交叉分析

17609523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609523.value: Dr Chan, Anita Kit Wa Prof Lee, Moosung Prof Postiglione, Gerard

17609523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609523.value: This proposed study will be the first large-scale mixed-methods study in Hong Kong to investigate inequalities in secondary school students’ educational experiences using intersectionality as an analytical tool. Addressing educational inequality is a priority for educators and policymakers in Hong Kong given its association with poor educational outcomes and serious economic and social problems, including student suicide and antisocial behavior, intergenerational poverty, and social polarization. Local studies have found significant links between educational inequality and demographic characteristics, particularly gender, ethnicity, and socioeconomic status (SES). However, little is known about exactly how these characteristics intersect and influence inequalities in the key schooling experiences of Hong Kong secondary school students. For example, ethnic minority girls in Hong Kong may experience unique inequalities in their schooling from the dual marginalization stemming from their ethnicity and gender. This lack of understanding has resulted in policies and practices that fail to adequately address educational inequalities experienced by students with diverse backgrounds. The proposed study aims to address this gap. We will examine the intersecting inequalities experienced by Hong Kong secondary school students and further unpack the underlying complex processes by considering the moderating role of schooling context (specifically, gender segregation and school SES). A two-phase mixed-methods research design will be used. The quantitative part (Phase 1) will consist of a territory-wide survey of approximately 1,700 students (Forms S3–S5) from 14 secondary schools. The survey will collect data on aspects of secondary school students’ schooling experiences that are critical to their learning opportunities and outcomes: (1) perceived care from teachers, (2) connectedness to their school and peers, (3) participation in school and extracurricular activities, and (4) engagement with the school curriculum. The subsequent qualitative analysis (Phase 2) will consist of a narrative analysis of in-depth interviews with students, teachers, and principals from three case-study schools of the 14 schools. The proposed will provide greater nuance in our understanding of inequality in local schooling experiences, enabling greater precision in identifying problems and delivering responsive and targeted strategies. The stories of diverse students, including those on the fringes of society, will provide fresh perspectives that reveal the problem of inequality more fully and increase the potential for deeper and sustainable change. The study will involve collaboration among interdisciplinary scholars and local non-governmental organizations and the findings will enable teachers and school leaders to address inequalities by mapping out specific practices for use in their classrooms and schools. 此擬議研究將是香港首個應用交叉理論為分析工具的大規模的混合方法研究，旨在探究香港中學生教育經歷中的不平等。基於香港教育不平等與其教育成果不佳，經濟問題和社會問題嚴峻相關聯（包括學生自殺和反社會行爲，跨代貧困，及社會兩極分化），故解決教育不平等問題乃香港教育工作者和政策制定者的當務之急。本地研究已證實教育不平等和人口特徵（特別是性別，種族和社會經濟地位）之間存在緊密聯係。然而，我們對這些特徵是如何相互交織並影響香港中學生教育經歷中的不平等現象知之甚少。例如，由於種族和性別雙重邊緣化的獨特身份，香港少數族裔女童可能會因此在學校遭受不平等對待。這種認知上的缺乏也會導致政策和實踐無法充分解決多元背景學生在教育上所遇到的不平等問題，因此本研究旨在彌補這一不足。 本研究將探究香港中學生所經歷的相互交織的不平等現象，並通過考慮學校教育環境（特別是性別隔離和社會經濟地位）的調節作用，進一步揭示其背後的複雜過程。本研究將采用兩個階段的混合方法研究設計開展研究。階段一為量化研究。此階段將在全港範圍内對來自14所中學約1,700名中三至中五學生進行問卷調查。調查將收集中學生在校經歷中對其學習機會和成果至關重要的數據，涵蓋方面包括：（1）對教師關愛的感知，（2）與學校和同學之間的連結，（3）學校和課外活動的參與，以及（4）學校課程的參與。階段二為質性研究。此階段將14所學校中的其中三所作爲案例研究，進一步對學校學生，教師，及校長做深入訪談和敍述性分析。 此擬議研究將使我們能夠更加細緻地瞭解當地學校教育中的不平等現象，從而更加準確地發現問題並采取針對性措施。多元化學生的故事 （包括社會邊緣化學生）將爲我們提供一個新的視角來全面地揭示不平等問題，為更深入和可持續的變革奠定基礎。此研究將涉及跨學科學者和當地非政府組織之間的協同合作，研究結果將有利於教師和學校領導制定具體措施來解決課堂和學校中的不平等問題。

17609623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609623.value: 成年人孤獨感的干預研究: 條件反射的應用

17609623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609623.value: Loneliness, a subjective sense of feeling lonely, has become a global epidemic. It is a significant threat to people's health because it predisposes depression and increases mortality. Conventional belief is that loneliness can be measured by the number of social connections and can be treated by opportunities for social activities. We argue that loneliness is subjective, and existing interventions for loneliness have failed to hit the root of the problem – the altered socio-affective processing. Therefore, we will apply a novel paradigm of intervention grounded in the principles of conditioning to minimize the loneliness feeling in lonely adults. Existing evidence has demonstrated the potential of using conditioning paradigm in treating people with social anxiety. Other applications have also proven success, such as in increasing self-esteem, reducing drinking behaviors. This novel conditioning paradigm will train the participants in associating positive emotional stimuli with social scene stimuli. This will create a transfer of positive valence to the social scenes that capture social encountering, producing a more positive perception to social interaction in the participants. As people’s perception of social interaction is closely tied to their loneliness feeling, after this intervention paradigm, it is expected that lonely people will benefit from the paradigm and have reduced loneliness feeling. Of not is that loneliness can be distinguished into social loneliness and emotional loneliness, which are mostly related to people’s different social networks and how they are predisposed. Therefore, we will recruit 180 high-social-lonely adults and high-emotional-lonely adults and assess the efficacy of a 6-session conditioning paradigm by investigating the conditioning-induced change in their socio-affective processing, loneliness, depressive symptoms, and neural correlates pre-, immediately after, and 3 months after the intervention using a randomized controlled trial design. To understand fully their change in loneliness levels, their loneliness will be evaluated objectively by the changes in their loneliness-related brain networks, implicitly by reaction-time test, and subjectively by self-report questionnaire. Daily loneliness levels throughout the study will also be measured to understand the impact of the conditioning intervention paradigm on their loneliness levels across time The outcome of this project will benefit the general population in this pandemic era in promoting betterment of mental health and quality of life, bringing positive change to well-being. It will also generate in-depth understanding of how loneliness is tied to socio-affective processing and how loneliness can be reduced by applying principles of conditioning. 孤獨是一種主觀的負面感受。近年來，孤獨感已經成為一種全球性的流行病。孤獨感對健康有顯著的不利影響，亦是抑鬱症和高死亡率的潛在危險因素。傳統觀點認為，孤獨是可以通過增加人參與社交活動的機會和次數來減少。但由於孤獨是一種主觀的心理活動，我們認為此方案不能精準解決問題的根源 - 社交及情緒處理的改變。 我們提出基於條件反射原理的干預措施將有助成年人對抗孤獨感。現有證據表明，使用條件反射干預對治療社交焦慮症患者有顯著成效。在其他方面，例如提高自信心、減少飲酒行為等，也有積極的干預效果。在本項目中，我們將應用條件反射原理訓練參加者將正向的刺激物與社交場景連結，增強其對社交場景的積極性和正面態度。由於人對社交的感受和孤獨感息息相關，我們期望較孤獨的人的孤獨感能得以舒緩。孤獨可以分為社交孤獨以及情感孤獨，並與人不同的社交網絡有關。我們將招募180位具較高社交孤獨感及具較高情感孤獨感的參加者進行6節條件反射的干預訓練，並採用隨機對照試驗設計在干預前、後、及3個月後測試他們的社交及情緒處理能力、孤獨感、抑鬱症狀、大腦神經網絡。為了全面了解參加者孤獨感的變化，除問卷調查外，我們還將使用反應時間測試及腦掃瞄。我們同時亦會收集參加者每天的孤獨感數據，以評估本項目的干預成效。 本項目提出的研究將促進民眾的心理健康和改善其生活質量，同時有助更深入了解孤獨感形成的心理機制，以及條件反射的應用對孤獨感的干預成效。

17609723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609723.value: 以神經語言學方法探討二語韻律與句法接口之加工

17609723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609723.value: Prof Do, Youngah Prof Jiang, Nan Prof Ouyang, Guang

17609723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609723.value: This research explores one of the most understudied research topics in the field of second language (L2) acquisition and processing, namely, the interface between prosody and syntax. Specifically, we first examine whether L2 learners can successfully attain native-like L2 prosody when first language (L1) and L2 prosody fundamentally differ. We further investigate whether successful learners of L2 prosody can utilize prosodic information to facilitate syntactic processing (and thus semantic processing as well) during real-time sentence comprehension. The current research concerns Cantonese-speaking learners of English, whose L1 and L2 show marked differences not only in prosody per se but also in its interaction with syntax. First, these two languages differ in how prosodic boundaries are formed: Stress plays a major role in prosodic boundary formation in English, but not in Cantonese. Second, they differ in how to prosodically signal major syntactic boundaries (i.e., boundaries of syntactic phrases such as noun and verb phrases): English places phrasal stress before syntactic boundaries, while Cantonese does not, relying on other cues such as pause particles. These marked prosodic differences between the two languages allow us to explore how successfully L2 learners can overcome dramatic L1–L2 differences in prosody by examining how sensitive Cantonese-speaking learners of English are to English prosodic boundaries and how effectively they utilize phrasal stress for syntactic processing. The present study employs electroencephalography (EEG), a non-invasive neuroimaging technique that has been found highly effective in exploring the fine-grained time courses of cognitive subprocesses underlying language processing. We utilize the two most widely used EEG data analysis techniques, namely, event-related potential (ERP) and time-frequency (TF) analysis. In our ERP analysis, we examine the Closure Positive Shift (CPS) ERP component to test our L2 learners’ sensitivity to prosodic boundaries in English (i.e., phrasal stress). In our TF analysis, we focus on increases in power in the low beta and gamma bands of our L2 learners’ EEG waveforms to examine how their L2 sentence comprehension (i.e., syntactic and semantic processing) is facilitated by prosodic information. The findings of this research will improve our understanding of the nature of L2 prosody acquisition and processing, as well as the interfaces between different subdomains of language in L2. Since L2 prosody has largely been overlooked by the L2 research community, not to mention its interface with other subdomains of language, this research will make novel and rare contributions to theories of L2 processing and acquisition. 這個研究項目探索二語習得和加工領域內，其中一個最缺研究的專題 — 韻律與句法接口。具體而言，我們會先考究，若二語學習者母語和二語在韻律方面不同，二語學習者能否成功習得趨近母語者程度的二語韻律。我們會再深入探討，這些二語韻律學習者能否利用韻律資訊，在實時句子理解中，促進句法加工（，從而亦促進語義加工）。 當前研究連繫到以粵語為母語的英語學習者。其母語和二語不單在音韻本質上，甚至在句法和韻律之間的互動中，有着顯著的差別。第一，這兩個語言的韻律分界處以不同方式形成：在英語中，重音在韻律分界處形成方面，有重要的角色；相反，此現象不見於粵語之中。第二，他們不同於以韻律標示主要句法分界處（即是，名詞和動詞片語的句法分界處）的方法：不同於粵語，英語將片語重音放置在句法分界處前。而粵語則依賴其它韻律訊號，例如用於暫停的語氣助詞。藉這些兩語之間韻律上顯着的不同，我們可透過試驗，以粵語為母語的英語學習者對英語韻律分界處的敏銳度和能在句法加工有效利用片語重音的程度，從而瞭解二語學習者能多太程度，克服一語二語在韻律上顯著的差別。 此研究利用一個名為腦電圖（Electroencephalography [EEG]）的非入侵神經成像技術。此技術能有效地呈現，蘊藏在語言加工內，次認知加工，細緻的時間進程。我們會採用兩個最被廣泛使用的腦電數據分析技術：事件相關電位及時頻分析。我們會以事件相關電位，探究终止正漂移（Closure Positive Shift [CPS]），從而評估上述二語學習者對英語片語重音以及韻律分界處的敏銳度。我們亦會以時頻分析，量化二語學習者腦電內的低Beta波段和Gamma波段的增強值，以探究他們的二語句子理解，能否被韻律資訊促進。 這個研究的結果會增加我們對二語韻律習得和加工以及不同二語語言領域之間接口的認知。由於二語韻律被學術界大幅度地忽略，而韻律與其他語言領域接口被忽略的程度更甚，這個研究會為二語加工和習得的理論，提供新穎和稀有的貢獻。

17609923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17609923.value: 香港人口事件與精神健康的關係：一項為期 15 年的前瞻性隊列研究

17609923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17609923.value: Prof Chang, Wing Chung Prof Galea, Sandro Miss Ma, Sze Wai Tiffany Dr Ning, Ke Dr Wong, Sau Man Corine

17609923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17609923.value: The mental health consequences of population shocks (e.g. epidemics, protests) are of great relevance to global populations. During the first year of COVID-19, an estimated additional 52 and 76 million individuals developed probable depression and anxiety in the world, respectively. However, it is unclear if this represents psychological distress in response to an abnormal event (e.g. COVID-19 pandemic) as opposed to true psychopathology since screening measures rather than psychiatric diagnostic interviews were used. Further, the long-term mental health burden of the COVID-19 pandemic or co-occurring population shocks is unknown. As Hong Kong has experienced both the 2019 social unrest and the 2020 COVID-19 pandemic, it serves as a social laboratory to assess the short- and long-term changes in population mental health following population shocks. By leveraging the FAMILY Cohort, a large population-representative cohort in Hong Kong, we have monitored the evolution of population mental health over the past 15 years. We showed that levels of probable depression and anxiety have substantially increased during population events and have yet to return to baseline. As the mental health burden from population shocks can be enduring and its aetiology multi-factorial, it is important to ascertain the long-term mental health outcomes and disentangle the contributions from different population events. Accordingly, we propose a longitudinal follow-up in this prospective cohort in 2024 to achieve the following objectives:- 1. To assess the current and lifetime prevalence of psychiatric disorders following the social unrest and COVID-19 pandemic in Hong Kong. 2. To assess the individual and joint contributions of population shocks to depression, anxiety, and post-traumatic stress disorder using population attributable fractions. 3. To examine the pattern and predictors of depression, anxiety and post-traumatic stress disorder during and after the social unrest and COVID-19 pandemic. In the proposed study, we will administer the Composite International Diagnostic Interview Version 5.0 (CIDI-5) to ascertain current and lifetime diagnoses of major depressive disorder, generalised anxiety disorder, and post-traumatic stress disorder. With multiple waves of longitudinal data before, during, and after each population event (i.e. 2014 Occupy Central, 2019 social unrest and 2020 COVID-19 pandemic), our prospective cohort study is uniquely positioned to assess the long-term mental health consequences of population shocks as well as the baseline and time-varying predictors. Our findings could inform health and social care professionals on the health needs, risk factors, and vulnerable groups, and inform interventions and service planning in Hong Kong and elsewhere.

17610123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610123.value: 香港雙語學童（廣東話及英語）口吃的表徵、識別和治療

17610123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17610123.value: Dr Law, Thomas Prof Mark, Onslow Dr Taiying , Lee

17610123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610123.value: 背景/動機： 相比單語兒童口吃的表徵和處理，目前有關雙語兒童口吃的研究尚未成熟，並且仍存在爭議。學術界一直對口語的語言特徵（即語言距離）以及語言熟練度/優勢對雙語口吃的表徵產生影響爭論不休。現時，雙語兒童口吃的識別主要建基於母語為英語的單語兒童創立的標準，而將這些單語兒童的標準應用於雙語兒童身上，是誤導的。 對那些說與英語在語言類型上有莫大分別的語言的孩子來說，現有標準更是格外具有爭議性。 此外，學界對於雙語使用者的口吃治療也存有爭論。具體而言，現有文獻對口吃治療應否只針對單一語言去處理，還是同時處理兩種語言持不同看法。而各語言的治療結果能否被通用及概括也是另一大爭議。無論如何，可以肯定的是，上述問題的答案對說兩種不同語言的有口吃的雙語兒童尤其重要。 目標： 本研究將聚焦於說兩種不同語言的雙語兒童(即廣東話和英語)。研究目標為：(a)在控制各語言熟練度的前提下，區分廣東話(音節等時語言)和英語(重音等時語言)口吃的表徵，(b)建立雙語兒童口吃識別的標準，以及(c)確定雙語兒童口吃治療的效果。 研究設計： 此研究將招募63名有口吃的雙語兒童（廣東話及英語）63名沒有口吃的雙語兒童，收集他們在不同語境和語言下的言語樣本。不同語言和組別的言語流暢度障礙的類型和頻率將被對比分析。有口吃的雙語兒童會被隨機分配到三個治療組別，包括廣東話組、英語組和雙語組(廣東話及英語)。這些組別將於一周內接受五節的節奏性言語訓練。最終治療效果會由剛治療後和治療後六周這兩個時間點中得出的成效比較所得。 研究影響/效益： 這項全方位的研究將為說兩種截然不同的語言的雙語兒童首次創設雙語口吃的表徵、診斷和治療。此項目將有助開拓文獻以及豐富有關語言類型對雙語兒童口吃表徵和處理的影響的理論。最後，研究結果將提出臨床指南，以便識別和治療雙語兒童（廣東話及英語）的口吃。

17610223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610223.value: 貝多芬與艾略特 (T. S. Eliot)：藝術、自由、法西斯主義

17610223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610223.value: This project tracks the relationship between the poetry of T.S. Eliot and Beethoven’s music in the interwar years. It is well known that Eliot’s Four Quartets takes its inspiration from Beethoven’s late quartets, in particular the String Quartet Opus 132. However, the history and significance of this relation has yet to be written partly due to difficulties in pinning down Eliot’s desire ‘to get something of [Opus 132] into verse before I die’ to its actual manifestation in the poetic texts: the connection is too elusive. However, new research has shown that the crucial lines in the Four Quartets – ‘at the still point of the turning world’ – refer to Beethoven, providing a key to understanding how Eliot uses the composer’s techniques in Opus 132 as processes within the Four Quartets. Opus 132 is a quartet about ‘still points’ with its symmetrical, recursive and palindromic techniques. While this analysis sheds new light on Eliot’s ‘musical’ processes in his poetry, more importantly it illuminates how critical Beethoven was to Eliot’s political and aesthetic development in the 1930s. The composer was not a side-interest: Eliot renegotiated the image of Beethoven in the interwar years to challenge the fascist’s appropriation of the composer. For Hitler, Beethoven was a paradigm of German identity and Fascist heroism. As such, this projects highlights the critical role Beethoven’s music played to in defining Europe during a period of political turmoil that, sadly, our own politics today is in danger of rehearsing. In this sense, it is a timely project that reflects on how artists negotiate complex and divisive issues in times of political upheaval as they search for a ‘still point’ that transcends the ideological placards and oppositional ideologies that whirl around them. For Eliot, Beethoven provided a glimpse of this ‘still point’. The project is original in (1) exploring the history of the relation between Eliot and Beethoven’s music and its critical significance for re-evaluating Eliot’s political and aesthetic views; and (2) carrying out a cross-disciplinary analysis of Eliot’s Quartets through musical techniques in Beethoven’s quartet. Both the history and analysis are new approaches, but ultimately the historical context and the technical analysis are inextricably linked in illuminating the image of Beethoven that Eliot wanted to project, and by implication the role of art in articulating a heroic paradigm that resists the volitional, self-determined and totalizing hero celebrated in fascist aesthetics. 貝多芬與艾略特 (T. S. Eliot)：藝術、自由、法西斯主義 此項目旨在追踪托馬斯·斯特恩斯·艾略特 (T.S. Eliot) 的詩歌作品與貝多芬在戰間期所創作的音樂之間的關係。眾所周知，艾略特的《四首四重奏》(Four Quartets) 靈感取自於貝多芬晚期弦樂四重奏作品，尤其是弦樂四重奏Opus 132。然而，兩者之間這一層關係的歷史和意義尚未被書寫。其原因之一是學者難以將艾略特 “在我去世前將Opus 132寫進詩歌裡” 這一心願與他的詩歌文本做確切對應：兩者的聯繫過於模糊而难以捉摸。然而，新的研究表明《四首四重奏》中的經典詩行 ── “在流轉的世界中那靜點” ── 正是指向貝多芬， 而這也為理解艾略特是如何在《四首四重奏》的書寫進程中借鑑貝多芬在Opus 132中的作曲技巧提供了重要線索 。因其採用的對稱、遞歸和迴文技法， Opus 132是一部關於 “靜點” (still points) 的四重奏。 雖然這一分析為理解艾略特詩歌中的 “音樂性”表現提供了嶄新視角，但更重要的是，它闡明了貝多芬在艾略特於1930 年代的政治和美學經驗提升過程中曾起到關鍵作用。貝多芬並不是艾略特的業餘興趣：在兩次世界大戰間期, 艾略特曾重新探討和協商貝多芬的形象，以挑戰法西斯主義者對這位作曲家的挪用。對於希特勒而言，貝多芬是德國身份認同和法西斯英雄主義的典範。因此，此研究項目凸顯了貝多芬的音樂對於定義歷史上正處政治動盪時代的歐洲所發揮的關鍵作用。可悲的是，當今政治正面臨著重演動盪歷史的危機。從這個意義上說，這是一個及時的研究項目，因為它致力於反思身處政治動盪時期的藝術家們是如何通過尋找 “靜點” (still points) ── 一個能超越那些在身邊迴旋的意識形態標語牌和種種對立意識形態的“靜點” ── 來協商複雜而分裂的議題。對於艾略特而言，正是貝多芬讓他得以一瞥這樣的一個 “靜點”。 該項目的原創性在於：（1）探討艾略特與貝多芬音樂兩者間關係的歷史，及其對於重新評價艾略特的政治和美學觀點的重要意義； (2)通過貝多芬四重奏作品中的音樂技巧，對艾略特的詩作《四首四重奏》進行跨學科分析。以上所述的歷史評估和跨學科分析都是全新的研究視角，但自始至终，歷史脈絡和技術性分析之間本就有著密不可分的關聯：是兩者共同照亮了艾略特所希望投射的貝多芬形象，並間接闡明了藝術在特定英雄形象範式的論述中所扮演的角色 ── 而此種範式正是對法西斯主義美學裡所頌揚的意志性的、自決的和一統化的英雄形象的抵抗。

17610423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610423.value: 建立面向教師的基於學習設計的可操作學習分析模型

17610423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610423.value: The focus of this project is to develop (1) a theoretical framework and an associated technology platform that supports the entire, integrated process of learning design (LD), e-learning implementation, and the selection and deployment of learning analytics and visualization (to be referred to as the (Integrated DEsign-Aware Learning & Analytics System, IDEALS), and (2) a sociotechnical model for the introduction of the IDEALS system that is proficient in promoting learning and adoption by K-12 STEM teachers. Learning analytics (LA) is a nascent field with a history of just over a decade. Since its emergence, researchers have pointed to the need for LA to be connected to learning design (LD) for it to contribute to the improvement of learning and teaching (Lockyer & Dawson, 2012). Despite the many theoretical constructions and empirical studies reported in the literature to connect LD to LA, the promise of LA to advance learning and teaching through the provision of diagnostic information and personalized intervention is rarely manifested in authentic learning settings. A review of the extant literature reveals that successful cases have all involved learning analytics and visualizations customized for the specific learning outcome(s) in a particular educational setting for the targeted kind of learners and subject matter domain (Law & Liang, 2020). There is a lack of generic systems and tools that can be deployed by teachers who do not have specialized technical knowledge to capitalize on the many LA tools that have been developed for their everyday professional practice. There are two prominent gaps that need to be addressed in order to provide a robust foundation for the development of IDEALS. First, there needs to be a (layered) taxonomy of pedagogically meaningful inquiry questions to guide teachers in the selection/construction of analytical questions suited to their practice context without the need for specialized technical knowledge. Secondly, further work needs to be done to select and articulate this taxonomy with published ontologies of LA constructs (e.g., Munoz, 2016) and tools to become an LD-integrated LA framework and ontology for validation and implementation in authentic learning contexts. The first part of this project addresses these two gaps by constructing an LD-integrated LA framework and taxonomy and validating this framework by constructing an instantiation of an IDEALS online system. The second part of the project is to refine a set of design principles for introducing IDEALS to K-12 STEM teachers through a design-based implementation study. 此項目的重點是 (1) 開發一個理論框架和一個相關的稱為 <<具學習設計意識的學習分析集成系統>> (簡稱IDEALS）的技術平台，以支持學習設計、實施電子學習以及可視化的選擇和部署學習分析和的一個集成系統，以及（2）建立一個能夠有效地促進 K-12 STEM 教師學習和採用IDEALS 系統的社會技術模型。 學習分析是一個新興領域，只有十多年的歷史。 自其出現以來，研究人員就指出學習分析需要與學習設計聯繫起來，以促進學習和教學的改進（Lockyer & Dawson，2012）。 儘管文獻中有不少把學習設計與學習分析連接起來的理論構建和實證研究，但真正能夠通過學習分析結果為學生提供個性化干預，從而促進學與教的例子，在真實學習環境中得到體現的卻很少。成功的學習分析和可視化案例都是為特定教育環境中的特定學習成果和學生群體定制的 (Law & Liang, 2020) 。這些LA 工具對沒有專業技術知識的教師而言卻難以應用。 要為 IDEALS 的發展提供堅實的基礎，需要解決兩個突出的難題。 首先，需要對具有教學意義的探究問題進行（分層）分類，使教師無需專業的技術知識便能選擇/構建適合其實踐情境的學習分析探究問題。 其次，需要做進一步的工作來選擇相匹配已發布的LA 構造本體（例如Munoz (2016)）和工具，以建立集成學習設計和學習分析於一體的框架和本體，以便在真實的學習環境中進行驗證和實施。因此，項目的第一部分是構建 集成學習設計和學習分析的 框架和分類法，並以此為基礎建立 IDEALS 在線系統作為驗證其解決這兩個難題的實例。項目的第二部分是通過基於設計的實施研究，完善一套設計原則，以便向 K-12 STEM 教師介紹 IDEALS。

17610723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17610723.value: 跨國日本流行文化在台灣（1980年代 - 2000年代）

17610723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17610723.value: Taiwan has been one of the most receptive markets for Japanese popular culture in East Asia. By the early 2000s it was the largest overseas market for Japanese cultural products. The project is an anthropological study of the spread of Japanese popular culture from the 1980s to the early 2000s in Taiwan, focusing on four Japanese popular cultural products: television drama, animation, comics and popular music. The project proposes an ‘actor-field nexus’ framework that is inspired by Howard Becker’s ‘art worlds’ theory and Pierre Bourdieu’s ‘field’ theory, to examine the mediation among transnational human agents, the Japanese cultural products in Taiwan, and the political economy within which this process has evolved. It focuses on the interaction between the practices of the transnational networks of actors, including policymakers, business actors, cultural intermediaries, and consumers in various fields of the export, import, circulation and consumption of the Japanese popular cultural products and the competition among the actors in each field. Extensive literature research, archival research, field research and in-depth interviews in Japan and Taiwan will be conducted to examine the interactions of individual actors involved in the processes of the spread of the Japanese popular cultural products. The project will explore the intentions and motivations of the agents and the cultural and business logic underpinning their behaviours, and examine how the strategies employed by the agents were shaped by the interrelationship between cultural policies and the change of international relations, including the fraught Sino-Japanese relations, and the characteristics and structures of the media industries in Japan and Taiwan embedded in the broader regional and international mediascapes. This project will contribute to the existing scholarship in Japanese popular culture in Taiwan, the majority of which tends to focus on the cultural and identity aspect of the phenomenon by emphasising the business nature of the processes. The project will enhance our understanding of the relationship between the regionalisation and transnationalization of Japanese popular culture, as Taiwan plays a key role in the dissemination of Japanese popular culture in Greater China. Thus it will also enhance the previous literature on inter-Asian cultural flows. The ‘actor-field nexus’ framework can be applied to other places and be used to examine different processes of transnationalization of popular culture such as the rise of the Korean wave. The findings of the project will also be of practical value to entrepreneurs, business enterprises and cultural policymakers. 台灣一直是東亞最為接受日本文化的市場之一。直到2000年初，台灣已成為日本文化產品最大的海外市場。本研究旨在以人類學角度探究1980年代到2000年初日本流行文化在台灣的傳播，並側重研究四種日本流行文化產品：電視劇、動畫、漫畫和流行音樂。受Howard Becker的「藝術世界」 (art worlds) 理論和Pierre Bourdieu的「場域」 (field) 理論的啟發，本研究提出「行動者—場域—鏈結」 (actor-field nexus) 的理論框架，以探討跨國代理人、在台的日本文化產品，以及政治經濟的互動關系。本項目集中研究跨國網絡中的參與者，包括在日本流行文化產品出口、進口、流通和消費的各個場域的政策制定者、商人、文化中介和消費者的互動實踐及競爭。研究員將會進行廣泛的文獻研究、檔案研究、田野研究以及在日本和台灣進行深度訪談。本項目將研究代理人的意圖和動機、其行為背後的文化和商業邏輯，並剖析文化政策和國際關系變化以及日本和台灣媒體業的特點和結構如何影響代理人所采用的策略。本項目將提高我們對日本流行文化區域化和跨國化關係的理解，也將有助於研究亞洲間文化流動。「行動者—場域—鏈結」理論也可以應用於其他範疇，並用於理解如韓流崛起等各種流行文化跨國化的過程。本項目的研究成果也將對企業家、商界和文化政策制定者具有實際價值。

17611023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611023.value: 中國宗教的地方配置：梅山教

17611023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611023.value: 中國宗教的地方配置：梅山教 本項目研究中國南方廣泛流傳的儀式傳統，即“梅山教”，論證其在中國宗教中的深刻意義。梅山之名源于湖南省中部的梅山地區——以新化和安化兩個古鎮爲中心。盡管梅山教有這種地方特色，但它已流行于湖南大部分地區，在湖南也被稱爲“元皇教”。此外，它還被湖南的土著民族（尤其是瑤族）傳播到中國西南部的其他省份，如今在東南亞一些國家也有分布。 通過分析研究不足的梅山教的地理和歷史構成，該項目旨在：首先，了解這一龐大的傳統；其次，闡明其在將小地方與更大的地理和文化網絡（包括道教網絡）連接起來的文化綜合體中的中介作用。 梅山地區的儀式手抄本將爲確定該傳統與鄰近地區互動歷史的關鍵方面，及其在新化和安化周邊村社（包括附近的瑤族社區）祭祀文化中的根源提供文本依據。這些手稿被通常被稱爲“師公”（Ritual Masters）的法師使用，他們在本地和跨區域傳統的交彙處工作，通常與道教領域密切相關，但並非道教的正式組成部分（Schipper 1985；Lagerwey 1998；Huang 2018）。 該項目以梅山地區（尤其是安化）和邵陽以東的瑤族社區爲重點，爲中國宗教研究提供了更廣泛的見解。在研究方法上，我有別于一般僅從宗教角度研究儀式手冊的方法，而是專注于三個方面：(1)地理（城鎮名稱或自然地標）；(2)敘事（通常與著名的明代小說有關）；(3)萬神殿（村神或自然地標）。 這種研究方法有別于傳統的梅山教研究，後者側重于與其他鄉土傳統的比較（Ye 2013；Zhang 2014）、與道教的聯系（Lui & Li 2015）、與古老或神話敘事的聯系（Li et al. 2012）、與某些神靈的聯系（Zhang 2005），或梅山傳統代表漢族或瑤族身份的研究（Zhang 2010；Huang 2018；Sun 2022）。 我認爲，要更全面、更細致地了解中國宗教的多樣性和一致性，就必須對這些地方儀式傳統進行研究。

17611823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17611823.value: 首爾城市山脈：透過空洞解讀城市

17611823.label: Project Objectives
17611823.value: To contribute to the discourse on the nature of “the city” by examining a system of urban thresholds in Seoul. To consolidate a method of reading the city focused on liminal and atypical spaces. To communicate these ideas and insights to the public, academic and architectural audiences.
rows: To contribute to the discourse on the nature of “the city” by examining a system of urban thresholds in Seoul.
To consolidate a method of reading the city focused on liminal and atypical spaces.
To communicate these ideas and insights to the public, academic and architectural audiences.

17611823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17611823.value: 仔細研究殘留的城市空間可以得出哪些教訓？ 這樣的解讀會影響我們構建“城市”敘事的方式嗎？其核心是 我的研究實踐是對東方內部空白、緩衝區和門檻的反思 亞洲海岸線地區。我之前的研究發現城市可以看作是一個系統 的閾值，在內部/外部、公共/私人的經典二重奏之間搖擺， 合法/非法。該系統的模糊狀態開啟了多種解釋方式 實體與虛空之間的物理和隱喻界限，讓城市得以呼吸。 曼谷和香港大都市地區已允許探索這一概念 通過製作圖紙構建不同尺度的空間模糊性 兩個城市的新代表，有助於人們對這兩個城市的意義有新的理解 西城群島。 在《首爾的城市山脈：從空虛中解讀城市》中，我建議擴展我的研究範圍。 研究區域為首爾大都市區。在之前的實地考察中，我 確定了未經審查的城市閾值的重複模式：十幾個城市迷你山脈 均勻地分佈在密集的城市結構中。在平坦的城市，如巴黎或 在北京，郊區通常位於城市的外圍。具體地理位置 然而，首爾看到未開發的山脈中斷了城市結構，提供了 為居民提供喘息的機會。不被視為主要文化地標，這些殘餘緩衝區 區域正面臨著被城市擴張逐漸消耗的威脅。 主要研究成果是題為“首爾城市山地地圖集”的展覽，將 為城市專業人士、政府機構和 公眾認為城市是圍繞地形地標建造的。首爾廳 首爾市政府提供的2,998平方米的展覽平台Urbanism & Architecture 政府已經對提供展覽場地表現出了濃厚的興趣。在 另外，首爾大學建築係是我們確認的 學術夥伴。展覽和相關研討會的目的是討論 城市及其用戶的集體代表，以努力增加公眾參與 了解、認識和欣賞首爾的城市文化。每個小山 將通過分析繪圖、物理模型和反思來表示 文本。獨家撰寫的同名書籍將為專家提供更好的參考 了解迷你山脈在居民日常生活中所發揮的作用，強調 將這一系統納入首爾未來發展討論的優點。 本書的長期目標是為亞洲年輕一代提供工具 建築師和城市規劃師，他們必須應對異構、分散和過度建設的問題 背景，以及誰可能試圖為其空間實踐定義一個新領域。

17613223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613223.value: 中国在线音乐市场的崛起：对中国加强知识产权保护的影响

17613223.label: Project Objectives
17613223.value: To examine the difficulties faced in eradicating digital music piracy in China before administrative enforcement measures were strengthened in 2015; To study how and why the administrative enforcement of online music copyright since 2015 has significantly reduced digital music piracy in China; To consider how the major Chinese music streaming platforms built their consumer base with measures dedicated to improving digital copyright protection and promoting the user experience of their streaming services; To assess the effectiveness of Chinese judicial enforcement of digital music copyright through leading court cases; To apply legal compliance theories to analyze how the administrative, judicial and corporate enforcement of music copyright has substantially strengthened Chinese citizens’ compliance with copyright rules in China; and To consider how the rise of the Chinese music streaming market can provide constructive lessons for improving IP enforcement and reducing piracy and counterfeiting in China, focusing on the relationship between administrative and judicial enforcement mechanisms.
rows: To examine the difficulties faced in eradicating digital music piracy in China before administrative enforcement measures were strengthened in 2015;
To study how and why the administrative enforcement of online music copyright since 2015 has significantly reduced digital music piracy in China;

To consider how the major Chinese music streaming platforms built their consumer base with measures dedicated to improving digital copyright protection and promoting the user experience of their streaming services;
To assess the effectiveness of Chinese judicial enforcement of digital music copyright through leading court cases;

To apply legal compliance theories to analyze how the administrative, judicial and corporate enforcement of music copyright has substantially strengthened Chinese citizens’ compliance with copyright rules in China; and

To consider how the rise of the Chinese music streaming market can provide constructive lessons for improving IP enforcement and reducing piracy and counterfeiting in China, focusing on the relationship between administrative and judicial enforcement mechanisms.

17613223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613223.value: China has long had a reputation for blatantly infringing intellectual property (IP) rights. Despite its waves of IP law reform, the country still attracts vehement criticism for its failures to curb IP piracy and counterfeiting. The conventional wisdom prevails that IP infringement is still rampant in China. Overlooked are China’s substantial improvements in the copyright protection of digital music. Over the past decade, China has developed one of the world’s most robust music streaming markets, reducing the rate of illegal music downloads from approximately 99% in 2011 to less than 4% in 2020. By offering Chinese Internet users paid access to licensed content, major music streaming platforms such as Tencent Music and NetEase Cloud Music have effectively contained copyright piracy. China’s National Copyright Administration and courts have also made significant contributions to this remarkable improvement. In this proposed project, I aim to conduct the first comprehensive and systematic study of the contributions made by China’s recent copyright reforms to the rise of its music streaming market. It examines the difficulties China faced in weeding out digital music piracy before the administrative enforcement measures adopted by the National Copyright Administration in 2015. I also seek to explore how the Chinese government, courts, and market have worked together since 2015 to transform China from a music piracy safe haven into a dynamic streaming market that respects copyright and creativity. Theoretically, I will develop a model to explain why Chinese music consumers’ compliance with copyright law has increased so dramatically by drawing on an in-depth analysis of the relevant legal rules and judicial decisions, empirical studies of the Chinese music streaming market, and interview results. Policy wise, I will further examine how such improved legal compliance behaviour and the rise of the Chinese music streaming market could provide dynamic, forward-looking lessons for strengthening IP enforcement in other areas and thereby significantly reducing IP piracy and counterfeiting in China. China has long had a reputation for blatantly infringing intellectual property (IP) rights. Despite its waves of IP law reform, the country still attracts vehement criticism for its failures to curb IP piracy and counterfeiting. The conventional wisdom prevails that IP infringement is rampant in China. Overlooked are China’s substantial improvements in the copyright protection of digital music. Over the past decade, China has developed one of the world’s most robust music streaming markets, reducing the rate of illegal music downloads from approximately 99% in 2011 to less than 4% in 2020. By offering Chinese Internet users paid access to licensed content, major music streaming platforms such as Tencent Music and NetEase Cloud Music have effectively contained copyright piracy. China’s National Copyright Administration and courts have also made significant contributions to this remarkable improvement. In this proposed project, I aim to conduct the first comprehensive and systematic study of the contributions made by China’s recent copyright reforms to the rise of its music streaming market. It examines the difficulties China faced in weeding out digital music piracy before the administrative enforcement measures adopted by the National Copyright Administration in 2015. I also seek to explore how the Chinese government, courts, and market have worked together since 2015 to transform China from a music piracy safe haven into a dynamic streaming market that respects copyright and creativity. Theoretically, I will develop a model to explain why Chinese music consumers’ compliance with copyright law has increased so dramatically by drawing on an in-depth analysis of the relevant legal rules and judicial decisions, empirical studies of the Chinese music streaming market, and interview results. Policy wise, I will further examine how such improved legal compliance behaviour and the rise of the Chinese music streaming market could provide dynamic, forward-looking lessons for strengthening IP enforcement in other areas and thereby significantly reducing IP piracy and counterfeiting in China. 中國長期以來一直因各種侵犯知識產權（IP）而聲名狼藉。儘管中國經歷了一波又一波的知識產權法改革，但在遏制知識產權盜版和仿冒方面的失敗仍然受到嚴厲指責。傳統觀念認為，中國的知識產權侵權行為猖獗。 然而，人們忽略了中國在數字音樂版權保護方面的實質性改進。在過去的十年裡，中國已經發展成為全球最強大的在線音樂市場之一，非法音樂下載的比例從2011年的約99%降至2020年的不到4%。通過為中國互聯網用戶提供付費許可內容，騰訊音樂和網易雲音樂等主要音樂流媒體平台有效地遏制了版權盜版。中國國家版權局和法院也為這一顯著改善作出了重要貢獻。 為執行本項目的研究，我希望對中國近期版權改革對其在線音樂市場崛起所作的貢獻進行第一次全面和系統的研究。我將考察中國在國家版權局2015年採取行政執法措施之前，消除數字音樂盜版方面所面臨的困難。我還將探討自2015年以來，中國政府、法院和市場如何共同努力，將中國從一個音樂盜版的安全港變成一個尊重版權和創意的充滿活力的流媒體市場。 在理論上，我將通過對相關法律規定和司法裁決的深入分析、對中國音樂流媒體市場的實證研究以及訪談結果，來發展一個分析模型以此來解釋為什麼中國音樂消費者遵守版權法的程度大幅提高。在政策方面，我將進一步研究這種改善的法律合規行為和中國在線音樂市場的崛起如何為加強其他領域的知識產權執法提供動態、前瞻性的經驗，從而大幅減少在中國的知識產權盜版和仿冒行為。

17613323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613323.value: 醫療及社會服務使用對社區長者社交衰弱與抑鬱關係的中介和調節作用

17613323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613323.value: Dr Chan, Wai Chi Dr Cheung, Denise Shuk Ting Dr Fong, Daniel Yee-Tak Prof LAI, Wing-Leung Daniel Prof Woo, Jean Prof Yu, Doris Sau Fung

17613323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613323.value: Frailty describes the condition that the age-related deteriorations in the various systems within the human body, which lead to subsequent loss of ability to carry out necessary daily activities. Recent literature expanded the concept of physical frailty to include multidimensional domains. Among them, social frailty refers to the loss of social and general resources, activities or abilities that are essential to fulfil basic social needs. Despite the international interest of assessing the relationship between social frailty and depression, there is a lack of longitudinal evidence from primary prospective cohort studies. Furthermore, as social frailty refers to the vulnerability of an individual in meeting social needs, the social determinants of health may play a crucial role to explain its negative health consequence. The Andersen’s Healthcare Utilisation Model might provide a coherent framework to delineate how social frailty affect care seeking, which in turn affect health outcome. According to the Bunt’s social frailty model, the resources limitations underpinning social frailty tie in with the enabling resources as stated in the Andersen’s model. The proposed study aimed to quantify the longitudinal relationship between social frailty and depression; to investigate the moderating and/or mediating role of health and social services utilisation in such relationship; and to explore the bidirectional relationships of social frailty, depression and health and social services utilisation among older adults. A two-year prospective cohort study will be conducted with 1000 community-dwelling older Chinese adults in Hong Kong. Purposive sampling will be employed to recruit participants with diverse levels of social frailty and health and social service utilistaion. Potential participants will be recruited from community centres, public areas, health care centres/clinics, elder academy and social media, and older households and hidden elders lists of the non-governmental organisations and the PI’s working contacts. In addition, a random sample will be recruited to explore the composition of the different subgroups. A structured questionnaire will be used, with the 8-item social frailty scale, a modified local adaptation of Client Service Receipt Inventory, the Geriatric Depression Scale, and other covariates. Baseline and four half-yearly assessments will be performed. The integrated model based on Andersen’s Healthcare Utilisation Model and Bunt’s social frailty model will be used to guide the whole study and interpretation of results. Linear mixed models and structural equation models will be used in the statistical analysis. The findings would inform service providers on the provision of services to reduce social frailty and depression. 衰弱是指身體機能隨着年老而出現退化，導致日常活動能力喪失的一種狀況。最近的文獻擴展了衰弱概念至各方面。其中，社交衰弱是指失去滿足基本社交需求所必需的資源、活動或能力。儘管國際社會對評估社交衰弱與抑鬱之 間的關係感興趣，但是目前仍缺乏由前瞻性隊列研究所提供的縱向實證。此外，社交衰弱亦指個人在滿足社交需求方面的脆弱性，與健康有關的社會因素可能對其負面影響的解釋發揮着至关重要的作用。Andersen醫療服務行為模式提供一個連貫的框架來描繪社交衰弱如何影響病患就醫，繼而影響健康。同時，在Bunt 社交衰弱模型中，資源限制造成社交衰弱，而該資源與Andersen模式中的有利資源密切相關。本研究旨在量化社區長者社交衰弱和抑鬱之間的縱向關係；研究醫療及社會服務使用對該關係的中介和/或調節作用；以及探討長者社交衰弱、抑鬱和醫療及社會服務使用的雙向關係。本研究將邀請1000名社區長者參加為期兩年的前瞻性隊列研究。我們將採用立意抽樣來招募不同社交衰弱程度及不同醫療及社會服務使用度的長者。研究對象會從社區中心、公眾場所、保健中心/診所、長者學苑及社交媒體、非政府機構的長者住戶及隱蔽長者名單，以及首席研究員的工作網絡中招募。此外，部份參加者將由隨機抽樣選出，以探討人群特徵的組成。問卷調查內容包括社交衰弱量表 (SFS-8)、經本地修訂的個人接受服務清單 (CSRI) 、老人抑鬱評估表 (GDS-15) 和其他簡單背景信息及病歷。參加者將接受5次評估 (包括基線評估和4次每半年一次跟進評估)。基於Andersen醫療服務行為模式及Bunt 社交衰弱模型的整合模型將用於指導整個研究和結果的解釋。數據分析將運用混合線性模式及結構方程模型。研究結果將為服務提供者提供有關減少社交衰弱及抑鬱服務的信息。

17613923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17613923.value: 互助伙伴運動對認知障礙症患者及家屬照顧者健康及社交互動的成效- 一項混合模式的隨機對照實驗

17613923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17613923.value: Dr Chau, Patsy Pui-Hing Prof Cheng, Sheung-Tak Dr Chiu, Ka Chun Patrick Prof Judge, Katherine S Prof Li, Wai Chi Polly Prof Siu, Parco Ming-Fai Prof Wong, Gloria

17613923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17613923.value: The global cost of dementia is over 818 billion, and a further rise is expected in the next decade. While family caregiving is the backbone of the formal care service, promoting “living well with dementia” needs to extend to a dyadic perspective to address the needs of persons with dementia and their caregivers. Unique to dementia caregiving, imbalanced exchange in the assistance, interaction, relationship and autonomy between the partners in a care dyad always challenges their social interaction and relationships. Such eroding dyadic dynamics not only worsens the mental health of caregivers, but also compromises the quality of caregiving, fosters more dementia deterioration, and eventually complicates the caregiving process. Nevertheless, least attention is directed to dyadic dynamics in promoting living well with dementia. Partner exercise is designed in a way which requires collaboration of two members to enable the workout of each other. In addition to the benefits of exercise on dementia symptom control and caregiver’s stress management, partner exercise provides a meaningful encounter to encourage reciprocity, collaboration and relationship closeness within the care dyad. This study aims to examine whether a 16-week theory-based partner exercise, named as Buddy-Up Dyadic Physical Activity (BUDPA) program, can improve dyadic dynamics and health outcomes of care dyads of mild to early-moderate dementia. This sequential mixed-method study will recruit 236 care dyads from the 8 elderly centers operated by 4 flagship NGOs in Hong Kong. They will be randomized to receive the enhanced BUDPA program or usual care. The changes in the dyadic dynamics and health outcomes [including symptom severity and health-related quality of life (HRQL) of persons with dementia; and affect, positive aspects of caregiving and HRQL of family caregivers] between the two study groups from baseline to upon completion of the training (T1), at 3 (T2) and 6 (T3) months thereafter will be compared. Besides, a subsample of 30 care dyads who completed the enhanced BUDPA will be interviewed for their perception toward BUDPA and the engagement experience. Data from outcome evaluation and interviews will be integrated to solicit a thorough understanding on the impact of BUDPA. This study marks the first attempt to use theory-driven dyadic intervention to enhance the dyadic dynamics and health outcomes of dementia care dyads. The project will advance the dyadic science in a dementia caregiving context and inform the development of evidence-based care model in dyadic fashion to promote living well with dementia in a caregiving context. 家庭照顧方式在高額成本的認知障礙症照顧中起著至關重要的緩衝作用。作為一種退行性疾病，認知障礙症不僅影響患者的整體健康，還會惡化家庭照顧者的健康。此外，與認知障礙症相關的心理行為問題對於患者及家屬照顧者的社交互動平衡具有很大的破壞性。 事實上，更有力的研究表明，社交互動平衡在進一步惡化患者及家屬照顧者健康方面起著突出的中介作用。近年來，認知障礙症照顧模式已發展成為一種雙人配對方式，以提患者和照顧者的健康狀況。然而，大多數雙人干預方法對加強患者和照顧者之間的社交互動平衡關注極少。 這項序列混合模式的隨機對照實驗的目的是研究互助伙伴運動（BUDPA）對輕度至早期中度認知障礙症患者及其照顧者的健康結果和社交互動的影響。BUDPA是一個為期16周的多模式合作運動計劃，要求雙人成員共同參與以實現鍛煉彼此。來自四家旗艦非政府組織的220個照護雙人組合將被隨機分配到BUDPA組或等待名單對照組。BUDPA組將接受（i）12次每周團體運動訓練，期間將整合一種雙人目標設定方法以支持每周兩次有組織的家庭自我練習；（ii）隨後的4週習慣階段，期間將舉行FaceTime視頻通話，以支持照護雙人將BUPDA納入日常生活慣例。等待名單對照組將在效果評估後接受相同的計劃。 雙人健康結果（認知功能、神經精神症狀、照顧者的情緒和負擔以及生活品質）、社會動態（社交互動、關係緊張度）和照顧收穫將會通過已驗證的測量方法在基線、16週和28週時被分別評估。數據分析將使用的三層次混合效應的重複測量模型，同時控制雙人間的相互依賴性。質化描述性訪談將徵求30對照顧雙人組合BUDPA的經驗看法。 本研究標誌著首次嘗試使用理論驅動的聯合干預方法來提高認知障礙症照顧雙人組合的健康和社會動態。本項目將促進對認知障礙症照顧背景下雙人動態的理論理解，並為發展健康促進實證服務提供指導，以提高雙人健康成效。

17615023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615023.value: 交纏的邊疆：深圳水—社會領域的演變

17615023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615023.value: 該項目首次從不斷變化的水利基礎設施和水—社會領域的視角來撰寫一部深圳自 1949 年以來的批判性歷史。深圳位於世界上最廣闊、最複雜的河口之一珠江三角洲的東側。數不清的工程干預和政治宏圖改變了深圳的生物物理過程。深圳市境內有 169 座政府管理的水庫。由310 條溪流和16,377 公里輸水管道組成的複雜網絡將這些水庫連接起來。它們共同構成了城市框架之中一個並不廣為人知卻至關重要的要素，一直在默默地維持和滋養深圳這座城市的社會經濟發展和社會生態福祉。 該項目希望通過將深圳的城市化理解為一個混合的社會生態過程，為關注深圳非凡的城市轉型和擴張的學術研究做出貢獻。該項目還希望通過呈現在深圳特定的水文地理和社會政治特徵下領土和環境治理的多層級性和偶然性，為水—社會學術研究——特別是圍繞中國水文政治開展的研究——做出貢獻。該項目將探索深圳的水—社會領域如何不斷演變和重塑。這些演變發生在改變著該區域的水文網絡、經濟基礎結構和政治關係的特定的歷史、社會、政治和文化背景下。 本項目指出，在任何特定時間，深圳所構想、規劃和建造的水—社會領域是如何與其他領域錯綜複雜地交織在一起——這些其他領域通常存在於時而重疊又時而平行的更廣泛的行政、管轄、水文和組織的尺度上。該項目由深圳水—社會領域的三個遞進階段所構成，包括「與香港為鄰的農業邊疆」（1949—1978）、「廣東省內的資本飛地」（1979—2009），以及「珠三角都會區的都市前沿」（2010至今）。這三個階段的劃定反映了在區域和國家層面的社會政治格局中深圳戰略地位的不斷變化，並與中國「五年計劃」體系的時間緯度相關聯。 該項目依賴於多重研究方法，包括基於地表驗實的空間分析、對文本和視覺檔案材料的研究，以及對參與深圳水—社會領域的演變和/或受演變影響的主要利益相關者的第一人稱訪談。該研究是針對自國家「十三五」規劃（2016—2020）提出「粵港澳大灣區」概念以來，公眾對深圳和泛珠三角地區發展的興趣重燃的及時回應。本研究所呈現的新的歷史敘述將會隨著時間推移而對學界內外作出貢獻，並有可能影響這一地區水利基礎設施相關的設計活動和政策決策，以推進社會環境的公平性和韌性。

17615123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615123.value: 強化暴露治療對的情緒化進食療效: 一項隨機對照的試驗研究

17615123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615123.value: 由負面情緒誘發的情緒化進食是一種普遍的健康風險行為，影響約10%至50%的社會人士。暴露治療是一種可以治療飲食失調的療法，但其治療情緒化進食的效用仍未被確立。此外，現有的暴露治療研究並未有充分運用以理論指導的治療方法。因此，此項研究將會開發專注治療情緒化進食的強化暴露治療。強化暴露治療將會整合以理論指導的治療方法，包括（1）暴露治療過程中會包含所有線索，不限於食物線索，例如情緒線索和環境線索；（2）在參與者身處的環境中（非治療場所）進行的暴露治療練習；（3）在暴露治療期間加強否定患者對情緒化進食的正面期望。現時，否定這些期望被認為是暴露治療中關鍵的心理變化機制，但其影響尚未經過實證評估。有見及此，我們提出一項雙盲、平行、和隨機對照的試驗研究來評估 強化暴露治療的療效以及評估否定患者對情緒化進食的正面期望在整個治療過程中的中介作用。 我們將招募 130 名患有經常性情緒化進食但未尋求心理治療或精神科幫助的參與者，並隨機分配他們去接受強化暴露治療或作為對照組的行為生活方式干預療程。 兩個療程都將在每周一次的課程進行六次。情緒化進食、次要結果（體重、情緒、生活質素、治療接受性和滿意度）以及情緒化進食期望的評估將在基線、治療後和治療八週後進行。 情緒化進食期望也將在每次進行曝光療程中被評估。 我們推測強化暴露治療將比行為生活方式干預更有效地減少情緒化進食，而對情緒化進食期望的改變會從中起中介作用。

Explore the mediating mechanisms of physical activities and depressive symptoms in the links between social isolation/loneliness and outcomes of multimorbidity and cognitive functioning.

17615223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615223.value: 社交孤立與孤獨感是隨著人口老化而加劇的全球現象。各種晚年的生活壓力，諸如身體健康功能的衰退、經濟資源的減少和家庭與關係結構的變化，均會增加長者的健康風險。在眾多老齡化所面臨的挑戰中，如何在晚年生活維繫一個穩定和具有支持性的社會網絡尤其重要。此外，由於不同國家的社會與文化規範深刻地影響著社交孤立和孤獨感，從跨國比較的視角了解社交孤立和孤獨的共通性（跨國可比較）和獨特性（各國特有），有助於了解如何促進全球長者的健康維護和生命福祉。 雖然社交孤立和孤獨感都描述了社會關係上的缺損，且過往文獻往往將它們視為是相似的概念，近來的研究顯示社交孤立和孤獨感是兩個不同的概念，必須將他們對於健康的影響進行區分。過去的研究顯示：社交孤立和孤獨感與自覺健康差、心血管疾病增加和死亡率之間存在著穩固的關聯。然而，社交孤立和孤獨對認知功能和多發性疾病的影響的證據尚不確定。這表明經歷社交孤立和/或孤獨的長者可能會有不同的健康後果，並且可能有其他機制將社交孤立/孤獨與健康結果聯繫在一起。然而，並不是每位長者都會經歷社交孤立和/或孤獨，而對於健康影響可能有異質性的存在。此外，社交孤立/孤獨與健康的關係在不同文化與社會經濟發展地區可能會有不同的結果，但目前文獻缺少關於這些關聯的跨國恆定性證據。 為了瞭解社交孤立/孤獨感與健康這兩者關係在不同國家的狀況，本研究使用了四個高度且可比較的國家長期資料庫（英國、美國、中國和南韓）進行分析。在標準化的理論框架指導下，我們將收集各個國家中社交孤立和孤獨感的共同和獨特指標，進而分析這些不同指標的社交孤立/孤獨感對健康的影響。在本研究中，我們將（1）描述社交孤立/孤獨感的盛行率和趨勢；（2）辨識孤立/孤獨群集及其相關因素；（3）探討社交孤立/孤獨感與認知功能/多發性疾病相關性的比較與競爭假設；（4）調查社交孤立/孤獨感與多發性疾病和認知功能之間聯繫的心理與社會機制。 這項研究將增進了解晚年生活社會支持的知識和實務。本研究將有助於理解不同國家間社交孤立和孤獨感的相似性和差異性、孤立/孤獨中的異質性群集、其相關因素、健康影響以及在不同國家間複製的機制。研究結果將提供跨國的證據與干預措施以解決全球關於社交孤立和孤獨感的公共衛生與社會議題。

17615323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615323.value: 學科内容與語言融合教學(CLIL)的多語言和多模態評估：理論與實踐

17615323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17615323.value: Dr Liu, Jiajia Prof Pun, Jack

17615323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615323.value: In Content and Language Integrated Learning (CLIL) programmes, students often encounter difficulties when mastering non-linguistic content knowledge through an additional language (L2). Realising the potential for students’ use of their holistic communication repertoire, researchers and educators have been more receptive to pedagogical translanguaging and incorporating a variety of semiotic resources as useful scaffolds during the meaning-making process in L2 in CLIL classrooms. However, attempts to extend multilingual and multimodal approaches to CLIL assessment have been limited. Such approaches are urgently and legitimately needed since effective assessment should align with objectives and instruction; and they can enhance the validity of CLIL assessment by alleviating potential language barriers. This study seeks to explore how CLIL assessment can embrace multilingualism and multimodality. Contextualised in English-medium instruction (a variant of CLIL) in Hong Kong and focusing on the subject of biology, the first phase of the study will be a textual analysis of a corpus of assessment questions to understand the roles of multilingual and multimodal resources in current CLIL assessment. Data will be collected from high-stakes public examinations, widely used textbooks and workbooks, and school-based examinations. Using a framework adapted from previous research on CLIL assessment and multimodality of disciplinary texts, the collected questions will be analysed in terms of their cognitive, (multi-)linguistic and multimodal characteristics and affordance in facilitating students’ comprehension of questions and construction/expression of ideas. Such textual analysis will be complemented with semi-structured interviews with teacher educators and experienced teachers. Based on the results of this first phase, teachers and students will be recruited to participate in the second phase of the study, where carefully designed multilingual and multimodal assessment tasks will be tried out. The validity of these assessments will be scrutinised by comparing students’ performance on conventional and new assessment designs, triangulated with in-depth analysis of students’ answers to different types of questions and their responses during stimulated recall interviews. The ultimate goal of the study is to generate a framework for designing multilingual and multimodal assessment in CLIL, which will advance theoretical discussion and empirical research in the underexplored area of CLIL research. The framework will also speak to principles of designing more valid assessment in CLIL, which in turn provide useful guidelines for policy makers, examiners and teachers. These will eventually have practical implications for CLIL teacher education, in terms of how to design more accessible and equitable assessments for multilingual students. 在學科内容與語言融合教學(CLIL) 課程中，學生通過他們的第二語言（L2）掌握學科內容知識時經常遇到困難。 基於運用學生的整體溝通資源的潛力，研究人員和教育工作者開始提倡在CLIL 課堂教學上使用跨語言和各種溝通資源，作為在知識建構過程中的有用支架。 然而，這種多語言和多模態方法還未擴展到 CLIL 的評估。 不過，於CLIL 評估中使用多語言和多模態是迫切且合理的，因為有效的評估應與課程目標和教學一致； 多語言和多模態評估亦可以通過減輕學生的潛在語言障礙來提高 CLIL 評估的有效性。 本研究旨在探討多語言和多模態如何應用於CLIL 評估之中。 本研究的第一階段將以香港以英語作為教學語言（CLIL 的其中一種）為背景，並針對生物科。研究團隊將從公開考試、廣泛使用的教科書和作業，以及校本考試中收集評估問題，並根據先前關於CLIL 評估和學科教科書多模態研究的框架，分析評估問題的認知、多語言和多模態特徵，以及能否幫助學生理解評估問題和表達其答案。 研究團隊還會邀請教師培訓人員和經驗豐富的教師進行半結構性訪談，以補充評估問題的分析。 根據第一階段的研究結果，研究團隊將招募教師和學生參與第二階段的研究。研究團隊將與教師設計多語言和多模態的評估，通過比較學生在傳統評估設計和實驗評估設計中的表現，並深入分析學生於不同類型問題的回答以及他們在訪談中的意見，來檢視多語言和多模態評估的有效性。 本研究的最終目標是建立一個設計 CLIL 多語言和多模態評估的框架，這將會推動 CLIL 評估方面的理論建構和實證研究。 該框架亦會闡述在 CLIL 課程中設計更有效的評估的原則，從而為政策制定者、評估人員和教師提供有用的參考和指引。 這些將促進 CLIL 教師在評估素養方面的持續專業發展。

17615523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615523.value: 台灣與香港的社會工作員的反同態度：隱性偏見、相關因素、歸因

17615523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17615523.value: Dr Chen, Eva Prof Chong, Eddie Siu Kwan Dr Cui, Lixian Dr Kwok, Diana K.

17615523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615523.value: Homo-negativity, an intolerant attitude toward homosexuality, is a sexual prejudice against lesbian, gay, and bisexual (LGB) individuals. Although social workers presumably have been trained to meet their clients’ mental health needs regardless of their backgrounds, studies with service users still report the pervasiveness of homo-negativity among service providers. This phenomenon warrants our attention because these prejudices and biases can compromise the provision and efficacy of mental health services for clients from marginalized communities. This study aims to unpack homo-negativity among social workers in Hong Kong and Taiwan and to investigate its implication in their practice. The study is guided by three theoretical bases. First, research on implicit bias has revealed the duality of attitudes. While explicit bias operate at a conscious level and are presumed to be measurable through self-report instruments, implicit bias represents an unconscious form of disposition that is not always accessible through retrospection. Identification of implicit biases is important given their stronger ability to predict discriminatory behaviours than the measure of explicit attitude. Second, the Bias of Crowds Model posits that assessment of implicit biases are measures of shared contexts rather than trait-like beliefs because implicit biases can be triggered by stereotypical concepts that are accessible in a specific environment. This tenet supports investigations into the individual, organizational, sociocultural, and policy (same-sex marriage legalization) correlates of implicit biases. Third, attribution theory has guided studies to uncover the attributional beliefs underlying sexual prejudice, such as fundamentalism and immutability. While dominant themes in the attributional beliefs reflect western cultural schemes, less is known about their intersection with Chinese culture and professional background. This study will adopt a cross-sectional design to collect quantitative data to identify the prevasiveness, correlates, and attributional beliefs of homo-negative attitudes among social workers in Hong Kong and Taiwan. A total of 200 social workers will be recruited to complete a set of self-report measures and the Sexuality-Implicit Association Test through a portable device. A vignette technique will be used to assess respondents’ level of practice competence with LGB people. This study will generate comprehensive and comparative data to characterize the attitudes towards LGB people harboured by social workers in Hong Kong and Taiwan. The study findings will help increase professionals’ awareness of implicit biases, contribute to the science of prejudice by identifying the intersection of cultural context, professional practice, and personal attitudes, and translate into strategies to reduce prejudice among social workers. 反同態度是一種對性小眾的偏見。受過專業培訓的社會工作員，理論上應該能在服務個案的過程中一視同仁，但一些針對服務使用者的研究，發現某些社會工作員仍然持有反同態度。此現象值得特別的關注，因為偏見與歧視會削減提供給被邊緣化群體的心理健康服務的質素及成效。本研究旨在揭露在香港與台灣的社會工作員的反同態度，以及其對專業實踐的影響。本研究有三個理論基礎。首先，研究者已經發現態度具有二元性：顯性偏見運作於意識層面，通常透過自陳式工具去測量；隱性偏見則是一種非意識的傾向，較難被個人覺察，且只能以觀察個人在某些情境的行為反應來測量。指認隱性偏見是重要的，因其比顯性偏見更能預測個人的歧視行為。第二個理論基礎為群體偏見模型，其主張隱性偏見測量的是一種共享的群體脈絡，而非類個人特質的信念，因為隱性偏見是可以被環境中的刻板印象所驅使。這個主張也支持研究應該去探討個人、組織、社會文化、與政策層面的相關因素。第三，根據歸因理論，我們可以去發現有關性偏見的歸因信念，例如性傾向是不是一種不可改變的本質。然而現有的歸因研究多是在歐美國家的文化脈絡進行，較少研究探討華人文化，也少有研究探討助人工作者是如何解釋性傾向的成因。本研究採用橫斷式設計，蒐集量性數據去指認台灣及香港社會工作員的反同態度，以探討反同態度的普遍性、相關因素、以及歸因信念。預計有兩百位社會工作員會參與本研究，填寫一系列自陳式的測量工具，以及性-隱性關聯測驗；同時本研究以案例分析的方法，去評估社會工作員與性小眾個人的專業能力。此研究將提供豐富的研究數據，去描述及比較在台灣與香港的社會工作員對於性小眾的態度。研究結果能提升助人專業者對於隱性偏見的覺察，讓我們瞭解文化脈絡、專業實踐以及個人態度之間的關係，並可以導引出降低社會工作員偏見的教育訓練。

17615623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17615623.value: 此刻生態哺乳介入對改善母乳餵哺結果的成效:一項隨機對照試驗

17615623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17615623.value: Dr Cheung, Yee Tak Derek Dr Hui, Amelia P.W. Dr Hui, Bryant P. H.

17615623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615623.value: Primparous mothers who plan to breastfeed but who did not go on to breastfeed often face high levels of emotional and psychological challenges in their transition to parenthood. This can adversely affect their breastfeeding experiences and general well-being, and are associated with stress, anxiety and postnatal depression. While family psychoeducation and other supportive group programs are available in health services, these require face-to-face education sessions over a long interval and high engagement and trusting relationships and often result in low attendance and high drop outs. Mothers have expressed the need for real-time, real world, personalized support that allow them to get immediate breastfeeding support, helps in overcoming the challenges and subsequently improve exclusive breastfeeding. In views of the above challenges occur during Chinese mothers’ cultural tradition practice "doing the month" of which women remain housebound during the first month postpartum. In addition to this, the precaution of the pandemic, women are often housebound and find it difficult to attend group support or seek help during the first month postpartum which is the critical period in sustaining exclusive breastfeeding and at high risk of weaning. This multi-center randomised control trial adopts two arm design to examine and compare the effects between ecological momentary intervention and usual care to improve breastfeeding outcomes. Its three objectives are (1) to increase the exclusivity and duration of breastfeeding, (2) increase breastfeeding self-efficacy and (3) breastfeeding knowledge and attitude. With significant positive outcomes found in the feasibility study, this ecological momentary intervention can be adopted by community maternal and child health services in Hong Kong to increase the proportion of exclusive breastfeeding. Thus, e-health interventions have potential to improve breastfeeding practices and child well-being. Such interventions have therefore been considered as a rising shift from traditional model of care towards an e-technology based health model that may improve local and global exclusive breastfeeding rates. 計劃餵哺母乳但沒有繼續的第一胎媽媽在過渡到為人家長的過程中往往會面臨高度的情感和心理挑戰。這或對她們的母乳餵哺經歷和整體健康產生不利影響，並與壓力、焦慮和產後抑鬱的形成有關。 雖然衛生服務部門提供了家庭心理教育和其他支援小組的項目，但這些項目包含跨越長時間的面授課程，以及需要高參與度和信任關係，導致出席率偏低和退出率偏高。母親們表明了她們需要實時、真實、個人化的支援，使她們能夠獲得即時的母乳餵哺支援，以幫助她們克服困難，從而改善全母乳餵哺 。 上述困難常在中國媽媽坐月子期間出現。雖然產後第一個月是維持全母乳餵哺的關鍵時期，且斷奶風險較高，但在此期間，媽媽們多難於出門，故她們難以參加群體支援活動或尋求幫助。 此項多中心隨機對照試驗採用雙臂設計來探討和比較生態瞬間介入和常規護理對改善母乳餵哺結果的效果。其三個目標是（1）增加全母乳餵哺率和持續時間，（2）提高母乳餵哺的自我效能和（3）增加母乳餵哺知識。 可行性研究中顯著的正面結果顯示，香港社區母嬰健康服務可以採用這種此刻生態介入措施，以提高全母乳餵哺的比例。 因此，這些行動醫療介入措施有改善母乳餵哺方法和兒童健康的潛力。此類介入措施亦被認為是從傳統護理模式走向基於電子科技的健康模式的轉變，或能延長全球全母乳餵哺的持續時間。

17615823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17615823.value: Miss Kwok, Wai Wai Dr Leung, Dara Prof Lum, Terry Yat Sang Dr Wong, Hoi Yan, Gloria Dr Zhang, Wen

17615823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17615823.value: Background: The COVID-19 pandemic has disproportionally affected older people’s mental health. While prevention and early treatment may alleviate the mental health burden, help-seeking is often delayed. To promote mental health help-seeking, different theories have hypothesised diverse mechanisms. The theory of planned behaviour (TPB) and nudge theory (NT) converge on social norms as promising targets for intervention, and picture superiority effects suggest that pictures might be more effective in engaging people over text. However, no intervention has been done to promote mental health help-seeking in older adults using pictures designed to convey social norms. Objectives: This study will: (a) co-design social norm-nudges (descriptive and pictorial) with different stakeholders; (b) examine the utility of revised TPB in understanding help-seeking intention in older Chinese; (c) examine the effectiveness of descriptive social norm-nudges and (d) pictorial social norm-nudges in improving mental health help-seeking intention compared to education. Methods: In Phase 1, we will adopt a participatory approach and engage 10 older adults, four mental health professionals, two researchers, and one graphic designer to co-design a set of descriptive and related pictorial social norm-nudges to be disseminated over 14 days. In Phase 2, we will conduct a three-arm randomised controlled trial (RCT) in 540 older adults aged 60 years and above recruited through NGOs, testing utility of revised TPB with baseline data, and the effectiveness of descriptive social norm-nudges (intervention group 1) and pictorial social norm-nudges (intervention group 2) comparing to traditional mental health education (control). Participants will be evenly randomised and receive 1 message/picture per day consecutively for 2 weeks. Researchers blind to group allocation will interview participants at baseline (T0), 2 weeks (post-intervention, T1), and 12 weeks (follow-up, T2). The primary outcomes are changes in subjective norms and help-seeking intention assessed using a revised Chinese version of TPB questionnaire (C-TPB); secondary outcomes include perceived behavioural control, help-seeking attitude, perceived barriers to help-seeking (C-TPB subscales), and mental health assessed by PHQ-9, GAD-7 and UCLA-3. Structural equation models and linear mixed models will be used to address objectives (b) and (c) (d), respectively. Significance: This proposed study has substantial theoretical and practical significance. From a theoretical stance, the findings will test the application of revised TPB on mental health help-seeking intention among older Chinese. From a practical standpoint, this study will produce a set of descriptive and pictorial social norm-nudges with established effects, which may be used for larger-scale mental health campaigns in the future. 概要 背景：新冠疫情對長者的心理健康造成了極大的影響。預防和早期治療可以減輕心理健康負擔，但長者往往在尋求幫助上有所延遲。為了促進長者及時尋求心理健康幫助，不同的理論假設了不同的機制。計劃行為理論（TPB）和助推理論（NT）都將社會規範視為有希望的干預目標，而圖片優勢效應表明圖片可能比文本更能有效地吸引人們的注意力。然而，尚未有研究使用旨在傳達社會規範的圖片來干預長者在心理健康上的求助行為。 目標：本研究有三個目的，(a) 與社群人士共同設計社會規範推動的文字與圖片； (b) 研究修訂後的 計劃行為理論在理解老年人尋求幫助的意圖方面的效用； (c) 檢驗文字描述性社會規範助推和 (d) 圖像社會規範助推在改善心理健康求助意願方面的有效性。 方法：在第一階段，我們將採用參與式方法，邀請 十名長者、四名心理健康專業人員、兩名研究人員和一名平面設計師共同設計一套社會規範助推文稿，和與文字配套的圖片。在第二階段，我們將對通過非政府組織招募的 540 名 60 歲及以上長者進行三臂隨機對照試驗（RCT），用基線數據測試修訂後的計劃行為理論的效用，用參加試驗前後的數據變化來檢測描述性社會規範助推（干預組1）和圖畫社會規範助推（干預組 2）與傳統心理健康教育（對照組）進行比較後的有效性。參與者將被均勻隨機分配，並連續 2 週每天收到 1 條消息/圖片。對分組分配不知情的研究人員將在基線 (T0)、2 週（干預後，T1）和 12 週（隨訪，T2）時採訪參與者。主要結果是主觀規範的變化以及使用修訂後的中文版問卷（C-TPB）評估的求助意圖；次要結果包括行為控制、尋求幫助的態度、尋求幫助的障礙、以及通過病人健康問卷（PHQ-9）、廣泛焦慮問卷（GAD-7） 和UCLA孤獨問卷（UCLA-3）評估的心理健康。結構方程模型和線性混合模型將分別用於實現目標 (b) 和 (c) (d)。 意義：本研究具有重要的理論和實踐意義。從理論角度來看，研究結果將檢驗修訂後的計劃行為理論對中國老年人心理健康求助意願的應用。從實踐的角度來看，這項研究將產生一套具有既定效果的文字描述性和圖解性社會規範推動，可用於未來更大規模的心理健康推廣活動。

17616323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17616323.value: 閱讀障礙和典型發展兒童的多規則統計學習的神經振蕩特徵

17616323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17616323.value: 人腦能夠内隱地探測不同類型的規律，然而有發展性閱讀障礙的讀寫障礙兒童對這些規律，尤其是對複雜、不確定環境中潛藏的條件概率和分佈頻率的神經表徵尚不明確。我們先前的統計學習和閲讀模型（SLR）和事件相關電位（ERP）研究表明，相較於典型發展的對照組而言，讀寫障礙兒兒童在統計學習方面表現出中等程度的缺陷，且該缺陷可能涉及多種神經機制，它們參與調控閲讀發展狀態（即有/無讀寫障礙）和項目統計特性（即信息輸入的可預測性和複雜性）在大腦内的融合表徵。然而，先前的研究受制於採用（1）單一類型的統計規律、（2）單一組典型發展兒童、及（3）覆蓋整個學習過程的平均ERP信號，因而難以回答以下問題：學習各類具備不同可預測性和複雜性的統計規律是否由多重神經機制控制？可預測性和複雜性在多大程度上影響讀寫障礙和典型發展兒童的多重神經機制？ 爲研究以上問題，我們將利用具有高靈敏度的腦電圖技術以及先進的時頻分析和貝葉斯計算模型來檢測（1）條件規律、分佈規律及其交互作用的神經振蕩機制，及（2）可預測性和複雜性如何影響讀寫障礙和典型發展兒童在進行多規律統計學習時的神經表徵。在連續三年中，60名三至四年級的讀寫障礙、60名年齡匹配的典型發展兒童以及60名閱讀能力匹配的二年級典型發展兒童將每年於實驗室完成一項多規律統計學習腦電圖實驗，和一系列配備可攜式腦電圖監測功能的閱讀能力評估。三個腦電圖實驗將採用創新的研究範式來同時操縱條件概率及分佈頻率，並探究當可預測性和複雜性不變（實驗1）、可預測性改變（實驗2a）及複雜性改變（實驗2b）時，統計學習過程中的神經活動。我們將借助Morlet小波轉換，在時頻域内分析單一規律統計學習的神經振蕩機制，並通過量化慢速神經振蕩相位與快速神經振蕩振幅之間的跨頻率耦合來捕捉兩類規律統計學習的交互作用。此外，我們將實施基於試次水平上的貝葉斯計算建模和對學習軌跡的精細分析，以探究項目可預測性和結構複雜性對於多規律統計學習的影響。 我們的研究結果將推進對統計學習神經基礎的探索，闡明哪種類型的統計學習與非典型閱讀發展更相關，並闡釋用以優化兒童閱讀能力訓練課程的設計原則。

17618723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17618723.value: 釐清學習進階的中間環節：受約束的 4PL 模型方法

17618723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17618723.value: Dr Ma, Wenchao Dr Tjoe, Hartono

17618723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17618723.value: Accurately measuring student growth is a crucial exercise because it provides a comprehensive picture of students’ learning and progress. Learning progression (LP) has been recently introduced as a framework to understand what students know across multiple levels of learning over time. Despite its promise, many issues in LP remain unsolved, and foremost of these is the “messy middle” problem, which directly affects the validity of LP-based inferences. Messy middle refers to students in the middle of LP levels who have partial or incomplete understanding to respond to certain tasks. As a result, the items located in the middle level and students with partial knowledge are usually estimated inaccurately. Psychometrically, messy middle manifests itself as items from different LP levels exhibiting disordinal item difficulties (e.g., items from a higher level are easier than those from a lower level). Previous studies suggest two main sources of the messy middle: (1) the item design or format may cause students to guess or slip, which in turn leads to disordinal item difficulties; and (2) the psychometric tools used to analyze LP data are not sufficiently sophisticated to account for the impact of guesses and slip on the item difficulty. This project aims to address the messy middle problem by using an advanced psychometric model, the four-parameter logistic (4PL) model, to clean the messiness in LP data. This project will also develop novel estimation algorithms and a computer program to implement the algorithms. The efficiency and the accuracy of the estimation algorithm will be evaluated using simulation studies. Second, this project will develop LPs for two extant mathematic assessments. The first assessment measures general Grade 8 mathematical knowledge, whereas the second focuses on proportional reasoning skills. The LPs developed in this project will be used to construct two LP-based assessments. The newly developed psychometric model will be applied to the LP-based assessment data to establish its practical viability. Furthermore, these results will be compared with those obtained using the traditional model to determine the extent to which the proposed approach can alter real-world inferences. Overall, the project is expected to have both theoretical and practical contributions to educational assessment. The proposed model and computer program will allow researchers to analyze better LP-based assessments to obtain more accurate ability estimates, hence, more accurate evaluation of student growth. The two mathematic assessments constructed in this project will serve as a prototype for developing more reliable and valid LP-based assessments.
