17619223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619223.value: 透過個人化即時通訊軟件為有神經精神症狀的輕度認知障礙患者提供接納與承諾療法（IMPACT）：混合方法研究

17619223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17619223.value: Dr Chau, Patsy Pui Hing Dr Chiu, Patrick Ka Chun Prof Cuijpers, Pim Dr Lau, Esther Yuet-ying Dr Lee, Jung Jae Jay Mrs Ye, Fen

17619223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619223.value: Up to 85% of persons with mild cognitive impairment (MCI) (PwMCI) have neuropsychiatric symptoms (NPSs), a symptom cluster of non-cognitive disturbances (i.e. transdiagnostic symptoms), including depression, anxiety, and apathy. NPSs are significantly associated with accelerated disease progression, premature institutionalisation, early death and a heavy economic burden. International guidelines suggest non-pharmacological interventions such as psychological interventions as the primary approach to addressing NPSs, but their provision to PwMCI has largely been overlooked in Hong Kong (HK) and elsewhere. A review of meta-analyses reveals acceptance and commitment therapy (ACT), an evidence-based psychotherapy, to exert a medium effect on complex and co-occurrent symptoms (i.e. transdiagnostic conditions; g = 0.57). Notably, technology-delivered ACT also exerts a medium effect on chronic health conditions (g = 0.52). Ecological momentary intervention (EMI) is an innovative, cost-effective intervention framework that utilises mobile messages such as instant messages (IMs) to deliver personalised, synchronous psychological interventions, showing a medium effect (g = 0.57). Yet, no study to date has investigated the effects of EMI and ACT on NPSs. The proposed study’s aims are to 1) evaluate the effectiveness of ACT delivered using IM applications (e.g. WhatsApp) among PwMCI to provide personalised, synchronous NPS support and 2) understand PwMCI’s experience of and compliance with the intervention. No similar study is found in electronic databases (e.g. PubMed and Cochrane Library) or Clinicaltrials.gov. 160 community-dwelling PwMCI with Mild Behavioural Impairment-Checklist (MBI-C) scores ≥ 7 (i.e. NPSs) will be recruited and individually randomised into an intervention or control group (n=80 each). The intervention group will receive 1) IM-delivered personalised ACT with brief MCI and NPS care education messages for 2 months at participants’ chosen times and frequencies and 2) therapist-led text and/or voice message-based psychological and disease management (i.e. MCI and NPSs) support to enhance ACT’s effects through real-time counselling and practical advice. The control group will receive one message on general psychological well-being with reminder messages for follow-up surveys. Post-intervention assessments at the 2- and 6-month follow-ups will include the primary outcome of the MBI-C and secondary outcomes of depressive symptoms (PHQ-9), anxiety symptoms(GAD-7), quality of life (EQ-5Q-5L), cognitive functions (HK-MoCA), and acceptance and actions (AAQ-II). Intention-to-treat and post-trial qualitative analysis (n=20) will be conducted. The study will strictly follow the CONSORT-EHEALTH checklist. This study will provide the first and practical evidence of the effectiveness of IM-delivered personalised ACT (IMPACT) in addressing NPSs in PwMCI in HK and beyond. 高達85％的輕度認知障礙患者（PwMCI）患有神經精神症狀（NPSs），這是一類非認知障礙（即跨診斷）的症狀，包括抑鬱、焦慮和冷漠呆滯。神經精神症狀與疾病惡化、提前住院、早逝以及沉重的經濟負擔密切相關。國際指引建議採用非藥物療法（例如心理療法）作為處理NPSs的主要方法，但這種療法卻在香港和其他地方被忽視了。 過往的的綜合分析指出，接納與承諾療法（ACT）是一種以證據為基礎的心理治療方法，對複雜和同時出現的症狀（即跨診斷症狀）呈現中等效果（g = 0.57）。值得注意的是，以科技傳遞的接納與承諾療法（ACT）對慢性健康狀況也有中等效果（g = 0.52）。生態瞬間介入（EMI）是一種創新及具成本效益的介入框架，利用手提電話即時信息傳遞個人化、同步的心理治療，也顯示出中等效果（g = 0.57）。然而，迄今尚無研究探討生態瞬間介入（EMI）和接納與承諾療法（ACT）對神經精神症狀（NPSs）的影響。 此擬議研究旨在1）評估透過即時通訊軟件（如WhatsApp）以生態瞬間介入框架為輕度認知障礙患者提供個人化及同步的神經精神症狀支援的成效及2）瞭解輕度認知障礙患者對該介入的體驗和依從性。電子數據庫（如PubMed和Cochrane Library或Clinicaltrials.gov）中均未有類似的研究。 我們將在社區裏招募160位在輕度行為障礙檢查表（MBI-C）得分7或以上的輕度認知障礙患者，並將其隨機分配到試驗組或對照組（每組各80位參加者）。試驗組的參加者將在自己選擇的時間和頻率下，連續兩個月收到以即時信息傳遞的個性化接納與承諾療法（ACT）及輕度認知障礙和神經精神症狀（NPS）的護理教育的信息。此外，試驗組還將收到由治療師以文字或語音形式提供的的心理和疾病管理（即輕度認知障礙和神經精神症狀）支援，以實時提供輔導和實用建議，以提升網絡接納與承諾療法（ACT）的效果；對照組將收到一條關於一般心理健康的信息，以及提醒參與後續問卷調查的訊息。介入後兩個月及六個月的跟進評估主要指標包括輕度行為障礙（MBI-C）、抑鬱（PHQ-9）、焦慮（GAD-7）、生活質素（EQ-5Q-5L）、認知功能（HK-MoCA）及接納與行動（AAQ-II）。我們會在試驗完成後進行意向分析及質性研究(n=20)分析。本研究將嚴格遵循CONSORT-EHEALTH指引。 此研究將會為香港及其他地區提供透過個人化即時通訊軟件為有神經精神症狀的輕度認知障礙患者提供承諾與行動治療有效性的首個證據。

17619523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619523.value: 以圖數據探索朝鮮半島中古時期兩班官僚貴族的聯姻網絡

17619523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619523.value: "Yangban as Graphs" is a data-rich sociopolitical history of the patronage and marriage networks of medieval Korea's yangban ("two branches", referring to capital-based civil and military bureaucrats) between 900 and 1550. This longitudinal study investigates the ambiguous understanding of birth and merit following the tenth-century collapse of the ascriptive "bone-rank" system, which sanctioned strict sumptuary laws and official rank by birthright. This project pays close attention to men of originally common ancestry who consolidated power through patron–client and marriage alliances, as well as their struggles to maintain their position across generations. Using innovative digital methods, I argue that the yangban aristocracy represents the culmination of centuries-long efforts to build a stable replacement for the bone-rank order. To historians of pre-twentieth century East Asia, I offer an empirical and long-term structural analysis of medieval Korea's gradual transformation into a centralized bureaucratic regime. My data-assisted and non-teleological methodology contributes to the collective effort to seek an alternative path to the enduring influence of Confucian evidential scholarship, Japanese colonial historiography, and Cold War modernization theory in Korean history. To make a clear distinction between historical actors' categories and modern analytic concepts, I will execute graph queries to engage in multiscale explorations of biographical data and identify groups responsible for social changes. In lieu of the protracted debates about stagnation, progress, and developmental stages, I propose testing a push–pull model conceived by comparing the medieval Korean case to other patrimonial societies. My hypothesis contends that many early medieval illustrious clans could not solidify their position as the political establishment. On the other hand, latecomers in the thirteenth and fourteenth centuries forged robust patronage and marriage ties that stabilized the center. To digital historians, I demonstrate the use of Neo4j for the central management of medieval yangban biographical records culled from dozens of existing online repositories. The current prototype of my proposed Medieval Yangban platform consists of 44,268 nodes and 23,090 edges. To improve the performance of graph queries and network cohesion calculations, I aim to increase the edge density and disambiguate the records by the end of the research period for this project. Upon completion, the Medieval Yangban platform will enable the discovery of hidden connections and assemblages among tens of thousands of medieval Korean personalities using Cypher queries. I will then use Gephi, Cytoscape, and Python's networkx library to conduct kinship network analysis on the output data. 本研究利用豐富的數據資料對900年至1550年間朝鮮半島兩班官僚貴族的聯姻網絡進行深入探討。研究重點為十世紀“骨品制度”崩解後出身與功績觀念的轉變。亦特別針對那些家庭背景比較卑微但透過庇護集團及婚姻聯盟來鞏固權力的人物的歷史，及其跨代維持權位所面臨的挑戰。藉由創新的數位技術，如圖數據庫管理系統Neo4j，顯示兩班貴族制度事實上象徵著數個世紀對找尋穩定替代骨品制度的不懈追求。

17619823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17619823.value: 審判自動化政府：中國香港在演算法治理時代的行政法改革

17619823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17619823.value: All over the world governments and public bodies have begun resorting to artificial intelligence (AI) and algorithmic decision–making to deliver supposedly more efficient, accurate, and consistent decisions in matters ranging from crime prevention and national security to taxation, health care, and social welfare. As a leading international financial centre, the only common law jurisdiction in East Asia, and a Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China embodying the ‘One Country, Two Systems’ principle, Hong Kong is no more an exception to this trend than its neighbour, the Chinese Mainland. New plans to convert the Region into a ‘smart city’ feature a heavy dose of ‘smart government’, which would proliferate deployment of big data analytics, chatbots, smart lampposts, digitalised licensing systems, automation of customs clearance and certain immigration services, and so on, all in the name of improving the delivery of public services. Despite its promise, however, algorithmic government driven by machine learning raises a horde of concerns, such as pervasive surveillance, the lack of transparency for ordinary people, and encoded biases, which are in serious tension with the rule of law and natural justice, principles directly or indirectly enshrined in the Hong Kong Basic Law. At the same time, all over the common law world, the administrative law that principally regulates public administrators is lagging behind the rapid strides being made in automating public administration. It is becoming ever more urgent to adapt administrative law principles more adequately to the needs and demands of the coming age of algorithmic government, before it is too late to conserve their exceptional contribution to liberty and justice. This study will undertake an original, unprecedented case study of Hong Kong under Chinese sovereignty, to offer something of originality and significance to the literatures on comparative administrative law and the law of AI. It will explore the current state of the art of smart government, the shortcomings of the incumbent administrative law regime in securing transparent, fair public sector use of AI, and propose reforms to judicial doctrine, legislation, and institutions that could make administrative law and justice fit for purpose in the coming age of the automated administrative state in this part of the world. 世界各地的政府和公共機構都開始採用人工智能和算法決策來提供更高效、準確和一致的決策：從預防犯罪和國家安全，到稅收、醫療保健和社會福利。作為領先的國際金融中心、東亞唯一的普通法司法管轄區，以及體現「一國兩制」原則的中華人民共和國特別行政區，香港也不例外。將香港特區轉變為 「智慧城市」的新計劃，把香港特區打造成一個「智慧城市」，其特點是大量採用「智慧政府」式大數據分析、聊天機器人、智能燈柱、數字化發牌系統、出入境服務的自動化等等，以改善公共服務的質素。儘管前景廣闊，由機器學習驅動的運算法政府引發大量擔憂，如無處不在的監控、缺乏透明度以及數碼偏見等問題，可能與《香港基本法》及《香港人權法案》直接或間接規定的法治和自然正義原則發生嚴重衝突。與此同時，在整個普通法世界，主要規範公共行政人員的行政法，落後於公共行政自動化的快速發展。為了保護行政法原則對自由和正義的特殊貢獻，在為時已晚之前，讓行政法原則更充分地適應即將到來的算法政府時代的需求，變得越來越緊迫。本研究將對中國香港進行史無前例的原創性案例研究，為比較行政法和人工智能法的文獻提供一些原創性的重要內容。它將探討智能政府的藝術現狀，現行行政法制度在確保公共部門透明及公平地使用人工智能方面的不足之處，並提出司法理論、立法和制度改革建議，使行政法和司法機構，充分適應即將到來的世界自動化行政時代。

17620223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620223.value: 远见的机器：1790-1830年英国的技术与史诗

17620223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620223.value: My project examines how, experimenting with epic form, poets in eighteenth- and nineteenth-century Britain turned to images of machinery to interrogate the limits to human freedom in an increasingly complex, dynamic world. Carrying out literary and digital analysis on the works of Darwin, Southey, Shelley, Blake, and others, I ask the following question: ‘What can Romantic thinking about machines in verse tell us about revolution, progress, necessity, and individual agency?’ Beyond contextualizing poetic encounters with machines both real and imaginary, I consider how technological change afforded innovative approaches to form, narrative, and the attribution of agency in the epic. In doing so, I take interdisciplinary research on the relationship between technology and literary forms in the long eighteenth century, research which has hitherto focused on the novel, into new territory. Though eighteenth-century critics doubted whether the epic could survive in an enlightened age, poets themselves invested in fantasies of the marvellous machine, playing with pace and plot to resist the models of cause and effect found in prose. By showing how poets drew on epic conventions to enrich the symbol of the machine, I will show how machines became such potent symbols of modernity precisely because they allowed for evocative engagements with the past. I will create a digital research resource for the Romantic epic, hosting topic-modelled texts online to facilitate further research into this important yet neglected genre. Using historical vector semantics and word-sense disambiguation, I will further examine the rich layers of meaning surrounding the word machinery in the period (‘Enginery; complicated workmanship; self-moved engines’, versus ‘the part which the deities, angels, or demons, act in a poem’, Johnson 1768) and publish the results as a peer-reviewed journal article. These two outputs will be instrumental in forming contextual knowledge for my final output: a book proposal on technology in the Romantic epic and an accompanying book chapter (on Shelley) to pitch to international university presses. Finally, examining experiences of anxiety and wonder in the face of the technological sublime, I will engage students and the wider public in my research through organising an interactive multi-media exhibition, allowing people to reflect upon their own affective responses to machinery with historical perspective. Co-sponsored by the Society of Fellows in the Humanities and organised in collaboration with the Arts Technology Lab at HKU, this exhibition will stage encounters with the literary past to provide valuable insight for our own changing times. 該项目将研究18至19世纪英国诗人在史诗形式上的实验，他们借助机械的意象来探讨在日益复杂、充满活力的世界中，人类自由的局限性。通过对达尔文、萨瑟伊、雪莱、布莱克等人的作品进行文学和数字分析，我提出以下问题：“浪漫主义诗歌中关于机械的思考如何揭示革命、进步、必然性和个体代理？” 除了将诗人与真实和虚构机械相结合的背景置于语境中，我还考虑到技术变革为史诗的形式、叙事和代理归属提供了创新方法。通过这样做，我将把关于18-19世纪文學与技术之间关系的跨学科研究引入新的领域。尽管18-19世纪的批评家怀疑史诗能否在启蒙时代存活下来，但诗人们自己却追求奇迹般的机械幻想，通过改变节奏和情节来抵抗散文中因果模型。通过展示诗人如何借鉴史诗的传统丰富机械的象征意义，我将展示机械为何成为现代性的强烈象征，正是因为它们允许人们与过去进行引人入胜的互动。 我将创建一个数字化研究资源，为浪漫主义史诗提供在线主题建模文本，以促进对这一重要但被忽视的流派的进一步研究。利用历史向量语义和词义消歧，我将进一步研究该时期关于"machinery"一词的丰富意义层面（如Johnson在1768年所定义的“复杂的工艺品；自动驱动的引擎”与“神、天使或恶魔在诗中扮演的角色”），并将研究结果发表为同行评议的期刊文章。这两个成果将对我最终的产出至关重要：关于浪漫主义史诗中技术的图书提案以及一篇附带的书籍章节（关于雪莱），以向国际大学出版社推介。 最后，通过研究技术崇高面前的焦虑和惊叹体验，我将通过组织一个互动多媒体展览来使学生和广大市民参与我的研究，让他们在历史的视角下反思对机械的情感反应。该展览由人文学者学会赞助，并与香港大学艺术技术实验室合作组织，将通过与文学过去的亲密接触为我们自己变化的时代提供宝贵的见解。

17620423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620423.value: 城市填充：尼泊爾拉利特普爾可持續及可負擔房屋示例

17620423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620423.value: In 2015, an earthquake of 7.6 magnitude struck Nepal damaging over one million homes. Over 81% of the rural housing stock has been rebuilt compared to only 38% of homes in urban areas within the Kathmandu Valley, Nepal’s most populous urban centre (HRRP, 2021). The demand for new homes is escalating as the region is rapidly urbanising , growing in population by 6.5% each year (MOUD, 2017). In the historic settlements in the Kathmandu Valley, including Lalitpur, Bhaktipur, Dhulikhel, Kirtipur, Bungamati, and Madhyapur Thimi, traditional Newari houses that were damaged in the earthquake are being replaced with concrete-framed structures with brick-infill. These are not insulated and do not thermally perform as well as a Newari house which is made of 4 layers of brick (Bajracharya, 2014). However, traditional buildings are 74% more expensive (Shrestha 2021), and seismic resilience is unreliable due to variance in their building details (EEFIT, 2016). Although concrete is perceived to be the safest construction, many frame structures can be prone to soft-storey failure in earthquakes (Build Change, 2015). Another issue is the increasing number of land disputes, which account for 36% of households delaying re-construction (HRRP, 2021). When plots are passed down to family members, subdivision results in narrow, tall houses with low levels of natural light and ventilation. If urban reconstruction efforts continue in this manner, the resulting housing stock will be at risk of future seismic events, will not meet future sustainability goals, and therefore pose a threat to future generations of urban dwellers. The aim of this project is to demonstrate how residents can build infill-housing that is affordable, has improved sustainability and seismic performance compared to concrete framed dwellings, and can address issues of land sub-division by developing more adaptable housing types. The project will focus on Lalitpur, as a case study site, that exemplifies the core issues facing reconstruction across Kathmandu Valley settlements. The outcome of the research can impact how residents choose to build their homes and change the policy for urban-infill of the government and development agencies. The research contributes to the current discourse on urban resilience, in-situ upgrading, and post-earthquake housing in Nepal. 2015年，尼泊爾發生7.6級大地震，超過100萬戶家庭受損i。農村住房有超過 81% 已得到重建，但在尼泊爾人口最多的市中心加德滿都谷地的住房則只有 38% 得到重建ii (HRRP, 2021)。這區對新房的需求隨著人口每年6.5%的增長及迅速的城市化而節節上升 (MOUD, 2017)。 在加德滿都谷地的歷史聚居點（包括拉利特普爾、巴克蒂普爾、杜利凱爾、基爾蒂普爾、邦加馬蒂及中央普爾蒂米），在地震中受損的傳統內瓦爾建築都以用磚填充的混凝土框架結構所取代。這結構並不能隔熱，隔熱性能更不如以四層磚建成的傳統內瓦爾房屋 (Bajracharya, 2014)。然而，傳統內瓦爾建築比起新建築貴74% (Shrestha, 2021)，更因為建築細節的差異，抗震能力並不可靠 (EEFIT, 2016)。雖然混凝土被認為是最安全的建築結構，但許多框架結構在地震中也很容易出現軟層破壞 (Build Change, 2015)。 另一問題是土地糾紛數量不斷增加，導致36%住房的重建需要延遲 (HRRP, 2021)。當土地傳承給家庭成員時，土地分割會導致新建的房屋又窄又高，引致自然光和通風水平降低。若城市重建工作繼續以這種方式進行，這種獲重建的住房不但繼續面臨地震風險，更無法滿足可持續發展的目標，繼而對往後世代的居民構成威脅。 本研究的目的是要展示當地居民如何建造 1. 經濟實惠，2. 比起混凝土框架建築較高的可持續性及抗震性，及 3. 能通過開發更靈活的住房類型解決土地細分問題的填充式住房。這項目將重點關注拉利特普爾作為案例研究地點，因為這地點展現了加德滿都谷地聚居點的重建正面臨的核心問題。研究成果可影響居民如何建造自己的房屋，並改變政府和開發機構的城市填充政策。這項研究為當前關於尼泊爾城市復原力、就地升級和震後住房的討論作出貢獻。

17620723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17620723.value: 密集綜合失語症康復治療對粵語患者的成效研究

17620723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17620723.value: Aphasia is an acquired language disorder caused by a left-hemispheric stroke or an injury to the brain regions responsible for language. Many aphasia rehabilitation studies, primarily focusing on English-speaking people with aphasia (PWA), target the single-word level, with treatment approaches rarely address sentence- or discourse-level performance. Most reports in the aphasiology literature also focus on weekly, biweekly, or monthly standard outpatient/community services. However, there is emerging evidence suggesting that PWA achieve larger and more clinically meaningful gains in language and psychosocial outcomes when they engage in an intensive and comprehensive aphasia program (ICAP). ICAPs differ from traditional aphasia rehabilitation models in that individualized treatments are delivered in a high-intensity dosage of at least 3 hours daily, over 2 weeks or more. The rehabilitation content of ICAPs is also highly comprehensive, targeting and covering multiple domains or training approaches, including individual and group therapy, targeted impairment-based language training, activity and participation levels of language and communication functioning in line with the World Health Organization’s International Classification of Functioning framework, and education support for PWA and their families/caregivers. Contrary to the increasing research evidence of ICAP in English, there is very little information on its use in Chinese-speaking PWA particularly due to linguistic differences of therapy materials. This proposed research aims is to examine the beneficial effects of an ICAP delivered in high doses of therapy over a short period of time on Chinese-speaking PWA. To develop a new model of aphasia rehabilitation in Hong Kong and examine how effectively the new ICAP can be implemented locally, we will (1) adapt the existing English-language ICAP model for Cantonese speakers, (2) test the model, and (3) compare/validate the new model with the existing English model. In other words, this project will investigate the efficacy of an intensive aphasia treatment approach that targets single-word, sentence, and discourse production (i.e., micro- and macrostructure), thereby growing the evidence base for language, cognitive, and psychosocial rehabilitation in native Cantonese-speaking PWA. This research has significance given Chinese is one of the most spoken languages globally but only a paucity of clinical evidence of aphasia therapy in Chinese is available. It will be the first systematic investigation on ICAP and will bridge the gap between the basic science and clinical contexts by developing and testing different rehabilitation programs for Chinese-speaking PWA. More critically, the project will be of both theoretical and clinical interest, with outcomes that are immediately translational. 失語症是一種後天性語言障礙，由左半球中風或負責語言的大腦區域損傷引起。許多失語症康復研究主要針對英語國家的失語症患者 ，目標是單個單詞水平，而治療方法很少涉及句子或話語水平的表現。失語症文獻中的大多數報告還關注每週、每兩週或每月的標準門診/社區服務。然而，有新的證據表明，當失語症患者參與密集綜合失語症康復治療(ICAP) 時，他們在語言和心理方面取得了更大、更具有臨床意義的進步。 ICAP 與傳統失語症康復模型不同，患者需要每天參與至少3 小時的高強度劑量治療，並持續兩週或更長時間。ICAP的康復內容也非常全面，針對和涵蓋多個領域或培訓方法，包括個別和小組治療、基於障礙有針對性的語言訓練、符合世界衛生組織國際分類-語言和溝通功能的活動和參與水平功能框架的治療、以及對失語症患者及其家人/照顧者的教育/訓練。和現今的英語 ICAP 研究證據相比，有關中文失語症患者的ICAP治療和對應可使用的材料非常缺乏。這項研究的目的是檢驗短期內高劑量治療的 ICAP 對中文失語症患者的有益效果。為了在香港開發失語症康復的新模式並研究新的 ICAP 在本地實施的有效性，我們將（1）針對粵語人士調整現有的英語 ICAP 模型，（2）測試該模型，以及（3）將新ICAP模型與現有的英語模型進行比較/驗證。換句話說，本項目將研究針對單詞、句子和話語產生（即微觀和宏觀結構）層面之失語症治療方法的功效，從而為母語為粵語的失語症患者之語言、認知和心理康復提供證據基礎。鑑於漢語是全球使用最廣泛的語言之一，但治療漢語失語症的臨床證據卻很少，這項研究具有重要意義。這將是對 ICAP 的首次系統研究，並將通過為中文失語症患者開發和測試不同的康復計劃來彌合基礎科學和臨床背景之間的差距。更重要的是，本項目將具有理論和臨床意義，其成果可以立即轉化為臨床訓練和日常練習指南。

17621123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17621123.value: 以學習分析、教學法及技術支援虛擬實境創客活動

17621123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17621123.value: Prof Chan, Carol Kwai Kuen Dr Hu, Xiao Dr Zhang, Chenwei

17621123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621123.value: Collaborative maker activities, which involve students working together to design and create products, are becoming popular in K–12 education for their advantages in enhancing learner agency, problem solving, digital literacies, and 21st century competencies. As a form of collaborative learning, collaborative maker activities are beneficial but highly complex, as they involve the co-evolution of multiple learners’ cognition, metacognition, and regulated learning at both the individual and group levels. Current research focuses on maker pedagogy and technology, with little attention paid to examining ongoing maker processes and using those processes as feedback and scaffolds for learning. Leveraging the prevalence of learner data on digital platforms and advances in computing technologies, researchers are now developing learning analytics to automatically examine ongoing collaborative learning processes and provide students with feedback for improving learning. Thus far, there have been few investigations harnessing the use of learning analytics for examining and scaffolding collaborative maker activities. Accordingly, building upon our prior experience on learning analytics and virtual reality (VR) story creation, the proposed project will address the research gaps by designing analytics, pedagogy, and technology for collaborative VR maker activities. The project has two objectives: 1) to examine the process of collaborative VR story creation using learning analytics and 2) to design learning analytics-based feedback (i.e., dashboards) and evaluate its efficacy for supporting students’ VR story creation and collaboration. The project will comprise three phases. Phase 1 develops the VR co-creation pedagogy and online collaborative VR-authoring platform for junior secondary school students. Phase 2 uses learning analytics data and techniques to examine collaborative processes during VR story co-creation and their relationships with learning outcomes. Phase 3 is a quasi-experimental study wherein the informative learning analytics indicators revealed in Phase 2 are used to design analytics-based dashboards to provide timely feedback to experimental students, while comparison students receive only VR-authoring support. The effectiveness of analytics feedback for maker activities and collaborative learning will be evaluated. The project findings will contribute to 1) knowledge and theory building on the collaboration and metacognitive-regulation processes of maker activities and artifact-mediated learning; 2) methodological advances in analyzing collaborative processes in maker activities using learning analytics; and 3) pedagogical designs and implications for developing dashboards and learning analytics-supported collaborative maker activities in schools. The pedagogy and platform developed will be available for teachers and students around the world to support their VR creation activities in various education contexts. 協作創客活動，旨在讓學生合力設計及製作成品，有助提升學生的學習主動性、解難能力、數碼素養及21世紀技能，近年深受幼稚園、中、小學歡迎。協作創客活動是協作學習的其中一種形式，涉及多個學習者在個人及小組層面上認知、元認知及調節學習的共同演化，益處甚多卻頗為複雜。 目前研究著重於創客教學及科技，惟甚少探討創客活動的過程或基於該過程給予學生反饋及支援。鑑於數碼平台上學習者數據的普遍性，加上科技的進步，學者正致力研發學習分析技術，用於自動地檢查協作學習的過程，為學生提供助長學習的反饋。然而，目前研究甚少運用學習分析技術來檢查及支援協作式創客活動。有見及此，是次項目建基於我們團隊在學習分析及創作虛擬實境上的經驗，將為協作式虛擬實境創客活動設計學習分析方法、教學法及技術，從而填補相關研究領域的空缺。 是次項目的兩個目標是：1) 以學習分析技術剖釋協作式虛擬實境創客活動，以及 2) 設計以學習分析為基礎的反饋（即可視化的介面），及評估其支援學生創作虛擬實境及協作過程的有效性。 是次項目將分為三個階段。階段一，我們將設計適合初中生的協作式虛擬實境創客活動教學法，以及研發虛擬實境創作平台。階段二，透過運用學習分析的數據及技術，我們將探討學生創造虛擬實境的協作學習過程及其與學習成果的關係。階段三為準實驗研究；階段二所得出的分析指標，將用作設計基於學習分析所設計的可視化介面，為實驗組的學生提供及時的反饋，而對照組的學生只會得到虛擬實境創作上的支援。我們將會評估以學習分析生成的反饋和學生的協作學習過程。 研究結果將 1) 增進有關創客活動中協作、元認知及調節學習過程的知識及有助理論建構， 2) 以學習分析技術剖釋創客活動的協作過程，提升相關的研究方法，及 3) 為在中學課堂中推進學習分析支援的協作式創客活動提供教學法及建議。是次項目所設計的教學法及開發的平台，將開放給世界各地的教師及學生使用，並支援不同教學情境中的虛擬實境創客活動。

17621523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17621523.value: 數字時代濫用時常主導地位

17621523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621523.value: 該擬議項目將探討價格歧視的加劇如何促進各種濫用市場支配地位的行為，以及競爭法應如何應對這一新出現的威脅。它將重點關注美國和歐盟，儘管其政策建議也應與其他司法管轄區相關。 近年來，在線零售商潛在地惡意使用算法，特別是為了促進共謀，引起了競爭法界的廣泛關注。然而，算法的反競爭潛力並不限於共謀。算法使在線零售商能夠以越來越高的精確度實施價格歧視，從而能夠有效區分邊際客戶和超邊際客戶。這種能力將使公司能夠更有效地追查濫用市場支配地位的行為。迄今為止，這個問題很少受到關注，這個擬議的項目致力於填補文獻中的空白。 價格歧視的加劇可以通過多種方式助長濫用市場支配地位的行為。就掠奪性定價而言，這意味著掠奪性企業可以將其低於成本的價格瞄準有可能轉向新進入者的邊際客戶，同時維持邊際以下客戶的現行價格。瞄準掠奪的能力將有助於最大限度地減少掠奪損失，從而使掠奪性定價成本更低、更可行。這挑戰了普遍的觀點，即掠奪性定價很少被嘗試，更很少成功。價格歧視的增強還提高了掠奪者收回掠奪損失的能力，使其能夠將掠奪後的價格上漲瞄準更忠誠的超邊際客戶。除了掠奪性定價之外，價格歧視的加強也促進了以類似方式使用排他性回扣。算法定位還允許搭售公司將其搭售定位於超邊際客戶，從而降低搭售成本。這可能會減少為企業帶來利潤而對消費者造成傷害所需的市場力量。它還可能影響某些搭售損害理論的應用。 擬議項目旨在編寫一本學術專著，就競爭法應如何解決強化價格歧視對濫用市場支配地位的影響提供詳細的政策建議。這些建議應該引起世界各地競爭執法機構以及經合組織和貿發會議等關注這一問題的國際組織的興趣。

17621623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
17621623.value: 探究国际非政府组织在一带一路绿色治理中的媒介作用

17621623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
17621623.value: Dr Farid, May Prof Lo, Carlos Wing-hung

17621623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
17621623.value: 中国庞大的“一带一路”倡议正在重塑国际发展的规范、架构和实践。作为全球发展行动者，中国的崛起对地缘战略动态和全球治理具有重要意义。全球化的中国在应对气候危机和环境治理方面将产生巨大影响。然而，现有关于全球中国的研究主要集中在中国的发展融资、软实力、地缘政治和地缘经济上，研究一个或一组中国海外发展的行为者。很少有研究探讨多元行为者如何合作或竞争来塑造中国的绿色“一带一路”。本研究采用多元行为者的视角，聚焦中国“一带一路”中多元行为者的动态互动，并阐明他们之间的互动方式、扮演的角色以及在环境治理方面取得的政策成果。具体而言，我们分析了全球行为者（国际非政府组织）在中国“一带一路”中的参与。我们试图回答以下四个研究问题： • 在全球范围内，为什么有些国际非政府组织参与中国“一带一路”的绿色化，而其他组织却不参与？ • 不同行为者，包括中国政府机构、国有和私营企业、非政府组织、国际非政府组织以及东道国政府和民间社会，如何相互作用以实现“一带一路”项目的绿色化？ • 国际非政府组织在中国“一带一路”背景下如何运用倡导策略塑造全球环境治理？ • 国际非政府组织在推动“一带一路”绿色化方面发挥了什么作用？ 我们将采用混合研究方法，即结合国际非政府组织的定量数据、对“一带一路”中不同利益相关者的定性访谈（包括政府机构、国有企业、私营企业、中国非政府组织、国际非政府组织和东道国行为者），以及在柬埔寨、印度尼西亚和土耳其进行的特定国别政治人类学研究。通过细分行为者并比较不同政策领域的项目，我们的研究可以提供一个基于实证的描述，揭示它们如何塑造全球中国的环境治理过程。其次，研究结果将通过实证案例丰富国际发展、国家与非政府组织关系以及环境治理的理论。第三，通过阐明不同行为者如何推动、参与或抵制中国全球化努力，我们可以为参与“一带一路”绿色化的组织和社区提供基于证据的建议，以指导政策、行动和项目。 我们在非政府组织与国家关系、国际发展和比较政治方面具备专业知识，并已在项目地点建立了合作关系。我们有信心按计划完成项目，并在顶级发展、国际关系和公共管理期刊上发表一本书和至少三篇文章。

18300623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18300623.value: 從物理學中的非遍歷性到優化問題中的非凸性 - 它們如何在變量空間中呈現？其含義及應用

18300623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18300623.value: In physics, a system is non-ergodic if it fails to visit all equally probable equilibrium states even after a very long time. A representative non-ergodic model is spin glass. To explain its non-ergodicity, physicists utilize energy landscapes, which are high-dimensional functions representing the dependence of system energy on variable configurations. The non-ergodicity of spin glass is then associated with rugged energy landscapes, characterized by exponentially many local minima and high-energy barriers, thus trapping the system in a subset of all probable states. We seem to understand well how energy landscapes influence emergent behaviors of physical systems, but how landscape-features such as barriers and plateaus manifest themselves in the variable space is less understood. Interestingly, one can only control how a system moves across barriers and plateaus in energy landscapes through manipulating variables in the variable space, but an understanding of how to connect energy landscapes with variable space is missing. Indeed, rugged energy landscapes in spin glass share similar features with non-convex objective functions in non-convex optimization problems. This non-convexity may have a non-trivial origin instead of simply an explicit form of non-convex objective functions or constraints. For instance, deep neural networks (DNNs), which are universal function approximators, can represent both convex and non-convex functions by optimizing the same form of loss function subject to different datasets. The increasing use of DNNs on artificial intelligence applications is also a major reason for the rapid increase in the interest of non-convex optimization problems in recent years. Similar to spin glass, the causal link between variable space and cost/loss landscape in non-convex optimization problems is largely unknown. In the proposed project, we aim to (1) generate new understandings to link features in the spin space to features in the rugged energy landscapes of spin glass, to better understand non-ergodicity in physics; (2) transfer our new understanding to link the variable space and the cost/loss landscape of non-convex optimization problems, to better understand non-convexity in optimization; (3) derive new barrier-overcoming and plateau-overcoming mechanisms for both spin glass and non-convex optimization problems; (4) integrate the new mechanisms in blending existing optimization approaches in both areas, leading to a new optimization paradigm for both non-ergodic physics systems and non-convex optimization problems. The project aims to contribute to both community of spin glass and non-convex optimization problems, and to non-convex optimization applications including deep learning and recommender systems. 在物理學中，非遍歷性是指系統經過很長時間仍無法經歷所有同等幾率的態，而其中一個具代表性的非遍歷模型是自旋玻璃。為解釋其非遍歷性，物理學家使用了能量地勢這個概念，以表示系統能量依賴變量狀態的高維函數關系。自旋玻璃的非遍歷性與其崎嶇不平的能量地勢相關，其特點是擁有指數般多的局部極小值和極高的能量障礙，把系統困在部分狀態中。我們似乎一直以能量地勢解釋物理系統的表現，但郤不清楚障礙和高原等能量地勢特征如何在變量空間呈現。有趣的是，我們只能通過操縱變量，才能控制系統在能量地勢中越過障礙和高原，郤不理解如何連接能量地勢與變量空間。 事實上，自旋玻璃中的崎嶇的能量地勢與優化問題中的非凸目標函數類似。這種非凸性可能並非源於簡單的非凸目標函數或約束條件，而是有其他的起源。如在深度人工神經網絡中，基於不同數據集，我們可以通過優化相同的損失函數使神經網絡模仿凸函數和非凸函數，而近年來其在人工智能中的廣泛應用也是非凸優化問題迅速受關注的主要原因。與自旋玻璃相似，我們仍然未理解非凸優化問題中的變量空間與成本/損失地勢之間的關系。 本項目的目標為：（1）建立變量空間與自旋玻璃崎嶇能量地勢之間的聯系，更好地理解物理學中的非遍歷性；（2）將這些新理論應用於理解變量空間與非凸優化問題的成本/損失地勢的關係，更好地理解優化問題中的非凸性；（3）為自旋玻璃和非凸優化問題提供新的機制，克服能量地勢中的障礙和高原；（4）將新機制與兩個領域中現有的優化方法結合，為非遍歷物理系統和非凸優化問題提供新的優化範式。 本項目旨在為自旋玻璃和非凸優化問題的研究領域作貢獻，並應用於深度學習和推薦系統等非凸優化。

18600123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18600123.value: 調查職前教師基於語料庫技術TPACK發展以及他們對獨立語言學習和教學的自我效能感：混合方法研究

18600123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18600123.value: Prof Chai, Ching Sing Dr Chen, Hsueh Chu Dr Crosthwaite, Peter

18600123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600123.value: Corpus technology has now become mainstream in language-related research. Empirical corpus-based studies have demonstrated many positive outcomes in learners’ development of various language skills. However, frontline language teachers in primary and secondary schools are unfamiliar with corpus technology, mainly due to the lack of technological, pedagogical and content knowledge (TPACK) training in corpus technology. To address this knowledge gap, we have recently developed a corpus-based language pedagogy (CBLP) that blends language pedagogy with corpus technology; it is a specific form of TPACK for corpus technology. Moreover, a popular claim regarding corpus use is that learners could develop their independent language-learning ability, but there is little empirical evidence to support this claim. With regard to student teachers who are non-native speakers of the language they teach, it is crucial to improve their self-efficacies in the independent learning and teaching of the target language since self-efficacies are key motivational constructs that influence their teaching performances. This proposal aims to frame training in corpus technology for student teachers within the TPACK framework to foster CBLP for effective teaching using corpus technology. This research will also provide a theoretical model by investigating how student teachers in Hong Kong and Mainland China receive TPACK training in corpus technology, and how this can influence their self-efficacies for independent language learning and teaching. A mixed-method approach will be adopted, including an intervention, a survey and a multi-case study. First, a six-week intervention of TPACK training in corpus technology will be conducted with 300 student teachers of English. Their learning outcomes will be measured via the survey data. Structural equation modelling will be conducted twice by employing the partial least squares method (PLS-SEM) at the beginning and at end of the training to test the proposed theoretical model and to measure the training effect on the model. A multi-case study involving selected student teachers will then be conducted to investigate how their self-efficacies for independent language learning and teaching are co-developed with their TPACK for corpus technology. Theoretically, the research will generate a new understanding of TPACK for corpus technology for teaching language subjects, and its relationship between self-efficacies for independent language learning and teaching. Such new knowledge could benefit research areas in corpus linguistics, language education and TPACK. Practically, the findings may generate empirical evidence regarding how to provide effective TPACK training in corpus technology to enable student teachers to improve their independent language learning and teaching self-efficacies. 語料庫技術現已成為語言相關研究的主流。涉及使用語料庫進行語言學習的實證研究在學習者各種語言技能的發展中顯示出許多有效的成果。然而，語料庫技術在初中和高中的一線語言教師中仍然鮮為人知。關鍵原因是語言教師教育專案中缺乏針對語料庫技術的TPACK培訓。因此，我們新建立了一個基於語料庫語的新型語言教學法（CBLP），將語言教學法與語料庫技術相結合。這是針對語料庫技術的特定形式的TPACK。此外，關於語料庫使用的一個流行觀點是，學習者可以發展他們的獨立語言學習能力，但支援這個觀點的實證證據很少。對於非母語的語言學生教師，我們認為提高他們的目的語言的獨立學習和教學的自我效能是至關重要的，因為自我效能是影響他們教學表現的關鍵動機因素。 本研究方案旨在為職前教師在TPACK框架內進行語料庫技術的培訓，以促進CBLP的有效教學。本研究還將通過調查香港和中國大陸的職前教師如何接受語料庫技術的TPACK培訓，以及這如何影響他們的獨立語言學習和教學的自我效能，提出一個理論模型。 我們將採用混合方法的研究方法，包括干預、調查和多案例研究。首先，將對300名英語學生教師進行為期6周的TPACK在語料庫技術的培訓干預。他們的學習成果將通過調查資料來測量。將在培訓開始和結束時，採用偏最小二乘法（PLS）進行兩次結構方程模型（SEM）分析，以測試提出的理論模型，並測量培訓對模型的影響。然後，將對選定的職前教師進行案例研究，以調查他們的獨立語言學習和教學的自我效能如何與他們的語料庫技術的TPACK共同發展。

18600523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18600523.value: 新出土戰國楚簡「孔子與時人對答」敘事研究

18600523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18600523.value: 孔子對中國政治、思想影響深遠。戰國時期，不同派別的學者已熱烈討論孔子的學術主張，也會引用、轉述他的說話闡述觀點，故此傳世文獻已出現大量孔子與時人對答的記載。秦始皇焚書以後，傳世先秦文獻都是經過漢儒整理的版本。「孔子」經過歷代學者不斷詮釋後，與先秦時期面貌已有一定差距。近年，大量戰國竹簡出土，當中不少孔子言論的記載，既有語錄形式，也有孔子與時人的對答。部分見於傳世文獻，也有散佚篇章，屬於第一手文獻，甚具學術價值，其敘事特點與傳世文獻也有差異。本計劃擬在前人基礎上全面分析有關記載，目的有三： 1.文獻整理：分類整理傳世文獻與出土竹簡裡孔子與時人對答」的記載，製作「資料匯編」。 2.比較分析：從敘事角度研究該批竹簡與相關傳世文獻的異同之處，探討兩者闡述觀點的特色和效果，推測不同文獻運用不同敘事方式的目的。 3.重建孔子言論可能的演變過程：分析其增加、散佚、被詮釋的情況，探討由孔子到孟荀之間儒家可能的發展痕跡。 Confucius has had a profound influence on Chinese politics and ideology. Starting from the Warring States Period, scholars from different schools engaged in heated debates on Confucius’ academic thought. They often expound their own viewpoints by quoting and paraphrasing Confucius’ sayings. As a result, abundant records of Confucius’ sayings and dialogues in the transmitted texts have emerged. After the burning of books by Emperor Qin Shi Huang, the surviving pre-Qin texts were compiled by Han Confucian scholars. The interpretation of "Confucius" has undergone continuous reinterpretation by scholars throughout the ages. It is far from the appearance of the Pre-Qin Period. In recent years, a large number of Warring States bamboo slips have been unearthed, many of which record Confucius' speeches in the form of quotations and dialogues between Confucius and the ancients. Some of these records can be found in transmitted texts, while others are scattered or lost, constituting primary source documents that hold great academic value. Differences in narrative features could be observed when comparing the excavated texts with the transmitted texts. This project aims to comprehensively analyze the relevant records based on previous research, with three objectives: 1. Literature Collation: Sort out the dialogical records between Confucius and the ancients in the excavated texts on the Chu Bamboo Slips and compile a “Database”. 2. Comparative Study: Compare and contrast the excavated texts and the transmitted texts in the perspective of narratology. Examine the features and effectiveness of presenting concepts and ideas in order to deduce the purpose of using different narrative modes. 3. Reconstruct the transformation progress of Confucius’ speeches: Analyze the complementary, distortion, and interpretation progress of Confucius’s speeches and examine the course of development of Confucianism from the period of Confucius to Mencius and Xunzi.
