18600623.value: 閱讀英語科學文本對於英語為第二語言/外語的學生而言具有挑戰性。在增強第二語言學習者閱讀科學文本的能力方面，已經提出了兩種主要策略。第一種是文本結構教學（Text structure instruction; TSI），它是一種明確且基於研究的方法去教授閱讀說明文。它包括教授文本結構策略，這是一種認知和元認知教學法，旨在提高對科學文本的理解能力。第二種策略為學習者提供動機支援和參與環節。此策略借鑒了自我決定理論（Self-determination theory; SDT），提出通過滿足學習者的自主、能力和關聯性三個基本心理需求，可以提高閱讀表現。儘管研究已經證明這兩種策略（即文本結構教學和以自我決定理論為本的動機策略）在提高英語為第二語言學習者的閱讀表現方面都各自有效，但據我們所知，還沒有研究探討這兩種策略是否可以整合，以產生更積極的協同效應來提高學生的閱讀表現。此外，我們還需要瞭解如何使文本結構教學更加有效，在本研究中，我們專注於元認知校正，這在文本結構教學中尚未被研究。 因此，本研究的主要目標是評估一種加入了動機支援的文本結構教學介入措施，能否提高中文母語者理解英語科學文本的能力。第二個目標是測試元認知校正在介入效果中是否起到調節作用，元認知校正指對自身表現的主觀判斷與在元認知監控時實際表現之間的關聯。考慮到兩種策略（文本結構教學和動機）與文本理解之間的正向關係，我們預期整合的介入措施（即參與式文本結構教學）將比僅採用文本結構教學更能提高學生的科學文本理解能力。我們還假設校正對結果產生顯著的調節作用，因為那些具有準確判斷並能更好地監控其理解表現的學生將從策略教學中獲益更多。 本研究將進行一項隨機對照試驗，將學生隨機分配到三個組別，比較以混合學習模式進行的三種網上介入措施（參與式文本結構教學、文本結構教學和常規教學）在提高英語科學文本理解能力方面的效果。研究將從香港本地中學招募約210名講廣東話的中一學生。每項介入計劃將持續約12個星期，共24教學小時數。為了檢驗介入效果，將進行前測、後測和三個月延宕後測。測試內容包括文本結構使用、科學文本理解、三種基本心理需求滿足度（自我決定理論；能力、關聯性和自主）以及閱讀動機。先備知識、單字朗讀和工作記憶將作為共變項進行測量，而元認知校正則作為潛在的調節變項在前測時測量。本研究的結果對科學文本閱讀的教學、以及動機在閱讀表現中的作用具有重要的意義。

18601023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601023.value: 採用交叉滯後的縱向研究探討社交情感技能如何影響兒童的閱讀理解的發展

18601023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18601023.value: Dr KWAN, Lok Yin Joyce Dr Poon, Kai Tak

18601023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601023.value: 社交情感技能即勝任社交任務的能力（Cook et al., 2008），以及理解自己和他人的情緒、控制自己的情緒和自我激勵的能力（Law et al., 2004）與兒童各項技能的發展廣泛相關。具有高社交情感能力的兒童往往比社交情感能力低的同齡人表現更好，特別是在學術發展方面，尤其是在閱讀理解這一重要技能方面（McArthur et al., 2022）。 然而，社交情感技能和閱讀理解之間的聯繫機制及社交情感技能差是否會導致兒童閱讀理解能力差，或者閱讀理解技能差是否會導致不良的社交體驗和情感問題等問題仍不清楚。 以這些問題為背景，本研究將探討：1）兒童社交情感技能與閱讀理解增長率之間的動態雙向關係，2）社交情感技能與閱讀理解之間聯繫的潛在機制，以及3 ）社交情感技能的增長/失敗是否會導致閱讀理解能力的增長/失敗，反之亦然。 此研究的參與者將是300名平均年齡為八歲的小學三年級學生。他們將連續三年（即三年級至五年級）接受一系列關於社交情感技能、口語能力（即詞彙知識）、認知能力（即工作記憶）、非語言推理、閱讀理解和家庭社會經濟地位（SES）的測試。 本研究將對文獻作出幾個創新的貢獻。當中最重要的是，本研究將採用縱向設計，有系統地測試社交情感技能和閱讀理解之間的雙向關係，從而更全面地瞭解兒童的社交情感技能如何影響其閱讀理解，反之亦然。我們還將通過測試認知能力、口語水準和單詞朗讀於社交情感技能和閱讀理解的關聯中的仲介作用，闡明社交情感技能和閱讀理解的相關性的機制。鑒於閱讀理解在成功的學術學習、就業和個人機遇中基礎作用，探討這些機制對於制定收窄兒童閱讀理解差距的政策和幹預至關重要。 此外，本研究的發現將：1）啟示父母、教育工作者和政策制定者提升閱讀理解和社交情感技能幹預的效果的途徑，以更好地促進兒童發展；2）反映結合社交情感技能、語言能力及認知能力，不但能更好地篩選出有閱讀困難風險的兒童，還可以增強這些幹預的效果；3）推動支援有社交情感問題和閱讀理解困難的兒童的政策和計畫。

18601223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601223.value: 受網絡欺凌華裔學生的認知重評與心理健康

18601223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18601223.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Farver, JoAnn M. Dr Ho, Chun Yip Henry Dr Law, Wilbert

18601223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601223.value: 網絡欺凌是一個嚴重的問題，其受害者往往感到焦慮、抑鬱，甚至可能有自殺行為。此外，部分憤怒的網絡欺凌受害者可能因未能有效地調節情緒，最終反過來欺凌他人，形成惡性循環。因此，有效的介入和培訓計劃可以幫助網絡欺凌受害者，提升他們的心理健康，並減少他們成為網絡欺凌者的傾向。 過去的研究指出“認知重評”是一種情緒調節策略，通過重新評估和改變對情境的認知來調節情緒反應，從而減少負面事件對心理健康的影響。然而，較少研究將認知重評這種低成本的策略應用到網絡欺凌受害者的身上。因此，本研究將設計一個認知重評的訓練，並評估其效用。 具體來說，我們將邀請中學及大學生參加心理健康教育（對照組）和認知重評訓練（實驗組）， 進行前測後測，並利用結構方程模型分析學生心理健康來評估認知重評訓練的效用。本研究的結果能爲對應網絡欺凌的措施及相關的學校課程提供參考，從而幫助網絡欺凌受害者，改善他們的心理健康，並有望打破網絡欺凌的惡性循環。

18601423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18601423.value: 聲調對發音的影響：透過聲學分析、超聲波成像和發音合成

18601423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18601423.value: This project seeks to investigate the relationship between tongue movement and tone in speech production – two parts of articulation formerly considered independent from each other. Although tone is produced by controlling vocal cord tension, a recent study on Swedish (Svensson Lundmark et al., 2021 [Phonetica 78:515–569]) has shown that pitch can affect tongue movement at the same time. We plan to extend this new line of research by looking at consonant-vowel coordination in Cantonese and Mandarin, two languages with respectively six and four lexical tones, under different tone and speech rate conditions. Both acoustic (formant) and articulatory (high temporal resolution ultrasound tongue imaging) data will be collected for analysis, followed by analysis-by-synthesis using VocalTractLab. Our findings will shed new lights on (i) our understanding of speech production, (ii) individual differences in articulatory control, and demonstrate (iii) the use of articulatory synthesis as a convenient tool for hypothesis-testing in articulation research. 本項目旨在研究言語產生過程中舌頭運動和聲調之間的關係——這兩個發音部位從前被認爲是相互獨立的。雖然聲調是通過控制聲帶張力產生的，但最近一項關於瑞典語的研究（Svensson Lundmark等，2021 [Phonetica 78:515-569]）表明，音高（pitch）還可以同時影響舌頭的運動。我們計劃在不同的聲調和語速條件下，通過研究粵語和普通話（分別有六個和四個聲調）輔音-元音的協同發音，來擴展這一新的研究思路。我們將收集聲學（共振峰）和發音（高時間分辨率超聲舌部成像）數據進行分析，然後使用VocalTractLab進行分析合成（analysis-by-synthesis）。我們的研究結果將有助於：(i) 深化我們對言語產生的理解；(ii) 揭示發音控制的個體差異；並證明(iii)發音器官參數合成是發音研究中假設檢驗（hypothesis-testing）的有效工具。

18602223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602223.value: 平衡車：兒童姿勢穩定性和控制能力的實證解決方案

18602223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602223.value: Dr Mok, Kam-Ming Dr Sun, Fenghua

18602223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602223.value: 能夠自由自在操控兩輪單車是每個人應該具備的基本身體活動能力。然而，全球約有9.7％的人仍然不懂得如何騎行單車。依這個比例計算，就相當於香港6.5萬名中小學生不會騎行單車。教授孩童掌握獨立地騎行單車是一件非常重要的事情，而當中很多孩童都是依賴家庭成員的支持。不幸的是，家中的監護人通常不會將孩子學習這項技能作為首要任務，可能是由於經濟狀況和/或缺乏單車相關知識，讓到有很多孩童都未能完全掌握單車在行駛的技術。資料顯示年輕且經驗不足的單車使用者在騎行時最容易發生單車事故，其中大多數都是單車使用者的自我撞擊意外。因此，學校在這方面扮演著重要的角色，讓每一個學生都能掌握這個應有的基本身體活動能力。 騎行單車的表現依賴於控制單車穩定性的能力，從而應對各種行車場景。在騎行單車的路途上，單車左右搖擺（即橫向偏差）往往是主要的不穩定情況。平衡車是一種最近流行的教授騎單車的方法。由於平衡車的設計就有如一輛沒有踏板的普通單車，讓新手學習時可以感受到控制身體重心在兩個輪子上，從而讓雙腳離地在平衡車上滑行。有證據顯示，使用平衡車可以降低學習的起始年齡和所需時間。我們團隊的初步研究證明了一個新型平衡車培訓計劃對成年人掌握所需的平衡技巧是有效的。然而，兒童的騎行單車表現、姿勢控制和培訓效果之間的因果關係尚未確定。到目前為止，可穿戴慣性測量裝置可以讓研究人員量化參與者的直立姿勢和單車動態場景中姿勢搖擺能力。因此，這項研究旨在： 1.量化姿勢穩定性，比較學齡兒童在直立姿勢和騎平衡車時的表現，包括會騎行單車的組別（騎行單車者）和不會騎行單車的組別（非騎行單車者）； 2.研究應用研究團體設計的平衡車訓練，改善不會騎行單車的人操控平衡車的穩定性； 3.研究應用研究團體設計的平衡車訓練對兒童運動技能和身體素質，以及對騎雙輪單車的信心的影響。 這個計劃將招募52名6至9歲的小學生來自當地學校。其中12名學生需要具備騎行單車的能力（騎行單車者組），而其他40名學生則不需要（非騎行單車者組）。該計劃分為兩個階段：1）現況調查，2）隨機對照試驗。

18602323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602323.value: 缺失的關聯：校長福祉素養以及影響因素和結果

18602323.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602323.value: Prof Oades, Lindsay Prof Qian, Haiyan Prof Riley, Philip Prof Walker, Allan David

18602523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18602523.value: 找出一個有效減低香港長者孤獨感的兩階段適應性介入

18602523.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18602523.value: Prof Choi, Namkee G Dr CHOW, Oi Wah Esther Prof Jiang, Da Dr Kwok, Yan Yan Jojo Dr Qian, Min Prof Yeung, Dannii

18602523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18602523.value: Our previous study showed that approximately 45% of Hong Kong Chinese older adults report that they feel lonely sometimes or always. It is well established that loneliness is associated with numerous detrimental consequences on psychological, physical, and cognitive health. Against this backdrop, it is of the utmost importance to develop an effective intervention to reduce loneliness among Hong Kong’s older adults, especially during times like the COVID-19 pandemic. The main objective of this study is to develop and identify an effective two-stage adaptive intervention for reducing loneliness among older Hong Kong Chinese adults involving behavioral activation and mindfulness meditation. Using a sequential multiple randomized trial (SMART), we aim to 1) evaluate whether a telephone-delivered behavioral activation (Tele-BA) intervention or a telephone-delivered mindfulness (Tele-MF) intervention is a more effective first-stage intervention in terms of reducing loneliness; 2) evaluate whether extending the original first-stage intervention with an additional motivation component or switching to an alternative intervention is more effective in reducing loneliness when participants are not responding to the first-stage intervention; 3) evaluate whether the Tele-BA–Tele-MF sequence (8 weeks) or the Tele-MF–Tele-BA sequence (8 weeks) is more effective in reducing loneliness; and 4) identify which of our four embedded 8-week two-stage adaptive interventions (Tele-BA with booster for responders and Tele-BA for nonresponders; Tele-BA with a booster for responders and Tele-MF for nonresponders; Tele-MF with a booster for responders and Tele-MF for nonresponders; Tele-MF with a booster for responders and Tele-BA for nonresponders) is the most effective for reducing loneliness. A random sample of 244 participants aged 65 and older who feel lonely will be recruited. Response will be defined as a 50% reduction in loneliness. Participants will be assessed at baseline and at 4 weeks, 8 weeks, 5 months, and 8 months after baseline. Apart from loneliness, we will also measure stress, symptoms of depression and anxiety, and sleep quality as secondary outcomes. The findings will not only inform us whether the SMART is an efficient approach for identifying an effective adaptive intervention for reducing loneliness but also, more importantly, provide evidence to understand and refine the biopsychosocial-pathways model of loneliness on which our selection of interventions and secondary outcomes is based. 我們較早前的研究顯示，約有45% 的香港華人長者有時或經常感到孤獨。孤獨感已經被廣泛確認與許多對心理、身體和認知健康有不利的後果相關。在這種情況下，制定有效的介入措施以減少香港長者的孤獨感至關重要，特別在2019冠狀病毒病的期間。本研究的主要目的為制定及識別一種有效的兩階段適應介入措施，包括積極行為介入及靜觀介入，以減少香港華人長者的孤獨感。有效介入的參加者定義為其孤獨感於進行介入後減少了50%。透過使用順序多重隨機試驗，我們的目標是：1) 評估電話行為介入或電話靜觀介入，哪種是更有效的第一階段介入措施以減少孤獨感；2) 評估若參加者在第一階段所進行的介入措施為「無效介入」時，將延伸原有第一階段介入措施加入激勵元素，還是轉換另一組的介入措施，哪種為更有效減少孤獨感；3) 評估電話行為介入至電話靜觀介入 (8星期)或電話靜觀介入至電話行為介入(8星期)，哪種為更有效減少孤獨感；及4) 識別嵌入的四種為期8星期的兩階段適應介入措施：(a)有效電話行為介入並加入延伸元素的參加者與無效電話行為介入的參加者；(b)有效電話行為介入並加入延伸元素的參加者與無效電話靜觀介入的參加者；(c)有效電話靜觀介入並加入延伸元素的參加者與無效電話靜觀介入的參加者；(d)有效電話靜觀介入並加入延伸元素的參加者與無效電話行為介入的參加者，哪種介入措施最有效減少孤獨感。 研究將會隨機抽樣選出244位65歲或以上有孤獨感的長者。參加者將會參與基線評估及於基線評估後的4星期、8星期、5個月及8個月進行跟進評估。除了孤獨感，我們亦會量度一系列的次要成效指標，包括壓力、抑鬱和焦慮的症狀以及睡眠質素等。研究結果使我們了解到順序多重隨機試驗是否能夠有效地識別適應介入措施以減少孤獨感。我們基於孤獨感之生物心理社會途徑模型，選擇介入措施及次要結果，而研究結果將提供證據以理解並完善整個模型。

18603923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18603923.value: 教師身份和對話對其教育變革能力和教學實踐的影響

18603923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18603923.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Halse, Christine Margaret Mr Hamid, Farid Abdul Dr Ho, Chun Sing Prof Leung, Suzannie Kit-ying Dr Wan, Sally Wai-yan

18603923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18603923.value: Even when actively collaborating, teachers need to connect new ideas about teaching and learning to their personal experiences to improve classroom teaching. However, researchers rarely consider how teachers’ previous out-of-school experiences—especially childhood experiences—influence their change capabilities. Our pilot studies show that childhood demographics are more influential than current statuses in shaping teacher identity. This proposal seeks to understand how childhood experiences underpin professional identity formation, thus influencing how teachers connect intended change with practice. The concept of “identity grafting” has been developed by the PI (Lee*, 2017) to illustrate how childhood experiences people “graft” onto their professional identities consequently influence their values toward change and their practices. Identity grafting refers to connections people form with selected social groups, and the identities they consequently take on, which influence how they reconcile differing values and engage in professional practices. For example, some teachers mostly favor new ideas, grafting these to develop a blended pedagogical identity; others mostly disengage, seeing new ideas as unwelcome influences grafting on their identities (Keiler, 2018). Employing four constructs (blending, integrating, reversing, and repressing) that comprise the theory of identity grafting, this research will explore how teachers mainly engage in specific forms of negotiations, as individuals, among peers, and between schools and systems. We will conduct a survey sampling at least 300 teachers each in Hong Kong and Singapore. Survey results will provide an overview of identity profiles of teachers by teacher demographics, school, class, and teaching practices. Observations of teacher dialogues and interviews will provide insight into childhood experiences, teacher collaboration, and teacher-student interaction influences on the identity grafting underpinning teaching practices. Our research seeks to raise teacher awareness about their identity grafting strategies, to help them make critical decisions about educational change for improving student learning. It fills critical gaps in the research literature regarding how teachers experience and navigate educational change, drawing connections between their personal experiences (childhood demographics and memories and teacher dialogues) and teaching practices. This project will contextualize the social influences of teacher identity, many of which are shaped by childhood. It will examine teachers who (re)construct diverse, dynamic identities from childhood as active agents of identity grafting. Teachers may adapt these frameworks as tools for self-reflection—particularly regarding how they may tighten synergies between teacher collaboration, classroom collaboration, and their teaching practices. 即使在積極合作的情況下，教師仍需將新的教學理念與個人經驗相結合，以改善課堂教學。然而，研究人員很少考慮教師過往的校外經歷 ，尤其是童年經歷 ，如何影響他們的變革能力。我們的試點研究表明，在塑造教師身份方面，童年時期的個人背景資料比教師的現狀更有影響力。本提案旨在瞭解童年經歷如何成为教師職業身份形成的基础，從而影響教師如何將預期的變革與實踐聯繫起來。 「身份嫁接」（Identity Grafting）這一概念是由PI（Lee*，2017）所提出，旨在說明人們如何將童年經歷「嫁接」到他們的職業身份上，從而影響他們對變革的價值觀和實踐。身份嫁接指的是人們與選定的社會群體所建立的聯繫，並由此塑造其身份，這影響了他們如何協調不同的價值觀和參與專業實踐。例如，一部分教師傾向於接納新理念，將其嫁接以發展出「融合」(Blended) 的教學身份；而另一部分教師則將新理念視為導致其身份妥協的影響，從而逆轉其教學身份（Keiler, 2018）。 本研究將採用建構身份嫁接理論的四種結構（融合 Blended、混合 Integrated、逆轉 Reversing和 壓抑 Repressed），探討教師作為個體、在同僚之間以及學校制度之間，如何主要參與特定形式的協商。我們將在香港和新加坡各至少抽取300名教師進行調查。 調查結果將按教師個人背景資料、學校、班級和教學實踐來概述教師的身份特徵。 通過觀察教師對話和訪談，我們將深入瞭解其童年經歷、教師合作以及師生互動對教學實踐作為身份嫁接基礎的影響。 我們的研究旨在提高教師對其身份嫁接策略的認識，説明他們在改善學生學習方面的教育變革上做出關鍵決策。本研究將完善過往研究文獻中，關於教師如何體驗和應對教育變革的討論空間，在教師的個人經歷（童年人口統計和記憶以及教師對話）和教學實踐之間建立了聯繫。本項目將對教師身份的社會影響進行背景分析，其中許多影響是由童年時期所形成的。它將考察那些以童年經歷（重新）建構多元身份的教師，作為其身份嫁接的積極推動。教師可以將這些框架作為自我反思的工具，特別是關於如何加強同儕合作、課堂合作和教學實踐之間的協同作用。

18604223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18604223.value: 朱駿聲說字訓詁與解文訓詁的比較研究

18604223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18604223.value: 朱駿聲是漢語詞義研究的權威，他編撰的《說文通訓定聲》（下稱「《定聲》」）是漢語詞義研究的經典著作。過去學者研究《定聲》或朱氏的語言學觀點，往往只取用《定聲》書內材料為據，視野受局限。事實上，朱駿聲著述宏富，除《定聲》外，據近人劉躍進統計，朱氏尚有著述百餘種，當中不乏朱駿聲說解經典的作品，如《六十四卦經解》、《尚書古注便讀》、《儀禮經注一隅》、《春秋左傳識小錄》、《離騷補注》等。《定聲》是辭書，取《定聲》記載的字典義（即「說字訓詁」）與朱氏在注解經籍時所下的訓詁（即「解文訓詁」）相較，兩者對同一典籍文字的說釋卻每有不同，如《定聲》釋「贊」為「見」，《儀禮經注一隅》卻云「贊，佐也」。本計劃比較朱駿聲說字與解文兩種訓詁的異同，從中觀察朱氏「說字」和「解文」的不同原則，並補充《定聲》未備的訓詁材料，讓朱氏建構的詞義系統可更完整地呈現。這項工作對《說文通訓定聲》、朱駿聲語言學成就以及漢語詞義的研究均有助益。 Zhu Junsheng is one of the Qing-era authorities on Chinese semantics and author of Shuowen Tongxun Dingsheng (hereafter “Dingsheng”), his magnum opus in the field. In the past, scholars who study Dingsheng or Zhu’s linguistic views often restrict themselves to material found within Dingsheng, therefore limiting to a certain extent the breadth and depth of their perspectives. In fact, Zhu is a prolific academic whose scholarly outputs are many. Apart from Dingsheng, Zhu’s entire corpus of outputs as surveyed in recent times by Liu Yuejin numbers well above one hundred, including many treatises with exegeses on the Confucian canon and other classics, such as Liushisi Gua Jingjie, Shangshu Guzhu Biandu, Yili Jingzhu Yiyu, Chunqiu Zuozhuan Zhi Xiaolu, Li Sao Buzhu, etc. Whereas Dingsheng is a lexicographical work; when we take the root (or etymological) meaning as glossed by Zhu in Dingsheng and compare it with or contrast it against his philological exegeses provided as interpretations to individual classics, we often find that the root meaning and the ad hoc meaning found in context are quite different. For example, Dingsheng would gloss the character “贊” (zàn) as ‘to see’, but in Yili Jingzhu Yiyu, Zhu would provide ‘to aid’ as the exegetic interpretation for the same character. The study proposed herein will examine his etymological analyses of Chinese characters and words by comparing them with or contrasting them against how he interprets the same set of characters and words in context through the philological exegeses he gives. Through this work, we shall extrapolate the principles behind his philological scholarship, all the while introducing philological material found in his classical treatises, to allow Zhu’s semantic network to be fully revealed. The proposed study will not only deepen existing understanding of Dingsheng and its value, but also broadening our appreciation of Zhu Junsheng’s linguistic legacy specifically and the wider field of Chinese semantics in general.

18604423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18604423.value: 透過遊戲學習機械人編程：對幼稚園兒童參與度和運算思維的影響

18604423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18604423.value: Prof BAUTISTA, Alfredo Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Lee, John Chi Kin Prof Li, Hui

18604423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18604423.value: Fostering computational thinking (CT) has become a growing global focus, and learning to program begins as early as kindergarten (Bers et al., 2022). However, kindergarten teachers often teach CT through structured programming curricula without capitalizing on children’s play. In Hong Kong, there is a lack of evidence-based pedagogical practices to promote kindergarteners’ CT development. Our pilot studies indicate that robot programming (RP) can enhance children’s CT by engaging them in hands-on manipulation of screen-free programmable robotics. Since play appeals to children’s natural curiosity and contributes to their learning, we propose to rigorously evaluate whether play-based pedagogies can better engage children in RP activities and enhance their CT, relative to direct instruction with a structured curriculum. Building on the theory of constructionism and the Digital Play Framework, this project proposes a play-based intervention to integrate RP into kindergarten classrooms. Since researchers debate the value of varying play-based pedagogies and the role of play in learning, this project will use a multi-group experimental design to evaluate the impact of play-based pedagogies versus direct instruction on 360 five-year-old children’s CT learning across eight weeks. Six Hong Kong kindergartens, their 12 classrooms and their 24 teachers will participate. Each kindergarten will be randomly assigned to one of the three groups, with teachers trained accordingly: RP via free play, RP via guided play, and RP via direct instruction (control). Children in the free play group will receive the robots and activity cards, and the children can freely play with the robots during their daily learning center time. In the guided play group, teachers will also have a deck of pedagogical questions to scaffold their children’s play-based RP. In the direct instruction group, teachers will give children step-by-step instructions to use the robots. All children will take pre- and post-intervention CT and engagement tests. Children’s RP activities will be videotaped to investigate their engagement. During and after the intervention, teachers will be interviewed to examine enablers and barriers to the implementation of RP activities. This project will fill an important knowledge gap regarding the comparative effectiveness of CT learning across free play, guided play, and direct instruction. The findings will inform the theorizing of a digital learning framework that can enhance our understanding of embedding digital technologies into classrooms to facilitate children’s learning. Evidence will also inform teachers effective pedagogies for early childhood programming education to equip children with CT needed in a rapidly changing digital society. 培養運算思維已成為全球日益關注的焦點，而學習編程早在幼稚園時期就已開始(Bers et al., 2022)。然而，幼稚園教師通常在結構化的編程課程中教授運算思維，而未善用兒童的遊戲。在香港，仍缺乏基於證據的教學實踐以促進幼稚園兒童的運算思維發展。我們的試驗性研究表明，機械人編程可以通過讓兒童進行無屏幕可編程機械人的實際操縱來增強他們的運算思維。由於遊戲符合兒童的天性並有助於他們的學習，因此我們建議嚴格評估基於遊戲的教學法是否可以比結構化課程的直接指導更好地吸引兒童參與機械人編程活動並增強他們的運算思維。本項目建立在建構主義理論和數字化遊戲框架的基礎上，提出了一種基於遊戲的干預措施，將機械人編程整合到幼稚園教室中。由於研究人員對不同的基於遊戲的教學法的價值和遊戲在學習中的作用存在爭議，因此本項目將使用多組實驗設計來評估基於遊戲的教學法與直接指導對360名五歲兒童在八周內進行運算思維學習的影響。六所香港幼稚園、其12個教室和24名教師將參與。每所幼稚園將隨機分配到三組之一，相應地培訓教師：自由遊戲的機械人編程、引導遊戲的機械人編程和直接指導的機械人編程（對照組）。自由遊戲組的兒童將接收機器人和活動卡，孩子可以在日常學習中心時間內自由地玩機器人。在引導遊戲組中，教師還將擁有一套教學問題卡，以支持兒童基於遊戲的機械人編程。在直接指導組中，教師將給出逐步使用機器人的指令給兒童。所有兒童都將接受干預前後的運算思維和參與度測試。兒童的機械人編程活動將被錄像以調查他們的參與度。在干預期間和之後，將對教師進行訪談，以檢查實施機械人編程活動的促進因素和障礙因素。本項目將填補關於自由遊戲、引導遊戲和直接指導對運算思維學習的相對效果的重要知識空白。研究結果將有助於理論化數字化學習框架，以促進我們理解如何將數碼技術融入教室以促進兒童的學習。證據還將為教師提供有效的幼兒編程教育教學法，以配備兒童在快速變化的數碼社會中所需的運算思維技能。

18605223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18605223.value: 利用在線互動式同儕評估發展學生回饋素養：交互模式、行為序列和影響因素

18605223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18605223.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Dr Sun, Daner Dr Yan, Zi

18605223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18605223.value: 回饋素養是指學生為改進學習，有效利用回饋時所需的回饋能力和傾向。在大學課程和評估體系中，具有回饋素養的學生能夠充分利用回饋，最大化其對學習的效益(Carless & Boud, 2018)，進而促進學生未來的職業發展和終身學習 (Winstone, Balloo & Carless, 2022)。儘管回饋素養非常重要，由於課程時間和空間的限制以及缺乏有效的教學模式，培養回饋素養對大學教師來說是一項艱巨的任務。 根據現有的研究發現，線上互動式同儕評估（OIPA）在加強回饋提供者和接收者之間對話交互方面具有巨大潛力(*Zhan, Wan & *Sun, 2022)，而這正是學生回饋素養發展的關鍵。然而，該領域還需更多的研究來填補以下四個空白。a) 尚未有針對OIPA幹預，採用對照組設計並測量幹預前後回饋素養變化的研究。 b) 很少有研究比較同步和非同步互動對培養學生回饋素養的效能。 c) 現有文獻尚未具體探討學生回饋互動中的行為序列是如何影響其回饋的使用。 d) 研究尚未系統地探討影響線上同儕評估環境中回饋互動的因素。 為了填補這些研究空白，本項目將採用自然實驗設計，開發並實施OIPA。被試為香港某教育大學修讀核心教育課程的教育學學士二年級學生。四個完整的班級將隨機分配到其中一種幹預條件（同步和非同步討論；每兩個小組一種幹預條件），另外四個完整的班級將隨機分配到一種控制條件（無互動線上同儕評估和無同儕評估；每兩個小組一種控制條件）。在實驗組中，學生的互動將根據4R階段（即，請求同儕回饋；評審同儕的作業；回應同儕回饋；根據同儕回饋修改作業）進行。OIPA將分四輪進行，在一學期內完成。 為了確定OIPA每種幹預的效果，本專案將通過中心化差分結構方程模型(Little et al., 2012)對被試幹預前後的回饋素養 (*Zhan，2022b) 進行分析。為了捕捉回饋互動過程中個人行為序列，我們還將收集大量網上系統日誌資料，並進行統計話語分析(*Chiu & Lehman-Willenbrock, 2016)。為了探索響OIPA過程中影響回饋互動的因素，我們還將收集實驗者被試的回顧性日誌和個人訪談資料，並通過反思性主題分析法(Braun & Clarke，2019)進行分析。 本項目的創新之處在於對回饋提供者和接收者之間的線上回饋互動，從交互模式、行為序列和影響因素進行仔細研究。本專案的研究結果將促進我們對OIPA如何影響學生回饋素養發展的機制產生新的理解。在實踐方面，本項目的研究結果將為大學教師提供有關OIPA活動設計和實施的教學建議，並啟發他們如何激發同儕回饋互動，以培養學生回饋素養。

18606223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18606223.value: 大學新生在英語授課 (EMI) 中的聆聽問題和聆聽策略的多變量縱貫性研究

18606223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18606223.value: Dr Chen, Hsueh Chu Dr Chung, Hiu Yui Edsoulla Dr Lo, Yuen Yi Prof Macaro, Ernesto

18606223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18606223.value: Recent years have seen a surge in English Medium Instruction (EMI) programmes across the globe, particularly in Europe and Asia. These programmes are characterised by the teaching and learning of content subjects (e.g., Science, Geography) taught through students’ second language (L2) English. Although studies on EMI secondary education have shown that the dual goal is not necessarily achieved, given the experience of listening to the teacher speak in English much more than their counterparts who learnt it in their first language (L1), these students tend to be better at listening in tertiary education. Yet, to date, there is a scarcity of research on listening problems encountered and listening strategies deployed by students when they are comprehending the teacher input at tertiary institutions. This study examines the listening problems as one type of transitional challenges in learning faced by university students, and the listening strategies that they use to cope with these problems. The study starts with the development and validation of a questionnaire to tap into students’ listening problems and strategies used. Using this newly developed and validated questionnaire, a comparison will be made between students who received EMI secondary education and those who had Chinese Medium Instruction (CMI) – the L1 of most students in Hong Kong. This study intends to pinpoint the problems encountered by the respective groups of students and how listening strategies are deployed to tackle these problems. The study will also use path analysis to reveal the relationship among listening problems, strategies used, vocabulary breadth and depth, academic achievement, and learners’ background variables, including academic disciplines and prior EMI experience. Finally, lesson observation and post-lesson stimulated recall interviews will be used to provide a rich description of how learners with different education background (EMI vs CMI, and prior experience in learning the content subjects) comprehend the teacher input in lectures. Pedagogical implications are to be generated in terms of how EMI and CMI students can be supported in the transition to tertiary education. 近年，英語授課 (EMI)在全球各地，尤其是歐洲和亞洲都十分普遍。英語授課的特色是以英語作為學生的第二語言作術科（如科學、地理）的教學語言。雖然有研究顯示英語授課不一定能達致英語水平和術科知識增長的雙重目標，但無疑學生在課堂中能累積更多經驗聆聽和接收老師以英語作解釋和教學，也因此這些學生普遍在大學學習時聆聽能力更高。可是，直到現時為止，並沒有充份的研究指出學生在聆聽大學老師授課時所遇到的困難和他們所應用的聆聽策略。本研究旨在探究大學新生由中學升讀到大學時所遇到的聆聽問題和他們用以解決這些問題的聆聽策略。首先，本研究會制定一份有信效度的問卷，用以測量學生所遇到的聆聽問題和他們所應用的聆聽策略。這份問卷會用以比較由英語授課中學和中文授課中學畢業並升讀大學的學生，以發現兩者有否遇到不同的聆聽困難，或應用不同的聆聽策略。本研究並會用路徑分析呈現聆聽問題、聆聽策略、詞彙廣度和深度、學術成績、以及學生背景變量，包括他們大學選修的學科和以往接受英語授課的經驗等等之間的關係。最後，透過課堂觀察和課後訪談，本研究會深入地描述不同學生怎樣理解老師的教學。本研究的結果會對EMI教學有重要的啟示，並幫助我們了解怎樣支援從不同授課語言的中學畢業並過渡到大學第一年的新生所遇到的困難。

18607123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607123.value: 顯性教學與任務重複對非華語學生口語互動的影響：一項準實驗研究

18607123.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18607123.value: Prof Goh, Christine C. M. Dr Liang, Yuan Mr Pang, Chi Chuen

18607123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607123.value: 口語互動對於第二語言學習者來說非常重要，因為它能促進二語習得，幫助獲得教育和就業機會，以及促進社會融合。儘管人們認為年輕的二語學習者可以自然而然地掌握交際互動的技巧與策略，但許多研究表明，口語互動在社交和認知方面都是具有挑戰性的。兒童在參與二語口語互動時往往會遇到困難。在香港，來自南亞和東南亞的非華語學生在口語互動中也面臨相似的問題。大量研究表明，促進二語口語互動的有效教學策略包括顯性教學、信息差任務和任務重複。然而，這些策略在除英語外的其他二語學習者中，特別是亞洲的年輕二語學習者中，鮮少被應用。因此，本研究旨在1）基於前人研究設計並實施能夠促進口語互動的干預模型；2）評估干預模型對提高年輕的非華語學生在粵語口語互動方面的影響；3）探索學生和教師對干預的有效性和適用性的看法。本研究將採用實驗對照組設計，研究工具包括前測、後測、延遲後測，以及課堂觀察和訪談。為確保有足夠的學生，本研究將招募120名非華語學生及其教師。這些參與者會被分配到實驗組和對照組。實驗教師將接受關於口語互動教學策略的培訓，並與研究人員共同開發教學材料。通過顯性教學、信息差任務和任務重複，干預模型將訓練學生的交際技巧和策略。為確保干預的忠實度，研究將採用課堂觀察和忠實度檢查表兩項工具。對照組將按照課本中的指示和活動進行學習。本研究將對兩組學生在干預前進行前測、干預後進行後測，並在結束後三週進行延遲後測。學生的口語表現將從話題管理、互動模式和意義協商三個方面進行分析。研究將運用統計方法分析組間和組內差異，從而檢查干預對學生口語互動的影響。此外，研究將通過訪談探索學生和教師對干預的有效性和適用性的看法。本研究旨在提供實證證據，以瞭解干預模型如何提高年輕的二語學習者的口語互動能力，並對如何將這些策略應用於亞洲情境提出建議。

18607223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607223.value: 漢代(公元前206−公元220年)禮器上的文與字

18607223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607223.value: Texts and images are commonly found on ancient ritual objects. These ritual objects, whether made of bronze, jade, lacquer, ceramic, or textile, frequently bear decorative motifs or pictorial images on the surface. Inscriptions or texts are somewhat less prevalent. Apart from the inscriptions on bronzes of the Western Zhou and Eastern Zhou periods, texts or words on ancient ritual objects tend to be subordinate to the images, or are there to provide information related to their manufacture. Interestingly though, during the Eastern Han period, some inscriptions or texts on a wide range of ritual objects appeared as separate motifs, or took on a more important role by being placed in a central position on the objects. The project aims to look into the under-researched aspect of these changes of function of texts on ritual objects during the Han times. An extensive survey of archaeological reports, collections and archives in different museums and institutes will develop a comprehensive database of the relevant objects and text records to lay a foundation for the study. In addition, this research will also carefully study the content and the way the texts are displayed on different types of ritual object of the Han period. It will also investigate the provenance of the texts by comparing them with different common textual materials of the same period. By studying archaeological material and historical texts, and adopting the interdisciplinary approach of art historical stylistic analyses and contextual material studies, this research will examine how the role of texts on ritual objects developed, and the changes in the relationship between texts and images on these objects during the Han era, particularly in the burial context. Furthermore, the factors driving the changes will be explored. This may provide insight into the contemporaneous belief in the afterlife, as well as perceptions of immortality. 文字與圖像都可見於古代禮器上。在不同的古代禮器，不論是青銅器、玉器、漆器、陶器、或是紡織品，都常帶有圖像紋飾，而帶刻文或文字則相對較少。除了西周和東周青銅器上的銘文，古代禮器上的文字多作為圖像紋飾的輔助，或作為器物的製作紀錄。及至東漢時期，情況有所轉變，部分禮器上的銘文或文字多不再依附圖像紋飾，而是單獨的出現。而且，這些刻文或文字都出現在較當眼或更重要的中央位置，這些變化似乎顯示禮器上的文字帶有更重要的功能或意義。此研究將透過整理不同的考古材料和歷史文獻，並採用藝術史風格分析和跨學科的研究方法，探討漢代禮器上的文字及其內容、功能和展示方式的發展，以至文字與圖像之間的關係變化。此外，本研究亦希望能了解促使這些變化的因素，以理解時人的死後信仰與長生觀念。

18607523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607523.value: 通過網上互動繪本閲讀計劃提升兒童的閲讀能力

18607523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607523.value: The proposed intervention study will examine and compare, in a digital storybook reading context, the effects of two core cognitive skills of morphological awareness (MA) and orthographic awareness (OA) and their effects of different training orders on Chinese word reading among Hong Kong Chinese kindergarteners. MA, referring to the understanding of the meaning structure, has been consistently found to be critical in Chinese word reading starting from kindergarten. OA, referring to the understanding of the structures, positions, and functions in print, has been found to be predictive of Chinese word reading mostly in the primary school grades. The sequential development of these two underlining metalinguistic skills contradicts the claims of Lexical Quality Hypothesis (Perfetti& Hart, 2002), stating that form and meaning should be both developed in high quality for skilled reading, regardless of developmental periods. This problem motivated the current study: for optimal reading development, should MA and OA be developed sequentially in their own sensitive periods or developed in parallel? The proposed intervention programme will be designed and implemented online, given the increasing impact of digital learning in everyday life and its apparent advantages of being cost-effective and not limited by time, location, or pandemic constraints. The answer to the question may seriously challenge the Lexical Quality Hypothesis, an influential theory in the field, or strongly support and elaborate it. According to the Lexical Quality Hypothesis, confusion in form or meaning leads to low quality representations. Thus, MA training in K3 is less likely to bring substantially higher lexical quality representations. Instead, OA training in K3, together with their original MA foundations, will more likely lead to a significantly enhanced lexical quality of word presentations, thus, better reading outcomes. Theoretically, the study will contribute to a more complete understanding of early reading development. Practically, the online reading programme could be used for all young Hong Kong children, supporting their preparation with solid fundamental literacy skills for school readiness. 本干預研究以網上繪本閲讀為媒介，探討並比較語素意識和正字法意識這兩種核心元語言認知能力以及他們不同的訓練順序對香港兒童中文字詞閱讀的影響。語素意識指的是對最小意義單元的覺察以及對意義結構的操作。語素意識對於中文字詞閱讀的重要性在幼稚園階段已經非常明顯。 正字法意識指的是對字形結構、位置和功能的理解。研究發現，正字法意識對於中文字詞閱讀的預測作用主要在小學階段開始體現。實證文獻説明，這兩種元語言意識對中文閲讀的作用有著很明顯的先後順序。然而，根據詞彙質量假說（Lexical Quality Hypothesis. Perfetti ＆ Hart, 2002）, 形式和意義都需要得到高質量的發展才能達至熟練閱讀。這激發了當前的研究問題：為達到最佳的閱讀發展，語素意識和正字法意識應該在各自的敏感期依次訓練還是同一時間一併訓練？ 鑑於網上學習在日常生活中的影響越來越大，及其具有成本效益且不受時間、地點或流行病限制的明顯優勢，本研究將通過網上實施干預課程。根據詞彙質量假說，形式或意義的不清晰會導致低質量的表徵。那麼對幼稚園三年級兒童的語素訓練將不太可能帶來更高的詞彙質量表徵。 相反，對幼稚園三年級兒童的正字法訓練，再配合他們原有的語素意識，更可能提高詞彙表徵的質量，從而達至更好的閱讀效果。 在理論層面上，這項研究將有助於更全面地了解早期閱讀發展。 在實踐層面上，本研究開發的網上閱讀計劃可開放給所有香港幼兒，幫助他們提高閲讀能力， 為升讀小學做好準備。

18607623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607623.value: 幼兒數學的學習差距：家庭環境、認知技能和數學能力的相乘作用

18607623.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18607623.value: Dr Lam, Chun Bun Ian Dr Liu, Cuina

18607623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607623.value: Children start developing their ability to think mathematically and explore and understand mathematical concepts and skills, e.g., counting, sorting, and matching, in daily routines and activities. The early math knowledge and skills learned in preschool lay the foundation for developing more complex mathematical concepts, critical thinking skills, and problem-solving abilities in school and later life. Children’s early competence in math has implications for later math and science achievements. With a poverty rate of 23.6% in Hong Kong (Census and Statistics Department, 2022), many children face risks when learning math that can cause substantial problems for themselves, their families, and society. The family socioeconomic status (SES) and home math environment (HME) profoundly shape children’s quality and frequency of early math learning. Children who grow up in family environments with risk factors, such as low SES and poor HME, face a heightened risk of encountering math difficulties. Children from low-SES families are more likely to have inadequate exposure to math learning, few math learning resources, and poor parent‒child interactions. Compared with their peers, children growing up in harsh environments generally have lower and slower development of early cognitive, language, and math skills, adversely affecting their later academic achievement and school success. This development gap among children with a low vs. middle family risk environment may begin in kindergarten and persist throughout their formal education. However, longitudinal research has rarely focused on the relationships between cognitive and math-specific skills and early math learning for Chinese children with different profiles of family environment risks. The proposed study will examine the Moderated Pathways Model that considers the impact of family environment factors on the associations of cognitive skills (i.e., language, executive functions, visuospatial) and math-specific skills (i.e., symbolic numeracy, patterning, and nonsymbolic quantity skills) in children’s early math development. This study will also examine the developmental trajectories of math learning outcomes in children in the three preschool years (from K1 to K3) who face different family environment risks and what predictors will decrease the math learning gap between children that do and do not face family environment risks. The findings can offer research-based evidence to raise children’s early math performance and address issues related to family environment risk. Teachers and policy-makers can also gain insights into developing educational policies and curricula while targeting children at risk of experiencing early math learning issues across the preschool years. 兒童可以在日常生活和活動中發展數學思維的能力和探索數學概念和技能，例如數數、分類和配對。在幼稚園階段習得的早期數學知識和技能為以後發展更複雜的數學概念、創造性思維和解決問題的能力奠定基礎。兒童早期的數學能力對以後的數學和科學成就具有重要意義。基於香港的貧困率達到23.6% （政府統計處，2022）， 很多兒童面臨數學學習的困難和風險，這給兒童自身、家庭和社會帶來了重大問題。家庭社會經濟地位和家庭數學環境對兒童早期數學學習的品質和頻率產生深遠影響。身處充滿風險因素的家庭環境的兒童例如低社會經濟地位和較差家庭數學環境，則更大可能經歷數學學習困難。來自低社會經濟地位的兒童更有可能接觸匱乏的數學學習機會和資源和低品質的親子互動。在匱乏環境中長大的兒童，與他們的同輩相比，一般有更低水準和緩慢發展的認知、語言和數學能力。這一來自中低家庭風險環境的發展差距可能始於幼稚園而持續到他們的常規教育階段。然而，縱向研究較少關注認知與數學技能與早期數學學習的關係，特別是不同家庭環境風險的中文兒童。本研究探索調節的數學路徑模型，研究家庭環境因素對認知技能（語言、執行功能和視覺空間）和數學技能（表徵性數學、規律、和非表徵性數量技能）在兒童早期數學發展中的作用。本研究將探索從低班到高班兒童三年的數學發展軌跡，這些兒童處於不同家庭環境風險因素，並發現哪些因素可以減少他們的數學學習差距。本研究將為兒童早期數學學習和家庭環境風險因素的議題提供實證為本的重要發現，並為關注兒童數學學習風險的教師和政策制定者的教育政策和課程開發提供重要參考。

18607723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607723.value: 青少年的數位素養實踐、網路社交與福祉：前因、模式與互動

18607723.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18607723.value: Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Prof Dewaele, Jean-Marc Prof Jiang, Lianjiang George Prof Yin, Hong-biao Prof Yu, Lu

18607823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607823.value: 執行功能在大學生跨語言寫作中的角色

18607823.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18607823.value: Dr Lin, Dan Prof Lin , Mei Yi Angel Prof Zhu, Xinhua

18607823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607823.value: Writing from sources (WFS) is a crucial ability that university students must acquire in order to gain new knowledge and achieve academic success. Contextualized in the unique background of Hong Kong, where biliteracy and trilingualism are valued, students are expected to select, organize, and connect information from cross-linguistic sources in writing activities using their both L1 (Chinese) and L2 (English) skills. Since previous studies on WFS were seldom conducted in bilingual contexts thus it is less clear on students’process in writing from cross-linguistic sources (WFCS) and related factors influencing students’ performance. The process of WFCS is essentially complicated as it involves multiple perspectives, multimodality, and translanguaging; thus, the ability to regulate various linguistic and cognitive skills directed to a specific goal—namely, executive function (EF)—is vitally important throughout the perplexing process of writing. Although growing literature has indicated that EF is a significant predictor accounting for students’ individual differences in literacy learning, its role in WFCS has not been studied. Under such a circumstance, this study aims to fulfill an important research gap in the bilingualism research by investigating the effect of EF on students’ performance in WFCS tasks. An explanatory sequential mixed-methods design will be adopted. A total of 150 undergraduates (year 1 or year 2) will be recruited for a quantitative study to complete a battery of tests, including three EF tests, two computerized WFCS tasks (i.e., write essay in Chinese and English respectively based on materials delivered in both Chinese and English) and tests for controlling variables (e.g., prior knowledge and typing speed). The data collected will be analysed and modeled using SPSS and Mplus. In qualitative session, an additional sample of 20 students will be invited to attend a think-aloud and a stimulated recall interview session. The qualitative data will be used to triangulate the quantitative findings to gain a full understanding of students’writing process and its relationship with EF. The proposed study has important theoretical and educational implications. Not only will it reveal the effects of important cognitive skills (i.e., EF) on complex literacy skills such as WFCS, it will also enrich our knowledge about tertiary students’ translanguaging writing practices. Furthermore, the innovative research findings will have valuable implications for current literacy pedagogies in Hong Kong, with its anticipated shift from monolingualism to multilingualism. More importantly, the empirical evidence will provide reference for other countries or regions and inject new ideas into multilingual education. 為獲取新知識和取得良好學業成績，大學生們應掌握根據素材寫作（writing from sourcees）這一重要能力。在香港重視兩文三語的獨特背景下，學生需能熟練運用母語（中文）和第二語言（英文）進行寫作，從以不同語言呈現的材料中選擇、組織和連接相關信息。因此，根據素材寫作是學生日常碰到的一種跨語言的寫作實踐。由於過往的素材寫作研究較少在雙語環境中進行，目前學界對學生這種跨語言寫作的寫作過程以及影響學生寫作表現的相關因素還不太清楚。 跨語言寫作的過程頗為複雜，因爲它涉及多角度的角度、多種呈現的模態和跨語言的形式；因此，在整個複雜的寫作過程中，執行功能作為一種因應特定目標調節各種語言和認知技能的機制就變得至關重要。在過往的研究中，許多文獻表明執行功能是造成學生寫作表現個體差異的重要預測因素，但對於執行功能在跨語言的素材寫作中的作用則知之甚少。在此情況下，本研究旨在通過調查執行功能對學生在跨語言素材寫作任務中表現的影響，填補雙語研究中的一個重要空白。 本研究採用探究性順序混合方法設計。計劃招募 150 名香港本地的大學生（一年級或二年級）進行定量研究，他們將完成一系列測試，包括三項執行功能測試、兩項跨語言的素材寫作任務（即根據中英文材料分別用中文和英文撰寫作文）以及控制變量（如先前知識和打字速度）測試。收集到的數據將使用 SPSS 和 Mplus 進行分析和建模。在定性研究中，還將邀請另外 20 名學生參加 "出聲思考 "和 "刺激回憶 "訪談。定性數據將與定量研究結果相互印證，以全面瞭解學生的寫作過程及其與執行功能的關係。 本研究預計將產生重要的理論和教育意義。它不僅能揭示重要認知技能（如執行功能）對複雜讀寫技能（如跨語言的素材寫作）的影響，還能豐富我們對大專學生跨語言寫作實踐的瞭解。此外，隨著香港的語言教學方法越來越注重從單語主義向多語主義轉變，本研究可提供創新性的研究成果，對當前的寫作教學法産生有意義的影響，甚至將爲其他國家或地區提供參考，爲多語言教育提供新的思考方向。

18607923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18607923.value: 少年STEM創客能動性的動態發展：一個結合混合方法設計的交叉序列研究

18607923.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18607923.value: Prof English, Lyn D. Dr Fu, Guopeng Dr Liu, Duo Dr Martin, Jenny

18607923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18607923.value: 能動性指的是人類在環境制約和挑戰面前發揮影響力及創造機會的意願和能力。人類正面臨前所未有的社會、經濟和環境挑戰。學生作為未來的公民，被期望在校期間發展潛能以克服挑戰和制約（OECD，2019），因此近期對學生能動性的研究受到越來越多的關注。Covid-19大流行給我們生活和工作帶來的不確定性也使得研究能動性的發展特點和開發提升能動性的方法更加迫切。 先前的質性研究表明，學生能動性的發展是動態的。然而，目前仍缺乏量化研究，探究其關鍵維度（即意願性、選擇性、自我感知、堅持性、自我反應性和交互性）長期發展。目前我們對這些維度之間如何互動以及影響它們發展的主要因素依然知之甚少。這些知識空缺使研究人員和教育工作者難以確定學生能動性的內部結構，預測其發展的關鍵時期，預見其不同維度發展之間的潛在不平衡。這些都阻礙了我們有效設計活動和課程以促進年輕學生能動性的發展。本研究旨在探究學生能動性的動態變化。其選擇以跨學科學習（即STEM創客活動）為研究背景主要基於兩點考慮。首先，STEM創客活動要求學生使用多個STEM學科（即科學、技術、工程和數學）的知識和技能，通過設計和搭建作品來解決結構不良問題。在這種高度整合的學習過程中，學生面臨更大的認知挑戰和資源制約，因此為研究人員提供了更多機會來研究學生能動性的變化。其次，瞭解STEM創客的能動性將有助於設計STEM創客活動，以最大程度發揮這一創新學習方法的教育價值。 基於項目成員對跨學科學習（例如English ＆ King，2019; Wan，So＆Zhan，2022）和學生能動性（例如Fu ＆ Clarke，2019; Martin，2016）的前期研究，本研究將採用結合混合方法設計的交叉序列研究範式，揭示STEM創客活動中學生能動性的複雜性。為了捕捉年輕STEM創客能動性的發展軌跡，並揭示其六個維度之間的關係，研究人員將向來自STEM創客活動特色的學校四個年級（3年級，4年級，5年級和6年級）的約720名學生發放前後調查問卷。本研究還將收集72名學生質性數據（包括音頻日記和基於製品的訪談），以進一步研究能動性6個維度的互動，並確定影響其能動態發展的因素。 本研究的創新在於採用交叉序列設計來揭示學生能動性的長期變化。其獨特的實施情境使得對學生能動性的動態研究更有效率。其研究結果將通過揭示學生能動性發展動態的三個主要方面（即發展軌跡、跨維度互動和影響因素）來推進能動性理論的發展。在實踐方面，其研究結果將為教育工作者和政策制定者提供基礎數據，以設計出有效方法來培養更具能動性的未來公民。

18608423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18608423.value: 聽覺認知訓練對於改善輕度至中度聽力缺損老年人的噪聲下言語識別, 認知, 和皮層下聲調解碼功能的有效性研究

18608423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18608423.value: Prof Anderson, Samira Prof Yuen, Kevin Chi-Pun

18608423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18608423.value: In Hong Kong, 43% of older adults with hearing impairment (HI) have refused medical referral or hearing aid rehabilitation and most of them are with mild-to-moderate sensorineural HI (Chen et al., 2022). Untreated HI is associated with social isolation, depression, and reduced quality of life (Henshaw & Ferguson, 2013) and 16% increase in the risk of incident dementia diagnosis (Fritze et al., 2016). They often complain “I can hear but I cannot understand what is being said in noise” (Humes et al., 2019). Economical and accessible alternative interventions thus, should be considered, such as the use of home-based computerized auditory/cognitive training, to improve cognitive functions and speech-in-noise (SIN) perception in this population (Ferguson & Henshaw, 2015). However, no such training program exists for Cantonese-speaking older adults. Therefore, we have developed a training program that incorporated both auditory training and working memory training (AT-WMT) for older adults with untreated mild-to-moderate sensorineural hearing impairment (UMHI). One innovation of the proposed AT-WMT program is to train working memory and SIN perception within one task to save training time while maximizing the transfer effects, instead of implementing working memory training and auditory training as two parallel tasks. The aim of the proposed study is to examine the efficacy of the proposed AT-WMT using a randomized controlled trial In addition, Auditory Brainstem Responses to Complex Sounds (cABR), a scalp-recorded physiological measurement, can be used to document AT-induced neural changes. cABR could be evoked using different speech stimuli. For the first time, we will measure whether cABR evoked by lexical tones can demonstrate treatment efficacy. cABR evoked by lexical tones have the potential to became a neural biomarker specific to Cantonese speakers to elucidate biological mechanisms contributing to auditory learning success, to predict training effects, and to select participants. A total of 120 Cantonese-speaking older adults with UMHI (40 per group) will be recruited and randomized prospectively into three groups: the AT, the AT-WMT, and a control group. Speech perception in noise test, cognitive function tests, and cABR will be administered before and after the intervention to demonstrate treatment efficacy. It is hypothesized that the proposed AT-WMT will outperform the AT and the active control in improvement of speech perception in noise and cognitive functions. In addition, cABR evoked by lexical tones can document training-induced neural changes. 在香港，43％的聽力障礙老年人拒絕接受醫療轉介或聽力干預，他們中的大多數是輕度至中度的感音神經性聽力損失患者。在噪聲環境下經常抱怨“我能聽到，但聽不懂”。未經治療的聽力障礙還與社交孤立、抑鬱和生活質量降低有關，並且會增加16％的認知障礙罹患風險。因此，應考慮經濟實惠和易於使用的替代干預措施，例如使用可在家中完成的計算機化的聽覺/認知訓練，以改善此人群的認知功能和噪聲中的言語識別。然而，目前沒有適用於粵語老年人的此類訓練計劃。 因此，我們開發了一個將聽覺訓練和工作記憶訓練（AT-WMT）結合起來的訓練計劃，適用於未經治療的輕度至中度感音神經性聽力損失的老年人。所提出的AT-WMT計劃的一個創新之處在於在將聽覺訓練和工作記憶訓練結合在一個訓練任務中，在節省訓練時間的同時，最大程度地發揮遷移（transfer-effects）效應。本研究的第一個目的是通過隨機對照試驗來檢驗所提出的AT-WMT的功效。 此外，對複雜聲音的聽覺腦幹反應（cABR），一種頭皮記錄的生理測量，可用於記錄聽覺/認知訓練引起的神經反應變化。cABR可以使用不同的語音刺激來引發。首次，我們將測量由聲調引發的cABR是否可以顯示治療效果。由聲調引發的cABR還可以成為針對粵語使用者的潛在神經生物標記，以闡明對聽覺學習成功做出貢獻的生物學機制，預測訓練效果並選擇參與者。 我們將招募120名粵語輕度至中度聽力損失的老年人（每組40名），並隨機將他們分為三組：聽覺訓練組，聽覺和工作記憶訓練組（AT-WMT），和積極對照組。將在干預前後進行噪聲下的言語識別測試，認知功能測試和cABR，以證明干預效果。我們認為聽覺和工作記憶訓練組（AT-WMT）將在改善噪聲下的言語識別和認知功能方面優於聽覺訓練組和積極對照組。此外，由聲調引發的cABR可以記錄訓練引起的神經反應變化。

18609023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18609023.value: 從多語言動機自我探討基層少數族裔學生在影子教育中的語言學習經歷

18609023.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18609023.value: Prof Erni, John N Dr Gube, Jan Christian C.

18609023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18609023.value: In many non-English-speaking countries, ethnic minority students tend to be linguistically and academically disadvantaged due to inadequate communication opportunities in English and the language of the migrated place. These can adversely affect their academic performance and motivation to learn these languages. What exacerbates such disadvantages is the global prevalence of private supplementary tutoring, or “shadow education”, particularly in contexts that emphasise academic performativity. In Hong Kong, many secondary school students invest in private tutoring in Chinese and English because these are core subjects in the local school curriculum. Passing these subjects is the prerequisite for university admission. Nevertheless, although they may be proficient in Cantonese and spoken English, ethnic minority students usually find these language examinations challenging, not just because they learn them as second/foreign languages but they may also not possess the necessary literacy or skills to tackle the public examinations. Private supplementary tutoring offers support in these aspects, but many ethnic minority students either cannot afford the tuition fees or the services catering for their needs are not widely available. Some non-governmental organisations (NGOs) offer low/free-fee supplementary tutoring for underprivileged ethnic minority students (i.e., those from low-income families) to help them catch up with their studies and integrate into the local community. Their language learning experience in this type of tutoring is still underexplored. Since motivation plays a significant role in language learning success, this study will draw on the Multilingual Motivational Self System to understand how underprivileged ethnic minority students’ language learning experience in supplementary tutoring interacts with their multilingual selves and shapes their motivational dynamics. In line with the recent “multilingual turn” in applied linguistics research, this study will capture the complexity of multilingual individuals’ motivations as mediated by contexts. Through narrative inquiry, it will analyse the language learning experience in relation to the future language selves of 30 underprivileged ethnic minority students receiving supplementary tutoring. Participants will be recruited through three NGOs. Data will be collected through three rounds of in-depth individual interviews, supplemented by the participants’ self-plotted “motigraphs”, informal conversations with the participants’ parents and tutors and documents. This study seeks to gather thick description of ethnic minority students’ narrative experiences to generate theoretical understanding of their dynamic multilingual motivational selves. The findings will yield theoretical insights in language motivation research and offer practical advice on how underprivileged ethnic minority students can be better supported in language learning in mainstream and shadow education. 在許多非英語國家，由於英語和移民地語言的交流機會不足，少數民族學生往往在語言和學業上處於不利地位。這可能對他們的學業和學習這些語言的動機產生不利影響。尤其在強調學業表現的情境下，全球盛行的補習或「影子教育」加劇了這些劣勢。在香港，許多中學生投資在中文和英文補習上，因為這些是本地學校課程的核心科目。考試通過這些科目是升讀大學的先決條件。然而，儘管少數族裔學生可能精通廣東話和英語口語，他們往往覺得這些語言考試具有挑戰性，不僅因為他們將這些語言作為第二或外語學習，而且他們可能不具備應對公開考試所需的讀寫能力或技考。補習在這些方面提供了支援，但許多少數族裔學生無力承擔學費，或者適合他們需求的服務並不普遍。一些非政府組織為基層少數族裔學生（即來自低收入家庭的學生）提供低價或免費的補習課程，以幫助他們追趕學習進度並融入當地社區。他們在這種補習中的語言學習經驗仍然未被充分探討。 由於動機在語言學習中起著重要作用，本研究將借鑒多語言動機自我系統理論，了解基層少數族裔學生在補習中的語言學習經歷如何與他們的多語言自我互動並塑造他們的動態動機。本研究將與最近應用語言學研究中的「多語言轉向」一致，捕捉處於情境中的多語言個體的動機複雜性。通過敘事研究，它將分析與三十位接受補習的基層少數族裔學生的未來語言自我相關的語言學習經歷。參與者將通過三個非政府組織招募。數據將透過三輪深度個別訪談收集，並由參與者自繪的「動機圖」、與參與者父母和補習導師的非正式對話和文件補充。本研究旨在收集對少數族裔學生敘事經歷的詳細描述，以理論了解他們動態的多語言動機自我。研究結果將為語言動機研究提供理論見解，並對如何在主流和影子教育中更有效地支援基層少數族裔學生的語言學習提供實用建議。

18609123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18609123.value: 結構方程模型框架內的多層次中介分析中的效應值測量和樣本數測定

18609123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18609123.value: 本研究旨在探討多層次中介模型的樣本量需求。在量化研究中，樣本量的測定是研究設計中不可缺少的一環。適當的樣本量可以確保測試的統計檢測力，並減少參數估計中的偏差。因此，樣本量對研究結論的可靠性、可信度和可複製性方面有著重大的影響。在社會科學和行為研究中，中介模型常用於研究人類過程。使用多層次數據進行中介分析進一步允許研究人員在不同層面（例如，學校和學生層面）上研究人類過程。儘管越來越多的研究人員對使用多層次中介分析來解決理論上有意義的問題感興趣，但樣本量的重要性並未都得到重視。其中一個原因是在複雜模型中的樣本量測定涉及多個考慮因素，例如效應大小、分析的模型規範和高級編程技能。已有研究發現許多研究無法滿足多層次中介分析的樣本量要求（McNeish，2017）。此外，雖然先前的研究人員已經表明，樣本量要求會受多個因素（例如組內相關系數和不平衡的聚類抽樣設計）影響而異，但研究人員有時仍傾向於將多層次模型中的單一“經驗法則” 過于籠統地涵蓋到如中介分析等不同多層次模型條件中。 本研究將解決多層次中介分析中的樣本量問題。本研究分為三個部分。第一部分會透過基準比較其他現有的多層次模型中的效應大小測量，研究多層次中介效應的效應值測量。效應大小是影響樣本量充足性的一個因素。第一部分的結果將增進研究人員對效應大小的理解，有助於在數據收集之前預測研究的效應值。第二部分將進行模擬研究，在多層次結構方程模型框架下，系統性地評估不同樣本量對多層次中介模型的檢測性能的影響，並制定一些法則，以確定多層次中介分析中的樣本量要求。第三部分將基於第一部分和第二部分的研究結果開發一個以R語言為基礎的程序，用於計算多層次中介分析的樣本量和效應值。本研究將幫助研究人員在資源有限的情況下確定多層次中介分析的最佳樣本量，並有助於改進多層次中介分析研究的研究設計，提高升研究方法設計的嚴謹性。

18609423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18609423.value: 睡眠不誤：延長睡眠對腦神經認知及情感功能的好處

18609423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18609423.value: Dr Cheung, Sing Hang Prof Chiu, Ming Ming Dr Hsiao, Janet Hui Wen Miss Lam, Yeuk Ching Dr Wong, Mark Lawrence Mr Zhang, Jinxiao

18609423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18609423.value: Sleep restriction is common in modern societies, particularly among emerging adults. Previous studies have demonstrated both the consequences of inadequate sleep and the benefits of short-term sleep extension. However, little is known about the effects of sleep gain in neurocognitive-affective functions over a longer period, mimicking a more meaningful, ecologically-valid habit change. In this project we will implement a two-week (plus one-month follow-up), home-based, nighttime 90-minute sleep extension (SE) program including evidence-based motivational interviewing processes and habit-change strategies in 150 chronically/habitually sleep-restricted (=<5.5 hours nightly sleep) emerging adults and compare them with 75 randomized controls who only undergo sleep hygiene education (SH). The study protocol consists of four phases spanning 2 months: 1-week home-based baseline monitoring (pre-test), 1-week SH (sleep stabilization period), 2-week SE for the SE group only (post-test), and 1-month maintenance period (follow-up). We will apply ambulatory monitoring of sleep and a combination of in-lab and ambulatory neural and behavioral measures of neurocognitive and affective functions as follows: (a) at T1 (Day 1), demographics, baseline mood and sleep; (b) at T2 (Day 7, pre-test), experimental tasks of vigilance, working memory, planning, inhibitory control on emotional stimuli, emotional reactivity, and regulation (with EEG/ERP), followed by polysomnography at home; (c) at T2-4 (weeks 2-4), actigraphy, sleep diary, and daily experience sampling; (d) at T4 (end of week 4, post-test), repeat T2 assessments; (e) at T5 (end of week 5), follow-up online survey of mood and sleep, and feedback of participants on the feasibility and acceptability/usability of the program. With a 2x2 factorial design (pretest/posttest, SH/SE), we hypothesize that SE would: (i) lengthen sleep duration, improve sleep quality, lower subjective sleepiness, and heighten vigilance; (ii) augment neurocognitive functions; (iii) improve affective functions; (iv) enhance neurocognitive functions beyond heightened vigilance; and (v) improve affective functions beyond lowered subjective sleepiness. With a theory-based and evidence-based method, lengthened protocol and maintenance period, and a broad yet targeted scope of functions assessed using a multi-method approach, our findings will advance understanding of the effects of sleep on neurocognitive-affective functions. Methodologically, we will also pioneer the assessment of cognitive-affective functions via home-based ambulatory monitoring and conduct a meta-analytic factor analysis of the Pittsburgh Sleep Quality Index (PSQI), thereby equipping sleep scientists and practitioners with low-cost mobile tools and the most evidence-based way of characterizing sleep quality in our target population of emerging adults who are typically sleep-restricted and poor sleepers. 睡眠限制在現代社會中很常見，尤其是在年青人中。先前的研究已經証明了睡眠不足的後果以及短期睡眠延長的好處。然而，關於睡眠增加對腦神經認知和情感功能的長期影響，尤其是在實驗室以外的習慣改變的影響，我們所知甚少。在本項目中，我們將對150名慢性/習慣性睡眠不足（每晚睡眠時間≤5.5小時）的新興成年人實施爲期兩週的（加上一個月的後續觀察）家庭環境下的夜間90分鐘睡眠延長（SE）計劃，包括基於証據的動機訪談過程和習慣改變策略，並將其與75名僅接受睡眠衛生教育（SH）的隨機對照組進行比較。研究方案包括四個階段，曆時2個月：1週家庭基線監測（前測），1週SH（睡眠穩定期），2週SE僅適用於SE組（後測），以及1個月的維持期（後續觀察）。我們將應用睡眠的流動監測和腦神經認知和情感功能的實驗室內外結合的神經和行爲測量方法，並邀請參與者對該計劃的可行性和可接受性/可用性提供反饋。我們將測試以下研究假設：SE能夠（i）延長睡眠時間，改善睡眠質量，降低主觀睏倦感，提高警覺性；（ii）增強神經認知功能；（iii）改善情感功能；（iv）除了提高警覺性之外，還能增強神經認知功能；（v）除了降低主觀嗜睡感之外，還能改善情感功能。通過基於理論和實證的方法、延長的實驗方案和維持期、以及廣泛但有針對性的功能範圍的多方法測量方法，我們的研究結果將推進對睡眠對腦神經認知和情感功能的影響的理解。

18610223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18610223.value: “以學習為中心的社會公義領導”：一個關於學校領導力的全新概念

18610223.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18610223.value: Dr DeMatthews, David Prof Qian, Haiyan Dr Shaked, Haim Dr Tan, Cheng Yong

18610223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18610223.value: The literature provides compelling evidence that school leadership matters for improved student experiences and outcomes. It is evident that schools need an increased focus on planning, organising, and supervising curriculum and instruction, through leadership for learning, to ensure the learning of all students. At the same time, educational policymakers, researchers, and practitioners have a longstanding interest in improving the schooling experiences of disadvantaged and marginalised students, including students from low-socioeconomic status backgrounds, immigrant students, and students with special needs, etc. Accordingly, the concept of social justice leadership has become prominent in educational theory and research. The primary roles of social justice leaders in schools include eliminating social and cultural inequalities and promoting equity, equality, and fairness among diverse groups. This research aims to conceptualise a new leadership model called “social justice leadership for learning (SOLE)”, by combining social justice leadership and leadership for learning practices of school principals to better serve the diverse learning needs of disadvantaged students. More specifically, this study aims to (1) ascertain specific leadership for learning practices enriched by the social justice perspective in three participating jurisdictions (Hong Kong, China; Israel; and Texas, USA); (2) determine the role of contextual factors in the formation and implementation of such practices; and (3) develop and validate a social justice leadership for learning scale (SOLE-S) for each jurisdiction, as well as a common scale for future comparative studies. Phase 1 of the proposed project relies on qualitative data to further explore and enrich the relevant school leadership practices, which the research team has identified through a literature review, along with both school- and system-level contextual drivers and challenges. Phase 2 includes the development of survey items for use in a follow-up survey study to create validated measurement tools for SOLE. This phase will develop and validate common survey items across three jurisdictions and additional unique items based on each jurisdiction’s particular needs. 過往研究發現學校領導對提升學生的學習體驗和成果至關重要。為了使所有學生的學習有所保證，學校需要通過以學習為中心的學校領導，更加注重對於課程體系和教學的規劃、組織和監督。同時，教育政策制定者、研究者及實踐者長期以來也十分關注提升弱勢和邊緣化群體的學習經歷。這些弱勢群體包括了來自低社會經濟地位背景的學生、移民學生及有特殊教育需要的學生等等。因此，社會公義學校領導的概念在教育理論和研究中備受關注。社會公義學校領導者的首要角色包括消除社會文化不平等及促進不同群體間的公平和平等。本項研究旨在將社會公義領導和以學習為中心的領導實踐相結合，以構建一個新的學校領導力模型 — “以學習為中心的社會公義領導” （social justice leadership for learning, SOLE），從而更好地滿足弱勢學生群體多樣化的需求。本項研究有三個具體的目標。第一，確定在三個參與研究的地區（中國香港、以色列和美國得克薩斯州）中，透過社會公義領導視角下的以學習為中心的領導實踐；第二，確定在這些實踐形成和執行過程中背景因素的影響；第三，為每個參與地區制定並驗證一個“以學習為中心的社會公義領導”的量表，以及一個通用量表以方便日後的比較性研究。在本項目的第一階段，研究組將首先通過文獻綜述確定相關的學校領導實踐，進而通過收集定性數據進一步探索及豐富這些實踐以及其在學校層面和系統層面遇到的背景驅動因素和挑戰。第二階段將著重制定調查問卷的問題，並在隨後的調查研究中驗證“已學習為中心的社會公義領導”的測量工具。該階段將制定並驗證適用於三個地區的調查研究問題，及根據每個地區的特殊需要而增加的額外問題。
