18611423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
18611423.value: 一石三鳥？電子及非電子數字棋盤遊戲對幼兒、家長及親子關係的影響

18611423.label: Co - Investigator(s)
18611423.value: Prof Chung, Kevin Kien Hoa Dr Kwan, Lok Yin Joyce Prof McBride, Catherine

18611423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
18611423.value: 親子一起玩數字棋盤遊戲，可促進幼兒的數學能力及興趣。然而，當有關遊戲以電子化形式進行，仍否能帶來好處，至今尚未確定。此外，過往不少研究都忽略了家庭數學活動會否改變家長的數學指導能力及親子關係。有見及此，是次研究旨在比較傳統（非電子）及電子數字棋盤遊戲對兒童、家長及親子關係的影響。 是次研究會將320名家長及其幼兒隨機分配成四組，以進行為期六週的實驗。該四組分別爲：玩傳統數字棋盤遊戲、玩電子數字棋盤遊戲、玩黏土（作為積極對照），以及維持平常狀態（作為被動對照）。研究人員會在實驗開始前及完結後，分別評估兒童在數學方面的表現（包括數學能力和興趣）、家長的數學指導能力，以及親子關係，並比較各評估項目在四種情況下隨時間的變化。在實驗完結後三個月，研究人員亦會再次評估兒童的數學表現，以探究不同遊戲對兒童日後數學表現的影響，以及家長的數學指導能力、親子關係和兒童日後數學表現之間的關係。 是次研究的結果，不僅能增進我們對傳統和電子數字棋盤遊戲好處的理解，且能啟發家長如何創建更具刺激性的家庭學習環境，從而提高兒童短期和長遠的數學成就。

21203123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21203123.value: 複合材料應變率依賴力學性能的仿生結構設計：研究，原型設計，與力學建模

21203123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21203123.value: 航空航天、船舶和汽車等廣泛的現代工業領域都基於先進複合材料的開發；目前複合材料恒定載入速率下力學性能的提升可通過仿生結構設計而實現。 然而，考慮複合材料實際應用時承受變化的載入速率，一個重要但很少被認識到的思路是仿生結構設計以獲得優異的應變率變化時力學性能（應變率依賴/率相關力學行為）。複合材料的應變率依賴性主要被歸因於材料屬性，例如粘彈性和/或粘塑性，而結構設計的影響並不清楚，儘管有大量關於生物和工程複合材料的應變率影響力學行為的文獻（材料和其結構是固定的）。申請人的一個發現表明，具有相似角蛋白成分但不同結構的角質材料表現不同的應變率依賴性（鯨須與人發的應變率敏感性指數差異450%），這為前述思路開闢了新途徑。此外，我們的初步研究表明，對比已工程應用的纖維-基體結構，仿生管狀結構的應變率硬化高 10%，非彈性應變率強化高 42%，以及應變率韌化（按平均應變能密度）高 10%。 本專案提出如下科學假設：結構通過優化組分的空間分佈可協同提高複合材料應變率硬化和韌化並限制損傷引起的弱化。 為了回答（i）結構如何影響應變率依賴力學行為，（ii）提取哪些有效的仿生結構以提高應變率依賴力學性能，以及（iii）如何量化和評估結構引起的應變率依賴力學性能，我們將（1）通過研究角質材料將不同的應變率依賴力學性能與不同的結構相關聯，（2）通過原型設計以提取和測試有效影響應變率依賴力學性能的結構特徵，以及（3）通過力學建模和例證以形成新的理論。 通過完成本項目研究，我們將能夠為研發具有優異應變率硬化和韌化的複合材料形成一種仿生結構設計的新策略， 將給出在應變率硬化和韌化兩方面可能都優於傳統複合材料的新的仿生結構。 此外，本項目將建立一個新的本構模型，解出與結構相關的參數函數方程以量化應變率效應並解析結構影響應變率依賴力學性能的重要機制。

21206123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21206123.value: 涡轮叶片形状与气膜冷却联合优化设计

21206123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206123.value: 燃气轮机被广泛应用于发电和飞机推进。其效率可以通过增加涡轮机入口温度来提高。随着现代涡轮机技术的发展，涡轮机入口温度已远超叶片材料的熔点。涡轮叶片需要通过气膜冷却技术来保护。气膜冷却主要通过向叶片上的数百个冷却孔注入冷却气体以在叶片表面形成保护气膜。在传统的涡轮机设计中，叶片形状和气膜冷却系统是相互独立依序设计产生的。而最近的研究（特别是跨音速涡轮机的研究）表明冷却气体可以与主流相互作用并改变主流，这挑战了依序设计中冷却气流被动地附着在叶片表面而不干扰主流的的基本假设。因此，我们提出了同时优化叶片形状和气膜冷却的并行设计方案，这样可以实现全冷却涡轮叶片的全局优化。 并行优化全冷却涡轮机的挑战包括叶片参数化建模、网格自动生成和降低计算成本。 首先，基于 PI 之前的工作，我们将开发专门用于全冷却涡轮机的参数化系统和网格生成器，并将其作为免费软件发布。 其次，我们将使用新颖的高效算法，多尺度方法，通过在粗网格中添加有源项来以可承受的计算成本实现高保真气膜冷却模拟。 这些方法由优化器串联并实现自动优化。 如果我们提出的并行优化方案比依序优化方案具有更好的气动传热性能，我们将发现一种提高燃气轮机叶片效率并延长叶片寿命的新方向。 此外我们将通过流体力学物理分析来定量研究并行优化中获得额外增益的气动传热机理，并为未来的全冷却涡轮叶片提供设计指南。

21206223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21206223.value: 石英玻璃的亞百納米精度增材製造

21206223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21206223.value: 石英玻璃是人類文明中不可或缺的材料，它被廣泛應用於日常生活和科技領域，無論是摩天大樓上數米寬的幕牆還是傳輸海量資料的細如髮絲的光纖，都是現代資訊社會的基礎。由於石英玻璃的高熔點、高硬度和高易碎性，石英玻璃的製造和生產既不節能，也不符合成本效益。特別是當今矽玻璃的高科技應用，如微納米光子器件、微流控通道、離子阱量子計算晶片等，都涉及微米級甚至納米級製造精度的自上而下的製造工藝，存在複雜、成品率低、無法製造任意三維結構等諸多弊端。近年來，石英玻璃增材製造技術不斷發展，具有材料浪費少、靈活性強、精度高等特點，可以製造出傳統工藝無法製造的嵌入式結構和晶格結構。其中，精度最高的技術是本提案的首席科學家及其合作者去年發明的矽玻璃納米級增材制造技術，其最小特徵尺寸為 180 納米，開創性地實現了矽玻璃三維微型和納米器件的製造。然而，對於亞波長光學和納米流體等先進領域的某些應用來說，這種精度仍然不夠，因為這些領域非常需要數十納米或更小的可製造特徵。 在本提案中，我們提出了一種基於超解析度雙光子飛秒鐳射三維納米列印與單分散功能化二氧化矽納米複合前驅體相結合的新技術，以克服現有方法中存在的光學衍射限制。我們預期，通過克服儀器和材料限制，特徵尺寸和線對線解析度分別小於 100 納米和 200 納米的二氧化矽玻璃結構可被製造出來。我們還將通過對製造材料的結構和材料特性進行儀器表徵，評估和優化製造過程，以確認其為無孔透明石英玻璃。此外，我們還將通過引入快速光束掃描技術來最大限度地提高製造速度，並通過合作製造設備來證明所提議技術的可行性。這一目標的實現將創造出一種有效的技術，以極高的精度製造任意三維石英玻璃物體，並將惠及光學、電子學和生物醫學等領域的眾多先進應用。

21212123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21212123.value: 具有碳点的光合生物杂化物用于从废水中太阳能制氢

21212123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21212123.value: 气候风险和能源价格上涨迫使采用清洁能源技术 像太阳能燃料一样，以减少我们对化石燃料的依赖。太阳能产生的氢气 (H2) 是 无碳化石燃料替代品。传统的氢气生产通常需要清洁水，因为 原料。在成熟的氢经济中，这会给水部门带来压力，并增加 能源成本。为了应对这一挑战，使用废水作为氢原料是 被提议作为可持续的解决方案。耦合无机物的光子/电子特性 具有天然微生物（生物）代谢特性的材料（非生物）是一种新途径 生产太阳能燃料。迄今为止报道的生物杂交体与非光合细菌结合 例如大肠杆菌与 CdS、CdSe、AgInS2 量子点 (QD) 等稀土材料， 在阳光下产生光能电子，刺激氢气的产生 微生物。虽然这些研究很有希望，但该领域仍处于早期阶段（技术 准备程度：1-3），有几个挑战需要解决，即（1） 非生物-生物电荷传输缓慢以及缺乏对非生物-生物电荷传输机制的理解 生物/非生物界面 (2) 氢气产量低，以及 (3) 使用昂贵、有毒和稀土 混合物中的无机材料。 该项目旨在通过整合来开发和评估功能性生物杂交 具有地球丰富的光催化剂的电活性/光合微生物。高效的 从无机半导体到微生物酶的电荷传输需要能级对齐。之前的工作通过将各种量子点与微生物配对来构建生物杂交体， 但尚未对能带排列进行详细评估。我们建议碳基 量子点（CD）作为生物混合材料中的非生物光活性材料，可能是一种 地球储量丰富/低成本/无毒的传统镉基量子点替代品。我们的目标是 通过优化能级排列来增强非生物/生物电荷传输 通过化学掺杂设计量子点。微生物-光催化剂界面将是 通过光电导/开尔文探针原子力显微镜在单细胞水平上进行探测 扩大我们对非生物/生物界面的基本理解，铺平道路 用于改进的生物杂交。进一步到材料级工程，H2 产量也可以是 通过实用的设备设计增加。采用比生物杂交更成熟的微生物电化学装置的设计原理可以帮助设计 更高效的生物混合设备。虽然微生物电化学装置需要外部 电力运行，这是一个限制，该系统报告的氢气产量高达 8升/升/天。我们建议设计具有集成微生物电化学和光生物催化系统的串联结构原型，并评估其太阳能性能 从废水中生产氢气，无需外部电力输入

21215423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21215423.value: 毫米波超大規模MIMO無線網絡的近場通信

21215423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21215423.value: 最新的第五代（5G）無線網絡的部署極大地重塑了我們日常生活的方方面面，並為行業的先進發展注入了活力。高通公司預計，到2035年，5G將推動全球數字經濟的經濟價值增長13.2萬億美元。在如此巨大成功的鼓舞下，學術界和產業界都已開始描繪下一代6G無線網絡的藍圖。為了支持大量激動人心的應用，如萬物互聯（IoE）、大數據分析和增強現實（AR），6G預計將實現極高的數據傳輸速率、超寬頻段和海量連接。這些嚴格的要求需要革命性和變革性的無線技術。 30千兆赫至300千兆赫的毫米波通信就是這樣一種顛覆性的技術，因為它可以破解頻譜緊縮的危機，釋放出千兆赫的頻譜。同時，由於毫米波信號的波長大大縮短，可以在收發器上緊湊地部署數十萬個天線元件，這與新出現的超大規模MIMO概念不謀而合。然而，在毫米波頻段利用超大規模MIMO不僅僅是在數量上增加天線尺寸和載波頻率，更重要的是實現了從傳統遠場通信到近場通信傳輸範式上本質的轉變。特別是天線孔徑的擴大和波長的縮短共同擴大了近場區域，而這一區域在傳統無線通信中通常被忽視。因此，本項目將重點關注近場毫米波超大規模MIMO通信，預計這將是下一代6G系統的典型傳輸場景。 然而，通信模式的突然轉變帶來了嚴峻的挑戰，本項目將通過為近場毫米波超大規模MIMO系統開發新的物理層（PHY）和介質訪問控制層（MAC）技術來應對這些挑戰。首先，隨着信道維度變得越來越大，用於信道估計和波束賦形的信號處理的複雜性也越來越高。考慮到近場毫米波信道的獨特性和硬件限制，開發有效的算法尤為重要。其次，要實現無阻塞近場毫米波通信，最重要的是考慮到超大規模MIMO陣列的可見區域和智能反射面的部署策略，創建可擴展的用戶調度，並提供理論支持。最後，由於未來的無線網絡趨向於高度複雜和異構，將對實用的近場和遠場混合通信進行研究。將特別關注利用智能天線選擇方法實現多功能混合場毫米波超大規模MIMO系統。

21216223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21216223.value: 鎂合金中缺陷輔助析出以控制力學行為的研究

21216223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21216223.value: To respond to the rapid climate change and the increasing energy crisis, energy-efficient and high-strength lightweight materials are highly desirable in advanced technologies in transportation, propulsion, aerospace industries, etc. Magnesium alloys are promising metallic materials to supplant their aluminum and steel counterparts in structural applications due to their lower densities. Part of the reason for their limited applications is their relatively low strength. Precipitation of fine particles in a supersaturated matrix is a common method to strengthen materials and has achieved notable success in developing high-strength steel and aluminum alloys. In contrast, its improvement capacity for magnesium alloys appears inadequate using conventional aging treatment. Pre-existing crystal defects can alter the precipitation trajectory by modifying the nucleation and growth of particles, holding the potential for further improvement in strengthening magnesium alloys. Encouraging process engineering of defect-assisted precipitation to change mechanical performance has been reported in applied studies. However, the fundamental knowledge of how distinctive defects in magnesium manipulate the precipitation process to control mechanical behavior still needs to be discovered. In this proposed project, the PI aims to understand the role of two distinctive defects in magnesium, dislocation and twin boundary, on the precipitation process in representative magnesium alloys. The experimental studies will systematically compare the well-known defects, dislocation and ordinary grain boundary, to benchmark the effect on precipitation process. We will employ bulk and small-scale mechanical testing to analyze the strengthening effectiveness of defect-assisted precipitation. Meanwhile, state-of-the-art microstructure characterization will be performed to elucidate the defect-solute interaction and deformation mechanism after precipitation. The project is expected to offer key insights into controlling defect-assisted precipitation to develop magnesium alloys with superior mechanical properties. The scientific knowledge obtained in this project will also be instructive to other precipitation-hardenable metallic materials with the same crystal structure as magnesium. 為應對迅速變化的氣候和不斷加劇的能源危機，先進交通、推進和航空航天技術領域對能效高、強度優越的輕質材料有著迫切需求。在此背景下，鎂合金因其較低的密度被認為是可以替代鋁合金和鋼材在結構應用領域的有前景的金屬材料。然而，限制其廣泛應用的因素之一在於其相對較低的強度。在金屬材料力學性能增強領域，通過在過飽和基體中引發細微顆粒的析出，是一種常用的增強方法，並在高強度鋼材和鋁合金的研發中取得了顯著成就。然而，與此相對應的是，傳統時效處理方法在提升鎂合金強度方面的效果似乎並不理想。晶體缺陷可以通過改變析出顆粒的成核和生長路徑，從而影響析出過程，進而潛在地進一步提升鎂合金的強度。以缺陷為輔助的析出過程工程在力學性能調控方面已在實際研究中得到了一定的驗證。然而，關於鎂合金中特定缺陷如何操縱析出過程以實現對力學行為的控制，其基礎性認知尚有待深入挖掘。 在本拟議的研究項目中，主要研究者旨在探究鎂合金中兩種獨特缺陷，即位錯和孿晶界，在典型鎂合金的析出過程中的作用。為了評估這些缺陷對析出過程的影響，我們將進行系統比較，將更普遍的位錯和普通晶界引入研究，以設立基準。我們將運用大尺度和小尺度的力學測試手段，對缺陷輔助析出的強化效果進行深入分析。與此同時，我們還將運用先進的微觀結構表徵手段，以闡明析出後的缺陷-溶質相互作用關係以及變形機制。此項目預計將深化我們對於控制缺陷輔助析出過程的認識，從而開發出具備優越力學性能的鎂合金。從本項目中所獲得的科學認知也將對於其他與鎂具有相同晶體結構的可析出硬化金屬材料的研究提供有益的啟示。

21217223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21217223.value: 基于热响应快速动力干燥剂与仿生高通量换热器的低温干燥剂涂层除湿器

21217223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21217223.value: 21世纪初，极端热事件对人类社会的宝贵财富、环境和健康产生了负面影响。这些极端热事件与大气湿度的增加密切相关，这不仅降低了人体的热舒适度，导致严重的热应激，还降低了室内空气质量并导致卫生问题。因此，高效低碳的除湿对于舒适、健康和可持续的生活至关重要。在众多的除湿技术中，干燥剂涂层换热器（DCHE）因其分离感性和潜在负荷、有效去除吸附放热和提高传热效率而脱颖而出。但还需要解决三大挑战：(1)提高干燥剂的吸附能力以获得更高的水分摄取和吸附动力学以缩短周期；(2)降低干燥剂的再生温度以降低能量输入；(3)提高物质交换效率并降低泵功率以提高能效。因此，人们希望有一种新型的DCHE，具有高吸附容量和动力学、低再生温度、高热/物质传输效率和低泵功率。 为了实现这些目标，我们将热响应复合干燥剂（TCD）与仿生高通量换热器（HEXs）有机结合，实现高吸附和低温DCHEs，这在现有技术中尚未报道。协同作用通过以下方式实现：(1)由热响应聚合物网络和吸湿盐组成的TCD，由于快速的水分扩散和大的水存储容量，将展现出快速动力和高容量的水吸附，并由于干燥剂的亲水到疏水转换而自动释放水，从而实现低再生温度和低能量输入。 (2)仿生的三周期最小表面（TPMS）HEX将提供高干燥剂-湿气热/质量传递面积和容量以及低泵功率，这归功于其内在的缠绕而光滑的流道。具体地说，我们首先建立干燥剂吸附-解吸动力学模型，并进行吸附-解吸实验，以了解水-聚合物相互作用如何决定汽/液传输，确定水摄取和汽体吸附率的理论极限，并优化干燥剂尺寸和材料性质的合理设计。之后，我们将通过CFD方法优化TPMS HEXs的几何参数，准备TCD涂层的TPMS HEXs，并评估和优化其吸附和再生特性。最后，我们将使用开发的TCD涂层TPMS HEXs原型新的干燥剂热泵，并评估其在一个封闭房间中的除湿效率和节能性能。我们预期我们的数值工具和新型原型将为节能建筑除湿和空调系统提供巨大的潜力。

21219223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21219223.value: 面向移動端無線充電的非接觸式側信道漏洞研究：漏洞探索與防禦

21219223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21219223.value: Wireless charging is becoming pervasive on smartphones, with over one billion released smartphones in 2021 supporting it and a predicted market of 12 billion US dollars in 2022. Unfortunately, recent research found that users' actions on smartphones while wireless charging can be uncovered at a coarse granularity, e.g., typing keystrokes, if compromising the charger's cable and/or using professional devices to monitor its power traces on contact. Our preliminary findings show that the situation is much worse than what we know so far. When people play on their smartphones while wireless charging, even a common commodity device like a smartphone can eavesdrop on their actions at a distance and recognize them in fine-grained detail, e.g., a series of keystrokes is a particular bank account's password. The literature has not realized the privacy leakage of these contactless channels because recent works have not adequately investigated the fundamental physical principle of mobile wireless charging, i.e., electromagnetic induction, that creates these channels. It thus cannot capture sufficient characteristics to identify fine-grained privacy leakage and lacks systematic approaches to uncover and explore contactless side channels, leaving their threats and impacts largely unknown and their mitigation incomplete. In this proposal, we aim to accomplish two major tasks: (i) comprehensively uncover and explore contactless side channels on mobile wireless charging and (ii) investigate the corresponding mitigation. Specifically, we start by proposing a physical law-driven approach to uncover contactless side channels stemming from electromagnetic induction, which allows wireless charging. We will next develop a context-aware framework that identifies privacy leakage in finer detail and use it to establish the upper bound of these channels' threats. Then, we will design a fast adaptation-assisted system to examine their resilience against various impact factors to evaluate their practical threat impacts. Regarding mitigation, we will model contactless side channels on mobile wireless charging to investigate how privacy is leaked from this charging process. With this in-depth knowledge, we will explore a context-adaptive perturbation mechanism at the mobile OS level to proactively prevent privacy leakage from wireless channels established by smartphones. We will also design a reactive lazy-asynchronization strategy at the level of protocol to protect privacy leakage from contactless channels on the charger side. The outcomes of this project are expected to reveal severe privacy threats in wireless charging and present their practical impacts to raise public awareness, provide effective mitigation techniques, and push the scientific frontier of this field forward. 近年來，無線充電技術在智能手機上得到普及，有超過十億支2021年推出的手機援此技術，預計相關市場在2022年的規模將達到120億美元。然而，近期研究發現，通過修改硬件或使用專業設備獲取的充電數據線電流，可以在一定程度上還原用戶在無線充電時對智能手機的操作，如用戶輸入等。 我們的初步研究結果顯示，此情況遠比我們先前所認知的更為嚴重。當人們在無線充電時使用手機，即便是如智能手機一般的非專業設備，也能遠程竊聽並地識別細粒度的用戶輸入，例如，當前輸入是某特定銀行帳戶的密碼。因為近期的安全研究並未深入探討移動無線充電的基本的電磁感應的原理，這些非接觸式通道的隱私洩露問題目前尚未被仔細研究。同時由於缺乏系統性的研究方法，使得這樣非接觸式側通道可以洩露的隱私粒度及其威脅和影響尚未明確，其緩解策略亦不完善。 我們旨在本項目中完成兩項主要任務：(i) 全面揭示和探索移動無線充電的非接觸式側通道；及 (ii) 研究相應的緩解策略。我們將首先提出一種基於物理定律的方法，以揭示源於電磁感應的非接觸式側通道。接著，我們將開發一套上下文敏感的框架，以更細緻地識別隱私洩露並理解其粒度程度。然後，我們將設計一套快速適應輔助系統，以評估其對各種影響因子的韌性，從而知曉其在真實世界的影響。關於緩解策略，我們將對移動無線充電的非接觸式側通道進行建模，深入研究隱私如何從此充電過程中洩露。憑藉這些知識，我們將研發在操作系統層級的上下文適應性干擾機制，以主動防止由智能手機建立的無線通道的隱私洩露。我們還將設計一套在協議層級的反應式懶同步策略，以防止充電器端的隱私洩露。 此項目的成果將揭示無線充電中的嚴重隱私威脅，並呈現其實際影響，從而提高公眾的警覺性，同時提供有效的緩解技術，並推進此領域的相關安全研究。

21219323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21219323.value: 推荐算法歧视的可解释性与消除方法

21219323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21219323.value: 互联网的迅速发展，让个性化推荐系统在现代社会中扮演着越来越重要的角色，它可以减少信息/选择过载，满足用户的个性化需求，并增加服务/产品供应商的收入。尽管非常有价值，但是近些年个性化推荐系统也被诟病会产生严重的负面影响：针对不同用户或者不同物品，推荐算法产生不公平或有偏见的推荐结果，从而导致了诸如性别偏见或者种族歧视等严重的负面后果。虽然，现有工作已经在着手解决推荐算法产生的不公平及歧视问题，但是这些方法只致力于保证最终结果的公平性或者局限在分析和缓解推荐模型的偏见，而忽略了导致推荐结果不公平的原因。 因此，在个性化推荐算法公平性研究中，有三个亟需解决的问题：1）如何设计可解释的公平性度量，从模型输入特征分析导致不公平或偏见的原因；2）如何对含有耦合特征的输入进行建模，从而能更准确地衡量算法公平性；3）如何设计通用的解决方案来缓解推荐结果的准确性-公平性困境。 针对以上问题，本项目拟从三个方面开展：1）为推荐算法设计可解释的公平性度量，基于Shapley值构建推荐算法的可解释框架，用来解释哪些模型输入特征导致了推荐算法的不公平。2）对耦合输入特征进行因果建模，解决现实生活中输入特征复杂关联的问题，保证公平性度量的准确性。3）构建兼顾推荐准确性和公平性的算法框架，设计通用的、模型无关的多目标优化框架，同时优化推荐的准确性和公平性。 本项目还将借助工业界合作伙伴的平台和支持，建立用于分析推荐算法中不公平性的实用软件系统，提供有效的推荐准确性和公平性平衡技术，增强推荐系统的透明度和可解释性，推动推荐系统领域研究的科学前沿。

21300223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21300223.value: 隨機圖的譜和特徵向量

21300223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21300223.value: The goal of this project is to understand the distribution of eigenvalues and eigenvectors of large random graphs. Random graph theory is an important topic that lies at the intersection of probability theory and graph theory. It can be regarded as the statistical approach to spectral graph theory, and it is particularly efficient in answering questions about the properties of typical graphs. From the application point of view, random graphs serve as effective models in the study of complex networks. We normally study a random graph through its adjacency matrix, which is simply a matrix whose entries are random variables, and thus, a random matrix. Random matrix theory (RMT) is a very active area of mathematics, whose origins lie in the work of Wigner in the fifties. A central topic in RMT is to study the behaviour of the individual eigenvalues, which we regard as "the microscopic eigenvalue statistics". The famous universality conjecture of random matrices asserts that the microscopic eigenvalue statistics depend only on the symmetry class of the matrix, instead of the law of the matrix elements. By the powerful three-step approach developed during the last decade, the universality conjecture has been established in great generality for the model of Wigner matrices. Unlike Wigner matrices, many important problems concerning random graphs are still unsolved, as the techniques and methods used for Winger matrices are often insufficient in the random graph setting. Regarding this issue, lots of new ideas have emerged in the last few years, which led to a number of promising results. In this project, we plan to continue generating new approaches, in the hope of answering important open questions concerning random graph models. In particular, we will study the spectral statistics of Erdős–Rényi graphs and random regular graphs. These are the two central random graph models and are of prominent interest. Our aim is to develop a systematic scheme to deeply promote the understanding of the universality phenomenon in random graphs. This project will enhance our knowledge of random graphs and random networks, thus making impacts on both mathematics and computer science. 本項目的目標是了解大型隨機圖的特徵值和特徵向量的分布。隨機圖是概率論中的一個重要課題，也是研究複雜網絡的一個有效模型。隨機圖的鄰接矩陣只不過是一個矩陣，其條目是取二進制值的隨機變量，因此是一個隨機矩陣。 隨機矩陣理論（RMT）是一個非常活躍的數學領域，起源於五十年代維格納（Wigner）的研究。隨機矩陣理論的一個核心課題是研究單個特徵值的行為，我們稱之為 "微觀特徵值統計"。著名的隨機矩陣普遍性猜想認為，微觀特徵值統計只取決於矩陣的對稱類，而不是矩陣元素的規律。通過過去十年中開發的強大的三步法，普遍性猜想在很大程度上適用於維格納矩陣。 與維格納矩陣不同，與隨機圖有關的許多重要問題仍未解決，因為用於維格納矩陣的技術和方法在隨機圖環境中往往不夠充分。關於這個問題，過去幾年中出現了很多新想法，並取得了許多有希望的成果。在本項目中，我們計劃繼續提出新方法，希望能回答有關隨機圖模型的重要開放問題。我們將研究 Erd ̋os-R ́enyi 圖和隨機正則圖的譜統計。這是兩個最簡單的隨機圖模型，也是人們最感興趣的模型。我們的目標是開發一種系統方案，深入促進對隨機圖中普遍性現象的理解。本項目將增進我們對隨機圖和隨機網絡的認識，從而對數學和計算機科學產生影響。

21300323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21300323.value: 一氧化碳高效電還原制備高濃度多碳醇

21303323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21303323.value: 控制錯誤發現率的變量選擇統計學方法及在人類基因數據中的應用

21303323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21303323.value: Variable selection, also known as feature selection, is at the heart of many scientific problems. An example of the problem is the identification of genetic variants that influence disease risk from among the millions of variants in the human genome. The proposed project will develop statistical methods that allow simultaneous analyses of all variables with the guarantee that a large proportion of the selected variables truly influence the outcome. The ability to correctly distinguish important variables from a large number of non-important ones will enhance knowledge and interpretability in many subject matter areas and allow effective interventions. For example, discovering which genetic variants are associated with a disease will aid development of personalized genetic treatments with higher success rates for patients with these variants and build disease prediction models with higher accuracy. The statistical methods developed in this project will contribute to the field of statistics and data science with powerful tools that aim to extract influential variables from high-dimensional datasets containing a very large number of variables. Variable selection is particularly challenging in genetic studies due to the complex correlation structure among genetic variants, where causal variants are often correlated with adjacent non-causal variants. This makes it difficult to distinguish causal variants from non-causal ones and often leads to false discoveries, where non-causal variants are incorrectly identified as causal variants. The proposed methods build upon the knockoff framework, a recently developed statistical method that provides statistical guarantees on the false discovery rate in the presence of complex correlations and facilitates interpretability and reproducibility of results. The proposed methods will be applied to multiple large-scale human genetic datasets with the goal of obtaining a more comprehensive understanding of how genetic variants influence disease risk. 變量選擇，也稱為特征選擇，是許多科學問題的核心。例如，我們所關心的一個科學問題是如何從人類基因組的數百萬個遺傳變異中識別影響疾病風險的致病遺傳變異。本項目所提出的統計學方法將允許對所有的變量同時進行分析和選擇，並確保所選擇的大部分變量能夠真正地影響結果。在大量非重要變量中準確地識別重要變量，將增進許多學科領域的知識和解釋能力，並實現有效的幹預。例如，識別與疾病相關的遺傳變異將有助於發展個性化的基因治療方案，提高攜帶這些遺傳變異的患者的治療成功率，並建立更準確的疾病預測模型。 本項目所提出的統計學方法將提供一個強大的統計學工具，旨在從包含海量變量的高維數據集中識別具有影響力的變量，為統計學和數據科學領域做出貢獻。變量選擇在基因研究中尤其具備挑戰性，因為遺傳變異之間存在復雜的相關結構，同時致病變異通常與相鄰的非致病變異相關。這使得區分致病和非致病變異變得非常困難，並常常導致錯誤發現，即將非致病變異錯誤地識別為致病變異。本項目所提出的統計學方法建立在前沿的仿制變量框架之上，可以在變量間存在復雜的相關結構的情況下有效地控制錯誤發現率，並提高結果的解釋性和可重復性。本項目所提出的統計學方法將應用於多個大規模的人類基因組數據集，以更全面地理解遺傳變異如何影響疾病風險。

21304023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21304023.value: 低維拓撲材料中散射激子態的ARPES研究

21304023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21304023.value: Traditional electronic devices that transfer information are based on electrical charges, which can be easily disturbed by environmental factors. In contrast, excitons, i.e., electron-hole pairs, are mobile and neutral in charge and are thus potentially superior information transmitters. Excitons in semiconductors are common and widely studied through optical methods. However, in metals, the screening effect by free electrons usually prevents the formation of excitons or allows them to appear only transiently. As optical methods cannot provide momentum information, angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy studies of excitons have gained interest in recent years since they can provide direct insight into momentum space. Recently, we discovered with angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy that robust dispersive (highly mobile) excitons can exist in quasi-one-dimensional metallic TaSe3 with nontrivial band topology, in which the internal crystal structures resemble parallel straight stripes. Another important recent development is the prediction and discovery of topological materials, which have unique electronic structures. Detecting and manipulating topological materials is important, as their physical properties have potential in future practical electronic applications. Thus, excitons in topological materials have wide-ranging applications, such as next-generation electronic devices for digital information transfer and photoelectric information conversion. In this proposed project, we aim to detect, analyze, and manipulate dispersive excitons in low-dimensional topological materials with angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy, as the low-dimensionality is favorable for directional transmission, and can enhance the robustness of excitons. Traditional excitons in semiconductors usually have small group velocities, limiting their mobility during transmission. However, dispersive excitons with finite velocity will increase the exciton mobility and information-transferring efficiency. We will first focus on manipulating the dispersive excitonic states in TaSe3. We will then search for new robust dispersive excitonic states in low-dimensional topological metals such as in the RNiC2 (where R is a rare earth element) family to confirm whether the presence of the dispersive excitons is universal. By the completion of this project, we expect to have detected and manipulated dispersive excitons in TaSe3 and RNiC2 and to have a clearer understanding of the properties of the mobile excitons. In addition to providing an update for the condensed matter physics research community, our findings will have future benefits in electronic device applications for high-technology startup firms, which may create more employment opportunities for society. 傳統的電子設備是基於電荷的，而電荷很容易受到環境因素的干擾。相比之下，激子，即電子-空穴對，是移動的且有電荷中性，因此可能是更優秀的信息傳輸者。半導體中的激子是常見的，並通過光學方法被廣泛研究。然而，在金屬中，自由電子的屏蔽效應通常會阻止激子的形成，或者只允許它們短暫地出現。由於光學方法無法提供動量信息，因此近年來，激子的角分辨光電子能譜學研究引起了人們的興趣，因為它們可以直接提供動量空間信息。最近，我們發現，在一維准金屬TaSe3中，具有非平庸帶拓撲性質的強色散（高度移動）激子可以存在，其中內部晶體結構類似於平行直條紋。凝聚态物理前沿中另一個重要的进展是預測和实验發現的拓撲材料，它們具有獨特的電子結構。檢測和操作拓撲材料很重要，因為它們的物理特性在未來實際的電子應用中具有潛力。因此，拓撲材料中的激子具有廣泛的應用，例如用於數字信息傳輸和光電信息轉換等下一代電子設備。 在這個提議的項目中，我們旨在使用角分辨光電子能譜學來檢測、分析和操作低維拓撲材料中的色散激子，因為低維度有利於定向傳輸，並且可以增強激子的穩定性。在半導體中，傳統的激子通常具有較小的群速度，限制了它們在傳輸過程中的移動性。然而，具有有限速度的色散激子將增加激子的移動性和信息傳輸效率。我們首先將專注於操作TaSe3中的色散激子態。然後，我們將尋找新的強色散激子態，這些態存在於低維拓撲金屬中，例如在RNiC2（其中R是一種稀土元素）家族中，以確認色散激子的存在是否普遍。通過完成這個項目，我們期望能夠在TaSe3和RNiC2中檢測並操控色散激子，並對移動激子的性質有更清晰的理解。除了為凝聚態物理研究界提供新见解，我們的發現將對高科技初創企業的電子設備應用帶來未來的益處，這可能為社會創造更多的就業機會。

21307223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21307223.value: 多連續體多尺度模型降階及其應用

21307223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21307223.value: Mathematical models in various applications often involve coupling the physical phenomena in different scales. In many cases, we are only interested in the macroscopic property of the model. For example, in weather forecast models or oil reservoir simulations, instead of taking care of the complex flow model on the microscopic scale, we want to simulate the target physical quantities on a large scale only. However, the small-scale features of the model can have a significant influence on the macroscopic solution. Therefore, it is important to have a systemic methodology to connect the macroscopic model with the microscopic model. For many homogenization-type upscaling models, the agent-based model is represented by a continuum model with a single state variable, or the dimension of the macroscopic state space is less than or equal to the dimension of the microscopic state space. Namely, the macroscopic system can be described by using fewer physical quantities. However, due to the complexity of the model, in some applications, we may need more macroscopic state functions to capture the properties of the model. In this proposal, we will focus on developing an upscaled multi-continuum multiscale model. That is, instead of having a “one-to-one” relation between the microscopic and the macroscopic quantities, we will consider the model with multiple essential averaging quantities. We will develop a multi-continuum model reduction technique with a detailed analysis to obtain a systematic and robust upscaling method. The proposed upscaling method involves defining the macroscopic continua to represent the essential quantities of the model and solving a local problem for each continuum in an oversampling domain to obtain a nonlocal upscaled operator which captures the macroscopic feature of the model. We will analyze the convergence of the upscaled operator and obtain an asymptotic local upscaled model under some assumptions. To verify the reliability of the proposed upscaling method, we will compare our model to some existing models for classical multiscale problems. In addition, we will apply the proposed method to some realistic models in different applications. These models sometimes involve complex nonlinear physical phenomena in an irregular domain. Therefore, we will also extend our upscaling method to nonlinear problems and study an upscaled model to handle irregular boundaries. For the complex models not being applicable to the upscaling method in the whole domain, we will consider the hybrid model which couple the macroscopic multi-continuum model with the microscopic model by introducing an interface condition. 各種應用中的數學模型通常涉及不同尺度的物理現象的耦合。 在許多情況下，我們只對模型的宏觀屬性感興趣。 例如，在天氣預報模型或油藏模擬中，我們不想考慮微觀尺度上的複雜流動模型，而只想在大尺度上模擬目標物理量。 然而，模型的小尺度特徵會對宏觀解決方案產生重大影響。 因此，有一個系統的方法來連接宏觀模型和微觀模型是很重要的。 對於許多同質化型升尺度模型，基於主體的模型由具有單個狀態變量的連續體模型來表示，或者宏觀狀態空間的維數小於或等於微觀狀態空間的維數。 即可以用較少的物理量來描述宏觀系統。 然而，由於模型的複雜性，在某些應用中，我們可能需要更宏觀的狀態函數來捕獲模型的屬性。 在本提案中，我們將重點關注開發升尺度多連續體多尺度模型。 也就是說，我們將考慮具有多個基本宏觀量的模型，而不是微觀量和宏觀量之間的一對一關係。 我們將開發一種多連續體模型降階技術，並進行詳細分析，以獲得系統且穩健的升尺度方法。 所提出的升尺度方法涉及定義宏觀連續體來表示模型的基本量，並解決過採樣域中每個連續體的局部問題，以獲得一個捕獲模型宏觀特徵的非局部升尺度算子。 我們將分析升尺度算子的收斂性，並在某些假設下獲得漸近局部升尺度模型。 為了驗證所提出的升尺度方法的可靠性，我們將我們的模型與經典多尺度問題的一些現有模型進行比較。 此外，我們會將所提出的方法應用於不同應用中的一些現實模型。 這些模型有時涉及不規則域中的複雜非線性物理現象。 因此，我們還將把我們的升尺度方法擴展到非線性問題，並研究處理不規則邊界的升尺度模型。 對於不適用於全域升尺度方法的複雜模型，我們將考慮混合模型，通過引入界面條件將宏觀多連續體模型與微觀模型耦合起來。

21308523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21308523.value: 用於酸性水電解的無貴金屬錳/鈷基析氧催化劑：原位研究，動態重構調製，和電解池測試

21308523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21308523.value: For the mass adoption of proton exchange membrane water electrolysis (PEMWE) to produce green hydrogen, it is vital to replace noble metal catalysts of scarce reserves with non-precious metal alternatives. The acidic environment in PEMWE accelerates the degradation of common noble metal-free oxides (NMFOs) during the oxygen evolution reaction (OER), particularly under harsh conditions (e.g., low pH, large current densities, and elevated temperatures), partially changing the original compositions/structures of NMFOs. This dynamic catalyst reconstruction process governs the evolution of catalytically active species and further determines the OER activity and stability. Therefore, to design highly-active and stable NMFOs for acidic OER, modulating their dynamic reconstruction is critical. Despite previous efforts, it remains tremendously challenging to overcome the activity-stability trade-off and improve both the acidic OER activity and stability of NMFOs. Moreover, the practical performance of newly-designed NFMOs should be assessed in PEMWE cells, as driving high-performance PEMWE with NMFOs has rarely been reported to date. Therefore, this project proposes to develop Mn/Co-based NFMOs as highly-active and stable electrocatalysts for the acidic OER. Mn oxides (MnOx) and Co oxides (CoOx) of different valences/structures are selected as the parent materials owing to their potentially high corrosion resistance and favorable binding with OER intermediates, respectively. First, we will assess their electrochemical characteristics (activity, stable potential window, and durability period) under various acidic OER conditions (overpotential, electrolyte pH, and temperature) and clarify the corresponding dynamic catalyst reconstructions using multiple operando characterizations. Second, we will engineer the electronic configurations of MnOx and CoOx (e.g., by the heterointerface and/or doping) to modulate their dynamic reconstruction and enhance both the acidic OER activity and stability. Our preliminary results demonstrate that the hybridized β-MnO2@Co3O4 delivers a comparable OER activity to RuO2 and better stability at 25 °C in 0.5M H2SO4, which motivates us to elucidate the modulation principle and further enhance the performance in even harsher OER conditions. Operando characterizations and density functional theory calculations will be combined to clarify the mechanism underlying the modulated catalyst reconstruction and improved performance. Third, the practical performance of the developed Mn/Co oxides as anode catalysts in PEMWE cells will be examined and optimized. We aim to develop Mn/Co-based NFMO catalysts that provide a PEMWE cell performance comparable to or even better than that of noble metal OER catalysts. By elucidating and regulating dynamic reconstruction, clarifying mechanisms, and developing high-performance electrocatalysts, this project will advance PEMWE technology for green hydrogen generation. 為了大規模採用質子交換膜電解水（PEMWE）生產綠色氫氣，用非貴金屬取代稀缺的貴金屬催化劑至關重要。 PEMWE中的酸性環境加速了常見的無貴金屬氧化物（NMFO）在析氧反應（OER）過程中的腐蝕溶解，特別是在惡劣條件下（例如低pH、大電流密度和高溫），部分改變了NMFO的原始組成/結構。這種動態催化劑重構過程控制著催化活性物質的演化，並進一步決定了 OER 活性和穩定性。因此，為了設計用於酸性 OER 的高活性和穩定的 NMFO，調節其動態重構至關重要。儘管之前做出了努力，但克服活性與穩定性之間的權衡並提高 NMFO 的酸性 OER 活性和穩定性仍然具有巨大的挑戰性。此外，新設計的 NFMO 的實際性能應該在 PEMWE 電池中進行評估，而迄今為止用 NMFO 驅動高性能 PEMWE 的報導很少。 本項目擬開發Mn/Co基NFMO作為酸性OER的高活性和穩定的電催化劑。不同價態/結構的錳氧化物 (MnOx) 和鈷氧化物 (CoOx) 因其潛在的高耐腐蝕性和與 OER 中間體的良好結合而被選擇作為母體材料。首先，我們將評估它們在不同酸性 OER 條件（過電位、電解質 pH 和溫度）下的電化學特性（活性、穩定電位窗口和耐久性），並使用多種原位表徵闡明相應的動態催化劑重構。其次，我們將設計 MnOx 和 CoOx 的電子構型（例如，通過異質界面和/或摻雜）來調節它們的動態重構並增強酸性 OER 活性和穩定性。我們的初步結果表明，雜化的 β-MnO2@Co3O4 具有與 RuO2 相當的 OER 活性，但在 25 °C 在 0.5M H2SO4 中具有優異的穩定性，這激勵我們闡明調製原理並進一步提高在更惡劣的 OER 條件下的性能。原位表徵和密度泛函理論計算將結合起來，以闡明調製催化劑重構和改進性能的潛在機制。第三，將檢驗和優化所開發的錳/鈷氧化物作為 PEMWE 電池陽極催化劑的實際性能。該項目旨在開發錳/鈷基 NFMO，其 PEMWE 電池性能可與基於貴金屬 OER 催化劑的 PEMWE 電池相媲美甚至優於其性能。通過闡明和調控動態重構、闡明機制和開發高性能電催化劑，該項目將推進綠色制氫的PEMWE技術。

21500423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21500423.value: 贏得人才戰爭的披露策略: 證據LinkedIn

21500423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21500423.value: Modern firms are competing to attract and retain qualified talent, which is cited as the most important concern of chief financial officers (Duke University 2021). As skilled labor is crucial for firm success, and high employee turnover is costly, firms are likely to use financial reporting and voluntary disclosure strategically to prevent employee turnover. However, we know little about how workers respond to their employers’ financial disclosures. In this proposal, I plan to explore novel data based on the individual online résumés of public company employees in order to investigate the effects of financial reporting and disclosure policies on labor market decisions. As a limited number of firms disclose information about their labor costs in their traditional accounting disclosures, I take a different approach by using micro-level data on individual employment and characteristics obtained from employees’ online profiles. The rise of online job platforms, such as LinkedIn, allows me to explore a broad population with detailed employment histories, education, demographic backgrounds, skill sets, and specialties. I predict that, first, firms meeting or beating earnings benchmarks (MBE) and engaging in upward earnings management can increase employee retention by maximizing employees’ expectations about their firms’ future performance. Second, firms providing voluntary earnings forecasts, particularly good news forecasts, can retain their workforce better. Also, firms withholding bad news disclosures could prevent employees from leaving the firms by controlling these employees’ future prospects. I expect that the effects of these disclosure strategies are stronger for experienced and specialized employees in accounting and technology because they can better incorporate public accounting information into their labor decisions. However, employee turnover would be less sensitive to accounting disclosure when workers’ outside employment opportunities are restricted after the covenant not to compete became more enforceable. I plan to corroborate the causal inference using Section 404 of the Sarbanes–Oxley Act as a quasi-natural experiment that improves financial reporting quality, as well as using Regulation Fair Disclosure as an exogenous shock to voluntary disclosure. This proposal responds to the critical question raised by Bartov, Givoly, and Hayn (2002) about why MBE firms perform better. Using rich data on individual labor market decisions, I suggest that improved employee retention makes MBE firms outperform firms that fall short of MBE. This study also sheds light on the best voluntary disclosure strategies that firms can use to win the competition for talent, leading to better future performance. 現代企業正在競相吸引和留住合格人才,這被認為是首席財務官最關心的問題(杜克大學，2021）。由於熟練勞動力對於公司的成功至關重要，而員工流動率高的成本高昂，因此公司可能會戰略性地使用財務報告和自願披露來防止員工流動。然而,我們對工人如何回應雇主的財務披露知之甚少。在本提案中,我計劃探索基於上市公司員工個人在線簡歷的新數據,以調查財務報告和披露政策對勞動力市場決策的影響。 由於少數公司在傳統會計披露中披露有關勞動力成本的信息, 因此我採取了不同的方法, 使用從員工在線資料中獲得的個人就業和特徵的微觀數據。LinkedIn 等在線求職平台的興起使我能夠探索具有詳細就業歷史,教育,人口背景,技能和專業的廣泛人群。 我預測, 首先, 達到或超過盈利基準(MBE) 並進行向上盈餘管理的公司可以通過最大限度地提高員工對公司未來業績的期望來提高員工保留率。其次, 提供自願盈利預測 (尤其是好消息預測)的公司可以更好地留住員工。此外, 不披露壞消息的公司可以通過控制員工的未來前景來阻止員工離開公司。 我預計這些披露策略對於會計和技術領域經驗豐富且專業的員工來說效果會更強，因為他們可以更好地將公共會計信息納入其勞動決策中。然而,在不競爭契約變得更加可執行之後,當工人的外部就業機會受到限制時,員工流動率對會計披露的敏感度就會降低。我計劃使用《薩班斯-奧克斯利法案》第 404 條作為提高財務報告質量的準自然實驗,並使用《公平披露條例》作為對自願披露的外生衝擊來證實因果推論。 該提案回應了 Bartov, Givoly 和 Hayn (2002) 提出的關於為什麼 MBE 公司表現更好的關鍵問題。利用有關個人勞動力市場決策的豐富數據，我認為，員工保留率的提高使得 MBE 公司的表現優於那些達不到 MBE 的公司。這項研究還揭示了企業可以用來保留員工的最佳自願披露策略,從而實現更好的未來績效。

21501623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21501623.value: 数字经济中当地新闻媒体的接触和态度

21501623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21501623.value: There have been significant changes in the provision of news during the past two decades. The rapid spread of digital online media has diminished the relative importance of traditional news providers such as newspapers, television, and radio. The purpose of this project is to study how access to and attitudes towards the media shape engagement with local news in the digital economy. Our empirical analysis is based on a new and comprehensive survey of households in the U.S. which was conducted in 2018. The survey data suggest that there are large racial and ethnic gaps in access to digital media and engagement with local news. Blacks and Hispanics are less engaged with digital online media than Whites. However, they are much more engaged with local news. To understand the causes of these differences, we consider a differentiated product model to capture provider choices, time allocations among the providers, and exposure to local news topics. We show that the parameters of the model are identified and can be estimated using maximum likelihood and the detailed survey data that is available to us. Once we have estimated the model, we study changes in engagement with local news media as we equalize the differences in education, income, attitudes, neighborhood quality, and provider choices among black and white households. 过去二十年来，新闻的提供方式发生了重大变化。 数字在线媒体的快速传播削弱了报纸、电视和广播等传统新闻提供商的相对重要性。 该项目的目的是研究对媒体的接触和态度如何影响数字经济中当地新闻的参与。 我们的实证分析基于 2018 年对美国家庭进行的一项新的全面调查。调查数据表明，在使用数字媒体和参与当地新闻方面存在巨大的种族和民族差距。 黑人和西班牙裔美国人对数字在线媒体的参与程度低于白人。 然而，他们更关注当地新闻。 为了了解这些差异的原因，我们考虑采用差异化的产品模型来捕获提供商的选择、提供商之间的时间分配以及对当地新闻主题的曝光。 我们表明，模型的参数已被识别，并且可以使用最大似然和我们可用的详细调查数据进行估计。 一旦我们估计了模型，我们就会研究与当地新闻媒体接触的变化，因为我们平衡了黑人和白人家庭在教育、收入、态度、社区质量和提供者选择方面的差异。

21503323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21503323.value: Not all market practitioners hold the same beliefs about the future: some are optimistic and some pessimistic. While it might, for instance, come from the fact that they have access to different information, the resulting heterogeneity in investor beliefs significantly impacts financial markets. These heterogeneous beliefs, which can be described in terms of statistical moments of the investor belief distribution, are well studied in the academic literature, and numerous works investigate how they affect stock returns, volatility, and trading volume. Among the main moments of investor belief heterogeneity–mean, standard deviation, and skewness–, most studies to date have focused on the second of these, which provides a measure of dispersion. However, despite its importance, belief dispersion does not capture all relevant information on belief heterogeneity that market practitioners could exploit. In particular, there is a lack of knowledge about the impact of the asymmetry of investor beliefs. This feature is captured by the third moment of the belief distribution: skewness. More precisely, in the context of belief heterogeneity, a positive skewness means that few investors have very optimistic views on a stock’s expected future cashflows, whereas most have slightly pessimistic views. A negative skewness means the opposite is true. Because these two situations differ greatly but can still exhibit identical belief dispersion, it is most likely that considering belief skewness has important asset pricing implications. Empirically, data further shows that investor beliefs display time-varying skewness, which further highlights the importance of studying this additional component of heterogeneous beliefs. This project aims to fill this knowledge gap by theoretically and empirically examining the impact of belief skewness on stock returns, volatility, and trading volume. It also aims to assess how this impact interacts with the impact of the first and second moments of the investor belief distribution. To do so, I will develop a general equilibrium model that incorporates a skewed distribution of investor beliefs, derive its implications on the stock characteristics, and test the model using empirical data. My findings will have significant implications. First, I will provide a comprehensive understanding of the impact of belief skewness, thereby increasing academic knowledge of how financial markets work. Second, the findings will help market practitioners better understand the impact of belief heterogeneity so that they can adapt their investment portfolios and trading strategies to achieve better financial performances. 並非所有市場從業者對未來都持有相同的信念：有些人樂觀，有些人悲觀。例如，雖然這可能來自於他們可以獲得不同的信息，但由此產生的投資者信念的異質性會對金融市場產生重大影響。這些異質信念可以用投資者信念分佈的統計矩來描述，學術文獻對此進行了深入研究，並且許多著作研究了它們如何影響股票回報、波動性和交易量。在投資者信念異質性的主要方面——均值、標準差和偏度——中，迄今為止大多數研究都集中在第二個方面，它提供了分散度的衡量標準。然而，儘管信念分散很重要，但它並沒有捕獲市場從業者可以利用的關於信念異質性的所有相關信息。 特別是，人們對投資者信念不對稱的影響缺乏了解。這個特徵可以通過置信分佈的三階矩來體現：偏度。更準確地說，在信念異質性的背景下，正偏度意味著很少有投資者對股票的預期未來現金流持非常樂觀的看法，而大多數投資者則持略微悲觀的看法。負偏度意味著相反的情況成立。由於這兩種情況差異很大，但仍然可以表現出相同的信念離散度，因此考慮信念偏度很可能具有重要的資產定價影響。從經驗來看，數據進一步表明，投資者信念表現出隨時間變化的偏度，這進一步凸顯了研究異質信念的這一附加組成部分的重要性。 該項目旨在通過理論和實證研究信念偏度對股票回報、波動性和交易量的影響來填補這一知識空白。它還旨在評估這種影響如何與投資者信念分佈的第一和第二時刻的影響相互作用。為此，我將開發一個一般均衡模型，其中包含投資者信念的偏態分佈，得出其對股票特徵的影響，並使用經驗數據測試該模型。 我的發現將產生重大影響。首先，我將全面了解信念偏度的影響，從而增加有關金融市場運作方式的學術知識。其次，研究結果將幫助市場從業者更好地理解信念異質性的影響，以便他們能夠調整投資組合和交易策略，以實現更好的財務業績。

21503523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21503523.value: 中美贸易紧张局势对中国出口和就业的影响

21503523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21503523.value: Trade tensions between China and the U.S. have escalated since the trade war began in 2018, and there is no evidence they are easing. There are two key aspects to the escalation in trade tensions: increases in bilateral trade barriers and increases in trade policy uncertainty. Much research on the trade war has investigated either the effects of trade barriers, especially tariff barriers, or the effects of policy uncertainty. So far, few papers have quantified both aspects within a unified framework. Hence, the combined effects of the two aspects remain uncertain, and the relative importance of each aspect remains unclear. The first aim of this proposed project is to fill this knowledge gap by developing and calibrating a dynamic general equilibrium model of international trade with heterogeneous firms and stochastic trade policies to interpret and quantify the effects of increased trade barriers and increased policy uncertainty on exports from China and employment within China. In addition to integrating of trade barriers and trade policy uncertainty, another major innovation of the proposed framework is that it allows for the existence of labor adjustment frictions across firms, which is often missing from existing workhorse models of international trade. It is important to consider such frictions for exports and employment. Recent research co-authored by the Principal Investigator has shown that labor adjustment costs affect export dynamics of Chinese manufacturing firms significantly, implying that trade tensions can directly affect firms’ labor decisions, which in turn affects export decisions. Therefore, without taking into account labor adjustment costs, the impact of trade tensions on export and employment will be underestimated. The second aim of this proposed project is to quantify the role of labor adjustment costs in the impact of trade tensions on exports and employment and evaluate the effect of potential labor market deregulation policies in mitigating the impact of trade tensions. This project will have substantial implications. First, it will improve understanding of the short- and long-term impacts of the trade war on China’s economy and particularly on exports and employment. Second, it will improve understanding of the interactions between exports and labor inputs, thereby enabling the government to implement more efficient trade or labor market policies to mitigate trade war effects. For example, if this study reveals that labor adjustment frictions significantly amplify the effect of the trade war, the government could implement relevant deregulation policies to decrease labor market frictions. 自2018年贸易战开始以来，中美之间的贸易紧张关系已经升级，而且没有证据显示这种紧张关系正在缓解。贸易紧张升级有两个关键方面：双边贸易壁垒的增加和贸易政策不确定性的增加。大量文献已经分别研究了贸易壁垒，特别是关税壁垒，或政策不确定性的影响。到目前为止，很少有论文在统一的框架内量化了这两个方面。因此，这两个方面的联合影响仍然不确定，每个方面的相对重要性仍然不清楚。本项目的第一个目标是通过发展和校准一个包含异质公司和随机贸易政策的国际贸易的动态一般均衡模型，来填补这个知识缺口，解释和量化增加贸易壁垒和增加政策不确定性对中国的出口和中国的就业的影响。 除了整合贸易壁垒和贸易政策不确定性之外，这个项目的框架的另一个主要创新是，它允许存在跨公司的劳动力调整摩擦，这在现有的国际贸易模型中往往被忽略或简化。最近由主要研究者共同撰写的研究已经表明，劳动力调整成本显著影响中国制造业公司的出口动态，这意味着贸易紧张可以直接影响公司的劳动力决策，从而影响出口决策。因此，如果不考虑劳动力调整成本，贸易紧张关系对出口和就业的影响将被低估。本项目的第二个目标是量化劳动力调整成本在贸易紧张对出口和就业影响中的作用，并评估可能的劳动市场放松政策对缓解贸易紧张影响的效果。 此项目的意义：首先，它将提高人们对贸易战对中国经济，特别是对出口和就业的短期和长期影响的理解。其次，它将提高人们对出口和劳动力投入之间相互作用的理解，使政府能够实施更有效的贸易或劳动市场政策以减轻贸易战的影响。例如，如果这项研究揭示出劳动力调整摩擦显著放大了贸易战的影响，政府可以实施相关的放松政策以减少劳动市场的摩擦。

21504123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21504123.value: 家族企業地位在目標公司對對沖基金激進主義反應中的作用：社會情感財富視角

21504123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21504123.value: Hedge fund activism has emerged as a key external form of corporate governance mechanism. While socio-emotional wealth theory suggests that the decision-making process of family firms places emphasis on non-financial wealth within the founding family, the mechanism through how family vs. non-family firms may alter their behavior towards activist hedge funds is relatively unknown. Through an examination of activist campaigns from 2003 to 2022 experienced by firms in the S&P 1500 index, we attempt to explore how the family firm status may influence the response of target firm when the firm is targeted by an activist hedge fund. 對沖基金激進主義已成為公司治理的關鍵外部形式機制. 雖然社會情感財富理論表明，決策家族企業在創立過程中註重非金融財富家族，家族企業與非家族企業如何改變它們的機制針對激進對沖基金的行為相對未知. 通過檢查根據標準普爾 1500 指數公司從 2003 年到 2022 年經歷的積極活動，我們嘗試探討家族企業的地位如何影響目標公司的反應當該公司成為激進對沖基金的目標時.

21506523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21506523.value: 人工智能如何重塑工作和職業？大灣區醫生和醫學實習生的案例

21506523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21506523.value: How is artificial intelligence (AI) reshaping work and professions? Machine learning algorithms have led to organizations embracing data in new ways (Kellogg, Valentine, & Christin, 2020). Organizations are quickly adopting technologies and developing AI tools for uses ranging from medical imaging to predictive policing (Lebovitz, Levina, & Lifshitz-Assaf, 2021; Waardenburg, Huysman, & Sergeeva, 2022). AI tools, developed using machine learning algorithms, are trained by experts (Pine & Bossen, 2021) who label and input data to recognize patterns (Faraj, Pachidi, & Sayegh, 2018). Scholars of work and professions have often centered studies around the use of technologies in the workplace (e.g., Anthony, 2021; Beane, 2019; Bechky, 2003; Orlikowski, 2000). Important contributions have examined how new technologies introduced into a workplace change how members of professional groups learn (Anthony, 2021; Beane, 2019; Edmondson, Bohmer, & Pisano, 2001; Kellogg, Myers, Gainer, & Singer, 2021), and relate to one another (Barley, 1986; 2015; Croidieu & Kim, 2018; Kellogg, 2022; Leonardi, 2007; Nelson and Irwin, 2014; Schultze & Orlikowski, 2004). These studies illustrate the importance of studying the situated use of new technologies, such as AI, where changes in work practices, roles, and relations occur on the ground (Barley & Beane, 2020). Despite scholars theorizing that AI will have an outsized influence on the future of work and professions (Bailey & Barley, 2020; Faraj, Pachidi, & Sayegh, 2018; Glaser, Pollock, & D’Adderio, 2021), there has been little empirical work to examine the situated use of AI in organizations (Bailey, Faraj, Hinds, Leonardi, & von Krogh, 2022). Studying AI use in the work place and how it is changing the way professionals work and relate to one another is an opportunity to unpack the black box of algorithms (Christin, 2020), with implications for understanding how the future of work is evolving. To contribute to this new stream of research on how AI is changing work and professions, I will conduct an ethnographic study of a hospital in the Greater Bay Area (GBA) to observe departments before, during, and after the implementation of medical AI tools. 人工智能（AI）如何重塑工作和職業？機器學習算法促使企業以新的方式擁抱數據（Kellogg, Valentine, & Christin, 2020）。從醫療成像到預測性警務，各組織都在快速採用技術並開發人工智能工具（Lebovitz、Levina 和 Lifshitz-Assaf，2021；Waardenburg、Huysman 和 Sergeeva，2022）。使用機器學習算法開發的人工智能工具由專家進行訓練（Pine & Bossen, 2021），專家標註並輸入數據以識別模式（Faraj, Pachidi, & Sayegh, 2018）。 研究工作和職業的學者通常圍繞工作場所的技術使用展開研究（例如，Anthony，2021；Beane，2019；Bechky，2003；Orlikowski，2000）。重要的貢獻是研究了引入工作場所的新技術如何改變專業團體成員的學習方式（Anthony, 2021; Beane, 2019; Edmondson, Bohmer, & Pisano, 2001; Kellogg, Myers, Gainer, & Singer, 2021）以及彼此之間的關係（Barley, 1986; 2015; Croidieu & Kim, 2018; Kellogg, 2022; Leonardi, 2007; Nelson and Irwin, 2014; Schultze & Orlikowski, 2004）。這些研究表明，研究人工智能等新技術的情景使用非常重要，因為在這些情景中，工作實踐、角色和關係都發生了變化（Barley & Beane, 2020）。儘管有學者從理論上認為人工智能將對未來的工作和職業產生巨大影響（Bailey & Barley, 2020; Faraj, Pachidi, & Sayegh, 2018; Glaser, Pollock, & D'Adderio, 2021），但研究人工智能在組織中的情景使用的實證工作卻很少（Bailey, Faraj, Hinds, Leonardi, & von Krogh, 2022）。研究人工智能在工作場所的應用，以及它如何改變專業人員的工作方式和相互關係，是解開算法黑箱的一個機會（Christin, 2020），對了解未來工作如何演變具有重要意義。 為了對人工智能如何改變工作和職業這一新的研究流作出貢獻，我將對大灣區（GBA）的一家醫院進行人種學研究，觀察醫療人工智能工具實施之前、期間和之後的部門情況。

21507423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21507423.value: 可替代产品的需求估计与价格优化

21507423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21507423.value: The advances in machine learning and data analytic tools have significantly facilitated the demand learning process, where companies estimate how customers will respond to various levels of prices. The demand forecasts then feed as inputs into the price optimization models to determine the best prices to meet their objectives. This process imposes several challenges in research and business practices. For the demand estimation stage, Machine learning models are widely used in the industry with outstanding performance in prediction accuracy, but they suffer from a lack of interpretability. Moreover, there is an increasing need to model substitution effects across products due to intensified levels of competition. This leads to high dimensional demand models that are likely to be intractable in optimization. The complexity in the demand model will translate to challenges in the optimization stage, where the model needs to address the high dimensional nonlinear forecast inputs and business constraints. In this project, we propose to develop and empirically verify a price optimization framework that captures product substitution patterns through flexible demand structures. Our preliminary studies develop a pairwise comparison estimation model to capture substitutions and prove its robustness under error term misspecifications. We plan to further investigate the estimator's theoretical properties and numerical performance through extensive numerical analysis and studies on real data. On the optimization side, we propose an approximation scheme by utilizing the intermediate variable to reduce the dimension of inputs. By discretizing the intermediate variable, we can also deal with the nonlinear inputs and business constraints. We plan to conduct numerical analysis using real data to identify the best type of intermediate variables. We also initiate an industry collaboration with Meituan bike, one of the largest bike-sharing companies in China. We plan to verify the proposed frameworks by utilizing real bike-sharing historical data, as well as designing and implementing field experiments. The research output of this project will contribute to the literature in the area of choice-based demand estimation and optimization. Moreover, we expect the project to have real business impacts on companies in their demand learning and pricing decision-making process. 机器学习和数据分析工具的进步显著促进了需求预测过程，企业可通过这些工具估计顾客对不同价格水平的反应。需求预测往往成为价格优化模型的输入信息以确定最佳价格。然而，这一过程在研究和业务实践中也带来了一些挑战。在需求估计阶段，虽然工业界广泛使用机器学习模型以获得出色的预测准确性，但这些模型的解释性却受到限制。此外，由于产品竞争愈发激烈，需要越来越多地对产品之间的替代效应进行建模。这导致高维度的需求模型在优化中可能变得难以处理。高复杂度的需求模型将转化为优化阶段的挑战，模型需要解决高维度非线性预测输入和业务约束方面的问题。在本项目中，我们计划通过对产品替代模式和灵活的需求结构建模，以开发并实证性地验证一个价格优化框架。我们的初步研究开发了一个配对比较估计模型以捕捉替代效应，并证明了在误差项规范不准确的情况下其稳健性。我们计划进一步通过广泛的数值分析和实际数据研究来探讨估计器的理论特性和数值性能。在优化方面，我们提出了一种利用中间变量的近似方案，以减少输入维度。通过对中间变量进行离散化，我们还可以处理非线性输入和业务约束。我们计划使用实际数据进行数值分析，以确定最佳类型的中间变量。此外，我们还与美团单车（中国最大的共享单车公司之一）展开行业合作。我们计划通过使用真实的共享单车历史数据，并设计和实施现场实验来验证所提出的框架。该项目的研究成果将为基于选择的需求估计和优化领域的文献做出贡献。此外，我们预期该项目将在企业的需求预测和定价决策过程中产生实际的业务影响。

21508123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21508123.value: 金融中內容分析與經濟語境結合研究

21508123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21508123.value: Content analysis with textual data is increasingly popular in financial research. A popular methodology is that a researcher counts the frequencies of positive or negative words in a text from sources like financial newspapers and uses that as a content measure. Then the researcher empirically investigates that measure’s statistical relationship with other economic variables. However, that methodology fails to account for economic contexts and thus fails to explain clearly what and how economic information is reflected in such content. An economic theory that explains such content measures is necessary, but the literature is still lacking. Based on my dissertation, I propose a novel method for analyzing financial textual data using economic theory. My dissertation shows that such frequency-based measures can be written as an analytical expression of the economic fundamentals and contextual variables such as market beliefs, investment opportunities in different economic states, and investors’ preferences. That relationship is the asymptotic limit of an equilibrium derived in a benchmark static setting. It captures the channel that content writers, such as business news editors, must report information selectively due to physical limits, such as the newspaper space, broadcast time slots, or conventional article lengths and models how selective coverage strategies change with the economic contexts. That model works well in predicting stylized facts about news content biases, such as sensationalism or appealing to the audience’s beliefs or preferences. Its tractability makes it convenient for empirical applications. This proposed project further completes the benchmark model by incorporating more realistic and detailed assumptions. I further account for the effects of the speed of the news cycles, which is important because, with different intensities of new shocks in booms versus busts, the reporting strategies will be different. I also extend the model to include dynamics, aiming to capture decisions on reporting timeliness. I further analyze the effects of the preference differences between the sender and the audience. Using the benchmark model with its extended developments, I proceed to empirically evaluate past literature on their potential misspecification problems and then develop a novel method to estimate a model for texts structurally using economic theory, a first in the literature. The contribution of the research will be that it fills the gap in the literature by modeling context in content analysis specific to finance. It is the first paper, to the best of my knowledge, that models texts for finance from a microeconomic perspective. 金融研究中使用文本數據進行的內容分析越加常見。研究者常使用財經報紙等文本數據中正面或負面詞語的詞頻來量化內容文本，以分析其與各經濟變量之間的統計關係。然而， 該方法并未结合經濟語境分析文本，故其難以清楚解釋文本數據中究竟反映了何種經濟信息。該類分析尚缺乏經濟理論的必要指導。 本計劃提出一種基於經濟理論分析文本數據的方法。我的畢業論文提出，前所指詞頻數據可以表示為經濟基本面和經濟語境變量（如市場信念、不同经济环境下的投资机会、投资者偏好等）的函數。該函數關係可以通過從一個基本的離散環境出發建模，然後取離散環境的漸進極限得到。該函數關係刻畫了內容作者（如財經新聞編輯等）在給定的經濟環境下如何選擇性地報道事實以適應內容長度（如報紙長度要求、節目播送時間要求、內容長度傳統等）的策略。該模型可以很好地解釋常見的新聞報導偏差，如報道的極端化傾向和內容作者對讀者的取悅行為。該模型推導的函數表達式可以於實證研究較為簡易地應用。 本提議中的項目通過增加更加現實的細節假設進一步完善該模型。該項目進一步將新聞週期的速度考慮在內。在經濟周期的不同時段，新信息出現速度不同，報道策略也會不同。本項目計劃進一步將模型拓展到動態，以將報道及時性分析納入考慮範疇。另外亦計劃進一步分析內容作者與讀者產生利益衝突時的情況。本項目計劃基於這些理論進一步實證檢驗已有的文本分析文獻中可能出現的誤識別問題，並首次開發一種利用經濟學理論來結構化分析文本數據的新方法。本項目意在填補金融學文獻中文本內容分析與經濟語境的結合研究的空缺。據我所知，本項目為首個利用微觀經濟學工具為金融中的文本數據建模的研究。

21604623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21604623.value: 劳动力老龄化和结构性转型

21604623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21604623.value: This project will investigate the connection between workforce aging and the structural shift from the manufacturing sector to the service sector. We present the macro-level stylized facts of the impact of regional workforce age structure on local manufacturing employment and output shares, as well as manufacturing wage premium. We argue about the causality by adopting two sets of instrumental variables for the regional workforce age structure, lagged regional birth rates and lagged regional abortion restrictions. We also provide the micro-level evidences we have accumulated so far on the differential impact of regional workforce age composition on local manufacturing and non-manufacturing firms, using the U.S. Census micro data. Motivated by these empirical results and the related literature, we propose a structural model to incorporate two potential channels through which workforce age composition shifts the manufacturing share in the economy. The first channel is the labor market fluidity associated with the younger workforce, which benefits the manufacturing sector and service sector to different degrees. The second channel is that workforce aging causes skill mismatch of workers to the technology embedded in the R&D and capital investment, which affects the technology- and capital-intensive manufacturing industries in particular. Then we outline the estimation procedure of the structural model with the Method of Simulated Moments. Finally, we propose to evaluate various policy devices given the irreversible trend of population aging, by conducting counterfactual policy experiments in the estimated structural model. 该项目将调查劳动力老龄化与从制造业向服务业的结构性转变之间的联系。我们呈现了区域劳动力年龄结构对当地制造业就业和产出份额以及制造业工资溢价影响的宏观层面的典型事实。我们通过对地区劳动力年龄结构、滞后地区出生率和滞后地区堕胎限制采用两组工具变量来讨论因果关系。我们还利用美国人口普查微观数据，提供迄今为止积累的微观证据，证明地区劳动力年龄构成对当地制造业和非制造业企业的不同影响。在这些实证结果和相关文献的推动下，我们提出了一个结构模型，将劳动力年龄构成改变制造业在经济中所占份额的两种潜在渠道纳入其中。第一个渠道是与年轻劳动力相关的劳动力市场流动性，这有利于制造业，因为该行业更容易受到劳动力市场摩擦的影响。第二个渠道是不同年龄结构下劳动力生产制造业相对于服务业的比较优势的变化，这是由于不同年龄组的技能构成存在差异。然后我们概述了用模拟矩法对结构模型进行估计的过程。我们还提供了一些结构模型的样本外验证练习。最后，我们建议在人口老龄化不可逆转的趋势下，通过对结构性模型实施反事实政策实验来评估可能的政策补救措施。

21606723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21606723.value: 義工工作設計、長者義工活動參與及健康老齡化：一項混合方法研究

21606723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21606723.value: 鼓勵長者參與義工活動是在個人和社會層面實現健康老化的關鍵倡議。過往大部分的研究著重於義工活動的數量（如，義工服務時數）以優化義工活動對健康的益處。然而，義工參與的質量（如義工的參與度）卻少有學者探討。更甚是，少有研究同時探討義工參與的數量和質量如何對晚年健康和幸福感產生影響。此外，尚未有研究探究義工工作特性、義工服務的時數/義工參與度，以及晚年健康/幸福感之間的理論關聯。本研究旨在將角色參與理論和工作設計理論融入積極老齡化的文獻中，以更好地理解如何優化長者義工活動的益處。 本研究有五大研究目的。第一，探討義工服務時數和義工參與程度與長者義工的健康和幸福感的關聯。第二，探討義工參與程度是否調節義工服務時數與健康和幸福感的之間關係。第三，研究義工工作特性，包括技能多樣性、任務重要性、任務認同度、自主性、義工工作反饋、義工服務中的社交支援和認可如何影響義工服務時數和義工參與程度。第四，探究義工工作的特性如何透過增加義工服務時數和義工參與程度間接影響長者義工的健康和幸福感。第五，洞悉設計和實施有意義的義工活動以吸引長者成為義工的最佳實踐和挑戰。 本研究將採用混合研究方法，具體包括兩大步驟。第一，研究者將從香港的長者社區中心招募450名60歲及以上的義工（回應研究目的1至4）。第二，研究者與長者義工進行焦點小組討論，以幫助解釋和具體化量化結果，深入理解他們的義工服務經驗。此外，研究者將與長者社區中心的社工和義工項目負責人進行焦點小組討論，以理解設計和實施義工工作環境以吸引長者的最佳實踐和挑戰（回應研究目的5）。 本研究旨在為積極老齡化文獻開創新局，深化義工工作特性如何对義工服務時數和義工參與程度，及健康老化影響的理論理解。研究結果將用於推動非營利組織系統地重組他們現有的義工服務計畫，並開發新的義工計畫作為健康老化的創新策略。是項研究並助力決策者建立支持性的義工工作環境以使長者發揮所能，貢獻社會，促進健康老化。

21607223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21607223.value: 深化建成環境暴露評估並研究其與各類健康結果之關聯

21607223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21607223.value: The built environment includes physical or manmade features such as streets and transit networks; green spaces and parks; buildings and other infrastructure, etc. This modifiable environment has been increasingly recognized as an important determinant of health in the modern society. When properly designed, the built environment can significantly promote the health and well-being of residents. Nevertheless, the built environment involves complicated and interacting infrastructure, with many different elements included. Traditional exposure assessment of the built environment most happened through self-reported questionnaire, or crude metrics from GIS calculations such as distance to highway/parks, Normalized Difference Vegetation Index (NDVI), etc. The rapid development of image processing technologies enabled by deep learning methods has opened the opportunity to advance the exposure assessment of the built environment. It is desirable to apply these methods to analyze the built environment and study its effect on a wide spectrum of health outcomes, which can give rise to more rational guidance to urban design and policy recommendations. In this project, deep learning models will be developed on satellite images around residential addresses collected in a database involving about 6,000 middle school students in a Chinese city. The developed model will be used to segment the built environment into individual features (green space, major roads, buildings, water, etc.). Further, their associations with a set of health outcomes (obesity, asthma and allergic symptoms, etc) will be investigated. Finally, the overall built environment will be treated as a composite factor and tested for how much it explains the variation in the health outcomes. The developed built environment image segmentation model can be used to process satellite images and assess built environment exposure for other cities as well. The findings of this study can also add value to the current evidence on understanding the impact of built environment on the health, benefiting public health and urban planning studies. 建成環境包括街道和運輸網絡、綠地和公園、建築物和其他基礎設施等物理或人工特徵。這種可修改的環境在現代社會中越來越被認識為健康的重要因素。當這種環境經適當設計時，可以顯著促進居民的健康和福祉。然而，建成環境涉及複雜且相互作用的基礎設施，包含許多不同的元素。傳統的建成環境暴露評估通常是通過自報問卷或從GIS計算中獲得的粗略指標，例如到高速公路/公園的距離、規範化差異植被指數（NDVI）等。深度學習方法驅動的影像處理技術的快速發展為改進建成環境的暴露評估提供了機會。將這些方法應用於分析建成環境並研究其對各種健康結果的影響是可行的，這將有助於更合理地指導城市設計和政策建議。在這個項目中，將在涉及中國一個城市約6,000名中學生的住址附近收集的衛星圖像上開發深度學習模型。開發的模型將用於將建成環境分割為個別的特徵（綠地、主要道路、建築物、水等）。此外，將調查這些特徵與一組健康結果（肥胖、哮喘和過敏症狀等）之間的關聯。最後，將將整個建成環境視為一個綜合因素，並測試其對健康結果變異的解釋程度。開發的建成環境圖像分割模型可以用於處理衛星圖像，評估其他城市的建成環境暴露。本研究的方法還可以被應用到之前對建成環境對健康影響的研究產生的數據庫，使公共衛生和城市規劃研究受益。

21607523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21607523.value: 快手低俗美學之淵源：中國東北與香港之間的媒介文化暗流

21607523.label: Project Objectives
21607523.value: The proposed project seeks to broaden the scope of current scholarship on short videos, livestream studies, platform studies and influencer studies, which are so far mostly based on Western-centric platforms (e.g. Twitch, YouTube and TikTok). The project focuses on a regional platform that is massively popular and controversial in China but very limited in global expansion. The outcome of this research will offer a contour of Chinese online video subcultures as well as generate new regional perspectives on the bourgeoning cultural fields of online video. In spotlighting marginal communities in Northeast China, this project is not only relevant to less developed regions of China but also connects to other subaltern contexts in the developing world. By employing the methods of online participant observation, database-building, ethnographic documentary, and extensive fieldwork in locations of Northeast China, this research will identify, catalogue and archive the provincialized video subcultures on Kuaishou according to the following selection criteria: those are (1) deemed “vulgar” by mainstream media and state intelligentsia; (2) directly produced by influencers or livestreamers from Northeast China and/or related to the region’s local folk cultures in some ways. The various forms of archived data include screenshots, video transcripts, livestream eventlogs, interviews, research notes, and so forth. The data collected during online fieldwork will form the foundation of a Wikibase database where connections between technologies, platforms, timelines, events, influencer personalities, and subcultural communities are meticulously drawn. This database will be released as a publicly accessible interactive website, which is expected to help generate resonances in collective memories as well as public discussions. By making visible and archiving a massively popular provincial mediascape and an alternative media ecology, the project will trace the origin of the provincialized Kuaishou subcultures back to Northeast China’s regional media-cultural history and examine its connections to Hong Kong mediascape in the 90s. In a 5-month fieldwork, the PI will visit various parts of Northeast China such as Harbin, Shenyang, Qiqihar, Changchun, Hegang and other locations in rural Heilongjiang. Participant observation and in-depth interviews of local research participants (recruited online and offline via their varying degrees of engagement with Kuaishou) will be conducted on (1) their memories of Northeast China’s mainstream folk cultures and underground subcultural scenes since the 90s, (2) how the local media and cultural production in the 90s Northeast China consumed and remediated Hong Kong culture from cinema, Cantopop, television, fashion to clubbing culture, and (3) how these cultural histories are related to contemporary provincial digital culture on Kuaishou. This project also seeks to explain contemporary Northeast China’s nostalgia for its own and Hong Kong’s past, by historicising the Kuaishou videos in which the Northeast Chinese locals performatively reenacted their everyday media cultures in the 90s. The fieldwork in Northeast China will also be supplemented by archival work in Hong Kong, in order to recapture and elucidate the undercurrents of media culture between Hong Kong and Northeast China in the 90s and its legacy for contemporary digital culture on Kuaishou. In collaboration with filmmaker Yan Cheng, this fieldwork in Northeast China will also produce a sensory-rich ethnographic documentary, which is expected to be submitted to documentary film festivals. Building on the above ethnographic and historical investigations into the origin of contemporary “vulgar” video cultures on Kuaishou in its extensive appropriations of the 90s Hong Kong mediascape, the proposed project will question the notion of vulgarity grounded in modern Chinese history, politics of cultural hierarchy and the cultural essentialism surrounding Northeast China. Instead of pathologising vulgarity or imposing an aesthetic hierarchy, the project seeks to describe and comprehend the indigenous notions of aesthetics and vulgarity held by Northeast China’s Kuaishou users, represented in their own memories of media cultures and regionally influenced internet slang. By describing and contextualising the visceral pleasure of vulgarity as opposed to the ahistorical sense of taste, this ethnographic theory of vulgarity will contribute to invigorating the academic concepts and discussions on aesthetics, popular culture and digital culture. The outputs on this front will include two peer-reviewed journal articles, one conference proceeding, one short-form book written in non-academic language as well as shorter and more publicly accessible magazine articles written in Chinese.

21607523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21607523.value: This project will provide an ethnographic and historical account of the online video subcultures on Kuaishou—a platform often characterised by its user base’s socioeconomic marginality and an alternative media ecology. Founded in 2011, Kuaishou was already the largest mobile-based short video platform in China in 2015 before TikTok/Douyin’s release. While TikTok took the global stage in 2017, Kuaishou built its success predominantly as a regional platform on the margins of Chinese society—the majority of its users come from smaller cities and rural areas. The rural userbase, visually rural backdrops in its trending videos, humble backgrounds of Kuaishou’s prominent celebrities, and the uninhibited performances of intense emotions precipitated widespread debates on its aesthetics of vulgarity. Such an impression attracted attacks from Chinese intellectual critics and eventually state scrutiny targeting the platform and its influencers. In particular, Northeast China served as the regional backdrop of Kuaishou’s meteoric rise and incubator of Kuaishou’s idiosyncratic digital culture, but also stereotypically blamed for Kuaishou’s identity of “vulgarity”. Previous approaches to Kuaishous’ alleged vulgarity have been bifurcated into either a simplistic dismissal of “low culture” or defending Kuaishou on the grounds that it offers more than vulgarity and therefore is misunderstood. This project suggests re-examining the historical particularities embedded in the provincialized digital cultures and vernacular aesthetics. For this purpose, this project will investigate the origin of subcultures formed around Kuaishou through regional pre-internet media cultures of Northeast China and how the region’s cultural imaginations of Hong Kong mediascape in the 90s are reincarnated as influential contemporary digital cultures. The proposed project will excavate the cultural and aesthetic genealogy between the Hong Kong-influenced pioneering folk cultures in Northeast China in the 90s and the present-day vulgarisation of Northeast China as a phenomenon of provincial internet culture. In order to achieve this objective, this proposed project will conduct platform-based digital ethnography on Kuaishou, offline fieldwork in Northeast China, and archival work in Hong Kong: all three parts of fieldwork and data collection will contribute to the building of a publicly accessible database and an ethnographic documentary that help document the cultural objects of various video subcultures on Kuaishou as well as theoretically situate the vulgar aesthetic in the past and present Northeast China and Hong Kong mediascapes in three academic publications. 該項目旨在快手上的網絡視頻亞文化進行民族誌和歷史研究 — 快手平台的特點被通常認為是其用戶群的社會經濟上的邊緣化和另類的媒介生態。快手成立於2011年，早在2015年抖音發布之前，它已經是中國最大的手機端短視頻平台。雖然抖音在 2017 年登上了全球舞台，但快手的成功在於，它作為中國社會邊緣人群的區域性平台，其大部分用戶來自於小城市和農村地區。農村用戶群、熱門視頻中直觀的農村背景、快手名人卑微的出身、以及毫無情緒、充滿情緒的表演，引發了人們對其低俗美學的廣泛討論。這種印象招致了來自中國知識分子批評家的攻擊，最終導致政府對該平台及其主播的審查。尤其是中國東北地區，它既是快手迅速崛起的地區背景板，也是快手特立獨行的文化的孵化器，但同時也被刻板地歸咎於快手的"低俗"身份的製造地。 以往對快手所謂的低俗性的研究方法分為兩種：一種是簡單化地否定 "低俗文化"，另一種是為快手辯護，理由是它提供了"低俗"之外更多的內容，因此它常被誤解。本項目建議重新審視地域化的網絡文化和鄉土美學中蘊含的歷史特殊性。為此，本項目將通過調研中國東北地區的前互聯網的媒介文化、以及探究東北地區對九十年代的香港媒介景觀的文化想象如何重新成為具有影響力的當代網絡文化，來針對圍繞快手所形成的亞文化的起源進行研究。 此次項目將挖掘九十年代受香港影響的中國東北民間文化先鋒，與當今作為地域性網絡文化現象的東北庸俗化現象之間的文化和美學上的譜系。為了實現這一目標，本項目將在快手上開展基於平台的數字民族志研究，在中國東北地區開展線下田野調查，並在香港開展檔案工作：所有這三個部分的田野調查和數據收集將有助於建立一個可公開訪問的數據庫和一部民族志紀錄片，以幫助記錄快手上各種視頻亞文化，並在三部學術出版物中對過去和現在的中國東北和香港媒介景觀中的低俗美學進行理論定位。

21609623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21609623.value: 跨国亚洲推理小说中的生态批评和生态女性主义

21609623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21609623.value: As media attention turns towards Asia in this time of climate crisis, ecofascistic views masquerading as ecoconsciousness have become increasingly seductive to a developed world eager to allocate blame. More than ever, the field of environmentalism needs to be rebalanced and shifted to account for—indeed, be colored in with—more international, non-Western and nonwhite perspectives and contexts. In this proposed project, I adopt an ecocritical and ecofeminist approach centering feminist, queer, and minoritized groups to examine transnational Asian speculative fiction as a response to climate change. In particular, I will analyze selected novels addressing pollution and toxic waste across different Asian contexts and show how Asia is connected to the world through toxic waste. By working with transnational Asian texts (in English and translation) such as Chang-Rae Lee’s On Such a Full Sea, Ruth Ozeki’s A Tale for the Time Being, Chen Qiufan’s Waste Tide, Chi Ta-Wei’s The Membranes, and Yoko Tawada’s The Last Children of Tokyo, and by complementing text analysis with relevant in-depth archival and site visit research, I aim to accomplish two goals. First, I want to debunk two myths about Asia’s environmental landscape—that it is either an unspoiled Shangri-La or a waste site due to poor environmental stewardship. Second, I aim to reveal the existence of a more measured reckoning with climate and pollution issues in Asia and demonstrate how these texts transcend dystopic imaginings of climate change, and how they may offer creative new ways to think about our current climate and environmental impact problems. This project will be the first in-depth study that brings together a wide range of transnational East Asian writers who tackle issues of pollution and toxic waste through speculative fiction. At stake is a new cartography based on “toxic intimacies” that situates Asia within the global circulation of waste. By grounding these texts in socio-historical and material contexts using a cultural studies ethnographic approach, and considering them through contemporary ecocritical and ecofeminist approaches developed by feminist, Asian, and woman of color thinkers, I will provide a new canon of transnational Asian speculative ecofiction and develop an ecofeminist framework that takes Asia as its center. This approach will firmly inscribe Asia as a core rather than peripheral element of these theoretical frameworks, offering a more accurate global history of literary environmental engagements. 在这个项目中，我采用生态批评和生态女权主义的方法，利用最近的学术成果，以女权主义者、酷儿和少数群体为中心，研究亚洲跨国投机小说，特别是研究亚洲如何通过有毒废物与世界联系起来的文本。 这种方法将坚定地将亚洲纳入这些理论框架的核心而非外围元素，从而提供更准确的全球文学环境历史。 该项目将是第一个深入研究，汇集了众多跨国东亚作家，他们通过推理小说来解决污染和有毒废物问题。 危在旦夕的是一种基于有毒亲密关系的新地图，它将亚洲置于全球废物循环之中。 在这个气候危机时期，随着媒体的注意力转向亚洲，伪装成生态意识的生态法西斯主义观点对急于指责的发达国家越来越有吸引力。 通过与跨国亚洲文本（英文和翻译）合作，如李昌来的《满海》、尾关露丝的《暂时的故事》、陈秋帆的《荒潮》、池大伟的《膜》和多和田洋子的《最后》 东京的孩子们，在不同的亚洲环境中直接承受污染和毒性，我的项目旨在实现两个主要目标。 首先，我想揭穿有关亚洲环境景观的两个神话：它要么是未受破坏的香格里拉，要么由于环境管理不善而成为一片废墟。 其次，我的目的是揭示亚洲对气候和污染问题存在更慎重的考虑，并展示这些文本如何基于恢复的劳动和毒性历史提供新的亲密关系，超越对气候变化的反乌托邦想象，以及它们如何提供创造性的新方法 思考我们当前的气候问题。 通过将这些跨国亚洲推理小说文本置于社会历史和物质背景中，使用文化研究民族志方法，并通过女权主义、亚洲和有色人种女性思想家开发的当代生态批评和生态女性主义方法来考虑它们，我的目标是开发一种新的 亚洲跨国投机生态小说的经典，并发展一个以亚洲为中心的生态女性主义框架。 该项目旨在反对以西方为中心的生态批评，响应阿米塔夫·戈什和黄心雅的呼吁，并以凯伦·索恩伯的作品为基础，探索文学的创造力，以应对气候灾难的紧迫挑战。

21610023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
21610023.value: 中国应对塑料污染的环境治理：可能或不可能完成的任务？

21610023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
21610023.value: 塑料污染对中国构建现代环境治理体系以及实现生态文明造成多方面的挑战。中国每年消费超过9000万吨的塑料产品，并且成为全球最多塑料垃圾产生国之一，中国应对这场环境危机所采用的规范措施将产生重大深远的影响。尽管最近几年中国不断努力缓解塑料污染，一些问题仍然存在，比如缺少全面治理塑料污染的法律，对现有法律法规的执行力较弱，非政府机构的作用有限以及采用可能会违反世界贸易组织规则的措施。因此，塑料污染仍将是中国所要面临的一个有可能持续恶化并导致环境危机的问题。本研究课题以塑料污染为个案探究中国环境保护法律法规体系的有效性并对有关中国环境治理的学术讨论作出重要贡献。本课题有望成为第一批系统全面分析中国不同行政层级下的塑料污染环境治理以及该治理体系与多边贸易体系之间关系的研究。本课题将采用多角度研究方法以理清中国解决塑料污染的法律法规体系并提高其执行能力。本课题将特别关注如何提升中国塑料治理措施与该国在世界贸易组织体系下应履行的义务之间的兼容性。中国最新提出的全链条治理模式已涵盖塑料生产，分销，消费，回收以及末端处理等阶段，并以此制定了越来越多的规范政策，这为法律分析提供了大量的素材。本课题还将探讨中国在塑料全产业链各个阶段中所采用的和贸易相关的措施是否在世界贸易组织规则下具有合规性。本课题通过法条和实证分析法，包括对中央和地方所出台的相关法律，法规和政策进行文本分析，以及访谈相关机构以及人士以对中国如何有效控制塑料污染提出及时的意见和建议。本研究希望可以整合相关机构和人士的观点以提升中国的环境治理能力。

22100623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22100623.value: LOXL4 在調節潰瘍性結腸炎巨噬細胞轉變中的作用機理研究

22100623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22100623.value: 潰瘍性結腸炎（UC）是一種慢性復發性的腸道疾病，其主要特徵是由於過多的促炎細胞激素產生而引起的黏膜炎症。目前的治療方法主要針對減緩炎症，但由於對持續性腸道炎症的機制缺乏了解，大多數UC患者未能獲得完全缓解。越來越多的研究表明，巨噬細胞向抗炎表型的功能轉變失敗，導致了失調的促炎巨噬細胞積聚和粘膜耐受力喪失，進而促進了與炎症相關的UC進展。 我们和其他研究發現，LOX及其家族成员LOXL4不仅仅在細胞外基質重塑中發揮作用,也在巨噬細胞耐受原性受损起著關鍵作用。我們初步的研究觀察到UC患者的炎症肠道组织中上調LOXL4的mRNA和蛋白质表達。這增加在C57BL/6小鼠中通過硫酸葡聚糖（DSS）誘導的慢性結腸炎模型中也得以複製。此外，LOXL4阻断減輕了慢性DSS誘導的結腸炎小鼠和自發性T細胞轉移Rag1-/-小鼠的疾病嚴重程度。在病理狀態下，結腸巨噬細胞高表達LOXL4。高表達的LOXL4与巨噬細胞中的促炎性TNFα和IL1基因表達有关。将LPS誘導的促炎性骨髓源巨噬細胞（BMDM）移植到受抗LOXL4處理的Rag1-/-結腸炎小鼠中，加剧小鼠对結腸炎的敏感性，並增強結腸促炎性基因的表達。LOXL4主要調控結腸巨噬細胞中脂肪酸β氧化（FAO）的機制。進一步的通路分析顯示，LOXL4降低了巨噬細胞中AMPKα的磷酸化水平。AMPKα的激活恢復了LOXL4过表達巨噬細胞中FAO調控的抗炎基因表達。 基於初步觀察，我們假設 LOXL4 的表達令到結腸巨噬細胞抗炎表型轉換失敗，從而促進 UC 的進展。我們計畫研究：（1）LOXL4在結腸炎的特徵功能；（2）LOXL4 調節巨噬細胞表型轉換的機制；（3）LOXL4 在結腸炎小鼠的治療潛力。這研究項目將有助於開拓治療UC的新途徑。
