22100923.value: 不規則單萜化合物的生物合成機理及其異源生產研究

22102823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22102823.value: 阻斷萎縮性骨骼肌釋放外泌體以增強骨骼：肌萎縮相關骨質流失的新治療策略？

22102823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22102823.value: 由失負荷引起的或與衰老（肌肉減少症）相關的骨骼肌萎縮總是伴隨著顯著的骨質流失，這與脆性骨折的風險增加密切相關，導致老年人和缺乏身體活動的人遭受嚴重的健康後果。然而，由於我們對機制的理解不完整，仍缺乏對抗肌肉萎縮相關骨質流失的醫學對策。 肌萎縮總是出現在明顯的骨質流失之前，並伴有收縮力減少和分泌肌因子的改變，並同時影響肌肉和骨骼的代謝活動。因而暗示了肌肉驅動的調節因素在肌萎縮相關骨質流失中不可或缺的作用。然而，臨床研究表明，各種運動療法，儘管部分保留了肌肉力量，卻不足以減輕肌萎縮相關的骨質流失。此外，臨床前研究表明，抑制對肌肉和骨骼都有不利影響的肌因子只會消除肌萎縮，並不能延緩骨質流失。可見，除了機械力和肌因子之外，其他肌肉衍生因素也可能導致肌萎縮相關的骨質流失。 新近的研究提示，肌肉還通過釋放外泌體（SMExo）包裹的肌肉特異性微小核酸（myomiR）調節其他器官功能。為了確定SMExo和myomiR在肌骨串擾中的作用，我們建立了一個在骨骼肌中特異性表達綠色螢光蛋白標記的外泌體標誌蛋白CD63的轉基因小鼠系（SMCD63-GFP），分別用於在尾部懸吊引起的下肢失負荷（HU）和自然衰老狀態下對SMExo和myomiR進行體內跟蹤。我們發現肌萎縮與SMExo中myomiR水平異常升高一起發展，並早於在骨質流失的出現。這些myomiR在臥床不起的患者和老年人中也同樣上調。SMExo在HU和老年小鼠的骨內均被檢測到。此外，通過遺傳學途徑阻斷SMExo釋放（SMRab27aKO）或敲低肌肉中myomiR水平，均減緩了與HU或衰老相關的血清myomiR上調，並減輕了肌萎縮相關的骨質流失。進一步的機理研究顯示：來自HU和老年小鼠的SMExo中的myomiR不僅在體外抑制了成骨活性和增強的碎骨活性，而且刺激了停滯小鼠的骨質流失。我們進一步開發了一種新型肌肉靶向外泌體抑制劑（SMExoInhib），該抑制劑對SMExo釋放具有抑制效力，並分別對HU小鼠和老年小鼠的骨質流失產生有益作用。綜上所述，我們假設阻斷萎縮性骨骼肌的SMExo釋放以中斷肌骨串擾可能是肌萎縮相關骨質流失的有效治療策略。 本項目的具體研究目標如下： 目標1：測試從HU小鼠補充含有myomiR的SMExo是否會加劇患有HU的年輕SMRab27aKO小鼠的肌萎縮相關骨質流失。 目標2：檢查從老年小鼠補充含有myomiR的SMExos是否會加劇老年SMRab27aKO小鼠的肌萎縮相關骨質流失。 目標3：評價SMExoInhib分別延緩年輕C57BL/6小鼠HU和老年C57BL/6小鼠肌萎縮相關骨質流失的治療效果。 這項研究將揭示新的肌肉-骨骼串擾調控機制。它還將有助於開發新的治療策略，以抵消肌肉減少症老年人或缺乏身體活動的個體的MA相關骨質流失。

22104123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22104123.value: 探索苯乙胺在腹瀉型腸易激綜合征中對5-羥色胺再攝取的調節作用機制

22104123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22104123.value: 腹瀉型腸易激綜合征（IBS-D）是一種常見的功能性腸道障礙，其主要症狀包括腹瀉、腹痛和腹脹。我們之前的研究（Nature Communications, 2019）以及其他臨床研究發現，IBS-D患者的血漿中5-羥色胺（5-HT）水準升高。治療使用5-HT拮抗劑能有效緩解症狀，進一步表明失調的腸道5-HT活性對IBS-D的發病機制起到作用。外周5-HT主要由腸道墨黑細胞合成，而被選擇性的5-羥色胺再攝取轉運蛋白（SERT）進行失活，而在IBS-D患者的結腸中發現SERT的表達下調。因此，失調的SERT增加了粘膜5-HT生物利用度，推動了IBS-D的發展。目前，對於IBS-D中SERT表達的調節機制尚不完全瞭解。越來越多的證據表明，腸道菌群可能在調節IBS-D中SERT水準方面起著作用，因為來自IBS-D患者的糞便移植可導致SERT下調，從而使無菌小鼠的外周5-HT水準升高。儘管腸道菌群在調節SERT表達和腸道5-HT水準方面的重要性，但負責調節5-HT穩態的腸道菌的種類，特別是對於5-HT再攝取的調節仍然未知，並且腸道菌群調節SERT表達的分子機制還不清楚。 通過對我們的IBS-D人群進行宏基因組分析，我們發現人體細菌Ruminococcus gnavus 菌株可能在調節IBS-D中的5-HT水準方面起到關鍵的致病作用(Cell Host & Microbe, 2023)。我們的臨床研究發現，在IBS-D患者中，R. gnavus與腹瀉症狀的嚴重程度和血清5-HT水準呈正相關。在無菌小鼠中，單菌株的R. gnavus導致類似IBS-D的腹瀉症狀，通過升高外周5-HT水準。從代謝的角度來看，我們發現來自R. gnavus介導的蛋白質降解代謝產物苯丙氨酸衍生物苯乙胺直接刺激腸道墨黑細胞中5-HT的生物合成，而這種作用是通過TAAR1的啟動實現的，TAAR1是芳香族微量胺（如苯乙胺）的G蛋白偶聯受體。因此，由於異常的R. gnavus富集而引起的苯乙胺/TAAR1/5-HT信號通路的啟動導致IBS-D患者腸道蠕動增強和結腸分泌物增加。在我們的後續研究中，我們進一步證明，在單菌株R. gnavus無菌小鼠和接受苯乙胺處理的正常小鼠中，結腸SERT的mRNA表達顯著下調。此外，我們還表明，低苯丙氨酸飲食導致正常小鼠的腸道蠕動減少，同時糞便中苯乙胺和血清5-HT水準降低。 基於這些觀察，我們假設除了其在5-HT生物合成中的促進作用外，R. gnavus可能通過苯乙胺介導的SERT下調對IBS-D中的5-HT再攝取障礙起貢獻作用。為了驗證這個假設，我們將通過以下目標研究苯乙胺在IBS-D的5-HT再攝取調節過程中的調節作用及其在IBS-D發病機制和治療中的應用: (1) 揭示R. gnavus及其代謝產物苯乙胺在抑制5-HT再攝取和調節腸道蠕動中的調節作用; (2) 研究R. gnavus產生的苯乙胺如何調節SERT表達，從而影響5-HT的攝取; (3) 探索低苯丙氨酸飲食干預在IBS-D治療中的潛力。該研究不僅將為宿主-微生物相互作用調節5-HT再攝取提供新的見解，而且為開發新的IBS-D治療方法打下基礎。

22202423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22202423.value: 可靠去中心化在線學習機制研究

22202623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22202623.value: 面向海量屬性圖的實時相關性檢索方案

22202623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22202623.value: 圖結構數據上的相關性搜索旨在從圖中檢索與查詢節點最相似的節點。這項任務是包括圖數據庫、搜索引擎和推薦系統等多種系統的基礎，用以支持排名和推薦等服務。在過去的二十年中，有大量的研究試圖設計出有效的相關性度量和高效的搜索/查詢算法。其中大多方法忽視了圖數據中的節點屬性信息（例如用戶的性別和基因的DNA序列），因此導致搜索結果質量欠佳。然而將屬性信息與圖拓撲結構信息進行無縫地融合是非常具有挑戰性的任務。因為節點和屬性是兩個異質實體，具有不同的內在特徵，並且它們的重要性因節點而異。此外，在大數據時代，圖數據的規模和動態性急劇增長，而許多在線服務需要實時響應（在100毫秒以內），這使得屬性圖上的相關性搜索的難度更上一個台階。據我們所知，現有的研究都未能成功地解決這兩個挑戰。為此，本項目旨在通過三個主要的技術貢獻克服上述侷限。首先，我們計劃為屬性圖設計一種全新的相關性度量，並為每個節點都單獨學習一個性化權重，以優化屬性和拓撲信息的結合和提高結果質量。我們還將提出一系列複雜的針對效率優化的技術手段，以實現在大規模屬性圖上的高效參數學習。此外，為了實現大型靜態圖上的實時相關性搜索查詢，我們打算設計一款基於圖嵌入的新型索引結構。配備了這些索引，我們將開發一款雙向搜索算法來支持實時查詢處理。最後，我們還將研究動態圖嵌入技術和增量索引更新策略，以助於將實時查詢處理方案擴展到大規模動態圖上。憑藉我們在圖數據相關性搜索、屬性圖數據分析和圖嵌入等課題上的豐富研究經驗，我們期望本項目能夠開發設計出一套行之有效的技術和工具，以提升互聯網與軟件行業中基於排名和推薦的在綫服務質量。

22302123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22302123.value: 對於曲面重建以及曲面光順的新穎數學模型和快速算法

22302123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22302123.value: 曲面處理（比如曲面重建以及曲面光順）是三位建模、數據可視化以及高級數據處理的重要問題。其在城市重建、醫療圖像、以及元宇宙等方面有著廣汎的應用。在城市重建中，曲面重建算法利用空載激光遙感測量（LiDAR）數據來建立三維城市模型。這對城市規劃以及虛擬旅游非常重要。元宇宙是一個致力於提供沉浸式體驗的虛擬世界。而曲面處理是其構造現實物體在虛擬世界中高質量三維模型的不可或缺的工具。爲了滿足對於高質量三維模型的不斷增加的需求，很多應用亟需高效的曲面處理算法。該項目的目標是對於曲面重建以及曲面光順發展新穎的數學模型以及快速算法。 在實際問題中，由於高吸光率以及掃描過程的阻礙，用於曲面重建的點雲數據往往部分缺失。基於不完整的點雲數據，很多現有方法有可能不能重構曲面的某些性質。而適用於不完整的點雲數據的曲面重建方法還處於發展階段。曲面光順的目標是磨光一個含有噪聲的曲面并且保留曲面的特徵，比如棱和角。高斯曲率在很多問題中已經證明是一個很好的正則項。但是由於高斯曲率的複雜度，有關其在曲面光順上的應用還相對較少。 本項目分爲兩部分。第一部分包括設計適用於不完整數據的曲面重建的模型，以及曲面光順的模型。對於曲面重建，本項目將在數據完整的區域通過擬合數據來重建曲面，而在數據缺失的區域利用臨近數據來推斷曲面特徵並重建。對於曲面光順，本項目將利用高斯曲率去設計新的正則項使得磨光后的曲面能夠保持曲面的棱和角。在第二部分，本項目將設計用來解決第一部分提出的模型的快速算法。我們將把每一個複雜問題分解成容易解決的子問題，並逐一設計高效算法。本項目將把我們的方法應用在LiDAR數據上來重建城市物體的三維模型。我們期待本項目的成果能爲曲面處理相關的數學模型以及快速算法方面做出重要貢獻。

22302723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22302723.value: 基於進化信息對蛋白質進行逆向工程

22302723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22302723.value: Proteins are incredible bio-machineries that play essential roles in almost all kinds of life activities and processes. Under physiological conditions, most proteins with stable folded structures can respond to the perturbations from the milieu and perform intrinsic dynamics around their native-state structures. These intrinsic dynamics encode the functionality of the proteins. Notably, the mutations in the amino acid sequences may lead to variations in the folded structures of the proteins, resulting in changes in dynamics and functions. Such a correspondence between evolution (sequence mutation) and dynamics (PRL, 127: 098103, 2021) is in line with the classical “sequence-structure-function” paradigm of proteins. However, it is challenging to predict precisely how a mutation will affect the dynamics of a protein and to determine the function-related mutations in protein engineering. Fortunately, recent years have witnessed the overwhelming success of AlphaFold (Nature, 596: 583-9, 2021) and other AI-based methods in bridging the sequence and structure of proteins. There are AI-predicted protein databases (AlphaFold Database and ESM Metagenomic Atlas) providing high-accuracy structural predictions of hundreds of millions of proteins, allowing extensive statistical analyses for protein evolution and dynamics. Previously, we demonstrated how AlphaFold Database could be applied to uncover general statistical trends in protein evolution (Mol Biol Evol, 39: msac197, 2022). In this research, we will go even further, using AI-predicted structure to learn the evolution of hundreds of protein families. Despite their different sequences, proteins from the same family have similar folded structures and intrinsic dynamics, especially those slow-mode motions corresponding to large-scale conformational changes. Following a reversed logic chain “dynamics-structure-sequence”, we aim to establish a theoretical framework of protein reverse engineering and elucidate how the changes in dynamics result from the mutations in sequences, opening the black boxes of protein functions. By combining perturbation analysis with statistical analysis of slow modes, we will identify the mutations that can significantly affect protein dynamics. Moreover, statistical physics analyses can help us to uncover the long-range correlations in the proteins (PRL, 118: 088102, 2017), i.e., to identify the key mutations distal from function-related regions and to reveal the epistasis interactions between two mutant sites. The predicted function-related mutations can be further validated by atomistic molecular simulation. We believe that such a framework will provide a promising approach to elucidate the genotype-phenotype mapping of proteins, promote our understanding of proteins’ functional or dysfunctional behaviours, and shed light on the research of drug design and protein engineering. 蛋白質作為構成生物系統的關鍵大分子，在幾乎所有生命活動和過程中都發揮著至關重要的作用。在生理條件下，大部分具有穩定摺疊結構的蛋白質可以響應來自環境的熱擾動，並在其天然態結構附近發生運動。蛋白質在天然態附近的固有動力學決定了蛋白質分子的生物功能。值得注意的是，蛋白質氨基酸序列中的突變可能導致其三維摺疊結構的變化，從而改變動力學和功能。這種在進化（序列突變）和動力學（PRL, 127: 098103, 2021）之間的對應關係與蛋白質的經典“序列—結構—功能”範式一致。然而，預測突變如何影響蛋白質的動力學，並確定與蛋白質功能相關的關鍵突變仍然是蛋白質工程領域具有挑戰性的關鍵課題。 幸運的是，近年來AlphaFold (Nature, 596: 583-9, 2021) 等基於人工智能（AI）大模型的方法在建立從蛋白質的序列到結構之間的聯繫方面取得了壓倒性的成功。現有的基於AI預測的蛋白質結構的數據庫（如AlphaFold數據庫和ESM數據庫等）提供了數以億計蛋白質的高精度結構預測，允許對蛋白質演化和動力學進行廣泛而深入的統計分析。在前期研究中，我們已經成功地利用AlphaFold數據庫來揭示蛋白質演化的一般統計趨勢（Mol Biol Evol, 39: msac197, 2022）；而在這項研究中，我們將更進一步，使用基於AI預測的結構來了解數百個蛋白質家族的演化。對同一家族的蛋白質而言，儘管它們的序列不同，但它們具有相似的天然態結構以及相應的固有動力學，尤其是與蛋白質大尺度構象變化相對應的慢速模式運動。關注於蛋白質中特定功能運動模式的變化，本項目的研究目標在於，打開蛋白質功能运动的黑盒子，構建从表型到基因型的反向邏輯鏈「動力學—結構—序列」，建立蛋白質逆向工程的理論框架，闡明序列中的突變如何導致動力學的變化。 通過結合微擾分析和慢速模式的統計分析，本研究將識別可以顯著影響蛋白質動力學的突變。此外，統計物理分析可以幫助我們揭示蛋白質中的長程相關性（PRL，118: 088102, 2017），即識別與功能相關區域遠距離的關鍵突變，並揭示兩個突變位點之間的上位互作。預測的與功能相關的突變可以進一步通過分子動力學模擬進行驗證。這樣的框架將為闡明蛋白質的基因型—表型映射提供一個有前景的方法，促進我們對蛋白質功能或功能障礙行為的理解，並為藥物設計和蛋白質工程的研究帶來啟示。

22302823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22302823.value: 發展粗粒化模型研究天然無序蛋白的下臨界溫度（LCST）相分離行為

22302823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22302823.value: Macromolecular phase separation has emerged as a new principle for understanding different cellular functions, e.g., signaling transduction. Phase separation is the process in which a homogeneous solution separates into two coexisting phases if the solute concentration is above the saturation concentration: a dense phase termed biomolecular condensates and a dilute phase. Membraneless organelles are examples of biomolecular condensates. These membraneless organelles provide temporal and spatial control of different cellular compartments. Dysregulation of phase separation is implicated in many human diseases, including neurodegenerative diseases and cancers. Thus, phase separation provides a molecular-level framework for understanding many diseases and exploring new therapeutic opportunities. Driven by multivalent interactions, certain classes of intrinsically disordered proteins (IDPs) can undergo phase separation with an upper critical solution temperature (UCST) or a lower critical solution temperature (LCST). For UCST-type phase behavior, phase separation occurs if the temperature is lower than a system-specific transition temperature. For LCST-type phase behavior, phase separation occurs if the temperature is lower than the transition temperature. The large length- and timescales of phase separation of IDPs are beyond the current capability of all-atom simulations. Thus, coarse-grained (CG) simulations become important and necessary tools for understanding the physics of phase separation of IDPs. Although CG models have provided important insights into the phase separation of IDPs, they cannot be used to simulate LCST-type phase behavior, as they do not account for driving forces for this process. To address this challenge, we propose to develop a new coarse-grained model that can be used to simulate both UCST- and LCST-type phase behavior. This model accounts for driving forces for LCST-type phase behavior, namely the temperature-dependent free energy of solvation and the release and binding of ions. Our preliminary results show that the proposed model can capture the single-chain behavior of IDPs with LCST-type phase behavior. The optimal force field parameters for this model will be explored. This model can be used to study the thermodynamics and kinetics of phase separation. Using NUP98, CTD PolII and ELPs as model systems, we will apply the model to investigate the molecular grammar governing the LCST-type phase behavior. We believe our new model will generate new insights into the LCST-type phase behavior of IDPs. In addition, we will apply this model to design sequences with LCST-type phase behaviors, which will be further validated by our experimental collaborator. These designed sequences hold great potential for designing biomaterials. 生物大分子相分離已經成為一種新的理解細胞功能，例如信號傳遞的物理法則。生物大分子相分離是指當溶質濃度超過飽和濃度時，濃度均勻的溶液分離成兩相共存的過程：一個被稱為生物分子凝聚體的致密相和一個稀釋相。無膜細胞器屬於生物分子凝聚體。這些無膜細胞器為實現各種細胞功能提供了時間和空間上的控制。相分離的失調與許多人類疾病有關，包括神經退行性疾病和癌症。因此，相分離為理解許多疾病並探索新的治療機會提供了新的物理框架。 某些天然無序蛋白質（IDPs）在多價相互作用的驅使下可以發生具有上臨界溶液溫度（UCST）或下臨界溶液溫度（LCST）的相分離。對於UCST型相行為，如果溫度低於系統特定的臨界溫度，則會發生相分離。對於LCST型相行為，如果溫度高於臨界溫度，則會發生相分離。IDPs相分離的長度和時間尺度超出了目前全原子模型所能達到的尺度。因此，粗粒化（CG）模型成為理解IDPs相分離物理法則的重要工具。雖然CG模型已經廣泛用於研究IDPs的UCST型相分離，但由於未考慮LCST型相分離的驅動力，它們無法用於模擬LCST型相行為。 為了應對這一挑戰，我們將開發一種新的粗粒化模型，可以用於模擬UCST型和LCST型相行為。該模型考慮了LCST型相行為的驅動力，即溫度依賴的溶解自由能和鹽離子效應。我們的初步結果顯示，該模型可以有效描述具有LCST型相行為無序蛋白的單鏈行為。我們將優化該模型的力場參數，用於研究相分離的熱力學和動力學過程。我們將使用NUP98、CTD PolII和ELPs作為模型系統，來揭示決定LCST型相行為的“分子語法”。此外，我們將應用該模型設計具有LCST型相行為的多肽序列，並由我們的實驗合作者進行進一步的驗證。這些設計的多肽序列在生物材料設計上具有巨大的潛力。

22303123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22303123.value: 核卷积平滑下的高维推断

22303123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22303123.value: Technological advances have made high-dimensional data ubiquitous in many scientific fields. In the past decades statisticians have witnessed the explosive developments of high-dimensional statistical methods and theory driven by the analysis of big data in fields such as biological science, medical science, public health, social sciences and finance, among others. Statistical inference is the key tool for scientific discoveries. Testing hypothesis under ultra-high dimensionality is important and very challenging. Existing works for high dimensional inference are typically based on least squares approach and canonical regression model, and they mainly focus on conditional mean and light-tailed data. However, in real applications, quantities other than the conditional mean is often of interest. For instance, the value at risk in econometrics and finance is studied through expectiles, which is a general position in a distribution including the mean as its special case. The existing theory in literature cannot provide inference of expectiles in ultra-high dimensions. Meanwhile, heavy-tailed distribution is a stylized feature for high-dimensional data, which has been confirmed by many studies in literature. In these cases, the canonical regression model has severe limitations and non-standard regression is more powerful. The overall target of this research project is to propose statistically and computationally efficient method for inference in these nonstandard yet more realistic high dimensional settings. In the first project of this proposal, we study the linear hypothesis testing problem for high dimensional regression coefficients, with no moment condition imposed on error distribution. We propose novel Wald and score test statistics based on convoluted rank regression estimator, which is a powerful estimator that remains valid under heavy-tailed error while adopting smooth loss so it is computationally efficient. In the second project, we focus on the testing problem for high dimensional expectile regression. Due to technical challenges caused by non-smoothness of the expectile loss, inference for expectile regression is unstudied in literature. We adopt kernel convolution to smooth the expectile loss, and propose corresponding Wald and score tests for high dimensional expectile regression. In both projects, we will prove that the distributions of proposed test statistics are asymptotically equivalent to chi-squared distribution with certain degrees of freedom. Power against local alternatives will also be investigated. We will conduct simulation studies and apply the proposed methods to analyze some high-dimensional datasets concerning genomics, climate study, econometrics and finance. 技术进步使高维数据在许多科学领域无处不在。在过去的几十年里，统计学家见证了生物科学、医学、公共卫生、社会科学和金融等领域在大数据分析驱动下的高维统计方法和理论的爆炸性发展。统计推断是科学发现的关键工具。在超高维的数据中进行假设检验是一个非常重要且极具挑战性的问题。现有的高维推断工作通常基于正则化的最小二乘回归，并主要关注条件均值和轻尾数据。然而，在实际应用中，除了条件均值之外的其他量通常也是令人感兴趣的。例如，计量经济学和金融中的风险价值是通过期望分位数来研究的，期望分位数是分布中的一种一般的位点，均值是它的一个特例。现有文献理论无法提供超高维回归下期望分位值的推断。同时，重尾分布是高维数据的一种典型的特征，这一点已被许多文献研究所证实。在这些情况下，标准的回归模型有严重的局限性，而非标准回归则更有效。本研究项目的总体目标是在这些非标准但更贴近现实的高维情形中，提出统计意义和计算意义下都高效的推断方法。在本提案的第一个项目中，我们在不对误差分布施加矩条件的情形下，研究高维回归系数的线性假设检验问题。在卷积秩回归估计量的基础上，我们原创性地提出Wald 和score检验统计量。卷积秩回归估计量在重尾误差下仍然高效，由于采用平滑损失函数，其计算效率也非常高。在第二个项目中，我们重点关注高维期望分位数回归的检验问题。由于期望分位数回归的损失函数不平滑所带来的技术挑战，期望分位数回归的推断在文献中尚未研究。我们采用核卷积来平滑期望分位数回归损失，并针对高维期望分位数回归提出相应的 Wald 和score检验。在这两个项目中，我们将证明所提出的检验统计量的分布渐近等价于具有一定自由度的卡方分布。我们也将探究所提出的方法针对局部备择假设的功效。我们将进行模拟研究并应用所提出的方法来分析一些有关基因组学，气候研究，计量经济学和金融的高维数据集。

22303723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22303723.value: 面向點對學習的隨機優化和學習理論

22303723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22303723.value: 機器學習旨在從經驗數據中自動提取知識，其廣泛應用於計算機視覺、生物信息學和醫學科學等領域。點對學習是機器學習的重要分支，相應預測模型的性能需要通過一組訓練樣例來評估。點對學習提供了求解一類機器學習任務的統一框架，其包括求解類別不平衡學習的AUC 極大化以及尋找數據相異性度量的度量學習。與此同時，現代技術正在創建大規模數據集，這些數據集通常包含敏感信息，例如患者記錄、人口普查信息、醫療信息或銷售交易。這些敏感信息的洩露可能會導致嚴重的社會或經濟問題。針對包含敏感信息的大規模數據集，如何設計高效的點對學習算法以及研究相應的學習理論是機器學習領域的重要課題。 隨機優化算法具有簡單有效且易於實現的特性，其廣泛應用於以深度神經網絡為代表的複雜模型的訓練。與此相比，隨機優化算法在點對學習的潛力還未被挖掘。例如現有的在線梯度下降算法在點對學習任務中的時間開銷依賴於樣本規模，不能滿足大數據時代的需要。本課題研究隨機優化算法的學習理論，並設計具有更好擴展性和泛化性的點對學習算法。本課題擬運用機器學習、應用數學、逼近理論、安全和統計學等領域的工具研究點對學習的理論基礎、算法設計以及具體應用。 具體地，本課題擬運用隨機優化的工具探索點對學習模型的設計、算法的開發以及其學習理論。運用目標函數曲面的幾何特性來嚴格建立算法的收斂性以及收斂速度，使用算法穩定性的概念分析算法的泛化誤差界，引入隱私保護技術在不損害實用性的情況下保護用戶的私人信息。本課題將重點關注計算複雜性、樣本複雜性和隱私保護之間的權衡。

22501823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22501823.value: 銀行業旋轉門：會計及其他影響

22501823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22501823.value: Banks’ revolving door hiring of former regulators is a prevalent phenomenon that generates substantial media coverage and policy discussions. Yet, the consequences of such hiring are underexplored, possibly because of the difficulty in measuring such hiring for a large sample of banks. I propose to collect millions of professional profiles from LinkedIn, the world’s largest professional network website, so that I can identify such hiring for a large sample of U.S. commercial banks. This data allow me to conduct comprehensive analyses on the potential consequences of banks’ revolving door hiring. While I mainly focus on accounting implications in this proposal, the data can be used to study a broader scope of outcomes. Specifically, I study the impact of revolving door hiring on banks’ loan loss recognition timeliness (LLRT). LLRT captures the extent to which banks account for forward-looking information when making loan loss provisions. Since the global financial crisis, regulators have emphasized the importance of LLRT in credit loss accounting and standard setters have introduced new accounting standards to promote it. Whether and how revolving door hiring affects banks’ accounting behavior is an empirical question. On the one hand, banks may want to leverage these candidates’ supervisory experience and accounting expertise so that they can better comply with regulatory requirements, resulting in increased LLRT. On the other hand, banks may want to leverage the social connections and knowledge of a former banking regulator to gain favorable treatment and insulate themselves from adverse regulatory actions, resulting in decreased LLRT. To collaborate the mechanisms, I study three conditions under which the effect of revolving door hiring on LLRT should be stronger: i) when the revolving door hires fulfill accounting-related job functions; ii) when they have extensive experience working at regulatory agencies; and iii) when they have experience working with the bank’s primary regulator. To broaden the scope of the study, I propose some additional analyses that go beyond LLRT. Specifically, I examine the impact of revolving door hiring on loan loss provision validity, reporting opacity, bank risk-taking, and regulatory enforcement actions. In sum, my proposed research can improve our understanding of how revolving door hiring affects banks’ accounting and other behaviors that are important to the stability of the banking system. The findings are likely to have policy implications such as allowing for evidence-based approach in consideration of whether to encourage/curtail the movement of workers between regulatory agencies and regulated entities. 銀行業旋轉門之聘用前任監管人員是一種普遍現象，引發了大量媒體報導和政策討論。然而，此類聘用的後果尚未得到充分研究，可能是因為難以度量大量銀行樣本的此類招聘行為。我建議從全球最大的職業網絡網站LinkedIn收集數以百萬計的職業檔案，從而我能夠識別大量美國商業銀行的此類招聘。這些數據使我能夠對銀行旋轉門招聘的潛在後果進行全面分析。雖然我主要關注該研究計劃中的會計影響，但這些數據可用於更廣泛的研究議題。 具體來說，我研究了旋轉門招聘對銀行貸款損失確認及時性（LLRT）的影響。 LLRT 反映了銀行在製定貸款損失撥備時考慮前瞻性信息的程度。自全球金融危機以來，監管機構強調了 LLRT 在信用損失會計中的重要性，準則制定者也推出了新的會計準則來推廣它。旋轉門招聘是否以及如何影響銀行的會計行為是一個實證問題。一方面，銀行可能希望利用這些候選人的監管經驗和會計專業知識，以便他們能夠更好地遵守監管要求，從而增加 LLRT。另一方面，銀行可能希望利用前銀行監管機構的社會關係和知識來獲得特殊待遇，並使自己免受監管處罰，從而導致 LLRT 下降。 為了進一步探討旋轉門招聘影響LLRT的機制，我研究了三種條件，在這三種條件下，旋轉門招聘對 LLRT 的影響應該更強：i）當旋轉門招聘的人員履行與會計相關的工作職能時； ii) 他們擁有在監管機構工作的豐富經驗； iii) 他們有與銀行的主管監管機構合作的經驗。為了擴大研究範圍，我還提出了一些 LLRT 之外的相關研究議題。具體來說，我計劃研究旋轉門招聘對貸款損失撥備有效性、財務報表透明度、銀行風險承擔和監管執法行動的影響。 總之，我提出的研究議題可以提高我們對旋轉門招聘如何影響銀行會計和其他對銀行體系穩定有重要影響的行為的理解。研究結果可能會有政策意義，例如允許採用基於證據的方法來考慮是否鼓勵/限制人員在監管機構和受監管實體之間的流動。

22501923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22501923.value: 工會對企業定價策略的影響

22501923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22501923.value: Using Nielsen retail scanner database, I examine the effect of labor unionization on firm’s product pricing volatility. I hypothesize that management of unionized firms will manipulate product prices in a manner that strengthens its bargaining position. Specifically, I predict that unionized firms will strategically increase product prices to lower sales and income numbers before labor contract negotiations, and subsequently offer more price discounts after the union contract negotiations to regain product market share. I further expect such effect of labor unions on product pricing will be less pronounced for (1) firms in states with right-to-work law but have no work stoppage provisions (i.e., weaker labor unions) and (2) firms who are constrained in cash. I also employ a regression discontinuity design to account for endogeneity issues. Overall, this paper sheds light on how management may use product price strategies to achieve a stronger bargaining position and offer new insight into how a company’s labor unionization can potentially affect the interests of its retail customers. 使用尼爾森零售掃描數據庫，我研究了工會化產品定價波動的影響。 我假設工會公司的管理層將以加強其討價還價地位的方式操縱產品價格。 具體來說，我預測加入工會的企業將在勞動合同談判前戰略性地提高產品價格，以降低銷售額和收入數字，並隨後在工會合同談判後提供更多價格折扣，以重新獲得產品市場份額。 我進一步預計，對於以下情況，工會對產品定價的影響將不太明顯: (1) 擁有工作權法但沒有停工條款的州的公司（即工會較弱）和 (2) 受到限制的公司用現金。 我還採用了斷點回歸設計來解決內生性問題。 總體而言，本文闡明了管理層如何利用產品價格策略來獲得更強的議價地位，並為公司的工會化如何可能影響其零售客戶的利益提供了新的見解。

22607423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22607423.value: 探討社區和非政府組織在香港的可持續危機翻譯中的角色

22607423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22607423.value: Effectively communicating crisis information such as hygiene instructions in an epidemic is key in mitigating risk in disaster situations. The small amount of literature examining crisis communication conducted via translation has sought to increase the visibility of translation in disaster situations and has advocated for a greater emphasis on multilingualism and multiculturalism in government policies. Scholars have also investigated the active participation undertaken by ordinary citizens in the form of crowdsourcing and volunteer translation. These citizen translators play different roles when they produce the translated messages collaboratively. However, the effectiveness and sustainability of their translation activities can be hindered by a lack of professional training, systematic organisation and its ad hoc nature. These challenges are also encountered by NGOs in their translation provisions, especially when serving minority language users. This project is situated in Hong Kong and aims to facilitate crisis communication with the city’s Nepalese and Pakistani South Asian (SA) residents who have been underprivileged in society and under-researched in the scholarly literature. The project will bring together two stakeholders, i.e. communities and NGOs, by introducing the practice of collaborative translation through a tailored training programme and developing a theoretically informed community of practice with technological support. The project team will first collect information regarding SA residents’ experience of crisis translation, through a combination of documentary and ethnographic methods including analysis of newspaper reports, evaluation of the crisis information made available on the government’s websites, and ethnographic fieldwork in the SA communities and NGOs. These will provide insights as to issues of availability, accessibility and acceptability in respect of crisis communication with residents speaking minority languages, as well as an initial understanding of the SA’s linguistic competence and communicational needs, and of the challenges that the two stakeholder groups have encountered. Having obtained an in-depth understanding of the status quo of crisis communication conducted in minority languages, the project team will implement a citizen translation training programme, in which collaborative translation involving both human and non-human actors plays a significant role. The monitoring and evaluation of the interactions between the participants and between human translators and machines, and the interplay between the NGO staff and SA residents, will significantly contribute to our understanding of the process of collaborative translation, non-professional translation and translator training. The outcomes from this project also include a sophisticated research methodology that will be replicable in other studies of participant- and process-oriented translation studies research. 有效傳遞和溝通危機信息（如流行病期間的衛生指示）是降低災害風險的關鍵。目前僅有少量文獻從翻譯學視角探究危機溝通。現有研究力在提升翻譯在災害情況下的作用，並主張在政府政策中更加重視社會的多語言和多元文化。學者們還調查了普通公民以眾包和志願者翻譯的形式積極參與危機翻譯的情況。這些公民譯員在協作翻譯信息時扮演不同的角色。然而，他們翻譯活動的有效性和可持續性可能會因缺乏專業培訓、系統的組織及其臨時性而受到影響。 非政府組織在提供翻譯服務時也遇到了這些挑戰 ，尤其是針對少數語言使用者的服務。本課題立足香港，旨在促進與當地尼泊爾和巴基斯坦南亞裔居民的危機溝通。少數族裔長期被社會忽視，學界就這一現象研究也不足。課題組引入協作翻譯，在理論的指導和科技的支持下，為社區和非政府組織搭建一個“實踐社群”。 課題組首先收集有關南亞居民就危機翻譯的體驗並分析收集到的資料。這一階段會用到的研究方法包括：分析新聞報道；評估政府網站上提供的危機信息；以及深入南亞社區和非政府組織實地觀察調研，並與社區居民和非政府組織工作人員交流和溝通。這些調研能從三方面提供關於與少數語言使用者進行危機溝通的現況：哪些信息以少數語言呈現、以什麼樣的方式傳遞與溝通、其可接受程度如何。另外，我們還可以在這一階段研究瞭解到南亞居民的語言能力和溝通需求，以及社區和非政府組織兩個利益相關群體在危機溝通方面遇到的困難。在深入瞭解了使用少數語言進行危機溝通的現狀後，課題組會引入公民翻譯培訓課程，在該課程實施階段，人與機器同時會參與到協作翻譯當中，並扮演重要角色。課題組會觀察和评估參與者之間的協作翻譯，參與者和機器之間的協作翻譯，以及翻譯過程中非政府組織工作人員與南亞裔居民之間的互動。本課題成果會大大有助於我們理解協作翻譯的過程、非專業翻譯，以及翻譯培訓。除此之外，課題成果還包括一套成熟的研究方法論，該方法論亦可用於其他重點關注翻譯過程和翻譯活動參與者的相關研究。

22611523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
22611523.value: 情境性民族主義：透過網路遊記的資料探勘分析中國旅行者的民族框架

22611523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
22611523.value: Despite many predictions of its inevitable decline, nationalism has become a recurring phenomenon of the contemporary world. Recent studies of nationalism have treated the nation as commonsensical, performed, and embodied—as a powerful, flexible frame of action that persists most forcefully outside of full-throated pronouncements and dramatic moments. The background assumption is that people do not think through the nation all the time; rather, national thinking and feelings are triggered in variable places and times. While qualitative work has associated nationalism with objects, events, holidays, spaces, landmarks, and consumer practices, there is an absence of comparative perspectives, using control groups of triggering phenomena to understand when nationalist framings arise and when they do not. There is also a lack of systematic tracing of independent and dependent variables, and larger datasets are rare. One solution to the problems of reliance on surveys and major events to interpret the nation as construct is to use naturally occurring data, which is better able to capture the behavioral and discursive expressions of the nation in actual contexts. My proposed project will use quantitative analyses of a large dataset taken from naturally occurring data—online travelogues—to map out the types of spaces, places, and situations that elicit political reactions and emotions from Chinese citizens and compare them to non-nationalistic situations. By examining across the various situations expressed in travelogue form, this study can more precisely map the appearance of national frames and trace how national identities are invoked across social and geographic space. To do this, the PI will use first use text mining tools to create a random sample of travelogues from the Chinese website Mafengwo. Next, these travelogues will be coded for various situations. Because of the sheer volume of situations, this project will look at keywords and phrases representing “peak experiences”, emotional moments where the travel diarists express surprise, shock, disappointment, pride, etc. Finally, once these situations are collected, they will be coded for relevant dependent variables (whether the nation is invoked, the valence [positive/negative/neutral] of the reactions, etc.) and independent variables (the type of situation, specific location, foreign/domestic encounter, etc.). Other modeled independent variables will include destination, travel companions, gender of author, age, and length of trip. These variables will be placed in statistical models to determine the factors that are more likely to produce nationalistic responses than non-nationalistic responses, understanding how geography and individual factors produce nation-inflected moments. 儘管許多人預測民族主義會不可避免地式微，但它已成為當代世界上一個反覆出現的現象。最近的民族主義研究將國家視為一種常識、表演/執行 和具體化的存在，作為一種強大而靈活的行動框架，最為持久地存在於非全情投入的聲明和戲劇性的時刻之外。背後假設是人們並不總是為國家著想；相反，民族思維和情感是在不同地點和時間觸發的。 定性研究儘管將民族主義與物件、事情、節日、空間、地標和消費實踐聯繫起來，但缺失了比較觀點，未能使用對照組觸發的現象來了解民族主義框架何時出現、何時不出現。同時亦欠缺對獨立和依賴變數的系統追踪，加上較大型的資料集也相當少見。要解決依靠調查和重大事件來解釋民族建構問題，方法是使用自然發生的數據，這樣更能捕捉到民族在實際情境中的行為和言論表達。 我提出的計畫是使用大量自然發生的數據──網路遊記──進行定量分析，以勾畫出哪些類型的空間、地點和情境能引發中國公民的政治反應和情感，並將其與非民族主義情境進行比較。通過研究遊記形式中表達的各種情境，本研究可以更精確地描繪國家框架的出現，並追蹤民族認同如何在社會和地理空間中被喚起。 為了實現這一目標，首先，主要研究人員將使用文本探勘工具從中國網站「馬蜂窩」中隨機選取一批遊記。接下來，這些遊記將根據各種情境進行編碼。由於情境數量龐大，本計畫將關注關鍵詞和短語，代表「高峰體驗」，即旅遊日誌中遊客表達驚訝、震驚、失望、自豪等情感的時刻。最後，一旦收集到這些情境，將對相關的依賴變數（是否引用國家、反應的價值取向\[正面/負面/中性\]等）和獨立變數（情境類型、具體位置、國內/國外經歷等）進行編碼。其他建模的獨立變數將包括目的地、旅行伴侶、作者性別、年齡和旅行持續時間。這些變數將被放入統計模型中，以確定哪些因素更有可能產生民族主義反應，而非民族主義反應，並了解地理和個人因素如何產生與國家相關的時刻。

23200223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23200223.value: 將視覺語言特徵納入科學文獻摘要

23200223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23200223.value: 自 COVID-19 出現以來，已經發表了數以萬計的研究論文（尤其是在醫學等科學領域），僅靠人工很難跟踪如此快速的進展。前所未有的緊迫性迫切需要先進的自然語言處理（NLP）技術來進行科學文獻摘要，以幫助科學家快速掌握文獻中的主要見解。科學文獻被認為是視覺豐富的文檔，不僅傳達文本，還傳達丰富的視覺語言內容，例如圖形和版式，它們攜帶重要信息。例如，圖形可以補充文本摘要，項目符號佈局等排版可以表示研究亮點。因此，總結文獻需要一個結合文本、圖形和版式的多模態模型。然而，科學 NLP 的發展尚未跟上這一趨勢，前沿的總結者大多是純文本的。這奠定了該提案的目標：研究視覺語言信息在科學概括中的使用。視覺語言信息已被證明對於文本理解任務很有用。我認為它對於文本生成也很有用。特別是，我將設計一個摘要框架來有效連接文本、圖形和版式，並利用新穎的融合機制在空間（例如，文本-圖形比率）、結構（例如，兄弟文本-圖形）和語義上聚合它們水平（例如，文本-圖形互補性）。為了進一步讓我的摘要器具備科學領域知識，我將設計一組多模態預訓練任務，這不僅豐富了我的摘要器的科學文檔的獨特屬性（例如，按章節內容），而且還學習了交叉不同模式之間的對應關係（例如，在了解每個論文部分的文本-圖形比例的情況下生成多模式摘要）。最後，將開發一個基準，即 Paper2Poster，以進一步評估我的摘要器推進實際科學摘要任務的潛力。 Paper2Poster 不僅要求摘要者俱備抽像源/輸入論文中的視覺和文本內容的技能，而且還要求能夠以視覺結構的佈局輸出它們以進行海報演示（例如，之字形）。相應地，我將使用一個新的概率生成模型來擴展我的摘要器，該模型支持基於摘要內容語義的內容感知佈局生成。雖然該提案旨在開發用於科學摘要的創新多模態解決方案，但其研究成果對於摘要之外的應用也很有價值，這些應用還需要視覺吸引力和有效的消息/想法溝通，並最終將有助於開發具有有效視覺通信的智能機器技能。

23502523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23502523.value: 當顧客的感激之情讓表面行為變得更有價值時：自我增強理論的角度

23502523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23502523.value: Surface acting is often thought to be an undesirable emotional labor strategy. Yet, this assumption is typically made based on the theoretical understanding of surface acting without considering factors that may shape the service experience of employees. Drawing from self-enhancement theory (Swann et al., 1987, 1989), I propose that service employees feel a greater sense of self-worth when customers react with gratitude to their surface acting than when they engage in deep acting. Specifically, these service employees would perceive themselves to be more competent. Further, to enhance their standings in the organization, service employees perceiving themselves to be more competent would engage in more helping behavior to their coworkers and engage in more creativity at work. Taken together, the present research challenges the dominant consensus that engaging in surface acting often leads to negative outcomes. Consequently, I highlight potential theoretical and practical implications that future research and practice should pay more attention to. 表面行為通常被認為是一種不良的情緒勞動策略。 然而，這種假設通常是基於對表面行為的理論理解而做出的，沒有考慮可能影響服務員工服務體驗的因素。 根據自我增強理論（Swann et al., 1987, 1989)，我認為，當顧客對他們的表面行為表現出感激之情時，服務員工比他們進行深層行為時會感受到更大的自我價值感。 具體來說，這些服務員工會認為自己更有能力。 此外，為了提高他們在組織中的地位，認為自己更有能力的服務員工會為同事提供更多幫助，並在工作中發揮更多創造力。 總而言之，目前的研究挑戰了主流共識，即表面行為往往會導致負面結果。 因此，我強調了未來研究和實踐應更多關注的潛在理論和實踐意義。

23502823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23502823.value: 探寻医疗领域中的多任务处理

23502823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23502823.value: Physicians often have to conduct different tasks simultaneously, manage multiple cases, and make a considerable number of decisions. The practice of multitasking has become increasingly pervasive and seems to be unavoidable, yet it has received little research attention. How does multitasking affect the productivity and quality of healthcare? How should multitasking be implemented? Providing a full and rigorous answer is highly challenging and has important implications for the design of effective policies to improve healthcare delivery. In this project, we will conduct thorough analyses on the impact of multitasking on physician decision-making and the quality of care, both empirically and theoretically. First, we will employ an administrative dataset of over 250,000 emergency department visits in a Southeast Asian country. Using these data, we will develop visit-level measures of physician multitasking that captures the complexity of patients concurrently managed by the physician. We will study how the level of multitasking affects treatment decisions and outcomes. We will further study how the variety of multitasked cases, conditional on the number of multitasked cases, affects the efficiency and quality of physician decision-making. Finally, we will explore how those effects vary along patient conditions, hospital environments, and physician characteristics. In the second stage, we will test the generalizability of our findings in other healthcare settings, both qualitatively and quantitively. We will conduct interviews with and seek suggestions from medical practitioners in different healthcare sections. We have also started collecting healthcare data in mainland China and Hong Kong and will conduct the multitasking analysis using the new data to get a more thorough understanding of multitasking in health care. Lastly, we will develop a theory of multitasking in health care and draw policy implications, based on the findings of the first two stages and those in the literature. We aim to develop a theoretical model that underlies multitasking and decision-making in healthcare. With a better understanding of multitasking and its consequences, our study aims to shed light on how multitasking should be implemented to maximize the productivity of healthcare providers and minimize medical errors. To summarize, our studies will systematically investigate various aspects of the multitasking behavior in health care, and offer strategies for improving efficiency and quality of care. Although our analysis will be rooted in Asian healthcare institutions, it will offer rich scientific and policy insights that have the potential for global impacts. 医生们经常需要同时执行多项任务、管理多个病例并做出大量决策。多任务处理的实践变得越来越普遍且不可避免，但却鲜有研究关注。多任务处理如何影响医疗保健的生产效率和质量？医疗领域中应该如何安排多任务？对这些问题提供全面且严谨的答案是非常具有挑战性的，但对于设计有效的医疗保健政策以改善服务至关重要。在本项目中，我们将从实证和理论两方面对多任务处理对医生决策和诊疗质量的影响进行全面的分析。在第一阶段，我们将使用超过250,000个急诊就诊的行政数据，衡量医生的多任务处理程度，并研究多任务处理程度的高低如何影响医生决策和患者治疗结果。我们还将研究在给定多任务处理数量的情况下，多任务处理的病例种类和构成如何影响医生决策的效率和质量。此外，我们将探讨这些影响如何随着患者病情、医院环境和医生特征而变化。在第二阶段，我们将在其他医疗保健领域定量和定性地测试我们的研究结果。我们将与不同医疗领域的医疗从业者进行访谈并寻求建议，收集更多的医疗保健数据，并使用新数据进行分析，以更全面地了解医疗保健中的多任务处理。最后，我们将基于第一和第二阶段的研究结果和文献中的研究结果，探索出医疗保健中的多任务处理理论，并提出政策建议。我们旨在开发一个理论模型，深入探讨医疗保健中的多任务处理和决策制定。通过更好地理解多任务处理及其影响，我们的研究将为实现医疗保健提供更高效、更高质量的服务提供策略。

23601323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23601323.value: 仕女畫中衣飾重要性的演變——吳友如與上海的媒介轉向（1870–1920 年代）

23601323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23601323.value: Late nineteenth-century and early Republican Shanghai witnessed an influx of foreign pictures, ideas, and technologies. Images of women were produced and disseminated in art forms other than traditional Chinese painting, including newly introduced lithographic prints and photographs. Advancements in printing and a thriving publishing industry facilitated the rise of pictorial magazines and periodicals. The adoption of these new visual imaging technologies from the 1870s to the 1920s marked the media turn in the mass production, reproduction, and appropriation of images of women across mediums, and they played a pivotal role in promoting the visibility of women in the male-dominated public sphere. Depictions of women’s clothes, including both the latest fashions and traditional robes, shaped a larger current of images of women in both legacy and novel mediums. By identifying fashion as a medium, this project investigates how women in pictorial representations were clothed, fashioned, and mediated in the turn-of-the-century visual and media revolution, an approach that has been overlooked in current art historical accounts of Chinese figure paintings of women. The notion of fashion shaped by socio-cultural forces was closely related to the agency of arbiters such as courtesans, painters, photographers, editors, publishers, textile and clothing makers and was facilitated by an emerging modern Chinese textile industry and a burgeoning mass media. This project takes an art historical and gendered approach to examining the role of fashion as creative agency and an integral part of print and media culture in the commercial, cosmopolitan city of Shanghai. To fill the lacuna in studies of female figure paintings and fashion in Qing China, this project focuses on Wu Youru (d. 1894), a prolific painter and image-making entrepreneur in a modernizing Shanghai, who remained a marginalized artisan in his time due to artistic and social hierarchies. It demonstrates Wu’s unprecedented role in fashioning pictorial traditions through his new aesthetic paradigm, which was simultaneously related to visual culture at the turn of the twentieth century and clearly distinguished from the classical mode. This project scrutinizes how gendered stereotypes and sexuality are represented and interpreted through the lenses of clothing, media, Chinese artistic tradition, and theories of fashion, replication, and gender, thereby revealing the intermediality and interactivity between mediums that have influenced the development of the arts.

23602623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23602623.value: 《地圖以外，銀幕之上：1978-1993年的中國進口電影》

23602623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23602623.value: 本研究聚焦從 1978 年到 1993 年間——即由「改革開放」開始，到為進口電影引入「票房分帳制度」為止——的中國電影市場，透過分析進口電影在中國的發行狀況、內容及營銷策略，探討二十世紀末全球媒體透過「差異性」而產生的交匯（Tsing，2004）。 過往對於這段時期（1978-1993）的中國電影研究，大多集中研究毛澤東時代電影的意識形態，以及自90年代中期開始進口荷里活“十大”電影帶來的巨大市場增長及巨額利潤。不少學者忽略了這段時期亦是大量中國民眾投入觀看電影，以及中國與其它媒體行業進行多樣化合作的高峰。在這段時期，題材多樣化的進口電影在中國市場極受歡迎，而這項被過往學術研究忽略的課題，構成本研究的題目——《地圖以外，銀幕之上：1978-1993年的中國進口電影》。本研究希望探討以下問題：該批進口電影如何令中國電影集團公司沿用的篩選準則產生變化？中國電影集團公司及其全球合作夥伴（尤其是在英國、美國和香港）之間的交易面臨甚麼挑戰和機遇？當時中國電影業的副文字（paratexts）——例如電影的宣傳品和電影流行雜誌等——如何呈現進口電影的內容和電影製作人？ 本研究借鑑Havens、Lotz和Tinic（2009）對媒體產業的批判研究理論，研究方法包括分析政治、經濟及社會方面的權力關係及運作；透過檔案研究、訪談、分析電影政策及電影的營銷材料，本研究希望指出1978-1993年間中國的進口電影，是一個常被忽略，但構成研究中國「後社會主義」的重要部分。參考Chris Berry的定義，「後社會主義」即「生成[中華人民共和國]社會文化形態的一個前所未有、根本性而持續的轉變過程。」(Berry, 2004: 4)本研究亦希望成為一個「全球南方」（the Global South）媒體市場的案例研究，揭示「全球南方」媒體市場如何融入跨國媒體行業的潮流（包括荷里活本身，及荷里活以外）（Schatz, 2014; Toby Miller等, 2005）。 本研究將是論述「中國大陸電影業加入全球媒體洪流」的學術著作的關鍵組成部分。本研究將深化、推動多個子領域的學術研究，包括跨國電影發行研究、重新審視「全球南方」媒體產業，以及電影混合經濟（包括正式與非正式）的運作模式。而對於嶺南的學生及相關研究者，本研究將收集並展示電影營銷和宣傳材料，讓有興趣的人士可以接觸這批從過去不同重要時刻蒐集而來的研究資料。

23603123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23603123.value: 爭奪非洲的數字基礎設施：電纜、基站、與中國在加納的通信公司

23603123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23603123.value: The encounter between “global China” and “digital Africa” in the 21st century has become a disruptive force in reshaping geopolitics and the global internet. As the global battle for digital supremacy intensifies, Africa’s digital infrastructure has emerged as a pivotal site of geopolitical competition. Facilitated by grand strategies such as the Belt and Road Initiative, Chinese tech companies are playing an instrumental role in building Africa’s digital infrastructure. Yet grounded empirical research remains rare to understand China’s digital rise in the Global South from the infrastructural perspective. This proposed project aims to fill this gap through the ethnography of digital infrastructure in Africa. Using digital infrastructure as an analytical lens, this project will investigate China-Africa engagement through the case of Ghana, a rising digital hub and the second-largest economy in West Africa. Focusing on two critical internet infrastructures—fiber optic cables and mobile base stations, this project will explore how Chinese tech companies such as Huawei have financed, designed, and constructed Ghana’s digital infrastructure, which will shed new light on China’s digital rise and the shifting geopolitics of the internet. This project will employ a multi-sited and multi-method approach by combining three research methods—ethnography, in-depth interviews, and document analysis. Based on ethnographic fieldwork, I will map the networks and mechanisms of digital infrastructure building in Ghana. Situating Huawei in both local and global contexts, I will explore how it cooperates and competes with a wide range of actors in laying fiber optic cables and building base stations in Ghana, especially in rural areas. This project has three major goals. (i) First, it will examine the “techno-politics” of digital infrastructure building in Ghana by viewing it as a site of geopolitical struggle and capitalist competition. (ii) Second, it will explore the “cultural politics” of digital infrastructure by looking at the discourses and cultural meanings people have constructed during the stages of design, construction, and everyday use in the Ghanaian context. (iii) Last, this research will theorize how China’s infrastructural capitalism is articulated, manifested, negotiated, and reshaped in China-Ghana context. By offering an empirically grounded and theoretically reflexive account of China-Ghana infrastructural engagement, this research will contribute to the interdisciplinary area of media and communication studies, China-Africa studies, and infrastructure studies. Evidence and insights gained from this research will also inform various policy makers regarding the opportunities and pitfalls arising from this digital infrastructure rivalry. “全球中國”與“數字非洲”這兩股新興力量在21世紀的相遇正在重塑全球互聯網形態與地緣政治。當全球數字霸權的爭奪賽日趨激烈之時，非洲的數字基礎設施正在成為地緣競爭的重要場所。得益於諸如“一帶一路”的大型戰略計劃，中國科技公司在建設非洲數字基礎設施的過程中發揮了舉足輕重的作用。但是，目前學術界仍然十分缺乏扎實的實證研究，以從基礎設施的視角來解釋中國在全球南方的數字崛起。 此項研究旨在通過對非洲數字基礎設施的民族志考察來填補這一空白。本研究將以加納為例來探究中非之間的數字基礎設施交往——它不僅是西非第二大經濟體而且是這一區域正在崛起的一個數字中心。具體而言，本研究將會關注中國科技公司（如華為）如何在加納投資、設計、以及建造兩種關鍵的互聯網基礎設施——光纖電纜與通訊基站，以幫助理解中國的數字崛起以及互聯網的地緣政治嬗變。 本項研究將綜合運用民族志、深度訪談、以及文獻研究法等三種研究方法。通過在中國與加納等地的多點民族志，我將繪製加納數字基礎設施建設的行動者網絡與動力學。將中國通信公司如華為置於本地與全球語境，我將探究它們如何與多元的行動者一起合作和競爭，以在加納鋪設光纖電纜與通訊基站，尤其是在農村地區。此項研究有三個主要的研究目標。第一，考察加納數字基礎設施建設的“技術政治”，關注數字基礎設施如何成為全球地緣競爭與資本競爭的一個重要場所。第二，考察加納數字基礎設施建設的“文化政治”，關注相關行動者圍繞數字基礎設施的設計、建造、以及日常使用所建構的話語及其文化意義。第三，解釋與理論化中國的基礎設施資本如何在加納的語境中被講述、展演、協商、與重塑。 基於在地的實證研究與理論反思，本研究所展現的中國與加納之間的數字基礎設施交往將拓展媒介與傳播研究、中非研究、以及基礎設施研究。本項研究的研究發現將有助於政策製定者理解數字基礎設施競賽所帶來的機會與挑戰。

23603223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23603223.value: In fields ranging from philosophy and cognitive science to economics and psychology, human behavior is standardly taken to be determined by a combination of two basic types of attitudes: cognitive (or belief-like) and conative (or desire- or preference-like). In modeling this behavior and the rules for what makes it rational, though, there is a significant puzzle regarding the ultimate structure of our basic conative attitudes. The puzzle, very roughly, is that it is far from clear that either of the leading candidates for ultimately explaining the conative side of (rational) human behavior, desire or preference, can play all the roles we need it to in properly modeling this behavior. Desires—which are essentially monistic, in that they concern single states or features—more naturally explain how it is we ultimately evaluate the particular features of our options (we want them), whereas preferences—which are essentially binary, in that they concern a ranking of one state or feature over another—more naturally explain how it is we ultimately choose between options (we prefer one to another). However, neither attitude neatly explains both. To properly model (rational) human behavior, then, we need an account of the nature of one of these attitudes (desire or preference) that explains everything about the nature of the other. That is, we need an account showing that one of the attitudes is more basic than, and ultimately explains the nature of, the other. My project will be to show that it is desire that is more basic than, and that ultimately explains the nature of, preference. Since preferences more naturally explain how our evaluations are reflected in outward, measurable choices, the view that preferences are the more basic attitude here has been the standard one, at least in fields where the empirical measurability of a hypothesis about the mind is a starting point for theorizing. I will thus offer a novel account of preference in terms of desire, and moreover, one that addresses a significant issue for views on which preference is the more basic attitude: the strong influence of context on choice. This influence has recently been suggested to cast doubt on the very idea of our having a stable set of basic preferences (and so conative attitudes) that determine choices, yet I will show that it casts no doubt at all on the idea of our having a stable set of basic desires. 从哲学和认知科学到经济学和心理学，人类行为通常被认为是由两种基本态度类型的组合决定的：认知（或类似信仰）和意动（或类似欲望或偏好）。 然而，在对这种行为及其理性规则进行建模时，关于我们基本意动态度的最终结构存在着一个重大难题。 非常粗略地说，这个谜题在于，最终解释（理性）人类行为、欲望或偏好的意向方面的主要候选者中的任何一个是否可以在正确建模这种行为时发挥我们需要的所有作用还远不清楚。 。 欲望——本质上是一元的，因为它们涉及单一状态或特征——更自然地解释了我们最终如何评估我们选择的特定特征（我们想要它们），而偏好——本质上是二元的，因为它们关注的是 一种状态或特征相对于另一种状态或特征的排名——更自然地解释我们最终如何在选项之间进行选择（我们更喜欢其中一个）。 然而，这两种态度都不能很好地解释两者。 那么，为了正确地模拟（理性）人类行为，我们需要对其中一种态度（欲望或偏好）的本质进行解释，以解释另一种态度的本质。 也就是说，我们需要一个说明，表明其中一种态度比另一种态度更为基本，并最终解释了另一种态度的本质。 我的项目将表明，欲望比偏好更基本，并且最终解释了偏好的本质。 由于偏好更自然地解释了我们的评估如何反映在外在的、可测量的选择中，因此偏好是更基本的态度的观点已经成为标准的观点，至少在以关于心灵的假设的经验可测量性为起点的领域中是如此。 用于理论化。 因此，我将从欲望的角度对偏好进行一种新颖的解释，而且，它解决了偏好是更基本态度的观点的一个重要问题：背景对选择的强烈影响。 这种影响最近被认为对我们拥有一套稳定的基本偏好（以及意动的态度）来决定选择的想法产生了怀疑，但我将证明它毫无疑问地对我们拥有一套稳定的基本偏好（以及意动的态度）的想法产生了怀疑。 一套稳定的基本愿望。

23603223.label: Realisation of objectives
23603223.value: The objectives have been fully achieved. Specifically, I have fully researched and written three papers for publication, two of which were accepted for publication—addressing Objective 1—and where these three papers fully address Objectives 2, 3, and 4. The more precise details are as follows. Paper 1: “Preference as Desire.” I have completed the research and the full manuscript for the paper “Preference as Desire,” addressing Objective 1. This paper has been accepted for publication in the Journal of Philosophy, widely regarded as a top 5 journal in philosophy. This paper addresses both Objective 2 and Objective 3. Specifically, it argues that desire is our most basic conative attitude, or the attitude that combines with belief to ultimately determine our actions, and thus that the ultimate structure of this attitude is monistic. Moreover, it challenges the decision-theoretic dogma that preference is the most fundamental conative attitude, and argues instead that desire is the most fundamental conative attitude. The significance of this result is indicated by the quality of journal the paper was accepted in. Paper 2: “Desire, Aversion, and Welfare.” I have completed the research and the full manuscript for the paper “Desire, Aversion, and Welfare,” addressing Objective 1. This paper has been accepted for publication in Analysis, widely regarded as a top 10 journal in philosophy. As anticipated, my research on the other two papers listed here helped me to see there was a directly related gap in the literature that I have filled with this paper. Specifically, I argue that important views linking desire to well-being or welfare are fundamentally flawed, in virtue of facts about the nature of desire. My noticing these facts about desire and their relation to well-being were a direct result of my research on the other two papers mentioned here. This is thus the third paper I mention in Objective 1. Paper 3: “How Framing Affects Choice: A Desire-First View.” I have completed the research and the full manuscript for the paper “How Framing Affects Choice: A Desire-First View,” addressing Objective 1. This paper is under review at a top 5 journal in philosophy. This paper addresses both Objective 3 and Objective 4. Specifically, it builds on my results in Paper 1—“Preference as Desire”—above, and continues my challenge of the decision-theoretic dogma that preference is the most fundamental conative attitude, and argues instead that desire is the most fundamental conative attitude. Additionally, it develops a solution to a significant puzzle in the study of rational decision-making, relating to how framing can affect choice, in terms of my “desire-first” framework. As this indicates, all four of my Objectives have been fully achieved.

23603223.label: Major findings and research outcome
23603223.value: This research project has successfully challenged a fundamental assumption in decision theory through three interconnected papers. The central finding establishes that desire, not preference, is the primary conative attitude that combines with belief to determine human action. In “Preference as Desire,” accepted for publication in the Journal of Philosophy (and to be published Open Access), I demonstrate that the structure of our fundamental conative attitude is monistic rather than comparative. This paper provides a novel framework reversing the traditional explanatory relationship between desire and preference, arguing that preferences should be understood as derivatives of more basic desire states. The acceptance of this work by a top-5 philosophy journal indicates the significance of this theoretical reorientation. Building on this foundation, “How Framing Affects Choice: A Desire-First View” (currently under review) applies the desire-first framework to resolve a persistent puzzle in rational decision theory. By reconceptualizing framing effects through the lens of desire rather than preference, this paper demonstrates how seemingly irrational choice patterns can be coherently explained, preserving the feasibility of modeling rational decision-making. This solution represents a significant advancement in addressing theoretical challenges that have troubled decision theorists. The research additionally yielded an important third paper, “Desire, Aversion, and Welfare,” accepted for publication in Analysis (and to be published Open Access), which is widely regarded as a top 10 journal in philosophy. This work identifies critical flaws in established theories connecting desire to well-being, offering important refinements to our understanding of how desire relates to welfare. These insights emerged directly from the deeper investigation of desire undertaken in the other two papers. Together, these papers constitute a cohesive challenge to decision-theoretic orthodoxy, offering a more plausible explanation of human decision-making by prioritizing desire over preference. This “desire-first” approach not only resolves existing theoretical puzzles but also opens new avenues for understanding human motivation and action. The acceptance of two papers in top-10 philosophy journals, with a third under review, confirms the scholarly significance and theoretical contribution of this research project.

23603223.label: Potential for further development of the research and the proposed course of action
23603223.value: The desire-first framework established in this research opens several promising avenues for future inquiry. The reconceptualization of preference as derivative of desire invites further theoretical exploration, particularly regarding how this approach might resolve other persistent puzzles in decision theory. One potential direction would be examining how the desire-first model applies to temporal choice problems and interpersonal utility comparisons. Additionally, the implications for welfare theory identified in “Desire, Aversion, and Welfare” suggest an opportunity to reconsider fundamental assumptions in theories of well-being. While my current project is complete, these unexplored dimensions demonstrate the richness of the desire-first paradigm and its potential to continue challenging established orthodoxy in decision theory. Future researchers may find fertile ground in these theoretical territories, building upon the foundation established in my three papers. In terms of future plans, I aim to explore the implications of my work in “Desire, Aversion, and Welfare” especially, and to continue research into the fundamental assumptions in theories of well-being.

23603223.label: Layman's Summary ofCompletion Report
23603223.value: This research challenges a basic assumption about how humans make decisions. Most theories assume that when we choose between options, we rely on preferences—comparisons like “I prefer chocolate to vanilla.” My research argues this gets things backward. Our choices actually stem from simpler feelings of desire—“I want chocolate”—and preferences are built from these basic desires. This insight matters because many theories about rational decision-making hit roadblocks when trying to explain certain puzzles, like why the way choices are described (their “framing”) can change what we choose. My work shows that if we start with desires rather than preferences, these puzzles become solvable. The value of this research extends beyond academic debate. How we understand human motivation affects fields ranging from economics to public policy. If preferences are merely derived from desires, rather than fundamental, we might need to reconsider how we measure well-being and evaluate policy outcomes. The publication of these ideas in top philosophy journals indicates their significance to our understanding of human decision-making and potentially opens new approaches to long-standing questions about rationality and choice.

23605023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23605023.value: 工厂人道主义:后社会主义的工厂

23605023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23605023.value: This project seeks to examine the cultural and intellectual history of the factory in the first decade of China’s reform project. It does so specifically through the lens of aesthetics and the theoretical discourse of humanism. Subsequent to the end of the Cultural Revolution, Chinese intellectuals engaged in what later became known as the “aesthetics fever” (meixue re), much of which was centred around a rejection of the highly dogmatic readings of Marx and Marxism that had characterized the Maoist period in favour of a return to the early Marx and his associated vocabulary of alienation, creative labour and species-being. The turn to the early Marx provided, in turn, the impetus for a renewed engagement with the field of Soviet aesthetics, and in particular Soviet ideas about the beautification or aestheticization of labour under the conditions of developed socialism. Within a complex and shifting field of currents and influences, the Soviet-authored discourse of “technical” or “labour” aesthetics (variously translated in Chinese as “jishu meixue”, “shengchan meixue” and “laodong meixue”) provided Chinese intellectuals with a way of imagining what labour in general and the factory in particular would be like under the changed conditions of the reform period. They drew from their Soviet interlocutors the possibility that aesthetic experience would be contained not only within the delimited field of art, but in the immediate conditions of labour itself, such that labour would take on the creative possibility of an artistic act, one compatible with the utopian visions of Marxist humanism. These Soviet ideas came to mediate between, on the one hand, the intellectual currents surrounding Marx’s conception of the human, and, on the other, practical imaginaries of what factories should be, above all in relation to the spatial contours of the factory, including such quotidian affairs as the introduction of gardens into factory settings, the use of colour and music on the shopfloor, and the aesthetic relation between workers, their machines and the products of their labour. The return to Soviet aesthetics in the first decade of China’s reform process and the final decade of the Soviet Union itself thereby came to authorize a new understanding of the human, the factory and socialist labour, as well as a turn away from the politics of class struggle that had dominated the Cultural Revolution. 本项目以中国改革开放初期与苏联社会主义后期的一系列理论交流为出发点，围绕马克思主义人文主义的概念语汇和“技术美学”理论。 -中国改革开放初期美学的出现，见证了早期马克思主义词汇的物种存在、异化和非异化劳动的广泛接受，同时伴随着20世纪60年代和70年代兴起的对苏联美学发展的兴趣浪潮 最重要的是，中国美学家对苏联的“技术美学”领域充满热情，这标志着苏联美学思想的潮流，将美的可能性扩展到艺术品或文学创作的有限空间之外，以设想工厂劳动如何成为一种审美。 通过在马克思主义人文主义背景下追踪这些美学思潮的轨迹，我展示了苏中美学相遇如何影响后毛泽东时代工厂和后社会主义的形成。

23605323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23605323.value: 可塑性、流動性與閾限性：重構東南亞華文文學中的冷戰青年

23605323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23605323.value: This project focuses on five critical, yet under-discussed Sinophone writers and seeks to understand how the figure of the youth in their works on Southeast Asia was used to negotiate ideas of nationalism, ethnicity, gender, and class during the Cold War. Often regarded as drivers of revolution and rebellion, the figure of the youth has taken on extraordinary political and cultural significance in 20th century global history. In modern Chinese history and literature, the youth has been construed as an integral symbol of national rejuvenation since the publication of Chen Duxiu’s treatise “A Call to Youth” in the Republican-era periodical New Youth. While scholars have studied the literary genealogies of the New Youth in modern Chinese literary representations during the 20th century, the question of how this trope of youth travelled and translated into Sinophone contexts, particularly during the Cold War, has yet to become an object of sustained inquiry. Joining conversations in the fields of modern Chinese literature, Sinophone studies, and Cold War studies, this project argues that representations of the youth in Sinophone Southeast Asian literature should not only be understood in conjunction with its modern Chinese literary lineages, but also within the context of the global Cold War. It focuses on the period when local nationalist and decolonization struggles of Southeast Asian countries coincided with the Cold War. Part One of my project discusses how the idea of New Youth translated into Southeast Asia during the Cold War through an examination of southbound Chinese intellectual Hu Yuzhi’s science fiction. Part Two focuses on the journeys of young male soldiers, teachers, and students represented in the novels of Vietnam-born Taiwanese writer Pan Lei and Indonesian Chinese writer Huang Dongping to highlight a gendered imagination of youth and nationhood. Part Three takes a retrospective look at the Cold War through Singapore-born Chinese writer Wang Xiaoping and China-born Malaysian writer Bai Yao’s autobiographical novels and examines how writers remembered and projected their young selves into their respective societies through the act of writing. Collectively, they demonstrate that the engendering of the youth in Sinophone Southeast Asian literature takes on a more polemical dimension than its Chinese counterpart given its implications of nationalism, ethnicity, and gender. They reveal the contesting modernities envisioned through the figure of the Cold War youth. The project outcome includes conference participation, two peer-reviewed journal articles, and a book manuscript for publication with a major university press. 二戰後的東南亞不僅見證了解殖與獨立民族運動的興起，同時也面臨著意識形態壁壘的冷戰格局。本研究計畫旨在梳理「青年」論述在二十世紀東南亞華文文學場域的發展脈絡，並瞭解東南亞華文文學中的青年形象如何成爲冷戰時期辯證與協商民族主義、種族、性別和階級等概念的重要場域。 綜觀二十世紀的世界歷史，「青年」一向被視為革命與民族運動的主力，具有非凡的政治與文化意義。在中國語境下，陳獨秀在《新青年》發表〈敬告青年〉一文後，「新青年」這一形象除了化為振興與改革中華民族文化的重要象徵，同時也成為中國現代文學中常見的核心人物。有關二十世紀中國現代文學的青年論述與形象研究成果豐碩，但相比之下，「新青年」的概念如何傳播至東南亞語境和影響當地華人作家的文學創作，卻尚未得到充分關注。有鑑於此，本計畫將結合中國現代文學研究、文化冷戰研究以及華語語系研究等三種研究視角，聚焦五位關鍵但鮮少被討論的華文作家及其作品，其中包括：抗戰時期下南洋的中國作家胡愈之、越南出生的台灣作家潘壘、印尼華人作家黃東平、新加坡出生的中國歸僑作家王嘯平，以及中國出生的馬來西亞華人作家白垚。本計畫通過分析這五位作家的作品，試著探究：究竟「新青年」的概念是以怎樣的形式傳入東南亞？成長於二十世紀動盪時代的東南亞華人作家如何以自己的革命、抗戰與離散經歷為題材，創作小說與撰寫回憶錄？作品中青年形象的建構又如何反映東南亞華人社群的文化、政治和民族認同的多樣性？筆者認為東南亞華文文學中的「冷戰青年」形象一方面繼承了中國「新青年」的精神面貌，另一方面亦被賦予更為複雜的時代意義，而這一形象可折射出東南亞華文文學現代性的多義性。

23605423.value: 小學生數碼安全的發展軌跡：識別風險和保護因素

23605423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23605423.value: 在數碼社會中，數碼素養對於我們（特別是年輕人）的日常生活而言越來越重要。除了數碼科技帶來的好處和機會之外，安全和可靠地使用數碼資訊和科技仍然面臨許多挑戰。然而，對於數碼安全發展軌跡的研究仍相當罕見。證據已經表明低社會經濟地位和父母教養方式對數碼素養有不良影響。為了更深入地理解社會經濟地位和父母教養方式如何與數碼安全發展軌跡相關聯，有必要確定這些關係下可能存在的中介和調節機制。同時，越來越多的人認識到執行功能和師生關係質量在數碼素養中發揮促進作用。然而，據我們所知，很少有研究同時探討執行功能和師生關係質量在家庭因素與數碼安全發展軌跡的關係中的作用。因此，本研究旨在識別小學高年級學生的數碼安全發展軌跡，並探索數碼安全發展軌跡模式的異質性。同時，本研究將結合家庭投資理論和依附理論，通過檢驗家庭因素（即社會經濟地位和父母教養方式）與數碼安全發展軌跡之間的直接關聯，執行功能的中介作用和師生關係質量的調節作用，將兩個學習環境（家庭和學校）聯繫在一起。此外，本研究將探索數碼安全發展軌跡的類別如何與家庭、學校和學生等因素相關聯。為了達到這些研究目標，本研究將採用長期追蹤研究設計，招募總共1,600名小學生，分別使用潛在成長曲線模型、潛在增長混合模型和多項邏輯回歸模型來解答六個研究問題。本研究將對現有的社會經濟地位、依附理論和數碼素養文獻做出貢獻。同時，本研究將有效促進旨在增強兒童的數碼安全技能和減少潛在的電子威脅（例如數據隱私和網絡欺凌）負面影響的教育計畫和項目的發展。此外，政府和非政府組織還可以制定針對低社會經濟地位學生的數碼安全政策。

23606023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23606023.value: 翻譯與現代藏語文的構建

23606023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23606023.value: Recently, a form of mixed speech dubbed ra-ma-lug skad ཪ་མ་ལུག་སྐད “neither-goat-nor-sheep language” has become a topic of scholarly interest. This nascent phenomenon of code-switching between Tibetan and Chinese is particularly popular among urban youth in Tibet. Sociolinguists and cultural studies scholars often associate the rise of ra-ma-lug skad with the marginalization of the Tibetan language. This proposed project builds on the premise that translation studies is particularly relevant when examining the formation of a Chinese-inflected, modern Tibetan vernacular. Following Tibet’s integration into the jurisdiction of the People’s Republic of China (PRC) in the 1950s, the Chinese government has set up specialized agencies, tasking them with translating Marxist pamphlets, textbooks, newspapers, and TV programs, as well as overseeing the coinage of technological, medical, and political neologisms based on Chinese precedents. However, sociolinguists and cultural studies scholars have thus far overlooked how state-endorsed mass translation projects, together with Chinese popular culture, have reshaped the lexicon and cultural references of modern colloquial Tibetan. This project aims to fill this void. In terms of methodology, it uses textual analysis to identify choices of translation strategies in a wide range of understudied primary materials. These sources include bilingual street slogans, textbooks, restaurant menus, and contemporary Chinese TV dramas dubbed into Tibetan. As such, this project seeks to demonstrate that the sustained, state-sanctioned translation of Chinese-language content into Tibetan since the 1950s has led to a protracted infusion of neologisms, new discourses, and novel modes of representation that helped Sinicize modern Tibetan diction in an efficacious yet inconspicuous way. In brief, this project draws on translation studies to better capture the features and intricacies of recent developments in Tibetan-Chinese bilingualism. 自1950年代起，大量的中文資料被翻譯成藏文。中國政府甚至成立了一系列機構來專門負責將政府文件、教材、報紙以及電視節目翻譯/譯製到包括藏語在內的少數民族語言。然而迄今爲止鮮有學者研究這些大規模翻譯行爲對藏語文産生了怎樣的影響。 該項目將旨在收集一系列包括街頭標語、教科書、以及電視劇在內的漢藏雙語原始語料幷通過對它們進行細緻的文本分析來準確描繪現代藏語文發展的最新特點以及背後的推動力。

23606823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
23606823.value: 風險倫理：如何在充滿不確定性的世界中合乎道德地生活

23606823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
23606823.value: It has been widely acknowledged that we need methods of ethical analysis that can successfully deal with risks and uncertainties in real life. There are different forms of risk and uncertainty, one of which is called low-probability, high-impact risk. The current COVID-19 pandemic has often been called a low-probability, high-impact risk that few people could have ever predicted. Yet, it has had massive negative impacts on society in different aspects. This project aims to provide a successful ethical analysis of how to deal with such low- probability, high-impact risk in real-life situations. The strategy is to first develop a new theoretical framework, namely non-expected utility maximization utilitarianism, which aims to provide a better account of the moral significance of low-probability, high-impact risks. The second stage is to apply the theoretical framework to solve real- life problems, with a particular focus on collective actions during pandemics. The first part of the project is to develop a new utilitarianism account of risk imposition that assimilates non-expected utility theories (hereinafter NEU). NEU is an alternative to the standard theory of choice under risk and uncertainty, namely the expected utility theory (hereafter EU). For example, an independence axiom underlies traditional EU, which implies that utilities and probabilities of outcomes are evaluated separately and then multiplied together. Some non-expected utility models (e.g., risk-weighted expected utility theory) replace the independence axiom with a weaker axiom, which allows interactions between probabilities and outcomes. Some non- expected utility theories (e.g., lexicographic utility theory) reject the axiom of continuity, which asserts that no outcome is so bad that one should reject risking it for the sake of the high chance of a marginal improvement on the status quo. Traditional utilitarianism often presumes the axioms of expected utility theory. The project will develop new forms of utilitarian account of risk, which does a better job than other versions in terms of addressing the moral significance of low-probability, high-impact risks. The new forms are inspired by NEU theories, including risk-weighted expected utility theory and lexicographic utility theory, respectively. The second part of the proposed project is to apply the new account of the morality of risk to the real world, focusing on collective actions during pandemics. I will show that the new NEU utilitarian theories can handle the collective harm problem in addressing the moral significance of mass masking during the COVID-19 pandemic. 摘要: 眾所周知，我們需要一個可以有效且成功處理應對我們日常生活中所面臨的不確定性和風險的倫理分析。這些風險和不確定性有很多種形式，其中一種風險，它發生的概率很低但是結果嚴重(low-probability high-stake risk)。比如2019 開始的全球新冠疫情，在它發生之前，普通大眾認為它發生的概率極低，但是這場疫情給我們生活的方方面面都帶來了極大的負面影響。 這項研究的目的是發展建立一個有效可行的倫理分析方法，用於處理在現實生活中面臨的類似於新冠疫情的風險。這項研究所採取的策略是首先建立一個新的理論框架，叫做基於非經典預期效用理論的功益主義 (non-expected utility theory utilitarianism)。非經典預期效用理論(non-expected utility theories)是有別於經典預期效用理論的一系列新的決策理論。一些非經典預期效用理論 將傳統的獨立性公理(independence axiom)弱化，以此允許概率方程和效用方程可以互相作用。另一些非經典預期效用理論否定了連續性公理(continuity axiom)，如此可以避免在任何情況下任何風險可以因為少量的邊際增長被忽略。此項目選擇Lara Buchak 的風險權重預期效用理論(risk-weighted expected utility theory)作為新功益主義的理論基礎。新的功益主義比傳統的基於經典預期效用理論的功益主義能更好的處理低概率高效用風險（low-probability high stake risk）。研究的第二階段，是將新理論運用於處理具體現實問題，主要關注的是大流行中的集體行為的倫理學問題。具體討論封城，全民接種疫苗等倫理基礎。

24102723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24102723.value: 新型樹突狀細胞亞群在抗癌免疫中的功能作用和調節機制

24102723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24102723.value: 免疫療法在實體瘤顯示出不同的治療效果， 加深了解腫瘤微環境（TME）可能會發現實體癌的精準治療策略。通過單細胞分辨率闡明非小細胞肺癌（NSCLC）的免疫動力學，我們出乎意料地發現了一種具有T細胞標誌物的獨特樹突狀細胞群，命名為“DCT”。它們表現出獨特的表型和轉錄組特徵，有別於樹突狀細胞、T 細胞和其他經典免疫細胞。 確定它們在 TME 中的功能和調節機制可能會揭示實體癌的精準治療策略。 我們報導了一種Smad3依賴性TME（Smad3-TME）可促進癌症進展，但其潛在機制仍不盡清楚。有趣的是，我們檢測到 DCT 豐度與 NSCLC 患者和同基因肺癌小鼠模型 LLC 的疾病進展呈 Smad3 依賴性負相關。 我們的初步數據表明，Smad3 的遺傳抑制可在體內和體外觸發小鼠和人漿細胞樣樹突狀細胞 (pDC) 的 DCT 發育。 此外，具有DCT表型的Smad3沉默pDC的過繼轉移在體內產生了更好的抗癌效果和T細胞激活能力。機制上，高階生物信息學分析揭示了T 細胞分化調節因子 Ikzf3 在 DCT 發育中的重要性。 Ikzf3 在 NSCLC 中的 DCT 中高表達，但沒有於其他 DC 亞型表達。 重要的是，我們的初步數據證明 TGF-β1/Smad3 信號傳導可以阻斷 pDC 中的 Ikzf3 轉錄，這可能代表了抑制 TME 中 DCT 免疫的保守機制。 基於這些新穎且令人興奮的發現，我們假設 DCT 是一種新型抗癌效應物，其發展可以通過 TGF-β1/Smad3 信號傳導在促腫瘤 TME 中被大幅度抑制。 因此，我們計劃通過研究 3 個具體目標來驗證以上假設：1）人類和小鼠促腫瘤 TME 中 DCT 抑制的證據； 2）確定DCT在體外和體內TME中的功能作用； 3) 最後，研究新型pDC特異性TGF-β1/Smad3/Ikzf3軸對基礎於DCT的免疫治療的調節機制和臨床意義。 我們希望通過本項研究確定DCT為新型抗癌效應物，證明Smad3-TME中被大幅抑制它以保持癌症進展，並展示 pDC 特異性 TGF-β1/Smad3/Ikzf3 免疫抑制軸作為TME 中的治療靶點用於增強 DCT抗癌免疫力對抗實體癌的可行性。 本項目的成果將具有高度創新性，並於科學和臨床上都具有重要意義。

24110323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24110323.value: II型輔助性T細胞在轉移性肝癌免疫治療耐藥性中的研究

24110323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24110323.value: 肝臟是惡性腫瘤常見的轉移部位，其中以結直腸癌（CRC）為主，其他像肺癌，胰腺癌和乳癌等也有不同比例的肝轉移病例。免疫檢查點抑制劑（ICI）的最新臨床研究進一步表明，在不同的晚期癌症患者中，沒有肝轉移的病人對ICI的藥物反應和療效明顯好過有肝轉移的病人，儘管這些晚期癌症病人也伴有其他器官如肺或者骨髓的轉移。在前臨床的機制研究中，有報道指出，肝臟中富集的CD11b+F4/80+FasL+巨噬細胞可以通過誘導殺傷性T細胞（CD8+T）的程序性死亡從而導致其耗竭，從而使機體產生對ICI的耐藥性。聚焦髓源性免疫抑制細胞（MDSC）和抗腫瘤的自然殺傷性T細胞（iNKT），我們研究組最近的研究結果也證明了肝臟免疫反應在轉移性肝癌的發展惡化和ICI耐藥性中的重要作用（Gut 2020; Cellular&Molecular Immunology，2021/2022）。然而，由於肝臟的複雜性和空間結構多層次的特點， 轉移性肝癌中ICI耐藥性的分子和細胞學機制仍有待進一步的解析。 在本項目的初步研究結果中，我們建立了對ICI耐藥的同步CRC和轉移性肝癌的原位小鼠模型。通過對該模型中肝臟單細胞的高通量流式細胞儀分析，首先，我們發現了和之前研究相似的結果，即肝轉移可以導致肝臟中CD11b+F4/80+Gr-1-巨噬細胞明顯增加。同時，我們發現輔助性T細胞（Th）的明顯減少，進一步的分析中表明這些Th細胞中，主要是T-bet-GATA3+Foxp3-II型（Th2），而不是常見的T-bet+GATA3-Foxp3-I型（Th1）和T-bet-GATA3-Foxp3+調節性T細胞（Treg）有數量上的變化，而且伴有白介素4（IL-4）的減少。這些新的發現可能和我們所研究建立的，和臨床病人相似度十分高的老鼠原位模型有關。的確，我們在有肝轉移癌症病人的肝臟浸潤性白細胞的單細胞測序結果的分析中，也進一步證明了Th2細胞特征基因（IL-4、IL-13等）和Th2轉錄因子GATA3的表達，相對於正常肝臟有明顯下降。同時，這些Th2細胞的基因評分與ICI療效相關指標，包括CD8+T細胞的功能耗竭，腫瘤血管增生成以及MMR指數成相關性。這些分析結果表明，Th2細胞的減少可能對肝轉移病人的ICI耐藥性有重要的調節作用。在我們建立的同位小鼠模型中，我們進一步測試了一種能激活Th2的藥物TSLP和ICI合用的免疫治療效果。結果如期證明Th2的活化可增加腫瘤對ICI的敏感性，減少腫瘤的生長速度。之前對Th2的研究主要集中在寄生蟲和細菌感染的相關領域，而最新的研究結果表明Th2可能對癌細胞的表型和腫瘤血管增生有抑制作用。因此，我們希望通過本項研究，進一步闡明Th2細胞在癌症肝轉移和ICI耐藥性中的重要調節作用以及作用機制，為肝轉移病人提供中新的藥物靶點，以期最大限度的提高ICI的療效。

24110523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24110523.value: 超聲內鏡引導交會技術 (EUS-guided rendezvous technique) 與早期預切乳頭切開術 (early precut papillotomy) 在內鏡逆行胰膽管造影術 (ERCP) 中膽管插管困難的治療成果比較：多中心隨機對照研究

24110523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24110523.value: 研究背景： 選擇性膽管插管是內鏡逆行膽胰管造影術（ERCP）治療良性和惡性膽胰疾病中最重要的步驟，但高達15%的病例可能會插管失敗。以體外膽道引流術作為膽管插管失敗的救援程序常與生活質量下降相關。預切乳頭切開術是一種先進的 ERCP 插管技術。雖然這技術是內窺鏡學會指引推薦用於救援膽管插管困難的方案，但它並非沒有局限性。超聲內鏡 (EUS) 引導膽道引流術是一種新型的介入性 EUS 技術，並越來越多在已使用先進的 ERCP 插管技術但仍無法進入膽管的患者中應用。 研究目標： 由於目前還沒有專門的多中心隨機對照研究來比較超聲內鏡引導交會技術 (EUS-guided rendezvous technique, EUS RV) 和早期預切乳頭切開術 (early precut papillotomy) 在膽管插管困難的患者中的治療效果，因此進行多中心隨機對照研究比較這兩種技術的首次膽管插管治療成果在臨床上具有非常重要的價值。 研究方法： 這將是一項由有豐富ERCP 和 EUS 經驗的醫生進行的前瞻性多中心隨機對照研究。 這研究將招募 188 名接受 ERCP並有原生膽管乳頭和膽管插管困難的患者。膽管插管困難的定義為 1) 10 次插管嘗試內膽管插管不成功，2) 插管 10 分鐘內膽管插管不成功，或 3) 2 次無意的胰管插管或胰管造影劑注射。合適的患者將以 1:1 的比例隨機分配使用超聲內鏡引導交會技術或早期預切乳頭切開術以進入膽道。 研究結果測量標準包括首次膽管插管的技術成功率、與手術相關的嚴重不良事件以及救援膽道引流術的使用率。 研究和臨床意義： -這將是第一個比較超聲內鏡引導交會技術和早期預切乳頭切開術對在ERCP 膽管插管困難患者的療效的多中心隨機對照研究，將對臨床應用有重要的影響。 這項研究將為腸胃科醫生和肝膽胰外科醫生在有良性或惡性膽胰疾病患者的ERCP臨床應用提供重要的第一級臨床研究證據。 -我們的研究結果可能有助減少 ERCP 膽管插管失敗，從而改善患者護理，減少救援性體外膽道引流術手術的需求，並減少體外引流導管相關的並發症和再次入院次數。 -我們的研究結果將有助腸胃膽胰病學會及內窺鏡學會制定 ERCP 膽管插管困難患者的治療指引，超聲內鏡引導膽道引流術的應用指引，以及現代進階內窺鏡醫生的先進 ERCP 和 EUS 引導膽道插管技術的培訓重點指引。

24200223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24200223.value: 一種構成式、全面且通用的三維視覺和自然語言學習框架

24200223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24200223.value: 近年來，視覺語言學習在大量圖像文本數據的學習方面取得了巨大成功，例如CLIP能夠匹配圖像和文本。最近，研究人員開始探索更具挑戰性但對許多實際應用至關重要的3D視覺語言學習，例如機器人學習和人機互動。然而，由於與2D任務相比，3D視覺語言學習在本質上存在差異，因此仍然處於探索不足的狀態。 首先，由於任務複雜度的提高，3D任務中的語言理解變得更加困難，其中基於實體的語言與面向任務的操作交織在一起。因此，迫切需要將複雜的語義分解為更簡單的形式。其次，僅獲得離散的分類標籤遠遠不足以理解3D場景。需要更豐富的信息，例如自然語言形式的描述。此外，像3D視覺語言導航這樣的3D應用還需要模型能夠處理動態變化的場景。構建滿足這些要求的表示仍然是現有方法無法解決的挑戰。第三，通用系統可以使用統一的模型架構和學習過程學習並完成各種任務。這種通用特性對於機器人在實際應用中執行多個任務至關重要。然而，3D視覺語言學習中的這一方向尚未得到充分開發。 為了解決這些挑戰，我們提出了一種構成式、全面且通用的3D視覺語言學習框架。我們提出了一種構成式語言到功能解釋過程，以改進3D任務中的語言理解。該過程自動將複雜文本解析為學習和可解釋的原子功能的組合，顯著減輕了適應複雜和新任務的困難。與此同時，通過將3D場景中的物體實體作為函數參數，我們的方法還提供了一種顯示實體與任務操作之間互動的表示方式。我們進一步提出了一種原創的3D場景語義表示，即實體表。與傳統的3D場景圖不同，我們的方法不僅更全面，而且與動態場景兼容。最後，我們提出了一個通用學習框架，統一解決各種3D視覺語言任務，充分釋放實際應用的潛力。 我們將在3D視覺語言任務上評估我們的系統，包括3D視覺定位、3D問答、3D場景語言解說以及動態場景中的任務，例如3D視覺語言導航。所有源代碼都將公開提供。該項目的成果將推動視覺語言學習的前沿，並在許多方面產生廣泛影響。
