24204023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24204023.value: 使用未標註數據提升RNA結構預測

24204023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24204023.value: 考慮到RNA分子在細胞信息傳遞和基因表達調控中的重要作用，以RNA為中心的研究，例如RNA藥物開發，包括RNA疫苗，最近得到了極大的促進，特別是在大流行期間。因此，對相關 RNA 的高分辨率結構信息的需求越來越大。 不幸的是，確定 RNA 結構比解析蛋白質結構更困難，並且通過實驗解析三級結構的 RNA 仍然很少。截至 2022 年 9 月，人們已經解析了 180000 個蛋白質結構，但僅解析了約 2000 個純 RNA 結構。包括 PI 團隊在內的研究人員已經開發出預測 RNA 結構的計算方法。然而，與準確預測蛋白質結構的 AlphaFold 不同，RNA 結構預測的工具還不夠準確。 現有的所有方法，包括PI以通訊作者或共同第一作者發表在Nature Communications、ICLR（口頭報告）、Briefings in Bioinformatics等相關論文，都嚴重依賴註釋數據。然而，如上所述，RNA 領域已解析的結構很少。如果只考慮標註數據，很難取得突破。另一方面，我們有大量沒有註釋結構信息的RNA序列，包括2700萬條ncRNA序列，這些序列在以前的方法中被忽略了。 PI首次提出利用大規模未註釋RNA序列來解決RNA領域的數據稀缺問題並改進RNA結構預測，而不是再等十年獲得足夠的註釋數據。 PI課題組以他為通訊作者的最近的一項工作中（NatureMethods的外部評審中），提出了一種通用RNA基礎模型（RNA-FM），可以從2700萬個序列中提取有意義的信息。在此，PI建議基於上述模型開發更具體的模型來預測RNA二級結構和3D結構。初步實驗表明，一個簡單的特定模型可以將二級結構預測的 F1 分數提高高達 13.5%。在3D結構預測上，基於RNA-FM的特定模型將平均均方根偏差從2021年發表在Science上的ARES的12.55 Å提高到4.65 Å。 PI將在擬議項目中開發更先進的具體模型和更全面的評估。 與蛋白質領域類似，RNA結構預測的突破將從根本上推動RNA療法的發展，例如RNA疫苗和siRNA藥物。

24209223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24209223.value: 手術機械人具身智能中數據驅動的控制策略學習和交互方法研究

24209223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24209223.value: 手術機械人在微創介入治療中的臨床應用日趨廣泛，對提升其自動化水平的需求日益顯著，特別是應對未來老齡化社會，有望幫助減輕外科醫生疲勞、提高手術效率。然而，手術操作複雜多樣，實現自主手術仍是一個長期具有挑戰性的目標，具身智能技術使機械人通過模擬器學習控制策略，有潛力推動手術任務自動化的研究。 目前的手術機械人具身智能僅支持基本場景，難以擴展到複雜手術任務，通常存在以下缺點：1) 構建模擬器仿真環境時難以手工設計複雜手術場景並且耗時低效；2）現有強化學習算法在學習複雜手術操作的控制策略時性能欠佳；3）仍然難以克服虛擬和真實環境差距導致無法在真機上遷移學習到的策略。其實導致這些問題的共同因素在於機器學習過程中現有解決方案尚未充分利用真實手術的專家數據。如今臨床上已常規錄制外科醫生的手術視頻，但是，如何提煉這些專家數據中蘊含的信息，並且有效納入手術機械人具身智能的學習範式仍待研究。在本項目中，我們將開發一個新型的手術機械人具身智能框架，採用數據驅動的思路解決模擬器手術場景仿真、控制策略學習、和模擬器嚮真機遷移的一系列難題。首先，我們將基於神經輻射場方法從雙目視頻中重建三維手術場景，從數據中高效生成多樣的虛擬環境以降低環境仿真的成本。其次，在仿真器中開發將手術機器人元操作組合成複雜動作的強化學習新方法，挖掘專家演示數據中的有用信息以提高策略學習的可擴展性。然後，得益於逼真的模擬器和優化的策略，我們將利用人機交互數據進行在線學習以實現控制策略從仿真器到真實機器人的高效遷移。最後，我們將集成這些模塊搭建一個專門用於手術機械人的具身智能平臺，並且以前列腺切除術中的典型手術任務為例，進行實驗驗證。我們前期已初步開發了一個手術機械人強化學習模擬器（名為SurRoL)，配備縫合針抓取和內鏡視角控制等基本任務，並且和達芬奇套件dVRK兼容。我們將在本項目中對該平臺進行充分拓展。它將是首個以數據驅動為主的手術機械人具身智能平臺，我們提出的方法具有通用性，用戶可導入其自己的數據以構建模擬器併研究其特定的自動化手術任務。本項目的研究成果將嚮全球手術機械人研究社區開源以推動領域發展。

24306223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24306223.value: 鎳基超導體電子態和磁性的X射線及中子譜學研究

24306223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24306223.value: The recent discovery of superconductivity in infinite-layer nickelates has triggered tremendous interest as this system holds the potential to become the fourth family of high-temperature superconductors after the cuprates, iron-based materials, and the hydrides. These nickelate systems share many similarities to the cuprates but also exhibit remarkable distinctions. Whether they can be understood by generalizing the theories established in the cuprates or from completely different perspectives is the central debate. Except for superconductivity, the infinite-layer nickelates also exhibit emergent phenomena including charge ordering and propagative magnetic excitations. While these behaviors are likely effects of many-body interactions, the microscopic origins remain elusive. The primary challenge to address these issues is the limited experimental information on the electronic and magnetic properties of this system. This is mainly due to the fact that superconductivity has only been observed in the thin film format of the infinite-layer nickelates where bulk measurements are restricted. The surface roughness of these films further holds back experimental access to the detailed electronic structure. To address this issue, the present project combines multiple x-ray and neutron scattering techniques to provide new insights into the low-energy physics that directly reflect the electronic, magnetic, and lattice properties of the system. Many of the approaches we will apply are developed in recent years and have demonstrated their effectiveness in the study of correlated systems including high-temperature superconductors. For example, the improvement of energy resolution of resonant inelastic x-ray scattering (RIXS) has rendered it a unique probe of magnetic excitations that is especially powerful in thin film systems. RIXS has also been recently applied to probe the charge and lattice dynamics in various correlated systems, including the cuprates, yielding quantitative information on the electronic interactions and their coupling to the crystal lattice. By applying these approaches to the nickelate superconductors, we infer the origin of the emergent behaviors that are encoded in the elementary excitations. In combination with elastic scattering experiments that address the nature of competing states to superconductivity, a comprehensive understanding of the nickelate superconductors will be reached. 最近在無限層鎳氧化物中發現的超導電性引發了大量研究興趣，因為這一體系有潛力成為繼銅氧化物、鐵基和氫化物體系之後的第四類高温超導材料。這類鎳氧化物和銅氧化物超導體具有很多相似之處但同時也表現出了顯著不同。關於這類材料是否能夠通過拓展現有的銅氧化物中建立起來的理論來描述，還是需要從完全不同的角度來理解是目前爭論的核心問題。除了超導電性之外，無限層鎳氧化物也表現出了包括電荷有序和具有傳播性的磁激發在內的演生現象。這些行為很可能由多體相互作用導致，但是其微觀起源尚未明確。解決這一問題面臨的主要挑戰是關於這一體系的電子態和磁性的現有實驗信息非常有限。這是因為目前只有薄膜樣品中可以觀測到超導電性，極大限制了對於其體性質的探測。另外目前該體系薄膜樣品的表面比較粗糙，進一步影響了電子態結構的實驗測量。 為了解決這些問題，本課題結合多種X射線和中子散射技術來研究與該體系電子態、磁性以及晶格相關的低能物理。這裏涉及到的很多方法是近年發展起來的，並已經在包括高温超導體在內的關聯體系中得到了有效運用。例如，共振非彈性X射線散射能量分辨率的提高使其成為磁激發的有效探測手段，尤其對薄膜樣品的研究非常重要。該手段最近也被運用在包括銅氧化物超導體在內的諸多關聯體系中的電荷和晶格動力學測量中。它可以定量給出電子間相互作用以及電子與晶格間的耦合強度。運用這些方法測量鎳氧化物超導體中的元激發可以幫助我們瞭解相應量子態的起源，結合彈性散射將進一步加深我們對該體系中和超導相競爭的有序態的理解。通過這些研究我們將建立起對鎳氧化物超導體的全面認識。

24307423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24307423.value: 基於B(sp2)-B(sp3)二硼烷合成子的非對稱多硼基烷烴的合成：方法及應用

24307423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24307423.value: 在有機分子中引入硼元素的方法已在合成化學中找到了寶貴的應用。基於多功能的碳-硼鍵的轉化，可以實現多種官能團的引入。作為傳統合成方法的替代方案，這種“硼化-官能團化”的策略逐漸顯示出其在效率、原子經濟性和通用性方面的優勢，促進了有機分子的合成和後期官能團化。因此，常見有機原料（如烴、鹵代物和醚）的選擇性硼基化引發了極大的研究興趣，同時也催生了新的反應模式和硼化試劑的開發。廣泛研究的硼基化反應包括過渡金屬催化的C-H硼化、不對稱的氫硼化、以及最近報導的自由基誘導的硼化。這些反應中，最常用的硼酸酯類的硼化試劑（例如，頻那醇硼烷HBpin，雙聯硼酸頻那醇酯B2pin2）已經得到了深入研究和廣泛應用。尋找新型硼合成子並將其應用於合成化學是我們的研究重點。例如，我們最近報導的二溴硼烷試劑可以實現烷基醚C-O鍵直接的硼插入，實現了一系列新型硼氧雜環的合成和轉化（Science 2021，372，175）。 儘管如此，由於合成方法缺乏和硼化試劑類型的限制，高效地在烷烴的同一碳中心引入兩個或更多不同的硼基團仍然具有挑戰性。此外，選擇性的碳硼鍵衍生化在有機分子的多官能團化和精確合成中具有的很大潛力，但通用易行的方法仍然有限。鑑於這些研究問題，並根據我們在硼化學中的研究經驗，我們計劃在這個提案中，開發新的方法，通過設計和製備新型非對稱sp2-sp3二硼烷試劑，構建結構多樣的多硼化碳中心。這些有機硼的下游轉化將用於多取代碳中心的合成及應用研究。 可以預計，該項目的成果將提高我們對sp2-sp3二硼烷性質的理解，以及了解其在製備非對稱多硼基烷烴中，反應性和選擇性方面的作用。這項研究也將產生一系列通用的合成方法，用於製備帶有多種功能團的多取代碳中心。預期這些方法將在生物活性化合物及藥物分子的合成中得到有價值的應用，並將進一步應用於新藥研發。

24308323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24308323.value: 超冷原子拓撲態:動力學探究相互作用對拓撲的影響

24308323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24308323.value: Topological states of matter have been simulated extensively using ultracold atoms. For example, the Dirac monopole, which is nonexistent in real space, has been synthesized; specifically, the Berry curvature and the Chern number of the monopole have been measured experimentally in spinor Bose-Einstein condensates. In addition, quantized Thouless pumping in the Rice-Melee model, which is also characterized by the Chern number, has been observed in optical superlattices. The experimental focus was on non-interacting systems until recently. In 2022, experimentalists observed the fractionalization of the Thouless pump in strongly interacting SU(2) Fermi gases. Strong interactions have been identified as one of the key ingredients in realizing exotic phases of matter in the condensed matter physics literature. However, what is exactly the interplay between the interactions and topology is not yet fully understood and will be explored in this proposal in the context of ultracold atoms. This project aims to study the interplay between interactions and topology in two different ultracold-atom systems: (i) spinor Bose-Einstein condensates and (ii) Bose gases or SU(N) Fermi gases in a one-dimensional optical superlattice. We will probe the change of topological defects due to interactions using dynamics such as adiabatic ramping of the governing parameters or a Thouless pumping in the time-dependent Rice-Mele model. In contrast to the literature, which uses approximate mean-field or two-body wave function approaches, we plan to treat the full many-body correlations. This challenging technique will be accomplished by restricting the treatment to the vicinity of defect points. Due to the robustness of the topology, we expect that the proposed many-body perturbation theory treatment will retain its predictive power even though the adiabatic path is far away from the topological defects. First, we will calculate the Chern number of the defects by analyzing the effective low-energy Hamiltonian in the vicinity of topological defect points. Second, we plan to perform numerical verifications using exact diagonalization and time-evolution block-decimation away from the defect points. Finally, we will propose experimentally realistic protocols for spinor Bose-Einstein condensates and SU(N) Fermi gases or Bose-Einstein condensates in one-dimensional optical lattices. Our theoretical predictions can be verified using state-of-the-art experimental platforms of ultracold atoms. We expect that our findings will be relevant not only to ultracold-atom systems, but also to a wide range of quantum simulation platforms such as trapped ions, superconducting quantum circuits, Rydberg atoms, and photonic systems, and to realistic condensed matter systems. 超冷原子可以模擬物質的拓撲態，比如三維空間中並不存在的狄拉克磁單極。具體來說，旋量玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態實驗測量了該磁單極的貝里曲率和陳數。光超晶格中觀察到了Rice-Melee模型中的量子化Thouless泵浦，它也是由陳數來表徵的。直到最近，實驗的焦點都集中在非相互作用的系統上。然而在2022年，實驗者在強相互作用的SU(2)費米氣體中觀察到了Thouless泵浦的分數化。強相互作用被認為是實現凝聚態物理文獻中物質的奇異相的關鍵因素之一。然而，強相互作用和拓撲之間的具體關係尚未完全理解，本項目將在超冷原子的背景下探討這一問題。 該項目旨在研究交互作用和拓撲在兩種不同的超冷原子系統中的相互作用：(i) 旋量玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態和(ii) 一維光學超晶格中的玻色氣體或SU(N)費米氣體。與使用平均場或兩體波函數方法的文獻相比，我們計劃處理全部的多體關聯。首先，我們將通過分析拓撲缺陷點附近的有效低能哈密頓量來計算缺陷的陳數。其次，我們計劃在缺陷點之外使用精確對角化和時間演化塊分解進行數值驗證。最後，我們將為一維光學晶格中的自旋玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態和SU(N)費米氣體或玻色-愛因斯坦凝聚態提出實驗上可操作的方案。 我們的理論預測可以使用超冷原子的最新實驗平台進行驗證。我們期望本項目不僅可用於超冷原子系統而且對於一系列的量子仿真平台如離子陷阱、超導量子電路、里德堡原子、光子系統以及實際的凝聚態系統都有指導意義。

24500923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24500923.value: 高頻數據的一致有效統計推斷方法

24500923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24500923.value: We propose a new estimator of the integrated volatility of asset returns using high-frequency data. The estimator is uniformly valid over a broad class of models for asset prices: the asset price could simply be a continuous-time semimartingale implied by the fundamental theorems of asset pricing. Or the asset price is a semimartingale process subject to pricing errors induced by various market frictions, and the pricing errors could be asymptotically vanishing, serially dependent, dependent on the semimartingale component, and could have a stochastic scale. This broad class nests almost all models of asset prices studied in asset pricing, market microstructure, and financial time series analysis. The uniformity is achieved by a data-driven selection of the bandwidth of the classic pre-averaging method. The selection procedure relies on the ReMeDI approach to measure pricing errors proposed by the PI in his PhD thesis (eventually published in Econometrica recently). The new estimator will provide a robust and uniform solution to many econometric problems in financial econometrics, e.g., estimation of the covariance matrix, estimation and detection of jumps, estimation of the leverage effect, etc. 我們提出了一種使用高頻數據估算資產回報的整合波動性的新的估計方法。該方法在一大類的資產價格模型中均有效：資產價格可以僅為資產定價的基本定理所暗示的連續時間半鞅現象。或者，資產價格是一種受到由各種市場摩擦引起的定價錯誤影響的半鞅現象過程，而這些定價錯誤可能是漸進消失的，序列相依的，依賴於半鞅現象組件的，並可能具有隨機規模。這一大類資產價格模型幾乎涵蓋了資產定價、市場微觀結構以及金融時間序列分析中研究的所有資產價格模型。通過數據驅動的帶寬選擇，實現了經典預平均方法的均勻性。該選擇過程依賴於由PI在其博士論文中（最終最近在Econometrica發表）提出的ReMeDI方法來測量定價錯誤。新的估計方法將為金融計量經濟學中的許多計量問題提供一種強健且一致的解決方案，例如，協方差矩陣的估算，跳躍的估算和檢測，杠桿效應的估算等。

24501623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24501623.value: 激進非政府組織和洗綠指控

24501623.label: Project Objectives
24501623.value: Investigate NGO activists’ campaigns alleging greenwashing and provide an overview of the frequency, outlet, severity, and context of situations in which greenwashing is more likely to occur using a novel international dataset on NGO activist campaigns. Data structure helps to directly identify greenwashing cases which also circumvents previous empirical challenges of identifying greenwashing (Hail et al. 2021). Based on the above generated greenwashing dataset, examine determinants of greenwashing and investigate when greenwashing is less like to occur (e.g., expect scrutiny from the media, investors, sell-side analysts, customers, and regulators to influence the likelihood of greenwashing) using the sample of directly identified and verified greenwashing cases. Analyze the immediate and longer-term consequences for alleged firms, such as stock market reactions, increases in bad press, increases in litigation, ESG rating downgrades, management turnover, and potential changes in reporting behavior, such as changes in corporate ESG disclosures by using the large international sample of directly identified greenwashing cases to better inform stakeholders about the consequences of greenwashing. Provide insights on the role of NGO activists and on their allegations can play to uncover firms’ dysfunctional reporting and disclosure behavior and their impact on firms’ consequences using the international evidence on NGO allegations and cross-sectional differences in the NGOs (e.g., power). Basically, study the cross-section of NGOs. Create a firm-year NGO allegation index, which would be based on all the comments (both negative and positive) that a company receives from NGOs each year.

24501623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24501623.value: 抽象的 如今，包括投資者在內的各種利益相關群體對企業的環境、社會和治理（“ESG”）績效越來越感興趣。 然而，這些利益相關者難以可靠地評估和比較公司的 ESG 績效，以調整其投資、就業、採購或執行決策。 為了應對這一挑戰，許多非政府組織（“NGO”）、行業協會和監管機構已開始制定ESG披露標準。 然而，企業ESG績效的許多維度很難量化，而量化需要很多假設。 因此，ESG 績效披露很難為外部人士核實。 因此，公司有動機以盡可能最好的方式展示自己的ESG 績效，也就是說，他們有動機進行“綠色清洗”，這需要各種形式的誤導性溝通，以塑造有關ESG 績效和實踐的過於積極的形象。 近年來，美國證券交易委員會和香港 ESG 督導小組等國際監管機構越來越多對“洗綠”行為進行審查，並已向投資者發出警報。 過去的研究很難識別洗綠行為，由於缺乏客觀基準，很難獲得洗綠行為的證據。在我們擬議項目中，通過研究NGO活動人士（“活動人士”）披露的國際洗綠指控的新數據，我們的目標是規避這些實證挑戰，並直接確定洗綠的背景、決定因素和後果。首先，我們研究企業如何進行綠色清洗（例如場地、形式）。對於洗綠的決定因素，我們首先考察，當公司 ESG 披露評級較高、投資者審查更嚴格、媒體關注度更高或公司遵循披露標準時，洗綠的可能性是否較小。然後，我們研究洗綠對公司及其管理層的直接和長期影響，包括信息披露方面潛在的可識別變化。 通過使用大量國際指控樣本，我們不僅希望為洗綠和披露文獻作出貢獻，還希望通過說明NGO行動主義在揭露洗綠行為中的作用，為有關NGO行動主義的文獻作出貢獻，因為這些活動人士已成為影響商業決策的重要參與者（Daubanes 和Rochet，2021），他們試圖阻止有害項目並推動企業自我監管。 總體而言，我們通過使用特定的背景提供了有關“綠色清洗”的重要的新證據，這有助於更好地識別“綠色清洗”發生的情況，並為這些活動人士的指控提供見解。 我們的研究結果不僅可以為公司及其管理者的決策提供信息，還可以幫助投資者和監管機構更好地理解活動人士的指控和公司的“洗綠”行為。

24503223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24503223.value: 對鄰里安全的感知是否資本化至房價？

24503223.label: Project Objectives
24503223.value: Examine the response of home sellers to the disclosure of gun ownership in their neighborhoods. Study the underlying mechanisms through which the gun-permit holders affect home values. We propose the "negative perceptions of neighborhood safety" hypothesis and test the heterogeneity in housing market responses. Propose some implications for policy makers and housing market participants regarding the importance of access to a clean, safe, and sustainable environment.

Study the underlying mechanisms through which the gun-permit holders affect home values. We propose the "negative perceptions of neighborhood safety" hypothesis and test the heterogeneity in housing market responses.
Propose some implications for policy makers and housing market participants regarding the importance of access to a clean, safe, and sustainable environment.

24503223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24503223.value: 2015年9月, 聯合國大會設立了17個全球可持續發展目標, 為實現人類和地球的和平與繁榮提供了一個共同的藍圖。作為17個可持續發展目標之一, 第11個的目標主題為“可持續城市和社區”, 是“使城市和社會具有包容性、安全性、彈性和可持續性”。正如第11個目標所強調的, 安全是社會可持續性的核心和必不可少的要素之一。安全感對居民的心理健康和整體福祉至關重要。正如心理學文獻所證實的那樣, 對鄰居里感到安全的人比不安全的人有更好的心理健康。本文的目標是衡量對鄰里安全的感知是否資本化至房價。為了探討這個問題, 首先, 我們探索對鄰里持槍的披露是否影響了周圍房地產的交易價格。其次, 我們研究哪些潛在的機制推動了住房市場價值的反應，我們認為其中一個潛在的機制是鄰里持槍的披露對當地居民對鄰居安全的感知造成了負向影響。總的來說, 本文研究強調了建設一個安全和可持續的社區的價值和重要性。

24505323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24505323.value: 稅收不確定性如何影響企業對高技術人才的需求？

24505323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24505323.value: Human capital, especially skilled labor, is one of the most important factors that affect firms productivity and also economic growth. Prior studies show that tax systems can affect labor force in various ways. In this study, I seek to understand how tax systems can affect corporate demand for skilled labor and thus labor force structure. Specifically, this project will investigate whether and how the tax uncertainty from tax authorities assessments of corporate income tax affect corporate demand for skilled and unskilled labor. Because hiring skilled labor requires firms to hold more cash than hiring unskilled labor. Tax authority assessments might result in large cash outflows, which will affect firms hiring decisions. To understand the dynamics, I will investigate whether firm decrease their overall hiring of skilled labor. I will also examine whether firms decrease the the overall employment for both skilled and unskilled labor, or they substitute the hiring of skilled labor by hiring more unskilled labor. 人力資本，特別是高技術人才，是影響企業生產力和經濟增長的重要因素。先前的研究錶明，稅收制度可以通過多種方式影響人才需求。此研究試圖了解稅收制度如何會影響企業對高技術人才的需求，從而影響勞動力結構。具體來說，該項目將研究政府稅務部門對企業所得稅的評估與調查是否會影響企業對技術和人才的需求。因為僱用熟練高技術人才的企業持有比僱用一般人才的企業需要更多的現金。政府稅務的調查可能會導致企業大量現金的流出，從而影響企業的招聘決策。我們將會研究公司是否因為稅務不確定性而減少了對高技術人才的需求。我們還將研究企業是否減少了整體就人才需求和其他普通人才的需求，或者企業是否通過僱傭更多的普通人才來替代高技術人才。

24505923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24505923.value: 銀行監管對企業債流動性影響的全面分析

24505923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24505923.value: 金融危機後的銀行監管對企業債券市場流動性產生了意想不到的成本。我們早期的研究（Wu，2020）以流動性即時性的惡化描述了這種成本。銀行監管通過更嚴格的資本要求減少了交易商銀行在正常時期的企業債庫存持有量。投資者因而必須等待更長時間才能執行交易。在這個新的課題裡，我們計劃研究監管對企業債券市場流動性帶來的好處。我們將這種收益量化為流動性的彈性維度，即價格如何吸收並從產生強烈的賣壓的流動性衝擊中恢復。監管使交易商可以在危機期間利用它們儲存的資本來“逆風而行”：在賣壓期間買入並在市場穩定後賣出，從而穩定干擾並更快地恢復價格。彈性是流動性中一個重要但被忽視的維度。研究人員通常關注買賣價差或交易規模。我們通過企業債券投資者的持有數據和交易商的監管交易數據來衡量彈性，研究不同市場參與者如何在流動性衝擊下改變其投資組合和庫存。08年金融危機和20年新冠疫情為我們的理論提供了良好的測試。企業債券市場是一個活躍的研究領域。其在國民經濟中有巨額發行量並在疫情期間受到嚴重干擾。美國有10萬億美元的未償還企業債務。美聯儲主席所指出，如果金融條件惡化，過度負債的企業可能面臨嚴重壓力。香港本身也是亞洲第三大債券市場。全面分析後危機時代國際銀行監管對企業債券流動性的影響因而顯得非常重要。

24507623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24507623.value: 解決專利邊界不清晰的問題：監管與訴訟對創新的影響

24507623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24507623.value: 創新長期以來被認識為進步和繁榮的基石，而專利製度被認為對促進有用的發明至關重要。然而，專利通知功能的失效——即由於未能清楚地界定所聲稱的發明範圍而引發的不良後果——對專利製度的正常運作提出了重大挑戰。自1990年代以來，由於新興技術（如計算機軟件）依賴於抽象的算法並且以前所未有的速度演變，這種情況變得極為嚴重。本研究旨在通過美國的兩項政策改革來檢視減輕專利通知問題如何影響創新。 現有研究已經展示了通知失敗對企業的鉅大成本，並提出了各種行政或司法的方法來解決這個問題。然而，我們尙缺乏關於它們對創新影響的確鑿證據；我們也不知道在專利審查過程中採取的監管方法是否比事後訴訟的法院規定更為有效。主要的挑戰包括：i）尋找在不確定邊界程度上的外生變化，ii）確定不同、不重曡的政策方法來解決同一個問題，以及iii）測量專利申請的明確程度，以理解政策改革可能影響機製的程度。 本研究旨在通過發掘兩種被認為在解決通知失敗方麵有效的不同方法來應對這些挑戰：一種是1997年最高法院的一項重大裁決，限製了等效原則侵權訴訟；另一種是專利局在2011年發佈的新審查準則，加强了權利要求的明確性和功能性要求。為了確定政策改革是否有效地減輕了通知失敗並促進了創新，我將把專利數據與法庭案件的提交情況聯係起來，並利用準實驗性變化（分別在企業面臨訴訟風險以及在发明專利面臨更嚴格的明確性審查方面）。我還將構建基於文本的權利要求明確性的量度，來探究監管規則的顯著性。 最後，本文將比較這兩種政策手段的在實證上的相對有效性，並使用Shleifer（2005）提出的法規-訴訟理論框架來解釋結果。當訴訟結果高度不確定且重複[復]利用法庭解決爭端過於昂貴時，該理論預測明確規則將是更有效的製度選擇。我的實證[証]結果將有助於為這一假設提供（支持或反對的）證據，並為學術和政策辯論提供洞察，權衡專利政策製定中的不同製度選擇。

24600323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24600323.value: 高密度生活環境裡的「中間空間」設計對長者活動及社交生活的影響：以香港資助房屋為案例研究

24600323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24600323.value: 像香港這樣的高密度城市中，居住單位經常狹窄且擁擠。屋邨裡的「中間空間（in-between spaces）」，例如電梯大堂、通道空間和平台，被設計或用作為居民活動的場所，成為居民家庭生活的延伸。本研究聚焦於空間的社交性，就高密度住宅裡「中間空間」設計對促進長者活動及社交生活的重要性作出研究。研究結果將為高密度住宅公共空間的設計和管理提供意見，促進健康社區、社區互助。 在低於標準的擁擠生活條件下，對「中間空間」設計花心思非常重要，其中原因有以下三個: （一）對行動不便和認知功能下降的長者而言，「中間空間」距離他們的居住單位鄰近，並且長者對這些地方比較熟悉，「中間空間」往往成為他們的重要活動空間；（二）適當規劃和設計的「中間空間」可以促進鄰居之間的自然互動，對社區互助網絡的發展扮演重要的角色；（三）「中間空間」的網絡很大程度上決定了家庭之間的物理距離和社會關係，這是一種硬件設計的配置，很難在入住後再進行重新構建改造。 以資助/公共屋邨作為案例進行探索，此研究以不同的質性方法收集數據，包括空間分析、制作用家地圖（user-mapping）、訪談、田野觀察和日記研究。研究會以三角互證方法（triangulation）對數據作出分析，了解「中間空間」的建築設計特徵和管理對長者在居住範圍內的社交生活影響。研究在幾方面作出貢獻：（一）探索長者的社交發展與維持及其在「中間空間」的活動之間的關係；（二）通過綜合現有定義/參數和田野記錄來建立「中間空間」的設計庫（inventory of in-between spaces）；和（三）辨認影響長者的喜好、體驗、活動和社會生活的環境因素。研究為更新高密度住宅公共空間的設計指引和理論提供實證，促進長者的社交生活、社交健康和整體福祉（wellbeing）。 過往很多研究集中探索長者的福祉與宏觀至中尺度的建築環境之間的關係。少部份的研究已經對微觀生活環境（場所/建築物）與長者的社交健康之間的關係。作為私人和公共之間的接口，多層的「中間空間」在高密度城市中很常見，它對於塑造垂直社區至關重要。此研究將填補長者福祉和微觀生活環境之關系在文獻上的不足，並為在高密度住宅項目內設計/規劃高效的社交空間提供可實踐的策略， 促進鄰里互助的健康社區，推動積極健康樂頤年 (healthy ageing)。

24602423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24602423.value: Mental health problems are a growing concern in modern societies such as Hong Kong. One way to support people’s mental well-being is to encourage them to engage in comfortable disclosure of their feelings and thoughts. Self-disclosure has been shown to help individuals reinforce positive feelings and release stress. With current advances in communication technology, chatbots capable of interacting with human users in a natural language may serve as an innovative and cost-efficient way to support self-disclosure, thus enhancing the mental well-being of the individual. The question remains: what kinds of chatbots would be make the most suitable listeners for facilitating self-disclosure? More specifically, chatbots possess varying degrees of anthropomorphic characteristics, which determine the level of their human likeness. As a critical design element in chatbots, features of anthropomorphism have received considerable attention in the literature. However, the association between anthropomorphic features of chatbots and users’ depth and breadth of self-disclosure has been understudied. The proposed study thus intends to systematically examine the effects of three different anthropomorphic chatbot design features—voice vs. text interaction, anthropomorphic appearance, and chatbot personality—on users’ self-disclosure and their implications for mental well-being. Previous research in chatbot supporting mental health has also been mostly using U.S. samples and stimuli. This project will focus on Hong Kong population and provide a starting point for future cross-national comparative studies on self-disclosure to chatbots and its effects. Additionally, anthropomorphism may only be one of the vital factors in determining users’ self-disclosure to chatbots. Issues such as privacy concern, social awkwardness, and technical deficiencies can also play important roles in the interaction experience. To fully understand how a user interacts with a chatbot and how well a chatbot support individuals’ needs of self-disclosure, an in-depth inquiry into user experience is also sorely needed. This project will first employ a two-week experimental study to compare users’ self-disclosures to chatbots against various anthropomorphic features (objective 1) and investigate the association between users’ self-disclosures to chatbots and changes in mental well-being (objective 2). In addition, the study will incorporate in-depth interviews with participants to gain a comprehensive understanding of users’ perceptions and attitudes toward anthropomorphic chatbots that support self-disclosure (objective 3). The results of this study will make a theoretical contribution by bridging theories on self-disclosure and the literature on anthropomorphism in human-computer interaction. Empirically, this study will produce practical guidelines for designing chatbots that support self-disclosure and mental well-being (objective 4). N/A

24606123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24606123.value: 善創作活：音樂經典生成和當代香港交響樂團

24606123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24606123.value: This project aims to forge new understandings of the post-European musical canon as a living construct, variously reshaping notions of the European ‘great composers’ and ‘classics’. Importantly, the project contributes living orchestral perspectives from outside the Anglophone West to related revisionist scholarship and its ongoing rethinking of canonical hegemonies, by conceptualising indigenous musical canons in the plural as they pertain to funded symphony orchestras in contemporary Hong Kong. This idea develops through a focus on three such institutions in the 2020s: the Hong Kong Philharmonic Orchestra, the Hong Kong Sinfonietta, and the new Greater Bay Area Youth Orchestra. I propose to examine them through the variegated agency of their musicians and administrators in programming, marketing, and outreach. Hence the project’s title, ‘Inventive Lives’. Bridging current music history scholarship, and current insights from performing arts practice, my project charts a timely discussion for canonical research today, mapping common ground between postcolonial musicology and the creative arts, and global European studies more broadly, through an intensified engagement with the post-European canon and its complex meanings. As such, my project not only builds on my first monograph, under contract, on the simultaneous flows and ruptures of twentieth-century European music cultures in China’s treaty port history (for which archival research has been completed). Crucially, the project now expands my purview to the twenty-first-century canon and its dynamics. Revisionist scholarship has been vital for interrogating the fixity of a Eurocentric musical canon, in striking tension with ‘classical music’s’ continuing appeal. Salient, unaddressed, questions thus emerge about the canon’s self-generative, agentic lives. In what ways is ‘the imaginary museum of musical works’, to echo Lydia Goehr’s words from three decades ago (1992), reconfigured and hybridised through indigenous canons, and according to whose stakes and agenda? Hong Kong, a Special Administrative Region of the People’s Republic of China—coupled with the symphony orchestra (as) institution—provides a fascinating inquiry here, due culturally to a living ecology of funded orchestras operative in a southern Chinese international city, and the orchestra’s re-profiling of its historical canonical registers. Accordingly, by interviewing musicians and administrators from my identified orchestras, and by drawing on their existing and emerging archives, I explore their richly varied, canon formations in tandem with the decision factors and processes involved. Capturing this research and its wider impact, the project’s deliverables extend from articles in musicology and interdisciplinary journals, to a second monograph proposal, to cross-sectoral pre-concert talks.

24608423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24608423.value: 區域貿易協定中的國有企業條款

24608423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24608423.value: Policy concerns regarding state-owned enterprises (SOEs) in trade have been a focal point in the US-China trade war and the legal reform of the World Trade Organization (WTO). Since the WTO has not made separate rulebooks on SOEs, countries with different policy preferences have progressively generated diverse SOE provisions in regional trade agreements (RTAs) to supplement the WTO rules. The aim of this study is to investigate these SOE provisions present in the 354 RTAs that are in force among the WTO members and to compare features of their texts and policies. This study builds on the PI’s previous research on SOEs in international law. The existing legal scholarship has provided comprehensive analyses of SOE rules in a few influential RTAs with reference to the WTO law and domestic practices of the signatories. This study, using text analysis tools and descriptive statistics, seeks to collect and generate new empirical evidence in the RTAs’ SOE provisions about their linguistic features and embedded policies. By utilizing a different research method, it will present the legal patterns and policies of SOE provisions with greater precision. In addition, this study will group and compare RTAs of different time periods and RTAs between signatories of different development levels according to regionalism theories in studies of international relations. The comparisons will reveal diverse lawmaking features in their SOE provisions and discern policy patterns of synchronization and divergence across time and space. By taking an interdisciplinary perspective, this study will provide a new understanding of RTAs’ developments. The empirical findings of this research can contribute to further policy discussions on SOEs in trade as well as interdisciplinary interests in regionalism and the WTO. They also serve as useful references for China and Hong Kong to recalibrate their existing RTA practices when joining new trade agreements that have SOE provisions. 關於國有企業（SOE）的貿易政策是中美貿易戰和世界貿易組織（WTO）法律改革的焦點。 由於WTO目前尚未制定單獨的國有企業規則，各國基於不同的貿易政策通過區域貿易協定（RTAs）逐漸達成了多樣化的國有企業條款對現有 WTO 規則進行補充。 本項目旨在調查目前 WTO 成員間已達成生效的 354 項區域貿易協定中的國有企業條款並比較其法律條文和貿易政策。 本項目建立在之前對國際法中關於國有企業的基礎研究之上。 現有法學研究多參考WTO法及相關國內法，對近些年個別具有影響力的區域貿易協定中的國有企業規則進行具體且詳實的研讀。 本項目則希望利用文本分析和統計工具系統地研究區域貿易協定中的國有企業條款，以更好地理解其文本特徵及背後蘊含的貿易政策。本項目中擬採用的研究方法可細緻地描述並歸納國有企業規則的法律及政策演變模式。 此外，本項目還將參考國際關係學說中的區域化理論，對不同時期以及不同發展水平國家之間的區域貿易協定進行分組比較。 這些比較研究將總結不同時期和空間下關於國有企業規則的國際立法共性和差異。本項目的跨學科視角可為 區域貿易協定的發展提供新的認識。 本項目的實證研究成果將有助于不同學科和政策制定者就貿易中的國有企業、中美貿易糾紛、區域化和WTO等主題展開後續討論。本項目亦將為中國和香港特別行政區在加入新區域貿易協議或修改現有協議時關於國有企業條款的談判提供有益參考。

24610123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24610123.value: 急步行訓練與認知行為療法於治療60歲或以上長者慢性原發性失眠效果的比對：一項隨機對照、局部盲法及非劣性臨床試驗

24610123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24610123.value: Elderly insomnia is a major public health concern. About half the people aged ≥60 years in Hong Kong suffer from insomnia. It is associated with many negative health outcomes and increases burden for affected individuals, their families, and the healthcare system. Cognitive behavioral therapy for insomnia (CBT-I) is the first-line treatment for chronic insomnia for older adults. Although CBT-I is very effective, there are many constraints on its implementation in treating elderly insomnia. Moderate-intensity physical exercise programs could improve insomnia among older adults. Brisk walking is among the most popular physical exercise globally. It brings a wide range of benefits and poses little risk of injury, making it an excellent choice for older adults. It is highly acceptable to local older adults. Brisk walking produced moderate-to-large and significant effects in improving insomnia/sleep quality among older adults, as compared to no intervention. However, no study performed head-to-head comparison between brisk walking and CBT-I in improving insomnia/sleep quality among older adults. This study is a single-blinded (outcome assessor) and parallel-group non-inferiority randomized controlled trial. The primary objective is to establish whether brisk walking training produces similar effects to group CBT-I in reducing insomnia severity in older adults with chronic primary insomnia. Participants are Chinese adults aged ≥60 years who fulfill the DSM-5 criteria for chronic primary insomnia. Their eligibility is initially screened by trained fieldworkers by telephone, and then confirmed via face-to-face interview with a clinical psychologist. A total of 92 eligible participants will be randomized 1:1 to either the brisk walking training group or the CBT-I group. Participants in the brisk walking training group receive an eight-week instructor-led interval brisk walking training program (five to six people/group, 40 minutes/session, three sessions/week). Those in the CBT-I group receive standard-of-care eight-session (five to six people/group, one and a half to two hours/session, one session/week) group CBT-I delivered by a trained therapist. Subjective and objective sleep outcomes are measured at baseline (T0), after completion of the intervention (T1), and six months (T2) and 12 months after T1 (T3). If brisk walking training is proven to be statistically non-inferior to CBT-I in reducing insomnia severity, it can be promoted and implemented as an alternative approach to CBT-I to alleviate elderly insomnia. It is potentially scalable and sustainable. Scaling up brisk walking may improve quality of life among older adults, and reduce the burden on their families and the healthcare system. 長者失眠是一個重要的公共衛生問題。目前香港的60歲或以上長者中，約有一半正受失眠困擾。失眠可引發諸多健康問題，並增加患者、其家庭和醫療系統的負擔。認知行為療法目前是治療長者慢性失眠的一線療法。雖然認知行為療法非常有效，但在實施過程中有諸多限制。 中等強度的體育運動可以改善長者的失眠情況。急步行是世界上最受歡迎的體育運動之一。急步行的受傷風險低，是一種適合長者的運動方式。香港長者對急步行的接受程度很高。與不進行任何干預相比，急步行可以顯著的改善長者失眠情況或睡眠質素。然而，目前尚無研究比較急步行訓練與認知行為療法在改善長者失眠情況或睡眠質素上的差異。 本研究是一項隨機單盲的平行非劣性臨床試驗。研究的主要目的是證明在減輕長者的失眠嚴重程度上，急步行訓練是否具有與認知行為治療相近的效果。研究的參加者是符合DSM-5慢性失眠標準的60歲或以上華人長者。工作人員首先會透過電話初步確認參加者是否符合研究入選條件，及後，臨床心理學家將進行面對面的訪談以確定參加者是否符合參加條件。共92名符合條件的參加者將會以1:1的比例被隨機分入急步行組或認知行為療法組。在導師的帶領下，急步行組的參加者將進行為期八星期的訓練（5-6人一組，每次訓練約40分鐘，每星期三節）。認知行為療法組的參加者將接受由專業治療師提供的為期八星期之標準療程（5-6人一組，每節1小時30分鐘至2小時，每星期一節）。本研究將測量參加者在基線、剛完成訓練/治療時、完成訓練/治療後的6個月和12個月的客觀和主觀睡眠指標。 如果急步行被證實具有與認知行為療法相近的效果，它可以成為認知行為療法以外的選擇並被推廣及應用，以減輕長者的失眠情況。急步行有可持續及被廣泛應用的潛力。推廣急步行可以提高長者的生活質素並減輕失眠對長者家庭和醫療系統帶來的負擔。

24612423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24612423.value: 數字化公益助力中國性別平等：草根非政府組織、募資實踐與平台治理

24612423.label: Project Objectives
24612423.value: To investigate the forms and representation of crowdfunding projects for gender causes on fundraising digital platforms and reflect on the potential and limitations of using the platform economy for social good. We will explore how gender NGOs use social appeals through narratives, pictures, and funding disclosure. By focusing on digital, philanthropic, platform user interfaces, search highlights obtained through user preference algorithms, and the transparency progress report of charities, we will produce categories based on the types of gender charity projects that are more likely to achieve their fundraising goals. To examine the strategies used by seventy (70) gender NGOs to mobilize resources for online crowdfunding events or other forms of fundraising activities through an online ethnography. We will follow selected gender NGOs’ public accounts, group chats of gender NGOs, and the personal accounts of key members to explore how they mobilize resources and volunteers on different digital platforms, solicit funding, and assert their presence to garner resources from supporters. We will study different strategies of framing issues and creating resonance. To collect in-depth interview data on the fundraising strategies of twenty (20) gender NGOs to examine how they navigate the changing regulatory governance of digital platforms, the tightened control of grassroots social organizations, and anti-feminist backlash. We will select NGOs to represent different gender issues: migrant women, domestic violence, sex education, and LGBT+. The variety of gender issues will provide insight into how NGOs frame their concerns on digital platforms and the varying degree to which they experience platform and state governance that is consequential to their digital platform resource mobilization strategies. To analyze how digital philanthropy and nonprofit governance shape gender NGO development. We will examine professionalization, compliance, resistance, compromise, and other kinds of organizational strategies gender organizations adopted to negotiate with digital platforms, the state, and society to advance gender equality after the passing of the 2016 Charity Law and 2017 Overseas NGO Law. To generate knowledge about the state of digital philanthropy and gender NGOs in China and explicate the promises and pitfalls of pursuing social good through mega digital platforms. The empowerment and marginalization effect of the platform economy will be explored through case studies of gender NGOs to shed light on the originality and prospects of digital philanthropy in China. We will generate evidence-based suggestions for giant tech companies to improve their digital platforms for social good and provide implications for nonprofit management policies.

24612523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24612523.value: （半）球之詩： 以創意研究聯結跨太平洋的多元歷史

24612523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24612523.value: 作為一種藝術媒介，沉浸式虛擬現實的發展尚處於起步階段。正如早期的電影製作只是一種新的戲劇表現形式，直到電影製片人建立起該媒介特有的準則，而虛擬現實也仍在發展其專屬領域的準則（Slater 和 Sanchez-Vives）。數位化文學的實踐者正著力研究如何利用虛擬現實的沉浸式特質來擴充和延展文學的標誌性效應：沉浸於虛構世界之感。這一開創性項目將為數字化文學的一個新興子領域——虛擬現實詩歌——作出貢獻；它既有助於確立在虛擬現實媒介裏進行文學創作的基本原則，也將探索虛擬現實作為詩歌傳播媒介時所產生的獨特的情感可能性。 本項目旨在全景球形照片中創作虛擬現實詩歌。當讀者觀看這些三維詩歌時，詩歌會在其周圍、上方和下方全景延伸。讀者通過移動頭部和身體，可以徜徉在作品的環境和文字中。全景球形攝影的技術尤其適用於寫作“地誌詩”，即主題及意象與寫作環境密切相關的詩歌。讀者進入虛擬的原地體驗時，可以尤其強烈地感受地誌詩的含義。 該項目以太平洋戰爭的重要遺址作為地誌詩的創作地點，聚焦在沖繩、首爾和關島。這些遺址分別在上世紀的不同時期被美國、日本和（南）韓國宣示主權。從戰爭期間到戰後，再到二十一世紀，這些遺址的主權曾被數次轉移和交易。因此，在這些遺址上，多元的、相互衝突的、層疊的歷史現實仍產生著共鳴。 儘管沖繩、首爾和關島設有眾多博物館和社區活動，致力於紀念太平洋戰爭，但本項目的虛擬現實詩歌則提供了一種開創性的方式，以跨太平洋的方法來聯結和思考這些獨特的地點及其獨特的歷史。該項目發出了創新性的邀請，讓讀者在每個虛擬地點沉浸式體驗特定歷史遺跡的地誌詩，並在不同遺址之間進行虛擬的穿梭旅行。通過這種方式，讀者不僅是讀者，還可以成為探索者，在過往的回音中追尋跨太平洋地區獨特多元而息息相關的歷史共鳴。

24614923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24614923.value: 面對國家與文化自由：中國西南糯禾文化生態恢復中關於文化韌性的民族誌研究

24614923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24614923.value: 中國黔東南地區的「禾」是一種地域性很強的稻類生態型，其中以糯類型為主。由於當地喀斯特垂直地貌中人與自然環境的長期相互適應，黔東南禾類展現出較強的抗逆性，且具有很高的文化和遺傳多樣性。糯禾亦是當地眾多少數民族的主要主食。然而，由於人口壓力和「教化蠻夷」的意圖，自清朝以來，歷屆政府持續推廣糯改秈。在民國時期，隨着中國西南邊疆被納入國家建設進程的重心以及現代化的思潮，數百種糯禾品種被簡化歸為單一的「低效」作物，並遭受到政府的控價。1949年之後，在綠色革命、工業化、以及雜交水稻強力推廣的影響下，黔東南地區糯禾品種進一步下降。然而，在所有這些與國家及其極端現代主義意識形態的遭遇中，糯禾依然在黔東南地區存活並且保持了繁榮的生命力。儘管其多樣性有所減少，該地區至今仍有百餘本地品種，糯禾依然是當地人們日常生活的文化核心。近年來，隨着政府不再要求當地種植雜交水稻，該地區村民正在實施大規模的對糯禾文化生態方面的恢復行動，展現了一種關於文化韌性的藝術。這種韌性也指出了對中國糯稻文化生態系統進行民族誌研究的必要性。通過多物種民族誌研究，本課題將進入百餘種糯禾與居住在黔東南地區的人們相遇的接觸地帶。通過採用這種視角，本研究將打破將稻米僅僅作為食品和農產品的刻板模式，並探索糯禾文化韌性背後的內驅力和文化邏輯。在發展研究的基礎上，本研究還將探討與糯改秈相關的國家發展意識形態所帶來的影響，並試圖為人類發展理論中阿馬蒂亞·森的文化自由主義等關鍵概念提供新的民族誌視角。

24615523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24615523.value: 養老金參數性改革的最優設計

24615523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24615523.value: 全球壽命延長的趨勢為許多國家的確定福利（Defined Benefit, DB）型現收現付制度（PAYGO）養老金帶來了巨大的財務壓力，因此迫切需要進行改革。提高退休年齡是最可行的選擇之一，因為它可以有效地糾正現有系統的精算失衡，並降低老年人口撫養比例。在實踐中，改革期間退休年齡往往可以表示為出生年份的線性函數，以此逐步提高人群的退休年齡。理論上，線性策略可以被證明為一個平穩提高退休年齡的優化問題的最優解。然而，該優化問題未能考慮改革的福利損失，忽略了養老金改革的目標（如減少赤字），並缺乏對代際與代內公平問題的探討。 為了解決這些缺陷，我們建議構建一個旨在在養老金改革期間最小化福利損失的優化問題，並通過最優控制方法來求解。為了確保所提議的改革策略對決策者和參與者是可實施且易於理解的，我們專注於養老金參數改革，包括提高退休年齡或調整繳費比例和養老金計算公式。為了減少不同收入階層之間的壽命差異的影響，我們在養老金改革期間使用累進制的繳費/養老金積累公式。此外，我們在優化中加入了財政約束以確保改革將恢復養老金制度的財政平衡，並引入公平約束以避免代際和代內重新分配中的不公平情況。我們將基於中國現有的DB PAYGO養老金制度進行建模，通過擬合中國數據來進行數值分析。該項目擬為最優養老金參數改革提供數學上的理論依據。該項目的結果將適用於更多擁有DB PAYGO制度的發展中國家。

24619023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
24619023.value: 在過渡性住宿中鏈接到家：一項關於香港精神病康復者構建“家”的實踐的質性研究

24619023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
24619023.value: People with mental health issues (MHIs) have long been disadvantaged in accessing appropriate housing—a place to call home. Since deinstitutionalization in the 1950s, mental health transitional accommodation programs (MHTAPs) informed by the Treatment First model have become a major intervention offering treatment and accommodation in many regions, including Hong Kong. These interventions have been increasingly challenged by long waiting lists, high withdrawal rates, and fierce criticism of their service outcomes, revealing the need for service reform and redesign. Although the Housing First model, which prioritizes housing over treatment, has been adopted in many Anglophone-European countries to replace MHTAPs, the implementation of this model is constrained by its reliance on available housing resources. Populated metropolises with limited housing resources, such as Hong Kong, need innovative strategies to reform accommodation support beyond the focus on treatment and/or housing. This study aims to promote a paradigmatic shift in orienting the objectives of mental health accommodation interventions from prioritizing housing and/or treatment to supporting homemaking practices, as having somewhere to live may not automatically contribute to the experience of home. At-homeness (i.e., the experience of being at home) has been identified as a universal aspiration of mental health consumers. It is fundamental to their recovery and could potentially lead to positive subjective experiences and greater engagement and commitment to their living environments. However, existing research, conducted mostly in Anglophone and European countries, is constrained by a reliance on conventional ideas of home centered around permanency and domesticity, devaluing the role that time-limited services may play. There is little research on how consumers conceptualize at-homeness and how homemaking is pursued individually, supported, or hampered in transitional mental health settings, particularly in non-Western contexts. By linking health geography and mental health research in homemaking, this project will explore the core meanings of at-homeness from the perspectives of consumers living in MHTAPs in Hong Kong, disentangle the patterns of their homemaking strategies, and examine how individual, service-level, and structural factors affect and shape consumers’ practices of homemaking. These objectives will be addressed by a qualitative study comprising in-depth interviews with consumers (n=60) and focused ethnography at three research sites of MHTAPs. The findings will draw implications for consumer advocacy and service provision, enhance the academic understanding of homemaking in mental health care, unconventional home circumstances and Asian contexts, and advance the application of home scholarship to social service contexts. 在獲取適當的住所、一個可稱之為“家”的地方的過程中，精神復元人士往往面對種種困難。自從20世紀50年代去院舍化浪潮(deinstitutionalization)興起以來，由治療優先模式（Treatment-first Model）主導的精神健康過渡性住宿服務已成為香港等許多地區精神康復服務體系當中的主要幹預措施。然而目前，這類措施的效果已飽受詬病，並且面對服務等待時間長、退出率高等諸多問題的困擾，揭示出服務改革的必要性。許多歐美國家採用了住房優先模式（Housing-first Model）來取代過渡住宿服務，但該模式的實施很大程度上受限於對可用住房資源的依賴。像香港這樣住房資源有限、人口密集的大都市，需要創新的策略來改革這類過渡性住宿服務，突破服務僅聚焦於提供治療或住所的局限。 本研究旨在推動一種範式轉變，將精神健康住宿干預的目標從優先考慮住房/治療轉向支援復元人士構建“家”的實踐，因為有地方住並不一定能夠自動對該住所產生家的體驗。眾多文獻證明， “在家”的感覺是精神復元人士的普遍追求，對他們的康復至關重要，並有助於建立更積極的主觀生活體驗，促進與環境空間的互動參與。 然而，現有的相關研究主要在歐美國家進行，並集中在對永久性和以家庭為中心的傳統的家的觀念的討論中，貶低了限時服務可能發揮的作用。 很少有研究探索精神復元人士如何在過渡性住宿服務環境中，理解“家”的概念及構建“家“的實踐。 透過將健康地理學與精神健康研究相結合，本研究將從居住在香港過渡性住宿服務的精神復元人士的視角，探索在家感的核心內涵，解析他們構建的“家”的策略模式，並探討個體、服務和結構性因素如何影響和塑造服務使用者的構建“家”的實踐。 本研究將採用深度訪談（n=60）的方法，並在三個精神健康過渡性住宿服務單位進行焦點民族志研究。 研究結果將為精神康復服務倡議和住宿服務發展提供啟示，增進學術界對精神健康服務中構建“家”的實踐的研究、非傳統家庭環境和亞洲背景之下的“家”的理解，並促進家的概念在社會服務研究領域中的應用。

25100523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25100523.value: 提升社區中風倖存者肌肉功能和活動能力的一套基於可穿戴超聲成像的視覺反饋 (UVF) 訓練策略：一項隨機對照研究

25100523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25100523.value: Stroke is a leading cause of disability, with heavy burden. Reducing the burden of stroke by evidence-based rehabilitative approach is urgent. Stroke survivors commonly have difficulties to visit hospitals/clinics for receiving rehabilitation treatments. When augmenting the muscle training with some feedback technologies, patients could only refer to the external biomechanical (e.g., walking speed and body posture) and physiological (e.g., electromyography or EMG) parameters to adjust their muscle activity, which may not be directly related to the muscle’s internal activity. Meanwhile, the muscle’s internal contraction characteristics may provide more straightforward information to support the patients’ trainings. Clinicians/therapists commonly refer to the imaged muscle’s internal contraction pattern/characteristics (e.g., via ultrasound imaging, magnetic resonance imaging or MRI) to support their clinical decisions/practices. Our previous study has also demonstrated that healthy young adults can improve their muscle training outcomes, by looking at the real-time ultrasound images showing their muscle contraction patterns during fitness training. However, it has remained unclear whether providing the real-time internal muscle contraction pattern/characteristics directly to the stroke patients, could improve the patients’ muscle training outcomes, which merits further study. Thus, this project aimed to improve the rehabilitative muscle training outcomes of community-dwelling stroke survivors, by developing a wearable ultrasound-imaging-based visual feedback (UVF) training strategy. This novel strategy will utilize the state-of-the-art wearable ultrasound imaging technologies and visual feedback technologies, to enable the stroke participants to visualize their internal muscle contraction pattern in real-time while contracting the paretic/affected muscles over twelve weeks. A randomized controlled trial (RCT) will be conducted on 78 community-dwelling stroke survivors that randomly allocated into three groups: 1) training without UVF, 2) training with UVF of the paretic muscles only, and 3) training with UVF of both the paretic and non-paretic muscles. The qualitative methods (interviews & group discussion) and quantitative methods (questionnaires, clinical assessments & instrumented measurements) will be employed; for evaluating the feasibility, acceptability, immediate and long-term effects of the developed strategy on the muscle function, physical activity, and physical activity of stroke participants. It is expected that the success of this project can provide an innovative strategy for improving muscle training outcomes and physical activity of community-dwelling stroke survivors, which can potentially improve their quality of life and well-being; help optimize the rehabilitation training scheme/protocol, by enabling the objective quantification of training process and improvement continuously; and facilitate the future implementation of tele-rehabilitation and home-/community-based rehabilitation training programs for disabled persons, with further optimization. 中風是致殘的首要成因之一，並帶來沉重的負擔。 因此，通過循證康復方法減輕中風相關負擔刻不容緩。中風倖存者通常很難去醫院/診所接受康復治療。當使用一些反饋技術增強肌肉訓練時，患者只能參考軀體外部生物力學（例如步行速度和身體姿勢）和生理學（例如肌電圖或肌電圖）相關參數來調整其肌肉活動，但此類反饋信息可能與肌肉內部的活動沒有直接關係。與此同時，肌肉的內部收縮特徵可以提供更直接的信息來指導患者訓練。 臨床醫生/康復治療師通常參考肌肉內部收縮模式/特徵（如通過超聲成像或 MRI磁共振等成像技術）來輔助他們的臨床決策/實踐。我們前期研究還表明，健康年輕人可以通過查看顯示其健身訓練期間肌肉收縮模式的即時超聲圖像來改善他們的肌肉訓練效果。然而，目前尚不清楚向中風患者提供該類即時肌肉內部收縮模式/特徵是否可以改善其偏癱側肌肉訓練結果，這值得進一步研究。 因此，該項目旨在通過開發基於可穿戴超聲成像的視覺反饋（UVF）訓練策略來改善社區中風倖存者的肌肉康復訓練效果。這種新穎的訓練策略將利用最先進的可穿戴超聲成像技術和視覺反饋技術，使中風參與者能夠在為期12周的訓練中，即時視覺化他們偏癱側肌肉的內部收縮模式。該項目將進行一項隨機對照試驗，並將78 名社區居住的中風倖存者隨機分為三組：1) 不進行 UVF 訓練，2) 僅對偏癱肌肉進行 UVF 訓練，及3) 偏癱和健康兩側肌群均進行 UVF 訓練。項目將採用定性（訪談和小組討論）和定量（問卷、臨床評估和儀器測量）方法來評估通過制定的訓練策略來提升中風參與者肌肉功能和活動能力的可行性、可接受性、即時和長期影響。 該項目的成功將可以為改善社區中風倖存者的肌肉訓練效果和活動能力提供新策略，以改善他們的生活品質和福祉；通過實現對訓練過程的客觀量化和持續改進，幫助優化相關康復訓練方案；並在進一步優化後，推動今後殘疾人遠程康復和家庭/社區康復訓練項目的實施。

25203623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25203623.value: 地鐵站數字孿生人群安全管理系統研發

25203623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25203623.value: Research Motivations: There are many metro systems in Asia carrying huge volume of passengers per day. When the crowd moves in a disordered manner, disastrous situations may happen. Thus, crowd management in metro stations, especially during emergencies, is a critical component of public safety management. Nonetheless, many current crowd management methods are experience-based and intuitively structured. The station or facility crowd management strategies are rarely analytically established or real-time data-driven, resulting in a more corrective response in emergency scenarios. The proposed study aims to fill this gap and provide more proactive crowd control measures in metro stations. This study proposed a digital twin system to leverage state-of-the-art vision-based techniques to collect crowd data for data-driven prediction and analysis. Computed results are then integrated with BIM-based information into a virtual simulation model for crowd management strategies. A Crowd Density Risk Level framework is established to support facility management and structure crowd safety strategies. In addition, a manual for crowd control strategies will be compiled. Last, a performance evaluation framework for the crowd safety management system is also proposed to justify the applicability of the system. Intellectual Merits: Top-view cameras will be utilized as the major data source for the proposed system, making privacy preservation much better than typical tilted cameras. There is a lack of crowd analysis using multiple top-view cameras, especially in metro station settings. The result of this study builds off of this gap and integrates with current crowd simulations to predict and alert station managers, facilitating more proactive control measures. In addition, the research framework includes self-evaluation of the proposed system through developing an evaluating framework for an effective crowd safety management system. Attributes for effective systems will be identified through structured semi-quantitative analysis, comprehensively listing intuitions into a list of indicators. The potential impact of the research goes beyond providing a data-driven daily crowd management system for metro stations and other indoor venues that serve large-scale events and occupants. The proposed evaluation framework is not merely customized for metro stations but also applicable for general crowd management, which includes indoor or outdoor venues, with or without limited headroom. Therefore, this proposed system can be potentially extended to other digital-twin-based facility management platforms, fitting as the crowd management module of such systems. Moreover, future works can be expanded to incorporate public safety events on the urban scale. 亞洲的地鐵系統通常承受著巨大的運輸壓力，大基數人群的無序移動則是導致災難性事件發生的一大誘因。 地鐵車站的人群管理（特別是緊急情況下）也由此成為公共安全管理的重要組成部分。 然而目前許多人群管理方法仍是基於經驗和直覺判斷， 大多數車站或設施的人群管理戰略缺少系統分析和實時數據驅動模式，遇到緊急情況很難做出準確的回應。 本研究旨在填補這一空白，並為地鐵人群管理人員提供更主動的人群管控措施。 本研究擬提出一個數位孿生系統，基於最先進的機器學習視覺分析技術收集人群數據，從而實現數據驅動的預測和分析。 並將此計算結果與基於BIM（Building Information Modeling）的資訊集成到人群管理策略的虛擬模擬模型中。 同時擬建立人群密度風險等級框架，以用於構建設施管理和構建人群安全策略。 此外，還將編製一份人群管控策略手冊以資參考。 本研究也將提出人群安全管理系統的績效評價框架，以驗證所提系統的適用性。

25208523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25208523.value: 基於光刻輔助金屬沉積方法實現高分辨率導電織物圖案的研究

25208523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25208523.value: The integration of multifunctional electronics into wearable forms has exhibited vast application possibilities in wellness tracking, illness treatment, and human-machine interactions. An ideal solution for making wearable electronics as integral parts of everyday outfits for long-term health-related applications is to directly integrate electronics into textiles (E-textiles). While significant progress has been made in realizing multifunctional E-textiles, existing E-textiles are still assembling electronic components with wire connections at a garment level. This makes E-textiles difficult to be comfortably worn by humans without being noticed and limits the device integration density. The fabrication of conductive textiles, the fundamental building blocks of E-Textiles, either involves steps that are less compatible with electronic manufacturing or hardly achieves high-resolution conductive tracks with desirable electrical stability and wearability inside fabrics. To date, the main challenge is a lack of an effective and versatile approach to fabricating conductive patterns with promising mechanical robustness and wearing performance on textiles in a high-resolution fabrication manner. Given this challenge, this project aims to leverage the conventional photolithographic patterning technology with textile metallization to develop high resolution, low electrical resistance, and mechanically and electrically robust conductive tracks into textiles, and to explore their proof-of-concept applications of textile-based electronic circuits for wearable electronic applications. Firstly, a textile-compatible photolithographic patterning approach will be proposed to assist the conformal coating of conductive metals around fibers and permeating within fabric structures. Underlying correlations among fabrication processes, fiber materials, fabric structures, and mechanical, electrical, and wearing performance of conductive patterns will be identified to optimize the permeated conductive tracks to high resolution, high electrical conductivity, electrical and mechanical stability, and wearing comfort. The optimized conductive patterns will then serve as the building blocks to fabricate electronic devices and circuity layouts for studying the integration of electronic circuits into textiles. The electrical, electrochemical, and wearing performance of the textile-based electronic devices as well as the durability of the as-integrated E-textiles under various wearing circumstances will be systematically studied. The fundamental study of the textile-compatible photolithography-assisted metal deposition in this project will provide scientific insights into the design and manufacturing of multifunctional E-textiles with ease of high-density integration. Since the proposed approach is compatible with electronic manufacturing processes and textile finishing, the process-structure-property correlational study, as well as the subsequent circuit demonstrations, can serve as the solid foundation for the further exploration of advanced E-textile systems with more complex integration of functionalities for wearable electronics applications. 相比傳統的便携式電子產品，將多功能電子元件融入可穿戴形式，在健康追蹤、疾病治療和人機互動領域中具有更廣泛的應用潛力。其中一個理想的融合方案，是將可穿戴電子產品成爲日常服裝的一部分，發展適合穿著的電子紡織品。雖然研究及工業界在實現多功能電子紡織品方面已經取得了重大進展，但現有的大部分電子紡織品仍需要在成衣層面上組裝電子元件和連接綫路。這使得電子紡織品難以在不被用戶察覺的情況下舒適穿戴，同時也限制了器件的集成密度。發展電子紡織品的其中一個關鍵步驟是開發導電紡織材料，但目前其主要的製備方式要麽與常規的電子製造技術不兼容，要麽難以在紡織品内實現具有穩定電學性能且不影響穿著的高精度導電綫路，即仍然缺乏一種能夠在織物上實現同時具備高導電性、良好機械强度以及適合穿戴的高分辨率導電圖案的有效方法。 鑒於這一挑戰，課題將結合傳統的光刻圖案技術與紡織品金屬化方法，在織物内開發高分辨率、低電阻、機械和電學穩定的導電圖案，並探索基於該新型導電織物於可穿戴電子領域的應用概念驗證。首先，將提出一種與織物材料和電子器件製造兼容的基於光刻技術的圖案化方法，以實現金屬在纖維表面和織物結構内的沉積。課題將重點探索製備過程、纖維材料、織物結構以及導電圖案的機械、電學和織物性能之間的相關性，以優化織物内的導電圖案，從而實現其高分辨率、高導電性、電學和機械穩定性以及織物舒適性。隨後，優化的導電圖案將作為構建電子器件和電路布局的基礎，實現電子電路于紡織品中的集成，並系統地探究器件和系統的電學、機械以及織物性能，以及在各種穿戴情况下的耐用性。 項目對光刻輔助金屬沉積在紡織品中的導電材料製備和器件系統應用進行基礎研究，可以爲設計和製造高密度集成的多功能電子紡織品提供研究基礎。由於所提出的方法與傳統的電子製造過程和紡織品處理較爲兼容，因此項目中針對製備-結構-性能的相關性研究以及隨后的電路展示可以作為進一步探索更多複雜功能集成的先進電子紡織品系統提供參考，有利於可穿戴電子應用的發展。

25210423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25210423.value: 完全相容化石基航油與可持續航油在寬工況熱解、氧化和燃燒中的獨特交互作用研究：基礎表徵與應用

25210423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25210423.value: 在全球「雙碳」背景下，民航業必須依賴可持續航空燃料實現降排減碳。 儘管受到全球市場和政府政策的強力推動，目前可持續航空燃料的發展與應用仍嚴重受限，比如：（a）僅有7種技術路徑被認證、最大摻混比例局限在50%，且產量遠小於傳統化石基航油市場（<1%）; （b）可持續航油的認證極其繁瑣，造成成本高、風險大; （c）在可持續航油的認證過程存在不一致性。 通過開發基於基礎燃燒特性的航油評估機制能很好地解決上述問題。 儘管如此，目前航油基礎燃燒特性的相關研究非常缺乏，且實驗所覆蓋的工況與發動機真實運行工況有較大偏差。 此外，儘管可持續航空燃油被認為是與傳統航油完全相容，但兩者的摻混往往會產生一些獨特的交互作用，對其燃燒性能產生不可忽略的影響。 本項目擬解決以上關鍵挑戰。 首先，在基本完全覆蓋航空發動機真實運行工況下獲取傳統化石基航油、可持續航空燃油以及兩者的摻混燃料的熱解、氧化、點火和火焰特性等基礎燃燒特性，並評估通過其甄別可持續航空燃料的可行性; 其次，結合理論推導、動力學類比和實驗觀測，探明可持續航油和傳統航油間獨特交互作用的主導機制; 最後，發展耦合獨特交互作用的高保真詳細反應動力學模型，並結合實驗與量化計算數據進行深度優化。

25213623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25213623.value: 用於物聯網無線能量傳輸的惠更斯源整流天線及目標可動態追蹤回溯反射式天線陣列研究

25213623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25213623.value: 無線能量傳輸（Wireless Power Transfer，簡稱WPT）通過電磁波收發實現，是一種綠色和革命性的供電技術，尤其適用于快速增長的物聯網（Internet of Things，簡稱IoT）應用。 根據一份商業市場報告，即《2028年全球物聯網市場及技術預測》，全球物聯網市場產值預計將由2020年的約9000億美元躍升至2028年的20000億美元。 智能家居、交通運輸、醫療保健系統、工業生產安全監控平台、數字化農業和環境保護等新興物聯網應用將大範圍得到應用。 隨著物聯網設備的普及，使用化學電池或太陽能電池等現有供電技術面臨著重大挑戰。傳統電源體積龐大，使用壽命有限。 對數目龐大的聯網設備進行手動更換電池是不現實的，並且處理這些廢棄電池將帶來嚴重的環境污染問題。 因此，開發一種革新的供電技術，例如目標可追蹤的無線能量傳輸技術，為物聯網設備提供能源，勢在必行。 實現該系統需要兩個緊密相關的子系統。 首先，需要設計安裝在物聯網平台上的超緊湊雙功能無線能量傳輸和通信子系統。其次，需要設計目標可穩定追蹤的無線能量發射天線陣列子系統。 然而，現有無線電能傳輸技術無法滿足上述功能需求。 該項目將透過創新的研究方法，實現以下三個目標，以填補上述技術空白。 首先，計劃研發一種超緊湊、低剖面、高效率的整流天線系統，用於安裝在小型物聯網平台上。 該項目將採用創新的設計方法，即採用共享孔徑雙圓極化小型惠更斯源天線單元實現該目標。 其次，目標實現一種緊湊、輕重量、穩定波束掃描的雙圓極化天線陣列。 該項目將研究一種新型的雙圓極化輻射元件，由兩個電小正交放置的惠更斯源天線組成，並擴展成大規模陣列，例如4×4陣列來驗證設計思路。 最後，目標研發一種緊湊的回溯反射式天線陣列，能夠自適應並穩定地向鎖定的物聯網目標進行無線能量傳輸。 該項目將研究一種新穎的設計方法，把輸出相位反向電路與自適應功率管理模塊結合起來。

25223223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25223223.value: 數據驅動的港口泊位分配問題研究：塑造高效、綠色、公平的船舶服務規劃

25223223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25223223.value: Seaports are the key nodes in the seaborne transport network and are critical to economies around the world. However, port congestion has become a global issue, leading to enormous economic losses and contributing to significant environmental damage. In addition, the handling costs incurred for the port, the fuel costs incurred for the vessels, and the fairness in allocating service delays among vessels are also important factors affecting the competitiveness of a seaport. As one of the world's busiest seaports, efficiency is crucially important for the Port of Hong Kong. Meanwhile, the port also faces fierce competition from its neighboring counterparts. Effective measures are urgently needed to enhance the performance of the Port of Hong Kong and maintain the city's competitiveness as an international maritime center. Berths, allocated places for vessels to dock, are the most important resource in a seaport. The performance of a seaport largely depends on the quality of its berth allocation plans. A good berth allocation plan represents a well-balanced tradeoff between efficiency, environmental impacts, costs, and fairness. Achieving an appropriate tradeoff is challenging, as it calls for the development of advanced operations research methods. The uncertainties of vessel arrival and handling times further complicate the decision procedure. The proposed project aims to design decision-making tools for seaports to generate berth allocation plans that are efficient, cost-effective, eco-friendly, equitable, and also robust against time uncertainties. To this end, the project will first develop deterministic and stochastic optimization models for the berth allocation problem. These models aim to create high-quality berth allocation plans by formulating an effective collaborative decision scheme between a seaport and its calling vessels over a novel and comprehensive multi-criteria evaluation system. We will also develop data-driven optimization approaches to solve the berth allocation problem. Using the large-volume, rich-detailed vessel traffic data, we will leverage machine learning (ML) algorithms to estimate posterior distributions of vessel arrival and handling times. Given the outputs of the ML algorithms and their features, we will generate estimated times with time buffers for the deterministic model and important scenarios for the stochastic model. To solve realistic instances, the project will develop solution algorithms that embed Benders decomposition and column generation in a branch-and-bound framework. Finally, case studies of the Port of Hong Kong will be conducted to demonstrate the practical applications of the project, which will ultimately help improve the performance of the port and contribute to its competitive advantages. 港口是海洋運輸網絡中的重要節點，對世界經濟發展有著重要作用。近年來，港口擁堵愈發成爲一項全球性的問題，造成大量經濟損失和嚴重的環境影響。除了裝卸效率和環境影響外，港口的服務水平和競爭力還受到其他多個因素的影響，包括其裝卸成本、相關船舶的燃油成本以及裝卸延誤在船舶間分配的公平性。香港港是世界上最繁忙的港口之一，高效的服務對其運營至關重要。與此同時，香港港也面臨著來自臨近港口的巨大競爭壓力。對港口管理方而言，爲提升香港港的服務水平幷維持香港作爲國際航運中心的地位，制定、實施有效的管理措施刻不容緩。 港口中的泊位爲船舶提供了靠泊位置，是港口中最爲重要的資源。港口泊位分配計劃的質量對港口服務水平有著重要的影響。高質量的泊位分配計劃應當實現裝卸效率、環境影響、服務成本以及公平性之間的平衡。而實現這些因素之間的有效權衡需要新的運籌學方法，其設計理論難度較大。此外，船舶到達和裝卸時間的不確定性則使得整個决策過程變得更爲複雜。 本研究項目將爲港口提供决策支持，以生成高效、環保、公平幷在不確定環境下能保持一定穩健性的泊位分配計劃。爲此，本項目將首先開發針對泊位分配問題的確定性和隨機優化模型。該模型將基于新型綜合性多目標評價系統，構建港口與挂靠船舶之間的協同决策機制。 爲高效地求解該模型，本項目還將開發一種數據驅動的優化方法。首先，基于海量的歷史船舶交通信息，本項目將通過機器學習方法分析船舶到達和裝卸時間的後驗分布。在此基礎上，本項目將爲確定性優化模型設置相應的緩衝時間，幷爲隨機優化模型産生重要的分析情境。爲求解具有實際規模的泊位分配問題，本項目將進一步基于分支定界框架，幷結合Benders分解技術和列生成技術設計高效的優化算法。 最後，本項目將利用香港港的實際案例測試模型和算法。案例分析結果有利于香港港提升其服務能力，幷最終增强其服務競爭力。

25232523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25232523.value: 鋅溴液流電池中的兩相流動與傳質問題研究

25232523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25232523.value: 本項目旨在研究鋅溴液流電池中的兩相流動和傳質特性。鋅溴液流電池具有高能量密度、低成本和優秀的可擴展性，是具有廣闊前景的長時儲能技術。然而，由於鋅溴液流電池性能較差，使得其尚未進入主流市場。一般而言，鋅溴液流電池需要加入溴絡合劑以解決交叉污染和腐蝕問題，但充電過程中形成的油相多溴化物會導致複雜的兩相流問題。一方面多溴化物相的形成會降低Br2/ Br−的氧化還原反應動力學，並可能沉積在電極表面，阻塞活性位點，從而導致嚴重的活化和濃差極化。另一方面，油-水兩相混合不良會導致正極中電解液分佈不均，這不僅會降低電池性能，還會觸發負極中的非均勻鋅沉積和枝晶生長。在本項目中，我們擬開發一種具有流場結構的鋅溴液流電池。與傳統的穿流式結構相比，旁流式的流道能將電解液均勻傳送到多孔電極中。我們的初步研究顯示，採用旁流式結構能夠將鋅溴液流電池的能量效率提高10%以上。為了進一步提高性能，我們將採用實驗與模擬相結合的方法，深入研究兩相流動傳質現象與電化學反應的耦合特性。具體而言，我們將：i）設計獨特的透明流動電池，原位研究設計和操作參數對兩相流行為和電池性能的影響；ii）開發多相傳質-電化學耦合模型，研究兩相流動與物質傳輸特性；iii）設計和開發梯度多孔電極，以協同強化離子、電子和物質的傳輸和均勻分佈； iv）優化並展示具有優異性能的鋅溴液流電池。本項目不僅能夠加深我們對鋅溴液流電池中兩相流現象的理解，還將推進一種最有前途的能源儲存技術的發展，促進可再生能源的利用。

25300323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25300323.value: 新型靶向脂肪組織的腸道酚類代謝物通過介導脂肪酸代謝以拮抗肥胖症

25300323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25300323.value: 肥胖症已經演變成一種世界性的流行病，其嚴重性與日俱增。白色脂肪組織功能障礙是肥胖症的主要標誌，影響能量代謝，加劇代謝紊亂，亦是重要的治療靶點。多酚是一種植源性天然產物，具有公認的代謝健康益處。我們的前期研究發現樹莓多酚提取物顯著降低高脂飲食誘發的小鼠身體肥胖併增加其能量消耗。然而，其體內發揮生物活性的成分和抗肥胖的機制尚不明確。由於其極低的生物利用度和未知的組織靶點，多酚的應用受到很大限制，而它們的腸道代謝物（如樹莓多酚衍生出的尿石素，主要為尿石素A和C）的生物利用度相對較高。我們的初步研究數據錶明，可以於脂肪內纍積的酚類代謝物中，尿石素C對成熟脂肪細胞內脂質積聚的抑制作用最強，甚至高於已知有抗肥胖功效的尿石素A。我們進一步評估了尿石素 C及其首過衍生物二甲基尿石素C在高脂飲食餵養的小鼠中的生物利用度、身體分佈和調節代謝的活性。我們首次發現尿石素C和二甲基尿石素C可以持續積聚於白色脂肪組織中超過24小時，而併非靶嚮肝臟。此外，非靶嚮代謝組學顯示尿石素C及二甲基尿石素C可以在短期內顯著降低具有脂毒性的酰基肉堿併上調與脂肪酸分解代謝相關的信號分子。在白色脂肪組織中，我們還發現AMPK被激活，AMPK是一種已知能促進脂肪酸氧化和脂肪組織產熱的主要能量感應酶。綜上所述，我們認為尿石素C及其衍生物可以通過促進脂肪酸分解代謝來減輕肥胖引起的白色脂肪組織功能障礙和脂毒性。

25300823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25300823.value: 基於延長二維單層雜化鈣鈦礦中熱載流子壽命的理論研究

25300823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25300823.value: 太陽能電池作為清潔能源技術能夠緩解全球能源危機併實現零碳排放。在這個背景下，提高太陽能電池的光電功率轉換效率（PCE）成為當務之急。然而，傳統太陽能電池受限於Shockley-Queisser能量轉換極限，難以進一步提升PCE。熱載流子太陽能電池（HCSCs）通過收集熱載流子的額外能量，為提高功率轉換效率帶來了重要機遇。然而，當前實現高效HCSCs仍受制於短暫的熱載流子壽命，這導致熱載流子提取效率低下。與傳統半導體相比，二維層狀雜化鈣鈦礦具有更長的熱載流子壽命，併在受光照、濕度和熱等影響下錶現出更好的穩定性。因此，它被認為是極具有前景的吸光材料。在深入探索和理解這類材料中的熱載流子冷卻過程方面，研究仍處於起步階段。為延長熱載流子的壽命，需要對二維層狀雜化鈣鈦礦中熱載流子冷卻動態進行原子級別的理解和策略性調控。本項目的核心目標包括：（i）深入研究熱載流子冷卻機制以及優選的晶體相，以實現熱載流子壽命的延長；（ii）深入理解電子結構（自旋軌道耦合和能帶分裂）對調控熱載流子壽命方面的作用，為延緩熱載流子冷卻提供新途徑； （iii）提供關於適當金屬離子摻雜的指導，以進一步提高熱載流子壽命。初步研究結果錶明，具有交替陽離子的二維單層雜化鈣鈦礦能夠有效延長熱載流子壽命。這個項目的研究將有助於揭示雜化鈣鈦礦中熱載流子冷卻機制，從而延長熱載流子的壽命，併為提升HCSCs的性能做出重要貢獻。

25301523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25301523.value: 數據驅動研發高性能二維電子器件的高介電材料

25301523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301523.value: 二維（2D）半導體，如二硫化鉬（MoS2），由於其優異的物理性能和原子層級的厚度，可以最小化短通道效應，因此被視為後摩爾定律時代納米電子器件有前景的溝道材料。然而，開發高性能的2D電子器件仍面臨挑戰。其中最重要問題是2D半導體與高k介電層之間的界面態密度過高，歸因於高k介電層表面存在的懸掛鍵和直接集成過程中對2D半導體的損傷。雖然基於轉移技術的集成可以緩解這些問題，但其難以大規模擴展、在實際應用中應用前途有限。因此，發現可以與2D半導體形成高質量界面並與半導體製造過程兼容的無懸掛鍵高k介電材料是非常必要的。 在本研究中，我們計劃使用數據驅動的方法開發無機分子晶體（IMCs）作為這樣的高k介電材料，這將極大地加速開發過程並降低成本。首先，我們將基於IMCs的結構特點，開發一個高通量計算篩選算法，從龐大的材料空間中有效地識別出候選IMCs。其次，我們將使用高通量第一性原理計算來計算IMCs的穩定性、帶隙和介電常數，以篩選出有前景的高k介電材料。第三，我們將使用深度密度泛函理論（DFT）計算來詳細研究IMCs薄膜和單層MoS2之間的關鍵界面屬性，如能帶偏移、缺陷性質和漏電流密度等。第四，我們將進一步通過實驗驗證理論預測的最有前景的界面，並展示高性能的2D電子器件。此外，我們將建立一個數據庫，共享IMCs結構-性質關係的高質量DFT數據。這個項目的實施有望識別出有前景的高k介電的IMCs，並為高k介電材料和2D半導體的高性能界面提供合理的設計原則。這將推動高性能2D電子器件及其新興設備應用的發展，提高可靠性並大大降低功耗。

25301923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25301923.value: 對於具備信息圖結構的比較數據的統計分析

25301923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25301923.value: 隨著東京奧運會的開幕和2022年足球世界杯的臨近，全球體育比賽正在以越來越快的速度從2019冠狀病毒病大流行恢復過來。這樣的體育比賽產生了豐富的數據，可以用於參與者的定量分析。這些體育比賽產生的數據通常包含兩部分：比較結果和比較圖，即參與個體之間的比賽圖。分析比較數據是指量化個體的能力值，隨後用於預測和排名。比較數據分析中最流行的方法之一是Bradley-Terry-Luce（BTL）模型。大多數依賴BTL模型的研究工作只關注比較結果，卻忽視了比較圖中的信息。具體來說，為了便於分析，比較圖通常被視為與比較結果獨立的一個部分。然而，這種簡化在真實的數據分析中可能並不總是適當的。例如，能力值更高的參與者更傾向於積極參與比賽，質量相近的商品更可能被拿來比較。這種觀察中的有偏採樣給分析比較數據帶來了新的問題和挑戰。為解決這些問題，此項目的主要目標是開發新的統計方法來分析比較數據，這些方法會將比較圖中的額外信息納入考慮範圍。本研究首先將兩個基礎模型，即貝塔模型和BTL模型結合，結合以得出貝塔-BTL模型，用於模擬比較結果和比較圖之間的依賴關係。我們為參數估計開發了一種高效的計算算法，並為高維圖參數（包括一致性和漸近正態性）建立了漸進性質。在此基礎上，我們考慮了貝塔-BTL模型的幾種擴展，以適應比較圖的各種生成機制以及不同類型的比較結果。該項目針對比較數據分析中的基本問題，其結果有望在體育分析、文獻計量學、推薦系統和其他領域具有廣泛的應用。

25303523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25303523.value: Boltzmann方程的流體動力學邊界層分析

25303523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25303523.value: 在存在物理邊界的情況下，嚴格驗證從Boltzmann方程到可壓縮Euler方程的極限一直以來都是動理學理論中的一個最基本的公開問題。此問題的本質困難產生與氣體與邊界之間的相互作用，以及因此所產生的在邊界附近的奇性結構。為了解決此問題， Sone等發展了一套漸進理論，並猜測在Euler流和Knudsen層之間存在一個流體動力學邊界層。在這個層裏，稀薄氣體的性態基本與高雷諾數流類似。 基於這樣的相似性，我們在此課題中想要研究層流不穩定性——一個在高雷諾數流中普遍存在的現象，能否在小Knudsen數假設下的Boltzmann方程的解中展現出來。我們將探究兩類流體動力學邊界層的不穩定性機製：第一類是帶拐點的層流。這類層流在宏觀無粘的擾動下是不穩定的。我們希望證明相關的Boltzmann方程的解也會具有譜不穩定性。更進一步，我們也會探究其非線性不穩定性。第二類層流具有很好的結構：幾何上它們是單調的和凹的，并且在宏觀層次它們滿足Rayleigh穩定性準則。然而經過漸進分析我們猜測，對應的Boltzmann方程的解中會產生很強的宏觀-微觀相互作用。這種相互作用會導致流體邊界層流在動理學層次的譜不穩定性。這個機製与高雷諾數流中的Tollmien-Schlichting不穩定性類似：當Knudsen數趨近於零時，宏觀-微觀相互作用將會約化到粘性-無粘相互作用。利用我們最近在亞音速邊界層流的工作中所發展的方法，我們將試圖從數學上嚴格驗證這一猜測。所期待的結果將清晰的揭示無窮小的微觀量會對稀薄氣體的形態產生不可忽略的影響。 最後，我們期待在此課題中所得到的結果不僅可以提供對流體動力學極限框架下Boltzmann方程解的性態的一個新的理解，而且可以在物理和工程领域中被廣泛地應用。

25305023.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25305023.value: 通过时间分辨分析扫描透射电镜解析金属氧化物光电神经形态器件的阻变和突触塑性机制

25305023.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25305023.value: The rapid development and wide applications of the internet of things (IoT) have put forward urgent requirements for high-performance artificial visual systems. However, state-of-the-art artificial visual systems are mostly based on complementary metal-oxide semiconductor (CMOS) sensors, in which the sensing, memory and processing units are physically separated. This leads to massive data conversion and transmission during device operation, hindering device efficiency and integrity improvement. Therefore, it is highly desirable to integrate sensing, memory and processing functions in intelligent image sensors for high-efficiency artificial visual systems. As an emerging smart information device, optoelectronic resistive synaptic device (ORSD) multifunctionally integrates optical sensing, memory, and optically-controlled synaptic plasticity into a single device, thus providing a promising solution for neuromorphic sensing in visual systems. Considering the compatibility with wafer manufacturing in the integrated circuit (IC) industry, metal-oxide ORSDs show promising potential in fabrication and application. The two-terminal nature of typical metal-oxide ORSDs also simplifies the large-scale integration. However, the lack of onsite detection of metal-oxide ORSDs’ working dynamics restricts the understanding of component-structure-property relationships, which blocks the further improvements and engineering of this novel device. Scanning transmission electron microscopy (STEM) is one of the most powerful tools for studying structure and physical properties with ultra-high spatial resolution. More importantly, STEM can provide a cross-sectional perspective for investigating devices’ inner and interfacial information. Based upon our newly developed in situ optical-electrical testing platform, controllable light stimulus and electrical testing can be applied simultaneously inside the TEM to simulate optoelectronic devices’ working conditions. Therefore, we propose to combine onsite in situ measurements with advanced analytical STEM approaches to unveil the physical mechanisms of metal-oxide ORSDs’ light-response properties. With the in situ light stimulus-driven resistance change, the evolutions of physical quantities, including structure, component, oxidation state, interfacial potential, and charge density in metal-oxide ORSD specimens, will be revealed by STEM imaging, diffraction and spectroscopy methods. Moreover, the time-dependent light-dosage controlled synaptic plasticity formation process will be captured by time-resolved analytical STEM using high-sensitive ultra-fast detectors. Machine learning tools will facilitate the high-efficiency extraction and analysis of valid data from in situ STEM datasets. Supported by theoretical calculations, our explorations will bring new insights into the origin of metal-oxide ORSDs’ light-tunable resistive switching and synaptic functions. The in-depth understanding of devices’ physical model and influence factors will then guide our efforts on the specific engineering with modulations on structure, components and defects for desired performances. 物联网的快速发展和广泛应用对高性能人工视觉系统提出了迫切需求。然而，现有的人工视觉系统大多基于互补金属氧化物半导体传感器，其中传感、存储和处理单元是物理上分离的。这导致设备运行期间需要进行大量的数据转换和传输，从而阻碍了设备效率和系统集成度的提高。因此，有必要在智能图像传感器中集成感知、存储和处理功能，以满足高效人工视觉系统的需求。 作为新兴智能信息器件，光电阻性突触器件将光学感知、存储和光控突触可塑性多功能地集成到单个设备中，为视觉系统中的神经形态感知提供了有希望的解决方案。考虑到与集成电路行业晶圆加工工艺的兼容性，金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件在制造和应用方面显示出极大的潜力。典型金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件的二端性质也简化了大规模集成。然而，目前对金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件的工作过程和机制仍缺乏表征，限制了对组分-结构-性能关系的理解，这阻碍了对这种新型器件的进一步改进和产品化。 扫描透射电子显微镜是具有超高空间分辨率的研究材料结构和物理性质的最强大工具之一。更重要的是，扫描透射电子显微镜可以提供横截面视角，用于研究器件内部和界面的信息。基于我们新开发的原位光电测试平台，可以在透射电子显微镜中同时应用可控光刺激和电学测试，从而模拟光电器件的工作条件。因此，这一研究项目拟将现场原位测量与先进的扫描透射电镜分析方法相结合，从而揭示金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件的光响应特性的物理机制。 在透射电镜中通过原位光刺激驱动的光电阻性突触器件的电阻变化，同时利用扫描透射电子显微成像、衍射和谱学等分析方法，有望揭示金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件样品中结构、组分、氧化态、界面电势和电荷密度等物理量的演变过程。此外，通过使用高灵敏度超快探测器以实现时间分辨的分析扫描透射电镜表征，可以捕捉到与时间相关的光剂量控制的突触可塑性形成过程。机器学习工具将有助于从原位扫描透射电镜数据集中高效提取和分析有效数据。在理论计算的支持下，我们的研究将为金属氧化物光电阻性突触器件的光可调电阻转换和突触功能的起源带来新的见解。对器件物理模型和影响因素的深入理解将指导我们在结构、组分和缺陷方面的特定调控，以实现所需的性能。

25503923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25503923.value: 元宇宙营销在款待业中：客户的元宇宙体验如何影响现实世界的线下行为？

25503923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25503923.value: Hospitality businesses are jumping on the metaverse trend for marketing purposes. Some leading brands have already set plans for metaverse marketing campaigns, including major restaurants (McDonald’s, Wendy’s), hotels (Four Seasons, Ritz Carlton), and entertainment groups (Walt Disney, Warner Music Group). By building a digital twin of its property on a metaverse platform (e.g., Decentraland, Sandbox, Zepeto), a hospitality business attracts people to virtually experience its product and actualize the virtual experience in the real world. A hotel enables people to enjoy additional amenities (e.g., a rooftop lounge, a mediation class, an art exhibition) in its virtual property to increase their intention to experience the amenities in the real world. By allowing people to order its signature menu in the metaverse and receive it in the real world, a restaurant encourages them to experience its dining services in the physical property. In a virtual concert, an organizer allows attendees to take a selfie or dance with the avatar of an artist aiming to heighten their excitement for the artist and thus lead them to buy a ticket for the real concert. Although a hospitality business expects the metaverse experience to impact customers’ intentions to visit and their offline behavior, it is unclear how the experiences influence those aspects. This research aims to examine the impact of the metaverse experience on customers’ intentions to visit and their offline behavior by answering the following research question: Does the metaverse experience induce customers to have a higher intention to visit a hospitality business’s physical property and repeat what they did in the virtual space in the real world? Furthermore, this research attempts to find boundary conditions that affect the impact of metaverse experience on customers’ intentions to visit and their offline behavior. In this regard, the following question is investigated: Under which conditions are customers more willing to visit a hospitality business’s physical property and more likely to repeat what they did during the metaverse experience in the real world? Among the hospitality sectors actively implementing metaverse marketing, this research selects the restaurant sector to answer the research questions. The findings of this research would allow a hospitality business to have clear expectations about metaverse marketing and improve its marketing strategies. Theoretically, given the scarcity of empirical studies on the impact of the metaverse experience on customers’ pre-trip and during-trip reactions, this research would serve as a fundamental work for future metaverse studies in the hospitality field. 款待业务正越来越多地借助元宇宙趋势进行营销。一些领先品牌已经制定了元宇宙营销计划，包括主要餐厅（麦当劳、温迪）、酒店（四季、丽思卡尔顿）和娱乐集团（华特迪士尼、华纳音乐集团）。通过在元宇宙平台（例如Decentraland、Sandbox、Zepeto）上构建其虚拟财产的数字副本，款待业务吸引人们在虚拟空间中体验其产品，并将虚拟体验实现在现实世界中。 酒店让人们在虚拟财产中享受额外的便利设施（例如屋顶休息室、冥想课程、艺术展览），以增加他们在现实世界中体验这些便利设施的意愿。餐厅允许人们在元宇宙中点餐，并在现实世界中收到餐点，鼓励他们在实体店体验用餐服务。在虚拟音乐会中，组织者允许参与者与艺术家的虚拟形象自拍或共舞，以增加他们对艺术家的兴奋，从而引导他们购买真实音乐会的门票。 尽管款待业务预计元宇宙体验会影响客户的参观意愿和线下行为，但目前尚不清楚这些体验对这些方面的影响。本研究旨在通过回答以下研究问题，考察元宇宙体验对客户参观意愿和线下行为的影响：元宇宙体验是否导致客户更有意愿参观款待业务的实体店，并在现实世界中重复他们在虚拟空间中的行为？此外，本研究试图找出影响元宇宙体验对客户参观意愿和线下行为影响的边界条件。在这方面，以下问题将得到调查：在哪些条件下，客户更愿意参观款待业务的实体店，并更有可能在现实世界中重复他们在元宇宙体验中的行为？ 在积极推行元宇宙营销的款待业务领域中，本研究选择餐厅行业来回答研究问题。本研究的发现将让款待业务对元宇宙营销有明确的期望，并改进其营销策略。从理论上讲，鉴于对元宇宙体验对客户出行前后反应影响的经验研究较为稀缺，本研究将为未来款待业领域的元宇宙研究提供基础工作。

25504623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25504623.value: 提升中小型餐廳減少食物浪費的可持續性創新的能力：成本效益方法

25504623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25504623.value: In 2015, the United Nations proposed its 2030 Agenda for ensuring sustainable development by adopting 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs). SDG implementation requires businesses to innovate or adopt sustainability-oriented innovations (SOIs). However, not all businesses can adopt SOIs; in particular, small- and medium sized enterprises (SMEs) face challenges in adopting such innovations due to resource constraints. Nevertheless, SOIs can benefit SMEs by increasing their competitive advantages and ensuring their compliance with the sustainable development targets. SMEs both lack the financial and human resources possessed by their larger counterparts and cannot obtain information about the costs and benefits of adopting SOIs—especially information that is not easily observed or assessed or non-market-based information—due to their limited resources and knowledge. SMEs also may not have sufficient resources or experience to quantify information for use in their decision-making, which may negatively affect SME decision-making about the adoption of SOIs, rendering the process inefficient. It is unclear how this lack of information about the adoption of SOIs affects SME decisions. The literature does not examine the impact of information processing regarding SOIs on SMEs’ decision making about adopting SOIs, especially the impact of processing information on food waste SOIs on SMEs’ decision making about adopting these SOIs. SMEs may require extensive information from multiple stakeholders when adopting food waste SOIs. This information could be related to the costs and benefits of adopting such SOIs and could influence SME’s decision-making. However, given the above-mentioned limits on SMEs’ information related to SOIs and on their knowledge on how to process this information, this proposed project will answer the following research question: How can SMEs identify relevant cost and benefit information about SOI adoption to improve their decision-making? A mixed-method research design involving three studies will be used to answer this research question. Semi-structured interviews with ~45 successful SOI adopters in restaurants regardless of size (Study 1) and a self-reported questionnaire of ~500 consumers (Study 2) will be conducted to evaluate the costs and benefits of adopting food waste SOIs. Scenarios will be generated from the cost and benefit information obtained from these studies and will be used to survey 200 small and medium-sized restaurant owners and managers to evaluate their willingness to adopt SOIs (Study 3). The proposed project will benefit SMEs, consumers, industry associations, the Hong Kong government, and the environment in different time spans. 2015年，聯合國提出了確保可持續發展的2030年議程，通過了17個可持續發展目標（SDG）。 可持續發展目標的實施要求企業進行創新或採用可持續發展導向的創新（SOI）。 然而，並非所有企業都可以採用 SOI； 特別是，由於資源限制，中小企業在採用此類創新方面面臨挑戰。 儘管如此，SOI 可以通過提高中小企業的競爭優勢並確保其遵守可持續發展目標來使中小企業受益。 中小企業既缺乏大型企業所擁有的財力和人力資源，又由於其資源和知識有限，無法獲得有關採用 SOI 的成本和收益的信息，尤其是不易觀察或評估的信息或非市場信息。 中小企業也可能沒有足夠的資源或經驗來量化決策中使用的信息，這可能會對中小企業關於採用 SOI 的決策產生負面影響，導致流程效率低下。 目前尚不清楚缺乏有關採用 SOI 的信息如何影響中小企業的決策。 文獻沒有研究有關 SOI 的信息處理對中小企業採用 SOI 的決策的影響，特別是處理食物垃圾 SOI 的信息對中小企業採用這些 SOI 的決策的影響。 中小企業在採用食物垃圾 SOI 時可能需要來自多個利益相關者的大量信息。 這些信息可能與採用此類 SOI 的成本和收益相關，並可能影響中小企業的決策。 然而，考慮到上述中小企業與 SOI 相關的信息以及他們對如何處理這些信息的知識的限制，本擬議項目將回答以下研究問題：中小企業如何識別有關採用 SOI 的相關成本和收益信息，以改進他們的決策？ 本擬議項目將使用涉及三項研究的混合方法研究設計來回答該研究問題。 將對約45 家餐廳中成功採用SOI 的餐廳（無論規模大小）進行半結構化訪談（研究1），並對約500 名消費者進行問卷調查（研究2），以評估採用食物垃圾SOI的成本和收益。 情景將根據從這些研究中獲得的成本和收益信息生成，並將被用於調查 200 名中小型餐廳業主和經理，以評估他們採用 SOI 的意願（研究 3）。 擬議的項目將在不同的時間跨度內惠及中小企業、消費者、行業協會、香港政府和環境。

25504823.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25504823.value: 與虛擬人共同創造價值： 面對面服務過程中非語言交流的影響

25504823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25504823.value: The service industry has been suffering from long-standing staff shortages and high labour costs, which have only been exacerbated by the Covid-19 pandemic. In response, virtual humans (VHs)—digital representations of humans leveraging computer-generated graphics, natural language processing, and speech recognition and synthesis—are employed to supplement human services. Employing VHs will gradually transform the nature of communication in face-to-face service encounters and introduce fundamental changes to value co-creation. Through the theoretical lens of the embodied social presence theory (ESPT), this project aims to (1) understand and redefine the non-verbal communication of non-biological virtual agents, (2) identify major non-verbal cues of VHs in face-to-face service encounters, (3) examine VHs’ non-verbal communication as a key tool that influences customers’ engagement with value co-creation via perceived social presence, emotions, and cognitive framing of warmth and competence, (4) evaluate the moderating effects of VHs’ gender, task orientation, and customers' technology readiness on the proposed theoretical paths, (5) advance the VH amination and further train and test the heterogeneous hierarchical message passing network (HHMPN) in emotion detection. This project will collect data from three service design workshops (pertaining to research aims 1&2) and five between-subject field experiments (research aims 3-5). This project will include researchers from hospitality management, business, and computer science. Two technology partners: Alibaba.com (Alibaba, a Chinese multinational company) and Accel Innovations Limited (Accel, a listed technology innovation company in Hong Kong), will provide VH prototypes for field experiments and assist in emotion detection in real-time. Three hotels in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area (GBA): -Hotel ICON (Hong Kong), Westin (Guangzhou), and Swissotel (Foshan), will provide testbeds for field experiments. This project has the potential to make major theoretical and managerial contributions. This project can shed new light on creating technology-driven service innovation in hospitality and other service sectors. Emphasis is given to non-verbal communication as it is often overlooked in favour of verbal communication. Additionally, this project can augment the understanding of the ESPT and extend the research scope of dyadic interactions to human-to-VH interactions. AI technology is becoming increasingly dominant in society, and exploring value co-creation with VHs is critical for successfully navigating this revolutionary shift. This project will generate VH interfaces that maximise customer satisfaction and optimise the allocation of financial and human resources in an era of chronic labour shortages. Moreover, the results will facilitate extending the research to other service parameters and destination contexts beyond the GBA. 長期以來，服務業一直面臨人員短缺和工作力成本高昂的問題。 大流行病進一步加劇了這些問題。 為此，利用計算機生成的圖形、自然語言處理以及語音辨識和合成技術的數位化人類代表（簡稱虛擬人）被用來補充人類服務。 虛擬人的使用將逐步改變面對面服務接觸中的交流性質，併為價值共創帶來根本性變化。 通過體現社會存在理論的理論視角，本專案旨在：（1）理解並重新定義非生物虛擬代理的非語言交流; （2）識別虛擬人類在面對面服務接觸中的主要非語言線索; （3）研究虛擬人類的非語言交流作為一種重要的工具，通過感知社會存在影響客戶參與價值共創; （4） 評估參與者的性別、任務取向和客戶的技術準備程度對所提出的理論路徑的調節作用; （5） 推進參與者的類比，並進一步訓練和測試異構分層資訊傳遞網路的情緒檢測能力。 本專案將從三個服務設計研討會（與研究目標 1 和 2 有關）和五個主體間實地實驗（與研究目標 3-5 有關）中收集數據。 本專案將包括來自酒店管理和人工智慧工程的研究人員。 兩個技術合作夥伴--阿裡巴巴和高陞集團控股有限公司（高陞，一家香港上市科技創新公司--將為現場實驗提供 虛擬人原型，並協助進行實時情緒檢測。 粵港澳大灣區的三家酒店--香港唯港薈 酒店、廣州威斯汀酒店和佛山瑞士酒店--將為現場實驗提供測試平臺。 該專案有可能在理論方面做出重大突破，對於行業和社會發展有重大貢獻。 該專案可為酒店業和其他服務行業的技術驅動型服務創新帶來新的啟示。 本專案重點關注非語言交流，因為非語言交流往往被忽視，而語言交流則更受青睞。 此外，該專案還能加深人們對體現社會存在理論的理解，並將人際互動的研究範圍擴展到人與 虛擬人的互動。 人工智慧技術在社會中正變得越來越重要，探索與虛擬人共同創造價值對於成功駕馭這一革命性轉變至關重要。 在勞動力長期短缺的時代，本專案將生成能最大限度提高客戶滿意度並優化財力和人力資源分配的虛擬運營商介面。 此外，研究結果還將為將研究擴展到其他服務參數和目的地環境提供基礎。
