25509523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25509523.value: 创投对初创公司在劳动力市场方面的影响

25509523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25509523.value: 创投对初创公司的成长及创新起着重要的作用。现有文献已经从多个角度分析过创投的影响来源， 包括创投如何辅助初创公司在成长初期规避失败的风险， 提高初创公司的生产力及管理效力，以及为初创公司争取更多的资金来源同业务伙伴等等。该项研究将专注于一个被较少分析但潜在的重要影响来源：即创投对初创公司劳动力构成及员工流动率的影响。涉及的主要数据将包括商业性创投交易数据，初创公司在领英网站的劳动力层面数据，以及其他关于初创公司微观层面的数据。证实模型将会分析接受创投的初创公司在劳动力构成及员工流动率方面如何区别于未接受创投的匹配控制组。研究结果将对如何促进高增长型创业具有借鉴意义。

25509623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25509623.value: 通過柔性結構提高供應鏈韌性：理論及航運物流中的應用

25509623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25509623.value: 最近，烏克蘭衝突和疫情相關干擾導致的供應震盪正在重塑全球供應鏈。除了對抗需求不確定性外，供應鏈運營商必須有效地緩解供應方面的不確定性。與此同時，在理論和實踐中，適時和有效地應對需求不確定性的供應鏈策略——柔性結構的能力在文獻中已有充分記載。本提案旨在探討柔性結構如何減輕供應不確定性，如供應中斷（例如，在疫情封鎖期間意外減產）和價格不確定性（例如，生產成本或商品價格的波動）。 本提案由兩個研究構成。在理論上，提出的項目的第一部分旨在驗證長鏈結構在緩解供應方面的不確定性方面的有效性。長鏈結構是文獻中特別受到關注的一種特殊柔性結構。我們考慮需求和/或供應分布未知且部分特徵化的情況。本研究將提出一種新的技術，矩分解法，通過求解錐優化問題來獲得概率界限。項目負責人的初步研究表明，除了考慮供應不確定性的其他維度外，由於其能夠輕鬆地納入更多分布信息（例如高階矩信息和平均絕對偏差），提出的新技術可以（i）收緊現有的II型服務水平界限，以及（ii）提供一種新的I型服務水平保證。 為了將理論轉化為實踐，我們將通過海洋燃料采購決策進一步探索靈活系統的好處，該決策占海運物流的總經營成本的50-80％。該應用首先提出了一個靈活的海洋加油網絡，其中一家海洋運輸公司與多家海洋燃料供應商簽訂合同。優化此網絡設計的問題可以被形式化為多階段隨機程序。第一階段選擇要簽訂合同的供應商。隨後階段根據實現的需求和燃料價格進行加油決策。為了更好地實現靈活的海洋加油網絡的好處，我們將開發一種數據驅動方法來優化加油決策，將現代機器學習的優勢與傳統運營研究建模和優化所獲得的結構洞察相結合。

25513423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25513423.value: 浪漫伴侣之间的收入差距如何影响共同消费决策

25513423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25513423.value: 收入差距，又称为收入不平等，指的是不同目标之间的收入分配差距，根据经济合作与发展组织（OECD），这是一个已被证明会影响经济增长和个体幸福感等多种结果的重要因素（Oishi、Kesebir和Diener，2011；Shankar和Shah，2003；Xie和Zhou，2014）。 但是，在一段浪漫关系中的收入差距如何影响共同消费决策呢？想象一对夫妻的生活方式，两位浪漫伴侣的收入大致相同。例如，一方可能每年获得8万美元的收入，而另一方可能获得7万美元。现在，再看另一对夫妻，他们总共获得相同数额的收入（即15万美元），但两位浪漫伴侣之间的收入差距更大。例如，一方可能赚取10万美元，另一方可能赚取5万美元。作为一对在给定年份内共同拥有15万美元预算的夫妻，这两对夫妻是否会为自己作为一对做出类似的购买决策，或者收入差距会影响他们所做的共同消费决策的类型？ 这项研究采取了一种新颖的方法，通过调查收入差距的作用来理解浪漫夫妻的财务关系。具体而言，研究表明，浪漫伴侣之间更大的收入差距会增加他们对奢侈品的偏爱。回到之前的例子，这个理论认为，与前一对夫妻相比，后一对夫妻更有可能为共同消费购买奢侈品。我在锚定文献的基础上提出，这种效应是由夫妻对更高收入者的收入（即10万美元）的锚定所驱动的，而不是夫妻的总收入水平（15万美元）。对于高收入差距的人而言，更高收入者的收入的显著性增加了两位伴侣作为一对的感知财富，相较于低收入差距的情况。这种作为一对的财富感知导致更强的共同消费奢侈品的偏好。研究最后提出了一个简单的引导，以促进加法思维，以减弱收入差距的影响。

25606623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25606623.value: 財務管理與各種針對中國女性的親密關係暴力：一項基於賦能理論的研究

25606623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25606623.value: Intimate partner violence (IPV) affects disproportionally women compared to men. This pattern is consistent across different cultural contexts (including in China) and causes severe harm to women’s well-being (Chen & Chan, 2021; Postmus et al., 2012; WHO, 2012). Since the outbreak of the COVID-19 pandemic, IPV against women has spiked further across the world (Morgan & Boxall, 2020). Thus, efforts are needed to address the long-existing and recently intensified problem. Two critical avenues for reducing IPV against women have been identified: promoting financial well-being and improving relational power (economic empowerment and psychological empowerment; Mandal, 2013; Raj et al., 2018). Women who experience low levels of financial well-being usually lack choices outside of relationships, which impedes their relational power and increases the risk of men perpetrating violence against women (Eggers de Campo & Steinert, 2022). Furthermore, the COVID-19 pandemic disproportionally harmed women’s financial well-being, leading to new IPV cases (Connor et al., 2020; Morgan & Boxall, 2020). As such, economic empowerment should be a priority for tackling IPV against women. Financial management has been found to facilitate financial well-being across different SES groups (Bhutoria & Vignoles, 2018; Chan et al., 2021; Dew & Xiao, 2011; Li et al., 2021). Financial management also improves relational power (Schuler & Nazneen, 2018) and reduces sexual/physical/psychological IPV against women (Eggers de Campo & Steinert, 2022). Nonetheless, Chinese women (especially those who are older and in lower SES) lack opportunities to learn financial management capabilities (Niu et al., 2020; Rink et al., 2021), and limited attention has been paid to improving Chinese women’s financial management capabilities (All-China Women’s Federation, 2021). This project is among the first in China to examine women’s financial management as an avenue for (economically and psychologically) empowering women and in turn reducing IPV against women. For an in-depth understanding, we will employ a convergent mixed methods design. Across different age and SES groups and using quota sampling, 940 women in different-sex relationships will be recruited. For the first time, we will consider the occurrence (versus non-occurrence) and extent of five types of IPV (e.g., physical IPV and economic abuse; Eggers de Campo & Steinert, 2022). We will also consider a variety of aspects of financial management (i.e., knowledge, attitudes, self-efficacy, and behaviors; Kaiser et al., 2022). Finally, we will use quantitative and qualitative findings to design/implement a pilot intervention, which will contribute to existing efforts in China to reduce IPV against women. 針對女性的親密伴侶暴力在世界乃至中國範圍內都普遍存在，並對女性的福祉造成嚴重損害（Chen & Chan，2021；WHO，2012）。自新冠大流行開始，全球範圍內針對女性的 親密關係暴力激增（Morgan & Boxall，2020）。因此，我們迫切需要解決這一長期存在且日益加劇的問題。 根據賦權理論和實證研究，減少針對女性的親密關係暴力的兩個關鍵途徑是促進女性的財務健康（即經濟賦權）和提升女性在親密關係中的權力（即心理賦權；Mandal，2013；Raj et al., 2018）。財務健康意味著滿足生活需求的財務安全和追求個人發展的財務自由。親密關係中的權力則意味著在參與、制定家庭決策和管理家庭資源的能力（Mandal，2013；Raj et al., 2018）。缺乏財務健康的女性通常在親密關係中也缺少權力，也更容遭受男性伴侶的親密關係暴力(Connor et al., 2020; Morgan & Boxall, 2020)。同時，新冠大流行對女性財務健康的損害尤為嚴重，這也使得一些之前未遭受過侵害的女性開始經歷親密關係暴力（Connor et al., 2020; Morgan & Boxall, 2020）。因此，在這兩條途徑中，我們將促進女性財務健康視為首要任務。 研究發現，財務管理可以促進不同社會經濟地位群體的財務健康（Bhutoria & Vignoles, 2018; Chan et al., 2021; Dew & Xiao, 2011; Li et al., 2021）。財務管理還可以提高親密關係中的權力（Schuler & Nazneen，2018）並減少針對女性的性、身體、心理暴力（Eggers de Campo & Steinert，2022）。然而，中國女性（尤其是年齡較大、社會經濟地位較低的女性）缺乏學習財務管理的機會（Niu et al., 2020; Rink et al., 2021）。國內對提高中國女性財務管理能力的關注也十分有限（全國婦女聯合會，2021）。 本項目是中國第一項關注女性財務管理，並將其作為經濟賦權、心理賦權、並減少針對女性的親密關係暴力的渠道的研究。為了加深理解，我們將進行混合方法研究，並採用配額抽樣招募940名不同年齡和社會經濟地位的女性。我們將首次考慮多種親密關係暴力的產生與否及嚴重程度（Eggers de Campo & Steinert，2022）。我們還將考慮財務管理的各個方面（即知識、態度、自我效能和行為；Kaiser et al., 2022）。最後，我們將利用混合方法研究的結果來設計並實施試點干預，這將有助進一步減少現有的針對中國女性的親密關係暴力。

25609323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25609323.value: 以應用語言學方法探討網上語言教學平台的歧視與個人推廣

25609323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25609323.value: 以應用語言學方法探討網上語言教學平台的歧視與個人推廣 過去十年，有數十個以語言教學為重心的網上平台冒起。這些平台價值數百萬美元，也有數百萬的語言學習者使用。全世界有數十萬人在這些平台上擔任語言導師——當中也包括數千香港人。全球對英文與普通話等熱門語言能力需求增加，該行業因此急速擴張。香港採用三語教育政策，使香港人在這個行業較易成功。然而，外間不會視英文與普通話為香港人的「母語」，因此他們在網上語言教學平台上也會受到歧視。這種針對非母語者的歧視又名「母語者主義」（native speakerism），該現象在非網上環境下已被研究得十分透徹，但鮮有以網上語言教學平台為背景，探討母語者主義的學術討論。 如同其他類型的網上平台工作者，網上語言導師會大量使用個人推廣突顯優勢，吸引潛在客人。個人推廣是非母語者對抗該歧視現象的重要手段，他們會直接向學生展示其專業知識。不過，我們對母語者及非母語者的個人推廣策略知之甚少，包括：1）其個人推廣策略種類；2）其個人推廣手法的話語層面；以及3）非母語者為反制或消除母語者主義影響可以採用哪些個人推廣策略。本項目將利用母語者主義相關研究、個人推廣理論，以及數碼平台技術支援，並採用多模式方法，就身份歧視與個人推廣在網上語言教學平台的交匯提供跨學科、全面的理解。 首席研究員（Curran & Jenks, in press）會基於其先導研究結果，先分析兩個大型網上語言教學平台（italki and AmazingTalker）上由網上導師自行撰寫的個人檔案。首席研究員會進行內容分析（n = 1,000），為不同網上導師採用的各種個人推廣策略分類。首席研究員亦會選取個人檔案（n = 20）作多模式分析，探討網上導師如何使用網上平台的多模式支援進行個人推廣。然後，首席研究員會訪問導師（n = 16）及學生（n = 16），以了解這兩個組別如何看待成功的個人推廣。最後，首席研究員會對italki平台的學習者（n = 900）進行調查實驗，以量化方式評估學習者對導師背景的偏好，以及量度導師採用的個人推廣策略對學習者偏好的影響程度。研究結果有助了解香港導師在網上語言學習平台所面對的歧視，以及他們能夠用以克服母語者主義的個人推廣策略。首席研究員會利用研究結果：1）就如何更有效地進行個人推廣，向非母語者導師提出建議；以及2）向網上語言教學平台提供建議，包括改變介面及搜索算法，協助所有合資格的網上語言導師確保一個不分族裔、國籍的公平市場。

25609723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25609723.value: 父母多維度心理控制與香港華人青少年的發展結果

25609723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25609723.value: Adolescents’ unfavorable developmental outcomes, including decreased well-being (e.g., life satisfaction) and increased ill-being (e.g., depression), recently intensified by COVID-19, have become serious social concerns in Chinese and other societies. Understanding the factors that affect adolescents’ developmental outcomes, either positively or negatively, is of great concern to parents, scholars, youth workers, and policymakers. Since parents are the primary socialization agents for children, parenting is a critical focus of inquiry. Parental psychological control (PC) has been described as dysfunctional parenting characterized by various intrusive practices (e.g., invalidating children’s thoughts and inducing shame or guilt) that aim to control and manipulate children’s emotional and cognitive experiences. Although PC, especially in its shame- and guilt-inducing forms, is commonly practiced by Chinese parents, findings regarding its effects on adolescent development have been contradictory, showing negative, insignificant, or even positive effects. Research gaps resulting in these discrepancies include the lack of a differentiated approach to PC based on a well-established multidimensional construct of PC in Chinese cultures and the insufficient attention paid to potential moderators, particularly parent–child relationship quality and adolescents’ cultural beliefs. This study seeks to address these research gaps and answer four research questions. First, drawing on a three-dimensional framework of parental PC among Chinese adolescents, we will examine the effect of each dimension on Chinese adolescents’ well-being and ill-being over time. Second, based on self-determination theory, we will explore the mediating effects of the satisfaction and frustration of adolescents’ basic psychological needs (i.e., autonomy, competence, and relatedness) on the relationship between parental PC and adolescents’ developmental outcomes. Third, we will test the hypothesized protective effect of high-quality parent–child relationships as it may make the child feel emotionally secure which would provoke positive attributions to parents’ PC, and it may also facilitate the internalization of external regulations and parental demands associated with PC. Fourth, we will explore the moderating effect of adolescents’ beliefs, positing that the more adolescents endorse Chinese beliefs about family collectivism, the less they are affected by their parents’ PC. We will conduct a three-year longitudinal study involving 1,300 Grade 7 Chinese adolescents in Hong Kong. The study will shed light on how different forms of PC and the proposed mediating and moderating mechanisms shape adolescents’ development in Chinese contexts. The findings will contribute to the development of parent education programs and family services to promote effective parenting and high-quality parent–child relationships, which ultimately nurture adolescents’ optimal development. 青少年群體的不良發展結果，包括幸福感（如生活滿意度）下降和不適感（如抑鬱症狀）增加，已成為中國和其他社會的嚴重社會問題。瞭解影響青少年發展結果的風險因素和保護因素是家長、學者、教育工作者、青少年服務工作者和政策制定者共同關注的話題。鑒於父母在兒童和青少年的成長中扮演著至關重要的角色，父母對子女的教養方式也成為這一領域重要的研究課題。 父母心理控制被認為是一種以侵入性方法（例如貶低或無效化孩子的看法，引發孩子的羞恥感或愧疚感）為特徵，旨在控制和操縱孩子的情感和認知體驗的不良教養方式。儘管使用心理控制手段，尤其是使孩子感到羞恥或內疚的方法，在中國父母中相對常見，但有關父母心理控制對中國青少年發展影響的研究結果卻不盡相同，甚至互相矛盾。導致研究結果出現不一致的原因包括：1）過往研究缺乏基於中國特定文化框架的、對父母心理控制多維度結構的準確定義和差異化測量，2）對潛在調節變數的影響，特別是親子關係品質和青少年家庭信仰的調節作用的關注不夠。 本研究旨在填補以上研究空白並回答以下四個研究問題。首先，本研究基於中國父母心理控制的三維度結構框架，考察不同維度父母心理控制對中國青少年發展結果的長期影響。其次，本研究基於自我決定理論探討青少年基本心理需求（即自主、勝任和歸屬）的滿足和挫折在父母心理控制和青少年發展結果之間的仲介作用。 第三，本研究將考察高品質親子關係的保護作用：好的親子關係令孩子擁有安全感，從而激發對父母心理控制這一教養方式的積極歸因；好的親子關係還可能促使孩子將父母心理控制所施加的規則和要求內化為自身動機。因此，良好的親子關係可能減弱父母心理控制對青少年發展的負面影響。第四，本研究還將探討青少年所持有的家庭信念的調節作用。我們預期青少年越支持家庭集體主義信念，他們受父母心理控制的負面影響就越小。 本研究將以香港1,300名七年級華人青少年為研究對象（即研究樣本），進行為期三年的縱向研究。該研究將揭示中國文化背景下不同維度的父母心理控制，以及研究提出的仲介和調節變數如何共同影響青少年發展。研究結果將有助於指導家長教育計畫和家庭服務政策的制定，以促進有效的父母教養方式和高品質的親子關係，從而令青少年得到最佳發展。

25610623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25610623.value: 親子關係的協商和發展: 同志與父母之間的親子關係研究

25610623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25610623.value: This study aims to examine whether and how Chinese parents work with their adult lesbian, gay, and bisexual (LGB) children to reflect on traditional family expectations and potentially create new forms of intimacy after the LGB child’s sexual orientation disclosure. The negotiations and tensions between family members are worthy of investigation, given the prominence of intergenerational interdependence in Chinese culture. Globally, many LGB people, particularly those fearing or experiencing parental rejection, are vulnerable to mental health risks, such as depression and suicidal thoughts. However, significant knowledge gaps remain in understanding LGB families of origin. Firstly, while ‘coming out’ to parents is a negotiation process affecting the entire family, the predominant focus has centred on LGB individuals, with limited attention to parents’ agency and concerns. Secondly, little is known about how parent-LGB child ties unfold over time. How and under what circumstances can intimacy be sustained between the two generations post-disclosure? Individual narrative interviews will be conducted with 20 families in Hong Kong, including LGB adults and (one or both of) their parents, to capture how they make meaning of what happens after disclosure of the child’s sexual orientation. Using the visual timeline method, each participant will also be asked to map important life events and transitions that facilitate or hinder parent-child emotional bonds. The analysis will address similarities and/or differences in why and how different family members tell these stories. The complexity of family negotiations, which may vacillate between confrontation and compromise, and between moments of denial and shame and those of acceptance and support, is also of interest. This study will link the personal, the familial, and the socio-cultural, drawing on the concepts of family imaginaries and practices of intimacy, combined with the theorisation of social scripts. Specifically, it will reveal how one works with family members to a place of mutual understanding and redefines intergenerational intimacy, and how traditional and new family scripts may collide and be (re-)interpreted. Conceptualising these processes as dialectical, the study moves beyond focusing on LGB vulnerability/agency and centres both LGB adults and their parents as active agents negotiating shared and/or conflicting expectations regarding family, marriage, and (grand)parenthood. With established collaboration with local organisations, mental health professionals, and corporate partners, this study will not only theoretically contribute to family sociology and gender and sexuality studies, but it will also inform services and interventions supporting family members with differing sexual orientations to build better relationships. 本研究旨在探討在成年同志子女告訴家長自己的性取向（出櫃）之後，家長如何與子女一起就傳統的家庭期望進行溝通與反思，以及如何重塑新的親子關係模式。鑒於傳統的中國文化中跨代家庭關係的重要性，家庭成員之間的關係和溝通是一個十分值得深入探討的議題。 在全球範圍內，許多同志，尤其害怕或曾經歷過被家長否定的同志，容易有較高的心理健康風險，例如容易抑鬱甚至產生自殺的念頭等。然而，我們對同志群體的原生家庭的瞭解依然知之甚少。首先，向家長出櫃是一個對整個家庭都會產生影響的過程，但目前的研究主要集中在同志個人身上，甚少了解家長的想法以及反應。其次，很少有研究深入研究同志子女與家長的關係如何隨著時間的變化而改變。因此，本研究的重點在於探討在同志向家長出櫃之後，有哪些因素可以促進兩代人之間的關係的發展？ 此研究將對二十個香港家庭中的成年同志以及其家長（一方或雙方）分別進行個人敘述訪談，以了解家庭如何解讀子女出櫃之後所發生的變化。此外，通過時間線的方法，每位參與者將繪製促進或阻礙親子關係的重要事件和轉折點。研究將分析不同家庭成員在講述這些經歷和故事的過程中的相同點和差異及其背後原因，亦會關注家庭成員之間的溝通和協商過程，包括過程中的衝突與妥協、否認與羞愧、接納與支持、或者在其他不同的立場和態度中間搖擺不定。 這項研究將借鑑「家庭想像」和「親密關係實踐」的概念，並結合「社會腳本理論」，將個人、家庭和社會文化聯繫起來。它將深入探討個人如何與家庭成員一起努力實現互相理解並重新定義跨代親密關係，以及家庭成員之間如何理解原本的家庭腳本並重新創造一個新的家庭腳本。本研究的重點不僅僅在於同志個人本身，而是同志和家長如何就家庭、婚姻、生育等觀點的差異及共識進行溝通和協商的過程。 此研究不僅在理論上為家庭社會學和性別研究做出貢獻，亦會通過與本地機構、心理健康專業人士及企業夥伴的合作，為支援同志家庭成員的服務提供重要資訊，以進一步提升同志與家庭成員之間的關係。

25612623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25612623.value: 詩學的構造：中國寫本文化中的詩歌收藏、文本形成及韻文演化（公元前479年至公元220年）

25612623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25612623.value: 在孔子（公元前479年逝世）身後的戰國時期，「詩」一詞主要是指早期儒家核心教材的一套歌曲，後來經典化為《詩》，漢代以來稱為《詩經》。本研究方案主要對象是中國早期韻文的脈絡中，《詩》是如何傳播的，而《詩經》是怎麼形成的。雖然《詩經》的典型和詮釋史對漢代以後「詩」文體的影響是眾所周知，但關於先秦「詩」的範疇和《詩》的經典化過程，一直以來都因為早期資料的匱乏而難以確認。然而，近年來，發現許多戰國秦漢（公元前479年–公元220年）的新出土材料。本項目將利用這些材料，其中包括《詩經》片段的寫本和上所未見的韻文，來展示在早期的中國寫本文化中，韻文是如何收集、傳播和閱讀的。 其最基本的貢獻是對幾個新出土文獻，包括詩歌集、最早對《詩》的詮釋材料和曲目等材料，進行首次詳細的分析和英譯。通過文獻學和翻譯，而對結構、韻律和互文的分析，第二個貢獻是將「詩」的詮釋史延伸到戰國時代，從寫本文化的視角來認識《詩》和「詩」的形成；不僅僅從歷代編纂、注釋角度來看。最後，有鑒於韻文的不同用法和模式（有助於文本背誦、文學紀錄、修辭效果、儀式性的語言魔法等等）將上述的成果與傳統的韻文學接軌，將新出土的簡帛材料放在傳世文獻、金文、石刻等零散研究領域的脈絡裡，綴合和重建早期中國的韻文學。

25615123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
25615123.value: 緊密文化與寬鬆文化中的自我意識與不道德行為

25615123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
25615123.value: In Mike Nichols’s film Closer, Dan once famously said, “What's so great about the truth? Try lying for a change, it's the currency of the world.” Has lying become the currency of the world? There's no shortage of unethical behavior making headlines across news outlets worldwide. Although less buzzworthy, dishonest actions have also crept into academia, and continue to show up in classrooms, businesses, and relationships. Given the prevalence of unethical behavior and its severe financial and reputational consequences, it is no surprise that behavior intervention has been the subject of much empirical research that seeks to mitigate unethical behavior (see Zhang, Gino, & Bazerman, 2014 for a recent review). Yet, despite this increased attention, much remains to be developed in primarily Western contexts, and we have very little knowledge of whether such interventions are effective in other cultural contexts. Studies have shown that inducing self-awareness of individuals’ moral standards is effective in curbing dishonesty (Batson, Thompson, Seuferling, Whitney, & Strongman, 1999; Diener & Wallbom, 1976; Vallacher & Solodky, 1979). self-awareness strengthens one’s motivation to uphold a positive view of the self, and when one’s perspective of cheating behaviors is inconsistent with a positive view of self, one is motivated to modify his/her behaviors (Kruglanski & Shteynberg, 2012). Based on the growing body of psychological and anthropological evidence that people across cultures hold divergent perceptions about the self, we examine how different aspects of self-awareness (private versus public) reduce unethical behavior in different cultures. More specifically, cultural contexts that emphasize the strength of social norms (i.e., cultural tightness-looseness) may emphasize one aspect of self-awareness more than the other, in turn, motivate behavior differently. Indeed, our pilot study provides preliminary support that raising private self-awareness is more effective in curbing dishonesty among individuals socialized in a loose culture, whereas increasing public self-awareness is more effective among tight culture individuals. In this proposal, we plan four studies further investigate whether different aspects of self-awareness reduce unethical behavior across tight-loose cultures. In Study 1, we will employ a cross-cultural survey to examine the link between public (versus private) self-awareness and tight (versus loose) cultures. Study 2a and 2b will experimentally manipulate private vs public self-awareness to explore its effects on dishonesty across cultures. Study 3 will experimentally manipulate cultural tightness-looseness to probe further the causal mechanisms underlying the effects. 在麥克·尼科爾斯的電影《愛情限時簽》中，主人公曾經著名地說過：“真相有什麼了不起？試著說说謊，那才是全世界都流通的貨幣。”謊言是否已經成為了流通世界的貨幣？不道德行為的新聞在全球的新聞媒體上屢見不鮮。这种的行為也已經滲透到學術界，並且繼續在課堂、企業和人際關係中出現。鑑於不道德行為的普遍存在以及其嚴重的財務和聲譽後果，行為干預已成為眾多實證研究的主題，旨在減輕不道德行為。然而，儘管這方面的關注有所增加，大多數研究仍主要在西方背景下進行，我們對這些結果是否可以推廣到其他文化背景中的了解甚少。 研究已經表明，引發個人道德標準的自我意識有助於遏制不誠實行為。自我意識強化了人們維護對自我的積極看法的動機。所以當一個人自我的積極觀和想要作弊的行为不一致时，他/她會有動機修正自己的行為。基於越來越多的心理學和人類學證據表明，不同文化背景下的人們對自我持有不同的感知，我們將探討自我意識的不同方面（私人和公共）如何在不同文化中減少不道德行為。更具體地說，強調社會規範力量的文化背景（即文化的緊密性-寬鬆性）可能會更加強調自我意識的某一方面，從而以不同的方式激發行為。 事實上，我們的研究提供了初步支持，即提高個人內省意識在遏制寬鬆文化社會化個體的不誠實行為方面更為有效，而提高公共自我意識在緊密文化背景中更為有效。在這個提案中，我們計劃進行四個研究，進一步探討不同自我意識方面是否能夠減少緊密與寬鬆文化中的不道德行為。在研究1中，我們將使用跨文化調查來研究公共自我意識（相對於個人內省意識）與緊密（相對於寬鬆）文化之間的聯繫。研究2a和2b將實驗性地操縱個人內省意識與公共自我意識，以探索它們對不同文化背景下不誠實行為的影響。研究3將實驗性地操縱文化的緊密性-寬鬆性，進一步探究其影響背後的因果機制

26100423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26100423.value: 整合CRISPR-Cas9全基因組篩選與合成基因環路用於炎症性腸病的治療

26100423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26100423.value: 炎症性腸病（IBD）已成為一個全球性的健康問題。這是一種目前尚無治愈方法的終身疾病。膳食、環境、遺傳因素以及人體腸道微生物群落都與疾病的發生和進展相關聯。作為主要常規治療方案的抗炎藥物卻常常會給患者帶來嚴重的副作用，極大地限制了其治療潛力。因此，我們迫切需要高效的靶向療法來緩解炎症性腸病患者的痛苦。 人類腸道上皮細胞與微生物群落之間的相互作用在炎症性腸病的發病和進展中起着相當重要的作用。尤其是腸道致病細菌，例如黏附侵襲性大腸桿菌（AIEC），與腸道微生物群落的失調有顯著的關係。然而，目前尚無有效的治療方法針對AIEC的定植以及對腸上皮細胞（IECs）的侵染。本研究項目旨在從宿主角度解決這個問題，期望能夠干預AIEC細菌的感染並恢復腸道生態系統的平衡。 我們將在模擬生理環境的體外共培養體系中進行高通量全基因組CRISPR-Cas9基因敲除遺傳篩選，系統地鑒定人類腸上皮樣細胞在致病菌侵染條件下的基因靶點，用以剖析IECs-AIEC複雜的相互作用，並鑒定細菌感染響應型轉錄因子，以指導人工合成啟動子（調控基因表達的短DNA序列）的設計。感染響應型合成啟動子將被整合到基因環路中，實現宿主細胞邏輯判斷的功能，從而特異性地高效驅動多種潛在治療載荷的表達，且不影響健康的宿主細胞。我們的長期目標是在人類腸上皮細胞中提供宿主導向的原位治療策略，通過安全的病毒載體傳遞並產生有效的治療載荷，而不引起全身性的副作用。 綜上所述，本研究項目將整合高通量CRISPR-Cas9遺傳篩選和合成生物學平台，為炎症性腸病中複雜的宿主-致病菌相互作用提供新的見解。本項目旨在開發一種基因環路驅動的宿主導向療法的驗證性平台，以恢復腸道局部生態系統的穩態，減輕炎症性腸病患者的痛苦。

26100923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26100923.value: 关于ATAD1在线粒体质量控制中机理的研究

26100923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26100923.value: 膜蛋白约占整个细胞蛋白质组成的三分之一。合成后，细胞必须将每种膜蛋白运送到正确的细胞器中，以确保其正常功能。尾锚定 (TA) 蛋白是一类特殊的膜蛋白，通过 C 末端锚定在膜上。最近的研究表明，ATAD1蛋白可识别错误定位到线粒体的 TA 蛋白，并将其从膜上提取出来。因为此功能，ATAD1 可以防止错误定位的蛋白质在线粒体上错误积累，并且还为这些蛋白质提供了第二次进入正确的细胞器的机会。 ATAD1 的活性对于正常细胞功能至关重要，因为缺乏 ATAD1 的细胞会出现线粒体功能受损； ATAD1 缺失的小鼠死于癫痫样综合征，ATAD1 的多种突变与人类神经系统疾病有关。尽管 ATAD1 在维持 OMM 上的蛋白质稳态方面发挥着重要作用，但一些关键问题仍未得到解答，并阻碍了该领域的发展：首先，ATAD1 识别和提取底物的机制是什么？跨膜结构域如何参与该反应？与疾病相关的突变如何影响其活性？这些问题的答案将提供对ATAD1 机制及其生理作用的重要知识，填补这个领域知识上的空白。

26103623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26103623.value: 運用單鹼基分辨率定量測序技術研究RNA修飾的生物學功能

26103623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26103623.value: RNA 修飾發生在幾乎所有生命形式的所有 RNA 物種中。例如，可逆的 N6-甲基腺苷 (m6A) 甲基化可調節各種生物過程中信使 RNA (mRNA) 的穩定性和翻譯。對於其他mRNA 修飾，例如假尿苷(Ψ)、2'-O-甲基化(Nm)、5-甲基胞苷(m5C) 和內含N7-甲基鳥苷(m7G)，其生物學功能的研究由於缺乏高特異性的抗體或缺乏在轉錄組範圍內對這些RNA 修飾進行測序的方法而長期受阻。在過去的三年裡，我參與開發了多種RNA修飾的定量測序方法，可在單鹼基分辨率下精確測定多種mRNA 修飾，例如針對m6A的m6A-SAC-seq、針對Ψ的BID- seq、針對2'-O-甲基化的Nm-Mut-seq，以及針對mRNA內含m7G 的m7G-seq。這些測序方法通過鹼基突變或鹼基缺失信號來監測RNA 修飾的化學計量變化，並準確地為修飾位點分配特定的“書寫”蛋白，從而促進“閱讀”蛋白的發現並揭示這些RNA 修飾的生物學功能。本項目從這些單鹼基分辨率、定量測序技術開始，進一步在生物技術開發和生物學功能研究層面進行拓展。首先，為解決在單細胞水平繪製mRNA 修飾圖譜的挑戰，本項目重點關注m6A和Ψ（哺乳動物mRNA中豐度最高的兩種化學修飾），旨在開發單細胞Ψ-BID-seq和單細胞m6A-SAC-seq，並實現其在生命科學領域中的廣泛應用。有關修飾位點位置和修飾化程度的細胞特異性信息，將以超精細表觀遺傳圖譜的形式闡明m6A和Ψ修飾如何調控早期胚胎髮育。其次，為系統研究染色質相關RNA（caRNA）上諸多種類RNA修飾（除m6A外）的生物學功能，基於BID-seq和m5C亞硫酸氫鹽等定量鹼基分辨率工具，本項目將研究caRNA上RNA修飾的分佈和生物學功能， 著重於caRNA中豐富的Ψ和m5C，並揭示這些RNA 修飾如何調節caRNA 穩定性、染色質可及性和轉錄激活等生物學過程的詳細機制。最後，在探索RNA病毒上的RNA修飾如何影響SARS-CoV-2感染時，Nm-Mut-seq揭示了SARS-CoV-2 RNA上許多位置存在著顯著的2'-O-甲基化(Nm)，其中大多數位點為高修飾化程度的Gm。本項目將研究何種宿主RNA修飾酶或病毒編碼甲基化酶作為SARS-CoV-2 RNA上Nm甲基化的“書寫”蛋白，並如何調節SARS-CoV-2病毒複製和基因表達。綜上所述，以上三部分内容將利用新的生物技術來研究多種RNA修飾在基因表達調控和多種生物過程中的功能和機制。

26201323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26201323.value: 疏水及高交换电流界面的可穿戴离子传感器以实现快速、长期连续监测

26201323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26201323.value: Current wearable technology for health monitoring centers on detecting “physical” vital signs. To expand opportunities for molecular recognition of “chemical” analytes through wearables, advancement in biochemical sensors is critical. Ions such as calcium and phosphate, essential minerals for bone health, are ideal candidates for wearable development. Direct detection of ions is commonly done by ion-selective electrodes (ISEs); however, ISEs cannot meet the requirements for long-term monitoring due to significant drift in measured potentials and repeated pre-conditioning requirements. The origins of the signal drifting come from inefficient ion-to-electron transducer (IET) and water permeation through the ion-selective membrane (ISM). To tackle the challenges, we will firstly develop a conducting polymer-based IET with high exchange current density and hydrophobicity. We will develop an enhanced IET utilizing PEDOT: PSS doped with transition metal complex such as hexacyanoferrate (HCF). This architecture will enhance the charge transfer kinetics and raise the redox capacitance to ensure a stable potential within a short time. Additionally, the IET will exhibit water repellent property due to the polymer backbone containing hydrophobic PSS block copolymer. Second, elastomer-based ISMs selective to Ca2+ and H2PO4-/HPO42- will be developed for high hydrophobicity and strong adhesion with the underlying IET to further prevent water permeation. We envision that such ISEs will enable continuous operation for 24 hours. Upon successful development of the ISEs, we will integrate them into our previously developed microfluidic chip containing sweat collection and sweat rate sensor. The system will be fully integrated with a small printed circuit board and will be tested in vitro and validated in vivo for a prolonged period. To demonstrate the promising potentials of our wearable system, we will finally perform correlation studies between sweat and blood Ca2+ and H2PO4-/HPO42- compositions. We envision that our ISEs investigation and development can guide future ISEs research to achieve long-term stability with minimal end procedures. Moreover, upon successful study of non-invasive approach to detect Ca2+ and H2PO4-/HPO42-, it can open a broad range of health applications to utilize sweat as a sampling source in wearable technology. 在健康监测中，现有的可穿戴技术主要致力于对“物理”生命体征的检测。为了拓展可穿戴设备在“化学”分析物方面的分子识别能力，生物化学传感器的进步是至关重要的。钙离子和磷酸根离子对于骨骼健康是不可或缺的矿物质，因此也是可穿戴传感器的理想目标物。离子的检测通常由离子选择性电极实现，然而，由于离子选择性电极存在剧烈的电势漂移和需要重复预处理等不足，其无法达到长期监测的要求。离子选择性电极的电势漂移源于较差的离子/电子转导性能和离子选择膜的渗水问题。 为应对该挑战，我们将首先开发具有高交换电流密度和疏水性的基于导电聚合物的离子/电子转导层。我们将利用铁氰化物等过渡金属复合物掺杂的聚（3,4-亚乙二氧基噻吩）/聚苯乙烯磺酸制备出高性能的离子/电子转导层。该结构可通过提升电荷转换动力学和增大氧化还原电容来实现快速的电势稳定。此外，由于离子/电子转导层含有疏水的聚苯乙烯磺酸嵌段共聚物，其会表现出疏水特性。进一步，我们会制备基于弹性体的对钙离子与磷酸氢根离子响应的离子选择膜，并将其用于制备离子/电子转导层，且该转导层的强疏水性及强粘附力会进一步抑制水的渗透。我们认为这种离子选择性电极可实现24小时的持续性检测。在成功开发离子选择性电极的基础上，我们将会把它们与先前开发的具有汗液收集和测速功能的微流体芯片结合。此系统会与一个微型印刷电路板整合，以用于长期体外测试，并将所得数据与体内检测结果验证。为了证明我们的可穿戴系统的巨大潜力，我们将进行汗液和血液中的钙离子、磷酸根离子的相关性研究。我们期望这项关于离子选择性电极的研究能够引领未来的离子选择性电极发展，即使用极少的终端步骤实现长期稳定的检测。此外，在成功实现非侵入式钙离子和磷酸根离子检测的基础上，该研究能为可穿戴汗液传感器技术开发更多健康应用的领域。

26204623.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26204623.value: 受強風荷載作用的混合木-鋼高層建築結構性能評估

26204623.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26204623.value: The impacts of the built environment on global climate change require city planners and construction stakeholders to seek more sustainable solutions toward safe, fast, affordable, and environmentally friendly urbanization, especially in dense metropolises like Hong Kong. In recent years, cross-laminated timber (CLT), a type of mass timber product, has gained global popularity for use in mid- to high-rise construction owing to its dimensional stability, adequate fire resistance, fast prefabrication, and excellent load resistance. The rapid expansion of the mass timber market also provides an opportunity for thinning out diseased or weakened trees and utilizing them to manufacture CLT panels to maintain healthier forests. Extensive research has been conducted on the material science, fire safety, and seismic resistance of CLT buildings. Their dynamic performance under strong wind loads, however, has rarely been investigated. As building height increases, wind loads could dominate the design. The lightweight and low-stiffness nature of CLT systems can lead to more vibration and discomfort for occupants. This is an important reason why taller timber buildings are not constructed in a typhoon-prone city like Hong Kong. Hybridization of CLT with other structural materials, in particular steel, combines their respective advantages to provide additional stiffness for novel timber-based skyscrapers. The proposed research will investigate the wind performance of a novel hybrid timber-steel (HTS) high-rise building. An advanced 3D finite element (FE) model for the HTS building using high-performance energy-dissipative connections will be developed. The model will capture the failure mode and load-sharing mechanism of the hybrid system under lateral loads, which are experimentally investigated through novel structural tests at both component-level and system-level. By performing wind tunnel pressure tests on prototype HTS buildings, spatiotemporal wind force data will be obtained for the dynamic analysis of the FE model. Influences of wind hazard, structural properties, and damping ratio on the wind responses of the HTS buildings will be quantified for the first time. The wind-structure interaction will be explored and the analysis results will be validated by performing wind tunnel aeroelastic tests. This proposed research will be the first attempt to quantify the wind effects on a hybrid tall timber-steel building. The successful completion of the project will provide essential information for the design, modeling, testing, and assessment of timber-based hybrid high-rise systems. With the rise of more CLT manufacturers in Mainland China, such system has particular potential for use in typhoon-prone Southeast Asian cities.

26208323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26208323.value: 施工任务中肌肉骨骼系统疾病风险评价：面向力量和重复因素的多模态学习方法

26208323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26208323.value: 全球建筑行业面临安全和健康的挑战。 体力疲劳在建筑工人中广泛存在，使得工人面临着高疲劳、受伤甚至死亡的风险，是引起施工安全事故的主要原因之一。 其中，肌肉骨骼系统疾病（MSDs）已被确认为建筑行业的重大负担。 此外，包括香港在内的许多国家和地区的建筑行业面临着劳动力老龄化问题。 建筑业迫切需要有效的MSD风险管理方法，以促进持续健康和高效的劳动力。 准确评估MSD风险是管理MSD风险的先决条件。 已有大量研究实现了施工任务期间MSD风险因素的自动监测，但多数关注姿态评估，而忽略了另外两个主要MSD风险因素-重物和重复任务-的识别和评估。 对以上因素的忽视极易导致建筑工人持续暴露于MSD风险中。 该项目旨在评估建筑工地上重物和重复任务所引起的肌肉骨骼系统疾病（MSD）风险。 研究难点在于：1）工人处于动态运动中，其外力难以准确估计; 2）工人重复动作往往不具备完全周期性。 面对上述问题，该项目旨在利用计算机视觉和可穿戴鞋垫技术来监测建筑任务中的重物处理负荷和重复任务：1）开发一种视觉传感器数据融合策略，以非侵入方式估计外力; 2）开发一种可以适应施工任务中不完美周期性模式的重复检测和计数机制; 3）实验室测试和现场试验验证。 该项目将采用多模态学习方法，利用视觉传感器模态的互补信息，获得准确的工人外力-姿态估计，使MSD风险评估方法对现场收集的原始数据的不完整性具有鲁棒性。 项目成果将使得MSD风险评估摆脱受控实验环境，适用于真实工地环境，有助于采集长期现场数据用於探究MSD成因，促进基于实际数据的MSD预防策略。

26208723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26208723.value: 從數據的角度理解電路布局：電子設計自動化中可信賴的機器學習技術

26208723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26208723.value: 隨着近年來集成電路的複雜性不斷增加，芯片的設計成本隨之上升。為了提高設計效率，基於機器學習的新方法已經在大量電子設計自動化（EDA）任務中展示出了潛力。然而一個被忽視的危機是，機器學習模型在電路上的預測經常不可靠。當模型用於從未見過的全新電路時，可能會出現意想不到的災難性錯誤預測。在實踐中，甚至模型開發者自己也不能準確地定義模型的適用範圍。而對電路的錯誤預測可能嚴重誤導設計者，包括提供錯誤的優化建議或忽視設計中存在的問題。這將延長設計周期、損害芯片質量、甚至導致芯片失敗。如果不能實現更可靠的電路設計預測，用戶最終將不可避免地對這項技術失去信心。 這種可靠性挑戰要求我們開發新技術。已有的工作主要側重於開發更先進的機器學習模型，而對電路數據本身的特殊屬性缺乏關注。我們認為電路是一種具有高度複雜性和異質性的特殊數據類型，這種特點加劇了可靠性問題。本項目將通過系統性分析挖掘電路數據，對電路布局相關的預測任務提供一般性的解決方案，包括設計規則檢查(DRC)熱點、電壓降熱點、和光刻熱點的預測。項目將提供可靠性評估技術，以避免信任不準確的預測。此外，項目還將增強模型可解釋性，以定量解釋每一個預測。它將幫助用戶檢查和理解每一個預測，從而進一步避免錯誤的預測。最後，我們將通過自動選擇適當的訓練數據來構建更可靠的模型。綜上，通過創新性地從理解電路數據的角度來提供解決方案，本項目將與已有的預測技術最大限度地兼容，並填補現有研究和商業化應用之間的差距。

26209123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26209123.value: 基於分佈式光纖傳感的結構性能評價：從應變分佈到結構損傷

26209123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26209123.value: 在災難事件發生後，現代城市需要能夠快速做出響應，以實現快速恢復。然而，這一韌性目標目前尚難以實現，因為大多數基礎設施為鋼筋混凝土結構，然而目前缺乏定量評估鋼筋混凝土結構性能的方法。目前的結構性能評估仍然依賴於工程師對結構表面損傷的目視檢查，這種方法既耗時又主觀。 分佈式光纖傳感技術有希望實現基礎設施結構性能定量評估。雖然分佈式光纖傳感技術已成功用於基礎設施損傷檢測，但以往的技術由於其精度和分辨率的不足，無法量化結構損傷。近期，高分辨率分佈式光纖傳感技術的發展，為實現從損傷檢測到損傷量化提供了可能性。特別是最新的分佈式光纖傳感技術，光頻域反射技術，提供了前所未有的高精度和分辨率。然而，儘管光頻域反射技術能夠詳細揭示局部應變，但目前仍難以從局部應變分佈推斷結構構件和整體結構的性能。因此，本研究旨在利用高分辨率分佈式光纖傳感技術，開發用於量化鋼筋混凝土結構損傷的方法和框架。在這個項目中，我們將結合高分辨率分佈式光纖傳感技術、精細的非線性數值分析、不確定性量化和機器學習，實現從應變分佈推斷結構層面損傷這一目標。具體目標如下： （i）開展實驗研究，應用分佈式光纖傳感技術進行剪切牆的監測，該實驗將被用於發展結構局部損傷量化方法，並提供實驗數據校准非線性數值模擬。 （ii）發展基於應變分佈的結構性能指標，並將其與機器學習方法相結合，利用應變分佈信息評估結構構件的損傷程度，並預測其剩餘承載能力。 （iii）考慮不同結構構件的重要性和損傷估計不確定性，優化分佈式光纖傳感器在結構層面的佈置，並發展基於物理機制的高斯過程模型，用於結構層面快速損傷評估。 總體而言，本項目將基於高分辨率分佈式光纖傳感技術，建立鋼筋混凝土結構損傷量化評估框架，推進基礎設施健康監測領域的發展。這一框架將為裝備分佈式光纖的結構實現實時自監測構建理論基礎。

26209223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26209223.value: 邁向零碳辦公建築-高密度城市環境中幕墻光伏一體化的綜合設計框架

26209223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26209223.value: Façade integrated photovoltaics (FIPV) is one of the most promising solutions to harvest solar energy and reduce carbon emissions in high-density urban contexts. Tall office buildings with large curtain walls are a typical building typology in city centres. However, due to the lack of suitable architectural methodologies and tools supporting the FIPV design for tall office buildings in high-density urban contexts, the potential of curtain walls’ FIPV application is rarely explored by practitioners. For instance, the glazing areas are often ignored for solar potential analysis in existing methods. As such, in this research, a holistic design framework will be developed to assist architects in designing curtain wall integrated PV systems, through a three-stage process covering 7 work packages. In the first stage, representative prototypes of tall office buildings and a pilot urban district will be converted into 3D BIM models for solar irradiation and interior daylight analysis (work package 1). Then the suitable solar irradiation thresholds range for curtain wall integrated semi-transparent PV will be investigated through multi-objective optimization simulations (work package 2). A multi-objective optimization algorithm will be developed to maximize energy production, energy saving, and balance the interior daylight performance. An analytical energy model describing the relationships among the performance of different objectives will also be proposed. The second stage consists of work packages 3-5 for experimental studies. In work package 3, scaled physical office room models with integrated PV materials will be constructed for an outdoor measurements campaign, validating the first stage’ results. In work package 4, the scaled office room models will be used for user-participated psychophysical studies (people can observe the interiors from the backside) to gain an in-depth understanding of how semi-transparent PV’ transmittances, integration positions and colour rendering properties will influence participants’ perceptions. Two or three promising semi-transparent PV designs will be applied to real office room façades for psychophysical validation. Parallelly, the impacts of the surface properties of opaque PV on the public’s visual preference will be analyzed (work package 5). The third stage is the summarization stage. In work package 6, the algorithm and the energy model will be improved, and holistic architectural design guidelines will be provided. In work package 7, the final research findings will be synthesized and integrated into a digital design framework to assist the architects’ decision-making regarding curtain wall integrated PV design. The design framework will be tested in collaboration with leading architectural companies. 立面光伏一體化（FIPV）是在高密度城市環境中收集太陽能並減少碳排放的最有前景的解決方案之一。 具有大面積幕牆的高層辦公樓是城市中心的典型建築類型， 然而，由於缺乏合適的建築方法和設計工具，現階段的建築設計流程中玻璃幕墻的太陽能利用潛力往往被忽略， 高密度城區辦公建築的幕牆FIPV的應用潛力亟待開發。 因此，本研究中將通過三個階段，涵蓋 七個子任務的研究，開發一個整體設計框架來協助建築師設計幕牆集成光伏系統。 在第一階段，我們將建立高層辦公樓和試點城區的代表性原型的3D BIM，以用於太陽輻射和室內日光分析（子任務一）。 然後通過多目標優化模擬研究適合幕牆集成半透明光伏的太陽輻照閾值範圍，最大限度地提高能源產量、節能並平衡室內日光性能（子任務二）。 在此基礎上提出描述不同目標性能之間關係的分析模型。 在第二階段我們將開展一系列實驗研究（子任務三至五）。子任務三中，我們將製作具有集成光伏材料的按比例縮小的物理辦公室模型，用於戶外測量以驗證第一階段的結果。 在子任務四中，我們將邀請參與者對縮放比例的辦公室房間模型進行心理物理研究，參與者可以觀察模型內部以深入了解半透明光伏的透光率、集成位置和顯色性屬性對參與者感知的影響。 表現優異的半透明光伏設計將被應用於真實的辦公室立面，以進行心理物理驗證。 子任務五將研究不透明光伏表面特性對公眾視覺偏好的影響。 第三階段是總結階段。 子任務六將基於第一及第二階段的成果優化算法和能量模型，並提供整體建築設計指南。 在子任務七中，最終的研究結果將被整合到數字設計框架中，以協助建築師做出有關幕牆一體化光伏設計的決策。 我們將和國際知名建築設計公司合作對該設計框架進行測試。

26209323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26209323.value: 模型預測控制優化香港住宅的能源效率與負荷柔性

26209323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26209323.value: 為實現香港的碳中和目標，電力系統正接入越來越多的可再生能源。大規模集成可再生能源對電力系統構成挑戰，因為可再生能源的隨機性和難以控制性。建築可以通過將負荷從電網壓力高峰期轉移到可再生能源豐富時期來幫助電網應對這一挑戰。模型預測控制（MPC）可以促進這種建築與電網的互動。然而，現有的研究主要集中在商業建築中應用MPC。儘管住宅建築具有可觀的節能和負荷轉移潛力，但它們在研究中被大大忽視。此外，在熱帶或亞熱帶地區，濕度控制的研究也存在不足。 本研究旨在開發適用於香港住宅建築的MPC控制器，以釋放其負荷柔性潛力。為實現這一目標，我們提出了包含三項任務的研究計劃。首先，我們計劃開發一個虛擬測試平臺，可以代表香港的高層公寓。其次，我們將先在虛擬測試平臺上開發MPC解決方案，然後再在真實建築中進行測試。我們的重點是通過研究可遷移的MPC架構來降低MPC的開發與部署成本。開發的MPC解決方案將在兩座高層公寓中部署和測試。最後一個任務是量化香港住宅存量的負荷轉移潛力。將開發一個等效的電池模型，使用兩個參數來量化建築物的負荷轉移潛力：儲能容量和充放電效率。然後我們將研究負荷轉移潛力如何受建築熱性能、舒適溫度範圍、分時電價等因素的影響。 本項目的交付成果包括：（a）一個標准化的虛擬測試平臺；（b）開發和現場演示“即插即用”的MPC解決方案；（c）一個等效的電池模型，用於量化建築物的負荷轉移潛力。 本研究提高了我們對濕度控制、MPC解決方案的可遷移性、在住宅建築中實施MPC時如何處理未測量的擾動和模型不確定性的認識。研究結果將促進MPC在住宅建築中的應用，促進更有效的建築與電網互動，並幫助電網吸收更多的可再生能源發電。

26210223.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26210223.value: 在线资源分配的新算法

26210223.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26210223.value: We consider a general online resource allocation problem with multiple resources, each with an individual initial capacity. At each period of a finite horizon T, one request arrives with a random size, which denotes how many resources will be consumed by serving this query, and a random reward. The online decision is made after the size and the reward is realized, without knowing the realization of the future queries. We assume that the size/reward of each query is drawn independently from a joint distribution. Such a problem is a central problem in operations research/management and has a wide range of applications in revenue management, supply chain management, and so on. For example, the well-known quantity-based network revenue management is a special case of this model. The focus of previous research is on deriving online policies with a nearly tight sublinear regret with respect to the prophet, an offline optimum that always makes the optimal decision in hindsight. It has been shown in the previous work when the reward distribution is continuous, one can achieve a log(T) regret bound. However, one challenge is that all the approaches proposed in previous work would rely on a so-called non-degeneracy assumption, which will require the ex-ante relaxation of the prophet to fall into a certain "position". Such an assumption is not only hard to verify and restricts the applicability of the previous policies, but also reveals a fundamental limitation of the theoretical analysis developed in the previous literature. The proposed research aims to get rid of the non-degeneracy assumption and develop a unified and new approach to analyzing the problem when the query distribution can be either continuous or discrete. We will analyze the problem from the basics and derive a generic framework for this fundamental problem. By exploiting our framework under various settings, we propose to show how our analysis can get over the limitations of the previous approaches and how the non-degeneracy assumption can be removed. Our new approach is expected to lead to new policies, which not only enjoy strong theoretical guarantees but are also easy to implement and can be deployed to solve many real-life problems. We also pursue multiple ways to generalize our framework, including combinations with online-learning and extensions to the price-based or choice-based models. We believe the potential outcome of this research will have a great impact on the stochastic analysis community and motivate more research following our framework. 我们考虑一个通用的在线资源分配问题，其中有多个资源，每个资源都有个体初始容量。有一个有限时间段的时间跨度。在每个时间段，会出现一个请求，并与一个随机大小关联，这个大小表示为为满足此查询将消耗多少资源，以及一个随机奖励。接受或拒绝的在线决策是在大小和奖励实现之后进行的，而不知道未来查询的实现。我们假设每个查询的大小/奖励是从一个联合分布中独立同分布地抽取的。这样的问题是运营研究/管理中的一个核心问题，在收入管理、供应链管理等方面具有广泛的应用。以前的研究重点是针对这个问题导出近似最优的在线策略，并证明与先知（一种离线的最佳决策，它事先知道所有查询的实现，并总是做出最优的决策）相比，几乎紧致的次线性遗憾。已经证明，当分布是连续的时候，可以实现一个与时间段数目对数成比例的遗憾界限。然而，一个挑战是以前工作中提出的所有方法都依赖于所谓的非退化假设，这将要求与先知相对应的线性规划落入某种"位置"。这种假设不仅难以验证，并限制了先前策略的适用性，而且揭示了以前文献中发展的理论分析的根本限制。所提出的研究旨在摆脱非退化假设，并开发一种新的分析方法来解决这个问题。我们将从基础开始分析这个问题，并为这个基本问题推导出一个通用框架。通过在各种设置下利用我们的框架，我们展示了我们的分析如何克服以前方法的限制，以及如何消除非退化假设。我们的新方法将导致新的策略，这些策略不仅具有强大的理论保证，而且易于实施，因此可以应用于解决许多实际问题。我们相信这项研究的潜在成果将对随机分析社区产生重大影响，并激发更多遵循我们框架的研究。

26211523.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26211523.value: 工程實踐中輸運現象的多尺度建模：求解氣體動理論方程的高階漸近保持和快速收斂方法

26211523.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26211523.value: Multiscale gas transport processes are found in many emerging technologies, e.g., freeze-drying (dehydration method used in food/biotech/pharmaceutical industries to preserve sensitive products), Fast-responding pressure-sensitive paint (experimental approach in aerodynamics to measure full-field air pressure), supercritical-CO2 enhanced shale gas recovery and carbon geo-sequestration, and atomically thin membranes to separate mixtures without using heat. New technological advancements rely on a better understanding of transport physics. Nevertheless, we still lack the computational capability to reliably reconstruct the transport phenomena in engineering circumstances, where the Knudsen number (the ratio of particle mean free path/mean free time to a relevant process length/time scale) spans over several orders of magnitude, and the classical Navier-Stokes-Fourier theory fails. The Boltzmann transport equation (BTE), modelling a thermodynamic system at the level of the particle distribution function, is an apt description. However, its high dimensionality and the coexisting of different scales impose tremendous challenges in solving the equation. Built upon my recent research, I will develop a scheme, namely the general synthetic iterative scheme, for predicting multiscale gas-mixture behaviours in three-dimensional (3D) engineering structures. Advanced scientific principles and numerical methods will be adopted to simultaneously achieve asymptotic preserving (obtain solutions without resolving small scales), fast convergence, and high-order approximation. This has yet to be done in previous studies. The scheme will be applied to simulate practical problems and gain new knowledge of transport mechanisms. Research emphases are: (a) deriving the synthetic macro-equations, which will be jointly solved with the BTE and are the key for asymptotic preserving and fast convergence; (b) enabling high-order approximation and accurate geometry description; (c) developing solution strategies to maintain consistent efficiency for nonlinear problems, and (d) actualising large-scale parallelisation and memory reduction. The classical/hybridisable discontinuous Galerkin (DG/HDG) and NURBS-enhanced finite element methods (NEFEM) will be used for spatial discretisation. A multigrid strategy will be developed to accelerate the inner iteration in solving the synthetic equations. Hybrid MPI-thread parallelisation and memory reduction techniques will be employed to reduce the computational cost of complex 3D simulations. It will be among the first attempts to formulate multigrid algorithms for HDG for a nonlinear convection-diffusion system and apply NEFEM in a kinetic solver. The research offers a novel vision for multiscale simulation: seeking multilevel modelling in different folds, specifically in this project, expediting resolution through the hierarchy of physical equations and multi-grids in numerical approximation. This will allow researchers and engineers to exploit new simulation capabilities to develop next-generation technologies. 多尺度氣體輸運過程存在於許多新興技術中，例如冷凍乾燥（食品/生物技術/製藥行業中用於保存敏感產品的脫水方法）、快速響應壓敏塗料（空氣動力學中用於測量全場壓強的實驗方法）、超臨界二氧化碳增強頁岩氣開采和二氧化碳地質封存，以及在分離混合物的原子薄膜。新技術的進步依賴於對輸運物理的深入了解。然而，我們仍然缺乏可靠地重建工程實踐中的輸運過程的計算能力。這類流動的努森數（粒子平均自由程/平均自由時間與相關過程特徵長度/時間的比）可跨越多個數量級， 經典的納維-斯托克斯-傅立葉方程失效。玻爾茲曼方程在粒子分佈函數層面對氣體流動進行建模，是一個恰當的描述。然而，其高維性和不同尺度的共存給方程的求解帶來了巨大的挑戰。 在這個項目中，我們將發展一個數值模擬方案，即通用合成迭代方法，用於預測三維工程結構中的氣體混合物的多尺度流動行為。我們將採用先進的科學原理和數值方法，同時實現漸近保持、快速收斂和高階近似。這在之前的研究中尚未完成。該方案將用於模擬實際工程問題並獲得輸運機制的新知識。研究重點包括：推導宏觀方程，該方程將與玻爾茲曼方程聯合求解，是漸近保持和快速收斂的關鍵； 實現高階近似和精確的幾何描述； 發展最優的方程求解策略以保證非線性問題的求解效率；以及 實現大規模並行化和減少內存消耗。 該研究為多尺度模擬提供了一個新思路：尋求不同層面的多級建模。在這個項目中，我們將通過不同尺度的物理方程和數值模擬中的多級網格來提高求解效率。這將使研究人員和工程師能夠利用更強大的模擬能力來研發新技術。

26304723.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26304723.value: 海洋浮游植物的鋅營養限制

26304723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26304723.value: 浮游植物是海洋食物鏈和生態系統的基礎。海洋浮游植物的生長和分佈受到環境中各种微量金屬元素等一系列營業元素的控制。鋅 (Zn)是一種對浮游植物非常重要的微量金屬元素，它作為很多蛋白酶的中心，參與碳固定、磷吸收、礦化與再礦化等一系列重要的生物過程。因此，海洋中鋅的生物可利用性可以調控浮游植物的生長與生物功能，並進一步決定海洋的生物碳輸出效率。本課題組在之前的研究中發現在現代海洋環境中硅藻和甲藻的生長很可能受到鋅的限制，而生物地球化學模型的結果也顯示隨著環境氣候變化，海洋環境中浮游植物的鋅限制會逐漸加劇。但是鋅元素究竟如果影響浮游植物的生長、分佈、功能、生物群落結構以及碳泵效率仍未明確。具有不同生態功能的浮游植物對鋅的需求量也未建立。環境因素，如溫度、光照如何影響浮游植物的鋅需求以及相應的分子機理也未明確。因此，本研究將從根本上探討不同生態功能組的浮游植物對鋅的需求。我們將在不同溫度光照條件下進行一系列浮游植物培養實驗，從而建立溫度和光照等環境因素對細胞鋅需求的影響，並進一步明確其分子機理。本研究獲取的實驗結果將會聯合海洋微量元素以及基因大數據用於對預測現代海洋以及氣候變化下海洋浮游植物的分佈、生態功能和碳固定效率受鋅限制的具體影響。

26307123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26307123.value: 通過光活化電子給體受體配合物策略獲得硼自由基和硼基化方法

26307123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26307123.value: In the past few years, boron radical-induced borylation has emerged as a transition-metal-free access to various organoboron compounds, which have been widely applied in numerous areas ranging from synthetic chemistry to the pharmaceutical industry. A multifaceted toolbox for the formation of boryl radicals is thus in an urgent need. In view of the approaches for producing open-shell radical species, photoexcitation of the electron-donor-acceptor (EDA) complex is of great interest because it is straightforward, convenient, and powerful without the need for external radical initiators or photosensitizers. Despite considerable achievements, using EDA-based strategy to access boron-centered radicals remains challenging due to the lack of EDA adducts that are appropriate for use as boron-radical precursors. Our preliminary discovery of using Lewis base-borane as a donor and boryl radical precursor gives a hint to the above research problems. For the first time, a borane donor and a pyridinium acceptor are engaged in the formation of EDA aggregates via non-conventional B–Hδ-∙∙∙Hδ+–C dihydrogen bonding, which facilitates photoinduced single-electron transfer (SET) to yield boron-centered radicals. On this basis, in this proposed project, we plan to investigate photoinduced borylation driven by non-conventional hydrogen-bond-bridged EDA complexes featuring boron hydride donors. To improve the scope and versatility, catalysts with well-tailored donating/accepting abilities will be introduced to realize the catalytic EDA-based transformations. Identifying EDA interactions is also an important part of this project. The discovery of a series of new EDA interactions and EDA-based catalytic systems is anticipated to result in a wide variety of organoboron derivatives that might find valuable applications in many areas. The improved understanding of the interaction between donors and acceptors that will result from this project will guide the design of EDA-based strategies with increased efficiency and broadened applications. 在過去幾年，硼自由基誘導的硼化反應已成為製備多種有機硼分子的重要方法。這些含硼分子已被廣泛應用於合成化學到醫藥工業等許多領域。因此，開發新型生成硼自由基的方法意義深遠。電子給體-受體配合物光激發策略是一個簡單、方便、強大，而且不需要外部自由基引髮劑或光敏劑的方法。但是，由於缺乏合適的硼自由基前體，利用該策略獲得硼自由基仍然極具挑戰性。 我們初步研究發現使用Lewis鹼-硼烷作為電子給體和硼自由基前體可以為上述問題提供解決方案。硼烷給體和吡啶鹽受體通過非常規的硼氫∙∙∙碳氫雙氫鍵形成電子給體-受體配合物。進一步通過光致單電子轉移產生硼自由基。在此基礎上，我們計劃研究由非常規氫鍵橋接的電子給體-受體配合物驅動的光致硼化反應。此外，我們將精心設計並引入電子給體/受體催化劑來實現催化硼化反應。研究電子給體/受體間相互作用也是該項目的重要目標。 可以預期，一系列新的電子給體/受體相互作用和相應的催化體係將被發現，用以製備多種有機硼衍生物。這些衍生物在諸多領域有重要的應用前景。由此項目得出的對給體和受體之間相互作用的理解將指導設計具有更高效率和廣泛應用的電子給體/受體光活化策略。

26308323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26308323.value: 复杂数据下关于亚组的可重复统计推断

26308323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26308323.value: Subgroup analysis aims to uncover and confirm treatment effect heterogeneity and is frequently used in drug development and regulatory decision-making. How to make replicable statistical inference on subgroups plays an important role in subgroup analysis. To generate trustworthy statistical evidence for subgroups, several methods have been proposed which typically assume candidate subgroups are predefined and the data are public. Over the past decade, numerous complex data, such as large-scale observational data, emerge and prevail, which poses both opportunities and challenges to subgroup analysis. Directly applying existing methods to complex data might not lead to replicable inference due to several issues in complex data. In this proposal, we focus on two specific complex data problems in subgroup analysis, identification bias in post-hoc identified subgroups and noise issue in private data, and aim to propose new statistical approaches to make replicable inference on subgroups in the presence of (1) post-hoc identified subgroups and (2) private data. We will consider different practical scenarios starting from the simple ones, such as clinical trials and nonoverlapped subgroups, to more challenging ones, such as observational studies and overlapped subgroups. The development of the proposed methods is motivated by the idea of adding noise and relies on intensive study of statistical properties of noise and resampling methods. The methods proposed in this proposal are expected to have broad applications in drug development and public health and beyond. The ultimate goal of the proposal is to support more timely delivery of effective drugs to patients in need with the development of novel statistical approaches which can better and appropriately utilize complex data in inferring subgroups. 亚组分析致力于发现并确认治疗效应的异质性，它在药品研发与监管决策中有着广泛的应用。如何对亚组做出可重复的统计推断是亚组分析中重要的一环，研究者为此提出了许多统计方法，但这些方法往往基于亚组是提前给定的并且数据是公开已知的。过去数十年复杂数据的出现，例如大规模观测数据，给亚组分析带来了前所未有的机遇与挑战。由于复杂数据新的统计特质，直接在复杂数据上应用传统统计方法得到的统计推断结论可能是不可重复的。在本课题中，我们关注亚组分析中以下两类具体的复杂数据问题，数据驱动识别亚组中的识别偏差和隐私数据中的噪声问题，并致力于提出新的统计方法在（1）亚组是数据驱动识别时和（2）数据是隐私保护时对亚组做出可重复的统计推断。我们将考虑不同的实际情况，从简单的临床试验，无重叠亚组到更复杂的观测试验，有重叠亚组。本课题研究的主要方法是噪声添加，关键点在于对噪声及相关重抽样方法统计性质的研究。我们期待本课题能够在药品研发，公共卫生等领域有广泛的应用。本课题的最终目标是通过开发新的统计工具，帮助我们在亚组统计推断中更好更恰当地使用复杂数据，进而加快有效药品到急需病人手中的进程。

26500923.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26500923.value: 地方治理與環境監管：來自中國城市化的證據

26500923.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26500923.value: Urbanization often brings economic benefits at the expense of environmental quality, and policymakers are constantly striving to achieve a delicate balance in between. Environmental economics literature has routinely tried to quantitatively identify said balance by conducting cost-benefit analysis on existing policy interventions in an effort to provide theoretical guidance for future environmental regulations. In practice, the effectiveness of these policy instruments often depends on enforcement, where local governments and officials play a vital role. However, due to low transparency in the local decision-making process, studies considering the role of local governance often fall short in quantitatively estimating the environmental impacts or, at best, can only offer suggestive evidence from pollution or emission outcomes. In this project, we offer to our knowledge the most detailed examination of how local governments strategically respond to environmental regulations, as directly estimated through their decision-making in the local land supply. This analysis leverages the spatial granularity of several rich and unique spatial datasets, including the universe of land transactions in China and locations of air pollution monitors, as well as detailed information on population density, city demographics, and city leaders' characteristics. We first propose a difference-in-differences framework, where we examine whether the land provision strategies of local governments differ before and after the installation of an air pollution monitoring network in the city, comparing land parcels close to monitors relative to land where the air quality is loosely monitored. We then augment the regression analysis with a dynamic structural model that characterizes the optimization problem of local government regarding their land provision decisions under environmental regulations. This study would provide insights to the principal-agent problem between central and local governments and the characteristics under which the implementation of environmental regulations is most effective. 城市化往往帶來經濟效益，但亦以環境品質為代價，而政策制定者則不斷努力在兩者之間取得微妙的平衡。環境經濟學家一直嘗試用定量工具研究這種平衡，並透過對現有政策進行成本效益分析，為未來的環境監管政策提供理論指引。然而，在實際應用中，這些政策工具的效力常取決於執行，而地方政府和官員在其中扮演關鍵角色。由於地方決策過程往往缺乏透明度，過去有關地方治理和環境影響的研究大多在定量評估方面存在不足，或最多只能從污染或排放結果提供暗示性證據。在本研究中，我們將探討地方政府如何在環境監管政策下，通過地方土地供應決策，策略性地平衡經濟發展與環境品質。我們的分析充分運用多個豐富且獨特的空間數據集，包括中國土地交易的完整數據庫、空氣污染監測站的位置，以及有關人口密度、城市人口統計、城市領導者特徵等詳細信息。我們首先將運用雙重差分方法，量化比較城市進行空氣污染監測前後，接近監測站的區塊與空氣質量監測較寬鬆的區塊之間的土地供應策略差異。隨後，我們將回歸分析與動態結構模型結合，以更好地描述地方政府在環境監管下的土地供應最優決策問題。這項研究有望深入洞察中央政府與地方政府之間的委託代理問題，以及實施環境監管的最適條件。

26501323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26501323.value: 多科室自適應行為下的病患流程管理

26502723.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26502723.value: A decentralized autonomous organization (DAO) is an entity with no central control and ownership. It is governed by members of a community (“users”) with enforcement of rules by smart contracts of a blockchain. The design of a DAO is proposed and determined by users through voting, in which one unit of a governance token (“token”) is used as a vote. This bottom-up design process of a DAO is in stark contrast to traditional centralized governance, such as shareholder voting in corporate governance. Starting from finance applications, such as Uniswap and Sushiswap, there are many centralized platforms aiming for full decentralization through the DAO model. We develop a theoretical model of two competing platforms for asset trading with strategic complementarity. A platform is initially designed by a centralized developer, but subsequently, she decides whether to decentralize the platform or keep it as a centralized platform (CP). Decentralization involves the distribution of a governance token, and users with the token can propose and implement a new design. With this model, we address several important questions; Does the decentralized governance model endogenously arise as an equilibrium outcome? What is the implication of DAOs for platform competition? Will the DAO model become a dominant structure of platform governance or can DAOs and traditional CPs coexist? Our preliminary results suggest that three types of situations can endogenously arise: (i) both platforms become DAOs, (ii) a DAO coexists with a CP, and (iii) both platforms operate as CPs. Moreover, they are characterized by the degree of strategic complementarity (i.e., positive interdependence between platforms). We show that being a DAO tends to be a dominant strategy for developers when the degree of strategic complementarity is high, while an intermediate degree of complementarity leads to the coexistence of a DAO and a CP. Our result indicates that a DAO introduces an additional layer of platform competition by users. If the economy has only traditional CPs, competition takes place between two centralized developers. In contrast, if one of the platforms becomes a DAO, users engage in the competition by proposing a new platform design on top of the developer competition. This additional layer amplifies strategic complementarity and increases the equilibrium platform profit, encouraging the other platform to be a DAO as well. When the degree of complementarity is high, the above positive effect dominates the cost of decentralization, leading to the DAO equilibrium. 分散型自治組織（DAO）是一种无需中央权威或所有权即可运作的实体。它由其社区成员管理，并以无信任、非保管的方式运作，其规则由区块链智能合约执行。我们分析了DAO之间的平台竞争，并研究了跨市场价格效应（外部性）对DAO发展的影响。通过将平台设计委托给多归属用户，DAO可以内部化平台之间的外部性，从而创造额外价值。原始平台开发者通过治理代币发行提取这个价值，但必须放弃对平台的控制，导致潜在的费用收入损失。我们发现，当跨市场外部性较强时，集中式平台开发者往往会采用DAO模型，但在外部性中等水平下，DAO和集中式平台都可以共存。

26502823.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26502823.value: 本提案探討人們如何運用行話辨識高專業地位。將探究行話的使用和評估在講者性別和母語為英語的背景下的差異。研究發現將對性別、語言學和印象管理領域的研究具有重要理論意義。 我將行話定義為特定專業或專門群體使用的社會學習的詞語、表達方式、隱喻或技術術語。它們用來替代更易理解且不太正式的選擇（定義來自Brown等人，2020年）。“行話”這個標籤也被用於貶低觀眾認為過於技術性的詞語。這兩個相互關聯的定義表明行話可以用來幫助講者實現溝通和社會目標。 我主張行話具有多種用途：一種是用於溝通，另一種是通過暗示講者是專家來展示其專業地位。地位是一個根本的人類動機。獲得專業知識是在專業領域獲得更高地位的一種途徑。我主張語言和行話是展示專業知識和地位的一種方式。因此，對於專家和非專家來說，了解如何進行專業知識的信號和識別是重要的。 目前的文獻未解釋行話如何用於表示地位。我的先前研究表明，行話是一種地位信號。當講者感到其地位受到威脅時，可以使用行話（Brown等人，2020年）。本提案基於這些發現，探討兩個具體問題。 首先，誰使用行話？因為男性比女性更關注地位，我提出男性使用的行話比女性更多。我還假設非母語講者將使用更多行話來進行溝通和信號表示地位。其次，觀眾如何對高度使用行話做出反應？現有文獻認為地位較低的行為者會受到懲罰。然而，我借鑒語言學理論和初步發現，假設觀眾對男性使用大量行話的懲罰較多，但對非母語講者的懲罰較少，因為他們推斷男性使用行話來表示地位，而非母語講者則是在努力進行溝通。這些發現將證明行話既是一種溝通工具，也是一種地位信號。 為了測試這些假設，我提議使用存檔數據集和實驗。兩個大型數據集可以調查誰使用更多行話以及在什麼情況下使用行話，並進行11個實驗來探討觀眾對行話使用的反應。

26503123.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26503123.value: 算法与性别：算法的男性化如何影响消费者决策

26503123.label: Project Objectives
26503123.value: To test whether people associate algorithms with a certain gender and if so, which gender is ascribed to algorithms. This research extends both research on algorithm adoption and gender perception by demonstrating that people associate masculinity with algorithms. This is because algorithms are characterized by predominantly masculine traits such as analytical processing and precision (Auster and Ohm 2000; Bem 1974; Spence and Helmreich 1978) and because more males work in industries relevant for developing and advancing algorithms (e.g., STEM industry; Martinez and Christnacht 2021) and thus are more frequently paired with algorithms. To further demonstrate that the association of algorithms with masculinity affects a wide range of downstream consequences including risk-taking behavior, green consumption, attribute weighting, and logo preference when interacting with algorithms. To design interventions to weaken the association between algorithms and masculinity. To identify a boundary condition for the effect: people associate femininity with algorithms that orally communicate with users (i.e., conversational AI agents).

26503123.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26503123.value: Algorithms are a growing presence in our daily lives, but little is known about whether consumers ascribe gender to algorithms, and if so, which gender is ascribed to them. This question is important not only because it extends our understanding of how people construe algorithms, but also because gender perspectives can affect attitude, social judgment, effectiveness of marketing communication, and purchase likelihood (Yan 2016; Brough et al. 2016; Zhang et al. 2022). In this research, we propose and demonstrate that people associate masculinity with algorithms and that this association affects a wide range of downstream consequences including risk-taking behavior, green consumption, attribute weighting, and logo preference when interacting with algorithms. We claim that consumers tend to associate masculinity with algorithms because algorithms are characterized by predominantly masculine traits such as analytical processing and precision (Auster and Ohm 2000; Bem 1974; Spence and Helmreich 1978) and because more males work in industries relevant for developing and advancing algorithms (e.g., STEM industry; Martinez and Christnacht 2021) and thus are more frequently paired with algorithms. We also identify a boundary condition for this association, where consumers are less likely to ascribe masculinity to conversational algorithms that orally interact with the users. This research makes several theoretical contributions. First, we contribute to the research on how consumers perceive and interact with algorithms (Bucher 2017; Logg et al. 2019) by showing that people tend to associate masculinity with algorithms and by demonstrating the nomological validity of this finding with consumers’ preference for algorithms for utilitarian and objective decisions (Castelo et al. 2019; Longoni and Cian 2020). Second, our findings extend the prior work on gender association (Yan 2016; Zhang et al. 2022). Third, we identify a novel mechanism that may contribute to consumers’ tendency to avoid recommendations made by algorithms (see Burton, Stein, and Jensen 2020 for a review). Practically, this research has direct implications for algorithm design and marketing communication involving algorithms. Our findings suggest that a recommendation from an algorithm can be more effective when it highlights characteristics of a product that people associate more often with masculinity. The gender perception documented in this research also has implications for policy makers and developers: to the extent that consumers are less likely to follow an algorithm’s 近年来，算法在我们的日常生活中日益受到重视，但我们尚未知道消费者是否赋予算法性别，以及如果是的话赋予哪种性别。在这项研究中，我们提出并证明人们普遍将算法与男性相联系，而这种联系会带来一系列的后续影响：如消费者与算法互动时是否更愿意冒险、是否更偏好绿色消费、如何分配不同属性权重以及更喜欢何种品牌标识等。我们认为消费者将算法与男性联系的原因主要源自两方面因素：首先，算法的主要特性往往偏向于男性特质，如分析处理和追求精确性等 (Auster and Ohm 2000; Bem 1974; Spence and Helmreich 1978)；其次，与女性相比，有更多的男性工作者从事与算法相关行业开发并推进算法相关技术 (例如 STEM 行业; Martinez and Christnacht 2021)。 从理论角度看，这项研究扩展了先前有关消费者对算法看法的研究(Bucher 2017; Logg et al.2019)，并且延申了性别问题(Yan 2016; Zhang et al. 2022)以及算法厌恶（参见Burton, Stein, and Jensen 2020）相关工作。从实践角度来看，我们的研究结果表明，通过强调算法的男性特质，我们能够使消费者更容易接受算法所推荐的产品，然而，同时也暗示了这种联系可能会引入不可预见的偏见。

26504423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26504423.value: In this project, we study a principal-agent problem in which a principal (she) wants to extract true information from an agent (he). The principal can ask the agent questions sequentially. However, the agent may not tell truth. In many situations, the agent lies for a higher payoff (e.g., a self-employed worker may pretend to be unemployed in order to receive government relief). We depart from the standard rationality assumption in the literature by assuming the agent to be bounded rational. We consider that the agent suffers from two well-documented types of bounded rationality, namely, anchoring to telling the truth and limited ability in contingent reasoning, which significantly increase the difficulty for the agent to lie consistently, especially in the dynamic setting. As the agent prefers truth-telling, he may be truthful when he does not feel the necessity to lie for a specific question. However, due to his limited capability in contingent reasoning, the agent may fail to perceive the connection between the current question and possible future questions and thus fail to reconcile his answers to sequential questions. As a result, the agent may be truthful at the beginning, and when he is asked a question for which he needs to lie, he may realize that he has already revealed too much information, which makes it impossible for him to make up any lie. Motivated by the above observation, the project investigates how to design a mechanism by jointly exploiting the two bounded rationality assumptions on the agent. A mechanism consists of a guideline and a dynamic questionnaire. The guideline specifies each possible outcome the agent can receive depending on his answers to the questionnaire. The key insight is that a guideline can be informative but complex so that an agent who suffers from the two cognitive limitations fails to lie consistently following the guideline. We explore the structure of such complex guidelines and how to adopt such guidelines in real-life applications. 在这个项目中，我们研究了一个委托代理问题。委托方希望从代理方那里获取私人信息，但是代理方的偏好与委托方的偏好不一致，因此存在说谎的动机。我们特别关注代理方的两种认知限制：对实话的定锚和有限的条件推理能力。对于这样的代理方，我们发现委托方可以设计一个机制，包括一个复杂的指南和一个动态问卷，以从代理方那里获取真实信息。这个机制的关键在于，通过一个复杂的指南，缺乏条件思考的代理方最初在回答前几个问题时不会找到说谎的理由。而当代理方意识到说谎的必要性时，他已经透露了所有的私人信息，并且无法找到一个与之前回答一致的谎言。 受到上述观察的启发，本项目研究如何通过利用上述的两个有限理性假设来设计机制。机制包括指南和动态问卷。指南限定了代理对问卷的每一种回答对应的结果。机制的关键点在于指南可以包含所有信息但异常复杂，以至于遭受两种认知限制的代理方无法通过说谎来一致地遵循指南。我们将研究这种复杂指南的结构以及如何在实际应用中采用这些指南。

26505423.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26505423.value: 通过银行贷款进行社会活动：大规模枪击事件的证据

26505423.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26505423.value: 我们研究对存款流动的担忧是否会影响银行向对环境和社会负责的企业提供贷款的决定。 我们提出一个模型，让存款人对贷款的环境和社会责任做出反应。 在这个模型中，对储户敏感性的外生冲击将导致存款从向不负责任的企业放贷的银行流出。 这种资金外流可能会导致这些贷款机构的流动性紧张，迫使他们提供更高的存款利率或减少贷款。 我们建议在大规模枪击事件的背景下测试这一框架，这对储户的担忧起到了外源性冲击。

26506323.label: Project Title(Chinese)
26506323.value: （不）願意辯論：擴展邊際中的說服過程

26506323.label: Abstract as per original application (English/Chinese)
26506323.value: 即使現今信息廣泛流通，大家對事實問題的分歧仍然存在。為什麼人們的觀點未能一致？一種解釋是人們希望保護自己珍視的信念，並試圖逃避與自己信念矛盾的信息(Golman, Hagmann, and Loewenstein 2017; Ho, Hagmann, and Loewenstein 2021)。心理學（參見 Crano and Prislin 2006的綜述）和經濟學（例如，Hagmann and Loewenstein 2019）研究了說服者如何克服這些障礙，例如，依靠個人敘述回應對方或表達對自己立場的不確定性。這些實驗的共同點是，它們集中於資訊接收者以及他們轉化信念的程度。然而在現實世界中，說服過程的誕生依賴於一個願意決定開展對話的參與者。在這個提案中，我們試圖在擴展邊際中審視說服過程：是什麼驅使人們與那些持相反觀點的人(不)互動？ 我們假設當對方持有（他們認為是）錯誤的信念（Molnar and Loewenstein 2020）時，人們會經歷負效用。人們會因為他們預計分歧是不愉快的而認為與對方互動有高代價。人們是否試圖說服對方則取決於對方會被說服的預期可能性以及談話的預期不愉快程度。我們假設個人（1）低估對方被說服的可能性，（2）高估談話的不愉快程度。因此，他們非常不願意參與辯論。與潛在的正確估測相比，互動性相對減低，溝通與說服也會發生的更少。在兩個初步實驗結果的基礎上，我們測試了相關機制並設計了提高人們對參與說服性對話意願的干預措施。為進一步促進資訊交流，我們假設擴展邊際中的說服者持有較不極端的信念，並且相比受干預的說服者會對自己說服對方的能力較不自信。促進這些擴展邊際中的說服者參與對話可能會減少衝突和兩極分化。 人們對持相反意見的人抱有越來越負面的看法，並高估了反對方觀點的極端性(Dimock et al. 2014; Yudkin, Hawkins, and Dixon 2019)。這可能並不奇怪，因為往往只有極端反對者才會大聲表達自己的看法。我們的研究旨在將較為中立的觀點帶到公眾面前，減少持相反意見的群體固有的分歧，並提高信念的準確性。
